comments: Very nice. Would highly reccomend. Clean and comfortable place.
Great place to  relax  and  explore Edinburgh from
My stay was really good and Alfredo was very helpful and responsive, he even gave recommendations on activities that I could do while in Scotland. The house felt like home away from home.

Great little place.
Good location , good cleanliness, good space, ideal place with free parking close to a lot of Edinburghs main attractions.
No issues.
Great communication.
Thanks.
appartement très  cocooning, parfait après de longues journées de marche.

Great location, quieter than the old town but within walking distance of the centre. Amenities were a little basic, but were fine for us as we weren’t spending much time in the flat. Given the location and time of year (festival) it was a great place to stay
We had a wonderful stay at Ilona's for the Fringe. The place is in a great location and is actually better than the pics as a little bigger than we expected. We had a lovely stay.
Very nice and cozy room! Great location, easily  reachable by bus!

The flat was well-equipped and very cosy with plenty of space to accommodate our party of 5. Access was straightforward and the benefits of secure and dedicated parking could not be over-estimated as we saw a couple of cars parked illegally being towed away first thing in the morning of day 1.
Having access to a pool and sauna was a real plus and something not to be overlooked - both were absolutely spotless and the booking system could not have been easier. Albeit somewhat chill at the beginning of December, the views from the roof terrace are well worth wrapping up for, especially if you’re a keen photographer like me.
Edinburgh’s Uber taxi service worked really well if you don’t fancy walking - however it’s a straightforward enough 15 minute walk to Princes Street if you fancy the exercise. The local area where the flat is based pleasantly surprised us a bit with the sheer number and variety of bars and restaurants.
All in all a very enjoyable experience.

A lovely apartment, very close to the train station in a quiet but central location. Clean and very well equipped. A warm welcome from the host who provided plenty of information about things to see and some lovely personal touches. I highly recommend this apartment as a  great place to stay in central Edinburgh.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! The hosts were incredibly friendly and quick to respond to all our questions, offering helpful suggestions throughout our visit. The accommodation itself was very cozy, exceptionally clean, and located in a quiet area with a lovely view. It was equipped with everything we could possibly need, making our stay comfortable and stress-free. We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would love to return in the future. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay and plenty of room to spread out. If ever traveling back to Scotland will make note of this great place to stay!

It was such a pleasure to stay at Roisin's home and to be hosted by her! She is a lovely, warm, hospitable host and human, and the location of her home in Edinburgh is outstanding. Her home is lovely, and I was able to walk everywhere, but if I had wanted to take the bus, there is a bus station right across the street from her home. I'm mostly plant-based, and she went out of her way to provide vegan milk and other food options for breakfast, which I deeply appreciated. There are vegan restaurants hear her home - and so much more. The bed is so comfortable, and I slept incredibly well, too. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and can't recommend Roisin (and Edinburgh) enough!!
We would be back there in a flash!  Super comfortable stay!!!

Great apartment just down the hill from all the main attractions that Edinburgh has to offer. The apartment is well presented with spacious living room and kitchen, two good sized modern bathrooms, a laundry and two bedrooms.
We enjoyed our stay here.

We had a wonderful stay in Edinburgh at Isaac and Derek’s place, they met us at the flat showed us around made us feel very welcome.
They were very responsive over messages and sent us the most incredible list of local recommendations many of which we tried.
The place was spotless, the linens were crisp and fresh smelling, the flat itself was beautifully furnished and tastefully decorated.
All in all, a lovely stay and would definitely go back again!
Thank you Derek and Isaac!

Wer es blitzsauber und aufgeräumt liebt und viel Platz braucht, sollte seine Erwartungen an diese Unterkunft nicht zu hoch setzen. Wer hier Toleranz walten lässt und mit etwas weniger zurecht kommt, wird aber durch die unglaublich zugewandte, liebevolle und integrative Art von Courtney sofort überzeugt sein. Sie ist eine tolle Gastgeberin, man fühlt sich aufgehoben und gut versorgt - nicht zuletzt durch die hauseigenen Hühner, leckeren Porridge und auch mal ein gemütliches Glas Wein. So jedenfalls ging es uns.
Wir haben uns superwohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder - Edinburgh bleibt für uns mit diesem Fleckchen Erde im Ortsteil Trinity verbunden.

Great stay for our work colleagues, we've booked this place for a few weeks now. Really handy having parking available also. It could do with a little bit of TLC but our work colleagues are happy at this property.

We had a fab stay in Edinburgh! The accommodation was perfect for our needs, as a base to explore. It was in easy reach of all transport links on Princes Street. The flat was as described, cosy and compact and the kitchen was very well equipped.  Eddie was a great host, responsive and considerate - we travelled with 2x young children and gave us a heads on the location in advance.
This is a great Airbnb to stay with a big group! Super close to Grassmarket and walkable to everywhere! Would highly recommend.
Great Place, Fantastic location. Host was  great, good communication. Will definitely stay here again.

There is no doubt that Lesleys flat is a lovely cosy flat in a stunning location, and we appreciated it's quirks and all it had to offer, including the hot drink station in our room, and use of fridge to store our breakfast items.
The flat is clearly loved and beautifully and thoughtfully decorated, however some aspects are a bit tired and needed attention, for these reasons it felt a little pricy for our experience when we visited.
From reviews, Lesley and family usually live in the flat whilst hosting, however during our stay, we did not meet Lesley as they were away.
Therefore not able to address some areas that needed unexpected attention, however these issues were resolved with quick kind communication and unlikely to occur in the future for other guests.

We had a great stay. Well located.
Fair bit of noise off the cars at night which made it harder to sleep but the beds were super comfy and the place was exactly what we needed after 2 days of travel.
I would def recommend this place
great place to stay with a good code system for rooms
We had an amazing stay, great location, friendly and helpful host.

The location was wonderful, only a couple of minutes from spectacular views of Holyrood Park, and about a half hour walk through a lovely park to reach the Old Town.  Christine was responsive to any needs.  There were restaurants and shops and grocery stores within only minutes of walking. Ubers were came quickly for transportation needs, and there were buss stops nearby.
Alojamiento agradable y muy cómodo. Un trato muy correcto y con indicaciones muy claras. A poca distancia en guagua del centro de la ciudad.

Sean's appartement was clean and had everything we needed.
great location as well!
totally recommend

The flat was very nice. Very quiet at night which is what we needed for being jet lagged. Lol. Very well located, just hop on the bus and it will take you to the city center. I would highly recommend this place. The hosts also had great communication

Absolutely loved our stay at Dunc and Dee's place. They were great hosts, communication before and during our stay was really good, check in instructions were clear and easy and they'd shared loads of recommendations for places to eat and drink in the local area. T
he apartment was spotless, perfect for us in a brilliant location. We really appreciated the bottle of fizz and the homemade shortbread. Thank you!
Would recommend staying here--close to the city center, but also quiet. Clean apartment with all amenities included.
Very peaceful place. Shower was nice and warm. Great choice of pillows. Would definitely stay again there
What an amazing room! We walked in and said ‘ WOW.’ Incredible location, so close to the city centre. We will definitely be staying again soon
Great location and fantastic hosts! Highly recommend!

We chose to visit Scotland for our 10 year wedding anniversary, and staying at Iliyana’s Outlander Experience flat was the perfect way to start our vacation! The flat is very close to plenty of great restaurants and shopping and just a short walk to the start of The Royal Mile. We enjoyed our stay and place to visit again!

We all enjoyed this beautiful West End flat: incredibly well located, one block from Airport transportation, a very walkable area and easy to reach Princes Street, the Castle and the Bridges on foot. The flat was light and bright, very fresh and clean, easy to live in. It worked very well for our family group, and was a welcoming spot to come home to.
Our visit was simple and uncomplicated. We'd LOVE to stay there again.
Good deal for Edinburgh accom & near transport links like the tram.
Nous avons passé un agréable moment à Edimbourg et dans cet appartement. Idéalement situé proche des transports et des monuments je le conseil vivement !!! Many thanks to Roni !!!

Catriona was a superb and extremely kind hostess. She was very helpful providing recommendations and links on what to do, where to go, giving clear instructions on transportation and how to get to her place from the airport (shared all options with me). She was very responsive at all times. She also allowed me to wash some of my clothes and even helped me in searching for alrernative routes to take back home as my flight got cancelled. I really enjoyed meeting her and staying at her place and felt very welcomed and right at home.
As for the accomodation itself, it is comfortable and cosy, close to public transportation, and in a beautiful walkable area with everything you need close by. The house was spotless and I felt very comfortable. Overall, a really great experience.
Excellent location on the Royal Mile. Armando was incredibly helpful and accommodating. Beautiful apartment, perfect for a city break.
Very comfortable flat, exceptionally clean accommodation. Calm location in the elegant New Town worth the pleasant 20min walk to the city centre. Carol was a friendly informative host.

Mohammed’s apartment was actually better than the pictures. Very clean and streamlined. He was gracious enough, too, to let me check in a little earlier to accommodate me. Having him meet me at the location and show me around was an extra bonus and nice touch.
The location was quiet and just about one mile from most of the bigger attractions. Very close to Holyrood.

Unfortunately the boiler was not working on a night when the temperature was in negatives. We contacted the host around 11:30 pm and did not get helpful response until next morning at which point it was too late to get an engineer out in time. Host was very apologetic about it but there was nothing we could do. I was expecting a concession or refund given we spent the whole booking without any heat or warm water. Apart from this the place was also very small and had a damp smell. The beddings were not up to quality and duvet was small in size compared to the bed.
Perfect place! Can’t wait to go back.
Lovely place and a great experience overall. Everything was well organised, clean and comfortable. The host was helpful and responsive. I would happily return in the future. 💕
Awesome

Séjour très agréable, Botond et Monia sont très accueillants et disponibles, et le logement était très propre ! L’emplacement est idéal grâce aux transports en communs, aussi bien pour le centre ville que pour l’aéroport. Merci beaucoup !

Super Unterkunft im Zentrum der Stadt. Viele der Sehenswürdigkeiten sind zu Fuß innerhalb von 10-15 Minuten erreichbar. Bahn-und Busstationen befinden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe und ermöglichen somit eine einfache Anreise und Abreise. Gastgeber sind sehr schnell erreichbar und freundlich!

Cathy was very flexible about check-in and -out, generous with advice and very hospitable.  We particularly appreciated the bowl of fresh fruit she left for us.  The unit was conveniently located, a walk to the tram from the airport and to the train station, and close enough to the heart of the Old Town for easy access, but in a somewhat less touristy neighborhood.

Estaba a 5 minutos de la parada del tranvía desde el aeropuerto. Muy cerca de la calle princesa.
El baño es muy grande y la habitación es suficientemente grande.
La única pega es que la cama no era muy cómoda y las almohadas eran demasiado planas.
Pero para estar unos pocos días está bien.
Great stay! Easy check-in and walking distance to everything.
Excellent localisation, the pods are comfortable, quiet enough, and access hours are flexible

Très bon séjour chez Brian en bord de mer ! Le logement est spacieux et très bien situé au calme !
Propre et très bien équipé, l'appartement de Brian est parfait.
Very spacious and good location!

This was the perfect way to start our trip. The place was beautiful. We enjoyed the wonderful wood fire place.
The property looks beautiful and there is a stunning view of the planes coming in.
Definitely recommend if you are looking for some Scottish charm

This was a great place to stay. Nice and quiet location with easy access either by foot or by bus to the city center area. The washing machine was a huge bonus. Check in and out was easy, Valentino was helpful and communicative. Super comfortable flat equipped with everything you’d need. Would gladly stay here again. Thanks!
Me and my friend stayed for 2 nights and loved how clean the house was. We enjoyed our time there
Ana was an amazing host and very helpful
Super mysigt boende och smidig in- och utcheckning! Luke var hjälpsam och tillgänglig för frågor och funderingar. Rekommenderar starkt!
Perfect location to explore Edinburgh from, the place is exactly as described and Ann replies super quickly, would definitely stay here again.

Look no further! This is where you want to stay! Irene is the most gracious host who goes the extra mile to make her guests feel welcomed. Her bubbly personality and eclectic home will be something you'll thoroughly enjoy.
Clear instructions on how to get in and around. No complaints.
非常满意的一段住宿体验！周围都是居民区所以十分安静，居住时不会被打扰。最令人惊喜的是厨房设施非常齐全，并且灶台是燃气灶，天知道燃气灶多适合做饭，简直不能喜欢更多。唯一的一点小缺点可能是楼层位于地下一层，可能不太适合腿脚不便的人，但对我们来说完全不是一个问题！而且房源性价比极高，走路两分钟就有一个tesco。
Nice and Cozy apartment, centrally located.
Well equipped and beautifully maintained apartment. Daniela is very approachable and very clear in her communication.

A fab, cleverly designed bolt hole to spend a couple of nights. Perfectly situated between the action in the city centre and peaceful Stockbridge.
The diffuser with essential oils, Borders biccies and the Bluetooth speaker were all a wonderful touch. Appreciated having both a normal blind and a blackout blind to make use of being in a basement flat.
Our restaurant reccies are Purslane, Noto and The Palmerston!
It is in the description, but make sure you’re okay with stairs to access the flat. Was manageable for us.
Location and facilities are superb. The privacy of having 2 seperate sleeping areas is a bonus when you have a mate that snores! Would definitely return.

Nice location. Took a walk to Calton Hill early one morning and walked to the Broughton for Sunday Roast reservations. If you have bad knees, be aware of stairs, although there is ground level bedroom and bath if that is an issue. Gorgeous remodel, you will not be disappointed. She left lots of nice extra touches including coffee and a delicious loaf of bread for breakfast.

Marilena was a great host for my week stay here with 2 of my female colleagues. It was a 15-20min taxi out of city centre, so the location was great for that. 2 out of the 3 bedrooms had very comfy beds, with the purple walled bed being very firm. It is important to note the walls are very thin and creaky at times. There are a few amenities missing in the kitchen, so cooking & cleaning had to be a little more creative, but Marilena was generous with bathroom products. If you’re staying here with more people, there was only one key provided so this proved difficult if we were travelling back at different times at night, as there isn’t a way of locking the house and leaving the key for people coming back later. Overall, exactly what we needed for the week for a comfortable work stay with a lovely blossom tree framing the street corner.

El apartamento está bien ubicado, al final de la calle principal de Old Town y a 5 minutos de Hollyrood House. Además, es un apartamento acogedor, limpio, moderno y muy nuevo. Nos encantó quedarnos allí.

The location of this home is great. We returned our car to the rental station and it was a short walk back. As well being on the Royal Mile everything we had left to do was very close at hand! Comfortable rooms and beds. Leaving for the airport was a breeze with a short walk to the tram station.

Our stay was very comfortable. The apartment feels luxurious and its such a relaxing place to return to after a day of exploring. The view is beautiful. The bedrooms and bathrooms were super clean and cozy. Beds were also very comfortable. Zero issues. It was a little higher on the price range than the others we had in mind but definitely worth it and glad we went for it.
Overall a very good stay! Wifi was awesome, beds were super comfortable however it was a little chilly and a little noisy.

Tout simplement parfait ! L’appartement est très agréable, bien placé, bien équipé… Les instructions d’entrée étaient simples et claires, Tom est un excellent hôte. Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir à Edimbourg dans l’appartement de Tom.
A lovely apartment, great location and very clean.
Great location, my favorite neighbourhood in Edinburgh, lots of bars and good restaurants nearby.  the fireplace was gorgeous, bug shared garden, would stay again!

Nous sommes arrivés tard faisant suite à un problème à l'aéroport. Tracey et son conjoint ont été très compréhensifs et gentils.
Le logement est impeccable, salle de bain avec baignoire et chambre privée. Tout était propre et impeccable.
On est à 30 minutes à pied du centre d'edimbourg, il y a également le tram et le bus à proximité.
tracey, son conjoint et le chat Charlie sont très amicaux et sont de bon conseils.
Je recommande fortement !
We had a great time! Perfect location, clean and comfortable and Richard thought of everything to make sure we were “at home”.
It was a great place to stay. I will recommend to my friends and to all the family with kids.

Very good experience staying in your apartment. Carlos is a very kind man and he s very helpful, gave us everything we needed in the 3 days staying there. The apartment is very clean, and big. 2 bathrooms are perfect for a large group like us.
Very recommend!!!
A well renovated apartment that has been kept clean and tidy. It is not too far a walk to the centre of Edinburgh, but is still quiet. It suited a friend and I well for a couple of nights.
Short walk to Haymarket restaurants and bars. Quiet location. Thank you for the stay!
Everything was good!
Fabulous stay - great location and wonderful host. Would certainly stay again!
Great !

We really enjoyed our stay here. The apartment was a good size, had everything we needed including a well stocked kitchen, Netflix and complementary tea, coffee, biscuits and toiletries. It was a very beautiful apartment - lovely high ceilings and features.  It was in an amazing location - just a 3 min walk from the castle which meant we could pop back during the day between activities with ease. Communication and check in were excellent. (We stayed as a family of 3 - adult and 2 kids).
Great apartment for our stay in Edinburgh!

This was an amazing stay for the weary travellers that my son and I were.  Ann went above and beyond as a host.  The home was charming from the front gate onwards.   Best air B and B I have stayed in.  As a air B and B host myself,  Ann taught me many things I can improve on.  Thank you Ann for the great one night stay and the chance to be welcomed into your home.

Les's apartment is spotless and luxurious. location awesome with panoramic views right on the ocean.  comfy bed. 2 Min walk to the bus stop that takes into Edinburgh. lots of dog walkers going along the sea front, nice for a brisk walk

We visited Edinburgh for a long weekend in September and Cara’s flat was the perfect place to stay. The flat is beautiful, has an enormous sitting room, located on a central but quiet street, and round the corner from some incredible restaurants, pubs and wine bars.
The flat is comfortable and peaceful, 25 mins walk from the city centre. There are a couple of nice cafes nearby. We had a lovely stay
Great flat in a great location. Would stay again.

Lynne was a great host.  I booked Lynne's place for my parents, she met us there and showed them how to work everything which was greatly appreciated and allowed for an easy check in.  Her place was close to the train station, the airport bus stop, and all the tourist things that are a must see.  The place was spotless;  they felt comfortable and at home.  Communication was amazing and instructions were clear.  I would recommend Lynne's place and would book again. Thank you for everything, Lynne!

Le logement était parfait pour notre temps passé la bas. Pas dans l’hypercentre historique mais très facile d’accès. Sonia a été très réactive et amicale par message. Le séjour s’est bien passé ! Je recommande !!!

The area around the stay is great I.e Eclectic mix of eateries, buildings and architecture, charity shops, parks and cinema all within walking distance !
Enjoyed meeting and chatting to other residents in the kitchen area

Awesome location - was close enough for a nice walk to city centre. Was far away enough from city centre for us to have some peace and quiet during the Fringe Festival. Dean Village, Water of Leith walk and great restaurants right nearby. Also a Sainsburys was just yards away. We enjoyed coming back to the flat each night. Would definitely recommend.
Great location in old town , lots of history, well equipped apartment

The location was convenient, max 10 min walk onto the Royal Mile. There is a Tesco express directly over the road. However, the surrounding area is mostly high-rise flats, which appear to be council flats and wasn’t quite what we expected from the listing and may not suit everyone. We struggled to locate the property. And Saturday night was quite noisy from residents outside the flats.
The property itself felt quite dated and could benefit from some updating, although it was extremely clean and was well equipped with milk, orange juice, toiletries and towels. The shower pressure was very low as per other feedbacks but functional. We did find the accommodation cold with storage heaters and there was no hot water in the taps.
Overall it was functional for a short stay in Edinburgh due to the location.

Central. Super convenient for EICC, and just round the back of the castle. Very congenial host. And parking too (just the one space, but gold dust in Edinburgh). Low bed might not be suitable for crumbling knees, but very comfortable.

This is such a cool little place. Stylish and comfortable and in the heart of everything. The location was fantastic and Michael was quick to respond to any issue or question.  It was the perfect place to stay,  and the Harry Potter inspired touches we're...magical.
Very good location and no problems !

The quality of the bedding and pillows was poor. I think we payed much too money to have flat pillows and polyester sheets.
The location and the apartment were accurate to the description. It was a quiet location not far from the busy part of town. The washer and dryer were very convenient to have.
进入房间，非常满意，Ben的服务也特别好，唯一短板就是楼梯，我们二大箱子，搬运🈶点尴尬😓🉑能爱丁堡的房子多数是这种楼梯，轻装的客人，我完全推荐这个房源

The room is big enough inside a charming flat. Everything was very clean. The location is very good with a free parking at 15min walk and the city center starting at 5 min walk. The room is looking the garden at the back of the building so it is quiet. Guillermo is very welcome and helpful. It was great to meet him.
Don’t miss this place!
It was good value. Sofa bed good for one person ideally but comfortable.

Claire’s place was exactly what it looks like in the pictures. It is her home, so it is not clinical and soulless; it is homely and welcoming. It was spotlessly clean. Entry instructions were super clear. Claire was extremely helpful with bus/train details to get in and out of the city.
There are tonnes of restaurants and coffee shops along Portobello High Street and also down onto the promenade. Being so close to the beach was an absolute joy - and The Beach House about a 10minute walk away did a terrific breakfast and lunch.
Would totally recommend Portobello as a location and Claire’s place offered everything we needed.
great

The place is clean, fully equipped kitchen, very clean and spacious apartment. Zero complains about anything from this stay. I would highly recommend staying here while visiting Edinburgh. 10/10 would rebook when revisiting.

Great central location, near to train station. The room is clean and cosy, excellent for staycation. Host is really friendly, he will greet us during check in. He also share with us nearby attractions and convenient stores.

The apartment is clean, spacious and trendy in a quiet neighborhood, almost walk distance to SaintBurry grocery store. Very close to Airport. If there are more cookware sets and cleaning supplies, that would be perfect.

Overall, we had an excellent time especially with the location being so close to the Edinburgh fringe and Tattoo events as well as wonderful eateries and the like. The place was fully equipped with all that was needed. Just a couple of things to note which are not really criticisms because we were fully aware of these before we arrived. Some might find the stairs difficult especially with suitcases and some couples might find the size of the double beds a challenge.
We managed ok and overall we were very pleased with our accommodation over our three night stay.

Gillian es una gran persona y su casa está en una muy buena ubicación cerca del nuevo Edimburgo
El tranvía y el autobús que va al aeropuerto están a 5 min caminando de su casa
Si regreso a la ciudad definitivamente me quedaré de nuevo con ella
The place was wonderful, location was amazing, close to everything!

We stayed at Laura’s place for 4 nights. Laura was very friendly and responsive and was happy to accommodate a later check-in. She was happy to help with any issues we had. The check-in instructions were very clear and the unit is easy to locate. It is extremely close to the surrounding bus stops making transport in and out of Edinburgh very easy. The unit is clean and neat and Laura provides so much. The area is extremely peaceful and also very safe. We had a lovely stay and can highly recommend!

Francois is very friendly, responsive and accommodating. He let me check in early and came to help me within 5 minutes when I didn't  know how to open the lockbox.  Everything is the same as described, except Francois made me feel welcome and his place feels like home.

Idea place to stay to explore Edinburgh and the surrounding area.
Clean and spacious, ideal.
Nice Stay. It feels like going home to my parents house. Everything is clean and organised. Bed is comfortable. Host is lovely.
Place was clean and well located! Especially loved that it was in the first floor (no walking up stairs!)

David回复消息非常及时，他答应了我们提前入住的请求，
位置：非常便利，可以走着去所有景点
装修：复古，有特色，宽敞的客厅和厨房
设施：完备，暖气需要自己调节温度才能保持一直热
房间：马桶和淋浴分别为两个卫生间
房子需要拎行李上一圈楼梯
其他方面这个房子非常完美，我们四个人都很喜欢
lovely accommodation.. very clean and amazing location and view

My daughter and I loved our stay at Selena's flat.  It is situated in a quiet neighborhood, and is only a short bus ride from the town center.  The flat was immaculately clean when we arrived, and the kitchen was well-equipped.  The bed was comfortable, as was the pull-out futon used by my daughter.  Although we never got to meet Selena,  she was very quick to communicate with us.  We gained entry to the flat with a key left in a lock box.  We would highly recommend this listing for anyone looking for a place in Edinburgh away from the hustle and bustle of the center of the city, but with easy access to it.
A great spot for a weekend break close to museums, the castle and the city centre. Susan was a great host and accommodated our early checkin and was flexible with checkout.
Jennet was incredibly welcoming and friendly, very glad to have had her as a host! Not only is her place in a good location, her place is also very warm,  comfortable and clean.
Alles is te belopen, de omgeving was veilig. Prima bedden, keuken was klein maar alles was aanwezig. Te kleine woonkamer.
Great stay, only wish we could have stayed longer!  The hosts were very accommodating and recommended several local restaurants that were also quite good.
Parfait !

Calum's place is really lovely. The apartment is in an historical building, and it is beautifully decorated. The room has a sea view - so great to wake up looking at the sea first thing in the morning! Everything was tidy, clean and curated. Calum gave us plenty of things to eat for breakfast and advices on where to dine. The only small downside might be that the house is not super close to the city center, but to be honest it is so well served by public transport (2 buses + the bus to the airport) that you really wouldn't notice the distance. The neighborhood is alsy very quiet and nice. Overall, a great stay!

Perfect location, nice open spaces and the personal touches on arrival were great.
Communication from host was amazing before, during and after our stay.
Fab accommodation, in a brilliant location. The flat was as described and great communication from the host, who got back to me straight away and agreed for an earlier check in time. Would recommend.

Claire war wirklich eine wundervolle Gastgeberin und das cottage ist sehr schöner, ruhiger Ort. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Man muss beachten, dass es nicht modern ist und vor allem das Bad ist ziemlich eng. Uns hat das allerdings nicht gestört.
Es gibt eine Bushaltestelle in der Nähe und der Bus fährt regelmäßig bis Edinburgh. Die Fahrt dauert 30 bis 40 Minuten, aber die Busse sind super. Man kann oben sitzen und eine tolle Aussicht genießen. Einen kleinen Supermarkt gibt es auch in der Nähe.
Achtung: gebt bei der Anreise unbedingt die Postleitzahl mit an. Das cottage ist in Currie,aber die Straße gibt es auch in Edinburgh. Wir standen erst vorm falschen Haus und mussten eine weitere Stunde Bus fahren.
Wir hatten wirklich eine tolle Zeit bei Claire und kommen gerne wieder!
Lovely little spot with everything you need for a night away. Great host (even brought us croissants in the morning) & the fluffy cat was an added extra!

Gwen is a wonderful hostess and her lovely room was absolutely perfect for our needs. There was everything that we needed for our 3 night stay and the bed was extremely comfortable. The icing on the cake was Jazz and her regular nightly visits that made us miss our own pusscats a lot less.

We had a wonderful stay at Michelle’s place! It was in a great location and such beautiful views! Super lovely, easy to check in! The only problem we had(which was no fault of Michelle’s) was trying to find parking as we had a rental car. We ended up parking at the Radisson parking garage and paid the overnight fee which was a bit expensive but worth it. We would definitely come back!
It was perfect, enjoyed the stay, loved the location thank you!

(Love the sandwich shop downstairs!) We arrived to a welcome gift from the hosts and also a beautiful bouquet of fresh flowers. Internet was excellent which is a must for us. The bed was very comfy with lots of pillows and a nice warm duvet. We didn't do any cooking but the kitchen had everything we needed if we had wanted to cook. And best of all, the home was SUPER CLEAN! I am so happy we booked with Dunc and Dee!!

My friend and I stayed at Andrew's place for 3 nights. The location is second to none. Right in the heart of the Royal Mile. Literally everything is at your doorstep. Amazing place ! We would surely stay again !

Me and my partner had such a lovely stay here The flat was immaculate and very cozy. Deirdre had added some lovely touches which made it feel like home. We would definitely stay here again as we visit Edinburgh very often!

Highly recommend this property.

Excellent apartment. Definitely recommend. Great location, beautiful apartment.

The perfect location to explore Edinburgh! Everything was walkable, and the flat was also so comfortable and quiet. Extremely easy walk from the train station too! Philip greeted us so warmly, we felt right at home. Amazing beds, perfect little kitchen, loved being able to do laundry while traveling. Even better than the lovely photos! Really couldn’t ask for a better location or comforts! Highly recommend.
Jeremy's a great host, very responsive to messages, apartments within walking distance of everything, very spacious and ideal for long stays, would stay again next time I'm in Edinburgh.

Muy lindo alojamiento, mucho más lindo que las fotos y muy espacioso. Can't speak highly enough about Dylan as a host. Excellent communication and local hints and tips, particularly around transport options. Spotless home, perfect location right in the city and walk able to all major destinations. Will return if in Edinburgh again, thank you.

Je recommande ce logement dans un quartier vraiment très sympa et agréable.

Hôte très réactif.

We had a lovely stay at this apartment - great location, near park, great cafes and supermarkets close by. It is an easy walk into the centre of the city only 20-30mins. The apartment was spacious and great for five people. We did have some issues with shower and dishwasher, Altido responded quickly and sent maintenance the next day to fix. Altido team were very responsive. Overall a great stay in this centrally located apartment.

There's no better Air Bnb host than Judith. As soon as we arrived, she welcomed us with tea and cookies. Her two cats, Monty and Duke are always around for a cuddle. The flat is SO cute and nicely decorated and clean. All the amenities you could ever need are here. The neighborhood is quiet but is full of cafes and restaurants and is a short walk to old Town. Also a very short walk to Calton Hill. Trust me, this place is worth it.

Nous avons adoré notre séjour dans le magnifique appartement de Nobert. Norbert a su répondre rapidement à toutes nos questions. Nous recommandons chaleureusement l’endroit comme ancrage central et pratique pour visiter Édimbourg.
We had a very comfortable stay in the apartment. Very spacious and tidy, all amenities we needed. Comms were great and hosts easy to deal with. Would definitely recommend.
Pier's flat is just beautiful. Peaceful, stylish, comfortable, well equipped, well located. Pier is a communicative and attentive host. I would definitely recommend his place to anyone.
Very nice and big apartment in Leith. Loved staying here during our time in Edinburgh. Ian was very helpful, and we would definetely stay here again.

Lewis is ontzettend vriendelijk, reageert snel en je krijgt ontzettend veel privacy in zijn huis
De kamer waar je in slaapt heeft alles wat je nodig hebt, de douche werkt heel goed en er staat ontbijt voor je klaar.

Highly recommend a stay here to explore the city, steps away from main attractions.  Amazingly hot shower! Excellent gathering space to visit with friends. Stocked kitchen is great. We were prepared for the stairs, carry on luggage and backpacks made it easy. You do hear noise from the square, however we felt it added to the charm and experience & as we enjoyed the music and pub scene. Hosts are phenomenal.
Great location! Very spacious and well maintained

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this adorable apartment! The decor and finishes are beautifully done, creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere that immediately felt like home. The location is excellent—peaceful, charming, and within easy walking distance of wonderful restaurants, coffee shops, and local stores.
One of our favorite aspects was that it is not located directly in the city center. After spending the day exploring busy downtown Edinburgh, it was such a pleasure to return to a quiet and relaxing neighborhood. It truly offered the best of both worlds: convenient access to the city while providing a peaceful retreat at the end of the day.
The owners were wonderful—kind, responsive, and thoughtful throughout our stay. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Edinburgh. Enjoy!

We loved our stay in this really well-presented, clean, comfortable Marchmont flat. Great apartment with the benefit of private parking!

great stay

Wij verbleven 3 nachten in Calum zijn appartement. Perfect voor een lang weekendje.

Good value, warm, clean and close to Herriot Watt.  You need to follow the instructions on how to get there very closely as there are lots of similar-sounding flats nearby.

Fiona is a wonderful hostess and her home is very nice. It is a very large room with comfortable beds. The bedroom view of the park is beautiful. There were no disappointments on our stay. I highly recommend it.

We're traveling with four kids and this apartment was a very practical with toys, a high chair, a travel cot, a fun triple bunk bed, and easy ground level access. There was a couple of playgrounds close by, and both a tram an buses right around the corner.

If you're traveling with kids I really recommend it!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Édimbourg dans la chambre Bide Collective.

Je recommande ce logement pour un séjour de courte durée à Édimbourg.

John was an excellent host and his place was beautiful! So comfortable and peaceful!! The breakfast provided was wonderful! Very near the airport! We recommend his place to anyone visiting the Edinburgh area!!

Great flat in a good location. 9 flights of stairs to negotiate, so maybe not for everyone, but the host did say that in the description. Would definitely use it again.

We enjoyed staying with Reaaz very much. The house is absolutely beautiful and our room was very comfortable. It is the perfect place to stay. We enjoyed chatting with Reaaz, he was very friendly and helpful.

Proche du tramway qui traverse Edimbourg ce qui est fort pratique

The apartment is beautiful, so bright and airy. The location is perfect and close to the centre. We had a really relaxing and peaceful couple of days and would recommend this place to anyone seeking the same experience.
A beautiful apartment in the perfect location!

We had a lovely time at Drummond Place.  We were three couples, staying in Edinburgh for several days. We had a car and had no trouble parking (and we were thankful that weekend parking is free!).  Several of us have been reading Alexander McCall Smith's 44 Scotland Street series, and enjoyed seeing many of the settings mentioned, including the Cumberland Bar, a good pub just around the corner. The house itself is just terrific:  the kitchen has everything one could ever need, and it was no problem for six of us to share.  The bathrooms are well appointed, the bedrooms are comfortable, and the sitting room is stylish and cozy.  The place was spotless, and Katie was easy to work with.  We highly recommend Drummond Place!
Dan & Alex are wonderful hosts! They know the area pretty well and we’re able to give local advice. They were very attentive & amiable. Highly recommend!

Thoroughly enjoyed the entire experience with this apartment booking. Eddie was terrific with communication prior to and on arrival and the apartment was spacious and spotless. Parking was available on site and free with the booking and the city, including the Royal Mile, was all within walking distance. Care and thought had gone into the provision of amenities including a supply of milk, cereal, and local biscuits for use. Would recommend this property to anyone travelling to Edinburgh and would book again if we go back.
We thought the place could do with some money spent on it, it had a run down feel to it, its location was ideal for us to explore Edinburgh.

Perfect location for convenient access to all things in Edinburgh.  When there was an issue, we found out about it BEFORE we arrived.  Communication always matters and Dave was great about keeping us well informed.

Had a great month long stay at Megan’s beautiful flat :) It was comfy, well decorated and modern, with lots of nice touches that made it feel like home right away! FYI the bed is a fold-out which we didn’t mind, but something to consider if you’re picky about beds.

Ord's Loft was an amazing stay for our first trip to Edinburgh and for attending the 75th Tattoo.  Plenty to do and see, and within walking distance to the show while also far enough to be quiet and private.

Levi, our host was great, communication was timely, helpful and very clear.

Clear communication with the host prior to arrival. Easy to find, we knew where it was, but often a car parked on the street approach covering the road sign to number 14 - not an issue of the hosts making I must stress. Easy access and friendly hosts. The location was perfect for us, just a 20 minute walk from the areas of the West End we needed to get to. Easily walkable to all areas of the city but that wouldn't have been great in poor weather. Safe parking for the car, a bonus in Edinburgh, and outside the charging zone. The hosts were most thoughtful in leaving a personalised message for us on arrival and we really appreciated the little details left for us, chocolate eggs, milk and flowers for instance. It's always good to walk into a rental and find it warm on arrival. Thank you. Tony and Hilary
Bon emplacement et appartement agréable.
She is a very warm and helpful host!
Lovely hotel, easy to find and check in. Great communication from the host, had a lovely time overall.

We had a great time at Usman’s house. Very quiet surroundings, beautiful garden and lovely house.
We recommend this host and the house. And hopefully will be back soon! Thank you Usman!
Nice and clean . Good location  and good communication with Jolly and Piotr.
Thanks

Andrews place was everything and more. The perfect place to stay to see Edinburgh. Andrew met us at the flat on arrival and ensured we had everything we needed for our stay. The flat was beautifully presented, very clean and well equipped. Only a 15 min walk into the centre, it was the ideal base for exploring. We loved our stay and we would definitely recommend. We cannot wait to return!

Patrick & Chee were wonderful host. Their home was lovely, clean and comfortable. The view from our room was magical and breathe taking. Patrick was very informative and his personal maps he makes for everyone was perfect to get around Edinburgh. We enjoyed our talks over breakfast and the food. Anything we needed, Patrick was there to help. He accommodated us by keeping our luggage until after check out and we were able to do laundry while we were there too. Having the Royal Mile and Edinburgh Castle right outside the back door was perfect. Wish we could have stayed longer. We recommend highly staying with Patrick and Chee, as we will again. Thank you again for your hospitality, you made our trip memorable.
Sharon and Paul

This place is absolutely fantastic! The location is everything, walkable to the castle and the Royal Mile. Enjoyed drinks and food all close by. The home is beautiful and had everything we needed. Just do not forget the key when you step outside on the patio, we locked ourselves out. Karyn and her husband were super responsive and came over right away to let us back in. Wonderful stay, highly recommend!
Wonderful stay! Jennifer was a great host.

Lovely place to stay during Fringe. Quiet yet walkable into town and venues.  Access to Dean Gardens a bonus - a peaceful haven. House was perfect for two, very clean, has everything we needed and very comfortable bed. Would stay again.
Very friendly and convenient for a one night stay.
Tak for et fint ophold! Lejligheden er hyggeligt indrettet og er dejlig lys
Everything went nice and easy. Very pleasant experience, highly recommended!

Ollie's place in Edinburgh was everything shown in the photos and beyond. The room featured a private bathroom and kitchen which we took full advantage of. It even came with 2 bottles of sparkling water in the refrigerator which was very handy. The bathroom smelled AMAZING, one of the best out of all the airbnbs I have used. The room was spacious and had lots of natural light with a nice view of the backyard.
The front entrance was thoughtfully lit with hanging lights that made the space feel that much more special. The location was perfect, we were able to walk from the train station to the apartment in 10-15 minutes with luggage and no problems at all.
I think the best part was Ollie being so thoughtful and generous as it was our honeymoon and he was able to surprise us with fresh flowers and bottle of Malbec to our choosing. I cannot explain how happy my wife was and how much we appreciated this.
The next time we go to Edinburgh I know exactly who we will be staying with. Cheers.

Great find  loved everything about the area was lovely and quiet was easy  to get to main town by bus or you could walk  was very clean well presented  bathroom was very clean  bed was really comfortable too. Would recommend  a stay here could not fault anything
Had a great stay at Jennifer’s place. The house was clean and comfortable as described and the host’s were great. We had a very good interaction with them. They were very cooperative too.
A comfortable, enjoyable stay in a beautiful, well equipped and located apartment
Would absolutely stay here again and again. So hip and comfortable!

Our apartment was like a home from home beautifully decorated extremely comfortable and cosy everything we needed was there a great deal of thought has gone into making it a comfortable place to stay. It is very well situated and  easy to get into the city, Fiona was very helpful and made our stay very easy would definitely go back again

A kind host, a quiet and great location. frequent buses into town. a light filled  room and very comfy bed. For those with limited mobility this spot has lots of steep stairs. Noel was very helpful with my bag. 🙏🏽
Very comfortable property , public transport very regular,  excellent standards, great stay, thanks a lot
Amazingly stylish loft apartment  that is near the airport!
Great place to stay, highly recommend! Within walking distance of Princes street and public transport just around the corner of the apartment. Secure, comfortable, and affordable.

Our second stay in this great little find. Fantastic location near to great shops and restaurants, tourist attractions and the tram stop.
Beautifully decorated and very homely feel - love this place.

The apartment is great, and well equipped. Staying with a one year old was very easy as well. Well located with a short bus ride to the city centre, and the parking space was excellent for ease of arrival and travel a little further out of the city for a day.
View to Holyrood park makes the trip up Arthur’s Seat even more tempting!

Stayed at Little Linton for 3 nights to be close to family who live near by, it was spotlessly clean and beautifully decorated with everything we needed for our stay, great location for getting into Edinburgh on public transport, nearest bus stop was 4 minutes walk away which was brilliant for getting a service to princess street in the city centre

Vi var så glade for at have valgt Hazels bolig. Hun var utroligt sød og imødekommende, og vi følte os virkelig hurtigt hjemme! Hendes hjem er virkelig hyggeligt og rart at være i, og så var der dejligt roligt. Man kunne nå centrum af Edinburgh med bus på cirka 30 minutter, og Portobello er også et rigtig dejligt kvarter. Vi siger mange tak for et rigtig godt ophold ❤️

Es un apartamento con todo lo que necesitas para pasar unos días en Edimburgo.
Pauline estuvo atenta y servicial en todo momento.
La ubicación es perfecta.

Fab location - even with being so central the apartment was really quiet so we all slept fantastically. Well equipped with everything you need - the washer-drier was a life-saver with 2 young kids who loved Edinburgh’s muddy puddles….

Apartament amb tots els equipaments necessaris, habitació amb llit de matrimoni on teníem el bressol de viatge, menjadoret amb sofà i tv, cuina totalment equipada.
És d’agraïr quan viatges amb nens, la rentadora i secadora.
Està a una zona residencial a 20-30 minuts amb autobús del centre d’Edimburg.
Totalment recomanable!

A acomodação do Paul fica muito bem localizada, próxima de praticamente todos os pontos turísticos a pé. O quarto estava muito limpo e organizado, nos sentimos em casa. A acomodação conta com uma cozinha bem equipada, tudo limpo e de fácil acesso, instruções claras e práticas. Super recomendo!
房间很棒！舒适干净，装修现代，窗外的海景超美。房主很友善，这几天的住宿非常愉快。Amazing Experience
Great place to stay.

A lovely, spacious and well equipped flat with parking space (a real bonus in Edinburgh). Walking distance to Holyrood Park and House as well as Scottish Parliament. Walkable to town centre too, just a little bit further. Great location to explore the city and surrounding areas.

We very much enjoyed our stay at Christine's. Obviously the location is as central as you can get for Old Town Edinburgh. It's very walkable for all of central Edinburgh, including Edinburgh Waverly. Despite being on the Royal Mile/Canongate, the building and flat are quite private. The front of the building can be loud because of the street traffic, but nothing unbearable. There is a nice garden behind the building and the Canongate Kirkyard next door. Communicating with Christine was easy and pleasant. I would recommend and consider staying again.

Maison agréable, grande et avec un jardin appréciable. Bien adaptée pour 4 adultes et 4 enfants.
La situation est idéale : dans un quartier calme et à seulement 5 minutes à pied du stade, parfait pour s’y rendre.
La communication avec Kat a été très bonne et l’accès pour récupérer les clefs très facile.
En revanche, elle n’est pas adaptée pour 6 adultes : les lits des chambres d’enfants sont inconfortables. La cuisine n’est pas fonctionnelle.
Le prix est beaucoup trop élevé pour les prestations (environ 1 000 € par nuit).
Awesome place! Thanks Karen
A lovely, clean and spacious flat in a great location! Great communication from the host and an all round good experience.

It is a very nice place. Clean rooms and adequate articles of daily use. Also the host is an very enthusiastic, facetious and nice man.  It was an unforgettable and valuable experience living there for four days.
Jo’s place couldn’t be more central and the views were amazing. Thanks again!

Ce logement est idéalement situé. Facile pour trouver et facile pour récupérer les clés. Ne vous arrêter pas aux parties communes . Le logement , lui est très agréable - chambre au calme et séjour sur une rue animée. L appartement est très bien entretenu et très cosy . La cuisine est très bien équipée et fonctionnelle . Salle de bain parfaite et très clean . Je recommande ce logement . Et je remercie nos hôtes pour tous leurs conseils .

James is definitely the most responsive host I've ever seen! The appartement is very clean, very confi although one bed has no bed frame and my friend didn't sleep too well.
I recommend
Craig is a really great host. the house is clean and warm. everything is perfect. 房东人很nice，沟通非常顺利，因为罢工到的非常晚，他还帮我们带吃的。房子很干净，舒服，很安全。
Appartement de qualité bien situé où nous avons passé d'excellents moments

Had the BEST AIRBNB experience with Jackie and Armando. They have a beautiful house and both of them go out of their way to make you feel at home. The room had a mini pantry which had everything from cookies, snacks, tea and coffee to even a digital luggage weighing scale which i really needed + makeup removing essentials. Armando even drove me ti the city twice early in the morning just so i could catch tge train or bus on time. Their kids are the cutest and have a very friendly cat too! The room even has a TV with Netflix and Prime video! I have never slept in a more comfortable bed and the surroundings are so peaceful. Even at their place, everything is quite and peaceful. They even had essentials to cook as well  ! Will definitely come back to Edinburgh and stay at their place again ! Both of them are the warmest hosts.
Mooie uitvalsbasis voor bezichtiging Edinburgh en omgeving.
Mary was very welcoming and friendly; she made our stay very pleasant, and was always ready to answer questions or provide helpful information.

Super hyggelig lejlighed, med en hyggelig stue og et meget veludstyret køkken, med alt hvad man skulle bruge af køkkenredskaber. Der var tydelige manualer for alt og en mængde guidebøger, man kunne fordybe sig i. Alt fungerede optimalt for os og vi har haft en rigtig skøn ferie.

Lewis's apartment was very comfortable and well appointed. And his welcome and instructions couldn't be faulted. We were two couples spending a few days at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe and the apartment was perfect for us with 2x bedrooms and 2x bathrooms. It's location was great for local event venues and for easy access to public transport to more distant events. It's also a short walk - literally 5 mins - from Edinburgh Waverley railway station (use the secondary, Calton Road station entrance next to platform 2 at the Northeast corner of the station). All in all a great place for an active and very interesting city break. Certainly a place to put on the list for future visits. Many thanks to Lewis and partner!

The place is absolutely fantastic ! Very well lit and has great vibes. Eveey detail has been taken care of. Smallest of items needed in the house to the one's we rarely use, are all available. Morag and Doug are sweethearts and they will go out of their way to help. It's a quiet locality but still close to the city centre. We absolutely loved our stay !
Solid spot.. Stockbridge location is amazing!! And convenient public transit to old town.
Perfect place for a budget trip to Edinburgh! Would come again!

Great stay at Jane’s place. Location was ideal as everything was walkable. Even though it is right above the bars and pubs of Grassmarket, it was not rowdy or disturbing and by 10pm there was no noise. Easy check in coordination too. Very homely flat where we felt at home straight away.
Perfect location for our family reunion.  Easy to find.  Comfortable and close to where family live.   Thank you Samantha

We reached late in the night, but John was nice enough to be waiting for us on the main street just to ensure we dont miss the place! Absolutely warm couple with loads of positivity.
the place is nice, clean and cosy. we had a great time!
John and Gail were kind enough to invite us over for a coffee on the day of departure!

The property was pretty much as advertised except the lane itself wasn't as per the online photo. The lane had piled up rubbish everywhere, graffiti over most walls and some fairly undesirable individuals lurking about. We didn't feel practically safe there.. Also the smart home system was overly complicated as evidenced by "how to use" signs all over the place!
Great location, great host. Will stay there again - we had 5 adults there and the flat was more than spacious
It was well situated for our purposes, clean, and a good space. The bed was comfortable. It fit the bill for what we wanted.
Beyond beautiful  ! The views were beyond lovely. I didn’t want to leave  ! Emily is lovely and I am so grateful I found this gem to stay in — hope to be back !
Had a great stay in Carols place on the Royal mile in Edinburgh. Good, clear communication about check in and tips on things to do in Edinburgh and place was as described. Thank you.

The location is perfect..with a great view of the castle, a minute from the royal mile and about 7 min from princess street. We had a fantastic 3 days at this apartment. It's fairly well equipped and comfortable for 3 adults.

Was a nice and convenient place to stay. Had access to Edinburgh and depending on your ability, you can walk to the royal mile and castle with ease. Just know the loft is tiny and is mainly best if you’re just looking for somewhere to lay your head at night.

Lovely place in a great location. Such a nice area with plenty to do while still maintaining a generally peaceful vibe. Easy, pleasant walk into the centre. The place itself was clean, homely and had everything required. Would highly recommend.

Although I didn’t meet Dave in person, he was extremely responsive to all my messages and always responded positively, politely and in a timely fashion. The neighbourhood is centrally located to major tourist attractions and restaurants. The flat is comfortable and spacious.

Fantastic modern flat with all you need for a very comfortable and relaxing stay in Edinburgh. Plenty of living space to relax, very comfortable beds, lots of hot water for showering in large spacious bathrooms, well stocked kitchen.
Peaceful location adjacent to a beautiful park and within easy walking distance to a local bakery, local Sainsbury’s and Edinburgh old town for bars, restaurants etc.
Sharon was an excellent host and responded very quickly to any questions we had.
Would highly recommend.

This location is ideal! Walking to anything you need is easy- so close to the castle yet removed from the big crowds.  Great recommendations for food.  Nice kitchen and dining areas.  Bathrooms are so clean! Entire place is ideal! Two short flights of stairs up to the flat.  Highly recommend!
Hezký a útulný byt v klidné oblasti. Naprosto skvělá dostupnost jak na letiště, tak i do centra. Po cestě na tramvaj je malý obchůdek, takže vše je snadno dostupné.

Edele’s apartment is  spacious, superbly equipped,  clean and extremely comfortable. There is always a parking spot outside the door and it is  in a great location with easy access to buses which go all over the city. Edele was super responsive and helpful when I needed to contact her and we had a great stay in her beautiful flat. Many thanks.
Amazing apartment full of lovely touches that made it a fantastic stay throughout. Aileen was incredibly helpful, the decor and comfort were great and the view is marvelous!

The Mound Apartments are the perfect place to stay in Edinburgh. It is super central to... everything really.
With wonderful hosts, that made me feel welcome, safe & taken care of.
The accommodation itself is very clean, with lovely details as a bonus: shampoo, shower gel, tea, coffee, ....Edinburgh brochures & printed recommendations where to go to, WiFi access, USB charging ports..
Although the apt. is located very central, it is calm & I slept very good.
No complaints from my side. I can recommend this accommodation absolutely. And I know where to stay at my next visit in amazing Edinburgh!
This apartment was located conveniently close to the airport. It was spotless and comfortable for our group of 5. Would recommend.

Ian’s flat was a great stay for a solo traveler. The location was perfect and central to everything. Gigi the cat was very friendly, and poked in to the room to hang out if no one else was home. The only thing to note was that there are a lot of stairs and it could be really strenuous getting up and down if you have a heavy bag. But Ian was easy to communicate with and the room was tidy, bright, and plenty of space for one.

Valerie's apartment is centrally located in the bruntsfield area. It is well kept and very clean.
There are amazing restaurants and stores within 2 minutes of walking distance. We truly enjoyed staying in the apartment. Valerie's is very communicative over phone and text.

El espacio es muy cómodo y cuenta con todo lo necesario para una estadía cómoda.
Sin embargo la calefacción no es lo suficientemente potente. Fui en invierno y hacía mucho frío dentro la calificación no subía de 17c°.
La comunicación con Rebeca es muy regular. Solo responde con mensajes genéricos nada personalizado

This air bnb was located in such a great place, easy to walk to shipping, food, and attractions. The check in directions were very clear but missed a few things, however the host was so responsive and helpful it didn’t hold us up. The place was very comfortable and well priced.
A truly beautiful property in a fabulous area.

This flat is literally so precious and smelled so nice. It is so primely located for all of the tourist-y things to do in Edinburgh. I'd recommend grabbing a pint at the Frankenstein Bar, coffee at The Elephant House and strolling along the mile to enjoy the picturesque view of the castle!

Our stay at Alex’s apartment was very pleasant—plenty of space to relax after a long day and nice decor. The location was great and only a 20 minute walk from the center of the city. Lots of nice restaurants and cafes nearby and Sainsbury’s across the street for any necessary supplies. Would definitely recommend!

The location of the apartment is simply sensational. Upper Bow 1 is the ideal starting point to explore Edinburgh. We were for 5 days in Edinburgh and could visit everything by foot. We found an apartment that exactly matched our expectations and the pictures. Communication with Denise and Callum was very good. We received all the necessary information in advance.

Le logement est beau et très confortable. Il y avait tous les équipements nécessaires et même des jeux de société et des puzzles pour passer un moment calme. Nous n'y sommes restés qu'une nuit, mais le séjour a été très agréable ! Merci à Jakob pour son accueil chaleureux !

We communicated with Joe the day before our arrival to say we would be arriving around 1.00pm and would it be possible to have early access. He responded quickly and stated early access at 1.00pm would be no problem. We texted about 12.30pm to say we would be with him around 12.50pm and he said access was not possible until 3.00pm as per the original booking, but we could leave our bags in his house, so we did. He did offer a bottle of wine as a goodwill gesture for the mix up. On leaving the room in the evening we discovered the lock on the door was broken. We tried to contact all three owners but with no success, so went out leaving the room unlocked and our valuables unattended. The quality of the towels and bedding in particular are very poor considering the price being charged. As the property is connected to the owners house it was not the quietest stay, with little sound proofing in the room. If you are charging top rates you need to provide good facilities not basic and simple.

David and Soraya you are such amazing hosts. Thanks for making me feel at home. Thanks for all the recommendations about the city and the tips and tricks and late night talks. I really enjoyed my stay. The flat is located is a great location very close to city centre, all the different attractions, and parks. The room was clean, tidy, well furnished and decorated, and had all what I need. So was the living room, kitchen, and whole flat. Definitely recommend staying with David and Soraya!

Quirky well-located apartment in Edinburgh. The place is laid out in an odd way, but it’s spacious and in a great location. Lovely touches include art on the walls and a piano made into a bookshelf and coffee table.
Rebecca’s place is stylish, cosy and comfortable. Only a short walk from the centre of Edinburgh, her apartment is ideal for exploring the city. Would recommend to all!

Foram extremamente gentis e receptivos. Tivemos problemas com nosso voo, que acabou atrasando e eles foram flexíveis com o horário do check in. Nos receberam da melhor forma possível, dando instruções e dicas dos arredores. Estavam disponíveis a todo momento, e a comunicação foi ótima. O quarto estava em perfeitas condições. A localização é muito boa para quem quer um lugar tranquilo e a poucos minutos de bares , restaurantes e cafés. Recomendo!
We had a lovely time. Very convenient to reach by bus from airport and lots of possibilities to get into town. Close to supermarket and also lovely to take the Leith walk into town

とても快適に過ごせました！
部屋はとても綺麗でしたが、共有スペースは一緒のタイミングに泊まってる人の質もあるのか、たまに水浸しになってしまっていましたがこれは宿の問題ではないです😅
観光のしやすい中心地にあってとてもおすすめです！

I would give 10 stars if I could. Veronique was a lovely host, and the apartment exceeded our expectations. It was so nice to come "home" after a day of exploring. The location is great, walkable to everything, including public transportation. I would highly recommend staying here when in Edinburgh!
Tegen het einde van onze roadtrip voor de tweede keer bij Gary overnacht. Wederom een aanrader!

Highly recommend this place! Sarah and Dom were lovely hosts that provided us with everything needed. The place is really modern and clean, and within a walking distance from the centre. We thoroughly enjoyed our visit!

Um bom lugar para se hospedar em Edimburgo. O airbnb fica a cerca de 4 minutos do parada de ônibus e a cerca de 25 minutos do centro. O quarto é espaçoso, limpo e a cama é confortável. Está tendo um obra ao lado do quarto nesse momento, mas mesmo assim não tivemos problemas com barulho.

Great place to stay for a couple of nights in Edinburgh. Convenient to the castle and lots of shops and restaurants near by. In a busy area but since it is off of the road you don’t get much noise. Highly recommend!

Jennifer was such a helpful host! She managed to organise an earlier check in for us and gave us some great recommendations for around Edinburgh (always responded within the hour too). The place was super cosy and only a 10 minute walk from the main area and train station. Would stay again!

Hyvä, rauhallinen sijainti Leathin asuinalueella. Lyhyt kävelymatka myös Britannia-alukseen. Carlan Airbnb on siisti huoneisto, jossa hyvin varusteltu keittiö ja kaikki (lämmitys, sähkö, jäääkaappi, kirjautuminen jne.) toimivat hyvin . Perushyvä huoneisto, ei luksusta eikä mitään ylimääräistä, mutta toimiva.

Un logement tout à fait adapté à notre séjour en famille
Très bien équipé, propre, soigné...
Un livret à disposition pour faciliter notre installation et notre séjour
Steve was so friendly and the space very much had a soul to it, made me feel very at home. Would absolutely stay again!
Clean, spacious, secure, quiet, flawless no issues at all. Look forward to going back.

Our stay was fantastic! The apt is located in a perfect spot. We walked everywhere! We had everything we needed in the apt and enjoyed being able to sit down to dinner as a family for a night in and relax. Mat’s recommendations for the pubs and restaurants were delicious. We will stay here again on our next trip to Edinburgh!

Het was een geweldig verblijf bij Charlotte! Het appartement heeft een uitstekende ligging en is volledig in orde.
Een aanrader!!
Good

Great location not far from the train station, car rental, stores and restaurants. Very good for 1 night.
The building is quite old and there is no elevator.
The room was smaller than what we perceived in the photos, we barely had enough room to open our 2 suitcases. The 2 other guestrooms must be bigger.
The water heater is located inside the room, so there is a periodic humming sound and we can hear the street quite well so bring your earplugs.
Kitchen is quite small, but it is fine if not used with the other guests.

Really can’t rate Paul and his flat high enough, we were travelling with 2 young girls and  after booking last minute with issues with our previous hotel, Paul kindly welcomed us with an earlier check-in which he didn’t need too. The space was lovely and clean, the location is right in the heart of the lovely area of Leith. Shops,cafe and gym close and far enough away. Wouldn’t think twice to book again for our next trip to Edinburgh.

A lovely place to stay, in a quiet street in a busy city. Our host was very helpful and welcoming, and responded to all our messages promptly. There was even home made shortbread (which was delicious).

Location, location, location.
Patsy was always very supportive
Nice, small appartment. Good to reach the old city by foot.
Lovely apartment!

Sally's is a beautiful Georgian house, very elegant but still homely and comfortable.
It is set in a peaceful part of Edinburgh but with very good links into the city centre.
Everything you could possibly need is provided. Sally is a kind and welcoming host and I enjoyed my stay immensely.
Exatamente como nas fotos, limpo e perto de tudo em frente a estação, com certeza voltaria, e tive que alterar minha reserva e o anfitrião foi super compreensivo
Very comfortable stay.
Fantastic place to stay! Spotless and has eveything you may need !! Definitely going back!!!
Sehr stilvolle Altbauwohnung in großartiger Lage zum Zentrum von Edinburgh. Roland ist ein sehr hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Wir würden sofort wiederkommen.

Julie's place was very comfortable, stylish and well appointed. She responded instantly and the check in process was very easy. The location is excellent, right next to the royal mile in a quiet corner :)

Plenty of communication beforehand with very clear instructions. Place exactly like described. Absolutely hands down best location in Old Town on the Royal Mile!!! Sooo much to do and a local pub became my second family for my extended stay. Very safe and very private once you close the heavy curtains at night. I’m so happy I chose this place! If I ever come back for another long stay I will try my hardest to rebook here. Way more “bang for your buck” over a hotel. 🙂

Fantastic townhouse which is both conveniently situated for both Leith and Edinburgh. A lovely little hideaway with amazing projector screen to kick back after exploring this fantastic capital and beautifully decorated! Loved it!

Graham’s place is beautiful, and Graham was super responsive to our messages before our stay. However, there are a couple things that I wish were different. First, there was no shampoo or body wash at the apartment, though they were listed as included on the property, and we had to buy our own. More importantly, we felt extremely rushed at check-out. The check-out was at 10:00. We were doing a final check around the apartment at 9:50, when the cleaning lady abruptly walked in. After I explained to her we were certainly checking out on time, instead of giving us some privacy and time, she walked straight to the kitchen to start cleaning. Given that we were literally on our way out and there was still 10 minutes before the check-out time, we certainly felt a bit offended. It was a shame that we felt so welcomed in the begging but rushed out at the end.
Charming place, amazing location, incredible for our week at the Fringe!

Samantha's place was just perfect and felt like a home from home. Very clean, spacious and everything to a very high standard. My teenagers loved the cinema room!The location is great with bus stops right outside and lots of lovely walks nearby. Samantha was the most helpful host ever, really couldn't have done more for us.  We hope to return. A huge thank you for making our trip so much easier and enjoyable.
A great spotless stylish place very well located, easy access to the main festival venues. Graham the host was very welcoming
Fabulous location. Really roomy and everything we need. Great eateries close by.
Would recommend

Very spacious and gorgeous flat close to the town centre! We loved our stay and particularly enjoyed the living room. The piano added a nice touch to our stay! We would have loved to have two showers instead of just one shower and a bath.  However, this wasn’t a big issue, as we read on previous reviews that it is not feasible (for plumbing reasons). Overall, would recommend!

We had a great experience with Patrick! He was very courteous and all our needs were fulfilled happily.
The apartment is beautiful and at the perfect spot - close to the train station and to all the main attractions! The room was delightful, comfortable and equipped up to the smallest details.
We looked for a place to sleep and got much more. We're happy to have had the chance to stay with Patrick and recommend it highly to anyone who visits Edinburgh. No need to look elsewhere, this is the very best you'll find!

My favorite place I have ever stayed in. This was so enjoyable and relaxing. It was so hard to leave! It was in a wonderful place, the beds were SO comfortable, and it was just so nice! Loved it so much.

HIghly recommend this apartment which was exactly what we wanted - living as locals away from the main drags but with conveniences just round the corner. The apartment is as listed, very clean and very well kitted out. All amenities are high quality (unlike some other airbnbs) e.g. beds, bedding, towels, kitchen utensils, cutlery, appliances etc. Debbie thought of everything I could need and communication is faultless. November 2019 - I cannot recommend this place.  Here's why... NO HEAT OR HOT WATER FOR 3 DAYS AND TERRIBLE CLEANING! Three of us Arrived and loved the lay out and location. We noticed the dirty dishes and utensils first. Then noticed it was cold so we turned up all the heaters and left for groceries, just to arrive back and realize we had a heating problem. Then realized we had no hot water either.  A very long story with a handyman the first night who couldn't fix it, a maintenance man the next day, then finally a professional HVAC guy who advised it was not fixable.  Each day it was evening before we were advised it wasn't going to be fixed.  We Sat at a café on the second day for hours to stay warm and use the WiFi to get help. Had to involve Airbnb. We moved out when once again the boiler went off after one shower. It was horrible to not have showers and to be cold after traveling. Every time we thought it was fixed it wasn't.  A beautiful apartment that hasn't been properly maintained.  A real shame!  Seriously, this took up 1/2 of our vacation before it was resolved by us finding another rental. This was not how I wanted to spend my time in Edinburgh and by the end of the ordeal I just felt like crying.  Traveling from Canada to Scotland and having so much of your time taken up with accommodation issues is not a fun vacation!  Unless the owner fixes the boiler issue and finds a better cleaning service I cannot recommend this place.  We also found the beds quite hard, but I suppose some people like them like that.  The only shower I did have after it was fixed temporarily didn't drain well so I had to turn it off before I was finished so it didn't over flow. Unfortunately, I do not recommend this apartment.
