Stockbridge, where this particular flat that Rebecca manages, is a beautiful village and I thoroughly enjoyed exploring it and the rest of Edinburgh during my 2-week stay. Unfortunately my communications with Rebecca leading up to my 2-week stay were unsatisfactory. Rebecca manages upward of 60 properties with 'her team' and though she responded quickly to any queries I had, her responses were perfunctory and indicative of someone juggling a lot. I had asked about bed linen, as I noticed in the images provided that there appeared to be just a single cotton throw over a sheet, and thus I was curious to know if there was a comforter or even an additional blanket. Her answer: "The bed linen is as shown." When I asked if an additional blanket could be 'rustled up,' her answer: "We are unable to provide additional blankets, so would ask you bring some should you need them, many thanks." A further message from me asking again for a blanket, was met with 'no response.' And so given her no-response response, I did as she said, I vacuum packed my own bed linen and brought it in my suitcase from Portugal! Upon checking in, I was beyond annoyed to discover that not only was the bed made up with a comforter (which does not appear in the images and thus is not shown) but there was also an additional comforter and fleece blanket in the wardrobe! The following morning, after my arrival at 8pm the previous evening for a 2-week stay, I received a 'welcome' message which included instructions on checking out! In that email this particular sentence struck me as very odd: "Please don’t take our basic supplies (toilet roll/hand soap/shampoo) home with you, as they are for the next guest stay as well." Odd, because there were no basic supplies to speak of. There was one toilet roll, and what appeared to be almost empty leftover plastic bottles of a previous guests soap and shampoo, and an almost empty bottle of hand sanitizer. The kitchen products were equally wanting: a bottle of hand soap that was empty, a bottle of dishwashing detergent that had the consistency of water (perhaps water had been added to it to make it go further), and one bottle of dishwasher detergent, one roll of paper towel and one linen hand towel. Perhaps adequate for an overnight guest, but for a 2-week stay, woefully inadequate. It was very clear that Rebecca had no idea what this flat contained, from bed linen to basic supplies. I also wondered when someone had last checked the condition of the flat. Following is a list of things I noticed that warranted attention: 1) The kitchen faucet was desperately loose 2) The heated towel rack in the bathroom did not work 3) The window by the bed appears not to open. 4) The comforter that was on the bed is stained with bodily fluids and stinks of smoke - it is desperately in need of laundering. 5) I've already mentioned the lack of bathroom & kitchen 'supplies.' 6) And for anyone considering a stay this Fall, 2022, the flat next door is undergoing restoration. The workmen arrive at 6:45 am each morning (except weekends) and park right in front of the front door of the flat, running their vehicle's engine till all workman have arrived, which was generally around 7am. They then begin hammering and drilling around 7:30am. A few days after I arrived, they installed a porta-potty right by the front door. I have already written to Rebecca with the above information, proposing that it would behoove her to know the apartments she manages, including contents and overall condition so that she’s able to advice incoming guests with full knowledge of what is available to them upon their arrival. It goes without saying that I would have preferred not to have brought my own bed linen! Unfortunately, I received another perfunctory reply to my last email: "Thank you for your feedback, this is very important, and vital for us to improve our services, so thank you for taking time to send us a message. We will look into everything mentioned above, and action where required. Thank you for staying with us. Best wishes, Rebecca & Team HAT xx” I might add that with each communication from Rebecca, I received kisses! I don’t believe I've ever received so many kisses from a stranger, but unfortunately the kisses did not make up for the unapologetic responses from Rebecca and “Team HAT.” My final comment: Stay in Stockbridge, it's gorgeous, and if you decide to stay at this particular listing, I think it'd be adequate for a couple of nights, particularly weekends, when there's no drilling from the workmen next door :)

The two bedrooms feel quite private because they are not next to each other and one has its own bathroom.   The apartment basically splits in two, essentially turning the second bedroom and second bath into its own suite as well.  The apartment is a couple blocks from Edinburgh castle, and right off the Royal Mile, outside some very cute stores.  It was the perfect location for Hogmanay events - convenient to everything.  The spiral stone staircase leading up to the first floor apartment is classic.  The internet worked well, as did the TV and the appliances.  The view from the big windows out onto the Royal Mile can entertain for hours.  We just loved sitting on the couch in the living room, absorbing the history and energy.  Despite being on the Royal Mile, there was no street noise in the bedrooms.  There are multiple small grocery stores within walking distance (we like to dine in for breakfast).
Super cute apartment, great location, great hosts! Highly recommend!
The location is amazing - comfortable beds and well-equipped apartment. We had a lovely stay.

Beautiful apartment in perfect location. The Royal Mile is the main focus for visitors like me and the apartment is right there. It’s also a very short distance from the train station.  The apartment itself is very comfortable and well maintained. Imagine the quality and finish of a hotel in the space of a typical Edinburgh apartment. We were very happy.

What a cozy flat in such a great location! Easy to get to busses and a short walk to the pier and the water. We were happy with the location. Roberta was very responsive even when we had concerns, and offered solutions, even though we had our own solutions to those concerns. She provided some cooking essentials so we were able to have suppers in to save a bit of money, and extras for kitchen or bath, as needed. We had a lovely time in Edinburgh and staying at Roberta's made it easy to get around. Thank you!

This was such a gem!! This was our first stop for our Scotland trip and it was a wonderful place and location. Great restaurants and surrounding areas. The instructions for everything were also so easy. We did come during an unusually hot week for Scotland, so the apartment was a little warm and there was no air. Overall I would absolutely stay here again and recommend it to anyone!!

Somewhat mixed feelings about our stay.
We stayed here for 2 nights. You are largely paying for the location and parking. This is the annexe/granny flat of a large property in a nice area of Edinburgh.
Vicki is responsive as a host. The kitchen is well stocked. The apartment is reasonably clean. The interiors, particularly the furnishings, paintwork and carpets are quite worn and dated. The bathroom seems relatively new. The price of the accommodation accurately reflects what you get compared to (more expensive) hotel accommodation in the city.
Unfortunately my wife had a large cluster of bites in the night in bed which resembled bed bug bites. Upon inspecting the sheets, the sheets themselves were clean but the mattress topper underneath was a bit dirty. We relayed this information back to the host.
This was a 3 star experience for us and whilst this accommodation may be suitable for most, we would not choose to stay here again.
First time visiting Edinburgh and I am glad I chose this lovely apartment to stay in! Everything was just as I expected it to be and David was a great host as well, highly recommend!

Einer der besten Unterkünfte, die wir je hatten. Sehr sauber und ruhig gelegen. Auf jede Anfrage antwortete uns Stuart  prompt. Alles war gut organisiert. Interessant ist unter anderem die technische Ausstattung der Wohnung (super WLAN, Netflix, Google Home). Gute Betten. Mit Parkplatz hatten wir Glück (direkt vor der Tür), aber im Umfeld sollte man immer was finden. Supermarkt ums Eck. Wir kommen wieder !!
Great, comforts place, excellent location!
The place was just great! Near a bunch of shops and restaurants! Very well appointed and had everything that we needed. The parking space was also a very nice surprise!

Great flat in a fantastic location.
Just as advertised, there was plenty of space for 4 of us.
The views are brilliant, you get to see the stunning cliffs near Arthur’s seat straight from both the bedroom and living room of the flat, so this was a really nice touch being able to come back after a long day sight seeing.
It was also really clean when we first came so props to the hosts.
They provided everything you’ll need from towels, to duvets and cooking utensils. The only thing we couldn’t find were mugs for tea so otherwise pretty good going!
Definitely willing to come to this flat again.
Location is ideal - very close to the holyrood palace/park and the royal mile (along which you’ll find pubs and restaurants to go to within a short walk - even some whisky trails!)
The residential and surrounding area was also reasonably quiet which is important.
Very happy guests!
Nice place to stay and great value for the location.
Great host, very responsive and helpful. Great property, very central!

The flat was fabulous, really well presented, exceptionally clean, warm, inviting and perfect for our two night stay. Great location and we had no trouble getting parking which can often be a problem in Edinburgh. We could not fault Rebecca’s place. Will definitely stay again!!!

Nicely located flat with beach near and great transport links.
Very clean and bright flat
Excellent location and even better host. Short walk to cafes and restaurants. Everything was super easy and the room was lovely

Jennifer’s garden flat was lovely , good location , short cab ride or bus ride to summer hall or town.
Would recommend .

This is a gorgeous flat in what I consider to be one of the best areas of Edinburgh to stay in. I live in Leith and booked the flat for my parents to spend a weekend at when they came to visit. Charlotte was there to meet us and show us around the flat, and was very helpful before and during my parents' stay.

The flat has everything you need, is really comfortable and warm unlike a lot of period flats which can be quite draughty. You're within easy walking distance of the city centre as well as Stockbridge, and the local area is great for restaurants, cafes and pubs.
Fantastic flat, comfortable, perfect location, and Charlotte was a very friendly and responsive host. Highly recommend.
Quiet and close to all the sight seeing attractions. Very comfortable and felt like at home. Great communication throughout and flexibility with earlier check in! Thanks!

Séjour très agréable dans un environnement très plaisant avec commerces, et pub à proximité. Logement dans une rue très calme.
Centre ville facile d'accès en bus mais également à pieds.
Promenades à pieds le long de la rivière (Water Leith) soit en remontant vers Dean village soit vers l'océan jusqu'au Royal Yacht.
Edimbourg est une ville où il est agréable de se déplacer à pieds, on peut, si l'on aime marcher se rendre dans tous les monuments.
A beautiful apartment. I will be recommending to friends and family and we will definitely be back! It really was the perfect getaway 😊

Todo estuvo bien con el departamento. Su ubicación es excelente, muy céntrica, y cuenta con un pequeño supermercado al lado que resultó de gran utilidad durante nuestra estadía. sin duda volveriamos y lo recomendare a mis amigos.
Daria war sehr aufgeschlossen, unkompliziert und nett.
Great spot about 10ish minutes walking from downtown Edinburgh. Chris is an awesome host. Definitely recommend!

Sarah's flat is a good basic option for a central stay in Edinburgh.  It's close to the Royal Mile, Holyrood, and Calton Hill - you can basically walk everywhere in the centre of the city.   The flat has two good-sized bedrooms and bathrooms.  The kitchen has the majority of the equipment/utensils needed to cook. Some basic equipment was missing, but I mentioned it to the host, who offered to restock it immediately.  We'd planned meals out, so this wasn't needed, but I'm sure it will be better stocked for future guests.  We had a couple of other minor issues but Sarah was quick to respond and resolve them.  We enjoyed our stay.
Another fantastic stay at David's apartment. Perfect for exploring Edinburgh. Would recommend to anyone!

Good location, good walking distance to all prime locations and groceries. Will definitely save you money taking taxis or public transport. The bnb has all the essential items you need. Would definitely recommend.
Perfection foot us
As advertised a very stylish, modern, clean and perfectly located flat. Quiet and calm but close to the grassmarket. Will stay again
Really nice place.

Lovely apartment, it had everything we needed. Spotlessly clean! Sonia and Chris were so helpful in providing info on the local area, especially with things to do for toddlers, places to eat and drink etc!
Thanks, the cabin was cosy and well equipped; just what was needed.
Amazing location,  this was perfect for what we needed.  Room was spotless.  Bathroom was also spotless.

The apt is just as how it is listed in the website. The apt is really spacious and can fit up to 10 persons or even a couple nore. The host is good at communicating with us regarding the reservation. Definitely trusted host!

Marie and Remi’s place offers a lovely double room. Located a short bus ride to the city or a 20min walk along a beautiful canal. Check in and out where very flexible which with my many bags and limited knowledge of Edinburgh’s geography was great. Remi greeted me and my many bags with warmth, and kindly pointed out on the map various routes and nice local cafes. The place was spotless and I was invited to use the facilities as wished. Overall, nice and convenient place to stay with lovely hosts.
Very helpful and friendly hosts, was flexible around the time that we arrived on train, clear instructions on departure, bed was very comfortable, the house was very clean

In a lovely, quiet street not far from the city centre this apartment had everything I needed for a short stay. It is well kept and clean, there is plenty of privacy but Ollie is on hand for anything needed. I would stay here again.

location for us was all about our dog. route into town was easy via foot, bus or uber. impressed. Sainsbury store plus walkable. Nice neighbours.
it is very close to football stadium so next schedule of matches. all very peaceful.

Catherine's place is what Airbnb is all about! I stayed here for two nights with my husband, and her home is wonderful, with great natural lighting, a very comfortable bed, and a nice, quiet neighborhood. The location is great...you're right next to Stockbridge which is just an adorable part of town with cute cafes and shops. Catherine is such a warm and down-to-earth host, and provided everything that was needed and more--tips for the neighborhood and great conversation. Highly recommend and would absolutely stay here again.

Everything was good and good ubication.
Kind regards.

Wir waren eine Woche in diesem wunderschönen Apartment. Von allen Unterkünften, die wir bisher auf AirBnB angemietet haben, ist diese wirklich am besten ausgestattet. Die Küche lässt keine Wünsche offen. Man hätte sogar Wäsche waschen können. Es gibt zwei Bäder: eins mit Dusche und eins mit Badewanne und integriertem Whirlpool.
Vor der Haustür kommt man mit zwei Bussen in die Stadt. Die nächsten Supermärkte sind auch fußläufig zu erreichen.
Wer mit dem Auto unterwegs ist, kann hinter dem Haus im Bonnington Gait parken.
Wir haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Für ganz kleine Kinder hätte es auch ein Kinderreisebett gegeben.
Des Weiteren gab es zwei Föhne, Bügeleisen, Bügelbrett, Wäscheständer, Kapselkaffeemaschine, Mikrowelle, Gasherd, Backofen, Geschirrspüler, Kühlschrank mit separatem Gefrierschrank, Wasserkocher, Toaster…alles was man so gebrauchen kann, wenn man sich selbst verpflegen möchte.
Had a great stay, place was clean and had everything you need :)
Great location and communication with the host! Would recommend this to all friends and family!

Generally speaking, this is a good PLACE to live in Edinburgh. I'll definitely emphasize its location where it is very close to central and the train station. There are many excellent restaurants and shops nearby. Though the only one worst thing is that the tower water is not warm enough. Even I turn up to the maximum, it is not satisfying.
Really lovely stay, Dominic was super flexible with us for check in and check out, and replied very quickly! The flat was very cute and would definitely stay again.
Adorable and quirky little studio in the heart of Edinburgh. Special weekend away. Thanks for having us.
Beautiful, cozy flat with everything you need for a visit to Edinburgh. Also close to the see what makes a stay even better.
Really enjoyed our stay. Vicki has left some basics in the fridge for breakfastwhich was a nice touch.
Very nice stay
Great location. we had a great time.

Wonderfully central property only a couple short steps from the royal mile. Everything we wanted to see was within a 20 min walk. Would highly recommend to friends as John was incredibly friendly and happy to recommend local cafes and eateries. When I mentioned about my partners dietary restrictions, John thoughfully sought out places that cater to her.

Paul's place is lovely. It's close to the park and bus stops to town. Everything is as described. There are buses going by the house every few minutes at night and the washer/dryer is a bit loud, but we were too tired by the end of the day to be bothered by it. Would recommend
Great location, great for eating out. Would recommend.

Excellent location, walking distance to most of the view point in Edinburgh, clean and everything same at it listed.
However, we followed Google map’s instruction from Edinburgh station to the site, which telling us to go upslope to the castle hill and downslope, with 2 large suitcases :(
The stay experience is very good, it is easy to go everywhere!Our landlord Jane was very kind to us and we loved Edinburgh so much. Hope to see you again 😊😊
Daniel is a great host and the flat is nice clean private place which is easily accessible by bus from Edinburgh City Centre.

A fantastic apartment within walking distance of the city centre. Apartment was spacious, and perfect for 4 adults, plus our 9 month old. Would definitely recommend and hope to visit again soon. Thanks!

The place is amazing in terms of location, you’re by foot 25m more or less to the center, the bus is right out front the door pretty much. Getting to and from the airport is seamless with public transportation.
Great Location!! As an American-only place that had washcloths!!! Great place!  Would stay again.

Nice Apartment with high ceilings and a good functional kitchen. Sofa and chairs comfy and the shower was easy to use. Close to Leith's Tram and Bus system and lots of pubs, restaurants and stores nearby. Roughly a 10-15min tram to waterfront and the same to Old Town Edinburgh. Andrea and her husband were super helpful and everything worked out well.

The apartment is in a great location. Public transportation was right outside the door. There are many restaurants, cafes, coffee shops and grocery stores within a few blocks. The beds and linens were comfortable. The kitchen had everything you would need to cook with a large refrigerator, stove, oven and microwave. The living room was spacious with huge skylights which bring in tons of light. We had a very enjoyable stay.
Great place to stay, great location and plenty of space in the apartment. Lynne and Robert were great hosts and would definitely stay again.

Fidelia was very responsive and helped with loads of recommendations for restaurants, etc. The house was spotless and as described. Couldn’t have asked for a better location - so close to the casts and just off the Royal Mile! We had a wonderful stay and would recommend.
We spent a night at Jack's and it was great! We parked quite easily around his place, we went to the city center by foot, and we slept very well!

Location, location, location! This flat is the perfect spot in Old Town Edinburgh. The apartment is bigger than the photos indicate,  very tastefully decorated, and was spotless on arrival. Yes, there is a very steep and long winding staircase to get to the flat, but that's the trade-off for staying in such a beautiful,  old, traditional location. The downstairs pubs do make it a bit noisy at night, but otherwise, it was a wonderful stay. We loved it. Thanks, Monique!
Toilet was very small and had a damaged window but everything else was good.
We had a great stay! I recommend

We stayed for a week over Christmas , very quiet flat, well located in a residential area in Leith, surrounded by great cafes, restaurants shops.
Walked a lot, but tram and bus services are making it very easy to explore the whole city.
Very responsive host, left us scones and biscuits and gave some recommendations for restaurants and shops, Welch Fishmongers in Newhaven 5⭐️
This was our 10th visit to Edinburgh, staying at Fiona’s flat made us feel almost like locals.
Highly recommend this place!

We really enjoyed our stay with Julia. She was very responsive and accomdating. The room was very clean and we especially loved the bathroom, there was so much space and the shower was wonderful. Great quiet area that was  close to the bus and a safe building too.
Thank you for everything.Your place is like heaven.Especially your garden.If we come to Edinburgh again your place is the main reason.💚

Wonderful place to stay.  Well appointed and comfortable in a central location to sights, shopping and dining.  Love the large windows and light.  Communication was easy and helpful.  Would highly recommend.

Michelle is a great host, very helpful and kind.
The flat is great, spacious and comfy. And very well located, with high standard shops and restaurants nearby.
I definitely recommend.

Appartement partagé avec 2 autres chambres : sdb et cuisine partagée, il faut avoir la chance d'avoir de bons colocataires (ce qui a été notre cas !).
Très propre. Chambre spacieuse et décorée simplement mais avec goût. Grand lit confortable.
Quartier calme et agréable au bord de la mer. 30 mn de bus pour aller dans le centre ville mais 3 lignes de bus possibles à 5 min à pied max, donc peu d'attentes aux arrêts. Bus spécial vers l'aéroport en 30 min, avec de la place pour stocker les bagages.
A cette époque de l'année (vacances d'été et Fringe Festival) où d'autres proposaient des dortoirs à 200 euros par personne, très bon rapport qualité-prix !
Très bon séjour, merci à Sirjana !

No Thrills,

Let yourself out
There not there to welcome you there not there to Assist,
TV remote didn’t work well,
Bed springs stick in your back,
Other then that it’s ok.
Couldn’t have asked for a better location in Edinburgh. Plenty to do within walking distance and beautiful sights all around. The host was quick to respond to any questions we had.

The whole experience of staying at Heather’s accommodation was amazing right from the time of booking! We went for daughters’ 30th birthday and to take family to the Military tattoo. Nothing was too much trouble for Heather even getting a birthday cake for our daughter! Lots of recommendations for restaurants, the place was in an ideal location and felt so homely! Heather was responsive throughout the whole experience and we would love to return!🥳

We had a fantastic 1 week stay at Finn’s cosy little flat. The surroundings in Dean Village are stunning, the flat is so warm and welcoming, the photos almost don’t do it justice it’s so nice! It felt just like home.
Kitchen and bathroom both really well equipped, lots of appliances too.
Finn was a lovely host, really friendly and welcoming, not to mention he gave us lots of great useful recommendations for the area.
We would come back for sure! Cannot recommend this place enough
A large apartment with comfortable beds but a good chance of disturbance during the night from revellers.
Well presented, stylish and clean apartment in a great location. I’d highly recommend!
Beautiful apartment, we absolutely loved our time at Julie's! There was a lot of contact from the team,  and any questions we had were responded to quickly.

Apartamento amplio, luminoso y tranquilo. Se corresponde con lo que anuncian. En los cuartos de baño no había toalleros y en el cuarto de baño de la habitación principal estaría bien que tuviese teléfono de ducha. El anfitrión respondía rápido. Un poco alejando del centro.
Tuvimos una estancia agradable.

We had a wonderful stay. The room was in a peaceful neighbourhood, yet not too far from the city centre. It was very clean and we had zero trouble with either the check-in or -out. A single point of feedback was the bed, which we experienced as uncomfortable.
The place was neat and clean. Still experience was good. It would have been good if kitchen was available. Location is good and nearby  Bus stops and grocery stores.

Alles bestens! 2 Schlafzimmer + ein schönes Wohnzimmer mit riesen TV und Wiii + gut ausgestattete Küche (inkl. Kaffeepads) + Wintergarten - Innenstadt und Strand super lit Bus erreichbar - gutes indiaches Restaurant und großer Supermarkt in der Nähe

David’s property was exactly as pictured on the website, there were no external photos so we didn’t know what to expect, the external was not what we expected but the locality and transport links were pretty good. We tended to take an Uber into the city centre which costed anywhere between £12 and £19 dependent on time of day. The house was great, garden needs some attention but looks like it’s being worked on. For reference the cutlery is in a drawer within the drawer below the hob!! Great weekend stay thanks David

Carol was responsive, property was not difficult to find and access was arranged. Bedroom was well prepared and brother David was helpful too. Bathroom was fairly clean but could do with a few more attention to cleanliness. Otherwise a good experience and restful night.

We had a wonderful stay in Edinburgh and couldn’t have asked for a better accommodation. The apartment was immaculate and beautifully designed, with every detail reflecting care and great taste. Lukasz was an exceptional host—warm, attentive, and genuinely thoughtful. He ensured we felt welcome from the moment we arrived and shared helpful tips on getting around the city and what sights to see.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Édimbourg. Le logement de Sylwia etait conforme à nos attentes et Sylwia a été une hôte très discrète mais réactive si besoin ! L’appartement est idéalement situé, propre et fonctionnel, en bref idéal pour un séjour de quelques jours !

We stayed here both upon arrival to Scotland and for our last night. The location is excellent, parking at the recommended car park was secure and easy to access. Travel time to the airport was minimal.
The flat is well appointed and comfortable, with great local recommendations.
Easy to explore the area on foot, with many main attractions at the doorstep.

Our stays with John could not have been more perfect. The room is bright and airy thanks to a massive window, the bed is very comfortable and the room and private bathroom are spotlessly clean. The breakfast is varied and indulgent, with lovely fresh fruits (we had strawberries and blackberries amongst other things!), every type of cereal you can think of, bread, croissants and various jams and spreads.
Moreover, John was beyond flexible and was able to sort every issue we might have: on both occasions, we were able to drop our bags early, pick them up later (enjoying a day of fringe after check-out), he allowed us to store our bicycles indoors overnight and allowed us to use his washing machine when our cycling gear needed a thorough wash. The maps and cycling guides we had erroneously left at home, were ordered again from Amazon and he didn't mind receiving them on our behalf and holding them for us.
And to top it all of, John is a very pleasant individual with whom we had many an interesting conversation ranging from local and global current affairs to practical tips on regional visitor highlights.
Excellent place for a long weekend. We were down for the rugby but it was a little further out than expected but that wasn’t anything on Paul’s side!

I booked this accommodation as a temporary stay for my son who was beginning college at Kings Buildings at University of Edinburgh. His student accommodation was a new build that wasn’t ready to move into at the beginning of college term. Miles and Morag facilitated our needs and went above and beyond to make my sons stay a welcoming and comfortable one, this being his first time moving from home. The apartment was only a five minute walk to his college building and also a short walk to the Cameron Toll Shopping Centre where there is a huge Sainsbury’s, Aldi, Argos, Subway, McDonalds and lots more. There is great access to bus routes in/out of the city. Miles and Morag were very informative and gave my son many recommendations for both the local area and the city. They were also in contact with me throughout my sons stay which was very reassuring to know that he was ok. The apartment itself is newly renovated and is very comfortable I would highly recommend this accommodation.

It was a lovely apartment.Dog friendly which was really important to us.A park just down the road for the dogs.Loads of bars and restaurants etc within easy walking distance.Would definitely stay here again
Great place and fantastic location
Very comfortable home in a private countryside location. Somewhat far from restaurants and shops but expected being in the country.
Nice home and perfect if you are more than 2/3. The place is nice and you can reach the city center in 30 minutes walking.
Perfect spot and place to explore Edinburgh from! Comfortable, warm and have everything we needed.
Nice cosy place a bit appart from the touristic neighboorhood but still really accessible since we didn't use the bus at all and walked around Edinburgh !
alles super!

Highly recommend this place, it’s quite central, the bus stand is right next to the place. The room is of good size and the bathroom is pristine and beautiful. The Wi-Fi is great and Bianca is a very nice host.

James' flat in Edinburgh is just perfect. It has everything you need for a pleasant stay, and is conveniently located in north Edinburgh. James was quick to respond and to sort out issues. Highly recommend!

Gerry was really nice and friendly! He was always available for any kind of problem or suggestion. However, I was expecting a different room and spaces compared to the reviews that I read, since, especially the common areas (toilette and kitchen) were not so clean and a really bad smell was present in all the apartment.

What can we say!!! Having usually stayed in hotels in Edinburgh when here for work this time we decided on an Airbnb given we would need to self cater. The apartment was absolutely fantastic and we didn't want to leave, warm, great views and excellent decor coupled with all the extra touches made it a trip to remember we are already planning a return trip.

Wonderful room in stunning house within great location. Few minutes from the centre yet so calm neighbourhood. Steve was prepared for my arrival and was responsive prior to it. He is friendly and helpful host with Charlie as adorable companion. Excellent choice, not even mentioning the price (wouldn't hesitate to pay more). Will definitely recommend to everyone that shall go to spend few nights Edinburgh.

stylish renovated apartment that completely lived up to our expectations
location very central
can only mention the apartment in positive tones.

We stayed for two nights. Angela made it easy for us to get there, easy access by bus or if you don’t need to carry heavy stuff around you might even walk from the city centre. The accommodation is also just round the corner from the beach.
The room was big clean and very quiet, the beds very comfy. It looked just like in the pictures. Sharing the bathroom was no problem as it was very clean, too. Angela had some great suggestions about what to do and where to go.
All in all, we had a lovely time and would definitely come here again.

Lovely place, very easy to get into the city, responsive host and overall a good experience. Only issue I faced was that for a family of 4, whilst the bedroom sufficiently accommodated 2 people, the sofa bed in the hall was not quite comfortable for 2 people (fine for 1, but opening it up for 2 was a bit of an issue as the pulled out bed kept falling off, though it didn’t affect us much as we stayed only for a night). Would recommend for 1-3 people or short stay for 4). Would book the place again if I travel in the future!

Absolut top.
Hier passt einfach alles: Lage, Ausstattung, Preis.
Sauber, ordentlich, gemütlich, kostenfreier Parkplatz vor der Tür, schöne Umgebung mit Restaurants, Supermarkt und Sehenswürdigkeiten. Gute Anbindung nach Edinburgh Zentrum (ca. 40 min. bis princess street mit dem Bus), mehrere Haltestellen um die Ecke.
Sehr hilfsbereiter und sehr freundlicher Gastgeber.
Eine der schönsten Unterkünfte unserer Rundreise.
Absolut empfehlenswert, wir würden definitiv wiederkommen!!

We enjoyed our stay. It met our expectations from Wendy's very detailed listing descriptions and previous reviews that mentioned some of the drawbacks (e.g. lots of stairs, slow drains, squeaky floors, smaller sized bed). The only significant disappointment was that the wifi was not working, and since we were there on the weekend there was no resolution for 2 of the 3 days we were there despite Wendy's best efforts to get service. She was quite apologetic about the situation. The apartment is very nicely decorated and so well located in the heart of old town, we enjoyed being in the middle of activities with most of the amenities of home. And when the double windows were closed it was pretty quiet and peaceful. I would definitely recommend it to anyone as long as you set your expectations according to the above mentioned caveats that are just part of the Old Town experience.
Great place.  location could not be better. Thanks.
Amazing location in a historic building - lovely modern flat!

A great place and an ideal location, near regular buses and a local shop nearby. The grandkids particularly enjoyed the hot tub!. Personally, I thought the couch was the most comfortable I've ever seen (my wife wants me to buy the same!). The house is very spacious and ideal for families. Next time I'm in Edinburgh, I would very much like to stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay at the property. It was centrally located, fantastically clean with all the amenity we could have required. There were plenty of suggestions for local food and the option of ordering some basic groceries before we even arrived. Truly fantastic. Thank you Trudi.

This stay is located perfectly in Stockbridge which is walking distance of everything: Stockbridge shops & restaurants, or over to the city centre. The flat was very well equipped with a nice big shower, spacious kitchen and washing machine. Check in was super clear and free parking on part of the street on the weekend!

Enjoyed our time here, the apartment is actually nicer than the pictures show, gorgeous views of the old and new town. Apartment was warm, clean, very comfortable. Has been renovated to a high standard, has everything you could want.
Water was turned off when we arrived but instructions were easy to follow to turn it back on.
Balcony access was confusing, says it’s not available on the listing but in the apartment there was a card mentioning you can go out there and it was also mentioned that you could as part of the pre check in instructions, but you can’t go out there.
Also think a 10am check out for a 4pm check in is very early, especially when there was still a bag of dirty laundry right outside the apartment door for our whole stay but we knew the check out time before booking. Wouldn’t stay again because of the 10am check out.
Rebecca’s team were very easy to deal with.

Le logement est bien situé, à mi-distance de l'aéroport et du centre-ville, et très facile d'accès, et propre.
L'environnement du logement est calme.
Gergena et Radoslav étaient très réactifs pour prendre des nouvelles ou proposer un service si besoin.
Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans cette magnifique ville.

We had a wonderful 4 days in Edinburgh. This was our second year coming to see the fringe and Louise couldn’t have been more helpful from booking all the way until leaving. Her guest house is beautiful, spotless and exactly as shown in the pictures. I loved the little touches like my name on the key when we opened the lockbox! Conveniently, there is a bus stop right outside which takes you to town in around 10 mins, and buses come every few minutes so no waiting. Would definitely stay again and will happily recommend to anyone looking for a place in Edinburgh. Thanks Louise for going over and above. We loved every second. Cat & Andy x
A beautiful property in a fantastic location, definitely one of the best we've stayed in

Wunderschönes Zimmer, man braucht ein paar Minuten in die Stadt mit dem Bus, dafür ist es schön ruhig. Die Gastgeberin ist sehr nett und unkompliziert , man fühlt sich wie zuhause ohne dass es sich merkwürdig anfühlt in einem fremden Haus zu wohnen.
Die Empfehlungen haben sich sehr gelohnt!
Rundum toller Aufenthalt!

There is a view as some of the other reviewers have mentioned but the windows are small and were dirty (on the outside) and I would say the view is more of a bonus rather than a deciding factor. The walls are quite thin, noise transfers easily, although the street noise didn’t bother us too much.
The check in process for this was quite extensive, had to fill out several documents to access the guest portal. You have to navigate from the Airbnb app to the guest portal for information. It was just a bit of a hassle.
The place felt clean upon arrival, the major stuff was clean (bathroom, linens) and overall it was clean enough for us to feel comfortable but the longer we were there the more we noticed the little details that had obviously been missed over time, dusty in several areas, corners in the bathroom had been missed, etc.
Nice place, nice location.
Great location with easy walking distance to the main attractions. Comfortable beds and well equipped.

I can't think of a better location. It's in Old Edinburgh, steps from Grassmarket Square, which has lots of places to eat and drink. And it's a short walk to the Royal Mile and lots of other sights, including the castle. Princes Street is about 12 minutes away on foot. To get there, first you walk up to the Royal Mile and then down. You'll do lots of walking up and down in Edinburgh. That's part of the charm. In fact, David's place is at the midway point of an alleyway. It was a haul wheeling two big suitcases and one carry-on from the train station to his place, though.
David's place is best for a single person or a couple. I stayed there with my daughter and discovered that David had missed my request for a second bed. I had to fashion one. The shower and Internet were good, though.
Not so good was the dryer. I wouldn't recommend having to dry clothes here.
A convenience store on Grassmarket Square sold wall plug-in adapters and umbrellas - both of which we needed.
You get great views of the castle from Grassmarket Square. And visiting the castle is a snap from the place - you just have to climb two sets of stairs.

Bel appartement chaleureux, à proximité de tout à pied.
Les lieux sont propres et tout y est pour un séjour agréable.

Appartement très bien situé, grand, lumineux et très propre. Une décoration moderne et chaleureuse. Communication facile avec Dunc et Dee. Merci pour les petites attentions !!!! Nous avons passé un séjour tres agréable et votre appartement y a contribué. Nous n'hésiterons pas à revenir chez vous !!!! Danielle, christophe et Eva

Really terrific apartment. Glenn is likely the most attentive host I’ve ever had. Extremely concerned about guest comfort and a first-rate communicator. The apartment is not only tastefully but curiously appointed. It’s clear the host has great aesthetic ideals and focus. A pleasure to stay and I would gratefully return.

Highly recommended. Lovely spot right next to castle. Very welcoming and accommodating hosts. Clean, beautiful and well equipped apartment. Fantastic welcome and communication throughout. A great stay.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans cet appartement, il y a plusieurs arrêts de bus juste a côté qui permettent de se rendre dans le centre de la ville en environ 30 minutes. L'hôte répond très vite à vos questions
Apartment was clean and easily accessible. Had everything that we needed for our stay. Warm and comfortable. Would stay again. Thanks Trudi.

I cannot recommend Zoryana's apartment enough. We've stayed in several Air BnBs in the past months and this is by far the most well-done. Zoryana was incredibly helpful and flexible, which was so nice for us because we were traveling outside of our home country. The beds were incredibly comfortable, the blinds made the bedrooms nice and dark, and the tub in the master bedroom was amazing. We have nothing negative to say about our stay here.
Enjoyable stay, suited to our needs. Harpreet was helpful and prompt in response to any queries.

Everything about the apartment was perfect - from the classical music playing on the radio when we entered to the Christmas tree and festive decorations. We had the most wonderful 4-night stay, and loved the bed in the box! Calim was a fantastic host, and I can't recommend his beautiful apartment enough!
Apartamento bem localizado, extremamente limpo e renovado.

Stylish flat in a great location, great amenities. The bed was extremely confortable and the premises very clean.
I strongly recommend for business stay if like me you are not fond of hotels, or for a romantic getaway.
A great host, and ideal location with Edinburgh a 20/25 minute walk away. Nice to be just off Leith Walk too. A good spot to stay for Edinburgh Fringe!

Super séjour à Édimbourg !  Le logement de John et Gail était parfait! Nous avons été très bien accueilli par les hottes! Ils ont toujours été à disposition au cas de besoin . Je recommande cet endroit!!!
Très bien situé , près de tout et silencieux . Bien équipé avec un four et laveuse.
Lovely flat. Plenty of space. Very clean. Comfortable beds. Close to buses. Excellent value. Would definitely recommend.

Rafaela was an excellent host, meeting us when we arrived and showed us around the apartment and how everything worked. A perfect apartment for a great trip!
Jonathan’s place was such a great choice! In such a great area, waking distance to everything. Would definitely stay there again. The layout is really great too, surprisingly huge!!

Perfect location, we found it easy to walk everywhere. Close to the city center and to Arthur’s Seat! Lovely homey feel and quiet, which was perfect to come back to after long days of walking around exploring.
Id recommend staying at this Appartment. It was very homely and clean. It was in a great location and had a really beautiful view of Arthurs seat too.
The place is beautiful!! You have buses that take you directly to the center of the city! Also, the communication with Anne-Marie was spectacular!
Great location and a very modern space! Loved our stay!

Great place, amazing view. Got a great sleep and the bathroom is fantastic! Get up early and grab a coffee so you can sit and look out at the castle and watch Princess Street come alive, you’ll love the place.

Jane was a great host that i ever had in all my air bnb experiences. She was so friendly and helpful! She has baked a very delicious cake for us, which was so kind of her amd thoughtful.
Home was so clean, and walking distance to everywhere. Very delightfully decorated house by Jane!
We felt like at home..
It was really nice to meet her and Sidney.
We would love to stay again on our next visit to Edinburgh :)

My stay at Michael‘s and Craig‘s place was amazing! They are really kind hosts and I felt very comfortable staying in their flat. The flat itself is clean, easily accessible and close to the center. All in all everything was great!

Nous avons passé notre dernière nuit en Ecosse chez Marion et tout a été parfait. L'appartement est impeccable, spacieux et confortable. Il est très bien situé (17 min à pieds de Waverley), et nous avons trouvé de bonnes adresses de resto autour. Merci pour votre accueil !
Sharon and her husband are very kind hosts with a lovely apartment to stay at!

This location far exceeded our expectations!  The place is much larger than the photos allow you to believe and it's in a perfect spot for walking access to nearly everything near the Royal Mile without being in the thick of the tourism and chaos. The place is in terrific condition with lots of natural light.  The rest of the building is very quite with only one tenant on the upper floor who we barely ever heard.  It was a restful and private retreat.  For light sleepers I recommend ear plugs as the noise from the few trucks that come down the road does reverberate due to the cobblestones.  That being said, it's been by far one of the best AirBnb experiences we've had to date!
Thank you for hospitality, lovely place . Would  be back for more next visit.
Excellent place in the heart of Edinburgh! There were 4 of us and plenty of room still. Ross was incredibly helpful and so kind even leaving us Whisky! Highly recommend this place. Thank you!

The place is really worth the value, it’s located well and not too far from anything.
Perfect place to spend after a day out exploring and a nice evening relaxed chilling with the tv, surround sound and jacuzzi tub.

All was perfect. Location, cleanliness, support, etc

todo de acuerdo a lo descripto, tenian detalles que hacian que te sintieras como en tu casa

Struttura nuova, dotata di ogni confort. La stanza era molto calda, non abbiamo trovato un termostato per la regolazione della temperatura interna. C’era un odore di cucinato che non è mai andato via nonostante la finestra aperta
AMAZING! Clean, lovely room as well as communal spaces and the staff were absolutely brilliant!!!! Hands down will be a repeat booking!
This is the BEST SPOT to stay for all the action on HIGH STREET in Edinburgh.  Excellent location, great view of events on the main street, lovely accommodations!

A lovely stay at Yvonne’s. The space was clean, comfortable and felt very welcoming. Yvonne was great at checking in and just very responsive overall. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend if you need a spot in this area
outstanding effortsto make our stay comfortable and enjoyable.   thx

Rachel is very helpful and responds quickly. This is one of the best places, and I highly recommend it.

The apartment is cosy, practical, beaufitul and really clean ! The area arount the apartment is really quiet but you can easily reach Haymarket by walk in around 10 minutes ! Jan is a very nice person who will make your stay perfect. Don't hesitate !

Comunicazione sempre rapida e alloggio facile da trovare, Chong e sua moglie sono stati molto disponibili. Ottima colazione inclusa nel prezzo.

Stuart's flat has an excellent location and it's close to absolutely everything (eg. Royal Mile, shops, pubs and so on). The place is well equipped and has all the ingredients for you to feel cozy...like your home away from home.
Lots of information available (about the flat and the city) and really good and fast communication.
5 * out of 5 * plus a bonus star for the goodies left.
Amazing location and the place with all the facilities. Clean and comfy.
Really comfortable beds!

We had a wonderful stay for our last night in Edinburgh. Ron and Linda‘s place was beautiful and extremely clean. The area was quiet and peaceful. We would definitely like to stay here again if we are so lucky to return.
Charming flat near the centre of the city. Had a great stay in a very clean flat, and the host was very friendly and very good at communication.

What an amazing apartment!
Super clean & tidy, spacious & the most perfect location!
Wonderful communication with Grant the cohost!

Beautiful flat in a lovely area of the city.  Everything was pretty much perfect.

My daughter and I chose Simon's place and it worked out perfectly.  It is on the tram and bus lines to the castle and also walkable (3miles).  Edinburgh is a fantastic town and Simon's place in the Shore proved to be  perfect location for us.

What can I say... beautiful apartment, great location- very close to city centre. Emily was extremely helpful and friendly. I would recommend it to everyone.
A beautiful room in a very fine location. No TV but that suited me.  Very quiet and comfortable.

We loved staying here, it was the perfect location to explore Edinburgh for a week. Eddie and David were great to work with and went above and beyond as hosts. We loved the flat and would stay here again if we’re ever back on the side of the world.

Location is a walkable distance to the train station and  older, historical part of Edinburgh.  Lovely!

A lovely apartment spotlessly clean. Wonderful location, home from home.

Overall, great value for what you get, and a great location!
Very tidy, clean and kind host!
It was a wonderful stay for us!  Highly recommend this flat for your stay in Edinburgh.
Beautiful modern house. Loads of natural light and plenty of space. A great location near the airport. Really friendly hosts. Spotlessly clean. Definitely recommend.

Hannah's a lovely lady,
Very helpful, relaxed and thoughtful.

Would highly recommend it!

We spent 20 days in the Fiona's apartment. The apartment is very close to the city center and very well connected by many bus lines. Fiona is a wonderful host. Overall, a great experience. Very very suggested

The staircase isn't the most welcoming but that aside, we had no issues at all with James's apartment and would happily stay again.
Lovely lovely location - clean and cute, very enjoyable stay!
Gordon was a excellent host.  Very  warm and welcoming Flexible attentive to our needs. Lovely breakfast

Lovely little place with all amenities. The bed is super comfy! Really lovely styling (it feels like the Scottish version of 'Hamptons' styling). Jolly is super helpful and great communication. I was sad to leave as It made me picture myself living in a cute little apartment in Edinburgh permanently.
Will definately use again when I'm in Edinburgh next time!

Clare is a fantastic host; very friendly, welcoming and helpful. The house itself is lovely and the kitchen is well-equipped, with a convenient shopping centre nearby within walking distance. Beautifully furnished place in a great, central location. I’d look at staying again my next time in the city.

It is a really close walk to the centre of Edinburgh or to head towards Arthur's Seat. We had a superb long weekend at the Fringe staying at Duncan's flat.
This is our first airbnb experience and it's been more than what we have expected. Thank you Selby for hosting us and we had such a great time in Edinburgh.
Really clean and nice place

Our stay at Angie was very pleasant, the cottage was tidy and located close to various public transport. Absolutely recommended!
