We would definitely recommend staying there :)

Valérie était extrêmement réactive et gentille. Le studio était parfait. De plus, Valérie avait laissé des petits snacks pour notre arrivée. C’est vraiment un logement que je recommande, que ce soit pour la localisation du logement (à seulement 20 minutes du centre en bus), pour la practicité du studio ou encore par la gentillesse de notre hôte. Je recommande vivemement.

We would definitely stay at Dunc and Dees place again.
The postion is just 2 minutes away from the Royal Mile and
well placed for getting around Edinburgh.
It has everything one needs for a very comfortable stay.
Super clean, a very comfortable bed , good kitchen.
We also enjoyed the very thoughtful gift of homemade shortbread and a bottle of
Prosecco on arrival.

There were 4 of us and the place is absolutely brilliant. Lots of space for everyone and we love how quiet it is at night. Richard is very friendly and have prepared everything we needed for the stay. There’s a Tesco express just round the corner where we can pick up stuffs to eat and drink. We took Uber to Princes Street everyday as our parents preferred to walk less and Richard’s place is easy to order Uber with reasonable price. There’s also a tram station very near to the house, it’s super accessible.
Very nice place for the price. Bathroom is very clean. Bed is comfy, and the coffee / tea station is well-stocked.
Merci pour la réactivité de Finlay, endroit très agréable :)
Thank you for accommodating us so last minute. Lovely flat in the centre, close to touristic attractions and restaurants. Will stay again if visiting Edinburgh.
Every thing is good but only the apartment is on third floor, we have to carry all baggage always from ground to third floor

DO Not Stay here. It was absolutely filthy. The cooker was caked with grease, bits of food and grime and was unusable meaning we had to eat out, the sofa bed had a condom wrapper in it,   the shower curtain is mouldy, the cutlery was dirty,the coffee cups were stained and dirty, the kitchen floor was dirty, saucepans had food baked in. We arrived and I had to spend 2 hours cleaning  given current Covid concerns a flat in this condition should not be being rented out. I contacted the management company (it is not "hosted" by an individual) the next morning as we had arrived at 10pm,and they made no offer to come and clean and just told me how they made their money. There is no customer service or concern for you as a guest. The location is noisy and the combination of this and the feeling of being somewhere that just wasn't clean made the trip a pretty miserable one.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans cet appartement avec ma fille de 15 ans. Le quartier est calme et sûr, ce qui était parfait pour nous. L’emplacement est idéal : à 5 minutes des cafés et restaurants, 10 minutes des commerces et arrêts de bus, et environ 20 minutes à pied du centre. Malgré cette proximité, le calme est absolu.
La vue sur Arthur’s Seat est superbe et la promenade juste derrière le bâtiment est magnifique, avec un accès direct à Holyrood Park. Le lit était très confortable et nous avons apprécié les petites attentions comme les produits de base à notre arrivée. Netflix a été un vrai plus pour nos soirées détente après de longues journées de marche.
Petit bémol avec l’eau chaude et la pression de l’eau, mais ça ne nous a pas plus embêté que ça.
Matthew est un hôte très réactif et attentionné. Merci pour votre accueil ! Nous recommandons vivement ce logement aux futurs voyageurs.

Sam's place was amazing and the backdrop of the hill made our stay special. The rooms were good size and we were provided by accessories if needed. The toilets were very clean and kitchen was spacious to sit inside. The location is very close to station and if you want a good place at reasonable price this is it.

So this is one of the few times that a place exceeded our expectations! The Airbnb listing isn't the most accurate - it states it's a studio apartment, free street parking, and the pictures are somewhat outdated. Luckily, the description told me there were 3 bedrooms. There's actually garage or resident parking, which was a big deal for us, and also the inside was fantastic! Very clean and comfortable, very spacious, lots of windows. The location was super quiet and peaceful, yet right in the city and very walkable! Can't recommend this listing enough!

Fabulous accommodation. Great location. We felt at home as soon as we walked in. Russell and Kirsty have thought of everything to make it comfortable. They were also very helpful at short notice when we had to arrive a day early. We will definitely return

Estuvimos un grupo para visitar a un amigo y conocer la ciudad. La localización cerca de la zona céntrica ofrecía todos los servicios, desde transporte a alimentación. Zona tranquila donde pudimos descansar muy bien. Todo muy bien preparado cuando llegamos y tal cual se anunciaba. Recomendable sin ninguna duda.

Great and very central place, everything in the city was within walking distance. The apartment was very clean and well furnished, a really nice and cozy space.
The one thing we were a bit disturbed by was noise during the night. The apartment is directly above a big bar which stays open until late and have some quite loud music coming in to the apartment. Noise from people walking in the hallway outside the apartment also comes through quite loud.
mark和bill很热情，刚到住所就为我们准备了咖啡。屋内干净整洁，与图片相符，客厅设计感十足，小狗很活泼和可爱，会与我们一起做球类活动，夜晚不会影响客人休息，可以放心入住。到市中心乘坐巴士15分钟左右路程，公交车站里住所3-5分钟走路路程。早餐是简约的英式早餐，配有酸奶和水果。总的来说是一个值得入住的地方，十分推荐，下次我到爱丁堡也会继续选择这个地方。

Rebecca is lovely, welcoming, friendly and so easy to talk to, great communication before and after booking. The flat is fantastic, great central location, so quiet at night, comfortable bed, brilliant garden which is so hard to come by and ideal for those barbecues! Such a warm, welcoming space and just a great apartment so thanks for having me!

It is really a pleasure to stay at Anna's place. She warmly welcomed us and is really friendly and eager to help. She is very attentive and the communication flows easy. Also, we really felt at home and could rest and sleep good.
No issues
All relevant informations have been provided. Suzann is very accommodating, the reception was very friendly, the rooms are bright and perfectly clean

Zoe's place was so perfect; in the center of all the action yet quiet & peaceful at the end of the busy day of shopping, eating, & site seeing. Clean, well stocked including towels, homey yet spacious & beautifully decorated. Easy instructions for arrival & check in. Do not pass this booking up!

Place was great. Perfect location to explore the heart of the city. Everything was as promised and hosts were there to explain all.
Certainly highly recommended

Patrick je skvělý hostitel, u kterého se budete cítit jako doma. Ráno nám přichystal menší snídani, s nadšením vyprávěl zajímavosti o Edinburghu a dal nám plno užitečných rad. Byl velmi pozorný. Ubytování bylo čisté, útulné a na velmi dobrém místě, vše máte na dosah ruky. Byli jsme tu moc spokojeni a rozhodně se brzy vrátíme!
Tudo era extremamente encantador, e o apartamento super limpo! Mariana é super comunicativa e simpática

This basement apartment (approximately 900 sq ft.) was very well appointed. It’s was very clean and well located. It was convenient to pretty much everything. The supermarket across the street was a major plus especially for a family such as ours. Kerrey and Jess were great in terms of their communication. After a day touring Edinburgh it was great to come back to nice and hot powerful showers. Both bathrooms had a great shower.  The place was very comfortable for a family of 4.
we are thankful for our whole stay. it was quite and peaceful. we enyoyed our 2 days stay. would definitely recommend to our friends and family.
Great host and super comfortable stay.
We had a very nice stay. The hosts were friendly, approachable and shared good tips and recommendations in Edin. Just a quick walk to city center makes the location perfect.
Great place. Lovely kitchen full of everything you need. Walkable to town and to the leith river walk. Bus stop also right outside. Would stay again!

Rowan’s apartment was in a great location in Edinburgh. Walkable with bus stops nearby to all the main attractions. The apartment was well equipped, spotless and very comfortable for a stay! We would definitely recommend.
Chambre chez l’habitant bien desservie par les bus pour aller en centre ville

We had such a pleasant time in Edinburgh, and Rachel's beautiful apartment only made it better because we had a nice home to come back to after tiring days out. We didn't get to meet Rachel during our stay, but prior to our arrival and departure, she sent us messages with really specific instructions so we didn't really have any doubts or questions about checking in and out. Her husband came to welcome us when we arrived, and he was really friendly, giving us a quick tour around the house and making sure we were aware of everything before he left. As hosts, they left instructions and even provided maps that helped in some last-minute planning. We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment, which was really well-equipped and just like what the description listed as well as what the photos shown (if not better). It had a very central and accessible location; places like the supermarket and (Haymarket) train station are a few minutes' walk away, and there are buses that go into the city centre and airport. It was like a temporary home and we would definitely not hesitate to go back if we were to visit Edinburgh again. Thank you for sharing with us your lovely apartment.
Fantastically spacious and well-appointed apartment. Location is excellent with the city centre within easy walking distance.
Once we got the picture of the key lock, no problems. ❤️

Loved loved loved! The apartment was clean and beautiful! It was perfect for 6 people. Ilona was very quick to response and very accommodating. Best airbnb ever! We would definitely stay here again if returning to this city.
The place had an incredible location, the flat was tidy and clean. The hosts were flexible and very communicative. Would highly recommend!

We loved our stay here. The apartment is spacious, updated, in a very quiet neighborhood but very close to the old town. Parking took some time, but we were able to find spots both nights. 10/10, would recommend.

Although located opposite a small retail park, the location was very quiet. 30 minutes walk to the centre of Edinburgh. Property was easy to find, excellent instruction, well equipped and ideal for a couple of night's stay. The only niggle was the shower kept tripping out, otherwise perfect. Would happily recommend.
Great venue right in the middle of the University campus. Easy access to most of Edinburgh's sites and venues.

Loved the floral and plant full backyard. It was so picturesque I loved it.
We had an issue with getting hot water and the hosts were responsive immediately and helped walk us through how to make a quick fix.
The bus routes were not hard to get to and we had a few options. Only 20 min bus ride from old town which was perfect.
Super cute and clean place and loved having a wash machine to clean up our travel clothes
Grand appartement lumineux idéalement situé

This is a lovely central location with everything within walking distance (we didn't use our car at all!) and nice shops and restaurants locally. Pauline and Mike are warm, welcoming and very helpful but respectful of their guests privacy. Great communication throughout as well.

We really enjoyed our stay here. East Rigg Lodge is beautiful, with stunning views accessible from the deck, and inside the house, perfect for relaxing. The outdoor space, complete with the unique bathtub and comfortable seating, made it feel extra special.
We felt very welcomed on arrival with fresh croissants and scones, which was such a delightful touch. Mitch, the host, was warm, responsive, and quick to answer any questions, which made everything easy and stress-free.
A highly recommended place and will definitely come back again. ❤️

Perfekt boende för vår familj med närhet till sevärdheter, restauranger och nöjen. Har alla bekvämligheter du behöver och känns riktigt fräscht.
-kan verkligen rekommendera
appartamento a piano terra in una zona molto tranquilla. completamente arredato con tutto ciò che serve per un breve soggiorno. consigliato !

Alison and Craig gave us a very warm welcome. The location of the flat is great and the flat itself is very lovely and made us feel at home. Upon arrival, we received some shortbread and some breakfast stuff was also available which was great. We very much enjoyed our stay at the Royal Mile Retreat.
really enjoyed staying at Shona's : very hospitable, friendly, helpful and knowledgeable

Fiona was a lovely and accommodating host with quick and friendly communication. The apartment was very clean, tidy and cosy - a perfect space for one or two people. Location is about 15 mins walk to Hollyrood and the bottom of the Royal Mile. Only downside is that you can hear the upstairs neighbours’ footsteps and voices easily so you may want earplugs if you are a light sleeper.

Facilities exactly as described,  very clean and tidy and great ensuite bathroom. Nice area with handy (and frequent)  public transport to the city centre. Hospitality+ very friendly and helpful on check-in.
We had a wonderful stay. Jennifer was super helpful and responsive. The flat is quiet, private, and peaceful. Highly recommended.
My stay at Hilary’s was my first Airbnb experience as well as my first trip to UK. It couldn’t have been better!

Sona's appartement was sparking clean, and Sona had prepared everything so that we could cook our own english breakfast on the morning. The children were fond of the games and the location is next to a bus stop that goes straight to the center, so this place is perfect for exploring the city with kids! Thank you Sona!
Great accommodation, the place looked exactly like the photos presented — it was very cosy and quaint. There is a co-op down the road and the Airbnb is a 15min walk away from the main Princes Street.
It  was lovely place and lovely holiday for us. Definetly I recommend for everyone who wants to spend amazing time 😊

The loft is on top of a garage. location is good. 20min walking distance to city centre. The place itself is new and clean. the host is responsive.
However, the cleansing company they use is not very good. the towels and bed linings are not clean. There is blood on the towel and on the quilt cover.

Nichola is a very responsive, friendly and helpful host. The place is nice and clean as well. Location is walkable to every attraction and easily accessible to public transportation. Highly recommended!

Stuart's apartment is lovely, very well located and very easy to live in. We have been travelling with two babies and our stay couldn't have been better, for them and for us.  Stuart has been extremely helpful and welcoming. And the price is really good too :) This is one of my best airbnb experience. I warmly recommend!

Bon séjour, l’appartement est fonctionnel, mais un peu éloigné du centre-ville et partagé avec la propriétaire, avec qui nous avons surtout échangé un Bonjour 😅. Lors de notre séjour en Écosse, nous avons particulièrement apprécié les Highlands, ainsi que l’accueil et la gentillesse des Écossais. En terminant notre séjour à Édimbourg, et après l’accueil de Katarzyna, nous étions finalement contents de rentrer chez nous.
This is a beautiful room and made for a relaxing couple of nights.
Lovely quiet secluded place in the heart of the New Town.

L'appartement est très bien situé à quelques pas du centre ville et dans un très joli quartier. Merci à Fiona pour nous avoir permis de déposer notre valise plus tôt et la récupérer plus tard le jour du départ. Je conseille ce logement à Édimbourg
Liam was friendly and the accommodation was in an area within walking distance to the city centre...just a 30/40 minute walk to the main centre or the sea front.
Fantastic location, and also very quiet. A gem of a place in the centre of Edinburgh

Daniela's home is regal, and extremely comfortable.  The area feels very safe and Daniela was always a text away. I do wish we'd stayed a few more days, to enjoy the city and house more. I'd definitely return and definitely recommend.
The location of the flat could not have been better. Great restaurants and coffee right outside our door.  Definitely worth it!  Iain was always helpful and responsive.

Great place- spotlessly clean, very quiet, warm, and comfortable. Agnes was a wonderful and friendly host during my stay and her communication ahead of my arrival was excellent. Brilliant location with good links into the city too. Highly recommended!

Dean war sehr zuvorkommend und hatte sofort viele Tips für die Stadt genannt.
Toller Gastgeber!! ja
This is a perfect place to stay if you're looking for convenience and comfort in the heart of Edinburgh.
Great place, clean and very good space, en-suite, small fridge was a good surprise and super host who cares

Viv and Paul's Grassmarket Approach flat was everything we'd hoped and more! The flat was clean and tidy when we arrived, and very comfortable for our party of three. The location is perfect. We had no problems accessing the apartment, and thoroughly enjoyed out stay in Edinburgh. I highly recommend this spot, and will definitely consider it for my next visit to Scotland!
房间特别漂亮温馨，有宾至如归的感觉。交通方便，设施齐全。房东还贴心的准备了牛奶和面包。下次有机会会再来。
Fantastic. Best place we stayed at for our holiday in the UK.

We had a fantastic and relaxing stay right in the heart of the city. The flat is spacious and beautifully decorated. It’s also equipped with every mod con. The location is brilliant for sightseeing round Edinburgh. Anna and Ian were super helpful hosts- especially when I was having a moment with the key box! We’d thoroughly recommend and hope very much to return.

Die Unterkunft war super gelegen. In nur 12 Minuten war man mit der Tram in der Stadt. May hat auf alle Fragen schnell geantwortet und wir konnten sogar etwas eher einchecken.
Für Edinburgh war die Unterkunft verhältnismäßig günstig.
Leider war im Badezimmer an der Decke und in der Duschwanne sehr viel Schimmel, was uns sehr gestört hat. Deshalb können wir leider keine bessere Bewertung vergeben.
Hanne was so helpful with all practicalities and gave us great advice on what to do in Edinburgh. The location is perfect, and the flat cosy. Highly recommended!
I never write reviews but had to for this place, it’s excellent in every way; super clean, lovely furnishings, great location. Very impressed.

Very nice apartment. Fiona’s daughter who lives there was also very nice. It’s also a nice location. This part of leithwalk has a lot of little shops and restaurants. But since the room is out the back it is very silent inside.

Quiet neighbourhood, close to the sea, and got a different view of Prince St. on my way to there. The room was lovely!
It's a pity I was busy sightseeing, otherwise I would choose to spend more time in Eleanor's beautiful garden with the chickens & the cat. ❤️
The room is nice and clean. There are great pubs and restaurants in the vicinity. Susan was really attentive and caring although web have not met her during our stay.
Very good value for the price ! The location is perfect and we enjoyed the discount at the bar ! The room got a good size and all the flat is very cute !
The staff has been extremely helpful. The position was perfect to visit Edinburgh old town and the cleanliness was spotless, which is very important especially during these uncertain times

Muy recomendable!! Excelente ubicación! El departamento muy limpio y cómodo.
La cocina muy bien equipada!
Las camas muy cómodas!
Tiene de todo ! Hasta el detalle de dos paraguas para usar en caso de lluvia.
Lo súper recomiendo
Really great space, everything as described and even a few extras thrown in. Steve was great and really helpful. Had a great stay!

I had a delightful stay at Rentir's Airbnb in Edinburgh. The location was perfect, offering easy access to the city's attractions and public transport. The neighbourhood was peaceful, ideal for relaxation.
Rentir's place was exceptionally clean and well-maintained. Every essential was provided, ensuring a comfortable stay. The bed was notably comfortable, contributing to restful nights.
Rentir excelled as a host with efficient communication and a focus on guest comfort. The check-in and check-out process was smooth, thanks to clear instructions.
Overall, Rentir's Airbnb is highly recommended for a comfortable, convenient stay in Edinburgh. Whether for short or longer visits, it's an excellent choice. Thanks, Rentir, for outstanding hospitality!

The house was lovely and very clean! A great location for getting around the city as there is a bus stop right outside. Family friendly with stair gates, cot, highchair, kids dishes, and even a special little gift for our little one. We had everything we could need!
Aardig personeel maar niet altijd aanwezig. Dan wel duidelijke instructies wat je moest doen

absolutely central location in Edinburgh, 2 min walk to Grass market (Sunday market ), 5 min walk to the castle or else you can take a longer route via royal mile if you don't wanna clime the steps.  everything is there in the house and  very convenient. also a supermarket within 2 min walk. great experience!

I, along with 3 friends, stayed at Karen's place one night during a visit to Edinburgh. The best thing about our experience was actually Karen herself! She's an energetic, funny and generous host who welcomed us with warmth (although we came in rather late) and showed us every detail of the apartment, as well as recommandations for sights and nightlife in the area.
The apartment is huge and accomodates 4 people without any problem (2 twin beds, 1 double bed, 1 convertible sofa) - the kitchen is also huge, clean and well equipped. Looking out the window you'll have great sights on the Castle! Only the warm water flow in the shower could be improved.
Location, location, location! Karen's place is steps away from Victoria Street, where you'll find great pubs, and the Royal Mile where all the sites worth visiting are. If you want to get to the other side of the Castle (bus and train station, Parliament, clubs etc...) it's only 10mn away by foot.
Overall a great experience, we will come back, thank you!
Amazing apartment, great location and great instructions and info from the host.

Very unhelpful host. Rude and condescending when answering messages, felt like he just didn’t care! Smelly stairs, grubby house grubby smelly bathroom. I would not recommend at all. Nothing like the picture!!!!!!

Habitación ordenada y limpia. Cama amplia y cómoda, cuenta un clóset y baño dentro de la habitación, el baño está amplio y limpio. Muy buena atención por parte del anfitrión nos dejó todo para preparar café.
Todo muy bien.
Great stay! Wonderful host communication and very convenient location.

Wee Palace is just that. A superbly decorated apartment on Grassmarket , just below the Royal Edinburgh castle. Being a top floor apartment , this provides fabulous views of the castle from the very comfortably appointed living room. . The Bedroom faces a courtyard so it is quiet at night. Douglas has left everything you could need for a fabulous stay. A folder provides local information including favourite restaurants and suggested activities. At your door step there is a plethora of restaurants , pubs and markets. Tourist attractions are a stones throw away. Brilliant location.
This apartment is truly stunning. If you can...Book It.
A really great stay at Jennifer’s place, she was very accommodating and the location and facilities were superb. Would 100% recommend!
This was perfect place to rest and explore after a long flight

This  apartment exceeded our expectations.  Locations was perfect, view of the castle lovely, quiet in the back in the bedroom with a serene view of a blooming tree.  Bed was great, and kitchen had everything we needed.  Instructions in the apt were excellent as well.  Would highly recommend this place right in the heart of Grassmarket Edinbourgh

Lovely flat in a perfect location, very central. Super clean and well equipped, comfy beds. Michelle was very helpful in letting us drop bags prior to checkin. Only issues were a wobbly toilet seat in the second bathroom, and instructions for the hob would be good as although I have one at home we still struggled!

Janet is one of the most hospitable people we've ever met!  We arrived after a very long day on trains from London and were so hungry - she greeted us with such warmth and suggested the most fantastic Thai place within walking distance.  Her place is spacious and the bathroom is awesome.  Many thanks to Ian as well for his helpful advice during our checkout.
John es muy amable y responde muy pronto. La casa tiene de todo y la zona es inmejorable, muy cerca de princess street y un centro comercial.
Nice apartment, I recommended

아주 좋습니다!
시내에서 걷기에는 조금 멀지만 버스 타면 10분안에 가능하고 집 바로 앞에 버스정류장 여러대가 있으며 버스도 여러대가 다닙니다!
명심해야할 것은 호스트 커플의 집에 있는 여러 방 중 한 방과 그들의 화장실을 공용으로 사용해야한다는 점입니다
그들은 매우 친절하고 스윗합니다! 정말 깨끗한 숙소이며 전기장판도 마련되어있습니다 :) 시내중심에서는 20분 정도 걸어야한다는 점, 호스트와 같은 공간에서 생활한다는 두 가지 점이 상관없으시다면 강력 추천합니다

Couldn't have asked for a better location. So central! The negative is that there was some street noise at night, but this will always be the case in a city centre. Great value for money and would definitely stay here again. Katie was also really helpful with info beforehand and helped to make our short stay hassle free! Thanks :)

Derek & Isaac are superb hosts, pre-trip communications were timely, friendly & generous. List of restaurants, activities, bars, pubs, breakfast places made trip planning simple & managed expectations.
Loved tasteful & comfortable interiors esp comfy sofa & king size bed in main bedrm. Shwr pressure great & home heating fast. Our favs abundance of absorbent fluffy towels, 3 ply toilet paper & good quality bed linen. Washer & dryer & dishwasher all new high end appliances a joy to use. Didn’t prepare meals but all needed right there.
If you’re looking for a high end property in an unbeatable walkable Old Town location with caring thoughtful experts in the Edinburgh scene then book in. As couple of seasoned travellers this has been our best airbnb experience yet. Derek kept in touch during our trip & responded to questions promptly with humour. It was like having a friend in new city who let you live in his glam house & told you where you should go in order to have the best time.
Very calming and clean environment. Very kind and had a great stay

Très joli appartement situé à 2min à pied du Royal Mile.
La chambre convient tout à fait.
Arrivée et départ facile.
Perfect location. We were there during the Fringe, and the apartment is situated in the middle of it all, yet tucked back far enough that you don’t hear street noise. Lynne was a great host.

Very nice place within walking distance of the main parts of the Edinburgh old town/new. Very nice host, helpful and responsive. Would definitely stay here again when visiting Edinburgh, no complaints or issues with anything, great host/place!
awesome location and very good apartment.
Confortable and very clean flat. Great host, very helpful and responsive. We had a wonderful time
great location with a reasonable price.

This is the best hostel I’ve stayed in. The facilities are clean, the pod bunks feel very private and the location is amazing- in the heart of Old town Edinburgh. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to explore this amazing city/part of the world.

Perfect flat right in the thick of Old Town! Even though it is in a very busy area (especially in the summer) the flat itself is tucked away and remarkably quiet for relaxing at the end of a long day of sight seeing. Look no further! You’ve found the perfect spot.

Sonia & Chris were very organised and accommodating. They provided an insiders guide of things to do in Edinburgh which was really helpful! The flat was exactly like the images and the perfect place for two. The location is walking distance from all attractions and really easy to get to from the airport using the bus. We would definitely recommend staying here!

This was a very nice and modern flat. Very well positioned, although quite noisy at night, but that is a trade off. We loved, that we could go back to flat for a short rest, before the next visit to a sight.
I would have loved to stay more days to enjoy this place, but we had to continue the trip in Scotland.

Fantastic location, could walk everywhere I needed to and there is a lot of great restaurants, bars and cafes around.
Rory was very communicative and proactive. Instructions were very clear.
The room is private and secure and in a flat with 3 more bedrooms. Access to the bathroom and kitchen was easy.
Very good place for a quick one night stay for a larger party.

Stayed for two nights with five of my friends and everything was perfect! It seemed to be so spacious with loads of natural light despite being a basement apartment.
The kitchen was very well stocked, with pots and pans and many crockery and cutlery available. It was also incredibly clean and comes with a coffee machine.
The beds were incredibly comfortable, with clean sheets and luxurious pillows.
We did have a problem with the sofa bed, however, but one of the co-hosts was incredibly quick to respond and fixed the issue in an hour, which we really appreciated.
The instructions for leaving were incredibly clear and did require us to do a million things - just simple things like ensuring all rubbish is in the bin and putting things back where they were.
Leon was also very kind enough to turn the heating on before we arrived, and ensured there were six towels and six chairs around the table.
Would definitely stay again during my next visit!

Peter hat uns sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit empfangen. Die Wohnung entspricht den Fotos und der Beschreibung genau und man fühlt sich sofort wohl. Es ist alles vorhanden was man braucht. Wir waren zwei Erwachsene und zwei Kinder. Dafür ist das Schlafsofa etwas eng. Man kann in 20-30 Minuten zum Castle  laufen und ist dann direkt in der Altstadt. Wir hatten drei wunderbare Tage und können es absolut empfehlen.

We had a fantastic stay at Kathy's place in Edinburgh. The location has good connectivity to the city center and public transport just steps away. Supermarkets and shops are conveniently nearby, making it easy to grab essentials. The apartment was clean and equipped with all the amenities as described. Kathy is an great host—responsive, and always quick to communicate, ensuring a seamless experience. I would highly recommend Kathy's place to anyone visiting Edinburgh.

Great place to stay! It was very clean and comfortable as well as aesthetically pleasing. Would book agin if ever in the area.

The flat is also a short walk from Arthur's seat, which is great to hike up on a clear day.
