Francesca is a wonderful host with a lovely home filled with colourful and unusual original art. There are so many thoughtful touches to make your stay as comfortable and convenient as possible I can’t list them here, but rest assured if you’re wondering “how will I...?” Francesca will have though of a way to make it as easy and as obvious as possible. It really captures the feeling of staying in a friend’s place when said friend is away. It’s a few minutes’ walk to the bustling Leith Walk and thus Edinburgh’s fantastic bus system. I can’t recommend this place enough and we’ll definitely stay here again.

We stayed at 1 Broughton Market during Christmas week and it was honestly one of the best decisions I made for this trip. The location is excellent — just a short walk to the tram station, which made travelling to and from the airport completely seamless. It’s also surrounded by cafés, shops and a mall, so getting food and doing quick shopping with my kids was effortless.
The Joivy team esp Mina, deserves special mention. They were very helpful and responsive, when we had an issue with a locked door, they replied within minutes and even sent a technician to fix it right away. That level of support really gave me peace of mind.
I noticed a comment in another review about the dumpster nearby, but in reality it wasn’t an issue at all. The area was clean, rubbish was collected early in the morning, and it didn’t disturb us in any way.
Overall, it was a lovely, stress-free stay, and I would definitely choose this unit again when I return.

Alan est un hôte trés sympathique et accueillant... Son logement est super bien implanté et Alan reste trés disponible et réactif pour toutes demandes. Il sait aussi se faire trés discret dans l'appartement qui est situé dans un coin trés calme et verdoyant (vue sur parc appréciable).
Logement et hôte à recommander....
Great location within walking distance of tourist attractions, bars, shops & restaurants. It was perfect for three couples for the weekend. The pool / table tennis was a nice added extra.

We had a really lovely stay at this apartment in Edinburgh. The location is fantastic, right in the centre and within easy walking distance of many attractions, which made exploring the city really convenient.
The apartment itself is spacious, well-equipped, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The host was excellent, very responsive, friendly, and accommodating. We especially appreciated the flexible check-in, which made our arrival much smoother.
Overall, we had a great experience and would happily recommend this place to others.

Wir haben uns in Carlas kleinem Cottage sofort sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung entspricht den Fotos und der Beschreibung. Wir fanden die kleine, hübsch bepflanzte Terrasse mit Blick auf den großen Garten besonders schön, hier haben wir abends gern noch ein wenig die Sonne auf der Bank genossen.
An nicht so warmen Tagen ist es schnell gemütlich warm. Die Küche ist mit allem ausgestattet, was man so benötigen könnte.
Wir haben prima geschlafen, die Matratze ist sehr bequem.
Die Lage in Crammond ist toll. Eine Bushaltestelle ist direkt in der Nähe, zum Weg am Fluss sind es nur ein paar Schritte und von dort ist man in wenigen Minuten am Strand. Dort haben wir gern abends noch einen Spaziergang gemacht.
Carla hat uns prima Tipps gegeben und wenn wir dürfen, kommen wir sicher gern noch einmal wieder.
Lovely house which has a lot of modern aspects to it. Communications excellent and it’s nice for a wee break away. Local tips for food places welcome.

Nuestra estancia ha sido simplemente increíble. La casa es súper agradable, estaba impecablemente limpia y cuidada hasta el último detalle. No se escuchaba absolutamente nada de ruidos, lo que hizo que el descanso fuera perfecto.
Las camas son comodísimas, con ropa de cama de calidad, y además encontramos todo lo necesario en los baños: champú, gel, crema corporal… incluso el aroma de la casa era acogedor, con flores frescas y muy agradable.
La cocina está totalmente equipada con todo tipo de menaje, lo que nos permitió cocinar como en casa. La ubicación no podría ser mejor: cerca del centro, muy bien comunicada y con una calle al lado llena de servicios de todo tipo.
Fue muy flexible con respecto a la hora de entrada y salida de la casa, lo que ayudó mucho a la logística con la familia, ya que íbamos con dos niños pequeños.
En resumen: hemos estado exageradamente bien, no se puede pedir más. ¡Sin duda, la recomendaría a cualquiera!
Great place to stay. It is close to Haymarket station and there are lots of restaurants in the local area.
It was a great experience and I highly recommend this nice place.
Lovely place, very clean and extremely comfortable. Fantastic communication from Ivy throughout, although, I would suggest trying to get the whole flat and not just the double room.

Highly recommended! Jer is very accommodating as he allowed early checkin and late checkout. The room is quite large but still warm, and with welcome flowers, fruits and goodies! The toilet is also very clean. The place is located in a quiet charming neighborhood, very near the city center and parks. Will definitely go back.

Le logement de Doreen est très facilement accessible par le train ( ce que j'ai fait=30 minutes environ) car l'arrêt de bus est situé juste en face de son appartement. Il est également pratique si l'on vient où que l'on va à l'aéroport car l'arrêt est à 5 minutes à pied.
Doreen est une hôtesse accomodante et serviable ,toujours souriante et disponible. La présence des chats est un bonus😉.

Stayed here for business - great to have my own space and all of the amenities Selena had provided such as milk, cereal, chocolate snacks etc - there's also a large supermarket across the road.  Everything worked really well and would definitely be happy to stay again.

A wonderful place for a late Christmas family gathering. Suited us very well for 4 staying and 3 joined us to dine and relax and for walks in nearby Blackford hill.  An easy wander from the house with stunning views even in a wild wintry day.
We had a lovely stay! The room is so beautiful  and the airbnb is located on a perfect place, just outside the tourist area. Very good value for money.
房间非常大，设施也很新。入住方便，很适合一家人出行
We loved our stay at Mark’s place, a really lovely apartment with everything you could need and about a mile along the river to the outskirts of the old town. Highly recommended!
Virkelig flot og rummelig lejlighed med god rumindeling. To gode badeværelser. Flot udsigt og virkelig flot lysindfald.

Great appartment, completely new and close to everything in Edinburgh. The owner bought us coffee and water so it is a nice welcome. Edinburgh castle is 2 min away. Would recommend this apartment to anyone.

Al and Ali were away on holiday, but their niece Katy was a gracious and friendly host.  The coach house is probably the nicest airbnb I have stayed in--fashionable and clean--while Ali and Al fully equipped it with coffee/tea/cereals/OJ and delicious bread and jam.   Only about a mile from the royal mile and museums, easily walkable but buses are available.  5 stars all around!

We had a wonderful stay at Daniel’s place for three days. The location is very convenient—just a 10-minute walk to the Royal Botanic Garden and around 20–30 minutes on foot to the city centre. There’s everything you might need nearby, including convenience stores and plenty of great spots to eat or grab a drink.
The house was spotlessly clean, and the kitchen was well-equipped with a good variety of utensils.
One thing to keep in mind is that the room is located directly above a bar, so it can get a bit noisy at times. However, we didn’t find it particularly disturbing.
Overall, I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking to enjoy their stay in Edinburgh.

Situated right on the Royal Mile, the location is excellent. The directions Mark provided on AirBnB were very clear, so the place was easy to find. The bed was comfortable and the room kept us warm even on the cold, windy nights. Mark was very pleasant and was able to provide lots of advice about where to go and what to see. Basic food was provided so we could help ourselves to breakfast at any time. My girlfriend and I had such a pleasant stay that we got engaged during our visit! Recommendations don't come much better than that.

Vi var strålende fornøyd med å bo hos Graig og Holly. Leiligheten var sjarmerende og har en sentral beliggenhet med gangavstand til det meste. Det ligger flere spisesteder like i nærheten, så vi valgte å spise alle måltider ute. Graig hadde flere gode anbefalinger i så måte.
Vi synes leiligheten var helt perfekt for en storfamilie på tur og vi savnet ingenting.
Merci à Christine pour son accueil. Tout était parfait. Je recommande vivement ce logement!

A great place to stay, just a few bus stops away from the Old Town, and yet in a very quiet and peaceful surrounding. The way how Louise prepared the flat and how practical her tips were for the stay, make it definitely worth it. Many thanks for everything!

This small one bed flat had everything needed for a city break in Edinburgh. Centrally situated on the Long Mile. The accommodation is neat and clean and well equipped, comfortable sofa and bed.
We really liked the quiet and rear garden view.
A great few days being tourists in this lovely city.
Alison was welcoming and helpful when we arrived after a long train journey. Thanks Helen

Had a nice stay here. Room was clean, bed really comfy. If you have a car with you, you’d have to pay £12 for 4 hours 5.30 - 8.30 which was a bit annoying but the apartment is central so understandable.

The apartment is in the most amazing location, situated on the Royal Mile, opposite the cathedral, meaning the castle is a 2 minute walk away!
Plenty of bars, restaurants and activities located round the corner and within walking distance.
Apartment is compact with everything you meed for a comfortable stay, absolutely 1000% recommend 👌🏻

Ho soggiornato nella stanza di Baz per due notti con mia sorella, ci siamo trovate molto bene, stanza molto carina e pulita
Posizione comoda, a circa 15 minuti a piedi dalla stazione di Waverley e proprio sotto a Holyrood Park.
Baz molto disponibile e veloce nelle risposte!

My stay at Jer's place was nothing but pleasant and nice. It was absolutely easy to communicate before my stay, Jer was flexible with my arrival and very welcoming throughout my whole stay.
It was actually the first AirBnB I stayed at that did offer the Breakfast as part of the stay. The flat was as clean and nice as in the pictures. Even though part of Jer's flat, I enjoyed the privacy of my room and bathroom at all times.
Jer was very polite but also accessible - he gave me great tips and it was very nice to have a little chat every now and then.
Finally, the flat is very close to everything you want to see in Edinburgh. All in all: a great stay!

My family of four really enjoyed our stay here. It is so charming and is much larger than it appears in the photos. We used the fireplace and it was so cozy. It’s also just a short walk to restaurants, coffee, and convenience stores. Highly recommend a stay here!

Good value and very quiet area. Easy check-in. Good bus connection to the city center (High Street only ~10 min by bus and walking only 25 min, with lots of shops to check out for a late night dessert. Plenty of street parking around (free most of the time, except 10-11:30am, M-F!)
ok ok ok
Really good!
Tony and his co-host communicated very well. Their accommodation is very comfortable and in an excellent location. It is great value for money we would certainly recommend it. Thank you, Chris.

We felt so lucky to have found Anji’s little gem in Edinburgh. The apartment is both spacious and cozy, spotlessly clean, and equipped with everything you could possibly need. On top of that, staying in such a beautiful historic house made it even more special. We loved every minute of our stay — thank you, Anji!

excellent location, walked literally everywhere in the city. sparkling clean, had all we needed. Fleur was very responsive & helpful before & during our stay, especially in allowing late check out + luggage storage. she was also super helpful when we needed the heat turned down due to an unexpected hot spell! would definitely stay again.

This apartment is something extra! It’s so cozy, it’s exactly like the pics and even better. Super clean. Very quiet. The sleep was awesome! The surroundings are beautiful, the beach is literally a 3 min walk from the apartment.
Callum answered straight away and was helpful. The instructions and the tips on what to do while in Edinburgh was super helpful! Thanks Callum! Hope we get the chance to come back some day!
We couldn't have been happier here - great hosts, perfect location and beautiful apartment! Would definitely recommend and stay here again :)
Great flat, so many little touches making it feel homey. Would definitely stay again!

Alison and her husband were great host. They made everything they could to make this trip a great moment for me and my friends.

We received a warm welcome when we arrived in Edimbourg and they helped us to find the place. They took the time to advise us some addresses and sightseeing to do.

The apartment was as described and the location is good.

I highly recommend a stay at Alison’s apartment.

Boris

lovely space to stay with family. close to Edingburgh and located in a lovely area with bars and restaurants to enjoy.
Cody was extremely helpful with instructions prior to arrival and was more than understanding when I accidentally broke a shelf in the fridge!
All in all it was a fantastic stay! Thanks Cody!

staff was very friendly and helpful. Room was as described. Enjoyed all my roommates. Everyone was super nice and had helpful tips as well. We were able to meet at breakfast across the street at Belishe. Bring a water bottle! fill up station was a great add.

This place had absolutely perfecr location with transport options right outside and only 20 minutes from the airport by bus.
Buildings in Edinburgh (and Scotland in general) are old and have their own specificities which should be expected - rooms are cold due to high ceilings and air flowing through even closed windows; bathroom was clean within reason and abilities of the host (again, old building so it can’t look like a new hotel). We had everything we needed, mattress was comfy and duvet kept us warm. Would absolutely recommend.
We loved our time here!!!

Rich & Will were excellent hosts, made us feel so welcome and happily answered any questions we had. They have such a lovely home, it was spotless and really cosy, and handy to city centre as well as buses and trams. The facilities were second to none and the breakfast foods were a lovely touch, just like the visitor and apartment guide, which we found extremely helpful. Toby was a wee dote and definitely the highlight of the stay! We would 100% recommend staying with Rich & Will and we'd love to stay again:)

I had a great over night stay here, it was just what I needed to break a long journey up.
It’s peaceful, easy to park, flat was very clean with lots of complimentary bits as well as useful info on local attractions.
I would stay here again
Appartamento grande e luminoso, pulito e con tutto quello che serve. Siamo stati molto bene

the flat was prett nice and cozy. the bathroom was very small and if you are not that flexible you have some problem using the toilett. the shower was a bit dirty and dark. the stairwell was a bit creepy but you get used to it. some more kitchenwear would be nice.
beside that, the neighborhood was very nice and you can go shopping withou 1 min walking.

Petite chambre sous les combles dans très jolie maison. Salle de bains partagée mais tres agréable et nettoyée tous les jours.
Excellent emplacement mais à eviter pour les grands ou en cas de problemes de sante car beaucoup d’escaliers !
Quelques equipements pourraient etre ajoutes
Very cute cosy apartment, really enjoyed our stay!

Close to everything, never used a taxi, plenty of shopping, drinking and eating in the area. Plenty of toilet paper provided, good supply of dishes and glasses, and coffee and sugar. Comfortable beds and pillows and the only complaint is that the water pressure in the shower trickles. Not a deal breaker though with all the other benefits.

The house is the highlight of our vacation. Initially we were afraid that is a bit far from city center, but the location in the park turns out better. We never stay in this kind of house. The house feels very homey, warm and inviting, has all the amenities and basic cooking ingredients that we need for the whole stay. The beds seem to be prepared for living in the house instead of for rental. The bathroom is very clean. The kitchen is fully functional and complete. And there is also washer and dryer. There are some options for public transport (bus) if you do not want to drive. In the end we have to drag our feet to get out of the house.
Overall, extremely recommended if you visit Edinburgh and would love to come back again.
Fabulous apartment. Very well finished and in a great location
The room was fantastic, very warm and comfortable with everything we needed for our short stay in Edinburgh. Highly recommend.
Rubistania was kind, knew the area well, and always there for support.
Great location, great price, very clean and comfortable!

This  apartment is nice and large with nice amenities.  Alfie even provided some food and treats to start our stay.  The best part of  staying here is that it is very well located,  central and walkable to many  areas that are must see.

Flat is very beautiful and clean. Very comfortable place. It is on the top floor without elevator, if u come with big luggage maybe is not convince. The landlord give many travel tips before we arrived. And first night we stay got some issues about heating and hot water, but landlord deal with it as soon as they can. Nice place.
Really nice apartment in a great location in the city, highly recommended!

James’ spot is perfectly situated away from the hustle of the Royal mile but close enough to walk. It looks out at Calton Hill and is close to many good restaurants and pubs. The kitchen is one of the best stocked kitchens I’ve seen in a European AirBnB. It is several flights of stairs to get up to the flat which was a little tough for my older parents but very easy for those of us with young knees. Comfy beds and all the amenities you could need, we will definitely stay there again!

Deborah's house is amazing--it is exactly where I wanna live in the future if I have my own place. It has everything you need and the ambience is lovely. Deborah's is very informative in terms of traveling tips and prompt in answering messages.

This place is in a great location and had everything we needed for our trip to Edinburgh. Garry was very accommodating with our request to add an extra guest and very helpful when our check in was delayed due to flights. Would stay here again.
Perfect place in Edinburgh! Would definitely stay again.

This place is very nicely decorated , clean and in a great location. The only reasons I don’t rate it 5 stars is that there is a lot of noise from the upstairs neighbours and  the party goers on the street. Another reason is that we pay a $26 cleaning fee and are expected to leave the place as if we hadn’t been there. I don’t mind cleaning up after myself but I don’t enjoy the fact that I’m paying $26 for the cleaning services that are required by Airbnb hosts such as vacuuming and washing of sheets.
The place was fantastic. Very clean. Very warm house. Nice atmosphere.

super recomendable !!!
en pleno centro y todo genial...
muchas gracias por estar siempre pendiente de nosotros .
saludos
Wow just an amazing place to stay. Easily walkable to everywhere you’d want to go.  Bus drop off from airport 5 mins from flat. Had a great time. Thank you Nikki

A lovely double room in the host's apartment. Characterful, calm, very well connected by bus to all areas of the city, but also within easy walking distance of all central sights too. Comfortable double bed, well equipped kitchen and pleasant sitting room...and cats (we love cats!) Cafés, restaurants and groceries all on the doorstep as well as green space. Easy to mix self catering with eating out during a stay. The hosts were away during our stay  so we didn't meet, but the lodger was welcoming and helpful. There was a heatwave during our stay and it would've been nice to open the bedroom window, but a fan was provided and gave us some air movement at night! Bring a dressing gown for trips to the loo and separate shower across the hall. All in all a great  location to explore Edinburgh from, comfortable, clean, and quirky. My daughter (16) and I enjoyed our stay and the fabulous city on our doorstep.
Great place

A wonderful apartment in vibrant Stockbridge - so nice, so quiet and so clean with great attention to detail. Alison is such a friendly host and communication was great! Lots of local bars, restaurants, bakeries and grocery stores in the neighborhood - and very pretty surroundings!
I can warmly recommend this apartment and will of course come back the next time I'm in Edinburgh!

We came to Edinburgh in August, which is a very busy time, but being centrally located was easy and great at this apartment! We enjoyed our stay, the apartment was clean and spacious, it was just a bit loud at times, but that is to be expected during the Fringe Festival with so many street performers and visitors.
Very good experience
Galina was very friendly and helpful. The room was exactly like in the photos and it is very easy to get to the city center.

Location really good for walks along the sea front, good selection of pubs and places to eat.
2 minute walk to bus stop that takes you straight to Edinburgh city centre.
Apartment was clean and tidy easy check in and had all amenities.

Di was a amazing host...
just like her amazing house would definitely recommend both without any hesitation...

We had a really wonderful time in Edinburgh and in Nicolas Apartement. We booked and arrived on the same Day, but Nicolad did everything to make us feel welcome, even on such short notice :) Thank you again for everything, it was a pleasure to meet you and your adorable little daughter! Hope to come back real soon. All the best!!
Great location. Very clean. Neighborhood can be rowdy on weekends but the place is well insulated and stays quiet.
I can recommend, Sabrina is very helpfull and lovely person...
Very clean flat and near to city center
Wonderful stay!
Piso confortable y muy bien situado en la Royal Mile. Muy tranquilo, en pleno old town y bien comunicado. Máxima amabilidad en el recibimiento y durante todo el proceso de reserva y contratación.

Alan is a superhost, very helpful, responsive and proactive. Also, the place was wonderful, clean, cozy and in a beautiful neighborhood. There is bus stop nearby, supermarket and many restaurants. All tourist attractions (city center) are 20 min by bus. I would highly recommend this place.

Jan’s place is in a really nice neighborhood close to city centre. It has supermarkets, cafes, shops, restaurants on leith walk which is minutes away from the apartment.
The apartment is cosy and has all that you need. Jan and Mareena are friendly and responsive hosts. We found them to be very responsive and accommodating to our particular needs. Really appreciated that because we were at the Fringe festival and it was not a typical holiday.

The most beautiful apartment I’ve ever laid my eyes upon! Myself and my partner stayed here for a romantic weekend away to celebrate our anniversary and we were not disappointed! The place is exactly as described and the photos don’t even do it justice, we were absolutely spoiled. A huge thanks to Azeem who went above and beyond to ensure that our stay was as comfortable and as enjoyable as can be. Can’t wait to come back soon!!

Laura’s place was as described, lovely, spacious and light (with blackout blinds in the bedrooms which was fab!). It had everything you would need to feel right at home.
The area was fab, twenty minutes (with children) to Princess Street which was easy to do. Within a few steps of the apartment was a Sainsbury local and Co-op to stock up on supplies. There were great restaurants too and we had a delicious breakfast in the local area both mornings. Unfortunately on the Saturday night everywhere was full (book in advance) but Pizza Express is a good standby!
Laura was a fabulous host. Very responsive and offered great tips. Would highly recommend her place.
Rosie’s place is so lovely and homely. Great location and Rosie was super responsive throughout our stay ☺️ we had the best Hogmanay! Would definitely recommend to stay here ☺️

Charlie is a nice, courteous, attentive gentleman who likes to communicate. The room was ok, bathroom and kitchen unclean and kitchen as well every other room I had access to was messy piled with stuff. It's Charlie's way of life, you have to deal with it... or leave. I was lucky enough to be able to shower somewhere else..
The breakfast was fine!

If you want a private, quite place to stay that's still in the middle of the action in Edinburgh, you've found it! This beautiful 2 bedroom place is my go-to; my second time booking. The host is responsive & attentive, and the place is very clean. Highly recommended for you travel stay.

Calim and his beautiful apartment were absolutely wonderful. The pictures do not do it full justice - a lot of attention to detail has gone into the apartment and we found it to be a lovely haven of art, music and books. The location was very central, we were delayed in arriving but Calim was fab - he arranged for us to pick up keys even though we ended up arriving at almost 1am and had even left us soup, bread and hummus! We would definitely stay here again!
very good

A wonderful spot to stay and equally wonderful host! Lynne's a great communicator and very helpful. The apartment was perfectly located, clean, and cozy. Great info on the neighborhood too (restaurants, groceries, and more). Felt like a home away from home. Looking forward to coming back!
Quartiere un po' decentrato ma facilmente raqggiungibile con i mezzi. Zona tranquilla. Flat nuovo  e molto accogliente. Sicuramente da consigliare.

This place is amazing! Lewis was there to greet us upon arrival and provided suggestions around town. Great location right in the center of the city. We walked around Edinburgh and only took a taxi to the castle because of the weather. No need to rent a car if you plan to stay around town. Apartment is perfect, very clean and spacious. Highly recommend!!
Very beautiful AirBnB with good connections to Bus and Tram. Ideal to explore Edinburgh through a very friendly host

We have rented many Airbnbs and this is the absolute best city apartment we have ever rented. It is right on the Royal Mile, it is amazingly well appointed with a modern kitchen, bathroom and living area. The bedrooms are spacious and comfortable. Even the views from the apartment are amazing. Philip is a great host. He helped us to find our way around the city and responded to any questions immediately
This apartment made our stay in Edinburgh that much better. Thanks Phil

Zoe’s house is better than we could have ever imagined. Very comfortable warm and clean. Located close enough to everything but also quite private. Cannot recommend this enough for your Edinburgh stay
Nice place, excellent location.  Everything was pretty much just as described.  Quick communication with Greg, too. Would love to stay here again if we return to the area.

Excelente estadía! muy buena ubicación. Ambiente cómodo. Habitación de 6 PODs mixta compartida, todo muy ordenado y limpio. Baño compartido por piso, todo excelentemente organizado. Para recomendar 100% !!!
Flat is wonderful and Amy is a great host giving plenty of tips and suggestions for our stay. Would definitely stay again!
I really enjoyed my 3 nights at Natalia’s place. Chris (her husband) is really nice too! The room was pretty. The bed comfortable and the bathroom really clean. Thank you for having me.

Wow! Just wow. One of the most stunning and thought out Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. Such amazing attention to detail and beautifully executed design. Very friendly, communicative hosts with great restaurant recommendations.
The location is fantastic and there is so much to do even within 5 minute walking radius.

Already planning our next trip as I can’t get enough of this home!

Location is fantastic. At the eastern end of the Royal Mile, everything is walkable from here. This end of the mile is more quiet, so although we were close to the action, there wasn’t excessive noise at night, just a few cars driving past. There is a car park, so we didn’t have to worry about finding parking in the city. Excellent restaurants nearby. The apartment itself was nice, very spacious for just two people, with a full kitchen and living area in addition to the bedroom and bathroom. Everything was clean. I appreciated the eclectic mix of furnishings and decor. Overall, a great experience staying here.
The apartment was fantastic, and the location was second-to-none. Great value for your money.

This is a great location. There are numerous pubs, cafes, restaurants and an Aldi within a 5 minute walk. The tram stop is also under 10 minutes away.
The apartment is spacious, clean and well appointed. There are nice views of the Water of Lieth and some bridges. We loved the place and felt comfy in it.
Simon was very responsive and provided excellent directions for getting in. I would definitely book again if I make it back to Edinburgh.
Very nice apartment with a friendly host! The neighborhood is calm. The flat was clean and cozy. It had everything we need. It's also at a great location, near most of the great places in Edinburgh!
Gary ist sehr freundlich und antwortet direkt auf jegliche Frage!
The room environment is excellent and the location is very convenient. It was a very satisfactory stay experience.

I definitely agree with all the previous comments. Tarik is very welcoming, providing all the necessary travelling information, and full of useful visiting tips. He makes you feel like home.
The apparemment is very nice and clean, close to the city centre and to major public transport accesses.

A Beautiful apartment with everything we needed. Great location and Bobbie was a great host.
We really enjoyed our stay.

It is a fantastic location, super close to the center of Edinburgh. The accommodation was clean, spacious, and well-maintained. The host was speedy to communicate. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again on my next trip to Edinburgh.

We have had an amazing weekend away in Edinburgh. Kelly was so helpful from the get go. The accommodation was great - clean & tidy, had everything you needed plus more!! Great location, friendly pub on the corner & a nice walk into the city. We will definitely be visiting again & can highly recommend Kelly’s place.

Bel appartement super bien situé, à 5 minutes de marche du magnifique Arthur’s Seat. Des restaurants et épiceries sont disponibles à moins de 15 minutes de marche. Convient très bien à une famille de 4. Nous avons adoré notre séjour!
Very good place
Great location, very clean and tidy. Felt like home.

Le logement est très agréable à vivre, proche du centre historique à pied, d'une rue avec de nombreuses commodités. Il est très propre, fidèle aux photos et on s'y est sentis très bien, comme chez nous ! Dawn est très agréable et flexible, elle nous a permis de découvrir la ville sans nos bagages le premier et dernier jour, ce qui a rendu le voyage bien plus agréable. Le lit est très confortable, on y a très bien dormi ! Je recommande vivement pour visiter Edimbourg !
Tolle Lage: Bushaltestellen um die Ecke, Walk of Water wenige Gehminuten entfernt, Hafen  zu Fuß erreichbar.
Perfect location for this lovely apartment right off the Lower Mile. Easy to get anywhere and a convenient walk to the train station. Nicola is a responsive and gracious host. Highly recommend.

Brilliant place to stay in the heart of Edinburgh within walking distance of a lot of things and easy access to public transport.
The flat was immaculate when we arrived, the design and decor were amazing.
The host Jack is great guy and very responsive 100% would recommend booking this place as a first choice for staying in Edinburgh!

Great stay at David’s! The flat was perfect for our group and in a great location in the city. David was also a massive help in making arrangements for us due to unforeseen circumstances - overall a great host!

The good things about this Airbnb: the location is fantastic. Can’t imagine a better place to be for a first visit to Edinburgh.
The not so good things: these will depend on preference, but we’ll mention here as they are things we did notice. Hot water was not particularly reliable (a few showers were lukewarm) and the WiFi was also unreliable/lower speed at times. We found the bed to be quite uncomfortable, with our feet sticking out of the end (I’m 5’8 and my partner is 6’2). The light coming through the bedroom window is quite bright, and there are no blackout curtains. Finally, there’s tons of humidity in the apartment and it makes everything a bit musty.
Overall, we do feel the price is a bit higher than the value on this place. Especially the $100 cleaning fee but having to do your own garbage and dishes - not sure what this fee really goes towards as it’s a one-bedroom flat. But the location and convenient check in were ideal.

We wanted to drop out bags off as we arrived so we could explore and use our time wisely, unfortunately when asked if this was possible we were told they would clean it as quick as we could so we could access as soon as possible. However we could access regardless at 3pm, at 2:30 it still hasn’t been cleaned however we were then told we could access to drop bags off. Arrived back at 5ish and it was clear the cleaners had done a very rushed job. Stains left over the kitchen, dust, dirty bathroom where toothbrushes are kept. This so really disappointing. I sent photos to the host and he did apologise but for the price we would not recommend. Also on night two the neighbours woke us twice being loud and rowdy. The location is handy but it’s not a luxurious as it looks.
Great for both short and long stays.

The flat was great, even better than what we expected, incredibly spacious. The communication with Susie/Lottie prior to our stay was timely and engaged, specially as we were delayed in arriving.
The apt was well stocked, and had everything we could need should we have wanted to cook (but we made the most of the local restaurants), the beds were comfortable (firm) and the apt was spotless. Would highly recommend it.

L’appartamento si trova proprio sul Royal Mile, una delle strade principali di Edimburgo. Siamo capitati nel weekend del festival Fringe e siamo stati davvero bene. La casa era come ce l’aspettavamo e le indicazioni per il check-in dettagliate e accessibili. Lo consiglio vivamente.
Amazing stay very central to everything you need pubs restaurants etc and an amazing place to stay very spacious and clean
Fantastic location for my half marathon… not close from the start but then not stupid far away. Either. A bit pricey for my budget but super safe for a solo travelling female.

What a great location! The apartment was in the thick of the city, but you wouldn’t know it because it was in a courtyard setting with the front door facing the interior gardens. The apartment was bright, clean, cozy and nicely decorated with an inventive combination of old and new.  The bed was very comfortable. Despite tight quarters, there was plenty of space to hang or put away your clothes. The living/eating area is upstairs adjacent to a patio with a view of the castle. The host was communicative and friendly. Tip: You can park on Lady Lawson Street around the corner. It’s free after 6:30 pm and before 8:30 in the morning. (We came from Inverness and returned our car the next day).

One of the nicest places we stayed on our trip through Scotland. Really appreciated all the attention to detail in the fixtures and design. Location is excellent - easily walk to all the sights. Very quiet - double paned windows in addition to a third sliding pane of glass help on sound and heating. Really like the skylights on the kitchen level. Beds were very comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.
Only note; the listing currently says parking is available on streets nearby but that has changed; all close local streets are now zoned/pay during the day. So if you have a car you'll need to park it at one of the city lots - there is one a 20 min walk away - there is an easy loading zone for the apartment out front.

Di was extremely helpful and always responded right away even going to far as to loan us her deck of cards. If I am ever back in Scotland, I will 100% stay here. It was a great location for three moms and two 18 year old kids we had the very best time and the house was so comfortable. The bedding was amazing and super clean, the kitchen was well stocked, and she even left us a little bit of milk and tea for our first morning.
Key is very difficult to use
Great stay for solo travellers, walkable distance to city center and Saida was a great and responsive host.

logement central dans la ville, parfaitement situé. extrêmement bien insonorisé, bien chauffé, et literie confortable.
nous avons visité la ville d'Edimbourg à pied, tout était très proche.
je recommande !!

Had a nice stay at Brae House with some family and friends. It is a student accomodation so it felt more like a hotel rather than an AirBnB, but offered excellent value for money and was in a great location in central Edinburgh. The receptionists were friendly and gave us useful local tips.
I would recommend bringing your own tea, coffee and toiletries as these are not provided. Another thing to be aware of is check out is at 10am which caught us off guard.
Le logement est très confortable et proche de l'aéroport, les hôtes sont à votre écoute et très gentils également

Clarance is a fantastic host! The house is conveniently located to be able to access the Old Town and Southside areas. It is on a quiet residential area, however there's plenty of places to go out within 20 min walk.
The breakfast provided makes for an excellent start of the day, and Clarance's hospitality is incredible.
The room was well equipped, although it was only for one night and provided comfortable accommodation for my friends and me.

we loved being at this spot. We were able to explore parts of Edinburgh we wouldn't have ventured to if we weren't staying a bit out of the city center, yet everything was super easy to get to using the busses!
Sehr tolle Unterkunft im Herzen der Stadt. Tolles Viertel mit sehr schönen Restaurants und Pubs.
perfect location and comfortable accommodation!
lovely family who made me feel very welcome.
Sabrina was very nice and flexible! We were very comfortable and slept great in the room. Would recommend!
Mon séjour s’est très bien passé ! Cat est disponible et répond rapidement! Son appartement est très confortable.

We loved our extended long weekend in Edinburgh.
As regular visitors we love the New Town location. Lots of lovely independent shops, bakeries nearby - and a Tesco express and Sainsbury’s local round each corner. The botanic gardens are nearby and well worth a visit.
The flat is the ground floor of a lovely traditional Edinburgh townhouse. High ceilings. Spotlessly clean. Lovely comfortable bed, at the front of the house and a comfortable sitting room at the rear with a virgin cable tv, nice bathroom with a great shower and a well equipped kitchen.
Communication ahead of arrival was excellent and key safe pick up couldn’t be easier. A perfect spot to explore the city. We will return.
Clean, quiet, comfortable and stylish place to stay.

Very nice modern apartment between Edinburgh town centre and Leith village. Perfect for exploring the city while being in a quiet but conveniently located area. Very comfortable and newly decorated, highly recommended.

I was in Edinburgh for 4 nights exploring surrounding areas - Waters of Leith, Portobello, Calton Hill and Arthur’s seat. It was wonderful coming home to a warm, cosy, comfy place with oodles of character.
Would highly recommend a stay here! Excellent all round!
Gosia is a great host and we enjoyed our stay at her flat. The flat was clean, had everything we needed and was in a great location.

Friendly staff, nice bar area with live music every evening and every day a different optional activity you can join. It is in the middle of Old Town and close to the trainstation. We loved our stay here.
Great flat in a central location.  Would highly recommend.
Adorable place with lots of character within easy walking distance of restaurants, cafes, Waters of Leith…Hosts were responsive and flexible, which we much appreciated!
Lovely and clean flat. Great location with good transport links. Claire was quick to respond and provided very clear instructions. Would definitely stay here again 😊

Lois was an amazing host, very welcoming, kind and accommodating. The place was lovely and a central hub to everything! Me and my friend went during Fringe fest (without realising), we went to see on of our favourite comedians, Daniel Sloss, Lois got us free tickets to the red raw show where he was also headlining.. this resulted in us meeting Sloss!! Thank you Lois! Great host, my friend's vegan and Lois was very accommodating and had a range of breakfast selection to choose from. Lovely place to stay, we would definitely stay again and recommend to all!
Great experience. Would happily stay there again.

This was hands down the best acommodation I’ve ever stayed in. From the instructions to the communication, everything was very clear and detailed. Location of the apartment is perfect, you can get pretty much everywhere on foot. It was clean, had a great view on the Bread St. and not to mention cozy and comfortable beds. We were 5 and for 4-day stay this was a briliant option. 10/10, recommend.

Valentino is an excellent host. He is very proactive and was very helpful in helping us with flexible check in. Loved the stay in Edinburgh and thanks to Valentino for enhancing our experience. Would love to be back at his property next time we visit this beautiful city.

We absolutely loved our stay! The apartment was very easy to reach by public transportation and simple to find. The host gave us clear instructions and was very friendly and respectful throughout. The place itself was beautiful and spotless.
A special mention goes to the “landlady” — the sweetest dog — who was incredibly attentive and caring. She even watched over us while we ate, making sure we were safe, and snuggled up with us to guarantee maximum comfort. Truly a one-of-a-kind service, haha!
Highly recommended!
espetáculo.  limpo e confortável. adoramos. 😍

Great, unusual place to stay. There are many wonderful classes downstairs during the day, ranging from meditation to symbolic circles to dance and t’ai chi. The room was basic but fine. The room was very quiet in the evenings and at night. Going up and down stairs to the bathroom was a little awkward for me. The hosts couldn’t have been nicer. Good place to stay, not too far from the bus route,  with the excellent 101 Bakery and (opposite side of the street) Fortitude Coffee just around the corner. Also around the corner is Isola restaurant, specializing in Sardinian cuisine. Moderately pricy but out of this world delicious food.

One of the best airbnbs I’ve had pleasure of staying in; blissfully quiet yet easy 10 mins walk from Morningside with array of cafes, independent shops and restaurants. Well designed, well equipped contemporary apartment, spotlessly clean and very comfortable bed. I loved watching the changing light over Braid/Blackford hills in the distance. Thanks for letting me check in so early on arrival too.
Diese Unterkunft ist eine perfekte Möglichkeit seine Zeit in Edinburgh zu verbringen. Die Wohnung ist einfah nur klasse und Jake sehr nett und proaktiv.

This is by far the best place we could've booked for our last couple days in Edinburgh. There is a bus stop literally right in front of Carol's house that goes straight to the airport, or alternatively you can catch a bus back into the city. Carol was very responsive, and when our flight was cancelled she was able to accommodate us for an extra day. I would highly recommend staying here!
Great flat - loved our time in Edinbrough!

The location was great and the apartment was sufficient for our needs. The layout is a bit awkward but functional. The kitchen could use some attention as the freezer was gross and there were only 1 or 2 dish towels and no paper towels.

Great location in Edinburgh, near enough to all the tourists sites, but far enough too. Only a 15 minute walk to the bottom of Arthurs Seat. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a great Edinburgh stay with out the hassle of the royal mile and the old town.

For the price it was really a great value for money. Although there were road closures, it’s still quite near to the remaining bus stops and it’s only 10mins drive with the bus to the city center. There are supermarkets nearby as well. In their flat you can freely cook. The room is clean with a huge flat screen TV, your own clothes hangers. The amenities are as described like in a hotel.
Both Lukas and Ji-Eun are very easy to talk to and they are welcoming and accommodating.

L'appartement est parfait.
Il est fidele aux photos.
On s'y est tellement bien senti, on se sentait comme chez nous et navons manqué de rien.
L'emplacement est ideal pour les déplacements à pied et en bus.
Nous rejoignons princes street face facilement a pied et les bus pour aller ailleurs passent au pied du logement.
Un grand merci pour ce bel appartement.
Je recommande.
Au plaisir de revenir !
We had a great stay at Cody’s apartment. It is beautifully furnished, well equipped and in a perfect location! The whole process was easy and well communicated. Definitely recommend!

Very nice an clean house! The neighborhood is very quiet and nice. The house is a little bit far away from the city center, but it’s easy to get by bus.  There are some shops and supermarket near. Was a really nice stay!!
Lovely apartment and a lovely host, very convenient location and great recommendations. We felt very well taken care of!
Excellent appartment in a perfect location for all that Edinburgh has to offer. Spotlessly clean and comfortable, a very stylish appartment.
Sehr schöner Aufenthalt. Wohnung wie beschrieben und sehr sauber. Gastgeber gut erreichbar und hat sogar früheren Check in ermöglicht.

Warm welcome, great advices about Edinburgh. The apartment is not far from the city center, about 20 minutes by bus or 30/40 minutes walking. We stay 4 nights and enjoy our stay with good services. Recomanded. Edinburgh is lovely, we find supermarkets near the apartment.
Thanks a lot!
Matteo and his friends

Great location and the hosts are fab. Would definitely stay again!!
The bed was comfy and the place was clean. Place had everything we needed.
Great little apartment! Very clean with nice update! Allowed us a late check out which was great for making the most of our trip!

absolutely beautiful apartment,
everything about our stay was perfect, Sarah was extremely helpful , very easy to get to city centre.. we was a group of 6 and we just got an uber.
will definitely return

The location is close to Dean Village, well communicated and very nice. The only thing is that currently there is a big construction in front, not very convenient if you need to telework.
The apartment is big and comfortable, with heaters that work well and keep the space warm.

Fantastic apartment, really well located with lots of buses from outside and shops in walking distance. flat was very clean and check in and out was very easy. excellent parks for kids at both saughton and Harrison. would definitely recommend!
Great location. Right off the mile. This does mean that it can be loud with windows open. If you spend the day doing stuff you won’t worry about it.

We had a great stay in Ross' flat.  Communication with Ross was amazing and the flat was very comfortable and peaceful.  Great area and lovely view from the living room.  We would definitely stay again.

This was the third time I used AIRBNB, without doubt, Cary is the best host and I believe she is one of the best in the whole hosts in Airbnb.  The first day in Edinburgh started with her warm welcome. The lovely Victorian house makes me feel like at home. The room is clean, bright, warm and well equipped. It was a great experience to live in Cary's house. It is part of our memory of Edinburgh. I believe I will go back and see you (Cary, Pete and cute Silly) soon.
Very central location with everything you need.

Sevi's place was great! Exactly what we were looking for. Perfect for a trip to Murrayfield as it was only a 10 minute walk to the stadium. Gorgeous building and lovely apartment. Sevi was really accommodating by allowing us to check in early, she also really helped us out with parking with some good tips and finally she left a lovely breakfast. I would definitely recommend a stay here particularly for a flying visit to the west of the city.
Good, location and better host with a nice flat quality-price.

Generally it was a good place. Close to the shops and restaurants. The castle is 15 minutes away. The major problem with the place is that you can't move inside the apartment and the building without making noise.  The parquet floors and the doors were creaking all the time.
Karen’s flat was in the perfect location and super clean!

Très petite maison très conviviale et bien équipée. Petit jardin très charmant et fleuri. À 45 minutes de marche du Royal Miles. Tout se fait à pied. Il y a une épicerie à côté. Les hôtes sont très réactifs aux messages. Bon choix pour séjourner à Édimbourgh. C'est vraiment très tranquille et le voisinage est sympathique.

Accueil très chaleureux chez Thanh-Lan qui a su nous mettre à l'aise et nous a donné beaucoup de conseils précieux pour visiter Édimbourg et ses alentours. Je recommande à toutes personnes de réserver ce logement, il y fait bon vivre. Merci encore.

Een prachtige locatie, heerlijk ruim appartement met enorm grote kamers.
Qua hygiëne zijn er behoorlijk wat werkpunten. Oppervlakkig schoon om te zeggen.
De stille buren en groene de buurt zijn een ware zegen na een drukke stads-dag.
Dele is een hele fijne communicatieve verhuurder.
Wij zijn fan!
Lucy’s place was so lovely. I’d recommend it to anyone. We had a great time there. It was super cozy & close to the city.

Logement très agréable, bien aménagé, propre, bien situé.
Nous avons apprécié avoir à disposition thé, café et lait.
Nous recommandons à 100%.

We felt so at home staying at Itziar's flat. It was central to everything you need inclusive of shops, restaurants, public transport and more. The flat was thoughtfully and strategically set out with small inclusions tjat made a big difference. Itziar is an amazing hostess, ensuring our stay was even better by equipping us with local knowledge and was able to help answer every question we had. We did not expext to feel as at home as we did in Itziar's flat. We were sad to leave.
Superbe appartement.Très calme.Bien relié au centre. Grant et Ellen sont des hôtes fantastiques.
We had a great stay. Catherine is a great host, communicated well, warm and friendly.  The place was very tidy and lovely equipped with everything one need with a good bed and nice bathroom.

Lovely place to stay if you are after a private peaceful location. Easy links into Edinburgh centre. The accommodation was very clean and the bed was extremely comfortable. Ahmet was very responsive towards all our messages, flexible and accommodating throughout. He made everything very easy and clear which made the stay more enjoyable. Definitely value for money and worth staying here.
Great place to stay! Very neat and the apartment is located near city’s attractions. Our hosts were super helpful and friendly. I highly recommend!
AirB&B was lovely, really can’t fault it. Beds were super comfy and had all we needed.

Roy's place thoroughly met our needs.  We were there to sleep, shower, have breakfast, make lunches, and then we were off exploring the rest of the time.  We appreciated the opportunity to do some laundry after being away from home for a while.  Do be aware of the three flights of stairs you must climb in order to get to Roy's flat.  The location is near a bus stop, and once we got our bearings, it was easy to figure out where we were going and how to get there.  While the building itself could use some TLC, Roy's place is as advertised...neat, tidy, and cosy.  Both Roy and Selena were excellent and prompt communicators.  Check in/out was simple.  Thanks to you both for an enjoyable stay in Edinburgh!

Logement adorable, situé dans un quartier très calme et paisible !
Hotel très réactive aux messages, on a passé une très bon séjour !
Le petit café conseillé à 5mn à pied du logement était impeccable
Je recommande à 100% ☺️
Shireen was a great host, very friendly and responsive. She immediately provided us with lots of suggestions for fun activities around the place.
A great spot in a great location. Thanks!
A lovely room in the cutest apartment very close to the city centre. Arvin has been the nicest host, I only wish we asked him to play for us on his special guitar.

Très bel appartement bien situé. Arrêt de bus pour l’aéroport à 5’ et tout près de princess street.
Nous vous le recommandons
Perfect place and perfect Pam. Thank you so much
We really enjoyed our stay in the wonderful apartment with a great location. The host was very helpful snd responsive. A great experience overall!

Great flat outside the city, but near enough to walk everywhere. Walking paths and local shops made this stay marvellous. There are no elevators, so if you had lots of luggage like we did, just be prepared. The walk to the city is about 45 mins. The nearest grocery store was just minutes away. We did take the bus sometimes and it was a simple system to understand. Overall the experience was great and would definitely stay here again!

I had a great time here with my mom and sister! The apartment is in a super convenient spot, close to convenience stores and neat shops and cafes. It’s also very close to a bus stop. I would absolutely stay here again!

My wife and I were so pleased with our stay here. Nice and quiet, very cozy. the 3rd floor location was not a problem for us. the flat is away from the street and we had no noise issues. the walk from Waverly station with rolling luggage was manageable and worth it for this location. The beds, kitchen, bathroom and living room were all perfect. Easy walking to the high street, the castle, the museum and Holyrood - can't imagine a better place for tourists or families who'd like a bit more room than a hotel. Heat and hot water were responsive. The shower diverter valve was sticky - really our only complaint and we dealt with it just fine. We hope the flat is available on our next visit.

Margaret is a superb host and incredibly accommodating.  The home is really clean, in a great location, and just feels warm and welcoming.   I would highly recommend this place and would gladly choose it again upon return.
Amazing views, great location. Highly recommended.

Apartamento muy bien situado en la Milla Real de Edimburgo. No tuve ningún problema salvo el Wi-Fi que lo necesitaba para trabajar. Martín me dio indicaciones oportunas para poder solucionarlo. La posibilidad de subir a la azotea hace que el apartamento sea aún más original. Sin lujos. Todo muy práctico. La calefacción perfecta. El baño perfecto. La cama me pareció cómoda y aunque está al lado de la Milla Real es un tranquilo. Repetiré cuando tenga que volver a Edimburgo si me es posible y está disponible.

Jana was a great host. Quick responses to my questions and provided thorough instructions before my arrival. The place was as described, great location mid way between the city center and close to the University. Place was sparkling clean and a great value for the location. Would gladly stay there again.
Nice and clean, and Marion is helpful... We liked this part of the town, and could easily walk from the house to the main streets and to the places you "must" see :)
Nice location - quiet neighborhood - good size apartment- very easy to walk to everything

We loved our stay at Victor’s place. The house is well equipped, clean and warm. Suitable to fit 5-6 guests. The neighborhood is quiet and we enjoyed walking around. Viktor is very responsive.
Loved the sense of humor inside the apartment. Definitely Recommended!
Duc estuvo siempre atento a nuestras necesidades y siempre mostró predisposición. Recomiendo.

This is a really nice place. Kathleen/Howard have thought of and provided so much to make it extremely comfortable for visitors. The location is on a quiet street with off-street parking which is a big plus. It is very convenient for getting a bus into the centre of Edinburgh, or even walking there. Local shops, cafes and restaurants are close by too.
We would strongly recommend this place for visitors to Edinburgh.

Emily’s place was wonderful with reality matching up very well with the descriptions.
Very close to everything of substance in Edinburgh and yet private enough to be quiet and cosy. Emily had furnished the house with the best of amenities and staying there was really comfortable for our family of five.
Will definitely look to come back here for our next visit

Wonderful stay, 10/10!! Carole was a lovely host and we really enjoyed staying at her place. She was very friendly and responsive. Her Airbnb was in great condition, very clean, and made you feel right at home.
This was a great location. An easy walk to the train with an 8 minute ride into Edinburgh; with a closer walk to bus stops as well. Also a quick walk to the town center that had restaurants, groceries, and pubs.
Would definitely stay with Carole again, if we are back visiting Edinburgh. Thank you Carole!!
Selena was a great host. The apartment was as advised and Selena was very responsive to messages.

Excellent location in nice residential  neighbourhood, easy walking distance to center. Alex was very accommodating and helpful and we enjoyed staying at his home! The apartment is very pretty and kitchen is really good. Would definitely book again.

The apartment was great - very clean and comfortable and in a fantastic area with plenty of bars/restaurants nearby. Everything was within walking distance which was very handy for seeing the city. Steve was a great host and easy to contact! I would definitely use the apartment again on a visit to Edinburgh.

With the Royal Mile a stone’s throw away, you never know what to expect for price and quality - this place was delightful, quiet, easy to access, and affordable while still being smack in the middle of Edinburgh and walking distance from busses and the Waverley Railway Station. Couldn’t have asked for better!
The apartment is in a great location. Having a parking space is a real benefit. Edinburgh is a great city to walk around. Once we parked the car we could leave it there until our departure.
Lovely place, clean, and reasonably well connected. Thanks for the stay, Stuart!

For my 30th birthday trip to Edinburgh in November 2023, we chose Sarah’s Dovecote Cottage. A vibrant 20-minute walk from the Royal Mile, with shops, bars, and cafes along the way. The cottage is a stunning retreat in a tranquil estate, boasting a modern bathroom with underfloor heating and a log fireplace. Sarah's directions were clear and we received a tour of the cottage revealing unique features like an underground ice house, which you can gaze right into through the reinforced glass window in the flooring. Her personal guides on local amenities added to the experience. The cottage, tucked in her secret garden, is a fairytale-like gem. We highly recommend Sarah’s charming cottage for an unforgettable stay.

Loved our stay at this delightful gem of a place with amazing views of the castle.  It was great being so central, surrounded by so many amenities but with surprisingly little noise. The flat itself was very comfortable, clean and cozy with everything we needed.   Maureen was a very friendly and helpful host doing her best to ensure our stay in Edinburgh was as enjoyable as possible.  Thanks, Maureen.  We will definitely be back!

Unfortunately we didn't have a very good experience, especially for the price of the accommodation which was one of the most expensive we paid on our trip in Europe. We miss a TV, a microwave. The internet was very bad and didn't work in every room. The bathroom had stains inside the bathtub, the drain was a little clogged and didn't feel clean. In addition, there was no product like shampoo and creams, common in all the other places we went. Communication with the host was time consuming

Fabulously stylish and large apartment.
Nothing is too much hassle for Greg.
Really helpful in storing bags after check out near the station.
Great coffee bar just opposite and very convenient for great restaurants.
As amazing as Edinburgh is, it was a bigger treat to come back and enjoy three flat..
highly recommended
Sehr zentral, sauber und unkompliziert

Such an amazing location. Alison was good with communicating with us & made us feel welcome. She also provided toys for our little one & gave us some suggestions of places to visit which would be good & we wouldn't have known about otherwise. Would definitely recommend this for a visit to Edinburgh.
The area of the house is very convenient, and there are buses downstairs to get to almost all the scenic spots. The house is very big, clean, well-equipped and comfortable and safe to live in.

This was our collective best UK airbnb experience to date!
Charlotte’s place was very warm and welcoming, it felt like we were in a home away from home from the moment we stepped in (and quite frankly we ended up staying in for the most part as all including the kids did not want to leave!)
- Location was super convenient from Waverley station, albeit being tricky with luggage and young children in tow but more of a factor of the edinburgh city charm (multi-level slopes, steps and cobblestones) than anything and well worth the trek!
- Everything from appliance and amenities were in excellent condition and a joy to use
- Place is nice and warm after a cold day/night out both literally and also figuratively speaking
There are already talks about coming back! Highly recommended!

Fiona and Gareth's flat was the perfect place to enjoy Edinburgh, right next to buses that take you into town and adjacent to a Lidl. Communication was good and they were always quick to reply. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a quiet place just outside of the city center.

What a place, I stay up and down the country and this one of the best in relation to location and the house itself was so clean and fantastically fitted out .
Great find I will be back time an time again
Lovely stay in a stylish and tidy apartment. Great location right next to the beach and within easy reach of Edinburgh's centre.
Great stay, comfortable and clean!

Fantastic stay at Amanda’s! The place was clean, cozy, and welcoming. Check-in was flexible, and Amanda went above and beyond with preparing documents outlining clear instructions/guidelines for the house, including several “how-to’s” for the kitchen and laundry. She also shared some wonderful suggestions for local restaurants.
The stay was exactly as I’d hoped, in a quiet neighborhood approx 20 minute bus ride from the city center.
This place is superb for a tourist . All the amenities are present . Rooms are much much better than how it looks. Pretty big in size , superb location. Highly recommended

We really enjoyed our stay in Veronique's place! It was very clean,spacious and we felt like our home.
The apartment is very close to the Christmas market and sightseeings thus we could easily walk.
Veronique also offered as a parking space where we could park our car during our stay without extra cost.
We definitely recommend Veronique's place and would love to stay there when visiting Edinburgh next time.

Great stay in Edinburgh. The flat is very well located with restaurant and shops all within walking distance.
The host was very flexible and accomodating for arrival and departure times.
lovely place to stay, would definitely consider staying here again

Cool apartment in a great location. Awesome view and Don was super helpful giving us a little tips on the wall sized map he has of Edinburgh. There was bread, butter and jam in the fridge which was very kind and delicious.

This apartment is right on the Royal Mile. It is very convenient to the train station and all the attractions. Even though it is in the heart of the action, we never had a problem with noise at night. The beds were comfortable, the kitchen was well appointed.
The entrance to the apartment is less inviting but it is easy access, and adequate for the type of building.
很好的一次入住体验 房间位置很好 距离各个景点都不远 我相信这间住宿非常适合拥有大件行李的住客居住 房间内装修也很精致 唯一一点是暖气不是持续的 其他都很满意

Lynn's friend Gigi hosted us very well. She is considerate and kind-hearted. The description of routine is detail and the location is near the Wavelery railway station by walking. The whole flat is extremely clean. Strongly recommend to live there and meet the nice girl Gigi.

Very good location, close to Holyrood Park north entrance. Parking was readily available on the street.
Instructions to enter were clear, and a guide with a video was sent out before arrival with check-in instructions.
The shared space before entering the apartment was a little dingy but this is not part of the property. The apartment itself was clean, tidy and well equipped.
apartamento muy bien ubicado en el centro de Edimburgo... muy fácil acceso a todo... excelente zona y muy bonito
Juste parfait je recommande!

The windows don’t block sound very well at all and while the street noise was not overly problematic for us if you are a light sleeper it may be bothersome.  Lastly the stairwell up to the Airbnb is rather grimy and reminiscent of a parking garage staircase. The outside door had a hole in it that people threw pamphlets into that never get picked up.  Not the most important part of your Edinburgh Airbnb experience but does not exactly say “luxury” either.  Overall not a bad choice as long as you don’t mind a small bed.

Roland's flat is a wonderful place to stay when in Edinburgh!  It's a lovely place clean, comfortable and tastefully decorated.  It has this great balance of feeling warm like somebody's home but also has the well placed details and extreme cleanliness of a nice hotel room. It's so immaculate that you don't feel like your sleeping in someone else's home which was something I worried about by going the route of Airbnb and not a hotel.  Roland's flat put my worries to rest, I loved it.  You literally can walk to every great location Edinburgh has to offer, the Palace of Holyrood, the Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle, all of it.  My favorite experience was waking up early getting a cup of coffee and walking from Roland's flat to the Salisbury Crags and taking in the gorgeous views of Arthur's Seat and the whole of Edinburgh, That alone was worth the trip.  We had the kitchen to make breakfast, I was able to stock the full sized fridge with my new favorite drink, blackcurrent  Ribena.  Roland also gave us a lovelly bottle of Champagne to celebrate Christmas which we enjoyed very much.  Lighting the candles in the chandelier gave the flat such a warm cozy feeling. The place is clean and in great location. About 10minutes walk to waverly station and walking distance to most places of attraction. Quiet despite in city centre
The only point to note for travellers with luggages are that there are some flight of stairs to climb which maybe a problem for large luggages
How a wonderful house! It has a great location in the old town! Very nearly to attractions.

Ett väldigt mysigt och fräscht boende! Små fina välkomstpresrnter köket och badrummet som förhöjde upplevelsen av god service. Bra kök och kaffemaskin. Varmt och gott när det även var frost utomhus. Nära buss och spårvagn till flygplatsen och till stan. Bra läge! Rekommenderar verkligen alla att boka stället om man vill njuta av Edinburgh.
Great place to stay! Short walk to all attractions. Very clean. Will stay here again, and recommend to others also.

Clear check in instructions, responsive and kind host. Place was clean but 1 room smelled dump and couldn't be used at all.
No privacy as lounge window on the building garden which is used by the neighbours, no access to us. They were looking inside the flat through windows which eas uncomfortable.
Ila kindly managed a hot water issue promptly. Good surroundings including the fountain park.

Had a fantastic stay in Edinburgh, Jeremy was very helpful and welcoming. The apartment is beautiful and spacious. It has everything you need and the beds are very comfortable. Great deli opposite for pastries and coffees. Lovely walk into town very much recommend this apartment.
Geweldige locatie met een prachtig uitzicht. ‘S avonds wat gehorig. Attente host.

Regretfully, we didn't sleep well due to a number of issues, which were communicated to the owners. I hope they will resolve them promptly so that future guests can receive the value they paid for and fully enjoy the property’s excellent location.

We spent a lovely stay in Sophie’s house!
The room is very cosy, you cas find everything you need in the house.
Nicely located in a calm street.
Sophie is charming host, very reactive by message!
Spent a lovely week here, the location is fantastic and the flat is cosy and well equipped.
Vänlig värdinna. Centralt boende, 20 min promenad till Princess street. Rent och snyggt.

This was a gem of a place. Perfectly situated to vist my family. The apartment was clean and well equipped.
Just off Leith Walk it's so accessible for buses and trams into the city centre.
Plenty of good cafes, pubs and restaurants nearby.
A great host and a great stay.
Thank you.

Me and my wife stayed for 3 nights at this spotless, cosy hideaway and loved it. Communication was excellent, check-in easy, and the place was immaculate and smelt amazing. The sofa and large TV were great for relaxing, the main shower was powerful, and the kitchen had everything we needed with thoughtful complimentary touches.
The bed was extremely comfortable with great pillows. We did the Outlander tour (highly recommend!) and also visited Mary King’s Close — another must. For getting into Edinburgh, we used the Newcraighall park and ride, which was cheap, quick, and very convenient.
Thank you, Aaron and Victor, for such a welcoming stay. We’d highly recommend this place to family and friends and will definitely be back to explore more of Edinburgh!

Abbey's place was perfect for us, a family with a teenager. We were centrally located to all the sites, which made walking around easy. We had a car and were able to store it in the garage carpark. The apartment has everything you need for short or long stays, it was very handy being able to cook some of our meals and use the washing machine.

Lovely flat In a very central location close to the castle and Grassmarket/Royal mile  ; had a very homely feel to it. Philipp was very accessible and quick to respond, we had a little issue with one of the amenities but Philipp was very quick to respond and try to come up with a resolution.

Felt so at home - thank you Ceilidh!
Ceilidh’s place is so comfortable and there are so many lovely touches like treats for my dog. The sofa is ridiculously comfy (I loved having a huge tv!), bathroom is modern and clean, kitchen well equipped. Ceilidh was so helpful and kind to talk to, and she’s really helped me get settled after my own flat has been flooded. The flat feels secure, and despite being in a block I did not hear any neighbours once! It was also a very warm flat, I hardly needed the heating on as it is well insulated.
Being next to the road means the bus stop is really close, and the buses into town are very regular. Having the retail park close by is really handy for shopping too. There’s also a walking trail a few minutes walk away, along a river and also to a nature reserve, so the dog enjoyed that. The estate seemed quiet and friendly.
Thanks again Ceilidh, we would definitely be back :)

Schönes Zimmer, voll ausgestattete Küche, problemlose Kommunikation mit Rory.
Treppe ist recht steil und abgetreten, aber darüber wurde ja im Voraus informiert.
AirBnB schafft es in der App (momentan?) nicht, die Check-In Informationen anzuzeigen, aber auf Nachfrage hat Rory direkt reagiert und die Infos geschickt.

Overall, we had an uncomfortable experience. We expected a dedicated bathroom as stated in the listing, but it was used by the host and accessible to others. On top of that, the bathroom’s cleanliness on arrival was not ideal, with visible marks and hair around the sink. We also didn’t receive the hospitality or welcome we usually experience with Airbnb stays, even though the family was home when we arrived. The one positive was the excellent location.
Place was good

Wonderful apartment in a central location.
Great stay for a family visiting Edinburgh, thank you Eddie and Natalie
Excelente atencion de Marck, es un super anfitrion!! El lugar es super agradable, muy limpio todo! La cama es super comoda, lo recomiendo 100x 100,/volveria seguro a hospedarme en la casa de Marck.

This house is absolutely beautiful and very well equipped. It was perfect for our large family gathering, and so near to local amenities and the tourist sights of Edinburgh. That said it is in a very quiet area, and the perfect place to relax after a day of sightseeing. The addition of a welcome hamper was also a lovely and thoughtful addition. I really wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this property.
Loved staying here. Close enough to most of the places we wanted to see that we could walk, but out of the way enough to be in a quiet neighborhood.

The most beautiful place I have ever been to! We are planning our return already as we had such a lovely time at Jo's place!
Jo is a perfect host, everything went smooth and easy! We are very grateful and feel lucky that we had a chance to stay 'on the top of Edinburgh'.
Fantastic place to stay! Right in the center of Old Town and very walkable. The space was clean and welcoming - even better than the pictures.

Great apartment in a great location.
As described.
We spent 4 nights here, felt at home, very relaxed and comfortable.
Had everything we needed.

Great location to see everything!!

We had a wonderful stay at Stephen's place and I would definitely recommend it to anyone.  He met us at the flat, and was very welcoming and helpful.  The location was perfect for getting around Edinburgh on foot.

Fedora’s place was absolutely adorable! Decorated beautifully, spacious, comfortable, and well-stocked. She was responsive and helpful. The apartment is easily accessible to and from both the train station and airport. There are many things to do and places to eat at along Leith Walk and towards city center!
A great place to stay, close to everything, very peacful and quiet. Well maintained and clean apartment. Highky recommend for a family or group of friends.
Highly recommend this apartment. The location was perfect and had a parking spot always available. It was clean, comfortable, and beautiful. Thank you Marta for a wonderful stay :)

Nice little flat above a double garage. Lovely gardens to look at from the balcony, though the garden furniture needs a bit of tlc.
Great area with excellent bus links to the centre and lots of coffee shops and independent shops close by.

Otherwise lovely, comfortable and warm.

The apartment was lovely, it was clean bright and well appointed.
Every room was comfortable with plenty of space especially the living room.
The cafe and restaurant at the end of the road were great with friendly staff and good food.
Edinburgh was a short walk away where we would recommend a bus tour, the people's museum and of course the castle.
We came by car and we parked it down the road where there was free parking, this meant we didn't have the worry of the parking meter.
We would definitely recommend the apartment and would enjoy going back.
Very comfortable stay .

A comfortable, well-equipped and spacious flat in a leafy area. Just a short walk to town or Arthur's seat with restaurants, shops, bus stop and everything you need nearby. Vicki was very welcoming and helpful  - we had a great stay!

A beautiful and lovely home. The excellence was palpable. Every moment I and my family spent in there  was a pleasure. The planning that went into making our stay an undiluted delight was heartwarming. Easily one of the best holiday homes we have been to!
all right

I enjoyed my stay with Magda. The accommodation was comfortable and spotlessly clean. It was nice to have my own bathroom too. I would thoroughly recommend this accommodation for a short visit to Edinburgh.

had a lovely stay nothing was to much trouble very helpful 5he only 5hing I would say it in the bath it needs a non slip mat in the bath for the slower use part from that brilliant. if I every come to Edinburgh again definitely stay here
Everything clean and charming, we have all the commodities. For sure we will come back

Host’s were very friendly and helpful

The appartment is very clean and well located, near the tramway, within walking distance from the old town, facing the playhouse theater. Giovanna was very welcoming and reactive. There is a very good friendly Italian restaurant downstairs. Highly recommended.
This Airbnb is amazing, we loved our time here! Such a lovely space and excellent location. Nice and quiet which meant a great nights sleep, would love to stay again!

This was a wonderful place to stay. It’s beautiful and comfortable. There were many little touches that made it special. The host was helpful and responsive.  There were many eating places nearby, and a short walk took us to the Botanic Gardens. Easy self check in, clean, warm, stunning views of the whole city! Great spot to stay.

Una habitación muy bonita y cómoda. Douglas es encantador y nos asesoró en cuanto a varias excursiones que queríamos hacer. Recomendamos 100% alojarse en su hogar. Privacidad total. Estuvimos con nuestro bebé y todo genial. Max, su perro, es adorable. Gracias por todo Douglas.
Great host and location

Sonia & Chris were absolutely great & efficient in communicating and even allowed us an early check-in time on the day itself. Will definitely recommend this place to friends & family.

It was a peaceful, clean and lovely place to stay. Kate was so kind and left us treats upon our arrival and gave clear instructions. She also provided a binder with suggestions on everything local. Highly recommend!

Sharon was easy to get in touch with at all times, the bed was really comfy and I enjoyed using the Bluetooth speaker for music during my stay.
