Great location, easy 20 min walk to old town and then 20 mins to the castle. Great value by far and awesome hospitality by Margaret who gave us a few tips and showed us the apartment. Wifi was very speedy, easy quick meals for breakie. oR several amazing pubs nearby.
we really appreciated the location!

Very nice flat close to the beach of Portobello. Flat contact was available when needed. All basic items were available.
Very likely coming back.

Great place to be!

Alojamiento cerca del centro (20-30 min a pie) pero en zona tranquila.

This bnb rocks!  And Martin makes sure you know how everything works in the bnb, and also acts as a tour guide providing lots of tips for enjoying the city.  There is tons of space with a very open and comfortable kitchen and living room. This could not be more convenient. It is 1/2 block from the royal mile. You might think it would be a bit noisy in Aug during the festival. But the bedroom faces to the back and is very quiet - no noise from the streets. It's only one flight of stairs - and easily navigated even for those who do not move as quickly and easily as they used to do so. HIGHLY recommend!
Nous sommes arrivés chez Nicolas, dans son appartement. Nicolas est très sympa, si besoin il nous a conseillé tout en étant très discret. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour 😁

Abbey's apartment was very comfortable and easy to access. The apartment had everything we needed for our festive weekend, and we were very happy and comfortable staying here for the weekend. The apartment was clean and quiet and we really enjoyed ourselves.

Appartement spacieux et agréable, très propre, dans un quartier calme et bien desservi par plusieurs lignes des bus (nous n’avons pas essayé le tram ou le métro).
Ross est très réactif et accommodant.
Un court mais super séjour à Edinburgh pour nous !

This is our second time staying at Jackies flat and it was as good as the first time. Clean, spacious, fully equipped, convenient....the list goes on. Very friendly staff. The Sunday Stockbridge Market is 5 minutes walk. But the flat is a great place. Can't recommend it enough and Jackie is very responsive to messages.
Loved the location of this flat! It was easy for us to walk or take a bus everywhere we wanted to go. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook simple meals at home.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Cordiners in Edinburgh old town! The flat was super cosy and felt like a home from home. It’s perfectly situated, just a 10 minute walk from Edinburgh castle and Princes Street. Whilst being pretty central, the flat felt homely, spacious and private. We’d highly recommend Carla’s flat to anyone wishing to visit Edinburgh. Thanks again!
We had a lovely stay , right in the heart of everything. Near to Sainsbury’s which was helpful and waking up to see the Edinburgh castle made it for me
Really enjoyed our stay.
Very comfortable stay right on the heart of the Old Town!

Just an amazing historical place. The location -a few hundred meters for the castle -is amazing. The apartment is in a historical building but it has all the comforts of a modern place. The only little complaint is that the internet wasn’t strong enough (2 people in our party were working). We hope to be able to stay there again next time we are in Edinburgh.

We had a very lovely experience at Alan's place this weekend. I arrived with my husband on Saturday and Alan made sure we could easily access the flat. The flat is an absolute gem! So tastefully decorated, it is certainly unique as it says in the description. We really love it, it was spotless clean, it has a nice coffe machine that my husband really enjoyed, big flat screen TVs both in the living room and bedroom, the bed was comfortable and sheets and towels were soft and clean.
The flat is in a very nice area, close to a small park and not too far from the old town. We felt safe and it was very easy to reach coffee shops and restaurants as well as the riverside walk. We chose not to take buses to reach the town center as we wanted to walk but Alan has prepared a very handy guide which he has hanged to the kitchen wall explaining transport suggestions, places of interest and house rules.
We did not meet him in person but we kept in touch via messages, he was very friendly and helpful. So if you are undecided I would really say go for it! We loved it and would definitely go back.
Great location. Great host. Everything went really well.

Cozy and efficient little apartment but easily big enough for our 3-person family. Lovely decor. Great location - lots of wonderful cafes, restaurants, shops immediately outside and a short walk to the Royal Mile or other areas. Bit of a haul up the steps if you have heavy luggage but manageable. We loved it and would happily stay again!

Rarely do I want to hang out in my Airbnb, but this one was different. The light was so beautiful. The bed so comfy. I loved having a coffee and watching the sunrise in the morning.
The apartment is super clean and minimal. The shower is fantastic! The hosts made me feel so at home. I’d stay here again in a heartbeat. 💗

Le logement correspond bien à la description et aux photos, il est très pratique et fonctionnel.

Notre séjour chez Gordon s’est très bien passé . Un bon déjeuner nous a été servi .Le café de Gordon est très bon ☕️☕️… important pour des belges(on aime le café le matin)! Très bon rapport qualité prix ❤️

This was the best Airbnb that I have ever stayed in! Communication with the owner and check in were easy and quick. The location was great and very close to all the attractions in Edinburgh. The room size was perfect for two people and both the bedroom and bathroom were very clean. Thanks for having us!
Absolutely no complaints. Very accomodating hosts and a lovely home!

Para quien desee visitar Edimburgo sin preocuparse del coche, le recomiendo la casa de Andrew. Es un anfitrión que hace que te sientas como en tu propia casa. La habitación es amplia y la cama muy cómoda para una pareja. Situación inmejorable de la casa en Cockburn Street, paralela a la Royal Mille y a dos minutos andando de la parada de autobuses y de la estación central de trenes de Waverley. Sobre todo para los que vengan del aeropuerto, pueden coger el Bus número 100 hasta Waverley Ida y vuelta cuesta 7,50 libras. En un fin de semana podrás ver Edimburgo cómodamente y disfrutar de su historia y monumentos.
Nosotros hemos disfrutado este fin de semana del festival Fringe y el ambiente callejero es fantástico, la gente moviéndose frenéticamente por todos los sitios para poder disfrutar de funciones callejeras y actuaciones de músicos desconocidos, pero fantásticos. Ojalá se pudiese copiar este festival en muchas ciudades para dar oportunidad de darse a conocer a muchos artistas.
Eso sí, te sientes como en casa, porque está pegado de españoles de todas las autonomías, tanto de vacaciones como trabajando y buscándose la vida allí, además de chinos, pero estos armados con su cámara, flash, flash, flash.
Si el tiempo respeta, es espectacular disfrutar de esta ciudad y de su gente.
Andrew, thanks for your hospitality!!!!!
Os recomiendo comprar sus originales camisetas pintadas por sus manos.

And to what other reviews have stated, yes it’s quite loud in the apartment, the floors are squeaking and there is an odd smell when entering the building. On top of that there was a constant hammering noise this morning from 7:30 till our check out.

A very clean and spacious flat that was very nicely furnished. The bathroom was large and very clean and the kitchen had everything that was needed. There was also an Aldi supermarket very close to the building next door. We had a great stay, thanks
Great apartment in an incredible location with direct access to the Royal Mile. Comfortable with lots of space to move around, and the host is so easy to work with!
Lovely area, great breakfast around corner.
The place it is amazing!! Situated in the heart of city centre. You can literally walk anywhere as everywhere is nearby.
Great, clean apartment in a perfect location! The host was very friendly and responsive, making the stay even better. I would definitely stay here again!

For a first-timer to Edinburgh, Ayub’s apartment was very convenient and budget-friendly. The apartment was well connected by a short walk to Saughton tram station and through Lothian buses 1, 2 & 22.
The apartment itself was as described - nicely furnished with comfortable beddings. Kitchen amenities were a plus!
Ayub was very responsive and was always available for any assistance or tips needed.
Despite having to climb up the short flight of stairs with my heavy luggage, I had a pleasant stay at the apartment.
Eddie and Natalie are great hosts. Apartment was as advertised, just minutes to all the sights. Very walkable. The apartment was very clean as expected.

Lovely Airbnb! We stayed here for one night and we wished we could stay longer! Super clean and just a beautifully done apartment. The communication was brilliant too. We stayed in Edinburgh as we were going to the Open at St Andrews. The apartment was lovely and clean and very spacious. The double bed was super comfy and the location was ideal for nearby bars and great restaurants.
We will definitely look to stay again when visiting Edinburgh
We had a great stay at Lucy’s place. The place was very clean. The pictures are also very accurate. Would recommend the place.
Btissam was always responsive and friendly. the place was clean and pretty, in a quiet area but still close to the sights :) can recommend
Uncomplicated, friendly, flexible, clean and easy appartement. Thank you, Lynne!
Great location. Walking distance to Parliament and Holyrood Palace. Very safe area and well accommodated. I definitely recommend this place!

Roland was a gracious host who arranged to meet us when we arrived at the apartment (flat in UK lingo) and showed us around the place carefully. He also checked with us later to make sure everything was OK.
The windows are very big and let in a lot of daylight. The bed is comfortable and the shower was as hot as we wished it to be. The place is decorated artistically, in good taste. We had the whole apartment to ourselves, snd it was very quiet.
The immediate neighborhood is residential, but it is only a short wslk to a variety of good restaurants and some convenience stores.
We ate our breakfasts in the dining room/kitchen.
The neighborhood felt safe. It is a 7/10 mile walk to Waverly Station and just under a mile to the Royal Mile. This was not bad for us since we were out the whole day. The distance to the Old City was a good tradeoff for the quiet.
Edinburgh is a wonderful city with so much to do. We especially recommend the Waters of Leith walkway, which offers beautiful and contemplative walking that doesn't feel like its in a bustling city.

We had a lovely stay and the room was spacious and spotless. We felt comfortable and the location is excellent with food places and shops all around. Great links to the city centre. Would definitely stay with Carol again!

It was a perfect stay experience in Edinburgh! The house was exactly same with photos. I and my family satisfied with everything. The hosts are really kind and reply was also fast. I strongly recommand this place if you try to find a place to stay in Edinburgh. Location is also very close to the station. Thank you so much !
回复迅速，房间干净整洁，有相对的自己的空间，主人很友善，我们来的第一天下雨，keith借了把大大的雨伞给我们，还有电源插头，非常感谢你们的帮助

Margaret was so nice and sweet!
We felt we had our own space and intimacy, the room and house were cool and the location was very nice!
We had a great experience.
Beautiful flat. Great shower. Lovely and quiet at night but close to all the sights of Ediburgh
Excellent host and great space!

Our stay was truly delightful. Despite a last-minute train cancellation, we arrived earlier than expected, and the host was incredibly accommodating—handing over the keys before the official check-in time without hesitation. That gesture alone made a stressful travel day much smoother.
The property itself was spotless and well-maintained, earning a solid 5/5 for cleanliness and comfort. It’s conveniently located, making it easy to explore nearby attractions without hassle. The only minor drawback was the train noise at night, which could be a bit disruptive to light sleepers.
Overall, a great experience with a responsive host and a well-situated, clean property.
Great flat, clean, nice bathroom and a great host. Fairly centrally located, a little walk from the actual city centre. Well worth its price!
It was really pleasant to stay in the apartment. It’s such a clean and cosy place to stay for vacation.
Thank You!
Great stay

We hebben ontzettend genoten van ons verblijf! Het appartement was boven verwachting en voldeed volledig aan al onze wensen. Alles was erg schoon en netjes, en bij aankomst stond er zelfs een leuke attentie voor ons klaar een heel warm welkom.
Het contact met de host was erg prettig: er was oprechte interesse, we kregen snel antwoord op vragen en alles verliep soepel. Ook de buurt was ideaal: alles wat je nodig hebt is dichtbij, maar zonder de drukte van de stad.
Dit verblijf heeft zeker bijgedragen aan onze fantastische herinnering aan Edinburgh. Een absolute aanrader!

Thank you it was lovely ,checkout flexible .
The host so friendly and the place so clean , thank you so much
Cost, clean and well located flat.

Amazing location to town and palace. About 20 minute walk to town. 5 minute walk to supermarket , pubs and breakfast cafes.  Very quiet area. And bus service at end of road if needed. Place has everything you need to have a comfortable stay. Uwe answered text and emails and was  communicating with us all the stay and before.

Amazing location and homely feel. Our stay was perfect for a couple and our 2 year old. Eleanor kindly provided us a cot and a highchair. No flights of steps to get into the property which was a massive plus with our pram. Would definitely stay here again. Thank you Eleanor!

The Airbnb was perfect! The team also arranged flowers, flower pedals on the bed and floor, chocolates, champagne, and a hand written card for our arrival! Our honeymoon was amazing! Thank you so much!

Agies Wohnung war der perfekte Ausgangspunkt für die Entdeckung der Stadt, zentral und umgeben von tollen Restaurants und Pubs. Die Wohnung ist groß, geschmackvoll eingerichtet und die zwei Bäder sind toll. Der Netflix Account und das gute Internet sind perfekt für Regentage. Kurz die Kinder und wir haben die Zeit sehr genossen. Danke Agie, für deine Gastfreundschaft und die schnelle Beantwortung unserer Fragen.

The apartment was nice and looked just like the pictures. It was clean and had everything I needed for a short stay. The location was really convenient, close to shops and transport. The host was helpful and easy to reach.
Great location for visiting Edinburgh
非常棒的住宅，房东非常热情，位置又好，还让我意外收获一场高尔夫球！完美的体验
Everything was extremely great; building, location, Paul and Mike and their hospitality, room, breakfast.. We wont be choosing anywhere else for the next time for sure.
Ideal for first timers in Edinburgh that will visit for more than a few days! plenty of amenities to ease your trip. Very central as well.
Clean, comfy room, and fantastic location. I didn’t have the pleasure of meeting the host but the room was easily accessible. This would be my first choice next time I’m in town.
A beautiful space perfectly located, couldn't ask for more for a weekend away. Thanks a lot Scott.
Thanks Olivia!
Everything was absolutely perfect. Great communications, spotless and spacious

Alan’s place was very comfortable, clean and close to lots of bus stations. Walkable distance to Portobello beach which was very nice. Alan was a very nice host and I would recommend staying at his place.
Lovely apartment close to so many attractions, restaurants and shops. Excellent in every way! Highly recommended!

Flexible check in, clear descriptions and exactly as in the pictures and description.
Rustic English charm, no unnecessary clutter and lovely pictures of the Scottish highland cow.🥰
Flushing the toilet is reminiscent of a ship cruise.🚢😅
Very recommend.

Great great location you can imagine!! So close to Edinburgh Castle!! Patrick gave us lots of local tips and really made our trip to Edinburgh impressive! Patrick is the best host I’ve ever met! The room is super awesome with great great window view, high quality & stylish!! Love Edinburgh even more :))

Tatiana was a great host.. prior to our visit she was able to recommend restaurants etc in the area and answer any questions we had. The accommodation was very clean and exactly as described.
不错的体验。房子位置便利，离超市车站都很近。房子空间大，床品干净。厨房用具完备。就是房子有些老旧，地板走起来会响，但是恰好也体验了一下苏格兰老建筑的感觉。总体体验感很不错，给旅程带来了良好的心情。
Excellent séjour, je recommande sans soucis ! L’appartement est très agréable et le centre est très facile d’accès
The flat was great, very spacious and not far from the city centre. Some great places very close for breakfast :)
A wonderfully located flat in the old town with a wonderful view of the castle. A great flat and a very helpful and welcoming host.

Lovely apartment (the pictures don't do it justice, much bigger than expected) in a brilliant location for the centre of town but in a slightly more peaceful street. Michelle was very accommodating with our arrival and departure as we had unfortunately had issues with the flybe collapse,  which helped greatly. A brilliant flat in a brilliant city!! Would strongly recommend and hope to stay here  again.
Calim's place is a wonderful space to enjoy Edinburgh from, In a great location and with some great insider tips from the host! Thank you
The house is very comfortable and clean
Very good location and a cute flat. Had a great time!

I didn't have a good smart phone and was given incorrect instruction how to get there, ending up taking a taxi to get there, however the rest was great.
She was really lovely, made my short holiday excellent. I slept well with very good bed and nice bath and very quite environment.

Lucas as a host was one of the most sweet and friendly that we had ever come across. Made us feel like home and made some insightful recommendations for food and sights in Edinburgh. The place was adjacent to the bus stop and the room was prestine with all the amenities. The bathroom was THE BEST with 5 star hotel like facilities.
P.S. : Lucas makes a bad a** espresso , do ask for some 😉

Everything was perfect, the location is nice a quiet and yet close to the city center. Everything is reachable on foot. Lot of good cafes and restaurant are almost just around the corner. Very comfortable and large bed, rooms were clean and spacious. Can definitely recommend!
Great place to stay.

Graeme’s place was beautiful and as described. We loved staying there. Plenty of room for a family of four. The property is located just 16 minutes from town which we walked most days. There is a keyless code entry system which is great for a seamless check in process. Graeme’s review and recommendations on where to go in Edinburgh were spot on and he was great at communicating. It is a quiet residential location so make sure I that is what you are looking for (which we were). We will definitely be back! X
L'appartamento è una splendida posizione, è accogliente e pulito. Philip è stato gentilissimo e molto disponibile. Assolutamente consigliato!!!
A lovely property in a great location with a very welcoming host. Thanks for helping to make our trip a great weekend.
Un hospedaje genial. Apartamento sencillo, a 20 min andando del centro, zona muy tranquila y acogedora en una de las ciudades más bellas del planeta!
Had a great stay! Really cool and stylish apartment in a great location close to pretty much everything!
The location was better than expected.  Really could not have asked for more in that regard.  The apartment was very clean and had amazing views.  We highly recommend Brian's place!

Nous avons passé une nuit dans le logement de Monica, car nous reprenions le train le lendemain en gare d'Édimbourg.
Les instructions pour accéder au logement étaient très claires, avec un accès au garage et donc un stationnement sécurisé et gratuit. Le logement était très propre, la literie, confortable. L'accès à deux arrêts de bus se fait en 5mn. Se rendre dans le centre d'Édimbourg est donc très facile, avec des bus qui circulent jusqu'à minuit, toutes les 15/20mn. Il y a ensuite les bus de nuit.
Tout le nécessaire était présent dans le logement, je le recommande vivement.
Wow! Great location with lots to do and see! Very comfortable amenities. We really enjoyed Scotland and this place contributed to our enjoyment. I would recommend.

The place was very clean, comfortable and located in a nice district with several places to have a drink, morning coffee and only 10/15 min to the train station. Mingjun was answering very quick to my messages regarding check in and some other stuff. Thanks for hosting us.
Great place. Parking available and still walkable to city centre. Instructions were great. Clean. If you don't fancy instant coffee, take your own plunger.

A group of 14 of us stayed at No19 The Apartment during the festival. I was tasked with booking the accommodation meaning that most of the group had not seen the place until they arrived. When they did their reactions said it all. Everyone was full of praise for the place as it certainly has that wow factor. To sum it up No19 The Apartment is quite simply amazing. Stylishly decorated, spacious, brilliant location and reasonably priced. Belinda and Stephen provided excellent communication throughout and couldn't have been more helpful. I highly recommend booking this place!

Man fühlt sich in der Wohnung schnell wohl und hat alles was man braucht. Sie liegt gleich neben einem schönen Park und Bushaltestellen sind reichlich in der Nähe. Bei Fragen musste man nie lange auf eine freundliche Antwort warten. Alles in allem kann ich die Wohnung empfehlen.

An absolutely stunning apartment perfectly placed for exploring Edinburgh. The apartment had everything we needed to make our stay comfortable and Martin and Weng went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed. They were very easy to communicate with and were happy to be flexible to make our lives easier with a baby. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend and would love to return one day.

Everthing was as described: the kitchen is equiped with everthing one could need, the apartement is lovely decorated, the bed is extremely comfortable and the hostess is very kind. Various busses take you to the city centre. All in all a very pleasant stay.
Very clean and cosy stay! The apartment was just like the pictures. Great communication from Daniel. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Everything (cleaning, furniture and security) was great but there was a heating problem that the rooms’ temperature was 15 degrees C (Outside was 10 so, no heating at all). Home owner could not resolve the issue.

Rona nous a accueilli personnellement et a été sympathique et à l'écoute de nos besoins tout au long de notre sejour. Le logement était parfait pour un weekend à Édimbourg, je recommande fortement et y retournerai sans hésitation.
Very helpful and flexible with checking in and out, in a great area, not too far from central Edinburgh, good price and extremely comfortable - fantastic to go back too after a long day exploring.
Amazing location  and the apartment has everything you need. Great host and easy to contact and check in etc. Thanks for a great stay!
Very convenient to visit central Edinburgh and the festival activities

Die Unterkunft ist prinzipiell sehr schön und sehr gut ausgestattet.
Gedacht ist die Wohnung für bis zu 5 Personen. Wir waren zu zweit. Zu den Betten muss noch Folgendes gesagt werden:
1 Schlafzimmer mit sehr schmalem Doppelbett ca. 1,40 cm breit.
1 sehr kleiner Raum, in den gerade 1 Einzelbett passt ohne Fenster und nur durch ein kleines Oberlicht Richtung Küche schwach erleuchtet.
1 Schlafsofa für 2 Personen im Wohnzimmer.
In der gesamten Wohnung lässt sich leider kein einziges Fenster öffnen. D.h. Schlafen bei offenem Fenster ist nicht möglich. Außer der Eingangstür zur Strasse gibt es noch eine Tür von der Küche aus in den Garten.
Die Lage ist sehr gut und auch ruhig gelegen. Die Gastgeberin kommuniziert schnell und freundlich!
Lovely stay! Clean, comfortable and a great location.

Todo muy bien y limpio.
Solo dos cosas para que tengan en cuenta:
Deberian avisar que son 3 pisos por escaleras, ya que llevamos equipajes pesados y nos costó mucho subirlos y bajarlos.
Por lo demás, todo excelente.

Uns hat es in der Wohnung sehr gut gefallen, sie ist chic und stylisch, es war alles da, was wir für einen guten Aufenthalt brauchen, ohne dass man sofort zum einkaufen gehen muss, inklusive Kaffeekapseln. Die Treppen kein Problem, das wussten wir ja, willkommenes Fitnesstraining. Bushaltestellen direkt vor der Haustüre so sind wir bequem überall hingekommen und abends nach dem Essen sogar zu Fuß bequeme 20 Minuten nach Hause spaziert. Etwas ruhiger könnte es sein, aber für eine Stadt so wie wir damit gerechnet hatten und es ging gut, ich hatte mir Citylärm schlimmer vorgestellt (lebe zuhause auf dem Land) und die Fenster gehen zur Seite raus, also geschützt. Die Betten waren ausnehmend bequem, bestens geschlafen. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Cafés in unmittelbarer Nähe. Und Edinburgh an sich, was für eine tolle Stadt! Sehr genossen, alles prima und die Wohnung würden wir jedem empfehlen!

The apartment was lovely. Caroline was a great host making sure everything was ok on arrival. There was a small problem with hot water which was dealt with promptly. Yes it was noisy at night but we expected that being in the centre of the nightlife. It was a great base to spent a weekend seeing the sights of Edinburgh. I would definitely stay there again.

A lovely place, and quite close to the centre. Commute is straightforward and fast (20 minutes by bus). Check-in and check-out are automated and easy — we didn’t have to reach out to the host even once during our stay. The room is cosy, and the bathroom is huge, clean, and well-equipped. Shared spaces were not busy at all. It was a memorable stay — would love to come back one day🌟
Smooth check in&out experience, tidy and cozy room with a great price rate.
Lucy is a very great host.
We had a wonderful stay, thank you.
Great value for 3 of us. Rosie was really responsive and let us check in early😊 a perfect base for seeing Edinburgh!

Great stay at this adorable spot! Decor was super stylish, kitchen had all the amenities for cooking breakfast or dinner in, it’s within walking distance to all the tourist & locals spots, and the communication with Darius’ team was spectacular. Highly recommend!!
The room was very comfortable and warm. Alison was very friendly and the breakfasts were delicious. Very close to walk to the centre of edinburgh.
Thanks for all.
Really handy for tram/buses into City Centre. Lots of decent pubs within walking distance. Excellent value for money and a really informative host. Highly recommended.
A nice flat in a good location (~10 min walk to the city centre). Good contact with the host :)

The apartment was perfectly located in Edinburgh and close to everything. Large apartment with lots of amenities and great communication by the evergreen team.
The only downside was that the front bedroom faces onto Grassmarket and it is very noisy at night and even into the early morning (3 am) because of the bars. Difficult to sleep in the bedroom facing grassmarket.
Very nice and cozy place! Great location, close to downtown. Highly recommend!

We had a great time in Edinburgh and the studio was lovely. The studio was located a bit away from the old town, but it was super easy to reach and it didn't take long (bus stop(s) were right outside our door). Around the corner is a street with everything you need like restaurants, (coffee) shops and supermarkets. The studio itself is beautiful, clean and well equipped. It's tucked away behind/between buildings, which makes it wonderfully quiet.
Mairi is very friendly and accommodating. We loved staying here and would definitely want to stay here again if we go back to Edinburgh.

We enjoyed the location of the apartment, it was easy to get to everything downtown.  Such a beautiful walkable area.  The kitchen was fairly well equipped.  Our only complaints were the the host was slow to respond to our first couple of inquiries and the mattress in the larger bedroom was extremely saggy in the middle - leading to very uncomfortable backs.

We enjoyed our time in this place. The flat is near restaurants, public transportation, the castle, museums, and more all within walking distance. The only thing I would note is that this flat is located above a pub and in an alley way, it can be a bit loud at night. Overall, it was a great experience and we loved our time.

lovely property, conveniently located in a great part of Edinburgh. Plenty of amenities locally.
Everything you need to make your stay worthwhile.
Comfortable stay with great communication from Sophie. Excellent instructions to find the key safe and  flat fits description. Easy tram ride in to centre.

This place is so perfect, I almost don’t want to tell anyone else about it & live there forever! Felt so at peace living with the geese, ducks, swans & many other birds in this truly beautiful cottage. Everything in perfect proportion. Super comfortable & light. Also so good that it’s really easy to get to the lovely Queensferry & Edinburgh itself. Will be returning again next time we visit Scotland.
Se siente como estar en casa ! El cuarto es muy agradable, luminoso y dormimos muy bien. Realmente nos encantó esta sensación de tranquilidad y sentirnos como si visitamos un familiar en Edimburgo.
Great location and the flat was absolutely beautiful!

This apartment is in a prime location. It was no more than a 5-15 minute walk from anything my husband and I wanted to do in Edinburgh. The apartment was beautiful and clean. Very modern and welcoming. Ben was also very helpful. He had so many suggestions and tips, and was very quick to respond when we had questions. I can't recommend this place more!

Great stay at Taiba! The view is amazing, looking straight out into Edinburgh castle. It's great being a penthouse, with the one downside that you do have to walk up the flight of stairs everyday (no elevator)
Cozy and stylish apartment with awesome surroundings

Nice trendy/modern décor really cute spot by the park, my husband and I just got married in Fort Augustus and we had a lovely stay in Edinburgh! Highly recommend getting couples photos with @landlphotographyyy

Fantastic location, great Greek down the road, Taxidi, best mousakka I have ever had! The apartment was lovely and spacious , very clean and light furniture.
Definitely recommend to anyone

Martin and his place are both amazing. We cannot be happier with everything. Martin was waiting for us at the appointment to show us everything. Two large bedrooms along with wonderful living space worked perfect. The location cannot be beat: perfect to visit both old town and new town. We had the most amazing time in Edinburgh and this place had a lot to do with our overall experience. Highly recommended. I know I will certainly reach out to him if I am planning a visit again.
Great location with great connectivity. Though the place is small, good for a few days.
Great stay! Sam communicates very clearly and as a result getting to the Airbnb/checking in is so easy! Great location and value - I would stay again.

We’ve had a wonderful weekend in Janice’s home; it felt very homely,is a great size and very comfortable, and had everything we needed. It’s close to the centre of Leith, with its lovely cafés and waterfront, and bus stops to the centre of Edinburgh. The Royal Yacht Britannia is within walking distance.
Parking locally was challenging at times, but this could have been impacted on by the tram/roadworks and the Edinburgh Fringe.
I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this house, and Janice was very friendly and helpful.
Home is as advertised. Comfort and walking distance to local restaurants and businesses.
Cosy apartment that has great facilities. Had a lovely stay and will definitely be booking again sometime in the near future!

Leila is a great host, friendly and knowledgeable about the locality and Edinburgh more generally. She is warm and welcoming and I would recommend a stay at her house without hesitation. It is a stylish and well maintained property.

Great Airbnb, a short walk away from the centre where of Edinburgh.
We would normally stay in a hotel with the children as they like a pool so this is a perfect place as it's has access to a lovely pool and sauna. Shirt walk away from lively restaurant's and Princess Street. Would definitely stay here again.

Very nice place and it is walkable to downtown, but be aware it's a mile uphill, no problem for us but might be for some. Well appointed and very quiet, an excellent home base to explore. A few things missing like detergent, napkins, but a store right around the corner. In general, we recommend. Host extremely responsive.

The flat is almost newly decorated and really comfortable. Also, the host is quite easily to contact by phone which is a nice thing for travelers. If we could find other chances to go there again , I would contact Graeme again definitely.

Pazartesi ve salı 2 gece konakladık,erken check in yapabilseydik daha mutlu olurduk (daireyle ilgili tek negatif yorumum ) .alttaki barın kalabalıklığını görmediğimiz için ses hakkında yorum yapamam. Wunderschöne Wohnung und sehr sauber. Der Parkplatz im Hof ist für alle, die mit dem Auto anreisen, unglaublich prakisch, da in der Gegend nur Anwohner-Parken erlaubt ist. Man kann das Auto stehen lassen, die Innenstadt ist bequem zu Fuß zu erreichen. Liz ist eine großartige Gastgeberin - vielen Dank für die Frühstücksutensilien. Wir würden die Wohnung jederzeit wieder buchen - uneingeschränkt zu empfehlen.

Superb home.
Would highly recommend.
Plenty of space and within walking distance to the city centre.

Amazing place, nicely decorated and cozy with everything you might need. Located on a calm and safe area, well connected to the city centre (we even walked).
We would repeat for sure!
Great location quite in the evenings easy to find comfortable beds ticked all of our boxes

Brilliant place basically in the royal mile, could not fault the location, or the apartment.Clean, tidy and well appointed. Binnur was very kind to allow us to drop our bags early, thanks so much. Would definitely recommend
Very nice, well located flat immaculately presented with thoughtful welcome extras
Un lugar tranquilo, muy limpio, contacto con Olga instantáneo. La casa es bonita.

Liv and Lee were really open, friendly and helpful. The room was very cosy and had everything we needed. We felt like home.  The location was very convenient,  easy access to the city center by bus. The bust stop 2 minute walk from the accommodation. I highly recommend Liv and Lee if you want to visit Edinburgh.
Bon séjour,  très bien placé 👍

Very happy with my stay, would have loved to stay longer and really explore the city.  The unit was perfect, clean, and conveniently located next to public transportation and walking distance to castle and royal mile.  Parking right around corner.  Dragon was very helpful and communicated with us every step of the way. Check in was quick, easy, and seamless. Be prepared to carry your luggage up the narrow steep stairs and know there is a drying rack, not a dryer in the unit.

Great location and a good setup for 3 of us. Lilly was very responsive when I had a question about check-in. I didn’t need a kitchen as we tend to eat out on vacation anyways. I would stay again if I visited again.

We had a lovely stay with Jenna. The room and apartment was spotless- it was exactly like the photos! The area is also nice and quiet, and is easy to get to and from the city center. We would gladly stay here again!

Lukaz and his girlfriend are great hosts. I have stayed here twice now and never had any issues. Each room has its on TV and lock for the doors. There is a kitchen which is great if you want to cook and save money and a little seating area. The apartment is outside the city center but the bus stop is about a 5 minute walk away and the bus to the city center takes about 15-20 minutes depending on where you want to get off.

We had such a wonderful time at Vivien’s Airbnb. The place was so beautiful, well kept and clean. It was close to town and walkable to the bus stop.
The decoration was stunning and we felt right at home. We would love to stay again! If I could give more than 5 stars, I would!
Thank you to Vivien and her lovely family.
Absolutely loved this beautiful flat in a historic building overlooking Dean Bridge. We stayed for Christmas with our son and it was the most perfect holiday for us.

This location is amazing! Great local pubs, grocery store, tram stop, and easy walk to the big tourist spots. Place is clean, very comfortable. Many little extras made our stay fantastic. Lewis is a great host and gave incredible detailed instructions for us to feel confident finding his place from airport. Perfect stay.

Lovely apartment in a perfect location. Considering it was close to amenities the apartment was really quiet. Pristinely clean and had everything we needed. We only had a short stay but would absolutely book again for a longer stay. Stuart was also really helpful and responsive to messages.

Really cute and clean centrally located spot, super convenient for shopping, eating, and exploring Edinburgh—we were able to stop in throughout the day to drop off shopping bags or grab raincoats between activities. Our flight also got in earlier than expected and Shahryar was responsive and accommodating, letting us check in a little earlier so we didn’t have to lug suitcases around the city until check-in. We loved it here!
Felt right at home! A lovely plot to pitch up and explore Edinburgh and surrounding areas - all round brill
We had an amazing time at Anke’s place. Apartment is breathtaking and cozy with a beautiful small garden. Close to public transport and very private. Highly recommended!
I was not able to keep my reservation however Dan was very responsive and pleasant to work with. I recommend this amazing place because the host was great!

We came to Edinburgh (two adults, one teen) for the Fringe and biking - both were easy to do from this lovely apartment, which was out of the craziness of the city center but was walkable and had easy bus stops. The apartment was clean and cozy, as described, and communication was prompt and helpful. Highly recommend!
Great location. Spacious flat. Just like the photos. Great shower pressure. Basic amenities, could do with a deep clean and a few extra touches but overall a good base to stay in Edinburgh.
Nice apartment close to the royal mile perfect for fringe fest.  First floor apartment, the street is normally quiet.
loved our stay here!! very walkable
Everything was as described.  Only minor issue was the primary staircase primary lighting was not on during our evening return.

Lovely apartment, spacious and clean in a quiet residential area, the owner Viv and husband were both friendly and helpful.
Within 2 minutes walk there is a bus stop which takes you into the city or to Leith the £4 day ticket is great hop on off buses and trams all day. You can also walk to Waverley station in about 30 minutes.
Small Tesco and Sainsbury within 5 minutes walk for essentials.
Would thoroughly recommend.
我很荣幸可以租到这样的房子。这真的是太棒了！房间与描述的完全一致，而且比照片上还多了一张三人沙发。打开窗户的景色也非常漂亮！最棒的是这套房间在市中心，离卡尔顿山很近。
Ryan was a great host! Super responsive! The air bnb was in a great location and has everything you need!

Really large space, did not expect it to be that large and spacious. The artwork in the flat gave so much charm. It was quite a bit of walk to city centre but the bus station is right outside the flat making it so convenient.

Beautiful property, just as the photos suggest. If you have your own transport it would be a fabulous place to stay whilst exploring Edinburgh as i think it’s is only a few minutes drive to the tram station which takes you in to central Edinburgh.
Vicky and John were lovely to deal with and I looking forward to going back.

We had such a great stay and would highly recommend. Perfect location with everything you would need, can't wait to go back.

Great apartment, clean with all facilities we needed.

Perfect location, beautiful property with large airy rooms. Although we had snow and freezing temperatures it was still cosy warm inside the flat. Everything you would  need was provided. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

We had lovely stay. Its very comfortable and the "kitchen" offers a lot of helpful supplies. We recommend this place!

Tony's place on Edmonstone's Close has a number of definite advantages. The place is spacious, pretty clean and very central - especially when Edinburgh is hopping during the August Festival.
However, there are a number of things to consider before renting.
1/ Access to the apartment was not as described. The instructions said the keybox had a particular marking, but we could not find any that matched the description, perhaps because it has rubbed off but no-one had bothered to check? When I called the phone number given for difficulties, the agent could not give clear directions regarding the location of the correct keybox and it was only by trial and error that we got the keys.
Further, when I asked if the address was apartment 2 in building 4 or the other way around, the agent completely misdirected us! It was only when other renters happened to turn up that we were able to eliminate the incorrect option. We were told that someone was coming to help, but they did not turn up for 30 minutes, by which time we’d worked it out ourselves.
But because of this, we were late for our first Ed Fest event and were not allowed into the theatre (wasted tickets GBP30). If the instructions had been clearer or the help more responsive, we would not have missed the show. As it was, the whole check-in process was unclear, frustrating and costly.
2/ The apartment is supposed to have two full bathrooms, one with a bathtub. Only a few days before our booking, we were told that the bathtub/shower in the master bathroom was unusable because of a leak.
This made a big difference to our stay, as my partner regards a morning bath as part of any vacation and the tub was one of our reasons for choosing the apartment. Still, by the time our host informed us of this problem, it was really too late to find alternative accommodation.
When we arrived at the apartment, I noticed that the sign saying we could not use the bath/shower in the master bathroom was laminated. It's possible that this was a recent response to the leak problem, but the permanent nature of the sign made me suspect that the problem has been ongoing for some time, but the host only informed us as clients after both payments we made and it was really too late for us to find other accommodation. I can't say this for sure of course, but if the bathtub and use of both bathrooms is important to you, please do check both bathrooms are fully functional well in advance of any payments.
If renting in summer, the apartment can get quite hot and stuffy, yet there is no cooling and not even room fans provided. You can open the windows in the cool of the evening, but there's quite a smell of cooking grease through the front room windows onto the Close (from the Mussels restaurant below) and both bedroom windows open onto a back street full of nightclubs, which pump it out till the wee hours, and from which people noisily emerge till 4 or 5am on weekends or during the Festival month.
4/ During our stay, the latch on the washer/drier was completely broken off, meaning you could not open the latch or use the laundry at all.
5/ The power point that you need to turn on to use the freezer makes a continual beep that you can hear through the walls into both bedrooms. Your choice is to keep your ice and ice cream frozen, or to have a peaceful sleep!
In short, the apartment itself is pretty good, but it is neither well maintained nor well managed, especially for the premium price.
In fairness, I should mention that we got small-ish refunds for both the bathroom issue and the check-in problems leading to our missed Edinburgh Festival show. But knowing what we do now, I would not rent again.

Ruth was an amazing host, she gave us so many suggestions and was very accommodating. We checked in very late and she ensured that we got to her place from the airport smoothly with clear instructions. The room was exactly like the pictures too !!

A fantastic place, convenient to town - walking to sightseeing, restaurants, bars, museums.
We even ordered uber eats and it was convenient.
Very comfortable space, lots of place for a family to spend time together and have privacy for calls. Kitchen was great too, and Jimmy and Mary left a few drinks for us!
We even caught up with them one evening on their amazing outside terrace with a fire pit - this was optional and we chose to say hello.

El apartamento es amplio, hemos viajado 2 adultos , 2 niños y 2 bebés y hemos estado cómodos.
Lo único malo al ir con carro de bbe es un tercero sin ascensor.
Si volvemos a Edimburgo sería para repetir 😊
This was a gorgeous & such a comfortable airbnb stay. Many thanks to Mark for his wonderful accommodation, clear communication & warm welcome. I would love to return sometime !
Very nice host and premium location flat !
Great apartment, easy and quick to get to central Edinburgh with the tram
Walkable, goo restaurants and safety place.

What a great location! Can see the castle from rear of building, and a very easy walk to it! Perfect him base for touring beautiful Edinburgh. The flat was very comfortable and clean. Although we didn't meet, our communication with Filip was good, he responded to all messages in a timely fashion!

Cuando reservé tenía la conciencia de que el lugar era económico, pero porque elegí una habitación compartida con ocho personas. Sin embargo, optar por una habitación económica no significa que deba estar sucia y eso fue lo que me ocurrió. La habitación tenía mal olor y cuando ingrese a mi cama noté que las sábanas estaban sucias y llenas de cabello de otra persona. Además, me enfermé con todo el polvo y las pelusas del lugar. Cuando hice el check-out regresé por mi maleta que había dejado en la bodega, pero antes fui a la habitación para asegurarme de no haber olvidado nada debido a que salí temprano por la mañana y no quería molestar a los otros huéspedes. Entonces me di cuenta de que ya habían arreglado mi cama pero no habían cambiado sábanas, solo recogieron el edredón y lo doblaron para dejarlo como cuando lo encontré.

Mijn dochter en ik hebben een geweldige tijd gehad in Edinburgh. De locatie was top! Bus lijn 11 stopte praktisch voor de deur en bracht ons naar Princess street in hartje Edinburgh. Je kunt overal met je bankpas betalen. Erg handig! Vanaf het vliegveld kun je de tram pakken met eindbestemming NewHaven. Dat is ongeveer een uurtje. Vanaf NewHaven is het een kwartiertje lopen naar het appartement van de host Raymond. Met de bussen kun je eigenlijk alles bereiken  dit is erg goed geregeld tegen een zeer redelijke prijs.  We hebben Raymond in die week eigenlijk maar twee keer gezien en gezellig met elkaar gesproken. Eigenlijk heb je heel veel privacy in het appartement. Wij bevelen Raymond van harte aan. Raymond is een goede host en qua kosten van het appartement is het een goede prijs kwaliteit verhouding.
Easy to check-in, responsive host, and quiet location (we didn't have any issues with the pub downstairs).
Tolle Unterkunft, zum weiterempfehlen!!! Dankee
Amazing location to use as a base to discover Edinburgh. We had lots of fun. Really comfy and welcoming and the bed was perfect. Thank you so much.

Martin's apt is centrally located and very tidy and modern. The couch is comfy, the bathroom floors are heated. The apt is very comfortable for 2 people. He even provided a nice breakfast of breakfast bars, eggs, toast, and milk. I would highly recommend his apt and would definitely stay there again if I could! It is very reasonably priced and Martin is very helpful!

We stayed with our 8 month old for 3 nights and had an overall good experience. Rebecca was very responsive before our arrival and during our stay. Conveniently located and good for a weekend getaway!

Place is as beautiful as captured in the photos. Location is perfect, with easy access to everything you'll want to see. This is also a ground floor unit, which is perfect for anyone with mobility issues. Keyless entry made it easy for multiple people to exit and enter as needed. Great communication from Gintare upon check in and check out. Great experience and would definitely stay again!
Susan was really welcoming and lovely, it was a pleasure to stay at her place. The room was also very big and nice and in a good location.

First, the scaffolding is off the windows and the Castle view is now restored!
Lewis' apartment is exactly as described in the listing. We loved the central location with easy access to buses and great walkability. The place is very comfortable, very clean, and perfect for a visit to Edinburgh. Lewis is a fantastic communicator and a great host. I would stay here again without hesitation.
The space is always very clean and organized for a 5 star stay
Eilidh & Matthew ont été très accueillants et gentils. L’appartement est parfait, central, très propre et très accommodant ! Je recommande à 100%.

L’estada a casa del Johnnie ha estat perfecta!!!.La casa era nova, inpecable i en Johnnie ens ha fet sentir més com a convidats que com a hostes. Ha tingut la delicadesa de ser amable i proactiu sense ser gens invasiu. Ens hi hem sentit cuidats. La comunicació ha estat perfecta. Quan tornem a Edimburg esperem poder tornar a allotjar-nos amb ell. Ho recomanem no sols com a un allotjament standard sinò com un lloc on hom s’hi sent acollits. Ho recomanaren als nostres familiars i amics
Gràcies Johnnie i fins aviat!!!

This apartment was very clean and looks just like the pictures. It was just a touch smaller then we had originally thought it was going to be. But, that was perfectly fine. It has all the amenities that you could want including iron, blowdryer, and robes. It is in an ok location. Not the best not also not the worse. It is a long walk to get to the attractions. We used Uber to get to the around. Deborah was very kind and answered quickly to all questions. All in all it is a cute apartment and a good experience.

Great place, great location. Will is a very nice guy and easy to communicate with. We really loved the way he had decorated the apartment. We'd stay at this apartment again the next time we go to Edinburgh.
So close to Hollyrood,  beautiful walking and felt safe.
Great hosts, allowed us to check in early and gave some great recommendations.
Great Location, well heated and all amenities provided

Me sentí muy segura aquí, respecto a mí siendo mujer en otro país y respecto a dejar mis cosas. La habitación tiene todas las comodidades que puedes necesitar. Está muy bien decorada, en general todo el piso, es cálido y funcional. Además, la ubicación es excelente, estás cerca de variadas tiendas y a tan solo unos minutos del centro de la ciudad y transportes para todos los lugares. Thanh-Lan respondió muy rápido y me ayudó con unos detalles de hora, así que muy agradecida. Lo mejor son sus dos perritos.
Te recomiendo encarecidamente hospedarte aquí :)
Unser Aufenthalt war perfekt. Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben und Calum & Karen sehr freundlich. Es hat alles super geklappt.
A beautiful apartment. Would stay again if going to edinburgh!

beautiful, spacious apartment in the heart of the city. Right on The Royal Mile! I went with my brother so we wanted a two room apt so it was excellent. Great character, very clean and excellent communication with the agency. Check in was easy. It was expensive but the location and the apt itself were fabulous!!
good one

Ci siamo trovati benissimo in un appartamento spazioso, dotato di due piani e un bagno molto bello. La posizione è perfetta, raggiungi tutto a piedi e sei in pieno centro. L'host è molto cordiale e disponibile
Jon’s place was a great stay for us as we explored the city. Comes recommended for others in the future.
Excellent room, clean and tidy. Lots of local information too.
Great location and amenities! Perfect spot to truly enjoy Edinburgh.

Viv’s place is cozy, sweet, sparkling clean, quiet and very functional. All the facilities are in great operation which made our trip very comfortable and convenient. We took Uber everyday and it was just about 10min drive to city center. Unfortunately we didn’t get a chance to see the host but the response especially prior to check-in was timely and helpful. I would recommend my friends to stay here for sure. Hope I have the chance to come back!
Felt very welcome by Denis, room very spacious and clean. Had a good nights sleep.

A estadia foi perfeita. O local é organizado, extremamente limpo e cheiroso. O ambiente é bonito, aconchegante e com espaço na medida. Disponibilizaram berço e cadeira de alimentação para o meu filho, o que facilitou muito nosso dia a dia. Além disso, a localização é perfeita. Fazíamos tudo a pé. Quando volta a Edimburgo, ficarei lá novamente.

Lovely flat in a great location.  Property is beautifully appointed and central to historic Edinburgh.  Host kindly accommodated our special request and responded quickly to all communications.  Our family was very comfortable in the flat and would definitely recommend.
Good,easy in approach,good host.

Location, location, location! Katie and Christian’s place is ideal for exploring the old town in Edinburgh and only a short walk to further adventures in new town. The space is cute and clean, and all communications were clear and prompt. It’s true what they say that the 2nd bedroom doesn’t really have space for anything else if you use two beds in there, but that didn’t really matter for us as we spent most of our time out exploring. Would stay again.
Great apartment and fantastic location!!
Good place in old town Edinburgh!
Great location for enjoying the Fringe. Handy having the kitchenette too. Would stay again.

Muy lindo departamento
Impecablemente amoblado, con muy buen gusto
La cama como disipa
Tenía todo lo necesario para una buena estadía
Un detalle importante cuando uno está viajando, el lavarropas muy bueno y el tender para secar la ropa, buenísimo, muy creativo
El barrio muy tranquilo, muchas ofertas de restaurantes y de tiendas de provisiones
Murray siempre fue muy amable y respondió consultas con rapidez
En pocas palabras un DIEZ
VOLVERÍA A ALQUILARLO

We spend five days at Maureen and Jago’s home. We had a warm welcome and a very pleasant stay in the double bed room. The bathroom was small but tidy. The living room and infitments left cozy and warm impressions. Edinburgh is a small city. So the apartment is not far away from city center. We recommend host and apartment to upcoming visitors and like to say thank you for all!
Hitomi+Lars

I'm so happy we found this absolute gem, Laura is an excellent host and her place was gorgeous, clean, spacious, and well stocked with nice amenities you wouldn't expect at an airbnb. I will definitely be staying here again!

Mary's place has many qualities.
Even though it is located in the suburb of Edinburgh, the free parking on the street and the 20 minutes bus ride to the center (the bus stop is right in front of the house) is very convenient. It is also quite close to the airport (15 min by car) and for people like us who had an early flight back, it was much appreciated.
The appartment was very clean and practical for our family of 2 adults and 2 kids. The kitchen is small and only has a microwave so you can't cook. But for a short stay it's not very much of a problem.
The supermarket is right in front of the house which was perfect.
Mary was also very kind and reactive.
The appartment also have a few flaws.
There's no real place to sit and eat, as there is only a sofa and a low table.
But the major issue for me was the noise. The place is located on a very big road with a lot of traffic and it was impossible not hear the cars at night even with earplugs.
We did have a nice stay overall!

Bridget was a fantastic host sending clear instructions for check in and the flat so we could be the most comfortable during our stay. The flat was immaculate; beautifully decorated, furnished and spotless.
Great location with a fantastic restaurant up the road (Herringbone Abbeyhill) and a great coffee shop (Little Fitzroy) nearby and walkable to the town centre as well as close to bus stops to make it easy to get around. Perfect for what we needed!
Thanks again to Bridget for a great stay!

The apartment is wonderful! Perfectly located, very clean, easy to access and great sitting areas to relax in after a long day. The only issue is noise (which is possibly expected considering you are right in the city center), but it was especially bad on Friday and Saturday night. The top floor room was the best for noise. Otherwise, the flat is perfect and just as described.
Wonderful place, perfect neighborhood and Andrew is the best host. You will love your stay.
Sevi 님의 친절하고 섬세한 셋팅이 돋보였습니다 . 친절히 맵으로 동네설명을 해주시며 대화를 이끌어주셔서 따뜻한 집과 같은 편안함을 느낄수 있었습니다
Lily is a wonderful host, she made my stay extremely convenient and was very easy to join and helpful. Her apartment is absolutely lovely and perfectly located in Edinburgh. I’ll come back for sure!

We absolutely loved our stay at Quendale 32 in Edinburgh! The host prepared everything with care and attention to detail, from thoughtfully arranged books and notes to beautifully chosen furniture; every corner felt welcoming and well-considered. The room was cosy and relaxing, perfect for unwinding after a day in the city.
The location is great, with easy access to the city centre, and the host kindly sent all the necessary information well in advance, making everything smooth.
The bathroom is located just outside the room and is shared with only one other room, which wasn’t a problem. It was always clean and nearby.
I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Edinburgh!
Was a great place to stay and explore the city.
Lovely stay, clean flat. 20 minute walk into Edinburgh town but a little further to proper restaurants. Beds were super comfy and everything in the flat was in good condition
Lovely stay in a great location near lots of cafes and restaurants. Maia was the perfect host and we felt right at home here.
Lovely accommodation fantastic location close to edinburgh royal infirmary
We spent 8 nights in this flat.  The location is very good on a quite street.  Emma was very responsive and we were able to easily come and go.  I highly recommend it.

Our fourth stay here was pleasant.
The HostEd-team that now manages the flat is very nice. A neat folder provides information on WIFI, heating etc. Towels, soap etc. are provided.
We were a bit unlucky this time because there was an awful sewer smell in the small bathroom. They sent someone to clear it, but it was back after a few hours. We couldn’t get rid of the smell either. This is the reason for four instead of five stars this time. (On a minor note, a dirty bed cover at our arrival was resolved quickly: We were brought a new one the next day.)
Everything else was perfect. The interior has changed again since our last stay, and the new bathroom and washer room are a great improvement. The swing, most important to our kids, was still there.
The location is super. You can access the beach within a minute. (Bring a dark towel for your sandy feet after a swim so you don’t get the nice white towels dirty.) A playground, shops and bus stops are close by.
We'd love to come back again.
Denis was the most friendly and lovely guy showing me around and offering help wherever I needed it. It really felt like I was back in my childhood home for a night! Thank you for having me.

Great location! Easy to get to all parts of the city and conveniently located in the heart of the city as well. The space was really nice, clean & spacious. It does get loud at times but that’s expected as it’s on a very popular street. It actually adds to the ambiance and I enjoyed people watching. Would definitely recommend!

The space was perfect for our trip, we were in a quieter area and able to walk to all the major areas or easily take a bus which was right out side our door.
Tesco right across the street for easy access.
Inside was perfectly decorated! We truly loved our time here.
Nuestra anfitriona hizo todo para hacernos sentir bienvenidos, y lo logró! La habitación es hermosa, cómoda y muy cálida. La ubicación es perfecta, el barrio es muy lindo y tranquilo.

Just returned from a fabulous weekend visiting Edinburgh to celebrate husband’s 50th
Kathy was such a kind and helpful host and always really fast responding to messages.
The apartment was spacious and had 2 bathrooms which was great. A small balcony to enjoy a morning cuppa was also lovely.
It’s in a great location. Literally a couple of minutes from Hibs football stadium.
We did a mixture of walking to at the attractions, Calton Hill 20 mins, Arthur’s seat 30 mins, Royal mile 35 mins, Leith 35 mins. We took Ubers just for convenience a few times too which were around £5-£7
Would highly recommend Kathy’s place for value for money and personalised service.
A box of chocolates was left for as a happy birthday gift too which was a lovely gesture.
Thanks Kathy
Great location on the edge of Grassmarket. Well furnished, with comfy bedding and access to Netflix. Host was very responsive and helpful. Would recommend
The location can’t be beat - and notwithstanding its location on the Royal Mile, outside noise was minimal. The flat was well-equipped. Check in and out were super easy.

LOVED OUT STAY HERE! What a beautiful place. Our stay was perfect here. The location is close to the airport, we took a taxi when we arrived into the city. To get into the city centre, we walked 1 3/4 miles to a park and ride which had a bus that went right to the main strip. Convenient for us as we enjoyed the walk. The house is immaculate!!!! We had so much space. A comfortable and spacious room with a modern and updated bathroom. A shower room with what seemed like a heated floor. A bar/kitchen area along with a living room with flat screen TV. There was also a loft area for additional space. So beautiful! The area is very quiet and private. We didn't get a chance to meet Vicky but her husband was extremely accommodating for our stay. Definitely would LOVE to stay here again! HIghly recommend it!

A beautiful flat in a fabulous location, and has an amazing view! It was a wonderful place to spend a few days and so much care and attention has been put into it's presentation. There was a little confusion during communication regarding check in, but everything was resolved and we had a great couple of days here. We would happily return.

This place was perfect! The location is literally steps from the Royal Mile, but despite that it was very quiet and we were never bothered by street noise outside. It was so great to have a place of our own to unwind after busy days. The home was very clean and comfortable, and we loved the movies!

An amazing space with an amazing host to match! Ideal for anyone visiting Edinburgh, located a stones throw from some of the cities best sights and eateries.
Combine this with a host with an abundance of local knowledge and excellent communicative skills to boot and you come out with something really special.
Very pleasant apartment with everything you would need for a weekend stay. Trudi was a great host and keen to ensure that the stay was a success. Very happy to recommend.

We had a wonderful stay at Ellie & Scott's place. The style and décor was exactly what we were looking for and we really loved the addition of the super deep bath. The beds are also super comfortable and overall the whole place just felt super stylish and welcoming.
Location wise it is fantastic and is right in the heart of Old Town (a 15-minute walk from Waverley). Check-in was very easy with Ellie and Scott providing very clear and timely instructions ahead of arrival.
The only thing which could be improved would be Wi-Fi strength - for a 3 day stay it wasn't a huge issue, but something to be aware of. We also struggled a little with turning the radiators on (it was rather cold when we visited, so perhaps mentioning how to do this in the arrival guide would be a good addition).
All in all though, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Ellie & Scott's, and hope we'll have chance to stay again sometime!

Beautifully appointed flat. Really felt like home. Some AirBnB’s have a collection of kitchen utensils obviously gathered from resale shops. This kitchen had quality utensils plus even more items than you could possibly use. Good, thick and large  towels. Bed was quite comfortable. A++++

We booked this property after having been let down by another at the last minute, on a busy bank holiday weekend.
Quirky Apartments were subsequently "a breath of fresh air". They were helpful; their communication was frequent and informative and they wasted no time in refunding me my deposit back.
The apartment was exactly as it was shown in the listing, plus, having a parking space — right outside the front door — was a real bonus.
It's so pleasing to find that there are some real professionals out there — thank you!
Lovely flat, very well kept and cosy. Thanks for a great stay!
Thank you Valerie, a wonderful home from home. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend your place to others.
Lovely place right off the royal mile. Easily walkable to just about any of the major things to see or restaurants. But also private and quiet. Loved it!
We went up for the Marathon Festival and the flat was perfect. Location fantastic and it had everything you needed.
Very cosy and comfortable house, very clean, beautiful views

Pros: Great strategic location, walking distance to tram Station, house well maintained except need some work for bathroom and bedroom locks, tesco (for groceries)
Cons: Parking issue even paid parking, however other options are park in tesco (free for 3 hours, can do for 4 hours also), some free parking after restriction zone ends, probably 5 to 8 minutes walk)
Guter Ort in einer ruhigen Gegend.
A warm welcome and lovely host. Caroline is very kind.

Hanne, was easy to contact & extremely helpful!! we rented a car and when we arrived a nice neighbor informed us we couldn't park where we were. I emailed Hanne who immediately offered to let us park at their home but we ended up finding street parking a round the corner.
the apt is perfectly located and is only 1 block from train/bus stations. there is also a friendly pub on the street with delicious food called Teuchters pub. if I am lucky enough to return I'd be happy to stay at Hanne's place again!
It was a great stay and Levi was very accommodating with an early check in. Very peaceful and easy access to the city center by bus/taxi

Lynne's place was super convenient to all things in Edinburgh and the home was stylish, comfortable and well outfitted. Lynne was a responsive host and had many helpful tips and suggestions for traveling in Edinburgh.
We enjoyed our stay at Lawrie's place. Would recommend.
Nice place, very comfortable but beds too soft

Fiona was helpful and kind from the very start. The lock box for the key was broken the day we checked in so she came to the apartment herself to let us in, and made sure to let us know that we can always reach out if we need any recommendations for the city. The lockbox worked again on our checkout day and everything went well with that too! Overall a great cozy place for a stay in Edinburgh

The apartment is really well presented and appointed, with some really cool decor and lighting so a joy to hang out in … and in a great location to explore and enjoy Edinburgh. Well stocked kitchen, great bathroom/showers … and lovely views from lounge.
Sean and Sally were really responsive and helpful hosts as we had to leave earlier than planned due to family issues, which was hugely appreciated.
Overall a really great apartment to explore Edinburgh and great hosts.
Amazing flat right next to the castle! We had a great time!

Fiona’s place is a really comfortable apartment in the middle of Morningside. It’s handy for local restaurants and the many small businesses and restaurants in the area as well as Waitrose and M&S Foodshop. Also handy for buses into the city centre. Fiona was very welcoming and a well of local knowledge.
Nicola and David’s home was perfect for my family! The location is absolutely perfect and the space was very comfortable.
Very cozy place! Charlie was super nice and made us a wonderful breakfast!!!!!

El apartamento estaba súper súper bien. Disponía de todo, había diferentes cafés para elegir y eso por la mañana se agradecía mucho. La distribución era perfecta y las dependencias estaban separadas en tres plantas. Además había instrucciones para manejar todos los aparatos. Valentina nos dijo que por la noche había mucho ruido, pero nosotros llegábamos tan cansados que no nos enteramos de nada. Por poner un pero, nosotros creíamos que el apartamento estaba más cerca de la zona céntrica, pero la Royal Mile está a una media hora andando, aunque eso pudo ser fallo nuestro, además pasan autobuses constantemente que dejan en el centro. Sin duda repetiré si alguna vez vuelvo a Edimburgo.

Natalia gave lots of information about the area and amenities which was very helpful. The directions were easy to follow and access very straightforward. The apartment is light and airy, being extremely spacious and well appointed. The condition of the property is immaculate and with the fully equipped kitchen, everything had been thought of. We cooked a full meal in the kitchen with no problem.
We discovered some very good restaurants and a harbour walk within a 5 minute drive at Newhaven and Stockbridge with its many interesting shops and cafe's is a 10 minute drive or 40 minute walk. A great stay and we will visit again.
房子很干净温馨，房东很热情，回复消息很及时，一次非常满意的入住体验！
The staff are so lovely, the rooms are great and spotless, also situated right in city centre. Second time staying here, and would undoubtedly stay again!
Great location and lovely house. I really enjoyed staying there.

El apartamento es muy cuco y acogedor. Tiene todo lo que necesitas. Esta ubicado en una zona tranquila .Alrededor hay muchos restaurantes de todo tipo . El transporte publico esta super bien conectado .Hemos pasado unos días  muy bonitos. Gracias para todo.
TUTTO PERFETTO E CORRISPONDENTE A QUANTO DICHIARATO, NEL CENTRO DELLA CITTA' VECCHIA COMODISSIMO A PIEDI
We enjoyed with our stay! Great location! Spectacular view! Responsive host!
Great location, clean, comfortable and central. Lovely view of Arthur's Seat, a 20 minute walk into Old Town.

The flat was just as we expected in a central location perfect for the Fringe Festival. Communication and response times were great with the host.
We enjoyed our stay and would consider staying there again when we visit Edinburgh.

I stayed at Carols with my mother who is nearly 70 and not able to walk as far as she used to, this location is perfect for exploring the royal mile/ old  town, Arthur’s seat,  the accommodation is lovely and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Great place and close to everything!

Sabrina was wonderful, very helpful and prompt to answer messages. The accommodation was as described, very central and well connected. The house and the room itself was very clean and the kitchen was well stocked with coffee, tea, milk etc. We were able to prepare hot breakfast and pack some sandwiches before we left for sightseeing.
We would definitely go back to Sabrina if we visit Edinburgh again.
Gerry is a great host. The room is clean and conveniently located. Good value and definitely recommended.

Catherine's place is so dreamy and quiet that it inspired me to write about her home, the natural light is wonderful and the place is so restful and also so close to downtown (one bus trip away.) Believe me, you won't want to stay along the Royal Mile, you'll want a good night sleep, so book here.
Lovely place, very close to the center, very helpful hosts - we had a great time and recommend staying!
The apartment is clean & in a good location, everything that Abbey has portrayed. Great for 2 couples. The only problem we had was the arrangement with the keys to the apartment.

Property is immaculate better & bigger than the pictures. Jonathan was extremely helpful and quick to respond to any questions I had. He was really helpful with arranging luggage storage . I would highly recommend his property and him as a host & would definitely stay at the property again I cannot recommend the accommodation or him highly enough.
spacious and comfortable flat in the centre of Edinburgh! A great place to stay for business or holiday
Natasa’s lovely home is perfectly located in the centre of the city and very well equipped. The 4 of us enjoyed our stay!

Nos gusto mucho quedarnos en el alojamiento de Thanh-Lan, estaba como en las fotos, la ubicación queda ideal para ir caminando al centro y nos gusto mucho la zona. Ella estaba flexible y nos dio recomendaciones. Todo muy bien.
Great flat in perfect location. Would definitely recommend
Great apartment and location
The bedroom was ok but the bathroom and kitchen were both a little tired.
Sol is a super nice host. The apartment is super well located, close to pretty much everything and the loft itself is lovely and very comfortable. Our days in Edinburgh were great :)

It was very easy to find the flat and get the keys. Karina gave us very quick responds whenever we needed. She also gave us information for the local pubs, cafes and restaurants.  We really liked the house and the neighborhood was very safe and alive with a very good bus connection. We totally recommend Karina and her place !

We REALLY enjoyed our stay at Leslie's flat! Leslie was inviting, kind, helpful, and knowledgeable about nearby sights and history of the area. The pictures of his place are beautiful on Airbnb, but it is STUNNING in person. Bus service is super close and convenient and gets you right into the city. The view of the sea was like a dream! 10/10 recommend!

The flat was fantastic - I had a great stay here. The bed is very comfortable, the kitchen is well equipped and the bath is splendid. The only problem is that the listing is managed by a company, which means you don't always communicate with the same person. For me this led to miscommunication about early check in (even though I confirmed this on the day of my arrival) which ended up with me waiting with all my belonging on the sidewalk outside the flat for about an hour while trying to get in touch with the hosting company and then waiting for the flat to be ready. This was an unpleasant way to begin my stay, but thankfully it greatly improved after this.
Excellent accommodation! Nice facilities and very convenience.

Excellent stay in an excellent part of the city, very close to the centre of town. Plenty of space, sofa beds are big enough to sleep two, though keep in mind it might get a bit cramped. Only complaint is with the comfort of the sofa beds, they weren't too bad, but far from the most comfortable night of sleep.

What a lovely place! Fiona is a great host. She was easy to communicate with and introduces you to the flat & city straight away. She even left a batch of super good homemade cookies to make us feel welcome- loved them!!!
The flat is just as you see in the pictures, lovely. Very clean and has all the basics you would need ie. kitchen supplies, etc. Not to mention the location is perfect. Super central and you can walk almost anywhere.
Definitely would recommend this flat and I will be coming back next time I stay in Edinburgh, thank you Fiona!
Excellent apartment, superb host. Highly recommended!

Possibly the best place I've stayed in. very easy to find and although it's situated just off the main road and I live in the country i didn't notice any intrusive noises from traffic. Plenty of parking available next to the building and the whole place was spotless. Ceilidh's apartment is on the first floor (one flight of stairs) and is a real home from home. Natalia and James have been very flexible and easy to communicate with. Would definitely come back :)
We were very happy with the apartment, location was great, Altido was very responsive, and the apartment was laid out very nicely.
Gorgeous apartment in a brilliant location. Felt at home right away. Clear communication throughout.
Good location which is near the tram station and easy to find.

We had a lovely stay at Kim’s (Kerry’s mum) place. She made us feel right at home, the room was nice and cosy, easy to reach by tram but also nicely located to take a walk from the city-Center. All in all it was the perfect place for our 3 night stay in Edinburgh.
Margaret is a really good host. I recommend her flat. We clearly enjoyed our stay.
Great hosts and location. However overpriced for what is on offer.
A very good place to stay for a short visit, conveniently located close to the city center.

What an amazing stay we had in this stunning apartment. Janice is an amazing host, very friendly and full of great ideas for places to go in the area. The apartment itself was spacious, tidy and very well presented. The location is just excellent, even more so with the Tram now in operation. We will be booking it again next year for sure!

We were really looking forward to our stay, as we decided to spend a little bit more than normal for more special accommodation. Unfortunately the flat is in need of TLC. Both the bedroom and bathroom do not match the photos and we were disappointed by the lack of attention to detail.
Luckily the bright and large living space and location meant that we weren’t too disheartened. The flat is surrounded by walkable restaurants and tourist attractions (like Edinburgh Castle and Dean Village).
We also had excellent communication before and throughout our stay.
With updating, this flat has so much potential, but at the moment it fell short of recommending to friends and family.

Le logement de David est encore mieux que sur les photos. Le quartier était parfait pour notre séjour, accessibilité à pied et en transport. Le logement était propre et fonctionnel, l’accueil de David au top !

You really couldn't find better lodging for your stay in Amsterdam.  Located on a gorgeous street right in the center of new town, convenient to everything.  Never more than a 20-30 minute walk to everywhere you'd want to go...not only Old Town but more interesting neighborhoods like Stockbridge and West End.  The common space is huge and very comfortable, and Scott really takes care of his guests.  It's a wonderful spot to set you up perfectly for success with your trip to Edinburgh.
A lovely place to stay in Edinburgh. Close enough to the town centre that we walked in everyday but far enough out to be peaceful and quiet.

très bon séjour passé à Édimbourg chez Sevi.
L'appartement est très bien situé, à 25 min à pied du centre, 20min en transports.
Sevi est très arrangeante et sympathique, nous recommanddons vivement.
