Adam  was very welcoming and contacted me during my stay to make sure everything was going swell . The location is very close to the city bus however is not so close “walking distance” as long as you can figure out transportation you will be fine and he will give advice. My biggest pet peeve were the upstairs neighbors they would be so noisy and it would sound like they were moving furniture all through the hours of the night . Other than that the place was cute and matched photo descriptions ! It was clean and provided everything I needed for my stay
Beautiful apartment in a fantastic part of Edinburgh. We loved our stay, would absolutely return if we were to visit the city again.

Mateusz’s place was amazing and a very spacious apartment can easily accommodate 4 people and even the sofas were comfortable and spacious, the check-in process was easy and communication was very smooth, will definitely come back. City centre is at approximately 15-20 minutes walk or easily accessible via bus. Had a seamless experience altogether!

Een prachtig appartement,  mooi, sfeervol en kleurrijk ingericht. Goede locatie dicht bij Holyroodhouse Palace, en ook de rest van het centrum is goed te belopen. Het trappenhuis imzier er wat verlopen uit, maar dat is het enige kleine kritiekpunt, en iets waar onze voorbeeldige gastheer Calum weinig aan kan doen.

Great modern apartment located in the West End, within easy walking distance to the Royal mile and other attractions in the area. This was my first Airbnb experience, and Jamie did an excellent job of making us feel welcome. The apartment is located in a safe area of town, and provided us with everything we could ever need during our stay. Will definitely return!
I enjoyed my stay. Lorraine was warm and welcoming with a smooth check-in and out process.
Great location, and a nice lovely home! Will definitely come back when visiting Edinburgh.

L'appartement de James était simplement PARFAIT ! Il est possible de se stationner dans la rue gratuitement et toutes les attractions sont à une courte distance de marche. L'endroit est idéal pour visiter la ville, tout en étant à la fois très calme. James est très sympathique et offre toutes les commodités nécessaires afin de rendre notre séjour agréable. On se sent comme à la maison. Merci James !

Perfect location for a weekend trip away, we only got the tram to and from the airport! Eddie is a great and responsive host who answered my questions and accommodated for us. Great living space and perfectly spacious. Mostly perfect overall.

A huge flat, in a great location with comfy beds, and great bathrooms. It is in need of some TLC in terms of touching up the walls, and replacing some chipped mugs - but this was November, and maybe it was showing signs of a busy season! The underfloor heating in the bathrooms was great, but the heating in the rest of the flat struggled due to the high ceilings and single glazed windows - we were grateful for the portable heaters in the living room.

Marta’s place is so wonderful. We all enjoyed our time there. It was walkable to the Royal Mile. And the view of Arthur’s Seat kept us interested at any time of the day. Her place is immaculate and so well appointed. I would highly recommend it for a cityscape.
This accommodation was comfortable for our family and Robyn was so kind to provide a cot and high chair for our baby.
The stay was spacious and conveniently located. However, there were some excessive rules that made it feel less welcoming.

Mark & Bill zijn ontzettend aardig en gastvrij. Ze zorgen er meteen voor dat je op je gemak bent.
Aan alles is gedacht. De ruimtes zijn zeer schoon en ze houden van luxe.
Zo is er een goed bed, fijne douche en het ontbijt heerlijk met zelfs een verwarmd bord.
De hondjes Duffy en Dexter zijn lief en goed opgevoed.
We vinden Edinburgh een prachtige stad en zouden graag eens terug komen. De bus naar het centrum stopt vlakbij het huis. Wij zijn te voet gegaan, er is veel te zien onderweg!
Susan was a lovely host. She was very responsive and was helpful. Her place was perfect!
The check-in process was very clear, a video with instructions was sent and we had no issues.  The place was beautiful and clean, the location was unbelievable! This place is a true gem in Edinburgh.

Truly a gem to find in the heart of Edinburgh! We enjoyed our stay a lot as it was very convenient transport-wise (and no stairs!) for a family of 5 travelling with an infant. Excellently designed apartment with 3 adequately spacious rooms. Very close to the tram stop and easily located via Uber from Waverley Station. Lots of things to do nearby and even in the flat! Spotlessly clean when we arrive! Great amenities especially the clean bathroom and kitchen! Definitely recommended if staying as a big family or group! Reasonably priced too considering we went during the busiest month due to the Fringe festival.

We were glad to come “home”
after our Highlands road trip. We stayed at this lovely condo when we first arrived in Edinburgh 10 days ago and were so happy to be coming back to the same clean and comfortable space. We can’t thank Eddie and Oonagh enough for their hospitality and support during our two visits to Edinburgh. We will definitely be back.

Perfect location in the middle of Edinburgh's historic New Town. Lots of helpful and thoughtful touches in the flat, in addition to being very well equipped. We felt at home immediately. We didn't need to contact Steve much but when we did he was immediately responsive and helpful. Will definitely stay again. Thanks, Steve!
Die Wohnung ist sehr stilvoll und hochwertig eingerichtet. Das Zimmer hnd Badezimmer waren sehr sauber und ordentlich. Alles in allem haben wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Apartment was lovely and clean. The heating was always on and it was very comfortable. It’s in an area with plenty of bus routes, and had a nice cafe and shop right beside it.

From start to finish, I can only recommend Click and Rent. Booking was easy, they made sure I was happy pre check in, great instructions, superb location yet quiet and private. The flat was spotlessly clean and had everything that you could want. Nice facilities and great use of the space to create more room for the renter. Very responsive if you had any questions. Highly recommended.
Everything to recommend!
Great place with comfortable beds and furniture.  Super location that was right on the Royal Mile.  Will stay here again when in Edinburgh!
Lovely place locations bit naff but fine if you don’t care about area or views

My friend and I had a wonderful stay at Sue's home. It was easy to get there from the airport. It was close to the bus stops so easy access to the center of Edinburgh. Sue was very responsive to my messages. The place was clean and comfortable. Highly recommend.

Very classy and artsy interieur, unbelievable beautiful, a real gem. Perfectly located, in the heart of Edinburgh. Very helpful host with everything you need. Felt like a home at a landlord. Our stay was perfect. Just one thing: there are many steps and no elevator, so bring a strong human with you :-)
In a nutshell: the place to stay at Edinburgh. So clean and wunderful, Thank you!

This accomodation was a breeze for us on the last leg of our trip. It’s such a homely feel and was equipped with everything we could need! Fast responses for any questions we had and great location. Super stylish and comfortable stay. Thanks heaps! Would recommend any day :)
Wonderful host and excellent place
Great location. Very cozy!

Great spacious bedroom with private bathroom, mini fridge & coffee maker. Only 20 min from the train station and near Harmonium, a really great vegan restaurant bar. Helen made a booklet with interesting details about representations of Edinburgh in literature :)

A cute apartment in an amazing location - just 2 minute walk from Edinburgh Castle and a 10 minute walk from Waverley Station. The host was very kind and easy to communicate with - would definitely recommend!

Only 3 chairs which were wobbly
Only 2 bowls and 1 small plate and only 3 plates
Can hear people walking around upstairs
Windows not very noise proof. Lots of noise overnight from people and cars on the streets
TV was a bit hard to get to the apps. Had to start and turn off and turn on the TV to get to the apps.

Le logement est bien situé, 30 minutes à pieds environ du Château d’Edimbourg. Tout était propre quand nous sommes arrivés et nous avons passé un bon séjour!
Cependant certaines chambres montrées sur les photos n’existent pas, ce qui ne nous a pas posé de problème car nous n’étions que 3 mais qui pourrait être gênant s’il y a beaucoup de voyageurs.

If you've ever been on a castle tour and thought to yourself that you really wanted to stay in one, this apartment is your chance. While not as big as a castle-it certainly gives you that sense. We all walked and just said "Wow." It is unique and convenient, being just steps away from the castle entrance and right on the Royal Mile. Communication was fast and helpful. Beds were comfortable and it was just, overall, a really cool place to stay for our family.
My wife and I loved staying with Charlie. He took great care and was a very hospitable host, with good recommendations and a great attitude. Thank you for a wonderful time!

Très bon séjour chez Gary ! Bel Appartement très bien équipé et au calme malgré le plein centre (et des ambulances de temps en temps!)
15 min à pied du château et princes’ street. Comme dit dans d’autres commentaires ne vous arrêtez pas aux poubelles de la rue localisées devant l’appartement.
Nous n’avions pas vu le 2e mail de Gary pour nous donner le bon code pour la boîte à clefs mais quand nous l’avons appelé il a été très réactif et sympathique pour nous le donner et nous permettre d’entrer dans le logement !
La vie en Écosse est chère mais nous recommandons vivement cet appartement pour loger à Edimbourg !

This is a great place, probably the nicest AirBNB we've stayed in. It was extremely clean, very well maintained, and had extremely nice fixtures and appliances: so many places are outfitted with the cheapest possible items in the kitchen, but this has an excellent (induction!) hob, and a quick-heating convection oven. We didn't do much cooking, but it meant we could easily go through our leftovers with ease. The location is convenient, with a close-by bus stop that's a quick ride to Haymarket and not much further to downtown. Or if you're like us and don't mind a walk it's also very accessible, and with a close entrance to the Water of Leith Walkway there's a lot of good walking to do. The host is easy to reach and responsive to anything that comes up. We'll be looking to stay here again if we have the need.
Lovely stay at Sarah’s place, very homely ☺️
Marion’s place is immaculate and very comfortable. The location is also perfect. Marion was very friendly and responsive. Excellent value.
Great location!  Beautiful space!

This is a wonderful flat right on The Royal Mile. Everything was exactly as described and Harvey was a very responsive host.
We stayed for 6 nights and now have strong legs from climbing the 5 flights several times a day.

Thank you Laila for a comfortable stay. The room was beautiful, spotless, and comfortable The location was great and so close to the bus. It was also quiet.
Thank you Laila!
had a great stay! The location is excellent , close to supermarkets and everything you need. The host was very friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend!
Great location, very well appointed apartment.
Me and my girlfriend stayed for a weekend get away at Jackie’s apartment. Very nice with a super helpful host.

Merci pour votre accueil
Endroit très bien situé à Édimbourg
Je recommande
Encore merci
Très belle appartement mes amis et moi même étions ravis de ce séjour

Great weekend just spent at Sarah Jane’s place. Great location and the flat is very spacious. Lots of cups and cutlery to use, plenty of towels etc. My bed was really comfortable. The shower head in the main bathroom is at a strange angle so you have to hold it but only a little detail. Would 100% recommend for big groups wanting to explore the city
Die Wohnung von Lindsey ist wirklich sehr gemütlich mit allem was man braucht. Sehr sauber und gut gelegen. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

YURI and Michael have been excellent hosts.  YURI keeps her home spotless and the room too. Location suited me the  most. YURI is a caring host always looking out for her guest. I recommend YURI and her home. Excellent & quiet location !
The house and rooms are nice and comfortable. However, car parking may be a challenge.
Lovely people, lovely flat.

We had a very pleasant stay. Rooms are spacious with varieties of  amenities. It is also clean and tidy. Looks exactly like the photo and description. The only thing that got minus point is the heater works very slow to heat up. Overall it was a 9.5/10 experience.
Good, clean flat in perfect location for us.  Lovely and bright.
Perfect location! The flat was great and very clean! Amy was soo nice and always there to help if needed.

Loved staying here! We took the train in from London and the flat was within walking distance (in the instructions from hosts, there are excellent details for getting there no matter how you arrive). Everything was so close! We were able to walk everywhere we went.
Having a place with a washer and dryer was GREAT and really helpful for those long vacations. This home was very comfortable with a well stocked kitchen.
We had one issue while we were there and Grant was very responsive and helpful! He even came out to the flat to fix the issue.
If you can get a reservation, jump on it! I reserved this location about 9 months before we travelled.
Fabulous location. Right on the Royal Mile. Wonderful spacious apartment. Comfortable bed and great nights sleep. Wendy is lovely. A perfect trip for us. Thank you
Great place to stay.
Beautiful and cozy place to stay. Basically in the city center. Only 5 Mins to Royal Mile. Hosts always reachable via chat in case of questions. Absolutely worth it.

We stayed at Linda‘s place just for one night at the end of our holiday before heading back home early next morning: and we wished we could have longer! A super nice host, comfy beds, impeccable bathroom, a lovely neighbourhood and amenities in the room any traveller could only wish for. Highly recommended!
Can’t recommend enough! Had a fantastic stay at Stuart’s beautiful apartment. Easy check-in, quick and clear communication and sparkling clean! We felt very comfortable and at home. Thanks Stuart!
This is such a lovely apartment in a fantastic location! Lucinda and Roger were extremely welcoming and friendly hosts. I would highly recommend staying here.

L’appartamento si trova in una posizione comodissima per visitare la città. Vicino a un parco bellissimo e a portata di mano ci sono ristoranti, pub e supermercati.
L’appartamento corrisponde alle foto.
Nel bagno c’è un problema dovuto allo scarico della doccia.
Molto apprezzate anche le indicazioni per raggiungere l’appartamento dall’aeroporto con i mezzi.

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment! The location is perfect—you can see Edinburgh Castle from the front door, which adds a special touch to the experience. Plenty of great brunch spots, cafes, and even some excellent cocktail bars are nearby, making it an ideal place to stay to explore the city.
The apartment itself was spotless, spacious, and incredibly comfortable. It had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. Barry was an excellent host—his communication was quick and clear, and he made sure we had all the necessary details for a smooth check-in and check-out.
I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Edinburgh!

The Stoil's flat is one of the nicest I rent on Airbnb ! Brand new, comfortable, located in the very center of Edinburgh... Last but not least, Stoil is a perfect host ! I can't find any reserve for future guests ! Very highly recommended place !

This was my first time in Edinburgh and this was the perfect place to stay! . It was a 20 minute walk to the centre and so many bars and restaurants around the area of the apartment as-well. The hosts were nothing but helpful with helping us with an early check in and also offering a later check out on our last day. The apartment itself was clean and had everything we needed. Will definitley be staying again on our return to Edinburgh!

Chambre très confortable, à quelques minutes de la vieille ville mais aussi très proche de Stockbridge. Laila a été très prévenante et nous a même permis de laisser nos bagages plus longtemps avant notre départ. Nous recommadons !

I would strongly recommend this accommodation.
Kerry was an excelente host. She received us and showed us the house (It is exactly the same as in the pictures, clean and comfortable). She was very kind and left some information about activities to do in the city.
She also left some welcome sweets and we had our own fridge in the living room with water. She left cereals for our breakfast and we had a coffee machine and a kettle and a variety of coffees and tea to help ourselves. Wonderful!
On top of this, she let us stay out bags until late as our flight was as night.
Thanks Kerry!
Perfect accommodation ☺️
location location location! if you want to be in the middle of everything,  this is the place.

Not worth a stay.
First they are charging 30 pound extra non refundable breakable policy which is non acceptable.
Second i asked many time for room heater not working. They are least bothered to reply on that matters.
I don’t recommend this place to stay.
Lovely host, amazing home, beautiful surroundings! We had a really nice time there, thank you Margaret!

Très bel appartement, bien situé et un hôte chaleureux ! Je ne suis pas restée longtemps à part pour dormir et me laver, mais la chambre était super et j’ai très bien dormi. Petit bonus : le chien trop mignon de Steve qui vient dire bonjour le soir! Merci pour tout, je reviendrai sans souci :)

Patrick was very nice and helpful, quick to reply to any questions.  It is in a lovely area and quite quiet, but you can still walk to the royal mile , may take 20 minutes.  The apartment was very nice and clean and has everything you need.  The only problems is the en-suite bedroom there is no toilet door and if you don’t draw your curtains the people in the other bedroom can see you on the toilet.  Also the en-suite bedroom has wooden  parts on the bed frame which is easy to catch your legs I have bruises on my legs .  However would definitely go again
Pretty apartment + an extraordinary host!  We would not have had better service at a 5 star hotel!  Thank you, Lizzie, for being so generous and thoughtful during our stay!
Beautiful location, massive reasonably-priced house, convenient to get to everywhere - would highly reccomed this spot to anyone visiting Edinburgh!
Gill was a great host! Very welcoming and everything was super clean. Thank you Gill!
Sean and Sally’s apartment was great! Very clean and modern with a lovely view of Edinburgh castle. Located very conveniently near all the major city attractions. Highly recommend!
Lovely flat; a lot of space, all facilities present, great view and neighbourhood.
Fantastic location for a great weekend in Edinburgh. Great location to start the day and climb Arthur's Seat.
Super Ausgangslage für einen Städtetrip in Edinburgh, alles gut fußläufig zu erreichen. Supermarkt direkt nebenan. Sehr sauber. Nachts etwas Straßenlärm, besser Ohropax einpacken.
Great stay! Salma is a terrific host.
Stunning modern apartment just as pictured. In the perfect location to explore Edinburgh - within 15 mins walking distance of Princes Street and Stockbridge. Would definitely recommend!
Very good accommodation. Shirley was kind and gave us good recommendations on bars around the place. We would definitely recommend the place.
gary is sooo great if i come to Edinburgh Again i will order again

Was over from Ireland for the highland show right in centre of city so was easy to get around 10mins walk from tram, apartment was clean and everything there that we needed, was a fairly high deposit needed few days before we landed which should be said on advertisement and also an extra towel charge which I think should be told when booking. Other than that all was good.
Thanks for all
Donal
Great location and place to stay!

What a wonderful place this was. I stayed here a week before Christmas and it truly enhanced that festive feeling. Upon arrival, the entrance was lit with fairy lights and I was immediately greeted by Maggie and welcomed into her home. The space is beautiful. A great comfy bed. Tea and coffee station to use at my leisure. As well as a working hairdryer provided, and a hot water bottle which had its use during the winter nights in Scotland. Bathroom services as described and easy to use. Everywhere was pristine and clean. I really felt at home. What’s more, kind Maggie made an effort to ask me what my plans were for the day, whenever we crossed paths and we slowly got to know each other more. She is an amazing host. Happy to help, with anything you need. Perfect proximity to the city centre, with a bus stop round the corner or a 10-15 minute straight road walk into the centre. Will absolutely be coming back here again, what a remarkable find.
Lovely place with a fantastic location. Host was very helpful and friendly

Really great location. Very clean and comfortable. Really quick responses to queries. Comfortable beds and quiet but convenient road. Walkable even with children to all main attractions.
Great facilities. Dishwasher and induction hob with plenty of cutlery, crockery etc. No washing machine which was a challenge for family with small children. Dry cleaners/ service wash available short walk away but not as convenient as on site washing machine.
Highly recommend this flat and host!

A fabulously clean, tidy and well equipped apartment. Better than I could have hoped for.
The location was superb! I can happily recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Edinburgh.

We loved our stay, the room was bright and fun. It was in a nice quiet neighbourhood within walking distance of everything you'd want to see.
I couldn't speak more highly of Kirstie & Alex, they were so helpful with any and all requests, they were great to talk to and I'd recommend a stay here to anyone.
Breakfast was great !
Nassima’s place is so modern and well decorated.Great communication and a perfect hideout . Perfect host

We loved our stay at Tatu’s place. It was so beautiful and felt just like home. The hosts were very helpful, and responsive. And such nice people.
It’s out from the city centre, but the bus stop is close and takes you right there, so it’s easy to navigate.
I would definitely stay here again.

Shelley made us feel at home right from the beginning. She was very welcoming and willing to help us with anything we needed around the place and by providing us with information about amenities around the area. The kitchen was fully equipped and the mattress was so comfortable we felt like floating. We recommend Shelley’s place wholeheartedly!
The flat was great! very clean, a lot of space, comfortable location! We had an amazing time!
Zdecydowanie wart swojej ceny! Przemili gospodarze i bardzo pomocni✨ nigdy nie byłam w tak przyjaznym dla gościa miejscu! Dzięki chłopaki za umilenie tego wyjazdu 🤍🤍

This apartment is not fit for purpose. The carpets are filthy and anything but hygienic. The toilet seat and flush in the En-Suite are broken. I have photos and videos to support this. The balcony doors are absolutely filthy too.
The access code given by Managing Agent was incorrect and had to contact them. The Managing Agent are very cold and not at all customer focused, very unprofessional, this was predominantly Rebecca who is very curt and blunt in her verbal and written communication.
Airbnb have not responded to the concerns I have raised.
Marketing photos etc are very easy to create, and this apartment is nothing like it is made out to be.
I left the property within 10 mins, notified the Managing Agent who simply told me to speak to Airbnb. I am now circa £240.00 out of pocket! A total waste of time and very stressful.
Beautiful room in a beautiful area
Absolutely stunning place in a perfect location. Trust me you will not be disappointed! Parking was a fantastic addition too.

The apartment is clean with every amenity you could wish for. The hosts are friendly and helpful and go out of their way to make you feel welcome.
Highly recommended.
Great spot to stay during a weekend in Edinburgh

Hôte proactif et réactif.
Proche aéroport et à 15 mn du centre.
great stay with a great location within a reasonable price. would stay again if in the area.
Charming meuse house in a great location.
We love Jane‘s place.  It is spacious, well appointed, clean, comfortable, and it is located in a wonderful neighborhood, with great restaurants and many small neighborhood stores.
Nice quiet neighborhood, away from the hustle and bustle of downtown Edinburgh. It has lots of natural light and is a short walk from a beautiful trail. Loved our stay!
Lovely flat, has everything you need and Calum was really helpful with any questions I had. Location is great, I would definitely stay again for another visit to Edinburgh 😊

Es war alles super. Rachel ist eine wirklich liebe Person und man konnte sich, wemn man sich zufällig getroffen hat, gut mit ihr unterhalten.
Gerne wieder :)

Perfect location,5 min walk from the station and centrally located on the Royal Mile, couldn’t have asked for more. Andy was great, very responsive. We travelled with two 3 year olds and chose to bring the buggy as we knew we’d be walking lots, there was a spiral staircase up to the apartment but our 3 year olds had no issue and my husband managed to get the double buggy up and down, if you struggled with steps this might not be the one for you. We loved it! The apartments everything you needed whilst exploring this wonderful city. Thanks again for having us!
Wonderful place to stay if you're visiting Edinburgh. Very clean, comfortable and convenient.
Location close to the public transport, relatively close to the airport. Spatious apartment, kind host.

Jonathon and Jackie’s place was extremely sweet! It’s a small space, but because it’s so well put together and thoughtfully decorated it feels bigger and is so comfortable to be in. We loved the area as well - a really nice stay!!

Heel fijne accommodatie gelegen in een gezellige buurt (Leith). Het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien en super schoon. Bij aankomst wachtte er een heerlijke fruitschaal op ons. De tips voor restaurants die je in het appartement kon vinden zijn zeer aan te bevelen!
Amazing flat just 5 minutes walk to the Edinburgh Castle , perfect to visit all the center of the city ,very nice furnitures and nice looking in general , the owner is very kind , 5 stars place
It has been an exciting few months, everything in the room is very good, and I am very grateful to Adrian for all his help, thank you very much!
this place was just what we needed while in town for an extended stay. the property is perfectly located if you want easy access to old town without the touristy vibe

Todo genial, una mujer super simpatica, nos dejo las camas limpizas, cuarto, cocina y baño limpios y con toallas. Incluso nos dejo hacer el check-in antes para dejar las maletas. Y nos permitio dejar las maletas alli, para cuidarlas y no dejarlas en cualquier otro lado. Repetiria sin dudar.

Nice cosy apartment in the heart of Edinburgh.
Almost all tourist spots are at walking distance and the apartment had all essentials for a family stay. Although, more breakfast options would have been ideal. Would recommend for a short stay of upto 4-5 days.

We were greeted by Angus' wife Victoria, who had the couch prepared with bedding as we had an extra body and a welcome basket ready on arrival! Amazing hosts, always made us feel at home and were extremely helpful! Apartment is class, two bedroom with huge beds, very clean, lovely kitchen with coffee maker etc. Angus then drove us to the airport at 6.15am - what a hero! We will be returning next year, highly recommend!

We didn´t meet Laura personally, but she was always reachable whenever we needed her.  She immediately refunded me some amount after some bulb broke out. The apartment was a bit far from the city, but it didn´t bother us. It is clean, it has a nice and practical kitchen.  There is a supermarket just around the corner that caters our daily consumption. The bathroom is very clean. We had a very comfortable bed. In that room where we slept, should have more storing room for clothes; hanging cabinets or something. But we are very satisfied with our stay in Laura´s apartment.
Merci à vous deux pour votre accueil et confiance, c’était très bien.
A nice flat and the hosts was amazing

Our stay at Wee Palace was fantastic. The location is simply perfect to explore this great city. You can reach all relevant sights within a few minutes. The apartment is super stylishly furnished - you feel right at home. Douglas was extremely helpful and provided all the information we needed - we found everything immediately and were able to check in quickly. I would definitely recommend this accommodation. A perfect stay!

Clean,  very comfortable and homely.  Every amenity and more that you would need.  A lived in flat,  full of character,  exactly as described, we loved it!! One of those places you weren't afraid to feel at home at from the second you arrived.   Perfect location for us with a dog, which took us across a lovely green busy park(Holyrood park) to the city centre. Probably a 15 minute walk from the flat to the bottom of Royal Mile, with lovely views along the way (Arthur's seat).   Morrisons about 10 minute walk,  couple of mins in the car away (far cheaper than the centre).  Russell, the host is really communicative,  helpful,  quick response, offering recommendations of where to go, quite a pleasure to communicate with; nothing is too much trouble.  Just to note, there are a couple of  lock safes, this one is at the left side of the bottom of the door (not instantly visible),  took us some time to figure that out:)  absolutely great place!!!

Katie was a great host. She provided us with everything we needed. The location of the apartment was excellent. There was a ton to do and great restaurants literally steps outside our door. Everything about the apartment was clean and the wifi was fast. I would definitely stay in Katie's place if I visit Edinburg again.
Lovely and confortable appartment near the very center of Edinburgh. James is very kind and you feel directly fine in his flat. Just,  a microwave would have been appreciated !

This was an incredible location right in the heart of GrassMarket and Victoria street, Edinburgh!
Exactly what we wanted it to be!
Great spot in Edinburgh that made it easy to explore the city. The flat was exactly as advertised and the host was easy to communicate with. We would recommend staying here!
Lovely little place in a great location.

Enjoyed our stay at Alistair's place. Its easy walking distance from all the main tourist attractions. We were able to find on street parking relatively easily. Alistair was very responsive to any questions we had. Would recommend staying here as a base to exploring Edinburgh City.

We had a great stay - everything was as pictured and described, beds were comfortable and the location was great, with lots of pubs, shops, and amenities around. The hosts provided a helpful guide with detailed instructions for check-in as well as tons of recommendations for local attractions, places to eat etc. which was fantastic. They were also communicative and easy to contact; had there been any issues I’m sure they would have been swiftly resolved, however everything went smoothly and we had a great stay.
Due to the central location some noise could be heard from the street outside at times but this was expected and not a problem for us.
Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.
Audrey was so welcoming, nothing was to much. She was really kind and super helpful. The Airbnb was exactly as described. I would highly recommend this host!
Had a wonderful stay, thank you so much for your hospitality.
Our stay was very good, an on the day last minute need for accommodation and they responded immediately which is exactly what we needed. All set up and homely when we arrived. Thank you!
I had an amazing stay at Wagner’s and Michelle’s home, they are the kindest people you can meet and the flat is so pretty and has such a cosy vibe! Thank you for our stay!

Beautifully decorated flat with a comfortable bed. Excellent location, really can’t beat it. Above busy restaurants/pubs, but couldn’t hear any noise. Lots of yummy treats were left for us, which definitely helped cure our jet lag. Hosts are responsive.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans ce logement. Malgré notre retard suite à un problème d'avion, Jakob était là pour nous accueillir.
L'appartement avait tout ce dont nous avions besoin. L'appartement est très lumineux, y compris le matin de bonne heure car il n'y a pas de store contre la porte. Les vitres fumées ne filtrent pas la lumière. A considérer si vous avez le sommeil léger.
Le tourne-disque a rajouté un petit plus à notre séjour. Nous n'hésiterons pas à revenir. :)
Honestly this exceeded expectations! It was a wonderful location, beautiful space and private but still felt within the city. Highly recommend!

Besser und größer als auf den Bildern.  Die Heizung hat super funktioniert, was im Winter wichtig war. Alles gut um die Ecke,...Supermärkte, Restaurants, Öpnv. Die Gegend ist voll in Ordnung. Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt.

Staying at Zeb's was like staying with a good friend. The location is fantastic, the views amazing and all for a very reasonable price. Zeb couldn't have been more helpful and friendly and the 'share house' style meant I got to hang out with other people staying with Zeb. I will be back for sure!
This place is perfect! I have zero complaints, it’s location is amazing, it has everything you could hope for, and you host is kind and flexible. This place is highly recommended and I will return!!

It was a nice walking distance away into the city centre but there was also directions left to get nearby public transport . The place was very nice and there were basic food stuffs left in the kitchen for us to have a snack when we arrived. Valerie was a great host and would reply quickly to any questions we had.
C’était parfait !
Great location and a super host and value for money.

Excellent location. Super comfy bed. Location of lockbox a bit strange and lift area is a little shabby. The towel rail is loose, did send a message about it but no response, just be aware if you are the next guests. Liked the 11.00am check out but no hot water or heating, did boost it but nothing seemed to happen. Despite a few negatives, the location really is excellent, right in the heart of things if you wish to visit The Royal Mile or the fabulous Stockbridge area. All in all I had a great stay.
Great location near Holyrood and lovely apartment. Zoe was quick to communicate and very helpful.

This apartment was so handy, just up the street from the Grassmarket and very near a Sainsbury’s Local for supplies. Great communication from David with clear instructions and handy recommendations. It’s not  huge but has everything you need for a short stay and an amazing view of the Castle from the bedroom and when heading into the apartment complex. Quite a few stairs so not recommended for anyone with mobility problems. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

This was a great stay while we were visiting Edinburgh! It was in a great location, felt very safe, and it was in a quieter area. All of the big tourist spots were easy to reach and walkable. Highly recommend!

This is a wonderful room. The host, Robert, was very welcoming and kindly showed us around the facilities. He also prepared some Scottish local food and whisky as a welcome gift, which was a lovely surprise. The room is well equipped and the location is very convenient. Highly recommended to everyone!

Die Wohnung ist super schön eingerichtet und es fehlt wirklich an nichts!
Die Lage ist super, man ist in 10Min zu Fuß am Meer/ Strand von Portobello. Und mit dem Bus sind es 30Min nach Edinburgh. Die Umgebung ist ruhig und man kann super nach einem Sightseeing Tag entspannen. Wir waren mit unserem Mietwagen dort und es gab in den Seitenstraße viele Parkplätze, nicht weit von der Wohnung entfernt.
Die Kommunikation mit David war toll, er hat sofort zurück geschrieben, wenn man Fragen hatte.
Die Wohnung ist sehr zu empfehlen! 😊

We read all the wonderful reviews before booking and they were spot on. The location was on a quiet street, but near many great restaurants and pubs. We walked everywhere, but the bus system ran right at the end of the street and was easy to navigate. All the homey touches made this a great place to relax after each day of exploring.
Beautiful appartment in a great location, close to the city center, with a well sorted kitchen and cosy living room. We had a wonderful time and would love to stay there again.
Great apartment in ideal location.

I echo what other reviewers have said.  Caroline's place is cute, clean, quiet, and perfectly walkable to everything you need and/ or want.  I'm looking forward to staying there the next time I visit this beautiful city!
Easy to find and in the Grassmarket area of the city, which was right below Edinburgh Castle. Plenty of bars and restaurants around, with great access to the Old Town.

Rosie was a brilliant host! Thanks for leaving the essentials in the kitchen. We were able to drop our bags slightly early which was great. The place was very tidy and and great links to all the key places to visit in Edinburgh. Thank you again Rosie for an amazing visit!
Adam & Charlotte
The appartment is great!
We had a lovely stay in Itziar‘s apartment. It is very cosy and you immediately feel at home!

I loved the weekend I spent at Mario’s apartment and would highly recommend it to other visitors to Edinburgh.
The flat is really comfortable, very clean and warm with lovely decorations. It’s also well-equipped – all the usual bedroom/bathroom/kitchen facilities, plus extras such as a coffee machine, hairdryer, television, tea and coffee etc., which was a fantastic bonus.
The location is nice and quiet, but also central, really handy for Holyrood Palace and Park and for exploring Leith.
Mario was a great host, very friendly, organised and easy to get in touch with. He also left a lot of helpful information about getting around in the city.
If I return to Edinburgh I would definitely hope to stay here again!
Kelly’s place is gorgeous and in a fantastic location! She is easy to communicate with and made our stay easy and stress free.

An amazing apartment, at a very convenient place in Edinburgh. The interior is great, and the beds very comfortable..
Everything you need is there. :-)
Thanks Ilona for having us, we would love to stay again!

A wonderful location in the heart of the old town, just minutes from Edinburgh Castle with many excellent shops, pubs, and restaurants within a short walk.  Clean and full of charm and has all the amenities you'll need. Plus, for an added bonus,  you'll get a leg workout every time you enter and leave the flat. Would definitely stay again.
Beautiful home, plenty of space, luxurious

Awesome first time (using AirBnB)!Absolutely lovely experience! The place was perfect and Reaaz gave an excellent orientation to Edinburgh. Everything was clean, comfortable, and after several days of lack of sleep, the bed was heavenly! Thanks to Reaaz, we saw sights that were less tourist-y and ate at amazing places. So happy with our experience, we will be back to Edinburgh, and If they will have us, with Scherie and Reaaz, for sure.
Lovely apartment in a convenient location for public transport. Communication and settling in was made very easy by host, Bob.
Thank you for my stay, it was a pleasure to stay at your place. The experience was great and I would definitely come back and recommend it! 😊
everything was perfect! starting from check in, the location is superb, the room and bathroom is clean!! totally recommend it :)))

La signora Elisabeth è stata sempre premurosa e sempre pronta al bisogno. Locale pulito e bagno impeccabile. Bus facili da raggiungere per gli spostamenti verso la città, a poche centinaia di mt. La zona è tranquilla. Quindi... consigliatissima. Prenderò in considerazione in futuro per un ritorno ad Edinburgo.

We had a lovely stay. A great week away to explore the city. Everything we could need was provided for. It was clean, warm, in a great location with a bus stop literally at the end of the road and convenient local shops (and a fantastic chippy). Anthony and Caroline live upstairs, accompanied by their gorgeous dog Hector, so if you need anything they are right on hand, but generally left us to our own devices. Perfect.

Great stay! The apartment was sparkling clean, and comfortable and the location was perfect. Close to lots of nice easterlies and bars and there’s a Tesco close by. Easy to access from the airport also.
It was quite cold however and although I understand that this is typical for a flat of this nature, the heating was difficult to use and stayed on for only Short periods at a time. We had to go out and buy hoodies to wear around the house in the evening times. A few extra fluffy blankets would be nice! There is nothing extra in the flat like milk for tea so when we arrived from a late flight that was a bit disappointing. Otherwise was a nice stay
Get what you pay for, only stated one night it’s easy check in and standard rooms

We stayed here with our toddler and baby.  Check in was easy and straight forward.  The place was just gorgeous and so comfortable! SO close to everything we needed and the handy guide made everything so much easier.  Sonia and Chris were also available at any time to help if needed.  We loved our stay and hope to be back some time soon!
入住体验非常好，很适合多人出行。房屋条件非常好

This is a well appointed apartment with homely calligraphy put on the walls.
There were a few snags, but I enjoyed the stay. Hollyrude park is very close and in my view he highlight of Edinburgh.
Really great and spacious apartment, beautiful appointed and super clean , but most of all the response from Sean in a dire situation during a storm eowyn was amazing! Forever grateful !
The location is fantastic, close to restaurants, shops, and the castle. An easy walk to anything you'd like to see or do. Would certainly recommend to anybody visiting Edinburgh.

Staying at Tracey’s was simply great and the best you could ask for from an Airbnb stay and an Airbnb host! The house was very clean, and very accessible to the city center. Tracey was a delight! She made porridge with fruit every morning for us. She was very fun and enjoyable to hang with after a full day at the fringe to debrief. She was super helpful with local recommendations and bus tips. Perfect Airbnb for a female solo traveler.
A wonderful little house right in the heart of the Dalry area. Very quiet in the sleeping area.

Great location, very convenient for my stay and well situated in the city.
The flat was comfy and quiet, and Fz was an attentive and helpful host.
Would stay here again.
Anne's place was in a great place with a superb location and great views. The only downside was the spiral staircase to the apartment. Taking bags up was a real challenge.

Fantastic studio apartment in the best location in Edinburgh, we thought.
Terrific views of Princes Street and Waverley.
The apartment was very clean and everything was as described.
We had an amazing stay there, thanks Jo.

Great position for exploring Edinburgh old town. Easy to walk with luggage from railway station. Spacious apartment that was comfortable for 4 people. However bathrooms were grubby - they needed a good scrub. Kitchen appliances were tired. We were happy to overlook these issues because of the position and size of the apartment.
Hosts were accommodating in allowing us to store our luggage before and after check out time which was very convenient.

Adorable flat in a great area, close to restaurants and pubs, short walk to the old town. The flat was incredibly clean and comfortable, equipped with all the essentials and modern conveniences (amazing water pressure). Jacqui was super friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!

Great place to stay. Like a studio apartment. Kitchen and living room separated from the bedroom. Has what u need for a comfortable stay. Near to Princes Street, the main shopping street in Edinburgh. Near restaurants and supermarket and train and tram station. Will stay again if I come to Edinburgh again.
Shona is a warm host who cares about her guests.
Siisti ja toimiva huomeisto hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä. Supermarketit kadun toisella puolella tekivät oleskelusta sujuvaa.
Nice and clean. A very good stay!
Jane fue una anfitriona maravillosa! Siempre estuvo disponible para nosotros y es un encanto! El alojamiento está en una ubicación muy céntrica de Edimburgo y es ideal para recorrer la ciudad

Jonathan's apartment is in a great location. Easy walk to many restaurants and attractions. Very easy check in. Wish we had more than 2 nights to spend in Edinburgh.
Attention to the rug in the living area as well as some red stains on the carpeting in the bedroom is needed. Both need to be replaced. Surprised to find this for the price of the apartment.

The place is super convenient, very easy to walk to all the major attractions. Paul is really friendly and helpful. He greeted us upon our arrival, helped us to carry the suites upstairs and is very responsive to all the inquiries. Would lightly recommended to anyone who is interested in visiting Edinburgh.
Great location, comfortable and very spacious. NIce welcome basket for us too.

We were very happy with our stay!
The apartment was clean and inviting and all necessary amenities were provided.
The view from the bedroom window of the castle was spectacular and the location was perfect for exploring Edinburgh by foot and public transport.
The host was very communicative and gave clear instructions.
We would highly recommend this place for your next stay in Edinburgh.
Un grand merci à Jenni pour son accueil, sa gentillesse et sa flexibilité. Son appartement est très accueillant.

We had a great stay at Greig’s flat.   It is in a perfect location at the bottom of the Royal Mile and the main attractions are walkable.  The flat itself was clean and spacious and had everything we needed.  Check in instructions were clear and Greig was very responsive.  I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it for a trip to Edinburgh

Anke place was the perfect choice for our stay in Edinburgh. Lovely area. Beautiful places to walk. The  apartment was open, gorgeous, beautiful design and feel. Arty, clean, pretty garden. Anke has really made sure you have everything you would need.  Very clear instructions.  Anke was such a perfect host. So many lovely and thoughtful touches, which made things feel so special! Lovely gift on our arrival. We hope to return again because we loved our stay so much!! Highly recommend staying here.
Wohnung war gut erreichbar mit dem Bus, innerhalb von 15min war man in der Innenstadt. Betten waren sehr bequem. Jane hat schnell und freundlich geantwortet:)
Todo perfecto

Final is fantastic! Very friendly and helpful. She was flexible with my check-in and check-out times. She gave recommendations for places to visit and dine. She also has an incredibly sweet cat :) The location of the house is very close to the bus stop, and it takes about 25 minutes to get to the city center by bus. I was very pleased. Thank you Final!

Perfect for a weekend in Edinburgh, clean room with comfy bed. Michael was very friendly and accommodating, showed us around then left us to it. The bathroom was spotless. The location is about a 20 minute walk from the centre which wasn’t a problem for us as it was a lovely walk. Would definitely recommend.

It was the most pleasant experience during our family trip in Edinburgh! The place was spacious and the kids were enjoying the place running around!Robert is a amazing host and respond to queries in time! We would love to stay here again and recommend this  place to anyone who want to stay in Edinburgh!

FANTASTIC stay - everything to make you feel at home; Margaret met us and showed us everything needed to know within the flat, easy car parking, great wifi, lovely homely touches (milk, tea, coffee, biscuits, crisps, cooking equipment, bath products). Easy walk into city/ old town or right near bus stop for a quick ride in. Would recommend 100%. Thanks Margaret

We had a lovely stay in this apartment. Everything matched the description, the apartment was clean and decorated in a vintage style which gave us just the right atmosphere of autumn Scotland. The location of the apartment is great, it is not far to the town centre and there is a supermarket a few minutes walk away. The only two negatives are the extremely noisy floor that makes a sound with every step and that it is quite cold inside, but that is very subjective. Overall I can definitely recommend staying in this apartment.

Had a really easy, peaceful and enjoyable stay. Really nice flat and plenty of space for the 6 of us.
As some constructive criticism we’d say that finding the flat was initially a little difficult as maps puts the address location slightly further up the street towards Tesco, so potentially some additional description would help.
The lock to the door was a bit difficult and took some effort to lock and unlock. I can imagine someone in the future using excessive force and damaging it
Everything well, communication with Julia and great that there is an extra bathroom with the room. Good location.

We loved our stay at Slawomir's! We had to book last minute and he was super accommodating to me and my group. The flat has everything you need, hair dryers, washer and the coffee table in the living room is full of pamphlets for attractions in and around the city. We spent a little time with him when he came to the flat and he gave us some places to check out while staying in Edinburgh. It was a great stay and I would recommend it!

Ethel and Billy are terrific hosts, and they have a lovely home. This was such a comfortable stay for me. Ethel offered to meet me at the bus stop near their place, and Billy walked me to bus stop on my way to the airport. It's in a great location, close to the airport and easy access to the city centre. Perfect for couples and solo travelers. Thanks again!

Appt difficile à trouver même pour le taxi…sdb sale . Le menage laisse à désirer . Du linge sale ds corbeilles en attente de lavage ds cuisine et du linge étendu ds pièce commune. Tv : pas télécommande ne fonctionne pas . Une caméra est placée ds pièce commune vers la fenêtre . Nous n’avons pas du tout apprécié . Une locataire (visiblement connaissance du propriétaire ) et énervée nous a dit que c’était comme cela et que c’était les règles sinon on pouvait partir…

Walking distance (1.6 miles) to Edinburgh Castle. Small and cozy flat that was comfortable for me and my husband. Yvonne provided plenty of brochures and direction on places to eat, grab groceries etc. Parking is on the street.
Great stay, clean flat, would stay again!
Truly brilliant and comfortable. Great location. Loved our stay!
Lovely flat..clean, tidy, had everything we needed and well located. Communication with Nicola was great too. Would be happy to stay again!

A beautiful apartment in the heart of Edinburgh. No where was more than a 15 minute walk.  More than enough space and things such as crockery for 4 people. I would highly recommend this apartment and host - easy to book. Great communication all the way through 😊

Great location, and was accurately as described in the listing.
It was loud in the evening, but not to the point where you couldn’t sleep.
Pretty good
Nice place, just like in pictures. Good instructions, easy to come from the airport. Quite near old town.
Very spacious apartment in University area. Easy to walk to main sights. City bus tour stop also very close. Views from apartment great
Excellent studio flat in Edinburgh. Lynn was very responsive, providing information and answering any questions and would certainly stay here again.
Anouk house is more than beautiful.Huge room with en -suite shower,kind sized bed and little balcony.Lovely place to stay,close to the bus stop to city centre.Friendly dogs.Highly recommended:)
Very close to Arthur's seat and only 10-15 minutes (walking) away from the city center. Jonathan was very welcoming and flatmate Silvia was great to chat with. I will definitely come back!

Highly recommend! My friend and I took a weekend to travel up to Edinburgh and we were able to find Natalia and Jame's place for a great price on a relatively short notice. The location is prime—we got off the train and the flat was a 7 minute walk from Haymarket station where we came in. The flat was really nice and had a super homey feel that was awesome to return to after a long day of activities. It's also close to a ton of restaurants and bars that were no problem to walk to at night.

We had a fabulous stay! The flat was clean, tidy, beautifully decorated and close to amenities, the station and also Edinburgh Playhouse which was great for us as we were in Edinburgh to see a play. Jennifer was a friendly and helpful host and great at communicating with us throughout our stay. Highly recommend!

What a great spacious apartment and so close to beautiful old town of Edinburgh. Cow gate is only a 5 minutes walk. The apartment is close to Surgeons' Hall Museum and some great places to eat. We will certainly come back for more.

Great Location right at the beach, with a still good connection to downtown. Lovely home as well, with two lovely cats.
Also, Francisca is a lovely host and was always helpful and friendly!
Excellent location, very nice apartment and very easy to arrange with Gareth. Will definitely use again if visiting Edinburgh.

L’appartement de Colin est une pépite au cœur d’Edimbourg. Nous avons adoré notre séjour dans cette appartement, avec une décoration typique et écossaise.
L’emplacement est idéal pour visiter la ville à pied à 25 minutes de la vieille ville.
Colin a été de très bons conseils pour le stationnement de notre voiture (parking gratuits en journée).
Je n’hésiterai pas revenir.

Absolutely amazing. Such a gorgeous home in a fabulous location. Iona was a brilliant host, very quick and easy to check in and had the place so clean with all the essentials already provided.
Looking forward to another trip to Edinburgh soon, will 100% book again! Thank you Iona
An amazing place to stay, in a beautiful part of Edinburgh.
Merci pour votre réactivité lors de nos échanges, pour la propreté de l'appartement. Nous avons passé un super séjour en nous sentant comme chez nous.
Such a great flat. Can’t fault the location, getting in and out of the centre via the tram is ideal. Myself and my husband and my two young boys really enjoyed our stay.
Perfecto para visitar Edimburgo. Zona algo apartada del centro pero muy bien comunicada en transporte público. En media hora estabas en la Royal Mile. Ceilidh es muy amable y atenta. Repetiríamos.
Great location, flat is comfortable and spacious. Hope to stay here again next time we visit edinburgh
Nice and modern. Accessible by bus or taxi to central edinburgh.

If you are wanting to stay in a place right in the heart of Old Town, this is the perfect place! It is just steps away from Edinburgh Castle, Victoria Street, and the Royal Mile. It is near lots of great restaurants and shopping as well.
The apartment itself was well stocked, clean, and comfortable. It appears exactly as described!
We have a wonderful time in Edinburgh at this apartment and would highly recommend it.

Notre séjour chez Jennifer était parfait, l’appartement est fidèle à sa description, super bien placé pour visiter Edimbourg à pieds. C’etait notre premier voyage avec notre bebe de 4 mois et Jennifer a été super souple pour l’arrivée et le depart ce qui nous a énormément aidé ! Nous recommandons à 100%

Very nice place. Everything was according to our expectations. He was available for us, especially when we arrived at 3 in the morning due to flight delay - always responsive.
Small breakfast corner with snacks was available all the time. Truly recommend!
A great stay in a beautiful area of the city! So much to do and see and so many wonderful restaurants and shops nearby.

Excellent stay this weekend for the festival. The apartment is extremely clean and comfortable. It's within easy reach of the city centre - just a 20 minute walk to the bottom of the Royal Mile. We really loved our stay here and will definitely be booking again next year. Stuart's communication was excellent and even a small mishap with the booking details was sorted very quickly. Thanks again Stuart.
Great location, suitable for family (on 3rd floor though). Light, spacious and well appointed

The apartment was very clean, cosy and better than expected. We loved the location, we did everything by foot.
As per others reviews, be aware that are a lot of stairs (It was not a problem for us, as we travelled light and it was a short stay) but if you are traveling with heavy suit case it can be painful.
For our check out, we messaged asking about the luggage storage but the host didn't reply us in a timely manner, however we could reach out to a lady that was cleaning the other room and she promptly helped us.
I really recommend this place.
Sharon is really friendly and gives me clear instructions! Besides of that, the environment near this flat is fantastic and I love it!

We loved staying at Trudi's apartment in Stockbridge - it was perfect for walking into the city as well as enjoying the local cafes and restaurants. The apartment was beautifully decorated, the beds were comfortable and everything that we could have needed was provided. Collecting the keys was easy and Trudi's communication was great. Can't recommend enough and would love to stay there again.

We had a great stay in Edinburgh. The apartment was clean, comfortable and well equipped and the location is ideal.   If you read the description and reviews, you'll know what to expect and then you won't be disappointed :-)

staying with Ava was like staying with an old friend! I immediately felt at home. Ava’s priority was always to make sure I felt safe and comfortable, especially as I was travelling alone. She helped get me sorted easily with the transit system and shared some great recommendations! I will definitely be staying with Ava every time I am in edinburgh. and to top it off, her kitties are the absolute sweetest!
great location in edinburgh, close to many of the main streets, busses and tram station. loft was lovely, well kept and cozy. would love to stay there again next time we pass through.
Great location in the heart of the Royal Mile.  Be ready to climb stairs!
Great location, very comfortable and super helpful and responsive host.

Katy was an excellent host. She accommodated an early check for one of our group members who happened to arrive earlier than scheduled. She was friendly and showed him around the house, explaining the details esp in the kitchen. The house was super clean and well supplied. The bedrooms had fresh linens and everything felt as if we were sleeping in our own home. The location was in a charming and lively neighborhood, near a big park and many markets, bars, and restaurants. By tube or ride share, it was easy access into the metro centers of London. However, there’s plenty to do around Islington too! We highly recommend Katy as a host and her home will surely bolster any future London visit. Thank you!

What a lovely stay. Sandra and husband were just lovely. Very welcoming but left to enjoy the quiet and peaceful surroundings. Felt private and cozy at the bottom of their garden. great facilities.
Such a short walk to the beach. thank you for your sharing your property .
Lisa & David - Adelaide, Australia

Our family enjoyed a fabulous three-night stay in this exceptional flat in the heart of Edinburgh's Old Town. The views of the city, especially at sunset, were unparalleled. The interior design of the apartment felt luxurious yet unpretentious, with high ceilings, beautiful lamp shades, comfy beds, and a beautiful modern bathroom.
The location right off the Royal Mile couldn't have been more convenient, and we recommend booking reservations for nearby Makar's Mash Bar a few weeks in advance of your stay. We went twice!
Jordan met us at the door when we arrived and was very helpful in getting us settled, providing a comprehensive tour of the apartment, and answering all of our questions. He also gave us some local recommendations, which we appreciated.
Should we have the opportunity to visit Edinburgh again, we would definitely choose to stay here again!

Martin war sehr ein netter, unkomplizierter Gastgeber. Wir konnten sogar früher als geplant in die Wohnung. Er hat sich sehr viel Zeit genommen und uns gesagt, was wir in Edinburgh alles unternehmen können. Und hat uns hilfreiche Tipps gegeben. Die Wohnung war sehr zentral und die Sehenswürdigkeiten waren in guter Gehdistanz erreichbar. Es hat uns sehr gefallen.

Initial impression entering the main front door was not superb, but this all changed when entering the apartment. Very clean, well laid out, comfy bed, and surprisingly, being on a major road, there was minimal noise at night.
Rachel left us tea and coffee and the basics, which was really welcoming and directed us to a very friendly wine bar close by. All in all, a great stay, thanks Rachel!

This place is really cozy - it has a lot of guide books, nice lightning and different electronic devices (even a synthesizer). There’s washing gel and dry rack for washing your clothes. The bed was comfortable but the sofa in the living room not so much. If you have a fuzzy sleeper in the family you might have to change your sleeping arrangements. The host is very amicable - he even sends you a guide for a walk in the city. Also, the place is quiet!
Peter was a great host, perfect communication before and when we are arrived. The apartment was great, spacious and perfect for our hen party weekend! Thanks so much !

Taca is very helpful and we communicate very well. The check-in was very convenient and the apartment was really clean and tidy. The beds were very comfortable to sleep. The location of the apartment is very good and it takes ten minutes to walk to the gate of the castle. We were really enjoyed the time in Edinburgh.

This cottage is truly lovely. Not just the inside (the photos don't do it justice) or the garden, but Gary's also decorated the space on the other side of the road so the view is nice, too. No more than five minutes from a larger Aldi and a bus stop with frequent buses into Edinburgh; the beach is just another few minutes beyond that. Portobello itself is also worth a visit.
A real "find"; we're so glad we stayed.
Amazing flat, just as pictured! Host is kind and easy to reach!

Steinvor’s flat was a dream, and the perfect place to stay with friends reuniting in Edinburgh. The space is beautiful, the views are stunning, and despite it being on the top floor -completely manageable. It’s well located, on a quiet street, and made getting around town so easy. I would recommend her home to anyone. She was great with communication prior to our visit and left amazing recommendations to guide us on our visit.
Great place to stay.  Joshua seemed liked a nice guy and a fellow traveler.  I liked his place.  It was so walkable for Edinburgh.

We had a wonderful time using Lynne's flat. It was very convenient to access locations throughout Old Town, and the views of the castle are spectacular. Lots of great restaurants in the Grassmarket area as well!

Staying at Emmanuele‘s place was really nice. We enjoyed it a lot since there was the festivals going on in the center and portobello was not as busy as the center. It was still easy to reach :)
The room is small, but that was okay for us and Manny was very friendly and we felt really welcome there.
We would definitely stay there again if we would come to Edinburgh again :)

L'un des meilleurs logements que j'ai pu avoir sur Airbnb.
Lieu extrêmement propre, très confortable et beau !
Hôte tres gentille rien de mieux pour une escale à Édimbourg !
Merci beaucoup Emma :)
Lovely, large house in the heart of Edinburgh. Close to everything, with good restaurants around. Would stay here again with a larger group!
The apartment is fantastic and so is its location. It was very clean and the beds were very comfy. Really hope we get the opportunity to stay here again!
Lovely and comfortable flat. But beware entrance area. Challenging spiral staircase up two flights and was grubby and gloomy.

The location was perfect with a reasonable 15 minute walk to most anything. Near to a couple markets for quick access to groceries. I loved the view and the home was well appointed. The bed was comfy and everything was well set up for travelers. I would stay again if I wind up in Edinburgh! Thank you!
Good value for money

Arrived 3pm. Easy collection of keys. Outside door a little awkward to unlock. Had to jiggle lock somewhat.
Building a bit too secluded, for a lone female.
Great views of churchyard.
Nice size apartment.
Basically left my things and went out exploring.
On my return. Noticed the flannelette duvet cover had lots of hairs on it. No topsheet present.
Duvet cover, towels and bath mat, so old and used. Wanted binning.
Sofa bed, was obviously meant to be a lighter shade of material. Was in need of professional clean. Looked dirty.
The single chair ( ? IKEA type)
Was stained and dirty.
A mountain of dust and duvet feathers under bed. Bathroom floor had hairs on.
Shower sealant black in areas.
Fridge, microwave, toilet all clean and usable. Wooden floors appeared vacuumed.
I vacated after one night.

Fantastic place, had everything I needed.
Getting in/out of Edinburgh was a simple bus ride.
Place was nice, quiet and comfortable.
The town of Portobello seemed to shut down about 10:30 which I wasn't expecting, but still was good
No issues
The apartment is spacious, clean, well equipped, and in a perfect location. Highly recommend staying here. Kieron was super nice/ easy going.

Maia’s lovely flat is very close to everywhere. Maia and her partner are very easy to communicate with and she respond me mostly on time. She is also very helpful, she gave us a lot of suggestions on our trip plan and traffic. I would definitely come back  if I visit Edinburgh again! Another great experience on AirBnB!

We had a fantastic stay here! The flat is even better in person than its description and pictures. David goes above and beyond to make sure you feel at home and comfortable, and it was lovely to chat with him a bit as we checked in. The location is also perfect if you want to be near the big tourist hotspots but still want your privacy! While it's worth noting that the street did get a bit loud on a Saturday night, I feel like that's to be expected given the central location and we had no issue with noise after that. Perfect stay!
Great location and value for what I paid. Bathrooms were a bit dirty but the rooms were clean. Great and helpful staff and overall I was happy with my experience.
人很好，而且会有免费饼干，入住之后没少帮我们忙，没少麻烦他们，太感谢了

Alan was very flexible, he was not in town but made sure we got th keys and kept in touch the entire time - the location is right in the middle of Royal Mile and most locations are a quick walk.  We had a car but found street parking within a 3 - 4 block radius.
Great location, but very small for 3 and did not have sufficient amenities. That being said, we really enjoyed our stay. Thank you!

We had an overnight stay in Edinburgh and Jenna‘s place was perfect for that! The room is lovely and Jenna is a fantastic host. The room came with towels, shower gel, cookies and a folder full of great recommendations in the area. We could walk to the city center and check out all the tourist attractions but the neighborhood was quiet and not touristy at all - which we very much appreciated.
We would definitely stay with Jenna again!
Thanks for everything :)

Kevin’s place is great, clean and comfortable, close to everything. Perfect for singles or a couple. So many transport options close by, but a nice walk into town if you prefer. I’d highly recommend and would stay here again if visiting Edinburgh.
Great location. Lovely apartment. Host was very accommodating.

What a gem! Conveniently located by the train station and in the middle of the Royal Mile, Allan’s place was wonderful. Although we didn’t meet, he was very responsive to questions and clear on check-in instructions. The beds were comfortable, and the water was always hot for showers. If this place is available, don’t hesitate to book!
Tolle Lage, ausreichend Platz für unsere 5köpfige Familie, viele nette Cafés und Pubs in der Nähe.

Die Unterkunft liegt in einer ruhigen Wohngegend, außerhalb des Zentrums von Edinburgh. Die Anbindung mit dem Bus ist gut und mehrere Haltestellen sind fußläufig erreichbar. (Im Bus kann man ganz einfach bargeldlos bezahlen.) Arthur's Seat ist ebenfalls gut zu Fuß zu erreichen.
Das Zimmer sieht aus wie auf den Bildern und das Bett ist bequem. Küche und Bad nutzt man gemeinsam mit Roberto. In der Küche findet sich alles was man braucht, um sich selbst zu versorgen. Andere Gäste sind nicht im Haus.
Die Kommunikation mit Roberto war super. Er hat immer schnell reagiert, hat schon im Vorhinein Tipps gegeben und war auch so lieb uns eine zweite Decke zu geben, weil wir besser schlafen, wenn jeder unter einer eigenen Decke liegt, egal wie groß die Decke auch sein mag. Auch im direkten persönlichen Kontakt war Roberto sehr nett und offen und wir haben uns gut unterhalten.
Great location and bigger than it looks in the pictures!

Nice apartment, nicely decorated and very clean!!
Downstairs entrance a little less clean,
probably due to the shared use with other residents,
very nice antique stairs to the floors,
we had a great time and will definitely come back here
Thank you Agie for your hospitality
and great tips for dining and activities in Edingburgh!!

This is a great 4 bedroom flat, we took a bedroom each but the flat easily sleeps more. The flat was clean and had all the amenities you require. The location is excellent, catch the 22 bus outside for a 15 min journey to Princes Street or take a short walk along to The Shore where there are great restaurants and cafes. There is a small supermarket opposite for all your needs. I would happily stay here again.

I would strongly recommend Toby's flat which is with Good Location (10min walk to city center), Clean&Tidy (northern europe style, kept like a new accommodation), Quiet (sit at an alley, none of street noise), Warm (heating opened before my arrival, free materials provided to guide Edinburgh, free milk prepared for breakfast). Thanks :)

Great location and description of the unit is fairly accurate. Host was very responsive. However, the bathroom could have mold. Strong scent that doesn’t seem right. The shower is also very poor with no water pressure and very little room.
The flat is in a great location, very central, perfect connection to the airport. Check in was easy and hassle free and the flat was very comfortable. We will be back

What can I say, the reviews tell it all. I didn’t meet Andrew in person, but I can tell he’s really a nice person! Communication was good from the beginning. Instead I met Andrew’s partner, Jen, who also super nice. The place is in the heart of the Old Town. Perfect! It was clean and lovely! Everything was perfect that I would love to stay in Andrew’s place again whenever I visit Edinburgh. He even so kind to send our left items. So grateful for a super nice host like Andrew. Thank you so much!

We had a lovely stay at Castle Gogar. The cottage was so lovely and the surroundings were peaceful, secluded yet all within reach of Edinburgh and everything we needed to get to. We brought our dog along and went on lovely walks, she enjoyed herself too. The cottage was clean and well presented. Overall we had a great stay - thanks so much!

I just returned from my first trip to Edinburgh. I couldn't be happier with our Airbnb selection. Walking directions from the train station were perfect and the instructions for accessing the key and the apartment were easy to follow. The apartment itself is ideally located in the center of everything and was super clean! Lastly, Nicola was a great host. She checked in with me a couple of times to make sure I didn't have any questions or issues. I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Edinburgh!

Galina welcomed us when we arrive at night, guide us to our room friendly, we also met her husband and their lovely dog. She sent us very detailed instruction of how to get their house, it was quite useful. The room and bath room are very clean. Cosy staying experience. Thanks!

Great location allows you to walk to about everywhere in Edinburgh.  Nice to have a spot to park the car and not have to worry about finding parking everywhere.  Plenty of room to relax after a long day exploring the city.
Good location very walkable and very near also to bus station. Flat is pretty much have everything you need. While there are other guest in the flat everyone is respect of each other privacy.
Muy buen lugar para visitar la ciudad, estuvimos muy cómodos.
Fabulous!!!

This is a wonderful apartment and Catt and her co host David are a credit to Airbnb.  The self check in is nice and easy, communication is prompt and helpful and the apartment is perfectly located with all conveniences.  I loved sitting in the window seats people watching.  The bedroom is quiet and luxuriously comfortable for a great night's sleep. My flight was delayed which resulted in my arrival after midnight but Catt and David were reassuringly contactable and took away any anxiety I had about being a lone female checking in so late. I will definitely book this apartment again.

We loved being in the center of everything. It was so nice to be able to walk everywhere and the flat was spacious enough for our family of five. The view from the living room was amazing. The flat was clean and well kept.

This apartment is an ideal location for exploring all that Edinburgh has to offer.  We walked everywhere as everything was close by and it was a pleasure to walk through all the beautiful squares and mews.  We drove from home to Edinburgh but didn't really need the car after arriving so the underground parking space made life very easy.  For such a central location, we were surprised at how quiet the apartment was, we didn't hear any neighbours or street noise. We stayed a week and it was a very cosy, comfortable home from home that was immaculately clean on our arrival.  Thank you.

Lewis is a perfect host his instructions were perfect and very informative.
The flat was as you see the pictures very spacious and in very good order, clean and tidy
plenty of towels and toiletries etc
The flat is in a central location with plenty shops, pubs and restaurants close by .
Highly recommend Lewis’s flat and when I’m in Edinburgh next I’ll be booking the flat
A lovely apartment in the heart of Edinburgh! Everything was as described and Mark was quick with responses. Would 100% recommend

Gute Wohnung in ruhiger Lage. Wir hatten die Wohnung für 6 Personen. Sie war wie beschrieben und groß genug, höchstens im Bereich der Hochbetten etwas eng, aber vollkommen machbar. Wir konnten auch etwas außerhalb der vorgegebenen Zeiten ein- und auschecken! Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern hat gut und schnell funktioniert. Stadtzentrum ist in 30 min zu Fuß erreichbar. Lidl und Tesco in 5 min. Kurz: Für einen Aufenthalt in Edinburgh top!
Alistair was a really friendly host and is great with quick responses to any questions we had. His home was very cozy and clean! Highly recommended, it was a pleasure to meet him.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The flat was really comfortable and had everything we needed. There are local shops that you can top up on bits and pieces. I will look to stay here again when visiting Edinburgh.
Lovely house, fantastic seating area in garden. Good location to city centre.

A very tidy and comfortable twin room at the front of the property. Front door keys provided and hosts happy for you to come and go as you please.
About twenty minutes from the city centre, with at least three bus routes passing the property.
Ample towels and even bath robes provided.

We enjoyed our stay immensely. Bernard is an exceptional host and was quite understanding when inclement weather extended our stay. We were able to add an additional night on to our trip without any issue.
I highly recommend this beautiful apartment and extend a heartfelt thank you to Bernard for his hospitality .

Morag was friendly and helpful, answering any questions promptly, and giving us all the information we needed for our stay. The room was cosy and had everything we needed, the bed was comfortable, and the bathroom spotless. Morag's place is within easy reach of the city centre, plus it's peaceful and quiet. I'd be very happy to stay there again and recommend it.

Logement très bien agencé et fonctionnel.
Chambres spacieuses
Quartier calme la nuit et à seulement 5 minutes des premiers pubs et de Victoria Street.
Parfait pour un sejour dans une capitale.
Je recommande

Duncan’s flat is in a great, central location within easy walking distance of the sights. We loved the views to Arthur’s Seat and being so close to Holyrood Park. Although centrally located it is quiet at night. The flat is lovely, very comfortable and well equipped. We really appreciated the free parking. Duncan was a great host and we thoroughly enjoyed our Edinburgh break. If we visit again we will definitely stay at Duncan’s place.
깜찍하게 꾸며 놓은 침실과 침구가 편안하고 깨끗했습니다 친절하게 체크인을 도와주시고 주변 레스토랑도 소개해 주셨습니다 귀여운 강아지 머피도 함께 환영해 줘요 화장실도 매우 깨끗합니다 침실에 티 세트도 구비되어 있어요 정말 최고의 숙소였어요! 다음에 에든버러에 다시 가게 된다면 또 묵고 싶습니다 감사해요 🩷
Personne super sympa et très réactive ! Le rbnb est idéalement placé. Cependant, la propreté de la sdb reste à désirer…
Boa localização. Espaço amplo.

Location is amazing however the guest room over the alley was terrible. My wife and I couldn’t sleep for 3 days from all the noise and light coming in. With no air conditioning or fans we had to keep windows open which let in all the noise from the drunk people. If not for the location I would have hated this place, it was perfect to be able to stop and drop things off and use the toilet but sleeping was almost impossible in the guest room over the alley.
Couldn’t recommend this apartment enough. Lovely and clean and cosy. Easy access to everything and check in was smooth. Thank you

My boyfriend and I had a wonderful stay at Nicola’s apartment. It’s exactly as described and has everything you could need to enjoy a break in Edinburgh. The location is excellent and is central to everything. Nicola is a great host and we wouldn’t hesitate to book in again on our next visit!
