The accommodation was clean, comfortable and just what we needed for our weekend stay in Edinburgh. Location was superb and even though it is located just off the main tourist area it was remarkably quiet. Highly recommended and can't wait to book again for our next visit.

Dan and Alex were amazing hosts! The flat was perfect and exactly as described: amazingly well decorated, very clean and with amazing views. There is a bus stop just outside the building complex that takes you to the city and back and there is always the option of a really nice walk there (about 1 hour)!
We were treated as part of the family and felt really comfortable. Dan and Alex were always really kind and great in helping us around, making us feel at home and even showing us around some parts of Edinburgh! If we ever go to Edinburgh we will definitely try and stay with them again: 5 stars!
Sehr gutes Studio Zimmer in einer perfekten Lage. Ca. 20 min Fußweg zu Stadtmitte. Ruhige Gegend mit vielen Restaurants in der Nähe.

very comfortable apartment in excellent location 15 mins walk form centre of city. very clean, nice extras like netflix and fold out sofa bed! pool and gym were cool too as was rooftop terrace and the views. Valentin was very helpful and friendly and easy to contact and left me a bottle of wine! 10/10 stay
Dejlig bolig og vært

A really lovely central flat at a good price and perfect for our long weekend in Edinburgh. On hand for buses into town and shops/cafes. Clean spacious flat with everything we needed to feel at home. Lovely quiet bedroom at the back with great view. On street parking over the weekend was free aswell which was an added bonus.
Great stay with June and Gordon, room was spacious and clean, good location and breakfast in the morning is a great addition.

Adeline was a great host, communicated quickly and was informative. Apartment was big, clean, very comfortable, and felt like home. Great location and lively nightlife. M&S grocery was nearby and has everything you need. Walking distance to beautiful landmarks, restaurants and pubs. Had a wonderful experience.
Haste ye back!

A fantastic apartment. Brilliant location in Edinburgh Old Town. Amazing view of the castle. A couple of minutes from Grassmarket.
Clean, comfortable, well presented apartment. Warm and cosy. Everything you need for a holiday or mini break. Considering the location it's lovely and quiet.
Excellent communication from the owners. Very helpful with clear instructions.
No parking at the apartment but it's only a few minutes walk away and reasonably priced and secure for city centre parking.
I would definitely return to this apartment. Absolutely loved my stay.

Hannah was so flexible and accommodated our request to check in early. Although Tessa was away at the time, she was still very responsive over email and answered so quickly regarding heating and restaurant recommendations. We loved the style of the room and comfort of the bed and pillows. The location was very central and walkable. We had a great stay and would love to go back!

We had a lovely stay in this 2 bedroom apartment, perfect for a family of 4. It was spacious, clean and comfortable with a well equipped kitchen. The bus stop in to the city centre was just round the corner and only 15 minutes into the city. There is also a retail park just a few minutes walk away. The communication from the host was extremely fast and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay here.

Everything was perfect!
We received all necessary information to find the flat and could easily reach it by foot from the centre. The room is perfect for two with a private bathroom. We did everything on foot but public transport is also close by. Jane is a very nice host. Would definitely recommend and come again if I ever need a room in Edinburgh. Thank you Jane.
Exactly as described. Easy check in and check out. Very clean and well equipped.

We had a lovely stay at Mary’s place. We arrived late due to flight delays but Mary was very supportive and patient and welcomed us once we arrived. Superb location 20 minutes walk from the city center with buses just a few steps from the house (one goes straight from and to the airport). Enough pubs and restaurants in the neighborhood m. Clean, quiet, with everything you need for breakfast ! Perfect I would totally come back.

Denise’s flat is in the absolute perfect location if you are looking to explore Edinburgh and are really only using the flat as a sleeping place. It is in the heart of the Royal Mile and you can catch tours, buses, taxis, and so much more within a short walk. We found the place a bit dusty and there was a bit of trash around the bed that was left from the previous people. If you are staying for a longer period of time remember to bring extra toilet paper, as you are only given 2 rolls, as well as paper towels, for there are none and only one kitchen towel for use.

This flat is special. Views of the castle, views of the mountains, and above all, a location right in the center of Old Edinburgh. You walk right out your front door and boom, you’re in a different century. The apartment itself is cozy and comfortable, windows in each room with views of the castle. The Bathroom even has a tub!  Finally, the hosts are kind and accommodating. This is a wonderful place to stay in a wonderful city.
Lucy was a great host. Even though I didn’t meet her in person, she was always responsive and available. The neighborhood is quiet and calm. Thank you for hosting me!
location is so nice. really close to calton hill

We very much enjoyed our stay at Agnieszka's little flat. It's located about a 20 minute walk from Princes Street/the city centre but there are bus stations nearby. The check in & check out was very uncomplicated via key box. The flat looked exactly as we had imagined it from the pictures and felt even a big more spacious than expected. It is well equipped with everything you might need and all the explanations were simple and helpful. We immediately felt like home and very comfortable. The communication before and during our stay was very good. There was nothing to complain about. I would definitely recommend a stay here and would return in future. Thank you.

Un appartamento grazioso, luminoso e pulito.
due camere da letto ( una matrimoniale e una singola) confortevoli, con tutto il necessario.( lenzuola e asciugamani e qualche gadget! )
Salottino con tavolo da pranzo e grande divano.
Cucina con tutto ciò che può servire.
il bagnetto nuovo è grazioso ( a disposizione dispenser con shampoo e bagnoschiuma ottimi )
Debora è stata molto disponibile alle nostre richieste su consigli e indicazioni. (graditissime)
Zona tranquilla con, a un paio di isolati, servizi di ogni tipo.. supermercati e fermate di bus / tram , ristoranti etc..
Unica pecca sono i tre piani di scale.. ma ne eravamo a conoscenza quindi non sono stati un problema.
Consigliato, ci siamo sentiti a casa.
Amazing host who was always  attentive in answering any questions we had.. apartment, location and the city itself exceeded all hopes and would definitely recommend
Perfect place!  close to Holyroodhouse palace and Edinburgh castle.   We were able to walk everywhere.
A lovely flat, very well situated and very cosy during a bitterly cold January week. Would definitely book again if it's available.
Fantastic location - close to really nice bars and restaurants. Check in was easy
Perfect place for a stopover. Clean, tidy, cute little room and just 20 mins walk down the canal to the Corn Exchange which is where I was headed for the evening. Gwen is a very good host.
Fast, thorough communication from Julie.  The place is comfortable and well appointed and great for buses to town.

Jackie’s flat was amazing and exactly what we were after in Edinburgh! The city centre location was absolutely brilliant and so easy to get the sites and the shopping! The flat was spotless and had everything we needed.
spacious house, responsive host, perfect for a group getaway in edinburgh

This place is fantastic! So affordable for what you get. It's right in the center of everything on the Royal Mile but once you get inside the apartment is quiet, quaint and spacious. Alison has done such an amazing job decorating and furnishing it and there is literally everything we could think of needing - even a clothes washer! Highly recommend staying here on your trip to Edinburgh.
Great location, clean and comfortable flat, tasty restaurants just around the corner!

Can't say enough nice things about Jane's place.  We did indeed overlook Edinburgh Castle, a view we woke to every day.  Centrally located so easy to walk to any bus and even the tram to go to the Royal Britannia.  Communication was quick and thorough and thoughtful.  Jane knew I was traveling with my handicapped granddaughter who needed some accommodations.  We felt safe leaving the wheelchair downstairs.  Jane brought us a shower chair at our request, which was very helpful.  We came into the unit to waiting tea, coffee, Scottish biscuits.  We aren't into video much, but the unit has an outstanding movie collection and really big screen.  Instructions were clear for everything, but not overwhelming.  All great.
Great place to stay for a few nights, staff is super friendly

Wonderfully equipped flat with everything you could ever need and more.   Loved the high ceilings and curved windows.  Location is great in the centre of the old part of Leith but on a quiet sidestreet.  Leith is becoming very stylish with upmarket eateries and pubs and is only a short bus trip straight into the city centre.
Great stay perfect for a night in Edinburgh visiting my daughter. Easy walking distance to the royal mile

Sehr schöne Wohnung, modern eingerichtet, alles neu renoviert und gut ausgestattet. Tolle Lage, Sehenswürdigkeiten zu Fuß erreichbar und auch gute Lokale in der Straße. Proaktive Kommunikation und dadurch  sehr einfacher check-in.

Very nice experience.
Only there wasn't a wifi and no use of the kitchen (as mentioned in the description of the room).
The host is very friendly and makes the guests comfortable and feel at ease.
Good location and friendly host.
Great place and location. Every detail has been thought of by Margaret and Neil. You won’t be disappointed.

Scott’s place is lovely, very spacious and in a lovely area. It was a 20 minute walk to new town (and parking) so perfect for a weekend away. He left helpful instructions regarding parking and recommendations and ensured the flat felt homely. Will definitely stay again.
Thaiha is wonderful host. I really enjoy my stay in Thaiha place. It’s very peaceful. Am really appreciate thaiha’s hosting
The Grassmarket apartment was awesome and a great value. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and appreciated Indre and Arnold’s responsiveness and simple instructions. Highly recommended!
Great stay. Very handy for what we needed. Would recommend.

Super séjour !
Daniel a été un hôte vraiment très gentil, réactif et arrangeant. Il a même eu de petites attentions qui ont rendu l’expérience encore plus agréable. Je recommande sans hésiter !☺️

Rona's place is an exceptional value. I highly recommend this stay for avid walkers as it's located within walking distance of every major attraction in Edinburgh.
I also liked having my own private bathroom, which is a huge plus for an AirBnB. Also, despite normally being a light sleeper, I slept like a stone on the comfortable bed. There is not even a trace of noise at night as the unit is tucked away in a quiet courtyard.
Lastly, Rona and her partner are friendly, thoughtful, and accommodating - I highly recommend this stay!

We stayed with Chrissy and Andy for a weekend and were more than thrilled. Their house is incredibly beautiful and the room provided is perfect. You have your own bathroom, with a bathtub, which I also took advantage of because I unfortunately had a cold. We felt wonderfully looked after, the breakfast was fabulous, Chrissy's freshly baked bread is really good! I can only recommend it! I can recommend anyone to stay with them if you come to Edinburgh, the flat is in a great location and you can get everywhere perfectly, even on foot. If I come to Edinburgh again, I will definitely come back to Chrissy and Andy's place.  :)
Great place!

The apartment was wonderful we couldnt have asked for better. In fact the photos dont do it enough justice as its a lot bigger in reality. We came for the Edinburgh Marathon and it was an ideal location for that and all our needs.. Would definitely stay here again

Portobello ist sehr ruhig, sauber und freundlich aber nicht weit vom Zentrum Edinburghs. Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön und historisch. Tee, Getränke und crackers waren im Zimmer. Giselle und Robin sind freundliche Leute. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Great location!  Hosts were super friendly and very helpful.  Would definitely stay again when we return!
Expect a clean well thought out flat with extremely comfortable beds. The bathroom was nice. I fell in love with this place.

What a lovely flat in the heart of Edinburgh! The location was perfect for walking around Old Town and New Town - close to the castle, train station, shops, pubs, and restaurants.  The flat itself is spacious, comfortable, clean, quiet, and well equipped - everything you'd want in a home-away-from-home holiday home base.  Communication from Jacqueline was excellent. Highly recommend this Airbnb in Edinburgh.
Excellent location, close to the centre, easy to walk to, comfy bed. Bianca was very welcoming and gave us lots of useful information. Highly recommend.

Un petit studio bien placé au centre de la ville. Une cuisine bien équipée même si on ne l'a pas utilisé . Bonne communication malgré que des fois il est difficile de se faire comprendre avec assistante numérique. Le logement était propre.
En contre partie,points négatifs :
* Matelas avec ressorts très resentis.
* vitrage non isolant. On entend les voitures rouler sur les pavés ce qui est dérangeant.
* un lampadaire très éblouissant juste à côté des fenêtres. Pas de stores couvrant la totalité des fenêtres.
Le canapé-lit du salon est inconfortable: Ressorts ressentis et espace au milieu très creux.

The chalet was lovely, homely and really well kitted out. It was so nice to be able to sit out and enjoy the beautiful garden and our kids loved having the space to play too. Sandy and Mike were really welcoming and helpful.

Location is perfect to discover central Edinburgh. Flat is nicely decorated and generally well equipped. Buses stop right in front of appartment. Evening and morning traffic could bother light sleepers, so bring earplugs along. Pull out bed (ca. 1.2m wide and 8cm thick) was not really suitable for our teenage kids. For small kids it would be okay.
Janet’s place was exactly as pictured. Beds were comfy and it was quiet. We would stay there again.
Amazing apartment in an amazing location! Definitely worth it for exploring the centre of the city.
一切都很好，還有個後院可以享受陽光，唯一一個小失望 也是我們自己沒有做好功課，位置沒有真的那麼靠近市中心，但是相對的社區附近的安靜環境會比住在市區好，反而多了一個寧靜的休息時間，可以在夜晚好好的休息。

Had a great stay, beautiful tiny apartment with, kitchen was great. Erin left us Coffee, tea and basic breakfast stuff which was super helpful.
Had a great stay, Erin was super responsive

Victors place was very well located, it was smart and modern. Great value for money! Only issue is that it had a weird smell in the studio. I couldn’t get of it, was quite strong. But other than that it was nice place.
Amazing experience and Harvey is the best!!
Amazing location! Very nice place to stay! Thanks for having us ❤️

Lovely flat and had a great time with friends there! The location is perfect and we loved walking around! Very convenient to have so many restaurants and stores so close by. Would definitely recommend! Hope the friendly host has a great week!

Spotless, large apartment with everything you need already inside, in the heart of Stockbridge - easily walkable to the city centre, surrounded by lots of independent shops and cafes. Easy to follow instructions for getting into the building. Will happily stay again in future visits to Edinburgh. Thanks Oscar!

This is a bijou apartment with all the warm hospitality and wonderful touches (croissants, fizz, Scottish toiletries, and great style) you’d expect from a super host. Hazel is warm, welcoming, always  available, incredibly helpful, and made our stay quite perfect. We loved the stylish apartment, located close to the bus route into the city centre, and fully intend to return next year. Thank you, Hazel!

Catherine was a very accommodating host. She offers quick responses and was very pleasant to deal with. The room I stayed in was well decorated, cozy and warm I felt relaxed and safe there. The property is minutes away from the city center but located on a quaint and quite street you'll have a very restful nights sleep. There is also a lovely lounge
area with a dining table and TV where you can eat a meal, unwind or read a book. If your in the area and need to book accommodation hesitate. Easy check-in and, nice host and comfortable. Enjoy 😉

This place was amazing! Jose and Jenny saved me with a last minute booking. They were warm and welcoming, the room and bathroom were comfortable, private and quiet. A little bit further out, but handy and easy for buses. I highly recommend.
Value for money

The listing description is very accurate and Bob's flat is absolutely gorgeous. The neighborhood is also very good with everything you need close by. The city centre is only a 20 min walk away and regular buses are available.
Bob is one of the most kind and helpful host I got the chance to meet. He made sure that everything was perfect with the flat.
Andrew's flat is in a wonderful part of town. Andrew gave us a great tip for a fun local pub with live music which made the night. Thanks so much!

We spent a lovely few days at the apartment which was just as described. It had all that we needed and the bed was very comfortable. David was very quick to respond to us and gave lots of great information about the apartment and the surrounding area. The location was a perfect base to explore Edinburgh and we were able to walk everywhere we needed.

A big thank you to Stuart who was the nicest host with such an incredible place!
Not only is Stuart's place so well situated (we walked everywhere - from the train station, to sightseeing, to the Christmas markets, and the 4 flights of stairs haha, definitely a good workout), its also perfectly presented. We wanted somewhere comfortable and home-like for our Christmas, to enable us to cook, relax and enjoy Edinburgh ... and Stuart's place ticked all those boxes!
We were so pleased that we found somewhere perfect for our holiday - thank you again Stuart, your place definitely made our Christmas very memorable! All the best, Samara & Bruno
Fantastic stay! Looking forward to returning in the future!

Annette's room is very nice and clean, with a view on the harbour and next to the bus stops, with easy access to the centre.
Annette was a great host - she gave us a lot of tips to visit the city and provided us with plenty of snacks and even breakfast. We would definitely recommend her place!

The flat was modern, spacious and clean with lovely period features and  with everything you need for a short stay. The entrance hall before you go up to the flat is quite dark and dingy but the flat itself is bright and light. Sadly you can hear a lot of noise from the flats above and next door so if you’re a light sleeper like me, bring ear plugs. A five minute walk from Calton Hill and a ten minute walk from the centre - perfect location.
Very nice Airbnb, pictures were not misleading! Definitely a nice location, neighborhood is calm and close to the center.
Beautiful and well kept place! we will definitely come back !

No words will do this little paradise justice! Staying with Kate in this immaculate, well designed and tranquil cottage was pure bliss. Everything is marvellous, modern, in the midst of nature only a 30 Min bus ride away from the heart of the city. Kate is one of the friendliest, most attentive and generous hosts I've met so far and I would love to stay with her again.
Ryan’s place was great to stay at! It was super close to the tram to get around, and close to lots of pubs. Highly recommend. Thank you Ryan!
This is a home away from home for me. Peaceful, comfortable, just perfect. Thanks Julie, fantastic stay as always.
Brilliant stay. Excellent location. Accommodation lived up to expectations.

Since it was a shared space, it came with certain restraints like keeping host informed of our exact checkin time and staying very very quiet so as to not disturb anyone and having to ask for drinking water but that's a choice you make when you book. Otherwise the hosts were great and room was as described. Location is slightly out of city center but you can find a bus stop 10 min walking!
We had a lovely few days at the flat. Great location in Stockbridge and the flat had everything we needed. We really appreciated the late check out opportunity. Would  stay here again in Edinburgh.
My dad was visiting me in Edinburgh so I let him stay in Steve's flat. Overall it was great place in a nice location. The room is very comfortable and well equipped.
The place was of great value and was close to good transport links to get around the city. Joshua is also very accommodating and responsive.

Dari sejak pertama masuk ke dalam rumahnya, kami langsung dibuat nyaman oleh aroma wangi dari dalam rumah nya. Ceilidh mendekorasi dengan sangat baik tempat tinggalnya, dan tentu saja merawat dengan baik dan rapih juga. Kami tidak menyangka akan mendapatkan begitu banyak amenities, seperti permen dan berbagai cemilan khas skotlandia, susu dan jus dikulkas, bahkan bathbomb, yang membuat liburan lebih terasa manis. Ceilidh juga sangat responsif dan sangat membantu atas segala pertanyaan yg kami tanyakan. Terimakasih banyak Ceilidh ! Sukses selalu untukmu 😊 !
We loved our stay at Jane’s place. It was a perfect location, with a spectacular view, beautiful living room and very comfortable bed. It was the best stop on our trip!
Tom’s flat was exactly as advertised - very modern, clean, and in a great location. The car parking space was also so handy!
Upon reflection, all aspects of our stay at Bryan’s place were excellent. Highly recommend as your place to stay in Edinburgh.
The apartment was perfect for our week in Edinburgh.  The location is amazing and Fidelia was extremely helpful.
Lovely home and great hosts. The room was perfect and communication was top tier. Would highly recommend!

This is a superbly situated cosy and comfortable base for exploring Edinburgh’s many attractions. The flat is attractive, clean and well kitted out. Not suitable for the elderly or those with mobility problems as it is on the third floor and access is via a steep flight of stone stairs. Otherwise, highly recommended!
Michelle’s place felt like a home away from home. She was incredibly helpful and kind. We loved how comfortable the house was and how she gave extra amenities. We will definitely stay again.
Very Nice ! Thank you very much !
Lovely homely place. Authentic Edinburgh vibes and all amenities are more than covered. Would recommend and come again! :)
A very warm and welcoming stay in an ideal location to explore beautiful Edinburgh!
Greatly located airbnb, just a little up a hill with detailed directions and check-in instructions. The room fit my needs and Marcus was very accommodating. Would return!
Everything was perfect! Thank you so much. Highly recommended.
The location was good and everything was as expected.

John war ein sehr freundlicher und ruhiger Gastgeber, der uns Tipps für die Gegend gegeben und unsere Privatsphäre respektiert hat. Außerdem durften wir während unseres 3-tägigen Aufenthaltes kostenlos auf den Privatparkplätzen des Hauses parken. Auch in der Wohnung war alles wie beschrieben und die Lage ermöglicht es, die ganze Stadt per Fuß zu erkunden. Da einzige kleine Manko war die Sauberkeit (im Bad). Wir würden erneut buchen!
Wonderful room at a place in walking distance of city centre. Nearby beautiful canals walk!

Alex's communication prior to arrival made for an easy check-in. It took us about 15 minutes to walk to South Bridge from the flat so it's perfectly located for a weekend in the city. Got some good sleep in too as the street was quiet and the bed was comfortable. A lovely, chilled stay from start to finish.

Thank you so much.
Thanks for what you have done for us!This is a very recommended home stay, and I will come back if I have the chance.入住Chris的民宿是我做的最正确的选择，他的家安静、古朴、温暖、干净。让我们在游玩一天后可以非常惬意的休息。Chris本人也好到爆，听说我定错票，他主动帮我退票重定，怕我搞不定，还同我一起去火车站，送我同老妈上车，最后我给我他一个大大的拥抱，感动的眼泪差点流下，感觉到爱丁堡因为他变得更美了。

overall great stay! not all of the information is in the Airbnb post but there is a really helpful house manual. If you have a car make sure you put the parking pass in immediately or you will be ticketed. we tried to check in early, unfortunately Johnathan did not respond quickly so we got ticketed and it's quite expensive.

En Syuan war sehr freundlich und aufmerksam. Das Zentrum war zu Fuß und auch per Bus rasch zu erreichen. Die Wohnung ist sehr ruhig gelegen. Gute Einkaufs-, Speiselokale und Bars 10 Minuten entfernt. Nähe zu Parkanlage und Botanischen Garten, kostenlose Parkmöglichkeit nicht weit entfernt. Wir würden wiederkommen.

Beautiful apartment set in the centre of Edinburgh, great facilities and beautifully furnished! Jane is also a very caring host, she made sure we got in to the flat ok and enjoyed our stay with detailed helpful information!

Property is as per photos and description, great communication leading up and during the stay, easy to locate with instructions given and it is a short distance from the tram stop we used to get from the airport. Property was verry clean and well kept, good WIFI and a smart TV with built in streaming Apps, a supermarket a few minutes away, a small walk to the start of the Royal Mile and the tourist sites, We were a family of 4 adults and were very comfortable during our stay at the house and would happily recommended.

Wonderful pied-a-terre close to everything (including the tram to the airport). Enjoyed 3 nights here with my kids. The apartment was clean and comfortable. Check in an check out were a breeze. Be prepared for the stairs, though - you'll definitely get your steps in! Would definitely stay here if I'm ever back in Edinburgh.

Natalie’s place was lovely!!
The walk up the stairs to the unit was a bit tiring but not reason enough to say it was a negative. Also, if the bathroom had been a bit bigger I would have given Natalie’s place a perfect review. All in all, our family really enjoyed Natalie’s place. The unit was very well-decorated, clean, tidy, chic, etc, it even smelled nice, too! Lots of natural light into the unit and bedrooms was a nice plus. Great plants as well.

Caroline has a great apartment. The location is amazing - few mins from the royal mile. The apartment is very spacious and has all the amenities you can ask for. Caroline was also a great host with clear instructions and communication. We would surely stay again!

Staying with Louisa and Noam was absolutely wonderful. From the moment of the booking until our final day at their apartment they were very kind and helpful. Their home and the room we stayed in was perfect for a weekend away in Edinburgh. The moment you arrive you feel very welcome (also from their dog and cat). The location is very close to the city center and is very peaceful to return to after a busy day. The room and seperate bathroom areas were very clean and definitely up to hotel standards, with the coziness of home. I will be recommending this beautiful room and kind host to everyone I know wishing to visit Edinburgh!

Super comfortable and relaxing flat to stay in. A kitchen with everything you might need, concise and comfortable bedrooms with a large open living space with soft lighting, comfortable chairs and a record player. Would recommend 100%!
Had a lovely last minute stay here, highly recommend

Ho soggiorno una notte con la mia famiglia. La camera numero 7 è un miniappartamento composto da camera, bagno e salottino , ricca di confort e coccole per gli ospiti. Siamo stati davvero bene. Ad ogni richiesta l'host è stato davvero gentile e disponibile. La zona è davvero tranquilla e comoda. Consigliatissimo!

I can not possibly speak highly enough of this stunning Flat. It comes exactly as advertised with everything you could possibly need.
With a bus stop a short walk away with several buses heading to Princes St (a 20-25 minute ride), a bus stop directly across the street for the trip back, and a Tram just a short walk away, you have plenty of options for getting around.
The Flat itself has an immaculately clean, beautiful modern looking interior with all of the amenities.
You definitely will not go hungry with several different restaurants right outside the front door, and a couple small grocery stores a short walk away.
Anne is a fantastic host, who replies very quickly, and offers a ton of valuable tips and suggestions to help put your mind at ease, and remove many of the typical stresses of traveling to a new place.
I highly recommend this Flat to anyone visiting Leith/Edinburgh, and hope that future travels bring me back again some day!
Thank you Anne 🙂

Excellent location., a short walk to Holyrood Palace. The flat is is clean, modern, well designed, the bedrooms are comfortable, the shower rooms inmmaculate. The lounge/dining room is spacious, the kitchen well equipped. The whole place made us feel at ease. We would have appreciated some information on the area, transport, useful numbers , maybe a map of the city.  We only found instructions on how to connect to wifi. Apart from that, everything was great.
Beautiful apartment, great host!
Great stay, prefect for two people and spacious living.
Large apartment in great central location. As reported by others for some time, needs a little TLC and a refresh then the 77 stairs rally could take you to penthouse heaven.

The apartment was perfectly equipped and in a wonderful location.
You have many bus lines very close and a lot of shops and supermarkets.
Monika was very kind and helpful.
Everything was great.

We all really enjoyed our time at the funky apartment. Amazing spot. Close to the tram and the bus system. Easy walking and lovely restaurants and coffee shops in the area. Hostess was very responsive and informative, as first timers to Edinburgh this was appreciated. Thank you for making it all so easy for us.
Ottima posizione per il centro. Nicolas è un host molto disponibile. Consigliamo
Was a lovely stay full of anything you might need. Could very easily be there for a short to mid term stay and call it home for a period.

We had an absolute blast during our stay in Scotland. We would recommend Rachel’s to anyone and would stay there again. Couldn’t be in a better location and Rachel is very communicative and accommodating.

جميلة ورائعة كل شي قريب منطقة جميلة
المبنى تراثي قديم وجميل العيب الوحيد عدم وجود مصعد لا انصح كبار السن او من يعاني من الام المفاصل وجود المنزل بالقرب من المقهى (يغلق س 9م)سبب بعض الإزعاج لكني أستمتعت بالسكن
شكرًا للجميع

Loved having the space to spread out w/3 bedrooms and 2 1/2 baths.  Very quiet by 10 each night once cheerfully chatty Patio bar across the alley closed outside space- would only be a concern if guests had younger kids w/early bedtime. Decent walkability to downtown areas.
Great host. Quiet place and nice neighborhood
Lovely apartment in an excellent location in Edinburgh. Marcus was a great host and made the check in process very smooth
The bedroom door is old and thin with quite some noice every time we enter. Bedsheet is very harsh. The room is right next to the main street with cars running all the time. Bathroom is a bit dusty.
Great location, garage parking is helpful. I would stay again.
Lovely comfortable and classy Edinburgh apartment, close to all amenities!! Would always be our first choice!
Mary is a great host as she is always happy to help and made us feel at home. 100% would recommend if you look for a nice and warm stay close to Edinburgh city center.

Absolutely spotless and clean, perfect location within minutes walking distance of Edinburgh Center but also in a quiet place, warm, modern, good parking and very responsive host. Perfect.
Very convenient for Ubers too!

We booked very last minute, just over 24 hours before we were due to arrive in Edinburgh - Christie was super helpful and accommodating. The flat is exactly as described, beautifully decorated and an excellent location right next to Arthur’s Seat and a short bus ride into the centre. Thanks for having us, and especially on such short notice! :)

An amazing piece of heaven. Cannot recommend this highly enough.  Stunningly beautiful and perfectly located to the Royal Mile, local shops and bespoke restaurants, incredible charming shops and lovely cafes.  10/10!!
was an awesome stay. being close to the castle and shops was awesome. would recommend.
We had a wonderful stay and the apartment was exactly as described. Clean and spacious with everything you need for your stay. Excellent and friendly communication. Thank you!
Wow great location, clean place, friendly host. hope to return!

perfect location. 5 minutes walk to royal mile and Edinburgh castle, easy to prince street and other attractions. A lot of cafe and restaurant nearby.  Logan is so considerate to let us store our luggage earlier. Great appreciations.

I had a really wonderful stay with Carole! She is the sweetest lady. The bed was incredibly comfortable and the room was spacious. Bathroom was also spacious! Her home is beautiful and historic. It is such an easy walk to Princes Street, Rose Street, Dean Village, and most major attractions. Very easy to get to the Airporter bus station! Carole provides a very nice breakfast each day... the fresh fruit was my favorite part. She can provide recommendations on places to eat dinner that are easy to get to but not touristy. I would love to stay with Carols again if I come back to Edinburgh.

Fabulous apartment located in a quiet area. Very close to Stockbridge by foot and near bus stops for all directions.
Fiona was an amazing host. Apartment was spotless with everything you could need for a short break.
Great location to explore Edinburgh, I had a great time here
El apartamento esta muy bien ubicado, cerca de todo y en una zona tranquila, y el trato del anfrition siempre fue inmediato ante cualquier problema o duda que tuvieramos. 100% recomendable

The apartment is very nicely decorated and well set out. It’s spacious and very well equipped. We stayed for 3 nights for a friend’s wedding and it suited us perfectly on our budget. The apartment is in a good location for easy access into the city. We walked into the centre most of the time, with it only taking about 20 mins. An Uber was only about 5 pounds to the city centre. The area seemed really quiet the weekend we were there, so no issues with noise. Would highly recommend this place as a base for seeing Edinburgh. Agnieszka was a fantastic host and asked us on our first night how things were going and if she could be of any help.  The biscuits and coffee machine added a lovely extra touch.

It was a lovely cosy room! Great location, only tough thing was the 3 flights of stairs but we knew that prior to the booking. We had everything we needed. The bed was very comfortable and the room inviting. Perfect for a 2 night stay!
We had a great time at Mario’s. The location is perfect - only a short walk to everywhere we wanted to go! Would definitely stay here again.
Thank you very much for your hospitality! The apartment is located near the bus stop, the owners were very nice, and flexible.
Everything was great! We had a really good time!

A good place to stay, access to multiple bus lines going frequently into downtown/old town; nothing much near the apartment itself in terms of shops or restaurants. Clean and functional. Four flight walk-up. Some of the furnishings (bed & mattress, kitchen table, bathroom floor) could use an upgrade. Views are spectacular.

Even though it was just for a night, Sandra and John went out of their way to make us feel welcomed and at home! They picked us up from the airport despite our flight being delayed two hours, were kind and welcoming even though we got there exhausted at midnight, and helped us figure out our rental car the next morning. They were lovely to chat with as well. Also, shout out to Pablo, their adorable tiny Pomeranian! Breakfast was delicious, and the bed was comfortable. We would recommend anyone going to Edinburgh choose this stay.

L'appartamento si trova in una strada tipica e piena di ristoranti, a pochi minuti a piedi dal castello in old town.  Accesso in self check in con istruzioni precise. L'appartamento e'  tipico e corredato di tutti i comfort.  Abbiamo trovato anche frutta fresca e tutto il necessasio per la colazione. Peccato esserci stati solo per una notte. Il costo e' un po' alto ma bisogna considerare che ad agosto Edimburgo e' affollata e piena di festival e si e' in una posizione strategica! Su indicazioni del proprietario abbiamo lasciato l'auto in un parcheggio a 15 min a piedi (ce ne sono di piu vicini ma piu' costosi). Sarebbe stato bello ci fosse qualche convenzione. Comunque consigliatissimo!
I was very happy with my stay. Shirene is friendly and accommodating. I will happily stay again.

Très joli logement (rez de chaussée d'une petite maison dans une rue "pittoresque"), les photos étaient conformes et les équipements mentionnés sur l'annonce bien présents. Grande douche à l'italienne, literie confortable, propre.
Nous y avons passé un sejour calme et agréable. Le quartier est aussi très sympa (parcs. cafés, restaurants, etc). A proximité du jardin botanique / dean village tout en restant a une distance raisonnable du centre.
立地が素晴らしく歩いて観光地を回れました。部屋も整理させれており、キッチンも使いやすかった。とてもオススメです。
Friendly host, supplier of cups of tea :) Quiet comfy place, close to bus stop into the city.

Grace’s place was excellent. Great location,
very cozy and well considered. Can’t recommend it enough, especially for any solo women travelers.

Great space to call home for a few days away. Everything you need for a pleasant stay. Perfect location close by to bus stops with regular buses into Edinburgh. Thoughtful extras left by the host on arrival.
Lovely stay in a perfect location. Charming old flat - would definitely stay again!
Research the area before you arrive, there are some really great places and things to experience in the area. The view from both front and back windows is wonderful.

Wonderful apartment, conveniently located in New Town. Simon is a warm and friendly host who answered any questions promptly and dropped by the apartment several times at our request and on short notice to help us out.

A great place run by lovely people.

A wonderful apartment in a central location, very peaceful and quiet but easy to access transport or walk to town, parks, restaurants etc. Beautifully furnished with attention to detail and everything you could need. A really restful atmosphere.

Excellent hôte. Logement cosy et impeccable. Lit hyper confortable et tram à côté ( 9mns). Quartier paisible et calme. Je recommande grandement. Cuisine et salle de bain partagé mais dans le respect tout se passe super.

It’s a great location, short walk to The Castle, Grassmarket etc. there’s a few car parks nearby and you can pull up and unload and check in with no problems. Spacious apartment, very well equipped - recommended
Warm welcome in a great location in Edinburgh!
Courteny was very fast answering, thoughtful and solved all are issues very fast. Very understanding, and Danielle was great sorting or arrival.
很好的房子，很干净，也很安静，期待下次再来！

I stayed at Asma's place for 3 nights and I kindly recommend it especially if you are a girl on a solo trip. the apartment is comfy and beautiful. the room is plenty of space and light. Asma is a really available host, flexible and ready to help.
10 out of 10

Mingjun's place was a perfect choice.
He was very responsive and helpful. He let us leave our luggage 2 hours before check-in time and leave it 5 hours after checkout time. He also offered us a cot for our baby.
The room is exactly like pictures and description, very tidy and clean. Common area downstairs with fully equipped kitchen and dining room.
The place is 10-15 minutes walk to Princes Street. Tram and bus stations are 1 minute walk away.
I'd recommend this place especially for couples and small families.

As 7 people visiting a city we knew nothing about this apartment was perfect! The location is ideal in the city, really central and super links to yeh airport. The apartment itself was really modern and extremely clean and looked after when we arrived. It had everything we needed and made our whole trip so much better. I would definitely recommend staying in this apartment for a group of people visiting Edinburgh. The host was extremely accommodating and helpful also.

Not bad, I was expecting to see two beds in the room, but on getting there it was just one bed in the room, and we are family of 5.. I had to stay in the livingroom with my other child.. Anyways its fine
Lovely apartment in a great area. Daniela is a fantastic host, and would definitely stay here if visiting  Edinburgh again.
Great and Friendly host. Easy check in instructions. Accessible to main town with bus . The host also gives you recommendations and how to get by around Edinburgh
Fantastic location right on the Mile and filled with character!
Nice and clean apartment. Good location.
Overall, we were very happy with our stay. The host was very friendly and helpful.

The location was incredible. The flat was clean and tidy. The only problem was the sofa bed which Daniel came to fix because the part that slides out which latch onto the rest of it so 2 people couldn’t sleep on it. I asked Daniel about the coffee machine because the pods seemed to be too big to fit in it, but had no reply from
him.
Upsides-
- perfect location
- clean / modern apartment
Downsides
-inconsistent communication with the host
- sofa bed is very uncomfortable
(I would recommend this place for 2 people because the bed is really comfortable)

It was a pleasure to stay here. The flat is just as described - eclectic, cozy and in a GREAT neighborhood. We felt so comfortable there, and looked forward to relaxing with the lovely park view and great music setup every night. The Stockbridge neighborhood was PERFECT for us, we loved being able to walk to excellent restaurants, pick up cheese and wine whenever we wanted and the sunday morning market was such a special treat! We also loved how convenient the location was if we wanted to enjoy or avoid more touristy areas. Overall, we have a great time and would definitely stay here again.

Estadia ótima! Fomos em 6 e foi perfeito, todos super bem acomodados. Ângela sempre muito atenciosa, facilitou o check in e check out e nos deu várias dicas do que fazer!
Único ponto é que tem muitos bichinhos e a internet não estava tão boa, mas de resto foi perfeito e com certeza voltaríamos mais vezes!
Obrigada por toda atenção!
Une chambre très propre avec tout ce qu’il faut pour le petit déjeuner et même produits de toilette. Une hôtesse accueillante et de bon conseil et dans un quartier très agréable.

David was fantastic. He met us at the apartment and showed us all of the amenities
The bathtub was an extra bonus as was the clothes washing machine (we did a much needed load of laundry)
David had snacks, coffee, tea, cookies, jam, milk, bread for toast and fresh oranges. Such a nice touch
The entrance is a bit unusual but once you get in the apartment it was superb
The living room was so comfortable
Wished we would have booked for longer
Highly recommend!
This is a really lovely, airy flat in a great part of Edinburgh, within an easy walk of the city centre. It is bright, clean and well-equipped, and was perfect for our 3 day stay. Thanks Joe.

Absolutely loved this place! It was easy to find and in the perfect location. The street was quiet and private but within a quick walk to restaurants, as well as an easy walk (even for my elderly parents and young children) to the city center. Quick walk to the bus stop too for catching the bus to and from the airport. The flat itself was clean and cozy with beautifully updated kitchens and bathrooms. It was the perfect size for 2 couples and 2 children (cute bunk bed room!). Highly recommend!

We had a great time at this apartment. It was very clean and had a good set of basic cooking supplies. It was nicely located a short walk away from one of the Hop On-Hop Off tour bus stops, and a short uphill climb to Edinburgh Castle and High Street. We were able to house one child on the living room sofa and the other in the bedroom, which made for a more comfortable trip for the two of them. The only negative was needing to hike up the stairs at the end of a long day of sightseeing. (It's on the top floor and three flights up, so not suitable for someone who may have difficulty with stairs.)
Jeffrey was very communicative and the apartment was ready when we arrived so we could go straight out for sightseeing. (He was able to have it cleaned a little earlier so we could check in right after our flight arrived. Not necessary but very accommodating.) I couldn't have asked for a better host for our first Airbnb rental.

Very nice place with all the essentials. It is very near to the grassmarket, the royal mile and the castle of Edinburgh.
I definitely recommend it.

Le logement de Steve est très bien situé et est parfait pour explorer Edimbourg. Nous y avons passé un très bon séjour.
Merci !

This is a lovely apartment in the heart of the old town. Surrounded by shops and cafes the location is perfect! Apartment was super clean and well provisioned. Within walking distance to all attractions. Host was communicative and helpful.
The tub might be hard to get in and out of if you have mobility issues.
Place was alright and clean, mattresses and furniture are dated and could definitely use an upgrade. Emily was very friendly and responsive

We were traveling with 2 seniors so the close location to the bus station after our organized tour along with the elevator made it very easy for them to get settled.
The space is huge and quiet at night. I’m sensitive to noise but I didn’t have any issues sleeping through the night.
The apartment also has a lot of restaurants within waking distance.

Beautiful appt, decoration stunning & well equipped!
Well positioned & very clean - highly recommend
All Stockbridge amenities on the doorstep

Richard’s place is the best place at Edinburgh for sure!  Richard is so nice and great at recommending places, you feel at home and he is so respectfull with your privacy and if you’re up for a good conversation he’s great at that too! 10/10.
Thank you so much - we totally enjoyed our stay!

Perched atop the steps of poets corner, with its prose embossed slabs, and just a hiccup or two away from the Jolly Judge terrace (currently only open for take outs to an appreciative mob), a fairy tale door leads you to a stairwell that winds you up to find your treasure. A pied a terre that literally seats you loftily in the heart of the old town, within spitting distance of the castle, cathedral and so much history. Lucky you Rapunzel!
Fastidiously clean, superbly designed with a quality of finish that shows it has been done with love. A judicious sprinkling of carefully chosen contemporary copper accessories and fabrics thread throughout and complement the modern greys, lending warmth. I found that whisky blended in seamlessly and also added warmth, perhaps this is the local influence in the design. The cordless blinds were a revelation and I especially liked the copper coat hangers. I was sorely tempted but didn’t!
Well equipped with a great layout and window seats that captivate you with the ever changing views. Many hours and complimentary coffees can be consumed sitting in the lounge one in the unlikely event that a pandemic should strike and limit your entertainment options. People watching is compulsory and the black ghost bus, parked opposite, is a must see on a dark evening with its eerie, dimly lit Hogwortian interior. Any resemblance to the Harry Potter version must surely be pure coincidence as this one is just a standard, black, double decker Routemaster. The opposite view extends to the Firth of Forth and the hills beyond, looking down the Royal Mile and over Holyrood Palace. This is best observed from the bedroom window seat, similarly comfortable but better suited to the left handed drinker.
The bathroom is of course also well designed, with a beautifully tiled floor and a matching tiled recess housing the freebie surfactants. The open ended shower with a large slate grey tray is actually much bigger than most rentals offer and has an adequately powerful, funky looking electric mixer unit, which recently appeared in an episode of Dr Who. A handy cupboard under the sink provides perfect storage for essential preening equipment. They even provide a 2 pin converter for charging such items.
A couple of minor points. A washing up bowl (copper trimmed possibly) wouldn’t go amiss and a lamp in the lounge would definitely enhance the mood when Harry’s (sorry, the Ghost) bus is brooding ominously below.
“Better by design” is definitely the strap line for this place and the location never disappoints. I thoroughly enjoyed my 5 days here, recommend it and will certainly return soon. Well done and many thanks to Anne and Lewis.

This place is great bang for your buck. Not only is it just enough space for three people, but it’s in the middle of the Royal Mile! The bed is super comfy and there are plenty of storage areas. There were absolutely no issues during our stay and Inger was flexible with our needs. Despite being on the Royal Mile, the noise from the street was not bothersome. Self check in was a breeze! I would happily stay here again any time!

Amanda’s apparent is a hidden gem. The incredible views, coupled with a fantastic array of great bars, restaurants, cafes, and all the best sights of old town Edinburgh within arms reach. I couldn’t recommend this enough, particularly for anyone on a walking holiday of the city.
The only negative in this otherwise perfect review is the lack of parking. There is plenty of on street parking but this is only limited to a maximum of 4 hours, and each hour is changed at city centre prices. There’s a number of private car parks fairly close by, but again this comes at a fairly hefty additional charge (approximately £30 per day). So again, I cannot fault the property or Amanda, both are incredible. Just watch out for that parking.

L’un des lits doubles est aussi plus petit donc à prendre en compte. L’hôte est très réactif pour les questions. Pratique pour deux couples avec les deux salles de bain. La localisation proche de Leith permet d’aller manger près du port moins fréquenté que le centre d’Edimbourg.

We’re so glad we chose Calim’s flat! It was brilliantly located, beautifully put together and was a lovely, cosy space to come back to after walking around Edinburgh each day. The bed was super comfy, the kitchen was very well kitted out and we enjoyed the nice view from the lounge. Couldn’t recommend more highly.

This place was perfect for our night in Edinburgh before leaving Scotland. The deck was so nice and everything was exactly as described. It was was walkable and in such charming neighborhood. I would recommend staying here and would come back!

If in Edinburgh, Islam’s property is the one to rent!
Tucked into the Bruntsfield neighborhood and convenient to many local cafes/shops/coffee houses, staying here gives travelers the experience of living in Edinburgh.
And when you’re ready to see all the top tourist spots, a two-minute walk takes you to the Holy Cross bus stop from which frequent bus service delivers you downtown in 10.
Islam’s property is immaculate, with a clean, modern, fit and finish. And Islam himself is a most generous and responsive host.
The Stables is a 10 out of 10 AirBnb experience!
Lovely little apartment. Close to haymarket station (5 min walk) giving good access to central Edinburgh. Loads of restaurants and coffee shops near by.

This air bnb was exactly what I needed and wanted. Immaculate, artsy, cozy with all the essentials that you can ask for, and then some. The bedroom was spotless, linens, decor, and the bed was the most comfortable bed I've ever slept in. Location was also great. You can walk and/or grab public transportation to the city sites and explore super easy. Absolutely loved and will be back, hopefully in warmer months. I celebrated my birthday and am so glad I chose Edinburgh and James' place. Till next time.
We had a great time!

Impeccable!! Literally perfection. Quite a gem. Great place to explore The Royal Mile—super close to The Palace of Holyrood House. Beautiful! And close to great public transport to the airport ! Cannot wait to return.  Super recommend!!

This was a really convenient and comfortable place to stay for a week. The hosts are very courteous and responsive and were very flexible with checkin time. Mairi met me at the property and she was just lovely. The steps are quite steep and uneven - guests who can’t carry their suitcases upstairs to second floor (third floor in US system) will have trouble. Everything was very clean in the flat, and the location is great. Would definitely stay there again! I
Lovely home, lovely host, lovely city

We had a lovely stay at the property to explore Portobello, Edinburgh and the Highlands. Property was spacious, clean and well-stocked for staying as a couple and it was in a nice, quiet location. Amenities in the property were good, although we did have a few issues with the lock being stiff. Overall, a great little place for a couple, especially if being outside of the city centre is something you're looking for.
Great stay in a fascinating building!

Fantastic apartment in the centre of Edinburgh.  Communication from Sonia and Chris was great throughout and their guide on Edinburgh was really useful.  The apartment is in walking distance of everything and is surrounded by great bars and restaurants. Would highly recommend a stay here!

This charming accommodation was a peaceful retreat from the busy crowds of Edinburgh’s Old and New Towns. Tucked away from the tourist hustle, it truly felt like a sanctuary. The apartment beautifully combines original character with modern comforts, creating a cozy and inviting space. It’s ideally located within walking distance to plenty of great cafés, restaurants, and markets. Andrew was a fantastic host—highly responsive and clear in all his communication. A wonderful stay overall.
Sehr schöne Wohnung und sehr gepflegt alles. Chris ist auch sehr nett und hilfsbereit, es war sehr angenehm und wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder dort hin.

Ha sido una estancia excelente. El apartamento está localizado muy cerca del centro, hemos ido andando a todos los puntos de interés, y a sólo 10 minutos de Calton Hill, con unas vistas asombrosas.
Teníamos todo lo necesario, incluido el desayuno que nos ha dejado preparado Julie-Ann. Hemos estado muy agusto, y ella se ha mostrado muy amable y dispuesta a ayudarnos en lo que necesitáramos.
Volveríamos a repetir, sin duda.
La casa está situada a 15 min del centro en un área muy tranquila, el descanso es excelente. Gillian es estupenda, te ayuda en todo lo que puede, es una host 10!! El desayuno es muy completo.
Quiet, clean and conveniently located and all for a reasonable price. Quick and helpful responses from Steve before arrival too. Definitely recommended.

Lovely compact apartment, very close to all the bars, cafes, restaurants in Stockbridge. A little hiccup on arrival with the keys not being in the agreed placed but we soon found them. Great place for a short stay in Edinburgh.
Fabulous location and apartment is well equipped.
Really enjoyed our stay. Great location. Love the big windows and decorative touches. Everything you’d need.
We loved this cozy flat! Great central location, comfortable, clean, exactly what I expected from the descriptions.
La casa di Valentina è veramente carina e accogliente. Host super gentile e attento nelle risposte.
Great location, great amenities, great size! Couldn’t be more pleased with our stay.

Wow we loved the Castle Nest!   So cozy and perfect location steps from the Castle and all the bars and restaurants.   Literally woke up day one to a bagpiper playing across the street (he starts every morning at 11 for the tour groups).   Amazing.

We only had a short stay at Monica's place so we didn't get to make the most of this beautiful spot but we had a nice comfortable stay. It's very conveniently located close to the airport. The unit is small but had most things we needed for a short stay. Monica provided clear instructions (it would be tricky to find otherwise) and was very responsive. We would happily recommend.
Everything was so clean and nice. Sofa bed was not so good to sleep in but easy to fix that.

My friends and I attended the Taylor Swift concert at Murrayfield and were extremely lucky to find this apartment.
Firstly, the apartment itself was incredible. Eclectic and decorated with so much thought and detail. Ground floor entry meant we didn't have to lug our bags up any stairs. The beds were very comfy. The kitchen is well-equipped and clean. The bathroom while small, is so cozy and I loved the shower.
Secondly, the location is incredible. We were easily able to walk back after the concert as the apartment is a 20 minute walk from Murrayfield. Everything we wanted to do was a walkable distance but even the public transport is super easy to find.
Lastly, Craig was very kind and responsive and allowed us to check in ahead of time since there was nobody checking out that day.
Thank you to the wonderful team that made a the trip so lovely. We felt right at home and would love to visit again!!

Sharon and John ' s house is reeeeally nice and comfortable! It 's pretty clean ! Sharon and  her husband is so nice to talk with! They  made us feel like saty in our own house! Highly recommended !(^ ^)
Great apartment in a good location. Nice being near to the Meadows which was a pleasant walk into town. Lots of cafes, bars and restaurants near by. Really enjoyed our visit to Edinburgh.
Carol was very friendly, and we felt welcome. Bed little small for 2 adults.

Lovely home in a quiet green area, extremely clean and very accessible to the tram with only a 10 mins walk. Close to airport and close to the center as well. What I loved the most about this flat is that it was truly one of the cleanest airbnb I’ve ever stayed at!
Easy check in, cozy spot, great location. No complaints!
Nice apartment just beside the Canal. Plenty of light in a dark Scotland due to nice roof lights. The house was ready for us at our arrival at 11:00 am. We highly recommend it

We had a wonderful stay in this flat. The kitchen is well equipped, the beds are very comfortable, the sitting area is relaxing. The location is fantastic, easy walk into the city, Deans Village, the canal for a stroll, etc …. bus routes are just down the road. You are not on a main road so it’s a quiet location.
Claire was such a joy to deal with, quick responses if you had questions.
I would not hesitate to return.
The B&B is near a bus stop so you can easily go to the city center. The room is perfect for a stay and the host is very nice.

Perfect accommodation for our working trip in Edinburgh.
The area is quiet and easy to find. There is a bus stop nearby and very easy to get the bus into the city centre.
The accommodation is well laid out, clean and has all the amenities you need.
Barry and Denise are perfect hosts; helpful, quick to respond to any questions and I will definitely stay again for either work or business.

The place is super central and was quiet. That was great and allowed us to enjoy our stay in Edinburgh.
Leo was super responsive which is always comforting for the guests
A nice place to stay
Great location, easy access

Amazing stay with family and very well located.
Well guided by host
Overall we 3 families were enjoyed lot.

Sally welcomes you with a smile and a charming personality. So it doesn't come as a surprise that her apartment is just as charming. Beware - you will not want to leave your room with all the fireplace, warmth and coziness going on there. And yes, I will agree with most of you, the bed is magically comfortable!
Whenever we did want to leave the apartment and explore Edinburgh, Sally was extremely helpful and answered all of our questions (and we have loads of them).
The location is everything you want - 15 minute walk to the very heart of Edinburgh and only 5 min to the incredible Arthur's seat. It is quite literally at your front door!
I would recommend Sally's quirky old apartment to everyone who wants to relax and have an unforgettable stay in Edinburgh!
Thanks Andy and Georgio! Nice stay!

The apartment was great. Looked exactly as pictured and even more convenient than we could have imagined. My partner and I love going out for food and checking out the local pubs. The location was perfect walking distance from everything. We also got a bit of a treat as there were concerts happening at the castle and we got to hear the Lumineers and Rod Stewart as we sat on the balcony taking in the beautiful scenery! Thanks for having us Xavi, we would certainly come again!

Nos sentimos muy cómodos con Nico, la habitación estaba al lado del toilette y la cocina lo que implicaba que usar lo que necesitabas sin molestar. Todo impecable y la habitación pequeña pero cómoda, con un ventanal precioso que da a un árbol con pajaritos. La ubicación está muy bien, no es en pleno centro de Edinburgo pero está excelentemente conectada con colectivos y el tranvía, llegando rápido a todos lados, incluso al aeropuerto. We were 4 adults. The apartment was perfect for our stay. Ruggero is a very friendly host and quick when we have got questions.
The location was also perfect.
If I visit Edinburgh again one day, I would love to come back.
Thank you

Very convenient location.  Can walk to many of the attractions of old town. Really appreciated that. Hiccup during check-in process. Code for lock box in online instructions was wrong. Had to call to get correct code. Host was surprised when I informed him of the issue. Check in and check out times not consistent on website and emailed instructions.  In one part, it states 3pm check in, 11am check out. Then we were told it’s 4pm check in, 10 am check out. No flexibility with check out times, even when 30 minute later check out time was requested. Kitchen lacked cooking basics such as sugar, salt, oil which was disappointing. Mattress in one of the bedrooms was in bad shape. Springs dig into back. My son had to sleep on blankets over the mattress so it was decently comfortable. Given the prior stellar reviews, must admit I was a little disappointed with the stay.

I had a wonderful stay at this cosy and comfortable place! The location is perfect — just a short walk to the city centre, yet in a quiet and safe area. The space itself was clean, warm, and felt like a home away from home. John is an incredibly friendly and welcoming host who made everything easy from check-in to check-out. Would definitely recommend staying here and hope to come back again!
Unbeatable location & felt very spacious!

It’s very rare I review anything, but I just have to on this occasion.
What an unbelievable stay in Edinburgh I’ve had and it was all down to the beautiful accommodation- Louise is a fantastic host and thinks about every detail, even going to the effort to put a birthday card for my wife in the room.
I honestly cannot wait to rebook to come back to Edinburgh because I won’t be looking at anywhere but here.
The room was huge, the bed so comfortable and the towel soft just what you’d want.
Thank you so much for helping me make my wife’s birthday special.

Dean is a great host, super nice and friendly. Easy to find and check in. Great quiet area and walkable to the old city.

Bellissima location in mezzo alla natura , casa confortevole anche per due famiglie.
Great location for the city, local amenities also very good. Nice room - very big.  Warm welcome and and relaxed.

Great location close to Easter Road, Leith walk and also city centre. Good communication and easy access to the premises. The property was exactly as described - clean and everything that was required was required was provided.

The apartment is perfectly situated in the centre of old town. Charlotte is a perfect host, helpful and easy to communicate with!
Great Garden Room .  Cozy Room to read and Relax .

This is a superb studio apartment  in prime location in grass market,Edinburgh. We were extremely happy with our visit as soon as we walked in,the place was very clean and tidy with everything you need. Even a bagpipe lamp! Very modern and stylish interior with a great view of the castle from one of the windows. Perfect place to stay for a short visit,I will definitely be coming back again!

EXCEPTIONAL location for visiting Edinburgh! There was no need for public transit at all, every popular attraction was within walking distance. Séjour très agréable dans un logement très pratique bien équipé.

Min samboer og jeg ble møtt med et smil og stor grad av imøtekommelse ved innsjekk en time før innsjekken vanligvis startet. Rommet var da ferdigstilt og vi slapp å sette fra oss bagasjen på oppbevaring.

Great place to stay and enjoy Edinburgh. Buses into Central city are fast and frequent and the room itself was lovely and clean and quiet. Would recommend.

Glenda was a brilliant host, she was helpful and responsive. The Airbnb had everything we needed and the recommendations for things to do were great. It was a perfect location and just what we needed for a few days away exploring a new city.

A beautiful, spacious apartment in a lovely part of Edinburgh, close to the centre. The apartment is well furnished and everything is provided. A real gem!!

Excelente opción para visitar Edimburgo y los alrededores. Gracias a Elaine por su atención.

The apartment was very cosy and well located with all conveniences available at walking distance. Rooms were very comfortable and our kids enjoyed the apartment a lot. We do hope to stay here again in our next trip!!
The house was clean and comfortable with great location.  We had a relax stay and feel right at home.
Great location for the royal mile, Edinburgh castle, and Arthur's seat! The host was responsive and helpful when needed, would recommend to anyone looking to visit Edinburgh.

Nous avons été accueillis très chaleureusement par Drew qui nous aidé de façon très réactive et qui a été au petits soins pendant notre séjour. Nous avons même pu célébrer notre mariage avec un apéritif offert. La chambre est très bien décorée, avec beaucoup de goût.

stayed here for two nights, for the running festival perfect location, lovely place to relax and get ready before hand and located a short walk from the bars and restaurants in town

Logement propre et chambre spacieuse avec beaucoup de rangement. A 25 minutes du centre-ville, c'est un très bon rapport qualité-prix. De plus Roberto est très arrangeant et resté disponible et à l'écoute tout le long du séjour.

Wow! Just Wow! It was a really nice stay. 20 minutes walk to the to the town, there’s a bus stop minutes away from the apartment goes to Edinburgh town. A lot of cafes and restaurants nearby. Small place overall but very clean and functional.

We so appreciated Susie and Bill’s lovely home to stay in, their friendly conversation and outstanding information and travel tips about Edinburgh. Their input made our Edinburgh visit incredible.  Highly recommend!
