Lloyd est très réactif, arrangeant et agréable 🤗

Valentino’s place was great! Excellent location. Holyrood park is pretty much your back yard when staying there. Walking distance to plenty of great restaurants and attractions. And Valentino was a very accommodating host.

Le logement est idéalement situé, accessible par plusieurs réseaux de bus. Les hôtes sont très réactif par messagerie et n’hésite pas à répondre à toutes les questions. Le logement est calme et le lit très confortable, ce qui est un grand plus quand on marche toute la journée !
Je recommande vivement ce logement et reviendrais assurément.

A gorgeous, bright, light apartment with a spacious living room and kitchen area. The bedrooms are a good size and nicely decorated. Our host was very thoughtful, welcoming us and making sure we had what we needed. The location is great--very close to the castle, the main shopping streets, as well as river-side walks. Super place and host.

We stayed 4 nights at Sonia and Chris’s. Their accommodation is superbly situated, an easy walk into Old Town, near great pubs, shops, a supermarket at the end of the laneway. The heating was great, just an overall nice vibe to the apartment. Would highly recommend.

“Charm” doesn’t come close how lovely Lauren’s flat is. We spent four nights enjoying our morning coffee in the kitchen window seat, the walkable neighborhood during the day and the very comfortable bed overnight. Lauren could not have been a greater host helping make sure our stay was comfortable from beginning to end. I’m truly grateful to have found this gem.
We stayed for one week at Pier's place and it was amazing. The flat is so beautiful and offers everything you need. I can highly recommend this lovely place!
Very nice flat. Perfect location, close to everything. Loved it. Will stay again on our next visit.

Cozy and clean appartment from which you can easily get into the city center.
Jen is a very friendly host with great communication throughout our stay.

Thank you so much for our stay in your lovely cosy and homely flat. The flat is in a very pretty, peaceful area but still in great walking distance to both the old town and new town. Stephen gave us some great recommendations on food and drink, all round fabulous stay thank you!
Good location, big apartment for 5/6 people

Monica was helpful and responsive. apartment is good if a little tired in places. Access to door needed a phone call as the secure key box wasn't working, recommend phoning / messaging in advance of arrival. No restaurants / shops in the immediate area and need a car or taxi to reach the city centre.

Very nice little flat perfectly placed in the middle of old Edinburgh, very tidy and perfect for 3 people. Both Alison and Craig welcomed us upon arrival. Communication was perfect before arrival in answering all our questions.
We will gladly recomend this town and appartment to everybody, and it is not the last time we visit this beautiful country.
Regards, Daniel, Helena and Irene

A great stay. The apartment is very beautiful and it is an attractive district. Shopping possibilities are very close and there are many buses in the city and to the beach. The area is rather quiet, but you are not far away from Calton Hill and Princess Street. Nina is very attentive and helpful. I can only recommend it.

Thank you Fiona for a lovely stay. It was faultless!
Everything we could want for was at hand. The space was beautiful, clean and well laid out. Stockbridge is the perfect location for a long weekend in Edinburgh and a visit to Scan and Scallie is a must. Would highly recommend.

This is a beautiful flat in a very nice upscale area.  Wonderful restaurants in the surrounding area and very peaceful and restful location.  We enjoyed our stay very much and would book again if we return to Edinburgh.

Paul’s place was great for our family (we are traveling with our two adult children). The apartment was clean and spacious, the kitchen well equipped (we did cook a few times). Paul had left fruits and vegetables which we really enjoyed. Because our train was very delayed and we did not arrive until 3am, Paul was very helpful in making sure we got in immediately and communicated with us until he knew we had arrived. The shower being separate from the toilet was a big help when getting ready. And the location was so convenient—we walked everywhere! Couldn’t have asked for a better first time experience using AirBnB! Would definitely stay here again!

The house was located in a peaceful residential area, very safe and easy to access the city center. Quite close to haymarket station as well, convenient for train travels. The rooms were kept very clean and tidy, and my room was spacious as well. The kitchen was easy to use, as well as  the washing machine. Though keep in mind it takes quite a long time to finish the wash. The shower was good overall, but sometimes it didn’t drain well. Host Martin was very quick in response, clear and informative. All in all, I’ll recommend this place to anyone.
Fab stay, Annette was fantastic and lots of lovely restaurants near by!
Great value and location. Andrew is a very good and responsive host. We’ll be back!
The property is exactly as described and was very clean. It is the perfect location to explore Edinburgh! I would highly recommend staying here.
lovely wee flat, very handy for town and travel options
Nice place to stay. Well equipped and great location. Would recommend!

Great apartment with an excellent and scenic location near Holyrood. Host is very easy to communicate with and very responsive. We stayed for a month, and were very happy to have such a comfortable "home" in Edinburgh.
Good memory

El apartamento es antiguo, con moqueta, sin ascensor y situado en el último piso, lo que lo hace poco práctico y nada accesible. El edificio en sí resulta feo y anticuado. La cocina está mal equipada, ya que no tiene microondas, y el mobiliario es viejo: dos sofás desgastados y una simple mesa de centro. Las habitaciones son básicas, con camas regulares, y los baños también antiguos, con pocas comodidades. La ducha funciona mal y las cortinas no bloquean la luz, lo que en verano, cuando amanece a las 4:30, dificulta mucho el descanso.
El barrio está a 50 minutos andando del centro. Los alrededores dan una sensación de inseguridad, con calles deterioradas, aspecto marginal y poca oferta gastronómica, concentrada en la zona del puerto, que actualmente está en obras. Pasear por allí no es agradable ni cómodo.
La anfitriona accedió a que dejáramos las maletas más tarde, pero finalmente apareció una persona para echarnos de malas formas, empañando aún más la experiencia.
No vale la pena
Great stay, very well located. We had a problem with the heater but it was easily solved. Everything was perfect.

I had such a wonderful stay!
The location is prime — right next to the beautiful Botanical Garden.
The flat is pristine and very well looked after. Carol clearly takes great care of the place.
There are lots of lovely details throughout, and the walls seem to hold history and soul.
It’s spacious, with high ceilings, and has everything you need for a comfortable stay.
Carol is a very kind and responsible host, and I felt truly at ease during my visit.
I feel blessed to have chosen such a lovely place.
Thank you so much xxx
We had a really lovely stay here and the apartment was nice. It’s a great location to walk around Edinburgh in a beautiful, peaceful area.

The door bells are a bit confusing so if you need to get someone to let you in, use your mobile! Buses are close by to take you into the centre.  Parking is tricky and very expensive, so best to use public transport.
Great place, friendly host.

Ayub was a great and friendly host. He was very communicative from pre-check in to check out. The place was very clean and the room spacious and comfortable. Tram car to the airport and  convenience store for quick supplies are about a 10 minute walk in a quiet neighborhood. Highly recommend this host.
Wonderful place, would absolutely stay here again! Highly recommended
It's a very good option and excellent location.
It was a nice stay and looking forward to visiting again!
Lovely place to lay your head for the night. Sabrina was amazing, helping us with directions and getting to the Airbnb from the airport. Would happily stay again.

Xuelian is an exceptional host!  The apartment is perfect for touring all of Edinburgh, easy access to buses and trains.  The bedrooms have plenty of room and beds are comfortable. Kitchen has everything you need including spices, cooking spray, one size cereal boxes, jams, milk and fresh fruit. The washer/dryer is one unit and works well.  The living room had plenty of space for 4 people, blankets, dining table,  and large TV.  There is a small grocery store 2 blocks away.  Restaurants highly recommended - Minto Cafe and La Casa - both within walking distance.
The flat was clean, affordable, and in a great location. I recommend it.
Apparemment impeccable, en plein centre ville. Hôte très accueillant et toujours disponible.
I have no complaints with David’s hosting.

A fantastic flat and a terrific host. Roger went above and beyond in every way. The unit itself was ideal for our group of 8. Very handy location near the new town, train station, and close to bus lines that go right into the old town. Ubers always arrived quickly when needed. Tons of space for our group. Kitchen was outstanding with great appliances and stocked with everything we needed. Pristine clean. Easy to find and access the unit. Comfortable sitting areas. I cannot speak highly enough about this historic but modern and functional apartment. Thank you Roger.
Excellent stay, convenient location and Ryan was a great host

A truly stunning apartment and a wonderful host. We stayed at Robert's home for a big family trip to Edinburgh. In our party were two 80 year olds with reduced mobility. The apartment itself is beautiful, clean, comfortable, quiet, extremely spacious and was equipped with every amenity we could possibly have needed for our stay (including a very good iron). The lift was useful for my grandparents.
The property is perfectly situated - everything seemed roughly a 20 minute walk away (the Botanic Gardens/Dean Village/the other end of Princes Street...) There were plenty of transport links nearby for those unable to walk as far or as quickly and there was a Co-Op shop only a 2-minute walk away where we could get supplies. Once you start walking, it only takes a couple of minutes before you start to reach pubs and restaurants. The check-in/check-out process was easy and efficient.
Robert was an extremely good host - he was very welcoming and attentive. He made it clear that he was on hand should we have any queries, require suggestions or have any issues - no matter how big or small.
Edinburgh is a phenominal city and Robert's apartment was the most perfect base to explore from - being able to relax there after a day of being out and about really made our holiday. Will definitely look to stay here again next time we come back to Edinburgh.
Wonderful place to stay! Highly recommended to anyone going to Edinburgh

Peaceful
Lovely views
Private and comfortable
Gillian was very kind and accommodating. She was very helpful and the room was very nice.

Gorgeous location and the cottage was so cozy! Sarah was very responsive and so kind! We met and she gave us a sweet and short introduction to the place. Her printouts were super helpful and informative. I learned so much about the history of the dovecot cottage; very fascinating!

Lovely stay Thankyou. Shahid was very efficient at communicating. The apartment was clean, warm and comfortable , and ideally placed for getting around Edinburgh and linking up with our daughter at the university.
Great location easy walk to major attractions
Great stay. Everything you need and a quick response

Perfect apartment in a quiet street. Spotlessly clean, warm and welcoming. 5 mins walk to Easter Road for supermarket and coffee shops etc, 10 min walk to Princess Street. I would thoroughly recommend.

very convenient
several good Asian restaurants nearby
walk to explore Edinburgh
Had a wonderful time!

Fantastic and Cozy place with a small kitchen. The place is clean, well maintained and apt for a family of 4. The kitchen is well equipped for the stay
Daniella and Glenda are responsive and considerate
Would surely book when we visit Edinburgh again

La ubicación es perfecta , está cerca del centro si te gusta pasear, pero muy bien comunicada con transporte público .
El acceso es cómodo y fácil y Luke es un anfitrión de 10, mandándote instrucciones fáciles para que no te pierdas .
El apartamento está muy limpio y ordenado , tanto el baño como la habitación son amplios y luminoso .
Nuestra estancia en casa de Luke ha sido maravillosa , él ha estado pendiente de nosotros en todo momento , facilitándonos cualquier cosa que necesitáramos .
Sin ninguna duda lo recomendaría a amigos que vayan a Edimburgo y si repito en esta cuidad seguro que me alojo con Luke .

Un bel appartement, à la décoration soignée et surtout bien équipé et spacieux. Il est situé à 25-30 minutes de marche de la vieille ville, ce qui reste très raisonnable d'autant que des bus passent dans la rue fréquemment. Nombreux commerces à proximité, et aussi des bars ce qui le rend parfois bruyant durant la nuit, mais c'est logique.
Au quatrième étage sans ascenseur, on fait du sport mais on le savait.
Je recommande !
Perfect bolt hole for our family after a day of sightseeing. Great location, clean, comfortable and well equipped. Highly recommend.

Für uns hatte die Unterkunft eine gute Lage, da wir in der Nähe eine Laufveranstaltung hatten. Ein großer, schöner Park ist nah dran. Altstadt ca 15 Minuten fußläufig zu erreichen.
Die Wohnung entsprach den Fotos und war sauber. Check in und Kommunikation war sehr gut.
Die Straße an sich ist nicht so schön und der Hausflur hat seine besten Zeiten hinter sich. Aber die Wohnung ist gut.

Location is fantastic and we were able to walk to most of the places we wanted to go - Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle, Arthur's Seat etc. We arrived by train and it is also very close to the Waverley train station.
Check-in was smooth and we didn't have any issues at all thanks to the clear instructions provided. The host is also very responsive and communication was great. The apartment was clean and pleasant, bath towels, basic toiletries and room slippers are provided. There is also a washing machine and we were able to do our laundry on the first day. There are however quite a lot of stairs (~4 flights) to climb to get to the apartment so if you are traveling with old people it might be an issue.
Un lugar muy cómodo para pasar el rato en familia, accesible a varios lugares céntricos y muy estable.
Easy going, basic accommodation, good crash pad, for Edinburgh.
Wonderful rental in a great location with funds going to a terrific cause!
Lovely apartment, close to City and Leith, bus stop opposite, ideal base to explore Edinburgh attractions and Arthur’s Seat, good comms from owner, decent price too.
Lovely flat. Quiet location. Well equipped. Valerie was very helpful and accommodating. Basic supplies were a nice touch plus pastries and shortbread!!! Yum

The space was beautiful and spacious, and certainly luxurious with ultra-comfortable beds and thoughtful touches from the hosts. Nicola and her family were so kind and helpful, taking a good deal of time from their day to fix the tv so that we could catch up on Wimbledon in the evenings! It’s very central and walkable to most of Edinburgh’s main attractions. We would definitely return!

Apartment as shown on the photos, kitchen and bathroom well equipped, nice toiletries. Entire flat is clean. Even washing machine. A little bit far from city centre, we used ÜBER, check it. Parking is free around, and seems there is place. To get in the apartment, read the instructions before carefully. Silent environmen. Nearby spermarket and also not to far several restaurants in the harbor.
Would stay again.
Beau petit appartement malheureusement problème de chauffage très chaud dans les chambres du bas et froid au dessus et isolation légère.

Fantastic property right in the centre of Edinburgh, easy walking distance to all parts of the city.
Matched pictures and descriptions - was clean, tidy, had all basics needed.
Great instructions to find flat, all makes sense once you arrive.
All in all great value accommodation and perfect location.
Helpful host
Perfect location; everything is walking distance (the castle, Arthur's seat, the new town). I would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Edinburgh.

L’emplacement du logement est vraiment bien situé. Toutefois, à notre arrivé à 15h au Check-in l’appartement n’était pas nettoyé. Nous avons essayé d’appeler l’hôte mais il n’a pas répondu ni rappelé. Les femmes de ménage sont arrivés qu’après et nous ont nettoyé l’appartement vite fait. Il n’était pas propre.
Absolutely incredible location! Luke and Jolita are wonderful, attentive hosts, and the flat is beautiful and clean. Couldn’t have enjoyed this stay more!

This was our second stay at The Office. It's a perfect location for visiting family. it's also a great location right next to the Walk of Leith path, near a good pub and cafe and the bus stop into Edinburgh is close by! we'll definitely be back!
Great location, pay & display street parking. lovely park nearby to walk our dog.
Delightful place to stay. Gorgeous large rooms; good beds; fine views; great location.

We really enjoyed our stay at Vinay’s flat, he was very kind and his communication was as fantastic.
The flat is in a new development - there’s a bud stop just outside the front door, took us a mere 15 minutes on a busy day to get in.
Lovely furniture and lots of really helpful bits provided.
Will definitely stay again next time we’re in Edinburgh. So much more for your money compared to hotel prices just a few miles away.
Thanks Vinay!

We loved our stay in marks apartment - it was better than imagined - a beautiful place with super comfortable bed and everything we needed to make us feel really welcome. It’s a great location in leith. We had a great stay while dropping off our daughter for her first term at uni and settling her in.
The annexe was very spacious and private.  Everything was ideal for us, with lots of little extras to make our stay more enjoyable. Judith is an excellent hostess and a very nice person.
Such a nice place to stay in Edinburgh! East 15 minute walk into the main city! Lots of space and great amenities!

My daughter and I just had the most amazing time in Edinburgh staying in Bryan’s beautiful flat.  Bryan is a wonderful host who made us feel very welcome.  His flat is in a lovely, very quiet residential area that is approximately a 15 min walk to the centre of the city.  We knew this was going to be our favorite place to stay while we were in Scotland, and it was. The photos and descriptions are 100 % accurate.  It truly is as stylish as it looks. I would highly recommend staying here. I certainly hope to be back in the near future.

very good place, the bed it's really comfortable.
Ideal location for sightseeing Edinburg.
i recommande.

We had a great stay. The place is at a central location right next to the royal mile, and the street and the home itself were very beautiful. Caroline was also super responsive and helpful! We had arrived earlier than check-in time and it was raining pretty badly and she was very open to let us drop our bags early. It was also quite cold at night, and we were not able to change the temperature, but once we reached out to Caroline, she was able to change it remotely, and was very friendly overall. Had a great time!

Judith was a wonderful host and made us feel very welcome from the moment we booked it! The home itself it’s absolutely beautiful and spotlessly clean and the bed was super comfortable and everything else that was in the room was an a lovely addition especially the Easter bunnies she left us as we were staying over the Easter weekend. As we were visiting for a wedding it was a beautiful room to get ready in and of course Duke made it extra special!
We had a great stay! Very cute place with helpful hosts! Thank you!

Great location and beautiful views of the castle and beyond ! Despite being right on Princess Street it was not noisy. The lift was great when you are traveling with large bags and the instructions on where to find the lock box were clear.  I would very much recommend the place to anyone considering it and hope I can book again when I return next year.
If I come back to Edinburgh I will chose the place again - really great location, really friendly people:)

God vært, der svarer hurtigt og venligt personale i receptionen. Der blev dog røget hash i og omkring boligen. Der lugtede af en fæl overdøvede parfume i opgangen. Værelset var meget småt, uden mulighed for gennemtræk eller ordentlig udluftning. Obs ingen aircondition. Det var mere end dobbelt så varmt indenfor end udenfor. Så man kunne ikke falde i søvn pga varmen. Madrassen var enormt dårlig og meget smal til to personer. Der var ikke udsugning på badeværelset så alt var fugtigt hele tiden.
Det ligger perfekt i gåafstand og lige ved siden af Tram. Det er nogle smukke omgivelser i området så beliggenheden er perfekt. Men ville ikke kunne sove på det værelse igen når man er to, og slet ikke i sommerperioden. Men vil meget vel bruge Joyvi som vært igen pga rigtig god responstid. Men ville ikke vælge dette værelse hvis man er to der skal sove sammen, og slet ikke hvis der er mere end 15° udenfor.

Right in the middle of where you need to be for Edinburgh, huge flat with so much room. Little noisy in the mornings from the shops and restaurants but your in the heart of it all so it’s to be expected. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Minh and her husband were wonderful hosts who were respectful of privacy while available to address any needs. Although the room is small, it is has everything you need artfully arranged to make the most of the space. Best of all is the quality mattress, so comfortable! The location is a walkable and safe residential neighborhood near transportation and restaurants. I highly recommend Minh's place!

Nos vamos muy contentos de nuestra estadía en Edimburgo. El departamento de Keiko y Donald nos agrado, con un perfume en el ambiente, la cama muy cómoda y muy bien ubicado para hacer nuestras caminatas y recorrer la ciudad. Ante cualquier duda nos respondieron rapido y amablemente.Muchas gracias!!!!
great appartment located in a beautiful surroundings short distance to the city centre. host was excellant would highly recomend
Great spot
great apartment with amazing location
Just fantastic location and a great place to stay! I would definitely go back if I am ever in Edinburgh. Thank you Irene 😍

We had a great stay at Sarah’s apartment! The location is great and close to many cafés and restaurants. You can take the bus to the city centre (15 minutes) or just walk (25 minutes). The flat looks like in the pictures. However, sometimes it got a little bit cold, especially at night. Nevertheless the bathroom was warm all the time. We would recommend staying there!

Wonderful experience from booking to check out. Michelle was super responsive during the entire process and was even there to greet us upon arrival. The flat itself was absolutely lovely and the location was great. The surrounding neighborhood had ample restaurants, coffee shops, and bars (Michelle provided some great recommendations). The flat was also walkable to all the popular sights but still quiet and relaxing. Traveled through Europe for 12 days and this was our favorite spot :) highly recommend!

Wonderful hosts! They were very accommodating and allowed me to drop my luggage off, well before checkin, after an early flight. The apartment is a great value for money. Haymarket is a pleasant neighborhood and access to the city center is straight forward. Highly recommended!

Nicola è stata un'ottima padrona di casa; anche se purtroppo non l'abbiamo conosciuta di persona, ci ha fornito tanti suggerimenti utilissimi ed è sempre stata in contatto con noi. l'appartamento è delizioso, arredato con grande gusto anche nei dettagli
la zona è molto strategica perché ben servita dai trasporti pubblici (tram diretto che porta all'aeroporto) ma molto funzionale anche spostandosi a piedi

Great stay, lovely apartment with everything you could need. Jack was friendly, and informative, checked in on us to make sure we were ok. Flat is in a lovely location right by the park and close to shops and amenities. Wonderful stay, will be booking again!
It was clean and cozy! Great place!

The photo for Sam's Airbnb doesn't do it justice! We were all wow'ed by her beautiful apartment. Big spacious bed rooms and a very open & bright living area. Both bathrooms very modern and spotless. The whole family was not expecting this beautiful home, It made our holiday! Sam was also very helpful and we knew she was only a message away! If we ever come back we will be staying again for sure. Thanks Sam :)

Bilal ans Sharron were extremely responsive with any questions I had. Their responses were helpful and kind in tone.
The apartment was just perfect, offering us everything we needed for our stay in Edinburgh. It was immaculately clean and the decor was fitting for the occasion. We received easy to follow instructions of how to enter the property, suggestions of things to do whilst in Edinburgh and regular check ins to ensure we were happy with anything. Could not recommend highly enough.

A beautiful apartment in a perfect location to enjoy the city. We got so many local tips and suggestions from the host and they responded directly when we had a question. It was a special time to travel due to corona and the host really help with suggestions on places that was open for food, things to do outside etc. I would warmly recommend this place and the amazing hosts.

A perfect little flat for anyone wanting to stay away from the hustle and bustle, with a quick two-stop-hop on the tram to get you right in the heart of Edinburgh. The comfiest bed we have ever experienced and plenty of room to hang all your evening wear. Adam was a great host who allowed us to check in early which, as our flight arrived at 8am, helped us massively in that we had somewhere to put our luggage. Highly recommend.

Had a wonderful time in beautiful Edinburgh. Craig is a fantastic host and a great person. He's exceptionally attentive to guests' needs, and his place is comfortable, spotless, and ideally situated to explore the city and the rest of Scotland. A genuine five stars from me and all the best! 😊

We had such a nice stay! Especially the communication with Tony was very positiv. The location of the Airbnb is just perfect, you can literally walk everywhere. Would definitely recommend! The only thing you should keep in mind is that the windows are very thin and you can hear everything thats going on on the street ;)

Had a great short stay. The views from the windows were great and the central location was perfect for exploring the city.
The only things I would mention 1. This was not an issue for me but the apartment is on the 3rd floor, lots of stairs, so may not be ideal for all and 2. although it wasn't particularly loud, it wasn't quiet either. Again, this was not an issue for me, I liked to be in the centre of the activity and close to everything. I would definitely stay here again.

It was my first time in Edinburgh and it was absolutely gorgeous, I think being able to stay so close to the action really helped my experience! Farbias place is so beautiful, really clean, super spacious, has a comfortable bed, and all amenities you need! Highly recommend staying here!!!

My family and I loved John’s place. It’s so cozy and comfortable and we felt right at home. It was near the bus stop. John was very helpful accommodating to all my questions and if we were to return to Edinburgh again, we will think of John’s place.

Charlotte was a great host. She welcomed us and gave us great information about the area. The flat was clean and quite, despite being in such a busy part of the city. Speaking of which, the location was great! Close to all the great sites. We would definitely stay there again.
Great place, great location, just slight call out that had to walk up 3 levels
Nice clean and quiet apartment in a good location.
Really nice apartment for a short stay with everything you could wish. Just remember to turn the handle UP right

The place had everything we needed and was located great for public transport towards the city centre and airport
Supermarket was also close by
We had a great stay (:
Perfect stay in Edinburgh!
Clean and excellent apartment. Jason is also very responsive. Highly recommended. Would stay again!
Absolute gem. Stayed for 2 nights with family (6 total).   Can't say enough wonderful things about our stay. Not a single even remotely negative thing about it.  Monica is awesome.
Right on the Royal Mile! Hard to beat the location, we were in the heart of the Royal Mile with everything easily available to us. The unit was clean, safe and quiet and we enjoyed our stay.
Such a lovely home and it came with great amenities! We loved coming home to it. Such a great place to stay.

Superbe appart bien situé ! Proche de la Rose street avec pubs et restaurants. Seul petit hic: dans la cuisine, il n'y a que le micro-ondes et la bouilloire utilisables. Mais tout l'appart était nickel et confortable !

Btissam was not at home during my stay. She kept in contact with me, making sure that I had what I needed, and that I felt comfortable. My only regret was that I did not get to meet her. She seems to be a lovely person. While the accommodations are modest and the bathroom entry is tight, both rooms served their purpose. Based on the listing, there were no surprises. I was there for four nights and walked to the Royal Mile area every day. The walk felt safe.

Lovely, traditional flat in the perfect location for exploring Edinburgh. Stayed here for a long weekend and was able to walk everywhere! The flat was perfect for 2 people, and everything we needed was available to us. Easy to find and check in/out was smooth. Highly recommend for those touring the city or looking to adventure through Scotland!
Noël went above and beyond to make our stay truly enjoyable. His place, conveniently situated, made it a delight to explore the city center on foot. Grateful for the wonderful experience!

Positives - the stay is at a great location. Just 2 min walk to the bus and tram stop. Lots of restaurants and cafes at walking distance. Tesco express - the local grocery store just 2 min walk away. The stay was clean and had all amenities listed. The storage space was ample with drawer, shelves and a cupboard. The switch boards were also ample.
Negatives - the bed is just 4 feet which is very small for 2 people to sleep. We couldn't get proper sleep on that bed. Not at all recommended if you need ample space to sleep. Also, our room was on West side and we visited in July mid time when it was very sunny and hot. There was no fan in the room. We requested for a fan at reception but they said that either they were already taken or they were broken. So we did not get a fan and it felt really hot in the room to sleep. The heat in the room in the evening was just unbearable. Apart from this, the shower area is very small. I don't think a fat person can even stand there and take shower.
Courteous and welcoming host who accommodated all my requests as best he could, including washing machine drying racks etc, especially with a very cute cat! Will stay again next time I need it.

We enjoyed our 4-day stay in this comfortable and practical flat, with easy access to local attractions and services. Had a few hiccups on arrival and along the way which were promptly rectified by the host, with great customer service and communications. The beds and lounge areas were really comfy and the kitchen really well fitted out. Would recommend staying here for the comfort of the flat and the responsiveness of the host if travelling to Edinburgh.

My stay was great overall. The place was clean and tidy, and the communication with the host was smooth and easy. The apartment is well-equipped with all the essentials. However, if two people are staying, the bed might feel a bit cramped, especially for men. But overall, I was very satisfied with the stay and would definitely recommend it!

Excelente atención por parte de Joyce, siempre se esforzó por atendernos y estar al pendiente de cualquier necesidad. La ubicación excelente, accesible y fácil de llegar. El cuarto y baño limpios siempre. La cama bien perfecta para una persona, para una pareja también está muy bien aunque depende de cómo estén acostumbrados a dormir. Los desayunos deliciosos y Joyce nos lo llevaba a la habitación. Gracias Joyce. We miss you :)
Bien que je ne parles pas très bien anglais l’hôte a été des plus agréable, je recommande vivement ce RBNB !
Lovely place to stay!

The location is great and the interior deco is as shown on the photos- very cozy but we were quite unlucky and disappointed with overall experience to be honest.
Most of them are easy fixes, related to lack of maintenance and cleaning, which Im sure the host can make so the next visits are much better.
The view of the flat, take away options nearby and the connectivity to the centre are a big plus!
Fantastic and such a lovely place. Made Edinburgh more memorable. Highly recommended
Great location, rooms was spacious and clean, easy to find.

First time visiting Edinburgh and choosing this Airbnb was a great choice. It was in a quiet, but active neighborhood with plenty of cafes to get your day started off on the right foot. Hector and Jen were great. Very proactive with communication which made our stay simple and smooth. The extra space allowed us to relax more so than if we stayed at a hotel nearby. The location was perfect for us. The cool mornings made the 20 minute walk to the city center very enjoyable, but it is also located near the Leith River where we were able to enjoy a stroll to the quaint Dean Village.
We enjoyed our stay and would recommend it!
Lovely, roomy place to rest after walking around Edinburgh all day. Absolutely recommended.
a wonderful trip thanks to Charlotte!

Super séjour passé dans la maison de Megan. Nous avons eu un très bon accueil et Megan nous a donné pleins de conseils sur les lieux à visiter, bars, restaurants…
La maison est situé à côté d’un arrêt de tramway, c’est très pratique pour se rendre dans le centre ville.
Je recommande
Great location, clean, and comfortable.

Francois was a great host, his apartment has everything as we needed and as he prescribed, the location is great and has easy access in the first floor, with a great view on the Royal mile street, we really enjoyed our stay and he was responding and helpful all the time.

Leila was delightful! So kind and helpful and offering recommendations for the area. The back garden was also lovely and I enjoyed sitting there to read on a beautiful sunny day. The neighborhood was nice with outdoor spaces to enjoy and food and shops nearby.
The bed was comfortable but high to get into and sitting on the edge caused me to slide off. It was also very cold in the room/house. I had to be under the electric blanket to be comfortable if I was not sleeping. The room is also a bit tight to navigate without a lot of room for luggage, but lots of drawers and storage and flat surfaces for things once unpacked.
Absolutely lovely flat, we will definitely be staying again! So cozy, comfortable, and perfect for two couples and a toddler. Highly recommend if you’re visiting Edinburgh.
Isabel was instantly welcoming and could not have been a better host. Thank you Isabel!

Lovely apartment in Edinburgh right on the Royal Mile. Alison is a great host and adds some nice touches like fresh flowers!
The space is great for 2 and is nice and cozy and decorated nicely!

Lovely clean room in a beautiful apartment close to the Waverley train station and the new and old parts of Edinburgh. Very handy location and easy to walk everywhere .
The bed was super comfortable, the hosts were very welcoming and it was a bonus to be greeted by their gorgeous dog.

Looked like the pictures, and generally as described. But unfortunately the cleanliness was just not up to par. The shower had black mould on both the shower head and the grout between tiles. There was also a black hair stuck to the shower wall when we first arrived, not belonging to us. There was quite a bit of dust in the bedroom and there were some personal photos in the bedroom, which made us feel uncomfortable like we were invading someone’s home. I think airbnbs should remain impersonal for this reason. Otherwise good amenities, quiet area and as seen in the photos.

Jon's place was in a great location. Just a few footsteps from the Royal Mile. The apartment had plenty of living space, clean and comfortable.
Just a bit of a warning... there are stairs. No elevator. This made hauling 5 pieces of lugguge up two flights of stairs very difficult.
You get your moneys worth; suitable for short visits
Lovely little flat in a great area. Perfect for exploring all Edinburgh has to offer

Gabriella es un persona amable y atenta.
El apartamento reune todas las condiciones para disfrutar de la estancia en Edimburgo.Muy recomendable.

Fiona’s place was very clean and spacious. Overall, the stay was very comfortable! She had provided all the necessities and was very accommodating. Her place was in a prime location - in a peaceful residential area but close to the city centre and nearby shops. I loved my stay here, thank you for having me :)

Great apartment, very close to the Royal Mile and the main turistic attractions. We were extremely satisfied with the the apartment in general, it was clean, comfortable and everything we needed was there. The host was always available for any issues. Definitely recommended!
A very well appointed apartment, lovely location. Highly recommended, great there is a lift and a parking space! Stairs down to the building are quite shallow, so take care carrying bags etc.
Nous avons passé 3 nuits chez Denise pour visiter Édimbourg. L appartement est conforme à la description et bien placé pour visiter la ville!
Great location! Close to all scenic spots in Edinburgh. Also, Sabrina was very helpful and warm. Will book again once we visit Edinburgh again!
Good communication. Near Haymarket station and many buses.  One of the rooms doesn't have a window.
We were in Edinburgh for our son’s graduation at the Usher Hall -perfect  location, only a 2 minute walk away. Beautiful flat, would definitely recommend for location and amenities.
had a good stay at Ricardo's place, everything was clean and as it was advertised.
Very much enjoyed my stay and wouldn’t hesitate to stay again in the future. Magdalena was very helpful with all aspects of the booking and has a  home, which is spotlessly clean
La casa esta genial, se puede ir andando al centro, se tarda unos 15 min, totalmente recomendable

We had a lovely experience at this apartment. It was a comfortable and elegant setting from the furnishings, to the ceilings and windows (we really loved it!). Local recommendations were left for us, along with instructions on the apartment (wifi, tv, etc). The neighborhood was excellent (posh residential) - a tiny bit far from old town if you see yourself wishing to walk to and from there frequently - but it was perfect for us. The host was available for all questions and made us feel at home.

Absolutely beautiful place to stay. Close to the center of things - an easy walk from the festival hubs - but nice and quiet and private. Loved being across from the gardens. Would absolutely stay again.

Really pleasant stay over NYE. Did not know Edinburgh so great to find the location was superb and close to everything we wanted to do. The flat is really classic but comfortable. It was snowing when we arrived but the flat was toasty and heating worked well. The bath taps in the en-suite do not work but used the shower. There was another bath if needed.

The most beautiful Airbnb I've stayed in.  Connor's place is peaceful but also a 10-15 minutes walk from the heart of town with lots of natural light being on the top floor. Great restaurant and coffee shops nearby. Several buses pick up nearby to get you wherever else you want to go.  Comfortable beds and all other amenities were as stated.  Would look forward to staying again.
The space worked well for our stay and had everything we needed. Communication was lacking.

Nous avons passés un très bon séjour dans le logement de Duc !
Le logement est calme et l’accès au centre d’Edimburg se fait très rapidement en bus !
Excellent rapport qualité/prix, nous recommandons !
房间很舒适干净，和照片描述的一样。在爱丁堡城市中心，去这些主要的景点步行都很方便。周围吃的东西也很多，居住环境很好。闹中取静。停车在不远处，24小时28镑，还算方便。推荐给来爱丁堡旅行的人。
这次是我5年后再次来到爱丁堡，女主人是我在英国B&B中所遇到的最好的房东之一。她为我们准备了牛奶、麦片、咖啡、红酒、果汁等等。房子温馨、干净、舒适，我下次还会关顾。
Ubicación bastante buena, alrededor de muchos restaurantes y bares, tiene mucha seguridad para entrar, la comunicación fue buena y sin problemas
Very good location but bathroom facilities are a tad on the basic side
Nice appartment and we had good stay location was great
Prayas place was in a great location, with modern facilities. Communication was also first class. Thanks

Ich hatte einen Aufenthalt, wie ich ihn mir gewünscht habe - nah an der Innenstadt, um Spaziergänge zu unternehmen, ohne öffentliche Verkehrsmittel. Außerdem war die Wohnung sehr gemütlich, genau das Richtige, um zu entspannen. Meine Gastgeber waren sehr flexibel, was für Kurzentschlossenen sehr hilfreich😉 Und für mich war es auch entscheidend, dass mein Auto einen Platz bekommen hat.
Sofia is very kind caring and considerate. She went to every length to help us learn to negotiate Edinburgh. The bed is SO comfy and Sofia helped us with an early check in! The perfect hostess.

Great place for a short stay! A choice of supermarkets nearby, good transport links into central Edinburgh! The best bit was communication with Valentin who was always very quick to respond and tried to accommodate our needs effectively, always eager to help!

Piccolo appartamento nel pieno centro di Edimburgo. La posizione è fantastica per spostarsi a piedi in tutta la città.
Andrew è un host fantastico, mi ha dato moltissimi consigli su ristoranti e locali in zona, che hanno reso ancora più speciale il mio soggiorno!
Consiglio a tutti questo appartamento per vivere a pieno la magia della città!

We loved our stay. The flat is extremely spacious and comfortable. Liliana was very quick at communicating, and very accomodating. We stayed 2 nights, in July when it was very hot weather. The flat remained lovely and cool. Also loved the outdoor space.
Morningside is an ideal area to stay in, away from the busy city center, but still within walking distance.
Thank you Liliana
Excellent all round

This was a very nice flat in a terrific location. Well equipped. Very responsive hosts. The couch in the living room was ratty, though and needs badly to be replaced, given the price point. As well, please be aware that the beds are small to North American ( Canadian) standards. However, I would definitely stay there again!
We will be back next year!

We enjoyed our stay at S's place. The place was clean, comfortable, and beautifully decorated. It had everything we needed, from coffee and tea, to detergent and washing machine. would recommend staying there!

Location,  location, location. The apartment is conveniently located near the grass market, castle, etc. The apartment was decently equipped if you chose to cook at home. Overall the apartment felt run down compared to the photos. The bedframe was broken, bedroom flooring worn and stained, and roller blinds broken in the bedroom. The value of this apartment is the location, but quality of the apartment is not quite there

Location was hard to find especially block 2 as not clearly signed. Then the lift was awful smelt disgusting and stairs were all disgusting and outside the apartment stuff dumped. Got there the actual apartment door was open so wasn’t sure it was safe.  The apartment was clean and what was expected but the overall building and lifts stairs would turn away other customers .

A+ wonderful location in Edinburgh.  Everything is walkable and plenty of fantastic local eateries. Check was easy and the flat was gorgeous, charming, roomy and just as described.  Plenty of small appliances, cleaning supplies and a small pantry of essentials to use. Stairs to the flat were not an issue.  Lisa is extremely responsive and we were able to drop luggage off early.

We stayed for 2 nights and thoroughly enjoyed the apartment. Views across the water are incredible morning, noon and night, much better watching TV! The apartment was perfect for us, really comfortable, easy to get to and fully secure parking.  There is a bus stop right outside and we made full use of it to get into the city centre plus to and from Leith. We'd love to stay again sometime.
Nice place, good location.
Perfect place to stay when visiting Edinburgh!

Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft von Luc. Von der Unterkunft lässt sich Leith super zu Fuß erkunden und auch der Weg nach Edinburgh mit Öffentliche Verkehrsmitteln ist gut zu erreichen.
Wir hatten die alles was wir gebraucht haben vor Ort.
Gekocht haben wir nicht.
Das Parken in der Tiefgarage hat super geklappt. Hier muss man nur etwas Glück haben, dass ein Stellplatz frei ist.
Wir können die Unterkunft weiterempfehlen und würden beim nächsten Trip nach Leith wiederkommen.
Great location with a nice walk into the city, parking included which is rare for the location. Perfect for a young couple for a few nights in Edinburgh

This is a great place and Charlotte was a very helpful and caring host.
The apartments location is amazing, very central. Everything is exactly like in the pictures.
We would definitely recommend this place!

Charlotte's flat is just beautiful and in a great location for exploring Edinburgh.  It was so cozy and also classy and had a ton of space.  The views out all of the gorgeous large windows were just beautiful - a garden and historic buildings on one side and the lovely street on the other.  We really enjoyed having a washer/dryer and the fully-equipped kitchen.  We're trying to figure out when we can come back and stay again!
We have spent a really good time in the lovely apartment. Very clean, tidy and well equipped. The location is also really good, close to most of the spots in the city.
Nice place to stay

l'appartement est très pratique, propre, calme et très bien situé pour rejoindre le centre d'Édimbourg ou l'aéroport.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour malgré une arrivée tardive.
Super leuke locatie vlakbij het centrum van Edinburgh. Alles was prima te lopen en Alan gaf fijne en duidelijke tips en instructies. Kortom zeker een aanrader!
The stay was amazing. The flat was nice and clean

Loved staying here for 1 evening last min ! Everything was perfect loved the little iron brus in the fridge and things to make a cup of tea& Biscoff biscuit in the morning. So was perfectly clean & tidy! The parking recommendation was brilliant aswell & lovely 10 min walk, maybe would keep it in mind if packing a lot. I would 100% be back & would stay here for multiple evenings so would recommend for a couples getaway!

Amanda's gardenhouse is literally an oasis in the middle of the city. I have never felt that comfy within such a short period of time. The house offers anything you need and might need for your visit. A fully equipped kitchen with fridge, toaster, coffee maker, kettle, silverware, oven - just perfect for a German breakfast which we of course don't want to miss. ;-) The bed was ready to use and the couch can easily converted into a bed in case you need it. What makes it even more beautiful are the skylights which one can observe the stars or squirrels in the morning. A handful of interesting City guides, books and a clear guestbook give you even more inspirations for your Edinburgh/Scotland-Tour. Neither you need to bring towels nor adapter.
It's the little things that makes you feel welcomed. A warm hello, fresh milk for tea, the flower bouquet on the table, an introduction of Scottish whisky-drinking habits, a quick chat on the porch. We were lucky being guests at Amanda's place. Thank you and hopefully we'll see us again.

Pauline‘s place is located in beautiful Bruntsfield - a lovely part of Edinburgh with cute stores and great restaurants. The place could not have been better to explore the city and to have a great time. We loved staying there!!

The location of this flat was beyond perfect for our short weekend in Edinburgh! Right off the Royal Mile so everything was within walking distance. The host was quick to respond to my messages and had everything ready for us as soon as we arrived. We loved our stay and would come back and stay again!
Beautiful apartment in a great location, well equipped and spotlessly clean , will most certainly be back .
We had a lovely stay, Armando was a wonderful host, gave us plenty of time describing all around Edinburgh and his recommendations were terrific

Great place, clean, cozy and great communication. Thanks Valentino for the warm welcome.
Would highly recommend and we will stay there again next time we’re in Edinburgh!
Lovely stay with my sister and little dog. Very clean, accurate pictures and wonderful communication with host

Pier is honestly one of the best hosts I’ve ever had… so quick to respond, so helpful, so committed to make sure the stay was excellent. I hope I have a chance to stay in one of his properties again because I know without a doubt it will be better than any hotel I could find! Book with Pier and feel at home, and in luxury, because it’s more carefree than home!! Enjoy (but don’t book when I’m trying to book or it’s on) lol!

We enjoyed a fabulous stay with Karen and her family. She certainly deserves her super host status. A lovely warm welcome, made us feel at home. Our bedroom was large, comfortable bed, chairs to sit and relaxin, TV, wardrobe, large windows, tastefully furnished, warm and exceptionally clean. We found the bedside lights with USB ports very handy! Our private shower and toilet room was large, had lovely fluffy towels and handy shower toiletries. Karen provided us with a great continental breakfast with crossaint, cereals, fruit jogurt etc and a large choice of teas. The house was very peaceful and we got a really good night's sleep each night. The hot water bottles in the bed were a lovely touch and most welcome after waking back late at night. The location was spot on as we could walk to all the sights and there's a direct bus from the airport. We highly recommend Karen's place. Thank you to Karen and family for being such excellent  hosts. We had a fabulous time!

Lovely house, all you need for a comfortable stay. Only a few mins walk to beach. We didn’t use our car as bus service is excellent. Very kind of host to leave some bread/milk & eggs.
Thank you for a lovely weekend break
The Wood family
Everything as described. Joe is extremely helpful and friendly. Highly recommended!

Accueillis très chaleureusement par Karen et Margaret qui étaient aux petits soins. Nous avions même de quoi petit déjeuner malgré notre départ très matinal! Adresse à 8 min à pied de Haymarket Station dans une rue calme, nous recommandons sans hésiter pour cette belle rencontre !
The apartment was gorgeous and felt like home away from home. The location was great and the place was beautiful.
This is a great place to stay for your Edinburgh holiday!

Tracy is a wonderful and at the same time a very inspiring host. I very much enjoyed staying in her home where she made me feel very at home. She’s very humorous, caring and taught me useful expressions in English 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Thank you for that. I’ll certainly will be back some day in the future!

David's place was thoroughly enjoyable. It was well stocked and clean. Great location and terrific view of the castle from the landing of the building. He also gave great suggestions for nearby restaurants. Quite easy to get in and out of the apartment too. I highly recommend this apartment!

The flat was clean, well located and great value. There was plenty of space for 6 of us, and easy bus/walking distance to everywhere we wanted to reach. Andy was able to work around our uncertain arrival time and help us access the flat when requited, which we really appreciated. A great stay, would definitely recommend.
Very nice place - clean and well equipped

What a great apartment! It is perfectly located allowing you to be able to walk into the city centre along the Union canal so that you can take in the sights and sounds of Edinburgh as you go. The apartment is well equipped with everything you need for a short or long stay. We thought that the apartment felt very warm and welcoming with some great art to add to the feel. Will definitely look to stay again next time we return to Edinburgh.

A great little base for a weekend in Edinburgh (around a 20 min walk into the centre). The flat was easy to access and the instructions were clear and easy to follow. It was clean and had been decorated nicely, and the bed was very comfy! Would stay again.
My only “negative” would be that it was inconvenient to have to exit the car park with the gate fob and then go back up to the flat to drop the fob off before leaving the key in the drop box back outside, but that is a very minor inconvenience for the bonus of having a secure car parking spot during the stay.

Our week in Edinburgh was made perfect and easy to navigate due to the incredibly convenient and walkable location of our Airbnb.
The apartment was just as described, incredibly well-appointed, yet cozy and welcoming. We were greeted by Isaac, given a quick tour, and settled into our temporary home for our trip.
Isaac and Derek provided incredibly clear and useful communication, from booking to check in, location directions to check out, and even an extensive list of things to do, see, taste, and drink. They are the model for impeccable hosts!
You cannot find a more accessible location than this; with two separate bedrooms and bathrooms, it was perfect for our family trip to balance time together with down time or privacy.
We sincerely hope to be back again, and hope to be able to stay in the heart of Old Town at this incredible unit.

Cute flat just outside of the City Centre with easy walk. Door was a little difficult at first but once we got it, there was no trouble moving forward. You do have to carry your luggage up a spiral staircase 1 floor, wasn’t really a problem for us, but could see it being a problem for someone with large or heavy luggage or someone with mobility challenges. Overall we enjoyed our stay, the unit is close to coffee shops, restaurants, and pubs filled with locals. The unit itself was clean and as described.
Excellent value for money as we visited in January when rates were lower. Very nice apartment, tastefully decorated and furnished a high standard.

Great location, but unsure why this property is listed under “Luxe.”
To start the listing mentions king size beds - however, they’re double beds, with uncomfortable bedding. The laminate floor makes so much noise when walked on. Lastly, to get a check-in message that includes the costs for replacements does not make you feel very welcomed. For the cost, I would recommend booking elsewhere.
Great location
lovely place
Amazing location right on the Royal Mile. Great to hear bagpipes as you wake up. Lots of activities, pubs and restaurants close by. Very comfy and warm. 10/10 location.

Such a lovely flat. Took the trip to Edinburgh on my own and felt very safe staying here. Great location, close to everything, comfy beds, free coffee & teas. The receptionist was incredibly helpful. Bit noisy with the wind and struggled to lock some windows but all in all a great stay

Laila is a very great host. She’s the perfect mixture of modest and proactive. We directly felt at home and loved being at the place. The room is very comfy and you have your own bathroom. We would always come back. Thank you so much for having us, Laila!
The flat was very nice and close to the main tourist attractions in Edinburgh. It was perfect for our short stay :)
Clean, comfortable and has everything needed for our stay. Thanks so much!

The apartment is in a great location, between Bruntsfield and Haymarket, and only 10 mins walk from Grassmarket and Edinburgh Castle.
The apartment itself is quiet, cosy and clean. Would definitely stay again.
The room is really really nice and Dawn was really kind and helpful. Would definetly choose this place again if I travelled to Edinburgh next time！
Air bnb was beautiful! Close to everything
The place was very well presented, clean, and pleasant. A short walk in to the centre of Edinburgh, with many nearby cafés that are wonderful.
Helpful staff, perfect location
Had a lovey stay at Mario's property. Had no issue, easy check in, plenty of parking. Close to all amenities. Very clean cosy property. Would definitely be back
Great place. Worth your money

Cici met me at check-in and showed me round the flat while offering tips about nearby transport links and restaurants. The flat was bright, clean and quiet, with a well-equipped and well-stocked kitchen. We had a pleasant stay.

Great place in a good location! House was spacious and clean and as advertised.
Parking was not as straightforward as advertised however, as spaces immediately around the property were permit only so you do have to hunt around a bit, but other than that it's a great place to stay
很棒的住宿体验，地理位置距离市中心很近，也很安全。房间设施很齐全，也很干净，下次还会选择这里！
처음 에딘버러 여행이었고 만약 혼자 여행 중이라면 추천하는 숙소입니다. 도보로 20분이면 에딘버러 올드타운, 30분이면 바다를 볼 수 있습니다. 숙소도 깨끗하고 모든 것이 좋았습니다! 다음에 또 방문하고 싶어요!
We stayed with Kerry while attending a weekend conference at the university. It's ideally situated and a perfect crash pad. Kerry was thoughtful and generous and a perfect host

We enjoyed our stay here. The location was great, and was walking distance from everything. Lily was an accommodating host! Just a few things to note: the bed was pretty springy and not the most comfortable, and the curtains let a ton of light into the room as soon as the sun came up. Definitely bring an eye mask if you are sensitive to sleeping in bright rooms. Overall though, we still enjoyed our stay here!
Great stay, highly recommend!
Deane and his family are super friendly and welcoming, the room is great and just as described, and the location is very central and in a fun part of town. Overall incredible value and amazing stay!

Appartement très bien placé, nous avons beaucoup aimé ce logement. Iain était très réactif aux messages envoyés et aux questions posés. Le logement est très spacieux, très bien placé avec un arrêt de tramway à 2 minutes à pieds !
Nous vous recommandons vivement ce logement !
Merci encore 😊
Alojamiento bonito y acogedor

This apartment was everything we hoped for when traveling to Edinburgh! Really beautifully furnished with tons of interesting books and reading books throughout the house. The linens were lovely, the beds comfy, and the towels extra plush. It was well heated and felt nice and cozy after a day of sightseeing in fairy cold weather! The decor transported us to another time and it truly felt that we were living this beautiful city’s history. The neighborhood is very vibrant with tons of restaurants and grocery stores and only a short walk from the historic downtown. Overall  fantastic stay!

Sam heeft alles tot in detail van tevoren beschreven en aan ons door gegeven. In huis heeft hij ons goed wegwijs gemaakt. Daarbij heeft hij gezorgd voor tijdelijke parkeervergunning en kregen we nog iets lekkers van hem mee bij afscheid. Opvallend in positieve zin is dat hij duidelijk een groot Harry Potter fan is. In een aantal details kwam dat naar voren zonder het te overdrijven. Mooie frisse slaap- en badkamer en een keuken met voldoende voorzieningen. Sam is daarbij een vriendelijke man.
Great location - situated just off the Grassmarket and literally under the castle itself. Flat was clean, tidy and well stocked with the basics. Good wifi as well.
Very nice flat, very clean and great location. Host was lovely and very responsive. Highly recommend😊
Location was excellent and free parking was wonderful!
Logement impec très bien situé dans le centre historique de Edimbourg. Très propre et pratique avec 2 enfants.

A superb location could not have been better, ten minutes from Waverly Railway Station and Tram direct to the Airport. On arrival it was such a pleasure to meet Joanne who was able to explain every thing. Whilst we did not need to use all the facilities the flat had  all that you would need for a longer visit. It was emasculate a very comfortable bed and a brilliant shower. Highly recommend any visitors to Edinburgh.
God til at svare alle tider på døgnet og lejligheden lå lige ud til busstoppestedet

Beautiful stay, amazing appliances in the kitchen. The location was perfect and Graeme was responsive and accomplished when we needed to stay a little later due to our rental car.. 10/10 will book again.

Lovely apartment, situated in a great place just off the Royal Mile. The apartment was super clean, well furnished  and had everything to make our stay great, including luxury toiletries, kitchen utensils and Nespresso machine with pods. Bed was really comfy and location perfect for exploring Edinburgh. Would definitely recommend!

Siamo stati 4 notti ed è stato da subito come essere a casa!
La casa è a 40 minuti a piedi dall’Arthur Seat e a 25 dalla old town, le fermate dell’autobus sono molto vicine.
Consigliatissimo

Kenzo is the sweetest and we had the most lovely stay we could have ever imagined. The apartment is perfectly located, super cozy and became our home for a couple of days.
Highly recommended!
We will definitely come back when returning to Scotland!!

Great central spot for the Royal mile and Edinburgh castle. Close to shops, coffee spots & pubs!  Taca is a wonderful host. She is great at communication and her flat is  clean, and stylish, with spectacular views.
Albert is a great host and you could not get a better location. The flat is a little quirky but we loved it.

Nous avons été ravis de passer quelques jours dans l'appartement de Charlotte, tout était impeccable, très proche du centre tout en étant très calme, à vivement recommander,
grâce aux informations reçues, nous avons dans nos expériences de restaurants et visites passé d'excellents moments.
Un grand merci pour ce service.
A beautiful apartment , well fitted out. Very easy to get in and a lovely stay. Would recommend this place to anyone.
Good location, close to the Royal Mile. Easy to access with great communication

Mein Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft war rundum perfekt. Die Wohnung ist super leicht zu finden – vom Flughafen aus einfach in die Bahn gestiegen und nach einer kurzen 5-minütigen Laufstrecke war ich schon da. Man kann wirklich alles bequem zu Fuß erreichen. Die Gastgeberin ist unglaublich freundlich und herzlich, sodass man sich direkt wohl und willkommen fühlt. Die Wohnung selbst war makellos sauber und sehr gemütlich. Besonders süß waren die Haustiere – unglaublich lieb und freundlich! Ich habe mich hier richtig wohlgefühlt und kann die Unterkunft wärmstens weiterempfehlen.
OMG I couldn't of asked for a better place!!! so convenient to tram and so close to everything!! John met us and went above and beyond

The location can’t be beat!! Very central to every place you need to go!!! Amazing apartment was clean and comfortable and right by a grocery store. Please pay attention to the entry instructions you get the morning of check in (would have made it easier for us)

The place was really great and suits all your needs no matter what your purpose of visit is, if you're looking for a chill getaway or just a place to sleep at and roam the city, it's great, the place is close to the waterfront which was great to visit but also has a bus stop right at your doorstep straight to town, place is in a lovely quiet neighborhood away from the city noise, check in was straightforward as well, the amenities this place provides will not take away from the quality of life you're used to and may even be better, WOULD DEFINITELY RECOMMEND FOR ANYONE, place is definitely worth the price even though it wasn't highly priced

Excelente ubicación en Old Town, muy cerca de la estación de trenes Waverley (llegamos en tren, así que eso estuvo muy bien). El apartamento es muy acogedor, muy bien decorado. Ci siamo trovate benissimo! Zona molto sicura a ogni ora del giorno e della notte, collegata benissimo sia al centro che all'aereoporto.

Great place. Would definitely stay again and recommend. Thanks for having us :)
Exactly as described. Very prompt and thoughtful host. Would highly recommend.
Wonderful place to stay!

Dawn and Leon made us very welcome and gave us loads of information, places to shop, lovely bar in the village the local ship shop which sold all kinds of food.  The bus stop into Edinburgh was only a couple of minutes away and was about every 10 minutes.

I had a wonderful time at Ha's place. The house is bright and modern. The room I stayed in was cosy with a comfortable bed. Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt und waren rundum zufrieden! Great stay
Great location and good value accommodation. Great location for exploring the city on foot.

Es war eine tolle Wohnung!!!!! Und eine super lage👍🏻

Aria’s place was exactly as described and my husband and I had a wonderful time there. It is about a 10 minute walk to the “tourist stuff,” which was perfect for us. It’s not a place with a view, but is so quiet and comfortable that it is a perfect place to stay for a few nights to go see the sights while staying away from the noise of the town center.
Getting there from the airport was super easy - the bus to take you to the center of town is right outside of baggage claim and it’s only about a half hour ride to Haymarket Station where you get off and walk a few minutes to Aria’s place. Her instructions on how to get to the door and use the key code are so thorough but I was in a hurry, I initially made a mistake putting the code, but Aria responded IMMEDIATELY! Lovely stay.
Great stay in Stockbridge, lovely apartment in a great location. Rebeca was very responsive to all our needs, highly recommend!

This is a great house at a convenient location, well managed and homely. Molto soddisfatti, alloggio comodo, ampio, pulito ed in posizione perfetta per visitare il centro di Edimburgo. Had a great stay in Edinburgh, and this Airbnb made it a perfect New Year’s Eve break for our family.

Thank you Juan, next time I’m in Edinburgh, I’ll be checking if your place is free!!

Apartamento precioso y muy espacioso para grupos de amigos o familias. Bien equipado y limpio. Nos dejaron hasta flores naturales al llegar. Y la piscina está fenomenal! Además muy bien localizado...cerca bus y tren para el centro. Super recomiendo

The air BnB was perfect for our needs as 6 friends visiting Edinburgh for a week. The only minor criticisms I have are that the door was a bit confusing to open so giving instructions for this in future may help, and there was not enough toilet roll provided for 6 people for a week! We would definitely stay here if we ever visit Edinburgh again.

Great place to stay in Edinburgh!

Great place to stay for a few nights when wanting to explore Edinburgh. The apartments has everything you need and the communication with the host was great. I would 10/10 recommend!

Wow. Just arrived home from an amazing stay at this lovely airbnb. It's without doubt one of the best i've ever stayed in. Shery and her family were wonderful hosts and you can tell they have put a lot of thought and care into the property, from the design and the appliances, which are very high quality, right down to the finishing touches! The mirror in the bathroom is electric so it doesn't steam up. There's a coffee machine with lots of pods and essentials such as bread, milk and cereal were supplied along with some treats - we even found two ice lollies in the freezer along with a very handy bag of ice. I was in Edinburgh to celebrate my birthday and they even got me a card and a small gift, which was ever so kind and thoughtful. They have the lovliest dog called Leo, and although Shery warned us he might bark, we barely heard a peep from him, though we did manage to see him and give him a fuss a couple of times. He is so cute and well behaved and would not be an issue for anyone who is wary of dogs. The airbnb is in the garden, but you enter through the garden gate, and it feels very private. It was lovely and quiet but a great location, with free on street parking (which is great if you're driving). We hopped on the number 44 bus into the city centre every day, and the bus stop is only about a 1 minute walk from the airbnb, and the bus fares are very reasonably priced. The airbnb is also walking distance to the beach, though we didn't have time to head down there ourselves. Location wise it was simply perfect. Shery gave me some good tips and recommendations for the Fringe Festival and the full guide was in the airbnb too, which was super helpful as we'd never been to the Fringe before. All in all, our stay was absolutely amazing. I would definitely book to stay here again and recommend the property to anyone visiting Edinburgh.
