I would definitely recommend this apartment and would happily stay here again.
Lovely place, would definitely stay again

Its a very nice place, only a couple of minutes by bus from downtown. There are some nice restaurants in the area and its right next to the train station which is very convenient too (you can get there from the airport by tram).
The place its nice, 2 nicely sized rooms and 2 bathrooms, so perfect for 4 people.
Everything was good

We booked Farah's flat for 1 night as we had a night out in Edinburgh, the rooms were spacious and the bed was comfy, the flat throughout was lovely designed and lovely decor.
Flat was clean throughout.
We got a taxi into town which wasn't far at all and the flat was located in a good location.
Check in was easy but the only downside was we struggled to open the main door and had to buzz another flat.
We will be booking again if needed.
We had a great stay at Valentina's. The space was clean and bright, checking in and out was easy, and it was a great launch point for enjoying Edinburgh.

Bijou apartment in a great spot for exploring Edinburgh - loads within easy walking distance, cabs are affordable if the walking gets too much (some of the hills are challenging!) and comfy beds. Couldn’t fault it - Taca super helpful with our special request which we greatly appreciated. Would stay again!
Fantastic host, very friendly and responsive. Lovely apartment

This place is worth it for the view alone - it must be the best possible view of the castle imaginable! The space is pretty much as described (though I found the living room larger than I'd imagined), and yes the bathroom is small, but it's all manageable (I've stayed in smaller!). We had some issues with the wifi going out but our hosts were very responsive, so if you experience the same, just contact them right away and they'll get it sorted for you. Others have written about the noise - we had no issues in the front room (it was very quiet with the double glazing), but Saturday night brought some loud drunken yelling from either the courtyard or buildings in the back, so just be prepared for that possibility as we were (to be fair, you are on their turf!). The view more than made up for it though.

Nous avons passé un formidable séjour à Edimbourg dans le logement proposé par Stuart et Laura. L’appartement se situe dans la vieille ville où se trouvent de nombreux restaurants, pubs et boutiques et il est très proche du château et d'autres lieux touristiques. Il est confortable et très bien équipé. Nous avons pu faire toutes nos visites à pied. Nous avons été accueillies très chaleureusement par Stuart et Laura et avons eu l'agréable surprise de trouver de nombreuses petites attentions : panier de fruits, biscuits salés et sucrés, thé, café, pain de mie, beurre, lait et même une bouteille de vin blanc ! Nous recommanderons cette adresse à nos amis sans hésitation !
very good stay!

Raymonde was very understanding of our situation and helped us much further than we might have hoped for. Without going into details, she was super friendly and accommodating. We’d return again, gladly.
Beautiful apartment in a great location for exploring the city on foot. Great communication around check in/out procedure & very clean, well presented apartment.
La habitación es muy agradable, limpia y amplia. Esta en una zona muy tranquila sin transito.  Gillian es una persona muy amable y que te ayuda en todo lo que puedas necesitar.
Ryan was an awesome host- we were able to get in early which was so nice after a red eye flight. The place was in a great location- walkable to all areas of interest. Quiet and comfort.

Great location for walking to Hollyrood and in to the Royal Mike. About two miles. Bar on the corner quieted down about 1 am if you like a little night life. The apartment was very clean with everything you need.

It's a lovely apartment, spacious and has a great character with the high ceiling and bay window etc. It was very clean and very well equipped, just like home. There were shops, a nice bakery and butcher in a few minutes walking distance. You can also just walk into the old town (about 20 min).  We managed to find parking in the street most of the time, but that can be tricky if you arrive back late. Parking is free after 5:30pm and on the weekends, so that's good.

Appartamento confortevole,rispecchia a pieno ciò che è scritto nell’annuncio.
Unica pecca la doccia,non si può fare in piedi perché altrimenti si batte la testa. Perciò sdraiati in vasca.
Tutto sommato esperienza positiva.

The flat is very large and comfortable and has everything you need. It was lovely to find some drinks in the fridge. Well located for the town center, it is just opposite a shopping area with a Sainsbury’s supermarket open till late. Valentino is very helpful and communicates well with his guests

Maria’s place is wonderful! If you are a Harry Potter fan like me, you’ll love this place. The entire apartment is HP themed, and you even get a handwritten note in a HP envelope to welcome you to the apartment. The kitchen is well equipped and the breakfast items are a plus! The beds are super comfortable and the place is spotless. The apartment is centered within walkable distance to the main attractions. Maria is a wonderful host, very kind, responsive and she goes above an beyond to help the guests. I can’t recommend this place enough!
She let us drop off our bags before check in which was very helpful. overall the place was comfortable to stay in and had public transport to the city centre nearby.
Nice apartment a taxi ride from the city centre. The area wasn’t the greatest but the host was friendly and helpful.

Sara’s place was very comfortable and convenient to the city center. Everything was walkable and it made it very easy to have a quick two nights in Edinburgh. Would absolutely recommend staying at Sara’s place, either a quick stay or longer term.
Nice little spacious gem, would return if in Edimburgh

Dave and Tokes have a gorgeous home - the home is tastefully appointed with a lot of artistic detail and is extremely cosy with a homey feel.
They are great hosts and took time to show us around the house and give us details of things to do around Edinburgh - this is very different from some hosts on airbnb who we've never had a chance to interact with as the home/unit is not their primary home or is a brokered listing.
I would definitely recommend their home! 10/10
PS: one minor thing to note is there is no attached bathroom with this particular unit - while it's not a major inconvenience (there is a private bathroom at the end of the hall) it's one thing to note for travelers who have a preference for one.
lovely apartment in a central location of Edinburgh.

We had a lovely stay! We travelled with our toddler (1,5yo) and Kornelia made sure we had everything we needed and then some. Really nice location, great dining options and playgrounds for the little one just around the corner.

Best Airbnb I’ve ever been. There wasn’t a single thing bad to say about it. The place is incredible, extremely comfortable and warm (specially for the winter season) and Efi is an outstanding host, always keen to help and answering straight away. Me and my family couldn’t be happier to spend this time here in Edinburgh at Efi’s airbnb, it made our trip extra magical! ✨

Great location - central but quiet. We walked pretty much everywhere from the property, but buses and trams are very accessible. The property was ideal for us on a mum and daughter break and I can thoroughly recommend Sinan as a host!

Great place, Brian is a wonderful host, he was so helpful and respond right away, amazing location. Highly recommend this place. You will be so surprise with a view. The only one things there is no elevator, so don’t bring big bags.

Great place, nice location, very comfortable appartment. Its good to be a little bit away from the center, as it offers a better look at the real Edinburgh, and makes the city all the more enjoyable. And the center is quite easy to reach anyways.
Loved the apartment !! Would love to come back and stay again

I stayed at this AirBnB for 4 nights/5 days over the Easter Holidays. Located on the 3rd floor and there is no elevator. Inside it is spacious and quite clean, the bed was very comfortable, the wifi fast, the smart TV good, shower pressure is quite weak though. The area is quite quiet and there is a large Lidl's supermarket opposite. Local transport was very good, only took about 5-8 minutes by bus from Waverley Station.
Unfortunately on arrival, there was no street parking available, had to drive around and parked a few streets away. The majority of the street is for permit holders only but there is a few free public spaces - free after 5:30PM weekdays and all day weekends.
Just had one issue, I didn't realise it on the first night but the next morning, there was no hot water coming from the taps/radiators were cold. Unfortunately I couldn't get hold of the host [was called into work] so I had to contact AirBnB for help. The boiler had low pressure which I fixed.
We chose this apartment for the location - right by the yoga studio and great for the fringe festival. The apartment was easy to find and we settle in right away. Everything was perfect.

Great location, close to a bus stop making it easy to get into town.
I would have stayed longer! Happy to stay again.

My stay at Iliio and Hamish's place was wonderful! First of all, the location is great. It's located in this charming neighborhood that is only about 15 minutes walk from all the landmarks. There are a lot of good pubs and restaurants in the area but none of them are on the immediate street so it was very quiet and peaceful at night. Ilio and Hamish were responsive and helpful and the check-in/check-out processes were quick and easy. The room was spacious and cozy with some nice decorations to boot. Overall, I could not have asked for a more pleasant stay for my first time in Edinburgh!

Super clean efficiency apartment. Great shower. Comfortable couch for 2. Netflix was a plus. Quiet location. Easy to get public transportation to the city center (bus or Uber/taxi). Washer dryer in the unit. Easy checkin using a lockbox! We arrived two hours early and Chris kindly accommodated us.
Really good location. Great apartment to hang out in and has a great kitchen to prepare food

Trystan was always quick to respond. The location is perfect, close to everything, particularly for the Edinburgh Fringe Festival which is why we were visiting. The room was solid, nice, comfortable. The shared bathroom was not a problem. The people at the bar downstairs were very accommodating, holding our bags when we checked in and out, and giving a discount on drinks etc. Definitely recommend.

The location is very strategic, but getting into the property felt like solving a treasure hunt. There were many steps to follow just to find the correct key and figure out which one opened the main door. The flat is on the 3rd floor with no lift, which made it quite difficult to carry our suitcases and stroller.
The building is old and the floors creak loudly like wooden boards. The interior design is actually nice, but because the building and the flat are quite old, it felt below our expectations.
The most disappointing part was the kitchen equipment. The cookware was dirty, the oven still had leftover bits inside, and the kettle was rusty when boiling water, a lot of rust particles came out, which is definitely not safe. Most of the cookware available was large-sized and also rusty or unclean.
Overall, the stay was not as comfortable as expected.

We loved our stay in Calim’s apartment.  The location is great if you’re looking at staying central and exploring Edinburgh as everything we visited was walking distance. The apartment itself was super cosy and felt like home with everything we needed, in addition to a warm welcome of shortbread and drinks!  Calim’s communication was also much appreciated as we received some great restaurant recommendations and also made check-in/out super easy. Highly recommend staying here if you’re thinking of visiting Edinburgh😊

A beautiful, stylish very modern apartment with all the mod cons, very clean and had everything for your stay. The location on the royal mile was superb the downside being no parking so I unfortunately spent nearing on £80 to park our car for 4 days which is extortionate I pay less in London!
The kitchenette is a thing of genius and took away the feel of a kitchen when relaxing in the evening. The city is amazing and the brewers is a stylish place to stay for sure.

If you want to be in the heart of the action, Christine's place is great. Walk out the door and you are on the royal mile with great pubs and restaurants steps away.  The trade off is the noise and the steps. If you are traveling with lots of baggage this might not be the best choice.

This was a fantastic place to stay, so close to the castle, attractions and amenities! Charlotte was very easy to contact, very helpful and generous, with lots of suggestions for food and activities!!
I would definitely stay again and I'd highly recommend!!
Perfect trip in edinbugh thanks to ronnie and his house !

Nell's place absolutely lived up to it.s photos and description. Bedroom was a lovely space, private, sunny (lovely warm weather the week I was there) and really comfortable. Separate private bathroom had everything you would need including a separate bath. The apartment is quirky and characterful but also very comfortable and welcoming. Lots of books and local guides to get you oriented. Great location, good walking distance in to town and across the bridge into the Old Town. Great walks close by on the New Town side too. Unfortunately I didn't get to meet Nell who was away but Mick welcomed me and was a great host during my stay. All arrangements for collecting keys etc worked well. Would love to stay again.

I found myself in Edinburgh at the last minute, and Paul was able to accommodate me with no problem at all. Paul was gone most of my trip and I was wondering if he even existed, But I met him on my final night there, he was kind and helpful.

Konumu oldukça merkezi. Yürüyerek 25 dakikada merkeze varabilirsiniz.Ya da 6 dakika yürüyerek toplu taşımaya ulaşabilirsiniz. Markete çok yakın güzel bir muhitte sakin bir sokaktı. Ev gayet güzel döşenmiş ve temizdi. İhtiyacımız olan her şey var fakat televizyon olması daha eğlenceli olabilirdi.Yinede internetin olmasına çok mutlu olduk. Teşekkürler

Fantastic flat in Morningside with easy access to central Edinburgh. The apartment was extremely spacious, comfortable and well stocked. It was very clean and the host was very accommodating.  It even has free parking outside on weekends which is a bonus in the centre of Edinburgh! I would 100% recommend.

The place is really nice & clean. It got everything you need and is really close to the city centre. There are nice cafés at the corner and some supermarkets as well. Thank you very much, we enjoyed our stay!
Absolute clean and nice. Ru is so warm hearted and always there to help. Hope the next journey with Ru.
Rooms are neat and clean as specified in pictures, location is good from my prospective. Castle is 10-15minute walk. Indian restaurants are 5 minutes walk, Tesco sainsbury easily accessible.

We loved our stay at Olivia’s! The apartment is so charming and feels very homey. The tram and bus stop is just a short walk from the apartment building which made getting around super easy. There were plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby to visit as well. The area also felt very safe. Olivia was a very kind host and provided an abundance of recommendations for our time in Edinburgh. I would recommend her apartment to anyone visiting Edinburgh!
Photos dont make justice. Great place!

Alex und Dan sind perfekte Gastgeber, sie sind sehr freundlich und aufmerksam. Wir fühlten uns sehr willkommen und haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen. Die Unterkunft ist sehr gemütlich und der Blick auf das Meer ist wunderbar. Er ist sehr ruhig, mit dem Bus braucht man nur wenige Minuten bis zur Stadtmitte. Es gibt viele Informationen in der Wohnung über die Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt und Dan hat uns weitere sehr gute Tipps für Ausflüge gegeben. Wir würden uns jederzeit gerne wieder bei Alex und Dan einmieten.

A truly charming, delightful and stylish apartment that puts you at the heart of Edinburgh. Perfectly presented by a most helpful host. Everything you would need in a place, and more... Sheer pleasure.

We had a wonderful stay in Sinan and Susan's cozy cottage! They were very attentive and helpful and the accommodation was super central yet quiet - a perfect base for exploring Edinburgh. It was perfect for the four of us and a baby!
So beautiful, amazing design, comfortable and clean! Felt right at home!

Lovely intimate flat just a bus journey away from Edinburgh town centre. Situated right on the beach with a lovely bistro a couple of doors down, it was an amazing spot! We watched the Aurora on the beach one night and it was fantastic. Already recommended this spot to my friends :)
Very nice, convenient apartment. Clean, functional and nicely decorated. Thank you !
Excellent location, great service!
First time in an AirBnB - couldn't fault it. Everything we neede and more.
The apartment was cozy and we have been comfortable.

Niran is indeed a nice person and his apartment is very nice and match exactly the description and photos.
I will surely check in again if I visit Scotland!!

No recomendable en absoluto. El alojamiento estaba sucio: la ducha tenía moho, el baño no estaba limpio, el suelo estaba sucio y las sábanas tenían pelos. Las mantas, además, olían mal.
La calefacción no funcionó durante dos días, por lo que no pudimos ducharnos porque el agua salía helada y tuvimos que dormir sin calefacción en pleno diciembre, con temperaturas exteriores entre –5 °C y 7 °C.
Pagamos 283 € por noche para pasar frío, no poder ducharnos y dormir en un lugar sucio.
A esto se suma que el alojamiento cuenta con dos sofás cama que anuncian como “camas”, pero son inestables e incómodos.
Si vas a Edimburgo, busca otro alojamiento.

Four of us stayed in this flat and we found it very neat and comfortable.  It had everything we needed and the location was very convenient.  Shahid was available and responsive to all of our requests.  Arriving late at night was no problem as he made arrangements for us to receive the key from the concierge.  Definitely recommend it--great place to stay!

Our stay at Chas and Gillian’s place was absolutely wonderful! From the very beginning, they welcomed us warmly and were always available to assist us with anything we needed during our stay. The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and fully equipped, with lovely touches that made our experience even more enjoyable. The location was perfect – close to the center of Edinburgh, yet in a quiet and safe neighborhood.
A big thank you to Chas and Gillian for their exceptional hospitality – we would definitely stay here again on our next visit to Edinburgh!

Absolutely stunning flat in the best location! Douglas was kind & informative with the best guestbook of suggestions I’ve ever seen. The furnishings & decor were to a very high speck & were so impressive. Not to mention it has the best view of the castle! It truly felt like a wee royal palace & I can’t wait to return.

This is a fantastic flat. The location is very central and in the most beautiful area of Edinburgh. Off street parking and access to local square gardens are unique features which make it stand out from other properties.

Selbys communication was fantastic and he is a very thoughtful Airbnb host. Our trip was sadly curtailed but Selby was great throughout and offered a refund for the part of our trip we sadly had to miss. Would certainly request to stay here if we stayed in Edinburgh again
Prima accommodatie in een rustige omgeving met goed openbaar vervoer naar de stad. Goede voorzieningen in de buurt.
A lovely place at a convenient location we needed for our stay.
Logement très agréable et confortable, proche des sites touristiques
We had a wonderful stay. A great location with lots of good recommendations for things to do and places to eat. A very responsive and friendly host. A perfect Christmas stay.

Very charming flat located in the perfect location near the heart of the city. So close to Carlton Hill and a number of other sites, restaurants and pubs within walking distance. Would definitely stay here again.

I had a really nice stay and felt very comfortable throughout. Everything was super clean, including the shared bathroom. The city center was easy to get to by bus, and Louise, the hostess, was very friendly and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay here again!

Fantastic stay in Edinburgh, close to rail lines , bus and trains , walkable to restaurants and room had everything we needed .
Ryan was a great responsive host and we can’t wait to come back .
Great location, highly recommended
Great location

Jeremy’s place was one of the best Airbnbs we’ve ever stayed in. The location was great, not too far from the tram stop, and with many good restaurants in walking distance. One downside was that we had to walk up to the fourth floor with luggage. But this was more than made up for by the care that Jeremy put into presenting the place. He thoughtfully provided many small things (e.g. universal plug adaptor, maps and books about Scotland), and there was even fresh croissants, milk, butter, and jam when we arrived. In summary, it was a beautiful place and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Fiona's place is great for a few nights in Edinburgh. It's in the quieter part of the city and the city center is easy to get to. She was very flexible and let us drop off our bags early so we could explore the city before checking in. Fiona is a responsive host and we had a great stay at her place! Would recommend her place to anyone that's looking to stay a few nights in Edinburgh!

Une jolie chambre décorée avec goût, une salle de bain privée, hygiène parfaite, des brochures touristiques, pleins de bons conseils de la part de Jacobine, emplacement idéal à quelques pas de l'arrêt de bus. Et Edinburgh quel coup de coeur <3

Simon and Katrina were incredibly responsive and helpful, even though I was delayed arriving in Edinburgh.

The flat is exactly as advertised, probably a little more spacious than I was expecting. Wifi and all appliances worked flawlessly.

As the flat is at basement level, there is a dehumidifier to prevent damp. I took Katrina's advice and left this running continuously, which worked extremely well and maintained a pleasant humidity throughout my stay.

Overall Simon and Katrina's flat provided a very enjoyable stay in a great part of a fantastic city. Recommended.

Our stay in this flat was great. It is very pretty and well placed for walking around the city. Christie was very accommodating with check-in and check-out, which made our stay wonderful.
We highly recommend this place if you come to Edinburgh!

Great apartment in a good location. It is a stylish apartment and the photos did it justice. Kitchen has everything that you need including dishwasher and washing machine. Beds super comfy.  Lovely bathrooms. It is well maintained and clean. The apartment is perfectly situated opposite a tram stop but the room in the front of property can thus hear the trams that were running throughout the night whilst we were there. Great restaurants, cafes and pubs on your doorstep. All in all, great accommodation and perfect base for exploring Edinburgh.

The apartment was spotlessly clean and well maintained. The kitchen was well stocked with plenty of crockery and utensils etc., and even some handy tea and coffee supplies. The lounge and dining area were really comfortable and elegantly decorated. The bed was incredibly comfortable, I had the best night's sleep! The location is beautiful, on the river and so peaceful. It is easy to walk through elegant Georgian streets to significant highlights of the city. Dean village, the botanical gardens, gallery of modern art, restaurants and cafes, the castle are all within easy reach. Looking forward to staying there again.

Great stay
Christelle super friendly
Quiet and slept like logs
Ideal location
Great restaurants close by
Great location for the city centre and the airport. Very spacious and clean. Would definitely stay again when back in Edinburgh

Hélène est véritablement une super hôte. Nous avons pu effectuer le check-in au matin ( au lieu de 16h)car il n'y avait pas de personnes dans l'appartement la veille ce qui est très appréciable. Le café ainsi que la bouteille de prosecco qui nous ont été gracieusement offerts sont des attentions qui font que l'on se sent bien accueilli. Enfin , l'appartement est très bien situé tant par rapport au fait qu'il soit à 35 minutes de l'aéroport ( bus et un peu de marché) que par rapport à sa proximité avec le centre ville ( 25 minutes à pied.) . En termes d'équipements, je note que la présence d'un sèche cheveux et d'un adaptateur pour les prises électriques sont particulièrement aidants .
Merci beaucoup Helen. 🙂

Loved our stay! My husband and I came from London to celebrate his birthday, and this place was perfect. Eddie and David were great hosts, David welcomed us personally and gave local tips for restaurants, bars and pubs (we visited them all 😁). The apartment is warm and well-equipped. I especially liked the shower setup - the showerhead is on one wall and its control is on the opposite one, so you can turn it on without getting wet with cold water first.

Eine tolle Unterkunft. In 15 Minuten vom Flughafen und auch nur 15 Minuten bis PrincessStreet. 5 Minuten Fußweg von der Tram aus. Sehr saubere Unterkunft und auch das Frühstück ist sehr zu empfehlen. Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und gemütlich. Wir werden suf jeden Fall wiederkommen. Müssen ja auch noch die Pancakes probieren. Nochmals tausend Dank an Sergej.
Great hosts, nice apartment, plenty of useful equipment, you will be welcomed with a guide, sweets and treats as well as basic amenities. Our hosts were very flexible around our constraints.
The Rufus's place is very comfortable, very close to the royal mile and all the best places in Edinburgh!I definitely recommend this place to all my friends!

Das Center ist wunderschön gelegen zwischen Natur und Innenstadt. Sehr nah am Holyrood Park und fast ebenso nah an der Royal Mile. Zum Einkaufen und Essen gehen muss man nicht weit laufen.
Das Center selbst ist ein schönes altes Gebäude mit großem Garten, in dem man auch mal gemütlich frühstücken kann. Küche, Bäder und Zimmer sind sehr ordentlich. Alle Personen, mit denen ich zu tun hatte, waren sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Da es ein aktiv genutztes Gemeindezentrum ist, muss man sich bewusst sein, dass je nach Veranstaltungsangebot viele Personen unterwegs sein können. Die Wände sind sehr hellhörig und wenn manche Türen ins Schloss fallen, kann es schon mal ein wenig wackeln. Zur Nachtruhe ist es aber auch wirklich richtig ruhig.
Das Zimmer ist groß und gemütlich eingerichtet mit einem großen Bett, einem Schreibtisch mit Stuhl, einem Kleiderschrank, einer Kommode, einer kleinen Bank und einem Sessel.
Insgesamt war es ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt.

We had a wonderful time staying here. The views are outstanding! Both Alex and Dan are lovely people and provided everything we needed. There are good bus links to the center of Edinburgh and the botanical gardens are a must see!! The flat is spotless and great value for money!
The apartment is on the 5th floor without lift. Besides this, everything is wonderful for friends or family traveling together.
Had a wonderful stay and it’s just close enough to the Royal mile without being on the Royal mile. Highly recommended!
Ideal location, clean, quiet, beautiful light, lovely interior. This place is absolutely perfect. I wish I was there now.
전반적으로 다 좋았습니다

My husband and I stayed at Liam's place our last night in Scotland. We arrived late in the evening from the train station and left very early the next morning for the airport. Liam was great at responding quickly to our messages. The flat was clean and our room had clean nice bedding, there was a TV and selection of movies to watch if we had had the time. There was also an electric kettle with mugs, tea, coffee and a couple of candy bars; much appreciated!
Overall we had a brief but pleasant stay.
位置很不错，旁边就是一个购物中心和超市，离火车站也很近。房屋实施很全，厨具和餐具很多。房间也很舒适。

James was an excellent host, and was extremely responsive and proactive in our dealings. Though there was some issue with the cleaning of the place, James immediately offered to send someone to re clean the apartment (we declined as we felt it was unnecessary as we were able to rectify the issue ourselves). Overall it was a nice stay and I would recommend.

Had a great stay at Kerry's! Convenient & well-located to explore Fringe festival's art.
Thank you!

The flat had great views, bed was comfortable and the kitchen had everything we needed.
The host was very responsive, friendly and answered all of our questions.
Only downside is we had 5 suitcases and the flat is in the 3rd floor and there was no elevator.

We could not have asked for a better host! Mary was so welcoming and hospitable. She is so easy to get along with and very helpful for knowing how to get to places or pointing you in the correct direction.
Mary is a great host, and leaves out some continental breakfast bits for you to eat each morning, which was fantastic!
The location is very peaceful and very well connected to the city center. Mary made us feel right at home and taken care of. 😊
An excellent choice for a city break to Edinburgh!

A perfect base for an Edinburgh stay. Ideal location, just minutes walk from a busy high street with bus routes into the city, yet beautifully peaceful and quiet. The flat is compact, but with everything we needed for our overnight stay, and room for 4 people to eat and hang out in the evening. Comfy beds: even the sofa bed, which is a rare & wonderful thing! Friendly, super-responsive hosts made a big difference. We hope to return and would recommend.
Great place! Everything is walkable from this appartement, it’s in a vibrant part of the city. The appartement itself is very cute and there is everything you need :)
Fluer was a wonderful host, very communicative and gave us wonderful recommendations for food and shopping nearby. Very comfortable for two people. Would absolutely stay again.

We were comfortable at the Dundas apartment.  It's a basement level but with large windows facing west that let in a lot of light.  A bus stop right outside is great when you don't feel like walking up the hill to Princes Street or need to connect to the airport bus line.  For those who want to use the kitchen, we thought it could be a bit better equipped; also, there is no freezer compartment in the small fridge.  We appreciated the fresh flowers, milk, and large fruit assortment left by the hosts.

Really loved this stay in Edinburgh with use of the garage. It was more than enough room for 4 people and would still work well for 5 with the pull out sofa. The location is really easy to get to and really quiet. Also has a nice view of Arthur’s Seat!
We also used the washer while there. Check-in was really easy with the lock boxes and the detailed instructions. Note that you have to walk stairs to get to the apartment and the bedrooms are then up stairs within the unit. Would happily return when back in Edinburgh.
We were very satisfied. The hostess was extra kind and ready to help us at any time. I would 100% recommend this accomodation!!

This flat is in a great location.. very near to the castle, lots of restaurants nearby, and the tour buses go past the door!  Walking tour guides bring groups into Riddles Court, so it has lots of history. We loved our stay! The flat is clean and has everything you could need.
The apartment was lovely, and the location was amazing!! We really appreciated how responsive the hosts were, and the Scottish goodies were a very nice touch!! Would recommend!

Location of the flat: The location of the flat is perfect for visiting Edinburgh. You can go to the city centre by a short walk (quite short if you go to Holyrood Castle); or by regular buses that are just a short walk from the apartment. It is surrounded by the services you can need. It is really close to the Meadowbank Shopping Park, where you can find supermarkets and others shops.
The apartment: The flat is really cozy. The kitchen is equipped and all the things we used work perfectly. Well, we missed only the microwave, but for the rest, it has all that you could need. The bedroom is really spacious. The living room has comfortable sofas and is fully equipped with Amazon Prima, Netflix and Nintendo 64 (ideal if you travel with a kid!).
The host: We didn’t meet Stuart personally. However he left complete instructions to us for making our stay as comfortable as possible. He answers quickly all our e-mails.
As a conclusion: Apartment highly recommended.
Nagyon jó elhelyezéskedés, kényelmes szállás.
Netjes verblijft op een goede locatie. 10-15 minuten lopen naar het centrum, en direct naast een tramhalte. De ruimte is netjes en ruim genoeg. Prima verblijf gehad!

Nice view on Arthur's Seat from living room, pretty far to walk to Old Town though.
It took a few hours to warm up the place by switching on the thermostat

We had such a great stay here! I stayed with my sister and we both absolutely loved it. The location is perfect everything is within a good walking distance, and if you don’t feel like walking far, there are trams and buses right nearby which made getting around super easy.
The host was lovely and really helpful, and we had no issues at all during our stay. The bed and pillows were also really comfortable, which made a big difference after long days exploring.
The floor can be a little creaky at times, so you might hear other guests moving around, but the host kindly provided earplugs which was a thoughtful touch. Also worth noting there are quite a few stairs to climb, so just something to keep in mind.
Would definitely recommend and would happily stay again!

We stayed with 2 families (4adults 2 children). It was a fantastic stay. The flat can not be located better. Right next to all attractions of Edinburgh.
The style/decoration of the house is great; the private garden is very special. Hosts are also very responsive and helped us a lot.
.
We loved Edinburgh and honestly cannot think of a better place to stay if we come the second time.

I was initially nerovus because this was my first time staying in a shared accommodation, but it was great! The place was comfortable, clean, quiet, and had everything I needed. Marina gave me a very thorough overview of things to do an see in Edinburgh which was great. I also was working remotely during my time and the wifi worked perfectly. Would definitely recommend for solo travelers who are willing to walk 15-20 min to the heart of the city!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The apartment is lovely and very clean. The location is excellent. It’s possible to walk into the city, we did this with our dog and it took about an hour but there is a bus stop immediately outside of the apartment too which is also dog friendly and the buses are frequent. There is a park next to the apartment block which is lovely. Andrew is a great host.
Amazing place, super cosy!

Beautiful place in a beautiful location, only things I would say that could have improved my stay is I would have loved it if the fireplace was in a working order. Could do with a few throws too as the living room is a bit chilly.

Na pewno świetna lokalizacja - blisko centrum, ale cicho, przy rzece, dużo zieleni. Dwa kroki do Ogrodu Botanicznego. Miła, nieinwazyjna, ale w razie potrzeby pomocna gospodyni. Czajnik i herbata/kawa w pokoju, można skorzystać z kuchni, płatki z mlekiem i sok na śniadanie dla chętnych w cenie. Czysto. Trochę zimno i wilgotno w pokoju, ręczniki nie schły. Ogólnie w porządku.
Beautiful apartment with a really cosy feel. Large enough for 6 adults to be in comfortably which was fab. We had some issues with the boiler which the host responded to quickly.
Student house flat share but what we needed for a couple of boys going to see the rugby. Check in and communication clear and value for money not terrible. Clean in the room. Great location.
Beautiful and clean apartment. We'll definitely recommend the place to friends and family.
This Airbnb is very spacious and comfortable. It is in a nice quiet area but in walking distance to restaurants. We appreciated that the kitchen had dishes, cutlery, a fridge, toaster, etc!
apartamento muy cómodo y agradable
It is very convenient to the new town !
Wonderful location and a very nice place to stay!

A really lovely flat in a great location - decorated beautifully and super well equipped so you feel immediately at home. Kelly has left a great guide for local restaurants and attractions, and is very friendly and communicative over message - highly recommend, would stay here again on future trips!
Great location, well appointed apartment,  close to grass market, restaurants, pubs and places of interest. ideal for access to the castle. we loved it.

Calum was a great host. He was super helpful and friendly. We appreciated the privacy and never felt disturbed by anything.
The Room itself was nicely decorated and had everything we needed. The view is amazing and we spent a lot of time just walking by the water and exploring the surrounding area. We would gladly come back here and stay with Calum again :)

My mum and I had a wonderful stay at Sadiah’s! The location was close to great cafes and quaint shops to wander into, and well connected to the city centre by multiple buses. Sadiah is the kindest and warmest host who treated my mum and I with so much hospitality(she even made us some amazing chai!) and we felt at home right away! She also gave us lots of great recommendations and tips on where to visit, which we truly appreciated! The space was a little more cluttered than the pictures but nothing got in our way much, and everything was clean. We had all the amenities we needed, and more, as Sadiah offered her kitchen supplies for us to use. Always love coming back for a nice chat with Sadiah, and would definitely recommend/return to stay again!

Consiglierei l'appartamento per due persone e non per una famiglia. Le lenzuola erano pulite e fresche ma il divano è stato abbandonato dalla pulizia. Ha problemi con le tubazioni della vasca che non lascia defluire l'acqua ed è stato scomodo usare lo stura lavandini, il water si trova in uno spazio di un metro per un metro, se qualcuno di voi è alto più di un metro e novanta ed è in sovrappeso farà fatica a fare i suoi bisogni. L'ingresso dell'immobile (e non della casa) è molto rovinato e sporco, ma l'appartamento al secondo piano non è male se si è in due.
Nice apartment with lovely arty details. Great location and walkable to most places. We enjoyed it.
Great apartment to stay in. Very easy check in and great location. Host is quick to respond.

Perfect host and good help with everything
Really liked the place if you don’t mind being a little outside Edinburgh
Good value for the money
We recommend Kerry and her AirBnB

Pier was the perfect host, with great communication both before and throughout the stay. The flat itself was very clean and modern, located in a quiet side street off the Leith Walk. In all, a perfect stay.

L’appartamento è bello, molto spazioso e arredato con gusto.

comodamente a piedi.
Host molto reattivo e disponibile.
Abbiamo segnalato alcuni interventi di manutenzione che dovranno essere effettuati.

Incredible location, quiet enough to be away from the hubbub but close enough to be easily walkable.
Large rooms tall ceilings as you would expect from a period Edinburgh apartment. Really well equipped and easy to find
Loved our weekend, would definitely return

We had a great time at Glenn’s apartment. The flat was spotless and easy to gain access, even late in the evening. Glenn’s suggestions about where to eat were helpful and we really enjoyed the local area, where we found Bonnie Burrito, Southpur and The Grange. Thanks so much Glenn!

My Sister and I come home to Edinburgh every year. We love the area where the property is and we found its location perfect for us. Every landmark is walkable or frequent buses into Princes Street at the top of the road. There is no shortage of places to eat in Bruntsfield, Tolcross and Morningside a short walk away. There is a mini Sainsbury’s 10 mins at the top of the road to pick up bread, fresh milk etc. We really spent very little time in the flat leaving early and returning in the evening so I can’t comment on the cooking facilities etc. There was always hot water for showers. The lounge was comfy to relax in the evening. We were glad to be able to adjust the heating thermostat as it got quite cold in the evening.
An initial problem on arrival was quickly resolved satisfactorily.

Lynda répond rapidement à nos questions et est à l’écoute de nos besoins.
l’appartement est quasiment neuf et très joli.
Il se situe sur une rue avec le tram mais cela n’est pas trop gênant si vous avez l’habitude d’habiter en ville.
La literie est de très bonne qualité. Le tram et la gare routière sont à 2min à pieds, la Chateau est à 10min à pied, tout se fait à pied rapidement. Je recommande vraiment.

Sally was really nice and welcoming. She had the room clean and ready for us. She offered us a very nice breakfast and a very nice chat. She also recomended places to eat and drink as a real scott! We recomend it 100%.

Excellent place for families or group of friends! Great location within walking distance of many great places! Perfect communication with very thoughtful Katherine. House with everything you need - stairs could be a problem for elderly people. Highly recommendable!
Ótimo espaço! Ficaríamos novamente!
The Hayloft was great for our 5-day stay! Good location, very walkable and if you don’t like walking, there’s multiple bus stops nearby. Communication with John was great! Would recommend:)
sehr schöne unterkunft

We had a great stay at Angus and Sabia’s flat. A comfortable place to relax after exploring Edinburgh. Good communication for an easy check-in and only a 15 minute walk to St James Quarter. Highly recommend!
Kenneth's place was a peaceful oasis after a  busy day in Edinburgh. Very comfortable, spotless and with everything you might need including croissants for breakfast :)

La habitacion estaba bien, la casa estaba ubicada a 25-30 min andando de la zona antigua, pero habia buenas conexiones de transporte para llegar a ella, tambien tenia cerca supermercados. En resumen, no esta mal ubicado pero esta muy bien conectado, y Shirley se mostro comunicativa en todo momento.
Beautiful apartment in a brilliant location. Everything was as described and Jennifer was a great host with a lovely recommendation for breakfast locally.
Thank you so much we really had a lovely stay
Todo fue perfecto, gracias.
Superb apartment, in a fab location, walking distance to all central locations. Apartment was clean and really homely... We had a fabulous stay and would highly recommend.
Superb experience! Excellent location and apartment. Highly recommended.
Stuart was very kind and available!  The apartment is full of history and interesting things.  I hope to come back more often!

Excellent base about a 20 minute walk from the city centre of Edinburgh, really smart and stylish apartment, very clean and some lovely extra touches (although the shortbread didn’t last long!). Liz is lovely and made everything very clear and easy to follow. Parking was convenient.
We (two adults, kids aged 15 and 12) had a great stay here. Sunday food market at Stockbridge; M&S Food at the garage round the corner; comfy, stylish space; garden space.

Chambre très propre et au calme absolu
Nous avons particulièrement apprécié de trouver la table du petit déjeuner prête à notre réveil.
Petit déjeuner très bon.
Sevi est une personne extrêmement agréable et gentille.
Nous recommandons vivement et reviendrons certainement.

Beautiful accommodation that was clean and spacious.
Water pressure in the shower was very weak, but other than this the place was perfect.
Ivy was kind and responsive also!

This place is well located, the host is super responsive and helpful, and it’s clean and relatively spacious. My only surprise, especially for the price, was at the lack of supplies within the flat. There were 2 sets of bath towels only, and only one dish towel - no extra soaps, shampoos, napkins, towels, coffee, of anything else that I feel is pretty standard, particularly at this price point. I had to go shopping for basic necessities, so be aware of that when booking. Otherwise, the place is great and I’d recommend.

I stayed at Paul’s during the Edinburgh Marathon and it was the best decision. The place met all my expectations. They were very considerate and not intrusive at all after I mentioned that I needed an early rest, and they were also very flexible with my checkout.

Fantastic location right in the middle of the Fringe fest events. Very comfortable beds and quite breezy with the windows open. Fans plus iron/ironing board are also provided.  Just note there is no adjacent parking!  We walked from a car park about 0.4 miles away up several flights of uneven street steps with golf clubs and our bags, which was challenging with all the crowds and traffic. But it's all a part of the experience in Edinburgh in August :) Thanks again and we hope to be back.

Eine schöne Wohnung in extrem guter Lage, die wahrscheinlich auch den Großteil des Preises ausmacht. Nett eingerichtet, aber das Ambiente ist ausbaufähig.
Die Kommunikation mit Alan war sehr gut, er gibt sehr hilfreiche Tips und antwortet sehr schnell.
Wir waren sehr positiv von der Sauberkeit der Unterkunft überrascht.
Excellent value for money, well recommended!

We all loved our stay in the flat. Flat was clean, very well equipped and spacious enough for 5 people. Julie was very welcoming, gave us information about the city and the neighbourhood and was commited to making our stay very comfortable. Lovely flat and host!
About a 25 minute walk to the castle. Lots of places to stop and see on the way. Good location, far enough away from the crowds to have a quiet night!

The apartment is about a 45 minute walk to the old town. There are trams available but I did not take them so I can’t comment on that. Fiona was a very nice host. She gave me recommendations before I arrived and was able to arrange an early check in that I appreciated. The kitchen is well equipped and there was nothing I needed that wasn’t there.  I found the apartment very comfortable and I would stay again.

This flat was accurate as in the pictures and description. Overall, the place was just the right size for 3 adults, although the beds felt small for 2 people. The kitchen was well-stocked, and had a lot of small appliances and pots/pans. The frig was big, and it was nice to have a washing machine. The dining table was small and cramped. The bathroom was clean and shower was nice. However, the sink faucet leaked onto the floor when turned on full stream. The sofas were comfortable and there was plenty to watch on TV. The flat is at the edge of The Meadows, and about a 20-25 min walk to the Royal Mile. There is a small supermarket at the end of the block, and a lot of interesting restaurants within a 10min walk. It was generally quiet, although there were some loud bar patrons over the weekend. The hosts were very responsive to all my questions, despite the time difference. Edinburgh is a beautiful city with interesting history and architecture!
The apartment is fantastic, big, well laid out and luxurious, I the heart of Edinburgh with shopping restaurants, castle etc etc all a 5-15min walk away.
This Airbnb has an absolutely fantastic view.

Excellent location for 4 adults & 1 baby, being on the Royal Mile; we stayed seven nights. Train station & car rental location within walking distance  ( day-rental only since no on-premise parking). Easy access to bus & Uber.  The apartment includes a modern updated bathroom, which was nice! Kitchen very adequate.   Be aware that there is a combination washer/dryer in same appliance. Living/ dining room is good size with two couches & table with 4 chairs.  Would definitely book this on our next visit to Edinburgh!

Everything was great. The location is perfect as it’s super easy to reach from the airport and from the old town. The room was very spacious and clean. Assean always replied immediately to messages and was friendly.

The flat is located at the old town and with walkable distance to all main attractions. Nicola is always helpful and did quick response to inquiries. The room is spacious and clean. The city is so beautiful and definitely we will come again! Thank you Nicola for the nice hosting.
很棒的一此入住；靠近王子街，玛莎超市购物便捷。
Great location near Grassmarket and the Royal Mile.  Great communication with host.  Good heating, appliances and facilities

Fin de séjour et retour chez Lucy avec plaisir puisque nous y avions déjà passé 2 nuits à notre arrivée.
Lucy est très arrangeante et agréable.
Bref tout est parfait.
Clean spacious rooms in a central location

We absolutely adored Ryan's flat. The location was in a residential area with groceries, restaurants, and a few great pubs within walking distance. The accommodations were unique, very clean, and so comfortable! We would stay again in a heartbeat! Thank you to Ryan for your kindness and hospitality!
Excelente, hermoso el departamento y la ubicación. Si vuelvo a Edimburgo, volvería al mismo.

Solo traveler using the flat as a reasonably priced base so I could tour different parts of Scotland. It was great.
Location:
Edinburgh Waverley is a five minute walk away. Restaurants and pubs galore with tram and bus links on the doorstep. I was checking out beforehand to do one more thing on my itinerary and was able to stash my luggage at the Premier Inn via Stasher down the street, so I could pick up my bags later.
Flat:
Utterly spacious and a lot for one person. Definitely great for families and groups of friends. I stayed in the room next to the front door. The bed was large and comfy, nice view of the street from the windows. Relatively quiet considering the location. I will say that the stairs up to the flat were not what I expected, taller and longer than the ones in my own home which is several stories so if you or a guest has issues with steps, I wouldn’t recommend and likely too much for small, younger children.
Host
Hosts were great. Kept in touch and gave clear instructions about check-in./check-out. Also had a lovely binder with instructions about the flat and trip ideas on where to visit locally and in Scotland. Let me know they were available if I had any questions.
Again, great stay and would do so again.

What a great place to stay and a brilliant host as well. Aleks was in constant communication, making sure everything was ok. Great location close to town but maybe a bit far for small children although there are buses on the doorstep. It was a fantastic base for a short stay.

The location of Raewyn’s flat is excellent and so close to the shops and cafes of Stockbridge and the Water of Leith walkway. The flat is super comfortable, very well decorated and very quiet at night, it’s a real home from home.

Appartamento in un'ottima posizione centrale. Si arriva a qualsiasi punto turistico centrale a piedi. Self check in disponibile e con spiegazione molto precisa di come farlo, per cui anche l'orario di arrivo serale non è stato un problema. Assean ha sempre risposto velocemente ai messaggi. Consigliato

Dorota was a wonderful host and super helpful and responsive. I was able to check in much sooner than the check-in time, which was a great help. Also, had a few staples (including milk for coffee) for me in the flat. Plus, Dorota came by regularly to clean the flat and change out the linens. It was a wonderful stay.
Stunning flat in central location with extremely helpful host. Would definitely stay here again
Nice flat
Fuss free stay! Central location, very clean, warm and comfortable stay. Very easy to stay in a cell with my boyfriend and we had the bathrooms right outside. We would stay here again for sure.

Greg,
Katrina and I really enjoyed Edinburgh and hope to stay in your beautiful city again one day. The window shutters were charming and not something you see where we’re from.
Jenny
Extremely clean and spacious flat in great area. Very responsive host. Great stay.
Great location for exploring Edinburgh with car parking a bonus!

Eden Locke gerçekten Edinburg’un en iyi konumlarından birindeydi. Ben 1 gün kaldım ama adeta bir ömür kalabileceğim kadar iyi bir odaydı. Resepsiyondaki çalışanlar çok kibar ve çok düzgündü. Dünyanın en güzel şehirlerinden biri olan Edinburgh’a bir daha gelirsem kesinlikle burada kalacağım. Teşekkürler!

Sylvia's place is super-convenient for travelers and tourists. Just a short walk from Edinburgh Waverley train station and right off the Royal Mile. Her flat was clean and cozy. The sofa bed was amazingly comfortable! There is also a delightful neighbor cat you might get to say hi to.

Aleksandra was a life saver for our stay in Edinburgh. We had to cancel our stay that we had booked due to a poor representation of the stay and very poor cleanliness and needed find a place to stay within hours. She messaged me back right away, got her place ready (which is her home that she Airbnb's when she is not there and she chose to accommodate us last minute and stay elsewhere) and waited for us to meet us there and show us around. She was a pleasure and a godsend and the place was absolutely stunning. It was so enjoyable to stay right in the city in a 3rd floor flat and see the beautiful views from every window. We did have someone older staying with us and he had trouble going up the four flights of stairs but he even said it was worth the struggle! Due to the last minute booking, I honestly didn't care about the price but it is definitely worth the splurge if you want an amazing location and view, and a cozy atmosphere while you are in the flat. I would highly recommend!!

Alojamiento muy bonito, limpio y con todo lo necesario para una cómoda estancia.
Ubicado en una zona residencial muy tranquila y agradable.
Muy bien comunicado con el centro a través de dos autobuses el 10 y 27, con la parada justo al lado. Supermercado Tesco a unos minutos a pie.
La comunicación con Sue ha sido fluida, rápida y siempre pendiente de nosotros.
Muy contentos de haber disfrutado de Edinburgh durante el día y llegar por la noche a este oasis a descansar.
Nuestra estancia ha sido perfecta.
Beautiful space with plenty to do in the near area. Would be helpful to have a car but if not it is not far to the nearest bus stop and buses come regularly and leave you right into the centre

It was lovely being able to come back to a such a perfect home from home, fully kitted out, self contained, comfortable studio with a small outside bistro table, after my long full days of enjoying everything I wanted including a walk in the Pentland Hills and exploring Edinburgh city.  The information and local guides provided are really useful and the welcome of requested Soya milk and gluten free bread was amazing. Gillian and Steven are perfect hosts, really responsive, friendly and have thought about the small details to anticipate the needs of travelling, including basic toiletries and kitchen supplies, condiments, a clothes dryer and even a few books to read. I'm disappointed we didn't get the chance to meet. I would definitely stay again.

Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt. Ana war äußerst freundlich, hilfsbereit und zuverlässig. Die Wohnung war sehr geräumig, sauber und gut ausgestattet, sodass wir uns von Anfang an wohlgefühlt haben.
Die Unterkunft befindet sich zwar nicht direkt im Zentrum, dennoch ist die Lage sehr praktisch: Eine Bushaltestelle und ein Einkaufsladen sind in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar, und die Altstadt ist mit dem Bus in etwa 20 Minuten bequem zu erreichen. Gleichzeitig ist die Umgebung angenehm ruhig, was den Aufenthalt besonders erholsam macht.
Besonders schön fanden wir das liebevoll vorbereitete Willkommenspaket mit Essen und Getränken – eine wirklich nette Geste. Auch die Kommunikation mit Ana war ausgezeichnet: Fragen wurden schnell beantwortet und der Kontakt war jederzeit sehr freundlich.
Wir können die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen und würden jederzeit wiederkommen.
Great place, exactly what we needed. My husband and I stayed there for almost a week and were quite happy. It was quite and a good location.

My husband & I loved our stay! The location was wonderful, the flat itself was beautiful, & we had everything we needed. There was a mix-up with how we got a hold of the keys, but our host was very responsive & everything worked out just fine. We were able to walk almost everywhere we went, or take the bus when needed. We really appreciated how many hangers were provided as well as the drawer space. The water pressure was good & the water itself wasn't too soft, (super soft water is a pet peeve of mine, so I was quite happy about that). We didn't use the kitchen much, but it was quite spacious & well stocked. The tall ceilings were a really nice feature. There isn't really any counter space in the bathroom, but the ledge under the mirror provided plenty of room for our toiletries. The one thing that would have been nice to have that was missing is a full-size mirror. Overall, we were very pleased with our stay & would love to come back in the future

Really enjoyed my stay notwithstanding the 65 steps it took to get to my attic apartment. Other than that I’d highly recommend this place. The location is great with most attractions within walking distance and surrounds are reasonably flat. Would definitely stay here again. 👍
Liegt sehr zentral und bietet alles was man für einen entspannten Aufenthalt braucht.

Wonderful stay. Good Airbnb and a nice view. Only downside (but mentioned in the text) that there is only one shower.
All in all we would definitely choose this airbnb again in Edinburgh.

Helen and Jamie were excellent hosts.  We were made welcome as soon as we arrived.  The house is amazing and all who stayed there absolutely loved it.  It was extremely well equipped, warm and comfortable.  The grounds are beautiful, our dog was in her element.  We would love to go again and really we all didn’t want to leave.  We had all gone to celebrate a family birthday and this was the icing on the cake!
Great apartment would highly recommend
thank you very much ! the room was perfect to visit Edinburgh ! Sabrina is a very nice, kind and friendly host ! Her house is very clean and tidy ! I definitely recommend it :))
Great, stylish apartment in an excellent location. Easy check in with the lock box and clear communications

Très beau petit logement super bien équipé! Trop propre!
Hôte très attentionné, nous avez laissé un petit panier de bienvenue, fromage, biscottes, petites confitures ! Café et thé disponible! Hôte a été d’un grand aide avec indication pour prendre le train pour poursuivre notre voyage vers Liverpool!
Endroit calme et bien situé!
Un seul bémol, si comme moi vous être sensible à la lumière , prévoir un loup pour dormir car le store laissé entrer la lumière du réverbère situé juste en devant de l’appartement!

Amazing space, the pictures don't do justice to the size of the apartment.  They were helpful in communication and flexible on check-out time.  Everything was tastefully furnished and we had all that we needed.
Un hôte aussi discret que réactif et bienveillant. Vous êtes chez lui et vous vous vous sentez comme chez vous.

Beautiful flat with a bus stop direct to the city center near by. Les was very helpful with showing us around town and working with us to allow us to drop off our bags before check in. I highly recommend staying here. The best place we have stayed on Airbnb!

Es war ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt. Man hat direkten Anschluss zum Holyrood Park, was sich als sehr angenehm für eine geplante Wanderung erwies. Zu Fuß waren wir in unter 10 Minuten bis zur Innenstadt.
Great place, everything was as expected!

I can’t recommend this listing highly enough. It must be the best location in the city, at the doorstep of the Castle and the Royal Mile. Olive provided courteous and prompt responses and keeps her place immaculate, stylish and is exactly as it appears in photos, with that unique and awe-inspiring view. As I was unlocking the door one evening a couple stopped me to tell me how lucky I was to be in such an ideal location. I agreed wholeheartedly. 10/10.

Vi nød virkelig at bo hos Jon! Han var hele tiden behjælpelig med informationer også selvom vi ikke selv spurgte. Han var meget hurtig til at svare. Vi måtte aflyse vores først planlægge tur grundet sygdom, og han var super forstående og hjælpsom. Senere åbnede han sit hjem op for at vi kunne booke igen, da vi skubbede turen til senere på året. Lejligheden passede perfekt til min svigermor der er dårligt gående. Kun få trapper op til lejligheden, og nem at komme rundt i indenfor.
Lejligheden ligger i et roligt kvarter forholdsvis tæt på byen, så man kan sagtens gå rundt. Ellers er det også nemt med busser.
Vi var meget tilfredse.
This apartment with the view of Edinburgh Castle is located in the old town of Edinburgh. It is a great place to stay. Stoil is easy to communicate with. He also gave useful suggestions.
Fabulous apartment,it exceeded our high expectations and we will definitely return

What a great apartment, fantastic location, near shops, restaurants, bars.. We were a group of 5 ladies, out to enjoy Edinburgh.  Entry was easy and using the key safe meant we could go out separately, and be sure a key was available to us. We all thought the bedrooms were really very good, the beds extremely comfortable, showers excellent. . The main living space was huge. Didn't cook anything but everything was there if we had needed to.  The sofas were comfortable, but gave us many a laugh as we tried to get back out of them! Not for those with mobility issues. We had a wonderful weekend and the apartment really met our needs. Many thanks.
A beautifully clean, and very central location. Great for a group wishing to visit the city

Victoria ha sido súper simpática, contestaba muy rápido y nos dio muchas indicaciones y consejos de lugares a los que ir.
Se nos retrasó mucho el vuelo y nos puso muchas facilidades para que nos fuese fácil llegar fuera la hora que fuese.
Además, su gatito Bran es monísimo.

This place was perfect for our needs and family of 6.  Axel's communication before, during and after decreased the stress.  His suggestions were excellent.  Location was great for everything we wanted to see.  We were able to cook, go out and rest when we needed it.  Best communication we have ever had with a host in our many stays.  Highly recommend!
Kaisa and Ben are both very friendly. Room was clean and tidy. My mom and i felt at home. Definitely recommend to book with them!

Vicky is so nice I wanted to start calling her 'mom' but had to stop myself.  Super gracious host who is attentive and aware of all our needs.  The "room" is more like a mansion by most European standards.  A heated bathroom floor, a second bathroom, a big screen TV with a wrap around couch and giant bedroom.  Bed was super comfy, Vicky with her motherly kindness even left us milk and cookies!  This is without question, the best place we have stayed at while using airbnb.  Thanks Vicky!  Oh, and the airport is only about 4 minutes away down country roads.  Highly recommended.

Location was away from the City Centre but still fantastic for what we wanted. Great restaurants, good selection of pubs and shops. Quiet back street. Just perfect. Would not hesitate in booking again and recommending it to friends and family.
Eleanor’s place is very central yet quiet, even during the last weekend of the festival. Eleanor was a lovely host who was able to accommodate our early check in. We would stay here again.

Rachel's place is wonderful.
In a great location so close to the city but really quiet.
The apartment is brilliantly decorated with loads of quirky items
Chocolates in every room was a lovely touch.
Communication was great and key pick up was very easy.

Cafes and restaurants just around the corner.
Loved Edinburgh- beautiful City

Heel fijn appartement in het nieuwere gedeelte van de stad, maar op loopafstand van het oude centrum. Leuke wijk met genoeg horecagelegenheden en openbaar vervoer in de buurt.

Martin is een zeer vriendelijke host die moeite doet om duidelijke instructies te geven en bijvoorbeeld flexibel te zijn met inchecken en geeft lokale tips.
Zeker een aanrader als je naar Edinburgh gaat!

If I could give more than 5 stars, I would! It felt like we were in a little oasis away from the noise of the city, but so conveniently close to everything and in a wonderful little neighborhood. We will most certainly be back if we find ourselves back in this beautiful city!

Fantastic flat with an incredible view. the photos don't do it justice. The unit is spacious and nicely appointed.
Very comfortably furnished, lots of books, games and a fully stocked kitchen that included sugar, coffee & tea.
I'll definitely be back

Liam’s place was perfect for my trip. Just spend one night and one day in Edinburgh. Location is walkable from Haymarket station, a good station to catch the tram to city centre and opposite way to airport, as well as trains. Check it was easy. Bed was comfy. My trip was quick but this was perfect for my stay.
Cozy and convenient location. 10-15 drive to the city center. Owner is friendly.
Una estancia perfecta, en una ubicación muy buena y muy tranquila. Recomiendo totalmente este alojamiento

Great little flat in the centre of Edinburgh’s New Town. Good pubs right on the doorstep, easy walk to everywhere and never needed to think about getting public transport. Nice living room, comfy beds and a lovely kitchen. We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend!
Vi var veldig fornøyde med leiligheten. Den var godt utstyrt og lå i et fredelig område. Anbefaler den gjerne til andre.
Great host and accommodation, perfect location.
We had a great stay at Maggie's place in Edinburgh! A warm welcome at a fantastic location in the city. I would definitely reccomend staying here and look forward to coming back!

maisonnette, très bien située. À 15 minutes du centre-ville par le tram. Tout le confort est proposé. Petit déjeuner fourni digne d’un quatre étoiles. Les hotes sont d’une extrême gentillesse et aux petits soins. À recommander les yeux fermés.

Lovely apartment, as described , quiet area but only minutes away from bars restaurants and cafes and a great view of Edinburgh city from the bedrooms and living room balcony . Dina is really helpful and quick to respond to any questions we had . We would definitely stay here again when we come back to Edinburgh again . Thankyou :0)

Natalia is a super sweet host. And the place is quite central and on the main street . Convenient to all the tourism spots, restaurants and grocery. The room is really spacious and has everything you need. Highly recommended!

We had a great time staying at Elizabeth’s place. It was clean, cosy and full of nice amenities ! Elizabeth was extremely responsive and easy to contact for any needs we had. Overall a great stay and I would definitely stay again !

Hannah's flat was ideal for our weekend stay. Had everything you need, very clean. Great location, we had a lovely walk through Holyrood Park which takes you out at the Royal Mile. Perfect little find, would highly recommend. Thank you :)

The beds were so comfortable and the location ideal for exploring Grassmarket and the Royal Mile, literally a short walk to both. Ideal location for a visit. Fiona was upfront about noise from the bar downstairs and even provides ear plugs. We used them and were able to get enough sleep. Amenities were superior to most AirB-n-Bs. Great value, responsive host, and excellent place to stay. Highly recommend.

Lovely place to stay and only a 15 min straight forward walk into the city centre … even my 13yr old didn’t complain going backwards and forwards!!
Quiet, comfortable and convenient with a lovely ambience and funky decor. Took my middle aged brain a little bit to understand how to connect to the projector but once we did it was fab and a big comfy sofa to boot.
Would def come back next time in Edinburgh .. :-)

La zona cucina e living dell’appartamento erano accoglienti e ben accessoriati, purtroppo la zona notte che si trovava in basso con finestre ermeticamente chiuse a chiave, dunque non apribili rendevano l’ambiente privo di ossigeno e soprattutto le pareti erano piene di muffa e umidità e tutto ciò rendeva l’aria insalubre e irrespirabile.
