Sicuri della vostra accoglienza, cordiali saluti.

Lewis’ house was perfect. Within 15 minutes of anything we wanted to do. Amazing views of Edinburgh Castle and surrounding sights. Perfect location for us to be able to sightsee and the house was very cozy for nights in to relax after walking all day. Would definitely recommend staying here.
Lovely flat, great layout kitchen to living room. great TV wifi etc. Nice homely feel. Comfy bed. Great Sofa. Location is great for the price, and it's on several useful bus routes.

Great place to stay in Edinburgh. Everything was just as described, the location was really central and convenient and the hosts were really helpful and quick to reply to ensure you have a lovely stay. Would definitely stay again when I'm next in Edinburgh.

My husband and myself stayed here for 3 nights with our 3 children. We loved it. The location was perfect for walking around and sightseeing. The apartment was beautifully decorated and very clean. The hosts were very friendly and helpful.

We had a wonderful stay at Holly's place during our family trip to Scotland. The accommodation was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and well-equipped for our group. The location was excellent and made it easy for us to explore the surrounding attractions.
The check-in process was smooth, and Holly was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The children especially enjoyed the experience, and the property provided a relaxing base after our busy days of sightseeing.
Thank you, Holly, for your hospitality. We had a memorable stay and would happily recommend your place to other families visiting the area. We would definitely consider staying here again in the future.

We had a wonderful time at Catherine's place in Edinburgh. Located in a peaceful area and within a walking distance to the city centre. would recommend staying here to a friend, would love to come back again!
There is no doubt, Taya is great host in Edinbra. Do not hesitate staying with her. We highly reccomended. The truths that location is so important in Edinbra, this place is so close center.

Great location - very close to lots of cafes and restaurants and only a short walk to central Edinburgh! Was perfect to stay at while I was running in the Half Marathon! The start line was a stones throw away!
Lovely house and Mary was such a wonderful host! Very clean room and she left us lots of snacks which was a really nice touch!
Thank you for having us Mary!

Thank you so much for everything, like I was so happy staying here. They went above and beyond to be helpful and also providing things that wouldn’t usually be in an Airbnb. Honestly one of the best I’ve ever stayed in. Thank you again
Very well located , clean and bright. Stayed with 3 adult children .

Fantastic newly renovated (just about complete) unit in the heart of Edinburgh. Traveled as a family of 2 adults and 2 children. Roomy and easy to navigate. Central to transportation and amenities. Highly recommended.
Wonderful appartment near the centre and very clean and cozy. Nikki reacts fast and provides you with a lot of useful tips.
Very clean and recently equipped and well appointed flat in pleasant area new to us but lively with good shopping and at least one very good restaurant.

I just want to say how amazing Viktor and Hana were . Throughout all of this they always made sure we were okay and if ever we needed anything or had any questions . Very quick at responding to anything I had to ask. Their home was absolutely amazing and lovely,  charming and cozy. Beautiful location and very easy to get into the town centre. I could not have asked for a better place . I fell In love from the second I walked into their lovely home .
Great location, super friendly, everything we were after

This would've otherwise been a lovely spot if it was not for the poor check-in process. We arrived and could not get the key in the lock to turn. I will add - there were 4 professional adults trying so it was not a "user error". We rang the concierge service, who sent us a video showing us how to turn the key - we tried & failed for almost two hours. The fact that they have a video showing how to turn the key indicates that the lock is faulty and there has been a problem before. They offered for us to walk to Edinburgh Castle (???) to pick up a spare key, but refused to send someone out to give us the key. The purpose of our stay was to get a good nights sleep before a road trip up North the following day. However, we eventually only gained entry after midnight. Whilst we were offered £60 as compensation, the handling of the experience by the call centre was absolutely poor. The flat itself was as described.
Beautiful home and lovely place to stay will be back Ben was very helpful

La chambre proposée par Louise est très chaleureuse et accueillante. Les petites attentions ne manquent pas et Louise a pensé à tout pour nous faire passer un agréable séjour. Elle nous a d ailleurs accueilli en personne pour nous donner des conseils et nous souhaiter la bienvenue. Enfin, le logement est idéalement situé à coté des lignes de bus et nous avons adoré notre séjour à Édimbourg qui est une ville magnifique avec une multitude de possibilité de randonnées (en villes ou sur les nombreuses collines).
We loved the stay at this property and an we are planing to return next time .

So nice, we stayed twice! My family returned to Isaac and Derek’s place a year after our first stay, and we plan to be back! This place and these hosts cannot be beat. The apartment is gorgeous, modern, and perfectly located in the heart of the Royal Mile. And Isaac and Derek are the loveliest and most accommodating hosts, who provide tons of recommendations and generous hospitality. Highly recommend and can’t wait to visit again!

This cozy apartment on the Royal Mile was PERFECT for my time in town. It was conveniently located, which made it easy to drop off my shopping or duck out of the rain for a moment without serious interruption to my day. It is also 100% as advertised, which is great especially since what sold me was the art work and secret bedroom! When I checked in, the previous guest had disconnected the lights, but David was so helpful and easily accessible and fixed the issue over text immediately. David is a great host who takes care to ensure his guests have what they need and are settling in nicely. I would highly recommend this stay to anyone visiting Edinburgh!

This is a wonderful studio apartment. The location can't be beat! It is central to so many things, great restaurant options and pubs. As is mentioned, there are quite a few stairs to walk up to the studio -- if stairs are an issue for you, also, it is right on the Royal Mile and at times you can hear some street noise, but we never found it the the point of being a bother.
Fantastisk hyggelig og god service av alle som jobbet der🙂
Marcus was very welcoming and location was perfect! Overall, great stay!

Susan’s place was very clean and beautiful. Everything was very comfortable and she was very quick and responsive to all our questions.
Thanks!

The room was very good, strategic location, to all the attractions away from the walk can be reached ~ The landlord is very serious and very enthusiastic, prepare a detailed map for us，ask about our needs, and prepare breakfast for us ~ is really a great experience, next time will be ordered here
Great spot close to the train station for a short stay.

The place was super central and in the middle of everything. Although off a main road, the unit was inward of the building facing a courtyard so the noise level was very minimal compared to expectations. The host was very responsive and provided us with a perfect sanctuary away from the madness of the festival while still being in the heart of it all. An absolute perfect stay for anyone looking to experience Edinburgh.
Great little place in a fantastic location. Good for couples or group of friends.

Très bel appartement cosy, très bien équipé, à 30min à pied du centre ville mais avec de nombreux bus également.
Notre séjour s'est très bien passé, merci à eilidh et Matthew.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Laila’s place. Laila and her family were very welcoming and their home is beautiful.  The room was very private and didn’t feel like a room in their home, thanks to a private bathroom. The room was spotless and in a brilliant location. We’d certainly stay here again!

We could not ask for a better location for going around Edinburgh. Literally go down the apartment steps into the nice shops, restaurants and bars of royal mile. Very clean and host was very helpful.  Perfect for 3 guests. It must be noted that there are a lot of steps (for someone with lots of luggage). Highly recommended.

Communication with Stuart was fantastic! He was super helpful.
We were travelling with 2 young children and all our extra needs were accomodated
The apartment is roomy and beds super comfy showers great.
Great location so handy with the Grass Market and Princess street, small
supermarket 2 mins away, Lothian Road 2 mins away where there are plenty of nice restaurants
Quite a few stairs up but thats a plus as there is less noise the higher up you are
Would highly recommend this lovely apartment

Helen est une hôte très accueillante et réactive. Elle s’adapte à nos besoins. L’appartement est très confortable, conforme aux photos. Le quartier est calme, facile d’accès et très mignon. Notre séjour a été très agréable. Thank you Helen!!
Anne‘s a very kind host. We arrived late at night which wasn’t an issue. Her porridge in the morning was perfect for the cold weather.
A good location,  beds very comfortable nice to have an outside space for the dog.
地理位置离爱丁堡火车站、市中心都很近。厨房吃的都任你使用，还帮忙拎行李。
Really lovely place, looked exactly like the photos. Very clean and comfortable. Excellent communication. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others. Thank you!
Great location and comfortable space. Ollie was very proactive in his communication.

We had a lovely stay here,
The room was to a very high standard and there were so many nice touches to make you feel welcome
The little extras were great such as toiletries, use of umbrellas, milk in the fridge. Decent sheets and towels. I would highly recommend Dunc and Dee as hosts.
Great place.
A hospedagem atendeu completamente as expectativas. excelente apartamento e localização. bem servido inclusive de supermercado. todas as instalações funcionando perfeitamente. Recomendo fortemente.
This apartment is in a great location. It is spacious and well appointed. We enjoyed having this as a base for our work & holiday week in Edinburgh. Handy to restaurants, pubs and transport.

Great place to stay for a weekend, or even more! It couldn't be more central, at the heart of Edinburgh Old Town. The flat is clean, well equipped, very practical. There are many shops around, as well as restaurants, bars and typical pubs. I warmly recommend!

Aida’s flat was exactly as described. It was spotless and comfortable. The location is outstanding in new town. We felt right at home. It was perfect for our family.
It was nice to greet Aida in person. She is a warm and wonderful person.
This was so central to everything! The place was clean and had everything you might need!

Andrew was nice.
He allowed us to keep our luggage as we arrived earlier. He was kind and helpful.
Lovely apartment. Everything you could need in it. Excellent location. We had a super stay and would certainly come again.

Joli logement plutôt spacieux situé dans la banlieue d’Edimbourg, à quelques centaines de mètres de la mer (plage et accès à une île à marée basse) et à deux pas de la rivière Almond, une jolie balade à faire à l’écart du tumulte de la ville. Parfait aussi pour se rendre au centre-ville avec le bus 47 dont un arrêt est situé à deux cents mètres à peine du logement. Il passe en général toutes les 20 minutes et en 25 minutes, on rejoint Princes Street ou en 40 minutes Grassmarket/Victoria Street ; le top.
Les avions passent très souvent au-dessus de la maison mais nous nous y sommes vite habitués. Donc, nous conseillons cette adresse très pratique.

We had a great time in Edinburgh and the apartment really helped. It's a cosy apartment which was big enough for the four of us. Rachel arranged everything perfectly and we had no issues finding or entering the place. The fact that there were 3 sets of keys was also quite useful. Do not hesitate to book, as the location is excellent and property itself as well.
Great apartment brilliant setting close enough to amenities but quiet at night. Brilliant communication,would definitely stay again

This place is fantastic!  The apartment is so clean and has a cool view of the castle from the bedroom nook. We did not rent a car and got around by foot. So glad we stayed here. Great amenities. Washer and dryer worked great. Would stay here again.
Great stay, highly recommend!
Perfect location for a weekend exploring Edinburgh. The flat was modern, spacious, bright and clean. Dele was welcoming and helpful.

A wonderful, quiet place away from the hustle and bustle of the city, surrounded by nature, a peaceful place ... And inside we had a large living room with a fridge, microwave and things that you could eat for breakfast, as well as drink coffee or tea ... Very comfortable bed, spacious bathroom and accessories for  preparation, such as a super make-up mirror or even an ironing board and iron.  You have everything you need here, the next time I visit Edinburgh I will definitely come back here.  I highly recommend!
I enjoyed staying there
Lovely flat and really well located. The tapas restaurant around the corner is amazing

Stayed here with my friend and my mother. When we arrived at the flat, Eleanor was there to greet us. She gave us the warmest welcome ever, and gave us a great introduction to Edinburgh. The location of the flat is absolutely fantastic, right next to Grass Market and directly beneath the Edinburgh castle. Getting around on foot was easy and there was plenty to see and do nearby. Loved my stay here. Can't say enough about what a great experience it was for my mom and I.
Wonderful flat with easy access to most of the city and an incredible view of the castle!
Nice b&b Close to Edinburgh City:)

It is a wonderfully decorated house with a landlord who has great taste. The house is clean and tidy and it has everything you need. Also, a big thank you to Kornelia for decorating the house with care, preparing balloons and champagne for us and even a birthday card! We were pleasantly surprised and happy 🥳 Everything was perfect, despite some non-human uncontrollable factors that happened during the process, Kornelia was very enthusiastic and responsible, she was friendly, kind and beautiful! Highly recommend this house!🥰🤩🥳💕
Great stay in a great location. Be prepared for the spiral staircase - large bag not recommended. Very stylish comfortable apartment in a historic building

Beautiful and comfortable!  Great location. So many shops and cafes on grass market street and so close to castle. Very safe building which I felt was important.  David was right on with replying to questions and check in info.

A group of 5 stayed at this apartment for 4 nights. We requested and were given 3 sets of keys. It has a great view of Arthur's Seat. This place is within walking distance of many points of interest. If walking isn't your thing, Uber rides to and from the city centre were cheap! The place was clean, tidy, and spaceous. Coffee, tea, bread, and milk were available to us. Wi-fi was included. Fully functional kitchen and washing machine. The host was friendly. The floors and the toilet flush were really loud, but I overall recommend this place!
Super emplacement pour profiter des animations du centre d'Edimburg. Top. Le garage est un plus.
Very comfortable and clean! Great location!
This is a great flat with a lot of room, in a nice location in Glasgow.  The kitchen is well-stocked, and it’s a great place to explore Glasgow from.

Prima woning en locatie. Met Uber in 8 minuten in het centrum - New en Old Town.
Wel wat weinig handdoeken voor vijf dagen.

Stephanie’s apartement was a great choice! It was easy to conquer Edinburgh from here! As both bedrooms have its own bathroom, it gave us the comfort we expected. I highly recommend it if climbing a few floors works for you after a long day in the city!
Lovely apartment in a quiet but smart part of Edinburgh. Easy walk in to town and just 15 minutes by foot to the station.
Great place close to Royal mile and station. We found it really easy to commute.
Fab place to stay. Met our expectations and catered for all of our needs. Would highly recommend. Clean and tidy and great sheets!
The hosts are wonderful and make you feel right at home.

Agies Unterkunft war perfekt für unseren Trip mit zwei Jungs (11 & 13Jahre) nach Edinburgh. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und geräumig, die Lage perfekt für alle Ausflüge. Es gibt zahlreiche tolle Restaurants und Pubs in unmittelbarer Nähe der Wohnung. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Agie hat tolle Empfehlungen gegeben und war jederzeit erreichbar. Danke für drei tolle Tage!

Great location & easily walkable to city sites. Very convenient. The kitchen well kitted out although we didn't use it choosing to eat out while there. WIFI worked well.
We found some aspects of the unit tired & in our opinion it could use an update - paint & minor esthetic repairs. The bathrooms definitely need work. The double bed in the larger room is small & not sure would work for 2 people especially as you roll into the middle. Master bath shower nozzle a challenge - could have been user error on my part but I never got it to work. The towels were small & 1 was ripped. The TV was also small. Finally, while the rules let you know you are on your own for toilet paper we were only provided 1/3 of a roll & had to purchase more - subsequently told we should have let Gordon know.
We had no issues with noise despite other reviews & Gordon noting it could be an issue; however, it was quiet when we were there.
Communications was good & the meet & greet appreciated.
John’s place is great! Lots of space and centrally located to new town places in walkable distance. I would stay here again.

Excellent two bedroom flat located meters from great pubs and restaurants. Fifteen minute walk to the Ocean Terminal shopping center and movie theater. Little Sainsbury grocer around the corner for basic foodstuffs. Clean. Excellent response from property managers.
Great, spacious apartment in brilliant location. Close walking distance to all attractions, and being able to park the car in the garage was a huge bonus.

We were happy with the Airbnb! It was really central, you could reach everything sight worthy in around 15 to 20 minutes plus on the actual street of the Airbnb were many delicious restaurants, cool bars and supermarkets. The communication with Sue and Grant was very friendly, uncomplicated and quick. They made sure that we were happy and everything was alright. We loved that even though it was a busy street, they offered earplugs for light sleepers like us so that we wouldn't get disturbed by any outside noises. The Airbnb was really clean overall. We would recommend this apartment :)

avantages, parking gratuit sur place, station essence juste à côté , tranquilité,tesco à 25m, magnifique parc immense à proximité
on peut aller à pied dans le centre , environ 30mn , mais c'est un peu fatiguant, surtout pour rentrer après la journée

My sister and I really enjoyed our stay at Ally’s flat. She welcomed us with lots of great recommendations and tips. She made us feel very comfortable like her place was our own! I enjoyed our conversations and her hospitality. Would recommend!!! Thanks Ally :).
Ps. The freshly squeezed orange juice was a plus!

muy agradable la zona y el apartamento impecable. realmente nos sentimos como en casa.
mi hija y yo solo tenemos palabras de agradecimiento.

Andrews property was beautifully furnished. The beds were very comfy  and the towels white and soft. The location was very convenient and safe with a community garden opposite to walk our dog at night and in the early morning which made it especially feel safe for me.

Ben's place was actually better than the photos.Lots of light from 3 large windows in the living area. It was in an excellent location with a supermarket right next door, and a few steps from "the Shore" on the "waters of Leith" with lots of great restaurants, pubs, and shops. There was easy access to transportation with buses right on Commercial street and Tram within a 5 minute walk. The kitchen was well furnished with full fridge, dishwasher, full oven, coffee maker, toaster etc. and although I did not need to use, clothes washer in kitchen, and dryer in hall closet. bath was immaculate. would return again gladly.
Dick

I just returned from a 4 day stay at Edinburgh. When you choose to stay at Manigeh’s place, you choose for a nice place with a homely atmosphere. The room is in the basement of a big house in a nice and quite neighborhood. Manigeh and her partner were very helpful with providing all the necessary information and support I needed. It is a low budget place of course, so don’t expect something very posh or luxurious. It offers the right value for the money. I choose this place mainly for its location outside the businesses and noise of the Old Town. Still, everything is within walking distance or can be reached by public transport easily.

If your looking for a home away from home this is the place - especially near a play park which the children loved. And a Lidl only 10 minutes walk away or two stops on the bus
Lovely location, not overlooked and larger than you would think.
Happily visit again
It was value for money and easy to get to town
Beautiful place and wonderful location.  Victor is a wonderful host!

Pete and Laura were a really nice host. They communicated really well and make sure I was already with finding the address and got comfortable with my stay. Everything was nice and clean and very cozy. They also have complimentary coffee, tea and some snacks. Also their cat is so cute and very affectionate. If you allergic cat please let the host know!

Lovely place to stay - fantastic location - lots of good restaurants around. Not far to walk to anywhere in town and a stone’s throw from the castle which was great.
Unfortunately at the minute there’s a large building site directly in front of the property so you tend to get woken at around 7am every morning by the builders. Not too bad if you want to get out and do things with your day though.
Very clean and a very sweet touch with teas/coffees and a pint of milk left for us when we arrived :)
All in all a very pleasant stay!

We had a great tine at #4. It is right on Rose Street, 3 floors above the Elements pub.  Rose St is pedestrian only and has lots of shops, restaurants and pubs.  It was nice weather and the streetside seating was out and in use. The back bedroom was relatively quiet, but the front has a fair bit of laughter drifting up from the street. It didn’t really bother us and added to the charm.  The only downsides were all the stairs ( no lift) and the shower hot water which was not working well. I’m sure Lynne will get right on that as we could see that keeping things up is a priority for her. The clothes washer was a big plus and worked well. We traveled from the airport EDI on the bus which stops at the Princes Street only a couple blocks away. The bus station for all the day tours is an easy 4-5 block walk away, so this flat is well positioned. We are glad we stayed here instead of Old Town which is just stupid crowded with tourists. Two thumbs up!

Soggiorno impeccabile. La stanza era grande e pulita e con tutto l’occorrente per il nostro soggiorno. Martin è stato un ospite accogliente, gentile e disponibile e i consigli che ci ha dato hanno contribuito a rendere migliore la nostra permanenza a Edimburgo. Anche gli spazi comuni erano molto puliti e dotati di tutto il necessario. La posizione è ottima per visitare Edimburgo, il centro è facilmente raggiungibile a piedi e la zona è ben servita dai mezzi (l’autobus 100 porta direttamente all’aeroporto). Super consigliato!

Greg's flat is beautiful. It was the perfect setting for a quick trip to Edinburgh. The location made it very easy to see the best parts of the city, right outside the front door. My boyfriend and I loved it here. We will be coming back for sure!

We had to find a place in the neighbourhood, and Joyce's home turned out as a wonderful surprise. She is welcoming and helpful. The room is very nice and super clean. Be careful with the enormous breakfast !
The place is beautiful and has everything you need , great location and excellent WiFi ... no negatives at all . Great place great host
非常好！干净整洁，东西一应俱全。房东人也很好。只是位置的话，去市中心可能需要坐bus。
By far the best place I’ve stayed for the price, 100% recommend it!
their place is full of peace we loved the interior of the house ....it's a beautiful house and George and Barbara are super responsive.thanku for hosting us will again visit definitely.

This place is perfect if you want to stay in central Edinburgh! The location couldn’t be better. Flat was clean and check in and out so easy.

Would stay again!

A great place with a great host!
Close to everywhere and easy to access the public transportation.
Clean place, amenities in good condition, great location, very responsive hosts

You’re in for a treat. This place looked good on the computer screen (loved the crown molding;) but it’s even more perfect than I could have guessed. Excellent location, a few minutes walk through a beautiful green park and you’re in the center of everything.
Maia is such an organized, thoughtful and good-humored person. You’re in good hands if you stay here.
Abi and the cats were a treat. We loved our stay in her flat and felt well welcomed! Great area too.

Nicole’s place is brilliantly positioned to enjoy Edinburgh, really central with everything walkable (also less than 800m from the main train and coach stations)
The apartment was ideal for two couples, really spacious with everything required.
Nicole is an excellent host, proactive and responds within an hour when there are question to be answered.
The apartment is excellent value and will ensure the best can be made of a stay In Edinburgh
Appartement conforme aux attentes très bien situé.  Je recommande aux voyageurs

Designed with so much style!! We loved our stay. Bed and shower were comfortable. A patio to enjoy coffee in the morning. The bus stops right outside that takes you to main city center in less than 10 mins. The tram is also nearby. They even left us breakfast items such as cereal, croissants, coffee, yogurt. Highly recommend!

영국은 숙소가 전반적으로 추운거같습니다. 다소 추웠다는 점과 메인관광지와 다소 거리가 있었다는 점(걸어서 다니기에는 먼거리) 말고는 매우 좋았습니다.
실수로 옷을 놓고 왔는데, 그에 대한 답변 속도가 많이 늦어 다소 실망스러웠습니다. 개인적 실수 부분이라 굳이 탓할 내용이 아닐수 있으나 런던 숙소로 옷을 보내주었다면 매우 감동했을거 같습니다.
Spot on. Perfect host. Very accommodating. Great place for a stopover

We had a lovely break at Viv's flat, which is ideally located for exploring Edinburgh's Old Town and the Royal Mile. The kitchen had everything we needed for cooking the occasional meal, though we mostly ate out in the many excellent restaurants nearby. In particular, Mary's Milk Bar, just a few minutes down the road, is a must-visit for gorgeous gelato! The flat was more than big enough for the two of us, with a comfy bed and warm shower. We'd certainly recommend it to other travellers!

We fell in love with the house we called home immediately upon stepping into it. Didn't expect it to be so spacious and so cozy, I literally screamed of joy when I first saw the kitchen! So spacious and clean! Very close to the Murrayfield Gas Rugby Stadium - the main purpose we were in Edinburgh, yet not too far from Edinburgh City Centre.
I have personally recommended Allan's place to my family & friends and would return and stay longer the next time.
Allan is very helpful and "friendly" in guiding us about the house and I am sure, he is as friendly in person.
Thanks, Allan, amazing home!

We had a wonderful time at this stylish place.
It’s easy to get there by bus but also a nice walk home after dinner.
Ruhige, saubere Wohnung die alles hatte was man braucht, super Lage!
Super zentral für eine Nacht in Edinburgh. Wir kommen gerne für einen längeren Aufenthalt wieder.
Very comfortable, good location, already booked again!
Super lovely and accomodating hosts and great location, easy walking distance to shops and public transport in a nice quiet suburb. Definitely recommend!

Yvonne's flat was perfectly located and really spacious for 2 people. Quick walk from the Royal Mile, Arthur's Seat, train station/downtown and in a charming neighborhood. I'd definitely stay here again!
Amazing little place to stay, very comfortable and Nell is really friendly. Perfect location

A little gem in the perfect location! Martin's apartment is just what you need. Warm and bright with lovely decore. The livingroom had the most comfortable sofas, a good size TV, and working wood fireplace (Wow!) Plus the view of Carlton Hill was like a postcard.
The bedrooms were also decorated so nicely, with soft colors and comfortable beds. Plenty of storage space for clothes.
The kitchen was bright and cheery with big windows and pretty blue/white decore. All the pots, pans, utensil items you need to bake, cook or just make a snack were provided, and a picnic basket that held sparkling water and goodies! A tray of coffee with a large tea selection was waiting for our arrival.
The bathroom was immaculate (As was the whole apartment) with a large, deep tub and well-working shower.
Martin was a wonderful host. All questions were responded to right away. He met us at the apartment and even let us leave our bags while it was being freshened up (We had arrived on an early flight). A delightful fellow!
The location of this apartment is perfect. It is easy walking distance to City Center, Carlton Hill and Old Town. The bus stops are one block from the front door and you can catch a bus to anywhere in Edinburgh. Eateries, grocery shops, movie theater are all within a few blocks. We took the tram from the airport and it left us off five minutes away from the apartment.
Thanks Martin for being such a good host and providing this little bit of "Home" in the best city in the world, Edinburgh!

Calim was an exceptional host! Great location, all the tips and sights were laid out, super easy to check in and find, and Calim was very responsive and always eager to help. If touring Edinburgh is the top of your list, you CANNOT beat this location. Thank you again Calim!
Very central but because of this the place is a bit noisy at night.
Great place for groups, clean and great space for socialising

Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral zum Stadtzentrum und jeder Menge Sehenswürdigkeiten! Zudem ist sie vom Flughafen aus äußerst einfach mit der Straßenbahn zu erreichen. Das Apartment war sehr sauber und voll ausgestattet!
Die Straße vorm Haus ist recht groß und laut, nachts ließ es sich aber dennoch gut schlafen, außerdem findet man alles, was man braucht in unmittelbarer Nähe. Vom Erscheinungsbild des Gebäudes und des Treppenhauses sollte man sich bei der Ankunft nicht täuschen lassen ;) die Wohnung ist makellos!
Wir würden sicher wiederkommen!
Lovely place

Phenomenal location for our large family to enjoy Edinburgh’s Old Town! Spotless apartment with everything you could possibly need, just steps from great restaurants, cafes and all the city’s sites. Would absolutely come back and stay here!

Anne is an amazing hostess!  So friendly and helpful giving suggestions as to where to eat and how to get around in her town. Her space was so very accommodating and she even prepared a lite breakfast for us before we left for the day.

The apartment is in an excellent area of Edinburgh with easy access (walking and public transit) to practically everything.  The apartment itself was great - clean, comfortable, etc. etc.  We would definitely stay there again!

Fantastic stay - location was within walking distance to so much including great food. The neighbors are super friendly and you felt more like a local than a visitor.
Dawn & Natalie were super responsive and had lots of recommendations!

The five star ratings for this unit are well-deserved. Mark was an excellent and unobtrusive host and we’d stay again in his apartment without hesitation. The two-floor unit is very conveniently located on the Royal Mile, but is quite quiet. It is clean and in excellent condition, and the room itself is large and very comfortable. We’d enthusiastically recommend this unit to anyone looking to visit Edinburgh.
Great location and easily walkable to the Royal Mile and Castle. Bus and trams are quite close. Great accommodations for a family or group of friends.
The appartment was very well appointed, especially the kitchen. The bed in the second bedroom sagged in the middle somewhat but that was a minor issue in a very comfortable appartment.

This stay was excellent. The apartment is beautiful with a great view and close to everything I wanted to see. There are many restaurants just out the door and the area is very interesting to walk and see the sights. I would surely return.
This is a must see for every one. The flat is amazing and impeccable and beyond words really. Great hosts, great location and amazing stay absolutely perfect will definitely return xxx

Lovely cosy and comfortable apartment in fabulous area. Close to city centre and the sights and also with lots of bars, restaurants and other amenities very close by. Very responsive and helpful host. Parking can be a bit of a challenge so leave a little bit of extra time to find a good spot nearby.
Perfect place for a city break in Edinburgh. Fantastic location :)

Absolutely fantastic apartment, one of the best we've ever stayed in. Immaculate, stylish, incredibly spacious. Extremely comfy beds. Centrally located so we walked everywhere, lots of nice bars and restaurants within a few mins walk. Lots of attention to detail in the furnishings and fixtures, all very high quality, and the food left for us was much appreciated. The Xmas tree was also a lovely touch. The only slightly negative thing I could say is that the sofa wasn't the comfiest, but that's a really minor quibble. Would highly recommend this apartment and would definitely stay again.
Great short stay, Martin was really informative and helpful. Room was clean and welcoming in a great location. Would recommend!
One of the finest air Bnbs on our trip to the UK.  Clean and relatively spacious and attractive. Best kitchen.  Many thanks!

An amazing apartment in a great location, a short walk to the Royal Mile and city centre. We were able to park our car on the front for free all weekend too.
It was lovely to go back to a hot bath and cosy apartment after a long day Christmas shopping. We enjoyed watching the squirrels run around the garden in the morning too.
The hosts were very welcoming and went out of their way to make our stay comfortable. We will definitely be back.
This flat was a dream! So beautiful and spacious and exactly what we needed.
The location was ideal for us and allowed us to explore Edinburgh easily. Flat was in excellent condition and can highly recommend a stay here.
enjoyed stay clean tidy down side no kettle in room to make a drinklong stay when you have to wait for a cafe to open in morning to get a drink

The flat was really clean, bright and airy when i arrived and it was is a great location for Holyrood Park and a short walk up the royal mile into the centre. The amazing weather was also a fantastic bonus.
Thank you
Jan

The property was right in the centre of Edinburgh within a 20 minute walking distance from the Royal Mile and the Castle and closer to many other places of interest. There were plenty of places to eat nearby.  Previous reviews have mentioned noise, we didn't find it a problem.
As a birding family, we thoroughly enjoyed the wildlife and the  wonderful paths for walking.  The boathouse was cozy and comfortable.

What a lovely flat! It was spacious, comfortable and so convenient! Plus, it’s surrounded by the best restaurants! The Royal Mile is about a 10 minute walk away. We really enjoyed our time in Edinburgh!
Amanda is a great host too! She’s so accommodating and a great communicator! We will definitely come back!

Sunshine from the window into the house ， felling warm and happy，I like stay at house , cooking and drinking coffee.
It is easy to go to the center of city and also be very close to Tesco supper store, so easy to buy what you want.
House decoration is simple but be more good taste。
See you next time~

So glad we choose this fabulous apartment for our first Airbnb experience! Excellent communication from initial booking to checking out, with clear information and instructions provided. Apartment itself was lovely and provided a wonderfully comfortable space to spend our 5 day Christmas break with the kids. Very well equipped, with lots of finishing touches that made the stay a home from home. Beds were super comfortable which meant we all had a wonderful sleep each night. Location is ideal, with an amazing view of Arthur’s Seat, plenty of free on street parking and only a short walk from the city centre. Cannot fault the apartment or the host one bit. Would gladly book again.

We stayed at Thomas's place for a long family weekend before Christmas. Thomas was proactive and answered all my queries quickly and efficiently.
The location was ideal for us as we love to walk. And it really is the only way to enjoy Edinburgh. However, buses are readily available for those who are unable to walk far.
We followed the recommendations and found the best eateries for brunch (great food) and later pizza (excellent).
The flat itself was perfect. Warm, comfortable beds, great view from bedroom windows. I woke early to the most beautiful sunrise from the hills.
The photos don't do the flat justice, it was perfect for 4 people. We visit Edinburgh a lot and will no doubt be using Thomas's place again.

This beautiful flat is located just a short 5 min walk from Waverly Station, perfect if you are arriving via rail. The flat has everything you need for your time in Edinburgh. Just off Princess street, easy access to all the major attractions including The Royal Mile and all major bus tours. Ross and Hayley are amazing hosts welcoming us with shortbread and whiskey upon arrival. Their communication is spot on with responses to our questions immediately. We highly recommend this flat for a couple, or family of 4. We will definitely book again.

This location is ideal for a couple visiting Edinburgh with a few days to explore that want good sized accommodation for Edinburgh at a reasonable price. Host is great, communication and arrival great.

Tarik was a fantastic host. He was in contact all the way through the booking to ensure I had all the information I needed to make my stay as easy as possible. He was helpful in making sure I had the breakfast I wanted available. He made me feel very much at home and relaxed in his flat. The room was spacious, clean and comfortable wth good facilities like wifi and digital TV. The flat is in a great area, very convienent for getting into the centre of Edinburgh. Great stay!
Great location and a lovely, clean apartment. Good kitchen with well stocked utensils.
excellent place to stay near to all the stations in Edinburgh.

We only had a brief stay at Gary's apartment but we felt safe, welcomed and comfortable. The apartment is lovely and in a good neighborhood in Leith that is well connected to buses and trams that will take you around the city. Gary was so accommodating and flexible and a wonderful conversationalist. He allowed us to drop off our bags before the check in time, use his living room to work during odd hours and gave us useful recommendations on things to do and places to dine. We couldn't have asked for more and would love to be back again!
Beautifully furnished and Muriel very welcoming.  A great location for walks with good links to the city.
Charming and cosy little place within walking distance to the heart of Edinburgh
Second time staying here and it was great!
The apartment was very clean and homey. It was very well located and walkable to everything.

Perfect location in New Town.  Easy to walk to all sights.  Rachel recommended a Fringe show for us to watch, and it was great.  Very responsive to our questions.  The flat had everything we needed, and the bed was very comfy.  Great spot!
特别感谢Rosie提供的住宿，我的家人来参加我的毕业典礼，我们在爱丁堡的这几天过得特别好，是难忘的回忆。我们在Rosie的厨房还会做早餐，周围有Lidl，Tesco和Sainsbury，地理位置非常好。Rosie帮助我们借来了多一份羽绒被，太舒服了！

logement très propre et facilement accessible en bus.
très bon accueil de Mary.

Fijne plek, rustig, vriendelijke buurman.

Very well located in the city and easy to access at any time of the day!

It is a beautiful apartment, the hosts were very flexible with the checkin- and out dates, and great communication, it was extremely clean, just beside the sea.
The only thing was that the front door lock is difficult to open - you have to trick it a bit, and don't panic, it will open eventually.
Excellent place, lovely host!
Fijn appartement. Vriendelijke verhuurders die je goed op de hoogte houden en altijd bereikbaar zijn. Locatie is goed te bereiken lopend en met de tram.
They were very kind and the place was lovely! Would definitely recommend and would absolutely love to be back!
Emma’s place was excellent. It was clean and quiet. Emma was very helpful and answered any questions I had. She was also very flexible and accommodating. I would definitely book this place again.
Barry was a great host, easy to contact and very amenable. The flat was clean, spacious and well equipped, and a great location for our requirements.

El apartamento está decorado muy lindo, bastante bien equipado y bien ubicado se puede ir caminando a todos los puntos de interés de la ciudad. Tiene supermercados y bares muy cerca. Muy tranquilo en cuanto a ruidos . Se puede descansar bien . La cama era cómoda.   Mariana es muy amable y a la orden. Lo recomiendo.

Apartamento funcional y limpio
Está ubicado en una zona tranquila, cerca de las calles comerciales y del centro de Edimburgo.

Wunderschönes Apartment in Dean-Village mit direktem Blick auf den Well Court.
Sehr ruhig, toller Blick vom Balkon. Keine halbe Stunde Fußweg nach Old oder New Town.
Wir haben uns super wohl gefühlt 😊
Craig was very proactive and made everything very easy for us. Apartment was as described and we had a great time! 😊

Great host, Mani was very hospitable and kind. The place was perfect for my needs: room and ensuite are on the top floor, so it feels quite private. Place was really clean, including the bathroom. Spacious.
Note it is some distance from downtown but it was very easy to manage busses in Edinburgh with contactless payment. I definitely recommend this for an affordable place outside the downtown core.

Beautiful, beautiful flat and couldn't be more central - anywhere you could want to be is in walking distance. We were 6 adults staying and there was more than enough space. Amazing high ceilings and huge big windows overlooking the Lyceum Theatre. Walk for 2 minutes and you can see the castle. Very, very pleased with our stay and would really recommend staying here - lovely welcoming touches on arrival. Thanks Iain!

We loved our stay at Kate’s, and wished we had at least 1-2 more days to explore the surrounding nature and walkways.   It was an easy bus into Edinburgh central and a peaceful place to come home to after a long day.   We prepared some of our meals here and wished we could have taken advantage of the garden table; it was a bit chilly.  Kate was very helpful and we enjoyed visiting with her.   She and her partner have created something quite special.    We will hopefully be able to return.
Lovely space and wonderful location, had a great time!

Excellent location for the city. The apartment is clean & spacious enough for 6 guests. The main shower wasn't working when we arrived, but Mark was quick to respond & come out & fix the problem. Thanks for having us.

Gorgeous modern apartment, a little outside the city. Its easily accessed by multiple buses and takes about 10-15 minutes to get into town or a walk of about 30 mins. It has a really comfortable bed for a greats night sleep. Just mind your head going into the bathroom if you're over 6ft as the door is quite low!

Had an excellent time at Moira’s flat. The flat is cozy with a great atmosphere.
Located in a great part of Edinburgh and it is easy to access all the main attractions in the city by foot from the flat.
Moira was very easy to communicate with and really quick to respond to any questions I had.
Would recommend the flat to anybody planning on staying in Edinburgh.

Absolutely loved Ruth’s place! It was in a great location and the space itself was so cozy. Ruth was also an incredible host and so quick to respond to any questions. Would highly recommended staying here when visiting Edinburgh!
Nice and clean place. Comfortable beds. Walking distance to town. Definitely recommend.
Todo bien
Gorgeous apartment in great location. Suzie is so welcoming and hospitable

El lugar es muy bonito, acogedor y cálido, ideal para pasar la noche después de pasear por la ciudad
Roberto fue muy amable y pendiente de recomendar lugares, además, habla Inglés y Español a la perfección, ideal para huéspedes hispanos
Pasamos unos días preciosos, todo cerca, fácil acceso , altamente recomendable
Verten var veldig hyggelig og tok godt imot oss. En svært positiv opplevelse. Imøtekommende, god kommunikasjon. Fikk gode råd. Kan anbefale stedet.
Very nice stay, everything was great!

Petit appartement sympathique au cœur de Haymarket à seulement 20 minutes à pied de Old Town. Cosy et très bien chauffé le logement était parfait pour un petit séjour à Édimbourg. L’hôte, Dele, était très sympathique et réactif aux messages, encore merci beaucoup à lui.

Very nice apartment in a very convenient place close to everything. Rooms were quiet even if we can hear the neighbors when they come back late. Furniture and decoration are new and modern although a bit minimal but not a problem for a few days. We will come back.

With a fantastic location, the apartment was easy to get to. For exploring the city for the first time, or for the 100th time, the apartment is the perfect mix between private and in the heart of the Royal Mile. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and recommend  this beautiful apartment to anyone and everyone!
Wonderful place to stay while visit Edinburgh. Away from the busyness of the downtown core, but just a quick, easy bus ride away. Would stay again without a doubt! Thanks Jeremy!

I always check the library and books. Excellent! Especially a book on 1001 choices of Scotch and a photography book called Genesis that is amazing.
Ok, he had Dawkin's book on the Selfish Gene, that needs a revision, but worth reading.

Perfect location, right on the grass markets and a few minutes walk to the castle. I would definitely recommend, communication from the hosts was fantastic and the apartment had everything we could have asked for.  Would definitely stay here again!

Très bon séjour dans l’appartement d’Elisa.
Hôte très agréable un véritable plaisir d’avoir échangé avec elle.

Afshin was a wonderful host. He gave us very detailed descriptions and left all the instructions for the amenities and equipment that we could use. The house was lovely and warm and very clean and overall made a great visit to Edinburgh.

Hola, el lugar es lindo, pero tiene algunas deficiencias. La calefacción no era suficiente y tuvimos mucho frío, no había papel en el baño y tuvimos que comprar el nuestro, las sábanas de la cama tenían algunas manchas. La chimenea es solo un adorno ya que no se puede conectar y encender.
En general lo demás estuvo bien. La ubicación está bien, aunque si debes caminar un poco, la comunicación con Rebecca estuvo excelente también.
C’è tutto il necessario per un soggiorno nella Città. Posizione comoda per i mezzi di trasporto verso il centro città e l’aeroporto.

Très bel appartement.
Accessible très facilement depuis l'aéroport par le tram.

The place location is quite good. Travelers can reach the oldtown and all places of interest in 20 minutes by foot. We were positively surprised and didn't expect for the owner to leave us some food and wine, which was quite nice as we arrived late at night.
The apartment is in the old building (which is ok) but the apartment is quite old itself, which was a bit disappointing and didn't look much the same as in the pictures. It really needs some improvement. The oven equipment was dirty (probably from the previous guests). The bed sheets had stains and some hair. The bathrooms need some extra cleaning. Carpets are old and I don't know if you can walk barefoot on it. Also there were noises in the apartment (windy outside), so the fireplace had some scary noises as well as something on the roof or somewhere. More or less it was ok for a short 3 night stay.
great location

Julie-Ann was a wonderful host, she was friendly and accommodating when I needed to arrive earlier than the stated check-in. The house is a great, walkable location, and was comfortable and welcoming.

We stayed at Marks over New Year and his place was just the perfect fit for us. The location is great and only takes around 30 minutes to walk into the city centre. The museum is just across the street so great if you're interested in art. The place has a warm and homely feel to it as well as being spacious. We loved staying at Marks and the communication from the moment of booking was great, he kept in contact throughout our stay to ensure we had everything we needed.

Stuart’s place is amazing, really light and airy.  It’s on the top floor of an old tenement, four floors up.  The location is perfect about 10 minutes walk from Waverley Station or St Andrews tram stop.  We had a great lunch at Rocksalt Cafe over the road, well prepared and flavoured sandwiches.  I’d recommend this to anyone to manage the 4 flights of stairs.
Very very recommendable. Anne is pleasant and thoughful. The house is impeccable. 100/100.

We booked Lawrence's place last minute after a canceled flight and it was an absolute lifesaver! They were super responsive right away and were always checking in to see if we needed anything- which was greatly appreciated after a very stressful start to our day. We had no luggage because it was still on our canceled flight, so we were able to do laundry and they even got us some bathrobes so we could wash the only clothes we had! We were so appreciative! The place was spotless, cozy, perfect location, and had everything we needed. Would definitely recommend!!
Fantastic location right off the royal mile and easy walking to train station.
Accommodation was just as described and good location
Very nice apartment. Quiet and accessible area. Excellent communication with host.
Everything went extremely well! Paul communicated amazingly! We had a wonderful time!!

A quirky clean apartment in a good location, only a quick bus journey to the city centre! Francesca was a very reliable, friendly host and kept in regular communication with us. The apartment also had a good wi-fi connection.
Nice flat in a great location. Good communications and flat was very clean.
Sent Robert a message that had a leak from roof and was dripping onto furniture.  Didn't get a response that he knew about it or thank you for informing him.

Ci siamo trovati benissimo in questo appartamento, in pieno centro storico. L’appartamento è ampio, con doppia camera e doppi servizi, pulito e ordinato, dotato anche di ampia cucina, perfetto per 4 persone. L’host ha sempre risposto prontamente ad ogni richiesta.
Il prezzo è un po’ caro ma nella media di Edimburgo.
Lo consiglio.
Stunning space, amazing location, a wonderful stay in all! I will definitely try to book again upon my next visit to Edinburgh
Lovely flat in a perfect central location, super handy for exploring the city! We had a great stay and great communication from the host :)
alles super, sehr empfehlenswert

Thank you so much Carol for everything!!!! We could not have wishes for a better host, a better apartment, a better location or a better equipment to use! We hope to come back soon, thank you from all our hearts!!!

Spacious, quiet apartment in a historic building with high ceilings and floor to ceiling windows. Great neighbourhood near the Dean Bridge, a picturesque walk into town. I really liked staying in a bedroom (bathroom attached) in Steve’s place. It is not large — might be best for one—but the bed is a comfortable size for two, just fine for a few days. Steve was friendly, helpful and generous with his space (we made coffee in his kitchen and had cereal one morning)— definitely recommended!

Cathy was friendly, approachable and ensured our stay was comfortable. Our room was clean and homely. The shower was spacious with good water pressure. We went for the twin bed set up where I had reservations that I might roll off the bed in the night as the single beds looked quite narrow, but thankfully this never happened! Although the place is apart of Cathy's home, it's very private as you have your own front door entrance. Directions provided by Cathy was very detailed and Cathy's place is very centrally located, about a 10 minute walk to Prince's Street.
Cathy is a great host and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It was perfect for our needs during the Fringe festival and we won't hesitate to return or to recommend it to friends.

The four of us had a lovely stay! House was warm, bright, and functional, and looked like the photos in the listing. Roberta was warm and easy to communicate with, both before and after I booked. Thank you :)

Lovely property, quite unique, very good use of space.
Hosts provided good information and it was easy to get in touch with them.
Sometimes noise could be heard from neighbouring properties and the property is next to a road.
Very easy to get into Edinburgh by bus, which run regularly.
This is the best Airbnb I have stayed in. I would love to stay again but I am sure it will be fully booked. I can’t recommend it highly enough
Great experience! Wonderful location and very easy check in experience.

We loved it.  Adorable, spacious two bedroom and 1.5  bath, two story flat in the heart of old town.  Fully updated but still has the old-world charm mixed with modern amenities.  Easy walking distance to everything in old town...tons of light and an amazing stove for cooking if that's your thing.  Beds were very comfortable, and the main bathroom had a large shower with jacuzzi tub.  Caroline was so communicative and responsive!  We would definitely stay here again.

James' place was exactly or better than it's in airbnb description. Well decorated, clean and as warmful as our home could be. The food included is an excellent bonus to start the day with full energy.
The flat is located 20 minutes to down town, it's a perfect walk while you are warming-up for a long day inside on this amazing city.
We highly recommend James' place, we will miss this flat as well Edinburgh.

Cheers James
We had a nice stay, Zeb was very welcoming and helpful. He suggested some nice places for us to visit.
Great wee place, close to city and very easy check in process

This appartment is clean, beautiful and obviously in the most attractive street of Edimburgh. The pub just in front is too nice and people are so kind.

Great location , perfect accommodations
Mark and Doug made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. The apartment was nicely decorated and our room and bed were comfortable. Their dinner recommendation and directions were spot on.
Perfect location to visit Edinburgh, the appartment is stunning and the host is friendly (and gave us some tips) !

We had a lovely stay at Lucy’s flat. It was perfect for my partner and I. The location was great and was walking distance from everything including a short walk to the beginning of the hike up to Arthur’s Seat. It was very cosy and we really enjoyed choosing from the many DVD’s and cooking in the really well kitted out kitchen. Thanks for a lovely place to stay Lucy !!
It was an amazing space to visit Edinburgh. The place and the amenities were great!
Louise avait un bel accueil et a répondu à nos questions rapides. C’est un lieu charmant et tranquille où séjourner. Nous avons adoré les lieux. Je recommandes fortement.
super easy and great location ! would definitely stay again (:

Just to thank Lloyd and family for letting us stay. A warm comfortable property with all the amenities. A home from home. Lovely touches of tea, coffee and sugar made settling in really easy. We will be back, thank you.

My experience was a solid OK, but certainly not great. That said, the room was relatively cheap and clean and booked at short notice. My major qualm is that I wasn't given the room that was advertised; instead I was allocated a room at basement level, with windows but of course no view, except a wall. Additionally, the room wasn't as luxurious as it had appeared on the pictures (but maybe this because I wasn't in the room that appeared on the pictures). I recall seeing the same complaint when reading through the comments before booking, and recall seeing Altido acknowledge this as a problem: but my experience is evidence of nothing yet being done to rectify it. There were also a few minor issues, like no hand soap (despite there being shower gel and clean towels) and plates and bowels provided that were dusty and slightly soap stained. That said, the room was acceptably clean and the bed was clean and comfy. I certainly wouldn't deter people booking a night or two here, but would suggest that the place (at least on the basis of the room I was given) is more budget than the pictures imply.

We booked this flat for 15 nights.  The key to the street level door didn't work well.  We asked for a replacement, but that request fell on deaf ears.  The apartment itself is very clean, but be aware that there are 75 steps to the top floor.  The bed is not a queen, maybe a double.  There were only a couple of towels for our 15 night stay.  Our request for more towels was met with a request to fill out a form and pay an additional 70 GBP.  Ridiculous!  The water heater wasn't working properly upon our arrival.  After communicating with GuestReady all they did was shove a manual under the door.  I spent some of my vacation time reading a manual and reprogramming the heater.  Maybe I should have charged them 70 GBP!  Kitchen needs to be better equipped - can't cook bigger meals with only one frying pan, one pot, and a couple of oven pans.  Street is noisy if you like to sleep with the window open.  We had one other issue with GuestReady after arriving, but I have no room to  explain!

El departamento de Shahid, es fantástico, con mucho espacio y una ubicación inmejorable, pudimos apreciar los conciertos de navidad desde nuestras ventanas.
A nuestra llegada estaba todo muy limpio y ordenado, con instrucciones claras para entrar.
La comunicación siempre fue fluida.

Gracias Shahid
Loved our stay here. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed and more. Hosts were more than helpful and location was perfect. Would stay again!!
Gary was very friendly and made us feel at home. The room and bathroom were very clean. Recommended when visiting Edinburgh

It was a perfect stay in Mhairi's house and I would recommend it to everyone!! The room with the bathroom attached is just perfect for one person and with the bus you are in the city in about 10 minutes. So I think it is in the best area to stay in Edinburgh if you want to be close the city centre. Also the neighbourhood is great with the botanic gardens just around the corner.
Mhairi is the best host you can imagine, as she is always there to help and made me feel like home.
So thanks a lot for that great stay and see you next time I'm around!

Brilliant location very close to the city centre
Really lovely modern apartment beautifully decorated
Hosts couldn’t be more helpful!

Lovely garden house, very tastefully designed, excellent shower room. Access to garden table & chairs in a delightful garden. Ideally placed, a short walk from the Meadows & Bruntsfield with its excellent cafes. Good communications, very welcoming hosts. We’ll definitely stay again!

The apartment is so close to Grassmarket! It’s more suitable for pedestrians than for owners of cars because parking is not easy to find so close to the street. We had a bit of trouble with the inner windows so it was a bit noisy (as it’s so close to everything) but overall it was great!

Very comfortable apartment in a central location. Communication by Susan was excellent and the thoughtful little touches she provided made our stay even more enjoyable.  We would definitely return to this location

Paul est un hôte génial !
Petites attentions comme des fruits et du thé/café à disposition.
Salle de bain parfaite avec la aussi tout à disposition.
Donne de bons conseils sur la ville et l'arrêt de bus est juste en face.
Top !
Me and my girlfriend had a great time. It’s beautiful property, I would definitely recommend.

Very happy with the accommodation, clean and tidy and well appointed. In a very secluded location, surrounded by trees. We even saw a Roe Deer in the garden on our last day. Would have no hesitation in recommending it to others. quite steep stairs, as on the third floor, but this was notified in advance, and well worth the climb.
Carol is very nice to us. The house is clean and comfortable

We absolutely loved our stay at The Mews this summer. The apartment was incredibly clean, cosy, and well set-up, including toiletries, milk and snacks on our arrival.
The location was excellent, being both walkable to the main city, as well as right next to bus, train and tram stations if needed.
Jock was an incredibly helpful, responsive and proactive host right from booking to check-out, giving us guidance on checking-in, location and local recommendations. (Definitely check out his guidebook!)
Jock additionally let us drop our suitcases early on our check-in day, which we greatly appreciated and did not expect. This gave us an extra half a day to explore the city freely.
We will definitely be checking to see if the Mews is available if we re-visit Edinburgh in the future. Thank you for having us :)
Really enjoyed our stay here, plenty of room for 6 people!
Nice department. The room was a bit noisy but everything was good. No far from the centre and well connected.

Ubytovaní je opravdu takové, jak ho hostitelka uvádí :) vše čisté, hezké a funkční. Lokalita je velmi příjemná, pěšky se dostanete na všechna krásná místa a autobusová zastávka třeba na delší výlety je hned před barákem :) Pobyt jsme si opravdu užili a rádi jsme se každý den vraceli "domů" :)

Amazing location in a vibrant neighborhood! Plenty of restaurants and pubs nearby. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and Johanna was a friendly and responsive host. Loved spending time with her adorable pets!
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour ! Anja est une hôte accueillante et à l'écoute. Ce fut un réel plaisir de vous rencontrer. Merci pour tout !

Had a great stay at Daniel’s place. It was very comfortable and clean. Daniel was welcoming and responded promptly to all my inquiries. In addition to personally introducing the place, there was a handwritten notebook in the room with all the information about the house and things to do in Edinburgh. The flat is located in a nice neighborhood near the city center, about a 30-minute walk, so I hardly had to use any transportation.
A lovely spacious flat in a great location, would definitely recommend

Andrea is an excellent host!! I had a very warm welcome and felt right at home. Andrea is very polite, friendly, helpful, respectful and funny. The room and house is lovely with a minimalistic touch. Definitely worth staying here.
The accommodation was centrally located and host was responsive, friendly and gave clear instructions for check-in & out to make it seamless. We enjoyed our time in Edinburgh.
My 3 friends and I loved our stay!! The location was great (coffee shop right below apartment is soooo good and great walking paths)! Apartment was clean, cozy, and comfortable!
Alles Bestens, gerne wieder :)
Nice and cozy apartment. Michele was a hreat host and very respectful.
lt was a comfortable short stay, l really enjoyed the location. The room and bathroom was very clean which was very important for me. Everyone was kind and friendly, l will come back again  x

Erstmal zum positiven:
- Das Preisleistungsverhältnis stimmte
- sauberes Zimmer
- flexibler und einfacher Check-In
- Waschmaschine und Parkplatz was selten ist
- schöner Park entlang eines Kanals 2min entfernt

Negatives und das leider:

- Das Bad wurde von einigen Mitbewohnern dreckig hinterlassen
- Flackerndes Licht im Zimmer 9

- Das Fach im Kühlschrank ist sehr klein was einem zusteht
