Fazit: Ich bin sicher vielen wird es gefallen, da die Preisleistung gut ist. Unser Erlebnis war jedoch nicht ganz Reibungslos deswegen 3 Sterne.
房间很温馨，房东人非常好👍🏻😊
Beautiful decor, spacious interior. Lovely linen on comfy beds & great location.
You can expect nothing but luxury at Lukasz’s place, beautifullly clean apartment with comfy bed and was just had a relaxing homie atmosphere to it!

This is such a superb find - central to so many sights and restaurants/pubs, a clean and well-decorated apartment. It was a very short walk from the closest Airlink 100 bus stop, which is also convenient. Greg is a great host- communicative and kind enough to let us drop our bags off early, which was so nice. The little thoughtful touches in the space really show that he cares! We had a short one night stay on a Sunday evening when it was quiet so I’m not sure the regular level of noise during a heavier bar night, but for us it was a peaceful and quiet stay. We are already plotting how and when we can return to stay again for longer!
A great find if you want to explore Leith . located in a beautiful part. of town with bars, coffee shops and restaurants. The apartment itseld is as described and very comfortable.

Excellent stay and host. Roberta is very responsive and tries to make the visit perfect. The flat is super clean and modern. Has a washer ( no drier but I think that’s normal for the area)
Great location. Airport to flat airlink200 to fishmarket square). Takes 40 minutes.
Easy to center of Edinburgh. We used busses and the tram. About 1/2 hour as well. Overall A+

Really lovely place to stay, the flat is great, even better in person than the photos! love the high ceilings and the decor. Windows are huge with a great views of Arthur's seat, and walking distance into Edinburgh. The flat is comfortable with pretty much everything you'd need for a break away. Would recommend to anyone.
Rebecca was quickly responsive when we messaged with a query.

I really enjoyed my stay here. The place was clean and organized, and it's in a great spot. Shilpa was super friendly and supportive, she helped me quickly with everything I needed. Would definitely recommend staying here 🥰🥰

I honestly can’t imagine a more perfect spot to stay in the city. The rooms are spotless and large. They are tastefully decorated . The host is quick to respond to any issues at all and even left some treats in the room to make guests feel extra welcome.  You are in a prime location but away from the noise. I would stay here next time, absolutely. If you can’t decide, I say go with this space. You won’t be disappointed!

Allan nous attendait à l'arrêt de bus. Allan et son fils sont très discrets et respectueux de notre intimité. Nous avons eu totalement libre accès à la cuisine, le salon et la salle en plus de notre chambre. Le logement est spacieux et très bien chauffé. Allan nous rend service, si besoin. Petit plus, Allan comprend un peu le français, ce qui a bien facilité notre communication. Je recommande complètement
Great apartment - large, clean and easy to walk to central parts of Edinburgh. Phillip was a great host.

Great location in a fun neighborhood.  Very accessible to New Town, Old Town, and the Royal Mile.  It's a nice little pocket of peace and quiet in the hustle and bustle of a vibrant city.  Kim is very welcoming and helpful!

The apartment was beautiful, very clean, and excellently located. Marion was so patient when our flight was very delayed and was super welcoming when we finally arrived. My family and I felt at home in this foreign (but amazing) city. I would stay there again for sure next time I'm back!

Het boekingsproces en de communicatie met de host verliep heel vlot en helder. Dunc en Dee geven veel nuttige info , wat het makkelijk maakt om je reis te plannen. Het appartementje is prima gelegen en heel goed uitgerust. We apprecieerden de kleine extra’s zoals de melk en de ontbijtgranen. Een groot gemak als je ‘s avonds aankomt na een lange trip. De host trakteerde ons op een overheerlijk mini pakketje zelfgebakken shortbread. Dat gaf het een persoonlijke touch en dat vonden we heel attent. We kijken met plezier terug op ons verblijf.
The place is clean and tidy. Near to public transportation. Very responsive host.
很不错 下次来还会住这里
MUY BUENA ESTANCIA Y LA UBICACIÓN BASTANTE BUENA. HAY UNA PARADA DE BUS JUSTO AL LADO Y LLEGAS AL CENTRO EN 20 MINUTOS.

Logement bien situé pour pouvoir profiter du centre. A la hauteur de nos espérances, ce loft était propre et bien fonctionnel.
merci John de proposer ce bien qui n'a fait qu embellir notre séjour à Edimbourg .

Our mom and daughter trip started well - great location, close to what we wanted to do…however over the span of four nights we noticed the heat was off - only to come on briefly before we woke in the am. We ended up walking around the house in blankets and my mom caught a cold. I reached out to the owners and were given instructions on how to work the heat. The program would not budge from its setting. It was clear the furnace was programmed to stay cold with restricted high and low (3-7). We asked around and were told through the grapevine that in E owners often do this to save money on air b&b rentals. Additionally, the furnishings are in dire need of replacement (they do not look like the picture) and had crumbs underneath and within. Renter beware. This accom should be cheaper for location being its literal only selling point.

My partner and I spent two nights at Docs place . It is so far the best Airbnb I have stayed. We were impressed by the warm hospitality and attention to detail. I would absolutely recommend the place to anyone coming to Edinburgh.

Mark and Doug have curated a really lovely space. The flat is beautifully decorated and is absolutely spotless. We couldn't have asked for anything more! Would 100% recommend this to anyone who wants to visit Edinburgh.
Adresse à recommander avec beaucoup de plaisir

A Brilliant stay and great time at the fringe.
Very helpful early bag drop, spacious rooms.
May stay next year!! (If the bin men finish their strike!)

Die Unterkunft von Calum können wir nur empfehlen. Sie entspricht der Beschreibung im Internet. Am besten hat uns die zentrale Lage gefallen. Wir könnten von dort aus wirklich alles auch zu Fuss erreichen und unseren Tag gut durchplanen. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten waren rundum auch optimal, so dass wir uns selbst gut versorgen konnten. Und Calum war als Gastgeber auch stets sehr freundlich und hilfreich, wenn es um Tipps und Hilfe ging. Mit der Wohnung macht man nichts falsch :)

Gordon has a beautifully quirky place right in the heart of Edinburgh's old town. Visiting for the Fringe festival I found it easy to walk everywhere I needed to go, and a lovely respite after the madness of the Fringe! Gordon was wonderfully accommodating, even storing our bags after we'd checked out and before our flight. Thank you Gordon!

We had a great stay at this place. Located in a great part of town, the apartment offers easy access to the city centre and is well connected to the rest of the city. Mike and Pauline were great hosts. They were super responsive and were able to accomodate all our needs, which was very helpful especially when travelling with a young child. We would stay here again and recommend this place.

Dina's place was exceptional and immaculate. Communication was excellent and Dina added some special touches on request.
Would definately return in the future, thank you..
Very clean. Great location. Will stay again.

A very well-located Airbnb for travelers looking to experience all Edinburgh has to offer who just need a place to hang their hat at the end of the day. Clean and comfortable, the room is private and well-maintained. I would stay there again in a heartbeat.
Très bien placé proche du centre historique.
The most place was pretty convenient and not far from all attractions,  I will definitely go back if im ever in Edinburgh
My stay in Edinburgh was splendid much to the serenity and great apartment of Nellie.

What a lovely stay in a cozy room in one of the best places in Edinburgh! Jessica was a fantastic host - always checking I had what I needed to be comfortable in her home. Her house is situated in a beautiful, leafy part of Edinburgh where you can sit outside with your morning coffee and listen to the sounds of the birds. The facilities are great. The room is quite small - so it's a good place to be if you will be out the whole day and just need a place to sleep. Overall, happy. Thank you, Jessica :)
prima accommodatie, schoon en op loopafstand van het centrum

I really liked the privacy at Amanda’s place. The room has a lock, so I felt safe and comfortable even with other renters in the house. It’s a bit far from the city centre, but the bus stop is just a 4-minute walk away, and the street is well-lit — perfect even when coming home late.
Great clean, cosy flat in a very convenient location!

Brilliantly positioned flat overlooking the water, close to bus and tram into Edinburgh and lots of lovely pubs and cafes close by. Perfect for a few days exploring the city with our teenage kids. Thank you!

El apartamento está de maravilla, hemos pasado tres días espectaculares con las mejores comodidades, buen colchón, agua caliente, la cocina muy bien equipada…La zona es tranquila y puedes llegar al centro de la ciudad dando un paseo por el canal. Catherine siempre estuvo pendiente de nosotros por si nos hacía falta cualquier cosa. Volvería con los ojos cerrados.
Εξαιρετική διαμονή. Ορισμένα δωμάτια είναι καλύτερα από άλλα.
The flat was immaculately clean and was in a good location close to the city centre.
A lovely stay at this wee flat. Ideal location, really cosy, clean and very well equipped. Would definitely stay again.

Stevan was a warm and considerate host. His house was beautiful and clean and the room was spacious. Stevan was kind enough to help with morning breakfast and was always up for a breakfast chat. It was clear that a lot of love had been put into this house and we felt happy to have been a part of Stevan’s home for our stay.
Very good location
Friendly host and great place to stay over!

On arrival Alex sat down with me and we had a good long chat. Alex was kind and welcoming, as well as being a very fascinating person. He really made me feel at ease and comfortable in his lovely home. The bedroom was cosy, the bed was nice and firm, with a feather duvet and a choice of feather or synthetic pillows. The shower was great. Very clean. Alex put the heating on for me so I was nice and warm all night. I liked the neighbourhood: the place is just off Morningside which has an array of shops and restaurants of many kinds. My taxi to Waverley railway station cost £10. I would definitely stay again.

Amazing location and such a cute apt! The space was large and very clean. Short walks to anywhere in Edinburgh’s City Center! Anji was quick to respond. I’d definitely stay here again and recommend this listing 100%.
Excellent stay! Place is so beautiful and clean, I’m walking distance to city centre! Will be back!
Terrific flat in an amazing location!

A comfortable and quiet flat in a block of flats.
Easy access from Tram
Supermarket close by
Was nice and warm despite sub zero conditions outside
Situation géographique exceptionnelle qui permet de visiter Edimbourg à pieds , l'appartement est calme et ne manque de rien , très bon séjour , a bientôt.

Het verblijf lijkt mooier en meer verzorgd op de foto’s dan in werkelijkheid. Het was oké, maar niet echt schoon en best achterstallig. De douche was een drama. Zo klein dat je je daar niet kunt wassen of keren. Het is zelfs moeilijk om de deuren achter je in de douche dicht te doen omdat het zo klein is. Je kunt daar alleen met moeite staan en het water over je heen laten lopen. De bed is ook een drama. Dit is geen tweepersoonsbed, anderhalve misschien maar het bed is niet voor twee personen bedoeld. Uiteindelijk sliep mijn zoon in het bed en hij paste daar net in zijn eentje en ik en mijn man op de twee aangeboden slaapbanken in de woonkamer. Daar lig je ook niet echt prettig op. Al met al het was mooi in Edinburg, de locatie van het verblijf is niet te ver van de oude stad, binnen 20 minuten loopafstand. Het is ook knus in dat huisje, maar het moet beter onderhouden worden en veel meer schoon worden. De communicatie met de host was prettig en makkelijk.

We travelled by car so the place was great for us to either travel to town or to leave into the countryside. The 19th century house provides a very special ambiance and the apartment had everything you might need.

The location is great. We had a favorite coffee shop and pub right up the street. The host was awesome: helpful and very attentive. The best part though was the really comfy brand NEW mattresses. We were grateful for those.

Goede locatie, dichtbij grassmarket.
Verhuurster zeer aardig en reageerde snel bij vragen. Appartement is schoon, alleen trappenhuis is echt vies.
'Net gerenoveerd’ kan intussen wel uit de omschrijving, zo nieuw is keuken en badkamer niet meer.
2de sleutel zou wel makkelijk zijn.
Lovely place and nice host!
Great location for exploring Edinburgh and a comfortable place to stay.
What a find in a very expensive city. 2 minutes walk from the tram made trips into city centre very easy. Very spacious bedrooms and living room - made for a great weekend. Thanks Jennifer
Paul

Merci pour ce séjour !
Valentino est très réactif et donnes des instructions claires quant aux modalités d’accès.
Le logement est très bien situé, 2min à pied jusqu’aux arrêts de bus. Très bien desservi.
La literie est de bonne qualité.
Nous recommandons vivement, super séjour !!
Lovely apartment and great location!
Great location!

This was perhaps our favorite place to stay yet. The vibe was perfection and we felt right at home. Calim was so easy to communicate with and provided us with great recommendations as well as created such character in the apartment even leaving fresh bread and jam and shortbread on our arrival. Would definitely stay here again!
We stayed as a group of friends, great location, we were spoilt for choice on places to eat and visit.  The apartment was fantastic, it was very comfortable and felt very homely.

Our recent stay didn't quite meet our expectations. The apartment felt rather dreary and lacked sufficient storage space, particularly in the second bedroom, making it challenging to unpack and feel settled.
Noise was a significant issue, with late-night disturbances from passersby making it difficult to get a good night's sleep and impacting our overall enjoyment. Additionally, a fan would have been helpful to alleviate the stuffiness of the apartment during the warm weather, especially since we couldn't get the windows open.
While the location has potential, the lack of amenities, persistent noise, and ventilation issues made for a disappointing stay.

Clunys place is in an amazing location, everything is super walkable and the place was very tidy. It is 68 steps from the front door up to the apartment so if you're less mobile I wouldn't recommend, but Cluny was kind enough to help carry my mom's bags and we did great while there. The pull out couch was quite comfortable as well.
Fabulous flat.. amazing location, and meets every requirement for anyone wanting to explore Edinburgh.

Super séjour Éric est un hôte super accueillant et sa maison est dans un quartier paisible typique du Royaume-Uni.
La chambre et la salle de bain sont exactement comme nous nous y attendons : très équipés, confortables, propres.
Merci Éric nous reviendrons !
Amazing apartment in the most perfect location. Couldnt recommend it any more. Great way to spend time in such a lovely city

Really enjoyed staying at Victoria’s. The accommodations were clean and accurately described. The bonus was having a fur friend from first moment. Also it’s surrounded by loads of restaurants and walkable to Edinburgh city centre.

Place was as described and was a great place for the 5 of us. Stuart was very responsive and accommodating with early check in. Most attractions are walkable and within 30 min but far enough for a quiet stay.
Perfect for a city break, comfy bed.
Harish is a nice host.

We arrived around 10pm. We had previously been given instructions on how to access the apartment. That was simple and straightforward to access the key and found the apartment easily.
It was lovely and warm in the apartment, but the bedroom windows were left open and heating off so the rooms were a bit cold. But they warmed up when the windows were closed.
We asked for bedding for the sofa bed but couldn't find any but because the apartment is so warm we could use the blankets off the beds. If it hadn't been nearly midnight when we settled and were ready for bed we would have contacted the hosts.
The beds were comfy, we used the dishwasher but not anything else in the kitchen.
We didn't find any plug in the bathroom sink and the ensuite plug did not fit.
The showers were hot and we enjoyed our stay. We would use it again if we came back to Edinburgh.
Bus stop is about 5 minutes walk so perfect for exploring the city.
Thank you for allowing us to stay.
Lovely stay! Everything was clean, and readily available. Marie communicated early and clearly and was even kind enough to pick us up from the train station for our check-in!
Wonderful hosts, flat was just as advert said: modern, clean and all rounded. Felt very welcome, lovely touches such as recommended places to eat etc. Thank you once again!

My wife and I stayed for 7 nights so a nice bed and pillows were a must and we were very happy. The room was clean, the welcome and communication were great. It is in a perfect spot for Edinburgh: Close to Princes and Lothian Street, where nearly every bus in the city flows through, right next to the Princes Street Gardens, and a straight shot to the Royal Mile. Definitely a winner!

Nice place, centrally located extremely close to waverly station, coffee shops, and pubs.   Easy access to taxis for trips to old town if you don’t want to hike, I’ll be on the look out for availability when I travel back to Edinburgh.
Had a great time. The apartment was beautiful and in a very central location. The kitchen had everything we could need and it was all very clean.
Good place to stay...
Very good location and friendly staff! Very clean and convenient as well! Highly recommend

Fiona was great - all information provided and questions answered quickly and fully :-)  The house was bigger than we expected and the shower was amazing.  My husband and I stayed for a whole 3 weeks, worked from home every week day, and cooked most nights. The location was perfect for our needs, with the conveniently located path meaning a 2 minute walk to the bus stop into town. Would recommend.

Wir waren für zwei Nächte bei Ashleigh zu Gast. Sie war eine super liebe Gastgeberin, sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Direkt am ersten Abend hat sie uns viele Tipps für Restaurants in der Umgebung gegeben. Wir haben uns bei ihr super wohl gefühlt, sie war immer zu erreichen und sowohl der Check-in als auch der Check-out waren absolut problemlos. Vielen lieben Dank für den schönen Aufenthalt in Edinburgh!

Daniel’s place is in lovely area of Edinburgh with easy access to restaurants and grocery stores. We really enjoyed walking around Stockbridge and relaxing in the flat after a long day hiking Arthur’s Seat. There are a lot of stairs to get to the flat so it’s definitely not for folks with mobility issues. Overall a wonderful stay! We would love to stay again.
Great flat. Really comfortable beds, and fantastic location. Stylish interior - the pictures do the place justice - it is very nice.
Je recommande ce logement! Près du centre, chambre impeccable, appartement très charmant. L'hôte était très accueillante et aimable. Super séjour!

An excellent option for those wanting easy access to the city centre with homely touches.
An excellent host with many thoughtful touches.

Lovely, bright and spacious apartment right in the heart of the action of Edinburgh Old Town.  Castle view from the sitting room and bedroom windows, excellent choice of restaurants, cafes and pubs across the street, and walking distance to all Edinburgh's main attractions.  Taiba is a brilliant host too, and so helpful.

We really enjoyed our stay at Graham’s lovely place. Very easy experience from start to finish, the flat was bright and spacious and fully equipped with everything we needed. Right on the doorstep of Arthur’s seat and also a stone’s throw from the Meadows! Great value for money and we would definitely come back and stay again.

It was the most lovely start for our Scotland Tour! Fiona and Stevie made us feel so comfortable and at home. Stevie gave us tea and lots of tips for Edinburgh. The room was clean with beautiful decoration and heavenly bedding - really we slept so well. The bathroom is modern and fully equipped. The little tea corner is just another lovely add on. Thank you for having us, would recommend for a relaxing stay. Supermarket and Costa Coffee are just around the corner, as well as Arthur's seat is really close by :)
Great apartment in an amazing location. Thank you to the host for their great communication

Had an amazing time at Lindsey's place. The location is fabulous, incredibly detailed decor, very comfy bed & the hot tub....... to die for
Would 100% recommend
Small, but cozy. Perfect if you don't need to spend much time at the accomodation. Allister is super nice

We can definately recommend Conor's apartment. It was cosy and comforable with fully equiped kitchen. It has a good location, outside the city centre but with many connections by tram / bus. Connor is an excellent host, helpful and responds very quickly.

We stayed for three nights in Nicola’s wonderful apartment. The location is just perfect, everything you need and want to see is nearby! The apartment is nice and cozy and just like how it is described. Nicola was the best host you could ask for! Our flight arrived early and we could drop our bags at the apartment so we wouldn’t have to carry them around until we could check in at 3pm. She was extremely helpful if we had any questions and always responded fast. Would love to come back here sometime!

A small apartment in a good location just outside the busyness of Edinburgh central. The apartment was as pictured and had good facilities. It was located near to lots of great pubs and a good selection of restaurants, coffee shops and bakery, which felt more like places where locals spent there time rather than the more touristy areas of the city.
We had great communication with Raul and they very kindly allowed us to check in earlier due to our early morning flight.
A couple of reviews mentioned a smell; our experience is that there was an odor when entering the front door to the apartment block and was quite strong in the shared hall, rather than from the apartment itself. I think because it is an old building, the odor naturally enters the apartment (albeit nowhere near as strong as when in the hallway), which I imagine is why the hosts have placed reed diffusers around the place. It would have been useful to open the windows for fresh air.
overall a good stay in a good location.

This a cute apartment in an area of Edinburgh that some great restaurants and shops. It’s convenient to Edinburgh sights and we even walked to the castle.  The bus line is easy also from here.  The best shower in Scotland!  Think of the walk up to 4th floor as your exercise to work off all the great food you will be eating!  Thanks Radek for a great stay!
Perfect place for visiting in Leith. Very comfy flat, spent many nights just hanging out on the couch!

great spot to stay in edinburgh! very cute apartment with plenty of space, comfy couches/beds, and cookies on arrival ! this was a really good stay in a great area that was central without feeling noisy or unsafe!
A nice place in a nice spot
Great place and location.
Ian ist ein sehr freundlicher  Gastgeber, der gerne Tipps gibt und sofort auf Fragen antwortet.

Tolles Appartement im Zentrum mit genug Platz
Danielle and Andrew are lovely and made our weekend really special.
Great host! Clean cozy space with every amenity you can think of. I had a great stay and a good sleep. Will definitely come back.

Dele's place was lovely, warm, spacious and clean and everything looked new. Extremely comfortable beds too. And, it couldn't have been in a better location for us. Bonus points for bring able to use Netflix and Prime. 10/10 would stay again. Thanks!

If we could buy the property and live in it for ourselves, we would! We are considering moving to Edinburgh and this apartment would be amazing. Its location is absolutely perfect and it's a great size for a one bedroom. We particularly loved the bathroom as it's big and spacious and new.
I can't recommend this place highly enough. It's more than a place to stay during your trip, it's a home.

Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben und wir haben uns von Anfang an direkt sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Lage ist super, man findet Restaurants sowie Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Cafés direkt in der Umgebung. Direkt am Eingang der Wohnung ist eine Bushaltestelle, wodurch man überall gut hinkommt. Trotz der direkten Straßenlage, halten die Fenster die Lautstärke gut draußen.
Carl war super freundlich und zuvorkommend. Er gab uns am Anfang Tipps für die Umgebung (Bars/Restaurants etc.) und kümmerte sich um die Wohnung, wenn etwas gemacht werden musste.
Außerdem hat er mir geholfen, Karten für ein Fußballspiel zu organisieren, was auch absolut nicht selbstverständlich ist.
Alles in Allem war es ein super Aufenthalt und wir können Carl und seine Wohnung wärmstens weiterempfehlen.

We really enjoyed our stay at Kitty's pretty and cosy flat. We felt really comfortable there and had everything we needed. When we arrived Kitty gave us a very warm welcome and some really helpful recommendations regarding our stay in Edinburgh. Even if the appartments location is a bit hidden the directions we got from Kitty made it easy to find it. The location of the flat right behind the Royal Mile in the centre of Edinburgh's old town is perfect for exploring the city and at the same time very quiet and calm. To sum it up, we had a great time and would like to stay again at Kitty's flat at any time.

My stay was wonderful! It was peaceful, and exactly what was needed after a redeye flight. Accommodations were as described, and very clean. Additionally, Joss was unbelievably responsive, helpful, and patient.
The only things to note is that other guests are pretty audible across walls, etc.

Greg foi um excelente host. Forneceu além de todas as informações necessárias, o que foi muito útil. Check-in fácil e rápido!
A localização do imóvel é excelente! Perto de tudo e pode-se fazer tudo a pé. Apartamento aconchegante e bem decorado. Um local que com certeza voltaríamos no futuro.
Obrigado ao Greg pela excelente estadia!

This Airbnb is exactly as pictured, it's light and spacious. It was spotless and had everything we would need for the few days we were there. It's a great location, we walked to everything when we stayed here, highly recommend it!

Good location just a couple of minutes drive away from the city centre. The accommodation has all the essentials including washing machine, flat iron, cooking essentials. The host was very responsive and helpful and the instructions were clear. Over all we had a nice stay.

Steve’s place is excellent in all respects, fantastic location, quiet, safe, great decor, enough space in the room with the split level to cohabit easily if your sharing and a nice big shower with great water pressure. Thanks for making us feel welcome, I highly recommend this place :)

We only stayed for one night at Mark And Jeana's place on our way back home from our road trip around Scotland. The location was perfect for us as we had an early fight the next day and it is only 20 min drive to the airport. The room and en suite bathroom were both clean and bed was comfortable. Jeana was a warm and welcoming host. We highly recommend the place.

This place was one of the best value and nicest Air B and B's that I have stayed at. Leon really went out of his way to make things homely, welcoming and comfortable. The apartment is only 10 minutes walk to main shopping area and has two nearby supermarkets and also little cafes. Great facilities at the house, free wifi, perfect kitchen with a Nespresso machine and wine fridge. The place was warm and dry. Would definitely stay again, Thanks Leon
Very well setup accommodation, everything you need and more.  Special attention to detail with appliances to make a more enjoyable stay.  Would recommend.
Great cabin, would stay here again.
Brilliant apartment, clean with and very comfortable. Good communication. Great location. Definitely recommend.

Jennifer en haar man waren zeer vriendelijk. Ralph was ook super lief en kwam steeds kwispelend dag zeggen als we binnen kwamen. 😄
Ik zou het verblijf zeker aanbevelen aan iedereen. We hebben 5 nachten verbleven en het was super! Locatie en busvervoer top!

Kim has been absolutely adorable! The flat is fantastic and the room very comfortable, clean and tidy. I stayed a week with my mum and we really felt at home.
Thank you so much Kim for making our stay so nice.

Très bon séjour, le lit était excellent nous avons extrêmement bien dormis, le quartier était très calme, facile d’accès en bus et la mer pas très loin.
L’hôte était très gentil et nous a conseillé pas mal d’endroit, je recommande fortement
Very well located. You can just walk to the old town.
Nice stay. Well matched with description and very responsive host.

We had two separate stays for Tessa's - 2 nights before our tour to the Hebrides and 2 nights after.  We chose Tessa's because the apartment is close to the bus and airport tram stations, and close to restaurants. Our room was large, with a king bed, large windows for light and air and enough outlets for our electronics.  Tessa is a lovely, outgoing person and we felt completely welcomed.

A hospedagem foi impecável! O lugar é extremamente limpo, confortável e exatamente como nas fotos. A localização é excelente muito perto do centro da cidade, o que facilitou conhecer Edimburgo a pé. O anfitrião foi atencioso e tudo funcionou perfeitamente durante a estadia. Recomendo muito e certamente voltaria!
Excellent property in central location. Everything you need for a super stay😀

Victorija's place was very comfortable and spacious and had all the amenities we could need. It is located in a very walkable area with lots of restaurants and pub options. It's a short walk to the castle and Old Town area.
Victorija kindly allowed us to drop bags prior to checkin so we could maximize our sightseeing.
A great experience

David’s apartment was spacious, clean, and perfect for our three night trip in Edinburgh! The apartment was in a nice area and felt very safe. It was about a 15 minute walk from the apartment to Old Town but there were plenty of shops, restaurants, and coffee shops nearby if you wanted to stay in the area.
David was friendly, helpful, and quick to respond to our questions. I highly recommend staying here for your next Edinburgh getaway. Thanks, David for making our first trip to Edinburgh a great experience!
I stayed here in Edinburgh with my mum and we loved it. Vroni made us feel at home even though she could not be in Edinburgh. The rooms are beautifully decorated and the location was great.
Great place to stay with family
Excellent location!  Walking distance to everything. Host was so sweet & very helpful!  Very large apartment and clean.
Very very nice and comfy place to live in!

Its a really cozy and cute apartment, perfect for a couple or 2.

It is in a really good location, 20 minutes from the city by foot.

Wonderful apartment. Great location. Walking distance to most everything, but if it is too far, or the weather is bad, the city has an amazing bus system.
Luxurious, super clean, high quality accommodation in spacious apartment with bus stop on the door step. Highly recommended - thanks very much to the hosts!

Colin's place is charming, immaculate, fully stocked & more spacious than the photos. I stayed alone for 3 nights and had a great time walking around the city. I could reach all interests by foot, but be tucked away in a quiet residential group of houses (w a small coffee house downstairs on the corner). One direction is very local and the other is more historic and tourist. A nice middle of the mix location overlooking a gorgeous grade school that gets fabulous sunsets. I'd recommend and stay again.
It’s a beautiful and lovely apartment, highly recommended
Nice apartment, good for 4 people. Amazing bars and restaurants in walking distance.
とても親切な方でした。観光地からも近くおすすめです！
Great spot for a large family with kids. we liked being away from touristy areas but still close to walk to it and great local pubs and restaurants.

Magnifique séjour à Édimbourg, l'appartement est très bien situé, la chambre est ravissante et dépaysante ! Les bus sont à proximité et le quartier est très vivant. Merci pour tout and take care!!!!
Amazing place. Perfect location.

We had a great time at Susie's arpartment. It is very central so we were able to explore Edinburgh on foot. You can easily reach the main station, the Royal Mile, Holyrood Palace and Arthur's Seat.
Susie's arpartment was clean and tidy, the beds really comfortable and she left easy to get instructions for everything.
We had a great time staying there!

Beautiful place! The location is conveniently close to all you could want to see and explore in Edinburgh. Emily was a lovely host and very helpful with everything we had questions about. We had a wonderful time and would highly recommend anyone to stay here!

The location was very good. The centre of Edinburgh was easy accessible because of the tram and busses.
They have everything you need to be comfortable.
We enjoyed our stay here!

I feel a 5 star review is too low a grading for Tom and Drew’s place.. They are outstanding hosts. Nothing is too much trouble. They are so easy to communicate with and utterly professional. Thank you so much both.
Karen and Barry
Thank you to Kim and An for an amazing stay. The place was spotlessly clean and peaceful :)

Superb location overlooking Royal Mile. Comfortable, clean and well-equipped. A visit we won’t forget as we watched the Queen’s coffin and Royal family processions between Holyroodhouse and St Giles Cathedral. Andy is great at communicating and assisting with any questions or concerns.
Xin 是个很好的房东，回应问题非常及时。房子很温馨，周边就有超市，非常便利，步行去景点也很方便。在爱丁堡度过了愉快的两天。

I highly recommended Lawrie's place. it is exactly as on the picture and was clean when we arrived. The street is quite and the house easy to find. We received quick answers and a lot of details whenever we had a question. Good location with bus stops and a Lidl around the house. it was great!

We had a fantastic stay at Scott’s place. The location is perfect just 10min walk from Waverly station. All the key attractions are within walkable distance. The view of Edinburgh castle from the drawing room is breath taking. The place is huge, neat and clean with very well equipped kitchen.
Comfy, cosy, cute! Great walkable location, lovely views, and wonderful host!
Had a wonderful stay. Location is perfect and the place had absolutely everything we needed. Would recommend to anyone!

Mike and Pauline were wonderful hosts and so friendly. The accommodation was a great base and exactly as described in a superb area of Edinburgh. So many gorgeous shops and eateries within a couple of minutes’ walk. Easy 30 min walk into town (we had two kids with us so probably quicker without!) but to be honest we could have spent our entire stay in the local vicinity! Thanks so much for a wonderful stay.

Das Zimmer war kleiner als erwartet und sehr dunkel. Es gab keine ausreichenden Ablagemöglichkeiten, weder im Zimmer noch im Badezimmer. Unser Zimmer befand sich direkt an der Straße, sodass das Fenster nicht geöffnet werden konnte. Die Straßen- und Gehweggeräusche waren deutlich zu hören. Die Küche und der Aufenthaltsraum lagen im Keller und verfügten über kein Fenster. In der Küche wurde über drei Tage hinweg der Müll nicht geleert und die Handtücher sowie Lappen nicht gewechselt.

Great location right on the Royal Mile, but because of that it is very noisy with bars turning out until 3am, then rubbish collection starting at around 6am. Also as it’s old property the floor boards creak so we could hear people upstairs moving around which they chose to do into the early hours!

Wow! what an incredible place. double volume massive rooms. super comfortable. incredible location very near to any of the things you'll want to see. i can highly recommend it. Flure was very communicative and also left us a wonderful hamper of goodies when we arrived. Staying here was a treat.
ps. visiting the Wally Dug pub just round the corner is well worth it - local, relaxed and not a hens party in sight (unlike every other pub ;)

Very clean, comfortable, well placed, walkable to everything, easy accessible from the airport. The only things I would specify for people visiting the UK for the first time- if you find the wifi isn't working, it's necessary to make sure the outlet with the wifi router has a switch that needs to be flipped on :) And the shower dial has two parts- the outer dial is for the water to come out of the showerhead, the inner is for the temperature.
Had a great stay with no issues.
Thank you for everything!

Perfecte locatie. Goede restaurants in de buurt. Lopend is alles heel goed te doen, ook naar Old Town.
Klein, maar prima slaapkamer, keuken aanwezig. Het halve tafeltje kan uitgeklapt worden tot rond tafeltje en er zijn uitklapstoelen voor het creëren van een ontbijt hoek, praktisch met de ruimte omgegaan.
Bagage kun je achterlaten en parkeren hebben wij gedaan in Q-park OMNI. Goede en nette garage. 20 minuutjes lopen wat geen straf is langs de bezienswaardigheden.

We initially choose the flat as it had a parking space, however a change of plan meant that we flew in instead. This was a good choice as it gave us more time in Edinburgh and getting from the airport to the city was quick and easy on the tram.
The flat was clean, comfortable and well equipped. The location was a short walk from the city centre so was a great base to explore from. It was quiet except for the morning rush hour, as there was a cobbled street right outside the bedroom, so don't forget your earplugs if you are a light sleeper. There are so many interesting places to visit, highlights were the Castle, National Museum and the Royal Yacht Britannia. We enjoyed meals at Baba, 3 Blind Mice (pizza) and Dishoom (Indian). We all enjoyed our stay and would love to come back soon.
Mes enfants ont apprécié leur séjour

Really high quality flat, in a fantastic location. Really great layout that is spacious, with privacy for all the bedrooms. Well taken care of and looks recently updated, while still maintaining the historic appeal to the place. Everything feels high quality.
Eddie was also super responsive in comms, and is a great host!
 For location, it’s right in the center of town near all the sites and great restaurants. Highly recommended spot!

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour, l'appartement était idéalement situé (proche de toutes les activités de la ville) et il était très propre et bien chauffé (très agréable étant donné la température extérieure). Si nous revenons à Edimbourg nous reviendrons ici!

Perfect location, close to many famous places, several minutes walk to supermarkets and cafes.

Our experience at Julia's place was perfect. The location is highly convenient, just a short 10-15 minute walk away from the city center. The bedroom and bathroom were immaculately clean, and the surrounding area was pleasantly peaceful. Julia provided us with a warm welcome and was easily reachable whenever we needed her.
Nice flat. Easy walk to stores, restaurants and bus stop. Clean and quiet. Great value for your money. Highly recommended.

Tana was a great host, she provided helpful instructions about check in and out and things to do in the area and directions and different travel options
I would 100% recommend
Our family of 6 had a wonderful stay here. Plenty of detail given before arrival and they had everything we needed for a 2 year old. Was very easy to catch the bus to central areas.

房间非常舒适温馨！入住体验非常棒！和家的感觉一样！周围也有Tesco，非常方便！而且我在入住的过程中遇到问题后房东Peter和助手Fiona处理的非常及时！我非常感谢他们的帮助！总体来说，这是一次非常不错的体验！正因为有这样的房间，我在爱丁堡玩的很愉快！

We really enjoyed our stay with Kirstie and Alex. They were very welcoming and their flat was very beautifully decorated and we felt right at home. We also had a lovely evening with Alex and a cup of tea in the living room.
Great well appointed two bedroom apartment with a washer and dryer. Eddie was very communicative. Wonderful transportation, restaurant and shopping recommendations provided.

Mark is a phenomenal host! The aesthetic of his home creates a joyful and eclectic vibe with lots of little details to discover and delight in. Emaculate yet homey and welcoming. Dame Olivia (his cat) alone is worth the visit. 😀
Nicholas was a great host and very responsive and communicated well throughout. The apartment was well presented and is in a great location and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿🥳😍
A great place to stay but only 2 bathrooms for 9 rooms so be prepared to cross your legs!  We also had an unpleasant smell in our room which we discussed at length but couldn’t work out what it was.

L'alloggio è perfetto, essenziale ma arredato con gusto, pulito, in una zona tranquilla ma non lontano dal centro di Edimburgo. Sevi è stata molto gentile e accogliente, la ringrazio e la consiglio vivamente come host!

I had an absolutely amazing 7-night stay at Ryan's place, and I enjoyed every moment of it. The flat is situated in a great district, easily walkable from the city centre, there are great pubs neirby. The flat itself has everything that is necessary for a short stay - the only thinkg I'd add is probably a microvave. Huge thanks to Ryan for everything!

The apartment is very well located. It's 2 minutes walking from Princess street and 5 minutes from Edinburgh Waverly. There are supermarkets, restaurants and shops near by. It is really well decorated and comfortable. You can find everything you will ever need! The hosts have been so helpful and thoughtful all the time. We recommend it to everyone and have no doubt we will be back to this nice apartment next time we visit Edinburgh!

Spacious and very comfortable flat. Well equipped. Location in the New Town was brilliant for our needs, close to everything including the tram line.  Would  certainly rebook on our next trip to Edinburgh.

Cet appartement est idéalement situé dans un quartier calme et résidentiel. idéal pour familles. Proche bus et petite supérette à 5 minutes. Nous avons apprécié les conseils de Pier et Monica. je recommande. Florian.

Great hosts! All communication went smooth both before, during and after our stay. The place is clean and cozy with all you need for a great long weekend. Would absolutely recommend this to anyone asking ⭐️⭐️⭐️

Philip’s place was perfect for our stay in Edinburgh! The location is excellent, with a bus stop right out front making it super easy to get around the city. Absolutely LOVED staying here in this little flat where we felt absolutely at home. The apartment was beautiful and had a very at home feel to it. Would absolutely recommend and look forward to visiting again in the future!
Excellent location and a wonderful host.  Close to everything, but quiet and cozy at night.  Comfortable beds and it looks just like the pictures.
Great place, fantastic location! Really enjoyed waking up to the sound of water each day. Loved it
Great flat and amazing location - can walk anywhere on the Mile and nearby!

Our stay was excellent! The location was fantastic and the accommodations were great! We were very comfortable. Phil was a phenomenal host! He was very friendly, kind, and attentive. We would 110% stay there again.
Great location,spotless room and lots of little extras in the room, also for being so close to the centre also found it nice and quiet at night
Highly recommended, very convenient location, a very nice apartment.
Perfect stay! The room is lovely, well located to explore the city, communication was great and we feel like at home. I would reccomand to stay at Ally's place. Thanks a lot!

We had such a wonderful stay. The house is exactly as pictured and we absolutely loved the vibe. Neil was a friendly host and provided very clear instructions. It really does feel like a peaceful artist’s retreat! ☺️

My partner and I had a lovely time in Edinburgh. Reaaz and Scherie had provided a very thorough guide to the city and Reaaz had some personalised top tips about what to see over the weekend. We were made to feel welcome and the room was lovely.

Great place to stay, well positioned in the city centre - cannot fault.
Super warm experience in this beautiful house full of positive energy. A great place to stay, where I felt better than at home ;)

We had a great few days in Edinburgh. Hiked the hills around Arthur’s Seat, toured the Castle and Holyrood House, and otherwise just explored the city and it’s great restaurants. Also fun to wake up with three coffee/breakfast shops right outside the front door below the flat.

Great location for Arthur's seat. quiet corner of the city. only prob was large number of bins outside front door. Ali was generally responsive, although was slow on our request for early checking. needs a cafetiere!

I had requested special requests which were eventually met but I did have to message several times before I received a reply which was extremely frustrating and inconvenient,
The location is very convenient, close to scenic spots and train stations, and the rooms are relatively large, providing a very comfortable experience.
The appartement was spotless, Francesca and Trish were very helpful and accommodating to our requests. We‘d definitely come again.

The kindest host I ever found: we appreciated a lot her advices and her attention toward us. The apartment was clean, the room is very comfortful and the chance to have breakfast was amazing. I had a great time in Jessica's place! The Summerhouse is super pretty, clean and tidy, and Jessica is always happy to accommodate her guests.
Great communication and great location, being the place in a beautiful area (Dean Village is few minutes walk) also quite close to Haymarket Station.

Great location, excellent accommodations and friendly hosts. Highly recommend.

What a great find on the Royal mile! Close to everything including Waverly station. Across the street from a pub and breakfast places up and down the street. This flat had lots of extras. Furniture very comfortable and bed was super nice.. I would stay here again.

Louisa and her partner were great hosts! They went above and beyond to be friendly and welcoming, and helped my partner and I figure out some logistical challenges. I highly recommend staying here to anyone who doesn’t mind sharing space on their vacation!

Jane ist eine ganz wunderbare Gastgeberin. Wir haben uns wie Zuhause gefühlt und ich wäre am Liebsten noch länger geblieben. Das Zimmer ist sehr schön und gemütlich und die Küche ist top. Nicht zu vergessen die beiden lieben Katzen. Ruby ist eine Schönheit.

Property was lovely and in a great location.

We loved this flat. Plenty of room for three with a comfortable sofa bed. Great neighborhood and lovely back garden. Had a small problem (just a mistake) that was fixed immediately. Would definitely recommend for anyone who wants to be a bit farther from the action of the main tourist area but likes a bit of quiet.

It was great. The apartment is lovely and it’s right next to the old town, so we could walk everywhere in the city. I would stay here again if i ever come back. Just back from a great stay in Edinburgh at Jamie's beautiful,  stylish flat.   In a great location near Dean Village which is well worth a visit to walk around the old streets and for a lovely walk along the Leith River.   I think we literally did everything in Edinburgh.   The Brittania Royal Yacht (really good), a bus tour, Edinburgh Castle, Holyrood Palace (fascinating), The Art Gallery (free and saw some famous paintings!)The Zoo (saw a Panda and the Penguins were fun!) and The Botanical Gardens (free and stunning!) and lots of pubs.  We even saw The Queen at the State Opening of Parliament with Charles and Camilla. The apartment is just in the right spot near to everything and Edinburgh is a beautiful city to explore.  We were there for 4 nights and had lots to do.  I would say the pubs are expensive  so take your pennies (there are a few Weatherspoons tho) and wrap up! Although we were very lucky with the weather. The connections from the airport are really easy.  We did the bus from the airport but there is also a tram.   Took half an hour.  I want to go back for the Fringe Festival next! Thank you Jamie for a perfect stay.

My stay at Ann’s place was so fantastic! The view of the castle took my breath away every morning and night.  The location is great.  Very close to the charming Victoria Street.  It was such a perfect place for me to stay for my first time in Edinburgh.
Kleine maar nuttige ruimte, als uitvalsbasis voor het ontdekken van de stad. Op 45 minuten lopen van het centrum maar een goede busverbinding

Kate is very sociable and talkative, story short, a great host! With her I had my third Airbnb experience in Edinburgh and it was one of the best honestly! Her home is really cozy and well decorated in my humble opinion. The flat is located in Leith so people staying there will have plenty of cool stuff to see nearby (Portobello being a must)! Really close to Kate's house is a bus stop that can take guests to the city centre in a matter of minutes. I didn't regret staying there one bit and if I needed would go there a second time. All the best Kate!

Perfect location! We were within walking distance of everything we wanted to see. Great apartment, well stocked, would stay again!

Fabulously appointed flat in a great location close to fantastic pubs, tram stop and top restaurants.  Andrew was a great communicator during our stay and provided excellent recommendations on local establishments.

Roland's place is better than depicted and described. Located close to the city centre, near to Leith and really well placed for public transport (including the new tram extension).
It is very well appointed, decorated in a wonderful eclectic style, with plenty of room and wonderful aspects (and beautiful sun filled rooms).
Roland is wonderful host - outstanding communication before and during, efficient check -in process and great local recommendations.
The place was perfect for my work trip to Edinburgh, allowing me to relax during a very busy time and have breakfast in a sun filled glorious kitchen. It enabled me to explore well-known areas and relax after full days. I'll be hopefully returning next year when I attend the same meeting.

The hostel is well located, making it easy to explore Edinburgh on foot.
There is a free water refill station inside and a restaurant across the street with affordable breakfast options.
I stayed in an 18-bed dorm with triple bunk beds, the room felt cramped, with little headroom, firm mattresses, and thin pillows, towels are not included.
The bathrooms and showers were reasonably clean, but maintenance could be improved. Most showers did not drain properly, and some toilets struggled to flush.
The chill room was basic and uncomfortable, and the WiFi did not work well.
However, the staff were friendly and helpful.
My first night was disrupted when a guest in my dorm had an issue that required staff to call the police at around 4:00 a.m, waking the room for about an hour, it was uncomfortable, but after speaking with the manager, we reached a satisfactory resolution.
Overall, it's a decent budget hostel with a great location and staff, though the facilities could be improved.

We absolutely loved our stay here!! Nestled just one street down from the Royal Mile, it boasts an incredibly strategic location. You're mere steps from all the historic charm and energy, yet wonderfully removed from the constant hustle and bustle, allowing for peaceful evenings and quiet mornings.

The apartment itself is a beautiful space, thoughtfully designed and incredibly comfortable. We particularly appreciated the little touches that made a big difference: the extra fans were a godsend during warmer evenings, and the 2-in-1 washer dryer was an absolute lifesaver, allowing us to pack light and keep our clothes fresh throughout our stay. This apartment truly felt like a home away from home!

Gorgeous little studio, the bath was amazing and the location is great, easily in the centre in 10 minutes. The check in process was really easy and the support team kept us up to date with everything and came back quickly on questions.

It is in very easy reach of the centre of town, and we also walked easily to the National Museum of Modern Art. Just worth noting that one of the bedrooms is two single beds - which we had missed. Thank you to Steve and Karen for a great stay, we will definitely be back!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Morag's place. Beautiful accommodation, spotlessly clean, with a comfortable bed. The complimentary tea, coffee and milk was great.
The underfloor heating in the beautiful ensuite bathroom was amazing, especially as we had snow during our stay!
Great location opposite the cathedral, close to restaurants and reasonably close to Murrayfield Stadium.

A cozy place to stay, close enough to everything. What I particularly liked was there was a good coffee machine (incl coffee), all utensils you can imagine, real plants and yoga mats. Makes it feel like you stay at a friends place

Spotlessly clean flat in a good location - very regular, nearby bus services into the city centre. Very close to a bank of EV chargers too which was a bonus for us. Daniela was very responsive, answering a couple of questions we had upon arrival immediately.

This modern apartment is a pleasure to stay in. With only a short stroll away to the heart of Edinburgh, you will enjoy exploring with your partner. Ps don't let the external staircase put you off, this adds to the character of the property and location. Someone who enjoys photography may be able to capture this scene perfectly!

Comfy room and bed in a very good neighbourhood. Manigeh is a very chilled host who makes your stay uncomplicated. Just be aware that the room is located in a basement, which means no natural light during the day. But there are other rooms downstairs and 2 shared bathrooms, with a coffee machine and a mini fridge to share. It’s all clean, calm and cosy. Very nice stay. Happy to recommend.

Kevin is a premium host.
Won’t have any issues here .
Well recommend.
all was fine, great responsiveness of the host, well equiped.

Chris's place had everything, and beyond, that makes it an amazing place to stay in Edinburgh. Close to the Tram (2 stops to the castle and street for shopping), 2 small convenience store and grocery just around the corner, and a thoughtfully well decorated home. A classic marriage between old structure and stylish new fittings. Superb shower and a fantastic hall. Wonderful beds and cosy rooms. Just got to love those windows! All in all a superb stay, right there on top of the best Airbnb experiences.
A wonderful period property, perfectly located in central Edinburgh.

Ich fühlte mich auf Anhieb Zuhause, das Tiny House war sehr gemütlich,  einladend und liebevoll eingerichtet. Die Umgebung ist zudem sehr ruhig, man kann dem Trubel der Innenstadt entkommen, die Bushaltestelle in die Stadt ist aber grad hinter dem Haus. Isla und Ihre Eltern waren sehr nett,  hilfsbereit und jederzeit erreichbar bei Fragen. Ich würde die Hütte jederzeit wieder buchen und auch sehr gerne weiterempfehlen.

A perfectly clean and nice place in the middle of Edinbugh Old Town. Not even a minute of walking to get to the Royal Mile. Many restaurants and pubs in close areas, such as Grassmarket. Simply great. Alan was very flexible when we had to make changes due to missed flights. Although we couldn‘t meet him in person, he cared about our comfort and was open for any questions or concerns. We highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to get a taste of a very vibrant city.

Por várias razões (pessoais) tivemos dificuldade em contactar a Rachel.
Não chegamos tarde mas já era noite.
A Rachel tinha dado instruções precisas para recolher a chave.
Facilitou o acesso à cozinha.
Quarto, cama e colchão confortáveis.
Wc com banheira. Água quente disponível.
A reserva foi feita sem pequeno almoço incluído mas a Rachel disponibilizou café.
Very nice place. Clean. Wonderful breakfast.  A few blocks walk to the tram to sights.
Great place in just outside central Edinburgh! Flat is cute and it was so easy for us to walk around to all the main sites. Martha was also very communicative. 10/10 recommend!
Een aanrader!!

We loved our stay at Jing’s place! It’s in such a great location. You have to try the Edinburgh Larder for breakfast right up the street. The kitchen was well stocked and had everything we needed. We would love to stay here if we come back!

We had a great time in Luke’s apartment. We liked its proximity to the Old Town’s restaurants and bars and had a great two days.
Luke was fantastic at getting back to us throughout the process and really flexible.
The apartment was clean and warm - although we didn’t really spend much time there. The bed was comfy and Luke’s suggestions of cafes etc came in very handy.
We had a bit of a palaver getting in as the key box is in a dark area so take a torch !! Other than that everything went really well.

This flat was very much what was advertised.  Great space, conveniently located right off the Royal Mile.  We appreciated little touches like fresh flowers, coffee, tea and milk.  We highly recommend picking this as your spot to stay in Edinburgh.

This is a comfortable home away from home with everything you could need. The location is perfect with shops and supermarkets close by and with a bus station, tram stop and railway station within walking distance.

I was travelling for business and Yvonne’s Place was ideal for a 4 night stay. Great location for nearby shops and public transport and only a short 15 minute walk to the central areas of the city (the Omnicentre is nearby with a cinema and gym). And Leith (Ocean View) is a short bus ride away. Yvonne provided very useful information about the area and was very responsive to any questions I had, both before and during my stay. I would be happy to recommend her place to anyone looking to stay in Edinburgh.
Nice place. Liz was very friendly. Nice view of the hills from the house. I recommend!
Perfect location for us. Our hosts were very helpful and kindly let us leave bags after check out, also offered us umbrellas to borrow as it was very wet.
Had a lovely time at Gabriella’s place. Good communication with the host, clean and cozy place.
非常好，房间干净整洁，房子背后景色很美！
Great flat, very convenient,quiet and comfortable. Very clean and spacious. Near to everything we needed.

Jonathan was a fantastic host. Our group booked last minute and he was extremely helpful with our check in process. His place was spotless and stylish, and was perfect for our short stay in Edinburgh. Conveniently located and within walking distance to everything we wanted to see!
Good place and also good restaurants nearby.

Jane est une hôte hyper accueillante et à l écoute de ses invités. Nous avons passé un super séjour dans son logement si joliment décoré. Il est agréable et tellement bien situé. Le tramway , les restaurants et les commerces sont à deux minutes . Édimbourg est une ville dynamique et à visiter absolument !!
Lovely flat, clean and very well equipped for a couple or a small family. The location was great for us and our two kids.

very nice host, really helpful and available.
Nice room in a very quiet neighborhood.
Not so close to city center (around 25mn) but with a very convenient bus stop nearby.
Overall a very nice place to stay when visiting Edinburg.

We had a great time in Edinburgh! The apartment is within walking distance from the city center. Everything you need is available. Although we did not meet in person, Alan is hospitable and easy to communicate with. The bed is a bit small.
Omdat wij beide dagen dat we er waren van de ochtend tot de avond Edinburgh aan het verkennen waren hebben wij de gezamelijke living niet benut. Alle andere voorzieningen waren prima in orde.

Très jolie maison,  chambre très belle.  Anne Marie est très gentille, sympathique et discrète. Nous avons passé un super week-end. Le logement est super bien desservi par le réseau de bus. Centre d'Edimbourg en seulement 25-30 max avec lignes directes.

The pictures and description don’t do justice to the beaut of a place this is. Elegant, chic, modern, and yet somehow very old fashioned as well. Fantastic decor, great amenities, quite rustic, and very convenient location. Thank you for being pet friendly, our dog had a ball walking the exquisite hardwood floors.

Great location and quiet place for a decent price. Close to tram and only 3 stops from city centre. Kitchen has everything to host four people.
Grocery stores are in a convenient walking distance.
Selena and Roy are great hosts, we loved the flat. Will defo go back any time!
I totally recommend this apartment! Everything was perfect!

Stayed in a few places now and I think that this is on a par if not better than all other's, like an earlier review please don't be put off by the exterior! Once inside the apartment is excellent, also situated close to a fantastic park and other attractions, easy access to all areas of the city with regular cheap public transport links, we will most definitely be back
Thanks Mario.
great place. either a walk or uber into the city. apartment is lovely and would highly recommend

Fiona's flat is increadably stylish and comfortable, there was nothing we missed. The photos and descriptions are exactly what you find, and communication was quick and easy. Location wise you could not want anything better and if the chance came to stay again we would without a doubt.

Great location, fantastic price, and cosy atmosphere. If you're wanting to go to the city centre it's a short bus journey away, however, if you're wanting to see stick around, the main street nearby has a selection of friendly cafes and restaurants. The Airbnb was exactly what we expected and a first class choice for book lovers. Warm space, all the amenities you could need, and a friendly responsive host. Would stay again.
Great place to stay and walk around old town Edinburgh. You won’t struggle to find anything right by the apartment and the view walking in is phenomenal

A friend of mine and I stayed at Lisa’s place for one night only, yet we’ve enjoyed it and appreciated the perfect location and quality of the bedroom. Everything has been good, from pre arrival communication to check out, and I’d definitely stay at Lisa’s place again in the future

The perfect base for a weekend in Edinburgh! Close to train station/bus links so easy to get around.
Selena was an attentive host, checking in to make sure we were ok and too see if we needed anything.
We would definitely use the flat again if we’re staying in Edinburgh.
Really great place to stay (such as on the pictures). Really clean. Calm area well connected to the center by different bus lines or a walk!

Great location, nice and quiet and within easy walking distance of Grassmarket. The flat was very clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Nespresso coffee machine was a real bonus! Li was very helpful and responsive to messages.

We had a fantastic stay at this 2-bedroom apartment in Edinburgh. The property was spotless on arrival – very clean and extremely well presented, with everything thoughtfully prepared for guests. The highlight has to be the beautiful sea view, which made mornings and evenings extra special. The apartment is comfortable, spacious, and in a great location for exploring Edinburgh and the surrounding area. It felt like a real home away from home, and we wouldn’t hesitate to stay again. Highly recommended!

We had a pleasant stay at this apartment.
Location is perfect to discover the Oldtown of Edinburgh. An the pubs of course.

Great place to stay. Room was clean, cosy, and looked the same as the pictures.
Noël was a very nice and helpful host.

This was my first time using Airbnb, and it couldn't have been a better experience. The instructions were very clear and easy, making things go very smoothly. The apartment was very clean and inviting. Then walking into the living room and seeing the spectacular view of Arthur's Seat through the window was the cherry on top.
We had a great time exploring Edinburgh and surrounding areas, while using the apartment as our home base. The location is excellent for getting around as well, with several scenic routs into the city center, as well as easy bus access right in the front of the building.
I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone else wanting to explore Edinburgh.

This is a great find, so close to the centre and excellent transport links . The flat was very clean and tidy with a fully equipped kitchen . Trudi made finding the key very easy and was in daily contact to see if we needed anything. The bedrooms were small, with no hanging space however the sitting room was enormous and made up for it. I would definitely stay here again .

It was an adequate stay. The flat was rather cold though, even if we tried adjusting the thermostat. Other than that it was fine. We didn’t properly check the extra charge if you stay for only one day and couldn’t cancel, so bear that in mind when booking. Only because of this we thought it was a tad expensive, but it’s quite close to the city centre so it’s the location you will be getting for the price.
The space was roomy .All of the items we needed to use the kitchen were provided. Response time from host was timely. They offered several wonderful food recommendations.
Lynn is a great host, very friendly. The home is clean and very comfortable. The location is only a few steps from Edinburgh Castle, Royal Mile and the pubs.

A great place to stay in Edinburgh, comfortable, warm and peaceful despite some rough weather. We managed to grab a parking space outside the door at the start of our stay, and were able to walk to everywhere we wanted to visit.
What a great spot near all the fun Edinburgh has to offer. A stylish space with all the amenities you’d expect. Highly recommended, thanks Melissa!
Large spacious flat on Royal Mall. Large bedrooms well stocked kitchen - love to stay again.

Harvey is such a great host. He is super responsive and was always able to answer any questions I had before and after arriving. Very clear instructions and a beautifully located apartment, centre of the Old town, near to great restaurants and pubs.
The stay was nice, airbnb was well equipped but the location is next to graveyard which was a bit scary for me but if you don’t mind that it’s great!

Tina’s place was exactly as described and super clean. She was super flexible and accommodating when checking in. She offered lots of tourist recommendations and bus routes to make our trip as easy as possible. Tina was super friendly and very responsive when messaging with her. Overall great place and we would definitely stay again! ☺️

Fabulous Edinburgh flat that makes you feel right at home - our family of 4 with 2 adult kids stayed very comfortably here - it was warm, clean, comfortable and had everything we needed.

Appreciated the lovely welcome drinks and chocolate but there are also great supermarkets nearby and a sweet little shop around the corner for newspapers, snacks and essentials
Very cosy place near to the centre of the city with all you need for a comfortable stay.
Would definitely stay here again. Small but charming space. Great location nearly in Holyrood Park. About a 20-25 min walk to the main drag of the royal mile, which was perfect for us.

Great location in a traditional edinburgh town house. It can get a bit noisy outside due to a bar being right opposite the flat, but what else do you expect when living in the center of Edinburgh old town. The flat offers all amenties you'd need and easily accomodates four (we were three, but the pull out sofa bed is big enough to sleep two). We could drop our luggage before the regular check in time and could stay longer than the regular check out time would've permitted. Patsy, Ann and John made our stay in Edinburgh a great experience. Highly recommend this flat if your in for a unique Edinburgh experience!

Anouk and her flatmates are extremely welcoming and friendly. The house is divine and very spacious. We had a great room. The house is in a good location very close to a bus into town as well as a massive shopping centre. We really felt like it was home from home!
Great spacious, well equipped apartment. Ideal for a family of 4, airbed worked ok for us for 5th person.
Cary and Pete are lovely hosts in a lovely house. They offer a pleasant room in a super-nice part of town. Highly recommended!
Fantastic place. Amazing location. Beautifully appointed. Immaculately clean. Extremely comfortable.  Highly recommended.
La terrazza …non è fattibile
Perfect for what we needed!

sandra and john her husband were excellent host the room was lovely and clean and the bed was so comfy had a great nights sleep.breakfast in the morning will set you up for the day i would highly recommend this host.
Quite near to Edinburgh city. Great communication.

Great host.
helpful.
spotless apt..
Andrew a gentleman

Ross was outstanding. He explained the amenities of the apartment and the surrounding sites.
The apartment was clean, orderly, and in a perfect location.
Ross answered all of our queries quickly and fully. He is approachable and friendly.
The way he treats his guests comes through in the same way he cares for his apartment.
I highly recommend Ross and his property. If you have an opportunity to rent it, do so quickly. You cannot beat the location and the price that he offers.

Davis was a great host, no problems finding the apartment thanks to his thorough instructions. Good location, you can easily walk to the center of the city or just take a bus in. Nice quiet neighborhood, beautiful view from the kitchen and living room. Good breakfast options. The spacious bed room was clean , as was the rest of his apartment. I only met David once during my three nights stay, maybe because I was out a lot being a tourist or he was working. But when finally met him , he sounded like a really nice guy. Highly recommend staying at his apartment.
One note though, the apartment is on the third floor and you need to climb stairs to the apartment.

ll nostro soggiorno a Edimburgo è stato molto positivo! La stanza era centralissima a due passi dal Castello di Edimburgo. Tantissimi bar dove fare colazione la mattina e pub per cenare a breve distanza. La stanza corrispondeva alla descrizione, molto curata e pulita e la comunicazione con la host ottima ed efficace. Lo consiglierei.

I loved Duc’s place. It is not far from the city centre, there are convenient stores near by, and quiet neighbourhood. Duc was always responsive and helpful. There are other tenants in the same house, my room was on the third floor. There was no lift but Duc helped me with the luggage. There were cookies, teas, coffee, cups, spoons, and an electric kettle in the room. The bathroom was very clean with plenty of toilet papers and had no odd smells.
Lovely apartment in a great location.  Very clean and tidy with full amenities.

This is a great apartment. Bright and airy but warm and comfortable too.  Super comfortable beds and bedding, well equipped kitchen and responsive heating and hot water. Laura offered lots of suggestions for local amenities and was quick to respond to all communications. The local area of Stockbridge has everything you need and is an easy walk from the city centre. There's also a lovely riverside walk just a few minutes away. I'd definitely stay here again.
Perfect for a special birthday weekend in Edinburgh

A Helen é uma pessoa muito simpática e gentil. Nos deixou muito à vontade.
Seu espaço é muito confortável, tudo muito limpo e bonito.
Altamente recomendável!

Salma’s place was great for our group. The apartment was charming and cozy. The location was great, very close to a lot of good restaurants and bars and within walking distance of Edinburgh castle. Salma was helpful with recommendations and quick replies. We would stay again!
Great stay, Shona is a lovely host.
Great place, fantastic design and a nice neighbourhood. Sarah is such a friendly host and she’s been helping out a lot! Definitely worth a visit if you come to Edinburgh 👏
很愉快的旅游体验！屋子十分的宽敞！地理位置很优越。

Absolute best place we could have asked for! I loved staying in Leith, probably more so than the main tourist attraction area. So much to do, and great restaurants! With the added bonus of missing a lot of the major crowds.
The Airbnb itself was such a great value. We had everything we needed, and Calum is such a proactive and kind host. I loved that he supplied us with all we needed for a quick breakfast, making our stay so much easier the next morning!
Do yourself a favor, and have a stress free stay in Edinburgh at Calum’s Airbnb :)
It was great, would stay again.

Great location in the heart of New Town, just a stone's throw from the castle. Plenty of pubs, restaurants and takeaways almost at the doorstep (good soundproof windows isolate from all street noise though). Detailed and accurate check-in instructions, the apartment was clean and prepared for our arrival. Lack of nearby car park options may be a bit of a nuisance for some (it was for us), although it was clearly mentioned in the listing. A very pleasant stay overall.

The space is great and low-key. Perfect for a stay with a friend or two in Edinburgh. Our hosts were super communicative, and the apartment was super clean and comfortable.
The streets are a bit noisy at night, so if that is a turn off, keep this in mind!

The apartment was extremely clean and tidy, everything was brand new. Very comfortable. You couldn't get a better location. The street has many cafes and boutique shops, and it's right around the corner from the Royal Mile. The bus from the airport also stops right around the corner. The host Martin was very friendly, helpful and accommodating.
I will definitely stay here again!
Comfy beds and easy check in. Was good being able to check in a bit early and the apartment was very clean.
Lovely flat in a great location

A beautiful flat and for such a central location having the kitchen and bedroom at the back of the property means very peaceful sleeps and relaxing breakfast at the kitchen table. The private parking space was a big benefit for our visit and once we mastered the one way streets around the property it was ideal! Thank you to Greg and Jo - we definitely intend to stay again in the future when visiting Edinburgh.
We had a great time at Debbie's place! Debbie is really talkative and kind person who can also recommend you local attractions. Highly recommend!
Great home and great host. Located above a bar so can be noisy, but the food is very good and you can get it at discounted rate.
Stockbridge is lovely, and this place was a nice base from which to visit it.
房间非常整洁，设施齐全，晚上很安静，离海边近，交通方便。适合三四人过夜。

Karen is an amazing host! Place was clean and tidy. She was so helpful as my 80 year mum and 60yr old me tried to navigate the city. She provided us clear instructions to find our way. She was available when we had questions but also not intrusive! We left a jumper there and she was willing to drop it at a hotel we were staying later in our trip! Christy helped us with our luggage and didn’t even grimace as we had well overpacked!  They are great folks and it was a pleasure to be in their home!
Good location but be aware of steep hill if you have mobility issues. In need of some tlc but fair value for money.
Casa bella, particolare, di impatto. Ben collegata con i mezzi . Da consigliare

We had a family break for 3 nights beds were comfy kitchen newly refurbished with a dishwasher and washer dryer fridge kettle tea cofee sugar

nice little apartment tucked away at the side of the castle . Cafes and bars on your door step and a short walk in to Edinburgh 10 min to princes st loads to do on the way
This place was great! Had everything we needed and the location was so convenient - within easy walking distance to anything we wanted to see. Would definitely stay there again!
Muy cerca del aeropuerto, los dueños responden a todas las dudas muy rápido, el alojamiento está muy buen, muy limpio

Prima plek om te verblijven voor bezoek aan Edinburgh. Op loopafstand van het centrum en bezienswaardigheden. Aardige en behulpzame hosts. Appartement is klein maar smaakvol ingericht. Leuke kunst aan de muur ook.
Prijs vindt ik aan de hoge kant maar je zit natuurlijk wel in het centrum van de stad.

My son and I stayed here for 3 weeks the location was great it was walkable to almost any of the major sights to see in Edinburgh and it is also very close to the University. I would definitely recommend staying here. The space sleeps 3-4 comfortably and the living are was large enough that we were not on top of each other. The kitchen was big enough to cook in and the only downside to the kitchen was that the refrigerator is small and there is not a lot of space to freeze anything. Overall I would recommend this place if you want a great location to access all of Edinburgh.
This cottage was even better than the pictures!! It’s in a great location and has spectacular views of the castle.
She's sweet and very helpful and the location can't be best. A little loud on the weekends but the convenience was worth it. Great for the price!

Wonderful stay! Short walk from the tram that made exploring the city easy but it was nice to stay in a quieter neighborhood by the water once we were done for the day. Few great coffee shops,  restaurants, and grocery stores within walking distance, too. Super clean space and the milk in the fridge was a lovely touch to go with our tea.
This cozy apartment is great! Recommend it to anyone for sure!
The apartment was beautifully decorated, cozy, and in a great location. Would highly recommend!

Anna and Simon were very responsive and gracious hosts. The check-in was superb, especially with the picture of the building so you knew exactly what to look for. The location is better than we imagined.
