It is in a central location but it is quiet when it’s time to take an afternoon nap or off to sleep. The kitchen and bathroom had everything we needed. There were extra pillows so getting comfortable was easy. Thanks again, Selina and Randall!

Nice and clean place, great location. As described, it is very near the train station, with loads of dining options nearby. Lisa is friendly and gave me some great tips for watering holes in the area.
Great host, very warm and friendly. Thanks for the hospitality
Cameron was really friendly and helpful when he messaged, and the apartment looks like the photos. Really clean place with good local transport links back into city centre.
Great location just outside of city center. Great spot for 1-2 person traveling!
Such a helpful and friendly host. Feel like home!

Logement plutôt conforme à la description. Hote très active pendant le séjour. Était ok pour nous arranger sur les horaires.
À côté du stade de rugby facile avec le tram.
Bien pour rester un week-end mais pas un gros séjour.

Annette was a lovely host who made sure all our needs were met. Everything was very comfortable, and she was very helpful for directions and touring Edinburgh. It was so nice to be across from the harbor, and the restaurants were great that were nearby. Thanks again, Annette!
A great place to stay. Lovely views looking into the city

We enjoyed our stay with Ally, she is a good host. Ally was very accommodating and friendly, and gave us several great local tips.  The space was very clean and neat, and it was within walking distance of quite a lot of sights.
beautiful surroundings nice and quiet well kept property overall a very nice place to stay would recommend to anyone

Gerrard went the extra mile to send us a lot of information on local places to eat and tours to look into. He added special touches to our room and visit to Edinburgh that made our stay memorable, and everything was only a short walk away- we would highly recommend staying here.
Great place and location would highly recommend. Superb communication from Greg leading up to the visit and after. If you want a central location you couldn't ask for a better place.

Josi and Tom are a really nice couple, and their house is great for exploring the city, as it is very near the centre. We had interesting chats with Tom in the mornings, and we heard him playing the piano ;-) We would stay again if we come back to Edinburgh!
Very handy to walk to most attractions

Pauline went above and beyond to make sure that we were comfortable. She had the quickest response time anytime we sent her a message. The place was just as the pictures looked and the kitchen was stocked with the necessities. She even had recommendations for local restaurants we could check out. We would definitely stay here again!

Very nice BnB. Centrally located to all the major attractions.

The place is clean and tidy, the environment is beautiful, next time I have a chance to stay again

Le logement était impeccable, de belles prestations, tout confort. Je n’ai malheureusement pas vu l’hôte mais les deux autres guests étaient très sympathiques.

Je recommande a 100%

Easy communication with hosts, very clean. About 20-30 minutes walking distance from city centre. Lot of shops and restaurants around the apartment.
Nice place overall.

We loved our stay with Dylan. He was a super friendly and welcoming host and gave really great recommendations- especially restaurants! Our room was nice and comfortable. The location is really nice and slightly removed from all the crowds tourists with nice local bars and restaurants to go to down the road.

Loved the place! Perfect location, and right next to a lot of pubs and restaurants. The castle was a 10min walk, so perfect to go for evening strolls. The apartment itself was nice and cozy for me and my family to spend the weekend. Definitely made our stay in Scotland comfortable :)
It was a very good stay at Maggie's house! The room was tidy and cozy, everything was beautifully arranged. Enjoyed the amazing garden and the accompany of puppy. Thanks Maggie!

Simon y Claire han sido súper amables y atentos. La casa es acogedora y la cama muy confortable. Buena ubicación,  con comercio y bares. A 15-20 minutos andando del centro, y muy bien conectado a través del transporte público.

Late check in, early check out,   the hostess not  helpfull at all, not as close to the main streets as expected , very noisy due to massive construction site next street , uncomfortable couch , terrible shower.
Stunning, such a beautiful stay, hosts were brilliant, the location was incredible, the place was spotless and had everything we needed, highly recommend for anyone looking to visit Edinburgh!

I had an amazing stay with Clare; she’s super friendly and will recommend you loads of good things in Edinburgh which is always good.

Was very quite despite being so close to everything

We arrived early and stored our luggage at a facility in Edinburgh and had an explore. The flat was ready early so we walked there and unpacked etc. The accommodation was perfect. Plenty of room. In a quiet area. Nice and clean. A view of Arthur’s seat and near to Holyrood Palace.
Every time I asked Duncan a question he got straight back and was most helpful.
I would definitely visit again

Comunicazione veloce e precisa. Casa pulita e confortevole, sia come spazi sia con i servizi offerti. Posizione ben servita dai mezzi pubblici (l'aeroporto distac30 minuti e il centro città  circa 10 minuti di bus), ma volendo si può  raggiungere il centro a piedi in 25 minuti facendo una passeggiata per Edimburgo. Ci sono due supermercati aperti fino ale 22 e dei locali in cui mangiare nelle immediate vicinanze. Per essere la prima volta che utilizzo questo tipo di alloggio sono pienamente soddisfatto.

We had a great stay and the apartment very much matched the photos. Valentina was always very quick to respond and very helpful when we needed help with the stove. (Our confusion - nothing was wrong with it!)
The stairwell was quite unflattering and dirty, but everything inside the apartment was lovely.
Great host!
The apartment was perfect! It was big, clean and the location was great! The host was very communicative and sent information in good time before our arrival. I can really recommend this apartment!

Dave was very kind and generous. He provided a lovely breakfast and had many tipps at hand to make our stay as nice as possible. He's always available for a little chat and has many stories to tell :) We would definetly come back!
I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Edinburgh. Amazing location and such a comfortable place to stay.

Great location. Close to the action but on a quieter side street away from the noise so you can sleep peacefully. The bathroom was big, modern and comfortable; very important to my wife and me. I definitely recommend this place.
Pier Luigi was a great host. He gave us great recommendations and his place was very clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay here again!
Lovely apartment with a great location. Couldn't be faulted
The place is beautiful and clean, has a nice location and the host, Alan, was very inviting and helpful.
Vielen Dank für die freundliche Aufnahme, Lage ist mit Auto sehr gut, Innenstadt schnell erreichbar- guter Anschluss zum Flughafen.
The apartment was better than expected and we loved it. Perfect position for exploring Edinburgh on foot.
Very nice, bright clean room in a good location for walking to major sites in Edinburgh. The hosts were very friendly and quite helpful. We had a great time.

My stay at Susan's home really couldn't have been nicer.  Unfortunately, the day I left, I got tangled up in an air traffic meltdown, and had to spend an extra night in Edinburgh.  If my flight insurance would have paid for it, I would have begged Susan to let me come back!  As it was, I needed to stay in one of the airline's approved soulless hotels. I would love to stay with Susan again if and when I am back in Edinburgh,

Tout était parfait ! Tony a été très soucieux de s’assurer que tout était propre et conforme, et ça l’était ! L’appartement est super bien situé, au pied de la rue Victoria, juste à côté du château, à proximité de plein de super restaurants. Je recommande vivement cet appartement pour votre séjour à Édimbourg 👏🏻

I liked staying at Sheila's. It felt homely, Sheila gave me a lot of info about places to go and see and pubic transport. The room was not big (however normal size and big enough for me) although that was stated when I selected the place (I think the other rooms may have been bigger). Could not lock my door. Sheila said it was safe and I decided to trust her. I would stay at Sheila's again.
Another wonderful stay with Anne Marie. Always lovely to come back to edinburgh and stay there :-)

Philip’s place was ideal for our trip to Edinburgh. Clean, convenient, and located in a great part of the city. Ideal if you’re attending an event at Murrayfield of just staging for the old town. Excellent in every way!
Spacious apartment in great location close to the station and lots of good places to eat. Seemed like excellent value and we would stay again. Thanks
We had an awesome stay here. The place had all the conveniences and was in a great location to easily explore Edinburgh. Highly recommended.
The space is cozy, I felt at home
A modern, stylish and relaxing apartment. Check-in was straightforward and there were lots of lovely little touches! We would love to stay again :-)

Wir waren zu fünft in der schönen und geräumigen Wohnung zu Gast und hatten eine tolle Zeit.
Die Wohnung in zentraler Lage mit netten Restaurants und Cafés in der Nachbarschaft und Blick auf den Park ist unbedingt zu empfehlen.
Wir kommen bestimmt mal wieder.
Lieben Dank, Daniela!
Sehr gut gelegene, praktische kleine Wohnung, nahe am Stadtzentrum und trotzdem ruhig.  Unkomplizierte, effiziente Gastgeberin.
Great place to stay - Anna was so helpful, and it was a lovely place to stay. Would recommend!
well appointed flat in a good position and a responsive host, comfy beds!!

Jonathan’s place was immaculate and in the perfect location. You walk out of the front door and can see the castle right away. His place was very modern and clean. Would stay here again in a heartbeat!

The flat is beautifully designed and everything was of good quality. Pier had thought of every single detail and it was amazing how much he managed to fit into this compact little flat. The bed was one of the most comfortable beds I have slept on outside my home. We enjoyed our stay in Edinburgh very much.

It was great staying with Andy. He has good taste in decoration, and keeps the place very clean.
I loved some of his suggested places, for example near his house there is Blackford hill, this is not a very touristy spot but it has such a great view of the entire city. You can see Edinburgh Castle, the cathedral and Arthur’s throne in the same frame. I would not have visited this place if it was not for his recommendation.

We had a fabulous pre Christmas stay in Levi’s garden apartment. It was beautifully clean and comfortable- perfect for our family. The kitchen is a great space to all gather.
Stockbridge is a lovely area to explore with great independent shops and restaurants, but walkable into central Edinburgh.
We hope to return.
A little tricky finding the correct door to the flat and lockbox - but once we got in it was a great place to stay. Location was awesome! There was plenty of space and everything was as described.

An exceptional housing in the very city center of Edinburgh.
The property was really clean and fully equipped, the bed is comfortable.
Micheal and Barry are nice and answered really fast to any enquiry we had.
The Harry Potter ambiance is there.
I highly recommend this flat for any trip to Edinburgh!
Thank you!

Steve’s place is great. Well located, we walked everywhere, and lots of nearby dining options. So nice to be located across the road from a beautiful green space. Steve was very helpful with local information. Thanks for an enjoyable stay.

From our first contact we were made to feel welcome and valued.  Great information provided on where to find things and what was available.   Endless hot water and brand new bathroom!  Automatic temperature control in the apartment too.
Clean and friendly as described.
Great location for walking into the city centre, good amenities, enjoyed our stay
Everything was very lovely. Harriet was super helpful and had everything very ready for our stay. The guides she gave us into the city were incredibly helpful. I highly suggest staying with them!
Lovely flat, spotlessly clean and the shower was fantastic
Had a great stay going to see a show at Edinburgh playhouse was centrally located for a meal before and close enough to walk back after the show.

Everything was as described. Following the other reviews, we expected it to be a bit noisy during the night and that was the case. We didn’t mind it. One little thing, there could be a Toaster in the otherwise well equipped kitchen. Heating was great, bedroom was nice and bathroom was good.

Absolutely loved Edinburgh and was able to purchase some Scottish gold earrings at Two Skies LITERALLY just down the walk which I hadn’t expected.  I had really wanted to go there and had no idea that it was neighbors to this listing! A little tight in the bedroom but that’s a European bedroom for ya! The location can’t be beat!

Great communication from booking, answered any queries that I had and accommodated. Friendly host, room was exactly as stated, easy walk from St Andrews square lots of cafes and shops around. We throughly enjoyed our stay
A great spot, easy walk to plenty of tourist attractions. Good kitchen, nice bathroom and comfortable bed.

Ich habe meinen Aufenthalt sehr genossen und mich sehr wohlgefühlt. Die Wohnung ist sehr durchdacht eingerichtet, alles hat seinen Platz und alles, was man für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt braucht, ist vorhanden. Da mein Flug verspätet war und ich im Dunkeln an einer falschen Haltestelle ausgestiegen bin, empfehle ich besonders allein reisenden Frauen, einen Bus zu wählen, der direkt vor die Unterkunft fährt und auch dort auszusteigen ;) Ansonsten ist die Lage und Gegend wirklich super!
Ich war untertags viel unterwegs und hatte daher keinen Kontakt zu anderen Gästen. Die Unterkunft ist etwas hellhörig, man hört Schritte, Gespräche und Nutzung der Küche oder des Bads. Ich habe trotzdem extrem gut geschlafen. Die Hausregeln sind klar kommuniziert und sorgen bei Einhaltung für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt. Łukasz habe ich nicht persönlich kennengelernt, aber bin mir sicher er wäre bei Problemen jederzeit zur Hilfe gewesen. Danke für den schönen Aufenthalt–ich würde jederzeit wieder buchen!

Poor start to our initial communication but made a good recovery on arrival.
Property lacking on basic essentials ie iron, sink basin, sink plug and clothes horse.
Location is brilliant, really close to city.
had a wonderful, thr place was clean and tidy. and toshie was very informative in regards to house rules and entry instructions!
Elizabeth was very responsive and friendly. The room is beautiful and it was spotless. I recommend her for everyone who is looking for a quiet place in Edinburgh

We enjoyed our stay. There were a few problems with the building front door but that was ultimately remedied. My biggest concern was the fact that the rubber seal in the washer was loaded with mold. I tried scrubbing that out to make it usable. We also lacked a bath mat in the master bathroom.  Hopefully these issues have been fixed.

The place was very good for 4 people and it provided everything listed. The only thing was that the internet stopped working on the second day and we couldn't get it fixed. Also, the lack of a shower door/barrier made a mess on the floor every time we took a shower.

We had an amazing time with Cary, she is a very attentive host and she gave us lots of information about Edinburgh and the Scottish culture.
The bedroom was really clean and cosy, we felt at home. Thank you so much 😊
Angela was very helpful and friendly, while being unobtrusive as well. The location was perfect for my needs, with easy parking as an added bonus. I would stay here again should the need arise.

I highly recommend this spot. It’s a gorgeous little apartment within walking distance of all the main attractions. Paulina was an excellent host and made sure I was well looked after. I would visit again.

Lugar acogedor con muy buena comunicación a la Old Town. El apartamento es un poco antiguo asi que crujen los pasillos al caminar. Ideal para grupos grandes aunque tiene solo un baño. La vista es maravillosa hacia los campos y la iglesia cerca.
This was a great stay in Edinburgh. The location is amazing and the flat was perfect for 4. We were able to check in early which was great and our host was very communicative. I definitely recommend!

Asked on the day if we could possibly gain access sooner. Lucky he was able to accommodate this. I was so thankful. Flat looks exactly like the pictures. The area was quiet and easily parked outside the flat.
About 10 min drive out the centre. Uber from the centre was £16.
Would stay again 👍

Muy bonita la habitación , limpia , buena ubicación.
Anfitrión atento

Sous les bons conseils de Charlotte nous avons pris le tram en sortant de l'aéroport. Celui-ci nous a déposé à quelques mètres du logement. L'appartement est bien situé, dans un quartier calme, à deux pas de la veille ville. Le beau temps nous a permis de prendre notre premier petit déjeuner écossais sur la terrasse (très agréable). Charlotte était en vacances pendant notre séjour et nous ne l'avons pas rencontré mais elle était très réactive.
Le seul petit inconvénient c'est le manque de place pour ouvrir une grande valise. Problème minime au vue du reste.
A conseiller

Estancia perfecta. Radek ha sido muy muy amable en todo el momento del viaje, atendiendo rápidamente los mensajes y ayudándonos con todo tipo de recomendaciones y consejos en la ciudad. Totalmente encantados y agradecidos con Radek y su amabilidad y disposición. El piso es pequeño, pero para 3 personas, más que suficiente. La ducha es amplia y las camas son muy cómodas. En definitiva, perfecto para lo que lo necesitas en unas vacaciones.
Edimburgo es preciosa. Seguramente, volveremos.

Sam was erg hartelijk en nam de tijd om ons rond te leiden in het huis en gaf uitgebreide toelichting op wat er allemaal te doen was in de stad.
Wat even wennen was de beperking van bewegingsvrijheid vanwege andere gasten. Dit is omschreven in de tekst, maar in ons geval was het toch wat vervelend om niet naar het toilet te kunnen in de ochtend omdat andere gasten uitgebreid de tijd namen in de badkamer. Een vergelijkbaar verhaal gold voor de avond ervoor in de keuken. Dus iets om rekening mee te houden.
Verder is de locatie op loopafstand van het centrum en kun je vanaf het apartments complex een fijne wandeling maken naar Holyrood Park/Arthur’s Seat, met een mooie uitzicht over de stad. (Kom begin of einde van de dag want je bent niet de enige die de stad graag vanaf dit uitzichtpunt wil zien).
Al met al, Sam was een ontzettend enthousiaste host en deze plek was voor ons prima voor een eerste nacht in Schorland. Dank voor je gastvrijheid!
De passage pour un séjour professionnel, j'ai été très bien accueilli chez Susan. Je recommande pour un petit séjour proche d'Édimbourg
Brilliant value, the loveliest host - and a great (central) location, yet quiet and cosy. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Amanda’s home. Thank you for making us so welcome Amanda!
Una ubicación realmente ESPECTACULAR, el departamento muy cómodo, limpio y de buen tamaño, muy apegado a las imagenes, cocina equipada y todo lo necesario para disfrutar y relajarse.

We had booked a different place that was already occupied when we arrived.  I found Lukas place in a panic to have a place to stay, she responded immediately to let us know we could go there as soon as we needed. She provided very clear pictures of the outside, how to use the locks, etc.  Condo was very nice, clean and close to bus stop.  Shower had good pressure in a large bathroom.  Would definitely recommend.

lovely clean and spacious place. lots of warning about sound levels on the listing. but didn't encounter any problems whilst we were there.
The floor mattresses are small so I had 2 shoved together. although there were no sheets.
kitchen was well equipped

Jennifer’s flat is a uniquely cozy Airbnb perfectly located in Edinburgh. It was the perfect place for us and our cat Merlin to stay and enjoy a holiday. Jennifer was an amazingly kind host who made us feel very welcomed and was always there to help. The flat itself is delightfully decorated and has everything you need to make you and your pet (or baby) feel comfortable. We are definitely keeping this one on the favourite list of Airbnbs for Edinburgh❤️

The appartement was in a good location, with great bus connections to the centre and Heriot Watt University. It was clean and cosy. The kitchen had all of the equipment we needed! All in all we had a pleasant stay.

Cody was always quick to reply,the place looked like the photos. There were 3 adults staying and we had plenty of room.
It is on the high street but, it wasn't noisy .
There are a few bars and restaurants with in walking distance. A bonus is the free parking down near the police station if you can get a spot.

Fantastic location, fantastic property, fantastic hostess. COULD NOT BE HAPPIER. Truly, an exceptional AirBnb -- Audrey has thought of everything!  Spotlessly clean, such comfy beds with warm, cozy duvets, fully equipped kitchen -- fully equipped everything! Audrey left so many thoughtful touches -- you can tell she really cares about your experience and wants you to feel right at home, which you do! Soooo quiet, peaceful and private. Rosebank Cottages is such a special place, with all the flowers and green everywhere you look, it's an oasis in this beautiful, busy city! We were so happy to come home to it every evening and nearby restaurants are fantastic. Easy to get into and out of the city on foot or by bus, and the Haymarket tram to and from the airport is awesome! Audrey was always there when we needed her, even advising us on a minor medical crisis our son experienced. We hated to leave this wonderful place and we can't wait to come back! Thank you Audrey!
The Apartment exceeded our expectations and the location couldn’t have been better. This apartment is perfect for a city break with your friends and we would highly recommend.

Georgia’s place is perfect for a lovely trip away in Edinburgh!
Close to local amenities, with a large Tesco literally on your doorstep!
You’re no more than a 30 minute walk into the centre of Edinburgh, with buses coming and going every 10-15 minutes.
Would definitely recommend this to anyone wanting to be stay in Edinburgh!!!!

Really lovely apartment, fantastic location with lots of independent shops and coffee shops literally just round the corner. Very quiet location, no noise issues at all. We were there at the end of Dec and were very toasty and warm.
Great base to see all the sights of Edinburgh, we walked in and out of the city each day, about 20 mins walk.
Would definitely recommend this as a place to stay.
Hanne was lovely and helpful, particularly kind when we were stranded in Edinburgh during Storm Arwen!

Guy is a friendly host who communicated really well with us during our stay.
The accommodation worked really well for our family as a base to explore Edinburgh during our 2 night stay. Edinburgh castle, Royal Mile etc. all within walking distance if you don’t mind a bit of a stroll!
The house itself is great for a family of 6…3 bedrooms here so no need for a sofa bed.
Overall, the house was tidy but the kitchen could really do with a deep clean to freshen it up.
Nice, clean and tidy flat. Kitchen appliances (washing machine) came in handy as we had our one year old with us. Tea bags also very appreciated!
Lovely quirky flat which we felt at home in right away. Parking was easy and transport links could not be better. Would have no hesitation in staying there again or recommending it.

Apartment is as described and a great spot for 2-4 people to enjoy the city. It’s about a 20 minute walk from Princes Street, with plenty of nice cafes around. We stayed here for the Fringe Festival, and is was a perfect location and size for that. Daria kept in touch with us and responded as needed. Many thanks!

Nos hôtes ont été très accueillants et réactifs à nos demandes. L’appartement est propre et suffisant pour nous qui étions 3 (un couple et un enfant). Le seul petit point que nous avons moins apprécié est la luminosité dans l’appartement la nuit mais nous ne sommes pas habitués à dormir avec de la lumière et chez nous il fait noir la nuit.
Le logement est situé à 35 min à pied du centre ville mais il y a des possibilités de transports en commun à proximité.
C’est un bon choix pour visiter Édimbourg qui est une très belle ville.
Perfect place to go to the old town by foot, but is in a very noisy street all night. Also room have poor isolation. Clean and easy to get into
accurate to the description and a nice location
Loved our stay here and would recommended to anyone! Amazing location to walk to all main spots in Edinburgh. Apartment was just as described, lovely and modern as well as clean. Thank you very much!

The place is nice and great location to go around Edinburgh. Very cozy as well.
Although the bedding and the thermal insulation of the apartment could be improved.
Enjoyed the stay
10/10 recommend. Felt like home away from home.

Amazing stay, beautiful and comfortable accommodation. Hospitality from Doug  was faultless, supported by Max the dog who was friendly and adorable. Can't recommend this place enough if you plan on visiting Edinburgh or the surrounding area. We will be sure to visit again!
Mhairi is super friendly and helpful and will point you in the direction of anywhere you want to explore in Edinburgh.
We had a great stay in this cosy cottage in a convenient location. Susan was a super responsive and communicative host!
Was a perfect place to stay while in the area for business.

We had a lovely stay just 5-10 minute walk from New Town and a 15-20 minute walk to Old Town. The architecture of Edinburgh is beautiful.
The apartment is really well laid out with every thing you could need.
The street can sound noisy when trying to fall asleep from passing cars and people talking loudly, but ear plugs are provided as the windows are single pane and I presume part of a listed building.
Overall a great stay!

Tom was a great host, really helpful and informative. He had a map waiting for us to give us a better idea of the surrounding area and things to see and do (all within walking distance around the city). The apartment itself was exceptionally clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Thanks again Tom, we'll be back for sure!
Apartamento precioso en la mejor zona posible de la ciudad, si volvemos a ir a Edimburgo no dudaremos en alojarnos en el mismo sitio

Emily's place is so cosy and so close to the centre. It was very quiet and the beds were very comfortable with great pillows. Access to netflix was perfect The cafe closest to the flat does a lovely breakfast (better than one we had in the old town). There's a small tesco 2 minutes walk. We would certainly recommend staying here. Thank you Emily! Perfect host! :D
все було чудово, апартаменти відповідають тим що на фото, господар весь час був на зв'язку,за що ми вдячні,все було чудово)

Parfaite nuit passée chez Ann. La chambre est parfaite et super propre. Elle adore échanger et parler avec ses invités. Elle fera tout pour que vous vous sentiez au mieux dans sa maison. Je recommande à 100 % si vous chercher proche de l'aéroport.
Great value, great host

Fantastic weekend we had here. Lovely and well maintained situated in a fantastic part of Edinburgh
Could not have found a better place to stay.

We had an absolutely great time at Anna's place! The house is exactly as in the pictures and situated in a very pleasant residential area. The rooms were very large and comfortable and all looked fabulous. The beds were very comfortable to sleep and nap in, and so is the couch haha. My kid really enjoyed their large bathtub.
There's a bus stop with a direct connection to the city center nearby which was very useful. A small supermarket is in the same street and a block further down there's a large supermarket and a street full of pubs, some bakeries and coffee places.
I can fully recommend Anna's place if you're looking for a calm place to rest after a full day of discovering Edinburgh!
Liz's house was a great base for a weekend trip to Edinburgh. Liz was lovely and welcoming, and provided everything I needed including delicious shortbread!
Warm welcome from the host and nice flat all makes for a pleasant stay. Great location within easy distant to the centre and lots of  shops conveniently nearby.

What's not to love! They'd even thought to add a magnetic rectangle that you can use to cover the digital clock on the oven to make the room a blackout at night. Perfect location to explore the city with everything you could possibly want. Amazing!
Recommend

Incredible location and gorgeous property. Staying here is a huge treat, you feel deeply connected to Edinburgh's history and beauty.
The views are priceless and memorable.
Highly recommended.
Needed the stay very last minute unexpectedly and it was very easy to book and use, thanks Daria!

This flat was just what we needed to close out a long vacation. We felt right at home, close to so many restaurants and shops while still being close to all the historic sights. Would love to stay here again!
Brilliant place in a perfect location

It was a nice place to stay and great location for getting into the city. Would have been nice if shower gel was provided and the blind fit the bedroom window. Check in/out a bit too early and late. Communication with host seemed automated rather than personal.

The apartment on Rose street is just perfect! Ideally located to explore the city, close to a supermarket, very spacious and super clean! The communication with Angie went very smooth as well.
Recommend it to solo travellers as well as to couples and small groups (up to 4 people). I'll definitely book with Angie again when I come back to the beautiful Edinburgh
muy bien conectado, descubrí Portobello y Pongo, el Gato, es adorable.Lo recomiendo

The apartment is just as pictured: bright, large, and roomy with very high ceilings and windows. It is clean, well appointed with comfortable beds and easily accommodated our party of six adults. The kitchen is fully equipped with appliances, utensils, and place settings. Located in New Town, It is extremely well situated as a base for walking to restaurants, shops, and up hill to historic sites in Old Town Edinburgh. The neighborhood has abundant local restaurants and cafes and shops. We highly recommend staying here. The hosts are very responsive and the check-in and check-out was simple.

The property is amazing, beautifully done inside, the location could not be better, absolutely fantastic place. Emma the host is first class with nice personal touches with fresh flowers, fresh milk and bread etc, even a small gift for my wife! Communication was very quick and accurate and was above and beyond with anything that she could do to help us with any aspect of our trip. Thank you! This place would be first on my list for a return trip to Edinburgh.

A brilliant stay in Edinburgh during the busy Fringe Festival. Excellent location near to the Meadows and Grassmarket, walkable to everywhere in city centre. Perfect. Quiet bedrooms, and all very clean and tidy. Recommended; would love to stay again!

Christie was very nice and easy to talk to, her place was amazing. The room we stayed in was tidy and clean. Location was also good just a few minutes from bus stop and there were several bus routes. Overall, it was a great place to stay for exploring Edinburgh.
Great location!  Exactly what we needed.  Thanks

The property was spacious, clean and easy to find. The bathrooms and kitchen were well equipped, with everything you might need. The location is quiet and private. Johnny, the host, is very nice and helpful. Parking was free from 18:30-8:30. Highly recommended property in Edinburgh.

Super cute place!! Olivia was extremely responsive, an excellent host. It was about a 30 minute walk for us to the royal mile, which was great. Public transport was also easy and accessible. Overall great stay!
Lovely apartment, stylishly furnished, well equipped. Great location to family in Stockbridge and near to the city centre!
Had a great time at Minh’s!! Rooms are clean and there’s a super cute cat, so friendly! Definitely recommend!!☺️☺️☺️
Very nice place. The location is perfect

Communication was excellent from start to finish. Fantastic, immaculately clean 3 bedroom property, each room with very modern en suite and whole property finished to a very high standard. Great location near centre of city, 5 minute walk from Princes Street. Highly recommend and definitely hope to stay here again.
Very nice apartment, good price, it is a great place for rest after long journey. Just one of the mattresses is too soft.

L'appartement de Tony est bien situé et calme. Si vous êtes en voiture, vous pouvez vous garer au parking gratuit Herminston park and ride et prendre la ligne de bus 25 qui vous arrête à 3 minutes à pied de l'appartement de Tony. Pour rejoindre le centre, cela prend 30/40min à pied mais il y a pas mal de bus !
Attention chez Tony, pas de petit déjeuner, pas de produits pour se doucher et pas conseils sur où manger ou se balader dans le quartier ! Mais tout ça sera sans doute réglé après ce commentaire ! ;)
Je recommande cet appartement.

A lovely, colorful, bright, warm and inviting flat with a terrific view in an interesting building  in a very good location. It's the kind of place you look forward to coming back to. The space is very well designed and nicely appointed, and the bed is super, super comfortable. The walk into town is quite nice and everything is close by. It's a great find and we'd definitely love to stay again.

Our stay in Joe & Anna’s was amazing! Joe was very welcoming, gave us local recommendations, assisted us with parking, helped us with our bags and was very accommodating. Joe & Anna’s place was very homely, in a great location, clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Couldn’t recommend this place enough. Thank you again for such a brilliant stay!

Martin was a very helpful host, explaining everything at check in.
Apartment is in a great location for all Edinburgh has to offer. Had good sleeps throughout our stay.
Martin even gave us some excellent recommendations for places to eat.
Overall an excellent stay.

The Airbnb we will forever benchmark against. It was simply stunning! More homely than a lot of homes! It’s so incredibly refreshing to be at a place that not only has the basics you could need, but everything over and above. I cannot recommend Kornelias apartment anymore. Superb host. Beautiful home. The best in every possible way 😊
Room was really nice and clean. Enjoyed my stay

Such a fantastic space--Alexander was very kind to us. Immediately when we arrived and met him, we felt safe and comfortable as he gave us a tour of the place. He keeps the place in pristine condition and had some great recommendations. Pretty close to everything which made it easy to get around. I would love to stay here again!!
Perfect spot for a flying visit!
lovely place, hope to be back soon!
Cozy apartment in a great location! Would stay again.

Appartamento spazioso comodo per una famiglia, in zona tranquilla, ma vicina ad una fermata dell’autobus che porta in centro, ma volendo ci si arriva facendo una camminata di 20 min.
Andrian e Jenny host molto cordiali e veloci nelle risposte
Carla is very kind  and her house is super beautiful especially tableware, the location of the house is convenient. Edinburgh is a beautiful city, want to come back for visiting again.

Her place was lovely, we had a great stay and will come back again if we are ever in Scotland, it's right by the bus stop into town(literally out the doorstep) and it's quiet and peaceful. Just a heads up for guests not from the UK, or have no need for a boiler for central heating. Please check with the host on how to use it as it can be a bit tricky - she is very helpful.
A superb accommodation in the beautiful Edinburgh! Gareth and Joanne were kind, responsive to all requests and infos. Their apartment is comfortable, highly functional, well served and located.

From the moment we got out of our taxi to find them waiting at the entry steps to our hugs goodbye, they made us feel like part of their family.  And what wonderful breakfasts!  My husband was so spoiled by them he wanted to know "when are the pastries coming?" at our next rental. We hope to go back someday!

A nice flat for 1-2 people with all the amenities that you need during a short or even longer stay. Clean, cosy, comfortable. Easily accessible from the city centre on foot or by bus. A perfect communication with Doreen’s team.
The apartment was so clean and cozy. If i visit Edinburgh in the future i would to stay in Denise’s apartment for sure.
Great place and location. Lovely place with everything required for a short stay!
Good place to stay, walkable to many places.

El alojamiento estaba bien, la habitación un poco pequeña para dos personas pero aceptable. La casa estaba limpia y ordenada. El acceso al alojamiento era fácil.
La zona residencial era genial, ya que tenía paradas de autobús bastante cerca y también hay tiendas y supermercados.
El anfitrión era amable, aunque poco hablador con nosotros, ya que no sabía nuestro idioma y tampoco hubo mucha relación, ya que no solíamos coincidir en la casa y cuando coincidíamos, estábamos en nuestras respectivas habitaciones sin molestar.
Segun y Temi son buenas personas. Estuvimos como en nuestra casa, dentro de lo que cabe.
Really lovely flat in great location well maintained nicely decorated and well maintained .
Nice clean place. Ideal for families
Josh nous a très bien reçu dans son bel appartement bien desservi au niveau transports.
wonderful place to stay and really close to public transportation. For all of those out of town people please add the Gett app for ordering cabs.

This is the second time I’ve stayed in this apartment. The flat is lovely and cosy. It’s warm and clean and newly renovated. The bedroom and sitting area is very comfortable. I would stay again if needed and definitely recommend it.
It’s a shame about the entrance to the block and communal area which isn’t nice , but that’s how a lot of apartment blocks are in Edinburgh.

Prima Wohnung in Laufnähe zum Zentrum, tolle Ausgangslage für das Festival. Die Wohnung selbst ist schon etwas älter, aber sehr gepflegt und sehr gut ausgestattet. Perfekt für einen Besuch der Stadt - wir werden gerne wiederkommen!
Great location, quiet and comfortable place. Everything was perfect. Communication with Suzanne was smooth and efficient. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this accommodation.
Good apartment in Craiglockhart with modern kitchen and bathroom and responsive hosts.
Some issues with our stay which we've fed back to the host but essentially it wasn't as advertised.
Great place to stay! Clean, cozy, and well located. The host was very helpful and quick to respond. Everything was smooth from check-in to check-out. Highly recommended!

Martin is very kind and communicative. He has a nicely decorated place witj freat views and great ammeneties. The place was cozy and quiet. I enjoyed relaxing there and watching tv with the fire going in the fireplace. There was tea and tea cakes as well which completed the mood along with plenty of reading material about the local sights. I couldn’t have found a better place to stay. Truly a wonderful spot witu great views. Also lots to do nearby and plenty of places to eat within walking distance as well as the place being right near public transit.
The place was a 25-minute walk to the city centre and Royal mile which was convenient. Carol wasn't present though her husband was very accommodating during our arrival which was really nice.
Had a super comfortable stay with my family (including two toddlers) and felt right at home! Fantastic location and Francois was awesome.
Stylish apartment - modern with excellent facilities.  Right in the town centre.  would use again
Courtney é un host fantastica! È di gradevole compagnia e ti fa sentire subito a tuo agio.. inoltre la casa è molto bella e la vista mare rende il risveglio ancora più dolce!

Excelente ubicación muy cerca del centro andando, zona residencial muy tranquila. Accedimos muy fácilmente con las instrucciones facilitadas, incluso pudimos entrar antes ya que nuestro vuelo llegaba muy temprano. El piso muy bonito, muy limpio y con todo lo necesario. Muy recomendable
Great wee place, immaculate and well located.

Sam’s place was within walking distance to the Edinburgh old and new town and public transport. It is located directly beside Arthur’s Seat. The room and shared toilet are very clean! We appreciated how Sam gave us really detailed info on checking-in and extensive guides on exploring the city. We really liked how he was quite flexible with the luggage storage before and after check-in as well - thanks for being so accommodating towards travelers! A responsible host whom we would recommend!

This house was exactly what we were looking for in Edinburgh- safe, very quiet,  spacious and close to the train station.  Jemima is a friendly, professional host who met us upon arrival to show us a few things about the house when we first arrived and was readily available to help figure out transportation options to see some sites out of town.
Had a wonderful stay!

This was the perfect location for our visit to Edinburgh Fringe and the apartment is right in the centre of the action.  As we had arrived on an early flight, Allan tried his very best to allow us early access to our accommodation by 12.30pm.  The apartment was clean and tidy and in addition to a nice Scottish welcome pack and a well equipped kitchen, there was plenty of loo paper, dishwasher tabs, teabags etc. The beds were made up with crisp linen and the double glazing on the windows really helped keep down the noise from passing cars on the cobbled streets outside.  The large window seat in the sitting room was a popular place to sit and watch the Fringe bustle outside.  We had the best time.
Beautifully furnished room. Bathroom separate but felt private. High quality bedding.

Darren’s place was fantastic! We had the best time exploring the neighborhood - so many great coffee shops, pubs and vintage shopping spots. Darren was very helpful and the apartment was exactly what we were looking for. We hope to return!
I booked this place for my parents. They had a great time and said nothing but great things about the place.

Can’t beat the location!! Definitely consider if you’re tall that the ceilings are short
Everything was perfect, no complaints!
Definitely check out the Oxford bar around the corner

CONSIDERANDO CHE I PREZZI DEGLI ALLOGGI IN QUESTA CITTA' SONO MOLTO ALTI, HO DECISO DI ADATTARMI. POSIZIONE OTTIMA, PER IL RESTO CONOSCEVO LA SITUAZIONE QUINDI NON MI POSSO LAMENTARE. NIENTE TELEVISIONE, BAGNO CONDIVISO, NIENTE ABAT JOUR. COMUNICAZIONE CON HOST VELOCE VIA CHAT.
The apartement was really centrally located and very clean. In addition we appreciated the fire place, which warmed the apartment and made it very cosy.

A lovely apartment, nicely furnished. Bed was very comfy & the bathroom spotless. The kitchen has what you need to do some cooking and store items in the fridge.
Dawn is very responsive if you are having any problems. We couldn't get the coffee pot to work and she was right on it, double checking to make sure it was in working order (it was and we just weren't familiar with its operation).
The neighborhood is great - lots of restaurants within an easy walking distance and some interesting shops. If you don't mind some uphill treks, the Castle is a short walk away.
The recommendations sent to us prior to check-in were very helpful and allowed us to enjoy our 4-day stay completely, without having to spend a lot of time researching where to eat, what to do, etc.
I'd stay at Dawn's place again without hesitation.
Great location particularly for the Fringe festival. Very Clean and tidy with possibly the most comfortable arm chair in the UK! A lovely flat and a good host.
Very welcoming. Enjoyed our stay. Location was pretty accessible by bus to Edinburgh city centre and other places to visit.
Rien à déclarer

All is described. Nice, clean and quiet place, 1.5 km from the central train station.
Jason was flexible on the arrival and checkout, which made the stay even better.
If you behave well, he may serve you a good strong coffee ☕😀

This is a university accommodation that rents out to tourists in the summer. The room is extremely nice (I compare it to the one I stayed in in Liverpool and others I've visited in that city). It's the perfect size, has good natural lighting, an excellent desk and bed, and a very comfortable private bathroom. The location makes it relatively cheap, yet within walking distance of the city center (about 15 minutes). The airport tram stops practically right outside the accommodation. The staff changes throughout the day, but they were all very friendly and willing to help with any problems.

Good location, very close to Arthur’s seat and about a 20 minute walk into the main centre.  Apartment was clean but clearly has a few maintenance issues with decor etc. and the bed was very creaky. Bathroom and kitchen clean and functional and served its purpose for us. It’s a little noisy with the train line and traffic so close. Only a 5 minute walk to Sainsbury’s which was handy as we didn’t want to eat out all of the time. All in all an ok stay which we would expect for the price we paid accommodating 4 adults.

Appartement au cœur du centre ville et entouré de bons restaurants, bar etc.
L’arrivée autonome est un grand plus et l’hôte est présent eu cas de besoin.
Je vous le conseille 👌

Really enjoyed our stay. Gail was very accommodating and friendly from the get go - she let us know the best buses to get into town quickly which, was much appreciated as we had lots of exploring to do.
The accommodation was clean, quiet and very charming. Would definitely stay again.
It was amazing stay in Edinburgh, was easy to find. Kept clean and everything was available what we needed. Definitely recommended.

Lisa was very communicative through text and didn't have a problem with us arriving late (around 10pm). Because she was out of town, her roommate settled us in and gave us the brief house tour. Flat location is excellent but I would have preferred a tidier room and shower--a bit dusty and unkempt for the price. Also, heartier breakfast items would have been nice. Nice extra, you'll find loads of pamphlets and info for touring the city. Was okay for our 1 night crash pad. Very close to Waverly Station, main sites and the pick up stand for numerous tour bus companies.

This Peaceful Morningside apartment was wonderful.  Sue and Grant’s communication was the best we have had.  They were able to fulfill our special request for extra towels with no problem.  Their recommendations for restaurants in the area and city center were excellent.  Everything was wonderful and we highly recommended staying in Sue and Grant’s apartment.
ok

L'appartamento di Nicola è molto carino. Non molto grande ma comunque confortevole per tre persone. Posizionato a 30 secondi da un supermercato fornito del necessario, dista una ventina di minuti a piedi dal centro della città, altrimenti raggiungibile con bus con fermata a due minuti dall'alloggio. Nicola è stata veramente disponibile. Consigliato. P.S. Per aprire il portone del palazzo servono le chiavi che sono all'interno della scatolina dove va inserito il codice. Non viene aperto in automatico con l'inserimento del codice.

A lovely place to stay right at the bottom of Victoria Street - the location was perfect. We felt right at home in this airbnb where everything was very modern and clean, we had everything at our fingertips. The hosts were very good at communicating and providing useful information. It was excellent value for money. I would highly recommend this place and will definitely be back for future visits to Edinburgh :)

What a gem of a place! Located in a fantasic area of the old town - really close to bars, restaurants, grocery shops, a great craft market and literally 5 mins from the Royal Mile and all the tourist hot spots. 10 mins (walk) to the Castle or the Christmas Market, 15 mins to Holyrood, 30mins to the Botanical Gardens etc. We only had 3 full days to cover our To Do list and we were able to walk to everything from the apartment. Suzie's apartment itself was exactly as described (including the very honest note about the stairs and being 4 floors up!) with plenty of guides, recommendations and local info provided in a really useful folder and basket of local books. Kitchen had everything we needed, the bedrooms were cosy, clean and really comfy and the bathroom was spotless! Communication with the hosts was superb and much appreciated.
Really lovely! Beautiful room and and extraordinary comfy bed! Would definitely come back! Really understanding about the fact we didn’t properly meet due to me moving my things into my new place!

Great place - comfortable, good amenities, and well situated (close to Queensview Drive for hike up to Arthur’s seat), and a lovely garden out back all to ourselves where we enjoyed coffee in the morning. Easy access to bus that takes you straight to city center.
A quiet, clean, spacious and comfortable retreat after a busy day in Edinburgh.  We enjoyed fixing a light meal and refreshing drink to unwind and recharge.

So happy with this find for accommodation.  Centrally situated close to train station and all major highlights of old city.  Comfortable and modern yet homely with all that you need for self catering or close to selection of restaurants and pubs. Hosts have a useful guide prepared which answers all questions but also quick to respond and communicate when necessary.  We loved our stay here and would highly recommend.
La chambre était un peu vieillote et étroite. Mais le ménage est fait tous les jours et les draps étaient très propres. Au vu de la localisation, bon rapport qualité prix.

Andy y Georgios fueron my amables en todo momento y se preocuparon por qué tuviéramos una buena estancia. Su casa es muy acogedora y muy bien conectada para poder visitar Edimburgo, con autobuses a menos de 1 minuto de la casa. Sin duda una experiencia genial.
Ha sido un placer y la recomendamos al 100%.
We had an amazing stay in Amanda’s beautiful home! We absolutely loved the location and the view of the Edinburgh Castle.  We wish we could’ve stayed longer!

We enjoyed our stay, it was very comfortable and loved the location. It was easy to navigate around. If I might point out one thing, it was a bit dark at night! There seemed to be a couple of lights out(maybe I was not seeing how to turn them on, but they seemed to be out). The living room area only had a couple of dim lights. But other than that, we had a great time!
去爱丁堡为了申请法签，这地理位置实在太好了，走路到办法签的地方也就五六分钟。而且去市里的景点坐公交车也极其方便。春姨人也超级nice，有什么问题回复的特别即时，而且还会给很多实用的建议，下次去爱丁堡一定还住在这里。
Fab place , lovely location . It was perfect . Ellie couldn't have been any more helpful to us :) really appreciate it !
Had a great time here, great location, handy to transport and restaurants, recommended

Hosts are thoughtful and kind, which is reflected in all that they do, from the apartment set-up to assisting guests during their stay.  Great location from which to explore beautiful Edinburgh and learn about its history.

Wir haben uns in John's Gästezimmer direkt sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist schön ruhig gelegen und mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln ist man schnell sowohl in der Innenstadt als auch am Flughafen. Alles war sauber, das Bett bequem und der Check in unkompliziert. John ist ein sehr guter Gastgeber, wir durften sogar spontan etwas eher ein- und auschecken. Vielen Dank!

This was my second time staying at this place, and once again, everything was perfect. The apartment is clean, cozy, and well taken care of. The host is a genuinely kind and helpful person—always ready to assist and make sure I’m comfortable. I truly appreciate the hospitality and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!
The flat was lovely, clean, and comfortable in an unbeatable location. Staying in a historic building right in the heart of the Royal Mile was an immersive and very fun way to experience Edinburgh.
Sean was great with communication before and during our stay. Wonderful place with lovely design and really good bath facilities. Would definitely stay again.
No, thank you.

Words can’t do justice, the place is better than what photos show. Marina was a great host with many small things adding up to a great overall experience. For example she had juice & milk cartons stocked before my arrival, I haven’t seen many hosts do that.
Overall a place I would return back to in a jiffy and highly recommend.
Thank you, Marina!

Eine sehr süße, frische und mintfarbengehaltene kleine Wohnung. Sehr klein aber fein. Wir haben besonders die kleinen Dinge geschätzt und wir konnten immer wieder was kleines Neues entdecken. Rundum waren wir sehr zufrieden.

Location location location! That’s what this accommodation offers. Direct tram from airport. Minutes from city centre and walkable restaurants, bars and shops. The flat was exactly as described. Everything you could need with clear instructions for everything. The only negative, was the toilet space was a bit tight for my 6’2 husband, but that’s not something that can be changed so hesitated to mention it. I would definitely come back to this flat next time we’re in Edinburgh.
The apartment was spotlessly clean & very stylish. It was in a fantastic location for restaurants, bars, pubs & exploring the city in general. I highly recommend.

Staying at Dereks apartement was wonderful. Derek prepared everything very nicely despite the short notice (1 day) as we were on a motorbike trip. He communicated and explained very well and really cared about our comfort (we were very glad about the umbrella). Its a nice apartment at at perfect spot in Edinburghs old town and we would whole-heartedly recommend it to everybody!

Florence is a great host, she stays with you in the Air BnB and you also share a bathroom with her. The room is small but perfect if you are exploring all day and just want to sleep there. Everything was so clean. It is a 20-25 mins walk to the city where all the attractions are. There are restaurants close to the AirBnB and there is a bus stop close by. For attractions , and walking expect a 20-25 min walk. Great experience overall, would be back!

We went to Edinburgh for a long weekend and had a fantastic time here. The place is in a brilliant quiet location yet only 15 mins walk to John Lewis. The parking outside the front is perfect and the place felt like home away from home. When travelling with an 8 month old was just what we needed.
Also just a note to say that communication with Owen was brilliant - best yet on Air BnB. Will definitely be back!
很好，房东回复消息很快，并且还帮助我们寄存行李，非常感谢

Thanks, Marita. Marita and her husband were very much warming in welcoming the guest. The house's inside interiors are pretty, every thing works well and the room is located in a good area. Will rent this room again if I'm visiting Edinburgh.

Fiona’s place was exactly as shown. Clean and comfortable with an excellent, comfy bed, great shower and a well equipped kitchen. The neighborhood is perfect for exploring Edinburgh on foot. Great grocery store, many cafes, restaurants and pubs only a block or two away. Only want to mention, as others have, that the apartment is on the top floor and some might find it difficult to bring heavy bags upstairs.

If you're looking for a home away from home in a fabulously central location in Edinburgh, then Dunc & Dee's apartment is a perfect choice ... it is so central in fact that we even got to watch some of the procession for the opening of parliament from the lounge window, which was an unexpected surprise.
Dunc & Dee are also extremely attentive hosts and it is clear how much they care about making your stay as enjoyable and comfortable as possible (including extra special touches like chilled prosecco and tasty shortbread waiting for you on arrival 🙂). Where they shone as hosts for us though, was how they proactively communicated with us once they were made aware of some isolated late night disturbances by their neighbours (which were outside any of our control) and how they kept us informed of what was being done to address it throughout.
We would definitely stay here again!
We call it 2-day home,  nice and clean,  walk to every sight-seeing spot. Thanks for offering a cozy stay. will definitely recommend to friends.

Great stay at David’s place. Perfect location in Stockbridge with restaurants, cafes, shops and walking on the doorstep. Responsive and quick to message back, would recommend to anyone coming to Edinburgh. Great for Stockbridge Market if you are there on a Sunday.

The location is great - easy walking distance to all manner of great restaurants and historic sights. Charlotte is a very gracious host, checking in to make sure everything is good and providing helpful local recommendations. We had a delightful week!

Valerie is an amazing host who goes out of her way to make you feel as comfortable and welcome as possible. The flat is in a nice location, just out of the city, with lovely views over Arthur's seat; there are also lots of bus links just a five minute walk away from the flat. The flat itself is perfectly clean and has all the necessary items for a short break away. 100% recommend to anyone who wishes to visit Edinburgh and appreciates homely touches in their accommodation.
John and Vicky were very friendly and accommodating. The listing was just as we would have expected if not better!
Küçük ama yeterli, çok ışıklı değil, kısa süreli kalışlar için ideal. Banyo biraz küçük ama biz hiç dert etmedik.

Very central location and spacious room and kitchen. Owner is very friendly and helpful. Noise from the great bar below but only until one in the morning so join them or use earplugs. :-)
Will certainly visit again in the future.
Olga was a lovely and responsibe host. The flat was as described, and a perfect size for the two of us. It’s in a great location near a main street with the tram, but was quiet and private.

We had a wonderful stay at Angus and Sabia's flat. The apartment has a beautiful interior, is very clean and well located, easy walking distances. Communication was easy and friendly! We would definitely recommend this place!

Had a great trip to Edinburgh, and this central flat was a great home base for us as we meandered around the city.
There was an unfortunate plumbing mishap we ran into which made us unable to use the washer, but Ryan did his best to address the issue and offered us alternative solutions.
Overall, would definitely stay here again just for the comfort and location.
Amazing!

The apartment was spacious and comfortable and just perfect for our stay.  It was a great location being just a short walk from Haymarket Station and the trams. There was a Co-op at the end of the road and a bus stop with frequent buses into town. Very nice restaurants within 5 minutes walk. The apartment was well equipped and providing tea, coffee and sugar was a nice touch. We shall definitely stay here when we return to Edinburgh.
Great place and location with a vert good host.
Lovely clean room with view out over large garden. Very straight forward liaising with Isabel re arrival etc - all round very good.
Perfectly located near to everything you could possibly need or want.
Loved the location and the easy access (good for the 70 year olds!). Nice accommodations. Roomy kitchen with washing machine. Great pizza across the street.

The place was great and very close to the city center, and our hosts were very responsive and attentive! We had a great time in Edinburgh and won't hesitate to book the same place if we come back to the city😊
we felt very welcome, Dr Mirwais was a great host and a perfect gentleman

My friends and I stayed here for a 40th birthday and had a great time. The accommodation is very nicely presented and comfortable, and has everything we needed. It's only 10-20 minutes by bus into the city (depending which part you're aiming for) and the buses are really regular. The shop (which we found ) for supplies was a little walk but nothing too much.
Excelente todo. Atención zona. El departamento. El lugar. Todo impecable
the place was nice and clean, but it can get quite dark at night. i stayed with family of 6 and we enjoy staying at kate’s,

Nous avons apprécié la quiétude et l'emplacement de l'appartement qui donnait sur le port. La possibilité de déjeuner sur le balcon avec vue sur le front de mer a été un plus. La chambre correspondait aux photos et les instructions claires et détaillées qui nous ont été transmises par Sirjana nous ont permis d'accéder facilement au logement. Nos horaires d'arrivée et de départ ne nous ont malheureusement pas permis d'échanger verbalement avec notre hôte, nous le recommandons néanmoins.

Modern apartment with beautiful views along the Water of Leith and across to Dean village.5 minute walk to city center and small shops are close by. Great base for visitors to Edinburgh and Don is a fantastic host.
A cute place in the perfect location-quiet yet walkable to everything. Spacious and comfortable.
公寓在皇家一公里的正中间 ，每天都欣赏古城美景，因位置特别好去哪都是步行可以到达，推荐这套房子，是个不错的选择！

Flat needs a little tender loving care. Mates coming home from the pug sang very well but felt like they were in the flat. Didn’t enjoy asking a few mates to move so as we could get in for the night. BUT the location made these inconveniences. it worth thi

The snug is the perfect get away. It's in a great location near resturants and bars but not at all noisey.  Also walking distance to many attractions like Edinburgh Castle and the Royal Mile. It had everything we needed and we can't wait to visit again

We had a lovely stay in this beautiful city and learnt so much about its history. A lot to see and we will definitely come again to see the sights that we didn’t manage to see. The apartment was just out of the city and we just used taxis to get into the city and back home which worked out cheaper than a bus for four of us. The apartment was spacious, clean and warm and very comfortable. Would definitely recommend to others. Thank you Robert, we would be happy to stay here again when we return, hopefully soon. Thanks again for everything including the welcome card and chocolates. Happy New Year. Best wishes.

If your staying in Edinburgh then this is the place to stay. For the price bang in the middle of everything it can’t be missed. The room itself was spotless and everything that is needed even if you wanted to do a little bit of cooking a snack. We will be staying here again next time in we go to Edinburgh
Stuart reageert snel en is heel aardig. Ruimte is ideaal voor een stadsbezoek, dichtbij alle bezienswaardigheden en erg rustig steegje. Zeker aan te raden, bedankt Stuart!
The place is in the perfect location, accessible to all the touristy areas.. Great place and great hosts! Thank you!
Rich & Will were very welcoming. Place was super clean and the bed was really comfy. Close to public transportation. We really enjoyed our stay

Lovely decorated cozy room. Both the room and separate private bathroom were clean and toiletries and bottled water were also provided. Josh was very accommodating with our check in time as our flight had been delayed. The bus stop for buses to the city is only 1 minute walk.
A really lovely flat in a great location for exploring Edinburgh. Very comfy beds.

Good location and close to transport with plenty of options to eat out or buy groceries. Unfortunately though the apartment  needs a thorough clean (very dusty throughout and the bathroom is covered in mould). The bed pillows were terrible and several years  past their use by date and the bed linen is overdue for an upgrade as well. In general it felt quite dingy and dark because it’s not really possible to open the vertical blinds due to lack of privacy.

Best location in town: 5 minutes walk away from Royal Mile, 10 from the Castle... close to everything: pubs, supermarkets, souvenir stores... No need to catch any transport at all.
The appartment itself was simple. The kitchen was well equiped but the pans were a bit overused.
The livingroom has everything you need but the furniture was also overused.
The bathroom, tiny and with no ventilation.
The bed was the best, as it was confortable and the accommodation was overall quiet all the time. So, you do not hear all the crazy nightlife in the surroundings...
We were unfortunately cold in the appartment and the wifi did not seem to work. Besides the use of warm water took us sometime to understand.
In general terms, best location in town but the appartment needs a bit of improvement.

It was a really nice experience to stay at Jane's. The location is perfect, easy access to buses and trams. Beautiful park as well as restaurants on a walking distance. Bobo is such a friendly sweet dog. 🐶
Had a lovely stay at Rebecca's Airbnb. Was the perfect location for being in Central Edinburgh.  It has a lovely homely and comfy feeling to the place. Would highly recommend this place!!

Lovely large apartment, ideal for a big group especially ones that are looking for a communal hang out area.
A roughly 15 minute walk from the tourist heart of the city.
Muy buena ubicación, buena comunicación con transporte público y posibilidad de moverse a pié para conocer la zona muy buena opción.
Ótima localização, próximo de um ponto de ônibus, cinco paradas do centro e dos pontos turísticos. A casa é linda, completa e bem limpa. Tivemos uma ótima estadia e aproveitamos muito.

We absolutely adored this property; from the cleanliness, to the decor, to the comfy beds, to the amenities, to the location, it was everything we needed and at a fantastic price!
The parking was very handy and secure. Due to the location we actually walked to a lot of places so we didn't need to use the car much!
Be aware that the downstairs bed is between a single and a double so unless you're quite slim, you might have some trouble sleeping!
Aside from this it was a great property and Bobbie was a friendly and welcoming host. We would definitely love to stay here again on our next visit!
离海边很近，天气好的时候窗口的风景很棒！但离市中心大概半小时巴士，如果经常去市中心的话不建议住这边。如果天气一直很棒的话，可以选择Agnes的住宿，在海边吹吹风很享受！房东人也很热情！

The room is very spacious, the beds particularly comfortable and the welcome very friendly! The accommodation is very close to the beautiful beach of Portobello and close to the centre by bus. We can only warmly recommend it! Thank you for everything Suzanna and your friend Danielle!
Enjoyed our stay. Would stay again.
We had a great stay.  The apartment location is perfect making it easy to walk to everything we wanted to see.  The apartment itself was extremely clean and had everything we needed
Easy to find, great place, comfy stay. NKD pizza recommendation from very lovely man in off licence spot on.

Excellent séjour dans un lieu confortable et bien équipé et accueillant. Un bouquet de fleurs et un panier garni nous attendaient. Craig est tres réactif et nous a aidé à distance à gérer les aléas de notre arrivée. Excellent conseil pour la conciergerie du dernier jour et les adresses communiquées (marché de Stockbridge du dimanche très sympa et gourmand !). Nous recommandons vivement cet hôte ! Merci Craig.
非常好！josh的房子很干净温馨，交通便利，街区很安静很适合出来散散心，我一般入睡比较慢，但在这个房间我很快就睡着了，因为很安心很舒适，真的是特别好的体验！从房屋布置看得出josh是个很有品味很爱打理房屋的房东
If you in Edinburgh must say they are great hosts nd have big heart. Must take valued suggestions from them in regards to Edinburgh. Reaaz is an amazing person.
Excellent stay in a beautiful flat in a perfect location. We would definitely stay here again!

We had an amazing time at this Airbnb! It is close to the city centre of Edinburgh (just a short bus ride away). The apartment was clean and very cozy. We met Lorna briefly and she was very friendly. Christie is also friendly and responds quickly. Thank you for the pleasant stay, we definitely will be back!

I have stayed at many home rentals over the years and Dee and Dougie’s lovely annexe/garden lounge ranks among the best of the best.
They are phenomenal hosts; they could teach a master class on hosting best practices.
From generous breakfast supplies and snacks to highly efficient information (including QR codes for transport options - brilliant!) to clever space-saving items to plentiful towels and hygiene items to thoughtful touches everywhere you look - they appear to have thought of just about anything a traveler could need or want.
Well-appointed and tastefully furnished throughout, the annexe and garden lounge (featuring dartboard and yoga supplies!) and its patio overlook a beautiful and well kempt garden.
Ratho with its charming canal is close to the airport with public transport options into Edinburgh.
I feel very lucky to have booked such a delightful place.
I cannot recommend the annexe more highly!
Our favourite place from our trip - such an amazing place to stay and right in the heart of Edinburgh and so perfect ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Great place. Very well located.
Catherine has been an extremely lovely host, a joy to chat with and really helpful, going out of her way to take care of me when I had an unfortunate incident. Would definitely go back!
Great place to stay! Close to the train (12 min ride) to Edinburgh.

I would fully recommend staying
The appt is in a great location, has everything you need and felt right at home
Will definitely try stay again next time im up Edinburgh.
Great location and responsive host!
Great flat near to the city center. We had a great time in the flat in Edinburgh.
Imogen was a wonderful host, and I can't imagine a better location for anyone wanting to explore the royal mile. Just incredible.
Very well located property in the middle of Edinburgh. All amenities easily reachable by foot or public transport. Apartment was clean and even better as the advertisement. Thank you for having us
This place was perfect for our stay in Edinburgh. It was clean and close to everything we wanted to see and do. We would definitely stay here again! 😊
离火车站非常的近，周边全是风景优美的老城区，所有景点从家里出发都是步行距离，是非常好的徒步旅行出发点。房间非常的大，装修也很有艺术气息，很喜欢房子的配色和装修，房东也非常的热情！
Really enjoyed my stay
Comfortable place in Edinburgh, with easy public transport to city centre.

Our stay on the Royal Mile was perfectly located for all our visit. The stairs were a “climb” but after we arrived it didn’t matter. Craig left us some goodies which was a nice surprise. My husband struggled on the third night on the mattress but he survived. Thanks for being a great host!

nice place to stay with easy access tu buses
good breakfast and nice host!
Great location and loved our stay.

Jane, hat eine super schöne Wohnung mit hohen Decken, hellen Räumen und super schön eingerichtet. Es war absolut traumhaft. Jane hat zwei super süße Katzen die einfach toll waren.

alles perfekt

A five start stay from start to finish! From the helpful suggestions on places nearby to the friendliness on arrival! Couldn’t have asked for any better! The room was spotless and so cosy! Will certainly be returning.

Can’t beat the location - footsteps of Edinburgh castle. There are steep steps to get to the castle and to the apartment from medival mile. Apartment was clean and had everything we needed. We were family of 3 occupying the space and it felt cramped but worked because of location and fact that we were not in the apartment for too long. Ideal for couples.
would stay again :)

Gillian is een zeer vriendelijke verhuurster. Je wordt verwelkomt met koekjes en drankjes op de kamer. De slaap en badkamer zijn zeer ruim. Zeer goed bed ook. Leuk om ook een ijskastje te hebben. Goede locatie voor Edinburgh te verkennen.

I can’t say enough about this apartment and the hosts.  You can’t beat the location. Noise is to be expected in such a central location and with earplugs, it didn’t bother us at all (even during The Fringe). We were three women and felt entirely safe. Nicely appointed kitchen which enabled us to buy a few staples and have breakfast and coffee (provided) prior to heading out for the day.  We were there just prior to and during the first few days of the Fringe. We were able to EASILY walk to all traditional tourist spots and also to the comedy clubs to see some acts. We also walked to the Royal Yacht (about an hour), but took an easy tram ride back.  We had a wonderful stay.

no words can express how much i love staying here. it’s my second time staying with andrew and anne, and i rarely return to the same accommodation. that speaks volumes! and they’re absolutely lovely hosts who are warm, friendly and give you space and privacy. the bathroom is spacious and all yours, the bedroom is roomy, clean and comfortable. and their cat, liquorice is absolutely lovely and affectionate. she solicits attention and love in the best way possible. and portobello beach and high street, with a wide variety of scrumptious bites is right outside this flat. 10/10.

We loved staying at Claire’s! The place was pristine and homey. It had all you needed. Hosts were welcoming and kind. The area was quiet and near bus and tram stops so it’s easy to get to city centre. Would highly recommend!

Had a lovely 3 night stay at Anne’s apartment. Perfect location for us as we wanted to be close to the city but in a quiet location. The close proximity to the tram was fantastic and made the journey to the apartment quick and stress free. Lots of useful information in a folder provided by the host. So many places to eat we didn’t know where to start! Highly recommended.

Lovely apartment within easy reach of Edinburgh city centre. Plenty of cafés & bars a short walk from the apartment. Beds very comfortable, as was the settee in the lounge. I would definitely stay again should we be lucky enough to visit Edinburgh again.

Excellent séjour, appartement très propre et idéalement situé pour visiter la vieille ville, supermarché à proximité, Lynn nous a très bien accueillis et est très réactive, nous avons apprécié les décorations de Noël, nous recommandons cet appartement.

très bon séjour, l'emplacement a côté de Arthur's Seat est idéal pour les promenades et la magnifique vue.
les commerces juste à côté sont pratiques pour faire des courses.
Pour aller au centre ville a pied, un peu loin mais réalisable, sinon bien desservi en bus 😉
Beautiful, cosy apartment. ideal location with bus stops at top of street to get into city centre. lovely fish shop at top of street and a co-op round the corner...perfect!

Great place to stay, comfy beds, and nice bathrooms.
Good launch pad to explore Edinburgh!!

Jacqueline was super friendly & helpful.
The accommodation was extremely comfortable & spacious, the bathroom modern & luxurious.
The location was absolutely perfect ... not far to walk anywhere - Stockbridge 8 mins, The Old Town 30 mins. Fell in love with Stockbridge.
We had the most fantastic time. Loved it.

Katie was a great host. There was a problem with the flat that we were originally meant to be staying in but she managed to find a perfect alternative so there was no hassle involved at all which was very impressive! The alternative flat was central, cosy and ideal for what we needed. I would definitely recommend Katie when visiting Edinburgh
Guter Aufenthalt. Gute Busverbindung zur Innenstadt.

Cong welcomed us very kindly and show us the house, also he provides the breakfast but our agenda wasn't available for breakfast at home. home is very good located. near to city center and airport. ve really easily get to airport at the 4 am in the morning from Cong's house
thank you for everything
Great place!

The room was lovely and in a really great location - not too far from the city centre and plenty of nice restaurants and bars nearby. Christopher was a very friendly and helpful host, would definitely stay there again!

This was my first hostel stay and it went pretty smoothly! The hostel was newer and nice, and the front desk was super sweet and helpful with everything I needed. If you can handle a cacophony of snores at night, you’ll be fine and enjoy this place. The location absolutely cannot be best compared to all the other hotels/hostels around. Book here if you’re planning on staying and walking everywhere!

Nous recommandons à 100% : la literie est très bonne, la chambre et salle de bain nickel ! Cuisine commune bien équipée. Situation géographique au top à deux du tram Mc Donald Road. On a vraiment passé un super séjour et les nuits sont calmes.
Beds very low to the ground with foam mattresses.  Nice area, free parking.  Stairs to all bedrooms.  Check-in time is 5:00 p.m.
Petit logement bien organisé et propre. À environ 30 minutes à pied du Old Town. Parfait pour un court séjour!!

Nice apartment in a great location for exploring Edinburgh city.  Lots of great places to eat nearby, wonderful deli (Broughton Market) just up the road and Agie forwarded recommendations as well. Lovely base for a long weekend stay in Edinburgh.

What can I say? A beautiful third floor flat entered through a near secret entrance, up 63 steps of a fantasy spiral staircase off of a magical and centrally located Close just steps from the Waverly train station, the Royal Mile and many outstanding shops, pubs and cafes.
Imagine staying in a walk-up top floor flat in a 160 year old building on Diagon Alley from Harry Potter with a wonderful view of the Balmoral.
Despite being in such a central busy location very close to the train station it was still very quiet in the flat. Very nice kitchen and living room, small but adequate bedrooms and two very clean bathrooms. I would go back to Jonathan’s flat in the heart of Edinburgh in a heartbeat and very much wish to do so again in the near future.
Super friendly & flexible host & his friends. Great location. Spacious, comfy, stylish apartment - pure joy! Thank you, Tony!

I stayed at Isla’s place during my visit to Edinburgh recently with my family. We absolutely loved the place. It’s well maintained and well connected to the centre. The fine details and beauty of the place makes you feel home. Isla is definitely a superb host. Highly recommend this place. :)
Very enjoyable

Fijn verblijf met ontbijt. Vriendelijke gastvrouw en heer. Ruime kamer met uitzicht op de heuvels.

Wir waren zu dritt knapp eine Woche in der Unterkunft, und ich würde wieder hin.

We had a lovely stay at Vic place. Super cozy room and a really welcoming host!
