Thankyou both, Vic and Bran, it was a great time with you both! :)
Very well located flat directly next to the meadows. The flat ist very well equipped and Paul even provided us some food and drinks. It was clean and we felt right at home.
2 night stay, perfect location 5 mins into the centre but out of the way so peaceful when you wanted it to be. Great place for a city break and well looked after

Susan’s place was perfect for our stay. The space is beautiful, spotless and in a great location only 20 minute drive or bus ride to the centre.
Susan is a great host. Communication was excellent, she was welcoming with many essentials to make us feel at home including teas, coffees and fresh smelling towels. Thank you so much Susan for having us stay in your lovely space.

Brilliant location. Lovely peaceful and quiet area but not to far from the city Centre. Hilary is very  kind and allowed me to drop my bag off as soon as I arrived even though it was a lot earlier than the time stated. The house is spotless and Hilary is great to talk to and she has a lovely little dog that makes sure the garden is kept free of any other animals 😊 Overall a brilliant place to book and stay in. Thank you

Joanna’s apartment was simply amazing! I stayed with my parents for a long weekend in July, we were the first guests, and it was perfect. The location is amazing, in the lively Grassmarket, just a few steps away from Victoria Street and the Royal Mile, and super close to the train station too. The apartment is bright, comfortable, spacious, and surprisingly quiet given its central location. You even get a view of the castle from the window! Will definitely stay again when I come back to Edinburgh.

This was mine and my husband’s first time coming to Edinburgh and what a place to stay. The apartment is more stunning in person than the pictures and you can pretty much walk to everywhere! I have never stayed in such a well equipped air bnb there was just everything there. Jeremy was such a fantastic host and so helpful. We really couldn’t fault it and would recommend this place to anyone for a stay in Edinburgh.
Thank you for being part of us in falling in love with Edinburgh and we will definitely come back!

Un posto bellissimo, sembrava di essere a casa, io non so se c'é un posto migliore ad Edinburgo, ma se volete fidarvi di un consiglio, allora scegliete questo appartamento. Straordinario. Cleaner and bigger than imagine!! Ollie is very nice and gave us detailed guidance! A wonderful experience😆😆
We had a really pleasant stay, the flat is lovely furnished and we felt at home immediately!

The apartment is up five flights of a spiral staircase and this would put some people off, BUT it's in a great location on the royal mile, very clean and comfortable, and we couldn't recommend more if you are fit and healthy.
The place is excellent!
Anja was nothing short of lovely! Cosy place that meets the needs of a short stay

The instructions we received were brilliantly detailed and as I was travelling over 200 miles with 3 children on my lonesome I needed as much help as I could get!  The Apartment was beautifully presented and the children settled in so quickly, they didn't even miss a television.  The welcome pack was very welcome and all the tiny instructions on things made staying extremely straightforward, definitely somebody had tested it out in detail a number of times.  We had a lovely stay and it was a home away from home, I know people say that but it really was and I had some of the best nights sleep I have had all year, it was so so peaceful.
Gracias
Great place to stay. Very quiet inside the flat despite being in the city centre. Very central. Had everything we needed.
David was an excellent host and the place was just what I expected and was very very comfortable for my extended stay.

This apartment was everything it was advertised to be. My girlfriend and I stayed here for three nights and couldn't have been happier. The location is incredible, the apartment was beautiful and very comfortable, and our hosts were very friendly and helpful.

For us the location was amazing. The apartment is located right next to Holyrood Park and you have excellent views of the park from the all of the rooms. Arthur's Seat is located in Holyrood park and has great views of the city from the top. If you go to Edinburgh this is a "must do" and if you stay here it is right out your doorstep. It also rains a lot in Edinburgh so having views of the park is great when you get stuck inside. After a couple storms we were treated to bright rainbows over Arthur's Seat. The apartment is also only a five minute walk from Holyrood palace and the start of the royal mile. It takes about 20-30 minutes to get down the mile to Edinburgh castle.

The apartment is also very nice and well equiped. The internet worked great. There is pleanty of pots/pans/plates etc. to cook if you want to, and the bed is SOOO comfortable. I need to find out where Marta gets her sheets. The only warning is that there is no elevator and it is on the top top floor (3rd or 4th I can't remember) so if you aren't mobile this could give you trouble.

Finally, our hosts were fantastic. They gave us excellent directions from the airport and it was very easy to find the place. We arrived late but they were able to meet us at the apartment with no problems at all. They had even left us tea and biscuits to welcome us.

Thanks again for the amazing place to stay guys.

You will appreciate being close to the airport as well as public transportation to downtown Edinburgh if you stay in this spacious  home with wonderful bath and  comfortable bed  ... a sweet family with 2 kiddos and dog.
Excellent appartement. Confortable, bien équipé, bien décoré et très propre. Parfait. Je recommande
整体体验很不错，只是房屋临近街道，窗户也没有隔音效果，我一整个晚上都没睡好觉，凌晨四点外面的车辆声音让我无法入眠。最后在退房的时候，一些小插曲出现，我也给房东合理解释了，希望我们双方都能有一个好的体验和印象，因为我们也是有素质的住客，愿房东也能理解。谢谢。

We enjoyed our stay here immensely. It was a perfect location for a few days exploring Edinburgh. The tram being only a 6 minute walk away and having a convenience store along that route- was perfect for us! The bed was comfortable and room was clean. Our host was incredibly responsive and flexible right from the start (immediately after booking!) This place was a great value! Do keep in mind that you do share a bathroom with other guests and we were able to hear their movements in our room all throughout the night. The guests were respectful and quiet so it worked out fine but there were a couple times where you may have to wait to use the bathroom or hear them on the stairs/moving around.

We had such a lovely stay! The location was perfect for us, just a short walk to the royal mile and overlooking the beautiful Greyfriars. There are many lovely restaurants in this area too, away from the tourist spots. Martin was a great host and responded very quickly if we had any questions. The apartment had wonderful character and we'd definitely visit again. Thank you!

Basil’s place was a perfect location for our stay in Edinburgh.
Well located, at walk distance from all the main spots of the old Edinburgh, a stone throw from the Mile. Good restaurants and coffee places nearby. Appartment simple but clean and well equipped, perfectly fitting our family of 3 people. Recommended!
Un séjour parfait dans une ville formidable, nous avons beaucoup profité de la ville historique grâce à la localisation idéale de notre logement; Je recommande chaudement cet appartement

Great spot and a so clean and brilliant showers..

Great spot that is central to a lot of what Edinburgh has to offer. Host was communicative and flexible. Very much enjoyed our stay!

Muy buena experiencia en el alojamiento, al salir te encuentras una calle bastante grande con restaurantes, bares, varios supermercados y 2 centros comerciales muy cerca. Las camas son estupendas. Las instrucciones del propietario son muy claras. Los vecinos son tranquilos. Volvería sin duda!
A casa com 4 quartos merece mais um banheiro

Great location to stay in Edinburgh. Very close to shops, restaurants, Edinburgh Waverley train station just a short walk, Royal mile a short walk ( a few hills to get there but a nice walk) . Host was very responsive and answered all our questions quickly.  The only downside was the two flights of stairs inside to get to the front door but we managed that fine. Also, there is one bedroom listed as having a king size bed - I think it is a queen size but still very nice accomodations. Beds are comfortable. Everything was well stocked. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place.

Aileen’s place was incredible! It was walking distance to everything we wanted to see during our stay! We were able to walk to the Edinburgh castle every night since it was only a few minutes away! The local restaurants and pubs were steps away & the breakfast spot ZaZas which was delicious was right next door. We were really surprised by how close everything was. The Airbnb was spotless and beautiful we especially appreciated the gorgeous view of the castle from the window! We appreciate how kind and accommodating Aileen was during our stay. 5 star place! :)
Check out time is a bit early, duvet covers are not very clean
Lovely place, super central! Would recommend for a short stop and as a solo traveler like myself.
Marita y Keith siempre se mostraron accesibles. Geniales para conversar en el apartamento. Sin dudarlo, volvería a quedarme con ellos.

Das Ehepaar welches das Zimmer vermietet ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wir durften unsere Wäsche bei ihnen waschen. Das Zimmer ist nicht groß aber man fühlt sich schnell wohl. Das Fenster zeigt zur Straße hin, welche stark befahren ist, doch mit geschlossen Fenster ist das kaum hörbar. Die Unterkunft liegt etwas außerhalb der Innenstadt, ist aber super zu Fuß oder mit dem Bus erreichbar. Es gibt auch einige Restaurants und Lebensmittelgeschäfte unmittelbar vor der Unterkunft.
Die Unterkunft ist perfekt für einen Städtetrip.

Had a great stay with Mike and Pauline, for one night - wish we’d had more time in Edinburgh, as the location was perfect for us. Mike & Pauline offered some great tips of local spots & were warm and welcoming hosts! We’d love to stay with them again!
Superb apartment, super well located. It made our stay perfect. We will come back!
Lovely flat with ample parking and near to amenities. Comfy beds. Well stocked with essentials and a few wee extras. Good value. Really appreciated flexible check in and out - thanks to Gill & Mark
We thoroughly enjoyed staying at castle snug, right in the heart of the city. Close to castle and great food and pubs!
Clean and comfortable stay

Daniela's flat was SO beautiful! We were only in town for a day between stops on a longer trip, and we so wished we could've stayed longer. The flat is spacious and comfortable, and in addition to a commanding a great view of the park across the street, it's also within an easy (+ lovely) walk of the center.

Daniela was very accommodating, and the logistics were very easy to handle. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place for your next stay in beautiful Edinburgh!
lovely lady, lovely place, lovely stay! Oh, and btw… Best shower ever!!! Many thanks for having us, Jon and Milly.
This was a great apartment. it truly matched the description. really enjoyed my stay!
Wonderful staying in wonderful apartment 🤍 it was cozy and unique
gorgeous apartment in a beautiful, peaceful area. We had a fabulous time

Wonderful area to stay and catch the bus into explore Edinburgh. Friendly and helpful hosts. Enjoyed the comfy bed and the little extras in the kitchen.
This is a lovely apartment and such a nice place to come back to after long days out and about! There are plenty of amenities just a short walk away and it was a great base for our trip.
Ubytování dobře dostupné tramvají přímo z letiště. Klidnější část Edinburgu s dobrým přístupem do centra.

clean and comfortable apartment, at the end of a quite cul-de-sac so no late night street noise. We walked everywhere, 30 mins to town and 20 mins to the beach, but there was always a bus going past. the food at The Willow down the road was good and The Scottie was a nice pub to have a drink.

Comfortable bed!!! Beautiful, clean room and house, great room amenities - microwave, hotplates, cutlery, coffee, tea, fridge. We saw Louise only briefly, but she was smiling and friendly. Bus stop in front of the house. We were very satisfied, we recommend.

Lovely apartment in a amazing location ! Eddie was really helpful with the check in / out process, and would definitely recommend and stay here again

An excellent and great value place to stay in Edinburgh - why on earth would you pay the same or more for a pokey budget hotel room? Central location, well equipped and spotlessly clean. Natasa and team were extremely accommodating and flexible when we needed to shift our stay around due to unforeseen circumstances. Great communication and follow up.
Location was amazing, close to the castle and main streets to walk around.

Tolle Unterkunft mit guter Busanbindung in einer ruhigen Gegend. Das Zimmer und das Bad waren sehr sauber und schön. Francesca ist eine perfekte Gastgeberin und hat uns auch mit Frühstücksartikel versorgt.
Really good location.
Unique and clean, with a view of the castle. The host is friendly and responds quickly. Recommended!

Wonderful place to stay and super close to everything.

Daria’s place was brilliant. Great location and easy to check in. Great vegan cafe just 20 seconds up the road.
Great little place, this was the second time we’ve stayed here and will definitely be returning soon! Highly recommend x
Lovely apartment in a great location.  Lots of steps, but it is a roof top apartment!
A Comfortable ,Clean Room .Lovely host very accommodating. I highly recommend staying with them if you come into town .
Ubicación y alojamiento excelente! Un apartamento encantador con todo lujo de detalles.

great place and location

The place is okay, but it is not worth the price. The windows are ancient and poorly insulated, so all the noise from the road is in the room. The walls aren´t very thick, so the noise from other rooms is heard very loudly.
Really friendly host and good base for a city break
A comfortable overnight stay in a convenient location.

I am so grateful to Pauline for offering this space. She was very responsive when informing her of my flight delay and provided me clear and concise instructions on gaining entrance. Rest assured that if you book this room, you will not regret it. For a first time solo traveler from the States, I’m so pleased with how everything worked out.

Schönes, neu renoviertes Gartenhaus in großem privaten Garten.

Thanks you two,

Richard & Sue.

Great location, easily accessible to the train station and scenic spots. The 18th-century building is very impressive. François is very friendly and helped me a lot with local tips, especially about the beautiful sunset on Carlton Hill. I will definitely stay here again next time.

This AirBnB fit the bill in all respects, and had the added bonus of being let by a "super host".  Our host provided us all the information we needed to find and get in to the unit.  He was also responsive whenever we had a question about the amenities in the unit and was proactive in providing information on what to see and where to eat while in Edinburgh.  The unit itself, a 2-bedroom/2-bath apartment, was very comfortable and nicely laid out.  We would definitely look at booking this apartment again.
Couldn’t have asked for a more fabulous location. Excellent amenities and exceedingly clean.
We enjoyed our time in this flat. It was very conveniently located for all of the things we wanted to see in Old Town.
Sevi ist eine gute und sehr freundliche Gastgeberin und hat uns mit Restauranttipps gut weitergeholfen. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Cosy apartment in lovely area, very central walking distance from main attractions, great price for the location, had a great time :~)

Nice clean and quiet house. 20min away by car from the old town, or 40 by bus (bus stop 2 min away).
Comfy bed
Loved staying in this Outlander themed Air BnB. We had a wonderful time exploring Scotland and the place was always a pleasure to return to at the end of the day. We will absolutely be back!

It was very easy to Check-In and easy to find. The surroundings were very beautiful and quiet, old nice buildings. We loved the quiet garden between the cottages. The interior was very classy and bright. The kitchen was nice to use. The only things that could have been better: Unfortunately we didn't know how to handle the windows and to get cold water in the shower.
We would definitely recommend this accommodation!

It was a very lovely stay. The appartment was very nice, lean and spacious. The location is also nice, in a quiet surrounding but it's tak about 20 minutes through the park to get to the city center.
Cary and her husband Pete are very welcoming and we enjoyed our stay very much. We will defenetly chose to stay at this place during our next visit to Edinbough.

Fantastic location only a 10 minute walk to Princes Street (albeit up a couple of hills, but this is Scotland after all) and not much further to the Royal Mile and Castle. Although close to the attractions it was very quiet at night and suitable for families etc.
The apartment is in a beautiful building in what appears to be a very expensive, nice and safe area of Edinburgh. The apartment itself is spacious and nice, although as mentioned in other reviews the beds may be a squeeze if you are 6ft or above in bedrooms 2&3. My wife and I are both more than 6ft but we were fine in the master bedroom. Also beware of the stairs, if you are less able this would be a problem, but not a big issue otherwise.
Overall a nice apartment in a nice area close to the attractions and tourist areas in Edinburgh, and I would recommend to family and friends.

Trudi's place was just what we needed (4 of us)! It's easy to get to all the main attractions from this place
The only thing we didn't realise after the fact was that there was an extra set of keys. I looked back and it was in the instructions, I just didn't read them (whoops).

Tidy & clean.
Well organised folder with instructions. Pointing out useful amenities in Edinburgh. Showing maps. Info was even translated in several languages.
Kitchen: Nice. Plenty of cereals. Bread & butter. Tea & coffee. Milk and fruit juice in the fridge etc.
The only setback was the heating:
No thermostat to regulate the heating during the day. Came on automatically; only towards the evening.
Bedroom: Excellent.
Our family of 4 had a lovely stay for 3 nights at Una’s home. It was all as we read on Airbnb. Would surely recommend it!
Totally fantastic location and a perfect location! Barry was a perfect host and was there every step of the way…..staying here is a must!

I stayed there for 4 days and it was amazing. Andrea was really helpful  my check-in was in the evening but I arrived in the afternoon, and she still let me leave my luggage and have coffee until the room was ready. The house was beautiful, and so was she. I definitely recommend staying here, especially since there’s a bus stop nearby that takes you straight to the city.
Great apartment in a fantastic location. Assean was extremely helpful and answered queries extremely quickly and provided lots of information.  Great experience..Thankyou!
A fantastic and modern apartment close to everything in Edinburgh but in a quiet and upscale neighborhood. Super responsive host. Highly recommend !
It was great, very spacious apartment.

excellent . Just what wee needed for a one night flying visit to Edinburgh.  Well appointed  small bothy style accommodation.  Spotlessly clean. Had everything  we needed.  Host was super responsive and helpful. Would return.

Great place to stay in Edinburgh, and easy to find.
Plenty of space for two people to stay here, and was a well stocked kitchen and felt worth the price paid.

Pako was a great host. Very friendly and helpful. He was keen to chatting with us but also respected our privacy. The room was cozy, especially the bed was real comfy. The apartment was fairly close to the city centre, we were able to get to the centre on foot. Also, the apartment is really close to Holyrood park and Arthur’s seat, so you can take a trip there without a need to use a public transport. We highly recommend this place for a stay when visiting Edinburgh!

I have to say that the place is a great accommodation, close to the city center with everything you need. Thank you to Agnes for welcoming us.
The rooms are very quiet, we slept very well.
The swimming pool was great in the morning, and next time I will try the Sauna.
Go for it !
Perfect location for exploring the old town and easy walking distance to central Edinburgh. Definitely would stay again.

This is a great flat with some beautifully quirky murals and decorative touches. Francesca is a great host, we had everything we needed and she checked in with us a couple of times to ensure that all was well. Highly recommended!
Apartments number 5 and 6 are located on the third floor, and there is no elevator in the building. They are not suitable at all for guests with a lot of luggage or for elderly people

Julie is a lovely host and her home is beautiful. added bonus is her dog Cassie who loves a fuss. I didn't feel out of place at Julie's because she is chatty and friendly. her home is lovely and clean. I would definitely recommend Julie's home
Fin leilighet i rolige Morningside. Gode transportmuligheter til sentrum. 2 gode senger.

Fijn appartement in een Harry Potter sfeer! Op loopafstand van het centrum. Vanuit het appartement kun je Edinburgh goed verkennen. Heerlijke croissantjes uit de oven! Maria reageert heel snel op berichtjes en is zeer attent. Tapadh leat!
This apartment is in the most amazing location to explore the city of Edinburgh. The apartment itself is clean and comfortable with all that's need for a stay away from home. Allan is a great host.
Superb quality, amazing location, friendly hosts - a terrific place to stay in Edinburgh - thank you !!

There's a maritime flavour to this apartment with views of the nearby dock and its visiting ships. Sebastian and Jenny are welcoming, easy going, well travelled hosts and I really enjoyed our evening conversation over rooibos tea. The apartment is light, airy and immaculately kept. The luxurious top-end futon deserves a special mention: a good night's sleep is assured although I only needed one of half a dozen pillows on offer! I was in Leith for a meeting so this was a one night stay but I hope to be back.

Perfect spot for exploring Edinburgh with enough room not to feel squashed in. Parking is an added bonus!
Lots of information about check-in.
My only minor niggle is that I requested an additional night but didn't get a reply.
I would definitely stay here again.

This is a great Airbnb in a very beautiful part of outer Edinburgh. Ana was very welcoming and accommodating, and we had no complaints about cleanliness or amenities. We appreciated having use of the kitchen!
Had a great time and apartment was in a great location.

Reggie and Murray were there perfect hosts, very welcoming with lots of great tips about Edinburgh.  They allowed us to leave our luggage before we checked in and out, which was really appreciated.  There were lots of nice touches like milk, fruit, chocolate in the room.  The room is gorgeous with a lovely view!  It is so spacious and quiet too.   It was truly a home from home and far better than staying in a hotel.  The perfect place for relaxing and seeing all that Edinburgh has to offer and we wouldn't hesitate to stay there again, should we have the opportunity!

Amamos!! Anfitriã muito receptiva e nos deixou bem à vontade. E claro, mimamos bastante o Merlin e a Isla haha muito fofos, carinhosos e tranquilos, foram companhias maravilhosas. Tudo muito limpo, confortável, fácil acesso a tudo e bem seguro. Recomendamos!!
easy place to stay!
Snabb och tydlig kommunikation, perfekt ställe mitt i stan.

Very cute and cozy house in prime location of Edinburg. David our host was very helpful and prompt guiding us to access the apartment. The apartment was spacious for 5 guests. The apartment was very clean. Highly recommended.

I had a home emergency that necessitated the use of this super cute, cosy little apartment, and I couldn’t have chosen better. The ingenious use of space in this property is simply amazing. Spotlessly clean, cool artwork and amazingly courteous hosts combined with a fantastic neighbourhood all made my stay truly memorable.

We visited during the festival and the apartment in Bellevue was an oasis from the busy Old Town. There were lots of great little pubs and restaurants nearby and only a 10 minute walk from Tesco.
The flat was clean, tidy and quiet which was good for relaxing after running between shows. I'll definitely be back next year!
lovely place to stay, nice touches snacks,drinks etc thank you
The location is very convenient. It is less than a 10-minute walk from the railway station. There is a convenience store at the entrance of the apartment.
Beautiful apartment and great location!

Bien situé, pratique et bien meublé.
Un peu froid, réglage de l'air climatisé difficile

Amazing brand new apartment. The bathroom is way better than many I've seen in hotels that were the same price per night as Ollie's accommodation. Extra points for the little bow made out of toilet paper. The rest of the room has everything you need, including the kitchen. The room has a lovely and cosy vibe. Even great to spend an evening in with some takeout food
Sitio céntrico. Perfecto para ver la ciudad. Muchos pubs y restaurantes muy cerca.
Really appreciated this quiet place and friendly host
I loved staying at Joe's place and will be back
Todo perfecto y a 10 min andando del centro
Good location, clean and comfortable all around plus kind and helpful host. Perfect place for Edinburgh holidays. Would love to visit and stay again, definitely.

Fantastisk leilighet, føltes som hjemme. Verten var aktiv på meldinger og lurte på om alt var bra og om vi manglet noe eller lurte på noe. Veldig ivaretagende og hyggelig.
Beliggenheten i et rolig boligstrøk med gangavstand til sentrum var perfekt.
Vi følte oss veldig velkommen. Bor der gjerne igjen.

Claire and Rob were wonderful hosts. Their accommodation was pristine, cosy, comfortable and easily accessible with the hosts’ clear instructions. The location is ideal, only a short bus ride from some of Edinburgh’s main attractions. Claire and Rob were very responsive and accommodating, and our whole experience was smooth and relaxing.

The apartment was light and lovely with modern amenities in a vintage, high-ceiling space and nice views of Queen Street. The primary bedroom and bathroom were huge and comfortable. It was a great place to spend Christmas in Edinburgh, and very walkable (within 10-15 minutes of the major attractions such as the Castle and Royal Mile, including the Stockbridge neighborhood and classic pubs). It was also nice to have two terrific coffee shops across the street, as well as one of the city’s best bars. Note that it is one small flight up to the 1st floor, and you should plan to shop for basics if you are staying more than a couple of days. Overall, we loved it and hope to return!
Had a lovely stay, great location to explore Edinburgh. Had everything we needed and Katie was a great host

Ha sido una estancia muy cómoda en un apartamento muy completo, tranquilo y la seguridad de tener una atención directa 24 horas de los gestores. Todo está perfecto. La limpieza excelente. Vale la pena
Great place to stay in Edinburg. The apartment is nice and has all the essentials. It’s really to easy reach the centre via a bus that’s only a couple minutes away.
Lovely apartment in a great location. Emily is a very accomodating host, could not recommend more!

El alojamiento estaba limpio. Tenía todo lo necesario. No estaba mal ubicado aunque hay que andar al centro unos 15 minutos, lo cual no es problema si no cargas con maletas pesadas.
La verdad que hemos estado muy bien.

Salma was so lovely since the very beginning. The house was so lovely, we felt like home❤️
Definitely will come back next time I visit Edinburgh.
If you want to be in walking distance of the sites, restaurants, and activities in Edinburgh, this is the place to be.
Place was very nice. Great area and the communication throughout was fantastic with Kath. Would definitely recommend this to others and would return to this property
Enjoyed our stay, great location and exactly as described. Would recommend to others who want to be close to amenities and attractions. We found it cosy and welcoming

Liz was wonderful! One of the best hosts I’ve worked with. Apartment was clean, well stocked and as described. Great instructions and lots of follow up. Checking in to make sure everything was going well and so very kind and responded so quickly. Thanks for a great stay and would love to come back!
Clean and nice apt
All was great - nice food & drink and local shops and it's easy by taxi or bus into town.

This was a great little apartment, had everything we needed. Michal was very helpful before our trip with his communication back and forth , instructions very easy to get into the flat. The location is exception abs very easy to get to and from town. We will be back. Thanks for the great stay x

Great perch for an Edinburgh stay.  I was only there one night but I appreciated the fully equipped, modern kitchen and bath.  View of the Castle high on its rock is extra nice. Bed was comfy and room was quiet.  Lots of restaurants and cafes nearby and very easy to get to the High Street with all the action there.

Wonderful base for a weekend with friends in Edinburgh. The flat was as described, perhaps larger than anticipated, and beds were comfy. Perfect for 3 adults, and kitchen was very functional and well equipped. The location can’t be beat, just a block or two away from Stockbridge high street and great dining, drinking and shopping. The private garden was lovely. Would definitely stay again!!
L'appartement est très agréable, propre et les lits sont confortables. Les informations pour accéder au logement sont très claires. Très bon rapport qualité prix.
Great location, great house 5 Stars !!!

What a great flat, very comfortable and plenty of room. Nicely decorated and has all that you need. We stayed for a weekend and had no need for cooking etc but it looked like it had all you would need. Liked the two bathrooms, liked the option to split up the king size bed into 2 singles as we were 3 adults ( not related) staying. The location was the best - so convenient for St James’s Quarter shopping centre, George street etc. yet it was so quiet ! Easy access to some lovely artisan cafes and restaurants. Flat has an outside terrace that we would use if we came back in warmer weather!   Really recommend it. Owner really responsive.
Perfect location, easy check in and check out
It was comfortable

We only spent the night at Vivien’s after a day in Edinburgh and before heading to the airport the next morning. Her place was an easy drive from sightseeing in Edinburgh and also to the airport. Everything was sparkling clean. She had a great kitchen which we didn’t have time to use. Great location with all the amenities you need. I would highly recommend staying here.
Trudy

The flat was very central. Close to all the best that Edinburgh has to offer. Cosy and clean with everything you could require for a nights stay to longer. Check in was easy, there was simple and transparent instructions by the host Sylvia. When we had a small issue,  she did everything in her power to be helpful and accommodating. I would be very happy to stay her again.
Wonderful stay in this apartment, the communication from Katie was excellent and very helpful before and after our stay. Great location, loved the city, and would highly recommend.
Dylan was great and the place exceeded our expectations. I would have no problem recommending his place to any fellow traveler.
Magdelena was very helpful and responsive during our stay. Beautiful apartment, would definitely recommend 😊

John's apartment is wonderful; he communicates well and the decor is amazing. You can feel the springs through some of the mattresses, but the location is good and it's perfect for large groups. We had a great stay and I would recommend this place to others.
Lovely place and perfect for large families. We stayed for a weekend and the central location is great. Lovely and clean with everything you need! Would definitely stay again and recommend to others!
Lovely apartment in great location

This place was perfect! The location is amazing and had everything we needed, it was perfectly clean and cosy. We would definitely go back again! There are a lot of small spiral stairs however to get to it so pack light.
This place is at the central location and very near to most of the tourist places. The host is very approachable and friendly.
Excellent location and great communication
Loved it. Great location. Tasteful decor. Quite unique. Spotless and so easy to stay at. Would go back. Great stay.
Amazing apartment!! It even has boardgames.. wish I could stay longer. Definitely worth it.

Ann’s place is in an amazing location in Edinburgh! Close to the castle and you really can see it from the apartment. It is also just around the corner from the Grassmarket with heaps of pubs, cafes and restaurants, as well as little book stores and antique shops. There is a Sainsburys in close walking distance and bus stops very close as well. The apartment is very comfortable with enough room to spread out. Ann’s communication was great and she was helpful with answering questions and check in was very easy. There were lovely little touches such as a nice bottle of wine to welcome us. We recommend Ann’s place and would definitely stay again!
Very nice flat everything is available and great location
It was a bit cold

We enjoyed our stay at Sue’s place.  Beautiful location.  Quiet street.  Plenty of space for my family of seven.  Very walkable to the shops, restaurants, and the Royal Mile.  Would definitely stay here again!

One of the best places I’ve ever stayed! If you’re looking for a central, clean, spacious, and stunning place to stay in Edinburgh, look no further! It has everything you need and you are in the perfect location to explore all attractions or access transportation if need be. Irene was also incredibly kind, helpful, and friendly while also giving you privacy and space :)

The first comment when we saw the apartment has been: 'Perfect house!'. Jana was very helpful and returned our messages very quickly. The apartment is very well mantained, cozy and with all comforts and it is just in the city centre!

It is not super close to the city centre, but walkable and it is what we wanted. The only small issue was that we had own car and dropping off and getting our luggage was a bit of a challenge. Otherwise we were very happy staying at this very clean and comfortable apartment.
Lovely location, gorgeous home.  Very good overnight stay.
Het is een mega fijn appartement. Rustig gelegen, en mooie omgeving! Een bushalte is vlakbij die je naar het centrum brengt, erg handig!

Great location with a short walk from Waverley Station.  Steve was there to greet us when we arrived and explained everything we needed to know.  We were a party of nine but felt we had plenty of room.

We had a great time in the flat with 2 adults and 4 kids. The location was excellent for exploring everywhere we wanted in Edinburgh on foot. The stairs up to the flat are steep and a bit worn as described by others but our children ages 4, 7, 7, and 10 managed without difficulty. Thanks for a great stay!

Our stay in Edinburgh was great - the apartment is in a fantastic location and communication for self check in was easy. Kitchen is refurbished with all amenities.
The place is advertised as double bed with sofa bed however the third bed is a small fold out cot - I would say this wasn’t suitable for an adult and the springs in it were broken so for safety my friend ended up taking the bedding and sleeping on the floor. The place is ideal for 2x adults.
Wonderful ensuite and clean bathroom. Lucy and Tu are kind and helpful.

This apartment absolutely surpassed our expectations . The photos are great but it’s even better in reality . The location  on the Grassmarket was ideal for us . The Pubs and restaurants were all easily accessible . It has Steep access stairs but we expected that and it was worth every step ! Both the Beds are super comfy  and the view from the windows are amazing . We were here for rugby and my husband’s 60th birthday and this was just the most perfect setting . Lisa was communicative throughout . I highly recommend this apartment. Thank you Lisa

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Christopher, un vrai coup de cœur ! L’appartement est idéalement situé, à seulement quelques minutes à pied du centre, ce qui est très pratique. Le fait qu’il soit à l’étage donne une réelle sensation d’indépendance, ce que nous avons beaucoup apprécié.
Le logement est impeccable, très propre et parfaitement équipé, rien ne manque. Mention spéciale pour la vue au moment du coucher de soleil, tout simplement magnifique !
Christopher est un hôte très gentil, réactif et agréable, ce qui rend l’expérience encore plus appréciable. Et une grosse pensée pour Pepi, la petite chienne, qui est adorable !
Nous reviendrons sans hésiter dans cet appartement si nous repassons dans la région. Au plaisir ! 😊
Je recommande vivement cette hôte,Anne est chaleureuse et fera tout le possible pour que vous poussiez passer un séjour au top!

I can’t say enough good things about Catherine. She is an absolutely wonderful host. She meet me when I first arrived and showed me around her place, told me how to use the different amenities and gave me great tips on local places to visit and to eat at.
I would have extended my stay with her if the room wasn’t already booked for the nights following my initial reservation! Definitely 5 stars all the way!!
Lovely apartament, close to the city center, with plenty of light and space :). Highly recommended

Great cozy space in a beautiful area and close to bus routes. David gave some great local recommendations and was very helpful.
Thanks for a great stay!
Was so good and close to everywhere . Love it

Nous avons séjourné dans la chambre d’ami de Victoria. Le lit était très confortable. La chambre est joliment décorée.
Victoria avait mis à disposition de quoi faire un petit déjeuner. Et elle nous a sauvé la vie avec les adaptateurs pour les prises (nous avions oublié le nôtre).
L’appartement est proche du tram de la ville il est donc facile de se déplacer. Il y a des magasins et pub à proximité.
Victoria a été très accueillante et toujours enthousiaste.
Je recommande vivement le séjour chez elle.
Excellent bnb. Great location if you want to explore exciting Edinburgh but also offers a lovely homely feel if you just want to stay in.

We loved our stay! The flat is on the top floor with beautiful natural light, and plenty of space to enjoy relaxing after a day exploring Edinburgh. Only tiny downside was the towels are very small and only two were provided for a 4 day, 3 night stay.
Great place to stay near city centre!! Quick responses, lovely host - would highly recommend!
Buen sitio interno,  bien ubicado .  Le falta limpieza a la escalera .  El anfitrión David es excelente persona y muy atentos .  Recomendable

Sam’s place is fantastic. I needed someplace big enough to bring my parents, my sister and children, and my daughter to enjoy the festivities in Edinburgh. The flat was perfect for us as each family had their own bedroom and there was enough space for us to chill out in the evening while the kids were in bed.
The location was fantastic. It’s in a beautiful area, close to good restaurants and local amenities and a short walk to the Christmas markets and the centre of town. The apartment itself is light and airy and impeccably clean. Sam provided very clear instructions and was very responsive throughout our stay.
It is up 3 flights of stairs which I didn’t think was a problem but my parents struggled a bit. I would definitely have returned if it wasn’t for the stairs.
El apartamento es amplio y bien equipado, en la zona se aparca genial, pero no está cerca del centro. Zona tranquila. Hemos estado muy agusto.

We were absolutely blown away with Dunc and Dees place! We were welcomed with homemade shortbread and Prosecco and a squeaky clean adorable apartment. The most stunning view of the castle as soon as you open the front door, great kitchen space and laundry too. Would highly recommend this place to anyone and we hope we’ll be back soon!!

I very much enjoyed staying at Steve's. The bedroom was perfect: lovely decoration, overlooking gardens, very quiet at night. I found Steve's apartment a very relaxing place to be. He was very easy-going too. The location couldn't be better: on a peaceful  street in a beautiful location but only minutes away on foot from all the most famous attractions.  I would most definitely stay there again on my next trip!

When every review expresses how wonderful the accommodation is and there is not even the slightest hint of a negative comment it tells you how good the experience has been. I can only repeat the words of other reviewers. James is a superb host, very attentive to the needs of guests and with an exceptional eye for interior design that is reflected throughout his home. it is an incredibly relaxing place to stay and has everything you could possibly need, close to vibrant streets but offering total peace and tranquility. The provision of bread, milk, eggs etc were very much appreciated. We will certainly try to book with James again when we next stay in Edinburgh.
Perfectly located flat and very comfortable
Nous avons passé un excellent week-end à Édimbourg, la maison est parfaite et très bien située

Our stay at John's place was great. the location is central in Old Town and if you're looking to hit up tourist spots this is a great home base.
Like other reviews have mentioned, the neighborhood is LOUD. We didn't notice much specific to the bar below, but the flat is on a main close from Waverly and there were people dragging suitcases up and down the stairs 24/7. Bring ear plugs and it won't be a problem.
John was friendly and responsive to all communications and was a great host.

We absolutely loved this flat, we didn’t want to go home!! The area was perfect - a short walk into lovely Leith and a really nice walk into the city too, a nice and quiet after the madness of the Fringe! Check-in was a breeze, the flat was spotless, homely, really nicely decorated and so well-stocked, it truly had everything you need and we felt really looked after. Only slight issue we had was that the shower runs hot and cold on-and-off, but that was actually quite nice in the morning to wake us up!! Also really handy having the big Tesco so close too. Magdalena was also an absolutely amazing host, so friendly, flexible and communicative, we really couldn’t ask for more and would recommend to anyone. Thank you so much, and we would love to stay again if you’ll have us!
Excellent stay.

Katie is a great host. very responsive and the apartment is centrally located in the heart of Edinburgh walkable from main attractions even with a toddler with us. The apartment was clean and even better then the listed photos. will definitely visit again.
A comfortable, cosy place to stay, within walking distance of the city centre, and with easy communication with the host.

Had a lovely few days in Edinburgh before Christmas with family. Great location and very peaceful. Lots of recommendations on where to go and eat. The log fire was a great addition. Couple of things to note, is that the flat is on the top floor with a lot of steps and no lift available. Apartment could do with a small amount of maintenance. The gas oven was held together by zip ties and the carbon dioxide alarm went off when using which wasn’t great or safe. Also, being high up and windy, the windows howled and created a draught.
Located in a quiet street in a nice neighbourhood with lots of cafes/bars/restaurants nearby. Short walk to Princes Street, bus and tram stops close by.

Graham was a brilliant host and the apartment was great for us. A perfect location for going to the Fringe being quite a short walk (15-20 mins) to most of the locations and Princes street and Grahams local tips for parking etc were really helpful. Would stay again.
Good
Fantastic flat, in a great location! Could not have asked for a better stay.

The rooms were really good and cheap.
The wall sound proofing is not good and sometimes room gets heated up , might be due to inaccurate heater settings
A clean and well described apartment. Highly recommend.
We stayed for the eras tour concert. It was a walkable distance to the stadium and to the old town.

Posizione centralissima,
Bella vista
Pulizia perfetta, accogliente e tutto perfetto...
Ci sono diversi scalini da fare ma poi una volta arrivati la locazione merita.
Lo consiglio.

First of all, we (three girls) loved our stay in Ninas flat. We stayed there for a bit more than 6 weeks. Nina and Douglas answered every single one of our questions (before and during our stay) and explained in great detail how to get into the flat (self check-in). We arrived around 10pm and it was no problem at all for them. We took the taxi to get to the flat. The ride was pretty quick (around 10 minutes) and the price was reasonable (under 10 pounds). For the rest of our stay we preferred to walk to the city centre (20-30 minutes) but there are bus stops literally everywhere. The flat is only 5 minutes away from Leith Walk and therefore near a lot of pubs and restaurants. Everything was in walking distance, like for example Calton Hill, Old Town, Edinburgh Castle, New Town, the shore, and lots more. There is a Tesco and a Lidl 5 minutes away as well.
The flat itself was clean and it felt like home after just a few days. It is a nice flat and the neighbours were nice people. We would love to stay there again sometime. I had a very very hard time to leave. We highly recommend the flat. Thank you so much for being very kind and helpful hosts, Nina and Douglas.

My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Derek’s. The place was clean and well prepared and we were grateful to have been able to check in early. Derek was always very responsive and quick to help and he always kept us in the loop of things. We appreciated his recommendations of what to do while we were there. The area itself is lovely and we felt very safe the entire stay, noise can travel up but even for a Friday and Saturday night it was always a good level. If you opt to walk from the tram we recommend taking carryons instead of large suitcases as there are a few stairs to get up but if you take a taxi then you are good for a case. We would hope to stay with Derek again as we really did have a wonderful time.
Very clean space, everything you need
Huge apartment. Big rooms. Great location. Would highly recommend this home.

This was a great experience. The place was very clean, little things like hair dryers and universal extension sockets are there, and it's a 7 minute walk from a big retail park that has everything you need.

Great stay at the Castle Snug! Perfect location - easy to get to from the train station / airport bus and right by the Royal Mile. Lovely character to the place and just what was needed for a weekend away.
Awesome hosts, cozy room. I spent 6 weeks and felt like a home. Denise and Karen are great host. Thank you so much. I hope to see you soon.

Lovely apartment with lots of natural light. The location was perfect for us due to its close proximity to the Western General Hospital. Very quiet area and the secure parking was a bonus. A big thank you to Gemma, Natalie and Jen for being so accommodating. We are looking forward to our next stay in November in our new 'home from home!

Clean, quiet flat and wonderful location!  Loved walked to Holyrood park each morning, easy to walk to everything in town. There are multiple bus stops out front as well. I felt safe and happy during our stay!
Third time staying at Charlotte’s place and I love it more every single time. The perfect location. Always feels like home!!

Exactly as described and Calum was a great host. We had a few questions before and during our stay and he was super responsive. We stayed over New Year’s 2025 so it was very busy. This apartment was perfect, close to everything we wanted to do and very quiet. Highly recommend. 5 stars *****

Everything about this place was great, no joke – the location was great and the 4 of us felt very comfortable in this space. Overall, definitely recommend both the location itself as well as the host! Thank you for our great stay!
Thank you Lindsey for our stay, it is a quiet and tidy apartment.

Excelente ubicación.
El transporte público te deje justo en frente del alojamiento desde el centro de Edimburgo. Todo está impecable muchas gracias por recibirnos en tu casa Elizabeth.
we had a great time and got a lot of help from Mirian, thanks for everything
Great location! The communication with the hosts was easy and smooth. There was one thing which could be improved that I will message the hosts directly.

Paul was a fantastic host!  The flat was just as described, comfortable and clean as well as decorated for Christmas which gave our holiday stay great atmosphere. Paul provided us with milk, bread, butter, mince pies and a bottle of wine as well as the traditional shortbread and dram of whiskey as we were celebrating New Years!  We would absolutely stay here again and would definitely recommend this flat to anyone looking to spend a few days in Edinburgh.

Me and my family had an excellent stay in Martin’s apartment! The apartment is very comfortable, bright and clean, and situated in a perfect location close to all the main attractions and lovely cafes. Martin was a great host, and his local knowledge was very interesting and helpful to us. I highly recommend this lovely place. Thank you Martin.

A gorgeous apartment. Plenty of space for a couple, really high spec and spotless. Everything you need for a stay in Edinburgh. Including a coffee machine with pods for a lovely coffee. Lots of nice little touches like that, including lovely shower gel scent diffusers. Also very warm and cosy.
It is more like a 20-30 minute walk into the centre of town, so be prepared for a bit of a walk. Fairly close to Holyrood Park and Arthur’s seat though.
We like a walk though so would definitely stay again! Thanks Morag and Linda!
Great place. Big space. definitely good for travelers.  We appreciate the host”s warm treatment
We had a lovely stay in Edinburgh. This place was a perfect base for us to explore from. Victor was a great host.

This is a lovely apartment. It was a bit of a mission getting access however that was because l didn't read the instructions correctly. one of the nicest air bnb's l have stayed in. No expense spared everything is really good quality. The kitchen is well equipped, the sofa bed and the main bed were really comfortable. The apartment is warm and everything is brand new.
Also the view of the castle is amazing especially when it's lit up of a night.
The host was very responsive and answered all my silly questions. We had a great stay right near the grass market

Perfect place in the Old Town. Very clean and well equipped.

I highly recommend it.

Dina’s place was great and in a good location. It’s a bit of a walk up to princes street but lots of local places to go.

Great experience as this is exactly how the first year of the Airbnb platform was operating with shared flats. The hosts made me feel very welcome and looked after. Great sleep in a very clean and quiet place. Compliments!

We (family of four) loved the very modern, extremely clean and well furnished apartment. It’s very close to train station and a short walk to Royal mile and worked well for us. Marc instructions were clear, his responses were quick and his description of the apartment is accurate.

Clean, modern and ideally located spot. Great hosts, who both make themselves known and available should you need anything.
Bus spot into the main city perfectly located outside.

Peaceful, lovely spot with great access to the city!

Steven and Gillian were excellent hosts. The place was comfy, cozy, and exactly as pictured. My partner and I were driving through Scotland and we had a great time here while we stayed in Scotland. Would stay again!
Accurate description of the apartment. Great location and surrounding! Definitely recommend it to the visitors in Edinburgh :)
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. This is a true value for money. Valentino, the host, was very helpful. Would certainly recommend for a group or family stay.

absolute bargain for the centre of edinburgh!

would be definetly booking again
The place was viby and had aura, everything in the was good quality including the bathroom products, had everything I needed. Bed was super comfortable. No notes.
Very nice place easy check in and check out. Lovely bedrooms. Quiet and nice surroundings.
Cracking location. Right in the heart of things but very quiet. Walking distance to everything (although not Balmoral Castle!) comfy beds, washing machine - the works!

Awesome location!
Right in the heart of everything.

Eleanor is Amazing!! She was the best host ever. She graciously picked us up at the station and made sure we knew where everything was located. The flat was clean and well kept. Exactly as pictured. The location was PERFECT for us. Easy walk to everything. I would not hesitate to stay in Eleanor's flat again. Definite SuperHost!!

I really love the place is beautiful and bright, The location is perfect everything is near, the neighbor is quite.

We went for the second time to stay with Janet. Again, we had an amazing stay. Janet is very welcoming and friendly, and gives good recommendations. She wants to provide her guests with the best, which is appreciated. Thank you again Janet!

Good little apartment, fairly convenient location, has everything you need (including an extraordinarily well equipped kitchen and a very comfortable bed). Communication very fast and reliable, self check-in easy, cleanliness perfect. The street outside is fairly noisy, but with the windows closed it's not an issue. Great location and apartment for spending most of your time out in the city. Derek provided a lot of information prior to check in about accessing the apartment.

We enjoyed our stay at Alexander’s house.
We literally could walk to the city centre in 20-25mins which was amazing.

tout est parfait, je recommande a 100%

Rebecca est une hôte très chaleureuse, elle est très à l’écoute et attentive à nos besoins.

This was a perfect place for our trip to Edinburgh.  The place was even better than advertised. The location was perfect as it was safe, quiet, and private. The place was perfect! I was so impressed by how big and how clean and tidy it was. Very convenient and the perfect place to explore a beautiful city!
Klein aber fein! Würde ich immer wieder buchen.

We had a fabulous stay and loved all the little touches — Dee’s delicious shortbread, the local recommendations, and stylish yet comfy furnishings. And about as central as one can get. So many great places just a few steps from the front door. Will definitely return!
I enjoyed every minute of my stay. I had no issues so could focus on the festival.
Spot on place. Clean, modern, convenient and great host.
Clare was a very nice host, gave me comprehensive information about Scotland which helped me a lot. On top of that, I really liked the coziness of the place. Highly recommended.
The place was nice and clean.A comfortable stay overall!
beata was very very kind and helpful. her house is very cozy and it’s in a nice neighborhood. even though i did not stay for that long, it was very pleasant :)

Beautiful apartment - a lot more spacious than the pictures convey.  Perfect position to access New and Old Town.  Parking in Omni about 6 minutes walk - £22 per day.   Three floors up, 77 stairs,  good for the pulse rate after a night out ; )   Worth it for the expansive views across the town and Forth from the living room and two of the bedrooms.  Highly recommended, we really want to return, thank you for making it available.

Such a wonderful stay - really helpful and kind - interesting and thoughtful too and had some fabulous food cooked by Rujira!!
I would highly recommend staying here .

Sam responded quickly to all our communication.
The apartment was gorgeous, lovely large bedrooms, well stocked kitchen, great shower and lots of lovely touches such as chargers, shopping bags and toiletries.
Walkable to city centre but also well sources by taxis and buses.
Would definitely stay again
Thank you.

John's place was absolutely lovely and felt like a real home away from home for the 7 weeks we were there. It had absolutely everything we needed, was very clean and comfortable and also very stylish and not just furnished with the cheapest Ikea furniture like most airbnbs. We never needed to contact John for anything the whole time we were there but he still checked in occasionally to make sure we were comfortable which was appreciated. We loved the flat, the location was amazing, very close to the Royal Mile , also walking distance from the central train station. It was clean, and very nicely decorated. David’s place was perfect for our stay. It is a beautiful flat in a great location. Thanks again!

Great location, and considering it’s on a buzzy street with restaurants and bars just below, it wasn’t too noisy late at night.

We could not have asked for a more perfect place to stay. It was quiet, and close to everything. It was beautifully appointed, very comfortable, and the hosts were lovely! Would love to come back someday.
Great central location. Perfect spot for those wanting to explore Edinburgh.

La casa se encuentra en un barrio residencial tranquilo cerca del parque Harrison y hay un pequeño supermercado bien surtido que abre hasta las 22:00. Cerca del canal que se puede ir andando hasta el centro en 30 minutos.
Es una casa agradable y acogedora. Hemos estado 5 personas muy a gusto.

Ha sido una maravillosa estancia, la casa está en un barrio perfecto, es grande, bien habilitada, cuenta con todo tipo de necesidades, está completa en cuanto a calefacción, sabanas, toallas, enseres de limpieza, todo muy cómodo y en perfecto funcionamiento. La ubicación no puede ser mejor, y andando a pocos minutos del centro de la ciudad.

We had a great one-night stay at Catherine's adorable flat. She was very flexible with our arrival time and was there the welcome us when we arrived. She gave us a tour and explained things we needed to know about the apartment (hot water, heating, etc.), and then gave us some recommendations for places to eat in the area (a link to the list is also included in the listing). Her place was very clean and comfortable, we felt right at home!
Not bad

Lovely, light-filled and comfortable apartment in an ideal location.   For those Harry Potter fans you are right in the center of things - just a few steps from Victoria street which inspired Diagon Alley and with views of other important Harry Potter sites from the apartment.  Emily and Nick are amazing hosts and their local tips were spot on.
Loved Graham’s place - well located, spacious and well appointed. We were able to walk to most places we wanted to see. Would highly recommend to others.

Loved staying here! We trully felt as living the local life, the flat is amazing. It has everything you need, and it keeps a traditional charm. The only inconvenience was an issue that would appear ocasionally with the water pressure, but it was only one of us to be unlucky to experience it, the others had no problems. The location is perfect, near a park, and walkable to the city centre. A bus station was right across the street, and the 16 line would get you literally everywhere. The street was full of cafes and restaurants, and our favourite pub, Bennets Bar located at just a 9 min walk. They have a large variety of whiskeys and beers, and a great atmosphere. It was always our first stop on our way home. 10/10 recommend
Lovely stay in a great location

Martin's apartment was everything we had hoped for AND more.  It was beautifully decorated inside and was immaculately clean. The big windows let in natural light and the apartment in general had a lovely energy. The bed was extremely comfortable (which my jet lag was appreciative).  It is located in the middle of everything you want to see, including great restaurants right in the street. Martin was super helpful leading up to check in, and even more so in person.  Great host. Thanks for the best weekend Martin!

Visited during the Edinburgh festival so prices are extremely high across the city. This is a very easy place to get to by bus (stops are only a few meters away) and Uber. There are some great restaurants and pubs in the area. Very clean accommodation and a place to spend a very comfortable night and then get out and partake in all that Edinburgh has to offer.
Really great location. Beautiful flat, very clean and everything you need :) would return xx
value for money. relatively clean and quiet (unless someone in your room snores at night). Very convenient location

This was a great place for my wife and I to use as a home base for exploring Scotland. It was within walking distance of most of the attractions in Edinburgh and we found plenty of nearby parking for our rental through the JustPark app.
The apartment is cozy with modern amenities and the host was extremely responsive to any requests we had. There are plenty of shops within walking distance for your day to day needs.
Highly recommended!
We had a great stay in Grace‘s lovely flat. Very nice to chat to, also she was very helpful througout our stay! Highly recommended! :)
This is an amazing space.  My wife and I plan on staying here again during our next visit to Scotland.

Dele's flat is a great place to stay and in a very convenient and central location. The shops and restaurants were within easy walking distance and the checking-in instructions were clear and straightforward as Dele was not in edinburgh at the time. Unfortunately we were missing bedding for the futon bed for the two nights we stayed which made the stay rather uncomfortable. Dele wasn't able to resolve the problem for us from a distance. If everything had been provided though I know we would have had a very enjoyable stay.
Fabulous hosts, location and snug!
Rebecca’s place was full of colour, and had an absolutely beautiful view, in a very good location, with restaurants and shops all around!!
Had a top stay for new year - was perfect for us a young couple. Host was very welcoming and helpful ... Thankyou !

The toilet seat was also broken during our stay.

Excellent property; very well fitted out and presented and a great location.  Would be very happy to return.  Check out the garden access key as the Queen Street Gardens are well worth a visit.  Kevin

The bed was super comfy with nice linens, the bathroom floor WAS HEATED and the kitchen was fully stocked and well designed. Everything was very walkable and there are tons of things to see in Edinburgh. The size of the flat was very generous and perfect for my daughter and I. As an owner of a vacation rental in southern California, Charlotte speaks my love language...what a beautiful experience she provided both in property and hosting. Merry Christmas!

Southern California
Très beau logement. Très propre et bien situé. Le seul inconvénient est qu’il n’y a qu’une salle de bain pour 3 ou 4 chambres.

Bianca is the greatest host I’ve ever had. She is very kind, always willing go help with anything the guests need, and gives a lot of recommendations for things to do, restaurants, bars.
I definitely will stay with Bianca again in future occasions.

Mary's accommmodation is an absolute gem.  Pristine, extremely comfortable and very peaceful, and Mary made us feel so welcome. If I could give this accommodation a higher rating, it would truly deserve it.  In addition, it is very easy to get into central Edinburgh - walkable and also a direct bus every couple of minutes or so, to the door!  We highly recommend this accommdation, and have already booked for next year!

It was a really cozy apartment. we had a great time staying there and it was alle clean and nice. the only thing missing was some space to put clothes inside, like a wardrobe.
I would definitely come back, because you can walk so easly in the city.

Very pleasant stay here with my son. Roy and Selena are so helpful, respond quickly to messages and make you feel at home. The flat had everything we needed, was cosy and clean with comfy beds! Really convenient for the tram with the tram stop just a short walk away and then just a short tram journey to the city centre. We arrived by car, parking was free and right outside the flat. Great stay, thank you.
Nice room, perfect location for visiting Edinburgh. Really outstanding were Sofias hospitality and her helpful recommendations for exploring the city!

A comfy little flat that will fulfill your needs well.  The neighbourhood is a little run down but still safe.  Entertainment system also good quality and hot water works.  Convenient for a walk or bus ride to town.  A good choice.

My husband and I really enjoyed our stay! The flat is spaceous, bright and airy. It had everything we needed for our two month stay and we felt completely at home and comfortable from day one. Good centrally located spot to visit Edinburgh. Jake is a great host!
I loved staying at Sharon’s flat for 10 days! Had everything you need and then some. Great location, great communication. Would stay again!

Cozy, lovely and artistic house, just look like the photo. Johanna is friendly and helpful, gave us many tips on what to check out in the Edinburgh. The location is very convenient, access to major tourist attraction within 15 min walk. We absolutely enjoy the accompany of our three little friends Tattie, Neeps and Griff. Highly recommend if you are a pet lover.
This was a lovely place to stay for a few days while working in Edinburgh. Would highly recommend.

Claire is a wonderful and welcoming host who gave us some great local tip. This is the perfect spot to have easy access to both the city and the countryside, and has beautiful touches like a fireplace.
Stayed overnight in Ds apartment and I can say enough about how it good the flat was. Can't get more central!! Would stay again.
Nice and peaceful room specially James is very hospitable man highly recommended the house
Vasilis was an excellent host! The apartment was perfect and very comfortable for our family. I would HIGHLY recommend this apartment to stay!!

Just like the listing says, this is a real gem. Ideally located, just 5 mins walk from the tram, buses and a supermarket to pick up essentials. Some real gems of coffee shops, bars and boutiques right on the doorstep.
Edinburgh's lovely restaurants and bars extremely walkable as is Princes St, the Royal Mile, Castle and other attractions.
The flat itself feels like a real home from home. On a quiet street and beautifully decorated in relaxed tones. Has a comfortable sofa and bed and lots of storage space and linens are good quality.
Kitchen has everything you need and the shower and bathroom are well equipped.
Suzanne was a lovely host. She messaged me to say the flat was ready earlier than check in and also checked I had found the flat and was settled in. A few welcome treats were a lovely touch.
All in all, this is a lovely place and I'd definitely stay here again.

It is the most comfortable house I lived  with a beautiful decoration. In cold winter, it is especially warm. It is such a cozy house that I fall into sleep quickly. I just do not want to get out of the house once I enter the house!  Besides, it has a good location with walks for around 15 minutes to the city center. I definitely recommend it to everyone, especially people with insomnia and mysophobia.
Daria was very nice and helpful and everything was good!

Charlotte was fantastic very accommodating and also very informative. The place was just perfect and had the most stunning views. Bread and eggs and milk left on arrival.
Would definitely come back again was an amazing stay.
Lynsey and Darren

We had an amazing weekend in Edinburgh, Donald responded quickly on all the questions I had! on the Friday we went to the Chop House in Leith which was amazing and in walking distance from the apartment! The location was quiet and we felt like it was home from home it was only a short cab ride into the centre would definitely recommend.

Fantastic place to explore Edinburgh from! We loved the location, couldn't have been closer to everything we wanted to see, and the flat is full of character and lovely to be in! James is an excellent host who gave us plenty of help finding the place and left us all the basics plus some lovely treats in the fridge! Highly recommend!

Nous sommes restées une semaine dans cet magnifique appartement, très bien décoré et idéalement situé : seulement 10-15 minutes à pied de la vieille ville et à 5 minutes de la nouvelle. C'est une chambre pleine de charme où il est agréable de se reposer après de grosses journées à visiter cette belle ville qu'est Édimbourg. Emily a été une hôte très agréable, pleine d'attentions, et serviable, toujours disponible pour nous et qui a su nous faire sentir comme à la maison ! Nous avons adoré séjourner chez Emilly et y retournerons sans hésitation lors de notre prochaine visite.
Je recommande bien évidemment cette chambre pour ceux qui veulent visiter cette magnifique ville !
Awesome stay!

Great location, only being 3 minutes away from supermarkets, public transport and pubs and then only less than 10 minutes to be in the heart of the city. Even though we went during new years, it was very quiet and peaceful.

Jonathan is a wonderful host - very helpful in getting us checked in and sharing info on buses, grocery stores. The apt is so close to both Aldi and Sainsbury grocery stores - so easy to get supplies. Also so many bus lines serve the streets right near the apt - easy to get to anywhere in Edinburgh. The apt was very comfortable and served our needs - although I think the photos in the listing show a "glossier" apt than it is in  reality. The neighborhood looks a bit "rough" because there is a lot of trash and litter on the streets and the buildings might look a little "tired" - but it is a very nice neighborhood, safe, filled with families and students. Please note that there is not a freezer in the refrigerator so we had to go buy ice every day.
Gary is an awesome host ! Place was great ! Gary made us feel at home.. he was very friendly with our pup.. brilliant local recommendation.. 5 star guy !

Les has a modern space with a great view. The house is wonderful with all amenities. My wife Prathyusha and I stayed there for 2 nights and had the most wonderful time. We wish we could have stayed longer. Les is a great host and a sweet person. We loved our conversations with him. He also suggested places to eat which were great as well. We definitely recommend his place and we wish we could stay here again soon.
This was a very nice stay in a perfect location and Dawn was super helpful and responded so quickly. Great host!

Iliyana’s place is very cute - of course particularly if you are an Outlander fan! It  is very well set up, designed & thought out - its great for a couple. The living area is very cosy, the shower is great and we found the bed very comfortable. She has also thought of pretty well everything you would need - there’s even a variety of overseas plug adapters in case you have forgotten yours! Whilst there is a process to get entry and park (free secure parking) , Iliyana provides detailed instructions and photos which are very helpful and security seemed very good. Iliyana is very responsive to any queries and helpful with suggestions if required. It’s also a great location in Edinburgh Old Town within a few minutes walk of the Main Street - High St (Royal Mile)but still quiet , Waverley Railway Station and even New Town (Princess St). Would definitely stay there again on another trip! P.S The sachets of instant porridge (what else!) and oat milk were a great way to kickstart the day!

Awesome stay! This was my family’s first time in Scotland and of course we wanted a spot right on the Royal mile. This place did not disappoint! Was very clean, great layout and clever ways to fit a lot of amenities into a small space.
A great flat and a great host!

This is a great place to stay right in the middle of Edinburgh. Martin was so helpful even though we were late with our arrival. He explained everything about the apt., places to go, and things to do in Edinburgh. We had a late flight out and Martin arranged to keep our luggage and meet  us to get it and see us on our way. He even got us pointed in the right direction for the tram to the airport. Tram stop is an easy walk with luggage. We would definitely stay there again.

Beautiful place to stay so clean and tidy. We really enjoyed our stay and liked that there was things for breakfast. The flat has everything you need and Caroline responded very quickly if we had any issues. The place was spotless, really light and spacious. We especially liked the courtyard to sit outside and enjoy the sunny weather. And the apartment is so close to the city centre but still really quiet as it is tucked away.

Joli appartement, propre, très bien situé. Le WiFi ne fonctionnait pas, et l'hôte n'a pas été très réactif pour nous répondre. Cela fait 3 semaines que nous attendons une réponse pour un geste commercial, nous avons donc fait intervenir Airbnb. A part ça, tout était très bien.

This apartment is extremely well located in the centre of the old town, close to Edinburgh Castle. It suited a family of 4 well with two bathrooms, and one large and one smaller bedroom. Paul provided helpful instructions and advice and was very responsive to our needs.
Cute place with lots of light.  Very responsive host. Walkable and good restaurants nearby. Thank you, Eddie!

Liam was very flexible and easy going. The location was a close walk to the city centre as well. We did not see Liam much, just got the area to ourselves and had no problems at all. We had what we needed in the bedroom (tea and chocolate included which was a lovely gesture).

Thanks very much Liam!!
Excellent accommodations, now frequently used by our CEO.

Tutto bene nell'alloggio di Belen, c'era tutto il necessario, leggermente fuori dal centro ma comunque raggiungibile in 15 minuti a piedi. Siamo stati 3 notti con due bimbe piccole e siamo stati molto bene.
