Fantastic location, plenty to see and do. Walking distance to most city attractions. Accommodation was spacious and comfortable. Felt authentically Georgian. As mentioned in other reviews, old fashioned windows in keeping with the building but therefore cold and don’t block any noise.
Friendly host. Very nice and cosy room. Beautiful view in a quiet neighbourhood.

Wir haben die Wohnung schnell gefunden. Die Erklärung bezgl. Des Schlüsselsafes war einfach. Die Wohnung sah genauso aus wie auf den Fotos. Die Unterkunft war super zentral. Man konnte von dort alles erreichen. Wir haben uns die gesamte Zeit dort wohl gefühlt.
Wir würden die Wohnung jederzeit wieder buchen. :)

The host Uncie mark was amazing, helped us with great tips and locations.
~ Thx uncie Mark

Great apartment with everything we needed for our short break. Apartment was clean and tidy, amenities were plenty. Location was great, central enough yet in the quieter end to get a good night's rest. Communication was excellent from initial enquiry to arrival. Would stay here again and recommend.
Great place with everything we needed (including a comfy sofa bed)! Conveniently located for only a short walk into the city centre 😊

Roland's flat is absolutely stunning and decorated beautifully, it was a pleasure to stay there for the weekend whilst running in the Edinburgh marathon Festival, for us the location was absolutely perfect. Roland was extremely helpful and friendly, and made us feel most welcome. We would definitely love to visit again, and will be recommending to others. Thanks Roland :)

We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment. It is easy to find and a very short walk from the nearby tram station which we used throughout the trip. Would highly recommend checking this out. Very comfortable and spacious for my wife and I. Everything was clean and nicely organized, and many amenities for those spending time at the apartment.

We had a lovely few days in this beautiful flat in the centre of Stockbridge. Having access to a gorgeous garden added to the enjoyment. We would highly recommend this place and hope to visit again ourselves. The hosts were helpful and quick to respond. 10/10 superb!

Great little place in a really good location. We were going to a concert at Murrayfield and found it was easy to walk from Joe's place in just under half an hour.
The area itself is lovely, very quiet at night. The bed was comfy and the shower was great!

Cedric is a very good host. even though the flat was not clean when we checked in, he immediately arranged a cleaner and offered 20% refund which you won't usually see with other airbnb hosts. the location is also very much accessible from the city centre and has good public transport connections. loved our stay here.
A great park nearby.

The flat was clean, cozy, and matched the description. However, Valentina was fairly inconsiderate and rude. On the day of check out I had a really bad stomach ache (the type that makes you unable to walk) and wanted to delay the check out by just 1 hour. Valentina, without any attempt to be empathetic, shut me down and refused the request. At 10 o'clock came this banging noise on the door (imaging someone whacking a heavy suitcase on the door) that lasted for a good 20 minutes. . .
Being kicked out of the flat when I am nearly passing out is not what I expected paying c. £400 for a stay
Also - note that there is a kindergarten underneath the residential building, which the living room of this house face. It is very noisy during the day if you are planning to work from home.
This is the perfect place to stay in Edinburgh. The flat was clean and was located very good. If I would come back to Edi I would stay at Liz place for sure! Thank you!

Perfect appartment for a city trip to Edinburgh. In just a few minutes by foot you'll be in city center with great pubs, bars & restaurants. The flat is clean & located in a quiet area. Check in was easy & Tom is very friendly host!
100 percent recommended!
A lovely spacious flat, spotlessly clean - great for a few days in Edinburgh with two small kids.
Elizabeth was very kind giving me tea as I got there after a long flight. Only stayed for a night but would gladly stay there again.
非常满意，地理位置优越，离火车站、公交车站都很近，出行很方便，居住环境也很安静，房间很干净，是一个完美的选择。

This apartment is awesome, 1 bed at upper stairs. Easy acess with public transport, near to groceries store, abit far frm Lidl. Just we can hear the neighbours talking at night. But the host prepare us the earbuds to sleep. Everything good & we have very pleasant stay.

Det som drar ner betyget av helhetsupplevelsen är avsaknaden av kaffebryggare! Nespresso-bryggare ger inte i närheten av den kaffe-kick jag (och många svenskar) vill ha på morgonen. Annars jättefräscht, fint och fantastisk plats att bo på i Edinburgh. Mina söner ÄLSKADE denna lägenhet som avslutning på en Skottlands-roadtrip (med enklare boenden).
Fiona is very helpful, the communication went smoothly
Alles wie erwartet.  Perfekt für Städtetrip...

We stayed in the apartment for three nights as a group of three friends and had a great experience. Chengquan was an exceptionally kind and helpful host. Our flight to Edinburgh was delayed, so we arrived quite late and reached the apartment around midnight. Chengquan stayed in active communication with us and made sure we arrived safely.
The apartment itself was very good and clean, and we had no complaints at all. Each of us had our own bed in separate rooms, which was very comfortable. Since our main goal was to explore Edinburgh, we spent most of our time out in the city, and the public transport connections from the apartment were very convenient.
Thank you, Chengquan, for such a pleasant stay!

Laura’s charming flat in Edinburgh is wonderful! The location is a little bit out of town, but a quick bus ride and you are right by the Royal Mile. However, the neighborhood is so quaint with delicious restaurants and little boutiques. The flat exceeded our expectations. Laura and her husband were very accommodating and quick to respond to any questions.

Lovely space on a great street. We arrived into Edinburgh a bit late, and public transportation to the apartment was easy (maybe 10 minute walk from the bus) and check in with lockbox was really easy. Host was quick to reply with any questions that we had. Absolutely no complaints and would stay again.
One thing to keep in mind is that the apartment is on a charming and popular street, which means that it can (will) be noisy until quite late at night/ early in the morning. We had ear plugs so this wasn’t a problem, and was well worth the pay off of having a great location:)

We had a very nice stay for 4 nights.
Mary is very friendly.
Bus stop is right in front of the door, but we walked all days into the city: 30 min walk to Royal mile, 20 min to the Meadows.
Nice place to stay for a family
Such a great place in Edinburgh, cheap & cosy, great flat !
It great place to stay with amazing surroundings.

What a great place to stay. We felt very welcome. The staff were fantastic, the room was perfect & the restaurant/bar was exactly what we wanted. Thoroughly recommend this place to anyone travelling to the Edinburgh area.
Francois is an amazing host, 5 starts .
Great place to stay in Edinburg!
De airbnb was echt heel fijn om in te verblijven. Gezellig ingericht, genoeg ruimte en een goede locatie. Verder was de communicatie met de host ook erg fijn!

Jake’s place was easy to locate as clear instructions were provided. There were lots of great cafes near by and it was walking distance from all the attractions I wanted to explore! Jake was in during the time of my stay so I got to meet him and he was very friendly and accommodating! The day of my checkout I had a late train booked home. Jake let me leave my luggage inside his place by the door so I could go on about exploring the city and pick it up closer to my departure time. Overall his place gave  very homie vibes! Would highly recommend for a short term stay! :)

My husband and I stayed at Alexander’s with my parents on a road trip across the U.K. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well located. Though, we did have trouble finding longterm parking. So, we wouldn’t recommend this location to anyone traveling via car.

Amazing place and super host, we had a great stay for the weekend at Steve’s house. It’s a beautiful house, well designed and very comfortable! Has everything you need and in a great location, Ateve was super helpful and accommodating throughout. Highly recommend!!

We stayed for 1 night with our 2 dogs. It was exactly as described, spacious, welcoming and spotlessly clean. Quiet residential street with off street parking.
Would definitely stay again without hesitation.

Fantastic stay, thank you :)
Considering the last minute arrangements Susie was more than helpful and accommodating.
Thank you again
Perfect location!

Was a great apartment , I stayed with 3 of my friends , plenty of space and well equipped. Fab location.
Would definitely recommend
Great stay. Big apartment near the centre with everything you need provided. The apartment was very clean and communication was easy. Would recommend.
mmm
Lovely flat. Excellent location.

This flat is all about the location! You are right on the Royal Mile, which makes accessing everything so easy. You’re a 5 minute walk to the castle and a 5 minute walk to new town. There’s great restaurants and pubs all around. If you’re looking for a place that is right in the heart of the city, this is it! We stayed for 4 days and it was a perfect location for exploring the city.
The flat is nice and well appointed. We stayed as a group of 4. The rooms are a little tight but the large closets have so much room for storing bags, suitcases, etc.
Great location, easy to walk around and see the major points of Edinburgh from it!

ABSOLUTELY RECOMMENDABLE!!! Nice, bright, clean, cozy and warm flat! Has a perfect location, very near to Hollywood Palace, ideal for starting a big walk round around Edinburgh. There are many services in the surrounding areas like supermarkets. Good WiFi, gallons of got water, heaters in all the spaces included the bathroom. Furthermore, Bryan is a nice person, supportive, took a time for explaining us all the house's aspects. We really enjoyed the stay! My mother was fascinated with the functional kitchen. Everything was tidy and clean. The bathroom is elegant and the shower can gives back your soul after a cold day. Thanks Bryan!!! Laura and Parents.

Nous avons passé un super séjour chez Dean et son ami.
Dean est très sympathique et nous a partagé quelques bons plans pour visiter Édimbourg. La chambre est très confortable, tout comme son salon lumineux ! Salle de bain partagée et cuisine impeccable pratique.
Nous sommes au 3eme étage et à 20min à pied du centre ville. Sinon Uber est une solution pratique.

This place was outstanding.  From the view, to the location, to all the extra little touches. I even had to have some concert tickets sent there and they hung on to them for me till I arrived.  Great place great service. I'll be back again.
A really lovely, reasonably priced apartment in a good location. Amazing shower with instant hot water. I would definitely recommend this place.
Recomiendo el alojamiento, cumplía con nuestras expectativas, todo como lo refleja el anuncio. el propietario atento y pendiente de todo.
Great hostess, and the location was central to everything.  Highly recommend.

One of the best stays we’ve had on our trip! The apartment was fully equipped with everything we needed — from a USB charger with all 3 types, high-speed WiFi, to a clean and modern bathroom stocked with new body soap, shampoo, and even toothbrushes.
The host was incredibly kind and helpful, always ready to assist and made sure we felt right at home. Me and my friend genuinely felt like we were staying in our own cozy space rather than a rental.
A special shoutout to the little thoughtful touches — we even got to enjoy some free food 😋, which was such a nice surprise after a long day out. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Edinburgh — we’d definitely love to come back!
Very nice place. Easy check in. Right in the middle of everything. We had an amazing time. Would recommend to anyone
Very nice flat with a lot of space. A bit further away from the center but still in walking distance. Thank you!

The location was amazing and so close to such good restaurants. Hannah was amazing and was able to let us in earlier than we expected due to some transportation shifts. Would absolutely recommend this as a place to stay.

We had the best time staying at your property. You had everything we needed for a short getaway to celebrate our anniversary. The location was beautiful, we really couldn’t have asked for anything more.
Located in a great location, very convenient to many restaurants and theatre. Very well kept and clean. And, a very responsive landlord.
Die Wohnung war genau wie auf den Fotos. Echt schön. Nebenan der Fluss und tolle Lokale in der Nähe.
Great deal and wonderful host. Excellent proactive communication and very responsive to questions. Highly recommend.

Very modern and pleasant place to stay, with a very nice and welcoming host. We were offered breakfast and weren’t expecting it, which was great! When I return to Edinburgh certainly will consider this place!

What a lovely place to stay. Kate and her family are the perfect hosts. We loved meeting Peggy the dog. Beautiful location and very peaceful right next to the Water of Leith. Perfect position for getting into Edinburgh. Good pub / restaurant within walking distance which offers a perfect roast. Good cafe within walking distance. The Office is such a lovely space and I would certainly recommend it. We hope to stay again someday!
This was a wonderful flat and Jane was amazing!
Rona was a perfect host. She was kind and helpful. The room was clean and I could use private bathroom. The location was also perfect for me.

This cozy apartment worked really well for us. It is close enough to the Royal Mile that everything was walkable, but it was also quiet and felt restful. Keith was super helpful with some specific questions we had which really helped our visit to Edinburgh

Je laisse ce message de la part de mes parents, Chantal et Jean-Claude pour qui nous avions réservé le logement : « L appartement de James est très accueillant, on a aimé la propreté des lieux et le calme.Excellente communication avec l hôte qui nous avait réservé des petites attentions à notre arrivée
Super séjour à Édimbourg
Merci pour votre accueil »

Great location. Walkable into the centre and nice coffee shops etc locally. Simple but has the basics. We managed to find on street parking for the weekend which is very rare! Hadn’t realised it didn’t have a double bed that’s on us.

Mat’s home was lovely . It was very comfortable and in a great location. Right near the castle and within walking distance to many pubs and shops . The personal touches they added were much appreciated. Mat and his wife were very responsive, caring hosts . I would recommend this place when you are looking for a place to stay in Edinburg.

Such a lovely experience getting to stay in Philipp and Karolina's cosy apartment. Location is just so perfect near Haymarket and the fact that it has a secure parking area is even more convenient! It is also near so many stores and restaurants within walking distance and very peaceful and quiet.
The apartment was immaculately clean and well stocked with essentials.
Communication with the hosts was such a lovely experience and all my queries were met, above and beyond, considering the pandemic had tampered with dates on 3 occasions. They have been nothing short of understanding and wonderful throughout the whole process and would highly recommend any stay in Edinburgh!
Logement super bien placé, dans une zone agréable, avec des restaurants sympas autour et proche du tramway pour se déplacer et aller direct à l’aéroport. Très bon rapport qualité prix.
Only stayed one night but everything was perfect. Located in a very nice area and the apartment is great.
Great location, and the flat was adorable. Danny had excellent and prompt communication if I ever had any questions. Highly recommend this place!
Fantastic place to stay and explore Edinburgh. The area has good pubs, shops and restaurants. The apartment was comfortable, had everything we needed and was nice to return to after a long day.

I had a great stay at Eddie's flat. It's a clean, modern flat in a perfect location next to the meadows. Had a few issues with the internet but Eddie was fast and responsive to try to fix this. Thank you Eddie.

Martin kindly greeted us at check in to explain how everything operated in the apartment. It is so spacious and beautifully finished. The kitchen is nicely equipped for cooking and Martin even supplied breakfast and milk etc for a cup of tea after our long drive! The beds are extremely comfortable and spacious so we slept well and throughly enjoyed our stay over christmas and we will be back. Many thanks!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as described, clean, and well-maintained, with all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The host was attentive and responsive, making the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. The location was perfect for exploring the area and everything within walking distance. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great place to stay!
Good central location in the new town, easy to access the b&b and the room with our access code. Good communication from Bide Collective and nice facilities in our room and ensuite

Casa muy agradable en zona residencial. Tiene  todas las comodidades que buscamos los turistas de casas rurales: cocina bien equipada con detalles, equipaciòn para ducha, plancha de calidad, secador, adaptador europeo de enchufes . Un encanto. Los anfitriones, encantadores.
Much more spacious than appears in photos. Plenty storage space so feels like home from home. Well equipped kitchen. Great location. Cosy and comfortable. Had all we needed and some extras.

Super dejlig og smuk indrettet lejlighed. Beliggenhed helt perfekt ift. bycentrum. Rigtig god modtagelse af værten som gav gode råd om parkering, supermarkeder mv.
Kan klart anbefales.

The accommodation is as described. Jim is very friendly and assisted me with any local information I needed while there.
Thanks, Jim and Louise,.

A very well presented house designed and furnished to a high standard in an excellent central location.
Our helpful host responded with lightning speed to our minor requests and questions.
We have stayed in airbnb properties in Edinburgh for the festival for the last four years and this was by far and away the best!
Highly recommended!
Wonderful place! We had a lovely stay!

great place to stay - only stayed one night and would have loved to stay longer! it was very warm and cosy and a spacious, comfortable, homely place to be. overall, very grateful for Manigeh's hospitality and impressed by the space.

Very warm, comfortable and clean house and room, lovely chat with Fiona and her husband who gave us good directions, nice en suite bathroom, calm and quiet location with good black out curtains and a quality mattress which helped us sleep well! Few minutes walk from a very large Sainsburys, and an Uber to the centre of Edinburgh is only £5-6 so that was our preferred mode of transport. Lovely stay!
Cozy place to stay
Great flat, top location
Brilliant stay in a great location. Flat was immaculate and we loved our stay. Lovely helpful host and would definitely stay again. Thank you

Gill's apartment on the Royal Mile is probably more than you could hope for.  It is about a 10 minute walk to the central train station and the bus stop from the airport.  It is nestled towards the end of the Royal Mile near the Canongate and Balmoral Palace.  Very very clean, uncluttered and comfortable.  There are mirrors and hair dryers in both bedrooms, plenty of closets,  a lovely and functional kitchen with more accessories than I have at home.   (we made and ate breakfast, some lunches and dinners easily).  The apartment has great views - Carlton Hill and University of Edinburgh Canongate.  Small grocery shops all around although we walked to the fancy Waitrose in Stockbridge.  When you walk out the door and go right, you are walking towards the Castle,  left to the Palace and straight through Canongate to Arthur's Seat,  I would note that this is a walk-up so you can eat that extra scone it you go in and out multiple times a day.   It is a wonder place to make yourself at home in Edinburgh.  Gill has set a high standard for my future Airbnb stays.

Natasa’s place was beautiful.  It was very clean and modern with upgraded kitchen amenities and washer/dryer.  The bathroom was spotless with a wonderful shower.   The location was perfect we could walk anywhere from here.  We had a beautiful view of the castle as well.    The bus stop was a quick walk to get back to the airport. When I come back to Edinburgh I will definitely stay here again.  Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Prayas' place is great.  It's spacious and clean and its location is perfect.  We would definitely recommend people to stay at his place when they visit Edinburgh.

We had a lovely stay at Tom and Izzy’s flat in Edinburgh. Perfect for our needs. We were able to get groceries, dine out and walk to points of interest, all from our flat. Our host was kind, helpful and responsive- couldn’t ask for more.

The property is close to the train station, shops and restaurants. The host is able to give us an accurate instruction on how to check in. Above all, the place is clean and complete with what we need. Superb Airbnb to book!
This is a great apartment for a stay in Edinburgh. It’s quite large and in a lovely and quiet street close to everything. Ellie and Scott were very helpful and responsive. I highly recommend

This place was large, cozy and warm, and well-located to get around Edinburgh. There is a lovely view out the kitchen window of stone steps and beautiful vines. The beds were great (sofa bed surprisingly comfy) and linens were nice and soft. It is a lower level with carpets so it does hold a bit of mustiness, but it is kept quite clean and tidy. Washer/dryer were very helpful and the kitchen well equipped for cooking meals.

Le logement est plus grand que sur les photos , les chambres , la pièce à vivre ..
un jardin arboré dont nous aurions adoré profiter si la météo l’avait permis .
Un vrai bijou ce logement
Les différents arrêts de bus à qq minutes à pieds .. et surtout celle de l’aéroport qui s’arrête juste devant la maison .

Clean and quiet, and the bed is really nice.
the location is right in the center of it. Go out your door, and the castle is just a short walk away.
Pablo is great, always helpful when needed.
Die Unterkunft lag weiter außerhalb als erwartet und war leider ein bisschen heruntergekommen. Trotzdem war es gut zum schlafen. Die anderen Gäste waren sehr nett.

Better than advertised! We stayed for 10 nights and it was the perfect home base for our exploring. It was so nice to be able to come back to the cottage, have plenty of space to relax and cook a meal. I will definitely book again in the future!

Toms place was really nice and cozy as the description says. It’s a 30 minute walk to the center of the city or 15 minute bus trip with the stop being 2 minutes away from the flat. I would recommend staying here but make sure you check the check-in time which is at 5pm. We arrived later than we originally planned due to delayed flight and the trams being out of service this was an issues as Tom will give the keys in person and had plans that he was late to due to this issue. Overall it was a great stay We would stay again.

Just back from an exceptional stay hosted by Michael and Paul in their stunning home. They kindly asked us what time we would be arriving and even though it was earlier than check in time they told us our room would be ready for us and that we didn’t have to hang about to wait until check in time which was more than ideal as my friend and I don’t like to travel lightly!
All the little personal touches water and ice in our room, robes, bath salts, luxurious bath products really made us feel right at home and not to mention the genuine friendless and welcoming we received from you both we really can’t wait to come back and tell all our friends they must stay here if visiting the capital.
The location of Crescent house is perfect for the new shopping centre st James which has just newly opened this weekend less than a 10 minute walk from the beautiful home.
Thank you so much again Michael and Paul we can’t wait to book our next stay!
Super convenient to tourist attractions. Nice restaurants in immediate surroundings. Coffee and pastries as well as grocery store just around the corner.

A fantastic place to explore Edinburgh and surroundings. The house was beautiful and had everything we could possibly wish for. It was spacious and spotless clean. Hosts were friendly and responsive. Close to tram stop and bus stops to take you to city center in less than 10 minutes. Lots of restaurants, take out options nearby. We fully enjoyed our stay here and highly recommend this house.

Great apartment, very well located (apart from the bar downstairs, but we were aware of it). Overall, we had a very good stay. A few things could be improved to better match the price point: the kitchen worktop showed some wear and stains, a couple of chairs were a bit wobbly, the microwave was slightly tilted (less practical for liquids), and the bathroom would benefit from an air extractor, especially for a 6-person accommodation. Also, the automatic door closers made it hard to keep doors open, and more doorstops would be helpful.
These are fairly minor details, but for the price I felt I couldn’t give the maximum rating. Early check-in and late check-out are also on the expensive side. That said, we still enjoyed the apartment and I would consider Monosuite again for a future stay in Edinburgh.
quiet and comfortable

This basement apartment was clean and the bedrooms and bathrooms are spacious however the main living room is quite small. We were only 3 guests, can’t imagine where 6 people would relax and watch TV. All amenities were good.
Great position! Wonderful staff!

One of the nicest and most thought out Airbnbs I’ve stayed in. It embraces the true concept of an Airbnb where many other places have become commercially driven.
The back yard with its vista on a nature walk, river and wildlife if you are fortunate to spot them priceless !

Très bon séjour chez Fernando.
Les transports en commun sont juste à côté, proche de l'aéroport.
Rapport qualité prix impeccable.
Seul bémol, le wifi est problématique mais je recommande vivement ce logement pour un petit séjour

Monika’s place perfectly located! So close to everything. It’s a great place for a solo traveller. I was running the Edinburgh half marathon while I was there, and Monika let me leave my bags while I was at the race and she was understanding even when the bus back took longer than expected.
Ich fand die Einrichtung und Deko ziemlich cool, hab mich wohl gefühlt, vor allem der Blick auf‘s Meer vom Bett aus

Although this flat not absolutely central to Princes Street (and doesn't pretend to be!), the buses into the centre are reasonably priced, frequent and take about 10 minutes in normal daytime traffic.
Very nice house. The landlord was enthusiastic. The traffic is very convenient！
Fantastic apartment, excellent location
In a really nice location, in walking distance to everything I wanted to do
A comfortable room in an excellent location! i really enjoyed my stay. Andre & Jim are fabulous hosts. The pups are adorable.
Kim is the best Airbnb host! She is kind, friendly, respectful. The apartment is clean and cozy. We feel at home :)

Andy et Louise sont très accueillants et partagent vraiment leur logement même la cuisine est mise à disposition (petit déjeuner copieux). Ils sont prévenants. Tout a été très simple et on ne s'est pas dérangé. La maison est proche des arrêts de bus, pratique pour aller en centre ville.

Absolutely brilliant accommodation and Gary is a fantastic host. The room and bathroom were exactly as described and as shown in the pictures and they were both immaculately clean. The shower is super powerful which was very much appreciated. The location was perfect for getting to the City and for also enjoying the immediate surroundings of beautiful Leith. Communication with Gary was faultless… he was incredibly helpful, informative and welcoming. Would 100% recommend and would stay again. 5* all the way!

Great flat for the two of us, walking distance to city but Uber real handy.
Only made coffee so didn’t make use of the kitchen and equipment.
Bathroom is small but perfectly functional. Communication with Margaret prompt, she even gave us the heads up re a WiFi problem though we didn’t actually use it but it did control heating and hot water

We had booked the apartment some time ago and therefore wondered whether we would be able to visit Edinburgh. Sharon had put everything in place to make us feel safe and the procedures  in place to make sure the the apartment was Covid-19 secure were very good. Julie, Catherine and I had a wonderful few days in Edinburgh.

Perfect bass to explore Edinburgh, apartment is like a home from home, parking space is really welcome, and congratulations to Jen for keeping the apartment so well kept, it was a pleasure to stay. We would definitely recommend, and this will not be our only visit
+++++++

Zeer gastvrij! Heeft veel te vertellen over de omgeving. Prima uitvalsbasis voor een bezoekje aan Edinburgh bus naar t centrum op loopafstand. Op slechts 5min. lopen enkele leuke pubs aan het water voor een hapje en drankje. Badkamer was niet brandschoon maar t verse en heerlijke ontbijt maakte dat dubbel en dwars goed!  Woonkamer staat tot je beschikking en heeft zeezicht!
Limpo, equipado, bem localizado. Recomendado.

Great spot perfectly placed from the city centre and the waters edge to get the best of the city experience. Surprisingly quiet street with minimal noise. Victoria and Colin were excellent hosts, very helpful and approachable people with a lovely home. Will certainly stay again when we return to Edinburgh.
Lovely brief stay here and it was perfect. Everywhere was spotlessly clean and smelt lovely! We would stay here again - thank you!

Este alojamiento ha sido todo un acierto, estuvimos en familia 4 adultos y 1 bebé. Muy cómodos, podíamos ir andando en un paseo muy agradable hasta el centro. Tenía todas las comodidades y productos para usar de buena calidad. Todo muy limpio y en muy buen estado. Totalmente recomendable. De lo mejor en lo que he estado. Muchas gracias Paul

Carol is such a welcoming and friendly host, who instantly made me feel comfortable in her home. The flat is in a lovely part of Edinburgh right next to the Botanic Gardens. It’s easy enough to walk into town from there, or there’s a bus stop right outside that will take you in. Carol also gave me lots of great recommendations for things to do & see during my stay. I would highly recommend staying with her, especially if you prefer to be a bit further from the busyness of the city/old town.

Judith is an incredibly wonderful person. she made us feel at home and was very helpful with her recommendations for the city. Her cat duke is a very sweet and welcoming cat. I definitely recommend it to everyone. Judith, I thank you very much and I am waiting for you in Antalya as soon as possible.
With love
Steves place was spacious, comfortable and clean. Highly recommend

Super cute the decor is lush.
Friendly host
Great location
Great place to stay, smack in the middle of Old Town! Will gladly be back when I'm in Edinburgh next time!
Wonderful place in a central location. Didn't need any transportation to get around to the sights and restaurants.

El departamento es realmente hermoso, muy lujoso, recién remodelado, limpio y luminoso. Nos sentimos como en una revista de diseño de interiores moderna.
Cada detalle está pensado, la cocina es de última tecnología.
Tiene una gran terraza, 2 livings, muchos televisores, amplias ventanas en cada habitación.
Es tal cual se ve en las fotos y mejor aún.
No os encontramos con ninguna persona, pero es muy fácil entrar con un código en la puerta. De todos modos Sarah estaba disponible por mail y durante nuestra estadía no necesitamos contactarla.
El barrio es muy bonito y central, tiene restoranes, pubs y tiendas de comida muy cerca. También transporte público cerca y caminando está muy cerca de Old town.
Un perfecto lugar para quedarse, no lo dudes. Nos hubiera gustado tener amigos para invitar

The appartment is well located and practical.
The cleaning was not great (Even after a second pass of cleaning..) and the beds are of poor quality.

Great little place to stay! Perfect location for wanting to visit Edinburgh. It’s out the way enough to have a peaceful night but also good walk or quick bus ride to the city centre. Plenty of shops and takeaways near by.
The actual flat was lovely, clean and had everything you needed.
Easy enough to get in with clear instructions.
Margaret was a fab host, great communication and quick responses.
Thank you for a lovely stay! Would definitely recommend!

Great location! Stockbridge is full of great little shops and restaurants, many just steps outside of David’s flat. This is a great place to stay if you are looking for a neighborhood away from the hustle and bustle of the tourist trap areas, yet it is still walkable to the main attractions In Edinburgh.

Mairi is a great host and the flat with the nice terrace is amazing. It is also located in such a nice area with many bars, cafés and shops. All together, with having nice sunny weather, we just had a perfect time in Edinburgh!

Mark and Bill were amazing host! They let us feel at home providing an outstanding service and great company. The room was super clean and everything was thought in the minimal details. When it came to breakfast there was plenty of choices with Bill turning himself in a great chef!
You need to stay here!  I'm sorry, it's like a 15min walk to center.   The place is mad clean, full kitchen/bath, bed is super comfortable.  Do it.
Gorgeous apartment, lovely host and great location if doing the Fringe Festival!

Wonderful stay! Great location. Apartment was spotless, sheets smelled wonderful and fresh! Perfect size for our family of five adults. The attention to detail was wonderful and included welcome goodies and fresh flowers. 🌸 Impressed and a perfect home away from home. Thank you!
Fantastic place, couldn't recommend enough. Kataezyna was very quick to respond and super helpful. Apartment was full equipped particularly the bathroom. couldn't fault!

My wife, 3 month old son, & I have just returned from an awesome weekend spent in this charming home. It’s full of character & has everything you need. The location is superb, giving you lots of choice to explore - everything is within walking distance. The Dean Gardens were a big bonus, providing a scenic shortcut to vibrant Stockbridge. Communication before our stay was fantastic. Highly recommend staying in Fiona’s Mews house.
Great place to stay

We had a most enjoyable stay in very cosy, homely & well equipped apartment.
Fantastic location in beautiful old part of Edinburgh City. Efi excellent host with recommendations of where to eat/ drink....
Would highly recommend this beautiful accommodation. Had a fabulous weekend.
Will be back.

Cozy flat in a charming building. Friendly & respectful neighbors! It is an old building so you may hear people chatting & walking above, although we were not disturbed during the night. Would stay again!

Rachel's Haymarket flat was absolutely perfect for our stay in Edinburgh for the Fringe and Tattoo. The location is brilliant, just a short 20 minute walk from the centre, or an inexpensive bus/taxi ride. Haymarket train station is also just around the corner. Closer by, there are some lovely restaurants and cafes as well as a large Co-Op, with all the local amenities making it feel like a safe area to walk at night.
3 of us stayed in the flat for a week, and there was plenty of space - the sofa bed is huge too! The flat is really clean, bright and airy and contained everything we required for an enjoyable week's stay.
Although we didn't meet Rachel, she was very helpful in arranging key collection nearby and quick at communication, giving us helpful tips for our stay as well.
I would definitely recommend this flat, and if visiting Edinburgh in the future, we would love to stay again.

We have a lovely time in Patrick's flat. It was clean and comfortable and the location was absolutely amazing - we were right in the middle of it all. We also very much enjoyed Patrick's company at breakfast and all the information he gave us about the area - we felt very much at home!
Great flat right in the heart of the Royal Mile.  Easy walk to Edinburgh castle, cafes and restaurants.  Public car park close by at the Waverly train station

beautiful 2nd floor flat. much bigger than it looked in the photos. 2 ensuits. 15 min walk to grass market. Plumbing was a little noisey. especially in the smaller room. kinda like a washing machine constantly on. but bearable as we weren't in a lot. we would stay in this flat again. was very comfortable and homely.
response time from host says usually within 5 hours. I waited nearly 2 days.
we definitely enjoyed our stay. and would recommend 👌
Very beautiful place to stay, feels like home. Coming again for sure! :)

My husband and I had a great 4 night stay at Karen’s place. The flat is right on The Shore and is perfectly located for getting into Edinburgh city centre and also out to areas such as North Berwick and St Andrews.
Leith is full of lovely coffee shops and restaurants which are all walkable from the flat.
The flat itself was lovely and warm which we really appreciated as it was quite chilly while we were there.
Thank you Karen for your friendly welcome and clear communication.
Lovely spacious apartment in a perfect location for exploring Edinburgh

Our stay was magic! Cute location with lots of character that has almost everything within walking distance. Karen was friendly and kind-when we had an issue with a bed, she was prompt and communicative about fixing it. Amazing views, plenty of sunlight, and a perfect layout for a larger group

Our stay in Edinburgh was brilliant. Monique’s flat was perfect. Guests should be aware that the stairs are quite narrow and steep - not for the faint of heart. Do not take a large suitcase 🤩🤩.
The flat itself was lovely, comfortable and spotlessly clean.
We highly recommend staying there. Thank you Monique 👍👍👍
The flat was perfect for our stay- it was clean, cosy and had everything we needed. The location was great for walking to the city centre and Arthurs seat.

This was a lovely flat in a convenient location.  My only caveats are that it is a fairly noisy location which is not something that can be communicated in a listing and is inherent and unavoidable cost of the central location on a busy street, and that the kitchen cooktop was not working and could not be repaired during our stay.  I trust that Duncan, who was unbelievably quick and helpful in responding to our questions will have it in working order as soon as he can, but prospective guests might wish to verify that it is working properly if they intend to do any food preparation on their own.
L’emplacement est ce que nous retiendrons de cet Airbnb. La propreté laissait à désirer et l’hôte ne répondait pas au message. Mais la localisation du bien était parfaite.

Jana’s apartment is a cozy, easily-accessible home away from home that made exploring Edinburgh extremely easy. Located at the heart of the old town, you are close to all main attractions and shops. With a short walk, you can reach the new town and the bus stop to the airport. We felt safe in the neighbourhood, and were pleasantly surprised with the quality of the coffee shops & restaurants around us. Definitely recommend!
Amazing place and amazing host. Clean, spacious and great location. Could recommend highly enough!
Great location, and very helpful host! Would recommend!

The place was comfortable and clean, and it wasn’t too far from restaurants and the main tourist attractions in Edinburg. I appreciated Gary’s exceptional communication and local recommendations. The pullout couch was also very comfortable!
This is a lovely family home. Just as described. In a great relatively central location. It felt very relaxing to stay there.

Carol was a wonderful host. before I got there she responded to all the queries I had in a matter of minutes and once I got there was just as helpful face to face.
the room was perfect - comfortable, clean, non fussy - felt just like home.
Carol also helped me with some tips on what to do in the limited time I had there and all her recco's were just on point.
the house was located in a very peaceful neighborhood and despite that very close to all the touristy parts of Edinburgh.
I would highly recommend this house for anyone travelling to Edinburgh
Shana's place is fantastic. Clean and spacious. free secure parking, which is a big bonus in Edinburgh. Only 25-30 minute walk into the City Centre. Was just what we needed.
We had a fantastic stay here. A lovely family house in a great location.
Highly recommended and very convenient just around the corner from Haymarket. Would definitely stay with Gillian again.
Fiona is a very friendly landlord, who not only recommended places to visit and eat, but also kindly prepared chocolate chip cookies for us. She was very helpful to help us check in and check out.

This was a lovely place to stay...absolutely spotless. A great location...about 10-15 mins in an Uber from the city centre and about £11. Angela was very responsive and friendly in communication. I would definitely recommend staying here.

This may be one of the most lovely Airbnbs I have ever stayed in. Juan was an incredible host, providing us with every amenity imaginable, including mallow tea cakes on our beds. Excellent location in a wonderful city.
The house was perfect for our stay.  I recently had total knee replacement so no stairs was a huge plus.  It was plenty roomy and clean.  We would definitely stay there again.
Great location, modern building with all amenities, wi fi etc you need. Has a very luxurious feel to it. I would recommend it, and would stay there again.
Lovely place in a very central spot of Edinburgh! Spacious with all necessary amenities for the stay. Would recommend to anybody planning a trip to Edinburgh :)

Check in process was simple and straightforward. Glenda is responsive and gives very useful instructions. Location is not the closest to town but also not complicated to commute. Accommodation was clean however the place felt a little dated and could use a bit of an upgrade. The kitchen tap had low pressure and Glenda gives a heads up about the taps.
All together it was an okay stay for us.
Central location to transportation... attractions ...restaurants . The flat was cute and clean. I will definitely book this flat again when I’m back in Edinburgh again !!
Great stay in a great location!
This apartment is great. It comfortably fit 3 people. It Was super easy to find. Gavin responds very quickly and was super hospitable. Would definitely visit again!
Allt som utlovat. Fräscht och prisvärt boende i ett georgianskt hus. Lagom promenad till city och dessutom just intill floden Leith där man kan följa "The water of Leith Walkway" till havet

We had a fantastic stay with Dorota: the room is very spacious and really beautifully styled, the kitchen was welcoming, and the location was in close reach of Arthur’s Seat, the city center, and Portobello beach. Dorota herself was really sweet and kind. Highly recommend!

I had a really pleasant stay at Mhairi’s charming house. She’s a lovely and welcoming host. The room has everything I needed. The location is great and the bus stop is literally right outside the doorstep. Her pup Charlie is so adorable too. Really recommend staying at hers if you’re traveling solo to Edinburgh!

This is my second time with Mark and Antonio and I absolutely love it! The room is spacious, the bed so incredibly comfortable and the place is immaculately decorated. The links to the centre are very convenient and the area, Leith, has plenty to do. Mark and Antonio’s recommendations were super useful (and delicious). It is always a pleasure to revisit their beautiful place. Mark and Antonio are fantastic hosts, always easy to reach, flexible and genuinely kind. Cannot recommend their place enough!
Apartment is very light and spacious, in a great location.

This property is perfectly situated for Murrayfield, 10 minute bus ride into City Centre, bus stop on the corner, good local pubs particularly The Bothy which not only is stunning the food lovely.
The property was spotless and extremly well presented & very comfortable. Carrie an excellent host and kept me continually informed with clear instructions, also Bobbie the owner extremly helpful.
Thank you all, we hope to return..
Faultless, good accommodation right at the royal mile. Thanks so much

The studio flat was perfectly located in Portobello, it was cosy but had everything you needed with kitchen supplies, fridge, (mini freezer for some ice pops). It was perfect for our trip to the Fringe as the buses ran late into the night. Parking can be tricky as it's all on-street, but we managed to find somewhere nearby. Dave & Gina were super responsive and helpful whenever we messaged them, they were great hosts.
This is a beautiful apartment right in the centre of Edinburgh. My friend & I had a lovely stay. Highly recommend!

First there are 80 steps to climb to get to the apartment. That should probably be mentioned in the ad. The bigger issue was that the shower door had been removed and wedged between the bedroom wall and dresser. There was no way to replace it. The shower drain was also completely clogged which caused the shower basin to fill and overflow in less than 10 min. There was no plunger in the apartment for us to try to move whatever clog was there. The knob in the shower was also broken making turning the water on and off as well as changing the temperature very difficult. The place also doesn’t match the pictures. Pics were clearly taken a long time ago when the place was new and didn’t have cracks in the foundation and flooring missing in the kitchen.  Brendan, the “host,” only sent automated messages and asked that we contact the management company for all issues. Wildly unhelpful.

Susan is a great host. She waited for us to handover the keys and personally showed us the way to our apartment.
She also suggested fee eating joints nearby.
Thanks Susan.
Lovely spot in a great neighborhood. Sonia went out of her way to be of assistance, 10/10 would stay again.

It was a great location for exploring Edinburgh and had great transport links.
Our accommodation was lovely, very comfortable and our hosts checked on us a couple of times to make sure all was ok.
Anne was very friendly. We had to find somewhere last minute during the Edinburgh Festival and Anne was very accommodating.
My friend and I had a wonderful time at Viktor & Hana’s place! It was perfectly located and was very cosy, very homely, perfect for autumn nights in Edinburgh!
5star stay, everything was fantastic and communication with the host was excellent. Would happily stay again.

The photos cannot do this place justice. It is so beautiful and picturesque, we stayed here for a week and every morning we would wake up blown away by how dreamy it is.
Jill was so responsive and helpful! It felt like we were at a private hotel. Our trip to Scotland was perfect and we’ll stay here again when we return <3

We were very impressed with the stylish decor and old-world charm of the apartment. Its location was convenient to trams and buses and there were many cafes and restaurants close by, as well as the Playhouse Theatre and a Tesco supermarket. Edinburgh is a beautiful city and we really enjoyed our stay.
Beautiful little flat in a quiet and nice area. We immediately felt at home and enjoyed our stay. Everything was clean and all worked well. We'd book it again.

Honestly had the best stay here, was so sad to leave. Andrew and Mark were both so accommodating for my stay. It was clean and well equipped with anything I needed. Best part was the heated floor in the bathroom! I 100% will be sharing this property for when my family and friends come to visit.

Great apartment eight of us and it was very clean and within walking distance ( about a mile) from old town. One bedroom has no window but wasn’t an issue.
Would definitely recommend it.
Perfect place to stay for a weekend get away ! Me and my partner absolutely loved it and it was central to everything. Would definitely stay there again!

What a wonderful place,  everything was perfect and we absolutely loved our stay there.  The cottage was incredibly comfortable and quiet and Kate, Alisdair and Peggy were wonderful hosts. If we come back this way we would definitely stay there again.

We spent a few days in Selena’s apartment with three people. The flat itself is very cute and according to the pictures (maybe a bit smaller) having all the amenities you need. For a person traveling alone I would not recommend the building/area, as it feels a bit sketchy and the makeshift lock on the door does not make you feel very safe. Also, the apartment was a bit smelly probably caused by the drain. But otherwise everything was fine for us.

Wir meine Tochter und ich , waren vom 15.04 bis 25.04 im Apartment. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Das Apartment war sauber und Ordentlich. Eleanor war uns eine sehr freundliche und liebenswürdige Gastgeberin. Das Apartment liegt sehr zentral. Um es kurz zu fassen ... es gibt absolut nichts Negatives was ich zu berichten hätte . wir würden jeder zeit bei Eleanor wieder Buchen.
Vielen dank für die schöne Zeit.

Beautiful room in a wonderful area in Edinburgh! The room is really big with a great, enormous en-suite bathroom (very clean). The big bed was comfortable, we slept well. there is a big TV. Nice interior design, as seen in the pictures.
The room is located in an apartment, which seems to be a massage practice and has other rooms that are rented through Airbnb (one of them apparently doesn't have a bathroom inside, but in the end of the corridor). We used it once before leaving and weren't supposed to. We are really sorry... again.
Great area to stay! Excellent restaurants close-by. Beautiful buildings and streets to just walk around. Location super central but quiet.
Jacqueline was always available through the Airbnb App. She allowed us to leave the luggage in the apartment, after checkout. Thank you again for that and sorry for our mistake!

Staying at Abbey Gate Studios was a great experience! The studio was modern, clean and cosy. It was a nice walk to the city center and back with nice views. It felt like I was living in the city for a while 🥰
Great flat, would happily stay again!

Brilliant stay in Edinburgh. Anna’s flat was beautifully clean and well-equipped. The location was central and it was easy to walk to everything we wanted to see, but it was also very quiet and private. I am already planning on coming back.
Great stay, nice and quiet place. Thank you

On the whole, we liked the flat very much. First, the positives. The location was great, checking in was easy, and the kitchen was very well equipped. The views from the flat were also really nice: on one side you could see Calton hill, and on the other you could see Salisbury Crags. Joivy was also able to help us when we got locked out through our own error. Second, the negatives. There were a few quirks---the bathroom had some mold and the flat had a weird smell, especially on the first floor. If we were to return to the area, we wouldn't mind staying in it again, but we'd probably look elsewhere first.
Thank you both for letting us use your home. It was sadly only for 1 night but very central, and just what we were looking for.  Would definitely book again and recommend to friends.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Édimbourg. Nous avions beaucoup de plaisir à revenir chaque soir chez Hana & Viktor. On s’est senti comme chez nous. On a apprécié la qualité des informations avec un p’tit plus pour les histoires terrifiantes …
Une mention particulière pour les Tacos à l’ananas …
Certes on aime marcher mais le lieu permet d’atteindre Old Town, New Town et toutes autres animations en moins de 15 minutes

Logement impeccable, propre, très calme, bonne température, cosy, on s'y sent à l'aise.
Belle vue sur Arthur's seat. A deux pas d'une plaine de gazon et balade sur la colline avoisinante. Parking privé à côté de l'appart. Steve est super réactif et donne de bons renseignements sur les facilités à Edimbourg. Je recommande vivement. Merci Steve.

I can't recommend Kellys place enough! Kelly herself is wonderful, and has put together an incredible book/map of suggestions of places to eat and things to do. The apartment is incredibly cosy and stylish, filled with art and unique furniture. We loved it and we cannot wait to stay again, it's in a fantastic location for getting around as well.
Great location ! Great communication ! Clean ! Really enjoyed it ! The only downside is the double bed which would be perfect with a new mattress! Thank you very much

第一次体验plus的住宿，名至实归。
-24小时热水十分方便，打开就有。厨房提供直饮过滤水，饮水卫生也不用太担忧；
-供暖设备使用简单，正确调整中控可以保证长时间的较高温度的供暖；
-卫生清洁上基本上和星级酒店的水平一致，比之前住过的airbnb要高上不少；
-床垫十分的舒适，柔软但是有一定的支撑度；
-房间的大小比想象得更大；
-厨房设施可以说是无敌完善，基本上是带食材就能直接开始做菜的程度。不用担心厨具不够，房东甚至还提供料理棒和料理机；调味料也可以涵盖简单的烹饪，演，胡椒，酱油，意大利醋，还有mix herb。
-周边得咖啡厅和餐厅选择比较多，light meal比较多，和Tesco，boots，sainsbury等便利店的位置都很近，生活方便。
-出行坐公交也十分便利，公交线路几乎可以直达各个大的景点，而且在几站以内。
-周边的绿地公园设施也很丰富，早晚出去走走看看本地人遛狗也挺幸福的
-房东十分友好，有问题的时候沟通非常及时。
-总之就是十分推荐。
Lovely flat! And Leith was a beautiful area! Loved the river walk:)

The flat is really lovely and cosy. It is very close to both the old and new town with shops close by. Millie quickly responded to all messages and checked everything was okay after we checked in. We really appreciated the tea and coffee!

Sam is a fantastic host for multiple reasons. Firstly, the rooms are clean, tidy and well-furnished so there is plenty of space to store your things in. Secondly, the location speaks for itself, just round the corner from the Royal Mile, sitting at the bottom of Arthur's Seat..... need I say more?
Perhaps most importantly is that Sam is very adaptable to your needs i.e. check-in times and offered flexibility on the people who were staying each night (as long as doesn't exceed the stated number, of course!).
Sam is extremely friendly and a lover of Harry Potter - a true superhost!
Thank you, Sam, and we can't wait for our next trip to Edinburgh!
What amazing couple always prompt in helping! Lovely clean house ! I highly recommend!

Nice place. Warm and confortable.
We were a group of 6 adults and 1 baby, and had everything we needed for our trip to the Christmas Markets.
Stuart was a great host. All instructions were clear and answered to everything we asked.
Amazing, peaceful stay next to bus stops, cafes, anything else you would need! Bridget was super responsive and her place was incredibly clean and spacious. Would 100% stay here again!

We had a really great stay at Peter’s place and enjoyed our time in Edinburgh a lot.
The flats location is great to visit Edinburgh, all while staying in a more calm part of the city. We directly felt at home and appreciated all the great tips and recommendations Peter gave to us.
I can highly recommend a stay at Peter’s place in Leith!

Very best Airbnb I’ve stayed at. Catherine goes above and beyond and is a wonderful hostess. Very comfortable bed bright and spacious bedroom. Quiet neighborhood great location. Easy and beautiful walk to the Royal Mile

Such a wonderful place, right in the heart of Edinburgh, but tucked away from the hustle and bustle. An absolute gem. Jock has thought of everything, and it has such a spirit of generosity and welcome. Wouldn’t hesitate to return.
Lovely place, great amenities & styling, convenient location. Hosts were great, easy to communicate with, and check-in/out was super smooth.
Great location, friendly hosts who are full of information about Edinburgh!
Great location and very walkable to the majority of sites.

The stay with Maureen was perfect! She was very nice and accommodating with letting us check in early to drop off bags. The apartment was spotless and very beautiful. And the view.. to die for! Highly recommend staying with Maureen when in Edinburgh!

Thank you. Great stay. Exactly what we wanted. Great location. Enough room for all 8 of us. Comfortable and warm. Lovely kitchen with plenty of tea, coffee and biscuits to keep us going. Really responsive and very helpful. Would definitely recommend. Thanks for a great stay.

Really great location, really enjoyed the stay was so homey and our dog absolutely loved it! Viktor and Hana were great when we had any questions and we would definitely recommend staying in their lovely home. It had a fully stocked kitchen which meant we could cook nice meals after a day of sightseeing. They also put together a list of things to see, how to get the them on public transport and a list of the local takeaways and cafes which was a lovely extra touch.
The location alone would have gotten a 5 star review, so close to Holyrood Park and a short walk away to the city centre. We walked up to Leith and along to Portobello beach too which just shows how easy it was to get around from a great starting point.
As an added (unused) extra they had also provided children's cutlery, potty and high chair which just goes to show how much thought has gone into being great hosts.
Great stay would definitely recommend.

Excellent location on the same street as Grassmarket, and minutes from the castle and Waverley. This stay was accurate to the listing, communication was great, and we really enjoyed staying with you - thanks!

L'appartement est exactement comme sur l'annonce, il est très bien situé dans un environnement calme et magnifique.
Les indications laissé par Rona pour le séjour sont excellentes et très utiles.
Le rapport qualité prix est très satisfaisant.
Je recommande vraiment cette appartement qui est parfait pour découvrir la magnifique ville d'Edimbourg.

Joe and Anna are so communicative, helpful and really nice people. I'd stay again any time I was in Edinburgh. Their flat is really comfortable, well equipped and the bonus was Stan, the cat who is as friendly as they are. I had a great stay.
This area is great as public transport is so good and it is just out of the really busy, tourist areas and has interesting shops and lots of good coffee shops. It was wonderfully peaceful and I felt completely safe walking home at night on my own.
I would have liked to have stayed much longer and I only touched the surface of Edinburgh. I'll definitely return and part of the attraction would be to stay with Joe, Anna and Stan again.
Really enjoyed staying here. If you want a place right in the middle of daily activities this is it. Really enjoyed the big flat, and being engulfed by Scottish culture. Great value

A beautiful, period property in a quiet part of Edinburgh. The flat was very well equipped and spotlessly clean , with great attention to detail.
We had an eighteen month old with us and we had everything we needed for his stay.
If we needed anything Gemma would always respond very quickly and was incredibly helpful.
I would highly recommend staying at The Butler Pantry
John fue muy atento y amable, la ubicación es increíble, la habitación es pequeña.
Great big clean modern flat in walking distance of the city center - thoroughly recommended for short & long stays
Great place to stay!!  Quiet neighborhood, easy access to public transportation and walkable to stores and restaurants.  It was perfect for our small family to stay in our few days we were in town.

This place was amazing the staff were really friendly and helpful the room was lovely and the cafe was really good will defiantly be back here. Me and my partner travelled 2 hours to get there and our check in wasn’t meant to be til 4 pm but we got there at 11:30am and was able to check straight in, we had to check out for 11am but our train home was 7pm and we had 8 bags and they kept all of them safe for us until we got the train I highly recommend will 1 million percent be back.

Maureen was such an amazing and friendly host! Not only did she give us a warm welcome, she also gave us many recommendations on where to go in edinburgh. The room was lovely, clean and had everything you needed! She even provided complimentary coffee, tea and snacks! Thank you Maureen, we had a really pleasant stay :)
I stayed two nights at Alan’s apartment. Alan is a great friendly host with excellent communication pre-arrival and makes you feel at home during your stay. The room was warm comfortable and quiet.
We had a fantastic weekend and would love to return. A fab apartment, great location, everything we needed and more! Thank you. x

The place was peaceful and very clean. Although the place was a bit further out from center, some would like it better because of less crowd and noise! The host was very responsive and communicated well- even accommodated few of our requests which was much appreciated. The price was a bit higher than expected but that must be because were there during the festival season (August). Highly recommend the place!

This place is such a gem! Really enjoyed the room and all the funky decor in the space. So fun! Also, location was perfect, and the Paradise Palms downstairs was awesome. Before we even left we were talking about coming back to stay here again if we ever visit Edinburgh in the future! Definitely highly recommend.
ok

El apartamento de Douglas es tal cual se muestra en las fotos,  la cama y el sillón cama muy comodos, las sábanas y toallas de buena calidad y la calefacción funciona excelente. Está a distancia a pie de todos los lugares más importantes y de la estación de tren (10 minutos sin valijas y 15/18 minutos con valijas). lo único en contra es que tiene el calefón/termotanque dentro de un armario en el dormitorio principal y cuando prende en su funcionamiento normal,hacer ruido que puede ser molesto a la hora de dormir. con respecto al ruido exterior que comentaron otros huespedes en mi caso no fue algo a destacar, hay que tener en cuenta que Edimburgo es una ciudad con mucha vida y en cada esquina hay un pub pero que tienen más actividad el fin de semana. en la semana no se sienten ruidos. pasamos una linda estadía en la casa de Douglas y lo agradecemos.

Nous avons adoré notre séjour chez Bianca. Elle nous a permis de déposer nos valises en avance et nous avons reçu un accueil très chaleureux. Elle nous a recommandé plusieurs adresses et nous avons même eu le droit à quelques cadeaux d'arrivée typiquement écossais. L'appartement est très bien placé (tram et bus à quelques mètres) et au calme. La chambre est propre et décorée avec goût. La literie est très confortable. Nous recommandons cette chambre pour un couple. Merci encore Bianca pour ton accueil ! 🫶🏻 Nous repartons avec d'excellents souvenirs de l'Écosse !
lovely and cosy place, host was very helpful, will definitely return on our next visit 😊
The apartment is comfortable and clean, conveniently located near the city center with easy access by taxi. The landlord is friendly and the place is suitable for families.
A very good place to stay central in the city. Check in was easy and the place was very clean and well setup

Very cosy place with lovely view on the park. A well equipped.kitchen and comfotable beddings.
Joachim
Perfect location! Loved waking up to our beautiful view. Very clean and felt like home!
We had a great stay.  Ryan's space was spacious and a great homebase for exploring Edinburgh. Would stay here again.
Lynn’s apartment was very modern and provided a great stay for us as we explored the area. It was very clean and tidy! We would definitely recommend.
Appartamento molto grazioso in una zona silenziosa e ben servita. E' possibile andare in centro a piedi. Check-in perfetto, dettagliato. Ottimo per una coppia.

Karen was a brilliant host. The flat is so central to all bars and restaurants and has lots of special touches. Very clean and had many extras that came in handy during our stay eg tea bags, food bags, hand wipes, prosecco glasses etc. The flat is beautiful and finished to a high standard. Loved the little extras that were there on arrival. Would definitely book again. Thanks for a lovely stay!
What a terrific place to stay when in Edinburgh. Great roomy accommodation with a wonderful host who was easily contactable. Pity we didn't have a longer stay.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cette location. Le quartier est très tranquille, à proximité d'un canal et pas très loin du centre ville (à pieds). L'appartement est spacieux, propre, bien fournis en équipements (il y a même une TV dans le salon avec une grande collection de DVD). Tout y est.
Un grand merci à Yana qui nous a permis de séjourné dans la superbe ville qu'est Edimbourg !
Yana est une hôte très réactive et très arrangeante, nous recommandons grandement ce airbnb !

Logement tres bien situé, proximité tram et bus.
Par contre pas de double vitrage et bruits de la rue.
À rafraîchir mais propre.
Draps et serviettes impeccables.

Sean's apartment is beautiful,  it is clean, well equiped and feels like a home from home.  Perfectly situated in the Grassmarket with easy access to the centre of Edinburgh.  You couldn't wish for a nicer host than Sean - he's what everyone hopes their host will be.

A wonderful place. Located at city centre with a reasonable price. Very tidy and cozy. Because of my limited vocabulary, I can't find more words to praise this place. Only thing that I am not satisfied is lack of socket in second bed room.

Io e il mio ragazzo abbiamo alloggiato per 5 giorni nella yellow room, è stato magnifico, l’atmosfera di quella camera era davvero speciale.
Natalia e Ken sono stati meravigliosi con noi, sempre disponibili e gentilissimi a far fronte ad ogni richiesta/dubbio.
Se capitiamo di nuovo ad Edimburgo so già dove prenotare!

The Rock House is a literal gem in the heart of Edinburgh. Full of charm and character throughout the house, the spacious kitchen (fully stocked), dining area (large table) and lounge (massive sofas) can easily accommodate a large family or several couples (as was our case). The private and peaceful garden was perfect for coffee in the morning or a glass of wine in the evening. Thankfully we had beautiful weather all weekend.
Marco was fantastic! Easy to work with, very accommodating and quick to respond to messages. We couldn’t say enough good things about the entire experience.

A great place to stay for a large group of people. Very clean and comfy beds. Good location for tourist attractions. The host was very responsive to messages. We had a fantastic stay in Edinburgh..
