Maggie hat eine herzliche, offene und annehmende Kommunikation. Die Wohnung und das Zimmer waren individuell und geschmackvoll eingerichtet, das Miteinander locker.
We enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb. It was close to the city centre and looked right on to the Meadows. There are a lot of stairs so keep that in mind if you have older people with you.

Our stay here was fantastic, the bed was comfy, the amenities were great and we thoroughly enjoyed it! Easy access to Edinburgh City centre and if you don't fancy going thar far I really recommend grabbing a bite on the Ship On the Shore in Leith itself!
Really hoping to go back in the future.
5*
A great, clean, cosy apartment in a central location

Spacious quiet flat in a great location for Fringe activities - walking distance to George Square or frequent nearby bus service to city centre.   Well equipped kitchen and comfy beds. Close to interesting local shops and restaurants.  Would be happy to stay there again.

I had a good stay. The accommodation is just along the road and is close to restaurants and supermarkets, so buying food was easy. As it is in the city center, it's walkable to the famous tourist spots of the city.
Communication with Paul and his team was not a problem as they are responsive and gave clear instructions prior to arrival.
For someone travelling solo, it's already a good place and they've even got other rooms to offer in the apartment for those in a group.

It’s a great host. He spent lots of time to solve some issues after I checked out from his apartment. Really thanks for his assistance.
非常好的房東，雖然在退房之後，遇到一些Airbnb的問題，但總是花時間陪我一起解決。很感謝他的幫忙。 是一個有責任心的房東。謝謝。

Our family of 7 pax stayed for one week in May 2017 for visiting our daughter who is studying in the Univ. of Edinburgh. The place is as described. Safe, clean & close to the city. Good communication, helpful & kind enough to pass the key to our daughter since we are arriving late.
As we are coming back to visit our daughter again in future, will surely book Jana's place. Highly recommended.

Great value for money, ideal location and very helpful staff (thanks especially to Charlotte for helping out when we managed to lock ourselves out of the apartment!). Only slight issue was the noise of the birds that sit outside the window of one of the bedrooms which wasn’t ideal first thing each morning, but for that to be the only noise issue during a stay in city centre then it really is minute… thanks again!
Le logement est très bien placé et bien équipé. Victor est arrangeant. Petit bémol sur le matelas du canapé lit qui manque d’épaisseur.
Great place to stay.  Host provider great recommendations and the property is conveniently located.

The Apartment in Frederick Street is in a great central location and only a 10/15 mins walk from Waverly Station. There are many restaurants and shops in the area with a very handy Co-op right across the road for any food shopping you may need. Edinburgh castle can be seen from the outside of the apartment building and Princess Gardens are just at the end of Frederick Street. Princess Street is a 2 mins walk. We are a family of 6, all adults, and we had so much space. You have everything you need. Would definitely recommend staying here.
Fantastic escape from the hustle and bustle of a day touring Edinburgh.
The apartment is very nice and is in a great location in the old town near Holyrood Palace. Also a Tesco Metro nearby is handy.

Amazing flat in an excellent location - far closer to the centre of town than we thought. Really well kitted out, has everything you would need and the local guide with tips on where to go/eat was really useful too. Would definitely return.

Lovely apartment, spacious and everything you need. The beds were very comfortable and sofas too.
Would definitely recommend and stay again!

I would stay in this airbnb again, it was in a great location, really nice furnishings, and comfy. It was a nice apartment to spend a few evenings in Edinburgh.
As below review says, the door to the apartment rattles when the door to the main building gets opened, so you think someone is at the door. This door is controlled by keypad only, there is a deadlock, but no latch/strikeplate on the opposite side, so didn't feel as secure as I would have liked.
Shower door didn't close properly so the bathroom floor got quite wet, but that is an easy fix.
A good airbnb, could be excellent with some small changes.

Nice flat and fit the bill for us! Close to everything. Pull out sofa perfect for our daughter. Washer was helpful too especially when our luggage arrived 34 hours after we did! Mat even left us laundry pods. Excellent host!!!

We absolutely loved our stay here. Every possible need was thought of and catered for. Little things like the coffee machine, milk in fridge and toiletries were what made this place so special.  The decor was lovely and fresh and the whole place was immaculate. Thank you so much for allowing us to stay in your lovely home.

Great experience.
Angela is welcoming and truly kind and I really liked chatting with her. The cats, Jasper and Bob, are lovely.
The Victorian house is beautiful, the room and the bathroom are comfortable and very nice.
The house is a bit far from the city centre, but bus stops are near and buses are frequent (at the moment, buses from the city centre follow a temporary diversion requiring a 10-minute walk to come back to the house).

We had a wonderful stay in Shahid's flat. It was spotlessly clean, the beds were comfortable, and the view of Arthur's Seat was great to see each day. The flat is situated near Holyrood Park, the Palace, Dynamic Earth and Parliament. It is an easy walk to the Royal Mile and the attractions on or near it.  Thanks, Shahid!

Wow - this was the greatest place to stay! We wanted a quiet family friendly area that was easily walkable to all the main sights and we found just that. Not only was location perfect, the flat itself was beautiful! We felt right at home and loved all the simple yet elegant touches that made it a cozy and comfy place to stay. The recommendations left at the flat were wonderful! We walked to coffee and breakfast each morning with nothing more than 5 minutes away. You’re right next to the water of Leith walkway which made for great morning strolls. It didn’t take long to walk into city center either! We were sad to leave and hope to come back!
在英国体验过最好的民宿，看得出来dayna非常用心在经营，房子非常干净整洁。家里的工具也很齐全，完美的住宿。

Excellent location! We loved the trip.
Daniel is also a very attentive host, parking is relatively easy, a short walk away from the flat.
When we stayed I dropped off and picked up our stuff from the back street which was very easy and straightforward.
Stockbridge is an extremely good location. Stylish and very community orientated. Lovely cafes, art gallery’s and shops up and down the street. Very clean and safe, which is almost unexpected from a city. Also very family orientated and dog friendly generally. The walk into central is a bit of an uphill walk. Not too bad but for those who don’t fancy walking or have medical challenges it can be difficult. But there are plenty of other ways to commute.
Had an amazing trip! Charlotte was very helpful, responsive and the flat was perfect 😊

We had a lovely stay here, great location and extremely spacious and beautiful apartment. However the internet did routinely cut out which was frustrating as stricter lockdown measures meant we were in every evening (more than usual).
Great location, lovely little flat

very nice and clean, the room has a great view at the see over the roof tops. AGNES presence is very discrete. She welcomed us with very helpful information regarding Portobello area, how to get around, where to eat and shop tips. She is very nice person. Easy check in and check out!
Awesome stay, lovely hosts & great location
Great location, ideal between old town & new town. Good size and extremely tidy, homely  & welcoming!
We had a lovely stay, rooms are large and clean. Ayub was only a message away if we needed anything! Ideal location not far from the airport and a tram stop that takes you into Edinburgh centre.

It was amazing stay.
Loved the place and location.
Everything was good

I don’t want to give any spoilers, but Sam’s place can only be described as a magical experience—there’s no other way to put it.
My brother and I had so much fun discovering all the hidden “spells” around the room. I’m really happy I got to stay in this Harry Potter fan room in a city I absolutely loved.
Everything was perfectly clean and organized.
Brilliant and stylish flat in an excellent location.
This apartment was spectacular! Very comfortable & suited our needs perfectly. Stylish decor & beautiful views from the balcony.
I had a great sleep in a lovely comfy bed - there was nice art on the walls and it was all very clean.  Mal was a quick and responsive communicator.

We had a wonderful time at Charlottes place. We stayed 10 days and it felt like a home. Great amenities, fantastic location. Walkable to everything with great restaurants and supermarket. We highly recommend staying here!!

A great place to stay and just as described in the info - well situated, bright, airy, spacious and clean.  All info from Philip clear and straightforward both for arrival and leaving.  Little things make a big difference - hot water always hot, heating easily adjusted, large big umbrella!!  Perfect location for the main attractions, easy walking distance and easy to come back to if you want a break during the day before going out again.  Bus stop literally outside the door (return) and over the road (going) takes you down to Brittannia and past the station if you dont want to walk it.  Italian restaurant couple of mins down the road on opposite side is really lovely.  The perfect place to stay for a city break.
This accommodation is outstanding in every respect and I would wholeheartedly recommend this place as it is one of the best that I have experienced with many thoughtful touches included.

This is the second time we have stayed at this amazing apartment. All the family came this time and we were happy to see it was just as good, if not better, than last time. So central and so much going on all the time. To stay right in the middle of the Royal Mile is as good as it gets in Edinburgh.
Tim and Michelle are incredibly responsive and helpful and the apartment is beautiful.
I'm just about to recommend them to someone else and we will definitely be back.
The first time we came to the apartment was for the Festival, so we weren't sure what a weekend in February would be like. But it was absolutely great still. Edinburgh is definitely still amazing in the cold and drizzle, so don't worry about the weather!!

Excellent stay! The location was perfect, and the host was incredibly responsive and accommodating, allowing us to check in a bit early, which was a big help. The space matched the description and photos exactly. There were five of us, and it felt cozy and comfortable throughout. The shower had great water pressure and temperature. Just a note: the heating is controlled by the host, but they responded quickly whenever we needed an adjustment, so it wasn’t a problem at all. I’d definitely stay here again!

We enjoyed our stay in this part of Edinburgh. It was very easy to access a supermarket, The Royal Mile, buses, The Grassmarket etc.... The accommodation was clean and had everything we needed for a pleasant stay.

Der Aufenthalt in Andrews AirBnB war super. Die Wohnung ist so zentral gelegen, dass wir alles was wir in Edinburgh machen wollten zu Fuß erreichen konnten. Die Wohnung ist sehr groß und man kann sehr bequem mit 3 Gästen unterkommen.
Andrew ist sehr hilfsbereit und antwortet schnell sollte etwas sein.
Während unseres Aufenthaltes gab es ein kleines Problem mit der Heizung was wir aber in Abstimmung mit Andrew sehr einfach lösen konnten.
Wir würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen!
Great stay, Suzanna is an amazing host.

Location is perfect. So close to the city center.
People in reception are really nice and helpful.
It was my second time in Destiny. Last year we had super clean and comfortable room with well equipped kitchen. This time room could be cleaner (dust and hair) and we had very unconfortable mattress. We hadn't got forks in the kitchen.

This flat is really beautiful and everything in it is new. The space is great and the location is excellent. It is just a few minutes away, walking from Waverley. Martin is a great host, really friendly, helpful, and responds very quickly. The fridge was stocked with milk, bread, eggs, etc when we arrived which was a really nice touch, and very much appreciated! I would love to stay here again next time I'm in Edinburgh and I can't recommend it enough.

Loved everything about this stay! Ruth was so kind to stock the fridge with eggs, milk and wine, and even had some snacks for us. Lovely home, lovely host, lovely location. Would absolutely stay here again!

We had a wonderful experience in Catriona and Bob’s home! It is so spacious, well laid out, and thoughtfully designed. Catriona and Bob are thoughtful hosts and were quick to respond and offer options when we needed to check in early. The patio out back was beautiful and fun to relax in. The location is well positioned - not far from all of the action, but you’re not right in the middle of it. Highly recommend staying at this lovely home.

Gilly’s home was lovely and the area was ideal! Great public transport links but also walkable to the centre and other areas.
The room had everything we needed and a very well equipped bathroom too. Would definitely return for our next visit to Edinburgh

We had a great stay. Location was great, 2KM walk from Edinburgh and also near Portobello beach. The place was clean, spacious and great beds! Natalie was very friendly, always responding to messages. Would definitely recommend!

We had a wonder time at Catherine and Craig’s place. It was conveniently located near all the attractions we wanted to see, and even though it was right next to a bar, it was quiet in the evenings when we went to bed. Would recommend this place without reservations if you’re looking for a place to stay in Edinburgh!
Very quiet, great location, and very spacious apartment.

Great Central Location
Very comfortable
Very nice touches
Would stay there again

Très bon ambiance dans cet appartement
Spacieux et confortable
Idéal pour une famille
L’environnement est calme et facilement accessible
Parking gratuit très cool pour la voiture de location
Les 2 salle de bain sont top
Merci encore Tony
We didn’t met Carol, but his husband Gerry. He was very welcoming. The apartment is close to all shops and near to the center. We slept very well, the bed was comfortable.

We had a great stay in Portobello and were really comfortable in the huge bedroom. Giselle and Robin were very accommodating and made sure we had everything we needed, also lovely to chat to and gave us some fantastic recommendations!

Very central, near everything.
We have used the bus just once as you could walk everywhere.
Clean, tidy, modernly furnished.
Easy check in and out instructions.
Very warm place.
Awesome location and home!

Apartament Pier'a położony jest w odległości 15min drogi od ostatniego przystanku tramwajowego. Śmiało więc można wybrać ten środek transportu jadąc z lotniska. Aby dojść do centrum Starego Miasta potrzeba ok. 30min. Apartament jest bardzo przytulnie urządzony. Na ścianach wiszą piękne zdjęcia zrobione przez Piera. Mieszkanie wyposażone jest we wszystko, co potrzebne jest podczas kilkudniowego pobytu - kuchnia w pełni wyposażona, suszarka, żelazko. Miłą niespodzianką był adapter/przejściówka do kontaktu oraz przygotowane dla nas foldery firm oferujących wycieczki poza Edynburg (gospodarz wiedział, że mamy w planie zwiedzanie okolic). Kontakt z Pierem był idealny - w każdej chwili dostarczał nam koniecznych szczegółowych informacji. Gorąco polecam ten apartament!
Francesca was a lovely host and her home was very cosy. I would defo recommend x
Bella was really friendly and everything looked as it was described. Everything was clean and Bella was really easy to talk to! Staying at her place was lovely!
Great place, very homely yet stylish flat. Great easy check in
Great place.  Pictures are real.  Highly recommended.

This was a real old-school BnB experience, where the host truly welcomes you, prepare you breakfast, and gives you a sense of the local life. I truly enjoyed every part of it, and the lengthy conversations with Emma. Such a generous host, you will get some welcome and takeaway gifts, as much food as you'd like, a rare kind of hospitality in Western cities! Keep in mind that the room, although comfortable, is rather small, so good for one person. Also keep in mind that you are sharing the apartment with the lovely Emma, who gives you as much privacy as you need but is also happy to chat and engage. Also very well located in a really nice neighborhood with lots around. Definite recommend for solo travelers wanting to experience the local side of Edinburgh!
Beautiful apartment, located right next to the beach. Loved the rustic and charming sense of the space. Rachel was very responsive and accommodating. Would definitely book again when in Edinburgh.
Overall we would suggest using this option upon visiting Edinburgh

Amanda's place is beautiful, very homey and a stones throw from Stockbridge. You can walk to Princess street as well.
We had a great stay!
Lovely house in a great area of Edinburgh.  Only a 30min walk to most of the Old Town.
Great place to stay for a short break in Edinburgh - everything in easy reach and walking distance, while a real home from home. Host is also very helpful - recommended!
El piso está muy bien localizado y es muy cómodo para un grupo como el nuestro de cinco personas. Sean es muy amable y estuvo siempre pendiente por si necesitabamos algo.
Lovely base for a couple days in Edinburgh- excellent communication and accomodation was great for our group of 5. Very well equipped and a nice quiet area.

This house is gorgeous, such lovely decor and there was plenty of space (there was 4 of us). It's very centrally located so super easy to walk around Edinburgh.
We really appreciated the little extras, such as the robes provided!
It was very clean and super easy to check in to. I would definitely stay here again :)
All is well just that the thermostat was a little tricky for us. At times it will be cold and have to adjust the thermostat. Other than that, it was a lovely house and Thomas responded fast too.
nice and clean airbnb, in a good location.

We loved staying in the flat. It was so spacious and we felt at home straight away. We all slept well and enjoyed the fact that the house seemed very quiet and safe. Bruntsfield is a lovely neighborhood and we enjoyed browsing the shops and eating out. You can easily walk or catch the bus to wherever you want to got. I would definitely recommend this place.
A great stay! Clean, beautiful, and comfortable!

Roberts flat is a beautifully considered, tastefully decorated and eminently comfortable and welcoming place to stay in an excellent location.
Beds supremely comfortable, all bathrooms spotless ( as is the rest of the property )
Quiet street and close to all local transport links too so very easy to use as a base for seeing the city.
Beautiful views from balcony too as per the pictures.
Worth also noting the superlative and highly professional we received from Andrew from B and B Buddy who made our stay equally excellent with his span and wealth of local knowledge from bars to restaurants - nothing genuinely was too much trouble
All in all a first class experience from start to finish - expectations truly exceeded

Many thanks to Suzanne for the beautifully presented accommodation that we stayed at whilst in fabulous Edinburgh. It was immaculately clean, well furnished and ticked all the boxes regarding the location. We’ve had a wonderful weekend x

Sally was a great host! Her place was clean and comfortable. A little far from the city centre but that is what is great about it. A escape from the busy city. Found different ways to go into city and then get back each night. I suggest walking to the tram at the end of its route (Newhaven Tram Stop)and taking it into all the historical attractions.  Along the way is a Beautiful walk by the bay and lots of interesting neighbourhoods to see.
It was a perfect few days in Edinburgh, not least thanks to this accommodation. Very luxurious and ideally located. No wishes were left unfulfilled.
Amazing location and very easy to communicate with, highly recommended!

Comfortable and very clean apartment.
Ideal if you bring your car.
Good location in a very simple neighborhood.
Although it does not have a living room, it has 3 bedrooms which in our case was excellent because we went with our teen age kids.
A good place if you use it as a base to get to know Edinburgh and get to the apartment to sleep.
Beautiful apartment really handy for the city centre and close to a tesco express and 2 lovely cafes for breakfast.

A beautiful room in a lovely house. Fabulous hosts.
The location is very close to Stockbridge which has many cafes, bars & restaurants.
I would 100% recommend staying here
We had a great stay here! The apartment is in a great location which is at most 15 mins walk from anything. Douglas was very friendly and helpful with recommendations.

Nicely situated flat, very central to a lot of the places you'd want to visit in the city. Restaurant, cafes and shops within 5 minutes walking distance. All the facilities you'd want out of a flat and a nice view too. Great host, would definitely recommend. We hope to visit again.

Al principio nos costó encontrar la caja con la llave porque había un mensaje nuevo con una nueva ubicación que no habíamos visto pero quitando eso la estancia estuvo excelente, el sitio muy limpio, la calefacción y el agua caliente estaba bien, la cama cómoda y todo muy limpio

Stayed at Florence’s for a long weekend and it was great! There are a couple of flights or so or stairs in terms of accessibility, the room is small but was shown as such in photos. I just need a bed/light/hair dryer and those boxes were ticked. Flat is well located for Edinburgh centre and Leith access and very quiet!
My only note is if booking in autumn/winter, I would recommend wearing thick/warm pyjamas, since the radiator is quite small and didnt warm the room up fully (it might also be an old flat block thing, no fault to Florence). Florence was great at comms too - thanks so much!

Patrick is a top notch host. He was very responsive both during the booking stage as well as when I had some questions during our stay. The apartment in Edinburgh was just beautiful. It was very spacious and had plenty of room for our group of five. The tall ceilings and beautiful furnishings made for a comfortable stay. We ended up spending most of our time in the kitchen at the large table sharing food and discussing our day. There is a single flight of stairs you have to climb to enter the apartment (no elevator option), so please plan accordingly. The apartment is a block and a half from a local grocery store, pharmacy, organic grocer, and a plethora of delicious restaurants. I would highly recommend staying at Patrick's apartment should you visit Edinburgh.
Beautiful apartment in an ideal part of town - pretty much everywhere in Edinburgh is walkable from here.  Dele couldn't have been more helpful, it was a pleasure to stay here

Roberto è un host accogliente ed è stato premuroso verso qualsiasi nostra necessità, ma allo stesso tempo ha rispettato con discrezione la nostra privacy.
La sistemazione è confortevole e molto pulita; Roberto mette a disposizione tutto quello di cui si ha bisogno! Si trova in una zona residenziale molto tranquilla, fuori dal centro storico che però è facilmente raggiungibile con i bus 19, 25 e 49.
Sicuramente un’ottima soluzione per visitare Edimburgo e i suoi dintorni (anche Glasgow) aiutati dagli ottimi consigli dell’host: Roberto infatti ha risposto con rapidità a ogni nostro messaggio,dandoci sempre indicazioni preziose! Consigliatissimo!

This flat is in an ideal location and easily accessible to public transit, restaurants, and multiple other attractions in Edinburgh. The property feels "grand" and was suitable for exactly what we needed.
Fine for a couple of days in Edinburgh. A nice area with plentyof good shops and restaurants, although a good 20 minute walk to the centre of town.

We picked Marta’s Edinburgh apartment because of the location and it did not disappoint! The entire city is at your doorstop! We also needed parking and that was always available. We did have minor concerns with the unit. The interior doors off the hallway going to the living area and bedroom were heavy and closed automatically. This made the unit feel small,  having to open and close doors continuously. Additionally there were no drawers or a dresser available for unpacking. Luggage needed to stay open on the floor. The only other concern we had was there was a problem with the toilet. Marta came out immediately and was very responsive but it took three days before the problem was resolved. These issues were small and basically just inconvenient, compared to the lovely decor and perfect location.
Gorgeous apartment, easy walk into town. Having the garage was an amazing perk, as our husbands went to golf in the St. Andrews area during our days there. Beautifully decorated!

I had a wonderful stay at Paul’s place in Edinburgh! The location is unbeatable — walkable from Edinburgh Waverley Station and very close to tram and bus stops, making it incredibly convenient for exploring Edinburgh and even traveling to other cities and towns in Scotland.
The accommodation was comfortable, and I especially loved the spacious bathroom, which was big and fully stocked with toiletries — such a thoughtful touch that made the stay even more convenient.
Paul was a great host, and everything about the stay made my trip smooth and stress-free. I’d definitely recommend staying here if you’re visiting Edinburgh!
Nice room in Edinburgh centre ! I recommand it for one or two nights. Access to kitchen and everything was clean.

Such a spacious, clean and beautiful house.. bu it’s quite far from city (around 30mins by bus) . thermal at kitchen downstairs did not work, and you have to walk around 1km from nearest bus stop to reach the house. the rest was perfect!

This is a great location- easy to walk to cafes, shops and to site seeing venues. Noisy street outside on weekend nights from people enjoying nightlife- comfy bed, tiny bathroom, nice touch to have towel warmer! Easy to find, and easy check in- negatives were muddy littered entrance in back of building and spooky concrete lobby/stairway to apartment. Minimal “extras” in flat- not a bar of soap or teabag - different from other places we have stayed. But would recommend for many other positives.
David was a great host, check-in was very easy and the apartment was very clean and tidy. Lovely stay in Edinburgh and would recommend for anyone wanting to stay in the city.

Claire is a lovely and gracious host! She was very friendly and communicative prior to check-in and was kind enough to let me know about some local events happening during my stay and to purchase tickets for some popular attractions, like Edinburgh Castle, ahead of time as they tend to sell out. Her place is easily accessible via public transportation from the airport and other areas of town through Haymarket station and is about a 20-30 minute walk to old town. The room itself is very spacious and exactly as described. There is a coffee maker and tea kettle in the room which are wonderful in the mornings. There is no AC, but there is a fan in the room, which helps a lot. The apartment is located up three flights of stairs, and there is no elevator, so be prepared if you have large or heavy luggage. Overall, a wonderful stay, and a super helpful and accommodating host! Thank you, Claire!

Sheila was a great host, very kind about making sure I had everything I needed and the stay was satisfying. The home is lovely and in a very pretty area, a beautiful canal-side walk or a short bus ride into the centre of town. And great value for money in the expensive Fringe Festival season, overall it was excellent!

This flat has everything you need. Cleanest I have stayed in with a great bed.
Great location for the rugby, shops, bars etc.
Fabulous host, communication was excellent and looking forward to our next stay.
Olivia’ s place was lovely. It was a great oasis of calm in the city and a great place to regroup mid trip.  It was close to restaurants and cultural attractions.

Sonia and Chris’s apartment is a real gem! The hosts were easy to communicate with, and I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. The flat is cozy and has personal touches. I loved using the record player, which also works as a Bluetooth speaker. Great location; very close to the Royal Mile. I would recommend staying here! The apartment was perfect for my stay and the hosts are friendly and communicative.

Detailed manual on kitchen table. Wifi info and restaurant, taxi #'s written on blackboard.
Prompt response to my e-mail enquirers on where to access a key for the flat.

Estuvimos muy agusto. Maia está pendiente de todos los detalles, nos dejó un libro lleno de recomendaciones, un mapa en la habitación que nos sirvió de mucho, incluso un adaptador para el enchufe. La ubicación es perfecta,en 10 minutos andando estás en pleno centro.

I had a lovely stay in this unique house. The property has a lot of character and charm, and the neighborhood is exceptionally quiet and peaceful. It’s also perfectly located near the Water of Leith, with a beautiful walkway that’s ideal for relaxing strolls.
Anita was a wonderful host – very kind and welcoming, and she took the time to clearly explain everything I needed to know. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a calm and distinctive place to stay.
good

Great apartment for two. Close to good amenities in Stockbridge. Uphill to Princes Street and quite away from main fringe venues but perfect for visiting Botanical Gardens and Leith waterway. Very quiet location
Es hat uns sehr gefallen bei Brain und würden jederzeit wieder kommen wollen.

L’appartamento di Simon è molto bello, funzionale e dotato di tutto il necessario.
Lo consiglio vivamente.
Amazing place. Very cozy location. Only downside is street noise which was manageable.

Super stylish and nicely decorated rooms in an old characteristic house on a truly perfect location to visit the old and the new town. Lot’s of interesting bars and restaurant around the corner but also a walk into the old town is not too far. Tease is a very kind host and let’s your feel welcome in her home. Absolute recommendation for your layover or city trip to Edinburgh!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Maria Eugenia. Celui-ci a commencé par une excellente communication avec Maria Eugenia, très sympathique, très arrangeante quant aux horaires d arrivée et de départ et qui prend la peine de vous accueillir personnellement.
L appartement correspond totalement aux photos, est très propre, bien équipé et chaleureux.
Le quartier est calme et très bien situé : 10/15 mn à pied de Grassmarket, Royal Miles, du Château, du Musée National et
15 mn à pied de Princess Street. Mais, vous trouverez de nombreux arrêts de bus au départ de l appartement, si vous préférez vous déplacer plus rapidement.
15 mn à pied de l arrêt de bus de l aéroport.
Egalement de nombreux supermarchés et restaurants dans le quartier, ce qui vous offre toutes les commodités pour passer un agréable séjour à Edinburgh.
Très bon rapport qualité / prix au vu des prix actuels des locations à Edinburgh.
Je recommande sans hésitation.

Caroline’s place was very comfortable. She ensured we understood the upstairs bedroom had lofted ceilings so we were not surprised. The kitchen was fully equipped. The bathroom too. Nice shower and comfortable beds.
Wonderful stay! Best possible location and beautiful home.

Great space in a very central location in Edinburgh. Had everything we needed for our stay.
A little noisy at night but nothing that stopped us from getting to sleep.
Would stay again - thanks Leon!

I stayed for two nights at Btissam accommodation, and I really enjoyed it. The location of the flat is not far from the city center, the room was clean with all needed amenities.
Btissam responded on my messages very quickly.
