The apartment is very close to the description.
Definitely, the stay has been very nice and it has contributed to our joyful of these days in Edinburgh.
Appartement idéalement situé à Edinbourg, 20 minutes du centre à pied. Appartement conforme à la description et propre. Procédures d'entrées et de sorties très simples et claires.
BART harika bir ev sahibi kendisi çok ilgili ve güler yüzlü ve çok anlayışlı kendisine çok teşekkür ederiz.
Amazing little place to stay and great location; only a short walk into Edinburgh centre. Lovely and clean and had all the basics you needed. Definitely going to be visiting again.

We enjoyed our stay it is close to Leith walk with lots of cafes, pubs and restaurants. There is a corner shop for small items very close by, a supermarket a 5 minutes walk.
The flat has a get feel with lots of homely touches. The bed is large and comfortable with really good pillows, good bathroom, we didn't use the kitchen but it is very well stocked.
Ahmets place was a lovely stay for my brother and I travelling from Australia! Had everything we needed & was close to the main streets of Edinburgh. Highly recommend this place! & Ahmet was lovely!

We loved this apartment so much! Thank you for the hospitality Beata, it was a haven to come home to after 25K steps a day through Edinburgh. Shower was amazing, beds were comfortable. The light throughout the apartment was stunning. Loved it so much.

Super séjour sur Édimbourg !! Logement juste à côté (10min à pied même pas) du centre historique de la ville écossaise.
Le problème du chauffage a été réglé rapidement, les hôtes sont disponibles et réactifs
Je recommande le logement à ceux qui veulent profiter d’un beau week end dans une magnifique ville !!
Brilliant location right on the Royal mile just down from the castle. Good communication with the owner and remained flexible through out. Would highly recommend!

Great place, close to Prince's street so all the shops are nearby. Great connection to other parts of the city either through bus or tram. Rooms was clean, kitchen spacious and the free tea and coffee is a nice touch.
Additionally, supermarket is right downstairs so all things were easy to buy for cooking, sanitary needs etc.
Great value for money. Highly recommend for adventurers and travelers.

Anne and Raymond are super good hosts. Extremely nice people. Very warm, helpful and friendly. Room was very clean and welcoming
Raymond offered to drop me every morning while he went to work. He also made a nice home cooked dinner one night. He helped me with local details.
Anne gave me warm thermal wear as I was very cold. She was more than happy to offer whatever help I needed.
Special mention to lovely doggies and a Darling cat. Loved playing with them.
Would love to stay with them if I ever manage to come back to lovely Edinburgh again! Strongly recommend Anne’s bnb. Thanks to Anne for making my stay awesome. My flight got delayed and Anne offered to extend the stay free of charge. Though I didn’t take it, the gesture matters! Thankyou Anne
Lovely modern apartment close to great amenities. Fiona was a warm and welcoming host.  Fantastic views out of the upstairs window. Would really recommend
Amazing apartment, we enjoyed our stay, great location.

Pauline's place is centrally located, clean and as described. The decorating was exquisite in the common areas. There is a beautiful view of the castle from outside the front door. My only qualm was with the bathroom. The ceilings are quite low for a tall person, so I had to stoop to shower. The same was true for the bathroom mirror. It was small and placed about belly level for me.
Great place and great location. My dad and I really got to enjoy a once in a lifetime trip.

A stunning apartment in a fabulous location - within walking distance of the old and new town of Edinburgh but don’t overlook the West end which is on your doorstep. The property has all that is needed for a comfortable stay. Free private parking at the rear of the property, clean towels & bedding and beautiful decor in fabulously large rooms. Would definitely recommend and happily stay here again when visiting Edinburgh. Communication was very good beforehand. The only thing that would improve the place would just be a few cosmetic touch ups to really make the place feel loved and cared for.
Great place! Smack in the middle of Edinburgh. Very clean and neat inside. Happy we could do our laundry on the same floor, after our grueling hike through west highland way

What a gem of a flat!
Super clean, beds really comfy and great showers. Julie was really helpful and always very responsive.
Fab location, 20 mins walk to castle, 10 mins botanical gardens. Surprisingly quiet considering its opposite student accommodation which I hadn’t realised! Despite being freshers week we didn’t hear a peep at night, so quiet.
Great restaurant 5 mins walk, the Tollhouse, beautiful food and great staff. Lots of other cafes and bars close by.
Would definitely return to Julie’s flat, cleanliness, comfort and location 10/10!

Thanks Trystan for offering such a lovely place. We really enjoy our 3 nights stay in Edinburgh. Would definitely come back when we revisit and recommend it to everyone. Sometimes there would be a bit noises from the bar downstairs at night but it is bearable and does not affect us at all.

I could finish this review in two words, "The view" and you would know all you need to know. Outside of the nice view, though, this apartment is wonderfully located near Grassmarket with shops and restaurants and easy access to a bus line. Ann wasn't able to meet us to check-in, but sent a thorough message both right before our arrival and shortly after our arrival to ensure we were comfortable. We did get to meet Ann at check-out and had a pleasant chat with her. We were very pleased with our stay in Edinburgh. The bed was comfortable, the shower was nice and we had plenty of space.

Great location, place was clean and spacious and as described. As others mentioned, it was def noisy, and due to a cold front it was pretty chilly, even w the heaters. The only unexpected thing was there is no clothes dryer, just a washer, so plan accordingly.
Communication was top notch.  Location was perfect.
Excellent location, lovely apartment!
Cosy appartment in the beautiful environs of Dean village. The host was flexible with check in/ out to accommodate our travel plans. The film projector was a bonus too.

We had a very pleasant stay. Everything was perfectly fine, the host was kind and welcoming, and the accommodation was clean and comfortable. The location was excellent – right in the city center, so everything was within easy walking distance. We would definitely recommend this place to others.

place was great. host andrew responded fast. checking in was easy. location is easy to get to(tram was nearby) and plenty of buses around. grocer was at the next corner. pictures shown are 100% accurate.
only gripe is floors and doors are abit creaky/squeaky, so if anyone is going to the toilet at night, everyone else will know.
still, a definite value for money. Will definitely book again if I'm back
Claire was lovely and accommodating. The room is HUGE and very clean! Only thing to note is that it’s close to an overpass which was loud so if you are sensitive to noise bring ear plugs.

The flat is located in an old tenement building so the dark stairs & stairway were a bit off putting on first entrance but fear not!  Once in the flat it is clean, bright and comfortable.  The position is good - about 10 mins walk to the castle, Royal Mile and grass market area.
It was a Great Experience

This room at Steve’s is a dream!! The architecture, the decor, the views, the location! I felt like I was in a Jane Austen novel! I also want to note that as a woman travelling alone, I found Steve to be an excellent host. He was helpful, respectful, pleasant and generous. The neighbourhood is well lit with wide open streets that make it feel safe for walking in the evening. It’s a short walk to the bustle of downtown but feels quiet and luxurious.

I had a wonderful stay at Gill and Mark's apartment in Edinburgh. They were incredibly responsive and proactive, reaching out to confirm my check-in time and accommodating my train schedule seamlessly.
The apartment itself is ideally located, just a 30-minute walk from the heart of Edinburgh's tourist attractions. For those who prefer not to walk, there's a convenient bus option that makes getting around even easier. Additionally, there's a Sainsbury's supermarket nearby, which was perfect for stocking up on food and drinks during my stay.
Overall, Gill and Mark were fantastic hosts, and the location couldn't have been better. Highly recommended!
Great place, exactly as described! Marco is fantastic, great host who made it easy and even checked on us. Thanks Marco! RECOMMEND!
Thanks Sharon.  Everything was perfect.  Fantastic flat in a great location.  Great communication.  Definitely a 5 star flat in Edinburgh.
This home is simply outstanding. Has everything and more that you need, including a sauna which was amazing!
很好

Thank you Francois for a wonderful weeks stay in your apartment with my family
Was everything we hoped for and more.
Clean comfortable and cosy home from home feel
Wonderful location quiet and private but ideally located to tour Edinburgh within 15/20 mins walk
Good for supermarket pubs restaurants etc
Was in Edinburgh to attend a special Family
Event so being close to all city ammenties and transport were important.
Again thank you Francois for your great warmth and hospitality
We're hoping to stay again next year
I would thoroughly recommend this Apartment for a great stay in Edinburgh
Great room, great value. I strongly recommend Josh’s place😀
Craig was very good at getting back to me. Checking in was easy. Craig's parents who helped with checking in were kind and helpful. I recommend the flat to anyone staying in Edinburgh.

Everything you need to feel right at home. Comfy bed, kitchen, washing machine,  Netflix and all in a super central location. Very easy to get to from the airport. Jacqui was very easy to communicate with. Thanks for meeting us, sharing useful tips and the little treats to help us settle in.
Quiet residential location within walking distance of a few restaurants and near to airport. Manoj responded rapidly to any queries or comments and was an excellent host.
Thanks Clare. I had a great time in Edinburgh, and enjoyed staying at your place. Thanks for the trip suggestions 😊

This is a great place for the fringe. it's on the far side of the meadows & so it was a pleasant walk back through the park in the evening. There are food shops on the street & although we didn't take advantage of them, there are also restaurants.
房源位置非常好，任何景点都可以步行到达，除了没有洗衣机，但房东给我们提供了公共洗衣机位置非常好。感谢房东，是个很好的房源
A lovely home, a warm and knowledgable host, greats eggs in the morning and a peaceful view. Couldn't ask for more!

You can’t find a better location to stay . The place is very modern and clean with everything you need . We stayed only for one night with two little children. Martin was very helpful and helped us with the parking , directions and had everything ready in the flat.  Highly recommend it this for holidays . But also think would be ideal for business travellers .

Nice walk to Grassmarket and the Royal Mile.  Many stores, cafes and restaurants in the vicinity.  Mike kindly left extra blankets for the chilly nights and the apartment was fully stocked with clean linens, towels and dishes for four. No kitchen, but a  microwave, kettle and tiny fridge is provided which served our breakfast needs. Mike also provided a baby cot! We enjoyed our stay and would come again!
Craig and his Airbnb were fantastic. the location, apartment, and host were exceptional. I would stay again, without a doubt.

Lovely modern apartment with great location. Walking distance to all attractions, close to grocerie store. Greig is very informative. There’s a folder with clear instructions and many tips and suggestion for us.
I had a wonderful stay at Dan & Marta’s apartment. The location was perfect, and the apartment was comfortable and well-equipped. Communication was smooth, and everything was as described.
Location for the city and Murrayfield is excellent. The flat is simply furnished but comfortable and clean. Small personal touches were appreciated and communication  always prompt.
Jack is a remarkable host! He’s proactive and precise with all the instructions given to us! A bus stop is literally just across his street and voila you can already access numerous attractions!

The room was lovely and spacious, with a great view of Arthur's seat. The flat is very centrally located and in easy walking distance to anything you might need, including Waverly train station.
Sam was a wonderful host, friendly and quick to respond to any messages. He was also very generous when I needed to stay past the check-in time for a work meeting.
I would highly recommend!

Studio très pratique situé à côté de l'aéroport. Le logement est propre et agréable.
Seul point noir : la douche ! Le débit d'eau est faible et la température très aléatoire.
O Mike é sensacional , sua casa é muito confortavel e limpa . me senti na minha casa .

The house and neighboorhood were quiet and safe, very close to tram and bus station. The distance house/tram station, house/airport and tram station/city was very convenient.
The house was clean. We really enjoy our stay in Edimburgh.
We totally recommend booking this place!

I don’t know how we could of been happier! This was our first time in an Airbnb and it was brilliant. The place was charming , comfortable & cozy and the location is right in the heart of everything! Thank you again!!
Scott
David was a great host. Property was beautiful. Would definitely stay there again and recommend it.
We loved everything at Karen,s place. Not even one single problem. Just perfect!

My friends and I really enjoyed our stay! Charlotte’s place is in such a central and convenient location to the train station and so many other things in Edinburgh. The one thing to flag (which may have been listed in the description but we underestimated the hills and steps in Edinburgh) is that the unit has many steep steps that you have to walk down to get to the entrance. We had some heavy suitcases and mobility issues both of which didn’t take away from our enjoyment of the AirBnB but just flagging. Would highly recommend Charlotte’s place for anyone looking for a centrally located but quite stay. The house was also well stocked with cleaning supplies, kitchen items, and more.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Holly’s place, perfectly located for our long weekend away!
Great flat, easy to find and access. Really great location and was perfect for what we needed!

Location is in the middle of everything! But the complex itself is quaint and very quiet, which we loved after a hectic week in London. Highly recommend the bar Dragonfly across the street for a nightcap. If you’re there on a weekend, Grassland Market around the corner is a must in the morning.
Luke and Jolita were so kind and helpful in planning our trip! Recommended tour companies, restaurants, must sees. You’re going to love Scotland and Edinburgh if you stay here.

For an extended stay this was very nice and convenient.  Having a private place to go to each night was a nice thing to look forward to.   Helen was extremely helpful and gracious.  There is no kitchen which I knew when I booked but it was perfect for what I needed and exactly as described.

Ollie’s Airbnb matched the description in ad. The apartment was clean, it met our expectations for size and setup as described in ad. He provided clear and concise instructions).
One downside was shower. The setup is dangerous and a true Health hazard.
My daughter ended up with first degree burns after her shower. Scalding to freezing cold within seconds.
Although the owner provided instructions on “rebooting the shower system” in the PDF he provided as part of check in, it is not clear as to the frequency of the problem. There is neither a warning in the bathroom or in the hallway near the bathroom nor any instructions posted in the apartment on fixing the shower. At 5:30am, one should not have to worry about being burned while taking a shower.
It is the worst shower setup I have ever experienced in my entire lifetime. It should be replaced ASAP as it is dangerous and a health hazard.
Super appart, très bien situé, à 10 minutes de la navette aéroport, à 15 minutes de grassmarket. Propreté irréprochable. Accueil sympa. Je ne peux que recommander. +++
We stayed here over our wedding weekend, it was a perfect stay. This fabulous flat had everything we needed and more! Calim even left us a bottle of Fizz to help us celebrate too. Highly recommend!!

Beautiful flat on Leith shore! We had such a relaxing couple of days revisiting Edinburgh. Karen’s flat is so comfortable and full of so many thoughtful touches. We’re looking forward to returning when we can. Thanks Karen!

tres bien situe, a 20 min a pied de la "old town" en passant par "the meadows".
logement propre dans une rue tranquille. Agnieszka est tres reactive, elle a repondu a nos messages pour nous conseiller et fait des propositions.
le seul bemol est les 3 etages a monter mais nous etions au courant et avons mis nos valises en consigne a bagage en ne conservant que l essentiel

The most perfect weekend in Edinburgh staying in this stylish and homely apartment, we did have to take a few Ubers into town due to not leaving ourselves long enough to walk. However it isn’t too far and the area is good. Wish we stayed longer!

The flat is lovely and ideally situated with a view of the castle from both the living room and bedroom. The castle is a 5 minute walk and grassmarket right outside has a lot to offer. Taiba is a friendly and super responsive host.

We had a great time at Royal Bolthole. The location was ideal for Carlton Hill, Arthur’s Seat, lots of restaurants, and Edinburgh attractions. Jo provided clear instructions and the place was clean and comfortable.

Annie's flat was lovely, located on the first floor. There are lots of restaurants, cafes and pubs near by. All very nice. The flat was exactly as described and the facilities were great and we had all the cutlery required to cook meals too. Bus stops into town and the airport were right outside. We walked into the city too which was very pleasant. The neighbourhood felt very safe.
La casa está muy bien ubicada, muy cerca de todos los puntos de interés. Ali ha estado atento en todo momento por si necesitabamos algo.
Garry's place is strategically located in Edinburgh and place is very well furnished, maintained. We felt right at home. However, would have liked the kitchen amenities to be a bit better.

Great and safe location. The place is spacious and alot of mirrors (bonus points for getting ready). Beds were comfy and bathroom is amazing—good water pressure.
Place is by the public stairs, there is noise from people walking in the day but it wasn’t loud/disturbing.
We had no wifi during our stay which is the only downside
Endroit idéalement situé pour découvrir la ville. Personnel très accueillant et à l'écoute. Nous recommandons. Très belle expérience
Absolutely loved the flat!
Felt as comfortable as I would in my own home as soon as I arrived! Very warm and welcoming host with a lovely and clean flat. Would highly recommend.
Very well maintained and nice apartment. The sleeping sofa is quite comfy and the location is great. I could go everywhere I wanted by foot.

Amazing location if you’re looking to be in the heart of everything and walking distance to all major sites. Nice clean and modern renovations to what is clearly an older building. We stayed with our 9 month old and found the pack and play, high chair and basket of toys very helpful. Rebecca and her team were super responsive.

Great stay at Kates place! Everything was as described. Such a good and easy location for getting about to different parts of the city. Very cosy, quiet and well equipped. Kate was really responsive and the ideal host.

Martin was a superb host going above and beyond in his assistance to us.  The flat provided us with everything we needed and that little extra.   And location, location, location!   Walking distance to everything was such a bonus!  We highly reccomend Martins Airbnb, one of the best we have had the pleasure to stay at.
Had a really nice stay, everyone was really lovely!

Nos ha encantado, no obstante tuvimos mala suerte con los inquilinos de la habitación de al lado, tuvimos que asearnos en el fregadero dos veces por qué se pasaban mucho tiempo en el aseo. Es lo malo de compartir aseo evidentemente, por eso nos supo mal pagar ese precio para terminar en esas condiciones. La casa impecable y preciosa, muy bien ubicada!
We loved the place and really appreciated the cleanliness of the apartment! The location is lovely and in a very quiet area,  Highly recommend!

We spent three days in Stuart's apartment and we were more than satisfied with the place, we will return to this apartment if we have to return to Edinburgh! One of the best AirBnB we have done so far. Thank You, Stuart !

Great kindness in an old fashioned house. Cong Shan was always available for communication to resolve any question prior our arrival. His wife received us and was very kind and helpful.
Close to the airport and public transport to the city centre.
Great location, the flat was kitted out well and nicely presented. Annie was also very helpful and responsive to queries.
My family and I enjoyed our stay in Edinburgh, we weren’t in the accommodation too much but it was well equipped, clean and central for our needs.
The apartment couldn’t me more central. And for what it’s worth your getting great value for your money.

Valentina was very communicative and prompt at helping when it was needed or asked of her. The apartment itself was as described and within 30 min walking distance to the Edinburgh Castle which was super convenient! The area was noisy with car sounds and upstairs neighbours continually into the night but earbuds were provided in the bedroom wardrobe. Everything you need is there and the washing machine was great. The main issue we had was the brightness of the light on the bedroom heater and the bright green exit lights on the stairway that couldn’t be turned off. However, this could easily be fixed with an addition of a  curtain over the bedroom entrance. Overall, a lovely spot to stay but the host Valentina and her friendliness was the stand-out.
Loved our Edinburgh stay at Sharon’s! Very clean but an easy walk to city centre and the Water of Leith Walkway to get you through and around town. Would definitely stay again!

We had a lovely stay here. The views are amazing and the home was very clean and tidy. It’s a short drive into the city centre and there’s some nice places to eat near by. We would all stay here again, thanks!
Great place to stay along the royal mile. The place is close to most visit places in Edinburgh. The apartment is spacious, easy to access and the host is very friendly.
This was such an amazing place to stay. Perfectly located and plenty of space, we’d absolutely LOVE to stay again.

Wybór apartamentu Caroline był strzałem w 10. Idealna lokalizacja do zwiedzania miasta, wszędzie blisko. Apartament był czysty i zgodny z opisem. A możliwość samodzielnego zameldowania była bardzo wygodna. W pobliżu apartamentu znajdują się sklepy z pamiątkami, sklep spożywczy, atrakcje turystyczne oraz przystanek autobusowy. Jeżeli kiedyś znowu pojedziemy do Edynburga to z pewnością wynajmiemy ten sam apartament. Serdecznie polecamy.
Lovely flat as described with a great location. Plenty more amenities than expected such as shampoo/conditioner/shower gel. Comfy beds and seamless check in. I would definitely stay here again.
Loved the apartment and loved Edinburgh. Fantastic location central to all the sites.

Brilliant Airbnb!
Perfect location, stylish accommodation, comfortable beds

Great location in the heart of the Royal Mile.  The space is bright, spacious and well-equipped.  Allan was very responsive and easy to communicate with. As others have mentioned, he left a bag of local goodies- so sweet. I would definitely recommend this space.
The Tunnock's teacakes and wee jar of marmalade were a nice welcoming touch. The flat was as described. Location was really fantastic.
Very nice location. Lots of bars and little shops around the corner. Accommodating host. Would stay here again.

Location was ideal to visit nearby sights so it’s definitely worth the price. However, the apartment is near some adult venues so it can be a bit loud late at night and thus hard to sleep. Also, prior to booking, the hosts approved our request to leave our suitcases at the apartment before check-in. This was our main purpose for booking this apartment. However, on a very rainy day, we received a message a few minutes before arrival at the apartment that the person to let us in the apartment was running late. We also could not reach one of the hosts by phone. My friend and I ended up rolling our suitcases to a restaurant to eat.. Luckily, afterwards, we got a hold of the other host and he gave us instructions on how to get into the apartment to leave our bags. Would have been satisfied if we were notified sooner or given an exact time for leaving our bags.
Fab apartment in a great location.

Mary ist sehr hilfsbereit und super freundlich. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Mit dem Bus und Tages Touristen Ticket kommt man günstig nach Edinburgh. Wir hatten eine super schöne Zeit. Ich werde auf jeden Fall wieder kommen und gerne bei Mary wohnen. Es war ein Freundinnen Wochenende..Wir wünschen Mary noch viele nette Gäste.

A thoroughly enjoyable stay at Calim's amazing apartment (anyone with a cd collection that spans from Nina Simone to Missy Elliot is a friend of ours)! So much so that we spent our first night soaking up it's cosy, welcoming surroundings that Calim has clearly gone above and beyond to perfect. Greeted with a bottle of bubbly, Calim was also very helpful in helping me plan our trip, from hotels, bars and comedy clubs, nothing was too much to ask for. We will certainly be back again. Thank you so much!
Je recommande fortement ce logement. Emplacement idéal, à 5 min à pied du château. Hôte très réactif et les équipements de l’appartement sont nombreux !

We had 4 night stay at Karen's. The beds were clean and house was welcoming. Karen and her family was always helpful and she ensured that we get our personal space and they were available if we required their support or guidance for travel. Not to miss that Karen invited us for a squash session which was thoroughly enjoyed by my husband and my 6 year old kid. We had easy access to  an fro to the city center from her house. Good location and place if you are planning for a long holiday where you can get a quite surrounding, personal space plus easy travel to city center. We had everything mentioned in the profile and itinerary by Karen.
David was a great host again, excellent local recommendations! This was my second stay with David and I would happily stay again next time I’m in Edinburgh
A cosy apartment in the centre of Edinburgh

Amanda’s lovely property In Bruntsfield was the perfect base for our weekend in Edinburgh. It is close to everything, with amazing shops and restaurants within a short stroll, yet the property is located down a quiet leafy road. Amanda was the perfect host and a pleasure to deal with in all communication.

We would 100% recommend a stay at Tu and Lucys. Their home is beautiful, clean and comfortable. Very friendly hosts and a gorgeous little sausage dog too. Location is lovely, two tram stops from princes street and very close to deans village for a nice walk. Thank you!
Very nice stay with easy accessibility to the city centre and other attractions.
Grosszügige im nordischen Stil eingerichtete Wohnung in lebendigem, sympathischen Viertel. Viele hübsche Läden, Cafés/Bars und Restaurants in unmittelbarer Umgebung.  Schöner Park vor der Haustür
It was a nice place. We have enjoyed our stay. Though the bathrooms are very compact. Interior of the apartment was lovely.

Adams place was perfect, place was tidy and great location, only a 10 minute walk to princes street, also a brilliant café just 2 minutes down the road!
The bed was really comfy and clean, shower was amazing and nice to have tea and coffee available!
Adam met me and told me where I could free park all weekend which was brilliant!
Price was brilliant to how central we were and would definitely stay here again!!
Alles super gepasst :) Raymond war bei der Ankunft und bei der Abreise da und war immer sehr freundlich. Die Fahrt in die Stadt ging super schnell und einfach.  Nur zu empfehlen.

Suzanne's place was a good value during Festival month. There are several bars, restaurants, and performance venues within a two block radius and an easy tram ride to everything else. The bedrooms and bathroom were a nice size; the snug area was surprisingly large. There is some construction happening right outside the building that started at 8a, but it was easy to ignore with the windows closed. I would stay here again.

Andrew was very generous - met us at the door and took our luggage before check in so we didn’t have to lug it around for the few hours before we could get into the flat. The flat was very clean and comfortable and was central to getting everywhere. We even met Milo the cat from the neighboring flat downstairs and was given a warm welcome. Andrew was very communicative and quick to respond to questions. Great stay.
Location, location! Excellent.
Lovely place, was a 15 minute drive into Edinburgh city centre with lots of public transport options. The house was beautiful and Justyna was a great host. Would definitely stay again 😁
Great place , well located for a city brake, would recommend to anyone
The place was beautiful and provided us travellers with everything we needed.

Excelente todo, la comunicación, el departamento es espacioso, cómodo, camas cómodas, cocina con todo lo necesario y confortable. La ubicación es muy buena, es calle principal, pero sin ruidos, todo muy bueno!! Sin dudas recomendable 100%

The location of the residence is close to the urban area, and there are free parking spaces provided, which is very convenient. In addition, the residence is neat and clean, the facilities are complete, and it is very comfortable. As for the noise of the train, it basically has no major impact on accommodation and rest. Very suitable for a family stay. The owner responded quickly and politely to questions.

Die Unterkunft ist wirklich super gemütlich.
Wir haben das Haus sehr schnell gefunden, es war alles gut beschrieben.
Das Hochbett war sehr gemütlich, es gibt ein Rollo um den Raum abzudunkeln und es ist angenehm ruhig.
In der Umgebung sind viele Pubs, Supermärkte und ähnliches. Bis in die Altstadt bzw in das Zentrum läuft man ungefähr 15-20 Minuten.
Einzig das Badezimmer war uns etwas eng, da es wirklich sehr wenig Platz bietet,das wussten wir aber durch die Fotos schon.
Die Küche haben wir nicht genutzt, deswegen kann ich dazu nichts sagen.
Die Gastgeber waren beim Check-in nicht vor Ort, haben uns aber den Schlüssel hinterlegt und uns alles gut beschrieben.
Perfect place to stay. Fast communication. Super insider tips with a very professional guide book.
The most amazing getaway before getting married in the borders! Thank you so much.
Wendy's apartment is located in the heart of historic Edinburgh and gives you a wonderful idea of what it is like to live there - loads of character.

We had a wonderful stay here, and can highly recommend it for anyone needing to stay in Edinburgh.

The room was well presented and comfortable, and the host was very friendly and helpful. Katrina made us feel very welcome, and she gave us plenty of great advice for travelling and things to do in Edinburgh.

Breakfast is provided, and we were given a range of options to choose from, and Katrina was very kind in preparing the table for us in the morning.

There are regular buses into the city centre which stop across the road, and we found them fast enough to take every day so travel isn't an issue. There is also a Morrisons supermarket across the road which is very useful, and the Cameron Toll shopping centre is a 20 minute walk away (or a few stops on the bus).

All in all, we were very happy with our stay here and can gladly recommend it to anyone else. We are very grateful to Katrina for her great hospitality!
Good communication thank you

This was literally the best place I've ever stayed! Perfect location, DEFINITELY worth the price - the apartment is clean and big and light with lots of room for two couples or a family. It was perfect for my friend and i to each have our own private space but to hang out in common areas when we wanted to.  The hosts also met me at midnight because of a late flight which was so so nice, and on top of that they left us bread, cookies, tea and coffee, butter, jam, cereal and milk! Could not ask for lovelier hosts or a lovelier place. Location wise it was a 10 minute walk from everything we wanted to do so that rocked - and a pretty walk at that! It is also located right next to a street with lots of restaurant options. Can't go wrong with this spot.

Thanks, Philip. Great place.
Less than 15 minutes to the Fringe in an Uber.
Beds were super comfortable.
Mark
excellente hôte que nous recommandons.

The location was perfect – close to local attractions, restaurants, and public transportation, making it easy to explore the area. The amenities provided were top-notch, including a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bedding, and fast Wi-Fi, which made my stay even better
Overall, I highly recommend staying at the place. It truly felt like a home
Tres accueillant et soucieux du bien-être.  Merci beaucoup
A delightful house with lots of character. Sally is charming and very welcoming. I felt that all my needs were attended to. I'd stay again very happily.
Perfect quiet place to base out of for a weekend in Edinburgh. Portobello was a great town to explore as well.

Great place very clean and good amenities
I would definitely stay again

The location of this apartment is amazing! Everything we wanted to see was within walking distance. Street noise could be heard from the living room but was never a problem. No noise at all in the bedrooms. Host was super responsive and helpful!

The cottage is beautiful and exactly what we expected.  There were biscuits, milk and tea ready in the kitchen. Everything was clean and well prepared. The location of the cottage was ideal, close to the tram and within easy walking distance of the Royal Mile. The hosts communicated in a very friendly manner and responded very quickly to enquiries.
Lovely apartment with parking.  Great location for walking into Princes Street.   Arrangements for arrival clear and easy to follow.  Some fab eating places nearby.
Martin was fantastic! Flat was perfect location and very nice! Will have to stay again when in Edinburgh!
Great location, close to a tram stop. Deborah was a responsive host and the place was clean and tidy.
It was an amazing stay. Really comfortable apartmant, great location, perfect communication and check in/check out experience. Highly recommended!

Fantastic location and impressive building. Really tiny though. One of us slept on the floor because the bed felt miniature. Very strong (musty) smell off the shower curtain. Overall loved the convenience but for the price would have liked a smell free bathroom
Easy check in, really close to everything!
Great place! Super clean and had everything we needed, from a hair dryer to milk in the fridge. Perfect location too, right by the city center.
Lovely place, very comfortable, nice decor, good heating, good location, everything you need for a short stay

This was a great place to stay that was super close to downtown! We stayed here for several nights and really enjoyed ourselves! Check-in was a breeze, and we appreciated having directions from the airport by bus and on foot. Marcus was very kind. He even helped us when my husband got sick and Marcus happened to have some medicine on hand to help us out. We really appreciated all the hospitality and would definitely recommend his place!

Gemütliche, schön eingerichtete Wohnung, welche die Erwartungen erfüllt hat. Für den Parkplatz mussten wir etwas laufen, war entlang der Warriston Road. Anfangs fehlte das Bettlaken für das zweite Bett, wurde jedoch am selben Tag noch vorbeigebracht. Wir konnten selber kochen was uns wichtig war, leider war das Geschirr etwas schmutzig, vor allem im Verhältnis zu den hohen Reinigungsgebühren. Die Kommunikation war super und schnell.
Really nice place to stay, convenient to the centre the town. Immaculately clean and safe place!!

Great value accommodation. The room was small but comfortable, the apartment had a great location and was very tidy, it occasionally got a bit noisy as it's located just above a busy main street. Overall we had a positive experience, Paul was very helpful and approachable with any questions we had.
Great location, responsive host!

This place is amazing! Even better then the pictures already suggest: the room is so wonderful, special and comfortable.
Dave and Tokes are very lovely hosts and are really keen on making your stay as pleasant as possible. They provided us with a delicious breakfast and an interesting welcome pack including great tips what to see in the city. The place is also perfect located for exploring Edinburgh by feet and it's so easy to reach from the train station. It's at a main road directly at a bus station, but even though the room is completely quiet and peaceful.
Furthermore if you're keen on interior design, music and traveling Dave and Tokes have a lot to offer and they're totally open for a chat or a beer in the evening.
Thanks a lot guys, even if your place would be in Fort William, we would love to come back! ;)
Nice family. Most helpful

We loved the cozy space on the west side. We were treated with the smell of a clean flat and there was shortbread! There was plenty of light and fresh air. The bed was comfortable and kitchen well equipped. It was so easy to get around by bus and there was plenty of good food and shopping close by.

Perfekt og hyggelig beliggenhed i Old Town. Patrick er hjælpsom, imødekommen og nem at tale med. Vi følte os velkomne.
Værelset var fint indrettet og sengen god.
HUSK adapter til de britiske stikkontakter.
It was great. The rooms were very clean and the hosts were very welcoming. It was a great experience.

I was traveling with my family and have stayed at many hostels in the past. This hostel required us to be split up into different rooms even though we clearly booked to be all places in the same room. When we asked why we were not placed in the same room like we booked, we were told that it “wouldn’t be fair to the other guests.” They did not want to keep groups together.
The facility was very nice and clean.

This was a great place to stay during our time in Edinburgh!  The condo was clean and had everything we needed. My daughter was excited to find an extra power adapter in the closet because she brought the wrong one. It was so nice to get a break from our hotel stays and was only a 20-minute drive or cab ride to the main sights (castle, Royal Mile, Scott Monument, etc). We were able to get some laundry done and enjoyed cooking a couple meals in instead of going out. John was very helpful and communicative. We couldn’t have asked for a better host!
The place was very cute and cozy, with everything we needed. We really enjoyed our stay and wished we could have stayed longer than one night. Would recommend :)

Amazing location! Couldn’t have asked for a better location- on the royal mile with bars, pubs, restaurants and shops on your door step and a straight walk up to the castle. We walked everywhere and didn’t get a taxi once! Really safe area and lovely view in the hills. Perfect size and a really nice balcony. Greig was on hand to answer any questions and added lots of small touches. The bottle of Prosecco went down very well.  Don’t hesitate to book this place it’s more than ideal!

We had a great time staying at Rosanne's. The room is fabulous and Portobello is just lovely. We split our time between Portobello and Edinburgh (theatre, ghost bus tour and castle visits had been booked in advance) - very regular buses and reasonable taxi prices if staying out a bit later. Had breakfast at two local cafes (one on beach, one on high street) would love to visit again.
No problem at all with shared bathroom.

Perfect respite in the middle of a month-long European tour. We enjoyed the quiet neighborhood, well appointed kitchen, comfortable living room, clean beds and inclusion of a washing machine! Easy access via bus 23 to the tourist sections of Edinburgh.
Only issue we had was with the heat/hot water. Remote thermostat was reporting temperatures 8-10 degrees warmer than actual temp, so boiler would not turn on. Clare was quick to respond, but unable to correct. We found a work-around for our stay and Clare assured us she would have it repaired. Didn’t feel it warranted less than 5 stars, as everything else was great. Just want future guests to be aware that this is now a known problem. If host fails to correct, then lower rating may be warranted.
En super lejlighed. Flottere end på billederne. Top service. Super beliggenhed. Kan godt finde på at komme til samme lejlighed igen. Tak for denne gang.
Great communication beforehand and location is brilliant .

Staying with Joyce was lovely.  She was so helpful and took better care of us than we had right to expect.  Accommodations were comfortable and the breakfast was wonderful.  It was nice being so close to all of Old Town.  Bus stop and train station close too.  It was the perfect spot with a perfect host.

Lovely apartment. Clean as a whistle. Great location and great host.
Highly recommended and will stay here again.
Ana has worked hard to make a clean and comfortable place.
Amazing hostel located right at prime location with great facilities
This was a clean, comfortable, well-equipped and very central base to explore Edinburgh from.
Beautiful apartment away from the city centre with a nice sea view and parking just downstairs. Room was cosy and bed was super comfortable. Had a Nespresso machine too which was a plus.

Carol and her husband were very welcoming and had lots of great suggestions around the city. The bed was super comfy, sheets were clean, and the flat itself was stylish. The location is a straight walk to princess street and waverly station, takes about 20 min. There's lots of shops, cafes, mini mart, bars around the place and it was very safe to walk around the city at night! Thanks again!

Stuart was our best host by far during our trip to the UK! He was there to personally meet us and he also helped us carry our luggage up the 4 flights of stairs! After showing us around his charming home, he also left us a welcome kit to listings of restaurants/stores around his neighborhood.  His place was neat but most importantly, welcoming! The views of Calton Hill from his unit was breathtaking!  Stuart was very responsive to our questions and recommendations, and was very easy to get a hold of via text. I highly recommend his place. It was easy access to the Waverley Train Station and The Royal Mile. I wish we had more time to spend in Edinburgh and the Highlands. We loved immersing ourselves in its history and culture. I would come back here in a heartbeat and stay again at Stuart's home.

Linda s'est montrée très accueillante et nous as permis de découvrir en sa compagnie des lieux que nous n'aurions très certainement pas vu dans le cas contraire.
Nous avons eu l'impression d'avoir passé un séjour chez une amie.

My friends and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Anthony's apartment. It was spotlessly clean and was exactly as described. Easy check-in/check-out and Anthony kept in touch before, during and after our stay. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for somewhere to stay in Edinburgh.
the little location us outstanding and near Morrisons. The place is exactly as described and Paul is very hospital and he left cookies for us.

Fiona’s accommodation was ideal for our short Edinburgh visit - a comfortable room with everything we needed, and very conveniently located within easy walking distance of the city centre.  Thank you.  We hope to be able to stay again sometime in the future.
Good location easy to walk to heart of Edinburgh.  Host offered good recommendations for local Coffee shops etc. Room and bathroom could do with a bit of TLC
Flott beliggenhet. Sentralt. Ok standard
Tout s’est parfaitement passé, Katarzyna est très gentille, très réactive aux demandes et donne beaucoup d’instructions. Hôte de qualité !

Great spot in Edinburgh to explore the city, directly on Grassmarket. I enjoyed having my coffee via the Nespresso machine in the morning overlooking the castle. Comfortable, lovely decor, all amenities to make a great base.
Lovely cute place in an amazing location. Very well layed out and feels quite private even though it's only a private room.

Totally sumptuous en suite room in a fantastic area of Edinburgh. Rubi has a glorious home & shares it very generously. The bed is maybe the most comfortable I've ever slept in & the private bathroom is perfect- such an ideal place to rest & an easy walk to everywhere in town. We had some lovely chats in the kitchen over coffee and breakfast too - she's a total gem of a host & I loved my stay
We love this place would definitely visit again.

The place is located in a quiet neighbourhood but still 5-min walk to the tram stop that brings you to the city centre. The room is very spacious as well. Moreover, Teeny is a great host who is not just fun to chat with, but also kind and helpful!
Cosy little flat, very convenient for our weekend trip!
Lovley appartement. Very clean and spacious. Perfectly situated to explore Edinburgh. Highly recommened.

Todo perfecto para dos o tres días. Sin embargo, si vas 6 días como nosotros,  la limpieza es un problema ya que no hay ni una escoba ni una fregona para mantenerlo limpio. Por lo demás ninguna queja, todo lo contrario, el apartamento está bonito decorado, las camas son cómodas, está cerca del centro y de la estación de tren. Recomendable
We’ve stayed at Allan’s other flat before - this week was super-convenient. Allan is a delightful host.

Logement très sympa, spacieux, confortable, bien équipé. Tout était conforme aux photos.
L'emplacement était parfait, environnement calme avec des commerces de proximité, Old Town à 30min à pied et très proche pour faire l'ascension d'Arthur's Seat.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour.
We loved our stay at the apartment. It was so close to everything and had great amenities!
lovely host and very comfortable room
Great spacious appartment.

We had a fabulous stay at Eddie’s  place for New Years.  The location is amazing as was the view of the castle for the fireworks.  Eddie’s place is well equipped and a great place for quality time with family and friends. Eddie was super responsive and flexible.  Highly recommend!

Great stay on Rose Street! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. The location is fantastic – right in the heart of Edinburgh, close to shops, restaurants, and attractions. Would definitely recommend.

L'appartamento di Mario e' esattamente come descritto e rispecchia le fotografie.
Io e il mio ragazzo ci abbiamo soggiornato per tre notti e ci siamo trovati molto bene. L'appartamento di Mario e' accogliente, il letto e' molto comodo e dispone di tutto il necessario per sentirvi a vostro agio durante il vostro soggiorno ad Edinburgo.
Dista pochi minuti dalla fermata del bus che vi porta in poco piu' di 5 minuti dlla stazione del treno dalla quale potete poi incamminarvi verso le attrazioni della citta'.
Nelle vicinanze trovate negozi e caffetterie e non molto distanti anche ristornati.
Comunicare con Mario e' stato facile in quanto e' stato molto veloce nel rispondere alle nostre domande. Mario e' stato molto gentile nel venirci incontro con l'orario del nostro check-in.
Abbiamo usufruito del servizio di check-in autonomo che e' stato molto semplice.
Se siete alla ricerca di un comodo alloggio durante il vostro soggiorno a Edinburgo non esitate a prenotare questo appartamento.

I was only here for the night, but I really enjoyed my stay. The bed was sooo comfortable and there was tea in the kitchen to enjoy. the host was kind enough to supply washing tablets for my clothing. It’s not far from the train, and there were plenty of busses around to bring you around the city. I went for breakfast at a recommended bakery and it was DELICIOUS. I recommend staying here. You’re safe, secure, and have everything you need.

Daniela's fine og rummelige lejlighed passede perfekt til vores families behov. Alt har været som forventet eller endnu bedre. Daniela's tydelige instruktioner til fx check-in i lejligheden, hvordan man kommer fra lufthavnen, aktiviteter og spisesteder i nærområdet osv. har gjort vores ophold ekstra bekvemt. Vi giver Daniela vores allerbedste anbefalinger.

This is a great place to stay! Ground floor flat near a beautiful park and easy access to so many places in Edinburgh. Place was comfortable and had all the basic needs, plus it was cool and calm during the warmer outside temperatures! Paul was very helpful and easy to communicate with.

The Cabin is a great place to stay. Beautiful decor, comfortable and in a great location for visiting the city of Edinburgh (20 minute drive/40 minute bus ride) or the surrounding area. Gill and Colin were very helpful. We would definitely stay again if visiting Edinburgh.

We stayed in Zinovia place for 3 nights and it was a great experience. She is very friendly and makes us feel home immediately. The house is very quiet and our room is clean, fresh linen and comfortable mattress. I would definitely stay here again if I visit Edinburgh in future. Thank you very much for treat us so well!!!

this apartment is operated by professionals. They communicate diligently and clearly. They adapted the apartment just as requested to accommodate our baby. It's sufficiently well equipped to cook without hassle, and ask laundry equipment was furnished. The building is extremely quiet and is a very good base to explore the heart of the city.

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment. It is very handy for local shops/pubs/restaurants and not too far to walk into city. Bus stop closs by too. The hosts were very helpful in answering any queries we had. We would have no hesitation in staying here again on our next visit to Edinburgh 👌😊
If you are looking for a flat to stay in a really nice part of Edinburgh for not look any further! Really well decorate! Well equipped! In a superbe location! And the host are super welcoming!
mooi studio appartement, op loop afstand van het kasteel en het centrum. prima verblijf voor meer dan één nacht.
Great place, I will come back again.

Nice place, nice location.  Being on the 3rd floor, 3 sets of stairs up, with no elevator, can be a bit challenging to an older crowd.  Especially with luggage.  But, it was a great place and location for enjoying the heart of Edinburgh.

This is a beautiful mews building in the heart of new (old) town. The place itself is well decorated, has everything you will need, and incredibly comfortable. The location is very easy both to Stockbridge / the rest of Edinburgh and to more touristy areas. Easy check in, great communication, and as listed. I would stay again!
Our stay was wonderful.  Great location.   The furniture was not the most comfortable.  However, we didn’t come to sit.  The short walk up to the royal mile was the best
Harry's place had a great feel and easy to walk to the city center! I would definitely stay again and recommend to anyone looking for a great place to stay!
Thank you so much for amazing hospitalities.
excellent position in Old town, close to the Royal Mile. The host was very effective in communication. He also gave us the possibility to check in early in the morning. Very recommended.

Jennet’s place was cozy and welcoming. The host answered any questions I had, and she had  very good knowledge of attractions, restaurants and the area in general. Perfect for single or couple travellers.
Unser Aufenthalt war ausgezeichnet. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber, gut gelegen und beinhaltete alles, was wir benötigten :) Wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder dorthin zurück!
Really lovely stay and fantastic communication from Peter. Great area and lovely neighbourhood - highly recommend

After many weeks of work and travel, we were grateful to land at Fariba's place.  Edinburgh's pathways are like portals -- ours lead literally from the Royal Mile into a beautiful and peaceful courtyard.  Fariba's place is bright, warm and spacious.  The kitchen had everything we needed, and the flat offered lots of comfortable places to rest and read.  Edinburgh's historic places, along with a multitude of shops, pubs, and restaurants, lie just a few steps away (back through the portal). One day, we walked out the door and took a 7-mile hike around Holyrood.  We usually don't stay in the middle of an Old Town district, due to concerns about crowds and bustle, but we made an exception this time and were glad we did.
Allan is truly an awesome and kind host, next time travelling to Edinburgh I will try to get a spot on his Airbnb again!

Alojamiento fantástico, céntrico y muy bonito, nos sentimos como en casa! Solo tuvimos un pequeño problema con las sábanas de la cama extra y Ross nos lo solucionó al instante. Volveríamos sin dudarlo.
Great place

Beautiful apartment. The photos on the listing definitely don't do it justice. So spacious and comfortable and had everything we needed. The apartment is in a lovely location within walking distance to many sites. Check-in instructions were very clear and we were even allowed an earlier check-in. Unfortunately our train was delayed and we didn't end up getting in earlier but we greatly appreciated that the host was so accommodating.
Lovely stay but felt the mattress was very soft and not that comfortable. Very easy to get around and go places as flat was very central.
Very good

This airbnb has the potential for a 5 star Stay in Edinburgh but lacks to get the Full Range of Stars because it‘s pretty Dirty with a Strange smell of urine. The Checkin was really easy with a quick two minute guide threw the Apartment. By checkin at the bar under the Apartment, we quickly noticed a Strange and strong smell of urine in the air. In the bedroom i had to Switch my sleeping Position because somehow the smell managed to get threw the floor all the way up into the Apartment. There also is much of dust all over the Apartment. We also couldn‘t Drink out of the glasses in the Kitchen because They were dirty too, so we had to clean them First. The couch also was Dirty with stains on it and idk maybe breadcrumbs inside. We also didnt feel well with using the towels because they smelled bad. The big bed was okay, the other 2 Little extra beds were pretty saggy, okay for sleep but Not really comfortable.
Potential for 5 Stars, with all the dirt maybe Barely 3 Stars worth it.

The apartment was very clean, well-organized, and comfortable, just what we needed. The location was also excellent, close to everything but still quiet and relaxing.
What really stood out was the host. He was incredibly helpful, kind, and always quick to respond. He went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed, and we truly appreciated his support during our stay.
Thank you so much for everything, we’d definitely stay here again!
Lovely peaceful stay. about 15/20 mins walk to bars and restaurants on the Royal mile.

Thomas has been a great host. Really fast in answering all our questions. The apartment was exactly as described with all the facilities in a very quiet area. There are a couple of buses in a walking distance (5-7min) that can take you to the central area, a mall nearby (10-13 min walking)  to get some groceries. There are unmarked parking spots in front of the building - which was great for us, coming in by car. All in all it was a great experience and I warmly recommend Thomas as a host for your trip in Edinburgh.
Nice room within walking distance to all attractions. Quiet neighbourhood and close to various. restaurants.
very comfortable
The apartment was well placed for our needs. Well outside the Edinburgh LEZ which caught me out on initially arriving in Edinburgh, easy for buses and taxis.
great apartment near the centre!
Good

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit bei Florence. Sie war eine sehr gute Gastgeberin und hat uns versucht jeden wunsch zu ermöglichen. Sie hat uns tipps für die Stadt gegeben und sich häufig nach unserem Wohlempfinden erkundigt. Die Lange der Wohnung war ebenfalls gut. Die Stadt sowie der Strand waren leicht zu Fuß erreichbar und es befindet sich eine bahn und bushaltestelle an der wohnung. Trotzdessen war es sehr ruhig in der Wohnung.

This was a wonderful spot very close to the heart of Edinburgh! The apartment was very nice and Graeme was wonderful. We had a little issue with the dryer (still not sure what happened, but we take full blame) and although it probable caused Graeme a headache, he was extremely gracious and helpful. I would 100% recommend 47 Thistle Street to anyone wanting the full Edinburgh experience! Thanks again for your kindness and hospitality!

Brilliant accommodation and Scott was fantastic, even let us store our bags as we arrived early. The place is spoltless and had everything we needed. We were a couple with a two year old and the crib was set up for us with pillow and blankets ready. The hall of the building is a bit tired and poorly lit but it’s not a reflection of the recently renovated, bright flat. Highly recommend
Great accomodation, would strongly recommend. Extremely comfy bed
10/10 location. Great place, spacious, bright and airy. Perfect place to stay in Edinburgh. Highly recommend.

What a beautiful, comfortable, and quiet location! Absolutely spotless inside, great facilities, and couldn’t be more central: everything is walkable. I can’t recommend this property highly enough and will definitely be back.
Aurore’s flat is absolutely perfect- from the location to the view of the castle, it exceeded our expectations. Also, great communication from the host to ensure our stay was great!

Overall, happy with the apartment.
Good
- Large enough for 6 people to be comfortable
- Secure, off the street parking is great
- Convenient small grocery and pharmacy
- Good places to eat (we recommend Teutchers) and a shopping mall are within a 15 minute walk
Not so good
- This is NOT convenient to most of Edinburgh's attractions and you will need to take a bus or drive if you want to visit most of Edinburgh
- It is on a busy street and the street noise can be very bad. It echoes up the building into the apartment and you can hear people on the street like they are right outside the window. We were woken up several times by loud people on the street below. It might not be so bad if you can keep the windows closed, but it was hot, and we needed to keep them open.

Amazing! So clean and cosy with all the amenities you can think of. There was a lot of extra homely touches that just makes the stay so comfortable and enjoyable. The location is also great!  I Highly highly recommend this apartment and can’t wait to go back.
Great place, the location made it really easy to explore everything in the centre of town and it was nice and quiet despite being so central.

We enjoyed our stay--especially the pub downstairs! It was so fun and had a really cool vibe. The flat is quiet, clean and in a superb location. We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go which was great for us! We had some issues that were quickly resolved because of Hanne's quick and consistent responses. Would definitely recommend her flat to anybody!

The room is in a shared apartment, small but very nice, perfect for who's traveling alone. The position of the apartment is very good, pretty close to the center (about 15mins walking). The area is nice and quiet. Carol and her husband were very kindly to wait for me till late in the night and telling me something about the city. I'll suggest their apartment to my friends!
endroit tranquille pour séjourner et très propre. le bus passe a proximité et met 20 min pour rejoindre waverly station. je recommande.
Great flat, in a great location. It was perfect for our needs. Loved Edinburgh.

Perfect location, everything within a walking distance. Flexible host, answered my messages within few minutes, flexible check-in was also possible. Good choice of restaurants and pubs in the area.
Windows didnt have the best insulation and you could feel wind coming through and it was abit noisy at night. Nevertheless worth the visit!
Very hospitable and a good location

Would recommend and return there
Perfect stay 😊

Anna is very friendly and helpful. The apartment is clean and located in a calm neighborhood. It is 30-45 minutes from the center by bus, with a bus stop 2 minutes from the apartment. The apartment has 4 rooms. I stayed for one month and had an easy stay. Thank you, Anna! Recommended!!!

Andrew and Jenny have a flat in a prime location on the royal mile, right in the heart of the old town. Sadly my stay was marred by several maintenance issues (blocked shower, curtain rail almost collapsing over TV, wooden wall panel falling over in kitchen) and a clunky check-in process due to difficulties finding the flat with somewhat unclear instructions (I had to end up getting a second cab which took me to the same place according to the instructions that was no where near the flat). However, Andrew and Jenny were speedy to respond to me and to try and facilitate fixing said maintenance issues, but unfortunately could not be done whilst I was there. It didn't impede my stay, but paying a premium price for a flat, one does expect some level of standards in place. They did rectify some missing hand towels which I appreciated! It is a really lovely flat- cozy, modern with a traditional edge, I unfortunately just had a bit of a bumpy experience.
Anji was a great host and very accommodating. The location wouldn’t be better and the place was wonderful. Highly recommend!!
Lovely flat in the city centre. Loads of room.
I had a wonderful time in Claire's very cosy and super equipped appartement. The location is perfect but the place still quiet, the patio is very nice. Just loved it!

We had a wonderful stay with our family. Clean & cozy place. Easy access to Holyrood Park. 30 mins walk / 5 mins ride to New Town or Royal Mile.
We would definitely come back when we visit Edinburgh again!

Incroyable accueil chez Alex ! Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour, et reviendrons sans hésitation.
Alex nous a fait sentir comme chez nous et c'est une personne vraiment très intéressante qui aime le contact humain !
Location, Location, Location. Perfect place to explore Edinburgh and steps from the Royal Mile. Great stay!
Good(👍ᐛ )
Thank you!

Het was een fijn appartement wat best gelegen lag. Klein half uurtje lopen en je was in de drukte van Edinburgh. De kamer was opgeruimd en lag wat lekkers, thee mokken, thee en koffie. Erg aangenaam om s’avonds of s’ochtends te nuttigen! Natalia is een lieve host die duidelijke instructies geeft hoe je naar het appartement komt en waar je alles kan vinden. Mijn moeder en ik hebben een fijn verblijf gehad en ontzettend genoten van onze tijd in Schotland.

Wonderful flat in a central location. Super close to the museums and galleries as well as the castle. There a lot of fantastic cafes/restaurants/pubs nearby. Additionally, there's a big M&S and a Sainsbury's local if you prefer cooking. The flat itself is great too. Relatively spacious, the kitchen has everything and anything you would need for cooking. Maybe the only thing to keep in mind, is that because it is so central, sometimes at nights you can hear people coming back from club/bars/night out but we did not find it too disturbing. The host, Andrew, was amazing as well. We had a couple issues that came up during our stay and he sorted out all of them quickly. All in all a wonderful place to stay. Would definitely recommend as well as come back to it again. :D

Apartamento bem localizado e bem equipado mas necessita de reformar alguns móveis como os colchões algo desconfortáveis e camas que fazem imenso barulho quando nos mexemos a dormir.
Necessita também de melhorar na limpeza.

Bra boende med rätt nära till det mesta. Ganska lyhört och mycket ljud från gatan, trafiken osv. Fönstrena är väldigt gamla så det blåser rätt igenom.
Annars var vi väldigt nöjda med allting och all service vi fick, Eddie var väldigt hjälpsam om man undrade något :)
The flat was fantastic! It was stocked with everything we needed. It is in a perfect location for easy access to the Royal Mile. Free parking was a huge bonus. We would definitely book again.
Lovely place to stay! Very clean and has everything you would require for a stay. Close to the city centre with plenty parking outside. Would definitely stay again!

The bathroom and toilet easy to use, a bit small, if you prefer spacious stays, but totally manageable for us. We liked the special touches like books to read in the toilet room and earplugs on the nightstands.
Natalia was kind, welcoming, communicated and shared local recommendations. She even left us a little anniversary gift. Very thoughtful.
We would stay here again ten times out of ten. Easy for walking to nearby restaurants and we felt perfectly safe walking back from the castle late night after dinner about 20 minutes. If you get the chance to, pop in to the Abbey next door for breakfast, for a pint or some whiskey. Lovely spot.
Thank you, Natalia!
Amazing place at a brilliant location, we didnt want to leave!

Daniel is a man of his word. Everything listed is exactly what should be expected. We had a lovely time staying there. Thank you Daniel.
Shout-out to Word of Mouth (cafe right next to the location) for being adorable and delicious!

Kornelia’s place was excellent - beautiful location, quiet and clean. Our welcome pack was very generous and had everything we needed to get us through our short stay. We will definitely look to book again the next time we’re in Edinburgh!

Very comfortable, modern, stylish apartment. Everything needed was provided and the towels and sheets were of high quality. The apartment was spotlessly clean. Great location - just in front of Charlotte Square and at the top of Princes' Street. Excellent communication & easy check-in.
Accommodation was very lovely and comfortable. Ethel is nice woman. It is very close to the airport.
Beautiful apartment, highly recommend!

El hospedaje de Daniela, es impecable, todo muy pulcro y limpio

La cama muy cómoda, así también la habitación en si y queda muy cerca de una estación de tranvia

The apartment is really beautiful and central. Perfect walking distance to all the main sights. It was also very clean and comfortable. The hosts were very helpful and gave lots of tips for our visit.

Great one night stay , the room was cool, Rui was very welcoming ,the food was G R E A T .
Do not hesitate !
the flat was a great base for a few days in Edinburgh. it is in an ideal location in the city. The flat is very comfortable and has everything you might need
Great host, beautiful home
We had a brilliant stay. The location is perfect for exploring Edinburgh with great transport links close to the apartment. It was clean and spacious.

We had a great time staying at Lyn’s place. It’s a beautiful apartment with a stunning view and the communication/check in was perfect. The kitchen was well equipped and everything was super comfortable. Highly recommended.
Lovely room, it’s exactly as per the pictures. The bathroom is cute and clean. The hosts are very friendly and reachable.

Duncan's flat is the perfect home from home if you are planning a trip to Edinburgh. Great location, short walk to all the transport centres, close to all the amenities, the old town, does and restaurants. Would highly recommend Duncan's place.

Manigeh was a wonderful host & so accommodating especially when my flight was delayed.
The room was spacious and very comfortable & the bathroom was wonderful. Just loved the power-shower!
Arden Street is well placed for all the attractions that Edinburgh offers.
Thanks Manigeh for a great stay. I hope to be back soon🤞
4th time at Ken’s and always a reliable and comfortable stay. Cheers Ken

We had an absolutely fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Edinburgh. The location is truly unbeatable and right in the heart of everything. You can easily hail a taxi, catch a nearby bus, and it’s just a short walk from the airport tram drop-off, which made getting around incredibly convenient.
One of the highlights was the stunning view of the castle. It really doesn’t get better than this in terms of both scenery and accessibility.
The check-in process was also incredibly smooth thanks to the super thorough, top-notch instructions for getting the keys. Everything was clearly explained and very easy to follow, which made arrival completely stress-free.
We did have a minor issue during our stay, but Aileen responded immediately and resolved it without any delay. Her responsiveness and care made a great stay even better.
Overall, this is a wonderful place to stay, and we highly recommend it!

A very nice place for family stay, an apartment close to a big house with private parking.
You have all in the apartment for your stay except washing machine, you can spend very independent life there when you travel in Edinburgh, the hosts are really kind and taking care to us, if we have any need, they are there (unfortunately we haven’t more than one), they give the good advice for you to go out in the city, we have very very good days there but pretty short, if we come back, that will be the first choice for our next trip.
Thanks Pauline and Mike!

My family and I had a lovely time staying at Karen's place. It looked as nice as it did in the photos and was spotless. It is very easy to find in the Royal Mile and a walking distance from the train station. Karen is a great host, very responsive and helpful in making sure our stay went well. Definitely would stay there again if I come back to Edinburgh.
Un apartamento muy bien situado, justo al lado de grassmarket, con vistas al castillo. Está muy limpio y con cosas básicas como papel aluminio o tiritas

Me sentí muy cómoda en la casa de Ben, ya que la cama era cómoda y pude  descansar perfectamente. Ben fué muy generoso compartiendome café y pan por las mañanas. Muchas gracias!
Great location. Nice clean place and host was really helpful.

Our stay at Holly’s was unfortunately cut short due to the train strikes, forcing us to leave a day early. But the time we did spend there was great. The apartment feels so homely and welcoming, and Holly and the two super sweet cats definitely helped with that! Holly was super communicative, even let us in earlier during her lunch break. The bedroom is spacious and the bed comfortable. The neighbourhood is nice and quiet, and the walk (uphill) to town very doable (when it’s not a rare 30 degrees, that is..). Would recommend!
Excellent place to stay to experience Edinburgh. Thoroughly recommend.
Excellent communication. Super responsive. Wonderful views over the water. Quiet but still close to city. Walking distance to Asda for groceries. Definitely would return to.

This was an excellent stay and spacious.
Walkable to new and old town.
Wunderschöne Wohnung mit zentraler Lage. Kann ich mit bestem Gewissen weiterempfehlen.

It was a lovely apartment, clean and cosy. The view from the windows was the best. Traveling to the city centre or Leith was short and easy, and the host provided good recommendations and tips. Our stay went smoothly and communication with the host was easy. I would definitely recommend it.

Nous n avons pas rencontre notre hôte, mais la communication écrite était correcte. L acces au Chalet n  est pas en faveur du logement. Le parking gratuit est dans la rue d à côté. Mention spéciale  l ambiance intérieure avec la cheminée. Sans breakfast le tarif pourrait être revu à la baisse.

Afterall if I look at the pros and cons, it was worth it and would give thid accomodation 4/5 as it needs further improvements to reach 5 stars.

Our stay on Marita’s home was nice.  Super clean environment in a perfect location within walking distance to popular tourist attractions.  Cereal, fruit, milk and coffee are provided which was appreciated.
The apartment was clean and spacious and in a great central location. All instructions were clearly communicated prior to arrival which made the stay hassle free. Many thanks

Kelly’s place is super cool, clean and comfortable!  My husband and I had a private bedroom and our 26-yr old son  slept in the living room on a comfy fold out couch. We loved the apartment! Very clean and comfortable! Thanks again!

Great experience 👍
Highly recommended, it’s worth to stay at this place.

Had such a wonderful stay. Great location. everything is walking distance. and the room was space and comfortable. would definitely book again on the next visit. keep up the great work Andy.
Peaceful room

We had such a great stay at Ali and Al’s for our time in Edinburgh! The place was beautiful and either close by where we wanted to go or with easy access to public transport. Fantastic time Edinburgh, the place was so clean and in a great location. Most importantly the host was always in contact, very helpful and awesome reviews. Highly recommend!

Le logement correspondait parfaitement à la description de l'annonce. Chambre spatieuse et fonctionnelle et impeccable. Maria est une hôte réactive et disponible qui a toujours répondu à nos questions. On recommande !

Martin’s apartment is conveniently located in old town of Edinburgh while also being walking distance from New Town. This listing was just as expected! It was super pretty and had a beautiful view of the castle! The room was super clean and had great amenities! Couldn't recommend more!!

Mhairi and Douglas are really friendly and helpful, and their dog is just the cutes ever, the location is perfect to get to the center, the area is super quiet and I could have the best night sleep in their comfy bed. All the neighbourhood is really friendly as well.
I had a amazing stay!! ✨
We could check out later that was nice. Location great.

Das Appartement bietet alles, was man bei einem Städtetrip braucht. Zentrumsnah, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel gleich um die Ecke, ebenso tolle Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. A welcoming home from home. Great location for being accessible to all streets and castle. Lots to do close to the property and the next door neighbour is great!

Had a great stay at Mays B&B. Flat was warm clean cosey. Beds were comfortable. Lovely touch of fresh milk and biscuits on arrival.
Jackie was a really good host, the flat was lovely and very well located. Would definitely recommend.

Edinburgh is a Must visit city

Excellent apartment with easy access to the city centre.

Monica's condo was very clean and the location was great. Most importantly, Monica was the best host. She was very responive and got back to us quickly if we had any questions. We would definitely stay at Monica's again and would recommend it to our friends and family.

Amazing! Flat was way better than the photos - absolutely massive. Bright with high ceilings and pristine. Felt and looked way bigger than the photos especially the kitchen and living room. Host could not have been more responsive and nice. Perfect location a short walk to the old city, tons of restaurants right nearby.
Great place, decor is excellent and everything you may need is there. Plus the biggest TV I have ever seen. Really nice place.
Best location! Just a few steps of the train station. Cem was an amazing host, always available and responsive!

We booked this for a work trip and it was easy to jump on a tram straight from the airport and super easy to get back on the tram to get into the centre of Edinburgh in about 15 minutes. Although there isn't anything other than a co-op in the immediate vicinity that was absolutely fine for us.
The accommodation is quiet, homely, easy to find and in a residential area. It had everything we needed and a full kitchen. 2 double bedrooms with plenty of storage and a lot go space in the communal areas.
Convenient, clean and a great spot to explore the city from away from the bustle of the centre.
Host was very responsive for all queries!
Fantastic apartment, very spacious. Great service from Margaret. 5 stars.
Absolutely magnificent apartment!  The location  is probably the best in Edinburgh to see everything.  Clean, stylish and wonderful place. Thank you!!

Carol’s place is perfect for exploring Edinburgh. Right on the Royal Mile and perfect for discovering the Old and New Towns of Edinburgh.  We loved the place and it was well equipped.  We would stay there again if we go back to Scotland.

Had a wonderful stay at James' apartment in Edinburgh with my family including my wife and kids as well as my parents. The apartment is in an ideal location to both land in Scotland as well as explore the sights of the city. The space itself is beautiful and gets wonderful light. Would love to stay here again. James was a great host and wonderful communicator.

We had a great stay at Alessandros !
The room was approx a 20 min bus from city centre and then 10 min walk from the bus stop. Alessandro had provided us with great directions and which bus we needed to take. Alessandro was a great host, allowed us privacy but checked in via messages and was very fast to respond if we needed anything. He also provided a taxi service the morning of our early flight which was fantastic. Would highly recommend!
Rea is a great host and help us a lot. The house is clean and tidy, great location and great view.

Michelle’s place has good ambiance, characteristic of the older times of that area. Great wooden floors, windows, kitchen is modern.

Nice room with what you need, clean bathroom and well-functioning kitchen. Rory has helpful instructions and descriptions! Thank you!
Great location with easy access to the bus stop.  The place was comfortable and there was plenty of space for my husband and I.  Really enjoyed our time there!
Amazing apartment with all the amenities you could want.
Great place to stay if your visiting Edinburgh
Victoria was a great host and the room is cosy, warm and perfect after a day of exploring the city. The location is ideal for the city centre and getting to/from the airport too.
Great stay at Mel’s beautiful waterside apartment, well connected to the West End with regular buses. She really welcomed me into her home.

Très bien situé, bien équipé. Personnel très accueillant, merci.
Juste un petit bémol : Ma chambre donnait sur le rue, où il y a un bar et il y avait des travaux, donc ça occasionnait un peu de bruit, et j'ai préféré laisser les stores fermés le temps de mon séjour.
