A comfortable flat with everything required for a short stay. It is in a lovely area, parking is a bonus! Good pubs and restaurants very close by. Easy access to trams, which are very efficient.

I had a fabulous stay. Communication with Andrew and Mark was friendly and helpful.  The apartment is tastefully furnished, well-equipped, clean, and comfortable. A great location, in a quiet beautiful crescent, only a 15-20 minute walk from Waverley Railway station and the city centre. I would highly recommend and would definitely visit again.
Amazing flat. Walking distance to city centre and calton hill. Outside of flat had some rubbish but inside is beautiful very spacious.

Colin’s apartment looks exactly like it does in the pictures. Excellent location. Probably walking distance to centre of the city. (Less than a fiver by Uber)
Was there for the marathon, perfectly suited our needs.

My partner and I really enjoyed this air bnb! Wish we had more time there! Co-host Ken was very kind and always there to help! They sent great recommendations for Edinburgh and were very flexible. Would definitely recommend :) not to mention the cutest room ever

We had a great time! Olivia is a lovely host, she was very helpful and easy to communicate with.
The apartment is beautiful and very well equipped. Everything was spotlessly clean.

We would definitely come back!

Even so because of the location I would stay here again as the apartment is a short walk to tram and bus stops, as well as a Tesco and shopping mall.
Amazing location, right in the center of the city. Beautiful, well thought out space. It's large enough that if you are staying for a more extended period you would be quite comfortable/happy!

Sinan has done a superb job of making his flat comfortable, modern and extremely clean. It is in a very quiet neighborhood, but very walkable to the city center. We would stay here again! (Three adults)
We enjoyed our stay

I would definitely recommend this property and like to say thanks.

Carole's place was easy to find, and she had already very helpfully told us where to park. Our room was spotlessly clean, very tastefully decorated, as was our bathroom which was virtually ensuite.  Lovely shower and double sinks with toiletries.  Our breakfasts were great, my husband was treated to smoked salmon and scrambled egg, while I enjoyed fresh fruit and cereal, although ham and cheese and yoghurt were also available.  The coffee was lovely!  We couldn't have asked for better. The place itself is within easy walking distance of Edinburgh city centre and everything that it has to offer.  Would definitely recommend, and definitely return next time we stay in Edinburgh.

Great location and a wonderful place to stay. Although very near Grassmarket, the apartment was quiet and a bit removed from traffic and noise. We would highly recommend it for your stay in Edinburgh.
we had a lovely stay at Tom & Izzy's apartment. beautifully decorated and perfectly clean. thank you!
Great location walkable to Edinburgh Castle. Lots of restaurants choices within walking distance. Charming old world feel with all the conveniences.
Lovely, clean flat in such a perfect location, easy to walk to both tram and zoo! Perfect for a holiday.

A homey flat above shops in Leith, a lovely Edinburgh neighborhood, with books, three TVs, bath, comfy sofas, spacious rooms. Easy to reach the centre by tram, or we walked along the river, which takes about an hour - such a great way to get to know the city.

Sehr gute und schnelle Kommunikation , schöne Wohnung in der Nähe der Altstadt und pubs
Very nice Airbnb.  Spacious rooms and clean. Hosts were responsive.  Great location within walking distance to tourist sites.

For the price you pay, you get an amazing stay. Plus, a breakfast is included. Cong is a great host, very friendly as well as his wife. Clean little apartment in a great location.   Well equipped with everything you need for a short stay.

It was a pleasure to stay at Andrew's. Easy going and quiet, he gave us great tips about the city. His place is perfectly located. I would totally recommend for a quick stay in Edinburgh!

Perfect location! Very close to Grassmarket pubs and incredible view of the castle from the balcony. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone looking for the perfect location to explore Edinburgh.

The location of Paul's place is brilliant. So nice to be able to do an early morning walk up Arthur's seat or walk into the old town. The flat itself was clean and functional and stylishly decorated. Everything was clean and comfortable. Would recommend and would stay again.

Mike and Pauline are great hosts, always quick to get back to you if you have any questions and to help rectify any issues. Great location, with all you need right on your doorstep! Would happily stay again.

Place is just 15-20 mins away from the princess street through Bus. Morrisons supermarket is near by to grab anything also to get for the airport also 10-15 mins walkable from Josh’s place.

Cute, clean and easy access to pretty much everything. Plenty of restaurants a street over, and easy walk into Old Town. Skye’s place is charming as can be.
Don’t forget to explore New Town, Holyrood park and take a tour w Rabbie’s - all highlights of our trip. We’ll be back, Scotland!
我非常喜欢Tracey, 她很有耐心，对待我像对待家人一样。有一天我从伦敦回来很晚，她站在门口等我直到晚上11点，我非常感动。家里的两只猫很安静很可爱，我爱这里的一切！谢谢Tracey的陪伴，明年我会回来看望您的。

Claire was a very friendly host, and the room was very comfortable. The heated bed was very nice, and kept the room cozy. The location was very peaceful and quiet, but had a direct bus line to and from the city which made transportation easy. We enjoyed our stay here, thanks Claire!

Glenn’s place is the perfect home base for exploring Edinburgh! While a little outside city centre, it was an easy 20 minute walk to high street and the old town. The apartment is very spacious and equipped with everything you need to make you feel at home. The bed is also really comfortable and it was relatively quiet at night. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend to anyone looking to stay in Edinburgh!

Good location in the city - convenient to old town and Grassmarket. We enjoyed the amenities - being able to eat in and do our laundry was particularly nice after a lot of traveling. The apartment was clean and comfortable.
very nice and spacious  home with all appliances. Location is inside the city. Car parking is available and host responds quickly.

Edward's place is very nice and comfortable. Has a nice view and with great natural light. You are at walking distance from many restaurantes and downtown (if you don't mind walking a bit more). We barely had to use public transportation, so it's a great location.
The flat is equipped with everything you may need during your stay, and Edward was kind enough to even leave us a little welcome present. Thank you!
Would recommend this place to other travelers.
A lovely Airbnb just as described, great communication from the host.

Tosi hyvä neljän hengen porukalle, voin suositella lämpimästi. Varaamisen yhteydessä piti todistella ettemme ole polttariporukka, ja muutenkin viestintää oli minun makuuni hieman liikaa, mutta toisaalta majoittajan viestintäaktiivisuus oli hyväkin juttu.

Also das Airbnb war super, es war klein aber fein.
Die Lage war ein Traum, man kommt überall zufuß hin. Zur Victoria Street läuft man nur 3 min und sonst ist man in 10 -15 min überall.
Zum Castle läuft man auch nur 8 min hoch. Also die Lage ist ein Traum.
Einen Supermarkt gibt es um die Ecke aber das Angebot ist sehr klein. Um zu einem Größeren zu kommen muss man 30 min mit dem Bus fahren.
Beim Kickass Hostel kann man für Wenig Geld seinen Koffer lassen vor dem Check in oder nach dem Ckeck out. Das Hostel liegt 2 min neben der Wohnung.
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber aber es hat lange gebraucht bis wir die Wohnung warm hatten.
Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

Everything went well with our stay.
Nice and quiet neighborhood. Close to main attractions. Apartment accordingly to our expectations.
Viv was proactive sending us all the information needed to get to the apartment.

Fantastic place to stay in Edinburgh. Nice area in and of itself, with good bars and restaurants near by, but also very convenient for Central Edinburgh and Arthur’s Seat. Frequent and easy bus links to all parts of the City.
The accommodation was lovely. Private, clean and great amenities.
Mairi was a friendly and very helpful host.
We would definitely stay again on future visits.
A great location, really spacious and had a pool table. We had a really good stay here. there are 3 toilets and 2 bathrooms so we never had to wait for others.

The perfect place to explore the Old Town. Apartment exactly as described with fully equipped kitchen (we cooked dinners both nights). Big enough for three people and very comfortable with everything you may need. Host was  very responsive, informative and accommodating. Will definitely keep an eye on this when visiting Edinburgh in the future.

We like the location, staff , and the hospitality
The room is comfortable.
Beautifully restored, well appointed historic property that we felt honored to spend time in.

The flat is in an amazing location, close to everything, but down a quiet street away from the hustle and bustle. We stayed on the weekend and the flat was quiet - it's a nice neighbourhood. The lounge sofa is really comfortable and seats 4 adults perfectly for a movie! There is a great welcome pack and Ewelina is a great host. Thanks for a great city escape.
Really lovely, centrally located apartment with an incredible view! Highly recommend.
Lovely apartment in a fantastic location for exploring Edinburgh. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

Absolutely recommend! I’ve stayed at many Airbnbs before, but I have never stayed at a place this perfect—clean, close to the city center, and with every need thoughtfully considered. You have a private bathroom connected to your room. Everything you might need, from coffee to medication, is ready and waiting for you. All that’s left for you to do is explore the city. Thosi, you are an amazing host. Thank you so much for your quick responses and attentiveness. You’ve changed my perspective on Airbnb once again. I’m so glad I chose you!

Armando was an excellent host throughout the trip. Flexible check in time, showed up and checked us in personally on arrival. The 7 bed apartment was exactly as advertised and walkable to restaurants and attractions. Great stay highly recommend.

Would definitely stay at Cathleen’s place again! We were a group of 8 celebrating a birthday and NYE. The house was perfect for us, really spacious, had lots of amenities for us to have a dinner party and Cathleen had given us loads of recommendations for activities and restaurants in the area. The house is beautiful too! Really made our trip special :)

Pauline was great. Easy to communicate with.
The place is spacious, great location, easy to get into town. Highly recommend for groups visiting Edinburgh.
Really great place to stay, was very clean and a great location for being in Edinburgh, would recommend and stay again
The accommodation was in a great location, clean and well-organized, with beautiful views of the castle. Thank you, I can happily recommend this place.
Menší pokoj, ale v naprostém pořádki, k dispozici kuchyně a společný pokoj. Největší výhoda: 15 chůze od vlakového a autobusového nádraží. Doporučuji
Lovely apartment and Sean is a fantastic host, very helpful and accommodating. Thanks again for having us!
Helen was really helpful, showing us where everything in the apartment was. The space itself was clean and spacious. Very happy, would come back again

Virkelig fantastisk lejlighed med flot interiør og virkelig godt indrettet! Det så præcis ud som på billederne. Da vi en enkelt gang kontaktede dem vedrørende nye håndklæder, fik vi respons næsten med det samme, og da vi kom tilbage var de lagt hos os. Lejligheden har en super lokation i gåafstand til hele byen. Det eneste, der trækker en smule ned, er at man bor lige ud til en byggeplads, der bygger fra klokken 7 om morgenen, også i weekenden. Det er dog ikke værternes fejl, og de stiller ørepropper til rådighed, hvilket var dejligt. Alt i alt er vi super tilfredse og vender gerne tilbage :)
Great host, perfect location and fabulous flat. Can't fault a thing. Would highly recommend staying here when in Edinburgh!
Thank you so much for warm hospitality during my stay. The house was very comfortable and everything was well-prepared. I truly appreciate your effort in making my trip smooth and enjoyable.

A fabulous stay - gorgeous house, room was very homely and I slept amazingly! Amanda was very friendly and it was lovely to get to know her a little bit when we met. Tea and coffee provided in the room along with soap and a towel if you needed to shower. A short but a very sweet stay:)

Alloggio ideale per visitare Edimburgo. Situato a 50 metri dalla fermata del tram per l’aeroporto e a 10 minuti a piedi dal Royal Mile. Posizione molto tranquilla. Grande appartamento con due stanze da letto e una splendida sala. La cucina era perfettamente attrezzata e molto accogliente. Siamo stati molto contenti e torneremo sicuramente.

We enjoyed our stay very much. Right in the heart of Edinburgh! So many beautiful places to see and things to do all within walking distance from the flat. Oh and dressing up in traditional Scottish Kilts were so much fun! (as suggested by our host) The flat is stunning!!!! Truley felt home from home. Could not fault anything about our stay. Finally. Our brilliant host. So friendly, helpful, the list goes on. Julie you have been fantastic. We’ll definitely be staying longer next time!
Beautiful house. Great Location. Fantastic hosts

We had a wonderful stay.  Couldn't have asked for a better location  which was within walking distance to everything that we wanted to see.  Kevin was wonderful with suggestion and communicating with me and allowed us to check in early.   There is nothing like seeing the castle from the balcony!
Great place to stay

Thank you, the apartment was clean and comfortable and just what we needed for
our weekend away. Plenty of shops, pubs and restaurants within walking distance. Check in really easy and host friendly.
Wir können die Unterkunft sehr empfehlen. Gabriele ist jederzeit gut zu erreichen und man erhält super Tipps für die Umgebung. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen.
Fantastic place, great host, great location. Beautiful and clean, decor was lovely and the view to the castle what a treat. 100% recommend and we will definitely be back.

Had a lovely stay at Sally’s.
Close to bus stop that takes you directly into town.
Quiet and peaceful location.
Really nice stylish flat. Has everything what you need and it’s on a beautiful street in a good location.
The flat was very clean, tidy, well equipped and actually felt like home. The neighbourhood of Stockbridge is always lovely and peaceful with great cafés and the botanics at a 15min walk.
Very nice apartment in a perfect location! The check-in and -out was very easy, since we got very detailed instructions. We would definitely go there again! 😊👍🏻
Perfect

L’apartament de la Jenny és fantàstic, net, ordenat i acollidor per a una família de quatre persones. Ubicat als afores d’Edimburg, a només quatre parades del centre de la ciutat amb el tramvia, que s’agafa a menys de cinc minuts a peu. A més, disposes d’un super Coop al costat.
El tracte de la Jenny, excel·lent. Sempre atenta a qualsevol dubte i molt ràpida en la resposta. Un plaer. El recomanem 100%.
Lovely location. Brilliant little base for our stay in the city. The place was spotless, easy to get to and the bed was incredibly comfy. 10/10. Thank you!
Wonderful property in a great location. Would recommend as a place to stay in Edinburgh.

I stayed at Lorna's place with my two bridesmaids before getting married the following day. It was in the perfect location for us to explore Edinburgh but also so homely for us to sit around and have a girly night in. The styling in the home is fab and Stockbridge is wonderful and lively. We had such a comfortable stay and communication with Lorna was very easy. Thank you for letting us into your beautiful home :)
Perfect Edinburgh apartment! We loved the high ceilings, spacious rooms, quiet street, wood floor, and lovely neighborhood.

Me and my friend had a great time staying in Ada & Cem's apartment. They weren't there but their friend Kerim took good care of us, and they were always available in the app. The flat is nice, cozy and clean and the location is amazing. It was quite cold inside, which is maybe what you should expect from Scotland in November. The duvet was nice and warm though so it's fine at night. We weren't aware that there would be other people in the apartment since the hosts told us that they would be away, so be aware that the other room might be rented out too. Overall we had a great time and would recommend Ada & Cem's apartment to anyone visiting Edinburgh.

Valentina gave clear instruction on the check in and check out procedures. The place is located in a location within walking distance from Princess Street etc and a paid parking lot. The apartment is clean and nice and wifi was quick. Thumbs up!

I cannot recommend this place enough. It was ABSOLUTELY the perfect location. It was in a quiet part of edinburgh, so cozy! We did not use the hot tub but it was clean and had the most adorable surroundings. The home was comfortable, set with a little coffee area, ready with milk, oat milk and other options. If I am ever in Edinburgh again this would be the place to stay!

Kevin’s flat was well appointed and roomy. Great location - just outside the hustle & bustle but easily walkable to everything. And it was very quiet too. Groceries were just a block away made for easy shopping to eat in. Would highly recommend.
Great location, host responded to questions straight away. The property was perfect for the two of us and easy to get into.
Quartier très calme, bus à deux pas direct pour la Old Town. Courtney est charmante, cultivée et très attentionné,  de plus elle nous a préparé d'excellents petits déjeuners.
I have lived in this lovely house for more than 20 days. It is very convenient for people to walk or go shopping. The landlord was nice, too. All in all, I recommend it!

Great host, fast and accurate communication. The flat is very spacious, bigger that we were expecting and perfect for our trip. The location is fantastic, walking distance to lots of restaurants, bars and sightseeing locations.
No está en el centro de Edimburgo pero hay un camión que te deja en los lugares turísticos, súper buen precio, el Airbnb es cómodo y limpio

The location was perfect with access to everything Edinburgh has to offer.
Plenty of great dining options nearby.
The apartment was great and was everything it said on the tin.
Seamless communication with hosts contributed to a most enjoyable weekend

The location was ideal for my purposes. I was warmly welcomed by the hosts and shown to a beautiful spacious room with tea & coffee making facilities. The bathroom was also very spacious and spotless. I had help with my luggage and overall had an extremely pleasant stay. I can highly recommend this AirB&B.

What a great AirBnb!  Denise gave great instructions and directions.  The apartment was very nice.  The location was fantastic, being right next to Edinburgh Castle, and the view was really amazing.  Would highly recommend this stay.

Perfect situation, explications clear
We spent such good time in Edimbourgh

It's an excellent place to stay in the middle of the city—a walkable distance from all the main locations. It was spotless and provided us with enough towels. An off-licence shop is right under the apartment, which is convenient for a quick meal—great communication with the host. Perfect parking if you are driving to the city.

What an amazing place!! Really great apartment with everything you need: Beds and sofas extremely comfortable, smart tv so could watch a bit of netflix between exploring the city, well equipped kitchen so can prep/cook your meals if you are so inclined.
The location is absolutely perfect - it looks out straight onto the royal mile - so it meant we could pop back between activities to change or chill or drop off shopping bags. I also wanted to highlight how safe it felt. I get very worried walking around on my own/with my boyfriend especially in unfamiliar cities and I had been worried about the apartment being on a close, but there was not one point where I felt unsafe or worried! Check in and out was very easy as well which was nice.
We had noted people saying about the noise from pub goers etc in other reviews before we came but we really did not notice any at all whilst in bed/sleeping. Only loud noise was the one o’clock gun from the castle!
Would highly recommend staying here to anyone, and will be to everyone who mentions they are going to Edinburgh :) 10/10!!!
Lovely as usual. Will recommend and be back soon

We spend 2 nights at ben flat, it was an amazing experience.
Definitely will visit it again!

Gregor and his friends were very attentive from the beginning and arranged the very smooth check-in.  The flat was bigger than I had expected and very quiet and comfortable.   The neighbourhood is full of nice shops you can never be tired of it. Overall, very good value considering it was during the fringe. Thank you Douglas!

Great stay in Edinburgh. The flat is well located, about 20-25 minutes from the Royal Mile and Old Town and 10 minutes from the Arthur’s Seat hike walking. Adam has been very responsive and provided clear instructions to check in. The room is very small but that fitted my needs as I was out all day.
Would recommend to discover the city!
Nice apartment at a nice location. Thanks Ceysa for the comfortable stay.

The place is close to the tram and we were able to get around the city pretty easily. The apartment was clean and comfortable, good if you are traveling with enough people to need two full bathrooms.  The rooms were bright, though, but i guess that helped us get up in the morning.
房子地理位置非常好，就在市中心，步行几分钟就可以到超市，餐馆和公交车站。房东超级友好，给我提供各种帮助。还会再来。我和我的孩子在这儿度过了非常愉快的十天。

Comfortable, spacious apartment in a lovely residential neighbourhood. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. V easy check-in. Patrick responded quickly to any queries and was v accommodating with any requests we had. Would recommend.

These two! I had the best time in their place and they are such great, lovely, beautiful people. Words can't really describe how everything,  every single detail made us feel so special. It was my mum's first time staying in an Airbnb and I had to tell her that I doubt any other place will be/ feel like Dave & Toke's home. We felt home and were spoiled with Scottish sweet treats and Tokes specially got me gluten free goods for my breakfast. Thank you so much for everything guys. I hope I find an excuse to go back to Edinburgh soon! x
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und entsprach der Beschreibung. Der Gastgeber war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Flat as described, great base to spend Christmas while visiting family. Lots of kids books and toys were a bonus.

Bill und Susan waren hervorragende Gastgeber. Das Zimmer mit Bad sowie das ganze Haus sind sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Die Betten sehr bequem. Das Frühstück nach Wunsch reichhaltig und abwechslungsreich. Wir haben uns sehr gut unterhalten über unterschiedliche Themen.
Die Stadt und Sehenswürdigkeiten sind Fußläufig gut erreichbar oder mit dem Buss in wenigen Minuten.
Wenn wir nochmal in Edinburgh sind waren Susan und Bill wieder unsere erste Wahl.
Rundum empfehlenswert.
Lovely apartment in a great location, very clean and excellent communication from Nikki. Thank you!
Really enjoyed our stay here, thanks for having us !
Highly recommend Suzie’s air B and B very hospitable host convenient to the centre and lovely clean and comfortable flat will return.

Had a great weekend at Julia’s place, apartment was as described and very comfortable with easy access to transport for the centre or the beach. We walked everywhere and found it easy to do. Would stay here again.

i can’t recommend this place enough! the location is perfect, and everything you will need and more is provided for you in this apartment. if you’re thinking of staying here, i recommend without hesitation! no complaints from me ◡̈
에든버러에서의 여행이 이 곳에서  더욱 행복하게 마무리 되었습니다. 그 곳의 가정집이 궁금해서 하루 묵었는데 ,계속 살고 싶을. 만큼 편안하고 좋았습니다.  다음에 또 묵고싶습니다. 감사합니다!!
Josh was a great host! Easy access to the city center by bus and we had a great time

This spot is the ideal spot for any group staying in Edinburgh. Imagine walking out the front door and being on the Royal Mile, the castle just a 2 min walk up the street and all the restaurants, pubs & attractions within walking distance.
Plenty of beds (we had 10 people in our group and we all slept comfortably), the kitchen is a little small for the 10 of us but you'll want to eat out for all your meals anyways, you're on vacation not at home :)
The host, Sarah-Jane, was great to deal with. She made sure we had all the details we needed and got back to us with any questions we had very quickly.
Can't say enough about this spot and its location. We had the best time in Edinburgh and the spot contributed greatly to that.
Mark
Great place to stay although the walk was quite long from the train station and to the old town.

Lovely stay in Edinburgh, fab location, 2 minute walk to the Edinburgh gin distillery tour. 4 of us stayed on a girls trip… just enough room for four. Only downside is it can be quite noisy during the night with people passing on their nights out.

Daniel was a fantastic host, always responded almost immediately. He was able to make a special accommodation that I truly appreciated and I had a little hiccup at check-in that he trouble shot lightning quick (I didn’t understand how the door works but he called me within a minute of sending him a message and walked me through within a few seconds.)
FYI, the bed is brand new. I got to use it for the first time and it is very comfortable! Everything that you need as far as food, groceries and amenities are on your block. Stockbridge is beautiful, outside the tourist area and you will more than likely need to transport in unless your training for a decathlon but I would stay here again because the neighborhood is a vibe and has lots of cool walkable areas to explore.
Note: Apartment is up two flights of stairs, there is no lift.
Bonus: It looks like there is a farmers market on Sundays, we didn’t get to go, but it looked very happening.
Great en-suite room located close to the city center, would recommend it for your stay

Gran lugar! Y Lucy lo hizo aún más inolvidable. Es una gran anfitriona, estuvo atenta a nosotros y se tomó el tiempo de hacer conversación con nosotros.
Hay muchos autobuses de fácil acceso y eso hace muy fácil la ubicación.

Summary: highly recommendable.
Check-In: perfect communication from Shahid, fast and acurate, so obtaining the key was easy.
Parking: there is an "one-yellow-line" area directly in front of the entrance, so dropping off baggage is easy. Parking is difficult within the city center generally, nothing Shahid can do.
Location to tourist attractions: perfect, no more can be said! Many breakfast opportunities around.
2 Bedrooms: perfect for two couples or one couple with up to three kids. We found the beds very comfortable and slept well. Clean. Windows towards Princess Street are soundproof. It gets quieter after 11 p.m. so we even left the window open.
Bathroom and toilet are in one room. Clean & spacious, no window but ventilated. Towels were supplied as well as shampoo & shower gel.
Livingroom (with small dining table for four): the room is really big and furnished with two comfortable couches (two seaters). We found the room decorated with good taste. We did not use the TV etc.
Wifi: was a little unstable now and again but generally good and fast.
Kitchen: all you need (and probably more than you need)
Other: no elevator to third story, you need to climb steps.
Check-Out: a two minute procedure any time of day, easy!
Thank you, Shahid!

Not one to write bad reviews, but when we got there there was an odd smell all around, including the bedding. We contacted the host, and he sent someone to smell the bedding, and later sent a message saying that the bedding was good, that he was not going to change it because it was not a hotel. It was only after we contacted airbnb and then airbnb asked him to change it that he offered new bedding or a refund. Not the friendliest host. When we got there all the windows were wide open, which only tells me that they are aware of the funny smell. The place was freezing cold! Conclusion: not the friendliest host, the place is cold and smells odd. Bus connections are great. And the bed is comfortable.
Very basic but was fine for one night. Good location - very close to station.

Killer location, as the photos suggest.  Excellent walkability to the touristy parts of town and transit.  The bed wasn't particularly comfortable and the shower head doesn't much fancy staying in place, but otherwise Vic's place is great.
Thank you Fiona for your help and kindness. It was our home away from home.  Joy and Allan from Australia

We had a great week at Jane's. The apartment was a perfect home-base for our family trip. With 4 adults, 2 teenagers and a toddler, we remarkably all had enough space to not feel on top of each other.
The apartment is an ideal location to explore this great walking city.
Highly recommend Jane's apartment for anyone spending time in Edinburgh.

My partner and I stayed here for a short break in Edinburgh and we were very happy we chose this apartment.
It's in an ideal location with lots of small shops and takeaways along the street and only a few minutes walk to the main centre.
The apartment was perfect; clean, warm and cosy. Couldn't fault it and found it very homely for our stay.
We ended up eating out quite a lot as there were great restaurants and cafes around, but would have been fine if we stayed in and cooked as there were plenty of shops nearby (tesco express, Co op and sainsburys local all within short walking distance). The apartment was well stocked with everything you could need (e.g teabags, sugar, salt&pepper) and all the utensils for cooking.
The only slight problem we had was that when we arrived on a Saturday evening, we struggled to find parking and had to go a few roads down.... But this was poor timing as there was a football game on nearby.
Over the next few days, parking spots were all quite full but we managed to find a spot outside the flat the next day.
We never met the hosts in person but they had great communication with us over the app. They gave clear checking in and out information and recommended things for us to do in the area. We also really appreciated the shortbread on the table.. It was delicious thank you!
For anyone planning to stay here, we recommend:
Shopping in the city centre
Walking up Arthur's seat (amazing views), Breakfast at The Pantry
Tea and Cakes at Mimis bakehouse
Dinner at New Chapters (this is if you want to treat yourself to a bit of an expensive but incredibly tasty high end meal).

Easy to find and located in center New town of Edinburgh, 10min walk from old Town. The studio is clean, fully equiped. You had a warm welcome with roses and poem. Reception were ready to help for any visit suggestion or questions. We spent a super night there.

The location of the apartment was great, right next to Calton hill. The host was really nice and welcoming on arrival showed us everything necessary. The check out time is very early (10am) which we were told before booking and when asked if we could stay a bit longer we were able to stay an additional hour. However, if your train/ plane is in the afternoon an early wake up might not be ideal so gotta keep that in consideration. Overall really good stay and would recommend.
The apartment was very nice and cosy, well situated. We had an excellent night there !
Central,  in the heart of Edinburgh.
All good! Nice to have our own space and Hamid was very responsive and helpful when needed. Would definitely recommend or stay again.

One of our favorite places to stay in Edinburgh! The location can’t be beat and the view out to Royal Mile and the rest of the city is beautiful. The apartment itself is very cozy and had everything we needed.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! It was a great location and was easily accessible, alongside the room being very hygienic and comfortable for us. Staff were super friendly and helpful and we would definitely stay again!
Thank you!
Wir haben den Aufenthalt in Carolines Wohnung sehr genossen. Alles hat super geklappt, können diese Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen.

I wasn’t prepared for such an amazing place! Lol! Words can not describe how amazing this place is. It is extremely clean and organized. The host has though of every detail. Place is modern and the moment you walk in you don’t want to leave. Towels and linens are hotel quality if not better. We were received with snacks on the table and basically everything we needed to even make  breakfast if we wanted to. Appliances are all top notch and extremely clean. Like they had never been used. Lizzie has definitely put a lot of thought into every little detail. The only complain we had is that we couldn’t stay longer! Please don’t miss out on this place! We are coming back next year!

Great place for a small family. The building is old, but the premises are well-maintained, and the stay is very comfortable.  What I liked is that the place is not in the middle of a tourist spot, but it is easy to get to the tourist areas. The place is calm and close to the beach, making it an excellent spot for an evening stroll and grabbing some food to eat. Overall, we had a great stay.
Sam has a great flat in a really nice part of Edinburgh. A cool place to stay.

Lovely space to stay in - light and bright and colourful. Nice area and close to cafes, Sainsburies, etc. Centre of town 15 minutes pleasant walk away. Calum quick to respond to any questions.
There is free parking in area but unlikely to be right outside house.

What a great location just beneath the castle and on the Grass Market.  Walkable to everywhere including all major attractions and nightlife.  Great place to feel the heartbeat and vibe of this beautiful city.  Very nicely updated and outfitted with everything we needed including lots of Scottish treats.  You won't be disappointed if you book this place for your Edinburgh stay!

The place was nice, just as described. It was expensive but in line with the prices in Edinburg so a good deal for the city. The only problem we encountered was that the parking spots were full so we had to wake up early to move the car away from the payed area.
We will stay again, thank you Xavi!
Great stay

We were a large group of Frenchmen visiting Edinburgh for a rugby game and we had a perfect time at John's place. The place was not only big enough to accomodate the thirteen of us: it's very comfortable, very charming (as Scottish as you can imagine as a random Frenchman!) and ideally located. Not to mention the very decent price. Plus: John is so nice and easy-going that he made everything simple. Thank you John, we're all looking forward to seeing you for the next rugby game!

Amazing apartment overlooking the Royal Mile. Very comfortable and close to everything including the Royal Procession! Loved everything about our stay. So thankful to Carol for having us to stay. Miss it already!!
Stella was a great host!  The breakfast was great, and she even bought GF crumpets for me to eat!  The conversations were also great, as was her cat! 🐈‍⬛
房子地理位置很好，入住也很方便。但是这回入住有点波折，前一个访客毁坏了房东的房子导致我们差点不能按时入住，后来也觉得当天也订不到房子了，就晚点还是去入住了，可是整个房子弥漫着一股难闻的气味，房东还留了空气清醒剂，但是不管用，味太重了，房东也很倒霉，希望他的房子快点恢复吧。
Wonderful 3 bedroom ‘home’ a stones throw from everything you would need in central Edinburgh.  Large and clean and well equipped.  Thank you!!

Try friendly host. Peaceful and clean room with nice view at the garden. Easy to get from town centre. Amazing coffee bar  next door. Towels, coffee and tea provided. I love my stay and if by any chance I am back to Edinburgh, I will defo consider to stay there again.

The apartment of Steve and Michael is very nice and great furnished. The City is fast to reach and also the harbor with its many small restaurants is footy.
Michael welcomed us very warmly and showed us everything in detail. Also he recommends a few Restaurants for lunch and breakfast.
We would rent this apartment again at any time
Lovely staff, awesome location and beautiful design in the apartment.. truly felt like a home away from home ❤️
Top locatie en super verblijf. Ruim en schoon!
Jacqueline’s place was gorgeous & spacious! I had a minor incident &she responded within minutes &was very kind. I appreciate you Jacqueline! When I come back to Edinburgh I hope to stay here again!

This is a lovely place not too far from City Centre. The 44 takes you into Princes Street and there is Night Bus service to return you home.
Good facilities and very clean and quiet.
Thanks very much for having me, Denis and Karen.

Liz and Hector's place is even better than the pictures portray and is well located in a lovely local community with easy access to everything Edinburgh has to offer.
Liz responds quickly to all communication and ensures the stay is trouble free.
Highly recommended!
Peter
Great location and flat!
We really enjoyed our stay at Emily’s flat. Great location and very comfortable. Emily was a very responsive and helpful host. Would definitely recommend staying.
Nicely maintained. Well located, walkable distance to central tourist places and restaurants.
Will is a wonderful, welcoming host and his cottage in the sky is an oasis in the heart of Edinburgh. We're already planning on coming back, only next time for longer.

Les hôtes sont très accueillants, nous avons eut pleins d'informations sur la ville et les astuces à connaître. La chambre est belle et confortable, le quartier calme tout en étant à proximité à pied du centre.
Les petits déjeuners sont copieux avec du choix.
Thanks again Cary and Pete
Thank you for a wonderful stay, the house has absolutely everything you could need. It’s super spacious and tastefully decorated. The location is amazing, hopefully I’ll be back soon :-)

A truly unique and beautiful apartment in a fantastic central location. Tessa was very accommodating and lovely to meet. Cannot wait to come back and stay for longer! The apartment looks like its straight out of Elle Decoration!
Lovely apartment in a great area, Leith is wonderful and the location is excellent
This was our second stay at Jacqui’s gem of a place! The location is perfect and she could not be more accommodating! We will definitely be back!
The place is very quiet and clean, close to supermarket and restaurant. Slawomir is a nice guy, he helped us to check in earlier and responded very quickly every time we needed help.

This was an absolute gem and I can see why it is listed under ‘rare find’.
The flat is absolute gorgeous, with modern furnishings and had me and my husband actually looking up ideas for our own place. The bed was comfy and plenty of room for two. Shower easy to operate and quickly became hot. Kitchen was fully stocked with great cooking utensils. Overall the place was extremely clean - I suffer from severe dust allergies and didn’t have to use my medication once.
My husband and I pretty much walked everywhere: Old Town (25 mins) Holyrood Park (20 mins). Huge selection of great cafe and restaurants within 10 min walk. Sainsbury’s local 5 mins.
Finally, Colin was brilliant. Very quick to reply to messages, offered to set up extras (should we have chosen) and clear instructions on arrival and WiFi.
Will definitely be choosing again! Many thanks.

The stay was comfortable and cozy, peaceful surroundings. The only thing is that there was a floor noise while you walk in the apartment. The apartment was very near to public transport, supermarkets and good restaurants.
Great location and everything you need, even running routes through the city. Perfect for our Edinburgh stay.

Feels like home when stayed in this apartment. Lovely person and very supportive with any questions. Easy access thru transportation especially LOTHIAN Buses in front of the apartment. Walking distance to the grocery shop. Thanks for sharing the apartment with us! Would love to come back again.
Thank you for everything!  A great location and a nice flat.

Many thanks to Joe for a lovely stay in Edinburgh and making us feel very at home. Joe was very accommodating and welcoming and we would recommend staying in their spacious, clean and homely flat to anyone :)
we had an amazing stay. Cara's home was a brilliant space, in a good location with everything we needed!

I used to live in Edinburgh for years.
Fiona’s place was the perfect place to call home for a few days while I dived back into memories and went back to places I loved so much. Very well located, right in front of the tramway (which finally goes down leith walk!), buses and all commodities, a stone throw from the St James Center.
Fiona and her daughters were the loveliest hosts. The perfect balance of warmth and trust.
Would highly recommend!
Anne is a great host. Very thoughtful. If we went back to this area I would repeat with her.

Bien placé - propre - une bière d'accueil - lit confortable - douche et wc séparés
Cuisine fonctionnelle

Fantastic location, walkable to great restaurants and most of the sites. great view of the castle. Perfect apartment, great bathroom, bedroom, living room and fully stocked kitchen, washer and dryer for your laundry!!  Just hoping the cleaning company can fix the mold smell in the closet.  Getting the key was not a hassle for us, just do an Uber stop from/to train or plane at Usher hall and pick up and drop off key round the corner (no stopping on the main street), it is not nearby.

Central location, right on the Royal Mile. A short walk from the Parliament and the Holyrood Palace; right on the route for several hop-on/hop-off buses. Occasional late night drunken chatter, passing by the bedroom windows, but all and all— a relatively quiet location. Do not go to Cafe Vivo right across the street— the Yelp reviews are misleading; terrible food and service.
Caroline’s place was very cute and clean. It’s got all the amenities you’ll ever need. Would absolutely stay here again!
Mel is so nice!! Her house is tidy and clean, she also prepare some food for breakfast. The day we live in was her birthday, happy birthday Mel!

We had a great stay at Roger`s place . We had a family wedding ( not ours I should add ) at the Mansfield Traquair centre so wanted a location close to the venue where 4 couples and a toddler could stay and Rogers place was ideal for this . I would agree with other reviewers who almost entirely have been very positive about the property . We had no issues when we were there . The property is well photographed and the description is accurate . It does highlight it is on the second floor .
My tips for people staying would be - check if the Mansfield Traquair centre will be open during your stay - we had been before and seen the murals but they are stunning - they are describe as Edinburgh`s Cistine Chapel - they are on view on the second Sunday in the month but much more frequently during the festival . Do check the website as things may change !

I arrived late but still accepted by the  host. Lovely place with a lovely host. Great location with easy tram access to downtown and the airport. It takes around 15 minutes to walk to the tram, while the train and bus station are about 7–10 minutes away depending on your walking speed. I’m a slow walker, so it took me a bit longer. Overall, a great place to stay. Thank you Jeanette and David.

Sean was an excellent host! He was very responsive, getting back to me in minutes sometimes! His place is cozy and very spacious, I will definitely stay there again when in Edinburgh. It was very easy to find and easy to get into. Parking just around the corner.
Great spot and a terrific host!
Beautiful apartment in a fantastic location would absolutely stay here again. The hosts were really attentive and accommodating. Highly recommend!
Great central location. Loved our stay
Andrew was a great host, and his apartment is in a fantastic location in the centre of town, just a couple of minutes from the train station.  Good dinner and drinks recommendations too!
Muy buena experiencia. Ubicación excelente.
We had a wonderful stay in Edinburgh, the apartment was really cosy, not too far from the centre, it was spotless and we had a great night sleep! Would definitely recommend
Dawn’s place was as described- very clean, very well situated for Edinburgh. Dawn was very quick to reply . I would recommend Dawn’s place without hesitation.
Very nice and elegant flat, spacious, centrally located and impeccably clean. We would definitely stay there again when in Edinburgh next time!
James was a great host. This was a lovely place to stay
Très bien

My stay here was fabulous. The bathroom was beautiful and had everything I needed. The room was cozy and felt private. Lucy was so kind and generous with her time and willingness to help. Would totally come back.
Lovely little flat in a fantastic location! Lily was very helpful and accommodating. I would highly recommend and hope to stay here again next time I’m in Edinburgh.

Our stay at Harvey's was great! Awesome location and really big apartment for such a central location.  The stairs are steep, but the description and other reviews had prepared us for this! Harvey was very communicative and helpful, he even put up a camp bed in the living room which really helped us out. We'd love to come back!

Was a really great stay. Wasn’t super clear from the listing that it was like a “hotel apartment”, but that was actually a nice surprise.
Host wasn’t able to serve drinks upon arrival which was a slight bummer, but honestly the stay was amazing.
it was comfortable, very nice and a clean place, near to supermarket and restaurants.
Modern and very clean and had everything you needed and more.  Assisted us with any question.  Would visit again if compete in Swim competition which was at commonwealth pool and reason for stay
Very good communication and host was very nice. The location is great
really comfortable，clean room，David is a really friendly guy ，I strongly recommend his accommadation

everything well prepared, really professional and caring; from the kitchen kit to the drinks, even prepared with a sparkling wine  for us relaxing in the night, and rooms are exactly same as shows online. Perfect location with mins walk to the forth bridge and sea. We had great time staying in, and make our business trip even happier.

Great spot for a couple nights and within walking distance for us of the main train station and city. Otherwise there are also trams or buses available. Plenty of restaurants nearby. We were also able to store our luggage prior to checking in which helped us explore the city for the day! Would recommend as a cheap stay.

The apartment was great and has everything you will need. Very clean and spacious (it's bigger than it looks in pics). The living room is very cozy. The TV has a bunch of channels and streaming (ie Netflix). The kitchen is well equipped and clean, has a dishwasher. There are 2 good sized bedrooms with lots of shelves/closets and space to put large suitcases. The beds aren't huge but that's not unusual for Europe. One of the bedrooms has its own bathroom, and there is another one off the main hallway. The bathrooms are renovated and super clean, lots of space to put your toiletries and they provide enough towels for everyone. There is a laundry machine but we didn't use it. You have to get your own detergent if you do. The location was perfect, right off West Bow St and walking distance to Royal Mile and all the main attractions (literally nothing was more than a 15 min walk). The Grassmarket area has tons of restaurants all 2 min away. The host was very responsive and accommodating.

This accommodation was absolutely perfect for us with grown up children and grandma with us. A room and bathroom each and fantastic lounge space to relax together - the wood burning fire a great bonus for Christmas coziness!
Bedding was lovely and soft so we all had a great nights sleep.
It was also a perfect location for us, made even better with parking.
Was lovely to talk to our host too.
We will definitely be back.
Beautiful apartment
the only slight downer which was a minor thing - accessing the top bunk with a stiff back. Slept well  and good value breakfast

Wonderful cosy and quiet room in Josh's lovely flat in Granton, spotlessly clean and beautifully decorated. We had our own private bathroom, could use the kitchen for coffee and breakfast, and had a lot of interesting attractions right on the doorstep: the Water of Leith Walkway, the lovely bustling Leith with its beautiful cafés, restaurants and shops, the Royal Botanic Garden, Silverknowes Beach, Cramond Beach and Cramond Causeway, Lauriston Castle, also Midhope Castle and Blackness Castle (in case you're into 'Outlander' and fancy a film locations tour :-) ), the three briges in South Queensferry. And on top of that the city centre is a ten minutes bus ride! Perfect! Highly recommended! Thank you, Josh, for a wonderful time!

A lovely property in a fantastic location, only 10-15 mins walk from many of Edinburgh’s main attractions.  This was the perfect base for our visit. Clean, well appointed and all the amenities that we needed as a large family group.  Rea was a fantastic host - very responsive to all our questions and provided very clear instructions for check-in and check out.  Would definitely recommend,
Excellent stay all round with a great location! Accomodating host and good facilities.

日本語のレビューが少ないですが、素晴らしいアパートです。マークは快く出迎えてくれました。部屋はロイヤルマイルに面したアパートの3階(イギリスではsecond floor)、階段上がって右側の部屋です。アパート全体に入るために1階の扉の鍵を開けてもらう必要があります。私はアパートの住民の方が出てきたのですぐ入れましたが、おそらく4のブザーを押すのがよいでしょう。部屋に入るとマークが部屋の使い方の説明を丁寧にしてくれました。さらにエディンバラの地図もくれて、写真スポットなども教えてくれました。英語があまり喋れなくても全然大丈夫でした。自分が行きたいとこを言うと、先にこっち言った方がいいかもね、とアドバイスも頂けました。ベットルームは広く、綺麗で快適でした。窓からはアーサーズシートと呼ばれる山？崖？丘？が見えます。いい眺めでした。暖房を付けなくてもとても快適に過ごせました。トイレと洗面台とシャワーとタブが一緒の大きな部屋にありました。一緒といってもユニットバスのようではなく、広くしっかり別れていてとても綺麗でした。日本人の清潔感で考えても全く問題ないくらい快適に使う事が出来ました。荷物ですが、私は11時に先に置いて観光出来ました。帰る日も3時まで置いておくことが出来ました。素晴らしいホストと部屋でした。
The room is located in the second floor by the Royal Mile. You can see the door on your right side when you get up stairs. Mark told me how to use the room clearly and kindly. He also gave me a Map of Edinburgh. The bedroom was clean and very comfortable. You can see the Arthur’s seat through the window. The shower room and toilet were very clean. Mark is nice person. The room is the best I have ever visited.
Prima plek om de Edinburgh te ontdekken.

It was a nice apartment for a night stay, the place was lovely and clean. Great communication from host too. Location unfortunately not great, the entrance is located on a back street with bags and rubbish all over, at least at the time of our visit. The neighbourhood didn't seem very friendly.

A great stay in a spacious, comfortable and clean apartment, managed by very responsive and helpful hosts.  It’s not in Edinburgh proper but very easy access (direct and frequent public transport, and even a great dedicated walking path), and the local area also has its charm.   24 hour mega supermarket 5 minutes walk away, a few good pubs, nice stroll to the sea and The Hive cafe close by is a gem.

We were a group of six and had a wonderful time in this beautiful apartment. It has everything you need and more. We ended up staying in rather than going out both evenings because we loved the place so much! Super clean and with better duvets and linen than most hotels. Simply perfect for a weekend getaway to Edinburgh.

This flat was amazing. It's great for 1 to 2 people. It's a very easy walk to old town and only a 5 min taxi trip. There is so much to down in Edinburgh and this flat is a great place to stay. The bed was very comfortable and the couch was as well. The shower had perfect tempture especially for this who like very hot ones. Mario was a great host and sent so many helpful hints and maps of the surrounding area. I would definitely book here again.
This a great apartment.  Already looked to book again, but unfortunately booked up.

Beautiful house, very good stay
thank you

This apartment is beautiful and spacious. It’s in an excellent location for the new town and the royal mile.
It has everything you need. I would definitely stay here again. It’s also very secure.

WOW!  What a great experience with Keith and his superb apartment.  Probably the best Air BNB and host experience we’ve had.  All amenities provided and service from Keith were exceptional. Great location, central.  Keith recommended dinner and event options that were exactly the experience we were looking for in Edinburgh.  Highly recommend- you will not be disappointed.
Carrie was a great host and she was very accommodating and kind. Her space is beautiful, spotless and cozy! The location is absolutely perfect!
Susan is a great Host, very efficient and attentive to all your needs!

For the same price that friends of ours paid for a small, pokey bedroom in a boutique hotel we had acres of space and every possible amenity,  in a really buzzing neighbourhood. For folks who have an aversion to climbing stairs the ascent up to the second floor might be a tad off putting, but all in all this is a great find. Would definitely stay here again.

Booked this place last minute due to a change in plans, and the hosts were super helpful getting me into a new place right next door to my previous spot! so helpful. Best shower, ever! Wonderful kitchen to use, and cozy place. would absolutely stay again
Really nice location and lovely room!
This room is great with everything you need and has beautiful little details! The location is also perfect as its walking distance to everything within Edinburgh.

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour chez Silke. La chambre est magnifique, exactement comme sur les photos, et vraiment très confortable. Le reste de la maison est charmant, bien que partagé, nous avons toujours eu notre intimité. De plus, le logement est parfaitement situé, dans une rue pleine de charme également et à proximité de la vieille ville. C’était un plaisir de traverser le parc pour s’y rendre. Nous garderons un très beau souvenir de ces quelques jours, l’hôte était absolument gentille et accueillante, et nous a attendu malgré notre arrivée tardive. Tout était parfait!

A perfect spot to explore beautiful Stockbridge! Much calmer than the very centre of town but still super walkable to the train station. Beautiful bars, pubs, shops, restaurants only a short wander away. Check in was super easy, the place was tidy & clean and well laid out to feel nice and spacious despite only being a small flat. Will definitely stay again!
Muy recomendabke el apartamento, buena zona para visitar la ciudad. Muy limpio, cuidado, calentito y agradable. Estupenda la comunicacion con Nicola.

Beliggenhed, beliggenhed, beliggenhed. Medmindre du har adgang til at booke ophold på slottet i Edinburgh, så bliver det ikke mere centralt end Arvins bolig. En perfekt base for et kortere ophold i Edinburgh, hvor hurtig og nem adgang til de vigtigste sights er af afgørende betydning.

Fantastic spacious apartment easy walk into the heart of Edinburgh. The addition of the parking was extra added bonus. could not ask for more

Don was a great host, very helpful and great with communication.
Cannot praise the apartment or Don enough.
Recommend to all.
Fantastisk sted!

Amplio departamento, bien equipado, y en una zona muy linda.
Pasamos hermosos días

What a marvelous, cozy place!  We immediately fell in love with this nicely furnished and well equipped maisonette apartment. It was close next to the river Leith, and to the Botanic garden, so plenty of opportunities to walk around and enjoy the green parts of Edinburg.  We were also very pleased to find that there was a wonderful historic swimming center right across the street, open almost every day until 10 pm and located in a recently refurbished very beautiful old building. The city center was easily accessible by bus, the next stop being just 7min away from our place. Concerning food and other stuffs, we found everything we needed at the Sainsbury's and Scotmid Coop supermarkets nearby.  Huge choice and good prices.  All in all the charming flat in Stockbridge was a wonderful experience. We loved it and will hopefully  come back soon.

Wendy is the perfect hostess. Her flat is beautiful and well located so that the city centre is easily accessible both on foot and by bus.
She gave us valuable tips and made our stay in Edinburgh very special!
I can 100% recommend staying with Wendy - we will definitely stay with her again if we travel to Edinburgh again
Lovely place, made me and my partner feel right at home
Un logement très bien situé, une chambre confortable, un hôte disponible et réactif . Une excellente adresse.

Susanna was so lovely. And she has a very nice home. It was pleasure to meet her and stay with her.
Would love to stay there again!

Todo bien en este alojamiento. Sobre todo por la atención de Marta en todo momento. Tuve un problema con el vuelo de ida y estuvo todo el tiempo volcada en ayudarme.
El barrio es una zona tranquila, residencial, pero muy bien comunicada con el centro de la ciudad por dos autobuses distintos, asi como con el aeropuerto con otro autobús.
Lo dicho, todo bien.
Amazing flat! Amazing view and very walkable to all the hot spots in town, you couldn’t find a better location.

Veldig bra leilighet, stille og rolig, kjøkken og bad virket nyoppusset, og kjøkkenet var svært godt utstyrt.
Helt ideelt sted å bo for 2 personer, men går også greit å være 4.
Like ved Leith Walk med restauranter og gode bussmuligheter. Og det så ut til at trikkesporet snart åpner også.
