Vickys air bnb was great. It was very clean and spacious and we were supplied with food/snacks/drinks which were very appreciated🫶🏼 would definitely recommend
很棒的体验

Edinburgh Views has two entrances on different levels. The lower one is accessible to trams, trains, shopping and galleries. The upper one cuts through the close to The Royal Mile, conveniently close to bus stops, restaurants, sights and all Edinburgh has to offer. Friendly hosts and an awesome place to stay.
Nice apartment, right in the tourist centre of Edinburgh. Beautiful views of the castle. Host was easy to communicate with and check in was easy.

Kerry was a fantastic host, accommodating and responsive.
The Edinburrow was squeaky clean and nicely appointed. The beds were very comfortable. The location was perfect for exploring many areas of the city with restaurants all around. We very much enjoyed our stay. We would recommend it.
Great location, great hosts! We’ll be back again soon!

Francois’s apartment was lovely. 7 of us stayed and we felt like there was plenty of room for us all. The rooms were all nice, clean and very spacious. The location was great and getting in and out was very convenient. Highly recommend!
This is a very good spot if you need proximity to the airport. There is parking in bays in front of the building. The room is functional, Shona is extremely friendly and considerate.

Wir haben uns sehr willkommen gefühlt und das Appartment wat wie beschrieben. Wir waren mit drei Kindern unterwegs und es hat vom Platz her ausgereicht. Die Kinder haben sich ebenfalls wohl gefühlt - es gab verschiedene Spiele im Appartment u.a. " Vier gewinnt". Das war toll! Das Appartement liegt ruhig, was für uns ebenfalls schön war nach einem langen Tag in der Stadt. Außerdem konnten die Kinder runter in den Hof. Die Betten waren sehr gemütlich und wir haben wirklich gut geschlafen und uns gerne im Appartement aufgehalten.

This was such a lovely stay! Very clean and well equipped - plenty of books and crannies for placing your toiletries which was great. This is in an excellent location as well, just a short walk from the royal mile.

We stayed at Fatim's apartment for three nights and we had a fantastic time. The apartment is beautiful, clean, well-equipped, and comfortable. It has all kitchen appliances, two bedrooms, a cosy living room with tv, and wireless internet. The apartment is perfectly located next to the beach and public transport to the city. Fatim was very friendly and helpful. She had arranged for bread, butter, and milk for breakfast on our arrival. She also gave us some booklets and recommendations about Edinburgh, and lent us some coins for the bus as we didn't have change. We felt very welcome and we highly recommend staying at Fatim's apartment.

I couldn’t recommend Rebecca’s place enough! She made our trip so much better, from a very late check in due to a delayed flight to the instructions and recommendations all the way through to a late check out as well. We felt so cared for and just like at home! The place itself is lovely, has everything you could possibly need and we couldn’t get enough of the cats! Truly the best Airbnb experience of our lives - Rebecca is just simply an incredible person and chatting to her made our evenings all the more special :) thank you so much for having us!

We had a wonderful 3-day stay with our family! The rooms were spacious, beautifully maintained, and provided the perfect retreat after our city adventures. Our hosts were incredibly friendly and attentive—they went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable, even sharing a curated list of must-see spots in and around the city, which made our trip extra special. Their hospitality truly made us feel at home. Highly recommend this lovely place to anyone visiting.
Great place and great host - clear instructions and comms, as well as a lovely location.
Logement très bien situé pour visiter la ville tout en étant très calme. Ben est un hôte réactif et sympathique, ses instructions étaient super claires.

Cat's accommodations are such a gem in the heart of Edinburgh. The room is warm, lovely, and very well laid out. The bed is comfy and the shower is hot (but not too hot). There are loads of great cafes, little shops and restaurants nearby. Cat herself is a relaxed and lovely host and I felt right at home immediately.

Amanda has the most beautiful home: sunlight-flooded; delightfully-decorated; and with a wonderful atmosphere (reflecting its owner's character).  And Amanda is such a hospitable hostess, even leaving breakfast out for us, and offering a list of places to eat at.  I cannot recommend this charming Stockbridge flat enough.
Ben is lovely. Very friendly and also interesting. Loves my stay. Will come back
A perfect place for a few days getaway.
Séjour très agréable. Tout était parfait et Tracey s’est toujours montrée très accueillante et prévenante. Je recommande
great place to stay for a solo traveler! super cozy room and beautiful bathroom. magda was very responsive as a host - i would definitely stay again!
房子非常好，有暖气，走三分钟就有超市，离景点都很近，而且房东人真的很好，如果下次来的话肯定还会住这。👏

Cozy and warm place! Janet is a very kind and lovely host!
Also room and bathroom super clean and wonderful location.
We enjoyed so much our stay!
Amazing stay would recommend to anyone went beyond a host would stay again

Un bon accueil. Une hôte avenante prête à rendre service. Une chambre propre et une très bonne situation géographique pour visiter Edimbourg à pied sans être très loin des arrêts de tramway qui vont à l'aéroport.
Abhishek was very friendly and very helpful. His family was also very nice to us.

Perfect host, perfect apartment, perfect location!
Apartment had absolutely everything we could need and we were able to walk everywhere. Michelle was so friendly and helpful. Parking a bonus. Could not recommend more as a place to stay.

Adorei a estadia, o espaço estava impecável.
Camas e almofadas muito confortáveis, a cozinha tinha tudo o que necessito para cozinhar e tudo estava extremamente limpo.
Senti-me em casa. Recomendo.

Top Lage für Edinburgh!
Wunderschöner & ruhiger Ort und das Zentrum ist gleich vor der Haustür. Direkt am Calton Hill gelegen und mit dem eigenen Garten, kann man sich nach einem ereignisreichen Tag in der Stadt bestens erholen. Wir würden die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen.

Wow- what an amazing location! We couldn’t get enough of the view from the living room window. Beats any fancy hotel! Aileen also filled the apartment with lovely personal touches so that it feels like a home away from home. Enjoyed the book collection which includes local guides and ghost stories for those feeling brave!
Lovely stay at Steve's place. The location is really close to the city, Christmas Markets etc. The room was clean and spacious, and Steve was very responsive and helpful.
Very clean. Walking distance to train station and the old town.  Great communication and recommendations for exploring the area.
Thank you both for the lovely stay in your flat. Clean, spacious and with everything I needed during my work trip to Edinburgh.
Absolutely beautiful apartment, perfectly placed and exactly as described.  Brilliant communication and info.  Would definitely recommend and would return.  Many thanks

Amazing location and quaint apartment. Perfect space for 2 with excellent amenities. Close to the Royal Mile and many pubs and restaurants. Host was responsive and clear with instructions. Hike Arthur’s Seat if you can!

Martin’s apartment is such a cosy and wonderful place to stay. It’s location is perfect for exploring Edinburgh and the host truly makes it special with little, extra touches like hot water bottles, Tunnocks Tea cakes and even a Christmas tree (our stay was in December!) Everything was spotlessly clean and it had all you could need for your stay. The log  fire was the cherry on the cake for us. We hope to stay again.
Carol has a lovely place and is very accommodating. I would recommend Carol’s place to anyone and would be glad to make a return trip!

Claire a été une hôte très agréable  et  répondant efficacement à nos demandes. l'appartement était très bien situé à proximité d'un parc et de Arthur's seat et d'un arrêt de bus très bien desservi pour le centre ville. Nous recommandons cette adresse
Was ok for the price paid but not as expected

The airbnb looks like the pictures. Catriona was very responsive and helpful with our early check-in. She gave us very good tips about things to do in the city. The house was clean and cozy.
We visited in december and the flat was cold. Thanks to Catriona’s advice we used the secondary heater option, hot water bottle and slept with two duvets. If you are visiting in winter would recommend bringing very thick clothes.
Nevertheless we are happy with our stay. It was one of the good airbnb experiences we had :)

This is a great place to stay at. I liked the display of books about Leith or Edinburgh. The design of this flat. Everything is close nearby. And Mark's recommandations were very useful.  I liked it and would definitely come again !

Super zu erreichen per Bus vom Airport und zu Fuss um in die Stadt zu gelangen.
Angenehm schönes Zimmer, Mikrowelle und Ofen in der WG-Küche zur Verfügung,
Alan, was an excellent host and deserves his SuperHost status. He was very welcoming, had good advice and great suggestions for our time in Edinburgh. We look forward to a return visit.

Brilliant spot to visit Edinburgh from. So much space in the apartment with everything you may need. Excellent transport links to the city centre with perfect bus number recommendations! We would definitely stay again.

A wonderful location, just one block from the Royal Mile, multiple cafés, convenient stores and gift shops on the same street. I was able to walk to all attractions. The hosts were excellent sending all details with pictures. The flat was clean and the bed was so comfortable. I was in the smaller Oban room but there was enough storage. It’s on the 3rd floor and 3 rooms share a kitchen and a bathroom but we never had issues. The street view was also nice. Overall I was very happy and wish I could stay longer.

The apartment is beautifully appointed with plenty of space. It is light and airy with comfortable furniture. Marta, our host was friendly and very helpful and even checked if we had any allergies to ensure the right breakfast foods were available. This was wonderful touch and very much appreciated. I also have an allergy to feathered bedding and Marta ensured that a synthetic alternative was in place for me.
The views out of the apartment of Holyrood Park are incredible and a pleasure to gaze out the window whilst eating breakfast or relaxing on the sofa.
We stayed here during Edinburgh Fringe - it was situated in a quiet part of the city and easy walking distance to the centre. A great place to chill out at the end of the day.
A perfect venue. Close to tram and amenities. Great space. Really quiet.
The place is beautiful and illuminated, and the location was perfect for us
Comfortable, clean, welcoming flat in a convenient location for Haymarket Station and within walking distance of Edinburgh centre.
Don’t miss Scottish National Museum.

Ideal location for visiting all attractions. Comfortable & clean. Good kitchen, however we didn’t cook, & only ate continental breakfasts. Plenty of room, & was perfect for a 3 generational  mini break. Ideal transport links within walking distance. Host friendly & accommodating.

The room is big, bright & spacious, with a lovely ensuite shower room. Lovely quiet location, with free parking; and you can easily walk into and about town.
Thank you, Natalie & Chris; for being kind, friendly, warm & welcoming hosts. So deeply appreciated.

I cannot say enough good words about Don and his home! Don was very knowledgeable about the area and gave us great tips and advice on where to go! The apartment was very clean, close to many popular sights, and had many amenities. I highly recommend this apartment and Don!
Amazing place most stay! Thanks for hosting :)
Ajm is an excellent host!

This place was PERFECT; perfect location, parking free, quiet, SUPER clean, literally 50 ft from the Royal Mile through a close. It was great because it even had extra toiletries in the bathroom, cleaning stuff in the kitchen (fully stocked), washer/dryer and just all around very comfortable. I felt like we had our very own apartment in the city center. I will definitely stay again when visiting Edinburgh. Thank you Keith!!!

logement tout à fait conforme au descriptif. Stefano est très amical et disponible. la chambre est simple mais très fonctionnelle. À environ 20 mn du centre via différents bus, l’accès au logement est facile

Katie and Omar are kind, thoughtful and responsive hosts. We stayed a whole month and nothing was too much trouble for them. Almost everything we needed was provided but do note there is no television. Also be aware that there is no lift and the accommodation is on the second floor. The apartment was spotlessly clean and the abundant linen and towels were fresh and new. The bedroom, with roll top bath is delightful. We only needed to contact our hosts twice and they immediately assisted us with charm and kindness.
The area just off Leith Walk is relatively quiet and safe and there is a good bus and tram service. We were there during the Edinburgh Festival and Fringe, so the city was vibrant and full of fun with cafes and restaurants offering great food. The Fringe, particularly, offered an unimaginable variety of entertainment for all. Given that lodging in Edinburgh is at an absolute premium during this period, Katie and Omar's apartment was great value for money.

This apartment was so beautiful, we were so impressed with the historic details, 14 ft hi ceilings, art, decor, comfy bed, luxurious bath and modern & well equipped kitchen.
The location in New Town was perfect. We walked to the castle, royal mile and all of the sights but at the end of the day, we returned to “our neighborhood” for dinner at the restaurants nearby. All were excellent and Fiona gives a list of suggestions in her welcome binder.
We’ve stayed at a lot of Airbnb places all over Europe and I have to say, this is one of the best. I felt like we’re staying in a home that should be in Architectural Digest magazine with incredibly comfortable furnishings.
If we come to Edinburgh again, we would definitely stay here.
Thanks for your hospitality.
Barbara & Kevin
It was an incredible stay.  Abbie was a wonderful host and helpful. Would recommend staying here without any worries.

Sally was approachable and always helped us promptly when needed.
The house location is incredible and allowed us to do everything we wanted by foot. There are many good restaurants and cafes around.
The house is large, cozy and as described and shown in the advertisement. As for cleanliness and structure, it lacks in few details.
Recommended!
Great place! Very comfortable for 4 adults. It's in a fairly private area but still accessible to Old Town. Clean. Lien was very communicative!
Unique, luxurious space in a great location. Iona was an excellent host, very responsive and welcoming, and her lovely flat was the perfect place to explore Edinburgh from. Highly recommended!

Location absolutely unbelievable. It's right by everything you need! Right in the city and close to all the sights as well as the coffee shops, bars and shops. It's cute and the tucked away on the back so really isn't noisy at all for the location. Sofa bed is okay for 2 nights but not longer than that but didn't job! Would definitely stay again. Thanks!
Enjoyed very much, great spot with easily accessible public transport and walkable to central Edinburgh

We have really good days!!!!!!
Very good facilities!!!
Strongly recommend!!
A quick turnaround for check in after a late booked, great communication and lovely place to stay

We had a lovely stay in Jacqui's apartment. It was clean, spacious and well equipped. Located in a calm area of Edinburgh, though still very closed to the main attractions.
Jacqui was thoughtful and really friendly. We followed few of her recommendations (tour, restaurant, museum) and we were never disappointed!
I 100% recommend her flat!
Leith is a great location a Pete t for us visiting family. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed.
Veldig hyggelig vert! Fleksibel og lokalkjent. Rommet var luftig, pent og romslig. Lokasjonen perfekt for turister, nær det meste som er verdt å se. Kommer gjerne igjen.
Very good central location,nice spacious apartment,everything in walk-able distance.
The place was so nice and clean. The location is great, we spent a very good time.
Really good location, apartment just as described.
Really great flat in a central location, in the heart of the action. It is a very clean and well presented flat. Aida is a fabulous host, very friendly and accommodating.

We’ve just arrived home from a wonderful stay at Emily’s flat and have had the most amazing time.
The flat was beautiful, clean, well maintained and in a great location (Edinburgh is on your doorstep). Fabulous facilities with the kitchen stocked with all the necessary equipment plus...milk in the fridge, soaps in the shower, Christmas tree up and absolute cleanliness. Also, the much appreciated personal friendly welcome, and so many more good things...
I recommend this as a five star flat all round!

We are delighted with our stay at Suzanna's place. Everything was perfect and she was really flexible. The room and bathroom were spotless and well-located in the house (you are on an isolated floor). The area is also quite peaceful and if you want to go to the city centre, the bus ride is no more than 20 minutes.
We highly recommend it!

This apartment was perfect! It's not downtown Edinburgh, so expect quite a walk to, however we actually preferred the walk. It allowed us to escape the tourist chaos, and we could also see a different part of Edinburgh - Leith.
We found that Goa was very friendly and provided a clean and well maintained apartment. Our only comment would be the lack of coat hooks in the front hall. Since it rained a few days that we were there, it would be nice to have hooks for our wet raincoats.
Thanks Goa!

Great location to explore both the old and new town. Only downside is the noise from outside the apartment from late night and into the wee hours. But that’s the price for the central location (used earplugs!). Apartment had everything we needed and superb having a coffee and watching the Royal Mile come to life each morning through the large windows. Hosts were fantastic with instructions and highly recommend them and this apartment for its central location.

I loved this flat! Everything had been thought of - from the charging mat for your phone to the kitchen utensils( I liked the draining board)
The bed was one of the most comfortable air b&b beds I have slept in ..
shower was also one of the best.
Thanks for the fizz- we drank it Valentine’s Day!!
A note - you get very fit walking up the 4 flights of stairs - (72 steps) but the views from the flat are stunning!

Siamo molto soddisfatti del nostro soggiorno: l’host è stato veramente disponibile e gentile, è stato anche molto flessibile riguardo agli orari di check-in e check-out. Inoltre l’appartamento era in ottime condizioni e molto pulito. Buona anche la posizione della casa. La consigliamo!

An absolutely lovely flat!  Very well appointed, clean and quiet.  Can't beat the location.  Check in was as easy as it gets and Philipp was warm, welcoming and very communicative through out the entire stay.  A wonderful place to stay if you are ever in Edinburgh, highly recommended.

Lovely apartment at a very convenient location. Douglas was very responsive and welcoming.
A dispute about a breakage after the checkout. But that doesn’t change the facts and my opinion about the apartment and the host.
The location is very nice and clean. The location is very well equipped. It's very close to the center of Edinburgh. Owen is very kind by message. It was a very good stay ! Would recommend.

The Grassmarket Snug was the most perfect place for our Edinburgh trip, in a wonderful location with good amenities.
The Snug was super comfortable and pristinely clean. In a grade II listed building steeped in history.
Ashlie&Grant kept in touch with clear guidance and instructions and the information about Edinburgh was really helpful.
Had the perfect stay thank you!

Fantastic place to stay for a couple of nights. Easy to walk into town and on a busy bus route. Had breakfast in the Greek place and red kite, both fab and ate at the Edinburgh street food market (about 10 minutes walk) and the Herringbone - spoilt for choice for good for food nearby!

Logement parfaitement propre, chaleureux et accueillant. Très fonctionnel. Rien ne manquait. Salle de bain nikel avec pression et eau chaude sans probleme. Parking gratuit et facile à quelques metres. Centre d'Edimbourg à 1h en bus  de l'agglomération donc très bon emplacement si vous venez avec votre voiture. On recommande vivement ! Merci Cody !

The place is old and the furniture the same in living room which is not same as the photos of the place,plus the floors and carpet it wasn't clean while I checked in and the bed sheets has a black spots and one of pillows had blood spots which is disgusting. She charged me 35pounds for early luggage drop off at 11:30 and she sent me an email regarding early check in so i can come early around 10:30 and I got a UBER for dropping me off at her place which is cost me around 20pounds and then I cant checked in because she sent an email by mistake which is not my fault which she didn't even offer me anything for her mistake at least a drop off my luggage after long flight.
The best thins in the place for me only the location was perfect that's it .

I had a very disappointing experience staying at this property. The heater was not working at all, which made the house extremely cold and uncomfortable to stay in. Additionally, the washroom locks were broken, which was quite inconvenient and concerning.
What made the situation worse was the lack of communication from the host. They did not respond to any of our questions or concerns during the stay.
Although Airbnb provided a partial refund, it did not adequately compensate for the discomfort we experienced, especially given how difficult it was to stay in such low temperatures.
Overall, I would not recommend this place to anyone

Feel very lucky to have found this property and we stayed here whilst performing at the fringe. This is a truely beautiful and immaculately clean flat with helpful and friendly hosts.  Everything we could possibly have needed was available and the flat is beautifully and tastefully designed throughout. Thank you to Scherie & Reaaz for making us so welcome.
We had a superb couple of days in this appartment. Spacious, fantastic area, everything we needed. - I can highly recommend.
Lars (Sigrid) was very responsive to our inquires. Clear instructions where helpful. Overall our stay in Edinburg was enjoyable.

This is a great place to stay!
The accommodation is exactly like the photos. The kitchen is well-kept, and you have everything you need to make your meals. The bed was extremely comfortable! The bathroom was immaculate, and the raindrop shower had great pressure (which is excellent for curly-haired girlies). The bath was a bonus for me.
The location is quiet, with little street traffic and quiet at night. The bus is easily accessible, and the area is very walkable. Great restaurants and pubs are nearby, and a grocery store is a short walk away.
Emily is a great host and has excellent resources on her page. She reached out before my arrival to make sure I had everything I needed and to schedule a meet-up. She is friendly and offered a tour of the accommodation.
I felt at ease and comfortable here, which is important as a female solo traveller. I also felt safe walking back to the house after dinner—everything was well lit.
I would 100% stay here again when I return to Edinburgh.
非常好！整个过程无比愉快！
We had a great stay at The Old Town Snug. It is close to all the wonderful sights, shops and restaurants of the city. The flat was very cosy, with amazingly comfortable beds and duvets!
A great stay with terrific hosts! Highly recommend!

I had an absolutely wonderful stay at Emma’s place. She is an incredibly friendly, welcoming, and helpful host who instantly makes you feel at home. The room and the entire apartment were spotlessly clean, very stylish, and beautifully decorated, with so many thoughtful amenities—everything you could possibly need and more.
The breakfast was outstanding, honestly the best I’ve ever had. The location is perfect: close to everything, yet cosy, peaceful, and quiet. Overall, an amazing experience from start to finish. I would highly recommend staying here and would happily return

When we arrived Rebecca give us a good welcome. She invited us and showed us our rooms. A lot of space! The dog gave us a nice welcome as well.
She told what was necessary to know and we’re we good have dinner.
We decided to walk to Balerno and in the centrum we found a good Indians restaurant.
We had also a nice and good breakfast, what ever wished for. And a good chat with Rebecca and Jimmy. But we good also stay just with the two of us if we didn’t want to talk.
So, we had an excellent stay with them!!!

The apartment was generally satisfactory and well located — not in the very center of Edinburgh, but conveniently close, with easy access by bus or about a 20-minute walk. There are several large supermarkets nearby, as well as a few restaurants and pubs. The neighborhood was fine overall, although we did experience one incident involving a very drunk person shouting in the building for several hours.
The apartment itself did not fully match the impression given by the photos. The renovation seems to have been done somewhat hastily, with relatively inexpensive materials. We encountered a couple of maintenance issues during our stay — the heating and kitchen fan — but both were resolved promptly. The managing company’s communication was excellent, and I appreciated their quick and helpful responses, as well as the temporary heaters the owner provided while the heating was being repaired.
With some additional attention, this property has the potential to be a great option in Edinburgh.

We had a wonderful few days exploring the sights of Edinburgh from Stephanie’s flat. The place itself is extremely comfortable, clean and just a lovely space to relax in. Communication with Stephanie was seamless and she was more than happy to offer recommendations for places to see, eat and enjoy. The location of the flat is very handy for the city centre. Would recommend as a great base from which to visit the city and surrounding areas from. Thank you and we will be back!
Awesome location! Very close to the castle (you can even see it from the living room). Clean as well. Would recommend this spot!

Great place to stay. Close to centre.
Lovely welcome croissants fresh bread eggs and honey ...plus more!

Galina was a lovely host. The house was modern and super clean. My only gripe was that it is a bit far from the city centre but then again there is excellent public transportation in Edinburgh as buses run every few minutes, so no real issue there. I highly recommend this place. Would love to go there again.

Selby's place was so beautiful and comfortable, and he is an incredibly kind and accessible host. He gave us many ideas about what to do in the neighborhood, and they were all excellent. We hope to stay with him again!

Unsere Gastgeber haben uns herzlich empfangen. Sie waren sehr aufgeschlossen und hilfsbereit.
Als wir unsere Unterkunft betraten, waren wir beeindruckt von der perfekten Einrichtung des Schlafzimmers, des Wohn- und Essbereichs und der Küche. Es fehlte an nichts. Alles war verfügbar.
Die perfekte Sauberkeit war bestechend.

Nous avons passés 3 nuits dans le logement de Nathalie et avions été très content.
C’est un logement agréable, propre et bien aménagé. Cuisine bien équipé, il manque néanmoins un micro-onde.
Proche du centre ville, dans un quartier calme.
Seul petit manquement, nous avons du acheter du papier toilette car un seul avait être prévu alors que nous restions 3 nuits.

Chris a été très accueillant et nous a donné pleins de bons conseils. Tres disponible. Immeuble tres sécurisé, proche de tout, des bons restaurants à proximité. Le logement etait tres propre avec tout le necessaire. Je recommande.
Ali was a very good host with always good communication and recommendations for places to eat and see in the area! I wish to come back again, no doubt.

A well-situated flat to explore the rest of Edinburgh with.  It’s a little modest in that there are not many homely comforts, but that is generally not what you need when traveling anyway.  Easily walkable to every where from the old town to Leith to several hills of note, I could not have been happier with the walkability of the apartment.  Close enough to a main street to feel comfortable walking alone at night, but not loud.  Ellie & Scott were responsive to my questions and also leave a nice little guidebook to give suggestions.
Posizione ottima ed host molto gentile e disponibile.
The best air bnb I have ever been to- felt like an oasis in the centre of the bustling city. Fantastic host- fantastic everything. Will return if I can, will recommend to all!!!

Alloggio in una posizione strategica per potersi muovere a piedi nella zona centrale di Edinburgo.
Gary molto molto disponibile, e l'appartamento pulitissimo e molto ordinato, come essere a casa.
Sicuramente lo terremo presente per la nostra prossima visita ad Edimburgo 😊
We had a lovely stay at annika’s place. Would recommend anyone travelling with family.

James and Jess' place is roomy! Unfortunately, we were only there for one night. We all agreed that when we come back to Edinburgh it would be a great location for visiting the city. It's conveniently located with many restaurants nearby. The flat was very clean and had everything we needed.

We loved staying at Jennifer’s place. She was a great host and super friendly! I would recommend and stay there again. The walk from the train was easy and location was great!
A little deck off the back with beautiful garden area!
Lovely place, great location. Just a little cold at night.

Sin lujos pero correcto

Just spent a great  weekend at the lovely Artists studio in Edinburgh.  It is first class, with high quality  decoration, fixtures and fittings . Fiona is very thoughtful , with milk, fruit, tea, coffee and delicious granola waiting for your arrival. She is also available if you need any help or advice. Would definitely stay there again next time we are in Edinburgh and would have no hesitation in recommending it to friends.
Brilliant flat in a really nice location, thanks for the stay!
Very comfortable bed. Fun decor. An overall unique and comfortable stay.

Stayed for 3 nights. We had a great time staying at Valentino’s place. Communication was great, place was clean and location pretty good. Not too far off from the center and had everything you needed around.
Check-in was easy too.
Definitely would come back and can only recommend his place. :)

Bob was a fantastic host. He was so helpful by letting us drop our bags off as soon as we had arrived on an early flight and gave us a slightly extended stay so that we weren't traipsing around with our bags on the day of our departure.
The house was beautiful, lovely decor and very clean and tidy. We both felt very much at home there :)
Bob left us some lovely bread, cereal,fruit, milk and butter for our breakfasts as well as a hair dryer and towels for our convenience. We didn't want to leave! Thanks Bob!

My first experience with using AirBnb and it was amazing. The place, the location everything!

Best place ever!!!! Six stars!
I’ve been in many airbnb places and this one was amazing. Me and my wife had a great time in Edinburgh and we are glad that we could find such a nice place with such a nice host.
Every thing perfect: cleaning, bedroom, shower, wifi, kitchen, coffee 😍.
Thank you so much Michele.

Colin was an amazing host! Quick responses and super helpful. The airbnb was easy to find and in a great location, so much to do nearby and the space was clean and beautiful. Bed was really comfortable and kitchen well equipped. Would stay here again if back in the area. Thanks again!

It is very convenient to arrive by bus from railway station. The host is so kind , so nice, so helpful for the trip to Edinburgh that I think no words can tell the wonderful living experience in the cozy and beautiful house. It is strongly recommended to reserve the house without any hesitation or doubt.We also thank the owners for waiting and coming to repair.
Thank you for the wonderful stay. It was a perfect women’s retreat. When we come back I will reserve this place once again.
We had a very nice stay. The apartment was sunny, clean, and well decorated. Necessities were nearby.

Great value for money. Lovely spacious house with quality furnishings.
Host friendly and provided tea, coffee, milk etc.
We had a brilliant family get together over Christmas.
I would recommend this house to anyone wishing to stay close to city centre. 😊😊
Appartement très propre, fonctionnel, emplacement idéale

Great flat, it has everything you might need for your time in Edinburgh. Paul was very quick to respond to any queries we had and was very helpful. All the essential amenities (towels, soap, TV, internet). Quiet street off about 15-20 min. walk from city center, reasonable walk from downtown, very enjoyable part of town, well-connected and full of nice things to do. I can highly recommend Paul and the flat for your stay in Edinburgh. Thanks for letting us stay!
Great place for a short stay in Edinburgh.  Plenty of space for two people and a great location for the centre of town and Stockbridge.
Great apartment in an awesome location. Very comfortable and well equipped.

Niel is a lovely host, and I had a great stay in his apartment. Nice room with a comfy bed, a stunning view of Arthur’s Seat and plenty of storage for a short stay. The room and whole apartment were spotlessly clean. The area is a nice, quiet, safe residential neighbourhood, a short easy walk from Waverley station and the city centre. Niel was really friendly and welcoming and was really flexible and amenable about check-in. I’d recommend his place to other travellers

I couldn't have found a better location to stay in Edinburgh, just off the Grassmarket, for such good value. The flat feels very secure, is well equipped and full of lovely touches. Ann is a very helpful host, and I would highly recommend staying here.
A fantastic stay in Edinburgh, made much better by staying in Margaret's place. A great location and the space was everything I needed.

Excellent stay, felt right at home. Beautiful location, very clean and cosy apartment. I would definitely recommend staying.
Only downside was the shower constantly went from scorching hot to cold, and it took forever to run a bath due to slow tap.

We had a lovely stay here, the apartment had a lovely, cosy feel to it. It was also very clean and tidy. There are lots of places to visit within walking distance and it’s easy to get in and around Edinburgh, to the airport, etc. using public transport too. Claire and Rob were super friendly and helpful and answered any questions we had very quickly. Would definitely recommend😊

What a perfect location to enjoy the area of Leith! Everything is right outside the front door. We couldn't be happier with our stay here. The apt has  everything you need to enjoy your stay. Great options to eat out or buy groceries if you prefer to cook instead. We highly recommend Zahn's Delicious Room (formerly Daisies Deli) on Bernard St. We had breakfast twice and they had the most delicious cake baked fresh that day.

Super Ausgangspunkt um Edingburgh und die Umgebung zu erkunden. Ruhige Lage, aber trotzdem ist man schnell in der Stadt und auch am Flughafen. Wir haben uns hier sehr wohl gefühlt. Vielen Dank für die Gastfreundschaft.
Very accommodating and responsive host! Would definitely stay again!
Very stylish flat, easy to access the city from! Great for either a short stay or a long stay. Communication from host was great, making the stay even smoother!

I really enjoyed my stay at Hanna's place. Personally, I loved the area it's located in; it's not the more touristy part of the city, rather it's adjacent to the Leith walk, which is full of great restaurants, pubs, shops, cafes, etc. The flat gets a good amount of natural light, and it's got a cozy feel to it. I will say the bathroom is a little small, but as I was just travelling on my own it didn't pose any issues for me. I would say Hanna's place is definitely worth considering!
性价比很高，房间非常漂亮，很有复古的味道，窗户也非常敞亮唯美

House has plenty of space for our multi generation family. Good wifi for multiple people to work and play electronics. Paula is very responsive. Cleaner seemed to miss a couple of things, but Paula gave us what we needed. Close to bus stop and restaurant. Great neighborhood, and we were able to leave our luggages after check out time as well!

My husband and I loved the location. It was lovely to wake up and walk around the corner and be at Arthur’s seat. The bus to get to the centre was about a 10 min walk away which was very convienet. The host was very helpful in giving clear instructions and would respond to my questions. Unfortunately my husband and I did not get much sleep the first night as the neighbours above were having a party till 2am. Luckily the host managed to sort it out and we had a more peaceful sleep the next night. We would have liked to have had more options for breakfast but the host catered for my dietary needs. My husband and I would have also liked if the host had curtains on the window and not a blind as it let a lot of light in and made it difficult to get to sleep.
Overall, the place suited us for our short trip and was good value for money.
Great place to stay. Spacious, clean and amazing view. Will definitely come back. Complete amenities apart from a microwave. But all in all great place to stay and cosy.

Appartement décoré simplement,  bien équipé pour accueillir un groupe de 16-17 personnes, très bien situé sur le Royal mail du vieux Edimbourg, à 15 minutes à pied de la gare et du terminus de la navette venant de l'aéroport, 10 minutes à pied du château et très proche de la cathédrale St-Gilles. Ne convient pas à des personnes handicapées au niveau des membres inférieurs ou ayant des problèmes à gravir des escaliers assez raides sur 2 gros étages).

ci siamo sentiti come a casa. il quartiere è bellissimo e tranquillo e molto facilmente collegato al centro di Edimburgo. il giardino pittoresco che si vede dalle finestre del salotto, ti fa subito immergere nell' atmosfera della scozia. inoltre, non meno importante, l appartamento era davvero pulito e in ordine all' arrivo. siamo stati benissimo e lo consigliamo a tutti.

Apartment in a great location close to the Castle, University and numerous pubs and restaurants. With this central location, it can get noisy at night though.
Apartment clean and beds comfy. However, an improvement would be the provision of shower gel and shampoo (as listed in amenities) as well as some kitchen essentials such as washing up liquid, dish sponges or dishwasher tablets and a few coffee pods.
But we enjoyed our 2 night break and would love to return again sometime soon. Thanks.
Charming flat, great location, would recommend to anyone wanting to visit the area
The house is just perfect. Very practical, nice, pleasant, clean, with a lot of nice facilities. And Ronnie is very reactive and easy to communicate with. Don't hesitate!

A nice and cosy cottage, which provides all facilities you may need during your stay. Clean beds and bathroom make you feel like at home. Small fridge, microwave and basic kitchenware for simple dining. Mike and Sandy were just great! They helped us a lot with all of our specific wishes.

It is very rare that a place on Airbnb is *exactly* as described, but this place definitely is! The space is gorgeous and right in a prime location in the middle of Edinburgh’s Georgian New Town area. Janet is a wonderful host! I stayed at her place for several months because of my job and I really enjoyed it.

If you are not convinced yet, let me tell you one more thing. Before staying at Janet's place, I must admit I was quite skeptical about sharing the kitchen. I really don't like sharing a flat. In this case it was just the kitchen, but still. In the end, contrary to my expectations, sharing the kitchen proved to be an advantage. First of all, I could always contact Janet just by going to the kitchen (if only it were always so easy to get in touch with your landlord). Furthermore, even though I was often spending quite some time in the kitchen, I almost always had it for myself. Last but not least, everybody knows how annoying it can be to forget to buy stuff like salt or washing liquid at the supermarket. Well, this has never been an issue for me! Basically, It has been as if I had my own kitchen, plus the basics (and sometimes more than that) were always available!!!

In the end, I cannot do anything else but strongly recommending Janet as a host!

An excellent Airbnb property –– we’d stay here again in a heartbeat.

Centrally located and quiet location, perfect for a short break to explore Edinburgh.  Flat was very clean and had many homey touches that made it very comfortable for a few days.  Derek was very communicative and quick to respond.  Would stay again!

Steve’s place was perfect for our group there for a golf trip!  Close to all things in Edinburgh and he went above and beyond to make sure we found fun things to do and great places to go.  We would definitely stay there again in the future.
Well-placed for visits to Murrayfield. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Communication was prompt and helpful. Would definitely recommend and hope to visit again!!
It was great thanks for everything

This is an absolute gem of a flat. Has all the touches that make this a wonderful place to stay. Warm, stunning rooms with high ceilings, delightful view of the street, right in the centre but also tucked away with stunning views of a private courtyard. Host is always available for queries. Guest information folder was really well put together. Bedding, towels and bathroom products all high quality. Just lovely and we can’t wait to come back. No hesitation in recommending Charlotte’s place. Wish we could have stayed longer!
A beautiful apartment close to everything - handy parking!

I had a wonderful stay in the apartment. It was clean and tastefully furnished. The incredibly soft bed linen deserves a special mention.
The communication was great with an extremely reactive host.
Overall an excellent experience, couldn't recommend more!

We had an amazing time staying in Laura’s apartment. It was on the top floor overlooking the main road with lots of independent shops and restaurants. A lovely and interesting high street and well worth exploring.
The apartment had two double bedrooms with really comfortable beds. We slept so well and makes a huge difference to your experience and stay especially after long days sightseeing.
Parking was fine for us. We parked outside the apartment everyday with no problem at all getting a space. The parking is charged for 2hr slots between 8:30am - 5:30pm. We paid for parking at the start or end of the day if needed. During the day we drove into Edinburgh and parked at the Q park Quartile parking which had a maximum charge of £20 for the day. I believe this was the cheapest city parking around.
The Italian next door, Pepe Nero was perfect for dinner and the food and service was excellent. Would highly recommend.
The apartment was comfortable, warm, light, well equipped, clean, had all the amenities needed.
Can’t think of any changes, cons or improvements. Was perfect for us.
If in Edinburgh again would definitely stay here and would be my first choice! Just excellent. Thank you for letting us stay.
Great studio apartment with everything you'd need. Great host who responds quickly and has good local recommendations.

It’s a shame because the place is nice but the issue was the alarm in the locked cupboard went off at 4 am and kept going odd, it was late so I didn’t contact the host (I should have) but thought I was very late and had a crying baby to deal with. Was an sleep due to the alarm. I wouldn’t stay here again based on this experience which may be out the hosts control due to the risk of that noise. It kept going off every 30 minutes. If you do come here make sure you bring your ear plugs
This is convinently located (close to the Royal Mile) while being far enough away for some privacy. The apartment is clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay again.
Cozy apartment in new town! It was very clean, the bed was comfortable too! Location is walkable to lost of places in Edinburgh!

Manula‘s apartment is located on a nice street not far away from Carton. It’s also very convinent to travel to places of interest by bus or tram. The apartment is tiny but clean and comfortable. I love the decoration inside. It feels warm and sweet. It is a good accommodation if you travel by yourself as a girl！

We can't imagine a better location in Edinburgh--right in the center of things yet quiet and peaceful. Viv was extraordinarily responsive and generous as a host. 10/10 would recommend and we would love to stay here again the next time we return to Edinburgh.
Very convenient and comfortable place to stay in Edinburgh. Apartment is small but has everything you need and is so convenient for everything.
Me gustó mucho la habitación, la cama es muy cómoda, el departamento en general, la atención de Michael fue muy grata, me gustó quedarme es su departamento, sin duda lo recomiendo.

Great place, beautiful neighborhood, walking distance to the key attractions across old and new town. Apartment is  wonderful for family for 4. Garage is a super plus. Lorna was proactive and entire process of check in and out was smooth. Strongly recommended
Lovely little flat within easy walking distance to Waverley Station, New Town, Old Town and Stockbridge. The team are very informative to make checking in and checking out as easy as possible.

Amazing flat in a fabulous  location. Spotlessly clean and really well appointed.  Everything thought of to make for a lovely,  relaxing  stay. Far more comfortable than any of the big hotels in the area for much more value. Would highly recommend and will be  back  again , hopefully  soon!
Verten var så hyggelig og hjelpsom, svarte raskt og det var et kjempefint mews-hus sentralt i Edinburgh. Vi hadde med vår datter på 1 år, og det var reiseseng der.

Habitación limpia y agradable, cercana al aeropuerto. Teníamos el vuelo muy temprano, así que fue una estancia muy corta. Precio alto para nuestro estándar, sobre todo tratándose de una habitación en casa habitada.
Excelente comunicación con Patrick, que nos dio mucha información y se ofreció a llevarnos al aeropuerto si no encontrábamos taxi/úber, lo cual nos tranquilizó mucho, aunque finalmente no lo necesitamos.
Recomendable.

Flat is in a good location near a tram stop, local shops and supermarkets. Good kitchen for making meals and very large tv. Eco friendly products were appreciated. Ground floor access to rear made it easy for buggy. Good communication from host.
Great place for a large group to stay. So much room and fab location. John was there to greet us and have a quick show around. Would book again
Thanks for hosting us
We spent 2 nights at Jeremy's place.  Wish we could have a longer stay as we were made so comfortable here. Highly recommend.

Die Wohnung ist toll gelegen: Mitten in Stockbridge, ein schönes und ruhiges Viertel, dennoch nahe am Stadzentrum. Die Wohnung ist gross und leicht erreichbar. Leider war sie aber sehr schmutzig (staubig, viele Flecken).

Anna et Nick ont été très sympathiques, de très bon conseil, aussi discrets que présents quand il le faut.
Petit déjeuner copieux.
La rue est paisible, le lit très confortable 😊
Le centre est facilement joignable en bus et à pied. Pas mal de restaurants à proximité.
Like staying over at a friend's.  I'd recommend Brian's place to anyone.

Main bedroom bed old and bed springs felt all night. Other 2 bedrooms beds comfortable. Great location and calming walk through The Meadows huge park straight into the main streets of the city.  A Chinese takeaway and pizza, fish and chips takeaway a few doors away. Both highly recommended.
Great place and a great location. Public transport is close and plenty of places to eat.

We could not speak more highly of this apartment! The home was very clean, spacious & had everything you could need. The location/proximity to downtown Edinburgh was perfect and truly picturesque.
The owner went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable.
We are truly grateful.
Logement propre et agréable, très proche du centre d'Édimbourg tout en étant dans une résidence calme.
The place is great and clean, Daria was very kind and helpful.
A fantastic stay - Claire and Rob were super helpful and responsive.

Annette was such a welcoming warm host. Nothing was too much trouble. She gave us some good recommendations to see in Edinburgh. Beautiful harbour side location. We were lucky with a parking space right outside the property.  Comfortable bed and lovely shower. Bus stop right outside which was very handy.

Audrey’s place is in a very nice area of old town Edinburgh. Very short walk to pubs and restaurants and the Edinburgh Castle. The place itself is super cute with lots of character. Audrey is an unbelievably good host, helpful in so many ways. Allowed us an early check in, left us snacks, gave us great recommendations and was very responsive and friendly to any questions we had. Highly recommend if you are staying in Edinburgh.

Stylish and very comfortable mews apartment. It’s like staying in an exclusive boutique hotel suite, but with all the extra touches that make it feel homely. Hazel is a lovely host.
A great location, we really enjoyed the walk into the centre of Edinburgh.

The apartment was very cozy, beautifully and stylishly furnished, and fully equipped. The kitchen in particular was exceptionally well equipped with everything you could possibly need. We really appreciated the quiet location, which allowed us to sleep peacefully without any disturbances. We absolutely loved enjoying the sunrise in the beautiful living room. Communication was completely smooth and hassle-free, and I would definitely recommend this apartment. Thank you once again very much for everything.

The apartment was great, very spacious and had everything we needed. The location is great being so central. The instructions for checkin were all very clear and hosts very responsive. I would definitely stay here again!
Lovely host, left us everything we would need and more. Would stay again! X

I had a fantastic stay at Mats Airbnb. The location was perfect, close to many beautiful restaurants and bars. Mat was helpful and accommodating.
The bathroom/shower was lovely! An overall wonderful stay in beautiful Edinburgh.

Très bel appartement à 30 minutes à pied du chateau d'Edimbourg. Un arrêt de tram est présent à 5 minutes à pied de l'appartement ce qui est une bonne alternative après une longue journée de marche.

Le plus pour nous a été le poêle à bois, très agréable en rentrant d'une journée bien remplie !
Martin est très réactif, nous avons beaucoup communiqué en amont et pendant le séjour.
Had such a lovely time staying here! Super calm and perfect for weekend getaways/solo travel. Calum is a great host and I will definitely be coming back! 😊
Good and clean stay

Great location in Edinburgh — close to everything we wanted to see in the city. The place was warm, cosy, and very comfortable. The host was friendly and extremely responsive, which made the stay even better. Would happily stay again!

Amazing wee flat in the heart of the city! Clean, tidy, everything you need for the perfect little weekend trip! Joanne is a fantastic host, kind, welcoming and extremely informative, cant recommend her enough and cant wait to visit again!!

We stayed here for 1 week and loved every minute.  The location is fantastic, central to everything , yet private enough where you could still have quiet.  The hosts have exceptional communication skills, offering confidence to us and one less thing to worry about before we went on our trip.  The shower is top notch.  Try the French place on Frederick street (Côté Brasserie) and nex door (Maryanne's ) .

This was a great spot to stay and be close to the main attractions of Edinburgh but also quietly secluded for a peaceful sleep. Isla the host was welcoming and offered good communication and recommendations

We rented this apartment for the night before and morning of our wedding for me and my bridesmaids. The apartment is absolutely beautiful and it is huge. Jane the host was lovely and very accommodating with our request for early check in she also provided a very detailed welcome manual which would be great for those in the city for a longer stay. Location was quiet but still a walking distance away from the city and a 5 mins walk to Leith Walk where you can get great cafes and restaurants for breakfast and lunch. We felt very welcome, everything was perfect, a cosy room and a spacious private bathroom. Great (and beautifully designed !) recommendations by Jean for the neighborhood.

The studio apartment was nicely furnished with a well equipped kitchen,. including condiments and utensils, and really nice bathroom.

I loved Radeks place.  Super clean and cozy.  Fabulous sheets and pillows.  Will be back!!
Great place! Super clean and feels like home on the city center of Edinburgh. Loved it!
A lovely place at great location. would definitely book again. All amenities were as mentioned, close to the beach, free parking. worked out perfectly for us.

I really enjoyed my stay at this perfect location, which is a 10/15 minute walk into Edinburgh city, or you can grab a taxi for £6.
I would 100% stay here again, and the property is big and clean with all the essentials you need and lots of shops and restaurants on your doorstep but also a quiet place to stay
Good communication and good location for what we needed. Accommodation was ok but a bit basic in some areas.

It's been exactly what we saw in the photos or even better. Very clean and cozy. Asma is very kind and she answered our questions immediately. Location is good with several buses to go to the centre.
I definitely recommend Asma and Mr Darcy to stay with! =D
Très propre, bien situé et Sean répond rapidement aux messages.
Really great stay lots around locally only 15 mins into city on bus thanks Ruth we really enjoyed our stay with you thanks Rob & Lou

Craig and Angie are a lovely, warm and kind couple. They were very welcoming and happy to help out with questions of any kind. They even provided chocolates, tea, water and coffee at the table in the room.

The location is perfect for a calm stay a bit outside the city. It is right next to a park, a nice historical café and a vibrant Inn loved by locals.
Really comfortable. Eleanor waited for us with tea and biscuits, flowers for us and things for our dog too.
Very central and beautifully presented apartment. Communication from host was excellent.
Decent location. Housing a bit outdated. Well stocked.

A haven indeed! This place is cosy and stylish - like a little perfectly formed IKEA show flat. A little out of the city of you don’t want to walk too far, but just across the road from a major supermarket so no need to worry about local amenities. A perfect cosy place for a weekend getaway.

Absolutely gorgeous flat (reminded us of a fancy design magazine) within striking distance of the main attractions in the city. The recommendations for food and activities are also great! We thoroughly enjoyed our time here.

Enjoyed this flat and would absolutely stay here again.

An amazing, cosy little flat with everything you could want or need for a short stay. very nice place, super central, and WAY better than getting a private room in a hostel :)

This place is wonderful, I would recommend without a moments hesitation. Warm, clean, stylish and lots of little extras you would not expect. Sarah and Joanna have got it just right. Thank you for a memorable stay, we will definitely visit again.xx

Fantastica esperienza.

We stayed down for one night. Very easy check in. Rough looking outside however very lovely flat. Clean, tidy and great facilities in the house. Was an amazing location to the tram, would definitely stay again.
Appartement très sympa, tout était propre et l’hôte très réactif et aimable. Nous avons même reçue un petit guide pour savoir comment se rendre à l’appart avec des instructions très clair.
Great place and perfect for a large group and in a fantastic location. thank you

Absolutely gorgeous place to stay! Would definitely stay here again ... is in an amazing location lots of public transport available and an easy 5-10 mins walk to the castle and old town of Edinburgh. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking to cook some meals as the kitchen was very well kitted out
Steve is a very kind host and his listing is absolutely beautiful!

A lovely quiet comfortable room with fabulous views in peaceful surrounds and a great location. Rachel was super kind and attentive, and I very much appreciated her willingness to accommodate my plans while in Edinburgh. Rachel could not have been more welcoming.
Fantastic location! Alison and Christian were lovely and very hospitable. Delicious breakfast and very comfortable room. Highly recommended! Edinburgh is fabulous.

A lovely quiet ground floor garden flat in a wonderful area of Stockbridge.
Easy to get into the City centre.

Le logement est bien situé, bus au bout de la rue pour aller dans la vieille ville, magasins à proximité pour faire les courses.

Il manque pas grand chose pour que ce soit parfait mais quelques points négatifs: peu de verres et assiettes, tous les robinets fuyaient ce qui fait que nous avons eu peu d’eau chaude pour les douches, store d’une chambre défectueux, joint de la douche bien abîmé.
It was great, very close to the city centre, and easily accessible. Loved the interior, well maintained, especially the kitchen. Had a fun time staying there.

Good apartment, not very far from city center by public transport, good quality/price report, with everything you need in the apartment. Essential commerce in the proximity. Good communication with the host. USB charging access absent for tourist who don’t think to bring adapter:)
Nota far from city center 15 mnts walk
Lovely Apartment in brilliant location with lovely views of Salisbury Crags from the front window. Harry was very friendly and informative.

Logement très propre se trouvant dans un quartier dynamique et au pied d’une station de tramway.

Aunque al llegar, la situación del portal (junto a contenedores), el propio portal y el ascensor, hacen que creas que te has equivocado de elección pero no es así.

Muy curioso el no tener contacto con nadie ni en el check in ni en el check out.
Eddie’s place was perfect for a couple’s weekend exploring Edinburgh! A great base in a lovely area - we loved the local pub, Kay’s. Would definitely recommend!

We had an amazing time staying at Scott’s during our trip to Edinburgh. We were welcomed very warmly and Scott was a friendly, thoughtful and professional host during our whole stay. He always let us know when he would be away or at the house which we greatly appreciated and he did everything to make us feel at home. We also received many useful tips for things to do and visit, and were provided with all the basic luxuries and various delicious options for breakfast every morning. The house was very clean and beautiful in general. All things considered, I truly cannot think of anything that could have been better! The accommodation might not exactly be in the city centre, but is very well connected through bus and tram. Leith itself actually is a great area as well with a lot of things to do and great bars and restaurants right around the corner of the house. In short, we would love to stay here again in the future! 🙂

Superb place on a peaceful street. Really clean, neat and tidy with all you need for a short stay. Less than 10mins walk to a gate into Holyrood park and easy access via bus into the city or out to coast. Gillian was really helpful and flexible. Great spot to stay in Edinburgh. Would definitely recommend.

My fiancé and I loved staying Calim’s place. It was extremely clean and had great amenities. It was centrally located to all the shops and restaurants. We will recommend his place to all of our friends. The stairs are a bit to get accustomed to but worth the hike :)
Easy check-in, communicative hosts with great recommendations and amazing location. Really enjoyed our stay.
a very beautiful house！and Lan help us a lot！nice trip：）
Perfect location in Edinburgh. The apartment was immaculate and comfortable. Susan was a brilliant host and was very patient when we were delayed on arrival. Would highly recommend.

Schöne, ruhige Unterkunft. zentral gelegen. Kommunikation mit Reggie Top! 👍
Very stylish and clean flat. Trudi responses to messages very fast. she allows us to check in earlier to store our luggages, thoughtful host.

Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt bei John sehr genossen. Die Wohnung war geräumig, die Betten waren bequem, die ÖPNV-Anbindung sehr gut. Die Kommunikation mit John war sehr gut: wir hatten Probleme mit der Waschmaschine (sie lies sich nicht öffnen) und er hat uns unkompliziert schnell geholfen. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

Craig’s flat is just lovely. It’s only a 10 minute walk into the centre of town and is in a nice quiet neighbourhood.
The flat is homely and comfy, which is what was needed after a busy day exploring Edinburgh. I would definitely stay again.
It was a very pleasant and comfortable staying. This gave us a such excellent experience. High recommendation!

The apartment is spacious and well appointed. The pictures are accurate. Everything worked as it should. The only negative was the parking lot was full of trash. Thats not really in the host's control, and it didn't affe t our stay. Public transportation is close by and city center is a short ride in.

A fantastic location for attending the fringe festival. The apartment was very comfortable for our group of six. There were a few things that made the stay less pleasant. Although we were six people, there were only five forks, and we had problems with both of the showers. The hallway at the top of the stairs is also dark and dangerous, as mentioned by numerous other reviewers. The owner/manager responded to us immediately, but did not fix the problems. I recommend Denise’s place, but with these caveats. Honestly, for the high price charged, it seems a good business decision for Denise to fix these seemingly simple and ongoing issues mentioned by others.

La habitación es muy bonita, el alojamiento está en una zona residencial muy fácil de llegar. Los anfitriones nos han procurado todo lo que necesitábamos. El perrito es hermoso y nos despidió por la mañana con mucho amor y cariño. 100% recomendado.

Anne’s place is excellently located for the amenities of Leith and Edinburgh. You’re not in the tourist epicentre but public transport makes it easily accessible and the area is pleasant and well situated for bars and cafes. The flat was clean and tidy and had some basic provisions available to tide us over until we could visit the nearby shops. Would definitely recommend for someone wanting a few days or more stay in the Leith/Edinburgh area.

What a great location for our stay in Edinburgh. It was a reasonable walk from Waverley Train station and right on the Royal Mile allowing us easy access to all the things we had planned for our stay. It was surprisingly quiet inside for its location and felt spacious for the four of us. Communication with the Host was great as well. We would stay here again.

These are simple rooms, good value, in a very good location. I went here because hotels in the center were booked and this was a good alternative. It's a room in an apartment where all rooms are rented, and you share the lounge, kitchen and bathroom. I never saw any of the other renters and the place was clean and well managed.

While this flat is very conveniently located to both Edinburgh Waverly and the Royal Mile, it was not the most ideal situation. Due to its proximity to the Royal Mile, it was very noisy at night. The host did take steps to prevent this by adding double windows, but the noise level was still high in the flat. Add to this mold in the bathroom and extremely uncomfortable beds, and our stay was not what we expected. There were no instructions on where things were/how things worked in the flat. Also, only one roll of toilet paper  (that we could find) in the entire place, with four women. It really is unfortunate, because you can't beat the location, but the amenities were just not up to snuff. I hesitate to say this, because it's Edinburgh which is basically one big staircase, but the flat was also up three flights of stairs, so beware if you have trouble with stairs.

Jemima’s place went above and beyond our expectations. Extremely well decorated, homey, and clean. Jemima went out of her way to make sure we were comfortable and happy. We loved this Airbnb and would highly recommend you stay here. 1000% would stay again when coming to Edinburgh!
Great spot to have walking access to all the best sites in Edinburgh.

Cary’s place is quiet and comfortable. She provided a lovely light breakfast, had great recommendations and general info about Edinburgh, and was all around enjoyable to chat with! She’s close to cafes, restaurants, small shops, and a lovely park. City Center is walkable. In fact, the only public transport we took our entire stay was back to Cary’s from the Botanics. And that was after a long day of sightseeing!

A lovely flat in a convenient location along the Royal Mile. Alison was extremely responsive and professional as a host, providing detailed instructions for check in. The flat was tidy and clean and provided all the basic necessities! We enjoyed our stay!
Peaceful neighborhood which is 10 minutes to old city center. Satisfying breakfast and gym facilities.
Great location, cozy flat. Would definitely book again.
Koselig leilighet i gåavstand til byen☺️

I would highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here for any return trips to Edinburgh!

Janet’s flat was absolutely lovely. I am convinced this is the best neighborhood to stay in when visiting Edinburgh. It’s quiet, clean, and a nice walk to the city center. Everything we needed was there and it was very comfortable. Cannot recommend enough!
Logement très agréable et propre, à environ 25mn de la vieille ville à pieds. Les transports sont accessibles facilement avec un arrêt de bus et une station de tram juste en bas de la rue.

It is hard to put into words what this airbnb was like… it was so terrible!

Oh and one sheet of loo roll?? And they expect 150 pounds cleaning fee! And to top this off there was a sanitary towel wrapper under the bed.
Absolutely disgusting from start to finish, so much so we left early! It was very upsetting as it was supposed to be a special weekend with family and I spent all my time trying to communicate to complain! Still waiting for a phone call about this experience.
Would not recommend!!

Apartment itself is really nice and a great location for access to central Edinburgh. Building its in is a little less attractive and the shower could do with some improvements but otherwise good enough
Nice apartment with free good and secure parking. Located very good to explore Edinburgh downtown on foot.
you got everything you need and it’s a good location! would use again!

Duncan was incredibly responsive and communicative. The apartment was sparkling clean, cozy, and inviting, and we couldn’t have asked for a better location. It was close enough to get to things quickly, but far enough away to be quiet. We would definitely stay here again!
整个房子非常干净整齐明亮，推荐

Overall a great place to stay!

War super. Sehr empfehlenswert. :)

The flat is located in a great location and has access to a large supermarket, restaurants, etc.  Joe was always available and was very responsive.  Overall a great experience.

Selena was a fantastic host. Very quick responses and very helpful. It's a nice location with a grocery store and restaurants nearby. The flat itself is just as the pictures show, very comfortable and cosy and well equipped. Highly recommended!

This is a great location, lots of pubs and restaurants. Easy access to buses and the tram on Princes Street. The apartment was everything promised in the advertisement. I would definitely recommend. Cheers!

Steve has a lovely place with lots of period details in a very nice part of Edinburgh that is well connected to the city centre. The room is very comfortable -  especially the small upstairs gallery and an en-suite bathroom give it a very private feel. Everything is exactly like in the pictures and Steve was very nice and welcoming, and we shared some lovely to chats. I didn't have time to check it out, but there is an amazing garden just across the street as well. Beautiful spot, would come again!

Yves and Joe were great hosts, we communicated via airbnb messanger where they provided helpful notes on where to locate keys (including photos), and the flat contained a detailed booklet on how items worked within the flat.
The flat.. unreal. The decor was really fun and sophisticated, that contained many wow moments the more you looked around. The vinyl collection was great fun to browse through and to play with many cool finds, and our favourites buried in the shelves. All in all, Yves and Joe were super comforting cyber hosts and we cannot fault them! We can't thank them enough for letting us stay :)

Giant space in a fantastic location! We had 3 couples and each had their own bathroom which was nice. The communication and check in process was very good. The beds were very comfortable.  Excellent value for the dollar though and would stay again.

Rona goes above and beyond to make you feel right at home. She has so many little details and amenities that make the stay so wonderful. The location is great to get all around the city and she and Lewis were so kind and offered many recommendations. We would highly recommend staying with Rona and hope we can return some day!

Great location. I was working on the Edinburgh Tram line and this property was located right next to a new tram stop McDonald Road.
Property was exactly as described and shown in the photos. The walls are still plastered and lacking any paint (presumably from a recent refurb) which was the only real negative but I can't grumble as this is shown in the photos. Overall a very pleasant stay.
Beautiful and incredibly clean accommodation, we had been made to feel very welcome by the hosts.

Honorata est une super hôte. La chambre correspondait parfaitement aux photos et le lieu était facilement accessible en tramway. Les petites attentions (thé, café, gâteaux, serviettes de bain, produits de toilette, sèche cheveux...) nous ont fait très plaisir. Merci pour tout et on l'espère à bientôt !

We had a brilliant stay in Edinburgh, the location was a 15 min walk to the centre. The apartment its self was fantastic, huge space for us (bigger than the pictures make it look) very clean and comfortable beds. Couldn’t have been happier with our stay!

David was really flexible, helpful and provided a lovely 'welcome package' of all the essentials (and some luxuries too). The apartment is very well provided for with everything you need, and is in a fantastic location (everything within walking distance - the sights, theatre, Prince's St and the Old Town - national portrait gallery across the road!). It's also a lovely old building, a wonderful place to stay.
It's a very cool location (both the apartment and neighbourhood). Ben was very helpful and accommodating. He made sure I had breakfast even though I had to leave early.
Loved our stay here! It was perfect :)
Place was great
Clean and comfortable stay. Prompt responses when booking and communicating and very accommodating with a late check out :-)

Everything about our stay in Steven's flat was perfect. It felt like a trip back to Georgian times with all the amenities of the 20th century. Steven met us at the door after our long flight from America and made us feel at home and comfortable with the way everything worked in the flat. He also shared recommendations for restaurants, groceries, etc. The flat was absolutely spotless. We would return in a heartbeat!
good place to stay but address  should be changed to  Alexander Dr as the current one brings you to a road down the street

Fantastic little “cottage”. Close to all amenities and old town and the University of Edinburgh. Lovely gift basket on arrival, plenty of pre-arrival information and Dorothy answered any questions directly. Would definitely stay there again when in Edinburgh.
Staying at Mhairi’s flat was a dream! Super convenient but quiet location, walkable to the tram. Hamish was amazing and fixed a small issue with the shower super quickly!

The location was fantastic. Stayed here with young children. Plenty of space for everyone. Bus route to everywhere right outside. Local cafes and shops right outside were fantastic. Alexander was a brilliant host.

En rigtig dejlig lejlighed med store, lyse rum og med en superimødekommende vært. Lejligheden ligger kun 10 minutters gang fra centrum.
Der er lidt støj fra gaden, men ikke mere end man kan forvente.
Fine faciliteter til at lave en kop te eller spise morgenmad. Dog er man nødt til at vaske op på badeværelset.
Man deler køleskab med andre beboere, men det var helt uproblematisk.
Man skal lige være opmærksom på, at man skal gennem begge soveværelser for at komme på badeværelset. Det kan måske være afgørende - afhængigt af hvem man rejser med.
Lily var superhurtig til at svare på beskeder, og lejligheden var i god stand - ren og pæn. Vi kommer gerne igen.

HI :D Tarik was an amazing host with a perfect place for my friend and I to stay over the weekend! The place was clean and his home was an amazing location, everything we needed and the places we wanted to go to was within walking distance. Tarik was very welcoming and immediately made us feel comfortable. I highly recommend staying at his place for your stay in edinburgh, you will not regret it! Thanks for having us Tarik! we miss you!

Roland's stunning apartment is perfectly located- the restaurants, cafes, shops near by are all great, Carlton Hill & Holyrood Park and the city centre are a pleasant, short walk away.
The apartment itself is beautifully furnished, very comfortable and made for a very enjoyable stay.
Roland is great- he met us on check in to talk through the local highlights and offer lots of help with getting around. We can't wait wait to come back!
Thanks Roland!

We had a fantastic stay at Dolly's place while attending a wedding in Edinburgh. We were lucky to meet Dolly on arrival whose warm introduction instantly made us feel at home. The place itself is wonderfully done, and spacious enough for the few nights we needed it. The early sunny mornings with coffee in hand strolling along the promenade was a real treat being minutes from the beach front. If you're looking to stay in or around Portobello or for a quieter alternative to the city centre like us, we would absolutely recommend. Top hospitality and beautiful home. We hope to return one day.

Sarah’s place was unique and fun. We enjoyed staying in a historic building with lots of character. The attention to detail in the remodeling and design of the space is apparent. Walkable to the main attractions and in a nice neighborhood with restaurants and bars nearby. Sarah was also great at communicating. Overall a wonderful host!
Highly recommend - sitting looking out across the Loch in the morning can’t be beaten
Great location in the old city of Edinburgh

Fantastic apartment! Great location and wonderful weather too! Apartment has everything you could possibly need and more.
At first we was a little concerned about the location to the campus but we didn’t hear a peep from anyone, Not even other tenants in the apartment block. Wonderfully decorated, quiet and comfortable. Would definitely recommend and we are already looking at dates on when we could return. Thank you so much for making our first Airbnb experience so easy and memorable.
油漆味有点重，其他的都很不错

Just by the pier, the home has a very good outlook and ambience! The indoors are cosy and beautiful decorated. Thomas has a collection of guide books and pamphlets, which is really helpful if you are new to Scotland and are wondering how to explore the city. All in all, I highly recommend the stay!

We were so overjoyed with this apartment. We walked in and we're blown away by all the little details that made it go above and beyond. There's everything you need in kitchen, bathroom and bedroom for your stay and there's even tea and milk (a godsend for us British). Getting in was easy, and the location is incredible. We walked everywhere and didnt ever have to take a taxi or bus.
If you're looking for a unique and luxurious stay while I'm Edinburgh, this is definitely the place. We will definitely be returning again!

Gwen es muy amable, nos recibió muy cálidamente y las instrucciones para llegar al alojamiento fueron muy claras. Recomiendo ampliamente su alojamiento, es un lugar muy tranquilo y con todas las comodidades necesarias. Sin duda volvería a hospedarme aquí.
Very comfortable. Close to transit, and within walking distance to all city attractions.

Mhairi was very quick to respond to my queries, and clear in her answers.
She was not there when I stayed, but made the directions very easy, so accessing her flat was just as she described.
My stay was great. The neighbourhood quiet and safe. It was easy to park, and just near the Royal Botanic Gardens (the most spectacular venue for the course I was running).
There was everything there to make my stay comfortable, and her flat is spacious and beautifully appointed.
I was very sad not to meet Mhairi and Hector, I'll stay again if I come back uo to Edinburgh.

We had a really pleasant stay with James. He was warm, responsive, and very organised from the start, with clear check-in instructions and even an early check-in option. We had a few lovely conversations during our stay, and he gave thoughtful suggestions based on our Edinburgh plans, which we really appreciated. Breakfast basics like oats, bread, and coffee were provided as listed and were especially convenient on early mornings before heading out to explore.
Two small things to note: the bedroom is quite compact. The bed is comfortable, but with larger suitcases it can feel tight and slightly cramped. Also, while the listing mentions access to the whole house, James was often in the living room relaxing or watching television.
