He never restricted us in any way, but the living room felt more like a private space in practice rather than a naturally shared one.
Overall, a welcoming, well-located and comfortable stay with a genuinely kind and thoughtful host.
Lovely place, would definitely stay again
Todo perfecto. Muchas gracias
just  great, feeling like at your own home...

Apartment was exactly as pictured, amazing location and views of the castle, easy walk from most restaurants and the royal mile. Craig was responsive, provided clear instructions on how to check-in / check-out and some recs for things to do. Perfect place for my family during our visit to Edinburgh.
非常幸运选择了这个民宿，房东夫妻十分友好热情，民宿位置交通便利出门就有巴士直达市中心王子街，对面就是爱丁堡动物园，房间比图片更好和舒适，有独立卫生间，干净整洁，房东还提供了美味的早餐，我的女儿非常喜欢这里，谢谢房东！有机会再来

Katie's flat was perfect. The location was brilliant - Stockbridge is lovely and it's easy to get into the rest of the city on foot or by public transport.
The flat itself is spacious and light and was well equipped.
Katie was a great host. She had lots of good recommendations and was very responsive with information about the stay.
Very unique, comfortable, cozy and a great location for exploring Edinburgh on foot.
Beautiful, comfortable apartment in a great area.  Would definitely choose to stay here again.

Excellent location and everything needed for a relaxed and comfortable stay in Edinburgh.  Steps from the Royal Mile, an easy 10-15 minute walk to Princes Street and the New Town, plenty of restaurants and bars within minutes of the flat.  Hosts provided a useful list of recommendations regarding food and drink. Shower water pressure perfect.  Great choice for 1-2 people.
Small but cozy appartment right on the top end of the Royal Mile. Excellent location! Kitchen is very small, so don’t plan to cook there. Communication was excellent, John gave a lot of hints & tips.

Lovely apartment and had everything that you could possibly need for a comfortable stay.  Nespresso machine and pods were a lovely touch!  Very central location and underground parking was a real bonus.  Would definitely recommend 😊

Dharma's place is lovely. She is a superhost and would do anything for you to have a nice stay.
The location is great and you can walk to the main tourists spots.
I would definitely recommend her place if you want to have a great time in Edinburgh.
Cosy appartement, relatively calm, 2 min walk to Royal Mile. Appartement had everything we needed (incl. washing machine and laundry rack). Alan was a  nice and helpful host. Thanks!
Excellent apartment, clean and very nice.. the position is excellent as well.. in the center of the city.. Recommanded to stay in Edinburgh.

A perfect vacation for me and my wife. We were to Edinburgh to celebrate our anniversary and I felt it couldn't have gone better. Denisa had greeted us very nicely on our first day and was courteous enough to guide us through the entire check-in process even though it was quite easy. It's basically another room in her house that has converted to a studio. Overall it was a good stay and I would recommend who is looking for cozy stay at Edinburgh.
Casa óptima. Extremamente limpa e cuidada. Mesmo muito perto da Royal mile. Recomendadissima.

Amazing property and location at this price. Right in the middle of old town, walking distance from the Royal mile. Our stay was extremely smooth and relaxing. All the instructions are clearly mentioned and Victor is friendly and quick to respond.
Overall I would definitely recommend the stay!
Great stay! Lovely apartment and nearby for everything we needed!

We loved our stay in Stockbridge and this Airbnb was perfect for our small family. Can had great instructions getting in and was very flexible.  The home had everything you could need from hooks, umbrellas, a drying rack and sugar and milk packets.  There is a lovely park near by, we loved the Raeburn and would highly recommend the Pastry Section which sells out of baked goods daily.  We will be back to Edinburgh and would love to stay again.
Zeer fijne compacte verblijfplaats. De wijk voelt veilig aan.
Lovely views, very comfortable and in a great location. Great place for a couple.

L'appartement de Simon est très bien situé, dans un quartier verdoyant et calme.
La terrasse est très agréable, nous avons aussi profité de la belle piscine, juste à côté.
We had a lovely stay and the flat was pristine! Thank you!

Sehr saubere Unterkunft mit allem ausgestattet was man braucht.
Gute Verkehrsanbindung ca. 2min. Fussweg zur nächsten Bushaltestelle.
Wir würden diese Unterkunft wieder nehmen.
Apartamento muy bien cuidado, estuvimos muy a gusto y buena comunicación con el centro de Edimburgo

Great communications from the host. Location is right in the heart of old town. The place was very clean, fresh smelling towels and bed sheets. Overall my family were very happy. No issues at all. Highly recommend.
Great place, recommend

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt und würden sie auf alle Fälle weiterempfehlen. Wer gerne ruhig und etwas abseits der Innenstadt (in 25 Min. mit dem Bus erreichbar - Haltestelle 5 Min. zu Fuss) wohnt, ist hier genau richtig. Die Kommunikation mit Hayley war jederzeit schnell, sehr freundlich und unkompliziert.
Clare was the perfect host, very responsive and helpful when we had to extend our stay. Our team enjoyed their stay and found the place very clean and comfortable.
Very clear check in instructions and responsive host. Apartment was very centrally located and very comfortable.
Had a lovely weekend at Joanna’s. Super close to everything , as described. It is noisy there but if you can’t beat them join them. Rooms were super cosy and clean. We had a wonderful time ☺️
Janny is a great host. We felt right at home. The location is great and everything was as described. I recommend it to everyone.
We had a lovely stay at this b&b. Everything we needed was included and the cabin was very cosy.

Ubytování nám zcela vyhovovalo. Vše v docházkové vzdálenosti a v okolí dobré bary/bistra. Jsou v blízkosti i obchody což je také velká výhoda. Byt byl v pořadku, odpovídal popisu a hostitel reagoval na dotazy obratem. Až bude opět cesta do Edinburghu, jistě bychom se sem vrátili. Doporučuji.

The stay at joe's was great. He quickly replied to my reservation enquiry even if it was very late at night and gave us the opportunity to check in early when our bus arrived in Edinburgh. He was always attentive and friendly and throughout our stay we really felt like home.
The location is excellent, the bus is a few steps away and takes you downtown in 15 minutes, lots of restaurants and takeaways in the area too if you feel like eating at home at night .
And of course Stan the cat was the cherry on the cake with the softest fur ever and always up for a cuddle !
Highly recommended!

Great location within walking distance of everything Edinburgh has to offer. Spacious accomodation with a secure entrance. The hosts greeted us on arrival and had a left a small gift for our daughter as it was her birthday which was a lovely touch. Would definitely stay again.
We had a great time staying at Ann's place. It's set in a great location and had everything we needed! Highly recommend staying here!

Wonderful apartment in a great location to see all the sights of Edinburgh, including a view of the castle. We needed a two bedroom, two bath apartment with queen or king beds. This one delivered at a reasonable price. It's huge, modern and comfortable!
Great location!

We had a lovely stay in Dalry. The house was clean, comfortable and very walkable to the New Town, Old Town and Murrayfield. We didn’t even have to use public transportation once as it’s a fairly central location.
We came for a concert and worried the neighborhood might get loud at night, but it was very peaceful and quiet.
Would highly recommend!
apartamento perfecto para una pareja. para estar haciendo turismo genial
Very beautiful, big room and very friendly, helpful host, good comunication. Very tasteful furniture. Great stay! :)

Laura was brilliant, everything was well organised and all queries were answered promptly. Apartment was exactly as advertised, very clean and beautifully decorated. Our stay was very comfortable. Would recommend to anyone.
Alan is a great host! He is so thoughtful and makes me feel at home. The place is peaceful and the room is cozy and comfortable. Highly recommend!

I had a lovely time here. Nicola is friendly and gave me some great ideas for places to eat and things to do. The room is very comfortable and peaceful- perfect if you're looking for a good night sleep! The accommodation is in walking distance of lots of nice cafes and restaurants and the tram fo getting around the city. I'd stay here again.
We had such a great time.  Beautiful flat in a lovely area.  Highly recommend
Sencillo apartamento, bien ubicado y con todo lo necesario para tener una estancia agradable.
Great location, clean and if we had any question he always responded promptly.

Highly recommend this apartment and hosts. Fantastic location which is within  walking distance to all the main sights. Very clean warm comfortable and well stocked apartment. . We followed lots of Duncan's recommendations for food, pubs, markets etc  Marys Milk ice cream is superb. Will be back!

Daniel was an exceptional host—friendly and easygoing—and the apartment is well-furnished and decorated. It was great to have the room as my base for a short trip. Especially appreciated having access to the espresso machine and laundry.

Great stay just outside Edinburgh. Quick trolly ride or a 25 minute walk into town on the Leith Walk. So much to see it goes by quickly! The internet was fast, house was clean, and check in with Craig’s parents was easy.
Woke up to the sound of birds every day! No traffic noise keeping us awake.
Had a great stay at the snug! The rental was exactly as pictured. Appreciated the sweet treats, milk, bread, and tea left for us. Good location and easy Uber to Old Town when needed.

Lovely apartment! Was incredibly tidy and spacious, in a perfect location just outside the center of town. The bed is incredibly comfortable! Rebecca was a perfect host and communication was easy and positive. Thank you so much for a brilliant stay - would definately recommend!

We have stayed in many Airbnbs and this was easily the best and a great value. Comfortable and stylish 2 bedroom flat in a beautiful, quiet, central location in New Town of Edinburgh. We appreciated that the beds are comfortable, the living area is spacious, and the kitchen and bath are updated. Check in was easy, host was responsive and helpful. The key to the beautiful park across the street is a nice bonus!
Great apartment, easy check-in and good location :)
Loved our stay here! Felt right at home... the flat was perfect for us and Hanna was an amazing host!

Very nice, spacious, clean flat. I didn't meet Jamie personally but he was quite responsive.
House rules and instructions to get the key were easy and had no issues.
Overall a great stay and I would stay at Jamie's again the next time I stay at Edinburgh!

This house is a great base for a wee weekend in Edinburgh. Great location, right beside the Meadows.
Skye’s house was full of thoughtful touches to make the stay really feel like home. We’d definitely book again!

Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt, der Check in verlief einfach und unkompliziert.
Die Kommunikation war gut und Darren hat steht’s immer direkt auf Fragen geantwortet. Die Küche war leider etwas spärlich ausgestattet und es war sehr kalt.
(Vielleicht waren wir aber auf zu doof die Heizung anzumachen)

What a gem this Airbnb is !
We have just spent 3 nights at this immaculately presented property with quality furniture and fittings.
Eliana and David have thought of everything you could need to make your stay amazing.
There were even some groceries to use in the fridge and cupboard which was a nice touch, after a long day of travelling to Edinburgh.
Comfortable beds with exquisite linen.
Central location with walking distance to many restaurants, cafes, pubs and attractions.
Eliana was a fantastic host. Was always friendly and very responsive to my enquires.
The best Airbnb we have stayed in during our holiday. Thank you so much !

We spent 3 nights in Stuart's lovely and complete apartment. It's just off the Royal Mile (literally 30 secs walk), has all the necessities for our family travel with our 6 month old daughter (high chairs, cot, washer/dryer, breakfast items).
We highly recommend staying in his apartment and will not hesitate to stay here again in future.

We highly recommend this Airbnb and would absolutely stay here again. It fulfilled and exceeded our primary requirements for a place to stay when traveling:
1. Quiet respite. It was really really quiet and calm.
2. Comfy bed. We slept like babies! It was so comfortable.
3. Good shower. Hot, strong and fabulous.
4. Sparkling clean. No more to say here.
5. Good location. We walked to everything from this cottage. It was perfect in this regard.
Additional pluses: awesome comfy couch with great view of the castle, tasty snacks, plenty of room, and all necessary appliances. We loved it here!
Very nicely updated furniture, flooring, decor and bathroom. Very clean too.

Nous avons passé un bon séjour chez Elisa. Le logement est assez proche du centre en bus ou en train et est situé dans quartier calme et agréable.
Elisa est disponible, à l’écoute et réactive ! Merci :)

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in Jamies Wohnung. Alles war sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet. Die Lage ist super, um die Stadt oder den Vulkan zu Fuß zu erreichen. Die Kommunikation war sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend.

The flat was lovely and amazingly located.
The toilet being in a different room than the shower was handy.
I love that 100 steps (I counted) from the gate was Mr. Woodfire pizza! Tasty pizza and friendly guys! We also ate at Thyme in the Premier Inn. Both are at the Lauriston Place and Lauriston Gardens intersection.
The dehumidifier was my friend.
Thank you for the photos of so many things, including the trash cans!
The dining area and living room were wonderful hangout places!
There were many outlets! That was convenient! We learned how to turn the outlets on.
Thank you so much for the communication, especially when my husband walked right past the (open) lock box with the key in his pocket.

Great location. Great house. Steve is a wonderful host, very friendly and helpful. He made sure we had everything we needed and had some very good suggestions for going around the city. The room itself is gorgeous. Charlie is a little ball of sunshine. Would definitely recommend!

Olivia is the loveliest host indeed.
All communication was super positive, any potential issues resolved promptly and good mood provided as a bonus.
The place is spacious, has everything you may need and tastefully decorated.
There are clear instructions and manuals literally for any use case!
Location is superb - close to city centre but quiet.
I absolutely enjoyed staying there.
Bon emplacement. Appartement spacieux. Rue festive mais bien isolé. L’appartement n’est pas hanté ce sont seulement les pas des voisins du dessus. Nous avons passé un bon séjour dans l’ensemble.
Alles super, danke Eddie.

Good location, walk everywhere! Clean and warm, big spacious room. Interesting decor and items in the hall :)  Really tasty all veggie food at the bar downstairs and a generous discount for us guests. Wish I'd been able to sample the cocktails they sound amazing. City noise was less than I expected so I did not need the earplugs which were thoughtfully provided. I felt like I was visiting a friend who'd just popped out. In short: I will go again.
Really beautiful space. The area was nice, quiet but still easily walkable. :)
Beautiful apartment with many amenities that’s walkable to all the sights.

We stayed for 4 nights for the blues and jazz festival. The location was perfect next to accessible cycle and walking paths to the city center through the meadows park. Access to cafes , shops, coffee shops etc 5 min walk from the studio. The studio was fully equipped and comfortable and on arrival there was milk , tea , coffee, biscuits and fresh flowers from the garden. The studio is set in a lovely garden and is safe, secluded and quiet with squirrels. There is off road parking space
At the property and we only used the car to arrive and on date of departure .
Very cozy! Easy access to the castle (by bus or walking).

Our stay was amazing! You cannot beat the location of this flat. It was so accessible to all of Old Town. The flat itself was very nice and clean. There is a bit of street noise at night that can get through the walls so that’s just something to be aware of. Overall, we had a fantastic time!

Large, centrally located apartment with 2 bathrooms & a super kitchen. Nice linens & amenities. Lewis was helpful!
We recommend this place.
Totally worth the money. Perfect location to explore Edinburgh and Amanda and Ed are just lovely! Would definitely book it again. Thank you so much x
Super easy/homely flat! Perfect for what we wanted!
Visiting our daughter in Leith and needed a couple extra beds. Place was across the street and exactly what we had hoped for. Clean, quiet, comfortable. Excellent stay in all respects

Beautiful Lodge , amazing setting . Ideal for six adults from Shropshire who were attending a Wedding in Balerno, near by. We came 2 days before the Big Day , so we were able to explore Edinburgh .
A shame we couldn't partake in the surfing & sauna . just not enough time . It looked FANTASTIC. Hopefully we'll return one day to do this & meet up with the new Mr & Mrs .
A fabulous place for families , friends .
Thank you to Holly & ALL at Lost Shores .
cozy !
Perfect location, very clean and had everything we needed! Great value.
Logement fidèle à la description. Tom est très réactif. Logement très propre! Merci.

This spot is fantastic! Everything is as advertised in a super walkable area. Quite convenient to the train station and everything on the Royal Mike. One thing to keep in mind is that you are close to the University of Edinburgh so on Friday and Saturday night you can hear a bit of outdoor noise but it wasn’t problematic for me at all. I had a really lovely stay and Sonia and Chris were very communicative and I had all the info I needed without any stress. Sonia and Chris also provided local restaurant recommendations which were really helpful if you want some local flavor!

Lovely little place in the middle of Edinburgh, I had a great stay and Ellie and Scott were responsive and helpful throughout. The flat is very clean, in a busy neighbourhood but itself fairly quiet and peaceful. It’s well equipped and I can highly recommend it!
Great location

Mary's has been the most amazing host and her home has been perfect for our needs.  Great location for access into Edinburgh, private parking and amenities close by.  The kitchen has everything you need and more, fantastic lounge to relax in, great shower and the comfiest bed for a good nights sleep.  The house has  the most amazing view of the road bridges and Fife.  The garden is beautiful, filled with wildlife and completely secure - which was such a bonus for our dogs.  There's also a park right across the road.  We needed to work during our stay, which was a breeze - with super fast WIFI throughout the house and dedicated work spaces.  We'd definitely book again and wholeheartedly recommend a stay at Mary's.

Very happy with our stay with Rich, everything was as described! We had a super clean and homely flat. He had great suggestions for Edinburgh attractions. We really enjoyed our stay and it is definitely recommended.
Perfect for a weekend stay.
Great place in a perfect location in Portobello just minutes walk from the beach. Flat was quiet and well presented throughout.

Desværre ser lejligheden slet ikke ud som på billederne. Den er meget mindre. Badeværelset var lille og sengen var klemt inde i et rum med en dobbeldyne.
Der var en dårlig lugt af fugt/svamp. Det hjalp dog efter 24timer med åbne vinduer.
Sengen er for blød.
Til næsten 2000kr pr nat, så var det ikke pengenr værd. Desværre

The apartment is perfect 👌. A beautiful big apartment to visit Edinburgh with a very friendly host.
Claire gave lovely advices for restaurants and bars.
Charming, great location, can’t be beaten for the price
Supreme location. Lovely apartment ( clean and modern)  close to all amenities ( bars restaurants shops)

Lovely 2 night stay. The flat was charming and spotless. Welcome guide had great suggestions for local restaurants and activities. Responsive, clear communications. We experienced a minor issue but it was promptly resolved, which was greatly appreciated. Free street parking outside the flat was very convenient. We would have happily stayed longer had our itinerary allowed.

El alojamiento está genial. Los dueños viven en la casa pero son muy amables y sientes total independencia.
Todo muy limpio y ordenado. Buenas indicaciones y fácil entrada.
Muy buen ubicado. Hay una parada de bus a 2 minutos andando y al centro se puede llegar en media hora.

Overall, the place is amazing, cozy and perfect after a whole day out. Can be abit far from the city centre but is fairly easy to go since a bus stop that takes you to the city centre is just right about the corner.

Location perfect for 7 ladies on a city break - right in the middle of the action, yet we felt safe, the apartment was very quiet, despite all the action on Princes Street. Spotless and spacious apartment. Had everything we needed. I had read previous reviews re the location of the keys, and there was much hilarity and picture taking, when I donned my blue latex gloves to retrieve them (7 nurses) . If I'm being very picky, I'd say there should be 7 dining chairs, if 7 adults are planning to eat at the table. No problem for us, as  we dined out. Beds all reported to be very comfortable. Everything was as seen and described on the App, or even better. Fully recommend this apartment.
Don’t pass this place up, it’s better than the pictures! Gorgeous, spacious, yet cozy. We absolutely loved the unique decor, personal touches, and proximity to everything! We will be back.
Had a wonderful stay.
Perfect for our overnight stay in Edinburgh:)

In aller Kürze: zentral, historisch, super Gastgeberin- perfekt für einen Aufenthalt in Edinburgh und uneingeschränkt zu empfehlen. Pubs/leckere Restaurants, die Royal Mile direkt vor der Haustüre , alle bekannten Sehenswürdigkeiten in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß zu erreichen  - geht kaum besser!

The picture of Edinburgh Castle is unimaginable until you get to this apartment. Everything was thought of and we could not have been more comfortable for three adults. Being in the Grassmarket is a perfect spot.
Amazing location. Flat has everything you need and there was even a goody bag for the dog.
숙소가 걸어서 시내에 이동할수 있는 위치에 있었고, 아늑하고 평안했고, 화장실은 깨끗하고 사용하기 편리했습니다. 덕분에 에든버러 여러곳을 관광할수있어 뜻깊은 추억을 만든것 같습니다. 친절하신 Nell님의 배려 감사합니다.
Sarah's place was the perfect base for our trip to Edinburgh. The flat was beautiful decorated and central to most of Edinburgh's tourist spots!
Steve's flat was the most comfortable, quiet, warm and in a great location. very well equipped. would recommend the flat to anyone, thank you Steve
Great flat, fantastic location, lovely interior, very comfortable. Plus, the check in process was perfect.

Wow what a stunning place!! Mary was so welcoming when we arrived and the house is just gorgeous, so welcoming and homely, just what you want after a long day. The room was lovely and the bed was so comfy. Mary was extremely helpful and very communicative. She thought about everything you could want for a little break away. We would definitely come back again and would recommend to any friends, family or anyone we meet looking for somewhere to stay in Edinburgh! Once again thank you for having us to stay! ❤️
Stunning room, beautiful location, incredibly clean. Great value!

The apartment is super clean and tidy. It is cool that it's fully stocked with all the basic little things that make your stay much easy. Big thanks to the owners! If I go to Edinburgh again, I want to stay in this apartment next time
Un allotjament molt agradable i centric. Ben equipat, net i amb una cuina ben equipada. El recomano!

Flat was in pristine condition and the location was superb. Easy directions left within the flat and great communication- the host thought of everything! Flat was incredibly clean and well-kitted. We had an incredibly enjoyable and comfortable stay. Great beds and bedding!
Great place in a great location. Exactly as described!

Πανέμορφο διαμέρισμα σε μια ήσυχη γειτονιά, 10 λεπτά από το κέντρο με το λεωφορείο. Πολλές επιλογές για φαγητό και ψώνια στη γειτονιά. Ο χώρος ήταν πολύ καθαρός και η κουζίνα πλήρως εξοπλισμένη. Η Kirstie ήταν άμεσα διαθέσιμη και μας έδωσε όλες τις πληροφορίες για την περιοχή.
Fantastic location and apartment was great too.
Manigeh is a lovely host - friendly, warm and always responds quickly to queries. It’s a great location for walking into town and the room was cosy, quiet and clean.

We dind’t meet Anjia, because she was on holiday but we met Anja’s son. He was very friendly and flexible for the check out because the Endinburgh weather was cold and we had the fly at 6 am.
I strongly recommend this apartment, clean, confortable and it is close to the center (15 minutes walk).
Loved the location and property
Es war ein toller Aufenthalt bei Carla und ihren Co-Hosts. Kann ich nur empfehlen. Sehr authentisch und super Ausgangspunkt, um Edinburgh zu erkunden.

Great place to stay in the heart of old town. Very easy as a base location for two touring couples. Read the reviews, it is noisy in the evening and you do hear the late night noises of a city until about 2 am. The beds were comfortable and we were able to enjoy watching some tv with four people on the couch. Bathroom was clean, showerhead had great pressure. Key pickup and drop off was very easy.

I’ll preface this review to share that this is middle of August during the Fringe Festival so I understand that the city is teeming with lots of tourists. The street noise was really a lot. While the evenings it was often loud people, the road traffic is constant and loud at all hours and a decent sleep was not had. The damp smell or odor in the lower main living area that other reviewers mention is quite off-putting and I preferred being upstairs in the bedroom. The manual needs updating as tv instructions are outdated and the information regarding some of the policies clash with what is in the Airbnb listing. To be clear, the location is amazing- a block down from Royal Mile and very close to train station and sightseeing landmarks. Contact was responsive to my queries. It was clean and tidy.
This was a great apartment and I would love to stay there again. Gill was also very friendly
We are very happy with the response given by the host. She offered mobile heater when the temperature was down. Microwave oven is suggested. Best host.

We had a lovely stay with Suzanna and Derek.
The room was very comfortable and the location was nice.
Great recommendations for what to see and eat.

Deze B&B was een absolute aanrader. Gelegen in een rustige buurt, is het de perfecte plek om te ontspannen na een dagje sightseeing in de prachtige maar soms drukke stad. En toch ben je er zo: in slechts 10 tot 12 minuten lopen, sta je al op de Royal Mile.
De B&B bood een unieke ervaring. Je bent echt te gast bij Andre en Jim! Hoewel je je eigen slaapkamer en badkamer hebt, deel je de voordeur, gang en woonkeuken. Dit was ons al bekend, dus het was geen verrassing. Andre, Jim en hun twee schattige, goed opgevoede beagles laten je meteen thuis voelen. Ze laten je alle ruimte, maar vinden het ook gezellig als je erbij komt zitten. “Hoeft niet, als je dat niet wilt, maar mag altijd”, aldus Jim.
Als het Schotse weer het toelaat, kun je ook gebruikmaken van hun terras aan de binnentuin. De gezamenlijke woonkeuken is voorzien van nette ontbijtfaciliteiten, en op je slaapkamer vind je een koffie- en theezetapparaat en fruit.
Hartelijk dank, Andre en Jim, voor jullie gastvrijheid.

Beautiful historical apartment in the heart of the old town, full of character with everything that you need including a huge, gorgeous bedroom. Perfectly placed to visit all attractions, couldn’t be more central. Plenty of wonderful places to eat and drink nearby. We loved it!

Ian's place was so nice, we felt right at home. Ian was responsive, friendly,and communicative host. Leith is a really great location away from the crowds of tourists in Old Town but with lots to do and great cafes and pubs. I would definitely recommend staying here!

Stuart’s apartment was the perfect base for our trip to Edinburgh. He was helpful and friendly, letting us check in a bit early on the day we arrived. The bedroom was very dark so we slept well, and the area was quiet but in easy walking distance of the tram. We’d definitely stay here again if we’re visiting Edinburgh.

Really nice stay with Renata & family. If you are looking to stay in a cosy home with a nice family, then look no further. The property is on a brand new housing estate, so really impressive place to stay on the outskirts of Edinburgh. Room was great quality.

This is a wonderful place to stay.  From the apartment, you can walk into the centre of Edinburgh, or walk to the end of the road and catch a tram or a bus very easily.  The apartment itself has everything you would need for a weekend or a week away or even longer, including washer / dryer, hairdryer, and even sockets with usb connections.  There is a fabulous selection of brochures about the city.  The main lounge is huge – with three sofas (one being a fold out bed).  We would definitely stay here again – thank you.
Wonderful spot! Emily was very accommodating, kind, and responsive, and the location was perfect. I would absolutely come here again!

I feel like home. Sheril is absolutely kind. The apartment is beautiful and comfy. The location is perfect if you want to walk around the city.
Me sentí como en casa. Sheril es extremadamente amable. El apartamento es muy hermoso y cómodo. La ubicación es perfecta si deseas salir caminando a conocer la ciudad.

Oli todella mukava yöpyä Sallyn ja hänen perheensä luona. Vaikka saavuin myöhäisellä lennolla minua odotettiin teekupillisen kanssa. Olo oli erittäin tervetullut. Erityismaininta ihanalle tuorepuurolle. Sallyn ja perheen koti oli erittäin viihtyisä.

The bothy was super cute and convenient. It's in a walkable location, however we did get a few ubers to old town and back. The location itself was quiet and peaceful. It would be lovely in summer time, with access to the gardens. The space was comfortable and Fleur provided an extra heater and blankets due to the cold weather which was very welcome.
I loved the design and style of the bathroom - really quirky and modern with a traditional twist.
Fleur's communication was welcoming and informative. we felt as though she was on hand for anything we might need and even allowed us a later check out which was greatly appreciated though in the end we didn't need it.
Perfect little spot for a couple looking for a city getaway with the option for a quiet night in.

I highly recommend staying with Keith and Rei. Their place is clean, comfortable and nicely decorated. Location is great in a cute neighborhood. And they are super friendly and hospitable. Really enjoyed chatting with them!
Note that the condo is on the second floor with stairs.

Chris was a great host. My friend and I stayed at his place for two nights. He gave us helpful guidance about the city and made sure we had everything we needed. He’s a very intelligent person and really easy to talk to. The place was very clean and cozy. I would happily recommend him to anyone, and we would definitely stay again next time we’re in Edinburgh.
Thank you, Chris, for everything!

What a wonderful place to stay in beautiful Edinburgh! We stayed 6 nights and could have stayed another week. The place was very comfortable, our family of 4, and had everything we needed. It is in a great location in New Town which was only about an 8min walk to the airport tram stop at princess street. We were able to easily take our luggage to the flat. A side note there are stairs up to the apartment. I believe some reviews mentioned street noise. It is situated on street that gets a lot of traffic. Honestly, it did not bother us. You are basically in the city center so that comes along with it. We loved the big windows and all the light from them.
Edinburgh from the flat was a perfect spring break stay! We walked to everything and so many places to eat and shop near by. The tours we ended up taking left from locations that were at the most 20min walks.
I cannot say anything negative about our stay. Our host was extremely helpful and went above and beyond to help us!

Lovely hosts with good communication, they were happy to stay out of the way, but also more than happy to be involved if you needed or wanted. Annexe was beautifully decorated, private and in a nice, safe, quiet area.
We felt right at home and after a long journey welcomed a quick and easy check in. Bus stop right around corner to get into the centre and an easy 15min walk to the coast and host of restaurants and bars.
Would stay again, highly recommend a stay here!

Rona was a great host. I stayed at her place during the Edinburgh festival and was lucky enough to find a place in Edinburgh, let alone a great place like this one. The room was very clean and I got free parking in the compound for the duration of my stay which was great. Rona also provided breakfast (bread, cereal, coffee) in the morning which was a big plus. The bathroom was very clean and there were spare toiletries in case you forgot something which was very thoughtful. All in all, it was a great stay and one my best airbnb experiences so far. I would recommend her place to anyone.

The location is fantastic, there are lots of restaurants around the area and the castle is only 10-15mins walk away. Almost all the touristy areas in the city are within walking distance from Rona's place which makes getting around very easy.
Fantastic, clean and well appointed apartment, perfect location, excellent service and wonderful communication with the host. We loved our 3 days in Edinburgh - Thanks Fiona!!
Nice apartment in great location for accessing the harbour and Edinburgh in general. We stayed as a family with 2 kids and was fine
Kind and caring host

Very comfortable room in a beautiful seaside area of Edinburgh. Courtney is easygoing and welcoming, enjoys meeting her guests and helped us out a lot. She even encouraged me to have a bubblepath at the end of a stressful day! Much appreciated. Free parking space very useful. If you have tendencies to hypertidiness, you might notice some uncleanliness here and there.

We had a great stay! The location is ideal – Leith Walk is full of restaurants, cafés, and pubs, with tram and bus stops nearby. You can also walk to the city centre in ca. 20-min. Check-in was smooth and the host was super responsive. The flat is newly renovated, nicely furnished, and well-equipped. It fit our family of four (incl. baby and 5-year-old) comfortably. The pull-out sofa is large but takes up most of the living room when open. The bathroom is small but functional, with good water pressure and hot water. We appreciated the thoughtful extras: plenty of towels, toiletries, and a well-stocked kitchen (oven, microwave, coffee maker, snacks, tea, etc.). A baby play/sleep pen with sheets and blankets was provided. The mattress was thin but we added blankets and our baby slept great. The main bed was spacious and comfy. Washing machine worked perfectly. The flat was generally clean, though we noticed some dust/hairs in corners. Overall, highly recommended – we’d love to come back!
Great apartment: spacious, stylish and in a lovely area. Parking super handy. Hope to stay again soon. Thank you.

Perfect apartment from which to visit beautiful Edinburgh. A view to die for and very contfortable apartment. While in an old building,  the apt appears to have been recently renovated with modern appliances and nice furnishings. Comtfortable bed! Great neighborhood around the corner from the Royal Mile with the back of the apartment overlooking famous Markars Square and the Writers Museum. The front of the building looks at across to New Town and Scott's Monument.   Highly recommended!
Our apartment was clean and comfortable with all the necessary amenities.

It was an amazing experience staying at  Rebeccas room. She was super friendly, always open for interesting conversations with helpful tips to discover Edinburgh and had two lovely cats. We would definitely come back if we are in Edinburgh.
干净温暖的房间，齐全便利的设施，距离大型超市开车10分钟！适合自驾

Stor, hyggelig leilighet med perfekt beliggenhet!
Hyggelig vert, som tilbød sen utsjekk og mulighet for å hente bagasje sent på ettermiddagen da det ikke kom nye gjester samme dag😊
El alojamiento cumplió las expectativas. Un acierto para visitar Edimburgo!

Heather was great, quick to respond and made both the checking in and out process easy. I booked the flat for my parents and they couldn't have been happier. The flat had everything you could need and more. Would definitely recommend and will book the next time anyone comes to visit. Thank you for making the whole easy and stress free
Lovely little flat, well located. Everything was very smooth. Not suitable for those with mobility issues.
Great stay！Would definitely recommend   to others.

Super séjour chez Fiona! Nous avons été bien accueillies par Fiona et son mari, qui ont pris le temps de nous donner des recommandations utilises pour notre weekend à Edimbourg. Le logement était fidèle à la description, propre, décoration de bon goût et de qualité.
L'emplacement est très calme et à 15 minutes à pied du centre ville.
Nous recommandons cet hébergement!
We had a wonderful visit and would highly recommend the unit to fellow travellers.  Nikki is a great host.

Very nice Appartement in a calm area of Corstorphine.
Well equipped.
Extremely friendly hosts.
30 min to the Royal Mile.
I really recommend this accommodation for a stay in Edinburgh.

Gilly’s place was perfect for a weekend escape to Edinburgh.  The bedroom was cosy and we loved the heated floors in the bathroom (helped thaw our frozen feet after a winter’s day out and about).  The location was ideal for getting into town and exploring Stockbridge.  Gilly was an excellent hostess and we’ll definitely look to stay again next time we’re up in Edinburgh.
Unit was clean and accessible. Had a great stay in the apartment. Thanks Paul
Cosy room in central of Edinburgh. Instructions are clear and Marcus was friendly and responsive. Thanks for nice experience 🙏

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful Edinburgh apartment. Lindsay and Roberto truly embody Scottish hospitality; warm, attentive, and incredibly responsive throughout our stay. They went above and beyond by helping us with our luggage, which was greatly appreciated and set the tone for a welcoming and stress-free visit. Their prompt communication and thoughtful recommendations to local hot spots made our time in Edinburgh even more enjoyable.
The apartment itself is perfectly situated in a charming residential neighborhood that offers an authentic taste of Scottish life. Despite its peaceful and quiet setting, it’s conveniently within walking distance of some of Edinburgh’s finest restaurants, attractions, and cultural landmarks.
This stay struck the perfect balance between comfort, character, and location. Highly recommended for anyone looking for an authentic and memorable Edinburgh experience.
Mark was an excellent host. His place is lovely and the location was central in Edinburgh. We can't carry a large luggage to our tour to the highlands and Mark helped to keep it. Thank you Mark.

The home space and Mairi are divine love container filled with loving-kindness vibes, gorgeously crafted garden corner, culturally-infused design, hot shower with high water pressure, artisan neighbourhood with smiles from heart, convenient location with harmonious balance, it is definitely a tranquil haven of serenity empowering my soul tenderly and powerfully. When I come back to Edinburgh, I wish to be immersed into part of this amazing light and reunion with Mairi again. Sincere blessing for everyone who come to this home space at every here and now. Mairi and family, thank you so much!

The apartment was in a great location, quick connections to airport and the city. The apartment itself wasn't so clean, the bed is very uncomfortable and the hot water is not the best...I had a few cold showers and uncomfortable sleeps.

Apartment and garden were just brilliant. The location could not be more ideal for everything, food, shops, amenity areas access to city centre. We found 2 streets away on Clinton Road the parking is twice as long for the same price as on the apartment street.
If you’re considering visiting Edinburgh this offers you great convenience with a lovely quiet area!
We hope to be back!!
We had a great few days in Rachel's neat home.  It was walking distance from all the major sites.  It was clean and comfortable and Rachel's instructions were clear and helpful.
Very helpful host
Logement sympa en centre ville avec une cuisine très fonctionnelle.

A super little apartment 20mins walk from the station. Easy access and had everything we needed including nespresso pods and chocolate biscuits! We actually cooked the first night and the kitchen had everything you need
Super comfy beds too, lovely and warm and cosy
Katie was really helpful and checked we were ok, if you want to get out of the hustle and bustle and not spend over the odds for somewhere to stay, this is perfect. We walked it twice and also got a quick cab ride back into the centre of town, really easy
Loved it, thank you

This place was magical — even better in person than in the photos. The bed was very comfortable, and everything I needed (and more!) was provided. The host was incredibly welcoming — the most hospitable I’ve ever met. The view from the room overlooked the mountains and charming streets. The living room was super cozy. I highly recommend staying here, and if I ever come back to Edinburgh, I’ll definitely stay again. Truly the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in!

Beautiful property in stunning surroundings.
The perfect place for some time away to recharge

The flat was quiet and we all slept well. We had a great stay. Bring from Edinburgh and having lived in Marchmont in the past this really did feel like home. The nearby children's parks, there are two, one for littleies are 5ish mins walk across the meadows and much improved from my days. Sainsbury local very convenient up Middle Meadow Walk. Clear views from the top of Arthur's seat and Edinburgh was buzzing in Festival anticipation, such fun.

Thank you David , It was easy to check in.
Clear instructions - clean place - walkable distance to town centre and touristic attractions.

A great place in Edinburgh. A private room with attached bathroom. The host also provides tea/coffee making facilities inside the room, so there’s hardly any need to leave the room. The bathroom was clean and well equipped with towels and toiletries. The common areas were labelled and well marked to avoid any confusion. The environment was peaceful. The checkin instructions were accurate and everything went seamlessly. All instructions were provided even before asking. Overall, wonderful stay.
Yuri was super flexible about me checking in a little later, and helped me locate parking before I came. I felt welcomed, and enjoyed my stay. Thank you!

Rebecca's is a tastefully and thoughtfully laid out apartment; spacious, comfortable it allowed me to thoroughly unwind and enjoy my stay. A bus stop is at the end of the street and taxis can be easily hailed too but it is very close to amenities to self-cater.
My preference was to walk and explore the city and her  recommendations  were a very helpful way to get started so do try them out.
I'd love to stay again if I'm lucky enough to return to Edinburgh.
Except the sofa bed is malfunctioned the rest is nice and comfy.

Jen is the perfect example of an Airbnb host, from booking to checking, she was helpful and attentive.
The apartment is in the most perfect location to see the Edinburgh sights, a 5-6 walk to Prince's Street, 20 mins walk to the Castle, the Royal Mile and Grassmarket. The apartment is fabulous, high ceilings, large comfortable beds and the master had a gorgeous view over Edinburgh. The space was well equipped, with a large living area, dining table and kitchenette. Plenty big enough for two couples.
I would highly recommend this apartment, and if we come back to Edinburgh, we will be back.

Fantastic stay! Lovely flat in a great location. The flat was exceptionally clean and comfortable with everything we required. Nikki is a brilliant host who responded quickly with all the information we needed. Would 100% recommend a stay here.
公寓非常安静和干净。女主人非常热情，每天都送给我们小点心。公寓离市中心走路20-30分钟。也有公交车到达。公寓周边有小的咖啡馆和餐馆还有好吃的披萨。我们与公寓主人联系非常方便，她会第一时间回复你的所有问题。这是一个不错的选择。

Excellent location, 2 minute walk from the castle and Grassmarket. Lots of shops & cafes on your doorstep. Flat is lovely, very clean. No problems accessing the flat - made easy by really clear instructions. Hosts also gave us a really helpful recommendations of where to keep our bags after checkout! Definitely recommend!

Bewertung für unser Airbnb in Edinburgh
Wir (eine Gruppe von drei Personen) hatten eine absolut wundervolle Zeit in diesem Airbnb! Die Unterkunft ist nicht nur super zentral gelegen, sondern auch mit unglaublich viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Man merkt sofort, wie viel Mühe und Sorgfalt in die Gestaltung gesteckt wurde.
Die Wohnung war sauber, gemütlich und hatte alles, was man für einen komfortablen Aufenthalt braucht. Besonders die durchdachten Details – sei es die stilvolle Einrichtung, die gemütlichen Betten oder die kleinen Extras – haben uns begeistert.
Die zentrale Lage war perfekt, um Edinburgh zu Fuß zu erkunden. Ob Sehenswürdigkeiten, Restaurants oder Einkaufsmöglichkeiten – alles war in wenigen Minuten erreichbar. Trotzdem war es ruhig und entspannt, sodass man sich immer wieder gerne zurückziehen konnte.
Vielen Dank an die Gastgeber:innen für diesen perfekten Aufenthalt! Wir kommen gerne wieder und können dieses Airbnb absolut weiterempfehlen.

Another lovely stay in Edinburgh at Scott’s place which is always, clean, well appointed and fully functional for all our needs. Excellent location and a beautiful view over the park. We love coming and Charlotte is an excellent host.
What an amazing location!! A stylish flat within easy walking distance of all the top Edinburgh sights!

We loved our stay with Alex, ( Dan was away) He was so welcoming, kind and helped us with planning our trip around Scotland. Great conversations. I loved the apartment, with their interesting collections of art and books. We were made to feel so comfortable in their home.
The location is great, overlooking the water from the decks and excellent location for public transport in to city centre.
Thanks Alex, we will be sure to return next time we visit Scotland . Hopefully meet Dan and Zeus the dog next time.
Was good, unfortunately lighter was broken and didn’t work for the gas stove
Location was amazing!! A stone throw away from everything Edinburgh had to offer. The property was amazing and inviting.

Cary et Pete font du B&B depuis des années et cela se ressent. Un accueil au top, des conseils pour profiter au mieux du séjour et un petit déjeuner complet pour bien commencer la journée.
Idéalement situé, tout peut se faire à pied. La chambre est accueillante et le lit très bon pour des nuits réparatrices.

The flat was just as described and great for our last night in Edinburgh. It was a good size for two people, and super nice to have two full baths. Being on an upper floor is always a challenge but we were prepared for the stairs and they weren’t bad with the landings in between.

Our host Dean was super accommodating, communicative, helpful and hospitable. The place is gorgeous, has comfortable beds, very stylish, spotless clean, with all amenities  and more. Great location, and check in was very easy! It’s close to coffee shops and restaurants...I would recommend the Thistle coffee shop for a quick bite, desserts, or delicious coffee.  I would highly recommend this place to anyone!! 😊

We loved our stay.  We appreciated you accommodating us on short notice.  the home was in a quiet and peaceful setting.  the back patio and deck was just lovely as we enjoyed our evening with a glass of wine. thank you!

As few words as possible… Martin is simply The Best.  I mean that. He could not have done more for us to make us happy to be there. The flat is in old Edinburg, that’s the beautiful part of town, in my opinion. I would highly recommend.
Elizabeth made my stay easy with her quick responses and helpful instructions. The room is as described, and public transportation to the center is very easy.
rien à signaler.  Le logement était super. Juste la difficulté pour se garer. Il faudra payer une place de parking.
appartement trèsconfortable et très bien situé à côté d'une station de tram.

The room was comfortable, Nice decorated, very clean and the flat centrally located, as described in the listing. The flat is a rooming house, there are 2 other rooms and we have to share the bathroom, the toilet and the kitchen. I don't like this kind of sharing. Especially when you want to use the toilets obliged to put something on in the middle of the night. In front of our room in the appartment there is also a studio for rehearsals of the bands playing at the bar under the groups can use this room from 11.00 am till 7.00 pm. There is also a large window but Trystan should have put a blind venitian that covers the whole window because there is no privacy as there is building just in front and the city lights doesn't let us sleep. The appartment is located just above a very noisy bar. If all these  circumstances of this flat were more directly stated in the profile, I probably would not have chosen this place. It was my first experience Airbnb and for sure next time i will be more careful before booking via this link.

The place is really spacious and has its own character.
It is located in an amazing spot so that it is calm but also close to nice bars and restaurants.
The host was very responsive, proactive and friendly :)
Great location,only 2 flights of stairs away from the castle,and 1 flight of stairs down to bars and cafes

This is hands down the best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had in 10 years of using the platform to travel. Jemima was lovely and accommodating, the space was beautiful. Very comfortable beds as well! Can’t recommend this place highly enough

Juan was an amazing host! He gave us many tips on getting around Edinburgh and the best places to visit and eat at. We felt at home in his home. The little treats during our stay were a lovely extra touch. Muchas Gracias, Juan!

The accommodation is better than expected. There is a washing machine and dishwasher included in the first class apartment. The quality and cleanliness is first class.
The location
is fantastic. Morningside is a lovely place, and access to the Cityis so easy by bus. However we found it to be such a lovely walk to the city. Around 30 minutes to the old town.
What a find!

Sarah and her family made us feel right at home. The room was lovely and bright and although it was freezing outside, with central heating and a lovely wood burning stove we were always very cozy. Coffee, tea, bagels and eggs were all left out for us which was a lovely surprise after the very early flight over! The buses went into the centre of Edinburgh very regularly and took only twenty minutes or so, so no hassle at all. The area of Portobello itself was beautiful also, I really loved that the seaside was only five minutes walk away. All in all, I had a fantastic time in Edinburgh and I greatly appreciate the chance to have stayed in the beautiful home of Sarah and her family!
Great location, fantastic and spacy apartment. Loved the view out the stunning windows. Would come back any time.

Great place to stay for 1 or 2 people, I would happily stay there again, clean and everything you need is provided. There is a bus stop very close by to get into the city centre or elsewhere, the 'private' carpark was always almost full but I always managed to find a space.

Ben's place was superbly refurbished and made into a modern space. The flat was very quiet as it's facing the communal garden away from the street, but note that it's north facing and so it's dark in winter. The bedroom curtain does such a good job blocking out the light and makes the room pitch dark. The shower was very powerful. We loved that the shower and the toilet are actually separate in two different spaces, which makes two people's morning activity easier. The flat is located in Tollcross, an easy 15 minutes walk to the Edinburgh city centre with lots of shops and supermarkets nearby. Ben was always available and super quick in response. He made sure that everything was great throughout our stay.

The flat was nice and clean, exactly as described on the page. Situated in a quiet neighborhood, Lidl just 4 mins away and has convenient link to the city centre. Chengquan has been super responsive and friendly, we really appreciate it.
Fantastic property in a brilliant location
Lovely place, a short walk from the centre, with a few pubs and restaurants close by. The pictures do not do it justice. Would highly recommend.
Excellent place with plenty of room. Easy parking
Everything was fantastic would stay again!
Roland's flat was amazing. Great location, quiet neighborhood with friendly neighbors, and every review on here is accurate. Great spot! I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

We had a wonderful stay here! It is right in the heart of everything! Convenient, clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay again. The hosts were very quick to respond to any messages and very pleasant to deal with. 😊
The washer/dryer in the kitchen area was extremely loud though…we thought it was going to bust out of the cabinet. But it washes and dries your clothes! Just don’t use it later in the evening…you may wake your neighbors.

We stayed at Careys for one night before we went on to travel to the north of Scotland. We really enjoyed our stay at her place. The room was great, we had our own bathroom and got a great breakfast. Carey was very nice and just a great host who gave us great tips for our stay in Edinburgh as well as for our trip through Scotland. Thanks Carey for having us!

Perfect base for exploring Edinburgh, so central but so quiet!
Modern with beautiful decor, very clean and secure.x
It was indeed a homely stay.

We had a great stay at Levi’s place. The apartment was easy to find, located in a beautiful building, and had a lovely scenic view from the window. It felt warm, cozy, and beautifully furnished, making it a very comfortable place to stay.
The location was excellent — close to the Tube, buses, restaurants, and plenty of attractions within walking distance. The apartment was also well maintained, with a fully equipped kitchen, a stocked bathroom, and everything we needed for our stay.
Levi was very responsive and helpful, offering great local recommendations and assisting us whenever needed.
The only thing to keep in mind is that the apartment is on the third floor with a spiral staircase, so carrying heavy luggage up and down can be quite challenging. Other than that, it was a wonderful stay and I’d definitely recommend it.

Convenient location but if you are sensitive to noise, you might look elsewhere as it is located on a busy street with lots of nightlife.
Apartment matched the photos but furniture and bed could use some updating.
Daniella was very kind, super responsive and quick to answer any questions. Beautiful sunlight in the kitchen/living room in the mornings.
Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Me and my father had a wonderful time! The apartment was in the perfect spot to get a feel for the city.

We were warmly welcomed by Allan and Judy, very friendly!! Explained everything that needed explaining  (heating, tv, etc…) the flat was fresh and clean once we arrived, was in a good location with shops, pubs & tram stop local! If we are ever in Edinburgh again we will 100% be re booking for this place. Thankyou!!

Not a great experience unfortunately. The place is very central and getting there was easy. However, the bathroom has no windows and no fan, plus the toilet flush needs 15 min to recharge after each flush. And this is nothing compared to the mess I found in my bed: sheets that had not been changed for God only knows how long, hair and stains all over the place. Considering that we paid almost 50 EUR of cleaning fees for one night, this is indecent to say the least.
Luckily Airbnb issued a refund.
Hat alles problemlos geklappt, nette Gespräche, gerne wieder!
Great location, very accessible. Clean and tidy room. Would love to book this place again in future
A nice cozy place for one or a few night stay. A bit up the hill so be prepared if with luggages. Overall a really nice place.

Great Goldilocks location, close enough to the centre yet quite enough for a good night's sleep.
very well run accomodation with a spacious room.
would use again 🙂

Great location (no more than 20 mins walk to most touristy locations), in a quiet neighborhood next to a charming park. Accommodations were very comfortable, and fit our family of 5 people very nicely. Kitchen fully stocked, everything was very clean and thoughtfully placed. We really enjoyed our stay and are sad to be leaving!

This was our first visit to Scotland, and this location was the perfect place to stay. Very central to everything in the city but also quiet for a good nights rest.
Melissa is the best Airbnb host I’ve ever been in contact with- her checkin guide was amazing and she was super responsive to anything we needed.
The apartment is beautiful- exactly like the pictures.
Every detail was covered… including everything we needed for coffee when we arrived- I loved this detail after getting off a very long flight! Just goes to show you Melissa thought of everything!
5 stars across the board… we recommend!
Thank you for hosting!

Rachel's home was so beautiful and welcoming. The location was incredible and so centrally located to everything we wanted. Rachel invited us in and showed us the accommodations, which were exactly as described. The view from our room of various old buildings was such a glimpse into the beautiful architecture of Edinburgh.
A nice, spacious and clean flat in a good location.
Lovely flat

I had a great stay at Ollie and Ella’s place in Edinburgh. Check-in was smooth and very clearly explained, and everything worked exactly as described. The room was comfortable, quiet, and well suited for a longer stay.
The location is a real highlight. There’s a grocery store right across the road, a gym just around the corner, and tram and bus stops very close by, making it extremely easy to get around the city. It was perfect for my daily commute to a workshop.
Communication with the hosts was easy and friendly, and the place felt well organised and cared for. Overall, a very pleasant stay in a well-connected area. I would happily return and would definitely recommend it to other guests.

We had a lovely stay at Gaya's house, it is a very cozy and beautiful home very practical, the bed was really comfortable, as well as the bathroom and kitchen where we could have a cup of tea. Gaya was very welcoming and nice and left a list of very helpful recommendations I would completely recommend this place
loved the apartment and would be using when ever going again yo Edinburgh. easy accessibility to bus stand and get in city within 20 mins. Easy to get responses from Stefan-Lucian. thanks once again.

The flat was very clean and well-equipped with comfy beds and plenty of living space. A great location, so near to the centre of Edinburgh yet with fantastic views over Holyrood Park to Arthur's Seat so it feels as though the countryside is all around. . We can highly recommend it as a wonderful place to stay.
Wonderful stay in a quieter area in Meadow Park. It was perfect for my wife and daughter to relax after our days of exploring the city. We would definitely recommend!

Ottima esperienza nella jungle room e a casa di Andrew che ci ha fatto sentire come a casa e ci ha dato dei validi consigli per i ristoranti. Ottima la posizione per girare a piedi la città e a 2 passi dalla stazione di haymarket.
A perfect stay! Attentive host,  great amenities, comfortable, cosy, clean, highly recommend 🙏
Great location - easy walk to royal mile and close to shops restaurants and shops. Easy to get transport.

Chris is a wonderful host - personable, interesting, helpful, friendly and generous!  We felt at home in his cozy and charming flat.  We enjoyed our chats around the kitchen table.  He provided us a nice continental breakfast to start our day, along with snacks later on...  In addition to our comfortable and spacious bedroom with king size bed, we had full access to his kitchen and living room.  Great location - close to the lovely botanic gardens and about a 10-15 minute walk to the vibrant downtown area.  I highly recommend staying with Chris!
Very warm and welcoming, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Rona's place and highly recommend staying there!
Nicely presented and well appointed property with everything needed for a few nights stay. Would recommend and would happily stay here again.
A lovely place near Gorgie, which is clean and well-worth the money. Gwen is super kind and has a beautiful cat. We had a great time at her place
Great location and nice place for a visit to the city !
We really enjoyed our stay at Andrew's place. It was comfortable and easy to get to. We loved all the bird song we heard.

It was so nice to stay on a quiet, intact 18th-century street in New Town just a block away from great restaurants, coffee, and pubs. Close to useful bus lines and away from the tourist hoard in Old Town. Plus comfortable bed, efficient washing machine, and a doable kitchen.

What can I say about this place? It's *exactly* what I was looking for. Easy walking distance to the Old Town, so many good places to eat and drink nearby, and this place is *cosy*. Artsy vibe, fantastic looks, and everything that you could need. We didn't need to cook in-house, but I'm kinda used to getting to a place and there being a pan, a knife, and a wooden spoon - here, you have everything that you could need to cook a gourmet meal, and a fridge packed with goodies. Little extras, like the chillies, pickles, milk, butter, bread etc really made it feel super welcoming. The only possible thing I could say is that you should be happy with stairs - Calim calls this out on the listing, and we were prepped (though we, as always, overpacked, so the stairs were a bit of a chore on check-in and out).
We can't wait to be back. I know that people say this all the time, but we really can't. Book this place while you can!

98 Montgomery street is a smart and welcoming home. The hosts have provided everything you could hope for in this beautiful Victorian flat. Only a short walk into the main town it’s ideal if you wish to be somewhere a little quieter but still close enough to access the town.
The flat itself is warm and welcoming with much of the period charm that can be expected in a flat of this period.
Monica and pier are wonderful hosts, ensuring all questions are answered quickly and accurately. My brother and I would be most happy to stay here in the near future!

Stuart's place is lovely, very comfortable with every amenity you  could want and nicely decorated. Location is good, near big supermarket and a 25 min walk or 15 min bus to almost anywhere in Edinburgh. Stuart is a great host who communicates promptly and clearly. Highly recommended.
Agie was a great host, and her place was in a wonderful location. It was nice being away from the tourists on Royal Mile and living more like a local.
Great stay at this apartment! So clean and perfect location. Could not recommend enough! :)
Alan‘s appartment is just perfect! There‘s everything you need in and also around the flat. Alan‘s a great host. I wish everyone that they can spend some time there!

Calum's flat was perfect and exactly described. The space was cozy and comfortable and had extra special touches to help us feel welcome. The location is ideal with excellent nearby restaurants and cafes. Great light came through the windows and it was very quiet. Check in and check out were a breeze and Calum was an excellent communicator. Would highly recommend this spot without any reservations for those visiting Edinburgh!
Perfect location, clean flat would come back again!
Great spot, all the amenities, great outdoor space, place was perfect.  Highly recommend!

Wonderful apt. Beautifully appointed. Water closet and shower room were a bit tight, but clean and bright. Buses, just a short walk, will take you to many of Edinburgh's highlights. Grocery store just a few blocks away. Would love to stay there again.
Casa molto carina, moderna ed arredata con gusto. Curata nei particolari e soprattutto pulita.
The stay was pleasant and the hosts responded to messages very quickly and clearly. Recommended stay.
The apartment is very nice, perfect location and big rooms.

Wonderful accommodation conveniently located just off the Royal Mile and within easy walking distance to all major Edinburgh attractions!  The flat was spotless, cosy and comfortable and Linda provided excellent communications and local tips to ensure we had an amazing stay while in Edinburgh.  5-star hosts that we will happily book again for our returns to Edinburgh.

El alojamiento de Paul es cómodo y limpio, tiene unas zonas comunes bonitas y ordenadas.
Cocina amplia donde poder hacer tus comidas.
Paul fue comunicativo y nos indicó cómo llegar al alojamiento, además los sitios que recomienda son buenos!
La zona nos gustó mucho , ya que queda cerca del centro andando unos 20 minutos y en bus 5 min , pasan muchísimos buses y son muy fáciles de coger.
Además hay muchísimos restaurantes de diferentes partes del mundo alrededor!
Definitivamente lo recomiendo, gracias por todo Paul! 😀👋🏻

Our stay in Charlotte’s flat was excellent. Communication was great from start to finish and we felt so welcomed.
The location is pretty much perfect and the flat had everything we needed.
Would stay again in a heartbeat.
Debs was a great host, very nice and friendly!

Alan è una persona molto gentile e disponibile. L'appartamento è esattamente come da spiegazione. Pulito,  ordinato e con tutto il necessario che serve per affrontare il soggiorno. In più è a due passi dal centro di Edimburgo. Se dovessi tornare qui sarà il mio punto di riferimento. Consigliato.

La Farah ha estat una molt bona anfitriona.
Totalment recomanable!!
Very responsive host with clear instructions. Easy to find and check in. Free parking near the building. Great view of the dock.
Fantastic place

Jean’s place is great for anyone willing to take a taxi or bus to the local sights or who is looking to just relax a bit in Edinburgh. Stockbridge is the perfect location to get a sense of the local mood. Jean’s beds feel new and supportive for both back and side sleepers. Jean was very friendly and accommodating. I accidentally left my phone at her place and she was far too kind in making sure it was returned to me before I left 5 days later. Thank you for a great experience in Edinburgh.
A lovely flat and very clean. A bus ride away from the city centre or a lovely walk along the canal. Would definitely recommend.

I had a great time in Edinburgh and that was also partly because of the ease and pricing of the hostel. It is in the perfect location, and the pricing is really good. The staff is amazing and very helpful and friendly.
I would note that the towels aren't free which I didn't realize from the ad, and also that cleanliness in the bedding area can be improved a bit.
But overall, great value for money and I really enjoyed my stay here.

El apartamento es perfecto! unas vistas muy bellas! Lu una anfitriona inigualable! Parecia que me leia el pensamiento, queria pregutnarle algo y cuando me metia en el chat ya me habia explicado la duda!
El apartamento esta en una zona ideal llena de bares, take aways, charity shops..justo abajo esta una linea de autobus que te lleva a cualquier parte de Edimburgo
todo perfecto!!!
Thanks so much a lovely stay.  Spacious and lovely surroundings, well equipped kitchen, great advice and Caroline was very responsive and helpful. Thanks so much!
Great location. Walking distance to Waverley Station. Clean rooms and comfortable beds! Definitely recommend to stay for family.
Amazing little hotel. Such a fun location and the cafe was an added little plus. The rooms were very comfortable and clean.

Loved Ann's place! location was perfect and with a view, super easy to walk anywhere. Communication was quick and efficient, and the instructions for checkin and out were very clear and easy to follow. Would stay again for sure
Perfect spot for the Old Town, transport links and getting about also by foot. Nice, clean apartment and perfect for 4 people. Friendly host and helpful.
A great place! Close to the city, great bus links, well equipped, clean and cosy.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt. Das Apartment ist schön eingerichtet und sehr sauber. Die Lage ist sehr zentral (und dadurch auch etwas lauter). Alles in allem kann ich das Apartment sehr empfehlen.

Scott and Charlotte were great hosts! The apartment was pristine and situated in an area that is central to many parts of the city. The kitchen was fully stocked with necessary equipment; rooms were welcoming and comfortable. They were responsive to questions and ready to help!
Nice place with plenty of space to fit 3 to 4 people. We equipped apartment in  a nice area.

Très bon séjour, arrivée impeccable, très bien situé sur la Royal Mile. Tout est accessible à pied : lieux à visiter, commerces.
Hôte sympathique et prenant quelques instants pour présenter la ville et les choses à voir.
Super séjour 👍
A stylish flat sparklingly clean. Well equipped for all your needs.
Excellent home in an excellent location. The supplied guide of the area was very handy as well!
We had the most fantastic time! The accommodation was a true home from home and Zoe went out of her way to make our young family feel welcome and happy! Could not have asked for more!

A clean and tidy little place to stay a]t in the heart of Edinburgh! it was close to amenities as well! It's a standard student accommodation so you shouldn't expect a premium room at the Premier Inn but the staff was friendly and the bed was comfy! what more could one as for when staying for a night?
Thank you, Ben!

Chambre très agréable avec une jolie vue et salle de bain privative. Emplacement idéal pour visiter la ville à pied.
Steve est très amical, nous a donné de bonnes adresses pour manger, nous avons bien échangé. Petit plus, ses chiens sont joueurs et très gentils.
Je recommande !
Location is great

This may have been the best Airbnb we have stayed in!  The location was perfect, loved looking out the window at the Castle!  There were lots of restaurants nearby and it is so close to the Royal Mile and other attractions.  The size of the place was great, loved having a separate bedroom.  The furniture was comfortable and we loved that it was decorated for Christmas!!  We highly recommend Aileen's place and would stay there again if we are back in Edinburgh.

Fantastic location with stunning views of Edinburgh castle. Had everything we needed close by with lots of restaurants, pubs, and shops.
Place was spotless and clean, lovely warm shower and very comfy bed.
Really nice stay :-)

Amazing location, walking distance from all important sites. Very comfortable bed and hot water all day. Patrick has ensured the place is sparkly clean and added small touches (fresh milk, chocolates and tea) in the room that made the stay pleasant.
le logement était très agréable, confortable et calme.
Beautiful room and a great window with the option to sip tea while relaxing after exploring the city. Very close to bus stop taking you to central Edinburgh. Was recommended very good restaurants
Great location for our stay in Edinburgh! Nice place and has everything you need for a base

Carol and Elizabeth was fantastic. Carol has been given clear instruction about anything we need there. We arrived before check in time and she has kindly given permission for us to drop our luggage so that we can spend more time exploring Edinburgh. We found the place very very very clean, comfortable, more beautiful than in the picture. We loved the apartment! It has everything we need. The location is superb, it is in walking distance to the national rail station and it is in the heart of every major sightseeing in Edinburgh. You don't need to take public transport anywhere. The key to the apartment with code and it is so much easier for us. The apartment is in the first floor with no lift. For us it is not a problem altough we have big luggage and Carol has mention this from the beginning. We highly recommend the apartment for everyone. We would come back for sure. Thank you Carol and Elizabeth for sharing this beautiful apartment with us.
Jorden and Cosmin are such lovely hosts! They are generous with sharing food and their place is the most stylish flat i’ve ever been. The shower is 5 star hotel level clean!!

This was our third visit to Veronique's lovely apartment.  The perfect place to stay when we visit Edinburgh.  It is a stylish, comfortable warm apartment that we live coming back to and brilliantly situated for exploring Edinburgh.  We highly recommend!

The place is bright and spacious, can easily accommodate two families. Had an additional foldable bed for the older kids to sleep in the parent room. The kitchen is well equipped, location is good, royal yacht is just next door. The view from the balconies is really good, we watched new year fireworks above Edinburgh castle from it!!! the place was warm and welcoming, had a good supply of cleaning products and basic essentials for our stay.
On the down side the place definitely could be better maintained. There was dust and rubbish under our beds and sofas and in the corners. we were traveling with two young kids and they were often picking up things they shouldn't have. Having only one pair of keys for such a big apartment is not convenient as it requires a lot of coordination between all 6 of us, and without keys you cannot call an elevator down. some of the lamp shades were not working, and two out of three radiators in the sitting room were out of order. otherwise good stay

Location is amazing--perfectly situated at the base of the Royal Mile. Space looks as pictured. We hit a few quirks with the WiFi and some of the windows, but nothing that would really prevent us from recommending it.

We very much enjoyed stopping here. Helpful & communicative hosts. Also really helpful to have parking and a lift to get our stuff up to the apartment.
The apartment is modern and lots of sitting space, and floor space for a toddler to play.
kitchen has everything needed, plates, cups, cutlery etc.
Bathroom clean and also has everything needed, Bath & shower.
Close enough to walk into Edinburgh, about 10 - 15 mins.
Bit noisy in the evening and night but that's to be expected being flats.
Overall was a nice apartment, close to walk in to Edinburgh, has parking and everything needed for a stay away.
would recommend.
Lynn's place is absolutely gorgeous with very comprehensive amenities. Kitchen is very equipped! Lynn is very responsive to any questions you might have during the stay, would recommend!

Eine schöne Unterkunft, alles sauber und so wie beschrieben. Die Gastgeber teilten uns viele Tips bezüglich der Stadt mit, was sehr freundlich ist. Schade war nur, dass wir nie jemanden persönlich angetroffen haben. Wir wurden leider in den 2 Tagen keinmal persönlich begrüßt oder in Empfang genommen. Ansonsten war alles super.
We would love to rent again next time.
I arrived quite earlier but the host greeted me and I checked in very smoothly. They were also very flexible about checking out. They  made my stay very easy and comfortable.
Great place to stay, great location, very clean, good amenities and comfortable, would definitely recommend.

This is the absolute perfect place for a stay in Edinburgh - beautiful flat, ideal location, and stunning view! Just steps from the castle, pubs, restaurants, shops, Old Town, and New Town. I can't recommend this highly enough!
Great location, great view!

Gary is a super attentive and friendly host, and his place was superclean and nice. We got some nice tips for the city and alltogether had a fun experience staying at Gary's. Communication was simple and easy. Thank you Gary!

My friend and I stayed at Anne's place for 3 nights in Dec 2023 and I honestly believe that this was my best Airbnb stay ever. As you an can imagine, the weather in Edinburgh in peak December is pretty miserable. However, the warmth and welcoming nature of Anne, Raymond, Stefan, Sharon, Indie and Tash (her dogs) made us feel right at home. May I add, the mattresses in the room are exceptional, perfectly soft and supportive. Other than the incredibly cosy stay, we had the pleasure of equally warm conversations with Anne. Feel free to close your eyes and book Anne's place for your visit to Edinburgh. Thanks Anne!
Clean and close to many things.

Verten svarte raskt og svarte på alle spørsmål vi kom med. Leiligheten var kjempe fin, med vakkert bad og kjøkken😍 Enkelt å sjekke både inn og ut. Leiligheten ligger ca 10-15 min unna gamlebyen noe som passet oss perfekt😁
Stanza molto bella, pulita. Buona colazione e super ospitali.
Cute and convenient location!
We had a great stay in Edinburgh. The apartment and location were excellent and Gordon is a very nice gentleman.

Delightful flat in an excellent location, so close to the Holyrood, Arthur’s Seat and all the city.  Jane is a very welcoming host, we really appreciated the great collection of Edinburgh books, the supplies in the fridge and Jane’s flexibility.

I had a great time.  I wasn't sure of booking because I felt I was gonna be far away from the main points of interest but to be honest walking around was part of the fun and great experience.  Thank you Hamish and Ilio for all the hospitality.  Hope to see you again sometime soon!

Dora’s home was perfect for our whistle stop NYE trip to Edinburgh.
The flat is so spacious and decor matched the period property perfectly. The bed was so comfy
The flat is a 20-30 min walk depending on how fast you walk. We did the walk at 11.30pm to Carlton hill to watch the fireworks and got there in plenty of time for the clock to strike.
The bus is easy and cheap and drops you off practically a min walk away. The road to which the flat is on has multiple restaurants and pubs plus hip independent shops . We had a takeaway from the Chinese a few doors down on NYE and it was delicious.
