Dora was so helpful prior to booking giving us lots of recommendations for restaurants and bars. Her communication during our stay was also faultless . If you don’t mind not being central and want a homely place to yourself , this is is the spot for you !
*Be mindful that the shower head is not fixed so you have to hold it whilst lathering up. Not adeal breaker but could bother some people

The only issue we had was that the heating was not working so the host had to bring some heaters for the night. The downside was that without heating there wasn’t any hot water either so we were unable to shower. Other than that everything else was fine.

Hemos estado tres parejas y la estancia ha sido inmejorable. Apartamento grande con tres habitaciones . Muy limpio y cómodo.
Localización estupenda, en plena new town cerca de bares, supermercados,restaurantes,…
Y a 12 minutos de la old town.
Una experiencia estupenda, si volvemos repetiremos sin dudarlo
Logement propre, agréable et très bien pour un week-end à visiter

We had an incredible stay at Belinda and Stephen's property in Edinburgh! Our group of 14 found the house to be absolutely perfect – spacious, beautifully decorated, and well-equipped with everything we needed. It was one of the best Airbnbs we’ve ever stayed in, making our Edinburgh experience truly unforgettable.
Belinda and Stephen were exceptional hosts, always responsive and attentive to our requests. Their warm hospitality and attention to detail made us feel right at home. We highly recommend this property to anyone visiting Edinburgh and look forward to staying here again in the future. Thank you, Belinda and Stephen, for a fantastic stay

We loved Tom & Izzy’s place. It was a very nice apartment with a very comfortable bed, which is so important when you’re traveling. Our GPS had trouble locating the apartment building because the road was closed on one end by the building.  Tom & Izzy did help us find it, but having to park and go into the apartment to get the key fob for the gate to the parking lot was difficult.
Very nice and well-appointed.

Caroline was such a lovely and responsive host. She was proactive in her communication, met us to let us in, allowed for early access to the space to drop off our luggage, and was helpful with local advice. The space was exactly as shown in pictures and had a private gate that allowed for a secure entrance to private terrace and apartment.
John recommended places to eat and tips on best buses. Really comfortable stay and great to have a bathroom and an en-suite. Great location for exploring Edinburgh and the coastline too.

We had a fantastic stay at Kim’s place. The place is very clean, nice and we felt very welcomed. The highlight for us was the beautiful uphill view of Edinburgh and the front garden. We’d highly recommend it!
wunderbares apartment. sauber gut gelegen bequem. kommunikation mit holly grossartig. zu empfehlen!

Absolutely loved staying in this flat. It is beautiful and the location is just fab! Host Amanda gave lots of great recommendations for places to eat and things to do. She was very responsive whenever I had any questions and even offered a late checkout/somewhere to keep our bags when plans changed.
There are so many great places to eat (Bon Vivant down the street highly recommend, get starters, you won't regret it!) and drink near the flat and its only a short walk to Princes street and lots of main attractions.
We would definitely stay here again!

Fantastic place to stay, Lucas and Tsarlin went above and beyond to ensure I had an enjoyable stay with them in Edinburgh. Would recommend anyone visiting here to stay with them in the future.
P.S Lucas makes fantastic potatoes!
A well-situated, furnished and provisioned property that was ideal for our needs.
Vi hade ett par fantastiska dagar i Edingburgh! Lätt att utgå från lägenheten till alla sevärdheter. 🙏🏻

We really enjoyed our stay with Michael. He was thoughtful and accommodating, and all the rooms were clean, comfortable and nicely furnished. The location was really convenient, just walking distance from the city centre. Thanks Michael!

We had an excellent experience. The location is great, near Portobello Beach and with easy access to the city center using the  nearby bus. Wendy prepared a clean room and breakfast area, which we really appreciated.
Very good! Perfectly situated if you prefer the old town. Easy to check in and out. Clean and nice apartment
amazing

This place is clean, comfortable and a reasonable walk to the center of Edinburgh. The guest bedroom sits conveniently on the main floor between the kitchen and a half bath. The bed and pillows were very comfortable.
Although we enjoyed walking into the center of town to enjoy the Fringe Festival we found the local pubs and eateries to be quite charming, of good quality and more relaxed.
Alistair and Paola are fine hosts and very helpful to their guests. We enjoyed staying with them.

Cat’s place is so lovely. I love the interior and decor of the place and have everything you need for your stay. Lots of great bakery and coffee shops nearby. A peaceful location but not far from the usual places. Overall it was a very comfortable stay. Cat is an amazing host as well. Highly recommended!

My best friend and I loved our stay at Michelle’s. The place was just like the photos, and her instructions for everything, from getting into the unit to how to work the stovetop and the shower were spot on. When we did have questions, Michelle’s response time was very quick.
The location was ideal, just a 2 minute walk to the bus stop, and only a couple of blocks to the grocery store. The neighborhood was also very quiet and peaceful. My favorite thing was the incredibly comfortable bed/linens and the electric fireplace, perfect with a cup of tea after a rainy day of sightseeing. Would definitely recommend!
Very nice place in a very convenient area of the city. Highly recommended!

Would definitely stay again. Had to chase up the check in details. Also was continuously bombarded with texts and emails during the stay which may have been computer generated, but of no real benefit for the stay. Location was excellent and lots of amenities and sights within walking distance.

This property is very well located just a half block off the Royal Mile and getting to everything is an easy walk.  It is on an upper floor of an older building, so plan a hike up about 4 sets of staircases with your luggage.  There's a lockbox on the outer door and the inside is utilized by many apartments.  There were often people outside standing around the outer door and we were uncomfortable about people forcing their way in when we opened the door.  It's in a high pickpocket area, so worth being extra cautious.  The apartment is a usual European style.  It was stuffy, and opening the windows brought in so much noise from the street.  The noise was very difficult at night.  One small fan was provided in the apartment, but did not help but one bedroom.  The apartment was clean and well stocked for 4 people.

Close to Haymarket station with a number of shops and cafes within walking distance. Flat was very clean and spacious, good sized rooms and comfy beds. Unfortunately we didn’t get the bedding we had requested for the sofa bed. There can be a bit of noise from the road outside, if you’re in the room downstairs with a window or on the sofa, but nothing that can’t be cancelled out with a pair of ear plugs. Would recommend staying here as it’s good value for money.
We had an amazing time in the apartment. Super close to the city center, lots of cute bars and cafes nearby! The apartment was very nice, equipped with everything you need, super clean and comfy.

Really disappointed. Accommodation was cold and smelled stale on arrival. Shower curtain rail was hanging off the wall and unsafe, and, despite reporting this to Airbnb, it was not rectified during our stay, which meant we were unable to safely use it after day 1! Fabulous location. Small, but clean and cosy.

Catherine is the most friendly host; open, engaging, helpful and knowledgable of the local area.
The house was conveniently located for travel to my work and the leisure centre is a 20min walk away.
I felt comfortable in Catherine's house where I could mix with the family or have my own space.
Great value for money is always a positive too😊

The house is beautiful. It has everything you need. It is spacious and bright. The owners paid lots of attention to the smallest details around. It is very clean and everything is well placed in the house. David made our stay much more nicer by recommending a list of places to visit which i can say are places not to be missed.
Thank you David for everything, the food, the recommendations, and for letting us enjoy our stay in your beautiful house.

Very spacious apartment, well stocked with everything needed, including ability for laundry. Walking distance to city center, but very quiet for sleeping. It is a old building and stairs to climb, which did not bother us.
Host communicated very well. Would stay again.

The apartment is very nice, in a perfect location for the Royal Mile and had everything we needed.
It was clean and exactly as pictured.
But the check-in was not good. There was no meet and greet as promised, so it took a long time as we got very limited information. But it all worked out in the end.
Appartement was ruim, opgeruimd en verzorgd. Een absolute aanrader!
Great location in Portobello, a stones throw from the beach and easy access into the city.

We couldn't have asked for nicer accommodation or a nicer host than Annette
The room and ensuite was cosy, warm, comfortable and yet roomy with every need catered for very thoughtfully right down to assorted breakfast supplies for a cold breakfast along with snacks to go. Annette is a very generous and helpful host particularly with giving directions and helpful sightseeing advice. We would definitely stay there again

Perfect location - spacious flat which had everything we needed - walking distance to  all sights and grocery shop which meant we didn’t need to use our car and it was parked safely in the  space provided in the car park opposite the flat.

Such a handy spot to stay. Friendly hosts and the breakfast was lovely. Right on the public transport route (lots of road traffic as a result) but comfortable and clean. Lots of stairs to get to the room (we had a lot of luggage 😂). Hosts were very accommodating.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour, le logement est très bien situé pour découvrir Edinbourgh. C est idéal.  Je recommande. Merci pour tout.

Everything was perfect, just what we needed. The flat is centrally located, very cosy and nicely decorated ; the beds are very comfortable. We will not look elsewhere if we are to return to Edinburgh!
Lovely room in Edinburgh, great host :)
Jederzeit gerne wieder. Die Unterkunft liegt perfekt und ist sehr sauber. Alles zu Fuß erreichbar.

Perfect place to stay. Central to town and very short walk to the Castle. Buy a return day ticket on the bus and visit the Royal Yacht Britannia for £18.50 each, well worth the 2 hour tour and  hop back on bus to visit the beach.

A 20 min du centre à pieds, appartement très bien situé, quartier calme. L’appartement est joli, grand et très bien équipé! Très bien pour 4. L’hôte est sympa et réactif.
Excellente alternative pour visiter Édimbourg et se loger à bon prix.
Pleasant stay, and nice apartment for a family. Easy access from airport, and easy to get to downtown by bus.

El departamento es tal cual como lo muestra el anuncio. Es grande, cómodo, buena calefacción, y está MUY BIEN ubicado (no puede ser mejor la ubicacion).
Uno puede tener privacidad a pesar de compartir el departamento con otros dos huéspedes, además de el anfitrión.
El único problema es que hay huéspedes que son muy mal educados y que hacen mucho ruido en la noche y no respetan el sueño del resto. Pero es cosa de azar quién comparta el espacio con uno.
Al menos a nosotros nos tocó por dos noches unos huéspedes muy ruidosos que dejaban el baño muy sucio. Marcus (el anfitrión) fue muy responsable y cuidadoso en tener todo limpio igual.
Todo excelente la verdad.
We stayed  at Robs apartment for 2 nights and it's a fantastic place to stay, in a fabulous location.  I wouldn't hesitate in recommending this apartment! Regards Lee

You cannot beat the location of this apartment. In a lovely neighbourhood, with everything on your doorstep. Free parking on the driveway & easy check in process. Amazing transport links in Edinburgh centre, but we were happy to walk. The apartment is basic, but spotless. The shower is very powerful. No oven in the kitchen, just two hobs, kettle & microwave, which was fine for a weekend trip.
Owner lives on site & was happy to let us check in early. They also offered lots of recommendations for restaurants in the area.

Andrew was great and he was quite flexible. We were a bit late in our arrival. Flat was quite nice and warm. The heating was on and the flat is nice and had a good day light. Flat was clean and in very good condition. The building is a bit old but not too bad. In terms of location, we had to take buses to the old town, it took 15 min, and they are quite frequent.
Overall good stay!

Silvia was truly a great host. She got in contact with us with details about every step of the Check-in. I could reach her anytime and she replied back fast! Amazing human and host :)
The room looked exactly like in the pictures, was in a good private and calm area. Buse stops are close by and can be used to reach the Centre in minutes.
Definitely recommend 😊
Logement sympathique et bien situé. Top séjour 👍🏼

Really great shower
Thank you Susan it was a pleasure to meet you and share your home briefly Sincerely Judy
A really beautiful room in the perfect location to explore Edinburgh. 10/10 for everything! Loved it and definitely hope to return. Thank you so much!
Heerlijk appartement dichtbij het centrum.

Great apartment in central Edinburgh. It was a fantastic location with so many wonderful places right on our doorstep. It couldn’t have been closer to the old town and royal mile. The apartment was cosy and comfortable and had all we needed. We really enjoyed our stay and Logan was super responsive and helped us where possible. We really appreciated that. Easy check in and check out. We had such a fabulous time and would stay again! Thank you Logan.

What an excellent apartment! You really can’t get a better location in the heart of Edinburgh and the apartment itself exceeded expectations. My parents, who had flown over from Australia, and I had the most wonderful time wandering the streets lounging in the evening in the delightfully furnished apartment. Will certainly stay again.
Lovely place to stay, great location and really fast communication. Had everything we needed for baby which was a massive help! Thanks so much!

A beautiful and very spacious house and garden, with all facilities needed for a large family to stay comfortably. I had to clarify the location but received prompt response. The house is located in a very peaceful area. Thoroughly enjoyed our visit.
Had a fabulous few days in the apartment, location great and bed comfy so couldn’t have asked for much more! Rebecca’s communication was great as well.

Jacqueline’s place was stunning and HUGE. It was perfect for the last night of our trip and would be fantastic for a group. Just know that the smaller bathroom is actually an en suite. It wasn't an issue for us, but just something to mention since we missed it initially.
Área residencial ..uns 15 minutos a pé da Princes Street. Acomodação adequada de acordo com o anúncio. Quarto e banheiro limpos. Sra.Isabel é bem simpática. Gostei de me hospedar lá .
Lovely host, very pleasant room and walkable to city centre
Beautiful flat in beautiful location. Everything about it made us feel welcome and best night’s sleep in ages as well!

The Studio was great. Terrific location - walking distance to just about anywhere you want to be. Felt very safe. Pictures are very accurate - though the bathroom is quite small and is by design a "wet room" which isn't ideal but workable. The bed was very comfortable and I think a full sized bed so heads up could be pretty tight for a couple (which we are and it was).
The hosts have done a nice job with a minimalist aesthetic and calming vibe.
fantastic  castle view on the second floor and the house is very clean😺
Stayed for almost a week and very satisfied. Highly recommended.

Nice modern flat. Plenty of space. Comfortable beds and furniture. Very clean. A fairly quiet area, especially where the bedrooms are situated towards the back of the building. Roza is very friendly and responsive and resolved one or two issues very fast. We had a lovely 4 night stay and would go back one day.
Great stay, loads of space in the flat and a perfect location. Peaceful and private whilst being in the heart of Stockbridge.

A lovely, stylish flat in a great part of town. We slept like logs thanks to how peaceful and silent the area was at night! Florence was a great host as well. Perfect for our flying visit to the fringe.

Daniel’s place was as I expected- quick and easy access to the town centre, Sainsbury’s and Starbucks across the street and free parking on the street. Daniel’s place was very cosy, easy to use heating and kitchen had everything that was needed except for a kitchen roll or a tissue box in the lounge or bedroom.  he also gave a great range of amenities in the kitchen and bathroom.
Fabulous hosts. Parking right outside the building and an easy walk into Edinburgh! Safe location and very quiet apartment and hosts.

We were actually surprised by what a fantastic job Claire and Rob did. They proactively provided very clear and helpful communication with photos for a seamless check in.
The place was undoubtedly very beautiful and well cleaned. We greatly appreciated how well it was stocked including extra bathroom essentials which saves us a trip to the store.
They are very friendly, responsive and helpful.
One of our best Air BnB experiences to date.
Great place to stay, nice apartment and lovely host
Exactly what we needed for our weekend in Edinburgh

Location is great and at the center of old town (High Street). It is great to access to several landmarks of Edinburgh. Also easy to walk to train station.
Derek makes the place like a home. Spacious layout of bedroom, kitchen, sitting for meals, and an OK bathroom.
Nice to include a washer machine for laundry but you do allow more than 24 hours to air dry. Kitchen seems to be equipped with essential tools if you want to cook. I did not cook with just one night stay.

Staying at Eilidh and Matthew's apartment was a pleasure. It is situated in a quiet, relaxed area that is still convenient for shops and not too far from the centre. If someone didn't wish to walk to the centre, the area is well serviced by buses and the tram. The flat itself is as the pictures show. It's comfortable, cosy and has everything you need. Overall, a great place to stay that also represents value for money.
Love the door and windows that allow the outside in! Easy to walk to many of the historic sites!

Sabrina était absente lors de mon séjour, mais j'ai séjourné dans son très bel appartement qu'elle avait bien préparé. Un quartier calme, mais pas excentré. Très accessible à pied et en transports publics.
Excellente communication par message et indications très précises. Merci 😊
great apartment, lovely location

Axel is a fantastic host that pays attention to the important details. His hospitality made our stay feel like home. The bnb was just as described and we especially enjoyed the comfy beds. Netflix and TV were great extras to have for our downtime. I would definitely reccomend a stay.
Lovely & clean. Exactly as described.
It's the best place to stay.. Donna and Doug are the best Host
Good location, nice space.

Casa molto pulita, ospitale e ben arredata. A due passi da supermercato, comoda per raggiungere il centro di Edimburgo e le spiagge. Unico appunto: andrebbero curate maggiormente le scale che portano all’appartamento.

Anna was a charming hostess always wanting to help.
Guests need to be aware that her flat is on the top floor after four flights of stairs so anyone with mobility problems should be aware of this. Parking could also be a slight issue.....
I would certainly stay there again.

Victoria is a great person and host and her place made us feel pretty much like home. It was cozy and warm and the cats were an added plus. Close to the city center with lots of pubs around for an end of day snack and a pint of beer. Hope to come back!

o apartamento é ótimo! Muito grande e espaçoso. Cheio de armários,  facilitou para deixar tudo organizado. Cozinha bem equipada e tudo de bom gosto. Cama excelente e lençóis otimos. um banheiro tem chuveiro e o outro banheira. Acesso fácil por elevador. Proximo ao Holyrrod

This was an awesome location for exploring old town Edinburgh.  Right on the Royal Mile, and you can not get much closer to the Castle.  The apartment was very cute with tons of  character, and great views of the Royal Mile.  For US travelers note that the beds are small compared to what we are used to...the full  size bed in one bedroom was tight for my wife and I (average size), as were the two twin beds for my teen daughters...but we found this to be pretty typical in Scotland.
位置很好，非常中心，去景点火车站都很方便。房间也很大。房间在四楼，假如有带大行李，旋转楼梯还是有些难度
A clean and amazing location. With it being in the middle of Edinburgh city centre and Leith and very frequent buses, you won’t get stuck for things to do. ☺️☺️
Great little apartment right next to Edinburgh castle. Loads to do in and around the area and just out the way enough to not hear the ruckus of the city. Excellent spot to stay!
Spacious living room. Area all clean & tidy. I love it!
Great location, almost right next to Easter Road stadium, Ross’ communication was fantastic, flat was very tidy upon arrival and we enjoyed our visit

Great stay, very accurate description and lovely quiet area.
Only recommendation is to signpost the cottage, found it difficult to locate initially

Really loved Dora's place, a lot bigger than the pictures showed and felt like a real home. Multiple highly rated takeaway spots and restaurants right on our doorstep and the tram from the airport stops a 1 min walk away. Would love to stay here again next time we're in Edinburgh!
Clare was super friendly an helpful - I had  a great time! Also very easygoing with the check-in. Thanks!

Amazing location. Hosts were responsive. Unfortunately, it felt like a lot of rules, instructions, etc. Also, the messages seemed very robotic, which was off putting and did not feel welcoming. I also think having coffee available in a minimum and there was not.

Catherine was so wonderful! The communication was amazing, the bed was so comfortable, the area was really safe with great transportation nearby, and chewy the dog was so friendly and cute! A must stay if you are ever in Edinburgh! 10/10
Thank you so much to David and Janice, we all had a an amazing weekend. The apartment was exactly as described and had everything we needed. We would definitely stay here again.

This gem of an apartment is superbly located,decorated and furnished.  Do not hesitate to visit, you will not be disappointed. All arrangements worked flawlessly, the “welcome pack” was generous and hugely enjoyable while Martin and Weng were the perfect hosts. An experience not to be missed.
Abigail was a fantastic host, disclosed all the necessary information with minimal fuss - Thank you Abigail

Die Unterkunft liegt mitten in der Stadt, weswegen es super einfach ist alles was man ansehen möchte zu Fuß zu erreichen.
Edinburgh war wirklich ein Traum.
Das einzige negative war das Internet. Mit diesem konnte ich oft kaum meine Emails abrufen, noch Videos ansehen.
Amazing place in such an easy location to navigate - would go back next time we visited

Lovely apartment, great location and superb communication from host.
Great location, close to the train station and to get around
great flat, the location is as good as it gets and the process is straightforward and relaxed.

Ellie and Scott were great to work with! Their place is very clean and comfortable. The location is very close to public transport, but also walkable if you want to explore the city on foot. We would definitely stay at their place again!
We had a really good stay in Edinburgh! Mariana was really helpful and kind :))
Would highly recommend! Lovely apartment
My family and I loved our stay at this good value apartment in the middle of Edinburgh’s old town. It’s the perfect base to explore Edinburgh! We hope to be back one day
Very unique property. We loved it!

Great flat in a great location. Easy walking distance to town centre and lots of lovely restaurants a few seconds away. The flat has everything you need (love the wallpaper!) and most importantly a super comfy bed with high quality bedding.

Racel이 정말 친절하게 잘 대해주셔서 좋았습니다.

Thanh-Lan was from the beginning very quick to respond and she has always been very friendly through her texts and face-to-face. I think that, in general, the quality of our stay in her place corresponds well with the amount of money that we payed.
Superbe séjour!! Valentino répond vite aux demandes, chouette appart

A great place to stay in Edinburgh, central location, close to Waverley station, and easy to walk to pubs, restaurants and to explore the old town and castle. Spotlessly clean, comfortable and warm, we really enjoyed our stay there.
Bide is at great location. The room was pretty cozy and super clean. I would book again for the next trip to Edinburgh!
房间整洁，卧室有可以单独使用的卫生间，房东的狗狗很可爱！

The cottage has the most spectacular view of the castle.  It's immaculate, beautifully decorated, and cozy.  The photos don't do it justice.  It's even better in person!  We loved the close proximity to Sainsbury, shops, restaurants, and everything we wanted to see and do.  This is a little gem and must stay while visiting Edinburgh.

This flat is an amazing place to call home for any amount of time you might be visiting Edinburgh. The pictures almost don’t do it justice, it’s even better in person. This is one of the cleanest AirBnBs we have ever stayed in.
Simon is very responsive and helpful, and we found him pleasant to chat with when needed.
The area is super quiet, as was the building. We had a lovely stay here, and would highly recommend to anyone.
Lovely apartment - very typical Edinburgh West End. Well put together and lots of basics included which was nice. Would recommend.

We had a wonderful stay in Edinburgh! The apartment was very clean and cozy. Eilidh and Matthew were super responsive, and we even got to check in early since they finished cleaning before 3PM, which was much appreciated! The apartment was quick and easy to get to from the city centre and very close to a bus stop. Would definitely stay here again!
Quick response to any circumstances. Recommend.
Mary was friendly and welcomed us correctly. Always approachable.

The apartment over delivered if anything! Excellent space for 6 people. Fabulous views. Perfect location. Clean. Easy to access.
I will recommend and hopefully come back one day

Evin konumu çok güzel. Her yere yakın ve tam şehrin merkezinde. Etrafında bir çok mekan ve alışveriş mağazası var. Özellikle alt katta Bar Napoli ve yemekleri harika. Great Stay. Would recommend

Exactly as advertised. Great place and was exactly what was needed. 10/10 would recommend

A brilliant place to stay for those that want to experience Edinburgh at it’s best. An ideal location for getting out into the city straight away! The flat itself is lovely and spacious!

Paolo is a great host, with a great place. It is the perfect place to stay while I am in Edinburgh on a training course.
Highly recommend! Beautiful space, so clean and comfortable. It was in an excellent location to explore the city. Definitely book this one 👏🏻👏🏻
Great apartment in brilliant spot in Edinburgh. Very peaceful and easy to walk or catch a bus.
great location!  Loved having the fan there

Lovely place in great walking distance from the city! Very nice and clean apartment that has everything you need! Shana was a responsive host and is easy to communicate with! Would love to come back to Shanas place! :)

We loved it there, it is just off the Royal Mile, so incredibly close to everything.
Thank you for such a lovely stay.
We had everything we needed, shops very close to the apartment and comfy bed.. Definitely worth coming back.

This apartment was perfect. It was modern, comfortable and we'll located. It is next to the Parliament building. The hosts were wonderful. It was the best airbnb we have ever stayed at. I wish I could own it. Lol.
Calim is a great host.  The moment you walk into his stylish apartment it feels like 'home'.  Excellent location close to theatre, museums, gallery, great restaurants and pubs.
A*

FANTASTIC place to stay near the airport. It was so comfortable and it was nice having all the amenities- new oven, great bathroom, a cozy bed. The hosts were very responsive and helpful. I recommend staying here!
Great location, directly in fron of the aurport transports. Very walkable to the city center. The apartment was very clean and pregty nice ngl.
Hôtes très accueillants et maison très chaleureuse, je recommande vivement!
Nicola and David were really responsive to any and all questions/requests throughout. The place was exactly as described, great location!
Amazing apartment with beautiful views. Absolutely huge! Defo recommend.

Tarik's place is nice, clean and well catered for including everything one could need for a short trip such as hairdryer, iron, shampoos, brekkie plus choccies and very well located. Tarik  was very hospitable.
Great stay, flat in a great location and in a very walkable area to anywhere in the city.
Perfect place to stay. Everything you need . Close to restaurants and tourist spots. Within walking distance

Lovely stay in a local neighbourhood. Excellent for the tram, or very easy for parking if you bring a car.
Beautifully fitted out and very welcoming. Cozy and well-provisioned.
A good space for 4 of us and we were able to have family round for board games.

My husband and I so enjoyed our visit in this sweet and homey flat in the heart of one of the most exciting areas of Edinburgh. There's no beating the view - the Castle! The shower worked great and the bed was super comfy. Susan was extremely welcoming and attentive - a great host. I'll be happy to stay here again if the opportunity should arise!

l'appartement correspond à la description et il est agréable. son emplacement est très bien pour visiter edinbourg: proche du centre et avec des commerces nombreux et les transports communs à proximité.

Nice flat, perfectly located, it has two comfortable double beds so ideal for two couples. The flat is very cozy. Easy to get from/to the airport by tram. Thanks Duncan!
Great Airbnb. Matched description, good location. Nice Airbnb and great host
Beautiful appartement ! Lovely days in Édimbourg !

Dan’s apartment was just perfect for my trip. It was very walkable, with loads of coffee shops, restaurants and grocery near by.  The apartment itself was cozy, clean and quiet. I would love to stay again!
Nice apartment in a nice location. Must immediately change the sofas in the living room!!! The team that runs the house is not so friendly and warm.

I can’t recommend this place enough. Joyce is literally one of the best people I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. She was the most helpful and accommodating person my wife and I have stayed with. She was funny, kind and always had some tea or coffee when we got back. We LOVED her.
Great location next to great restaurants and pubs, all within walking distance. 12/10 would recommend it.
Brilliant place to stay right in the centre of Edinburgh. Albert is a very good host. He answered all my queries very promptly and plied me with cups of tea.

Very well kept, well stocked, comfortable, and convenient airbnb in the heart of edinburgh. The castleview from the entrance is special. The host was very helpful, responding to our questions promptly and informatively.  Would definitely recommend this for people visiting edinburgh for the first time.
Two of the nicest people I met ! Everything was perfect, we really enjoyed it. The place is really beautiful and very well situated. Thank you both for everything !

Jonathan's flat is perfect for a few days in Edinburgh with good bus connections to the center. The flat is functional and feels homey, and has everything one needs when away from home.

The room is lovely and the location is not far from the station. The most important thing is that the host is nice.

Recomiendo a Charlotte, sin duda. Ha sido muy amable con nosotros durante toda la estancia. Nos ha sugerido muchas actividades para hacer en Edimburgo y hemos estado siempre en contacto por esta vía. Gracias.

David's place is very quiet and all the things that we needed is in there. 😊
Ideal location, comfy beds, no noise even though it’s on a main road. We had a great stay! Thankyou :)

Very nice stay at Elizabeth's place. I spoke with Mary by messages, everything was well-indicated. The apartment is lovely and very warm, which we appreciated a lot! You can cook easily with the equipment provided.

The location of the flat is ideal, tucked snuggly away on a quiet street with lots of characteristic shops, cafeterias and restaurants. A perfect peaceful retreat in the evening after a day out.
5 minute walk radius gives us access to all supermarkets like tesco, sainsburys and M&S. Old town is just 10 minute walk away, across Waverley Bridge. So, for us, we had the best of both worlds.
The flat itself is newly-refurbished, well-presented, homely and cosy. Super clean, of course. Spacious bedroom with amble storage. Great water pressure in the shower. Lovely living room and fully equipped kitchen. The flat was always warm. I do believe that we had great value for money booking this Airbnb service!
Craig and Catherine were always just a message away. Communication was always prompt. The host even expressed concerns for us when the (usual) rain of Edinburgh hit the city for a whole full day. It felt like we were staying at a caring friend's place.
Bottom line is that I highly recommend Craig and Catherine's flat and service. Will book again next time we visit Edinburgh!

L’appartement est très bien placé, et on peut facilement se balader et surtout le tramway amène partout à Édimbourg, où l’on veut aller si on veut pas trop marcher ! Le quartier du port est très agréable et beaucoup de restaurants.
Si je dois retourner à Édimbourg, je reprendrais cet appartement !
Fine place, a good deal for a larger group.
Had a great stay, loved the location of the flat with parking outside. The welcome video was a great idea.
Very welcoming and accommodating host. Conor was thoughtful and very easy to communicate with. I will definitely stay here again.
We were made to feel very welcome. It was exactly as described. Pete and Laura were lovely and gave us some great recommendations!
Great Location and excellent beds.Deane and Co were great hosts. Would stay again. If you have A disabled badge parking not a problem.

Lovely clean and comfortable place, conveniently located for where we wanted to be and within walking distance of cafés and restaurants for breakfast and evening meals. Would definitely recommend, and we hope to use again.

Notre codage s'est déroulé sans accro, Henry a accepté un early check in et a mis a disposition tout se do t nous avions besoin. !! lit parapluie, serviettes, quelques dosettes de café et une liste d'activités a ne pas manquer !!!
L'emplacement est idéal, proche gare, tram et bus.
Je recommande fortement cet hôte ainsi que ce logement !!!!!
Logement très bien placé, bien desservi et idéal pour 3 personnes ( un lit double et un canapé-lit) . L’hôte est très disponible, réactif et donne de super recommandations de restaurants.

Sarah’s cottage met all of our expectations!! She greeted us personally to show us around the space and talk us through places in the area, as well as how to use appliances in the cottage. The cottage is located in a great location, close to everything you want to do! The spa style shower/bathroom and heated floors were amazing. Perfect to warm up in after a cold day in Edinburgh!
Thank you so much James, it has been a pleasure staying at your home in Edinburgh. It's a wonderful place, felt like home

My mom, brother, and I traveled to Edinburgh to kick off our weeklong vacation in Scotland. Elizabeth’s place was a great spot to start our trip. She was very accommodating with our early morning flight, allowing us to drop off bags prior to the normal check-in time. We found the flat’s location to be a great spot to explore the city on foot and enjoyed walking through the Meadows Park to get to old town. A few blocks away you can find several places to eat, coffee shop, pubs, etc.
As others have mentioned in their reviews, the flights of steps might be tricky for some people, especially if they’re hauling larger pieces of luggage. The bathroom is rather tight, especially by American standards, but we had no issues with it.
Beautiful flat, great location, great hosts. Ideal for a weekend away in Edinburgh.

La casa esta muy bien situada, en un paseo estas en el centro y la zona es muy agradable. El autobús y el tranvía para ir al aeropuerto están muy cerca. El apartamento tiene de todo, pero eche de menos un secador de pelo. También vendrían bien unas cortinas mas opacas o unas persianas en la habitación, pues entra mucha luz por la mañana y te despierta.
La dueña te deja café, te, leche ,aceite,vinagre y otros detalles que son muy de agradecer.
En resumen una estancia muy agradable.
Mary's apartment was amazing. Couldn't have asked for a better location. We were walking distance from everything. Right next to the Edinburgh Castle and the Royal Mile. Would definitely recommend.

Margaret was very friendly and her place was so neat! She loves to chat with the guest so we got to know little things about Edinburgh. The view from the bedroom is wonderful and the bedroom is very cozy. Loved the stay and definitely will come again!

Our second stay at Rebecca’s.
Great position for a walk along the shoreline of portabello and a short bus ride into Edinburgh. Apartment has everything you need, spacious, clean and a comfortable bed.
Would certainly recommend a stay at Rebecca’s.
Despite of my late reservations and notice,they welcomed me. The room was really clean and is near quiet city center. I could have great times.
Clean and tidy space in a good location for exploring Edinburgh a short walk from the centre. Good communication and hassle free stay

Logement semblable à une auberge de jeunesse, bien situé car au pieds du tramway et à 15 min à pieds du centre. Chambre fidèle à la description toutefois je vous conseille d’avoir un masque et surtout des boules quies pour pouvoir dormir paisiblement car si quelqu’un se balade dans la chambre d’à côté ou dans les couloirs nous entendons absolument tout. Il y a une grande salle de bain avec WC mais petit bémol pour la 2e salle d’eau/WC qui est vraiment trop petite, nous nous douchons vraiment sur le WC.
Sinon appartement propre, il me semble qu’une dame de ménage passe tous les jours !

Die Unterkunft war in Ordnung, wir hatten einen guten Aufenthalt. Rebecca hat rasch kommuniziert und wir konnten auch 30min früher in die Unterkunft. Die Lage der Unterkunft ist gut, man ist recht rasch in der Stadt. Die Betten und die Bettwäsche waren sehr gut.
Schwierig an der Unterkunft war der Lärm. Es gibt nur einglasige nicht-schallisolierte Fenster und die Bahn fährt 5m von der Wohnung vorbei. Man hört jedes Auto auf der Straße fahren und jede Bahn. Selbst mit Ohrenschutz-Ohrstöpseln habe ich alles gehört und wir haben alle leider nicht gut geschlafen. Das müssen Leute berücksichtigen, bevir sie buchen. Es gibt auch keinen Parkplatz bei dieser Wohnung. Check-out war um 10h und bereits um 9.50 stand jemand vor der Tür, das finde ich etwas unnötig stressig - wir waren bereits auf dem Weg nach draußen.
Really cute place at good location with amazing views! Emily had been really lovely as well hosting us and the communication was great
Nice apartment close to the city center with its own local shops and pubs. The apartment is clean and Keith is very welcoming and helpful!
We liked it so much we stayed again, will be back again at next games.

Absolutely fantastic stay (second time booking)! Sam is an amazing host who made our trip to Edinburgh truly special. His communication was excellent - very thorough and detailed, making everything incredibly easy for us. Sam's wealth of knowledge about the area was invaluable; his travel suggestions were spot on and greatly enhanced our experience. The room and bathroom were always super clean and had everything we needed. We really appreciated how considerate Sam was throughout our stay. The location is perfect, very close to the city centre and numerous tourist attractions. We highly recommend Sam's place to our friends, family, and anyone looking to visit Edinburgh. Can't wait to come back!
Thank you very much Sam!

Great find & host who sent really clear instructions. Good value for central location. All beds, towels, bathroom and kitchen super clean. Nice surprise to walk in and find snacks supplied and the warmth of the apartment. Would stay again, thank you!
Excellent apartment with plenty of room. Perfectly comfortable for six people. Communication with Karen was very efficient in the lead up to check in.
This space is lovely! Perfect size for two people. And the location could not be better. It is a 10 min walk to the castle/ royal mile. Would recommend others to stay.
Élizabeth est une personne très conciliante, elle a accepté que nous déposions nos bagages plus tôt. Nous recommandons ce logement.
Had a lovely stay in Edinburgh at Keith's place. Well located stay and comfy beds. Perfect for a group of 4 friends.
A lovely place to stay - very clean, comfortable and cosy. The appartment is decorated and furnished to a very high standard.
Perfect stay, everything in the flat was great, ideal location, great communication.
L'endroit vaut vraiment le detour. Nous avons adoré la déco. L'emplacement est idéal pour visiter la ville. Le resto qui est en dessous est excellent.

The flat is perfect, you feel in home since the first moment you are there, equipped with every little thing you need to enjoy Edinburgh. It's near from the city center by bus, and also walking, located in a quite neighborhood with a lot of beautiful shops, restaurants, supermarkets and nice places near, like The Shore, The Leith Walk, parks, etc. And it's perfect because of Andy, he's a polite, helpful and funny person (The Best!).
His flat is an amazing place to stay, no matter the nights you'll be there, you'll love it!
Gorgeous space in a fantastic location.
Helpful hosts, clean and stylish flat, close to beach, great for a relaxed trip with reasonably easy city access.

Charlotte a été très accueillante, elle nous a donné plein d'informations concernant son quartier ainsi que des recommandations de restaurants. Son logement est très agréable, calme et à proximité des bus et du tramway. C'est avec plaisir que nous aimerions un jour y retourner.

The apartment was just as described. Clean, comfortable and well decorated.
When you enter the main entrance to the building the hallway is dated but architectural nice.
The walk into the city centre in 35 minutes or an average of £5.50 using uber.
There is a strip mall with a supermarket, KFC and other shops just 5 minutes walk away and a collection of takeaways 7/8 minutes away.
Mario is a lovely guy and very tentative. He made our stay worth every penny.
Lorene’s home was beautiful and Lorene herself was a very friendly and helpful host. Would definitely recommend this room.

Excellent logement, très confortable et conforme à ce qui était mentionné sur le site. Il y a tout ce qu'il faut pour le breakfast, un lave-linge, un étendage à linge. Il ne manque vraiment.
Nous avons utilisé les transports en commun à 4mn de la maison, très pratique.
Bernice est une hôtesse très accueillante et réactive.
Tout était parfait et cela nous a permis d'avoir un superbe séjour à Edimbourg .
Merci Bernice!!
Wonderful cottage, very hi standards of cleanliness and decor. Highly recommended.

John was responsive and sent a plumber over when there was a backup and replaced a tea kettle that we found to be broken fairly quickly. His notes were very cordial and nice. The apartment is very clean, the beds are comfortable and the location is great. Overall however the place needs someone to replace and repair the amenities that are worn or broken, and freshen up the linens, bedding, and pillows as they are well loved. The place is very clean and quiet but you definitely feel like this is a rental that is keeping costs low.

Cary nous attendait (ma fille est arrivée 1 jour avant moi). Le logement est impeccable et très propre. Cary et son mari sont présents mais discrets. Ils donnent également de bons conseils et sont disponibles pour les hôtes, prêts à rendre service. La chambre donne sur un petit jardin et la rue est sans issue donc très calme. Nous sommes à environ 15-20 mn à pied de Grassmarket et Victoria Street. Je recommande donc vivement ce logement.
Miejsce dobrze skomunikowane, czyste i w spokojnej dzielnicy. Mieszkanie było bardzo przytulne i czyste. Polecam!

James war ein wundervoller Gastgeber und das Appartment ist sehr, sehr schön. Es war alles für das Frühstück vorhanden und die selbstgemachte Marmelade war köstlich. Ich kann dieses Appartement nur empfehlen und würde jederzeit wieder kommen. Vielen dank James

Alles war super:) die Wohnung liegt in der Nähe von der station hayermarkt. In der Nähe war ein lidl, da konnte man gut einkaufen gehen. Ebenso waren wir oft zu Fuß unterwegs das man alles so ziemlich zu Fuß erreicht hatte. Alles wir waren sehr zu Frieden mit allem. Und der Kontakt war super wenn man fragen hatte konnte man die beiden kontaktieren und man erhielt schnell eine Antwort:)
The room was as advertised, and with the en-suite bathroom and kettle + tea/coffee it felt like we were in a hotel room. Great location, walking distance from most attractions.
The perfect location, what a great stay

Wij hebben het enorm naar ons zin gehad bij Jacobine en David. Ontzettend gastvrije mensen en een heerlijk huis. Bushalte naar het centrum op loopafstand en we hebben veel goede tips gekregen voor activiteiten en lekker eten. We konden leuk kletsen over onze gedeelde hobby en hebben ons verblijf als erg fijn ervaren. 100% een aanrader!
David is very prompt in replying to messages. The place was very clean and quiet. Will highly recommend.
Super comfy and spacious accommodation. Very central for all parts of the city. Sally was proactive and helpful.

Having an interest in design and architecture. We were looking forward to our short stay in the studio. We found it to be a little design gem tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the city. We hope to return.

Helped us to return rental car and made us feel very comfortable as if we were in our own home with family!!! We’re willing to go out of their way to help in any way they could - superb stay and would highly recommend anyone looking for fantastic accommodation. Thanks Linda and George!!!

Wir waren zu 3 im Appartement, es war mit viel Liebe eingerichtet und wirklich sehr sauber. Sogar an Milch und Saft und Kaffe wurde gedacht, die Küche ist gut ausgestattet. Auch ist man mit dem Bus gut angeschlossen um ins Stadtzentrum zu kommen. Auch der Strand an der Portobello ist zu Fuss gemütlich zu erreichen wenn man gerne mal außerhalb der Stadt etwas unternehmen möchte. Wir waren wirklich sehr zufrieden mit dem Angebot von Kay und würden jederzeit wieder für einem Besuch zurückkommen.
I had a fantastic time at this flat. It’s very homely and the location is amazing! Everything was super clean and it had everything you could need!
Great Host, made us feel very welcome, communicated effectively , met us at check-in and showed us around - Thank You
A great little apartment with nice touches and in a wonderful area!
This is the perfect location to visit Edinburgh. The decor is beautiful and beds and linens are so comfortable! Emma went over the top to accommodate us.
Great place, so close to everything but protected from the noise of the Mile.

Everything was absolutely wonderful. Lovely home, super comfy bed, located to lots of nice restaurants and the cinema. There was a massive collection of DVDs as well, which kept the kids busy, and there were a lot of thoughtful touches throughout the house. We really enjoyed our stay, highly recommend!

Everything was great - clear instructions, perfect location near the city centre, clean and spacious flat. Fresh flowers as well as cereals, fruits and croissants for breakfast should you be hungry. Would totally recommend Rose’s flat for your stay in Edinburgh.
Absolutely enjoyed staying at Dave & Tokes, such a warm welcome, stunning and super stylish house. Will definitely be staying again once back to Edinburgh. Many thanks!
Very cozy place.  Calum is a wonderful host.  We enjoyed the fruit and snacks he provided.  He even had milk in the fridge!   Very clean flat!

사진보다 더 좋았어요!
침구도 포근하고 깨끗하고 좋았구.
따뜻한 물이 잘 나오는 샤워룸도 좋았어요.
호스트가 구워준 따뜻한 빵과 커피로 아침식사 간단히 가능해서 더 좋았구요.
다음에 간다면 다른 방에 묵어보고싶어요

Rachel has given us, a family of five with an tiny little newborn baby, the warmest welcome possible. Even before we arrived in her apartment, she helped us out with bed an bath for the little one.
Once arrived, she pointed out dozens of great restaurants, venues and playgrounds.

The apartment is very spacious, cozy and has a lovely quirky bohemian feel about it. The Japanese soaking tub is amazing!Great area to start visit of Edinburgh, too.

The apartment is in a great location in the city. Its easy to walk around or take public transport. There is a grocery store not far if you don't want to eat out which is perfect. There is also some great cafes near by. We would stay in the apartment again if we are in the area.
Wohnung ist sehr zu empfehlen.
No comment
Lovely area and cute little appratment

Claire est une super hôte ! Elle nous a très bien reçu et nous avions même des petits produits locaux comme cadeaux. Claire est très disponible et sera la première à vous conseiller les meilleurs endroits de la ville !
La chambre est grande un peu bruyante sur la grande route mais très agréable :)
Sonia siempre atenta, buena ubicación, el tranvía solo a 3 minutos caminando para llevarte al centro y fácil también para ir al aeropuerto

After staying places with no real host, it was so nice to be welcomed into Irene's home. And to be asked how was your day. And to be given good local advice.
The bedroom, bath and kitchen were squeaky clean. The location was ideal for exploring the heart of Edinburgh. Thanks!

What a fantastic location! So glad we found this place. Easy to get anywhere around Old town Edinburgh from here. Tom and Gill were great to communicate with, and very responsive. Directions to get here were very clear. Would definitely recommend this place for anyone travelling to Edinburgh!
Lovely place to stay in a great location!

I couldn’t recommend staying with Pauline and the Bide Collective enough.
The space itself was impeccably clean and is upkept by cleaners and Pauline daily. Every comfort has been considered as well. There is tea, coffee, milk (regular and alt), biscuits, extra soft blankets, pillows, a chaise outside the bedroom, multi-plug, and full length mirrors throughout the house. The beds are comfortable and I appreciated the clothes hangers in our room.
The ceilings are low and it is an old building so sound travels, but like most travelers we carry ear plugs and eye masks so it made no difference to us. With the location being so centrally located it was worth it.
Pauline was also extremely responsive and helped us adjust our plans after some unexpected travel changes. We felt supported by her and would jump at the opportunity to stay again. Thank you!
Really enjoyed in Katie’s place, very comfortable in a quiet but great location.
Lovely apartment with a gorgeous king sized bed and very central in the city with everything being a 15 min walk away

Katy was a very gracious host, she met us at the door and gave us a tour, things to note, local recommendations, and a complimentary loaf of bread from a local baker which was delicious - and a nice touch. She was very quick with responses if we ever needed anything, and he recommendations were great too - we ended up going the the Regent which was a nice way to start night 1 in Edinburgh. The place was exactly like the photos, a good size for two, and had beautiful afternoon light in the kitchen. The space is eclectic and very tastefully decorated and it was lovely staying somewhere that felt lived in and like a home rather than a hotel room. There were quite a few stairs to get to the place if you have big bags, but if you’re looking for a place to stay in a beautiful city with lots of history - this is perfect. Thanks again for a great stay Katy, we would stay again in a heartbeat :)
We had a wonderful time during our stay, the place was clean, location was convenient and it met all our needs. Donald was great and we had such an amazing weekend visit. Thanks so much !!

The location is perfect which is obviously why they can get away with charging so much but all of the furniature was shabby, there was mould on the windows and as an asthmatic this was creating breathing problems and I left before the end of our stay to sleep at my mums in Glasgow instead. The shower did not work properly (scalding hot/freezing cold with no in between) and the carpets were all torn and stained. Also if you are staying with more than 3 people there is only a 3 seater couch in the living room which I dont think is adequate.
A lovely, sparkling clean, and well-appointed apartment in a good location. We will stay here again when we make another visit to Edinburgh - and also recommend to friends.
Comfy & cozy apartment with everything you need. The place was spotless, the hosts are helpful and thoughtful, location is great - quiet place not far from city center. Would definitely recommend!
Large home. Very comfortable. Liked the separation of bedrooms and bath. Beautiful place to stay. You won’t be disappointed
Great place in walking distance to the city centre. Quiet area and the apartment was as described, with easy instructions for getting there and checking in.
Lovely host, extremely kind and generous, would definitely recommend!

Fantastic New Town location.
Very well equipped, very clean, lots of space, extremely comfortable and stylish. Great communication with Marion too! I highly recommend this lovely flat.
Tolle Lage in Edinburgh

Clarance is a very responsive, flexible and understanding (worked well with initial poor comms from my side) host, who is also extremely welcoming.
The location is walkable to the Holyrood/Arthurs Seat area (15/20 minutes). The city is a little further, but it’s well connected to transport links.
The property is located in a nice quiet spot too.

Great location and comfortable accommodations! We had a little trouble finding the apartment but had no trouble getting in contact with someone to guide us. We also picked this room because it listed washer and dryer and planned to do laundry since this was a halfway point for a two week trip. The washer and dryer were very different from the US and could not get as much done as we hoped. Overallwe had a great experience and would stay again!
Great stay!
the appartement was really Nice and the location perfect. allastair who receive us was really helpfull. we will stay again if we go back !

Elzbieta and her family were very welcoming and friendly.  The apartment is located on a busy high street but there is parking available in nearby side streets.  The location is convenient for the airport, city and surrounding areas with several bus routes very nearby.
A really nice and pretty place to rest for short trips! Charlotte is always very friendly and helpful. We had a great stay here.

She was amazing!!! Beautiful place with great restaurants near. Her and her son were very welcoming and were happy to have a lovely chat and recommend restaurants and activities. We had our dog staying with us and we came back to see that they had given her a treat which was really kind of them. She is definitely a super host and we hope to stay there again. Would recommend to everyone!!! :)

Great experience.   Flat is very clean and has all the amenities you'll need.  Wi-fi, hair dryers, iron.    Located on Royal Mile and walking distance to the train station.    Nice to have host there when we arrived for the many questions we had.   Would definitely stay here again and can't wait to go back!

Really lovely little flat, decorated really nicely. Easy instructions for check in. Very good location for access to Edinburgh but as it is on a major road, it can be quite loud at night - but this is to be expected in a major city!
Lovely stay with lovely folks! I would recommend this stay to anyone, Tsarlin and Lucas were so kind and welcoming and hospitable. We had plenty of privacy and there were lovely thoughtful details.
Zustand von Haus und Wohnung ortsüblich angemessen. Hervorragende Lage! Vermieter ist top und war sehr entgegenkommend.
Good for our overnight stay before flying from airport early. Marcus was very helpful

We had a wonderful stay at Luke’s place! The accommodation was cozy, clean, and we felt very comfortable from the very beginning. Luke was a great host – always available and very helpful at any time. Thank you for the warm hospitality, we’d love to come back! 🌟
Katie had been very accommodating and kind. Her place is convenient for going around the city and visiting the landmarks. Will definitely stay again!

Lovely, spacious, cute and cozy apartment with extremely kind owners. Well furnished and well equipped, we felt right at home. Close to the Meadows and walkable to everything yet in a tranquil neighborhood.

We had a fantastic weekend!
The property was in a great location to access Edinburgh city centre, we wanted somewhere that we could easily walk with dogs which took us about 20 minutes.
We could not of asked for more with the property, very spacious and comfortable. Everything was provided, towels and clean bedding and the kitchen was very well equipped.
Access was super easy, all information for codes and keys was clearly provided and plenty of parking.
We would definitely recommend this property and also use ourselves again if we are going to Edinburgh.
Thank you very much for making our weekend a great one!

Sol, le frère de Scherie a été très réactif et disponible, il s'est totalement adapté à notre arrivée alors que nous avions des aléas de voyage. L'appartement est extrêmement propre et aménagé avec style. La chambre est confortable, c'est un petit cocon de douceur et de chaleur qui contraste avec l'hiver écossais! La salle de bain était également impeccable, moderne et bien aménagée.
Par rapport à l'emplacement, il faut prévoir de marcher au moins une vingtaine de minutes pour se rendre au centre-ville, sinon les bus sont très fréquents en journée, moins en soirée.
Néanmoins, nous recommandons absolument le logement!

Heel fijn verblijf gehad. Gezellig, schoon en gunstig gelegen plek. Gilly was heel vriendelijk en we voelden ons zeer welkom.
Kortom, een aanrader!

We enjoyed a lovely stay at this stylishly decorated flat. The Christmas tree and decorations were a lovely touch which my kids particularly enjoyed. Great location for shops (co-op)  cafes (Costa and Cafe Vigo plus plenty others) and the pub over the road. Bus stop right outside to get easy access into the city. St. Margaret’s park, the Corstorphine Inn and the Dover cafe 3 mins walk away. The lockbox was a little stiff but Lauren was easy to communicate with and we gained entry to it moments after speaking to her. We would definitely stay again.
Peter's flat is clean, spacious and in an ideal location. The beds are comfortable and the kitchen is well equipped. It was ideal for us as a family and it suited our needs perfectly.

Staying at Francesca’s was perfect for our weekend away to Edinburgh to see the Christmas markets. Francesca’s communication was absolutely fantastic. We had a late evening flight and she kindly set the heating so that the apartment was lovely and warm when we arrived.  The space was very clean and the beds are really comfy. Ubers too and from town were no more than around £15 which was ideal.
Sam is a great host, he goes above and beyond to ensure your stay is comfortable. The room is situated in a great area within walking distance to key attractions.

Excellent location, though the windows are not sound insulating so not optimal for light sleepers. The space is rather tight, but it is comfortable and nicely furnished. Good value considering the location. Note that the WiFi is absolutely abysmal, so make sure to have a good roaming plan. Duncan was a very accommodating and responsive host and we had no issues during our stay.

I absolutely loved my stay here! The host was so kind and helpful, which made everything so much easier. The location couldn’t have been better—everything was within walking distance, which was super convenient.
The room and bathroom were really clean and comfortable. For the price, it was totally worth it.
Honestly, I was so happy with everything and would 100% recommend this place to anyone visiting. Thank you for making my trip even better!
Great stay, perfect location and a very comfortable place to stay.
The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. & the amenities are complete and great. Feels homey
Ambienti pulitissimi, ottima posizione, host gentili, simpatici e discreti.

We arrived and there was no key in the lockbox. We called and messaged the host. There was no answer to the call but eventually the host messaged us that they canceled the reservation (I had booked it weeks in advance, received the entry instructions the night before, and even provided the host with my personal ph# and email in case they needed to let me know anything important like a CANCELATION; Airbnb did not have the reservation canceled in their records). The host said I needed to contact Airbnb to resolve the issue. I am standing on the street in the rain on a foreign phone without wifi or data, but the host tells me I have to take care of this issue on my own. Airbnb says they will refund and give me a coupon for 20% of the booking cost to book in the future. Pathetic. I had to book two hotel rooms last-minute at a much higher price, much further from the part of the city we wished to visit, and our first day in Edinburgh was ruined by the host’s lack of communication.

Nice, clean apartment with free street parking.  Conveniently located to tram stop to get into the city and a grocery store. There was a baby cot and high chair for use, which was nice to have. We enjoyed our time in Edinburgh.
Great place with a lot of space that is immaculately clean. Very walk to Royal Mile, tams to Leith and to the airport. Great choice.

We were in apartment 4 for our 3 night stay in Edinburgh. There were 10 of us, 5 adults and 5 adult children.
The check in procedure was easy and we even got a call an hour before check in time to let us know that the apartment was ready. The option to store our luggage before check in and after check out was so helpful.
The apartment was fantastic. The photographs do not do it justice. It was extremely spacious and being on the 3rd floor, the views were stunning. It was a bit of hike to the top floor the first time we climbed the stairs, (definitely not suitable for anyone with mobility issues!), but we soon got used to it.
The kitchen was well equipped and the dishwasher was very useful, especially with 10 of us.
The beds were THE most comfortable beds that I have experienced in any airbnb or hotel I have stayed at.
My husband and I and our 2 daughters had the 2 rooms on the upper floor, sharing a bathroom. The toilet seat was broken. I contacted Destination Edinburgh and it was fixed the same day. The only negative was the showers. We all experienced difficulty in regulating the temperature and it would go from freezing cold to scorching hot. But again the staff were extremely prompt in dealing with the query.
The apartment was very centrally located, just a short walk from Waverley station and close to the shops, restaurants, bars and amenities. Yet despite it's central location, it was very quiet.
The communication with Suzanne was great at the time of booking and she was extremely prompt at responding to any queries along the way.
I would definitely recommend this apartment and having also had a sneak peak at the ground floor apartment that sleeps 6, I have already decided that I will be staying here again for my next trip to Edinburgh.

Bell’appartamento, pulito e spazioso,
Vicky gentilissima, lo consiglio al 100 %

A wonderful place to stay, clean and equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay, in a great location to explore the city of Edinburgh. There is free car parking at the premises and the city is 20min walk through the beautiful Meadows. Pauline and Mike were very friendly and welcoming. Highly recommended.

Such a gem of a place in the middle of the city, with a beautiful shared garden in front of the flat. It’s large and spacious which easily accommodated my party of 10 people. It’s also conveniently located and within walking distance to most city centre attractions. The place was a bit tricky to find but John was great in sending detailed check in information prior to us arriving. Overall a wonderful experience which greatly complimented our stay in Edinburgh!
We loved staying here — about a 15 min walk to central Edinburgh. We frequented pubs and restaurants nearby. It was quiet and safe. We loved all the space too. Thank you for having us!

Very convenient for town. Comfortable bed and apartment had all we needed.

Sinon l’espace commun restait toujours très propre. Et la communication avec Duc était très agréable, efficace et rapide !
Merci beaucoup on a passer un très bon moment à bientôt j’espère !
I had a wonderful evening at the flat. The atmosphere was charming and comfortable. I can't wait to return for another memorable stay. Thank you!
We loved staying at Piers place, it is in such a central location,check in was easy, the place felt comfortable and cosy. We had a lovely stay at piers place and would definitely recommend!

Brilliant stay! Lovely flat with a perfect location on the Royal Mile. A short walk to Edinburgh Castle, Mary King’s Close and 10 mins from the Christmas Market. The noisy upstairs neighbour didn’t disrupt the stay much at all. David was incredibly helpful, allowing an early check in as our flight arrived very early in the morning - a life saver. Highly recommend!
Perfect location, with bus lines within 3 minutes walk. Super nice host. Highly recommended.
Exactly as described, amazing location, no issues whatsoever
Comfortable and stylish flat, the location is perfect with a great pub on the same street. Perfect to get to from the airport.

Great place to stay in the center of Edinburgh – this is just a several minute walk to all the main city attractions and interesting locations. The house itself was amazing to host our 6-people-and-1-dog group. Each floor has a bathroom(s) which is a major win when you travel as a group and want to optimize for time, especially in the morning. The living rooms was cozy with a comfortable sofa and a spacious table. Would definitely stay here again if I travel to Edinburgh in the future.

We had a lovely stay at this Airbnb in Edinburgh. The location is very strategic—close to many attractions and easy to get around. The house itself is spacious and perfect for spending quality time with family. All the facilities were excellent and everything was clean and well-maintained.
The only downside was the host’s very slow response time, which was quite frustrating at times. Communication could definitely be improved. Other than that, it was a great stay overall.

We had a great time and really enjoyed the great location close to the river. A lot of restaurants, pubs and bars nearby. Anita was friendly and helpful and made sure our arrival was nice! The bathroom is a bit tricky, the sink is tiny and the water almost does not drain at all. Shower also drains slowly and one time the water stopped completlly. Thankfully Anita responded quickly and helped us to fix it within minutes.
Overall, the apartment is nice and the surrounding area great, would stay there again!
It was a calm and lovely stay! Would book again.
Well equipped, clean and a lovely host. We would definitely recommend this stay!

We had a really excellent time staying with Alejandro and Harriet! The room was wonderful and it was great to have our own bathroom. They were incredibly friendly and accommodating hosts. I felt like I was staying with friends. It was great to be able to sit and chat with Harriet and the other couple that was staying there when we wanted to and yet feel like we could have our privacy and own space when we wanted it. We travelled in the UK for 3.5 weeks and this was one of the best stays we had. Thank you so much, guys!

Geweldige lokatie in het centrum,
Het appartement is op de bovenste verdieping dus wel 3 trappen op.
Woonkamer wel wat krap voor 6 personen maar dat lag meer aan verkeerd meubilair.
(bv een groot bureau wat niet gebruikt wordt )
Keuken is klein maar goed ingericht.
Badkamer is wat klein maar oké alleen jammer dat de douchestang kapot was.
Slaapkamers goed ingericht met ruimte voor je spullen.
In 1 slaapkamer was het bed wel erg laag bijna op de grond. De matrassen zijn voor sommige misschien iets te zacht.

I stayed with Carol for 9 nights between leases. Carol and her Family were very welcoming and great hosts.  The room is nice and roomy with a very comfortable bed. Great location - the bus stop to the city is right across the road and there are many buses you can get. Buses going in the other direction (airport and other locations west of the city) right on the door step. Massive tesco close by was super handy. Bathroom and kitchen amenities were perfect. This room is excellent value also! Enjoyed my stay here and would definitely recommend to anyone. Thanks for having me Carol :)
Great hostel! Very busy and vibrant
Stunning decor, absolutely pristine with everything you could possibly need. Blown away by this gem of a place.

Fernando and Jolanta where lovely hosts, super responsive and very understanding of my traveling chaos :-) returning from the Isle of Skye. I had a lovely, quiet, clean room only a 15 minute walk from Edinburgh Park Station, which is very convenient for both the city and the airport. It's a shared accommodation, and my flatmates where really kind and shared coffee and milk the first morning because I arrived late and had no chance to buy groceries. Hosts also let me store my heavy luggage until it was time to go to the airport. Fab hosts, warmly recommended!

The location was excellent, very central and easy to reach all the major city centre attractions. The room is basic but clean and has everything you need for a short stay. We were particularly impressed with how comfortable the bed was considering it's a sofabed. This place is excellent value for money.
The only small issue we had was getting in - none of the numbers of the booking confirmation worked and when I found a business card with a number that did work, we had to walk to a different location to get the codes to get in. It might make sense to give the codes in the booking confirmation email instead in future.
Other than that small hiccup at the beginning, we had an excellent stay, thank you.

The apartment was very nice, I really liked the design. The bed and the sofa were very comfy, the kitchen had everything you may need, even the soy sauce!
The location if a bit of a walk from the main attractions, but not very far away, and there are large grocery stores nearby.
The host was very friendly, responsive and helpful, overall it it a great place to stay, highly recommend!

El apartamento calidad precio muy bien, buena zona, a 20 minutos a pie de la Royal Mile, pero tuvimos un problema con la calefacción y no se preocuparon , es más lo tuvimos que solucionar nosotros al día siguiente cuando nos dimos cuenta que eran las pilas, que por cierto las compramos nosotros.Esperaba que después de haber comunicado por la noche al llegar que no estaba encendida y no funcionaba,y que tuvimos que dormir con los chaquetones y calentar la habitación con el secador, hubieran venido a solucionarlo al día siguiente , pero no, al llegar al apartamento la segunda noche seguía igual y eso que avisé que para nosotros era muy importante la calefacción....Una pena que por esto, nos vayamos con mal sabor de boca con el alojamiento, entiendo que se puedan acabar las pilas pero si digo que hay un problema no creo que sea yo la que lo tenga que solucionar
Great location and walkable

I had a very pleasant stay at Ryan’s place, which is ideally located close to Haymarket Station with bus and tram connections. The place is small and snug but really cozy and comfortable, making it ideal for my purpose of a short and easy overnight stay. I did not make use of the kitchen but it looked very nice. Thank you Ryan for the clear instructions and friendly communication!
Highly recommend.  Lovely apartment.  Lovely people

The place was bright and spacious! It’s on a main bus line to get you up the hill to the heart of Edinburgh but also walking distance to the community of Stockbridge. Lawrie was quick to respond and supportive when we had a question about the flat. Definitely recommend staying here!
Great location for exploring Edinburgh, lovely apartment, very well equipped, with a helpful and gracious host - we hope to come again!

Everything was perfect . The place was very nice and clean in a peaceful and safe neighborhood. Public transport was just a short walk away, which made explore the city very easy . Final was also super kind and flexible.  I really enjoyed my stay here. I would love to come back!!!

Jane's flat is beautiful, comfortable and spotlessly clean. Jane is a really friendly host, easy to be around which makes for a very relaxed stay. Very comfortable double bed, fabulous shower and a really good location, quiet but very close to the heart of Leith and with easy access to Edinburgh centre.
Highly recommended!

Lindsey's place was perfect for my stay whilst working in Edinburgh. The space was clean and cosy, I felt really comfortable here! Like lots of places in Edinburgh, there are quite a few stairs so just be aware of that if you have a big case :) The place is central - just 5 minutes walk from the station and close to all of the restaurants and shops. Lindsey was really quick to respond to my messages and check in was really easy too. Would recommend to others.

Jeremy’s flat was very clean, quiet and comfortable. He was there to greet us and orient us to the accommodation. Local transit just outside the door made visiting the city centre easy and economical. Jeremy was easy to contact for local recommendations. Perfect for the beginning of our first visit to Scotland. Definitely recommend for a stay in Edinburgh!
A great quiet spot for our group in Edinburgh, we walked to the castle and parks. We especially appreciated Craig’s flexibility to check in early.

Our stay at Graeme's was phenomenal. The bus into town stops right outside the door, and three lines go directly to the city center, which is simply fantastic. The room was very clean and comfortable. The bed was excellent. Graeme himself is an exceptionally kind host. He gave us great recommendations, which we took advantage of. We were completely happy. Thanks again for everything.

Itziar's place was perfect for our Edinburgh adventure.  We have stayed in Leith before and like the neighborhood. it's close to transit and has all the amenities you need for a stay.  Everything we need was in the apartment which was great.  It was very comfortable for the two of us.

My partner and i stayed in a studio at Eden Locke for 2 nights as we were visiting Edinburgh over the Christmas period. The hotel is located in a perfect position, so easy to get to the main attractions and links to and from the airport. Simon hosted us and they were very friendly and reassured us we could have more of anything we needed in the room etc.
Thankyou for a lovely stay!
Bed was a bit soft but other than that it was lovely
Perfect place for a family holidays!
A great location in the heart of old town. Fantastic places to eat and drink on the doorstep. The flat was very comfortable and well equipped

We had a lovely stay at Shirley’s Place in Edinburgh. The room was cozy and well-maintained. We experienced an issue with the Wi-Fi late at night, but Shirley was incredibly responsive and came right up to fix it. Overall, an excellent experience with a fantastic host!
Really thanks for the homeowner. It is a very nice and clean place. Near the bus stop. All the same from the picture. This bnb give us a good trip in Edinburgh.

Good location but had some issues with the heating. The apartment seems of an older style in person than on the pictures but the kitchen and bathroom were great. Fab location and responsive host. He was very helpful!  Apartment was nice and as described. FYI- no top sheet was provided. This is pretty common in Europe, but as an American it feels a bit strange to get into bed just under a duvet.

Comfortable

We really enjoyed our stay here. The apartment is stunning, spacious and beautifully decorated; it has everything you need. The location is fantastic with a great view of the castle. Great location! Great parking

Prayas is a superb host. His house is not even a minutes walk to Royal Mile. Reaching there is very easy and convenient. His apartment gives you a feel of Scotish culture because of the decorations and interior done by him.
I would love to stay at his apartment again and would higly recommend it to all known people who are visiting to Edinburgh.

The flat is wonderful! Just as described and the location is amazing! It's steps away from great shopping and dining, and the castle is literally a couple minutes' walk away. Communication with Katie started early and she's incredibly responsive. I'd recommend this location 100%!

Terrific flat in perfect location to explore the city.  Very clean, with all modern appliances, and comfortable beds.  Interactions with host were cheery and pleasant.  I would stay here again without hesitation, and would recommend it to anyone who wants to stay closer to all the attractions.
Loving host , walking distance to the town
A good base to explore Edinburgh

Lovely modern room in ancient building in Edinburgh Old Town - well equipped spacious and quiet room
