Patrick provided clear directions to the apartment and was a great balance if informative and sociable and not intrusive
Recommend his place and will go back

Great place! Very cozy! Love the location as it is very close to a bus stop that you can take right to the city. The apartment is clean and tidy. Ted is very kind and answered all of our questions! I would stay here again!
Great location, everything within walking distance!

Fiona and her Husband were very kind, we arrived at 11pm and they receveid us with a smile in their faces and willing to help us with everything we needed

The house is really confortable and i would recommend it 100% to anyone who is interested to rent her place! 5 stars

We hadden een heerlijk verblijf in dit gezellige appartement. Het was schoon en alles wat we nodig hadden was aanwezig. Joan had zelfs als welkom wat lekkere dingen voor ons neergelegd. Ligging prima, vlak bij een park maar ook in de stad. Aanrader!

Kate’s place was really fantastic! We had such a lovely stay! The house was really nice. The rooms were perfect for the 7 of us and the kitchen was incredible! We loved every single space of the house! (Especially the lounge) 💗
Kate’s caretaker Marnie was very nice and helpful. They were both responsive with our queries even if we were already there.
Would definitely recommend Kate’s place to all our friends and family who are planning to visit Edinburgh! The location is great since it’s easy to ride the bus from there.
Five stars from all of us! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

It was a wonderful flat with quick easy access to downtown. The room has a very comfortable bed with great linens and feather bed. The sun facing room looks over a beautiful court yard. Bathroom is very clean with a heated floor and towel rack. There is a definite climb of stairs to the flat but anyone in good health can manage and building has a secure entry. Mark met us and went over the city and where to visit. Lots of coffee shops and dining just outside the building. Safe neighborhood if you are planning late night adventures. Thank you Mark for opening your home to us. I would definitely stay with you again.

Loved Edinburgh and would diffenttly recommend this place to stay in Edinburgh nice quiet location and not far from the city the place was clean and really great for our needs would diffenttly stay here again if stayed in Edinburgh again
Great quiet location with an incredible view of the city. The hosts were easy to communicate with and were so flexible and understanding when arrival times were delayed. We had such a lovely stay.

Super logement ,

Claire and Robs apartment was perfect for our stay in Edinburgh, it was fully equipped and was very comfortable. Ideally located and nice and quiet.
Very enjoyable stay at Maia’s lovely apartment. Fantastic location. Maia was welcoming, helpful, and made us feel very comfortable during our stay.
Rudran的房子无可挑剔，房东提供的帮助非常及时详尽，还给了我非常有用的HP walk攻略。非常推荐！

chris was a brilliant host, very helpful with booking us a taxi etc, his home is very nice and absolutely spotless. we booked this home due to having an early morning flight, taxi company he uses was bang on time and only £15 so perfect location for airport
Chris met us at the apartment and was very helpful with details of the place and things to do and see around Edinburgh.

This is one of those ‘Little gems’ that you don’t want to tell the world about because you want it to always be available to book! It is such a perfect place, warm, cosy, spotlessly clean, comfortable beds, great shower, the location is fantastic And Aida could not have been more welcoming or helpful with the check in and check out . We travel a lot and stay in many places and this has to be one of our favourite so far, we definitely will be back to stay again in the near future. Thank you for such a perfect stay.

Sarah was a wonderful host! She made us feel at home in Edinburgh, was very helpful and proactive. The room and bathroom were very neat and clean (with fresh towels after a swim), like a hotel but with the warmth of a attentive and welcoming host. It was the perfect accommodation during the Fringe festival.

Great location, great apartment, very clean. Loved our stay. A little inconvenient having to pick up and drop the key off at the train station with luggage. The washer/dryer did not work so well. Clothes did not dry. Would stay at this location again despite the minor hiccups.

Apartment was great and in an ideal location for exploring, 10 min walk into the centre.
Rebecca was a great host, providing clear instructions and checking via message regularly

Roberta was a wonderful host, very supportive and thoughtful.
The apartment is sparkling clean and cozy ;-)
A total recommendation!
Quarto muito bom, bem localizado. Luciana super atenciosa, nos deixou super a vontade.

Beautiful apartment close to downtown! So comfortable and lovely interior. Robin and Ella were able to let us check in early, which was amazing. They were very responsive.

Excellent property. Very central but still feels hidden away as basement flat.

Would book again

Il soggiorno da Gillian è stato super…proprio come ce lo aspettavamo!! Comodo (ca 20/25 min) al centro della città, ma vicino al mare e molto tranquillo. Pleasant stay!
Cute, quirky apartment in the perfect location for a short stay in Edinburgh!

I stayed here with my partner and parents over the Edinburgh Marathon weekend - it’s well located on Leith Walk, with lots of good restaurants and bars within walkable distance. It’s just a short tram ride or ~30 mins walk into central Edinburgh, so this was a perfect location for us!
Lien was a great host, and gave us all the information we needed. The flat itself was great - we had everything we needed and it was a nice space to spend our long weekend!
Appartement très chaleureux et très bien situé pour découvrir la ville. Calme, il est à 5 minutes à pieds des rues animées de New Town.  Hanne nous a aidé à trouver une place de parking non  payante.
Great place to stay, easy to check in and nice location!

We had such a lovely stay here in Edinburgh. We were only stopping over for a night on our way to the highlands but we felt so at home and welcomed, we were sad we couldn't stay longer! Really handy location for getting into the centre but staying away from the business and the space was so clean and comfortable.

Jean-Marthieu est un hôte agréable. Il est proactif et nous a permis de déposer nos valises avant l’heure d’entrée officielle. Cela nous a facilité la vie. Apparemment conforme à l’annonce. Bien placé.

Stopped here for one night, as travelling by bike doing the John Muir trail - it is up a hill out of the main town. Anne was very friendly and welcomed us into her home and helped by storing the bikes inside. Bed was lovely and comfortable and breakfast fine for seeing us on our way.

What a lovely home and family!! So very kind and helpful. A true home away from home. Highly recommend!!! The only negative is it's distance from the city centre, but there are many & frequent buses that service the neighbourhood, and the journey is not arduous. Thank you Jen & Josè.

This place was perfect for our stay. If you like walking you can go to the city centre in about 30min walk, and if you don't like it, you have plenty of buses in front of the place. Everything was clean and Grace was very helpful with everything. I recommend this place!

We were delighted with Anna's place - the location is superb - very walkable to everywhere.  The view of the castle from the courtyard is excellent.  We do recommend taking the HOHO to acquaint yourself with Edinburgh.  It is easy to catch it at Grassmarket Square.  Thank you Anna!
Magnifico 10/10

This is a great place to stay in Edinburgh - plenty of room for two couples & the complimentary G&T was much appreciated! We loved Ro’s recommendation for Fieldwork (great coffee just around the corner) & El Cartel (Mexican).

Très bel appartement.

Great location on estate with express bus  during rush hour to city in 20 minutes. Rural views over open farmland. Comfortable accommodation, especially the bed. Plenty of space in kitchen and dining area.

Excellent location!! We walked pretty much everywhere- perfect spot for my husband, our 7 year old, and me.

I highly recommend that you book this place if it's available during your stay in Edinburgh. We've already started planning our next trip over and this is where we will be staying again. Thanks again Morag and David for helping make our trip abroad memorable.
Great location, friendly hosts and brilliant flat for a weekend in Edinburgh.
Great place! Lots of room! Not too far out of central Edinburgh. Quite a lot of stairs to get up as it’s on the top floor.

Great location, 20 minutes walk to the city centre, restaurants, supermarkets and bars around the flat. Quiet and peaceful area.

A great find right by Holyrood parks, cleanliness, comms, check in were all superb.
Lovely flat, everything we needed in a close walking distance. Rosie kept me upto date the whole way through,. Great host.

Great apartment!

Wonderful stay! Nice apartment in a great location.
Fantastic Location and great place. Would stay here again.

Nice little basement flat central to Edinburgh.

Departamento muy cómodo, limpio y muy bien ubicado, se puede descansar perfectamente libre del ruido de la calle. Ideal para recorrer la ciudad a pie. Todos los lugares importantes a pocos minutos a pie. recomendable 100%.
Great location walking distance to Old Town. Great local eateries and pubs. Safe and cosy.

Stewart flat is very clean and beautiful, it is close to downtown and it has really beautiful view around the flat. The host is a really nice lady, I hope I will have chance to live here longer next time.

A brilliant place to stay as a small family. It’s not slap bang in Edinburgh but all the better for it: blissfully quiet (you really cannot hear the airport), a genuinely beautiful garden to relax in, but just 5 minutes drive from the free park and ride, which is 20 minutes into central Edinburgh.

We were super happy with our stay at Dolly and Andy’s place! The apartment was exactly as described – clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Good Place to stay centrally

The best host ever! It was a pleasure to get to know Roberto and stay in his lovely apartment. Everything was like described, and the care for details by Roberto is astonishing. Ideal location and pleasant flat, we have had a perfect stay in Edinburgh!

Beautiful apartment.  Great location. Extra touches made us feel very welcome. Would highly recommend.

Ideal space and location.
Great apartment, perfect location.

This unit was in an excellent location! Very close to lots of bars, restaurants, and the royal mile. Room was clean and well maintained. Great location in Edinburgh

Great location in Edinburgh, great for getting around. Can be some street noise, welcome to the big city.

Small but perfectly formed.  Perfect little place to stay for a few nights in Edinburgh.  Easy check in - lots of information about the local area, and not far from all the places you may wish to visit.
Brillaint apartment and only a short walk into centre of town,  I would highly recommend this place to anyone.  Gordan kept in good communication with me throughout.
merci beaucoup à Raymond qui est très aimable et très serviable.  nous le recommandons !!!

We had a great time at Skye’s place! The location was very convenient and the accommodation is super charming. Skye was also very friendly, helpful and responsive! Absolutely wonderful Flat and location! We stayed in Edinburgh for a couple of days for my girlfriends birthday and she loved and appreciated the history behind the building as well as the decor. Would 100% stay again
The apartment has been perfect
Nice apartment in a really good location.

It was perfect. Well recommended.
Lovely place to stay. Perfect location. Good communication.

Very clean, and in a wonderful area. Easily within walking distance of the city centre if you’d rather avoid public transport. I’d say the place is even nicer in person than compared to photos - I would recommend. Great value.
Excellent value,  very central,  very clean,  charming flat with character.  Great host.
Perfect place for a stay in Edinburgh. Great location. Lovely apartment.

I absolutely my 2-day stay here. Ella and Ollie were amazing hosts who constantly messaged to make sure I was doing well and everything was to my liking. Sandy's place is just perfect for people who love to discover the city center by walk. It's close to historic center and other interesting spots in Edinburgh. On top of that, it's very cozy with really nice host ready to give any tips.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Angus et Sabia sur Édimbourg. L’appartement était idéalement situé a proximité des points d’intérêts de la ville et non loin du tramway permettant rapidement de déposer nos bagages.

Malgré le fait que nous n’ayons jamais rencontré nos hôtes, l’agence de gestion était très cordiale et rapide pour nous répondre. Attention, un dépôt de garantie de 250£ est demandé après validation de la chambre, il serai je pense judicieux de le préciser dans l’annonce.

Carol was a lovely, friendly welcoming host! The bed was super comfy and warm, and the bathroom was very clean and I even had fresh brand new towels. Steps away from everything in Old Town. Great location and lovely apartment. The building dates from 1820. Absolutely fabulous!

Nous avons passé une très bonne semaine chez Liz & Hector, le logement était parfait, suffisamment grand pour nous 4 et très bien situé. Edimbourg est une ville magnifique et les Ecossais sont vraiment des gens très accueillants. Super séjour !!!
Perfect location. Walkable to all attractions. Clean and Well-kept.

lovely place, and great host!

it was really clean and everything was as expected. Zatoon reacted always really fast in case we had some questions.

Coisy and great old fashion place, make specific atmosphere. Everything was good and great location

Cosy, homely place superbly located just off the Meadows with plenty of local, independent shops and Sainsbury’s, Tesco, & Waitrose all in easy walking distance.

Rebecca’s place was perfect for our long weekend in Edinburgh. It was cosy & had everything we needed.

The area is safe & the crescent was peaceful. Would recommend!
I was thrilled with the accommodation, after a long and tiring journey it was such a relief to  find a beautiful place to stay. I will definitely book again.

Erin was a fantastic host, extremely flexible and understanding, for example she allowed us to leave our bags at her place for the day so we could have some extra time site seeing before our flights. Tessa's flat is beautiful with comfortable beds, fluffy white towels and good bed linen, well equipped kitchen and comfortable sitting room. This place was amazing. It was in a great location- right along the Royal Mile. David is very friendly and helpful. Would definitely recommend staying here!
Great Place, just as described  clean. And close to many shops.

Great location within easy walking to all the lovely amenities in Stockbridge. Close to Botanical gardens which are well worth a visit and Inverleith Park. Water of Leith Walkway is very pretty.
A bit of a hike up hill to Prince’s Street but in a good bus route if you don’t want to walk.
Hamish was very responsive and a good host. Flat was clean and as advertised.
Great location. Good instructions. Was great to have a car park and access to a lift as we travelled with someone with mobility issues.

The communication on how to get to the apartment was very good, as well as recommendations on what to do in Edinburgh.

A beautiful space, 5 minutes from the airport. 10 minutes into town by car. You need your own transport if staying here really. Hard to imagine you are so close to Edinburgh city as it feels as though one was in the heart of the country.

We really enjoyed our stay at Dele's apartment. I was incredibly impressed the way Dele was always quick to reply to my emails - sometimes it felt almost immediate.

The apartment itself was great - the location was FANTASTIC! Walking distance to virtually all the key tourist attractions.

Everything was perfect

Elizabeth went up and beyond helping us with our airline booking problems. We feel privileged to have met her!

Really nice homely apartment. Totally met expectations. Very well equipped and spotless. Bobby is a great host, replying very quickly to our messages and giving clear directions and instructions for checking in. This is very well located - only a 15 minute bus journey to the city centre.

Beautiful home and very responsive and friendly host.  The location near the train station was perfect for getting around.  We really enjoyed our stay.

The location was outstanding, only a minute from the Royal Mile.

a very aesthetic and comfortable stay! I  loved the place, and the location so much! The flat was spotless! I would definitely love to stay there, if I have the chance to visit beautiful edinburgh again!

Great stay at Rita and Owen’s little house. The neighborhood is quiet, with good bus and tram connections, and both large and small supermarkets are within walking distance. The house itself is modern, cozy, and well equipped. Communication was quick and friendly throughout.
Beautiful cottage, great location for Edinburgh and surrounding areas. Highly recommend staying here!

Lindsay and Roberto met us on arrival and made feel immediately welcome. It was great to meet hosts who were so friendly and were really interested in ensuring we had a wonderful time. This house was awesome and I really enjoyed my staying in Mark's flat. The location is great and close to Calton Hill and Princes street. The flat is very stylish and neat. I wished I could've stayed more!

Excellent flat within walking distance to all the great spots in Edinburgh.

If you are looking for a fancy place maybe this is not for you, but for someone looking for a very comfortable, well located and well equipped place, I will fully recommend.

Todo perfecto!!
Una estancia y atención geniales!!

The apartment was just as described and the pictures were very accurate.  The bed was very comfortable.  The location was perfect for us.  We could walk to Old Town in about 20-25 mins and to Stockbridge in about 15 mins.  Although there are numerous restaurants and coffee shops around the apt, we went to several great restaurants on Broughton St (only 5 mins away).  There are several bus stops/bus lines around the apt, so we could take the extensive bus system when we didn't feel like walking.  The Cumberland Bar is only a few steps away and is really just a traditional local pub.  It was great relaxing with a drink and some pub food in the evening while being surrounded by all the locals.  There were 4-5 markets within 5-10 minutes walk, and since the kitchen is fully equipped, we were able to make our breakfasts and many dinners throughout our stay.

I recommend it for sure and I would stay there again. It is not very close to the city centre, but is a good price/value for travelling some days.
pros:

cos:

I’d love to stay here again the next time I visit.

Walkable to city center, convenient nearby shopping and food, very responsive host. The apartment wasn’t as clean as we’re used to with other rentals, the towels were thin and crunchy, and overall the price was probably more than it should have been. This felt more like a motel stay than a hotel stay.

Beautiful apartment, great location, well equipped, clean, if anything, it was a bit noisy because of this central location and single glazing. Also, it took a day or so to get the apartment fully heated.  Still, would stay again.

L'appartamento è veramente molto bello, pulito e ordinato. A pochi minuti dal centro e in una zona tranquilla, ottima per riposarsi e per raggiungere le principali attività. L'Host è stato molto disponibile, ha risposto sempre alle nostre richieste in tempi eccezionali.
Really atmospheric apartment in great location. Stephen met us late in the evening after we were delayed and even met us again a few days later to pick up some things we left behind.

Fantastic apartment! Very cosy, actually had to turn the heating down as it was so warm at night. Good wifi and a good TV. Will definitely stay there again when I'm planning another trip to Edinburgh. Great central location but away from hustle and bustle.
Great location, perfect layout for couples, the kitchen was well stocked with breakfast options. Overall, a great stay in the perfect place for vacation.  Would come back again!

A fantastic find during our stay in Edinburgh. Nice size for 3 adults and a baby, very clean, and comfortable beds. Can't beat the location! Very easy to walk to the sights and tons of great restaurants just on the street. The apartment has everything you need to be comfortable and relax. Duncan and Dee were very response during our stay and have made the place welcoming for guests!

Absolutely lovely stay! Close enough to walk to all the sights (or catch a bus), comfortable home, and thoughtful, helpful communication with the host. The mattress in the main bedroom was very comfortable, plenty of hot water, and we appreciated all the kitchen amenities. We were snowed in one day, and didn’t mind staying in this delightful little home - just played games and watched the snow in the large bright windows.
Thank you, Lucy! It was a really wonderful stay!

公寓的地段不错，去任一爱丁堡市区的主要景点都可步行，附近吃的也不少。
但是公寓位于四楼，没有电梯，行李较多腿脚不方便的人请慎重考虑。
房东很认真地对待我们，从入住前就能感受到他的热情。虽然房屋老旧，但房东还是花了不少心思改造，使得生活在里面比较便利，尤其是厨房不错。客厅布置的很有情调，视野也不错。
总之，两晚在这里我们住的不错，性价比也不错。
Great stay and home was as described.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It is a good place for a vacation in Edinburgh.
I loved staying here over Christmas, it felt like a dream looking out to the castle.

My first trip as a solo traveler and first time in Edinburgh was made all the more special, staying at Yuri and Michael's place. Yuri was super helpful with directions from the airport, I couldn't go wrong. The flat has the most wonderful energy and really reflects Yuri and Michael's personalities - warm and friendly (the chamomile tea  to take to my room was so lovely). It was great to have a catch up with them after a day exploring and they gave me fab suggestions of where to visit, in particular Dean Village and Stockbridge. An absolute must see, as you can walk along the Water of Leith between the two and grab some food/drinks in Stockbridge. The flat is on the third floor (great views over the common and toward Arthur's Seat!) but you have to use the stairs, so not suitable for anyone with mobility issues. The bedroom itself is charming and I was happy just sitting in there relaxing. Very quiet at night and the bed is super comfy, if a little creaky. 100% will return next year x

Ellie and Scott’s apt was incredibly clean and comfortable. The toilet and shower were split into two separate mini bathrooms which was incredibly convenient for my husband and I. Also they provided coffee for us to make ourselves which was nice! Would definitely stay again!
Beautiful home, very spacious! Responsive host and great neighbourhood! Loved our stay

Ci siamo trovate davvero molto bene nell'alloggio di Maureen.
La posizione era buona, la pulizia impeccabile e la stanza molto confortevole, completa di tutto quello che serviva e anche di più! Molto buono anche il rapporto qualità/prezzo. Se dovessimo tornare ad Edimburgo sarebbe un piacere alloggiare nuovamente qui :)
Nous avons passé deux superbes nuits chez Cong Shan et sa femme! Ce sont des hôtes très accueillants et très arrangeants! Et le breakfast proposé était excellent

tan solo la vista era suficiente, pero llegar y ser recibidas con toallas limpias, chocolates, una carta de efi y ver toda la decoración del departamento lo hizo increíblemente hermoso.
vale la pena tan solo por la vista pero tambien recibes la comodidad, es super facil recorrer el lugar ya que la zona esta muy bien ubicada y la vista del castillo desde el cuarto increíble!!
hermoso lugar!! muy recomendado
Very good for the price.
Lovely flat, great location. Lots of info on local bars and restaurants, and handy tips on things to do.
Charlottes place was a very small cute place with a great location. The bath was very slow aswell as the wifi
Clean place and host was most helpful
Excelente alojamiento en Edinburgo, muy cerca de zonas de interés turística y tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia en la ciudad. Ojalá podamos volver!
Posizione abbastanza comoda e alloggio abbastanza accogliente
Lovely place, host was very accommodating and a great location.
Great apartment for a couple. Walking distance to Royal Mile and CBD. Highly recommended.
Really lovely property. Close to all city attractions
Vielen Dank, Michele, für diesen wunderbaren Aufenthalt! Es war ein wunderschönes Zimmer und wir fühlten uns gut aufgehoben!
The flat looked exactly like the beautiful pictures. Colin warmly welcomed us and it was possible to contact him any time. We got more than anyone can expect. I would love to stay there again.

Wir haben drei Tage bei Anna und Radek verbracht und wünschten, wir wären noch länger geblieben. Die Wohnung ist mit liebevollen Details eingerichtet und super gelegen, sodass wir viele Ausflüge zu Fuss unternehmen konnten. Die Natur sowie das städtische Treiben liegen quasi vor der Haustür. Was unseren Aufenthalt perfekt gemacht hat, war Anna und Radeks warmherzige und zuvorkommende Gastfreundschaft. Wir haben uns sofort wie zu Hause gefühlt und die wunderbaren Gespräche mit ihnen in der Küche bis spät nachts sehr genossen. Wir kommen bestimmt wieder!
Cool place.

This place was great! Perfect location for walking everywhere and amazing view of Arthur’s Seat just out the window. Place was clean and tidy and Claire was super responsive and helpful!
Fantastic stay!
房东人特别好，会特意给我们做中国菜，因为我喜欢吃辣的，还特意在煎鱼的时候加了很多辣椒。和房东约好，下次来爱丁堡，还住在这里。

Calm and quiet area, from which you can easily reach the city centre via bus (30 min).
Douglas has been fantastic in explaining us all the details of the room, and super-available in providing us anything we needed.
The bed was very very comfortable, much appeciated especially after long walks around the city :D
Also the snacks and tea saved our mornings!
Great apartment, very clean, great location, would highly recommend!!
The house is clean and got all things needed like kitchen and laundry machine. And the surrounding is quite but within few minutes walk you can reach the castle and prince street.
This place was a great place to stay! Very comfortable with the Mega Couch for an extra bed and was close to a bus stop to for transportation! Highly recommend this place.

Nice  place, excellent location with a tram stop right nearby to get you to/from the airport as well as to/from town in quick time. Down side was a real lack of storage and hanging space for our clothes; we stayed for four days and had no drawers or cupboards to put clothes away, so you are living out of the suitcase. Otherwise a great place.
Very nice place. Feels like a part of history. I bit hard to find but the folks at the ice cream shop pointed us in the right direction and all was well after that. Lovely place
Tom and Steph were lovely and approachable..knowledgeable of public transport and their area they live in .. beautiful home ..
Stephen is a wonderful host and we can only recommend his apartment. Thanks

Lovely apartment in a beautiful part of the city. The only downside for us was all the steps to the Apartment, we stayed with a baby and had to carry her up and down the steps each time we went out!  Ivy was an amazing host!

1 night stay on a really busy August weekend. East to find, flat is actually bigger than it looks on the pics (otherwise exactly as stated).
Quiet location but close enough by uber or bus to all attractions (spent time in Leith and city centre). I would definitely recommend and would have no hesitation in book again in available on our next visit.

the flat is very clean, the place is wonderful and Josh is a Super host!
We repeat for sure!
We had a lovely stay in Marek’s flat. It was cosy and warm and beautiful to come home to after a day of sightseeing.
Excellent location and an place to stay.
一切都很好，公寓很大很舒服、也很干净。我非常喜欢公寓的设计。房东热情，回复消息及时，自助入住也非常方便。很安静很优美，就是离市中心没有那么近，但出行也非常方便。另外，房东在公寓准备了很多一包一包的食物可以烹饪，但我没看懂如何使用于是没有吃：如果有机会愿意再来。

We had a brilliant few days staying in the garden house, great people to deal with, and always ready to help with anything.
Would definitely look at staying here again when next visiting Edinburgh.
location was perfect for sightseeing and restaurants.  Very well equipped spacious apartment.

L'appartement est très bien agencé, fourni et propre. la vue est très sympa du balcon. nous avons passé une journée et demi à Edimbourg et avons pu profiter de toutes les activités à proximité. nous recommandons sas aucun souci !

Daniela was a gracious host!  The communication was quick always, the place really just so cute and perfect, and it was just as easy as she mentioned to get downtown.  The perfect spot away from the masses but still so close.  Highly recommend and would definitely stay again if I have the chance!
Such a nice apartment and really helpful friendly host! Thanks Rebecca, had a lovely time.

This accommodation was clean when I arrived, though the room was not cleaned again while I was there. Towels and bed linens were cheap and thin but did the job. The mattress was hard and lumpy but not the worst I’ve slept on. The accommodation is on Leith Walk, which is a busy street with bars, cars, trams etc, so it is noisy throughout the night, although I was prepared for this from looking on a map.
The most awful thing about the room was the heat. The window hardly opens, so there is no airflow in the room and there was no fan provided. I could barely sleep because it was so hot.
It would have been nice if there was a kettle with tea/coffee in the room, but there was a nice coffee shop over the road, and plenty of shops within walking distance.
I think I’d rather just fork out the extra cash for a hotel in future.
Wonderful host, very helpful, always with good advise, clean place, good transport to the city and easy one. Everything was simply very good. I will come back.

It was a great pleasure to stay at Cat’s home. I felt welcomed. Cat is really nice, and she doesn’t hesitate to give great advices. My trip wouldn’t have been the same without her.
Thank you again Cat !
Good location. House is clean.

This has been amazing to stay at we would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to stay in Edinburgh the hosts are lovely and you would have everything you need for an amazing time thank you again we may be returning in the future 🥰

Chris is a great host. The apartment is a short walk away from the town.
Kitchen area is spacious ... Home made bread smelled and tasted lovely.
Made to feel very welcome. Would recommend staying there. We had two nights.
Thank you Chris had a lovely time.
Better than the photos and really easy to find from the airport and going into the centre
The flat was gorgeous and very clean. There was a leak in the ceiling coming from the flat upstairs and Lea responded within minutes and had it fixed the very next day. I highly recommend this flat.
We arrived late and had an easy check-in and went straight to bed. For what we needed it was perfect.
Wonderful location with everything you need for a great stay in Edinburgh. Good communication from host. Would definitely recommend!
Couldn’t have asked for more.
Lovely, clean and convenient, plus a king sized bed (hard to find in Europe) and Jenet was warm and friendly and gave us good advise on dinner. We would definitely visit again!

Great apartment, we used it for a base for going to Murrayfield, perfect location and so handy having Lidl on the doorstep. Great base for exploring Edinburgh and very close to Haymarket Station. Would stay here again!

Fantastic location, very clean and tidy with everything you could ask for and a nice pack of shortbread and tablet on arrival.
Nothing was to much and communication was fantastic throughout.
Highly recommended with excellent location and good public transport into Edinburgh itself.
We had an enjoyable stay in a truly centrally located - and clean and charming - apartment. Armando was very helpful at check-in and gave useful advise on things to see in Edinburgh.

This cute apartment was perfect for us! We were able to walk to all the typical tourist places within 15 minutes, depending on if it was up hill or not. This listing is across the street from a pub that is open late, but we were not bothered by the noise, all of us being city girls.

Central and good location for Edinburgh. We parked the car at Linda’s and walked everywhere.
2 bathrooms are good for a 3 bedrooms house and was just nice for the 6 of us.
I am satisfied with my visit. We were two people in the group. Both of us were happy to stay there. Peaceful location and easy acces to Edinburgh city by bus. The staff were friendly.

Reaaz was very friendly and helped alot with directions and suggestions of places to visit or to eat. His home was very lovely and clean. It was great and would recommand this home to anyone visiting Edinburgh!

We had a wonderful stay with Mark and Bill. They made us feel welcome. The room and bathroom  were very clean. Breakfast was very good. It was a big advantage that we could park the car. They also gave us good tips for restaurants. We can highly recommend this accommodation.

The decoration is very beautiful and the environment is clean, and the location is very good to visit the sites in Edinburgh. In addition, Macro is very kind, and will answer your questions quickly, and then provide instant help. We strongly recommend you to have a stay in the b&b when going to Edinburgh.
Easy to get in to, clean surprisingly spacious place. Simple walk to downtown,  but not a ton of activities in the immediate area

Absolutely brilliant stay, don’t hesitate, incredible shower, Selby is gentleman and so thoughtful. We got a little drenched by the rain and he saved the day. Thank you so much for your fabulous place :)

Had a great time in Edinburgh, the apartment was lovely for our group. Comfy beds (and sofa beds) kitchen had everything we needed and was in a great location. It can be noisy outside at night at the weekend, but it's to be expected on a street with bars and restaurants nearby, not a bad reflection on the apartment!

What can I say, Fi’s place is absolutely beautiful and the view is breathtaking, I can see why people come to Dean Village every morning. The sound of the river and the birds chirping was the cherry on top.
The place is really close to the city center by walking or taking uber.
Overall, the place is warm and comfortable and we absolutely loved it!
We hope to be back soon!
房子很大，设施齐全，离爱丁堡城堡步行可到。因为在顶楼所以如果是大件行李搬运较为不便，次卧的洗手间在里面反锁后容易卡住打不开，要小心留意。
Really Nice Flat. Would not expect such a beautifully furnished apartment in the heart of the city.
Perfect location and a lovely homely comfortable place to stay. We really enjoyed our stay here. Great  communication and clear instructions on how to get in.

What a lovely, peaceful place to stay. Jessica was a wonderful host and ensured there were personal touches such as the fabulous home-made blueberry sponge!
She kindly leant me an umbrella on a particularly wet Edinburgh evening, as I had just flown back in from Göteburg without one!
I would definitely stay at Jessica's again 😃
Utmärkt! Tack så mycket Jessica, och vi ses!
Julie B
Inverness
muy atenta! impecable la habitación y el baño! así como las recomendaciones y el servicio de wifi
Great stay, thank you so much!
Very cosy house. The host recieved us and told us everything we needed to know, and even gave us some tips for our visit of Edimburgh. Will recomend!

Mary and her flat were great. Amazing location as you couldn't have been closer to the castle without being in it!  Loved the cleanliness and amenities. Everything was great building is a bit hard to find if coming in a car (number is high at top of steps). But other than that no complaints. Would highly recommend.

Such a hidden gem! A lovely flat just steps from the Royal Mile and very easy to access.
The flat has everything you need to be right at home when you’re in Edinburgh. The kitchen is outfitted with all the necessary basics and Deborah left us a package of butter biscuits as well! We loved the hot water on demand in the shower!
The flat was spotless and Deborah was super fast responding when we had a question.
We will absolutely check the availability for this flat when we’re back!
Grate place to stay. Very clean, very spacious. Zatoon is lovely and couldn't help enough. Hope to stay again next year.
The location can’t be beat, everything else is ok. The place felt a bit rundown, but it’s clean. If you are not looking for something fancy, this is the right place. Overall, it’s satisfied.
Amazingly comfortable bed! Didnt want to leave most mornings. And quick to respond and always willing to give helpful tips! Would definitely stay again if I return to scotland!

If you are looking for a local experience in Edinburgh, YOU MUST FIND MARK AND BILL!
With their warm, open and genuine personalities, they were the best Airbnb hosts we ever had. They championed the Airbnb spirit where they treated us like family (and fed us like one too!). Their dog Dexter was really cute too!
Our room also exceeded our expectations. It was very pretty, clean and comfortable. We had the best sleep in ages!
Overall, our time with Mark and Bill was so amazing that we didn't want to leave their apartment! We will definitely be staying with Mark and Bill again when we come back to Edinburgh! - Jessica

I would recommend Sally's Air B and B. We felt like our room - which had two comfortable sofas, television, DVD player, kettle and herbal teas, books, cosy alcove bed, beautiful wooden windows - was our home away from home. Sally offered us wood for the fire which made our stay all the more special. It's not far from the old town so was very convenient for any tourist visit to Edinburgh.

Such a lovely space in a fantastic area. Everything you could need was at your doorstep and buses are right on your doorstep for all over the city. Ian was a great host, and very communicative when we needed to get in contact with him. Would definitely stay again and recommend 😊
Muy linda habitación, completa. Baño espacioso. La anfitriona muy amable, contestaba muy rápido los mensajes. Volvería.

Excellent service from owners. Property close to all main streets in New Town and easy walk to Old Town. Close to all shops, restaurants and pubs!
Room was spotless and so was the shared bathroom which wasn’t a problem at all. Would definitely stay again.

This is an excellent place in an ideal location in Edinburgh. Dunc and Dee are very responsive and the place was exactly as described. They also left us a bottle of Prosecco and some other complimentary food items and made us feel at home.
Sehr saubere und hübsche Unterkunft. Joyce ist eine tolle Gastgeberin.

Unfortunately, my stay at this Airbnb wasn’t the most comfortable experience. There were several issues that made it hard to relax. The walls in the bedroom had visible smudges everywhere, and there were spiders all over the place. They would crawl out from under the sofas and by my feet while I was cooking. The garden looked quite overgrown, which added to the overall neglected feel.
Inside, the kettle was in bad shape and the DVD player didn’t work at all which was extremely disappointing since we planned on staying in most nights. The bed was extremely uncomfortable, making it tough to get a good night’s sleep—on top of that, cats were running across the roof at night, which kept me awake.
The checkout process also felt unreasonable. The host’s list asked guests to do a lot of cleaning before leaving, despite a cleaning fee being charged; which didn’t feel justified given the state of the place.
I think this property needs some serious maintenance before it’s a comfortable stay.

Nice apartment in a fantastic location in central Edingburg. Everything is close by. Great communication.
However, two things to note: 1) there is a construction site right next door that will continue to be there over the next few months. We were woken up before 8am on every day except Sunday. 2) the photos online are not represenative any more - it's evident that this apartment has seen many guests over recent years - a lot of wear&tear.
Charmant logement proche de nombreux points de visites (Calton Hill, Arthur's Seat, musées, Château Edimbourg, The Meadows,...)

We had a great time in Trystan's apartment. The apartment was exceptionally clean and beautifully decorated, and very spacious. The apartment is well-located and we accessed all parts of the city by foot. Trystan was a very welcoming and receptive host. Make sure you ask him for restaurant recommendations in the area. They were excellent!

J'ai passé 10 jours sur Edinbourg avec une amie. Fiona et Stuart nous ont parfaitement bien accueillies, le logement est à environ 30-40mn de marche du centre de la vielle ville, mais ça se fait bien, surtout si on longe la rivière.
Well presented, clean, good location, quick responses, well equipped, guide book for local attractions.
Really cozy and nice house to stay

The stay was comfortable.
The only drawback was thin walls of the building and house owner being next door so you may not even speak properly, otherwise will get noise complaint.
Secondly house was clean which was good
This is our second time staying at Hazels apartment! Love it! Wouldn’t stay anywhere else now when visiting Edinburgh!
The location of this apartment is absolutely perfect if you are coming in on a train. The check-in was seamless, and I got the best sleep I've gotten in a while on the queen mattress!
Kenny’s place is so close to the Castle and lots of sites! There was so much to do but little time… definitely going to come back.
Amazing accommodation!

Amazing place to stay
Close enough to the castle
Convenient
Claire is helpful and responsive

What a beautiful home!  It was my Mum's 60th birthday weekend away and she absolutely loved the space - high ceilings, stylish furniture, sparkling clean... what more could you want?  The whole flat felt spacious enough for all of us (there were 5 of us), and the shared lounge and kitchen had everything we could possibly need and more.   The flat feels super homely and cosy with a few family photos dotted around.  If your party is more than 6 I would say it would be a squeeze as there is one bathroom with shower and toilet in the same room.  We would definitely stay here again, next time we visit Edinburgh!  Thank you so much Momo.

Pauls flat is easy to find.  It's located close from Haymaket. The flat is modern and very beautiful. It was perfect for a stay in beautiful Edinburgh. Paul send me all the necessary instructions before I arrived. I had a very pleasant time in his flat. Thanks Paul. 😊

Jamie is an awesome host, very helpful, friendly and thoughtful. He had milk, OJ, cereal, coffee available for us to use which we did. His apartment is very clean and comfortable, I felt at ease as soon as I entered the apartment. How he describes his place and surroundings is exactly how it is. Very walkable to all places like the royal mile, Edinburgh castle,  museums and restaurants. He   answered very quickly when I messaged him about a hair dryer. I would definitely recommend this place if you need a place to stay in Edinburgh.

Jay’s place has a fantastic location—within walking distance to all major tourist attractions. There are supermarkets, shops, restaurants, and cafés just around the corner. Jay was very responsive and quick to reply to our messages. The flat is accessed by about 20 steps, but even with a stroller and a small child, it wasn’t a big issue for us. The apartment was well-equipped with many essentials we might need. The only downside was that the carpets made the place feel a bit dusty.

Spacious and airy apartment which, as others have said is larger than it appears in the photos. A great location too we walked to almost everything. Lots of lovely restaurants nearby for breakfast and dinner. We would highly recommend it.
Jamie’s place was in a perfect location - super easy to access from both the airport and getting into town. Super easy to use and very responsive. The place was comfortable and fully functional!!
Great flat with a roof top deck. The flat is centrally located in the downtown area. It was quiet and comfortable. I would stay there again!

We had a great stay during our time in Edinburgh! The location was walkable to everything we wanted to explore and was also close to the airport for easy traveling. We could see the castle from our window, which was an added bonus! The communication was clear and helpful to make finding the place super easy. They even allowed us to check in early, which was so helpful after an overnight flight! We will definitely return the next time we're in Edinburgh!
Very central but also quiet location, friendly host,  comfy room with own shower room, simple but nice diy breakfast, excellent value. We would definitely stay here again. Thanks very much Sevi.

This was a lovely base for 4 adults in the Stockbridge area. Kitchen had everything we needed to prepare our own meals during some of our stay, was close to Dean village and the Stockbridge market. Lots of cafes and restaurants close by and easy access to the bus. Rooms are small making it a bit tight for suitcases but very comfortable. Washer available but is outside the unit. This is a lower level unit but has big windows.

Lovely apartment, with a beautiful view from the living room window.
Inchkeith View had everything we needed for our holiday. The apartment itself was spotlessly clean and very cosy, beds were comfortable.
Only a few minutes away from the hustle and bustle of the city, but it was incredibly quiet.
Delicious food at the Starbank Inn, only a few minutes walk away.
Stairs up to the apartment are hard work if like me you are a little unfit! But my sons had no problem.
Great place to stay, would highly recommend.

We had an amazing time at Vivien’s place. Everything was sparkling clean. There were cooking essentials provided as well as tons of touristic info available. About 30 min walk to the main attractions in the city centre and 15 min walk yo Leith.

Endroit facile d'accès, chambre et appartement très propre.
Possibilité de prendre le petit déjeuner dans la cuisine. Un peu décentré mais en 20 minutes de marche,
on atteint le centre d' Edimbourg.
Fantastic location, lovely flat, and David was such a helpful host - communicative, flexible, and provided information on everything we could ever have wanted. A great experience!
The bed was super comfy and bedroom was thought fully kitted out. Great location if you want to explore the city and are using public transport.
Notre séjour chez Margaret s'est très bien passé, l'appartement est très agréable et est non loin du centre ville à pied ou en transport ! merci !
Very beautiful and comfortable house. Ideal for the larger groups. Highly recommended.

Very clean appartement, very cosy, we had a great time there!
We stayed only for one night but it was really nice! The communication with Aykut was very smooth and efficient.
Would recommend this place for everyone that wants to be a bit out of the city center, in a calm environment 😊
We had a great stay in the Appartement of Zoryana! Everything was as beautiful as described and the communication went perfectly. We can highly recommend to stay here when you are in Edingburgh.

Gros coup de cœur pour cet appartement. Lumineux, moderne, superbement décoré, bien équipé, on s'y sent tout de suite comme chez soi.
Situé dans le quartier incroyable de Stockbridge dans une ruelle au calme et à côté des commerces et restaurants.
Ailsa a été adorable, répondant à nos questions rapidement.
Merci pour votre accueil et votre délicate attention pour le petit-déjeuner et tout le reste. En un seul mot, nous avons adoré.

Islam's place is wonderful, and he treats you like if you're a close friend. His property is gorgeous, and the private barn you stay in is very nice. It's all modern, one bathroom but very nice, two beds and a pull out couch which I personally slept on and was fine. It's a beautifully done barn and have nothing negative to say. His property is gated and private, so you have nothing to worry about, plus the town is walking distance and I highly recommend walking. Islam will give you recommendations, and he is so welcoming that I can't stress this enough. He was by far our best host on our two week UK trip, and I would 100% contact him again if I returned to Edinburgh. Do a castle tour, try different scotches, and check out Georges Street for shopping and bars! We personally did not like grass market, and the Royal Mile is nice to walk but very touristy. Georges Street and the surrounding areas are where you want to be at night for good drinks and a good vibe. Thanks again Islam!

The location was absolutely perfect, and the views were stunning! and the hosts gave us so many local recommendations! If only I had more time there to explore it all! If I get to go back to Edinburgh I will absolutely be stopping here!
Convenient
Nice place with friendly people

Beautiful home with thoughtful touches arranged by the host on arrival! Sharon was easy to reach and also provided a brochure of all recommendations to visit. Home is beautiful, amazing location, bus stop 1 minute away with a 10 minute bus ride to all attractions. Highly recommend, great value for money!!

Une expérience mitigée dans le logement de Rachel. Bien qu’il y ait de nombreux points positifs, d’autres éléments ont entaché notre séjour, notamment :
- des traces de moisissures dans la partie basse du bac de douche
- des ampoules non fonctionnelles ou inutilisables : au dessus du lit, au dessus de la douche et le tube néon de la cuisine
- le faux plafond donne l’impression d’un cache misère, de l’air froid y fuit lorsque vous prenez votre douche, et l’air chaud s’y accumule quand vous essayez de chauffer la chambre
- la porte d’entrée n’est pas étanche, on y voit un peu à travers ce qui nous a donné un léger sentiment d’insécurité
- le voisin du dessus est une véritable nuisance, il tape au sol à des heures très tardives.
- la moquette est trouée à quelques endroits
Mention honorable pour la literie qui est exceptionnelle, la vue splendide et la localisation exceptionnellement pratique de ce logement. Ce sont de loin ses plus grands atouts.

David's Airbnb in Edinburgh was fantastic. The location in New Town is ideal, surrounded by great restaurants and charming shops, and just a 10-minute walk from the tram station. The beds were extremely comfortable, and the apartment itself is beautifully decorated, making it a really pleasant place to stay. David was also one of the best hosts I've had: incredibly thorough and quick in his communication, which made everything seamless. Highly recommend.

The apartment is ideally located and very well-maintained. Everything was super clean, in good condition, and comfortable. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay there and would highly recommend it. Everything is provided for the comfort of the guests and I truly felt at home. I will definitely go back. My best airbnb experience so far!
Wonderful place to stay in Edinburgh

Lovely rooms with great views. Quiet but very convenient location for fringe events. We didn't see them that much but when we did they were very friendly and extremely helpful. Modern bathroom, soft white towels and nice shower gel provided. Comfortable bed and pretty bedroom with phone chargers, a nice touch.
Carol was a great host, very nice room in a great location in the city! Carol was very helpful and welcoming, would highly recommend a stay with her!

The apartment was very nice and everything promised was there. I would like to thank Ben for excellent communication, precise instructions and his willingness to agree to our early check-in and later check-out. Recommend. :-)

My partner and I stayed for one night. The room was as described. The bed was is very soft and comfortable.
Check in was super easy and Luciana was really responsive. The location is great and less than ten mins from a tram stop to get in and out of the city centre easily and cheaply.
My only comment would be about parking. We were lucky the one space to park was free behind the building, if it wasn’t i’m not sure where we would have parked - all the parking in the surrounding streets was max stay 4 hours and was extortionate so I think you need to be weary of this!

We had a lovely stay at Debbie’s for the Half Marathon weekend. She had great recommendations for restaurants and helped us figure out how we would get into the centre for starting the Half Marathon. We felt right at home instantly, Debbie was so friendly. A quiet and peaceful area within walking distance to the beach. We would definitely stay again, thanks Debbie!
Un apartamento precioso, todo muy cuidado. La ubicacion es muy buena.
Trudi's apartment is amazing.   Beautifully comfortable.   Proximity to all of Edinburg sights could not be better.
Lovely cottage in Edinburgh. Great location. The host was helpful and responsive to answered my questions. Would definitely like to stay here again.

Greg is such a fantastic host and gave loads of recommendations of things to do and see as it was our first trip to Edinburgh. The flat is so central and is within walking distance to anywhere you want to go. The flat is warm, spacious and most importantly spotlessly clean.

Sarah est une hôte très agréable, qui sait accueillir et conseiller au mieux ses invités.
La localisation du logement est parfaite pour rejoindre en bus ou même a pieds les endroits phare a visiter a Édimbourg.
Le logement en lui même est très agréable, le bâtiment ne paye pas de mine, mais une fois dans l’appartement on se s’en tout de suite a l’aise. Très bon séjour.

David is a kind, considerate, and generous host who turned my experience in Edinburgh into one of the best times that I’ve had. When I was nervous, he helped me out, and was always available with a word of advice and a heartening presence. Bottom line-stay with him!
Lovely flat and perfect if you need two bedrooms. Perfect also even if you only need one!
Wonderful accommodation that was incredibly well equipped and a very accommodating host! Would highly recommend.

Allans cottage was a perfect stay and equipped with everything you need and more. The calm serenity and jacuzzi was a great escape from our busy city lives. We have enjoyed ourselves thoroughly and left feeling relaxed. Highly recommend. Thank you Allan.

Sean was an outstanding host from start to finish. He communicated clearly and promptly, sharing useful details and local tips well in advance, which made the whole trip feel effortless before we even arrived. The check-in process was seamless — exactly what you want after a long journey.
The apartment itself was a real highlight. It was spotlessly clean throughout — bedrooms, bathroom, and kitchen all immaculate. The kitchen was very well equipped and came with a large, empty fridge ready for our stay, which we really appreciated. The heating was pre-programmed to run all day and night, making the place wonderfully warm and cosy during our 4-night stay — no small thing in Edinburgh!
The location is ideal for anyone wanting easy access to the city centre, with everything within reach.
We couldn't have asked for more. Highly recommend Sean's place and would not hesitate to come back!
La stanza e molto confortevole e pulita come indicata in foto, la casa si trova a meno di 200 metri dalle fermate dei autobus , consiglio la stanza di Anne Marie

This place is fantastic!! It's in an excellent location and the place was very cozy and perfect for people watching! There's tons of great restaurants right outside the door and super close to the castle. Would highly recommend staying here!

Clare’s place was ideal for my first visit to Scotland which was a work trip, a real home from home. The location was perfect, close enough to the city to take in all that Edinburgh has to offer but far enough away from the hustle and bustle.
The place is really spacious and well maintained, the beds and pillows very comfortable, and the kitchen stocked with everything you would need to prepare meals. There is a small retail park just a few minutes walk away with restaurants, or a Sainsbury’s local to pick up some groceries.
I had a great stay here and would book this again when visiting Scotland for work or pleasure in the future.

We had a really nice stay here - the apartment was very clean, cosy, comfortable and functional! It’s about a 20 minute walk into Edinburgh Old Town, and if you go through the Meadows/past the university it’s a really nice stroll that gets you into the city centre around Greyfriars. Clear and proactive communication from the host too, which was helpful!

Our stay in Pierson’s flat was simply perfect. We love Edinburgh anyway but the location and the decoration of the flat together with Pierson’s care and thought that he put into his information manual, took it to another level. There is the sweetest garden which was the best spot for early evening drinks in the sun.  We will be back!
Hard to beat the location when visiting Edinburgh. Right by the meadows and very walkable!
Beautiful home, great location,
Super séjour à edinbourg. L’appartement est parfait, à proximité du centre ville. Tout peut se faire à pied !

The flat is stunning and very well located. It has a bus stop right in front of the building. Andrew is a very good host and was always very quick to respond. A perfect place to stay with great value for money. Will surely stay here again when I visit Edinburgh again.
I recommend
The place is very well located, and the space is amazing. Highly recommended
Un lugar estratégico, básico pero la ubicación es excelente.
Great location and very responsive host.
Pier’s place is exactly like the photos, it’s clean, and a good distance from all the tourist attractions. Also a great price!
The room was very comfy and extremely clean. Fruit, snacks and lovely coffee!  Great communication by the host.
Anna’s apartement was very lovely. Everything was clean and tidy. It’s a quiet street just a walking distance from everything. Perfect for a family ! We would warmly recommand it !

Great apartment. Not far from the station. The instructions given by the host were very clear and easy to follow for finding it and getting in. We did have a few issues with the key which was a technical fault not don’t to the host. But it was sorted and we had a fantastic stay. All you could need to a break in such a fantastic city.
Thanks so much

Great central location, close to the Meadows and interesting independent shops/restaurants/coffee bars. On a bus route with lots of buses going into the centre Edinburgh.
The apartment is very well equipped, warm and I felt at home immediately.
Chris is a very good host - friendly and helpful, making my stay super easy.
Thank you for a great stay!
A cosy stay with easy access to town by bus or a pleasant walk. Hilary was a great host and was always available for questions.  Thanks!

에든버러 캐슬 도보로 이동 가능하고 다른곳도 버스타면 15분이면 도착해요. 방이 아늑하고 아기자기해서 분위기가 좋아요. 특히 개인 욕실이 있어서 좋았어요.

에딘버러에 방문하면 숙박을 추천해요^^

Communication from the host was excellent.
The apartment itself was as expected, clean and tidy, well looked after and located in what felt like a typical street for Leith. It is two minutes from a tram stop that takes you straight to the centre and we found plenty of nice restaurants nearby for meals. Parking was readily available and we were able to leave our car right outside the apartment.
This was a great base for our adventure to Edinburgh. Would recommend.

Fiona's basement flat apartment is ideal for up to two couples or a couple with young children who want stylish accommodation, with every amenity needed, and the ability to walk to all that central Edinburgh has to offer. The apartment is quiet and private with a lovely view to a pretty back garden. Bus stop is 50m away. Highly recommend.
Very nice stay, clean room. Bathroom with a bath all to yourself. Very helpful host. I definitelly recommend, if you are planning a trip to Edinburgh.

Would definitely recommend to stay at Helen’s place! Helen was a great host and provided really helpful recommendations.
Located in a nice area of Edinburgh. It’s very walkable into town, and alternatively the bus route is super simple.
And the bed was so so comfortable :)
Wonderful place! I am a solo traveler first time in Edinburgh and this spot was comfortable, clean and convenient. Carol and Jerry were both super kind and helpful. Excellent value overall!
This place is awesome, had some clesning issyes but not too bad, but i love the area

We were very impressed with the service.
You will get everything what you expect in a good house. Worth to visit. Thanks to Ayub for his kindness and welcoming behaviour.

We had a wonderful stay at Alistair’s place! Everything was just as described – clean and comfortable. Alistair was very friendly and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the start. A special highlight was his adorable cat Spooky. We’d love to come back!

Fiona’s place was an absolute gem. Tucked just outside the bustle of the Old Town, it offered the perfect retreat for our family of four peaceful, yet easily walkable to all the main attractions. The apartment was surprisingly spacious much larger than it appeared in the photos and well equipped.
We loved having a Tesco Express just around the corner, along with some fantastic local restaurants and takeaways nearby (highly recommend The Chippy by Spencer for an easy dinner). One of the true highlights was the garden out back a great spot to unwind after a day of exploring. And just a short stroll away, Calton Hill provided stunning evening views of Edinburgh, particularly at night.
If you’re after charm, convenience, and calm, skip the noisy heart of the Old Town and stay here instead. You won’t regret it.

Spacious and clean! Sally was responsive and accommodative throughout the process. Check-in was easy, parking in the back was convenient, and the location was walking distance to dining and shopping. Wish our stay could have been longer than just one night but would gladly stay here again. Thank you Sally!

Margaret’s Airbnb was a great location for our recent stay. Within walking distance to The Royal Mile, Holyrood House and meeting area for our day tour with Rabbies. Just down the road is a grocery too! Beautiful view of Arthurs Seat. The apartment was clean, well stocked and comfortable. Any questions we had were answered promptly. Very pleased!
The location is very good and easy to get to the city centre of Edinburgh.  I like there is parking space provided for the place.  Thank you
We really enjoyed staying in this beautiful flat. It was everything we wanted for a short stay in Edinburgh and couldn’t recommend it enough!
A fantastic apartment in our favourite area of Edinburgh. The little touches provided made for an excellent stay. Highly recommended!

Een heel fijn plekje in Edinburgh. Netjes, op loopafstand van de oude stad, maar ook voldoende OV op de hoek. Supermarkt aan de overkant. Ollie en Ella gaven duidelijke instructies op voorhand en checkten ook tijdens het verblijf of alles naar wens was. Helemaal top!
Great  host! Fast and friendly answers to questions/messages, flexible and helpful
un logement agréable et pratique qui saura contenter les gens de passage pour visiter la Edimbourg et sa région quelques jours grâce à spn emplacement idéal au pied du chateau et de la vieille ville.
Super nice place! Clean room, bed comfortable, welcoming vibe. Thanks Ella and Ollie!

It was so lovely to stay in robin’s airbnb
Everything was clean, organized and the location was great!

We hebben enorm genoten van ons weekend Edinburgh en deze goede accommodatie was daar onderdeel van. Duidelijke instructies en goede, snelle communicatie met de verhuurder. Centrum op loopafstand + leuke bars/restaurants/supermarkt.

شكراً ديفيد لقد استمتعت بالاقامة حقاً ، المكان رائع يوجد جميع المستلزمات والسعر مناسب جداً مقارنة في الاسعار بباقي ادنبره ، سكنت ثلاث ليالي واستمتعت جداً والنت مجاني ، من المزايا امام الشقه نقطه توقف للباص ، ايضاً باص ٢٦ يبعد خمس دقائق مشياً ويمكنك ان تصل لوسط ادنبره في ١١ دقيقه ، المكان جميل وحي وقريب من الشاطئ حوالي سبع دقائق مشياً ، الشقه جميله جداً ونظيفة وديفيد سريع بالرد ، الزيارة راح تتكر بأذن الله ، انصحكم بالمكان نظيف ومريح وفيه كل الخدامات .

The only thing we regret about Édimbourg is that we didn't spend more time at Les' place. The flat is just perfect, even more beautiful than in the photos, we were very well received, even though we arrived a bit late. I highly recommend it and we hope to be able to return one day, with more time. Thank you for your patience and for welcoming us so well!

The hostel itself is very nice, with a pleasant outdoor area and various activities inside. The receptionist was helpful and kind. However, the room did not meet expectations. There were visible dirt marks on the walls, including stains that looked like blood, the room was quite dark, and there were no hooks or hangers at all.
Additionally, there was excessive noise from other guests for many hours during the night, which made it impossible for me to sleep. This caused great dissatisfaction, as I was on vacation and needed rest. Because of this experience, I would not choose to stay again.
Overall, the hostel is beautiful and well-priced, but due to the room condition and lack of sleep, I kindly request a partial refund
Appartamento molto bello, centrale, pulito. Consigliatissimo!!
Nothing bad to say really, a really nice host who puts a lot of care so you feel welcomed and a nice orange cat 🐈

Sarah hat uns sehr warmherzig empfangen und uns einen schönen Aufenthalt bereitet. Besonders waren die Wärmeflaschen, die sie uns für einen Nachtspaziergang auf den Arthurs Seat mitgegeben hat. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und das Zimmer liebevoll mit Blick auf Details eingerichtet. Wir haben kaum gemerkt, dass wir kein eigenes Bad hatten. Gerne wieder wenn wir in Edinburgh sind.

Great little studio just on the edge of the new town. Good for a short stay, but if you want to cook meals etc it may be a little under supplied in the kitchen. Easy check in and out and great communication from the host.

Amy’s place is great!  Great location - close to bus stops and the tram.  But can walk to all the tourist spots. The flat was super clean and beds were so comfortable.   We would definitely stay again!

What a fun, easy place to stay for a quick trip to Edinburgh!
Ben’s place is centrally located and is a quick walk to places to eat, the castle and plenty of other activities!
Jon communication was perfect, check in was smooth, place location is really closed to the centrum . Apartment is cozy perfect for couple to explore the city during the day and night.

We had a lovely stay and really enjoyed our time here. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Great communication from the hosts as well. We’d happily stay again and recommend it to others.

John's been one of the best Airbnb hosts we've had so far. He has been extremely responsive to our messages from the very beginning. When we arrived, he received us and showed us his cozy and comfortable home, which, I have to say, is very well located as it's close to the city center but still on a quiet street.
The bedroom is exceptionally nice, and has everything you'd need; he provided us with extra sheets, and everything was clean and tidy. Plus, we had an amazing private bathroom.
John provides a really complete breakfast every morning (with fruits, coffee, tea, croissants, cereals, and more). He is a very warm and kind person, open to answering any questions or doubts you might have about Edinburgh. He even shared recommendations about the Highlands, as we were heading there after our stay. You'll feel at home if you stay at John's place. Thanks, John! hope we meet again soon.
Great stay and location! Thank you very much

Für den Preis war die Unterkunft in Ordnung. Die Busverbindung in die Stadt war super. In der Nähe gab es einen Supermarkt. Das Ein und Auschecken war super. Leider waren einige der Mitbewohner sehr unordentlich und haben das Badezimmer und die Küche dreckig hinterlassen. Dafür kann Fernando aber nichts.

Great stay, thanks Calim. Clear instructions about how to find the place, great suggestions for where to eat and a beautiful well-equipped flat. The stairs are a killer after a long day, but definitely part of the charm! Can't beat the location. Hope to come back. Thanks.
Great location, and easy to navigate!
Très jolie chambre décoré avec gout...Grand fenêtre avec vue sur un parc dans un quartier central et chic...Parfait!!

Fijn appartement, prettige communicatie en goede plek in Edinburgh! Er heerst een fijne sfeer. Behulpzame verhuurder.
Bedden waren wel erg smal, zeker voor de wat grote Hollander! Het stapelbed voelt ook wat krap en benauwd. We hebben dit matras beneden neergelegd en toen was er genoeg frisse lucht. Wel fijne matrassen.
Hadden iets meer glazen kunnen staan. Sommige borden en glazen waren niet goed afgewassen en nog vuil. De keuken heeft veel mogelijkheden als een goede oven, grote koelkast, 2 soorten koffiezetapparaten, waterkoker en gezellige open haard. Je moet wel zelf aan vuur en hout denken!
Fijne tijd daar met vriendinnen gehad.
Excellent location, lovely flat!
Great location, amazing vibe of Castle, lovely apartment! Close to pubs, Castle and Royal Mile.
Great apartment with plenty of space, character and comfort. Would highly reccommend to anyone. Even the little details like a stereo and shower toiletries really made the stay feel homely.
我抵達愛丁堡第一天下整天雨, 坐公車又因為公車調度, 中途放我們下車, 人生地不熟的, 後來很艱難的抵達, 屋主很熱心的協助, 讓我們在心情低落時給我們適當的協助!真的非常感謝Alison!Thank you so much.

Great host, fast response and super friendly. Apartment is nice and spacious and in a great location close to the city. Has everything you need, especially great laundry facilities. Highly recommend !

This apartment is generally good. Location is great. We had some issues opening the downstairs door, but eventually used the app and that worked fine.
Some things can be improved tho:
All mattresses are terrible. The doubles beds are 2 singles pushed together and 2 are different heights. This really does need to be addressed.

Ricky’s flat was the perfect landing spot for us in Leith. Easy access to the tram, buses, totally convenient. Loved our visit the Cooperage and would book again. Wish the weather had been better, but that’s our luck! Thank you, Ricky!
It was a great place to stay in Edinburgh. Easy access to lots of points off interest. Be up for steps.
I  can highly recommend this apartment, great location, great people watching from the window and it's a great apartment

Our stay was amazing, Misha was a great host waiting for us, great communication before and during our stay.
The apartment was amazing, very clean, very comfortable, and it looked like brand new. We enjoy walking so we went everywhere by foot!
The window view was great, and the area I quite!
I suggest it 100%!!!

This cosy home completely exceeded my expectations. They have thought of everything you might possibly need while travelling (e.g fast Wi-Fi and USB ports) I really appreciated their local knowledge and found them to be warm and welcoming without being intrusive. Biggest bonus is the amazing shower pressure! Would love to stay again, thanks guys.

Wir hatten ein tolles verlängertes Wochenende in Seans Apartment. Die Lage war perfekt, wir konnten all unsere Ziele zu Fuß erreichen. In direkter Nähe gab es zahlreiche Restaurants und Cafés. Während unseres Aufenthalts gab es eine Sturmwarnung, die Wohnung war der perfekte gemütliche Rückzugsort vor dem Unwetter. Danke, dass wir in deiner Wohnung bleiben durften, Sean!
Thanks!
The host was a kind person. However the room and the bed smelled bad. The property needs better cleaning especially bathroom.

Nous avons passé un séjour parfait dans le confortable appartement de Craig au calme, proche des commodités et du centre ville.
Un grand merci à Craig qui nous a chaleureusement accueillis et donnés de précieux conseils sur les commerces et les quartiers d'Edimbourg.
We had a very lovely stay at Les' place! Its a lovely home with a stunning view and a great spot to get into Edinburgh from. We will definitely recommend everyone staying here :)
A lovely host. Caroline could not have done anymore for my daughter and I. Would highly recommend to anyone wishing to travel to Edinburgh. Location was stunning.

Super apartement propre et decoré avec un immense goût...je le conseille vivement
Great stay in this clean apartement with beautiful design....strongly advise it.

Great apartment as a base in Edinburgh. Spacious, well equipped and beautifully renovated. Comfortable beds! In a quiet laneway but near a very busy street. Despite this, inside the apartment is very quiet and there was no noise to disturb us.
Great location, walking distance to castle, Royal Mile, many other attractions and cafes and restaurants.
You will not nicer, more helpful and responsive hosts anywhere. Sean and Sally went above and beyond to help us with luggage storage etc. and just made everything easy. So a huge thanks.
the host is always very helpfull, friendly and if you want to know about the area or services she will help

This is probably the best AirBnB I've ever stayed in! Lukasz left so many personal touches that made us feel very welcome. The place is very close to the Royal Mile and some great restaurants, and there's a convenience store less than a block away. The kitchen is fully equipped and the place is overall very quiet and clean. We would definitely stay here again!
Great location and very comfortable
Great apartment in a good location.
Superbe appartement propre et bien situé pour visiter Edinburg et pour se reposer près de la mer.

Abigail’s home was cozy, comfortable, and clean. It was just far enough from the tourist chaos but close enough to walk to and from. The street is quiet and very beautiful. Abigail was responsive, friendly, and so lovely. Highly recommend staying with her.
Everything was fine- friendly host and close to west end! Thank you!

beautiful apartment in a beautiful part of Edinburgh
, within walking distance of all attractions, a lovely quiet space to come back to after a busy day exploring, would highly recommend. parking space was an added bonus, thank you

Très bien situé avec tram et bus au pied de l'hôtel qui desservent tous les points touristiques d'Edimbourg.
La chambre reste petite et sans clim pour le tarif proposé.
Attention à la taille du matelas, il ne faut pas être trop grand pour s'y maintenir !
Il y a un festival dans toute la ville pendant le mois d'août, les prix ont tendance à s'envoler rapidement !!
Lovely space with an unique, amazing view and great location!
Amazing stay. Great location and all around a wonderful Airbnb!

The flat is in a block away from the main road, and I found it quiet while I was there.
Plenty of amenities (especially on Leith Walk, only a short walk away - in fact, I made no use of public transport during my stay as the city centre is extremely close by.
Very enjoyable stay. The space was comfortable, quiet, and in a convenient location.

Sam is one of the most amazing people you will ever meet. Helpful, kind at heart and just genuinely a really great guy to talk with.
Everything about the Airbnb was spotless and with flaws. The bed was well made, the sheets were fresh, and sooooo comfy and warm.
It's a 2 minute walk to a bus stop with connections to Edinburgh Castle and ocean terminal and sits just off the Royal Mile.
This is an absolute must go for when it comes to your stay in Edinburgh. It doesn't get better for this price than this.
THERES to many great things to list about this stay at Sam's AIRBNB and he truly allowed me, on my birthday to realise how great this city truly is.

Zona comoda, centro raggiungibile a piedi e con bus sotto casa.
L’alloggio di per sé era ok, ma avrebbe sicuramente bisogno di molta manutenzione.
La stanza con il letto a castello era più uno sgabuzzino che altro.
Le porte praticamente non si chiudono.
Viene fornito solo un cuscino per letto e non c’è possibilità di averne in più.
Inoltre, l’appartamento è isolato molto male, quindi si sente qualsiasi rumore dal corridoio d’ingresso al palazzo.
Il pavimento scricchiola tantissimo.
La via in cui si trova il palazzo è poco curata e spesso sporca.
Di positivo c’è la cucina che è piccola ma ben attrezzata e i termosifoni che riscaldano molto velocemente.

We brought our friend to Edinburgh as a birthday present and had a great time. The apartment is clean, perfectly located and cosy. Patsy, John and Ann made it all so easy for us. We will definitely be back!

Had a lovely couple of nights at Dawn’s property, great location on the outskirts of Edinburgh to explore the city with regular buses to and from the city. Property was very clean, had all the amenities that you need and Dawn herself very welcoming.

Nice place to stay in if you’re wanting to be a little bit out of the city center!
Comfortable beds.

​The photos make the place look better than it actually is in reality.
​There is no living room. The apartment consists only of a kitchen and three bedrooms.
​Despite having three bedrooms, only one of them has a proper double bed.
​The bathroom is extremely small and very uncomfortable to use. The furniture and overall interior are in poor condition and feel like they are barely holding together.
​The general impression is that this apartment is typically rented out to students with very low requirements, rather than being a quality accommodation for travelers. I would not recommend unless location is your only priority.
Posizione comoda e casa confortevole, tutto fantastico
Apartment is very close from the airport and room is pretty comfortable, the zone is very quiet and safe to walk around

Brian and Katie are a lovely, friendly couple. The room was large, cosy and very stylish.
