We can definitely recommend Brian and Kate’s place. You won’t be disappointed!

Appartement idéalement situé, au calme, à deux pas des commerces et des transports en commun. Les instructions d’accès sont précises et détaillées, tout comme les consignes à respecter sur place. Un logement propre et bien entretenu.

Anne's place was perfect to explore Edinburgh. It's right at the bottom of Arthur's seat and we easily walked to the main streets of Edinburgh without needing to drive or take public transport. The flat is very spacious and has everything you need to make you feel at home as soon as you arrive. I definitely recommend Anne's place and will for sure come back there the next time we visit Edinburgh.
We had a very comfortable stay at this Airbnb.  Lewis quickly responded to our questions and was super helpful.  Great location.
goede locatie er zijn veel dingen in de buurt te doen. de host is erg vriendelijk.
Clean, good location, easy to find/get in, and responsive hosts. The stairs and elevator a somewhat scary and not very robust
An excellent property in a fantastic location for exploring Edinburgh.
Would stay at this property again. Clean and tidy and basics available upon arrival.

Had a really great stay in Edinburgh at Agnieszka's place! The place was sparkling clean and communication was quick and clear. Only about 20-25 min walk to centre of town. Would definitely recommend staying here.
Everything was perfect–beautiful place and very well located. Would definitey stay here again!
Hermoso lugar. Una casa muy espaciosa y cómoda. El lugar ideal para conocer Edimburgo.

This is an exceptional rental. Every surface, every corner, every utensil is immaculate. The location is ideal in terms of restaurants, wine shops and bakeries, it’s also a short walking distance (a beautiful walk) into the city center. We loved the location and how everything is easy walking distance.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this lovely flat. It's furnished beautifully and has all the amenities you would require on a  weekend break. The flat was very clean and fresh. The check in/out procedure was super easy to follow. William was a fantastic host and provided lots of local knowledge and tips. Perfectly located with only a 15/20 minute walk to city centre. We would 100% recommend this place to anyone staying in Edinburgh.

Très bon séjour chez Lawrie, nous avons aimé la proximité des lieux avec le centre d'Edimbourg, et la facilité de trouver le logement. Même si en journée la rue est passante devant le logement, les nuits sont calmes. A bientôt

Was very flexible with check in. Allowed check in before listed time. Very close to attractions and food and beverage places. Very helpful with directions to places and to flat when arriving from airport. Cozy flat with all amenities for our stay. Very quiet area of city and close to bus stops.

Very quiet and cosy place to stay. Parking is a real bonus. The accommodation was lovely and warm and clean. Good WiFi. 5 minutes walk to supermarkets and restaurants. Good frequent bus service to city centre. We’ll be back!

A very large, clean, and well decorated apartment for our 2-day stay in the city.  It is in the very quiet residential area but we can go to City Center with short and cheap Uber rides and left our rental car at the parking space provide.  The unit provides washer and dryer and it was perfect for our mid trip laundry.  We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you Bobby and Neil !

This was a great place to stay. Central to all the sights in Edinburgh. All the buzz of the city.
The nightlife was right below the apartment so not a lot of quiet time but we loved it!

This is a such a comfortable property in an amazing location. Everything is right on the doorstep. This can mean it’s a little noisy at night so not ideal if you’re a very light sleeper, although I’m a fairly light sleeper and only woke up a couple of times.

This apartment is central, functional, and comfortable. Very homely and we wish we had longer here.

The apartment is amazing, spacious and more than comfortable for five of us. The location is great, basically in the city center, just 10 minutes walk from the old town, with lot of shops, bar, restaurants in the area. Dawn is a kind and helpful host, communication was pleasant and polite, we received all the necessary information. If we would go back to Edinburgh, we would definitely look for this apartment again. Highly recommended!
douche trop petite mais le reste du logement au top. Bien situé dans un secteur calme.
Place was extremely clean and beautiful. Great location as it was near lots of shops!
Great spot in Edinburgh.  Quiet neighborhood but close to everything you’d want and very walkable. Adorable outside spot and very clean!

Was a great experience to stay in Edinburgh, the location of the house is brilliant. Easy to get access to any tourist attractions from the house, and Isla gave lots of useful local advice. While it is complicated to park a car in the central area of Edinburgh.

Perfect Edinburgh home for the three of us. With the fold out sofa bed in the lounge we had a room each. Stylishly on trend, great use of space, quiet mews, thoughtfully furnished.
Particularly enjoyed the riverside walk of Leith where the sun shone at the lovely portside cafe, thanks Proclaimers there was indeed sunshine on Leith!

We had a great time in Edinburgh and at Alex's place. The check-in went great and was very easy. Alex was very welcoming and communicative and gave us lots of recommendations for what to do, and what not to do, around the city.

We really felt at home during our stay! I can only recommend Alex as a host.
Lovely home. Great location. Highly recommend.

Jenny was a perfect host and her house is in the perfect location. It's a very peaceful neighborhood not too far away from the city center (max 20-30 min walk). We were very happy we got to explore Leith too. Jenny was kind and caring. I would definitely recommend her house to everyone.
The location is close to Haymarket (a few minutes).

We had a bad start as it took alsmost 1h to manage to get the keys for the flat. But the company was really easy to reach. Afterwards everything was fine. The appartment is very well located, close to the waverley station and to many restaurants and activities. The flat had everything we needed.
Keep in mind that there are 4 floors to climb by stairs.
è andato tutto benissimo, non abbiamo avuto alcun problema

This second floor apartment is situated right next to usher hall and is only a 10-15 min walk up to the castle. The whole place was clean, comfortable and the Denise was extremely accommodating arranging the cleaning company to provide us a high chair and cot for our 15 month old son (at a small price). I would definitely stay here again. I feel like I have a second home now right in the heart of Edinburgh!

an amazing location, right in the middle of Edinburgh, great for day trips and sightseeing. The place was very clean, with all the appliances needed for a longer stay. I am extremely satisfied with this holiday.
This place was perfect! Great amenities, great location, great communication! What more can I say -- we loved it!
Lovely to stay at Selby’s for 2 days and I love his kitchen!
Bra boende med närhet till kollektivtrafik. Det var inte långt till vare sig restauranger och kaféer. Maxine var en perfekt värd och svarade snabbt när vi hade några frågor. Kan varmt rekommenderas.

What a wonderful apartment! I stayed here with six friends over Hogmanay and it was the perfect place to stay. We stayed in the Garden Room for a couple of nights and couldn’t recommend it more. Perfect in all possible ways!
Great location and value for money
Would definitely use again

Fabulous place.  Perfect location. Everything we needed was right out the front door.  Even though it's in the middle of town it was very quiet.  The unit included everything we could imagine and  it was all top quality.  If we're every in Edinburgh again this will be where we stay,

We do suggest this house for your Edinburgh experience.
Everything was well organized, clean and the house is full of all you need and may expect.
Great solution
We have had a lovely time here xx really appreciate your help.

Recommended place to stay in Edinburgh, especially for family with children.

Pleasant stay, private in the host,s back garden.

A very nice location in the heart of leith. You find anything you need in the flat and around.
Would definitely come back

Greay location and  enough space for our family of 4. the hosts had a lot of helpful resources on the nearby area and communicated responsively. Perfect apartment for our Edinburgh stay! Excellent location and apartment was very spacious for 3 of us!

Flat is just as advertised. Really nice with plenty of space for the 2 of us. Good central location.

Première fois que nous dormons chez l’habitant. Ce fut 1 court séjour paisible et agréable chez Andrew et Danielle. Nous avons été bien reçu, ainsi que par le chien Bonnie. Nous étions comme à la maison. Nous recommandons fortement cette maison. 🏠

Quiet, very convenient location. Everything as described. Very responsive host.
Très bon séjour

The space worked well for us.  I was thinking based on the map that it was further from old town than it actually was. But it was actually a pretty easy walk. My only not picky complaint is that the king beds are 2 twin beds pushed together and I found it uncomfortable. If the mattresses were a little nicer, the place would be absolutely PERFECT!

Valerie's flat is a wonderful place where you immediately feel like home. The flat is well connected with the bus line to the city Centre. Walking to the city Centre take you about 40 min. My girlfriend and I can only recommend this accommodation.
Really great experience in a nice location, all of the kitchen utensils are ready to us and clean. Would book again

Thank you for a great stay in your Air BnB. It is finished to such a beautiful standard and was such a pleasant place to stay. It was super clean and had everything we needed. Jonathan was a great host and was easily contactable when we needed to get in touch, and very helpful. I would stay in this accommodation again in a heartbeat. Thanks so much

Everything you could ask for in a stay. The room was exactly what I needed for a night, it was clean and quiet. The instructions were clear and Valentina communicated quickly and clearly. Location was great. Would highly recommend booking this room!
Michals place was really comfortable, well equipped and in a great area. Made our stay in Edinburgh that much better. Thanks

Carol's house is really good because of its cleanness and near to the transportation so it is easy to achieve the city center or railway station.

Apartment was spotlessly clean & easy to find, with comfortable beds

From beginning to end it was a great trip. Eddie’s place was exactly as we expected and is central to everything in Edinburgh. Great space well appointed and a great place to spend a vacation
I will definitely be back.

James offers a superb first floor flat, large and comfortable with everything you could wish for.  He is a very thoughtful host and easy to communicate with. We can thoroughly recommend his place to visitors to Edinburgh.

We had a lovely stay, apartment was as described and very comfortable. Very walkable to and from the Royal Mile in 10 mins or so and plenty of small local eateries on the doorstep. Great value stay would recommend.

Sehr freundlich und schnelle Hilfeleistung bei Problemen. Tolle Unterkunft. Sehr gut gelegen mit tollem Blick aufs Meer und sogar die Burg sieht man vom Balkon.
Very Good bedding and very nice appartmnent. Rosie and Nick (and their son) made us feel very welcome. They are beautiful souls. I really recommend these hosts
wonderful stay, the cabin was exactly as pictured and very quiet.

Thanks again for a great stay!
a very nice, clean, comfortable and awesome home to stay, much better than expectation.......

I recommend this place to anyone! I arrived in Edinburgh very late and needed a last minute home, they were very welcoming and the vibes in general were so so lovely, great value for the price and the location is perfect for anyone wanting to get to know Scotland or Edinburgh

Didn’t stay in Edinburgh too long but the place is great. It wasn’t too far from the city if you know how to work the transportation or the uber it wasn’t a high price to get to places like the city center if you don’t want to walk.
Brodie was very responsive and our very few mishaps were easily, I checked out earlier and he was able to accommodate as well as provide extra info on the city prior to the check in, so if you’re looking for a good place and host this is it.
The sofa bed was comfortable as well as the main bedroom, if you don’t want to spend all your money outside on food you can easily get some groceries from the stores nearby to make some food in the kitchen.

Great apartment with plenty of space for everyone. It’s situated in a perfect location right in the centre of Edinburgh! The host was excellent at communication and was always happy to help with any questions.
A very special place to stay. Location couldn't be better. check in was super easy. Absolutely loved the cozy atmosphere and slept like a rock
Der Vermieter sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wohnung sehr gemütlich und sehr gepflegt und sehr sauber. Die Wohnung sehr nah vom royalmile. Besten am Vermieter

Yvonne was a great host too and check-in and out couldn’t have been easier. We’d stay here again in a heartbeat.

It is a really awesome experience staying here. Quite near to the waverly station. The apartment is really cosy and nice. Stuart is really thoughful, leaving all the travel brochures in the room,and keeping the apartment well equipped.

There's some mould around the bathtub sealant - could be replaced. Kitchen sink tap drips at random times - quite annoying if someone is sleeping in the sofa bed, as it does during the night - again something that should be quite easy to fix.
Details like this are important for whoever is staying there - hope this information is useful to the owner.

Excelente opcion para quedarse en el centro de Edimburgo. Las habitaciones son amplias y con camas y sábanas muy cómodas. Los calentadores ayudan mucho con el frío de la ciudad. Iain is a nice host who likes to talk to you and gives very good tips for your visit.

Fantastic host, would happily recommend the accommodation.

Appartement en RDC très bien situé à quelques encablures de l'arrêt de tram, permettant de rejoindre Old Edi très facilement.

We had a great time here, there is more than enough room for four. Hosts were in touch & available throughout our stay. Very close to local grocery stores(one direction) & to the city centre (the other) will definitely be using this one again 😊👏 oh & 5* for the welcome basket

the flat was absolutely amazing. so comfortable and cozy and spacious. either everything you need at hand. the location is one of the best neighborhoods in Edinburgh. for us it was conveniently close to relatves. we will definitely book this again if we come over.

The space is nice because you have privacy in the 2 bedrooms and can spread out with the living room and dining area. 2 Quick Mentions: It does get loud out night with the bars dumping their bottles in the trash bins all night and the seagulls fighting outside the windows. :)  And if you are superstitious just wanted to mention that this apartment is located literally in or around the underground vaults. We took the city of the dead ghost tour the first night which was really cool, but the front door is literally in between the entrance and exits to the vaults. We did not have any ghost encounters, but I did want to mention it in case someone is afraid of spirits. We heard multiple times how our street was one of the most haunted streets in town. So maybe that is a bonus if you are looking for ghost stories. The apartment and location is great though so I would still recommend it.

We had a wonderful stay at the Johnston Apartment. Very unique and interesting flat, comfortable and modern but maintained its historic charm. The host John was very communicative and gave great detail about check in and early drop for our luggage. Location was ideal for touring about Edinburgh, right in the heart of the Royal Mile and easy walk to Grassmarket and Princes Street. We will definitely stay here again when we return to Edinburgh.

Charlotte was a fantastic host and the apartment was superb (it's really hard to beat waking up to a view of a castle). Charlotte was very accommodating as well when our flight was delayed and she was still able to meet us when we got in. She provided a thorough walk-through of the apartment and gave us a great, detailed description of the city and what to see and where to visit. Many thanks!

Lloyd, Hazel, and Alan went above and beyond to help us get set up for our trip to Scotland. We were renting a car and wanted to buy a car seat that our family could take down to England to give to another family member for their little one to use. We needed to get it delivered and they graciously offered to have it delivered to them before we arrived, and they took it to the apartment for us for our arrival. The rooms were clean and well set up, the kitchen was spacious, the patio had an incredible view of the castle. It was a great spot to easily walk right into the thick of things. My only note for other people with any mobility issues at all is that it is up 4 flights of very steep, old, and partially worn away stairs (as is the nature of beautiful ancient cities) and it is above a very loud pub if you have any light sleepers (as is much of Edinburgh generally). Thank you so much Lloyd, Hazel, and Alan!

ottimo alloggio vicino al centro con i mezzi pubblici peccato l'assenza di parcheggio nelle vicinanze ma Daniela ci ha fornito tutte le indicazioni necessarie sia prima che durante il soggiorno grazie.
Loved this flat! Charming and in the best location. Wish I could have stayed longer!

Biggest positives are super clean and tidy, polite and respectful hosts, close to bus stop, great car parking and nice and quiet.
Thank you!
Great stay at a clean, comfortable and convenient apartment in a wonderful area in Edinburgh, in walking distance to all of the main highlights of the city. Great communication and tips from Gary.
Paul's place is great for people who are keen on hostel style of accommodation. The place is in the great area, very close to the center.

Valentina ist eine super nette Gastgeberin. Aufgrund vieler Bewertungen, dass die Wohnung sehr hellhörig zur Straße gelegen sei, wurden wir von ihr klar darauf hingewiesen Oropax mitzunehmen. Im Endeffekt haben meine Freundin und ich die Wohnung als nicht all zu hellhörig empfunden und konnten gut ohne Oropax schlafen. Die Wohnung hat eine sehr gute Lage, ein schönes Café um die Ecke, man ist fußläufig in der Stadt und auch mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut angebunden. Es war alles in allem ein sehr schöner Urlaub.

Such a cozy and welcoming place to stay! The room was spotless, and the bed was incredibly soft and comfortable. After spending a long day exploring Edinburgh city centre, it was the perfect place to unwind and enjoy some peace and quiet.
Robin was a fantastic host—friendly, welcoming, and kind enough to wait for my arrival and personally show me to my room. They also have a very well-behaved and adorable dog, which was a lovely bonus!
I would highly recommend staying here, especially if you’re traveling solo. If you’re traveling with others, they also have other rooms available to suit your needs.

This was a lovely place to stay, location great, apartment spotless and a very helpful host.
Fiona went above and beyond with the flexibility of check in and presentation of property.
Would definitely use again if staying in Edinburgh.

Loved the stay with Deane’s place! I was staying there for 3 nights with my elderly parents. The location was super convenient with bus stop right around the corner and an included go to breakfast. Deane and his daughter were always so responsive and friendly. Normally the check in time is at 2 pm but we had heavy bags and they allowed us an early check in. The room was clean and spacious. The only con about room 7 I could think of is the bathroom area. It’s very compact and my elderly parents found it very hard to take a bath properly. But overall super satisfied with the stay and would highly recommend their place.
Grace was an amazing host. The rental was beautiful and the location was perfect with easily accessible public transit or just a short walk to the city center. I would definitely stay here again!

Place was very clean! A little bit old, furniture wise but beds were good. We got an early check it which was lovely! Was only a little bit of a hassle to find the place after picking up the key but managed to find it.

Three of us stayed in Stoil's flat in January. The location is amazing, located right on the Royal Mile, very close to a number of restaurants, shops and pubs. The flat is easy to reach from the train station, which is also where the airport bus drops off. There is a full-sized bed, along with a full-sized couch bed, which was plenty of room for four people to stay if you don't mind sharing a bed. I highly recommend this flat!
The private room was spacious in a nice apartment. The bed was very comfortable. The host was quick to respond when I had questions and had great restaurant recommendations in the area.

The apartment itself is nice, outside not very much. Neighbors were smoking and the smell creeped inside. And it wasn’t very clean. There was trash on the way.
But the space once you enter is actually clean and nice.

Sandy’s place was great. I stayed in the flat as I was running the Edinburgh marathon and the start line was a 10 minute bus journey away. Very good transport with lots of shops nearby. Good communication from Sandy.

This is a lovely flat, beautifully presented. Lots of space for downtime if required. Ruth the host responded instantly when contacted.  The flat is less than 10 minutes from the Botanic gardens. We would not hesitate to book again in the future.
Great location right on the Royal Mile. Right above the Worlds End pub. Lots of restaurants and shops nearby and easy to walk to destinations!

Our stay with Karen was very comfortable. It was a quiet neighbourhood with an easy connection to the city center by a short walk and bus.
The room and bathroom were very clean and whenever we needed something, Karen was very quick to reply.
Would recommend!
An amazing apartment with super friendly hosts! Would recommend
I honestly can’t recommend this whole experience enough. The location, the attentiveness by Natalie - you’ve just got to do it.
Great location, very clean, ideal for a stay in Edinburgh, would recommend.
Quiet and warm, everything is within walking distance. Nice place for the festival!
Very friendly host.  Nice place.  Just a lot of stairs.  Very warm room.

Myself and two friends had a great time staying at Ds. Fantastic location, easy access and very clean. We were only there for one night but it had everything we needed for a very short and sweet trip to Edinburgh.

Moray is a great and nice person and very helpful. His apartment is very buautiful and clean and well manintined . Best part is bus stops and heymarket and other shops are just 2-3 mins walk.
have a very beautiful big garden.
highly recomended.
Great surroundings, close to the beach and public transport. Amazing host!

Overall it was a great experience! Our first time in a shared apartment and it couldn't have gone better. The room is, however, quite small.
Other than that it was a good experience. Charlotte was extremely responsive and helpful so that was great to see!

Kate’s flat is finished to such a high standard, it’s location is so central and Kate’s prompt response all made this a special place to stay. I would definitely recommend it.
We stayed towards the end of October and the flat is great to dip in and out of depending on the Scottish weather! It’s a short 10min walk to Princes Street or 2 mins to the bus and tram stops.
The flat is light and airy with big windows and high ceilings. Historically Edinburgh’s new town have these big basement flats set back and cut away from the pavement. It easily accommodated 4 adults and 2 children with big enough sofas, dinning table and bathrooms. With all kitchen pieces needed to cook family meals.
The shops and restaurants and popular tourist spots are all close, as well as some less known treats like the walk along the Leith river through Dean village into Stockbridge.
We had a great week there.
Un vaste appartement en plein centre-ville, à proximité du château des restaurants et des pubs.
Suzanna was lovely and very accommodating. Gave wonderful pub suggestions! The room was great and very clean.

Jamie and Helen’s house is a spacious and atmospheric family home in a peaceful rural setting only 25 minutes from central Edinburgh. We were 14 adults and we were very comfortable- not just in terms of bedrooms and bathrooms but also with the multiple reception rooms that allowed us to congregate in little or large groups, as well as finding peaceful spots to work or read.
The July/ August weather was very wet but we managed to fit in a few hours on the tennis court (playable but in need of some TLC) and did a huge and successful barbecue in the rain, thanks to the quirky barbecue hut!
It’s very much a family home still, which adds a lot of atmosphere and history to the already historic building. If you want a bland, modern and minimalist space, this is definitely not your choice. But if you’d like to experience how the British upper classes live their lives, then this is very much your happy place.
Expect a warm welcome. Just a short bus or tram trip into Edinburgh city centre, or a 30 minute walk. Very handy for Murrayfield.

Nuestra estadía con Julia fue excelente! Su casa está muy bien ubicada, fácil acceso a las principales atracciones de Edimburgo (de hecho, nos resultó un excelente punto medio entre la vieja y la nueva ciudad). Nuestro vuelo salió retrasado, llegamos de madrugada, y Julia igual nos esperó para recibirnos y enseñarnos el lugar. Es una anfitriona espectacular, amable y atenta a todo! Gracias Julia por todo, fueron unos días increíbles!! Volveremos!

Perfect location with everything from the airport to Brittania accessible from the tram stop just metres away. All of Edinburgh’s city highlights including red buses, art galleries, the Royal Mile as well as restaurants and pubs within easy reach. Thanks again Margaret.

Diese Unterkunft war eine der schönsten auf unserer Rundreise.
Sie ist ganz toll und modern eingerichtet und wirklich super ausgestattet.
Der Check-in war flexibel und das Parken vor der Tür war auch mit einem großen Auto wirklich kein Problem.
Wir haben uns echt total wohl gefühlt und würden diese Unterkunft jederzeit weiterempfehlen.
Mairi selbst ist auch ganz herzlich und jederzeit erreichbar 🤎🍀

Di’s beautiful home was a perfect fit for our extended family. It met every need … and more! The home was exceptionally clean, spacious, and incredibly comfortable. After each long days of touring the enchanting city of Edinburgh, we loved “coming home” to relax!
Di met our family upon check in and walked through the home with us. She also provided a notebook with very helpful and detailed information to assist us during our stay.
Di’s communication was exceptional before, during and after our visit. Wow!
Di and Eddie felt like friends when we left after our one week stay. If we are blessed with the opportunity to return to Scotland, we would DEFINITELY stay at Di’s lovely home!
Very rapid response! And suitable for family trip’s apartment!

Beautiful flat in an amazing location. Central so can be used to explore Edinburgh easily on foot but also right next to Haymarket train station so easy access to the rest of Scotland.
Despite being so central and close to transport links the flat is very quiet and feels very private. Great for relaxing and unwinding at the end of the day.
Jake’s communication was perfect and he was always on hand when we needed to ask anything.
Highly recommend for anyone looking to visit Edinburgh.

Leiligheten var akkurat som forventet. Den ligger i et rolig område, med kort avstand til kollektivtrafikk og restauranter og barer.
Fiona var også usedvanlig god til å kommunisere i forkant av oppholdet, med tydelige instruksjoner og gode tips til hvordan vi skulle komme oss frem, og hva vi skulle gjøre i nærområdet.n
Vi storkoste oss her! Anbefales på det sterkeste!
Well arranged and nice spot

Very nice flat in an excellent location. There are some really nice local amenities within a couple of minutes walk but the city centre is only around 20 minutes away as well.
The flat itself is very pleasant, very neat and comes with everything you'd expect for your stay, and the host Kieron was very helpful and informative, arriving and responding without delay whenever needed.
We would highly recommend this place and would happily stay again in the future.

Very friendly welcome, you feel comfortable immediately. Very quiet and cosy, near bus stations, city centre can easily be reached.
Anne-Marie is a super-host!!!

Genuinely the perfect place for our long weekend in Edinburgh for my 30th Birthday with friends and family, and to run the marathon. Fantastic location, spotless and beautiful house with enough space and bathrooms. Will not hesitate to return or recommend to others! Loved it and thanks to Lizzie for making it such a pleasure.
Great location, very clean and comfortable room, bathroom and kitchen, super friendly and helpful host. Highly recommended!

Lovely, comfortable, sparkling clean apartment with all the amenities necessary.  Cosy heating, comfortable beds and lounge room with lovely bathrooms.  It was perfect for our stay in Edinburgh. Great location near Arthur’s Seat / Holyrood Palace and a beautiful 15 min walk to centre of the Old Town. Taxis easy to get and affordable if too tired for walking. Local supermarket within easy walking distance. Very high quality Air bnb. Host a breeze to communicate with. Highly recommend.
the place was comfortable for our family of 4, the beds are comfortable and we had enough space. very responsive host and pleasant communication. I would stay here again!
Kirstyさんありがとうございました。お借りしたお部屋は綺麗で、居心地が良かったです。事前にオススメのスポットやレストランも教えていただきエディンバラ観光を非常に楽しめました。Kirstyさんはとても親切でお人柄もよく、素敵な方でした！

Apart from arriving to find there was no hot water and the sink in the bathroom was clogged, we had a really pleasant stay! We loved the little details, the books and the record player. Great location too, in a very quiet neighbourhood and close to the airport. Definitely recommend!
Great location and perfect stay.

Communication with Stoil was without any trouble. Always very kind and perfectly guides to the place and also a very nice contact with the service-team which let us in and explained everything. The flat is really nice and in a very good location. Almost 5 min into the old city! Perfect also for 5 people we had enough space...
I only recommend to stay at Stoils.
We have been going to the Fringe for over a decade and this is the best accommodation we have found.
Great spot to explore Edinburgh from. Well connected public transport and near the beach! Had everything you could need, lovely and quiet. Perfect little get away.
Very spacious house and close to amenities . Parking was a bit of a problem as there was no street parking beside the house.

Angie's flat is is so conveniently located and also spotless and very comfortable. We had a fabulous time there! It was easy to check in and out. I highly recommend it. Thanks again Angie!
This is a great apartment to stay, short walk to the Edinburgh Mile.  It was great to have parking as this is not always available in a city.  A very well appointed, cosy apartment.
Great stay, thanks Victor for flexibility with check in and for being so reactive when we had the key issue. Would definitely stay again.
Great flat, within walking distance of everything you need for a city break!
Perfect quiet apartment in great location for Stockbridge, botanical gardens and New Town

Steve was great, and the apartment beautiful.  A historic, yet nicely updated place.  One bathroom has a really great rainfall shower head and the kitchen is new and very nice.  There is an uphill walk to the area near Waverly train station, but only about a 10 minute walk.  Easy tram service to the airport a couple blocks away, also many pubs and restaurants a short walk away.  One pub is a few doors away, but very quiet neighborhood.  Check in was easy with the lockbox.  Place is very roomy and clean.  Would definitely stay again.

My family had a great time and truly enjoyed staying here. Convenient Location, clean and spacious apartment, also including the car park permit. Fast response, and helpful from Barry. I definitely recommend it to my friends.

Lovely well decorated flat with lots of space. Easy distance from most of the sights in on Edinburgh.
100% would recommend!

Everything went smoothly from start to finish. Julie replied to all my messages promptly and though she wasn't there in person to greet us her lovely parents were and made us feel very welcome. A little food essential pack was left for us which was a fantastic touch and totally unexpected but very much appreciated. Our first time using Airbnb has been great and we will most certainly consider it again. Will most definitely recommend Julies flat in Queenserry.
Couldn't get a better location if you're wanting to explore the heart of Edinburgh. A homely and really spacious apartment, everything you need.
fantastic stay in a beautiful flat, thanks Sean and Sally!

Great location by the coast and good transport into town. Jana was generally very helpful with any questions, check-in instructions were very clear.
We were a bit surprised by the quality of the flat on arrival as it is need of TLC, it’s a reasonable new build and feels cheaply built as many are; it isn’t aging well. The photos look a lot newer than the current state, the room we stayed in had cheap foam squares on one wall for noise and black plastic over one of the mirrored doors.
The room was comfortable but feels a bit neglected and smelt very strongly of cleaning products. The bed was very comfortable and the view very nice, especially the sun rise.
The bathroom fan wasn’t working and felt a bit damp with signs of mould.
The kitchen was a good size but felt neglected with one of the gas burners not working. It looks like the wrong flame heads are used as gas gently leaks out when used.
Nice stay but a bit expensive for the quality.

We had a wonderful stay at Alex’s Airbnb! The home was clean, quiet, and well equipped with everything we needed. The host was incredibly kind and responsive whenever we had questions.
The overall space is on the smaller side, if you are traveling with a lot of luggage note there is limited closet space and minimal extra storage, while this wasn’t a big issue it is something to keep in mind. There are also a few flights of stairs you need to climb to access the home. (No elevator) The bathroom is small but well kept. We appreciated the wonderful shower with excellent hot water after a long cold day.
Overall we enjoyed the location, with absolutely fantastic views of the castle and appreciated the thoughtful little amenities of tea, coffee and snacks that were provided as well! It was a delightful stay!
Great location and lovely place to stay. Would definitely stay there again!

The apartment is amazing and Andrew was a great host. Good location about 20-25 min from the centre by bus, the station is right outside the building. We had a lovely experience and would recommend this place.

Excellent hosts, great place and amenities. Ideal if you want to visit Edinburgh with easy links to tram and buses and train to Edinburgh. Shopping centre nearby. Vicky & John were brilliant!
Would certainly stay here again.

Millie's apartment is ideally situated in Edinburgh. Its quirky and goergously decorated while having hime from home comfort. Millie is a 5 star communicator and went the extra mile to make our stay as personal and special as possible. We will definitely be back!

The apartment was very big and beautiful. There was a lot of dust and ditt on the floors but atleast the bathroom and kitchen was very clean. It was also kind of hard to understand the lock since we didn't have any clear instructions with the two locks, however the beds and stay overall was very pleasent and we would come back again.

Nice place in the old town of Edinburgh, perfect for 3 people. Walking distance to most places in the city. The host was nice and welcoming. We could leave our luggage before check-in, which was very convenient. The standard of the flat is like most places in Edinburgh, but perfect for a long weekend.

Muy bien ubicado (algo ruidosa la calle, sobre todo para el dormitorio que da a ella).

This was such a lovely experience.  Everything was walking distance. Great shops and restaurants in the neighborhood. Our hosts made it easy to check in and out. We will be staying here again on our next trip to Edinburgh.  Thank you.

This was a great place to stay .Bus stop literally around the corner  and tram service a short walk which gave us flexibility in travelling to the city centre. Eateries and food store close by The location very peaceful. The property was pristine. It had everything we needed ,private . Great overall.  Will be staying again. Highly recommended
Perfect location for a weekend at the Fringe, especially with the tram now in Leith. Miranda was an excellent host!

Great places to crash on a budget. £30 a head and we managed to crash for one night as our flight from Edinburgh was cancelled.
Perfect to stay for a single night where you need a bed for the night.

We had a lovely stay! The house is just like the pictures: cozy, warm, and very comfortable. The kitchen is fully equipped, which was a big plus. The location is perfect, surrounded by shops and restaurants, though being on a busy street means you’ll hear people chatting outside at night.
A couple of tips for future guests: the Wi-Fi can be a bit unstable at times, and if you are tall, watch your head in the top bunk! Overall, the house rules are very clear, we felt very welcome, and we would definitely stay here again.

The lock was annoying. Had to wait 10 minutes to enter the property. Instructions was very clear, so it was easy check in without any hassles. The rooms were clean and same as pictures.
TV wasn’t smart, so had to watch local channels.
What I really loved is the Location. A very convenient spot for us to travel to the old and new town.

Stayed here for an extended weekend, so the closeness to the city center (just a short walk) really came in handy. The place was spacious and everything worked just fine. Sadly didn’t get to use the pool because they had closed it a bit early, but the possibility is nice to have. Owner was always available if we had questions and was quick to help.
Over all enjoyed our stay here.
Violeta et Sam sont très accueillants et leur appartement est très chaleureux. C’est avec plaisir que nous  les recommandons.
Great host and home!

Was a great place to stop.

Place is located near center around 35 mins walking distance to princess street. Park just infront house. Walking distance to sea side, both ways. Near Arthurs seat, and Calton hill. Séjour agréable d’une semaine en début septembre 2025. Le logement offre le nécessaire pour passer du bon temps après les visites de cette très belle ville. Je ne peux que conseiller ce logement pour visiter Édimbourg (en plus, nous pouvons nous garer gratuitement dans la rue).
Un appartement cosy, très propre et fonctionnel  avec une magnifique vue sur le château. Aileen est à l’écoute et disponible pour toute demande. Je recommande à 100%.
A perfect place for shorter or even longer stay. The hosts were very friendly and accommodating, and made my stay pleasant.

The flat is in a great location, very central to old town and the castle.
We had ongoing issues with the electronic lock on the front door. When we were on the way to the airbnb from the airport we still had not received instructions for how to enter the flat, Altido was responsive and sent the link after we asked. The electronic lock was actually a link to a website where you had to unlock the door from your phone. This was a problem when we didn’t have good cell service or the website wouldn’t load. Luckily between my partner and I, usually one of us would eventually get it to work.
Just be aware that you must have good cell service to be able to unlock the door (and don’t let your phone die).
The flat could use some upgrades, the pillows were awful and we actually went to the store nearby and bought our own. The bathroom could also use a trash can.
Overall we had a nice stay and the Altido team was friendly.

Great location! An easy walk to the Royal Mile, as well as restaurants and coffee shops. Bathroom was clean, beds were comfortable, though the they were smaller than advertised (queen and full sized, not king and queen). The freezer in the kitchen was broken, I assume, because there was a small freezer sitting in the corner, plus one of the cabinet drawers was broken. The place was very quaint though, and fit the bill for what we needed.
Very comfortable and well located flat.
Everything was perfect, great and quiet place to relax in the centre of city

The hosts were very friendly and welcoming. They were present on check in. Lovely apartment in older style, nice features include a second WC and Sky TV in both bedroom and main room. The mansion itself needs some upkeep. A very good stay.

Schönes Appartement in guter Lage.
Die Straße hat viele Unterkünfte,deshalb ist es nachts oft laut. Auch das Haus selbst ist etwas hellhörig.

The apartment is beautiful, clean and tidy. Lewis really takes care of every detail, and it’s equipped with everything you might need for a few days in Edinburgh. The breakfast he prepares every morning was delicious and really saved us. Highly recommended!

David was so helpful providing recommendations for places to visit and things to do that we wished we could have spent more time in Edinburgh! He was very welcoming and friendly, doing all he could to provide a true home away from home. I'd gladly stay with him again in the future.
Superb as always. Near the airport but rural and really quiet, and a short drive, uber, or walk and tram from Edinburgh. Highly recommended.

Steven could not have been nicer, and his flat was cozy as well as practical. Perhaps the best was our interactions and getting to know more about each other. On the whole, loved every bit of the stay!
Die Unterkunft hat sehr viel Flair und ist super gelegen. Ganz in der Nähe findet man mehrere empfehlenswerte Gaststätten und das Zentrum kann man in wenigen Minuten zu Fuss erreichen.
Exceptionally clean, well-stocked kitchen including plenty of basics for cooking. Lovely space and great location, will be back.

Unfortunately, I had to cancel this booking after only 20 minutes in the accommodation. On entering the shared access, myself and my son were met by a strong smell of cannabis. The apartment also smelt, in particular the bedroom. Even with ventilation, the smell was so strong it gave my son a headache. As a lone parent, travelling with a minor, I contacted the host with my concerns. After an hour and 45 minutes, of the host reading my message, but receiving no reply, I contacted Air B&B Support, who acted very promptly due to nature of the concern, and advised me to seek alternative accommodation. The host had offered to attend the apartment to use a device to remove smells, but we were advised we could not be in the property for 2 hours after, and this would not be done until the morning. Thankfully, I were able to find a last minute hotel for our 4 night stay.
When returning to the accommodation to collect our belongings, the host was there, to tell me, he could not smell cannabis!

Arvin was a fantastic host and even stayed up as our flight was delayed. We arrived to him making us a fresh cup of Iranian tea and he served it with some biscuits. A really lovely gesture after a tiring journey to Edinburgh. His home is truly beautiful and the photos do not do it justice, it was perfectly homey. Arvin was a very considerate and caring host. I would recommend staying here as it is a great base and in the middle of everything. If I ever return I would certainly book here. Thanks again for your hospitality Arvin! 😊
Very friendly and helpful.  Great location. Would recommend
Great location - within walking distance from main attractions and just across from park with playground which our two years old loved.
quiet and near the city centre. i loved it.

I had a great stay at Hatice’s property! The room and bathroom were clean. The main entrance was clean and easy to walk through as well! Plutôt bien situé, il y a des restaurants/bars et supermarché proches mais la rue est quand même calme. L'appartement est assez bien aménagé cependant gros problème de gestion du chauffage !

The room is very comfortable and tidy. The host is very enthusiastic. I had a happy holiday：）
Very clean, very central location.
rachel is very friendly and kind went the extra mile. i would recommend this gaff to anyone. very modern property and quiet area.

We had a lovely stay! The flat looks just like the pictures (very authentic impression). Easy to get into the city centre (by bus or by walking). Great location
Great staff
All around great and will return soon

Nuestra estancia fue perfecta. El alojamiento tiene una localización muy buena y en 10 minutos estás en el centro . We had a great stay at Nicola’s apartment. It was comfortable, warm and in a great location. Nicola herself was brilliant and very communicative!

Joyce is a really kind lady and perfect very caring hostess. The flat is very clean and cosy. We liked her and her place very much. It is close to transportation ,calm place .Walkable to main city attractions And we would totally recommend the place for travellers to stay.

It's a really nice, well-equipped place in a great location for our needs. Colin is a thoughtful and responsive host. We would stay here again.

Fantastic communication from Fiona. Beautiful clean and well equipped apartment. Nice decor and the Christmas tree in the lounge was a really lovely unexpected extra.
Would definitely recommend as really easy access to town centre on very frequent buses. Also taxis were not expensive on the couple of occasions we used them.
All beds were super comfy, which made our stay even more comfortable. Thank you, it was an absolute pleasure staying here.
Really good communication and helpful. The location of the flat is perfect. The flat itself has all what‘s needed.
Sam is a greaaaaat host and staying at his cozy place makes my memory with Edinburgh better.
A perfect place for a short stay. Great location with easy access into town. We managed to park outside which was a bonus. Very clean and comfortable.

Wow! Doesn't begin to describe the great experience I had staying in Steve's amazing flat.

Wonderful place as described! Laura was a friendly host and willing to help anytime. Easy access to public transport.

Great host who gave us info about the local area.  Really well-placed flat, close to everything.

wonderfuI place and a great host! she has taken great care of her place and it gives a very homely feeling. the location is superb and offers convenient connection in to the city. would definitely stay again and recommend to other visitors to Edinburgh!

Great place to stay! Awesome host and very informative. Would 10/10 recommend to others.

This place is as described, it is not one of those places that has all the perfect amenities and an abundance of pillows and knickknacks everywhere. It’s more like a just fine workspace and sleep space if you are in Edinburgh for business and just need someplace to stay. The bed in the living room could use some extra boards underneath it so that you don’t sink in where the boards are not. The location was just fine, there is a large Muslim community in the area and so it is quite relaxed and quiet. The shower is not very large at all so if you are turning around or be bending down to pick something up, that’s on the floor of the shower might require you to open the shower door. Also take care not to pull on the showerhead as it will come out from the wall. If a contractor did the work to get this place ready they were not a very good contractor. All that said, we had a fine time and the place was completely adequate.

The house is located in a very beautiful and quiet neighborhood, just 10 minutes by bus or a 30‑minute walk from the city center. The room had everything we needed, and the bed was very comfortable. I absolutely loved my time spent in Edinburgh and staying at Marghe’s AirBnB. She was such a friendly and welcoming host. Easy to talk to and so generous with her space. Great location to enjoy the city which is literally on the doorstep.  Flat was all it said it would be and Dunc and Dee were speedy in their responses even when the questions were stupid!! Good accommodation close to the centre of Edinburgh with free parking on site!  Nice cosy 2nd floor flat that was family friendly and close to local amenities which made travelling with our little boy much easier and less stressful.

Great stay! Very clean and Thaiha was very kind. She even offered to take our bags when we arrived early which was brilliant. Would stay again!

The apartment was clean, well equipped and quiet. Also the beds were comfortable.

So many perks to tempt us thanks!  Lovely AirBnB that we thoroughly enjoyed.  The bed was one of the most comfortable and cosy.  We highly recommend this place!

Très bel appartement, bien décoré. Emplacement au calme tout en étant proche du centre. Je recommande!

Kirstys lägenhet överensstämde med beskrivning, bilder och våra förväntningar. Modernt, rent, bekvämt.

Great location with easy access. Susan is very friendly and helpful.

Très bon logement qualité/prix/prestations recommandé pour 8 ou 9 personnes, mais pas 10.

The apartment was incredible. It had everything we needed (and more!). We enjoyed sifting through the wide assortment of books in very peaceful surroundings and stepping out to the pub to see local musicians. It was a stay we will always remember.

We were pleasantly surprised at how spacious the apartment was. It’s a great size and felt very cosy. The apartment was clean and tidy, with towels shampoos and body wash provided for each person. The property is in a great location and was walkable from all the main sights with lots of restaurants, cafes and bars in the immediate area. The nearest tesco was also only a couple of minutes away by foot too which was very handy. All in all, if you’re staying in Edinburgh I would highly recommend this property!

Stayed here for 4 nights, while on a girls get away! Apartment was in the PERFECT location! The view of the castle was incredible!
The apartment was well stocked, had everything we needed, super spacious much bigger than it looked in photos!
Host was incredible, we had a few issues while we were there but all were either resolved quickly or feedback taken into account graciously!
I will say that the apartment is on the 4th floor so there are a lot of stairs (but there are everywhere in Edinburgh!)
Would 1000% stay here again!
The place felt like home , exactly as the picture , the host was responsive. I have no negative comments. Thank you for the treats the cookies and the jelly bean and we had fruits as well  ☺️☺️

The home was spacious , very well furnished and in a great area
Close to city center yet quiet.
Host was so responsive before and during stay.  Response time was impressive.  Devoted host ! Amazing place and host.

This flat is fantastic for a stay in Edinburgh and the location is perfect! The only downside was the $84USD cleaning fee that is not accounted for in the advertised price until you go to request your stay. This makes the advertised price a little misleading since the fee is on the expensive side. Overall, my stay was amazing and I would recommend this flat to others!

This apartment is the perfect stylish getaway! My friend and I spent four nights here and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The longest walk to anywhere is about half and hour but we got bus day passes each day which were four pounds that made getting around so easy and the bus stop is only a couple metres from the doorstep with constant buses to the city centre, which was an amazing surprise! There is Edinburgh bus station we used about five minutes away that we used to store our luggage on our final day after check out which was very reasonable and spacious.
Calum was a pleasure to talk to and was so helpful with any questions we had. We got gorgeous biscuits and breakfast on arrival which was so nice considering how early we arrived. If I ever came back to Edinburgh (which I 100% plan to after this trip) I will definitely be trying to book Calum’s place again!
There is Sainsbury’s right across the road, so many good food places nearby and a cafe right outside the front door so in terms of locations it was incredible! The apartment itself is beautiful and extremely clean! The bed was very comfortable as well. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Edinburgh
Just the ticket

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Cary est une personne très agréable et conviviale.
Sa maison est décorée avec beaucoup de goût et bien tenue.
Il y a des arrêts de bus à proximité et de nombreux restaurants.
La vieille ville est à 15-20 mn à pieds.
The apartment is in a great and vibrant area, many pubs and shops in the streets! A cozy little home!
Another nice stay in Meera’s cosy place. Lots of generous, thoughtful touches, and a great location for getting in and out of Edinburgh.
The apartment  was roomy, quiet and in a great location.  Easy walk to lots of areas. Katie was very helpful and friendly.

Everything about this flat is simply perfect. Anna and Ian are gracious and kind. The location is fantastic, the flat is modern, tasteful and impeccably clean. The icing on the cake is their lovey little dog, Douglas, who befriended our dog Sherlock. He quite stole our hearts.
I’d rate this a solid 20 out 10 and hope to be back.
Very well located appartement in Edinburgh, with plenty of amenities in the surroundings. Paul always responded quickly to my messages. I definitely recommend this place!

I stayed with Margaret after a long tour through the beautiful Highlands, I was exhausted and Margaret was very lovely. The stay and her hospitality was the best and the chat was very enjoyable and rewarding.
The town is easy to get to by bus and also very close to the airport. I had a cosy and energising stay thanks to Margaret's hospitality.

Charlie's apartment is the best way to live your holiday in Scotland. It is a very comfortable apartment with all the confort you might need during your staying. The kitchen is very well furnished and we were able to have breakfast and dinner home in a couple of occasions. There is a big couch were you can relax and watch tv after the long walks and activities. The bed is comfortable and the restroom clean. Checking in and out was pretty easy as Charlie ia very responsive and helpful. The position ia great either to walk or take public transportation to the main locations and attractions.
We hope we can go back soon!
This place was wonderful for our stay in Edinburgh. Very walkable to public transit and very tidy.

Staying at Karen's house made us feel like arrived home. The room is very clean and tidy. The beds are very comfortable. Chris helped us to carry our luggage upstairs. I enjoyed the green house and the tree house build by him. We enjoyed chatting with them. Karen suggested where to park the car and the way to drive to York which is very helpful. The breakfast is great. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place. Thank you very much Karen and Chris!
Good place to stay.

A really excellent flat. Lots of room and cozy beds—we especially liked the twin bed set—and modern conveniences. There Visitors should be aware the WiFi is indeed slow and what’s more my US Verizon phone got a poor signal in the apartment. But if you’re in the center of Edinburgh why be online?

The en-suite room is very nice, with a lovely high ceiling. it's also located in a beautiful part of New Town - within walking distance of town centre. Only negative was the comfort of the bed - it would benefit from a new more comfortable mattress
Muy buena ubicación y apartamento agradable y luminoso pero para 5 personas es muy justa ya que no tiene mesa para más de dos personas y la escalera de acceso al tercer piso es angosta.
Thank you so much Calim, your flat is so nice and we loved all the little touches. We had a great weekend, what an fabulous location. We will be back:)

Le logement est très beau, une vie de château, dans un lieu extraordinaire. Au calme mais pas loin d’Edimbourg. Le lit de la chambre est extrêmement confortable.
Les canapés conviennent à 2 enfants comme dit dans l’annonce.
Je vais conseiller ce logement à toutes mes connaissances!
This could not be a more perfect location for a visit a to Edinburgh. It’s also a beautiful apartment, and we could not have been happier there!

Fully recommended . We have such a great time at Ally´s place. The Room is beautifull and very comfortable, nothing missing in our opinion. Ally is super friendly and very good advisor for secret spots around her place :) !  If we return to beautifull Edimburgh, we will look to stay with her again. Cheers Ally :)

The flat is an absolute treasure, from the cheerful orange door to the cosy sound of the record player, such beautiful decor and overall vibe, we loved it. The location of the flat was perfect for us, Portabello is lovely and quiet, felt very safe and being situated on the coast was amazing for seaside walks, best of both worlds as the bus route into the centre was so straightforward and the bus stop was just opposite the door! Parking was free and nearby, Aldi walking distance too, cafes and shops. Only downside was that we were two friends sharing the space and there isn’t much privacy, I only had a curtain to separate my single bedroom and the bathroom door was quite ‘gappy’ so I feel this would be better suited to couples sharing the double room. The mattress in the single room is uncomfortable and single bed wasn’t made up on arrival but I found the bedding in the wardrobe, would benefit from a topper perhaps. Also no TV. Thanks for having us, lovely flat and Edinburgh is a dream!

This is a lovely apartment in Edinburgh Old Town. It is clean and well equipped. It was a very easy walking distance into the centre of Edinburgh with plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. Communication was clear and she responded quickly to my messages. I would recommend this location
Nous avons passé un super week-end chez Harry. L’appartement est très bien situé.
Good location, nice clean apartment. Could have done with some more wine glasses / water glasses etc as there wasn’t enough for 4. Rebecca was a good host and always replied quickly.
Great location and a nice place. They were courteous and easy going. Thanks!

We had a great stay at this flat and thought the location was perfect for our time in Edinburgh. It's located on a quite and charming street and was easy enough to walk to anywhere we wanted to go in the city.

Great Apartment - clean and spacious.  It was  a pity the sauna wasn't working or that we weren't told about this beforehand.  Impossible to shower in the ensuite as water fluctuated between boiling and cold.  Whilst it is an appartment for 6, the amount of hot water does not enable 6 people to shower consecutively.  One of the plugs for the heaters was fixed whilst we we there, which was appreciated, but unfortunately after that the heaters in the other two bedrooms did not work!

Excellent host who provided all the information we needed prior to our arrival and once there about the local area too. Everything we required was in the accommodation which was well presented. For us a 40 minute walk into the centre of Edinburgh but the bus stops for the centre or Leith we’re only a short walk away. No problem with parking as we were able to use the driveway, in any case lots of street parking available. Highly recommended for your Edinburgh stay.

Le séjour chez Isabella était super!
C'est une hôte adorable et elle a été aux petits soins dès mon arrivée, s'assurant que je ne manquais de rien durant tout mon séjour.
Elle a aussi été de très bon conseil et à su me renseigner si j'avais des questions.
La chambre est spacieuse, très propre, lumineuse et calme.

l'endroit est facilement accessible, il y a de nombreux bus à proximité et le centre ville est à 25 minutes à pied.

Merci à Isabella pour son accueil et sa sympathie.
As a woman that travels alone, I had a very good experience staying here!
Konumu merkeze yakındı old Town 10 dakika da ulaşabildik. Tren garına ve otobüs duraklarına da yakindi. Tekrar gelirsem burada kalırım. Mutfak araç gereçleri gayet yeterliydi. Banyo da temizdi.
A very nicely decorated flat in a great location with views of Edinburgh Castle. Sean and Dean were excellent hosts.

The apartment was fantastic, very clean and modern. John was also a fantastic host and answered every question we had within a matter of minutes. We stayed over christmas and had a wonderful time in Edinburgh, both outside the apartment and inside it :) I will most definitely book Johns apartment again as it was perfect for my small family. Its a 10 out of 10 for us <3
David’s place is great, it’s private but not a far walk into the main areas of the city. David’s friendly and welcoming, I definitely recommend this stay.

Bit of a rough check in but I think this is a one off situation. The host seems like an overall lovely person. Place was clean, outside area was a bit sketchy but still safe inside. Floors were creaky and the other tenants were moving around a lot during late and early hours. Overall though, I would recommend this place for those looking for a good deal. Thanks for your hospitality, Lukasz!
For anyone who wants to spend time on the Upper End of the Royal, Paul’s apartment is a superb place to stay.  Clean, good beds, and nice kitchen.
A wonderful stay at a cosy apartment,  not too far from the city center and other points of interest.  Elaine was a great host. Thank you!

Tessa's flat is beautiful and extremely stylish. Everything was clean and comfortable and the freshly baked bread every morning was a treat. Tessa was a friendly and accommodating host. Highly recommended!
Zoals omschreven
我非常喜欢Edi的房子，明亮又干净。卧室够宽敞。洗手间也非常的宽大和干净。附近有公交车很快就直达市中心，交通很方便。能住在这非常满意和开心。感谢Edi和她丈夫的友好接待。是一个绝对要推荐给大家的房源！

It’s a dorm. But a good one. Something affordable that also has a provate bathroom and a kitchen.
Rather firm mattresses.
Paul was very accommodating and his place was exactly as described. Would stay there again if I go back to Edinburgh

Perfekt für eine kurze Nacht vor einem sehr frühen Flug zurück nach Hause. Wir konnten schon früher in die Unterkunft und unsere Sachen dort lassen. So hatten wir noch einen entspannten Zwisxhenstopp mit Stadtbummel in Edinburgh.

Perfectly located for exploring th city on foot, with close proximity to the Edinburgh conference center. It's professionally run, with the kitchen generally well-equipped. Lots of condiments etc left behind by previous guests which was appreciated. Yes it's a multi-story climb up the stairs but you're above any street noise - it's peaceful. The lock on the main door to the street didn't always latch shut.
Mansarda piccola e accogliente, una chicca.

Absolutely fantastic stay at Susie's! The apartment is just beautiful, great size, lovely living space, comfy beds, and really good location.
Susie is a great communicator, and was helpful.
Definitely recommended.

It is no exaggeration when I say Jessica IS THE BEST HOST you'll find in Edinburgh. She fed me when the cafes were closed, helped me navigate the city and very kindly even helped me get my forgotten belongings back. Go ahead and book this place without a single more thought. The house is absolutely incredible, full of art and easily one of the best b&bs I've stayed at! ✨
房间非常干净，设施齐全，地理位置优越，离超市和旅游景点很近！非常友好的房东！推荐给大家！

Nice apartment in a multi flatted complex. We were a bit concerned that it would be quite noisy but on the night we stayed it was very quiet. Well equipped kitchen and excellent guidance notes - very helpful. One or two small enhancements would make it even better but air lock in water system to sort the knocking noise needs attention. Served our purpose well. Thanks

숙소위치가 굉장히 좋았습니다. 이백년된 숙소라고해서 좀 걱정많았는데 깔끔하고 아름다웠습니다. 조금 삐그덕거리는 소리가 거슬릴수도 있겠지만 저는 옛느낌이 나서 좋았습니다.

Kasdeer was so accommodating!  He let us in early after a red eye flight so we could rest even before the cleaning was done. And didn't mind helping with luggage. Great or even awesome location.  Lots of value!!

We had a lovely stay. Simon was very helpful and responsive to any messages. The flat was as described, clean and easy to find. Access was by key safe which was easy to find and use. Thank you for everything.
Great place, very helpful with check in and recommendations. Walking distance to a lot of highlights.

I had a great stay! Gerry (Carol’s husband, as I did not get to meet Carol) was a super nice host, he came to find me when I couldn’t find the place (due to my lack of orientation skills), and the place had everything I needed! I would come back there without hesitation :)

La casa de Lyn es muy acogedora. La habitación tiene ventanas amplias a un jardín espacioso y sin ruidos.
La cama es amplia y confortable.
El aseo es muy correcto. La ducha con agua caliente y buena presión es muy relajante después de un día de caminatas.
El trato con Lyn es muy respetuoso, ella te acoge y te pregunta lo que necesitas de forma cocreta pero no invade tu espacio. El barrio es perfecto a 15 minutos del centro de Edinburgo a pie, o en pocos minutos con autobuses. Es un barrio tranquilo y seguro.
Tiene un perro muy simpático que se llama Dex y le encanta recibir visitas. Al marcharnos se puso en la puerta para despedirse también.
Estancia muy agradable.
David’s place was clean with comfortable beds. A five minute walk to tram or bus stop and good access to Edinburgh.

Myself and my boyfriend had a lovely stay in this boutique apartment during the Edinburgh Fringe Festival.
The apartment had everything we needed. Jennifer had even left homemade lemon loaf for us and homemade jams in the fridge along with milk, eggs, bread and butter.. Lovely touch!
We had our inlaws staying for one night and slept on the sofa which turned into a bed which they had no complaints about.
The apartment is in the basement but it had has lots of light, very private and quiet.
The location of the apartment is ideal. Close to a few cafes, bakeries and newsagents and just a 10minute walk (uphill) into the centre of Edinburgh on Princes Street.
The only negative is that the wifi wasn't set up as we were the first guests in the apartment but we found cafes nearby that had wifi we could use.
I would definitely stay here again and recommend to family/friends.
Thanks for having us as your first guests Jennifer!!
John ha estado pendiente en todo momento y el piso era tal cual se describía y la ubicación inmejorable. La decoración nos ha encantado!

Perfect position to explore Edinburgh, really close to the royal mile and all the main sights. Lovely apartment with everything you need. Despite not meeting Jon he was really helpful and even accomodated us storing our bags as we had a later flight. Would definitely reccomend.
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and ideally located. The host was wonderful. Highly recommend!

I had a beautiful stay! Rubi was so welcoming and friendly, I felt right at home while staying there. Nothing was ever too big to ask. She was just lovely! My only comment would be the parrot and baby are quiet loud at times but aside from that, I had a perfect stay and would definitely come again

Tom was an excellent host who provided clear and easy instructions on finding and accessing the property. The flat was in a great location close to the meadows park and near lots of great restaurants and bars in the southside. I found it surprisingly quiet at night considering its location. The flat had everything we needed for a couple of days in Edinburgh.

The entrance and stairway to the room was dingy and depressing… the room itself did not look well maintained we’ll see around the baseboards and corners, etc. I was there for a wedding and I was by far paying more than anybody else in the area. The refrigerator was outside of the kitchen. I enjoyed the bedroom and the living room.
Roy and Selena were very helpful and responsive. The flat is clean and well equipped, and very near bus routes taking you into the city. Thank you!

Paulina es una anfitriona muy atenta, el apartamento es tal cual se describe en las fotos, la limpieza es buena, pero depende de las personas que hayan estado antes, los utensilios de cocina podrían estar más limpios, aún que Paulina siempre está atenta en que la limpieza esté de 10.
Lo recomiendo al 100% y si vuelvo a Edimburgo , me volveré a alojar aquí.
Lovely big room in  a great location in Edinburgh

The flat was lovely and in a great location. Warm, clean and a great size. As others have said, the boiler (in the smaller room) can be a little loud when it turns on throughout the night, and the living room faces the street outside so on Friday nights it can be a little loud. Nothing that was a deal-breaker though. Very responsive and helpful hosts

The apartment was nice but I found hair on the bed and bugs in the closets  The sofa is also quite old and has stains on it - I would recommend to update if possible. Lastly, please make sure to fix the floor in the bedroom. After these fixes, the place would be perfect.

The kind hosts respected the fact that I arrived super tired, so we didn't chat long but they're great. The apartment is nice and has all the comforts of home. Good location, on a quiet street and near the university.

I stayed in Epicurean Clerk for four nights for a conference. The apartment is totally stunning - the living room is great and the kitchen and living room are lovely to hang out in. It's also in a great location - around 10 minutes walk from the centre of town. Would definitely recommend.
完美的房子，干净整洁，整体设施非常齐全，很智能的房子，房东非常友善，下次一定会再来
Beautiful apartment

Look no further for your stay in Edinburgh! My friends and I attended the University of Edinburgh and graduated last year, so returning to this city was exciting and nostalgic. Staying on the Royal Mile was so much fun and really made us feel at home again. The flat was beautiful, even better than the photos, and the environment was just wonderful. You can hear all the street performers if you open the windows, but there is still a lot of privacy if you would like to keep them shut. Perfect location for tourists who don't have loads of time to wander the streets or would like to be in the middle of the action. Also allows for convenience if you would like to pop back to the flat halfway through the day. We loved it and next time we're in Edinburgh we'll definitely be staying again! Katie was also a wonderful and attentive host, she went above and beyond to make our trip easy and fun!
Wow. Lovely place to stay. Great view. So quiet, but so close to the city.
This Airbnb was roomy, extremely convenient, and cute! Will definitely stay again next time we’re in Edinburgh.
Fantastic stay! Denise was very communicative and accommodating!!
Excellent  emplacement

This is a fantastic apartment in an ideal location. The view of Calton Hill is just stunning and the apartment has everything you need. We cooked each evening but there are plenty of places to eat close by and do check out the amazing bookshop around the corner. This was our third visit and hopefully not our last. Thank you Martin!
Perfect location for a weekend away. Everything we needed. Thank you.

Convenient night's stay after a late flight- quite near the airport. Quiet street.
Lovely people, very keen to provide everything we might need.
The room is quite small and rather filled with plants. Part of a family home.
Lovely, modern private bathroom.

Logement idéalement situé dans le centre.
Je recommande

Had a lovely long bank holiday weekend in Edinburgh and Kathyrn’s flat was ideally located for getting the the marathon, which was our primary reason for visiting the city.

The flat had everything we needed to feel comfortable in a our base for the weekend. The flat was well equipped, clean and tidy and offered all that was detailed in the description.
Very happy to recommend Kathyn’s place and would stay here again on the next visit to the fine city of Edinburgh.

This flat was great to stay in while visiting Edinburgh. We were in walking distance to a lot of things and near tram and buses. Peter was very responsive if I had questions or needed something. The flat itself was clean and comfortably slept 4. I would stay here again on my next visit!

Appartement plutôt bien situé, et correspond à la description dans son ensemble.
Hôte amicale et réactif.
Propreté à revoir.

It was a lovely Airbnb. Great location to everything. It looked exactly as the pics do. A big hill to walk up so if you have issues walking there is another route to take.
The showers had ample hot water and great pressure to relax in after a big day of adventures. Lots of towels and it’s really nice having a washer/dryer right there. There is also clothes lines in the courtyard to hang them to dry. The beds were comfy and the building and area is quiet. And the view!!!!! Million dollar view right outside the window 💕
I would definitely recommend this flat to anyone who wants to visit and when we come back we will definitely be staying here again.
The flat is light, warm and cosy. The beds are comfortable, with bedside lamps that are powerful enough to actually enable you you to read, a rare thing!
Friendly host and wonderful location.
Claire is een zeer gastvrije,  tweetalige ( NL en UK) host en runt een leuke en knusse B&B om vandaaruit met openbaar vervoer naar Edinburgh (Bus 44 voor £2 in 35 min) te gaan.
Great apartment in a great location! Perfect for a weekend trip

The flat was very spacious, clean, nicely furnished and well equipped. The location was fantastic, close to many attractions in the city. It is on a street with many restaurants and bars, which is great, but created a bit of noise at times.   That is the price of being so close to so many commercial choices, and did not significantly impact us.  We would stay there again.

I absolutely loved my stay in Sarah's home. The bedroom and apartment were exactly as pictured and described in the beautiful beachside town of Portobello, about a 30-min bus ride to the city center of Edinburgh, and an hour by public transportation to the airport. Sarah is a gracious host. Her daughters are lovely! We got on swimmingly and had great conversations. They were all very welcoming and kind, even hosting a "Haggis Night" so that I could try haggis the proper Scottish way--with "neeps and tatties." The apartment is about a 5-minute walk to the beach and is next to a lovely street with lots of cute shops. Sainsbury's and Aldi are close by. There are also a variety of places to eat nearby.
Sarah's place is a great find if you're looking to get outside of the hustle and bustle of the city center and find an oasis close to the beach. I fell absolutely in love with Edinburgh and feeling a part of Sarah's family made my holiday all the more special. Highly recommend this Airbnb!
Excellent stay.  City centre not too far away. Good transport links. Good balance of budget and convenience. Would stay again.

The host was very accommodating even though I arrived quite late on the check-in date, I also received help when needed.

The apartment is perfectly located, the Waverley station is close, there are many nice shops and restaurants in the area and it takes you 10 minutes to walk to the beautiful Holyrood Park (tip for dog owners).

I enjoyed my stay and I definitely recommend Jonathan's apartment.
Very pleasant stay at Margaret's !
The room was clean and lovely. It just near the bus station. And James was friendly and talkative, many good information were provided, well recommended
Beautiful, spacious apartment in a fantastic peaceful location that was handy for everything we wanted to do in the city.
Nice place to stay, everything was clean and Liam‘s a trustworthy and reliable person. Thanks!

P.E.R.F.E.C.T I love Melville's place its beautiful , spacious , quiet , super clean and just amazing. Everything you need is there . Nearby shops and a massive shopping centre just 9 minutes away. Ciara is the sweetest and melville is so kind. We really enjoyed staying here  :D

James was superb and very helpful. His flat is fantastic and excellent value for money. You are unlikely to find something this high quality and so affordable.it was astonishing!if I'm in town again it will be a no brainer.

We initially thought we had arrived at the wrong address as the exterior of the apartment building appeared derelict.
