We were initially concerned with what was waiting for us in the apartment based on these first impressions.
Moreover, we had paid to have an early check-in however, upon arrival it was obvious that the apartment was not ready. The host communicated back promptly, was apologetic and was able to organise cleaner immediately and provided refund. Nevertheless, this negatively affected our experience as we were travelling with a baby who needed to be settled in after an early start that day.
The host advertises the apartment as 5 stars but I believe it doesnt meet the standards advertised. 2nd bedroom was very small, more suitable to have a single bed and stains were seen on pillowcases.
Great location to the centre of town. The tesco close by was really handy. The large place catered well to our group of six.
Apartment in a very good location with the essential amenities.

Charlotte was a wonderful host and the apartment was just perfect. She was helpful and communicative leading up, left us snacks, juice, tea and coffee, and was very welcoming. The location was amazing - everything in the old town including the castle, grassmarket, the royal mile, was within an easy 10 minute walk, and new town was walkable too. The apartment was beautiful and very stylish and had everything we needed including laundry. It honestly felt like home. The only warning would be to prepare for somewhat precarious stairs! It's a 4th floor walk up in an old building and we had a lot of luggage. The apartment and location far outweighed this, but good to know. We had a car and Charlotte gave us some helpful free parking suggestions, but we actually ended up parking at the Raddison a few blocks down for 19£ since we only had one day full - just a tip! Thanks for everything Charlotte :) we will be back!
Really nice place to stay with all the amenities you need. Glenn is a very nice and considerate host and he responded quickly to all of our queries!
Had a lovely stay, hosts were really responsive to any questions, place was cosy and in a great location easy to get into city centre.
Great, stylish location.  Close to shops of all kinds - specialty coffee, natural foods, pubs etc.
Appartamento e stanza molto ben arredati e accoglienti. Steve molto amichevole e gentile.

Loved the place! Everything you could need, comfortable and clean. When you walk into the stairwell, you’ll have a moment of skepticism (it’s an older building and looks it). Three flights of stairs feels a bit longer because they are big floors. Once you get inside, you’ll love it! Beautiful bedroom, great washer, and a drying rack. Two rain shower heads and handhelds, with hot water for a great way to warm up after a long chilly day. Great little work space, wonderful natural lighting. In general, just a few blocks from everything you’d need. University of Edinburgh, GrassMarket, Victoria Street, the Castle, all within .5 mile. Not far to the airport Bright Bus or AirLink100 either. If you happen to be checking out and need a place to store your bags, Kick Ass Hostel down on GrassMarket will take secure them for a small fee. I’m sure there are other options as well, but that was convenient and worked well for us.
Thanks for a great stay!
Chambre au calme,proche réseau bus.
very close by the city center, comfortable and clean! great host!
Lovely apartment within walking distance of the city centre. Highly recommended!
Greg was great, supper helpful and very quick responses. He left very clear instructions and had everything we needed. :)

Our stay at Asmaa´s place was perfect! She´s an excellent host and the communication was great. Her apartment is beautiful, very well equipped and clean. The cat was very friendly and quiet too. The apartment is very well connected to the city center by public transport. Also you can go by foot through Holyrood Park, it´s a beautiful walk. We absolutely recommend staying at Asmaa´s!
Brilliant location. So friendly and very lovely apartment. Will Defo be back and book this apartment! Such a fabulous host
lovely apartment!  would recommend again.
Very good hospitality. The flat is in a great location within a short walk from the Royal Mile and just a few minutes away from Sainsbury's.
Fine appartment, with easy walk to town centre.

Such an amazing location and so much space, especially for an apartment in the Old Town! Everything was neat and in working order. David was helpful and responsive, and check-in and check-out were very straightforward.
房子非常大，推荐给喜欢复古风格的小伙伴们。
Lien was a great host. He was very responsive and friendly. He kept the place very clean and it felt like a home to us. Will definitely recommend to everyone out there :)
awesome spot!! I felt like i was in a 3 star hotel. The only challenge was the stairs. but everything was amazing

Marco’s place was as beautiful (if not more) than advertised. Great neighborhood, very well appointed, and very clean. He’s also the perfect host - very responsive and accommodating. I will definitely stay in Marco’s home again. Thanks for a lovely weekend!
Great place to stop for a city break in Edinburgh, cannot fault. Highly recommend staying here!
This is a big house in a great historic location in Edinburgh. John was very flexible about check in and everything I needed.
Sarah is a very warm and welcoming host, making me feel at home right away. The room was bright and spacious. I’d definitely recommend :)

We had a lovely stay at Kate’s place. It was cosy and comfortable and had everything we needed for our short stay. Beautiful parks are just a walk away and it was easy to access the main town and tourist attractions via a short bus trip. Kate’s breakfast in the morning made us feel right at home. Thanks for having us!
Miriam is extremely friendly and helpful with suggestions on things to do. Her place was so cute and very clean and tidy. Lots of amenities as well as some snacks and water.
The flat is on the third floor which wasn't mentioned in the description. Very hard to climb if you have alot of luggage
We enjoyed the flat very much. It was comfy and clean and had everything we needed. The Parking space was a nice perk.
We loved our stay and how close this was to Old Town.

Carla was responsive to all of our needs, even checking in to make sure we were all right when the humidity had gotten quite high. The bathroom was very clean and she had all the things we needed to make our stay efficient, including cooking and washing our clothing.
If you get the chance to stay here I highly recommend going on walks and exploring. Heading down to the beach and pier in the mornings was one of my favourite things to do. I even had the chance to accidentally wake up when the tide was low and cross over to a special small island. For anyone into adventures or history I recommend you do just that.
Getting to Edinburgh from here was so easy, and having parking on the street made it possible for us to go on day trips to North Berkshire and Glasgow.
Thank you for providing us shelter, and being so flexible with our stay, Carla. :)
非常不错的入住体验。房东的入住说明很清晰，房间设施齐全，很温馨。地理位置很方便，去哪里都不远。这个价格能住到这样品质的公寓非常划算。

The apartment and the room was really clean and and there was nothing to complain about in regards to the apartment at all. We had a private bathroom which was really nice as well. However there were a few issues, as Hannah was very quick to accept our reservation (and payment) but not very helpful afterwards. She couldn’t check us in on the day we arrived, and even the next day we had to wait a little to be able to drop our bags in the evening. I think if she accepts the booking she has to make sure we can get into the apartment somehow. We had to book a hostel for the night instead, and tried to ask her to refund us for the night she couldn’t let us in, but she never replied to our messages ever again. I thought especially about the check in times she wasn’t flexible although in the description of the listing it said that she could arrange something. It’s obviously not her fault that she has to work but it’s not really okay if we don’t get to stay for nights that we pay for. We also didn’t arrive at an unreasonable time, our flight arrived at 8:20pm, and we couldn’t get an earlier one. Unfortunately for us it was a very tense stay and ultimately we paid for 3 nights despite only having access to the apartment for around 12 hours.
Really lovely space, at a really good price in a great location to explore Edinburgh's old town and beyond! Perfect for our long weekend.
We had a lovely time in Edinburgh. Apartment was very clean and spacious. I can see myself staying here again and will recommend it to others

This is a wonderful place to stay when in Edinburgh. I once stayed in Barcelona not 5 min walk from Sagrada Familia, yet this place here felt more central. Wonderful bright room, very warm in winter. Great check in process, wonderful communication. I'd stay there again for sure.

Fablious stay in George’s apartment. Faultless instructions, great location.. all very easy peasy. Recommend all day long. However Australia beat us at rugby… can we get our money back George 🤔🥃🤣.  Thanks again.

Die Unterkunft ist für 4 Personen super. Auch die Lage ist Ideal, wenn man Edinburgh erkunden will.
James ist gut Erreichbar und antwortet sehr schnell. Wir hatten leider das Problem, dass uns ein Brummen in einer Nacht wachgehalten hat. James war so lieb und hat am nächsten Morgen angeboten direkt vorbei zu kommen, um es sich anzuschauen. Aber mit einer hellhörigen Wohnung muss man bei dem Altbau rechnen.
Alles in allem hatten wir einen tollen Aufenthalt mit bequemen Betten und einer sauberen Wohnung.

I booked James's apartment as a place to stay for two friends of mine who were visiting me in Edinburgh. The apartment is located in a very desirable, modern development, within easy walking distance of the city centre and most of Edinburgh's major sights. The apartment itself offers modern comfort, cleanliness and quiet surroundings: my friends were delighted! James was an excellent host, very professional and very responsive. I had previously booked an apartment in the same development through a professional holiday rental agency - but James's apartment was better equipped than theirs, and my interactions with him were much more straightforward! Overall, this was a first-rate Airbnb experience.

After a day-long journey to Scotland, I felt relief and relaxation the moment we entered Ailsa’s AirBnb.
We were greeted by music playing gently, a stocked fridge/restroom, the most comfortable beds, and a squeaky clean yet beautifully decorated home.
All of the final touches and details, such as the fresh bread and jams, truly made us feel like VIP’s during our stay. I loved how walkable the neighborhood was—about 15 minutes from city center, yet 30 seconds away from many shops and restaurants, bus stops, many Edinburgh gems such as Dean Street and Inverleith Park.
I was especially grateful for the washer (we were completely fine without a dryer) and separate room to dry our clothes or store our luggage. We enjoyed movies on the lovely couches in the living room and enjoyed the natural lightening and beautiful views from the bedrooms. When I return to Edinburgh, I hope to stay here! This Airbnb was perfect—I truly have nothing negative or constructive to say. Thank you!

Our stay was very nice. William was very clear with his instructions, proactive and kind.
Location is very nice, you're next to Royal Mile and everything is nearby. But the appartement itself is very quiet.
Good place for a vacation in Edinburgh

Morag was a great host. He was very caring and always ready to give us tips about things to do in Edinburgh. His apartment is newly renovated, extremely cozy and located in a quiet, but well-served neighborhood (3 to 9 minutes walking from the next bus stop).
The bus ride to the city center takes about 15 minutes.
The room is well furnished and the bed is larger than it looks in the photo. The view on Arthur Seat is cherry on the cake.
Morag spoilt us every morning with his sweet breakfast and barista cappuccino. Finally, he had no problem preparing vegan breakfast even with a very short notice.
We loved our stay and would be very happy to book Morag's room for our next stay in Edinburgh.
The place is a bit worn down, but alright considering the location and price. The doors don't have handles but strings to open and close. The sofa bed is quite small for two people.
A great place, well located and cared for, and very well decorated!
Great location and lovely flat lots of light. Chris was really helpful.

This is located perfectly in the heart of the Old Town/Royal Mile, but really quiet and peaceful. Really comfortable, clean, and excellent check in/communication from the hosts. Have stayed here twice and would always make this my first choice in Edinburgh for both business and leisure.

It was a pleasure staying with Btissam. She is a kind and friendly host. The room is very comfortable and location is very central with easy transit accessibility. Check in and communication was great. Btissam provides you plenty of personal space and privacy. Wi-Fi connection worked well.
Feedback and a few nice to have things would include: a desk lamp for evening work. Since there is no access to the kitchen, a hot water kettle, mugs, cutlery and a bar fridge in the room would be helpful. A trash/recycling bin is missing from the room. For a short term stay these are all fine, but can see potential challenges for longer term stays. All the best!

Thank you Kim & Kerry for the hospitality.
The place is very clean and very quiet, I didn't see Kerry but Kim was there and telling you anything you need, breakfast is available over the days, a fruit bowl in the room ..
The city center is a 15-20 minute walk away.
You will not regret booking this wonderful place.

Loved staying at Martin’s place.
Beautiful views of the New Town and Calton Hill.
Tram stop nearby made everything accessible.
Super comfy beds.
Would love to come back some day!
Jamie was great and responsive during my stay! The neighborhood was great and it was easy to get to the city center by car or public transport. Overall, a great place to stay!!

Monika writes back really fast, just once she forgot her phone at home.
The aparment is small but cute and were happy to stay there.
You can hear the street and people walking by, but that was no bother to us.
Monika's apartment was overall clean, just some dirt in the shower and some hair.

HOST TOP!!!
Appartamento posizione, pulizia e ben fornito di tutto.

What an amazing stay! I could not recommend you stay here more! The guys are so helpful with local recommendations and the room is nice and spacious. You will pass out for hours in the bed. The place is in a perfect location for a visit to Edinburgh. We walked around the whole city and could stop back in the apartment multiple times throughout the day. Thanks guys
Christine muy atenta, en departamento es perfecto, volveria a ir

Lovely base to be in for a few nights for exploring Edinburgh.
Location couldn't be more perfect - so close to the city centre and tourist spots.
Communication was great, and check-in was easy.
The room itself was very spacious and has a lock so it felt very secure. Edinburgh Fringe program / food recommendations were laid out which was a really nice touch. Shared spaces are always going to vary with who you end up sharing with but all in all it was great and we would definitely stay again ☺️
房间干净整洁，体验非常好
Great flat in a fantastic location - would definitely recommend as a lovely place to stay to explore Edinburgh.

Vi er veldig fornøyde med overnattingen. Vi hadde god kontakt med Gillian, fikk tydelige veibeskrivelser og hadde ingen problemer med å finne huset. Vi er takknemlige for at vi fikk sjekke inn tidligere.
Vi hadde en egen etasje for oss selv, og det var veldig behagelig. Alt var akkurat slik Gillian hadde beskrevet, men bildene var ikke helt like virkeligheten, siden det var mye mer koselig enn på bildene :-) Vi hadde også en fin utsikt fra rommet vårt.
Gillian var veldig snill og hjelpsom, og det var hyggelig å ta en prat med henne. Hvis vi reiser tilbake til Edinburgh, vil vi gjerne overnatte hos henne igjen.

We had a wonderful stay in Marios place and absolutely fell in love with Edinburgh.
Great location, homely and clean apartment. Mario was great to communicate with and left easy to understand instructions for check in. We would not hesitate to book this place again.
5 star stay in Edinburgh , at the centre of old town , 5 minutes walk to the castle. Great place to stay
Great host,  great property in a quiet area with easy access into the centre of Edinburgh.  I would definitely look at staying here again.

There were two of us and we really enjoyed our stay. The location can not be beat, much better than the touristy old part of town but still very walkable. The street is pedestrian only.
The apartment had 18th century charm and yet remodeled with all the modern amenities you would want. The apartment was spotless and had wonderfully comfortable beds, linens, and plenty of luxury towels in the bathroom.
We would stay again.

Posizione strategica per aeroporto o centro città in macchina o con i mezzi. Come base di appoggio la notte prima del volo di ritorno è andata bene. A piedi, a breve distanza, puoi raggiungere alcuni posti per mangiare. La zona, anche se ben collegata, è un quartiere di periferia...
Host gentilissimo, ci ha fatto il caffè la mattina, e simpatico.
Indicazioni chiarissime per giungere a destinazione e super proattivo.

This Airbnb was in an excellent location! Just a short walk around the corner to Greyfriar’s Kirkyard and a 5 min walk to the Royal Mile in Old Town. Check in was easy and the hosts were very gracious. Overall great value for Edinburgh!
I definitely recommend Jean's place, the communication  between  us went well from the date I booked until last day.
Great place, very convenient to mall and station.

We really enjoyed our stay in Morningside, the apartment was stylish and homely and with easy access to the city centre. We were surprised at just how nice the apartment was and we enjoyed spending time relaxing in the flat. Anyone looking at spending a few days in Edinburgh should consider staying here, we will be back!
A really lovely flat in a great location. The hosts Adam and Colin were really helpful and welcoming. We would happily stay here again!

The location was great right off the royal mile for most of the major attractions. The city center is also a short walk away as well. Check in was very nice and clean as Abbey had clear instructions both checking in and out.

房子离火车站不远，打车6镑多就能到，附近有很多趟公交车可以选择。每间房间主色调都不同，被单都很干净。这间屋子晚上开灯躺床上看天花板也是也挺享受的，去了自己体会。厨房很宽敞，喜欢。到达二楼的楼梯很有特色，是传统的蜗牛旋转楼梯，没有电梯哦。房东夫妇人都很好，先生帮我把超沉的行李提上去的，先生年纪也不轻了，很感动。太太我喜欢叫她老师，很健谈，会给你不少可借鉴的经验。总之，很开心认识房东夫妇，愉快的一次旅行，不错的房子！

Many thanks to our hosts who were very welcoming and helpful.
The apartment was beautiful.
Had a lovely stay. Host was very communicative, friendly and helpful. Very clean and prime location. Would definitely recommend for a solo traveler!
Great host, good communication

This was a great apartment for the amount of money that we paid. It was clean and tidy and adequate for myself and my friends. I cannot comment on the swimming pool and roof terrace as we didn't use either. Val was really friendly and made it easy for us to pick up the keys. My friend found a free parking spot in the street outside which was bonus as it is free to park from Friday evening and all weekend. There is a co-op, coffee shop and dominoes pizza near by and the apartment is walking distance to the centre of Edinburgh. The only problem we had was with the toilet flush but we reported this on leaving. I would recommend this apartment if you are looking for a place to stay whilst you explore Edinburgh.
The location of Basil's apartment was great, as our itenary was focused on Old Town and hiking Arthur's Seat.
Great place to stay. Thank you.

J'ai beaucoup aimé ce gite, car il m'a donné l'impression de remonter dans le temps! Nous avons été content de la chambre pour 3. La literie était confortable et la salle de bain top. Cong Shan est une hote attentionnée et réactive. Il est très facile d'aller du gite au centre d'Edimbourgh par bus: plusieurs lignes s'arrêtent aux pieds du gite! Le bus rapide (100) pour l'aéroport s'y arrête également. La seule raison pour laquelle je n'ai pas mis 5* est que je n'ai pas réussi à me connecter au Wi-Fi sur mon iphone. Mon mari et ma fille avec leur téléphones androids n'ont pas eu de problèmes.
Location, location, location! This is about as central as you can get! Everything you could want, with Scottish touches. Would stay again.
Place in an interesting par of the city, friendly apartament mates.
Great place in an excellent location! Lots of little extras and fairly quiet for being so close to town.  Would definitely stay again and have already recommended to friends!

We enjoyed our stay in Edinburgh. Unfortunately we could not meet the host because they were away, but the room were we stayed is really nice. The bed is really comfy, slept a lot! Connections to city center are quite good, bus is at a 2 minute walk. We recommend this place.
Lovely apartment in a great neighbourhood. Easy to get into Edinburgh for attractions.
Steven was fabulous. Very friendly and welcoming with helpful local advice and his place is lovely!
Lovely, friendly, and attentive host!

Convenient location with easy access and nice amenities. Very responsive to questions and concerns, and most issues dealt with in the thorough materials sent before check-in. Nicely equipped kitchen and bath. The few negatives: the furniture was worn and uncomfortable (importantly, the beds were comfortable!), including not much room to eat, having bedrooms on a different level than the bathroom was inconvenient and we couldn't warm it to our comfort. Wish we had time to read the great selection of books! Enjoyable, convenient place to stay for a week in a great city.

Stanza molto bella e curata in ottima posizione. Il quartiere è tranquillo e pittoresco, a pochi passi dalle principali attrazioni di Edimburgo. Steve è un host molto disponibile e amichevole. In più c’è la compagnia di un cagnolino molto tenero! Consiglio vivamente.

je ne vais pas être plus innovant que les autres, tout était vraiment très bien, Mr et Mme Shan étaient très accueillants et compréhensifs.
seul bémol, la salle de bain

Paolo is simply a lovely person, we just couldn't stop chatting.
He provided a very detailed list of suggestions and tips to get around the town.
His place was very nice, and very close to the Craigmillar Castle, which everyone should visit. His place is also very close to a Lidl, which helps a lot if you are on a budget like I was.
He also provided a very nice coffee and the amenities you would need away from home.
The price was definitely worth it, if I go back to Edinburgh anytime soon I will definitely book it again.
Cheers!

I would highly recommend this Airbnb because it is in the perfect location and the host was absolutely fantastic! My group and I really enjoyed our stay because the property was very clean and comfortable.

Joe’s place was a real little cosy gem, very clean, well looked after and exactly what I needed for a night before my trip to the airport, very close to the Skylink 200 bus that takes you there. Nice little touches throughout, a great shower, I was very happy.
Fantastic place in the best location. Hosts were extremely helpful and everything was just great.
Easy to access from tram line and minutes away from shopping centers, attractions and surrounding neighborhoods

We had a great stay at Luc’s property. It was the perfect location for the wedding we attended at the Leith distillery but was also only a 10 min uber to get you to Princess street. Luc was very responsive and the photos and the description of the property all matched. Overall a very nice stay and I would definitely stay here again. Thanks
Amazing apartment, modern clean and really nicely decorated! Gintare was responsive and everything was smooth and easy. 100% recommended.
Brilliant accomodation and perfect for a short break in the city - would definitely stay again
Great appartement! Really good location with plenty to do and nice restaurants nearby. Place was clean and had everything, even a washer and dryer. We had a great stay.
Splurged for my 30th birthday on this place and glad I did. Such a cool building and the bed alone was worth it.
Great place to stay in Edinburgh. Perfect for the fringe. Lots of coffee shops within a few minutes walk. Kitchen was well equipped and the apartment clean. Thank you.
Great, spacious and tidy flat in a great central location. Great communication from host

El apartamento esta muy bien , utensilios de cocina faltaba sarten . la localización buena está a unos 20 minutos de la rosal miles. La limpieza aceptable,  baños limpios pero suelo y polvo regular. Calefacción muy buena . Si volviera creo que repetiría.

David’s place is absolutely gorgeous and it exceeded our expectations…it was so fun to stay right in the heart of  all the things we wanted to see, and the building/apartment has retained the vibe of old town, high ceilings with big windows that look out over the city in two directions. We were half tempted to skip the sight seeing and just hang out in the apartment.  It’s a really lovely space. A little street noise, but not bad at all if you close up the windows. David was great to communicate with -practice and helpful with recommendations. Fantastic place. We would stay again in a heartbeat.
Class place, class location, class hosts.
Lovely stay with Dunc and Dee. The apartment was great and in such a brilliant location, you are able to walk to most things. Communication was also great, thanks both! Will be back.

Très bon logement bien situé dans le quartier de Leith. Restaurant, bar et tram à proximité.
Hôte très réactive. Je recommande.
Clean and homely place to stay with  ample space for two. Self check in was very easy and host was very helpful in all communications.
Great position and wonderful host. The house is in a perfect position to enjoy Edinburgh. I'll be back :)

Another lovely stay in this well-located apartment. Very clean and had everything we needed, and  more. Never had any problems here in the many years we have stayed at Jana's place. Comfortable beds and sofa, very fresh carpets and seemed freshly painted too, kitchen very recent and a pleasure to use.
Great location, good communication from Louise and the flat was spotlessly clean

We were there in Scotland for five days, everything worked very well, but we did have some trouble with the washer/dryer. For some reason, we just couldn’t get it to work properly, but I don’t know if that was the appliance itself or the fact that it was a newfangled kind.  lol we had been hoping to do a load of laundry while we were away, but it had to wait.
Pohodové ubytování, super poloha, vybavená kuchyň. Vše v pořádku.
Great location to explore the city without the hassle of self-driving into the city :) very easy self check-in!

the house is very good, clean, and pretty new, the owner is very friendly and helpful. only 2 things to remind the potential renters: 1) only 1 washroom available; 2) the washroom is a little bit old, the shower water volume is not high, the floor of the toilet is obsolete. all else is satisfying
lovely apartment+stunning location, very friendly and helpful apartment’s owner

We travel a lot and frequently use Air B and B.  I can easily say this was one of my all time favorite places. It is cozy yet spacious, historic yet modern, and peaceful yet close to all of the action.  The house is spotless and the kitchen has everything you need. The bathroom is spacious & new and the floors are also heated. The grounds are gorgeous! You're surrounded by mature hedges,  gardens & roses and the singing birds are such a treat. Truly peaceful.  Sarah was kind and helpful and made us feel right at home. This spot definitely made our trip to Scotland that much more special, and  we hope to be back there again one day.
Easy to find, great location, apartment is in great condition and very clean. Would recommend!

Brilliant location and a beautiful apartment. It’s on a lively street so there is some outside noise, but the bedroom is in the back and away from that.
Could not recommend this place more
Fantastic flat centrally located. Great host!
You cannot find a better location in Edinburgh! Everything is close! The place is clean and has all the amenities. Highly recommend. Thank you!
Amazing location- we loved Cockburn Street with its range of cafes and shops and so close to Royal Mile! Beautiful flat and very comfortable. Thank you!

Catriona is a very thoughtful host and there are lots of little touches that make you feel welcome. The bedroom is comfortable with nice linen  and in  is in a quiet location. The house is very clean throughout.It is easy to get to the city center  from there And it is a 15 min walk to the botanic gardens. I would recommend if you are looking for somewhere nice to stay..

Fantastic little studio only a 10-15 minute walk into town. With that said, there was a whole range of cafes, restaurants and bars on our doorstep. Situated on a very quiet street you don’t hear any street noise despite being so close to the hustle and bustle!
Great amenities available. Very secure accomodation. Would recommend!
Daniel was the perfect host. A beautiful and clean place to stay, he helped us to settle in and answered all of our questions. Thanks!

We had a wonderful stay in Edinburgh! The flat was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. The location was perfect, close to great cafes, restaurants, and within walking distance of the main sights.
Great place to stay, the hosts are really friendly and lovely, made me feel so welcome and at home. Thank you x
Lovely flat, great Leith location, well managed, thanks!

Hôte très accceuillant, le petit déjeuner semble vraiment intéressant.
La température de la chambre et de la douche un peu fraîche.

Die Wohnung war sehr leicht zu finden.
Ca. 5 min zum öffentlichen Bus
Ca 2 min zum Strand, der sehr schön ist.
Klein, aber fein ist diese Wohnung, sehr liebevoll mit alten Möbeln eingerichtet.
Tolle Unterkunft
This is a fantastic flat right in the heart of the west end of Edinburgh. Princess Street and George Street are a few moments walk. The flat is cosy,  homely  and comfortable.

Logement spacieux et confortable. Chacune des trois chambres dispose d'une salle de bains. L’appartement est un peu émoigné du centre mais bien desservi par plusieurs lignes de bus et surtout proche du beau parc de Hollyrood.
James est réactif et attentif au confort de ses hôtes.
Quiet street, clean comfortable room & close to everything.

Beautiful house, matched the description.
Clean and had everything you could need.
Julie was very accommodating and responsive throughout our stay. Would definitely recommend!
This apartment is well located in Old Town , a short walk to many attractions one wants to see in Edinburgh.

We hebben met z'n vieren geslapen in dit appartement, dat ging prima. Het appartement is erg goed uitgerust, er is zelfs eten!
De lokatie was goed, vlakbij Arthur's Seat en aan het begin van de Royal Mile. Veel verkeer voor de deur, maar daar heb je binnen geen last van.
Het contact met de verhuurder was ook erg goed, we hebben veel goede tips gekregen.
Lovely place, exceptionally clean and the host is a great guy!

A beautiful apartment in an excellent location.
All check in instructions were clear and easy to follow.
Would book again when visiting Edinburgh.
Glimrende lejlighed. Centralt liggende i område med pubs og restauranter

We felt right at home with Ethel who made us feel very welcome. The easy bus/tram/train links made it an ideal base for seeing family and sights in the city centre. Ethel knows the area and city in great detail which was really helpful for planning our day.
Good location. Comfortable bed and showers. Gareth has amazing aesthetic sense , special mention the paintings and photographs on his wall. We had a lovely stay.  Thanks.

Das Apartment liegt zentral in Leith und ist sehr gut an den öffentlichen Verkehr angebunden. In der Nähe gibt es zahlreiche Restaurants und Bars - man kann den Tag hier sehr gut starten und Enden lassen, ohne auf das Zentrum angewiesen zu sein.
Das Apartment selbst bietet alles, was man für einen (längeren) Aufenthalt benötigt. Für kälteempfindliche Personen könnte es im tiefen Winter etwas frisch sein - dies haben aber alle alten Gebäude in Edinburgh gemeinsam und man gewöhnt sich daran.
Emily ist als Host sehr kommunikativ gewesen und hat uns mit allen Informationen versorgt, welche für benötigt habe. Ihr lokaler Guide ist sehr gut und ein gute Inspirationsquelle gewesen. Wir würden ihr Apartment beim nächsten Mal noch einmal buchen!
Amazing!

Lovely person, lovely house!
I had a nice time and they are a nice welcome family!
communucation, location, cleaning were all top♡ thank you,Susan!

L'appartement est idéalement situé à tous points de vue : tout près de l'arrêt du bus Airlink 100 qui relie le centre ville à l'aéroport, à 10mn à pied du centre historique, et à 5mn à pied de l'arrêt du tram pour se rendre au port ou ailleurs.
Le logement était très propre et fidèle aux photos et à la description. Il est un peu vieillot et un peu bruyant vu sa situation et la proximité du tram mais cela n'est pas vraiment gênant vu le peu de temps qu'on y reste. Il n'y a aucune possibilité d'y cuisiner comme mentionné dans l'annonce, et pas d'évier pour laver les couverts du petit-déjeuner pour lesquels on doit utiliser le lavabo de la salle d'eau mais pour un séjour de 2 ou 3 nuits, cela convient parfaitement. La présence d'une petite cafetière serait un plus pour les touristes français :-)
Un atout supplémentaire : le fait que Keiko mette à notre disposition un local à bagages en dehors des heures de réservation. Merci !
Such a beautiful and comfortable stay.  I would definately come back here.  Very safe neighborhood.
Lovely flat in an excellent location! Just a short walk into town.
Alles perfekt

I emailed Yvonne and did not get clear enough instructions to adjust the heater to a comfortable level until the third day of our stay resulting in uncomfortable nights the previous two days.
Below are the instructions we finally got
To lower the heat, turn the dial anti clockwise so the 2 or 1 is at the top.
There is an ‘input’ and ‘output’ (unfortunately the painter painted over them).
Input (right dial) is how much heat is stored and the Output (left dial) is for how much of the stored heat is released.
You can always turn them off (white switch on the wall by the curtains at ground level with a red light above). Be aware, they are storage heaters and take a while to heat up again.
