Esta muy bien ubicado, lo que nos permitió conocer la parte turística de Edimburgo a pie (el Castillo, Royal mile, Victoria street). Incluso la calle de los pubs (Grassmarket) comienza en la esquina, hay un supermercado a una cuadra y una panadería enfrente al departamento con unas cosas muy ricas y una dueña super amable.  La vista al castillo cada vez que entrábamos al departamento es hermosa y los vecinos muy tranquilos y amables. No tuvimos inconveniente alguno salvo un ruido que había dentro de la casa como un zumbido cuando llegamos, pero consultamos con David y enseguida nos dijo como apagarlo. En resumen nos encantó y volveríamos sin dudarlo.
Fantastic space! Great amenities and location! Anthony and Caroline are a joy to work with. This space is highly, highly recommended.

I had a lovely stay here. Iain was a very amenable host; if this is any illustration, when I arrived in Edinburgh, it was pouring it down with rain. Iain kindly made me a steaming hot cup of nettle tea, then chatted to me about the best amenities in the local area. He made me feel very settled and welcome. Highly recommended for a city break in Edinburgh.
Very clean and a good location with a new tram stop right outside. Exceptional host. Would recommend.
Beautiful place, felt at home as soon as we entered the apartment. Very comfortable beds. Everything in good working order. Superb communication with Grace. Highly recommended!
Beautiful clean flat very central , cant find any faults , loved it

We had a great time in Daniela and Duncan's apartment. It is our greatest experience in Airbnb. Firstly, D&D apartment's location is great, which is close to Princes Street. And it was  quiet. Secondly, the apartment was soooooo clean and tidy. And it's got everything we need and might need, like spare lamp and first aid case. Thirdly, Daniela and Duncan are a lovely and kind couple. Our flight was three hours delayed, even though we didn't meet in person, they always kept in touch with us, and asked how is everything going. They explained everything in detail, and we are very grateful for everything they had done for us. We strongly recommend D&D apartment:)

Good location, walking distance from most places. The flat has a nest device which made warming up the flat very easy. Very friendly host and communication was good.
Flat could be cleaner: rug in the living room needs a deep clean, we found a ball of human hair in one of the bedrooms on a seat and there was generally a lot of dust. Experienced quite a few maintenance issues: quite a few lights weren't working and the extractor fan wasn't working either. The master bedroom door wouldn't shut. The flat is also advertised as 1.5 bathrooms but only has one toilet.
床上有很长的头发；沙发下面灰尘较多；暖气很好；所有的门，开门方向都有问题，感觉很奇怪！位置还是很不错的；但是有车位，虽然我没用，但这个在爱丁堡其实很棒！整体来说 中规中矩吧！
Ideale ligging in Stockbridge. Levendige wijk! Parkeerplaats is fantastisch! Gezellige inrichting! Perfect!

Spent a lovely few days in Daniele's place! The location was great, close to the centre and lots of resturants and shops near-by. The flat itself was tidy and compact, we felt welcomed instantly. The hosts were also super helpful with accomadating to our needs! Would recommened.

Super responsive hostess who met us there to give us all the info. Place is small but that worked beautifully since it was just my husband and myself. Great location with a really good restaurant within feet of it's door.
Lovely apartment. Great location. Highly recommended.

lovely place
very comfortable
Without doubt, the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in. Very clean room and bathroom. Quiet area of a very busy city. I’ll rebook when next in city.

This is everything you need in a nutshell if going to this beautiful city for the weekend .perfect location ,spotless clean ,fully equipped kitchen ,comfy beds,great shower,comfy sofa ...the list goes on .Only tip ...bring earplugs as sounds from the cars on the street can disturb your sleep but is to be expected from such a central location .very fast communication from host and extremely easy check in and out .we will definitely be returning  to this beautiful apartment 👍🏻

Pésima atención, no se comunicaron conmigo para hablar de mi llegada, y yo mande mensajes y nunca respondieron. aun así, llegue y habia una persona y nunca me abrió. Me tuve que ir y conseguí un alojamiento de último minuto

This flat is in a great location, right behind the castle so easy to walk to all different areas of Edinburgh and not far from tram stops.
It is very clean and well equipped for cooking.
The property would benefit from some investment as the mattresses are uncomfortable and you can feel all the springs, some of the light bulbs in the bathroom were out including the one in the shower, and there isn't a blackout blind in the double bedroom which lets the streetlights flood in. The bathroom window isn't quite fully shut so the room could get cold in the winter, but the heating is easy to adjust.

Cute little home tucked in the corner of an old historic building. Located a bit far out from the main tourist things but still walkable and not far from great restaurants and bars. Host was lovely and responsive :)
Lovely apartment with easy access to the town centre, very homely and helpful host
Tom was a very helpful and great host! The instructions for the property were very clear and the apartment itself was lovely and a fantastic location

Good location on Leith Walk, with lots of local cafe and food options a few minutes walk from the door.  Allotted car parking space was really useful for a central Edinburgh location.  Accommodation was clean and tidy. Expect a little  street noise.

Guy’s place was perfect for our family stay in Edinburgh. The apartment is large and comfortably fit 6 adults. The pictures do not do the apartment justice- the living area is very spacious and kitchen well equipped. The place is in a great location, we walked into Princes Street in 20 mins. The space was clean and homely and Guy was very helpful and responsive when I had questions. I thoroughly recommend Guy’s place, we had a wonderful stay.

Kelly's place is absolutely gorgeous and the location spot on. Cosy, sweet and charming, it is the embodiment of its host: Kelly has been so responsive, helpful, and attentive! I would absolutely recommend to stay at Kelly's place, the best way to discover and enjoy Edinburgh.

这简直就是艺术家的房子！每一处细节都提现了Steven对生活的热爱和他的艺术品味。Dream House!他非常友好地为我和我母亲介绍了公寓设施，分享他的食物等等。甚至还贴心的准备了转换插头。
交通也十分方便，不论去市区还是机场。推荐！
A great apartment as a base for exploring the city. Has everything you need and hosts were great. Would recommend.
One of the most beautiful places I’ve ever stayed in. The apartment is cozy and super nice. Strongly recommended

Incredible place and location. Very spacious, beautiful place, nice furniture and very cozy. We were 6 adults and a baby, and we had plenty of space! It is a short distance from the center, but in a quiet area, so there are no noise problems.
You have a lot of shops around the corner and also very nice restaurants. The kitchen was clean and tidy and had everything we needed.
Dele was very kind and a great host. He also answered all our queries almost immediately.
Highly recommended, we will definitely stay there again on our next visit to Edinburgh.

We had such an incredible stay at Natalie’s apartment. From the moment you walk in you feel right at home - We especially did with all of the additional festive touches! It’s in a perfect location nearby Grassmarket and a short walk up the stairs to the castle - we would definitely stay here again and have recommended it to friends!

The apartment was in an excellent location for sightseeing. Parking was difficult so better if you don’t need to park as very close to the station. There was a welcome pack and soap and ample loo roll which is always welcome and it was clean inside. However the communal entrance was not in great shape and the front step stank. Also the arrangement for picking up the key was inconvenient after a long journey as you have to go to a drop box on another street. The only other issue we had was the instructions to take the bins to an alleyway on another street. Something I would expect the host to arrange for. But all in all good accommodation, comfy beds and a good kitchen and clean inside.

This place was special to my wife and I. Staying at Anne’s place was like staying at home. Anne was so comforting, warm, inviting and loving. She took such good care of us as if we were her own kids, and we truly felt it. Anne’s home is lovely and the living room, bathroom and bedroom you get is just fantastic. The bed is one of the most comfortable I’ve ever stayed in at an Airbnb, so soft and the covers were like a cloud! We woke up to a homemade breakfast both mornings and we couldn’t have asked for a better way to wake up. Anne, and her husband Alan, gave us great recommendations and we fit in what we could and enjoyed them. Be sure to hit up Bailie’s! When it came time to unfortunately leave, Anne personally took us to the train station herself where we departed with a hug. We’ll always remember Anne’s place, it honestly was like going back home and staying with our parents, and for that we’re grateful.

Had a great stay here! Walkable to all the key spots around town and close to some nice cafes and restaurants. It was a great space for a group of 4 - only thing I’d note is come prepared to go up and down some steps!
Very clean, comfortable, spacious accommodation with all necessary amenities and equipment.  Close to central Edinburgh and to Haymarket station, with tram, train and bus transport close by.

Jonathan is the friendliest, most responsive and most communicative host we’ve ever had! All information about public transportation and apartment instructions were very detailed. And he responded right away. The apartment is lovely and comfortable. Good water pressure and hot water. We had coffee for the mornings. The Aldi is just a block away. Bus to city center right outside the door. We’d stay here again. Thank you, Jonathan!

This is a beautifully presented flat with lots of space and great amenities, Jeremy is a very helpful host who provides the personal touch. It is a good location for the theatre and not too far from the town centre. Will almost certainly be back.

The location is amazing, right in the center, close to everything, and the view from the side window in the living room, is like a painting, gorgeous!
The apartment was spotless! And it's so modern! The beds are really comfortable, the bathrooms are clean and modern (you can have a nice bath if you want to!). I have zero complaints about my staying! The host replied to my messages in a timely manner, i talked on the phone with the manager of the place (because we were a few minutes late to check out and the cleaning crew had arrived!), and he is a sweetheart. The price is more than fair, and there's absolutely nothing deceiving about the description and pictures of the place. The host more than deserves the 5 star rating she has.

I’m originally from Scotland (born in Edinburgh and lived there for years) but live in the USA now. We stayed here during a trip home to visit family and friends, and loved everything about the apartment. Great location, clean, easy check in process, all the amenities you need, etc. Would definitely recommend!

This is a beautiful real Edinburgh apartment in a stunning location, a short walk to city centre and a moment away from numerous local amenities. It has high ceilings which make it spacious and underfloor heating keeping it cosy and warm. There are lovely touches throughout and everything you could need to make your stay like a home from home. We had a lovely email from our host pre arrival giving us all the information we would need and she contacted us throughout our stay to ensure we were happy and regarding check out. The location on the park was great for us as we were able to run every morning and head up to Arthur’s seat. Fantastic, thank you for a lovely stay.
Lovely property and great location.
Catriona was friendly and kind, her house was lovely and close enough to any bus stops.
Fantastic communication and very responsive to messages. A lovely spacious apartment in a great location with everything we needed, we would definitely book again.

Un grand merci à Valda pour son hospitalité et la qualité de son accueil. Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable dans cette charmante maison à l’architecture victorienne et à la décoration très soignée. À recommander sans hésiter
Vincent

Estuvimos muy a gusto en el apartamento. No le falta de nada para alojarte unos dias en esta maravillosa ciudad. A unos 35 minutos andando del centro.
La casa estaba limpia, las camas eran muy cómodas. Tuvieron un detalle dejándonos cápsulas de café para todos los dias que estuvimos.
Recomiendo este alojamiento a todo el que vaya a Edimburgo.
Great place to stay in the heart of old town Edinburgh. Lovely clean, central and beautiful views, loved our stay here

We really enjoyed our time at Killerstain Stables visiting family on the outskirts of Edinburgh. The communication was great as was the accommodation. Really easy to get in with the key lock box and found the accommodation was clean and welcoming, thank you.
Would recommend.
Great place and location.
Great apartment, exactly as described. Easy access to central Edinburgh. Highly recommend!

We absolutely enjoyed our time in Leith. Edinburgh in general is super walkable, but to get to city centre was only a 20 minute walk. The neighborhood was very friendly and quiet. We fell in love and ended up becoming “locals” at the Mother Superior Bar for the duration of our stay. Will definitely be back!!!!

Marina’s place was absolutely beautiful and she is so friendly and welcoming.  The house has been magnificently restored and I love how she furnished the Airbnb.  My room was cozy and comfortable, I had a private bathroom with the bathtub (so nice to take a bath on these colder days!) and the kitchen was large and where I liked to sit in the morning enjoying my coffee and breakfast.  She has everything you can think of in the kitchen - pretty amazing!  I also enjoyed meeting the other guests, even if briefly, and was nice knowing Marina was there if needed, to answer any questions, provide wonderful sightseeing recommendations, or just to chat with.  I will definitely be back to this wonderful Airbnb gem in Edinburgh :)

Spent four days at David’s place, he gave us perfect instructions on how to get there and met us at the agreed time.  He thanked fully explained how everything worked.  The location is right in the middle of all the attractions and lots and lots of restaurants within walking distance of Airbnb.  Would highly recommend a stay at David’s place.

I had a lovely stay at Denis’s Place!! He was very kind and responsive !! The room is beautiful and in a very quiet and peaceful neighbourhood !! As I was constantly travelling I needed some quiet time and was able to get that!! The home is just a 15 min walk from the train station !! I will highly recommend this place for a wonderful stay!!
Hope to stay again in the future again!!

Place is really close to everything you might want to check out, and to the train station. I guess because it's only a room you might not feel like you have perfect privacy and comfort but it's a cool place and very nice for shorter stays

Simplemente encantador, un hospedaje que supera a las fotos. Ubicación excelente con vistas bellas del castillo y cerca de zona comercial tranquila y bonita. La calefacción nos ayudó mucho ya que no estamos acostumbrados a climas tan fríos y con viento. Eleanor siempre fue muy atenta y nos recibió de una manera muy cálida y linda, en todo momento se esforzó por darnos las mejores recomendaciones e instrucciones… Sin duda volveremos a este apartamento
The place was perfect for us!  My two benchmarks are the bed and the shower!  Both were top notch.  Comfortable bed with good quality linens!

We had a great stay at the apartment! It was big, very clean and as described. The owner Iain was very helpful via emails, excellent communicator. Would definitely be looking for this apartment in my next trip to Edinburgh!
Super, vielen Dank!
Excellent flat, everything you need.  Easy bus ride to the city.
Allan’s place was perfect and scenic of Edinburgh. The location was perfect and Allan was super responsive to my questions. I hope to stay here again but longer in the future!
Deans village was a perfect area and everything exceeded expectations. 10/10, would stay again.
Incredible location, communication, and stay overall! Highly recommend

A great base , lovely restaurants & bars near by . The Rose Leaf pub & Fishers restaurant are particularly good .
The bed is comfortable, more pillows needed !!! most people sleep with 2 each .
There are a lot of stairs to get to the apartment 3 double flights , quite hard going with suitcases & not suitable for everyone .
easy to get into Edinburgh on No. 16 bus takes 20mins . We tried a few local taxi companies on a few occasions, they were all fully booked .
Easy, check in, nice location,  clean flat.

Sandy i njen muž su bili jako susretljivi i fleksibilni oko dolaska i odlaska te mogućnosti ostavljanja prtljage nakon izlaska iz smještaja. Lokacija smještaja je odlična i sve je blizu i pješice i javnim prijevozom. Soba je bila uredna i imala sve što je bilo u opisu. Hvala što ste nas ugostili!
Excellent hidden gem , close to everything Edinburgh has to offer , spotless comfortable and easy check in a must if your passing thro or longer stays top notch
Very nice place in good location
this was a wonderful place to retreat to in Edinburgh!

Wonderful stay and would love to come back. Located in a very nice residential area but very close to shops, grocery and also the edinburgh street food market!!!! Walkable to the castle, holyrood house, arthurs seat, train station, mall, etc. Great location. Flat was very spacious, lots of room to spread out and sleep. Excellent house with great communication. Loved it!

Having lived in the Stockbridge area of Edinburgh previously, Alex's home was the absolute perfect place to stay to reconnect with the area. It's in a superb location and easily walkable to New Town and Old Town. Buses are also right outside the door if you aren't up to a walk, and they come by frequently. The home was picture perfect and the garden's out front provide such a welcome pop of color and a beautiful place to sit and enjoy the day. I highly recommend Alex's place to anyone considering a stay in Edinburgh.

Dave and Tokes are awesome hosts! The evening I arrived they were both home to greet me and had a bunch of maps, guides, and suggestions to help me plan my stay. Their flat it so interestingly decorated and they have some great linens and bath products it felt like staying in a unique boutique hotel! It's also very close to the base of the Royal Mile and Arthur's Seat as well as some nice cafés and restaurants - so great location.
More than anything they were both super helpful and friendly. I was traveling alone and they were so welcoming to my hanging out and chatting with them after dinner, which really made my stay special. Will definitely come back to stay next time I'm in Edinburgh! Thanks guys!

The location of Dave & Tokes’ place was very convenient, there was no trouble walking/getting around Edinburgh at all. They even provided my friend and I with a cute little personalised map which we found very useful when it came to deciding what to do/where to eat. Will definitely come back here if I’m ever in Edinburgh again!
Lovely apartment. Great Communication with Margaret.

We had such an amazing stay in Sharon’s property and what a host she is! We couldn’t have been more impressed by the cleanliness and fantastic amenities provided. Sharon was very flexible and had great communication too. Thank you so much for having us<3

This a great place to stay to enjoy the delights of Edinburgh. Walks around Arthur's seat and Salisbury Crag can be done from the doorstep and the bars and restaurants of the city are also within walking distance. The house itself is very homely and beautifully decorated with works of art. There is also an amazing collection of books. I'm very likely to return to Edinburgh and would definitely stay here again.

Location was SO quiet, even being in an apartment building. Could walk to grocery store. We only stayed one night before a flight, so didnt get to explore too much, but location was easy to the airport. We were traveling as 2 adults and 2 kids, and the pullout sofa was easy to set up and nice for the kids. The bathroom and kitchen were huge - and so well equipped it felt like staying in someone's actual home. Also, there is a lift - but we didn't remember until after we had carried our bags up all the stairs. So be sure to rememeber there is one and not repeat our mistake!
Great location, big rooms, very clean and has everything we need. But can get a little bit noisy because it’s near the street. Would recommend to stay here!

We love the place, the room we got is perfect for two people. I love that it has it's own toilet and the amenities are complete as described in the listing. Everything is clean and organised. Harriet is a great host, very friendly and responsive. It's a great place to rest after a whole day of touring the city. The bus stops are walking distance too. We are also grateful for the welcome Prosecco 🩷.
位置很好 离一家很好吃的火锅店很近 楼下一家韩餐也很好吃 附近有超市 房间干净整洁 很舒适 房主回消息也很快 从火车站打Uber大概6镑 总之性价比很高 住的很舒服 推荐！

We could not have asked for a better host or a better apartment. Brian answered all of our questions very quickly and could not have been more accommodating. The apartment itself is fantastic: spacious rooms, modern kitchen and bath, and fast WIFI. And the location! 1 block off the Royal Mile, right behind Deacon Brodie’s pub, but not too noisy at night. Terrific views out every window and less than a 10 minute walk to the train station, grocery stores and multiple parks. There cannot possibly be a better apartment rental in Edinburgh.
Lovely spacious flat perfect for 2 couples. Great walking location. Clean and well decorated. We highly recommend staying there. Kathy
I would book this place again. Great location and very quiet at night. I was renting a car and the place was a short walk to the car rental and everything else downtown.

We had an amazing time in this beautiful flat, which we stayed in for my friend’s hen weekend. The place feels luxurious, at a very reasonable price! Thank you much to lovely Linda, who gave us a tour and was very friendly!

房子位置很好，去哪里都很方便。由于房间在二楼，没有电梯，所以对于携带大行李箱的游客来说，可能是一个挑战。东西都很干净，但床单和沙发的靠背上有一些污渍。不确定是因为时间太长导致无法清洗还是由于其他什么原因，但整体上还是很干净整洁的。入住的指引很完善，详细的介绍了进入房间的方式以及WiFi密码。户型很好，光线明亮且每个房间都很大和规整，但卫生间只有一个而且有点小。
整体来说是一个很棒的房子。

We stayed only one night at Jennet home but we felt immediately welcomed.
Very cosy home and room, well organised and furnished.
I must mention the lovely breakfast, nicely prepared with great a choice (I am a yogurt and granola fan and having it made my day). Despite the one of the "B"s in BnB is breakfast many times this is very minimal and commercial.
Jennet really showed what it means preparing and offering a small but complete breakfast.
Thank you Jennet,
Next time we will stay again for sure.

An absolutely stunning apartment only a 15 minute walk from the city centre. The rooms are large and so well decorated. There is a lovey bar downstairs which has a magician on Thursday nights (highly recommend). I will definitely be returning here.
genial !! apartamento precioso a 15 minutos  andando de todo!! Martín super amable y muy atento!! repetiría seguro!!! todo de 10!!!

Daljits place is beautiful. Instructions to self check in were spot on and it’s cleanliness, modern decor and chocolates on the bed left for us were a lovely touch.
It’s in a perfect location close enough to walk into Leith, and easy enough to jump on a bus to get into the city centre.
Highly recommend this place and we’ll definitely be back!
The best location and a really lovely comfortable flat!!!
Thanks for a really great stay in a really great cottage! Plus points for the owl, Benarty is a magical place :-)
깨끗하고 좋았습니다.
Great location, easy check in and great accommodations. Would certainly stay here again.
Great location for a short break.

Nell has a clean place but she is brusk and seems not to like the bother of having a guest- she greeted me then said she s let ne get settled. Then if I had any questions. So I asked. Can I just tap on your door ? “Oh,no! I was supposed to contact her through AIRBNB. From the next room. . I felt unwelcome - one cup, one glass, one tarnished Tea spoon. Bed frame has very sharp edges in a room quite small. Flooring slippery at foot of bed. No lock on my bedroom door. No privacy screen. Nell leaves her doors open to areas I am not allowed. Absolutely
No warmth from this host on this visit. Perfunctory politeness.

Loved our stay! The AirBnB is just around the corner from the Balfour Tram stop - we got a 5 day pass and rode it our entire stay to all the sights so it was super convenient. The decorations are so much fun. When we discovered the hairdryer was missing, Connor was responsive and ordered one to be delivered the next day.  We would definitely stay again and recommend to others!
Nice and clean space, will definitely come back.

Marion’s place is perfect for a stay in Edinburgh. The location is very central, and the apartment kitted out with everything you might need for your stay. Marion was so accommodating and even offered an earlier check in as the apartment was vacant the night before. Would definitely recommend and hope to stay again. 🙂
všechno naprosto v pořádku. Ubytování velmi nadstandardní,perfektně vybavena koupelna.

La casa de Eddie es totalmente recomendada, muy espaciosa, fue perfecta para nuestra familia. Tenía todo lo necesario para cocinar y está en un lugar muy tranquilo. Ademas tuvimos una muy buena comunicación con Eddie.

Nuestra experiencia en el apartamento de Fiona fue fantástica.
El apartamento cuenta con todo lo necesario y mas.
Ubicación ideal para moverse por la ciudad, muy limpio y ordenado tal como aparece en las fotos.
Fiona fue muy buena anfitriona, siempre amable y dispuesta a nuestros pedidos.
Muuuuy recomendable, de volver a Edimburgo, no dudaríamos en repetir alojamiento.
Excelente opción, gracias Fiona!!!
The keys to the garden were incredibly cool and made walking to places fun and easy! Thank you!
Knus plekje, loopafstand van het centrum, afspraken werden correct nagekomen. Kortom, prima ervaring.
Great location, parking, room to spread out! Everything was great!

Lovely quiet apartment with great views.
Very comfy large bed.
We stayed in December and Holly had put up a nice Christmas tree.
Great communication and quick responses from her to any questions.
Awesome time !!!
Lovely host, great location, the host let us put our luggage early. Rooms are clean and nice. Perfect place to stay at Edinburgh.

Zoe was the best host we could’ve asked for!! She was so kind and always willing to help give directions or tell us anything we needed to know! The place is close to the tram station too so we took the tram everywhere! It was a wonderful stay!
Charming flat, great location, easy communication with the host, would love to come back soon!

Fresh flowers, fresh fruits, handmade biscuits & sparkling wine! Who could ask for more?
A modern apartment in the midle of the Old Town! Perfect!

We had a lovely week-long stay at Shery’s AirBNB !
We found that the studio was super well located, only a 20 minute bus ride from town and only a 15-20 minute walk to the beach. Check-in was super easy as the host greeted us immediately to show us into the BNB and gave us great recommendations of places to visit in the area. Shery also made sure to contact us before our stay to provide us with detailed instructions on how to get to the BNB which included bus routes etc. The studio itself was very beautiful, modern and came equipped with everything we needed and even came with an additional lovely welcome package, which was a nice touch.
Overall we are very grateful to Shery for hosting our stay in Edinburgh and for being so accommodating and helpful. We highly recommend staying here if you can !
Very good host. The appartement is like described and near city center! The communication was timely and polite

One-of-a kind location; had the best window view for people watching at the end of the day! Also one of the most comfortable beds I’ve ever slept on at an Airbnb. Note for anyone planning to cook meals: Kitchen had sufficient cooking tools but no pantry basics (or at least none I could find) so just make sure to buy that from the store (oils, spices, etc). Everything else was great!
Good location and nice house! Steve is friendly and Charlie is so lovely! I recommend this to everyone who wants to stay in Edinburgh.

Todo perfecto! Todo limpio, cocina súper equipada para cocinar con todo lo necesario y más! habitacion con calefacción para no pasar frío. Cristina siempre respondió amablemente a nuestras inquietudes. Con un solo colectivo estabas en el centro o en el aeropuerto. Recomiendo!! saludos
Great flat in a central location. would stay again
This place was in the best location and the Harry Potter theme was amazing. Everything you want/need!
不太喜欢这次住宿体验。首先，房间很吵，晚上还一直能听到很大声的音乐，不知道是酒吧还是谁在开party？一个房间的窗帘根本不避光。卫生间的水也很小。是一次不开心的入住体验，不推荐

Le logement est parfait pour visiter Edimbourg.  Des bus vers le centre (old town) passent  juste à côté du logement. Le logement est très confortable et suffit amplement pour 2 personnes. Bei est très réactive en cas de problème. Je recommande à 100% ce logement.
Appartement très bien placé, proche de tout mais très calme
Stunning apartment in a beautiful location and extremely central too…. would highly recommend!

We went for the tattoo, great location only 15mins from centre with great bus links.
would highly recommend.

My stay in Edinburgh was rather short but this location allowed me to do what I needed in a free and efficient manner due to the close proximity of the tram station and the ease of its service.
The apartment is well equipped, warm and insulated and clean. The host was very responsive when I needed some help with the washing machine.
A very positive experience and would highly recommend this property for two people or one looking for a central base whilst visiting Edinburgh.
El apartamento está un poco alejado del centro pero tiene muy buena comunicacion. Por lo demas esta perfecto.
The flat was great, very central and the view of the castle is wonderful! A great find that I would definitely recommend.
Very good location that near train station, the flat is clean and lovely. The host is very kind and cares about the guests, giving many good travel suggestions for the travelers.

We really liked our stay at Jennifer’s place. It is spacious and bright. The location is great. It was very easy to take the tram from the airport and walk a few blocks to the unit. There were plenty of great dining choices. It was the perfect spot to explore Edinburgh from.
Great place, bijou but comfortable and good location.
Very nice apartment with all amenities near all the action you could want in Edinburgh.

This was truly a special Airbnb. The studio itself was beautiful and clean, with a highlight being the stunning bathroom. It was also in a wonderful location with proximity to Old Town. Grant was a pleasure to communicate with and an excellent host. We would definitely return!

Sally's place is perfect for a stay in Edinburgh. The place is a close walk to everything you want to do in Edinburgh and right beside Arthur's Seat. The place is really nice and cozy and has everything you need in an apartment. Sally was a lovely host and made us feel right at home.  I would definitely stay here again if I found myself in Edinburgh in the near future.

Great place to stay with a friendly host
Highly recommend
super hote !

The host was brilliant from the moment we booked the stay until we left. Communication was fast whenever we messaged Gill.
We had a few glitches, one off the bath drainage system was very slow in draining the water and the main shower head was not working.
We advised this to Gill who had already provided us details for the property management team.
When I rang the lettings team he told me they was aware of the issue and will send someone around to do a temporary fix which was kind off annoying as they could have done the temporary fix before we got there if they couldn't fix it.
On our first day out off the two that we was there, we was without a shower as 4 of us using the small shower head in the other shower would have taken longer and we had already planned lots of things to do in the 2days we were there.
We was charged for cleaning fee which I felt like we was robbed off as the flat had alot of fluff, visible dust on the floor and window sills. I did mention it to the lettings team to which I got a reply if you are not happy then you can make your own arrangements for tonight. The letting team didn't do any justice to Gill who was a brilliant host.
Overall the location was very good quite a few stairs to go up to the top floor but we didn’t mind this at all, the apartment is in a good location, central to a lot of history and amenities.
The apartment itself was cosy and the kitchen in particular was lovely.
Denis he’s nice person friendly and helpful Nice view and very calm to sleep thanks

Had a great stay at Calum’s place in Edinburgh. The apartment was perfect, it had everything you need including nice little extras such as small snacks. The apartment is filled with impressive art that really adds to the nice atmosphere and coziness. Would definitely recommend staying here while exploring the city and its surroundings! Thanks Calum!
Great place! Conveniently located within a 5-15 minute walk of everything, but still on a relatively quiet side street.
Great location and a lovely clean apartment. A little cold on arrival.
非常舒适的入住体验，房间很大很整洁，装修很有特色，房东非常热情，非常推荐！
Good location, just round the corner from the Grassmarket. Nice decor. Quiet at night.
What a beautiful, homely and modern space! Clean and light and the bed is incredibly comfy!! We had a wonderful stay with a quick and easy check in/out. Thank you for having us!
Definitely recommended, very good location and easy access for everything if you are planning with family
Kelly was a wonderful host very welcoming & went to a lot of trouble with our stay. Beautifully decorated apartment.
Really made Edinburgh feel like home! 🌼 I was treated with kindness, consideration and had a room that was perfect. So appreciated.
As described and other reviewers' comments - clean, cozy and central with soft sheets and comfortable bed. Basically a great hotel suite just without a reception/breakfast.
Great location close to the tram into Edinburgh. Very central in Leith which has great pubs and restaurants. Despite central location this is a quiet apartment. Well stocked kitchen.

Perfecte uitvalsbasis voor een citytrip naar Edinburgh, en voor een roadtrip door Schotland met de auto. De gratis parkeerplaats is echt geweldig. Het is 30 minuten wandelen naar Princes street. Het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien. De verdieping is bereikbaar via een lift, dus geen gesleep met koffers op de trap.
Houdt wel rekening met de hoogte van het bed; deze is erg laag en daardoor mogelijk niet geschikt voor mensen met bijvoorbeeld rug- of knieproblemen.
Great spot. Super convenient. Clean and homely. Exactly what I was looking for.

Firstly, brilliant location, on the Royal Mile and handy for all the city centre attractions.  Flat was clean, comfortable and cosy, with everything we needed for a short stay.  Armando was a very welcoming host, kindly booking us in early as we had arrived by train with luggage, and providing maps and local advice on what to see.  Would definitely come back next time we visit Edinburgh.

Stayed here for 3 nights with my boyfriend and it was a home away from home. Beautiful decorated and in the best location possible, completely surrounded by restaurants, bars and shops. Will definitely be returning next year for another long weekend.
parfait pour rester a proximity de l'aéroport!
Mooi modern appartement achter het huis van de verhuurder. Voorzien van alle gemakken en vriendelijke verhuurder.

I recommend anyone to stay here if you want to be located right in the city centre and be surrounded by nice restaurants and public transport. My family and I had a great stay. It was easy to communicate with Hanne. Didn't get the chance to meet her but everything worked out well for us! Checking in and out of the flat was really flexible. I would totally come back to stay in Hanne's flat if I ever come back to Edinburgh.
Very nice flat in a great location.

We found Mario's place is very near to the most favourable tourist destination of Edinburgh. It is only taking a couple minutes by car to the Palace of Holyroodhouse, Edinburgh Castle and Royal Mile. We hired a car as we would go to Loch Ness in north of Scotland to enjoy the beautyful scenery of Scotland highland. We easly got a parking lot for the car in Milton Road in front of the apt. Mario is a responsive and helpful host. Once we were about leaving for Edinburgh, he initiated to text us what time we would check in the apt. I remember I asked Mario about parking rule in Central Edinburgh, he responded by calling me. He tried his best to make his guests happy. All house appliances worked very well, the water pressure was quite strong and the bed set was good. My daughter slept well in the sofa bed. In short, we had a wonderful and memorable stay at Mario's place

My friend and I absolutely loved our stay! The place was clean, cozy, and just what we needed for a relaxing trip. Brock and Becky were such wonderful hosts—super friendly and helpful. We had a great time and would definitely stay here again!

The flat is charming.  It is very clean and was stocked with lots of fluffy white towels.  It is perfectly located for walking to all the famous places in Edinburgh, but also located in a secluded, quiet, out of the way spot.  It is just as described and shown in the photos. We appreciated the numerous power strips that made it easy to charge our devices and the generous supply of coffee. The host is responsive.  10 out of 10. Would highly recommend and would stay there again.

Nous avons passer 2 nuits chez Lorraine et nous nous sommes senti comme à la maison.
Lorraine est très sympathique et accueillante (malgres notre anglais très médiocre nous avons réussi à nous comprendre).
L’appartement correspond à l’annonce, le quartier est calme et on ce sent en sécurité . Un arrêt de bus ce situ tout proche de l’appartement et permet de ce rendre en ville rapidement, ce qui est très pratique.
La chambre était belle et très propre, tout comme le reste de l’appartement.

If you’re looking for a beautiful, well located, safe place in Edinburgh, you’ve got it! Lovely interior, comfy beds, all the mod cons you’ll need and very responsive hosts.  We came during Fringe and lucked upon this property which was the exact location suited for our trip.  Francois was  delightful.  You won’t be disappointed.

The apartment was easy to find and luckily we were able to park right outside the building (normally I think you have to pay if staying during the week as the area is mainly for permit holders only). Instructions for check in were simple and well-communicated.
The flat was well presented and as described. It is very spacious and warm.
Would definitely recommend for someone looking to stay in the centre of Edinburgh.

Great accommodation and welcoming staff. Perfect location and good for a getaway with friends.
The only reason I didn’t give a perfect score was because the rooms were very hot and the windows can’t be opened. I’d still go back and recommend to friends.

Vineeth was a wonderful and accommodating host! The apartment was right on the Royal Mile in the perfect location I couldn’t have asked for a better spot! It was so cute inside and only one flight of stairs to go up with my luggage which is always a plus. I would definitely recommend this property!
Amazing house. Very clean on arrival. Very easy to communicate with

The house is in the central of the old town which is convenient for touristic attractions and public transport.  Most surprisingly is that you can see the castle directly from the window. The room is well-equipped and has everything for a short stay (or even long stay).  Ann is really great host, almost reply immediately. There was a problem with the hot water but Ann solved it quickly.  One thing to mention is that cuz the house is just beside the road so it is a little bit noisy in daytime but quiet at night. Close to some great bars and restaurant! We spent a very good night there! Thank you Ann!

We had a great stay at Paul’s place in the heart of the Royal Mile. The apartment is very close to the Castle and the other attractions of the Old Town. It provided a quiet oasis when we wanted to get away from the crowds. The apartment was clean and comfortable, with good beds and pillows, and good furniture, and everything we needed. Paul was very clear with the instructions, and gave us great recommendations for local restaurants and things to do. The apartment easily accommodated our family of 5 adults. We were also able to do some laundry in the washing machine, and let our items air dry on a drying rack.

Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt in Leith, sehr nah zum Stadtzentrum und wirklich schön ! Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und tolle Pubs waren direkt um die Ecke.
Emily war super nett und die Kommunikation und Anweisungen waren ganz einfach.
Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt 💜✨
Great spot! They were extremely responsive and helpful with local recommendations.
Kristy niet persoonlijk ontmoet, maar ons wel erg welkom gevoeld in haar huis. Communicatie was prima en reageerde snel op berichtjes. De brownies waren heerlijk en super verzorgd ontbijt. Dankjewel

Absolutely perfect.  Would do 10 stars if we could, Nikki was so wonderful and helpful. Super comfy beds, beautifully decorated, she left all the necessities and more.  Want to come back to Scotland just to stay here!  Location couldn't be better, both centrally located yet peaceful. You've moved the bar up a great deal, Nikki.  Thanks again.

Room Looks exactly same in the pics and Kim was so welcoming and responsive.
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Really enjoyed our stay, the place was well located and was a true reflection of the images provided.
السكن كان ممتاز ونظيف وتعامل دانييل كان رائع جدا وحميع الخدمات متوفره ومنطقة رائعه

Rebbeca and sandy' s place was perfect for our needs. Really good location and super nice apparement. They also gave us some wine , cake and scotch samples. We had a wonderful stay and I recommend it to anyone who needs a place to stay in Edinburgh.

A gorgeous place to stay.
Everything you could need in the kitchen. Toiletries in the bathroom. Comfy bed with lovely bed linen.
Was close to restaurants, etc
Frequent buses into city or a nice walk through Holyrood Park.
Lovely to find,fresh flowers.
milk and bubbly in the fridge.
Future guests will not be disappointed.

It was lovely staying at Eleanor’s. She herself was just wonderful. Very kind and helpful! The place itself was quite spacious, clean and beautiful. Its very well connected by bus to city centre and other places. Would definitely go there again next m in Edinburgh xx
Amazing place to stay! Highly recommended

"We’re so glad we chose Janice’s place in Leith! It was just far enough from the city center to experience the charm of the local community while still being conveniently close to supermarkets, cafés, and restaurants. We even discovered a fantastic little old pub with the friendliest atmosphere. Getting to the city or Old Town was a breeze—just a quick 10-minute tram ride away. A perfect stay!"

Stylish, cozy and cute place, but the location is EVERYTHING! Just off the Royal Mile, the apartment is super convenient for exploring the city, and comes with great views that remind you that you're in Old Town Edinburgh. Really enjoyed my stay at Dunc and Dee's place.
Good value, simple, comfortable room
Amazing place! The host was very nice and allowed us to drop our luggage off early. The space had everything we needed, and it was in a great area!

The only times we needed to get a bus was in and out of the rail station on a simple bus journey as it was a bit far to walk with a rucsac.  Otherwise, central Edinburgh is remarkably compact to visit on foot with no need for buses.  Also try a walk along the river Leith to the old port of Leith and then catch a 35 bus all the walk back - so simple!  Modern art gallery is incredible for Surrealist paintings - and free, with a great cafe too.

i stayed for five nights, had a really peaceful stay. loved their cat as well who made sure to great us every time we entered the front door, hes super cute! Love how our host was super flexible with check in and check out
Comfortable and clean accommodation, with a lovely garden, a private entrance, and in a quiet neighbourhood.
很喜歡這間公寓。 在市中心吃飯，行街，購物很方便。 到景點也很近，步行可至，步行至火車站大約15分鐘。 公寓非常整齊乾淨。裝修很新，煮食工具齊備，焗爐很新和乾淨。 淋浴空間寬敞舒適。 屋主回覆迅速。 如果我再到愛丁堡會再次入住。

Had an excellent stay at Carlos' place - very comfortable and clean, quiet at night for sleeping, and a short walk from some fun cafes and bars.
Would highly recommend :)
Kym was an amazing host. We loved our stay and the location was close to everything.

The place has been really well thought about; not just the space that's available, but how it is to be used - the needs of the guest are clearly thought about. From having some spare shampoo, to some light breakfast items (especially after a long journey), it shows the hosts really care about the people who stay there. Clean, tidy, and a fantastic location! The place *may* be haunted...TV turned on randomly, as did the hall light. Joking, probably not haunted... Bit still weird. Nonetheless, would massively recommend to anyone heading to Edinburgh!!
Appartement fonctionnel , hôte très agréable. Linge de lit propre . Petit bémol : salle de bain et vaisselle pas très propres
Clare’s flat was cozy and felt like a home away from home. The location was absolutely amazing, central to all the sights yet still quiet and peaceful. Thanks Clare for being an amazing host :)

A truly marvellous apartment and a wonderful host. The apartment couldn’t be better located, everything you’d want to see is just a short walk away. The place itself is wonderful, it is almost a struggle to tear yourself away from the beautiful space Calim has created to go and explore the splendour of Edinburgh. The extra touches that Calim puts in, having the lamps dimly lit and Radio 3 playing when you arrive, to fresh bread and breakfast amenities really make a difference. Not only that but he was incredibly helpful by meeting us prior to check in to take our bags and letting us leave a little later than planned. Thank you for a truly lovely stay.

Lovely stay in Edinburgh! Comfortable room and a very convenient location with easy access to the city centre.
Access to the kitchen and coffee was really appreciated.
Thank you, Will & Kate, we’d happily stay again!

Had a lovely 3 days here. Accommodation was very comfortable and we had everything we needed. Great location for Edinburgh - just a straight road all the way to the City Centre. Lovely and peaceful too. Recommended.
Our stay here was wonderful. The place is nice and well connected. It is also near the ocean and some beautiful locations. We went almost every day to Egg Bao Pablo for breakfast. It was amazing.

Perfect Location. The big supermarket right outside the Apartment which is very useful.
Very easy to find and enjoyed our stay.
Great apartment with a nice location, less than a 10-minute walk from the station. The kitchen is fully equipped, perfect for cooking.
It was great to stay at Douglas' place. Very close to city center with the amazing Arthur's Seat nearby.
Lovely place absolutely beautiful and would stay again
A lovely quiet space, which was just as described. Warm and cosy on a cold night.

Dave's flat doesn't look like much from the outside, but inside it's lovely.  Our group of 6 young (and not so young adults) immensely enjoyed our stay.  Great coffee shop, middle eastern bakery and Sainsbury's close by!  Top notch beds and bedding!

Salwomir's place is just as it is described.  It has a well-equipped kitchen and a beautiful outlook over parkland. Both bedrooms are clean with fresh bed linen .  The supermarket is only a five minute walk away and there is a good bus service very close as well.   The area is quiet and you can watch the dogs and their owners stretching their legs in the evening in the parkland below.
The flat was perfect. It was lovely and near Old Town, New Town, and not far from Holyrood, Edinburgh Castle, and other great sights. Would stay there again and definitely recommend to others.

Beautiful flat in a wonderful neighborhood. Close by to cafes and transport. Place was clean and had enough space for our group. Kitchen was generously stocked and linens were provided. Check in was a breeze and Sam was a super responsive host. Highly recommend!

We had a great stay whilst in Edinburgh to see Taylor Swift. The apartment was clean and modern with plenty of space and some lovely touches to make our stay better. We had a lovely walk along the waterfront into Leith with stunning views across the Forth. Would definitely stay again.

Emma’s place was the perfect location for our family of four during our stay in Edinburgh. It couldn’t be more convenient to the attractions and restaurants.  This rental was pristine clean, wonderful bedding on comfortable beds.  The treats, coffee and tea were appreciated. I would stay again and highly recommend it. Thank you.

Marita and Heath were very welcoming. The bedroom is conveniently located beside the main entry.  Spotless, modern kitchen and bath. Great made to order breakfast (full Scottish if you would like).  The location is 15 minutes from just about everything.  We looked forward to coffee and conversation to get our day started.

The place was exactly as described, in walking distance of most places, especially the old town and Waverley station.  Easily accessible and the place was super clean with everything we needed. Great price for what we wanted and the host was very responsive, providing great recommendations to make our stay in Edinburgh even better! We would definitely stay here again the next time we visit! Thank you Wietze!

My family stayed at Katie's apartment for 5 nights.  A very comfortable place for our group of 5!  Very close to sights and restaurants, but on a beautiful peaceful street which was lovely to come home to.
Fiona was extremely welcoming and a warm and generous host. Fiona will definitely be our first choice when next in Edinburgh.

[ Extremely BAD experience ]
I had a very disappointing experience at this hostel. While I was still checked in, my belongings were thrown away by housekeeping because they assumed the bag was trash, even though it was transparent and clearly contained personal items. The bag was placed next to my luggage in a public area, and no one informed me that I could not leave things there.
The way the situation was handled was unacceptable — instead of trying to locate or keep the valuable items, the management simply stated their policy and took no real responsibility. Losing my teeth retainer was not only costly but also extremely inconvenient. I would not recommend this place to anyone who values their belongings and expects reasonable communication from the staff.

Excellent!
Great property…..great hosts…..great location
Had a really peaceful and enjoyable 4 night stay with young daughter, lots to see and do in the local area and really convenient for travel to Edinburgh centre. Property is very clean and well presented in a lovely quiet location with very friendly and helpful hosts. All amenities that you would need are provided, and a lovely touch was a welcome bottle of wine, biscuits and and sweets on arrival….very welcome after a long drive!
Great location for commonwealth pool with plenty of local eateries. Quiet part of town and just 30 min walk to city centre plus good bus service.

My husband and I stayed in Martin's place for 5 days and absolutely loved it!  Cockburn Street is very conveniently located between the old and new town and you are 2 minutes from Waverley station and everything on the Royal Mile.  Martin's place was exceptionally clean and well stocked.  He was kind enough to provide some basic food stuff and we lacked nothing in terms of kitchen equipment.  Martin was also kind enough to share what his own favourite places in the city are to see and experience.  My husband and I really enjoyed our stay and when we return to Edinburgh, we know the place to stay!
Great location within easy walking of the main town centre, modern, and clean
Very nice and private room. If you want to stay for more than a couple nights you might miss a microwave or a kitchen since you can’t cook or heat anything, but for a short stay is quite nice.

The room was simple and filled our basic needs for a few nights in Edinburgh. Cedric was friendly and very quick to respond with any issues we had. The walls are thin and you hear people in the next room walking around, but this didn’t bother us much. The bathroom could do with a shower curtain and shower holder higher up to be able to shower standing up.

Sangita was very accommodating, and made us feel like it was our own home. The location is great - right on the Royal Mile. The kitchen had all the basic equipment to cook a meal. There was no facility for recycling, which we did find disappointing, as we try to be considerate travellers. Overall a very nice trip.

Check in at observatory house was welcoming and very professional and friendly. Made for a good start to the stay. The lay out of the place was great, decor was simple, sophisticated and beautiful. Place was spotlessly clean. I couldn't have cleaned it better myself.
On our first night stay we realised the second bedroom didn't have black out blinds which was a surprise as it listed on Airbnb under amenities that black out blinds were present in the bedrooms. We mentioned to our hosts and they remedied this within hours by providing us a solution that worked well for us for the second night.
Beds were also super comfy. Firm enough for hubby who loves super firm beds and not too firm for me. It is rare to find beds that both hubby and I find comfortable and by some miracle the beds here found the magic spot!
The host clearly works hard and care very much for their guests. Super responsive and accommodating during our stay at the observatory house. This, the check in experience and the cleanliness, plus the unique experience of staying at such a historic building warrants a 5 star ⭐ inspite of the slight inaccuracy in the listing.
Views from calton hill were amazing and it was nice to walk up and down the hill. Only pointer would be if you have a pram, when you use maps on goo gle or gps etc to find your way there and back, tell the app that you are cycling so it take you via the route with no stairs. Overall we thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

Valentino's apartment is decent, spacious place with comfortable beds.
But as it says pet friendly I suggest to bring your cat with yourself as we had an unexpected visitor as well (a mouse). Unfortunately we couldn't record the animal as it was quite quick and didn't stop for a pose.

Right in the heart of the city.
It’s a “party dorm” bunkhouse, so make sure you understand this.
As long as you do, you can’t do wrong.
First night was amazing. Quiet, thoughtful bunkmates. Second night, smelly annoying guys that played music over their phones in the room.
None of that is a reflection on the hosts.
It’s all down to the people staying there and it’s always a crap shoot in hostels in popular places like this.
Good luck...?
As for the hosts and the running of the place, totally professional and top notch.
Just know what you’re signing up for, is all I’m saying.
And bring your earplugs!
Hashtag: hostellife, amirite? 🤣

Nous recommandons avec grand plaisir le logement proposé par Killian. Très facile d'accès via plusieurs bus. Kilian était là pour nous accueillir et à notre départ. Il a pu nous expliquer plusieurs choses intéressantes.  La literie est excellente et tout est très propre. Kilian proposé même un 0etit déjeuner.  Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez lui et nous l’en remercions.

Superb stay, easy to find. Nancy gave very helpful check-in info, with additional pictures. Excellent location for walking around the city and visiting many sights. Clean accomodation, looked as the pictures show. Towels and shower gel provided which was also very helpful. WiFi was easy to connect to.

Pros: lovely location. Right in the pink triangle (yes, straight tourists, those are gay bars!) and a charming row of nice townhouses. Big bedroom, big bed, charming little desk laid out with teacups and saucers. Big bathroom with a HUGE tub, and as a larger person who really can’t use a normal one it was amazing to soak a while.
Cons:
- asked about dropping off our bags before check-in ~1 week in advance and was told that would be fine - with no further detail offered. Was only told the morning of that we would have to come at a particular time. Dropped £10 on a BagBnB (nonrefundable) only to have her text and say never mind, it’s ready.
- wasn’t given full check-in instructions at any point. Messaged her throughout the day about questions such as where the key was and what the WiFi was. To her credit she was responsive.
- the WiFi, on that note, was weak and I kept losing signal. The electricity was also odd and I had trouble getting my phone to charge (which made me panicky as I’m quite dependent on it for travel).
Would recommend a stay here but would also recommend being very thorough about preparations and proactively getting the information you need.
Martin is a great host, wants every guest to make the most of their trip and to make you feel at home.
The room is comfortable and the location of the appartment is great. Lisa is a very kind host. Thank you.
Great place to stay near Princes St and Leith Walk. The room and common areas were very clean and tidy, and Alexander made us feel welcome.  Wouldn't hesitate to come back in the future. Thank you.

This is an amazing location! It’s center to the Royal Mile and perfect for some people watching.
Note: Since it is an old flat you hear neighbors at night… all night. If you have the windows open you also hear all the street noise. However this comes with the amazing location and was well worth a little noise.

We had a fantastic time at Scott’s. We have already decided to do it again next year. The apartment was fantastic, my grandchildren loved it. Easy to walk to all the attractions such as the castle and the town. Arthur’s seat is close by and my grandchildren spent many hours playing golf on the course opposite.  The kitchen was lovely, with one of my grandchildren loving the kitchen island.  We all had a fantastic time, and are looking forward to returning next year.
Nice host and lovely place

We had such a great time staying at Marina’s! Definitely worth it & it is a great location to walk around the city and explore all of the amazing sights in Edinburgh 🙂 Everything was perfect and we enjoyed the flat and hospitality offered throughout our stay.
A beautiful apartment with everything you need! It’s a relatively quick walk to the Old Town, with some great cafes and bars right around the corner.

We really enjoyed our stay at Steve's! The room was beautiful and very clean, if anything it was even nicer than the pictures. Steve was an excellent host, would highly recommend staying here. Very close access to buses to the airport and to Old Town and Edinburgh Castle.
Great place, great host.

Excellent location. Can get to all the attractions Edinburgh has to offer easily. Comfortable place with plenty of room. Having two bathrooms was a bonus. This is a basement apartment don’t expect any views or ability to leave windows open at night.

What an absolutely delightful cottage, right in the heart of everything, and yet so private. We have had the most amazing stay in this beautiful city, and our accommodation was the icing on the cake. The pics on airbnb, which are great, do not do it justice.
Everything was perfect, spotlessly clean, and everything we needed.
The view from the sitting room was magical, and the perfect place to sit an relax at the end of the day.
We can't wait to return.
Beautiful, confortable and cozy  flat, in a quiet area, very close to the centre town (10-15 min walk). Jamie was very kind and responsive. Strongly recommended!

I am glad that I chose this place to stay because it made my trip even a better one. Angie was kind from the beginning till the end, the room was clean and the bed was VERY comfortable just like other people write! Also there are maps, guide books and hair dryer Angie prepared for you, which is useful and helpful. Nothing to complain. Would love to stay here again when i come back! Thank you Angie. :)

Amazing little place to stay if your looking for something that is fantastic value for money. Very clean and cosy, would stay here again and again. Alex is an amazing host and tells you everything you need to know for your stay. Would 100% recommend.
Fantastic property.  Perfect for exploring Edinburgh. Great location with lots of lovely places to eat nearby. Main attractions 20/25 min walk away. would definitely recommend and retun.
Ótima localização e um lugar aconchegante. Deu para fazer tudo que pretendíamos a pé.

Sin duda mi estancia favorita del viaje.
El apartamento es muy amplio y se encuentra en una excelente ubicación no tenía que caminar demasiado para llegar a todos los lugares turísticos que deseaba visitar.
La llegada y salida fue sumamente sencilla.
Favio en recepción fue súper amable y atento con nosotros, nos fue de ayuda como guía turístico y gastronómico :)
Sin duda volvería a hospedarme ahí, es la mejor opción

Lovely place to stay in, very safe, quiet residential area and only 20-25 mins walk into the city centre through the nice Meadows or 7-10 on bus. Nice fish takeaway called Fish only 5 mins walk away and small Sainsbury's also handy for getting essentials. Very clean and modern, great shower and comfortable bed. No complaints at all and would definitely stay here again when we are next in the city.

The place was amazing itself , it felt like home even tho it wasn’t my house . The location was nice as well , it was close to the grocery shops ,and central Edinburgh. The host was very friendly and was replying fast . Overall great experience,will be coming back !
Excelente ubicación, súper cómodo
Nice and clean room with private bathroom. Everything as expected, really good value

Sallys room was absolutely perfect for our week in Edinburgh. The room was huge, with a very comfortable double in the bunk bed arrangement (we didn’t need the top bunk) and there was plenty of space to relax in the room when we were tired from exploring. Sally kindly made up a breakfast basket for us every morning and she was so thoughtful making them vegan for us as we’d spoken before we arrived about both being vegan.
