The lounge was also very comfortable (with smart TV and subscriptions to Netflix etc. ready to use), the kitchen was fully equipped and plenty of storage in the bedroom for us to tuck our belongings away. Parking was also a huge bonus and felt secure.
Everything was as described; check in was safe, easy and even enjoyable thanks to prosecco and homemade shortbread waiting for us; and Dunc and Dee were super responsive and really helpful with any questions and recommendations.

Had absolutely a great time. The room was VERY spacious and the view was unbelievable. Bus into town was easy to navigate.

Dan was beyond gracious in opening his home and was very helpful in providing suggestions. Would absolutely come back to visit and would recommend to others as well.
Jordan was a very friendly and responsive host, he turned on the heating before we arrived and the house was beautiful and cozy.

Amazing studio, we felt so at home and it was a perfect base from which to explore the lovely local area as well as the city. Loved the decor and the skylights which gave the whole place a great feel. Wish we could have stayed longer, would thoroughly recommend!
Very nice host.

We had a comfortable stay for a party of 4. This apartment is a 20 minute walk from Waverly station / Old Town and nearby attractions. The apartment itself is well-furnished. We were able to wash clothes, eat in some nights, and enjoy plentiful personal space.
Our friends found some hair on the floor in their bedroom, likely from a prior stay. Perhaps the dark flooring made it easy to miss during cleaning. Otherwise the bathroom and kitchen were clean and well-equipped.
Parking spots are reserved, but sometimes they may be occupied without authorization. The host, John, was helpful in communicating with the warden to get them cleared for us.
I will recommend this place for groups of 4-6 people who want to have a convenient, centrally-located stay in Edinburgh.
Anne is a nice Person, got more than i expected

En rigtig dejlig ren og hyggelig lejlighed, der er lokaliseret perfekt i edinburghs centrum. Gaden er fyldt med barer og butikker og ligger i gåafstand til alt.
Nemt at komme fra/til lufthavn med bus og meget nem indtjekning.
Kan anbefales
Lovely stay! Farah was extremely kind and helpful

Great location for visiting the city with the flat in a beautiful building. The flat was lovely and snug over a cold weekend and the host was very helpful in allowing us to check in a little earlier so we could drop our bags off

It’s a great location easy to access to city streets and tram to Glasgow. Warm, elegant, spotless place to stay, and easy to communicate with. Highly recommended. Thank you very much Scotland and to this lovely BnB :)

Jane es una gran anfitriona
. siempre dispuesta y atenta a nuestras requisitorias. su casa es hermosa y muy cómoda con hermosos detalles. a 10 minutos caminando de todos los atractivos. recomiendo la casa de Jane como el lugar para alojarse si visitas edimburgo. volvería con seguridad
Fab place, jimmy and Rebecca were great hosts and helpful.  Space was lovely, very comfy bed and great having tea facilities in the bedroom.  Would definitely recommend
A stunning flat in an amazing location, had the best weekend here! Absolutely fantastic!

Lovely peaceful clean apartment, especially after the hustle and bustle of the city centre, but still very walkable to the centre. Great communication and hints and tips, in a lovely area. We will be back - thanks

Great location, very clean, with amazing bed linens and friendly hosts.
The apartment I stayed in on the first floor had not yet been refurbished, so the bathroom was quite old and not in very good condition.

Had a great stay,  the place was very clean and cozy. Greats communication from the hosts. Pretty good location. Across the street from a bus stop, that is only a 20 minute ride to city centre. Overall was a really good place to stay :)
good location, walkable to the city. lovely big lounge room, bedrooms and kitchen. shower and bathroom is very small, but manageable!
Great size place, in a top location. Only down sides were really slow wifi / internet and couldn't figure out the 'nest' heating controls. But all in all a good stay in a wonderful city.

Der Aufenthalt hat uns gut gefallen. Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben und sauber. Die Wohnung liegt zwar innenstadtnah, allerdings in einer Ecke mit drei Stripclubs. Nachts konnte es dadurch schon etwas lauter in der Straße werden. In direkter Nähe befindet sich aber auch ein Supermarkt. Das Haus an sich ist alt und der Hausflur dementsprechend auch alt und muffig. Die Wohnung an sich hatte aber alles, was man braucht.
Der Gastgeber Thomas war zu jeder Zeit und immer zu erreichen. Er gab uns auch nach dem Check-Out noch die Möglichkeit, unser Gepäck abzustellen. Sehr freundlich.

Perfect location
Perfect host
Perfect trip

Excelente lugar para ir a visitar Edimburgo, con un autobus llegas al centro y al aropuerto, la zona era muy tranquila, el lugar estaba impecable y tenias todo lo necesario para desayunar y productos de higiene.
Super recomendable!
Beautiful, eclectic, with friendly host

- Great location (close to bus/tram stop and railway station)
- Easy to check in and out
- Very nice place, spacious and comfortable

Lovely stay and well kept periodic home !
Really cozy and close to the city centre.
Lovely accommodation

Amazing apartment in one of the best neighborhoods in Edinburgh. The Leith walk is at your doorstep (make sure to do this towards Dean's village). Minutes to new town/old town by bus or a very short walk. Stockbridge itself is a very cool area. Tons of independent stores (Don't miss Rare Birds bookshop), and amazing restaurants/cafes. The flat is perfect. Spacious, modern, comfortable, and fully equipped. We had a wonderful stay, and will seek this place on our next trip to Edinburgh. Thanks Laura.

This flat was wonderful! Very clean with a modern style, the loft bed was my favorite part. It is close to everything that you need and has lovely floor to ceiling windows that give you some good views of the neighborhood.

El apartamento estaba en una zona cercana al centro, en un barrio rodeado de cafeterías, restaurantes y supermercados. Autobuses en la puerta para comunicar con las zonas de más interés. La casa perfectamente equipada, no nos falto nada y muy limpia.

Had an amazing time with our family in Edinburgh and it was made all the more special by Holly and her beautiful home. It was the ideal space for 10 of us. The Prosecco that greeted us as we arrived a lovely touch. It was spotlessly clean, very conveniently located in a quiet residential area and plenty of space. The standouts were the especially large bedrooms, private garden and open-plan living/dining room. Can’t recommend this place or Holly highly enough. Thank you for your hospitality.

This AirBnB is PERFECT! Well appointed and located there is nothing to complain about. From the personalized greeting and orientation to the high quality details. We felt safe, comfortable and it was conveniently located near Arthur's seat, the Royal Mile and a reasonable walk to the Castle. My daughter travelled for over 30 hours to meet me in Edinburgh,  we weren't disappointed! Eddie even made efforts to make my birthday weekend a never to be forgotten memory. Thank you!

100/10, great place, spotlessly clean, well appointed, great location for easy access to Edinburgh by bus, secure parking, even a good selection of complimentary products. Easily the best Airbnb in Scotland

We enjoyed our short stay at Martins apartment a lot and will recommend the cozy place to friends and family. Martin was always very easy to reach and very helpful when we had questions. Thanks for having us!

Great stay overall. The location was excellent and made it very easy to get around. The house itself is aesthetically pleasing. Communication with the host was smooth and proactive throughout, which made the experience even better. Would definitely recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay at Francois's flat. It was a great central home base in Edinburgh for our 8 day stay.  It has all of the features we were looking for with restaurants, shopping, transportation and tons of things to do all within walking distance. On weekend nights there is some noise because it is a busy area. Depending on the weather, the flat can get warm without opening the windows so that is a bit of a balance.  Overall, we recommend and would stay again!

We had a great time staying in Caroline's place. Check-in was easy and the flat looks just like the photos, we especially loved sitting in the back patio space after a long day exploring Edinburgh. The apartment is in an amazing location, most things we wanted to see in the city were no more than a 15 minute walk away. Thanks for having us Caroline!
Chambre très agréable, la literie est super. Appartement bien situé pour passer un week-end à Édimbourg, tout est faisable à pied. Merci Lewis !

Absolutely stunning apartment in a little slice of Scottish paradise. The views from the balcony are breathtaking. Spotlessly clean, beautiful decor and a host who was incredibly helpful even with excellent restaurant recommendations. Don’t hesitate, book this while you can!

Wunderschöne Wohnung in ruhiger Umgebung in der unmittelbaren Nähe des Naherholungsgebiets Water of Leigh. Gute Anbindung in die Innenstadt, ein Supermarkt und kleine Restaurants sind auch gleich in der Nähe. Empfehlung!

Mes enfants ont adoré séjourner dans l'appartement très cosy de Rachel. Idéalement situé pour visiter Édimbourg, l'appartement est impeccable et correspond entièrement aux photos et descriptif . Excellente communication avec Rachel. Nous recommandons +++
Great place to stay, super close to a major bus station. Perfect launching point for a nice day in Edinburgh!

Don’t hesitate to book this place ! We loved our stay there! It was easy to walk from the tram to the building with our luggage no problem. Very fast answers when we had a question. Very clean place !
Great flat and location! We had a beautiful stay.

Our stay at Dunc & Dee's was perfect. We even had home made shortbreads to welcome us. The location of the appartment is  close to all the tourist sites and quite calm. Lots of restaurants and shops nearby. We felt at "home". On arrival, Dunc was here to greet us and show us around. He also provided a very detailed list of all the activities / restaurants nearby which was really useful. He  took the time to make sure that we had a pleasant stay. I would definitly go back. Thanks again to the both of you! We had a great WE ;-)

We stayed there with my parents and my daughter. First the positives. This is a really nice place with a cosy common area and lovely decorated. It’s a convenient location to get into center , airport and further out, although we had a car.
Then the negatives. We would have given a 5 star if not for the following reasons:
There was water damage due to some recent leak around chimney and the ceiling in downstairs bedroom is affected with a large stain and a noticeable damp smell which is not ideal for asthmatics and allergy sufferers. We slept with the window open. Host said it was to be fixed so I’d probably check before booking if this would be a deal breaker for you.
Microwave didn’t work properly and you need to hold the door closed to make sure it doesn’t cut off also which is also an inconvenience if you rely on it. Again host said it would be fixed soon.

D.L’s Home has been my favourite AirBNB experience so far! D.L’s attention to detail is second to none, with everything you might need to feel at home. Her home is beautiful and D.L was always available to answer any questions I had. I would love to come again and stay longer!
Hermoso departamento con todo lo que necesitas y más 🙂 además la ubicación es perfecta y a la noche podes salir al pasillo a ver el castillo. Volvería todas las veces que pueda!
Comfortable and spacious, well located. Some aspects of the property getting a bit tired to ask this high a price, but actually comfortable and well set up. Had a great stay.

Perfect Stay.
Great location for the Fringe, you can walk to all venues with most of the main ones under 5 minutes walk away.
Flat has everything you need, clean and tidy, and Eddy was very proactive and helpful
Great apartment.  host was very responsive. brilliant Location. woulld definitely use again

Estada molt agradable!!
Habitació amb lavabo, dins d’un pis, el què és una gran oportunitat per coneixer gent local.
Vam arribar molt tard a la nit, i l’amfitrió ens va esperar per donar-nos la benvinguda.
Llit molt còmode, tot molt net. Estada genial!!

A good basic apartment in a great location. Aykut was very friendly and helpful. We walked into the city but you can also take the No11 bus. A quiet residential area with many amenities within walking distance.
Great levels of hospitality & a good assortment of basics there to help ease you in to your stay. A great, easy to read manual answered any questions we may have had. Would stay again!
cozy room，convenient location

Tony’s place is great! Cannot be a better location. The arrival at the metal door leading into the little alley at first felt weird, but once you get in, you get it.
We felt at home and we did not lack anything. The amenities were exactly what was needed.
Easy to get anywhere. This place is THE place to stay to get to know Edinburgh.
Thanks Tony and the team!
excelente

Julie’s place is as described, very clean & comfortable with generous supply of towels. Location is excellent for public transport or walking to key sites and eateries. Julie is also quick to respond to any queries one may have. We appreciated the snacks, coffee & milk that was provided too!

Natascha’s apartment was great—very well kept, clean, and comfortable throughout our stay. Everything was exactly as described and clearly well maintained. The bathroom is very small, to the point where my knees touched the door when sitting down, but this is simply due to the style and layout of the flat rather than a cleanliness or quality issue. Overall, I would definitely recommend this apartment and would be happy to book again.
Greig is a great host and his place is so close to everything, super clean with many thoughtful touches.  We couldn’t have picked a better place for our trip to Edinburgh.

Great location!  clear communication and instructions for check-in.  This is just below Edinburgh Castle and close the the Grass Market area.  Place was clean and exactly what was shown.  The clothes washer worked well and was a nice amenity.
Parfait

De locatie was top. We konden vanaf het appartement lopend alle kanten op (old en new Town, botanische tuinen, royal mile enz). Er waren veel pubs en cafe’s in de buurt. De straat uit was een supermarkt.
Verder was er veel aanwezig qua benodigdheden en voelde het appartement ruim. Het contact was erg goed, er lag zelfs wat te eten en drinken voor ons klaar.
Alleen de geur en schimmel in de badkamer waren minder en de bedden waren wat aan de harde kant.

Lovely apartment in a fantastic location. Quiet, yet within short walking distance into the centre of Edinburgh. The apartment itself was clean, well equipped and comfortable. The host responded quickly to questions and was friendly and helpful. Would highly recommend.
Fantastic stay..... lovely property!
A perfect introduction to Airbnb!  The accommodation was first class. Vicky was friendly, helpful and welcoming.  I wouldn't hesitate to recommend.

We absolutely loved our stay at Valentino’s. it was the perfect size for our family with 3 kids. So comfortable and felt right at home. Walking distance to everything we needed.
Would definitely recommend staying here!!

Very cute and private airbnb and bus was very accessible to go into town. Lorraine was always very helpful and attentive, as well as considerate to our needs. I felt very safe in this area and would come here again when I stay in Scotland.
Very well placed for the tram and good value during the Fringe
Good location close to shops and takeaways, nice clean flat and responsive hosts.

Très bon séjour chez Elizabeth, accueillante et discrète. Logement propre et facile d'accès en bus.
Bonne communication avec Elizabeth. Je recommande ;)
Helpful and kind host and good accommodation for multiple guests.
brilliant stay! Dele was great needed more towels and he was very prompt! brilliant area. thank you again
I had a wonderful stay in this lovely, well appointed, comfortable room. Perfectly located for site seeing throughout the city. Sabrina was a fantastic host! Would highly recommend!

We came down to Edinburgh for a three night stay 18 -21 Oct. from Aberdeen for our daughters wedding and wanted somewhere close to the venue, The Caves on Cowgate, and this flat was just perfect. About a five minute walk down and about a ten minute stroll to  the royal mile. The flat itself was very clean and warm and for being on a main ish road, very quiet. Our bedroom was at the front of the flat and our granddaughter had the rear one but we were not disturbed by noise at all for the length of our stay. The beds were really, really comfortable which gave a good nights sleep. There was everything you would need in the flat for a short stay in Edinburgh and, for sight seeing, it is ideally placed for places like the Castle and at the other end of the royal mile, Dynamic Earth, both great places to visit. For the more adventurous, there is also Arthurs Seat to climb.  Would I like to go back and stay there the next time we are in Edinburgh, yes and I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the city and wanting somewhere nice to stay. The host, Rosie, was just a text or call away if you needed her. A clear 5 stars from me.
Very very clean.  Beds were very comfortable.  Shower was a bit small which didn’t affect us too much, but large people might have trouble using the en suite bathroom. Great stay and fun location.

We had a beautiful stay at this lovely flat. Thank you so much for making the lead up to Christmas so special. The Christmas tree was a very special touch. Don’t be out off by the outside appearance or the long stairs up. This place is beautiful
Alles gut
Deirdre’s place was perfect for our two night stay. Clean, spacious and modern. Very cosy. Kitchen was well stocked. Deirdre was very welcoming, responsive and happy to help.

The flat is in a great location and is walking distance to all historical sites as well as the train station.  The flat was very comfortable for my teenage son and I as the living room couch makes out into a bed.  I would highly recommend the flat for anyone traveling to Edinburgh.
A stunning flat. Can highly recommend it. Leith is great too, with great bars and restaurants on the doorstep and frequent transport into town.
It was a nice place to stay for couple a days. We were able to chat with other guests staying there. I would definitely stay here again.
Beautiful accommodation in a convenient location. Lizzie was quick to respond to our inquiries before and during our stay.

We stayed for four nights in Paul's lovely apartment.
Paul was a very welcoming host and pleasure to meet, he answered all our questions and recommended places to visit and eat.
The building itself appears to be hundreds of years old; it has a lot of character and has been thoroughly modernised inside to a very high standard and was absolutely spotless. It will easily sleep a family of four, an ensuite master bedroom with a double bed and a second room with two single beds and a separate bathroom.
The living room consists of a modern kitchenette with everything you would need to cook and an extendable dining table. Paul was kind enough to leave us some snacks as well as fresh milk, juice and croissants.
The apartment benefits from being right on the Royal Mile in the fabulous Old Town (great view from the kitchen/living room) and as such everything is conveniently located and always felt safe. It is within walking distance to Edinburgh Waverley station and the best way 'up' the hill to avoid climbing the 100+ steps fully laden with luggage is to walk along Cockburn Street and turn right at the top (about a 5 minute walk from there to the apartment)
Some of the places to visit, especially if you have children is the Dynamic Earth (great 4D experience!) right next to the Scottish Parliment building by Holyrood Road, The National Museum of Scotland on Chambers Street, Camera Obscura and World of Illusions (just a few minutes walk from the apartment and on the same road) and Edinburgh Castle just a few minutes further down.
Another great place to visit if you have a head for heights is Athur's Seat which is the peak of an inactive volcano.
There is plenty to do but we would advise you plan ahead with your activities to get the most out of your trip.
We had a great few days in Edinburgh and would recommend Paul's apartment for its great location and convenience.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön. Etwas außerhalb des Zentrums gelegen, aber mit dem Bus ist man schnell in der Stadt. Dafür ist es sehr ruhig in der Gegend. In der Wohnung hat man alles, was man braucht. Die Küche war sehr gut und vielseitig eingerichtet. Die Wohnung war insgesamt sehr sauber und hatte für unseren Aufenthalt alles, was wir gebraucht haben. Die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin war immer freundlich und schnell. Wir können die Unterkunft empfehlen.
Lovely place to stay in Edinburgh! Sue is a wonderful hostess. 100% recommended!

Great getaway for two people. Perfect location, right next to grassmarket and only 10 minute walk from centre of town. Quick responses from host when in need of help. Highly recommend this to anyone looking for an place to stay when visiting Edinburgh!

Abigail was a lovely down to earth host who made us feel right at home and encouraged us to treat her home as her own. Really nice and clean room with en suite facilities.
She went the extra mile by letting us check in early too. Her two dogs were adorable and she always left out breakfast for us which I wasn't expecting, being new to Air B&B.
Great location in easy walking distance of the city centre, Leith, Stockbridge and Newhaven which was ideal for exploring.
Would recommend and also hope to visit again!

The flat is well located, next to the old town and you can have a lot of activities (pubs, café, restaurants, etc.). Ashlie&Grant are reactive if you have any questions.
Everything was clean and the flat is cosy. We enjoyed our stay there.
Very nice place with comfortable stay  good b ,fast.easy sccess to the city,friendly host.

Friendly people, nice dog, felt like home straight away! We were also offered a local and warm breakfast, which made the stay even more lovely! Definitely will recommend staying here to all my loved ones.

Alejandro and Harriet were very kind and welcoming, making sure that our stay was pleasant throughout. Everything was immaculately clean, bed was comfy and there were multiple breakfast options (all provided in the room). Only good things to say about these hosts!
Perfect location and lovely spacious place.
A great place to stay!
Very nice spot! In a great neighborhood. Only about 10 minutes to the main stuff.

Simon was a great host! The flat was clean and felt like home away from home. Close to an ASDA,  a shopping mall, HMY Britannia, and the tram into town. Good food around too! I would stay here again without hesitation. Thank you Simon!
Lovely clean large apartment with everything and more that we needed for our short stay. Close to the city centre, Haymarket and the tram stop. Would highly recommend.

Un lloc molt guai! La zona comú és genial per conèixer gent i fins i tot per passar-hi vespres i parts del dia. L’habitació de dues persones més que bé per tenir certa intimitat i lloc de desconnexió!
Great location right in the middle of town.
warm, modern flat near center. no problem with check in/out

A lovely flat in a perfect location for exploring the city of Edinburgh. Well provided for so able to eat in if wanted and a good amount of space for chilling after city walking. Would definitely use again and recommend to others.
Lovely weekend break.

Great location, well laid out flat in historic Georgian new town. Central but quiet. Comfortable and stylish. High ceilings, modern decoration with some period features retained. Very clean. Excellent host - very organised, helpful, and rapid responses to queries. Only one minor issue - the blinds aren't completely blackout so 2of 3 bedrooms (at the front) are not totally dark in the late Edinburgh evenings, so baby bedtime at 1830 was tricky until we moved the cot (which Barry the host also thoughtfully provided).
Lovely room in a great location, would recommend

Nice flat and perfect location. The Royal Mile is right behind the building. Everything we wanted to visit was a short walk away. Pubs, restaurants, cafes, shopping and the train station are a few blocks away. A ton of touristy things close by, too.
Absolutely beautiful apartment in the heart of Edinburgh! Spacious, pristine, and comfortable. A short walk to all the major attractions and plenty of restaurants/cafes nearby.

Nice place with many bus stops to the city. If you dont mind walking Portobello beach and other things are 25-30 min away. Also we appreciated the option to cook every now and then. The kitchen is very well equipped - we didnt miss a thing.
A wonderful stay. Thank you.
Great location, super easy to find. Very clean and tidy, our host were lovely and incredibly helpful. Would definitely stay again! 😁
Highly recommend this apartment. Wonderful in every way. Great location and bonus having parking. We would definitely return in the future.

We stayed here from Sunday 29th October - 2nd November 2023 as the first stop on our honeymoon in Scotland. We’ve never been to Edinburgh before, but Don’s instructions of how to find the apartment was really helpful. Don also contacted us well in advance of our booking with local recommendations for food and drink - this was very helpful  as it gave us chance to look places up and helped us to find our bearings. The location of the apartment is beautiful and it had everything that we needed, it was also a short walk from the centre and we could not of asked for a better place to stay! Thank you Don - Emma & Luke (Travelling from North Wales).
good location

Charlie was super flexible with me and my uncertain schedule. He cooked me breakfast, and recommended routes to take and places to see. A lovely, homely room which was peaceful, and a very comfy bed. Would 100% recommend.
Convenient location with good public transort links. Clean place. Very comfortable bed.

The stay here was amazing. The apartment was well equipped with almost everything you might need, super clean, and what made it even more special was the location — close to the main attractions, within a comfortable walking distance, and the view of the castle was truly priceless.
The only thing you might want to keep in mind is that the apartment is on the second floor with no elevator, and the staircase is very spiral. If you have a lot of luggage or big heavy suitcases like we did, it can be a bit tricky.
Other than that, I’d definitely love to stay here again!
这家民宿绝对是本次英国之行最满意的住宿体验，房间内部设施卫生和装修都超级棒，堪称五星级标准。房东 Kim 也很 nice ，房屋紧邻公园，后院外就是一条小河，周边环境安静优美，特别适合自驾有车的游客。
Great location with parking, walkable to the city center, host was quick to answer any questions

立地は素晴らしく、ホストも迅速に返信をくださり大変親切でした。少し古い建物でしたが、中は暖かかったです。
また、基本的に必要なものが揃っていて、快適に過ごすことができました。
ただ、衛生面にはいくつか問題がありました。
バスルームには前の宿泊者の髪が残っていて、清潔ではありませんでした。また、ソファベッドを利用しようとしましたがネズミのフンで汚れていて、使うことができませんでした。朝起きた時や外出から戻ると、ソファにネズミのフンが落ちていて、一緒に泊まった友人がネズミを見かけました。
他にも、まな板に虫がついていました。
丁寧なホストだっただけに、残念でした。

The stay was great and the host really responsive and kind. The only thing I would recommend is a better sound proof installation in order to feel more private. Other than that honestly I would stay again. The house was clean in a quiet area and with easy access to plenty of buses that go ti the city center.

Catherine was a lovely host. My room was comfortable and well-lit. Catherine and her daughter were very helpful with any questions that I had. Their dog Chewie was so friendly! As someone who can be nervous around dogs I had no problems with him. The location of the house was near public transit so it was easy to get around Edinburgh. This was my first experience with an Airbnb host and the process went very smoothly. I would definitely stay with Catherine again. Thank you so much!

Lovely host, he is welcoming!
We forgot our outlet adapter for phones, and fortunately he has a power strip. He were always here when we needed. Excellent and funny host with lovely room.

If you’re ever visiting Edinburgh Gilly’s place is a must. Not only is the property a luxury stay Gilly doesn’t leave any stone unturned. Having worked for the National Trust she knows everywhere from dining out to sports, theatre you name it Gilly knows about it.
I would most definitely come back here again.

I booked Lucy and Christian's space for my mom, who was flying in from the US on her own. Lucy and Christian were incredibly helpful and communicative, and my mom absolutely LOVED staying with them. Thank you again!! We hope to see you again :)

Dave is really good host. The room is on the 4th floor so you can see peaceful meadow and serene scenery through the window. Also with antique furniture it’s meticulously organised. It was so nice to stay there and strongly recommend it!

We really enjoyed our stay with family of 5, our kids love it here and want to stay all month long.
Perfect stay if you want to visit Edinburgh City.
Thank you! We had an amazing stay. Perfect location, clean well-equipped accommodation and proactive, friendly communication. We couldn't have asked for more. We hope to be back!

Deb's place is in a good location right near Holyrood house and is easy walking distance to the Royal Mile and Edinburgh castle.
While we enjoyed our stay in Edinburgh and enjoyed our sightseeing there we were a bit taken aback by the host's patronising attitude when we asked for laundry soap (it's not provided, which is problematic for light travellers!) It set an unpleasant tone for our stay that was compounded when we discovered the host had not appropriately arranged the flat for 2 adults and a child and we had to hunt out an extra towel, fold out bed and bedding for ourselves.

We had a wonderful stay at Pete and Loana’s place. They were incredibly welcoming and made us feel right at home. The house itself is lovely, with beautiful surroundings and a peaceful atmosphere. If you enjoy walking, it’s only about 40 minutes to Arthur’s Seat - a great way to take in the scenery. Highly recommend!

My family and I love the place, the apt itself is very cozy, clean and just nice for four of us. The location is superb, it is walkable to all the attractions and not to forget Andy, the wonderdul host who allowed for early check in as our flight arrived much earlier. Highly recommended!
Location was superb, quite and safe neighbourhood. No surprises, everything was exactly same how it was written at the advert.
Chambre sympathique non loin du centre ville d'Édimbourg. L'hôte était sympathique et respectueux même si nous avons dû attendre une demi heure devant le logement. Malgré cela, le séjour fut agréable
1 minute away from a big supermarket. Super convenient. Host is very friendly. We are extremely grateful that the host allowed late checkout on our last day. I’d give 11/10 of this place.

Reaaz was a wonderful host. His flat is beautifully decorated and very clean. All of the comforts one could need are provided. Me made us feel very welcome and was very flexible with us about check in times, storing luggage while we explored, etc. If you are interested in enjoying the beauty of Edinburgh, Reazz's place is an excellent choice. It was the favorite of our stay in London and Scotland.

As experience travellers, my partner and I are in firm agreement that this place is a good example of folks wanting to cash-in on a neighbourhood than provide a quality Airbnb stay.
The location is easy to find in a bustling commercial area, within a short walk from the train station. There is a lovely view of the castle from the front windows of the apartment.
Unfortunately, though, the location is the strongest asset of this stay by far. The apartment is in serious need of general maintenance, routine deep clean and some basic updating to the apartment and its listing on Airbnb.
When we arrived we noticed several light bulbs or switches didn’t work, at least two drains were clogged (both in the master bedroom en-suite) and cupboard doors did not work as they should (e.g stay open).
Cleanliness was by far the worst feature of our stay. While we can acknowledge the sheets were freshly changed and a basic wipe down was done, the place was filthy. Baseboards had a layer of dust, there were sticky spots and stains on walls and doors, the kitchen bin stunk and was sticky, we found open food left behind in cupboards and hairs stuck on chairs, carpet and couches, as well as tape left stuck to the walls and ceiling (presumably from other guests?). And the coffee maker looked as if it hadn’t been cleaned in months (if ever). In short, the place was overdue for a deep clean!
Lastly, the hosts seriously need to consider investing in the space to update it to its full potential AND update the listing. We were told there was some usual wear and tear on the place since the photos were first taken but it was more like it was run-down (which the hosts acknowledged when we messaged them about our concerns). The beds were lumpy and uncomfortable, the couches are disgusting and much of the place looked cheaply put together in person rather than nicely set as in the photos. Actually, in several instances the photos didn’t reflect what the apartment offered - e.g the dishes were completely different than ones pictured. Other investments into this place that could improve the experience include upgrading the windows to modern, energy efficient double pane windows, as the current windows let in not only a lot of draft but sound from across the street (read: the issue here isn’t the sound of the city per se - of course the city centre will be loud - but the outdated windows). Periodically updating furniture to ensure its comfortable should be a given but also providing cleaning supplies and basic necessities would make this stay much better (there was only one dish towel for an apartment meant to host 8 people).
All in all, this place does not live up the reviews nor it’s description. I suppose if you’re looking just for a place to crash after a night on the town it may be alright but don’t look too closely or you’ll be grossed out by what you see and what you’ve paid!

Le drain de la douche ne coulait pas bien, donc il fallait prendre des pauses durant notre douche afin d’éviter que l’eau ne s’accumule au fond et déborde. Nous y avons passé 2 jours et c’était suffisant, je n’y serais pas resté plus longtemps. C’était « correct » pour le prix payé, mais il y aurait place à amélioration. Le logement était sécuritaire, et la cuisine commune était propre et bien équipée.
Fantastic apartment in a great location. Would highly recommend
Great location in the heart of Edinburgh with easy access to the old town. As others have said the building itself is a bit offbeat which takes away from the value for money.

spent a long weekend in Edinburgh with my son and daughter and their families (7 in total) to attend a wedding.  So pleased that we stayed in this beautiful apartment, extremely comfortable, a home from home. The grandchildren loved it, so much space for hide and seek!! Stockbridge is a great area of Edinburgh, lots of shops and restaurants/cafes within 5 to 10 minutes of the apartment and we walked into Princes street on several occasions, it took about 25 minutes even with 73 year old grandparents in tow!! Overall I can highly recommend this apartment and would definitely choose again.
What a great place - clean, easy check in and out and excellent location!

Miroslav’s flat was perfect for what we needed. Bedrooms were a great size plus it had two bathrooms which is hard to find! Bus stop is 3 minutes walk from the flat and only a 30 minute ride away from the Royal Mile. Miroslav made sure we felt at home and even went out and bought us something we needed for the kitchen. There’s two grocery stores within walking distance which was fabulous. Would stay here again!
Great location. Everything needed to explore Edinburgh.
Appartement propre, grand et lumineux. Notre hôte était parfaitement disponible et à l’écoute de nos demandes. Très bon séjour chez Nina !
Great host! Strongly recommend the place. Thanks!

This apartment had everything we needed for our stay! Margaret was a thorough and responsive host, It was right alongside a few major bus lines, easily walkable to other sites and landmarks, had a great restaurants in the area and plenty of space for six people to live comfortably  without feeling like they were on top of one another. I would highly recommend this location to anyone visiting Edinburgh.

I had an excellent time in Edinburgh and Olessia's apartment was wonderful to come home to after a busy day out and about.  the apartment was extremely quiet and clean.  It was easy to control the temperature as well. She left some wonderful little treats in the fridge for us to enjoy.  The bathrooms were well proportioned and very comfortable.  Olessia was very quick and responsive with texts and updates throughout our trip.  I definitely recommend her flat for anyone traveling to Edinburgh.

Rosie en John zijn fijne hosts. Behulpzaam en steeds bereikbaar voor vragen.
Het appartement van Rosie en John heeft een super fijne locatie: rustig gelegen in een prettige buurt, tegenover Holyrood Palace, om de hoek van de Royal Mile en ook om de hoek van Arthur’s Seat. Het is voorzien van alle gemakken: een fijne keuken (waarin – heel fijn - een aantal basis spullen aanwezig waren), een heerlijke douche en leuke woonkamer met uitzicht op de entree van de Holyrood Palace.
Het appartement is voorzien van een kleine, rustige eenpersoonskamer zonder ramen met prima bed én een slaapkamer met (smaller type) twee persoonsbed. Rosie had voor ons het beddengoed voor de bedbank in de woonkamer achtergelaten voor het geval we daar gebruik van wilden maken. Dat was heel fijn maar uiteindelijk niet nodig. Al met al hebben we genoten van dit heerlijke appartement met haar geweldige ligging.

Roisin esta muy atenta, está al pendiente de tus preguntas por mensaje. El alojamiento para llegar en bus se encuentran a unos 40 mins del centro de Edimburgo y la parada está a unos metros de distancia. Es muy tranquilo donde está situado la casa. El único inconveniente es que no cuentas con un llave propia de tu cuarto.

Nous avons passé un tres agréable séjour sur Edimbourg .
L appartement est tres bien situé spacieux silencieux .
Valérie est tres agréable, au soin de ses hôtes , réactive face aux différentes questions et problèmes .
Un petite remarque cependant la cuisine est peu équipée si vous de idea de cuisiner ou dîner dans le logement entre amis .
Il manque aussi une table dans le salon et de décoration pour être plus chaleureux .
Un séchoir pour étendre le linge serait le bienvenue aussi.
Sinon logement agréable et Valérie est une personne très réactive et sympathique envers ses hôtes .
Yann

Great quiet location to use as a home base while exploring Edinburgh. Very handy to be within walking distance of the a wide variety of restaurants, stellar coffee shops, and the tram (which runs straight to the airport). Thank you Rachel for being such a welcoming host, we look forward to visiting again.
Lovely stay
Hermoso lugar, con vista hermosa
It was great.  Good location.  Would highly recommend to anyone wanting to explore the city.

Perfect location, so close to everything! Very clean appartement with everything we needed. Host was very quick and easy to contact and answered the queries we had. There was 5 of us so one stayed on the pull -out couch which suited our dynamic anyway. Would recommend to anyone !

The pictures do not do it justice! You are absolutely next-door to Edinburgh Castle! The stairs out of your apartment leads straight up to the castle. Olive was quick with her responses. She was generous and helpful and we absolutely loved being in such close proximity to everything Edinburgh had to offer!

The flat is in a wonderful area of Edinburgh. There are lots of restaurants nearby and it is walkable to many attractions while being private and away from the touristy areas.
The flat is charming and nicely decorated. The living room is beautiful with modern furnishings and period decor. There’s a well-equipped kitchen that is tastefully decorated. The master bedroom is spacious, and the other two bedrooms are perfect for kids. The host is great.
There are some minor items that could make the stay better. The toilet in the master bath is difficult to flush; it works sometimes. The internet is spotty. The kitchen needs a kitchen trash bin. There is a garbage can in the kitchen that is for the street. It’s large and smells. Because it is big, garbage bags won’t fit so you have to pull the bag out each time to add contents. There were also flowers, which was a nice touch. However, the flowers died after a couple days of our stay. Synthetic flowers may be better.

Fantastic apartment and the included garage was awesome. Beautiful, immaculately clean and everything you could need to hand.
Short flight of stairs to the upstairs. Steep and not recommended if you have knee or hip issues. Having said that my elderly mother was able to get up and down with some help.
Highly recommend. Enjoy.
Wonderful host, very accommodating. Location is great, quite and hip neighborhood with great restaurants and cute shops. Easy public transport to city center and airport. Clean and homey apartment

Had an amazing stay at City Retreat. I ended up extending my stay by one more day and when contacting the host the reply was immediate :) The place is spacious and each guest has their own bathroom - this all for a great value, especially considering how close it is to city center! I recommend booking this airbnb if you plan on visiting Edinburgh!

Thank you Steve and Emma, for a great place to stay while visiting Edinburgh in August.
The flat was on quiet street and everything was as described in the listing.
Landry and detergent was very helpful.
Perfect location and perfect Airbnb
Excellent place. Alan sent a detailed email of how to find the place. Excellent and quiet location.

Very lovely and charming place to stay, would definitely recommend! It had everything we needed and is close to Haymarket train station and also about a 15 minute walk to Edinburgh Castle. The house was very homely and clean, and as the other reviews have said, perfect for couples.
Melanie was very helpful and arranged for someone else to meet us with the keys as she was away.

The house was very clean, and the host was very kind and friendly. They had a beautiful cat that I enjoyed petting. My only issue was that the bathroom door didn’t have a lock, which made me feel a bit uncomfortable.

It's been a pleasure being Daniela's guests. Everything was well arranged and you got the informotion you needed. The flat was really cozy, spacious and exactly like offered in the pictures. The flat is really good located. Just a 10min walk to oldtown and the castle. Therefore its been really quiet and youve got an amazing view on the "meadows". If i would visit edinburgh again there would be definitely a comeback to Daniela's place! 5* + best regards from Germany and thank you very much :)

The apartment was beautifully presented and extremely comfortable. The decor was nice, complemented by a few plants and a great deal of books, and the rooms were well lit with light from the large windows during the day and various lamps to create whatever ambience desired in the evening. The view from the windows was great and I even opened my eyes to a view of Arthur’s Seat out the bedroom window in the morning - which was definitely a highlight of the stay.
James was quick to respond, gave clear and accurate instructions, and filled the apartment with lots of thoughtful touches, including: fresh juice, milk, tea, coffee, cereals, olive oil, bathroom supplies, towels and there was even a Jenga set over which a friend and I enjoyed an evening.
I thoroughly recommend staying here - I will certainly be checking its availability next time I’m in Edinburgh.

The location of the flat was superb with everything being only a short walk away. Pablo was a friendly host and made our stay homely and welcoming. The flat itself was clean and had everything you needed and the free coffee in the morning was spot on!

Si algo destaco del alojamiento es la recepción. Michael nos estuvo esperando a nuestra llegada y nos dio instrucciones útiles para movernos por la ciudad. Nos recibió con una sonrisa a pesar que llegáramos tarde y seguramente estuviera cansado.
Muchas gracias por ese detalle!!
En cuanto al alojamiento está muy bien,limpio y camas cómodas. Se encuentra a 10min en bus al centro y la parada está justo debajo del piso. Muy bien conectado!!!
Malgrat estar molt lluny del centre està ben comnunicat i la relació qualitat preu és molt bona. Es dorm fantasticament.

This is a very beautiful and well located apartment. The pictures don’t really do justice to the apartment and it’s easier to located and in a friendly environment. Host is superb and always available when needed. I’d pick this place over and over again.
Excellent hosts, place was super clean and pristine. Very welcoming and warm environment. Absolutely 10/10 recommended.

Très joli appartement, très propre et bien situé. Idéal pour deux, pas adapté pour 4 car le couchage dans le canapé du salon n'est pas confortable et il n'y a pas d'occultant à la fenêtre. Hôte peu réactive et peu flexible.

If your main priority is having a reserved parking space, like ours was, this is your place to stay!  Was only a 15 minute walk to the Castle and Royal Mile.  Plenty of restraunts and local grocery store right around the corner.  I would recommend this place to anyone.  Thank you Rebecca!
Great location & clear instructions on finding it

We stayed three nights with Hannah and liked it a lot! She was really nice and helpful, but we didn’t see her a lot since she had to work and we both were busy exploring the beautiful city of Edinburgh. We would definitely recommend booking her place!

Everything about our stay exceeded our expectations!
This home is perfect for exploring Edinburgh. Yes, the Castle and Old town is not to be missed. But, Stockbridge was such a wonderful surprise. We loved being so close to many shops, restaurants and pubs. We were able to walk to Dean Village and the Botanical Gardens as well.
Your home was lovely and well taken care of! Thank you making our family feel right at home with your warm welcome and excellent knowledge of the area.
We highly recommend this home!!
Excellent stay at Francois’ place. It was super clean, spacious and in the perfect location. I would recommend.
Superbe petit appartement aux murs roses, bien décoré et aménagé. Très pratique pour un séjour en ville.
Very lovely flat, everything you need is there. Very close to the centre and good communication from the host.

We booked this home the night before check in after issues at another place. Our booking was confirmed quickly and even with it being last minute we were offered early check in and the home was immaculately cleaned. It is a beautiful home, close to central without being busy around it. It perfectly fit our needs, we even cooked 2 meals here and the kitchen had all that we needed. I couldn’t recommend this home and host enough.
The apartment was clean and nice, Slawomir was friendly and helpful. Couldn't have asked for more.

Cannot recommend Carols’ beautiful home enough. A lovely, kind host who made me feel incredibly welcome. Great location with a bus stop literally right outside the door, so handy for getting to airport & in to town. Carol was extremely helpful with letting me know what buses I should take and how to find her place. Beautiful, comfortable room and a bathroom of dreams! A friendly face for a cuppa in the morning was much appreciated. Would definitely stay again! Thank you Carol for making the first night of my trip so blissfully easy and enjoyable! :)

Janet welcomed us with a beautiful smile. We found ourselves in a clean, tidy house, with everything that is necessary and perhaps even more, suited to our needs. The location is strategic because it is close to the bus stop to the center of Edinburgh and to the airport: you can very well park your car and choose to visit the city without going into traffic with the car.
With Janet a family atmosphere was immediately created, also favored by the sharing of the kitchen (meeting place and exchange), in a perfect balance between privacy and the desire for mutual knowledge.
Janet is always ready to provide any information that is required (to us has been a great deal of help, even Janet thank you!).
Definitely recommended for those who want to visit this beautiful city.
Super-clean, warm and ideally situated for the tram into the centre of town, the flat is an ideal base to explore Edinburgh from. It couldn't have been better.
Really beautiful flat in a great location.Flat was super clean and well equipped. Plant Bae cafe downstairs has great vegan breakfast and coffee. We will be back

This place is a great choice right in the heart of Old Town. We were within walking distance to everything and it was safe. Check-in was seamless and the place was clean and just as expected.
The common areas aren't huge so just a note that this isn't ideal if you're planning on spending a ton of time at the place!
I loved the renovated bathroom!
Very lovely Place! Super clean and a very nice location. We greatly enjoyed our stay and really appreciate Mariana letting us have late check out while we waited for our train!

The flat was lovely, just as per the photos.  A nice variety of restaurants are located outside the building and the surrounding neighborhood as well as a Sainbury grocery around the corner.  Flat was well stocked & equipped.  Mel left us lovely welcome goodies and was very responsive to questions.  As we had a lengthy stay, she even periodically texted to see how we were doing.  Location was very convenient for traveling by bus in several directions; downtown Edinburgh was a short ride away.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!  Can highly recommend!
Great place! Perfectly located for a first visit to Edinburgh’s top touristic spots!
Home was cozy and location was superb!
Ollie & Ella were extremely helpful, friendly, and responsive hosts. We would stay here again the next time we visit Edinburgh.

Harriet’s place was the ideal spot to explore Edinburgh for a few days. Very easy to walk or catch the bus into the city centre. Harriet was very accommodating, allowing us to check in early and leave our bags for the day before heading to the airport. Would stay again.
Beautiful flat close to central Edinburgh. Well equipped kitchen. Clean, modern and comfortably accommodated 10 guests.
Great stay, Gail was very helpful and the Wendy house was lovely. Located in a great location to city centre by bus 10 or 27

The entrance inside to the stairwell (up 35 steps not the 20 steps described) is not in any way attractive. Inside the flat,  the squeaky wood floors were really loud and annoying. We found the sofa to be very uncomfortable. The bed is not King Size by USA standards. Beds in Europe tend to be smaller. Ear plugs are needed to sleep due to the noise from people on the street below.   We spent most of our time sightseeing and found the Flat to be well  located. The owners provided lots of local information ahead of time which was nice. When I let them know we had arrived without difficulty, I also let them know that the drapes in the bedroom needed attention. They were very responsive and offered to come over the next day.  It was not a big deal so we just left them alone to be fixed at a later date.
Vielen Dank für deine Gastfreundschaft Charlotte. Haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen. Alles war wie beschrieben und es hat uns an nichts gefehlt. Würden jederzeit wieder kommen. Liebe Grüße ☺️
Great place to stay!!

Great stay in a fab location near the beach and bus routes into Edinburgh. Lovely big room and bathroom shared with guests from another room (though we never saw them). Something to note is that although this is in someone's private home, the accommodation is cut off from the main house and acts like an independent apartment. My mum who stayed with me isn’t used to this set up and initially found it a bit uncomfortable, but still had a great stay.
Really nice location, very close to the center of the city. Highly recommend!
Thank you Luc for a lovely stay, made meeting my first grandchild very pleasant.
Great little room, as described and pictured. Very easy to check in and check out

Our stay was perfect for what we needed.  Super close to restaurants and shops, and Princess Street, a main hub for busses and trams.  Joss and the rest of the team were excellent with communication and quick to respond to any questions we had.  If you need a place to sleep in between exploring the wonderful city of Edinburgh, this is a great spot.

We loved being in the heart of Edinburgh.  We walked everywhere except of course when we took the Hop On Hop Off bus to get a flavor of the broader area.  This house is good for long or short term stays with full kitchen supplies.  LR is very cozy with lots of comfortable seating.  Bed is comfortable.  They even had 2 drying racks for laundry which was great since we never use a dryer.  And the little “get started” package was very helpful.  Thank you.  Needless to say, we enjoyed our stay.
Great flat and Emma was lovely
Perfect location right around the corner from Castlehill and still quiet. Apartment has everything you need, great view. Highly recommended.

Denise og Julian var rigtig gode til at respondere hurtigt med klare instruktioner, og det var også rart at man fik en brochure med omkring instrukser og anbefalinger i nabolaget.
Ja der er meget støj fra Rose Street - MEN det er en del af at bo så centralt, så det var vi forberedt på. Man kan ikke forvente andet ligegyldigt hvilken storby man besøger.
Vi prioriterede at skulle finde en bolig med gåafstand til alt og det kan nok ikke være mere centralt end det var.
Instrukserne til check-in og check-ud var klare og nemme og forstå.
Lejligheden ligner akkurat billederne.
Det eneste negative vi kunne komme på var rengøringen i køkkenet, da køkkenredskaberne var klistrede men det kunne vi hurtigt selv ordne på 5 minutter, så det var ikke et stort problem. Værelserne var ellers rene.
Ville klart besøge lejligheden igen i fremtiden.

Highly recommended!!
We had a fantastic time at Rich and Will’s home.
Close walking distance to several shops, attractions, bars and eateries. Tram and bus stops are also close.
Such kind people, they even supplied coffee, tea and things for us to make breakfast. We loved the company, and conversations, discussing life, past and future travel plans and giving their adorable pups some love.
They are friendly and respond quickly to any questions. Their home is clean, and comfortable. Bedroom and bath was perfect, bed was very comfortable too. They made us feel like it was our home away from home.
Would definitely stay there again.
Beautiful apartment, lovely area, highly recommended.

This is my second visit, and l am totally content with this hospitable landlord and his wife. they are so friendly, the house is so comfortable and lovely, they helped me feel myself at home. I hope to see that lovely couple again.

We had an excellent stay! It was a fantastic location and Linda was so kind and flexible. We were able to walk everywhere and it offered easy access to Stockbridge. Our only regret was not staying longer! Thanks for having us!

Karen is nice and lovely.
I love this place so much. It's clean and comfortable.

Wonderful place to stay for Edinburgh break. Central location makes it handily situated for all Edinburgh's attractions. Lots of restaurants, cafes and pubs close by. Apartment is very well equipped with everything you need and very clean. Excellent value too. Great communication. Highly recommended.

It was terrible hot in The flat. We askes for fan, but there no more legt. The beds have no mattresstoppers and were very hard. Munch noise from other guests and difficult to sleep.The zink missed The plug and we askes for A New without success.

Mi experiencia en este viaje no hubiera sido la misma sin Alex. Encontré un amigo y a una gran persona en mi parcerito. Sin lugar a dudas es el mejor anfitrión con el que me he quedado en todos mis viajes y cuando vuelva a Edimburgo en el futuro, no buscaría otro lugar para quedarme.

Sue and Grant's flat is a great place to stay right in the centre of Morningside. The flat has two good sized bedrooms with plenty of wardrobe space for clothes, a large sitting room, great powerful shower and a well equipped kitchen. My partner, daughter and I were very comfortable here for almost a week and I'd happily book again if I needed a place to stay in Morningside. Communication in the run up to the stay was prompt and helpful and Sue and Grant very kindly touched base after our first night to check everything was fine.

Fantastic place, in a very good location close to local attractions. Princess Street and the Edinburgh Castle is both about 10-15min walk.
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is lovely and feels like home from home. We highly recommend this place. I think we will be back in a near future :))))
A quality room in a great location. No coffee and tea provision but an enjoyable stay for sure

Dave & Tokes are the most wonderful hosts ever! Not only is their home absolutely gorgeous, but they both have the sweetest, most pleasant demeanor. They both greeted us upon our arrival, gave us a tour of our home away from home (which it definitely felt like), and provided us with a wealth of information about Edinburgh and her many offerings. They provided us with a nice breakfast of croissants, fruit, cereals, OJ, coffee, & tea and when we left the last day (at 5am) Dave was up with a breakfast to go bag to see us off. He also set up our taxi for the airport that morning. It was so great to stay with them that we were sad to leave. Should we ever return to Edinburgh, we will definitely look to them for our accommodations. Thanks, guys!

The room is 3-5 min walk from the buses that will take you to the centre in about 30min. Very quiet residential neighborhood. 10 min walk to a huge Morrison supermarket.
The room is on the 2nd floor with a ceiling window. Marvelous sunrises. It is very clean, the bed is comfortable, the linen impeccably clean.
There's a private bathroom with an instant heating shower.
We shared the house with 2 tenants, practically didn't see them.
The kitchen has everything you need but it's not spotless.
Bring your own tea/coffee/sugar...
The host was always in touch, answered immediately. We had some issues with the heating which were solved really quickly.
The mat in the bath tub needs perhaps replacement. The rest was perfect.

Easy stay at Edinburgh. The communication with the host was easy, convenient and friendly. The appartment itself was really well equipped. Tiny minus for the poor air inside the appartment and smoking neighbor.

Wir waren nur eine Nacht da und sind spät angekommen - das war aber kein Problem, da wir Anweisungen erhalten haben. Man sollte kurz Bescheid geben, dass man mit einem Auto anreist, da die Parkmöglichkeiten dort begrenzt sind, aber auch das war kein Problem. Carol war sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber, ruhig und das Bett sehr bequem. Sehr zu empfehlen.

We had a very good time at Isabel's place. She is a lovely and welcoming person and her house is simply beautiful - I really loved her way of furnishing and decorating.
The house is located very well for visiting the city, all the touristic spots are in walking distance and we especially enjoyed Stockbridge with its small shops, pubs and restaurants.
Thanks for everything :-)

The key lock box was not labelled and there were a few, had to try them all before we finally got in. The communual hall/ stairs is not looked after and we got a shock at the state of it ! However the flat was perfect for our stay, very central and clean

Tessa met met half way down the stairs & helped me up with my case. She offered me a drink straight away. I was free to use the kitchen & living room.
My room was spacious with small en suite shower, loo & washbasin, all perfectly adequate. The bed was comfortable. I had keys so that I could come & go as I pleased.
The flat is very conveniently located, not far from the centre.
My only negative comments are that it was rather expensive ( I realise it was festival time, but I still think it was overpriced)
Breakfast was rather spartan & consisted of a bowel of strawberries & unripe plums + 1 croissant. & tea or coffee.
everything was perfect. location was really nice.

Merci à Jadwiga et Vitalijs pour leur accueil chaleureux dans leur charmante maison.
Tout était parfait nous avons même eux droit à des petites attentions à notre arrivée.
Une petite maison paisible et tellement agréable dans un quartier résidentiel facile d’accès depuis le centre ville.
Merci encore à vous ☺️
Laura
Wish I could’ve stayed longer! The perfect cozy stay in a really great location! Ryan was a great host and I would definitely stay in this Airbnb again.
La cabane est tout à fait conforme à la description. Très bonne adresse, nous nous y sommes senti très bien.
Dimitriy's place was perfect for the 2 of us.  Convenient location. We were able to walk to all our favorite places. It was also clean and had a very comfortable bed. I would stay here again!
We had a wonderful stay- the location is amazing and the house is beautiful- and perfect to accommodate 6 people. Highly recommend!
Clean, well-equipped kitchen, great location!

For a stay in Edinburgh right in the heart of the city centre this property is perfectly located at the top of Leith walk to be a stones throw from Edinburgh’s new town.
My colleague and I were staying for a work trip and the majority of the stay was lovely. However there were a few unexpected things within the flat. Compared to the photos a lot of the furniture and fittings were different to what was present within the apartment, these may need updating in future. Additionally, the shower door was broken and the oven was not operational for the entirety stay of our trip. Credit to the Joivy team with their quick responses, however even after sending out technicians to look at the oven, our stay was impacted by this as we’d planned to cook food for our stay. I
I would still recommend this flat based on its location in the centre of Edinburgh.
Luka’s place is awesome will definitely book in future as Luka was very friendly and helpful.
lovely place and stay.

Gerrard was warm and welcoming, extremely prompt in all communications, and flexible to our off-hour check in constraints. It was great staying in such a central spot to Edinburgh Castle, the Royal Mile, etc. and we felt very safe and at home during our trip.
Gorgeous apartment in amazing location. Definitely recommend!

Отличная квартира  , коммуникабельный , отвественный козяин . До большого супермаркета 5 минут , до королевской мили 15-20 пешком . Машина под домом на бесплатной парковке , но ей не пользовались , гуляли пешком , очень понравилось . Рекомендую этот вариант
Amazing and comfortable stay right by everything in Edinburgh!
10/10 would stay again! Absolutely gorgeous flat nice and quiet yet a 2 minute walk to town!

Location is perfect. All attractions are walking distance if you want to leave this charming “outlander “ inspired flat.  Great place for a weekend or longer! Amazing decor and comfy. Would highly recommend!

Allen and Liz were the very best kind of hosts: swiftly responsive to all our enquiries from the first email, accommodating of our specific requirements, warm-hearted, generous and very good humoured. We really felt welcome and honoured, as their guests.

We are regular visitors to Edinburgh (usually staying with friends, and also a daughter currently living here) and Hamish's Hame is in a great neighbourhood and very well connected for public transport. It's a very attractive apartment: quiet, bright, neat, very clean, well-organised, with lots of careful, thoughtful attention to detail, throughout. Three of us (including husband and adult daughter) stayed for three nights and we were really comfortable. There's a great king-size bed; and the two single mattresses, which make up the sofa-bed in the living/dining room, met our requirements really well when my older daughter joined us, spontaneously, on two of the three nights. The shower in the bathroom is a really good one and it's nice and roomy once you're through the slightly narrow entrance of the shower unit. We also made good use of the comprehensively well-equipped, excellent kitchen.

Allen and Liz went beyond the call of duty to ensure we felt 'at home'. Allen collected us from the train station, as if we were family, showed us around the flat and offered to be on call throughout our stay, should we need him. (Everything was fantastic, so we didn't.) We found a welcoming, personal letter and firm, funny, heartwarming instructions not to panic about minor damage to the property; we found books, DVDs, delicious complimentary scottish refreshments and useful basic food items in the kitchen cupboards.

I suppose I should say 'thank you' but I'm not sure if I really want to. I've been selfishly reluctant to write this review; I know it will just add to Allen and Liz's reputation. Hamish's Hame is a little gem and will be constantly booked up and WE will never have the opportunity to stay here, again.

So. Baaah.
The location is very good and the rooms are very beautiful. The only pity is that the shower flow is low.

Harriet’s place is Airbnb at its best - she provides an excellent window into Edinburgh at a great price and in a real home. Her neighborhood is slightly out of the center, but access to the main tourist attractions is quick and easy via public transit, or a walk if you’re feeling sporty. You can park for free, though you may have to search a bit for a spot. The room was well-outfitted, and Harriet was very friendly and provided great recommendations. I’d be very happy to stay here again.
Amazing host, couldn’t have asked for a better location. Endless activities to do within walking distance, perfect accommodation. Would highly recommend.

Excellent location and great apartment for 1-2 people to stay in. Many of Edinburgh’s must-see sights are close by and great restaurants/coffee shops nearby as well. The interior of the apartment itself is very distinct, featuring a unique design that allows into the space so much natural light, which I greatly admired. The apartment was also very clean and it was easy to reach out to Astrid.
Be advised (and I genuinely did not know this before booking): the apartment is on the 3rd floor and the only way to get to it is through a curved staircase, so you’ll have to carry your luggage all the way up when you check-in. Also, not much space inside the apartment to store your luggage, so they might have to hang out in the living room.
Other than that, great place to book if you’re a light traveler wishing to visit beautiful Edinburgh!

We stayed at the Townhouse-Leith for 4 days and had a wonderful experience. Alexander was extremely helpful, providing detailed information and guidance both before and during our stay. The rooms were well-equipped with all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay, and the place was spotless and well-maintained. The location is also great—just a 1-minute walk to the bus stop for easy access to the city centre and Royal Mile. We would absolutely love to stay here again on our next visit to Edinburgh and highly recommend it to others. Thank you, Alexander!
Brilliant flat with lots of space in a fantastic location. Strongly recommend.

lovely apartment. Great location. really nice walk into city centre.
Great hosts.

Our stay at Courtney's was absolutely perfect : great location at about 20 minutes in bus from the city center, lovely and clean flat, and delicious breakfast made by her!
Courtney is a lovely person. We loved talking with her and listening to her recommendations about Edinburgh. (plus she has adorable pets 🐾)
We highly recommend! 😊
Fantastic apartment. Great communication.

The flat was even better than expected - clean, cosy, modern and the region was really quiet. Definitely worth its price!
It's not in the city centre, but we never expected it to be there.
I could only recommend if you don't have any problem taking the bus for 20-25 minutes to the centre.
Allan was really kind and took us with his car when checking in and even took care about our breakfast on the next morning!
Overall really great experience.
Stanislav

Wonderful modern stylish flat with great view over the river and historic buildings.
Owner was keen to help and responded quickly.
Pleasant walk to the vicinity of the Royal Mile, despite all the rain we had during our stay.
Private undercover parking makes this an easy place to pick but there are lots of reasons we would want to return ... especially the bath.
Fantastic apartment!
Lovely stay.
This is a huge and lovely flat. Hosted by a great guy, Armando. Everything our group needed for our short stay in Edinburgh.

We travelled from Newcastle to attend a friend’s graduation and booked this Airbnb for a short stay. Unfortunately, our experience was very disappointing.
We have lived in the UK for over a year and fully understand and respect the local laws and customs. We returned quietly to the property around 3:30 AM after being out. We spoke briefly outside about the key before entering, without raising our voices or causing any disturbance.
A woman from upstairs came out and asked us to lower our voices. We immediately apologized and went inside. However, around ten minutes later, the police arrived, stating there had been a noise complaint. They checked the property, found no issues, and confirmed there was no party or disturbance of any kind.
This situation made us feel very uncomfortable and unwelcome. We were quiet, respectful guests at all times, yet we were treated unfairly. Due to this unpleasant experience, we decided to check out immed and return to Newcastle.
Disgusting and Embarrass

Perfect location
So easy to get about by bus right out side

It was a lovely apartment in a great spot of town where you can walk to any destination. The apartment itself had everything you could need. Even included a pint of milk to make a warm cup of tea. I would definitely stay here again.

Alison’s apartment was wonderful! Very spacious for our family of 5, nearly everyone had their own bathroom. The location was perfect. Only about a 5 min walk to the train station and less than 10 mins to old town. There were tons of cute bakeries and coffee shops around for the morning! Couldn’t have found a better place for us to stay in Edinburgh.
A comfortable bed, spotless room and luxury en-suite shower room in a lovely and accessible location. Ben and Kasia are welcoming and superb hosts. I highly recommend.
Lovely location and overall beautiful room to stay in. The whole process was easy, and wonderful. It was perfect for our trip to Edinburgh! Thanks Laila and Alan

We cannot speak highly enough of this absolute gem.
From initial booking through to check out, Allan the host was incredible.
The property is comfortable and spacious enough for two. The hot tub what a luxury to sit and view the planes landing and taking off within the comfort of a gorgeous garden.
There really was more than we could need. Lovely break would highly recommend.
Thanks for having us
Great place and location.  Ideal for a group of four. Very comfortable and well equipped.
Lovely apartment, so easy to get to everywhere we wanted to go. Great hosts. Thank you for having us.

Alan is a friendly host, and was very helpful when we needed anything. The place was super clean, the room was a perfect size for 2 people. The area is good, with groceries stores around and a couple of buses that take you central in 25-30mins. Overall, really enjoyed my stay!
Great place to stay, easy to get there and very quiet

The apartment is well-decorated and very clean. And the location was very convenient for visiting Edinburgh. Even though we just stayed there for one night and there were some issues with the shower, Alison and her husband offered immediate help. Wish they can get the shower fixed as soon as possible. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to visit Edinburgh.
Harriet was lovely, and so was the room. Really comfortable stay and far enough out of the hustle and bustle to be relaxing. Thank you!
很不错，位置特别好，去所有地方都很方便！
Beau logement, bel emplacement près des attractions mais en retrait pour un peu de calme. J'y retournerais sans hésiter!!

Sevi was communicative, flexible. The room was spacious, charming, super quiet, with an ensuite bathroom. The view onto the courtyard was beautiful. Sevi was accommodating and helpful. I loved the location! perfect! everyplace was walkable.

Located in the desirable Stockbridge suburb of Edinburgh, our host, Oscar’s condominium overlooks a beautiful bowling green. The unit is well maintained and clean, and Oscar is very accommodating. We would not hesitate to lodge at Oscar’s AirBnB again.
Had a wonderful stay here - the apartment is perfect.  Spacious, clean, bright, airy - and the hosts were so helpful.  Would love to come back.

Lizzie's place is great. Its got a big open plan kitchen and living room area that is the perfect place for large groups or families to hang out while making dinner / meals. The rooms were spacious, clean and the beds were super comfortable. Located near the playhouse and very central in Edinburgh.
We had a comfortable stay at the property. Property is at the centre of the town. Enjoyed it.

Great little apartment right in the city centre! The apartment itself is tastefully decorated and spotlessly clean. Exceptionally comfortable beds. There is a bit of noise from the street below which is full of restaurants and pubs, but nothing a bit of white noise didn’t block out. Lovely bottle of wine chilling in the fridge on our arrival which was most welcome! Sonia was very helpful with providing a high chair for our baby. Would definitely recommend anyone to stay here.
Literally the center of Edinburgh. Beautiful, make sure you read the parking restrictions. If you have a vehicle you will be doing some walking.
房间很干净，很舒适，居住体验感很好，就是离市区有些远，坐公交半小时左右路程

Very nice, spacious apartment, although a bit dated. Entering the place feels stepping back in time, but (mostly) in a charming manner.
Comfortable beds and generally very large rooms, apart from the bathrooms which are relatively small, but functional. Windows are old and poorly insulated, but there's central heating for the colder periods.
It's in a quiet neighborhood, 10 minutes walk from Grassmarket Square which is close to the city center. In the other direction there's not much to see.
I recommend the place, unless you're looking for something new.
La estancia ha sido estupenda, todo perfecto. La comunicación con Helen genial. Súper recomendado el alojamiento.
Had plenty of space and was in an excellent location. Would recommend.
Good
真的太爱这里了！房东Ceysa非常热情，我们英语不好，有很多问题，她会第一时间响应，很有耐心！房间一尘不染，住的非常舒适，强烈推荐！

This flat is realy spacious, the kitchen is very well equipped, suitable for cooking for a big family. the rooms were cosy, the heating worked properly, the water was hot in the showers.
The location was perfect, everything in a walkable distance, restaurants and shops in the street. The instruction video about getting in the house was very helpful, as well as the online manual for the house equipment.
Fantastic apartment right in the centre of the city, would stay here again in a heart beat.

Allison was a great hostess! Apartment was clean and very comfortable.  The location of the apartment is excellent - very conveniently located to bus stops (literally steps from the apartment) that we could take into the center of town. We enjoyed the many cafes and restaurants right around the corner.  Thank you!!

Very well appointed apartment in a safe location, with all required necessities for a family, including milk and bread! The garage had plenty of spaces but found the checkin and checkout process to be slightly cumbersome. The apartment keys, and garage fob are in the apartment, so one would need to make multiple trips to the apartment to get in/out of, the garage. Also, we used a comforter on the sofa bed, to prevent the springs from poking (even for kids). Perhaps add a topper? Overall great stay and would recommend!
A great place to stay in Edinburgh. Convenient location, comfortable, clean apartment and all the home comforts! Richard is a very considerate host.

Francesca was such a great host and an excellent communicator. I had the best time staying at the house! A clean beautiful vibrant house with everything you could possibly need for your comfortable stay. I was on a solo trip and the place was not too far from the city centre with really good transportation connections. Felt like home away from home.

From the minute we requested to book Caroline's place until after we left, Caroline was in communication with us.  All of her instructions were clear and concise.  Pictures were included to help find the apartment. She gave recommendations for food and things to do.  Her household manual was clear and very helpful using all of the appliances in the apartment.  The apartment was clean and as described. There was more than adequate room.  A thoughtful touch was the bowl of individual cereal boxes to start us off for breakfast as well as tea and coffee! (Great idea for our first morning when we hadn't gotten the lay of the land). With respect to the sights, we don't mind walking and we walked everywhere from the apartment. (For those who may not want as much walking, there were buses nearby.) All in all, we were very happy staying at Caroline's place.  To those choosing to stay here in the future, ENJOY your stay!!
Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen, sehr sauber und top Standard, gute öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, alles wie auf den Bildern. Wir können die Unterkunft nur empfehlen, gerne wieder.

Un lugar cálido confortable y en una ubicación estratégica. Su anfitrión Lewis muy amable y en cada momento nos hizo sentir como en casa. Tiene todas las comodidades que hacen falta y Lewis se preocupa a cada momento por las necesidades de los viajeros. En definitiva todo lo necesario y el plus de Lewis que hace la diferencia.
Fue una buena alternativa para pasar año nuevo pese a estar un poco distante del centro. Por otro lado como estaba alejado era un barrio muy tranquilo y residencial.
房东Gerry非常热情、幽默、有活力、乐于助人，看上去比照片年轻许多。房东太太给做了可口的早餐。非常感谢!
Great stay, lovely apartment!
