With the exception of a hiccup at check in, it was a great stay.  Great location and flat.  Very clean, all the amenities one needs and well presented.
Very comfortable stay in Luca's home.

The location was probably the highlight of the property, being surrounded by bars and restaurants in the very centre of Edinburgh.  Despite being in quite an old building, the apartment was very clean and welcoming.  The bathroom and one of the bedrooms are quite small but are still nice enough.  We really enjoyed our stay and I would recommend!
Nice flat with great access to town, would recommend!

An excellent host. Great communication before, during and after our stay. The apartment was immaculate with very tasteful interior design. There were some nice treats on arrival too. The apartment itself is in a good location with regular buses nearby but we opted to walk to town for the festival. Would definitely use again.

Nós amamos este airbnb! Nos sentimos em casa, porque vimos o cuidado e atenção que os proprietários cuidam dele. Tudo de muita qualidade! A sala é super aconchegante, conseguimos descansar, relaxar e conversar ao redor da adorável lareira. Excelente, e super recomendo! A localização não é extremamente central, mas ainda muito perto e caminhável! Obrigada aos proprietários pela maravilhosa hospedagem!
Very clean and spacious. Perfect for a larger family or group of friends. Goos restaurants at walking distance.
Incredible location. Lovely space.

A beautiful and clean apartment in an excellent location in Stockbridge for a weekend in Edinburgh.  We did feel that 10am was quite early for checkout on a Sunday morning, especially when next check-in isn't until 4pm. Very responsive host and we all thoroughly enjoyed our stay !

We had a wonderful stay at Rosie’s place! The apartment is in a perfect location—just a short walk to many of Edinburgh’s main attractions, which made exploring the city super convenient.
From the moment we walked in, we felt right at home. The space is even more charming and cozy than it looks in the photos. Rosie went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, leaving us bottled water, Coke, and a lovely selection of cookies.
The bathroom was spotless and stocked with high-quality toiletries, which was such a nice touch. The beds were incredibly comfortable, and our family of four had a great night’s sleep.
We truly appreciated all the thoughtful details and hospitality. This stay was one of the highlights of our trip. Would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Edinburgh.

David was an amazing host, who helped us out with several things, like parking, which we couldn’t arrange with a foreign mobile number.  His place is in a great location - we walked everywhere. And if you don’t want to venture too far, the castle and several good restaurants and pubs are within a few blocks.

I had a relaxing and lovely stay at Abi’s place.
The room was spacious, very clean and well-lit. Abi had prepared some light snacks which was very thoughtful and the location of the place is superb. There’s restaurants, cafes, and groceries within 5-10 mins walk. Also it’s very close to the famous Lannan Bakery. I couldn’t recommend more about this place - responsive host, and two sweet cats and a comfortable stay!
Lovely, central apartment,  with everything you need for a fab stay. Comfortable and safe

Ha sido genial la estancia, muy bien ubicada para ir caminando a los sitios más relevantes.
Y tema limpieza muy bien también.
Il   sig. Cong Shan sempre attento  ad ogni mio messaggio, ha dimostrato  grande disponibilità  e gentilezza  ad ogni mia richiesta.  La posizione  della camera è veramente  strategica per tutto.
房东Greig人很好，有什么问题都及时回复，房子很容易找到，也很方便，居住环境也很好，阳台风景很美，房间也很干净，推荐居住！
Wonderful place and cosy flat  to chill and have some rest after long day visites, only 15 /20 minutes walk from Old Town and City Center. Warm Welcome from Anthony & Caroline on Christmas Day.

Great flat in a great part of Edinburgh. I really appreciated how close it was to major transit hubs like Edinburgh airport and Waverly station. Close to Leith Walk a beautiful green space that will take you down through Dean Village into the National Museums of Modern 1 & 2. Very close to Botanical Gardens. Amazing amount of thrift/charity shops and a M&S and Sainsbury literally around the corner. Great cafes (check out Books N’ Cup cafe open until 10 pm. Chill staff great tea/coffee, sweet treats). The flat was super clean and it was nice to be able to relax in the space and make simple meals. The views out of the apartment windows are charming. Keith was super responsive when an issue came up and helped navigate through it. I would gladly stay here again as the location had so much more to explore alas I was only there for two nights.
nice room and warm host

Janet è una persona molto piacevole che ha sempre dato il massimo della disponibilità, sia prima del nostro arrivo che durante il soggiorno. Ha saputo darci utili informazioni sugli spostamenti.
La casa è situata in una posizione non molto centrale ma molto tranquilla e comodissima per gli spostamenti con i bus, la fermata è a pochi minuti da casa e i bus passano frequentemente e raggiungono il centro in un quarto d'ora circa.
Il prezzo della casa è in linea con i prezzi della Scozia.

Wir waren 9 Tage im Apartment. Die Möblierung war neuwertig. Es war sehr ordentlich und sauber. Zum Empfang standen Getränke, Snacks und Obst da!  Mosthafa ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber. Gerne wieder!

Overall the apartment was as described clean, spacious and comfortable. The only down side was on the initial information it stated ample free street parking. When we arrived there were signs indicating it was all permit or 4hour stay maximum. When I messaged I was told there was only limited free spaces. If I had known I may not have booked. The collection of taxis with DVLA wheel clamps on was slightly off putting. Also the instructions to alter the heating was in French, so I left it alone.
SO FRIENDLY

Our stay was very comfortable. The apartment was conveniently located, airy, well lit and well furnished. Upon arrival, the caretaker Diane's husband David arrived promptly and helped us settle in. The flat comes with a complete manual of everything so operating any white good is not a problem at all. The apartment is kid friendly with board games available. Overall a very good experience and we would highly recommend this place.
Great little apartment and the location could not have been better. Will definitely stay here again! Alan was also very accommodating and easy to get in touch with with any questions.
Loved the location! It was very easy to get anywhere we wanted to go. The flat was very peaceful at night and comfortable to sleep in. Would recommend!
nice place,  a few minutes walk to Waverly station,  Royal Mile,  and Tesco express.

Mooi huisje met 2 slaapkamers wat groot genoeg was voor ons tweetjes. Richting de royal mild was het toch nog wel een stukje lopen dus adviseer ik wel om gebruik te maken van het openbaar vervoer. Ik adviseer dit huisje iedereen aan en zou ook zeker nog een keer terug gaan.
A great place to stay real home from home
Great location and very centrally located to many of Edinburgh’s top spots. The reserved parking space was a huge bonus and the apartment is huge and beautifully decorated!

very nice apartment was better than photos. Excellent location.
Communication was not great as told no parking but there was free parking over the weekend when staid there.
Also had to provide verification with passport etc on a secondary app which then provided keysafe though did not store this so fould not leave key on lockbox on way out.
Close to city centre, clean, quick replies, amazing bed, great price.
Nice flat, very well located
Gaya was very friendly and easy to reach. The flat is clean and quiet and in a great location.  Shops, Cafes and Arthurs seat are very close. We had 2 great days in Edinburgh. I recommend this flat.

My friend and I had a wonderful stay, we used an uber to travel into Edinburgh and back and we had no problems with this. There was a bowls club across the road from the property and this became very noisy at night ( we stayed over the weekend) but this was our only gripe.
È stato tutto perfetto. L’appartamento è nuovo, pulitissimo e molto curato in tutti i dettagli. Massima disponibilità e gentilezza. Top!
Crud’s was great. Very helpful when I was trying to book taxi to airport. Nice accommodations with a beautiful redone bathroom. Loved her dog!
Absolutely amazing place, couldn’t have been any better located walking distance to everything. Would definitely stay again.

This place was absolutely perfect for our family trip. The location is ideal! Couldn’t be better. The Airbnb is beautifully decorated and had everything we needed. Above and beyond. Such a special place to spend with our extended family. Highly recommend!
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und hat eine Top Lage. Claire ist eine super Gastgeberin. Gerne wieder.

The flat was very clean and central - close to everything needed. I was really pleased with the way Keiko & Donald dealed with our request. They replied very fast and the info they gave was clear and accurate. I liked the fact they left for us coffee and chocolate in the room (really nice from their side) and tips for our stay in Edinburgh. I would definitely recommend the place. Really nice hosts! ❤

The host is friendly and knowledgable of the area.
Close to Murrayfield.
The accommodation was basic and not the most hygienic. I felt that six guests were too many to share one bathroom in the morning.

Excellent stay in a lovely room at the front with great views in a nice area.  Bed very comfortable in the well equipped room. Louise was very helpful and gave us extra art books to read on top of the books and magazines provided. On a great bus route too.  Well worth the stay, would highly recommend.
We had a great stay at this apartment. David was an excellent host, very responsive. Would definitely recommend!

David's place was centrally located in New Town yet very quiet at night. The apartment was clean and nicely decorated, and the bed linens were comfortable and high quality. David was a very responsive and thoughtful host. He met us at the apartment prior to check-in so we could drop off our bags. When we arrived later, there were snacks and grocery essentials waiting in the kitchen, and the apartment had everything we could need. We would definitely stay there again on our next visit to Edinburgh.

Zoe nos recibió con una enorme sonrisa a pesar de que llegamos tarde después de una excursión a las higlands que se atrasó, luego vino la sorpresa hermosa de su perrito 🐶 Fredy todo un caballero que nos llenó de besos! Pasamos solo una noche y nos quedó mucho por disfrutar, la limpieza del alojamiento era de otro mundo, impecable, Zoé!! Muchas gracias por recibirnos y gracias por tu calidez!!
Seguro volveremos!!
Very timely and responsive host.  Everything was wonderful.  Back yard garden was amazing!

Great maisonette with everything you could possibly need for a weekend away. Very good location/peaceful base with easy links to visit Edinburgh and The Royal Highland Show. A busy takeaway is very close, however noise always reduced to minimal after around 9pm - so was never an issue for us. Otherwise beautiful place to visit :)

We stayed in James place for four nights and it was everything we could have hoped for. Everything went as described, From the reviews to the nice detailed pictures. Clean airbnb, very well located and Easy to reach from the airport via tram and a short walk. You can also reach a lot of the main spots in the city within a 25 to 35 min walk. James was great in communicating and provided us with good recommendations for food and places to checkout. One of our favorites was Safari Lounge. Pizza geeks was also very good. Check out polentino for sandwiches and cloud 9 Edinburgh for cool souvenirs and decor. The apartment was also close to Easter road stadium which is home to Hibernian FC. We got lucky and got to see the last game of the season. Can’t forget the view of Arthur Seat! Thank you James again for being an awesome host.
The first stop on our trip was Edinburgh. The apartment is within walking distance of all the city center attractions, yet it was quiet. We felt very comfortable. I can only recommend it.

Ali was a thoughtful and incredibly responsive host who ensured that my and my brother's stay at his flat in Edinburgh went smoothly. The flat was exactly as listed and very well-kept, and both the bed in the bedroom and the fold-out sofa -- as per my brother on the latter end -- were comfortable and spacious, perfect for weary travelers.
It was easy to access the Royal Mile, Abbey Hill, Arthur's Seat, and everything around Holyrood from there, and taxis/Ubers were cheap when letting in the urge of laziness to commute to Prince's Street or Haymarket.
Absolutely loved our stay here and hope to have Ali as a host again, when I'm back in the city.

The flat was easy to find, I was shown around and given the keys by Daniela. My dad and siblings loved the place - I was commended for finding such a place. There's an African shop on Gorgie road, we were able to get all the Nigerian spices and groceries we needed. My graduation was a huge success as I had a lovely apartment to host my folks. Thanks Daniela.

If you going to Edu, this is the place to stay. The apartment is fantastic. It’s located in the heart of the city, with amazing restaurants and bars nearby. Our host was on point and everything went smoothly.

You won‘t find a better host than Gary! So many good recommendations for what to do and what to eat in Edinburgh - especially in Leith. Your own bedroom and bathroom are super clean and tidy.
Definitely a 11/10 🙌🏼

I am so grateful that I was able to stay at Maureen’s place. It’s so conveniently located, easy walk to any prime spots and there’s a lovely park nearby. The room was super comfortable, big and I had everything I needed - mini fridge, tea kettle, umbrella. Maureen was very kind and responsive. I loved my stay!!!

Un logement où on se sent bien, à la fois simple et bien décoré, tranquille.
Iain est sympathique et nous fait sentir à l’aise. Il peut nous donner beaucoup d’infos sur Edinburgh et l’Ecosse.
Situé au s/o de Leith. Le centre-ville d’Edinburgh est facilement accessible par bus en 20 min. apprx. (via la rue perpendiculaire immediate); la partie touristique de Leith n’est pas loin non plus.
Chambre très propre (w-c aussi) simple et au style un peu « zen » avec une petite touche mid-century.
Il n’y a pas de meuble de rangement ou garde-robe, **mais c’est très ok avec la barre à cintres et le rack à souliers/étagères portatif, ainsi que les étagères encastrées où j’ai tassé un peu les décorations pour y mettre de mes choses.
Table de travail(on peut y manger si Iain est en télétravail sur table princip.) un peu petite, mais avec petit laptup on s’arrange bien.
Murs suffisamment étanches selon paramètres d’un logis. J’ai très bien dormi.
Cuisine très ok en général.
J’y retournerais !
Thanks, Jess, for a brilliant stay in your beautiful flat! It was perfect for what we needed for the weekend.

Convenient location, safe and secure. Responsive host to any queries. Beware parking as only paid parking with a four hour limit is in the area. We could not find the spots indicated in the description of the apartment.

Judy and Colin were delightful and welcoming. The accommodation was very well located- giving privacy, quiet environment after a day of sightseeing and attending the Fringe Festival…. The bus service was excellent.  Judy had some wonderful touches that made you feel extra special and very welcomed… we can highly recommend this stay in Edinbrugh

Everything in Edinburgh’s Center City is walkable from Charlotte’s flat. Excellent location for the Fringe Festival and the many attractions of Edinburgh. Flat was cozy, comfortable and well appointed. Even the walk up was easy after a day or two!! We loved Charlottes’s place! It was perfect for us.

Great little apartment for a short stay. Plenty of good eateries within walking distance and an easy walk to the city centre. A big bonus is the off street parking and dog friendliness. Mike and Pauline were great hosts, friendly and responsive.

Lovely flat in central Edinburgh. Nicely appointed with plenty of good quality facilities, comfy beds, lovely bathroom and shower, plenty of wardrobe space, good wifi and great TV.  Parking’s a bit of a hassle but apart from that no other issues. Very quiet, too, but near the Lothian Rd and city centre for shops and restaurants. Really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend.
A wonderful unit, close to major sites and attractions.  Very clean and well-appointed
It was very amazing, Adam is very good and kind host.

Jag och en väninna bodde tre nätter i Åland lägenhet. Vi är väldigt nöjda både med lägenheten som var ren, trevlig och välutrustad  och läget som var väldigt lugnt men så nära till allt i stan. Kan verkligen rekommenderas!
100% would stay here again and highly recommend to other considering this listing. Amazing location with fittings!
One of the best Airbnb places I stayed at. Stylish, sparkling clean and in a great location. I certainly recommend!

Emily’s flat was clean and a great place to come back to every day after sight seeing in Edinburgh. Flat looked brand new, clean, and quiet. Great place to stay if you are looking for a place just off the beaten path for peace and quiet from the hustle of the city. Great place!!!!
Sévi est une hôte attentionnée. L'emplacement du logement est idéal pour un séjour à Edimbourg (accès en transports en commun très facile depuis l'aéroport, 20 min à pieds de la vieille ville)

Big, big thank you to Joss and the team! The place is absolutely brilliant - room size was amazing for Edinburgh, super clean, well equipped. Quiet area, walkable distance - only 5’ to Princess Street. The team was very proactive and provided super clear instructions for the check-in, not to mention the fact that they also suggested a few restaurants nearby. 10/5*!! Definitely coming back here!
A lovely welcome from smiling faces - the room was well equipped including a sound machine to assist sleep 😁. Great location. Would definitely recommend and stay there again

This apartment is perfectly situated on the lower end of the Royal Mile, stepping out onto the Mile you are immediately surrounded by shops, pubs, cafes and lovely places to eat. Turn left up the street and the adventure begins! so much to see and do! This place is the perfect place to base yourself for an amazing time in Edinburgh, thank you Nicola!

Sam has been an attentive and caring host throughout our entire stay. The place is within walking distance to the centre and many attractions such as Arthur's seat, the parliament or the gallery.
Room and stay was just as expected, no issues whatsoever. Would recommend and come again. we had a great time! ☺️

Maia is an excellent host and her place is fabulous! Warm, cosy and close to lots of nice cafes and restaurants, it’s also just a short walk into the city.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay, appreciating the comfortable bed and bedding as one of us was,sadly, ill and in bed. Her folder of tips about her city and maps and other small thoughtful details really added to our stay. We will definitely return when in Edinburgh again.

Lovely welcoming hostess.
Apartment spotlessly clean with all amenities you could need and more.
Great location to get into city centre- easily walkable in 15- 20 mins.
The only niggle was that there was only 1 toilet ( bathroom has only shower &sink).
We came across a wonderful cafe for breakfast called La Viola, only 5 minute walk from apartment ( best breakfast we've ever had) lots of choice and excellent service - definitely worth a try.
Thank you Yvonne for our wonderful time in your lovely apartment
Nichola was so nice and welcoming. Everything was as described and super clean. I had a lovely stay! :)

Damian’s place in Edinburgh is a beautiful flat with gorgeous furnishings. The kitchen was incredible and full of high end appliances. There was copious wardrobe space for those doing a longer stay. The beds were large and very comfortable and we slept well, though sounds from the primary school across the street did make sure we didn’t sleep in and waste our days in the city.
The area was well-served by several bus routes and we did walk along the canal one day to get into the heart of Edinburgh. We also walked to restaurants and shops closer by in the neighbourhood.
The only drawback was that for someone with scent allergies, I struggled with the scent diffuser and scented laundry soap and had to up my antihistamines during the stay. I was able to put the diffuser away in the utility room and close the door but it meant I avoided that area and couldn’t do laundry myself.

Excellent home away from home. Modern , clean, easy to locate and get settled.
My family and I felt at home for the week, had everything we needed.
The area itself was clean , friendly locals, plenty of restaurants and very easy to get to touristy spots including a 15 minute walk from Edinburgh Waverley station.
Host was excellent and proactive from booking to check out. Would 100% stay with this host again.
Fantastic location and excellent communication with hosts who gave great suggestions for dog friendly places to eat/drink. Thank you

Amazing stay at Laila's flat in the heart of Edinburgh. We were very well received. The room is nice, clean and spacious. It is very well located near the city centre, but it is quiet at the same time.
Definitely recommend.

An amazing location. Away from the noise and chaos of the city Centre. Very close to the bus stations. Can easily get to the city center in 10-15
by bus. The view of Arthur’s seat (from the living room) is magnificent. The apartment is thoughtfully decorated and spotless. Joanna and Jonathan were so friendly and welcoming. Gave great recommendations! The room itself is cozy and the bed is so comfortable. I highly recommend!!

Thanks for a brilliant stay! The place was beautiful, we loved the little touches! Perfect little spot to come back to after exploring the city. Skye was great, the place was clean and had everything we needed. Thanks again!
Very nice apartment with great views and location. Victor is really responsible and helpful. Highly recommend.

Le logement est bien plus spacieux qu'il n'en paraît sur les photos. La localisation est très bonne avec un marché le samedi matin juste à côté. Le quartier est calme.
Merci Craig !

Needed a place to stay last minute and Rachel couldn't have been more amenable & helpful! Although the stairs are a bit of a trek if you have heavy luggage, the views and convenience of being so close to the train station and old town easily outweighs that. Rachel had everything I needed, and despite such a short stay, had a lovely time.
Second time here at Eden Locke in Edinburgh, and we absolutely loved it. A great space to feel at home in the middle of the city with all the amenities you need!

The flat was charming and as described.  It is far enough from the hustle of the city center to be quiet at night.  Yet it was easily walkable to Princess St and there are plenty of restaurants close by.  The neighborhood pub on the next block provided a nice space for a quick snack & drink after a long day of sightseeing.

Nicely furnished, spacious, and clean! Host was very responsive and accommodating for check in, which is very appreciated! Great location, short bus ride from the center of Edinburgh. Very easy to get around, would recommend staying here!
Perfect place for a city centre stay. Very convenient, easy communication with the host. All basic requirements  are available in the flat. Rooms are nice and roomy.
Comfort, beauty, functionality and convenience make this flat the ideal place to stay in Edinburgh.  I hope to return and when I do I will certainly stay here again!

What an amazing place and the best hosts! Came for our daughter’s graduation and the comfort and locale was fantastic. Flexible check in, perfect amenities including coffee which we appreciated, beautiful space and incredible location close to everywhere from Old Town to New Town. Wonderful views from all rooms too. Loved being here for the week! Sue and Grant were incredibly responsive, checked in on us to make sure everything was alright and if we needed anything. When our flight was canceled they responded so swiftly and fortunately for us there was availability for another night making a stressful situation far more palatable. Would absolutely stay again here.

très bonne localisation.
A 5 min de l'arrêt de bus pour nous amener au centre ville en 15 min a peine.
Le logement est très fonctionnel.
Craig est très aimable et réactif.
très bien pour 2 personnes.
Merci Craig.

This was the perfect stay and location for my solo trip. The instructions were so easy to follow and Aileen was super communicative and sweet. The flat was exactly as described and the pictures of the view don't do it true justice. I will definitely be booking this Airbnb when I return to Scotland in the future, well worth the price. 10/10 recommend.

Calim's place was such an amazing find - so glad I stayed here, though I wish I could've stayed longer.
The place was very well decorated - loved the eclectic artifacts all over the house - felt like stepping back into a different time while still having all the modern amenities in place! And I particularly appreciated all the delicious food that Calim had kept for his guests in the kitchen - the shortbread cookies were delicious, and I quite shamelessly helped myself to quite a few of them :). Also loved the fact that there was pretty much anything you'd want for breakfast in the refrigerator - bread, various fruit preserves, milk, orange juice, coffee, tea.
And the location was fantastic - minutes away from Edinburgh Old Town, which truly felt like a magical place. Thanks Calim for making my stay even more special.

The apartment was clean, easy to find and access and well located with a lot of restaurants and cafes nearby. The apartment also matches with the description and the pictures.
We shared the apartment with some other visitors and didn’t have any problems with them. If you’re easily bothered by other people or noises, maybe the apartment is not the best choice for you. In our opinion, the apartment is a good choice if you’re looking for a rather cheap accommodation for a couple of days.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Roland's apartment. It was bright, airy and quiet. The location on a quiet Georgian street was close enough to all the marvelous sights that Edinburgh has to offer. We were able to cook a lovely Italian meal courtesy of his well-equipped kitchen and a great Italian deli around the corner. Would highly recommend!
Super, well equipped and comfortable apartment. Modern and well fitted.
We really enjoyed our stay, Jennifer was a lovely host with good restaurant recommendations and prompt communication. We will definitely be back! Thank you.
Alexander's apartment is well located in a fairly quiet neighbour hold, yet in walking distance from restaurants and sights. The apartment is very nice we enjoyed our stay.
We loved staying at the place. We mainly came for the tattoo but the location was also perfectly to explore the city and have a look around! Would deffo come back
Perfecto location,  spotlessly clean and amazing communication. Highly recommended
Excellent location, central to everything. Perfect house for a large group.  Highly recommended.

L’alloggio è posizionato in una zona da cui si raggiunge in pochissimo tempo il centro (a piedi). Fiona è stata molto accogliente, gentile e ci ha dato tanti consigli.
Segnaliamo soltanto poche problematiche: il flusso d’acqua della doccia era molto basso e non c’era acqua calda dal lavandino; non c’erano prese vicino al letto; si sentivano le vibrazioni della finestra al passaggio delle auto sulla strada.
Nell’ insieme una buona esperienza.
Great location, pristine home with awesome amenities.

Daria was a wonderful host! The flat is perfect for two people - incredibly warm and very cozy! Ideal for our stay. Checking in and out was very easy and Daria provided very clear instructions as to how to get to the flat. The only thing is that the upstairs neighbours are very loud in the mornings - but that can’t really be helped.
Thank you Daria for a lovely stay!!

the place is a lovely cosy set up. The instructions given by the host were extremely clear about the place and what to do.
We will definitely come back in the future and recommend it to others.

Nichola was an amazing host. A very proactive individual & fast talker. It felt like I was in university again with the most ideal housemate possible. Her place is very closely accessible to public transit and some cute cafes and bites. I walked back on a summer night and felt safe in the neighborhood. Definitely a good budget friendly option. Highly recommended stay!

The room is functional for one person
It looks out onto a main road, so there is a lot of road noise
It needs a blackout curtain or blind
There is a dog in the property, which woke me up at 5am barking
The kitchen sink was full of dirty dishes
The bathroom needed some TLC
The apartment was very clean and you have your own private bathroom across the hall. The Airbnb actually doesn’t have free parking on premise - only paid street parking.

The apartment was clean and up to date. There are front and back doors, but they're a bit tricky to find at first. Once you know where they are though, you're all good to go!  Andrea was awesome and let us drop our bags off early so we didn't have to lug them around all day! Great for soccer fans as the stadium is right across the street! 💖
Perfect place to stay in Edimburgh, quiet, clean and perfectly decorated.
We had a lovely stay. Everything was perfect. The apartment is very well located.
It’s a very convenient and safe place to live in. Check in and check out was convenient too. Space was clean and very comfortable. Will come next time!

We had an absolutely lovely few days at Kim’s place. The house is beautiful in the most peaceful surroundings and we were so relaxed the moment we walked in until we left! The house was spotless and so comfortable- I think I will need to purchase some electric reclining sofas as we all miss them! My children loved the extra touches like children’s books on the bookshelves and board games in the cupboards. We had a Chinese in the apartment from a restaurant that the host suggested and it was excellent. I couldn’t recommend this listing more,  great communication too from a very friendly host - 10/10!

Janie's place was well situated as the bus stop is just 1 min walk away, it is very easy to get around! Overall my friend and I enjoy our stay, the only downside is the place was a little dusty, but other than that everything was amazing. Towels and shampoos were all provided, instructions from Janie on checking in was smooth & easy and it was also very nice of her to let us check in early! :) Cheers!

We had a wonderful time at Ali and Al’s. It was our first time travelling with our 9 month old and this was the perfect place for a small family. They even made us a baby gate for the top of the stairs! The location is great for getting around on foot or bus, and right beside Arthur’s Seat. Ali and Al are right next door if you need anything (we didn’t) and communication was easy and quick. They left us a binder of restaurant recommendations and we enjoyed every one we tried. We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend to anyone.
Amazing place and easy to reach all sites. Felt at ease being there.
Great communication from the host Barry and a lovely place to stay!
Ivy's place was in a perfect location for us to explore the city.  It was clean, had everything we needed.  I would stay here again.

Angela is a more than friendly and helpful host. Communication was very proactive, easy and she helps wherever she can. Accommodation itself was very nice, quiet, with everything that was needed for our 4 day stay and it was accessible for us independently at all times.
Can highly recommend it and would come back for sure.

The accommodation was perfect for our weekend visit to Edinburgh. Welcoming, clean, and with all the facilities we needed + the 'wee dram' was a lovely bonus! It was soo convenient to be able to leave the car outside and use public transport. Ian was very flexible, friendly, and responsive both before and during our visit. We'd love to stay again sometime.
Le séjour chez Janet a été parfait. C’est une dame très gentille. Le logement était très propre et confortable, elle nous a même offert des viennoiseries décadentes. Je recommande vivement!

Our stay at Frasers place was great!! It has everything listed and was very clean and comfortable for our group. Loved the sounds of the birds out back, very peaceful. Also close to bus stops that take you right into the city center and a supermarket is right down the street. Definitely recommend going to the Old Eastway Tap down the street for dinner and/or drinks, the food is amazing. Fraser was a lovely host and messaged to check in on us after we arrived. I have no complaints and definitely recommend staying here!

This was my and my friend’s first time in Scotland and we couldn’t be happier about finding Sandra’s place. It was a short ride by Uber from the airport and we had no issues getting inside and settled. The welcome package was incredibly informative of the surrounding area and gave us tips on how to use the public transport. The kitchen has all the utensils and spices we needed to make dinner if we didn’t want to eat out and the local grocery store was about a 15-20 minute walk which was nice considering we went back often. I wouldn’t say it was an issue but the only thing to “complain” about was the shower pressure in the bathroom. It isn’t super strong so showers can take a bit longer. It was really minor compared to the great experience we had with Sandra.
If you have to chase a place to be in Edimburgh this is THE PLACE.
We had a lovely stay!

Carla was an amazing host who kept Intouch and checked in to makesure we were in and ok.
Place was just what we needed for a base to explore Edinburgh. Would stay again for sure.
Xx
Excellent place and location. I would happily stay there again!

Hanna’s space was absolutely beautiful and perfectly situated near everything, but on a quiet street. As a host she was super responsive and friendly. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and recommend this space to anyone visiting.
Kind host, adorable dog, lovely garden surroundings!
Thaiha and Duc and even little Doodoo were very welcoming. We also got some cookies, tea, coffee and water for the stay. Easy access and a very beautiful home. Thank you Thaiha and Duc!

Pier is an excellent host. All the instructions for our arrival at the flat and whilst there were very clear, even down to labels on certain appliances to aid quick use. It’s a level of detail I’ve not seen in a lot of AirB&B’s and definitely helpful.
The flat itself was very comfortable and clean. Everything looks like it’s been recently renovated, so presents and functions perfectly. Beds / bedding etc were very comfortable.
The location is what drew us to the flat though - Stockbridge is a vibrant part of Edinburgh with great cafes, bars, restaurants and walks right on your door step, not to mention a 15 minute walk into the city centre through the very picturesque New Town. Definitely recommended.

I only stayed one night but Courtney made me feel really welcome in her home. Very comfortable and spacious room and the view over the firth alone is well worth a visit! Look forward to staying again.

A great apartment in a fantastic location in central Edinburgh. It’s worth noting that the keys to get in are located at Edinburgh Waverley station rather than at the apartment, so if you’re driving up it’s not as simple as just driving to the property (and the same when you’re leaving). Other than that though, the whole trip was fantastic and it’s somewhere I’d definitely stay again

David’s place in Edinburgh was perfect for our new year week getaway. It was our first time in the city and David was a gracious host who took the time to go over the city’s attractions in detail with us and gave us very useful pointers..He was also kind to guide us when we were stuck planning our onward journey. We loved his property with authentic furniture and decor and the bed was one of the most comfortable ones we’ve had in a long time. Any review would be incomplete without mentioning the perfect English/Scottish breakfast spread he cooked for us and his darling dog Figgy who absolutely stole our hearts. This particular stay will stand out as a memorable one to both of us and it even got us thinking maybe we should take up running an Airbnb ourselves in the future! Thanks David!
Lovely clean room in a great location for exploring the city. Secure parking very close by and a very friendly host.

We loved staying here on our short visit to Edinburgh, clean, comfortable, fantastic location. It was amazing to have free secure car parking and the welcome snacks were such a treat to find on arrival. We would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Edinburgh - Thank you so much!

Alan was a great host, responded quickly and had thought out all instructions. Property was newly refurbished and stylish, but also comfortable enough. We had small children with us and the portacot and the high chair were excellent quality.

Bon séjour de 3 nuits. l'appartement correspond à la description. le canapé lit devrait être changé pour améliorer l'accueil de 4 adultes. très proche de tout à Edimbourg. bon rapport qualité prix.
Merci à Kate.

The flat was in a very nice location and easy access to the centre on foot. It was in the basement but there was enough light to come through and the place was clean and comfortable beds in two rooms. Emma and her business partners replied my questions quickly each time. My friend and I used this flat for our base during our business trip to Edinburgh. I would recommend this place for people who use both business and leisure.

I really enjoyed my stay at Btissams place. It’s super easy to find since she gave me clear instructions beforehand. The location is very convenient.
The room is comfortable and having my own bathroom was a big plus for me. Thank you for sharing your home with me, I’ll gladly come back.
Lovely clean and cozy little flat in a very handy location. Good shower and comfy bed. Would stay again.

Kitty’s property Was absolutely brilliant. It was furnished beautifully and had a decadence and warm ambience about it. She was an excellent hostess and put herself out to return to the property to greet us when we had a miscommunication between us.  She went the extra mile. Thank you so much
Vše bylo skvele!
10-15 min walk from centre, close to restaurants, easy parking.

We had such a lovely time in the flat, thank you Christie! The room was exactly as described and shown in the pictures and was gorgeously decorated, private, and clean. Christie was a great host and was really quick to respond to messages. The area is lovely. If you go be sure to stop in at the vast number of independent coffee shops on Leith Walk! Really easy to walk or jump on a bus to the city centre too. Great value for money. Can’t recommend enough and we’ll be sure to check if this is available next time we’re in Edinburgh!

Roza’s place was great! Just what we were looking for staying overnight in Edinburgh. We had everything we needed, checkin and out was simple and we could get into town for supper in 10 minutes. Recommend! 😃
Very nice and peaceful location, easy to come and go and the hosts were very friendly.
Great place, clean stylish, beautifully furnished. Easy for check in check out, all infos in one message, really easy communication. Would recommend!
Great location and close to transit. Rowan had great local recommendations!

L'emplacement de l'appartement est idéal pour visiter Edimbourg. Nous avons tout fait à pied. L'appartement est parfait, propre, confortable et très bien aménagé. James est très bien organisé et tout fut donc très facile. Nous avons passé un super séjour à Edimbourg.
Perfectly located, beautiful apartment in Edinburgh's Old town. We absolutely enjoyed our stay here!
nice place, great location
Beautiful spot. Excellent location.

Howard and Kathleen's home is absolutely heavenly. It is an incredible garden retreat minutes away walking from a bustling downtown. Not only is the home lovely, eco-friendly, and thoughtfully put together, but Howard and Kathleen are magnificent hosts as well.
We would love to come back here, and fully endorse their home for anyone else looking to stay in Edinburgh.

A great flat - don’t let the austere entrance fool you! Very comfortable for three of us with the added bonus of being in the heart of Stockbridge; close to all the amenities and a short stroll to all the sites.
Highly recommended.

The apartment was in a very charming neighborhood and an easy bus ride to the city center. We really enjoyed the Morningside restaurants and shops in addition to our tourist sightseeing downtown. The apartment was very bright and clean and we didn't have any issues with noise from the neighbors. The bathroom and shower stall are  small but functional. Aciel was excellent at communicating with us throughout our stay, and even provided us with some snacks. We had a wonderful weekend there. Unfortunately there was a little problem post-stay. After we returned from our trip we were contacted by Aciel about broken veneer on the bathroom vanity. We're not sure how it happened but think maybe one of our shirts caught on the loose laminate veneer and bent it back. She requested a portion of our deposit to help cover the cost of repairs and we paid her what she asked. This kind of situation is always risk using Airbnb. However, in this case it worked out ok.
Prima verblijf gehad, goede bedden, leuke hond,  vriendelijke en behulpzame host.

A simultaneously cosy and spaceous apartment, in a great location, with plenty of charn and original features. A really great base for exploring Edinburgh, with all the big sights within a (short) walking distance.
Comfy beds, and plenty of seating space in the lounge to relax and unwind.

The place was an absolute gem, especially for a 6 night stay. It's quite bigger than expected so it was nice having a lot of space. Our first night there, it was cold so when I messaged her about the temp, she was quick to respond & help out with her nesting system & how to work it. Furthermore, everything looked & smelled very clean so that was a plus. When using the shower, it can take a while to figure out but just be very careful as the temp can get VERY hot while trying to play around with it. The pipes rumble & make loud sounds while the water is on so just keep that in mind as it creeped our daughter out. Not a complaint, whatsoever, but if you have children, reassure them they did not break anything or there are no creepy monsters in the wall, it's just an old structure. Moreover, if you do laundry & need to dry it, what i found to be very helpful is to place the drying rack into the main level bathroom and keep the door closed while heat is running. Will definitely stay again!
Gorgeous flat in the perfect location . Super professional with great communication , thanks !

Scott’s flat is incredible. We had the most wonderful 2 night stay. Such a walkable location. Flat was so cozy and comfortable and their taste is impeccable. Will definitely be back.
❤️

Oddny est très sympathique et discrète. Elle nous a indiqué des endroits pour déjeuner.
Le logement est très propre et proche de plusieurs bus.
Très bon séjour.
Eddie and Jane were very responsive. We found the place really centrally located - Old Town - easy to walk to key sites. Great stay!

Lovely apartment in great location with excellent facilities for a short stay. Room was very clean and well appointed.
Excellent communication with hosts and very clear instructions on all items relevant to making our stay very enjoyable.
Es war ein angenehmer Aufenthalt bei Jana. Das Zimmer entsprach der Beschreibung. Zimmer Check in und Out war unkompliziert. Everything was fine. :-)

Sally is a very lovely host. Very friendly and helpful. She gave us the priority to use the bathroom and we had good conversations during our stay. She had many leaflets and guides in the room which is very useful for our tour in Edinburgh. The room and bathroom is very clean, appreciate the breakfast basket provided! Overall very good experience staying with Sally! 👍

Really beautiful house in a great location for visiting Edinburgh centre and surrounding areas. You can walk into the centre/castle in about 20 minutes which meant the house was close but still nice and quiet!
Plenty of cafes, little shops and a small Tesco just around the corner.
Note, you can only park on the road outside for 4 hours at a time so we had to unexpectedly move our car quite far which was a shame.

Great location, Stockbridge has lots of good restaurants & bars. 5 minutes into central Edinburgh the other way, everywhere was so easy to get to from here! Nice & peaceful too, away from the crowds. Great value for money! Fleur was a lovely host & made us feel very welcome.
The only negative, for us, was there are no windows that open & it felt stuffy.
Great location to stay at and responsive host
Anja's place is comfy and well located. All was very clean and she was the perfect host

Stephen’s place is a fantastic gem! The eclectic collections of books, vinyls, artwork, musical instruments and beautiful furniture are quite “characterful” indeed. I loved it! The photos of the flat are very faithful (but the lighting is brighter during daytime on sunny days). The actual living space (bedding, towels, bathtub, etc.) was all clean. Of course, the place is not for everyone, because you would be staying in an apartment that is usually “lived-in” (with intriguing knick-knacks everywhere; also, you can see dust behind the bed) and which is not specifically tailored for hotel-like guests (floor in the kitchen area sort of unfinished, not for bare feet; surroundings of the bath a bit broken). But, like so many previous guests, I absolutely loved it – it is all part of the character of the place. Plus, you get to enjoy discovering Stephen’s eclectic taste in music (great sound system!) and books. All in all, it felt like an immense privilege to be staying in such an “insanely cool” place (to quote a previous reviewer’s comments). Stephen himself was quite responsive and accommodating and Dai even came back to meet me after the initial handover to give me a better key as I was having trouble with the one I had. The location is also wonderful. The apartment is in “New” Town (actually 19th century Georgian houses), on a residential street in front of a quiet park, but close to a nice coffee shop, small supermarket and cool restaurants, and just a short walk from the centre. It was lovely to be staying in such a fantastic appartment, and I definitely hope to be able come back to Stephen’s flat if I get to return to Edinburgh. I would book this flat again without hesitation.

This was a lovely place to stay. Fair warning: there are so many stairs! I was unprepared for that.
The space was clean and tidy, and it made the perfect place to land for a couple of nights.

We were just in town for a day and overnight then on to airport for home. Very nice apartment with lots of space for four adults.
Will book again if back to Edinburgh.
Host very responsive!

Oda temiz ve yeterliydi. Mutfakta aradığım her şeyi buldum ve ilave olarak çay, kahve sıcak su konusunda herhangi bir problem yaşamadım. İlk gece ısıtma ile ilgili problem olmasına rağmen sonraki günler sorunsuzdu. Ev sahibi hızlı bir şekilde sorularıma cevap verdi ve özellikle geç giriş konusunda çok yardımcı oldu. Bölgeye göre oda için fiyat makul diyebilirim. Sadece akşam yatmak için kullanacaksanız ideal bir yer. Tek sorun elektrikli su ısıtıcı nedeni ile duşdaki su yetersiz olabiliyor. Yine de her şey için teşekkürler

Not too much to add to what others commented… Yes there are three strip clubs at the ‘pubic triangle’ close by, but even at night on the street there was no highly noticeable noise. Upstairs with the window closed, could not hear a thing.
The spot itself was very nice inside - clean, modern, etc. For me, the availability of a washer (with drying function) and a drying rack, and an iron / board, was particularly helpful. And being a short walk from the edge of old town was obviously great. Thomas’ colleague was responsive and clear with instructions, so everything went perfectly smoothly. Thanks : )

Levi's place is really lovely.  It was very clean with good amenities. The beds were the comfiest we have slept on in any Airbnb. Great towels too. Stockbridge is an excellent place to stay as it's away from crowds but many places are easily walkable, like the Royal Botanical Gardens, and the Water of Leith Walkway, both of which are gorgeous. Waitrose, the Co-op and M and S food are all within a few  minutes walk. There's a good bus service into central Edinburgh. It's a lovely area. Communication with Levi was great and timely. I definitely recommend staying here.
So glad we found it, right in the center of a magic part of the city. Wonderful places to eat, get ice cream, explore stair cases and history
Angie was extremely sweet and accommodating. Great location and had all we needed. Thanks
We loved staying with Susan and her family, they were super friendly and have a beautiful home! Susan went above and beyond to look after us and we are very grateful. Thank-you again for having us.

Très bon séjour passé là bas. Tout est propre et confortable, les équipements nécessaires sont présents. L'appartement est bien relié au reste de la ville pour pouvoir tout visiter. L'hôte est très réactif et arrangeant, ce qui est toujours agréable. Nous recommandons !
位置很好 出行方便 很温馨
Lovely stay , great hosts
A charming house and a charming room with generous space.
Really lovely apartment with all the essentials and some extras which were a nice surprise. Excellent location!

Marina和Dylan是很好的房东，她们热情友善，把房子布置的非常漂亮整洁，和图片一模一样！
他们还有两只可爱的小猫，Athena很友善与人亲近，Cali一直没有理我🤣
地理位置很好，距离车站很近。说实话爱丁堡是一个很小的城市，我们几乎能步行到达所有景点。
最后很感谢Marina和Dylan的接待，希望下次我来爱丁堡的时候还能订到他们的房子！我非常推荐

The apartment was very nice and Sara was friendly and helpful. The location is fantastic, so many restaurants and close to the Royal Mile. Despite being in the middle of busy Old Town, we found the place to be quiet.
Highly recommended!
Great location, clean apartment, friendly host.

I really enjoyed being in Edinburgh, and I was really comfortable in Final's room. the room is little but more that enough if you just want it to sleep and have a shower. she has some things for breakfast and snacks, which was SO helpful, I really loved that

This place was exactly as pictured and so comfortable! We visited several of the restaurants and pubs close by. All of them were fantastic! We had a couple of questions during our stay and our host was quick to answer which was great. I would definitely recommend this to others visiting the area!!

Wir kamen an dem Tag etwas verspätet wurden aber von Josè direkt herzlich in Empfang genommen. Er war sehr freundlich und gesprächig, hat uns gut beraten was die Sehenswürdigkeiten anging. Die Wohnung hat den selben Flair wie auf den Fotos, es stehen Wasser, Kaffee und Tee jederzeit zur Verfügung. Das Bad konnten wir jederzeit nutzen ohne das man sich in die Quere kommt. Kann ich jedem empfehlen der ein paar Tage in Edinburgh verbingen möchte!
A great place to enjoy around Edinburgh
A beautiful apartment in a beautiful part of the city! She was super communicative and lovely to correspond with. We loved her pets and the bedroom was beautiful.

They seriously thought of everything you could possibly need for a comfortable and enjoyable stay! From the wireless chargers to the TV streaming accounts. Made me feel incredibly welcome to their home and I would definitely stay again
Mooie locatie vlak bij de tram van Leith naar de luchthaven dwars door het centrum.

The place was comfortable and very well located, near many nice restaurants and shopping. Public transportation was nearby. The apartment has a washing machine which came in handy and very important for us it had a secure parking place.
Mattia was a great and friendly host and would definitely recommend for anyone staying in or around Edinburgh.

Appartement très bien situé et calme, près des Meadows, à 15 mn de Old Town. Notre chambre tait comme un petit cocon. Jim a été un hôte parfait, discret, attentif. Grâce à lui et son accueil, et un prix très raisonnable, nous avons passé un excellent séjour et avons pu profiter pleinement du Fringe festival. On espère revenir. Merci

Thank you :)

There are some nice bars and restaurants within easy walking distance from the property and we particularly enjoyed Teuchters Bar for a beer, and The Shore for a meal. We also had a nice day out walking the Water of Leith walkway - the tram from Leith gets you to Edinburgh Waverley, then a couple of train stops down to Kingsknowe station then a 4 minute walk to the Walkway to explore the nearby Colinton Tunnel, then walk back to Leith.
