The ability to sit at the window with a drink watching ppl & listening to street performers outside was very nice
Things to note:
Wasn't the cleanest with some stains on furniture / carpets and plenty of dust. A number of the kitchen items hadn't been cleaned.
The internet was terrible. It wasn't fast enough to stream video or have conference calls. We contacted the host who did respond but wasn't able to solve - I suspect it's just the wires in the building.
Much of their information including vital check-in info (like which apartment it is) is only found on their website link which was confusing.
Summary: this would be a perfect option for a crash pad for younger people looking to hit the bars around the area. This would probably not be a good option for a long term stay for older people looking for an actual apt
Excellent flat in very good peaceful location where you can walk to town centre.
Great host, responsive and helpful. Flat was spotless and exactly as photographed.

Place was very spacious and clean. Great location, a few blocks from the tram stop (very convenient if coming from the airport) and hosts were very accessible and cordial. The couch in the living room looked a bit dirty so we just put a sheet on top and it was fine. Highly recommend this place.
We really enjoyed our stay. It was comfortable with all the conveniences in a nice quiet location.  Thank you!
Great experience!! Nice view from the windows and perfect location. So clean when we arrived!
Extremely unsatisfied. Taca is blaming damages to the apartment on us when we did nothing of the sort. She is trying to extort over $300 from us from damages we did not cause.
Nice place and close to everything

We so enjoyed our time in this home.  There was room for the four of us to have our own space.   It is beautifully decorated and very clean.   Located near many restaurants and shops....a great spot to rest after exploring the city.

Victor & Hana’s place was very well equipped. Super comfy bed. Yes it is compact but well thought out and comfy. Very nice stay and communication was great checking in to see all was ok.
Right by the promenade with parking.
Loved it!!

This place was incredible!! You can see the castle from the bedroom window and it’s just a quick walk up the hill to Old Town. Efi was amazing and suggested parking in the area! So many beautiful things to see and great places to eat. We will definitely stay here again!
Rekommenderar starkt detta boendet! Lägenheten var otroligt mysig, allt låg inom gångavstånd och Charlotte var en superbra värd!

A good stay. A nice and cozy apartment that was very clean, tidy and well equipped. We had a minor plumbing issue but Brodie had this resolved immediately. The hosts communication was exemplary. A great place to stay for a weekend away in Edinburgh.

Patrick was a wonderful host. He provided directions to his location along with pictures as directions which was very helpful Once we settled in he reviewed the information he provided about Edinburgh . This included a map, a list of sight to see with a priority list as to which were better then others. The list also contained places to shop and places to eat based on feed back from previous guests. The location of the apartment is ideal for visitors to Edinburgh. Being in the old city it provides a unique perspective on life in early Edinburgh.
The room that we had with the private bath was comfortable and very clean. Being able to come and go as we pleased was very accommodating. We would recommend Patrick’s place to anyone visiting Edinburgh.
Tana's place was absolutely perfect for our trip to Edinburgh! The location was great, and the apartment was so charming and clean. We had a fantastic time and would definitely stay here again.
Very easy and lovely location.

The location is ideal for a stay in Edinburgh.  We wanted to visit the sites but also travel outside the city so we had a car.  Being able to park our vehicle without concern whilst we walked around was ideal and it was convenient when we wanted to tour outside.  It was so central and we could walk everywhere or hop on the buses which were frequent and easy to use with the Edinburgh transport app.

Appartamento bellissimo a 5 min dalla old town con appena sotto anche dei posticini perfetti per fare colazione. L’host gentilissima ha dato tutte le indicazioni perfettamente per raggiungere l appartamento ed entrare con check in flessibile, super disponibile per tutto e risponde molto rapidamente. Consiglio questo appartamento per chi vuole soggiornare ad Edimburgo con tutte le comodità di avere tutto vicino , tornerò sicuramente.

The apartment was exactly as described. Easy instructions for check-in from Sam.
The area is quiet but still walkable to central Edinburgh.
Apartment was clean and warm.

Loved the old town. Good value and easy to walk to major attractions at such a busy time. Entry to unit was a little daunting , many steps and in need of cleaning and repair. The unit itself and its amenities was great, and the shared bathroom never a problem.
I can fully recommed this accomodation. Fully equipped. Location is perfect, 20 minutes to the Edynburg center. Hosts very helpful.

Calim's place is absolutely fantastic! Definitely stay here if you come to Edinburgh! First off his eye to design is delightful. We truly enjoyed all the books, the antiques, and the overall look and feel of his apartment. The honest bar is fantastic! We didn't use it, but we loved the idea of it. Calim's place is the best stocked airbnb we have stayed in yet! Plenty of towels, dishes, books, glasses for every drink imaginable, and so much more! Bed was super comfy and very cool to stay in. This was definitely a wonderful spot for our honeymoon! Thanks again - we will be back!
Knus en leuk ingericht appartement, goed gelegen in het oude centrum. Contact met de verhuurder is efficiënt en zeer goed. Voor lange mensen zijn de bedden aan de kleine kant, verder top!

Really lovely flat - pristine, gorgeous decor, full of lots of little things that made us feel very welcome. Bedrooms are spacious and comfortable and the living room is perfect for relaxing after a busy day in the centre! Bathroom and kitchen were exceptionally clean and user friendly.
The flat is 15mins leisurely walk away from the zoo (the main reason we chose to stay here) and 5mins walk away from the tram stop, which was very convenient for getting into the city centre.
Roy and Selena were very responsive and friendly hosts.
100% would recommend!
Beautiful property, great host. Would definitely stay here again.
位置非常非常的便利，楼下商场和xiao小餐厅均有。穿过苏格兰mei shu g美术馆后就到了爱丁堡城堡，xing jia b性价比很高
Alan is really nice and kind. The bedroom is comfortable and clean. 100% recommendation!

Excellent location in the heart of the old town. Comfortable, clean and well equipped. Sofa bed easy to use. Extra bedding in cupboard. Had a great stay in lovely city. Access is up 2 flights of stairs if you have mobility issues, but nice and quiet being up from street. Would definitely stay again. Thank you

Hanah's house is a very good place to stay when your touring Edinburgh. The location is good, silent neighborhood. A lot of buses near by, the house is very clean, the bed is good. Hanah is a very nice host, she spent time to give us advice about the city and good spots to see.
Very hospitable and great conversationalists!!

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment. the apartment is beautifully decorated, well laid out, and very clean. Calum has created a beautiful, relaxing space that was a pleasure to stay in.
The apartment is in a great location, easily walkable into town and close by to transport links. Plus being so close to Holyrood park and Arthur's Seat is a huge bonus.
Calum was an extremely friendly, welcoming host and was great at responding promptly to any queries we had.
Overall a fantastic apartment, close to everything that Edinburgh has to offer.
We stayed for a night when up for a wedding. The house is in a lovely quiet locations, great views from our room and all we needed for a comfortable shower and sleep which is all we needed!
After my third visit, I can confirm that Jennet's place is perfect for any travellers! And yes, the bathroom floor is heated!! :)

Convenient central location, easy to find using the directions given. Comfy bed and beautiful view of a garden from the bedroom window. Lovely selection of breakfast foods and comfy sitting area and kitchen. Host was welcoming and left lots of tourist brochures and information. Steep narrow staircase with no landing at the top made transporting luggage awkward. Thanks for a great stay!

We’ve stayed in AirBnBs all over the world and Chas and Gillian’s place is certainly one of the best we’ve ever stayed in.  Outstanding hospitality, warm welcome, great location and lovely hosts make it really special.  It’s also in an excellent location for accessing the centre of town.  Very highly recommended!
Good place to stay for a few nights, close to the tram and bus stops, not too far from Princes street if you like to walk.

El apartamento está bien. Estaba limpio, salvo los cubiertos, y tenía la cocina muy completa.
Agua caliente y calefacción muy bien. Richard atento y amable.
Disponía de wifi y secador de pelo.
Tiene un baño justo de tamaño pero suficiente y la habitación dormitorio bastante bien.
Solo un par de cosas, la cerradura de la puerta que costaba bastante abrirla y cerrarla, ya nos lo explicó Richard, pero se podía arreglar y echamos en falta, al no haber salon o sala de estar, una mesita con un par de sillas para en la cocina o en la habitación para poder desayunar o cenar.
Está a unos 15 minutos andando de la Royal Mile y el tranvía del aeropuerto tiene parada muy cerca.
Una tienda que cierra tarde en la esquina, y varios pub cercanos y sitios para comer, también un sitio de food tracks muy cerquita.
Segundo piso sin ascensor a tener en cuenta si tienes problemas para subir escaleras, por la zona son así.
Por precio nos pareció un buen sitio, bien comunicado y Richard un buen anfitrión.

Simple studio. Wish there had been seating option, at least a comfy chair. Didn't realize there was no cooktop or freezer. Very nice space but on small side. Comfortable bed though which was a relief after a week of bad ones! Recommend staying here but consider booking larger unit

Fabulous hosts, so welcoming and friendly, nothing was too much to ask! Lovely little spot, great homely touches in cabin, perfect location for getting around via car or public transport. Very toasty and everything you could possibly need! The kids thoroughly enjoyed their little room and bunk beds and also the very calm and friendly doggy who loved a game of footy! Great shower and coffee too!! We will absolutely be back! Thanks for having us :)
ottima posizione, ricevimento cordiale, appartamento funzionale  peccato che fosse molto buio

This places is lovely, close to the centre although far enough away to not be bothered about all hustle and bustle of the busy streets,
The place is as comfortable and inviting especially after a lot of walking about through the town.
Thank you for being a great host and letting us book so last minute your were very helpfully with our impromptu cost to Edinburgh

Judith and Duke’s home was beautifully decorated and spotless! It was so relaxing and Judith and Duke made us feel more like family stepping through the door than guests. It was a lovely place to lay our head at night during our short stay in beautiful Edinburgh. Judith had so many great recommendations for places to eat (that were fantastic!), things to do and sights to see. Hiking Arthur’s Seat was my sister and my favorite thing we did in Edinburgh. Duke made our stay even more memorable. 💕Would love to come back someday and stay with Judith and Duke!
Great apartment, in an excellent location. Check in was easy and we would certainly stay again.
Loved this place. Location was perfect, would stay here again. Clean, comfy and cozy

Great place to stay very easy access to and from airport via tram as was getting onto city. We bought a tram pass which worked out very reasonable and trams every 7 minutes. The apartment exceeded expectations with everything you could want for a stay away from home.

I only had one day stay in Edinburgh and so I stayed in Manigeh's property for one night only. Manigeh is nice and friendly.
The property is clean and room is spacious and minimalistic. the washroom is modern style and very clean. there is tea / coffee facility available with snacks and fruits outside the room, which is nice.
The check in was a bit hassled. I reached the property but was not sure if it is the right one. Unfortunately the host was not available on the phone so I had to wait outside for sometime , after which I knocked unassuredly and after some time the host came out to welcome me.
The room is in the basement area which I don't mind, but you cannot lock the room when you leave it to go out, which I found to be a bit uncomfortable. Also the cellular signals are unreachable in the room so you have to rely on the wifi, whose signals are a bit weak and sometimes fade out and you are left with no connection. Hope this issue is resolved.
All in all I think I would prefer to stay in Manigeh's place again if I visit Edinburgh.

Rose's flat was in a great location on a bus route to the city centre. The flat was clean and well-equipped with some breakfast things and some toiletries which was a nice touch. Rose was really helpful with answering questions beforehand and she gave very clear instructions to us. Overall, it was a great place to explore Edinburgh and we'd visit again!

Una maravilla de experiencia ! Nos hemos sentido en casa , todo como lo describe y la ubicación perfecta para llegar al centro .
Salma encantadora , atenta y dispuesta a ayudarte en lo que pueda.
Gracias por todo.
Un saludo !
Homely place to stay. We really enjoyed it. A nice walk to and around town. Shop nearby. Need to be aware that the bathroom is a tight fit and would be hard for a large person.

A casa é exatamente como descrito, tive uma ótima estadia, local muito tranquilo e perto de supermercado, lojas e restaurantes. A casa estava impecavelmente limpa e tinha todos os utensílios para preparar refeições. Assim como materiais de limpeza para manter a casa organizada. Certamente vale muito o custo/ benefício. Voltarei com toda certeza.
Obrigada John pela excelente estadia.

I can’t say enough great things about Toshie and her beautiful space! It is very centrally located and walkable to the train station, which was very convenient. The space is wonderful, with a very comfortable bed and clean, spacious bathroom. However, the best part was Toshie herself. During my stay, I was feeling under the weather and she came downstairs to stay with me, brought me water, and even called the NHS for me to see if I needed to go to the hospital. It was very scary being alone in a foreign country not feeling well, but Toshie was such an amazing and caring host. I will definitely be back.

The location of the flat is perfect, near all the attractions of the Old Town with a stunning view of the castle, and it was lovely and warm inside. Bathroom was small but the shower was great. There are also some great cafes nearby and several supermarkets. The only issues have already been discussed in the listing's many reviews, the main ones being the extremely uncomfortable sofas, too much light in the bedroom and no curtain in the kitchen. In addition there is no way to wash dishes as no plug in the sink.

We hadden een geweldig verblijf in de AirBnB van Olessia. De buitenruimte, locatie en het mooie interieur beviel ons zeer. Ook de communicatie met Olessia gaat erg makkelijk, ze reageert snel. Kortom, een aanrader!

Paul was a really nice host and communication was fast and easy. The room was clean and everything we needed for our weekend stay :)
Would recommend and stay there again!

Idyllic location in quiet area with the sound of the babbling river nearby!! Such a cozy place, perfect spot for a relaxing holiday that is still close to all Edinburgh has to offer. If you want good food and drink, follow the water of Leith down 10 minutes to Stockbridge area. :)

A cosy room a short walk away from all major sites in Edinburgh - great location. Free tea, coffee & shortbread! Smart TV for the rainy evenings. Clean, spacious room and bathroom. A busy/loud street down below, so not the best for light sleepers who need the window open (it can get stuffy). But apart from that a great stay.

Perfect New Town pied-a-terre - unbeatable location if you want to be right in the middle of the city with easy access to everything. 10 minute walk from Waverley, 5 minutes to Edinburgh's best coffee at Lowdown, and 15 mins or less to the major sights. Clean and easy to access, would stay again.

Five of us stayed for 2 nights in July, using all three bedrooms. We were met by Fiona as arranged and she opened the underground private car-park for our two cars. She also provided a set of keys for everyone so you don't need to worry about how to get in if you go out alone.

She then gave us a tour of the apartment which is large and beautifully appointed with everything you will ever need for a comfortable stay. The furniture is all high quality and there are seats for six people. You certainly don't feel as if you are squashed in. The view over the rooftops of Edinburgh is also quite special.

The kitchen has all modern appliances and Fiona included milk, orange juice, ground and instant coffee and homemade cookies, as well as all the normal condiments etc.

The bedrooms are all of a good size with two king size and one double bed, and there is lots of wardrobe space in the apartment. Having three separate bathrooms (two en-suite) is a real bonus. As we were attending a wedding it was also useful to have large mirrors so that the ladies could check that they looked OK before they went out!

Although it is on the 5th floor, it has a lift so access is not a problem.

As for location, my brother told me it took him just over ten minutes to walk to Princes Street, and a taxi to the top of the Royal Mile took less that ten minutes and cost £8. There are loads of different bars and restaurants within the local area - Leith Walk is full of them. Fiona also provides an information booklet which lists local taxi numbers, and the numbers of many of the eateries if you want to book a meal.

All in all, we thought this was the ideal place to stay for my son's wedding - having the large lounge/dining area meant that we were able to sit and talk - unlike being in separate rooms in a hotel. The facilities are excellent and Fiona gave us all the information we needed to have a really good stay in Edinburgh.

If we were returning we would definitely want to stay here again.

Christine war eine ganz wundervolle und bezaubernde Gastgeberin, die sich große Mühe gibt ihren Gästen den Aufenthalt so angenehm wie möglich zu machen. Sei es durch kleine Aufmerksamkeiten oder das sie stets erreichbar ist und als Ansprechpartnerin jederzeit zur Verfügung steht.
Die Unterkunft ist super gelegen. Man kann entweder ganz entspannt in die City laufen, oder direkt um die Ecke in den Bus einsteigen. Für mich war es eine Freude bei ihr zu übernachten und ich komme auf jeden Fall gerne wieder!
Enjoyable stay. Most sightseeing spots within walking distance

Es war sehr nett und ruhig, man kam zu Fuß oder mit dem Bus ins Zentrum von Edinburgh, es war schön warm in der Wohnung, es gab Küchengeräte zur Nutzung, im Bad war es recht feucht und daher an einigen Ecken Schimmel. Unser Zimmer hatte eine gute Größe und Ausstattung. Gerry hat schnell auf Fragen geantwortet und der Check-in hat kontaktlos funktioniert.

Mazen was an amazing host! He was very responsive and welcoming. The flat is cozy and clean in a secure apartment building in a quiet neighborhood, just a short walk from the tram that takes you into the city centre. He's created a book that serves as a guide for local restaurants with all the info you need while staying in the area, and he was able to share insights on other places I planned to visit. I felt very safe as a solo woman and would stay here again!

Natasha’s place was great to live it. It was the same as in the photos. Natasha is also very responsive and helpful with any questions i had. She was also quick to help with any issues i had. The place is really close to the bus station and also walkable from the city centre which made it really worth it for us!

It was lovely stay. William gave all the instructions so perfectly in the message and you are smoothly checked-in. The house is at a prime location in Edinburgh and everything, literally everything to explore is just a walk away. They have this beautiful kitchen area, you can make this cup of coffee and just sit there in the morning, listening the birds chirping. It’s all lovely and comfortable.

Emma’s home was a beautiful place to stay in Edinburgh. Very easy to find and great location to walk to lots of sights and shops. Emma was very helpful and flexible as a host - would definitely stay here again on any future trips to Edinburgh!

The airbnb is in a residential area but just steps away from the bus to take you downtown if you don’t want to walk. Great little coffee shops near by, they had a list of their favorites at the Airbnb and that was very helpful. It’s also close to Arthur’s seat, getting to the trailhead was easy. If I ever come back to Edinburgh I will be staying here again.
Very centric place. Hosts were great at communication and leaving instructions. Thank you for hosting us!

Excelente opción dentro del casco antiguo y enfrente del castillo! El departamento coincide con las fotos y la descripción, tiene todo lo necesario para cocinar y para descansar .
Lo único negativo es el ruido de la calle por la noche, si bien el departamento tiene ventanas que aparentan ser insonorizas se escucha un poco, entiendo que se debe a que está en un primer piso. De todas maneras se puede descansar bien.

As the accommodation is located within the Old Town, it is really close to the major attractions. It was also near bus stops that provide a good connection to different parts of Edinburgh. Even though there is no lift in the building, the staircase was wide enough to easily carry up large luggage up to the top floor.
Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben und die Umgebung ist gut zu Fuß zu Erkunden. Wir waren sehr zufrieden.
Fantastic place to stay, great location & parking space really helpful for us. Would definitely recommend to others.

This was a perfect place to stay on the Royal Mile within walking distance to many of Edinburgh's points of interest.  The instructions on how to access the place were clear and helpful, and the amenities in the apartment were as listed ( especially nice was the washer and dryer in the unit).  While we ate out all the time, but if you were inclined to cook in the unit there were many kitchen supplies to use.  We had a great time and enjoyed coming back to this nice relaxing place after full days of exploring Edinburgh and its surroundings.

Beautiful apartment, plenty of room, comfortable beds. The views from the apartment are amazing. The location is perfect and walkable to everything in Edinburgh you would want to see and experience. We also did a few tours out of Edinburgh and those were very walkable as well to get to our guides. Edinburgh is such a great city to spend a week.
Beautiful little flat within walking distance of Haymarket Station, has great facilities and the host was on hand if needed. Would love to come back and stay again

Bij aankomst kreeg ik een warm onthaal van Muriel en de nodige instructies. Ik kwam terecht in een comfortabel appartement met een gerieflijke keuken. Alle voorzieningen zijn er: oven, kookplaat, microgolf, waterkoker, … Er stond zelfs melk, fruitsap en spuitwater in de koelkast en confituur, ontbijtgranen en havermout in de kast. Zo aangenaam, dan moest ik niet direct naar de winkel rennen! Comfortabel bed en een badkamer met inloopdouche.
Groot was mijn verrassing toen bleek dat ik ook gebruik mocht maken van Muriel’s weelderige tuin. Hoe vaak heb ik daar gegeten, heerlijk.
Met bus 16 heb je een rechtstreekse lijn naar het centrum, de bushalte is om de hoek, meerdere bussen per uur.
Wie zoekt naar een rustige plek buiten het drukkere centrum van Edinburgh, zit hier op zijn plaats.
Een aanrader.
Bedankt, Muriel!

I had an amazing stay! Abi was incredibly warm and friendly, always ready to help with anything I needed. The room was clean, spacious, and so cozy—it felt like home. I slept so well and felt very comfortable throughout my stay. Highly recommend!

Lovely host , beautiful Den attached to main home with all things needed .
Breakfast cereals , butter , bread , milk , tea , coffee and biscuits all a lovely addition .
A visiting fox and a lovely secluded garden .
Great location and nice clean flat. Host provided clear instructions to find the flat and entry information

Well located apartment.  Short walks to restaurants, groceries, the castle, Victoria Street and the Royal Mile. I was a solo traveler and felt very comfortable and safe.  Would book this apartment again if in Edinburgh.

I really enjoyed my stay! The location is perfect, close to the center, quiet and nice, the bus station is right behind the building. The apartment was clean and the bed was comfortable. I  highly recommend this apartment and its hosts!
Top Apartment, sehr freundliche und unkomplizierte Kommunikation. Es war alles da, was man braucht und die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber. Absolut empfehlenswert!

Beautifully designed apartment, and the comfiest bed ever!! Emily’s place had everything we needed for a long weekend in Edinburgh and was walking distance to both Leith and Edinburgh town. The detailed local recommendations and suggestions were a really lovely touch too.

The accommodation was absolutely great, within ealking distance of the city centre, but in a quiet street. It was beautiful, clean, and just right for our stay. There was just a small  'glitch' regarding the keys being locked in the building, so a locksmith was called out to access the property. This was something that was very unforseen, and only delayed access by half an hour or so. It was juat a bit stressful as we had our friend's a show booked at the Fringe, which we were worried we'd miss. Otherwise everything was perfect.
Ich war mit meiner Frau zwei Nächte bei Hilary. Der Aufenthalt war perfekt! Hilary ist eine sehr freundliche und hilfsbereite Frau. Ihr selbst gemachtes Brot fantastisch.

A great, spacious, central location. Really clean, lots of space for the family. Very clear instructions on how to check in. The only downfall was the noise of the pub’s vents that you could hear at night from the back rooms, but that’s something that comes with such a central flat.
Noel is a nice host, he is super helpful and very easygoing. The room was super clean and the location is great!
Good place to stay

The images matched our expectations 100% and the team were excellent with their communication throughout.
We were in a prime location and the apartment has such a lovely character.
Incredibly enjoyable stay!

Paul is super nice Host and he answers imidiatly. The location of the flat is perfect for sightseeing and very close to all main areas. Our only issue was the cleanliness. Our room was quite dirty.
I
I would highly recommend Charlotte’s apartment! The location cannot be beat with so many options for dining and things to do within walking distance.
Great place! Spotlessly clean and exactly as shown in the photos. Highly recommend!
Enjoyed a family reunion (Grandad turned 90) as well as  some great meals in Edinburgh . including a wonderful lunch at Cafe Gallo  in Stockbridge .

The flat is in a good central location, but on one of the busier & grubbier streets of Edinburgh.  During our 2 night stay we barely slept due to the noise from people outside, sirens, or from the buses at the bus stop directly outside the flat, all going on until the early hours. There was also lots of noise late into the night from people coming & going to other flats.  The flat is generally in need of repair and some of the furniture is in a poor state. Also, on our visit it could have been a lot cleaner.  Overall, good location but 2-star accomodation. Good if the price is right, i.e. low.

This was an excellent apartment so convenient to walk to city centre. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Buses ran nearby if needed with good links to the airport
There was a supermarket nearby which made catering easy. I would recommend this to anyone, with 3 bedrooms it really suited our family of 6.
Very clean and comfortable. Peaceful area with the choice to walk or take a bus. Jenny was great at responding to messages and left a helpful guide book in the room.
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here. The location was central to just about everything I wanted to see and most everything was even walking distance.

Will and Rowan are very hospitable and great hosts.
Their home was better than expected and we loved the high quality furniture you have equipped it with.
We will no doubt consider booking it again .
Thanks guys.

Prachtig appartement op de kelderverdieping van een statig huis in Edinburgh. Ook hele goede bedden. Op wandelafstand van het centrum, en dus heel goed gelegen.
Het appartement bestaat uit 2 slaapkamers en een badkamer, verbonden door een lange gang. Deze gang wordt echter ook occasioneel door de eigenaars zelf gebruikt (die in de rest van het huis wonen). Vreemd om plots iemand in en uit "ons deel" van de gang te horen lopen.
Daarnaast ook jammer dat de ramen niet open kunnen. Het appartement verluchten konden we enkel door de voordeur open te zetten.
The place is fantastic, better than I expected, and we had very clear instructions from the host which was very useful

Positifs :
-Emplacement très bien (attention rue pentue)
-instructions claires
- très propre
NÉGATIFS:
- Qualité de la literie médiocres ! Vraiment nous sommes repartis cassés
- STORE NON OCCULTANT!!! réveillés très très tôt par la lumière du jour. Horrible
- aucune pression dans la douche, pareil très désagréable avec peu d’écoulement
-pas d’insonorisation
- amenez vos serviettes de bain, les leurs sont un gommage gratuit
Good location for getting into the centre of Edinburgh. Quiet area with local cafes and places to eat near by.

Fantastic location just off the royal mile. 10-15 minute walk to the castle or Haymarket. Super nice to have covered underground parking! You will hear some road/construction noise, but nothing I wouldn’t expect being in a city. Also, if you’re in to whisky don’t miss out on Cadenhead’s shop literally 1 min from the apartment. They have a great selection and have their own bottlings as well.
Nice to be in a real flat and out of the busy tourist bubble of the centre of Edinburgh. And good to be supporting a local person instead of a big hotel.
Perfect! Beautiful little flat near the centre. Jennet was really helpful.

Beautiful place, very spacious and everything was taken care of including some nice touches like fresh fruit and veg left for us. Very close to everything, Royal Mile, Arthur's Seat, Holyrood etc are all easily walkable. Paul was a great host with really good communication, texting us some top suggestions for places to go drinking. Would definitely recommend staying here.
Beautiful apartment. Friendly and unobtrusive hosts. A little far out, but so safe and easy to get anywhere by bus. Would definitely stay again.

Reggie's home was the perfect festive getaway- convenient location, beautiful cosy room, gorgeous views and a very accommodating host.
I would absolutely recommend this pad to anyone else coming to Edinburgh. It really made our stay.

What a lovely little apartment!
It’s decorated beautifully and is very clean. Access was very easy as it’s all done through an online portal that accessed the doors so there was no faffing around waiting for someone to let us in. We were especially impressed as we had only booked the day before travelling and found the place to be ready for our arrival with towels etc. all being prepared.
The location is amazing for everything you’d want to do as most landmarks and shops are within in small walking distance as it’s right in the centre. There are of course plenty of dining options around too whether they be independent places or franchise.
Now… there were one or two downsides. The BIGGEST issue is parking. We weren’t sure where to go so contacted the host to be emailed back 5 minutes later saying “there is on street parking nearby”… all of the parking around the area is max 3/4 hours which is no good for anyone staying there (we were there two nights) so their advice wasn’t great if we’re honest. After some searching online, the closest and cheapest option was an NCP car park located on the other side of the castle. It’s a 20 minute walk back to the apartment and cost us £55 for 2 days which isn’t exactly ideal. There were other little things like the shower gel bottle in the shower being empty but these are little things that we weren’t really bothered about.
Overall we would very much rate the experience and would go back again but probably on the train so as to avoid the nightmare parking situation!

Ronnie is a fantastic super host who displayed excellent communication skills prior to our arrival and provided an earlier check in with a warm welcome to all 7 of us females!
Ronnie's home far exceeded our expectations and his attention to detail was outstanding.
We loved staying in this beautiful, warm, spacious, well-equipped home with all the comforts one could only imagine.
We would highly recommend Ronnie's home and look forward to staying there again whilst in Edinburgh.
Do not hesitate folks as you wont regret staying here.

The flat was very, comfortable, warm and clean.
All the information about how to find it and collect the keys was perfectly clear and concise (felt like we were following instructions on a treasure hunt!)
It's central location allowed us to get around on foot most of the time. When we took taxis in the evening they were never more than £7.
Altogether, we are really happy with our stay here and would definitely book again...

It was nice flat, more spacious than I expected.  There is an additional small room with a single bed.  Our family was happy to stay there. I felt like home. On the first day, Zeeshan's father kindly explained everything and Zeeshan also made effort to confirm whether there is anything inconvenient by calling.  Calton hill and Hollyrood Palace is close to the flat. Big mart is also next building.  I would like to recommend this flat.

Lisa was welcoming and helpful. Her descriptions of the location and facilities provided in the flat itself were accurate and useful. We felt very much at home and made use of the well-equipped kitchen and comfortable, well-decorated living area.The flat is part of an intriguing old building in a lovely and central part of Edinburgh. It allowed us to take full advantage of the Festival programme and as such, contributed significantly to our overall enjoyment of the trip.

A beautiful, cosy one bedroom apartment in a perfect location with easy tram access and walking distance from Princes Street & the new St James Quarter. Michelle is so accommodating and pays attention to the smallest details, a wonderful host. The kitchen is fully stocked if you would like to cook but there are some amazing restaurants even on the main road.

I was visiting my daughter who is at university in Edinburgh. Cathy was extremely helpful both prior to and during our stay; she couldn't do enough for us!  The room was immaculately clean and had absolutely everything you could possibly need or want. I would highly recommend Cathy's room and will be calling her again when I'm next in Edinburgh.  Thanks Cathy!
Beautiful apartment located in a nice neighborhood! Rebecca was very helpful and always provided us with detailed information! Looking forward to staying here again!

The apartment is well located and looks nice, but the lack of basic amenities such as sugar and the listed coffee pot being instantaneous coffee made this a bit disappointing. We struggled to enter the building to retrieve the key and had to negotiate with the concierge to get the keys. Wali was nice but when asked for an early check in offered a rate of 24£ pounds an hour. Being asked to take the trash out while finding a dishwasher still filled with dirty dished was also on the list. All of this combined makes it a very mixed experience where it felt like us being there was more of a disturbance than something welcomed.

Lovely 1bed town house, very good location, close to everything, locate in a hidden alley. Bed was comfortable and bathroom was clean. Very responsive host. Good value and would recommend to anyone who wants to stay for visiting the city.
So close to university and reminds me my uni life. No drawers to use in the bedroom, but I guess it’s not a big deal. It has got all the essentials.

Will and Kate are warm, welcoming hosts, who offer their local expertise and make you feel immediately at home, staying on their ground floor. Their place is private and has everything needed for a great stay: super comfortable bed, kitchenette, laundry, and excellent shower.
All perfect. Position exceptional of you want to stay in the old town

We had a lovely stay at this property, it was a really nice spot and only a stones throw from Stockbridge high street and the centre of Edinburgh. The host was very helpful and responsive when we had questions about our stay.
Amazing stay at Tony’s apartment. Amazing views, very clean, secure, quiet and very comfortably sleeps 5-6 people. A super host and always responsive to questions very quickly.  Thanks again Tony.

The apartment was well equipped and in a fabulous location off the Royal Mile and within walking distance to many sites. One perk was the amazing view of Arthur's Seat which I had the luxury of waking up to every morning. It was clean and had a great lay-out. Unfortunately, there are no lifts which made climbing up and down a few flights of stairs a bit strenuous, especially as we were a group of girls but may not be an issue for some. We had plumbing issues on the first day which became progressively worse as the days passed (culminating in a leak that affected the neighbours in the floors below causing us to be unable to use the kitchen sink and dishwasher) but the host seemed responsive in getting it sorted after our departure. I hope it was sorted before the new guests arrived. Seemed serious. I think a bolt or additional lock on the front door might be helpful for security reasons (we had a strange drunk man come knocking on the door one night and would have appreciated that extra layer of security). Apart from this, I would definitely recommend a stay at Colin's in the future for the reasons mentioned earlier.

The Wee Thistle is a really great apartment, perfectly situated for visiting all the sites of Edinburgh. The apartment was perfectly clean and had everything we needed, included little touches like milk, tea bags, coffee and some tasty shortbread! Communication with Gavin was great throughout planning the trip - really fast responses. Would definitely recommend this place to stay, great value for money.
A light and airy flat in a very good location for exploring Edinburgh. Handy parking space and lift.
Nice location, cozy to stay. Easily get to Edinburgh castle and Royal mile. Great to stay with family

David’s apartment is spacious, well-located and sparkling clean. David was easy to contact and provided a fantastic array of local tips. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend David as a host.
apparemment très bien situé et correspondant à la description.1 seul bémol l'appartement est prévu pour6 personnes et le ballond'eau chaude n'est pas adapté

The apartment was very central. We never needed to take public transportation (except from an to the airport) since everything was in walking distance. You can find everything you need there and it is really clean and offers enough space for two. Would definitely recommend staying here!

We really enjoyed our stay here.  Based on Monica’s directions, it was very easy to find.  The unit had everything we needed, and was very comfortable. She was very good about staying in touch with us if we needed anything.

Loved our stay here - the room was cosy and exactly what we needed for our short break to Edinburgh. Transport to the centre was straight forward via the buses (41 and 43) and we found this easily due to Joe’s explanations. Room was very clean and checking in and out was simple. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others.

The best accommodation on our five week trip! David was a wonderful host, he met us at check-in and made sure we were settled. The location can’t be beat and we found everything very comfortable. Definitely recommend!
I absolutely loved staying at this apartment! I was there for the month and Katherine was so lovely and helpful! The proximity to the botanic garden and multiple bus stops is perfect!

Four of us stayed for the weekend while Scotland hosted Ireland in the 6 Nations Rugby. This place was both excellent value and a great location. Very easy to get to from the airport via the Tram, and clear instructions for accessing. Tram also makes heading back into the city very easy! The place was very clean and despite the bitterly cold Scottish weather, we didn't need to adjust the heating. Lovely and warm upon arrival! I would highly recommend to anyone for a weekend.
We had a lovely stay at Jane's flat in Marchmont.  It is an ideal location because almost everything is in walking distance.  Everything worked and the flat was warm and welcoming.
very good location

Appartement confortable, propre et idéalement situé pour une visite d’Édimbourg à pieds.
Équipe disponible et réactive aux moindres demandes.
Je recommande !

We had a perfect stay in Philip and Alison's place! The home was beautiful, and we felt very welcome. They were kind to my friends and I, they made sure everything went well, and their dog is adorable. Thank you so much for hosting us!

Radek and Marines flat is Gorgeous and impeccably clean!  This was our first trip to Edinburgh visiting the University with our daughter and she did not want to leave. It was everything we wanted and more. Transportation, proximity to all the main attractions, shops, restaurants (Rose Street) and The Castle. Radek’s recommendations  saved us a lot of time since we where only there 3 days. I can’t say much more but thank you and we got a good workout on the steps.

Joli logement
Bien situé et très propre
Bonne literie

Todo muy bien.
La ubicación y el lugar están bien ubicados. Es un sitio muy cómodo y cuenta con todo lo necesario para una estancia agradable.

The most magical , enchanted, stately yet cozy experience my group of friends have ever had on vacation. Thanks to Agnes! Absolutely immaculate , spacious, well cared for home … that is a 10 min walk from anything and everything in Edinburgh!!! 5 stars are NOT enough!
Thank you THANK YOU!!!

What a beautiful and positive home! I really enjoyed my stay at Holly’s place - she’s a warm, friendly and caring host.  Everything, from the beautiful, homely flat to her two cute cats to our fun chats, was perfect! I would highly recommend. The place is about 20 mins walk from Edinburgh Waverley in a quiet residential street. There’s a large Tesco a short walk away and a cute cafe serving delicious bagels! The room is cosy and the bed was very comfortable. Holly made me feel just like at home! The whole flat has a lot of quirky, cool decorations which I really loved.  Hope I can come back again soon, thank you Holly!! :)
Brilliant flat. Lovely and central, just what we needed for our 2 day visit to Edinburgh. The flat itself is neat,tidy and very comfortable.

The flat matched the descriptions and the photos. Overall, it was indeed generally good. The location was also convenient with multiple bus routes heading to the city centre. The corridors and stairs of the building was, however, slightly dirty and lighting was dim. That being said, these were things beyond Jack's remit and he was indeed very thoughtful - the milk in the fridge was a gentle touch.
Very homely and well equipped apartment. Would recommend to friends and family

Its very confortable and clean. Sam was very helpful and friendly.
Hoping to return soon.

Kornelia is an excellent host. She was quick to respond to every question. The apartment was spotless. She has thought of all the little things-breakfast items, coffee and tea, plenty of linens,etc. This was a perfect base to enjoy Edinburgh. The pictures posted show how nicely appointed the apartment is. It has a comfortable bed as well.

The apartment was PERFECT! It was just a bit away from the old town so it was very quiet and peaceful but easily walkable. The path thru the park was so nice!
We would stay here again!

Martin is definitely a super host ! He went above and beyond in meeting us and giving us a tour of the place. He even brought our super heavy luggage up the stairs AND came out to the street to show us where to park and how to use the parking meter. The location was perfect! Could walk within 1 minute to the grass market and the royal mile was a 5minute walk away. Views of the base of the castle from our window !

My parents and I had a comfortable and pleasant stay at Kerry’s cottage. It was conveniently located close to Currie Hill and surrounded by beautiful greenery. Thank you, Kerry!
Beautiful apartment close to downtown. Would highly recommend this place :)
It’s small but a very clean and comfortable place to stay in a fantastic central location, with great cafes and pubs downstairs.
The room is stylish and comfortable. The bathroom  is clean . The public area is nice and clean.
Amazing place to stay, would highly recommend!

Le logement est incroyable, parfaitement situé, beau et grand et luxueux, un peu cher mais il vaut vraiment le coup au vu de l’emplacement géographique (au cœur de new Town toutes les boutiques, restau et bars à côté , à 10min à pied du centre historique  et à 5 min à pied du tram qui amène directement à l’aéroport). Gros coup de cœur
Lovely flat in a good location. Couple issues with getting keys at check-in but the team did their best to sort it out as soon as possible. Would recommend.

Andrew’s place was centrally located, quiet and secure and with excellent transport links. It was a spacious flat with comfortable beds and lovely crockery.

Overall, we had a excellent time in Edinburgh and in the flat and it suited us as a party of 3.

A handy base for exploring Edinburgh by foot or bus. NB Only paid parking around the flat.
Lovely and cosy as the temperatures plummeted. On third floor so pack light!

Great place to stay near Central Edinburgh. Everything we needed and expected. We didn't meet the host but communication was great. All great!
A nice location that is only a mile out from the central Edinburgh attractions. It was cimfortable and quiet at Mary's place.

Thank you for the fantastic stay at your apartment. It was just beautiful. We really enjoyed our stay, it was close to the city centre and located in such a beautiful part of Edinburgh. Thank you so much we will be sure to return.

Anne is a truly exceptional host.She is friendly and helpful, sharing tips for eating out and local walks etc . The accommodation is spotless and has lots of little extras and personal touches such as guide books, coffee machine and a well stocked fridge. If you are thinking of staying here, stop thinking and book - you won’t regret it!

This is my second stay at Andrew’s apartment which speaks for itself. This time I needed to bring a car and it was very easy to park right outside. For somewhere so central this well equipped and peaceful flat is perfect for recuperating after a day out!

Great location in the heart of New Town, easy walking access to the sites, restaurants, etc. As a place to lay your head while you explore Edinburgh it works well. Communication was clear and the flat was clean.
This is a great place to stay if you are doing the sites of Edinburgh.

Pros: Rebecca was very lovely and answered any questions we had very quickly. The location was great and the check-in was easy. The bathroom was very nice and modern. The accommodation generally needs a lick of paint, the sofas had a few stains and there were quite a few spiderwebs. We couldn’t find a “walk-in wardrobe” but we did find an alcove covered by a curtain in the entryway that seems to be used as a storage space, so maybe the listing needs to be updated.

The place was perfect for our short stay. The location was perfect, the flat had everything we needed. However, the bed sheets were itchy and the place had a few flies. It didn’t bother us too much but it was a tad annoying. Other then that we enjoyed our stay!
Great communication with the host, lovely touches inside the house, and very clean.  - n

when we arrived my husband  goes "winner'  fantastic place spotless clean. huge place. close to so many things. we only had a few moments to sit and chill in the back terrace but it was very nice. wish we had more days.

Sehr schöner und ruhiger Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und alles was man braucht war vorhanden!

Homely. arty apartment overlooking the sea. Perfect respite while visiting the fringe.

Stay was excellent, however they should work on shower as it was not working properly. Everything was perfect except that.

This place was magical!  So much character, so comfortable, and so carefully kitted out with everything we could possibly need. We even met the owner Fleur, who runs Bothy Coffee from a converted police box on the edge of Queen's Gardens every weekday 8am-12.30pm.

Sophie’s flat is in a great location: there’s a huge green park roughly 7 mins away walking for anyone who brings a dog, and both the bus stop to get you close to the city center and a small grocery store for bits and bobs are just around the corner from the flat. The flat was spacious and well appointed (coffee, enough shampoo/conditioner/body wash for the first day, washing up liquid and sponges, etc.) and the private parking space was appreciated. Sophie is quickly responsive to any questions.
Great place to stay, spotless clean bathroom, cosy living room.

Excellent place to stay and great connections into the city with a short bus ride. Kornelia was very helpful before and throughout the trip and always responsive. Would recommend this place to anyone staying in and around the city!

The other reviews are accurate -- Daria and Maciej are warm, welcoming, and wonderful.  They are particularly good at making you feel comfortable in their space.  They have set up the room with real consideration of what a traveller needs -- they've thought of everything.  The location is well away from the city centre, but it's very well connected by a number of different bus lines.  Excellent value for money, and very comfortable.  No downsides whatsoever!
Lovely gardens and yoga studio!

Fantastic apartment. Excellent location surrounded by great restaurants and cocktail bars. Lovely interiors. Thank you

Great place. Close to all of the restaurants, pubs, and in the heart of the city.

Lovely place, nice to have the garden to enjoy, beds were comfy, really good powerful showers, fresh towels and bedding, warm and clear instructions on using the heating if needed. Everything you could need in the kitchen. Hosts were really communicative and helpful.

Sean is a fantastic host and welcoming. His communication is very quick, informative and great, and gave us some awesome tips. His flat is spacious and clean, and very well located. Highly recommend a stay here! Thanks Sean!
Excellent location very close to tram stop and the zoo. Very family friendly. Little extras left in the flat really helped us to settle in.

Recommended to stay with Margaret. She is so friendly and welcoming nice and clean place

Just as everybody mentioned, the perfect place to discover Edinburgh. Perfectly located, walkable as well as close to every bus route, not touristy, very « neighborly » . The apartment itself is beautiful furnished, comfortable and sunny (yes we had sunny days!).  Highly recommend. Thanks Rachel.

The flat was just like the photos. The owner was kind she even prepared snacks for us. It had everything we could ask for but there was a bit cold because the heating wasn’t working that good and shower has very light pressure. But beside’s that it was great.
Great stay in central Edinburgh- spacious apartment in great location. Would recommend. Stayed at the weekend and it was a little noisy but we knew that and it didn’t worry us.
Emma was great!! Very nice and helpful!

We had a lovely stay at Sheila‘s. Our room was super cozy and had everything we needed.

Very nice, clean cozy flat. It’s clear Valentina has put a lot of thought into ensuring guests have a comfortable stay. Would recommend!

Great accommodation and good location in Morningside.

Located in a charming 18th Century built apartment, the bed was super comfortable in a spacious room. Albert was both welcoming and knowledgeable with recommendations of the local attractions. Brian and Christine communicated very well from booking to after our stay. The Snug was exactly as advertised and we loved it. Very clean, accessible for our elderly friends, everything was brilliant and we would be happy to stay again.
Great apartment with a very convenient location with public transport available from right outside the door.
Couldn’t fault it. Thanks for making us feel welcome, Chris! I’ll be coming back when I’m in Edinburgh again.

Absolutely loved my stay here. Such a beautiful space and the hosts were responsive, helpful, and went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable. I especially enjoyed the little things they provided during my stay to make me feel like I was right at home. I can’t wait to stay here again.

A wonderful place and location! Mary was very accommodating. We would stay here again.

Itiziar's flat was perfect for my father and brother to stay in while visiting me in Edinburgh; it was so clean and presentable, exactly as described! The flat is compact but very well organised and so bright and airy, and the beds were very comfortable.

Thank you again Ixi, I would recommend this to anyone travelling in Edinburgh and will be booking again soon I'm sure :)

Catherine was a super host. We have never met, but communication was very good. She answered quickly to all my messages. Apartment was clean and cosy, we had also a private bathroom. Good location of the apartment, close to city centre. We had a nice stay there and I would book it definitely again. Thanks.

Apartment was great. It was a little far out, which was ok as we had a car. Great kitchen and tea coffee biscuits etc was a really nice touch. The dining room table was a bit of a pain as we put down a glass of cold water and it marked. Other than that felt at home
