Stunning apartment in a nice location with easy access to everything Edinburgh has to offer. Fiona was really helpful with information and recommendations for our stay. Would highly recommend.

Ha sido fantástico!! hemos estado unos días visitando la ciudad y la verdad que no hemos podido elegir mejor, ha sido como estar en casa y Ryan ha sido súper atento, es muy fáci y rapida la comunicación. Pensamos volver y pensamos repetir con el apartamento!

에든버러 중심의 모든 명소를 걸어서 가볼 수 있는 최고의 위치예요. 창문 전망은 사진과 똑같고, 실내가 정말 아늑하고 예쁘게 꾸며져 있어서 집안에 있는 동안에도 에든버러 감성에 푹 빠질 수 있었어요. Aileen은 세심한 호스트로 메시지 답장이 매우 빠르고, 중간에 저희가 잘 지내고 있는지 숙소에 문제는 없는지 물어봐 주셨어요. 온수가 잘 나오는 점이 특히 좋았습니다.

Was okay. It was nice not to be in the hustle and bustle of the city, but wasn't our favorite. Wifi was spotty (if you need to work, not recommended), there is no freezer and the beds are spring mattresses, so just prepare yourself.

Sauberes Hotel und sehr Platzeffizientes Zimmer, aber etwas chaotisch.
Das Bett knarzt, es lief die Lüftung durchgehend mit einem hörbaren Brummen (nichts für Geräuschempfindliche), keine Kleiderbügel im großem Kleiderschrank.
Beim ersten Mal Anmerken ist nichts passiert, beim zweiten Mal wurde uns geholfen (Kleiderbügel und Lüftung; Bett haben wir nicht gefragt)
Die Lage ist gut, zwar 30 Fußminuten von der Innenstadt weg, aber viele gute Restaurants und 3 Supermärkte in der Gegend.

Honest review for future guests - We had a very disappointing experience which is a big shame as the property has potential. Our stay was ruined by the unacceptable lack of cleanliness. Soon after arriving, I realised how dirty the floor was. I walked around for 5 minutes and my socks were almost black from the filth off the floor. I decided I would hoover and mop it myself, but no hoover is provided (only a cheap dustpan) and when I saw the mop that was left behind I was even more disgusted. The mop was absolutely filthy and black. There was dirty water still in the mop bucket too. I had to clean the toilet myself because I did spot urine & waste marks on the underside of the toilet seat. Dust everywhere. Bedsheets with hairs on them. Cobwebs. Bathtub was dirty (I had to wipe it), windows filthy. I have pictures of how unclean things were and Airbnb are offering a partial refund. Not fair of Jack to say it’s “luxury” and charge a  £100 cleaning fee. I regret bringing my toddler here.
Apartment was great for our stay in Edinburgh visiting the sites. Was a few kilometres from town but didn’t bother us. Apartment was clean and tidy and easy to find. Really enjoyed our stay

Claire è stata fin da subito molto accogliente dandoci informazioni e indicazioni molto utili. L’appartamento è tenuto con molta cura, ideale per un breve soggiorno in città, noi abbiamo alloggiato in 5 e siamo stati bene. Posizione comoda per spostamenti da e per aeroporto e per visitare il centro città a piedi! Se tornassi ad Edimburgo alloggerei di nuovo da Claire!

Alison and Christian were extremely kind and accommodating and have a lovely home. We spent two nights with them and wish we could've stayed longer! The room is on the 3rd floor, very cute, and incredibly sunny. (The curtains are nice and heavy in case you're sensitive to that.) A set of towels is provided, and the bathroom is equipped with a basket of shampoos and body wash samples. The beds are comfortable and the wifi is fast.

Their home is a short walk to the city center and the Meadows park makes a nice buffer so the neighborhood is quiet at night. My friend and I enjoyed sitting in the park after our long days in town and watching people picnicking and playing. It is also an easy walk to the base of Arthur's Seat. The parlor is set up with a selection of teas, coffee, and cereal. Breakfast was delicious and fresh and we enjoyed meeting the couple staying in the room across from ours.

The cats are very cute and lovable, but will try to sneak into your room (and out the window), so be alert! Thanks for a great stay, Alison and Christian!

Fiona and Calvin’s flat is a dream. Both comfortable and stylish, it felt like a boutique Scandinavian hotel. The neighborhood is safe and quiet, and there is convenient public transportation to the city center and plenty of great restaurants, cafes, and pubs nearby. They gave us tons of excellent suggestions for food and drink, and were warm and wonderful hosts. We loved every minute here and will rebook if we’re ever fortunate enough to come back to Edinburgh. Highly recommend this lovely flat.

The Auld Pottery was perfectly located to experience all the best gems in Edinburgh. Bring your walking shoes as you'll find that you can walk in any direction from the Pottery and find something wonderful to see. The hosts were very communicative and helpful during the check in and check out process. Look forward to booking again in the future!
All good

We had a wonderful, comfortable stay in Edinburgh and all enjoyed the accommodation and what it had to offer.
The Christmas markets were very busy but very good.
Would recommend Momo’s place as it’s easily accessible for everything the city has to explore.
Many thanks!

Fantastic apartment & the host has thought of everything that you may need during your stay. Secure parking a great bonus. Centrally located to the main attractions- you feel that you are tucked away yet you are so close to everything. Lovely & clean apartment & the added bonus is the apartment was close enough for us to not only walk into  Edinburgh centre but also to BT Murrayfield where we were watching a concert during our stay.  Four of us stayed in total & it always felt like there was plenty of room

I'd recommend this absolutely! The apartment is spacious and extremely comfortable, and in a wonderful part of town, right by the Meadows and close to some lovely cafes, stores, and places to get groceries. Colin was extremely responsive and informative, and left a few staples in the fridge, saving that initial trip to the store; couldn't ask for a better host! The neighborhood is quiet and very safe; I'd absolutely stay here again.
Súper recomendable muy amplio todo impecable y la ubicación bien

We had a lovely stay for 5 days and it was worth it. The beach was nearby and it was good to ho for walks, enjoy the breeze from the sea. Some good food shops near the beach side, felt lively. Would definitely come back again.

Vue du salon sur un immeuble désaffecté et côté chambre sur une ruelle un peu sale. ..Le logement est cependant agréable : spacieux bien équipé, peu bruyant et très bien situé pour découvrir Édimbourg !
Note it is on the top level and there is no elevator.
Amazing decoration, very clean and tidy. Good value for money, we will definitely use it again.

This is the perfect place to stay in Edinburgh. The apartment is stunning with a beautiful garden. The hosts are fantastic and always on hand to help to ensure you have a perfect stay. We had to arrange childcare for a wedding and Olessia was extremely helpful with recommendations. Lots of added extra made this apartment feel like true luxury. Secure garage parking close to the apartment. Will be staying here again for our next trip to Edinburgh.
Thanks again

Lovely stay on the outskirts of Edinburgh. It was easy to walk to the centre for food and activities. The flat was clean and tidy and we found it very warm and comfortable.
Free parking is available in the street over the weekend, and just a short walk away during the week
Great spot right off the Royal Mile! Perfect and spacious location!
Perfect

Der Aufenthalt war perfekt und es hat mir sehr gut gefallen. Die Kommunikation war toll, sehr schnelle Antworten und extrem freundlich. Vor Ort war alles wie beschrieben. Eine schöne ruhige Lage trotz Stadtnähe. Gute Busanbindung, auch zu Fuß wunderbar zu erreichen und schnell am Flughafen.
Ich werde definitiv wiederkommen und kann die Unterkunft zu 100% weiterempfehlen.
Great location, easy access to both Leith and the city centre. Great as a base after a day of exploring.
Perfect apartment for a big group. Stayed for a stag do and the flat was in a great location. Check in and check out was very smooth with Don.
Cozy apartment really close to the city center. All clean and the communication with Emily was super easy, always there to help! Highly recommended!
Hele vriendelijke mensen. Zeer gastvrij. Mochten ook onze koffers achterlaten na het uitchecken om nog naarder centrum te gaan
Un très beau séjour, Christopher est un hôte attentif à ses voyageurs. Le logement était très propre, rangé et proche du centre ville

Lovely house; immaculate and cosy. Hot tub in an outdoor house, so perfect no need to go out in the cold to get to! Bathrooms are beautiful and it’s ideal place to go for somewhere to relax.
I’ve been 3 times now and will continue to book.

Great house for the weekend! 6 adults stayed and there was plenty of room. The kitchen was well stocked with kitchen utensils as we cooked one night and made breakfast. Dishwasher was fab! We took Uber taxis to get in and out of the city which was roughly between £8-£12 but between us all is very cheap! It’s around 10 minutes to the centre. The house is located in a residential area and could accommodate our two cars. Hot showers and we had a good night sleep. There is another bedroom to sleep 8 but the dining table would struggle to sit 8. Would highly recommend!
Merci à Paul pour sa réactivité tout au long du séjour. Tout était parfait !

A great place to stay when visiting Edinburgh. The location is perfect and ina beautoful neighborhood.  Has  access to the centre by many busses and can reach within 7 minutes. We had a great walk to Camden Beach. worth the visit. The rooms are clean and Berry has been extremely kind to us . Berry took the mornings to chat with us and it was a beautiful stay. Would definitely recomend.

非常喜欢Dylan家的装修风格。简约现代，大方得体。尤其是卫生间和主卧，充满了科技感。 厨房很大，调味料齐全，主卧的床角内嵌有电视，可以通过遥控器升上来观看
Dylan为我们入住做了细致的工作，包括生活的方方面面，还为我们整理了爱丁堡吃喝玩乐的推荐清单，非常用心

Everything was perfect, the room and bathroom were extremely clean. We had everything we needed for comfortable stay including fresh towels and bedding, hairdryer, iron, fridge, all kitchen utilities, tableware, washing machine and dryer, and even coffee machine. Michele provided us with all laundry, bathroom supplies, lots of think to cook at home, and some basic breakfast stuff (toast bread, butter, jam, Nutella and etc).
The location was a bit far from the city center, but we had a car, so it wasn’t a problem(for this we had free parking).
Michele is a very kind, helpful, responsive and in general nice person. If I come again to Edinburgh I will definitely try to stay here!
Thank you very much !!!

Probably didn’t get to spend as much time in this apartment as we should’ve with how busy we were this weekend but the apartment matched the listing. It was clean, convenient and a great cheaper alternative to some of the big hotels in the city whilst being in an ideal location. Certainly worth the money, would recommend.

We had the utmost pleasure to stay at this gem and were delighted! I have stayed in various Airbnbs around the world - from NYC over Lima to Mexico - and hands down, this one was my favorite. You cannot beat the location!! Right under the Edinburgh Castle, situated on Grassmarket which is filled with little cafés and restaurants and a popular hot spot in Edinburgh. The picturesque Victoria Street is right around the corner, a few steps away is a cute cat café, supermarkets and convenience stores are close also ... Basically a dream come true Airbnb! The hosts were super nice and responsive, we were even treated to a nice little surprise in our apartment. <3 I can say for sure that I will be back (hoping to find availability because this gem will surely be booked always! If you visit Edinburgh - look no further!

This is a lovely 2nd floor flat with seaviews out of 3 windows. It is very nicely decorated and furnished, and has everything one could possibly need. We thoroughly recommend it and would stay again if we return to Edinburgh. Thanks.
Great location. Easy to find. Close to the centre.

El departamento era muy acogedor, todo estaba limpio y ordenado. En general todo el lugar tenía lo necesario para una estadía tranquila y cómoda, las sábanas estaban limpias y la cama era muy cómoda, las toallas igual estaban limpias. Valentina siempre estuvo al pendiente y nos dio instrucciones muy claras para el check out, dejo un manual para usuarios del departamento donde explica a detalle cómo usar los aparatos, la estufa, reglas de la casa, recomendaciones de restaurantes (super buenos a los que fuimos), mapas de la zona y muchas otras recomendaciones de lugares para visitar. Lo único que no fue de nuestro agrado es que el departamento está en el segundo piso y no hay elevador, fue difícil subir nuestras maletas ya que eran pesadas, adicional a eso, las paredes son algo delgadas, ya que podíamos escuchar la conversación de las personas del departamento de a lado al igual que sus aparatos electrónicos. En general todo estuvo muy bien.
Natalia's place was great! The location is great (close to Arthur's Seat). The kitchen is gorgeous and the art decorating the property is beautiful.
Great location and property
非常棒，很温馨的公寓，位置也十分优越。

We really enjoyed our stay at Dana’s place. It’s in a beautiful neighborhood that’s peaceful and quiet but only a 15 minute walk from Royal Mile. Cafes, restaurants, and grocery stores were all within a 5 minute walk. Her place was clean, well equipped, and very comfortable. Her garden was beautiful. Dana was wonderful and easy to communicate and we would absolutely recommend her place!

Even though I never met Assean in person, he checked in frequently through this app offering detailed helps and hints about the flat and check in. The place was simple but very clean and comfortable which is all a traveler could ask for! There was one issue with the shower but Assean warned me about it as it wasn’t getting fixed until after I left so I could tell he takes very good care of the flat and his guests! Would defiantly stay at this location again

Super séjour !
Des hôtes très sympathiques et réactifs (:
Central location that is very convenient in old town. Everything is in walking distance.

We stayed at Nicola's place in 2 parts during our Scotland trip. So, writing 1 combined feedback :) She and her little daughter welcomed us on the 1st day! The apartment was very clean and comfortable. We had a great stay!

This beautiful apartment was exactly as described. It was extremely comfortable with nice bed linens etc. The kitchen was very well stocked, with plenty of kitchen equipment and a nice coffee machine. There was a very nice courtyard garden and the whole apartment felt very spacious. I would be very happy to stay there again.

For the most part, I had a very good experience. The host answers quickly and precisely and the place is fine to stay a couple of days if you do not want to go to a hostel. Although it is easy to hear what other people do, most keep silence as much as they can. There are pubs and restaurants nearby to go out at night, and the neighbourhood did not seem dangerous. The cleaning could have been better. 4/5.
Nice location, great stay
Good value overall .
Comfortable stay, great host and amazing views from the balcony

A very nice and comfortable stay. David and family very nice hosts. And the breakfast offered is just awesome. Pancakes were the cherry on top.
Just the bathroom, though private, is not attached.
We had a great stay with Marina. The apartment is beautiful and it's in a great location.

I must say it was an amazing airbnb that I booked. Denisa has been really kind and helpful throughout my stay at her place. The place is extremely cozy and comfortable. It is convenient to travel to city which took us 30-40mins.
Denisa was also really understanding when I requested to store my luggage at the airbnb after checkout as my train was cancelled.
Thank you for your amazing hospitality❤️
The location was superb!! We had a great time and loved the place.

Robert was an amazing host. He greeted us the first day and gave us great recommendations. As far as the AirBnb, the pictures do not do this place justice! It is a big space, very clean, well decorated. It is in the perfect location, close to all things Edinburgh. Very walkable, 10/10  would recommend.
Very pleasant host, facilities are fine and at a very fair price. Location very convenient.
Wonderful place for our family to stay! Lots of room to spread out and sit together, great location!

We had a lovely time at Gillian’s Studio flat! The flat was very clean, the bed was super comfortable and the kitchen had everything you need for a home cooked meal/breakfast. The location was perfect, in a quiet neighbourhood just out of town, accessible by walking or a short taxi. We would definitely recommend staying here and will definitely come back next time we visit Edinburgh! :)

We had an amazing time at Jonathan place!
We booked for a week and he is the best host I ever had on airbnb, considering that I travelled 38 countries!
He picked up from the station and gave us a ride in old town then showed us clear instructions for everything in the flat.
My personal opinion is not to get fooled by old furniture, everything was functional and all the facilities included like nobody else.
Unlike other host where I had to buy spices, coffe, shower gel, shampoo and toiletries or to beg for an extra towel, he has everything included.
The apartment is huge and cosy and makes you feel like home. Especially the natural plants and the pictures on the walls which gives soul to the flat.
The location is walking distance from all the popular area to visit in Edinburgh!
The view is amazing to the holyrood hills....
To be honest I rather a cosy place like this than a luxury souless flat with no facilities where they charge extra for everything you ask.
Great location and stay with family of four!

Ritornerei da Virginia! Ci ha accolti come un’amica di famiglia con un buon tea. Posizione eccellente, abbiamo goduto del silenzio e della tranquillità della zona, della contemporanea vicinanza al centro, 20 minuti di piacevole passeggiata o mezzi pubblici efficientissimi.
Fermata a 5/10 minuti per l’aeroporto, un tram o bus diretto.
Valore aggiunto, Nala, la gatta di casa, che ho potuto coccolare ogni tanto.
Unico neo, se devo trovarlo, lo spazio per i vestiti in camera, ma credo ci stiano lavorando, la camera era tinteggiata di fresco, infissi e termosifoni nuovi.
A cozy and nice place for our short trip.

Great place to stay when visiting Edinburgh. Easy walk to all the major attractions. Supermarkets and restaurants close by. Comfortable beds with good linen. Our only issue was trying to find parking but found one 17 minutes walk away at Q park after we dropped off our bags.
Fantastic place, Pauline was great, quick response and a good house tour. Traveling as a big group had no effects, loads of space for all of us!
The flat is lovely, has all necessary utilities. The location is great. I’d definitely come back.
The apartment is amazing!

As an American the rooms were a little smaller than my family was used to, & the lens of the camera taking the pictures for the listing also made it seem slightly larger than it was…this being said there was a floor plan and dimensions listed só I easily could have calculated the space if I wanted to. Despite the smaller size than I was expecting it was plenty spacious and had everything we needed for our almost 2week stay. It was very clean and nicely decorated. I also really appreciated the detailed check-in instructions as we would be getting in after dark. 10/10 would stay here again.

Wir waren 4 Nächte dort und hatten eine ganz tolle Zeit.  Die Umgebung ist nicht die aller schönst aber mit dem Bus ist alles sehr schnell erreichbar und eine Bar und einen Supermarkt gibt es fussläufig. Sarah und ihre beiden behaarten Freunde waren super gastfreundlich und unkomplizierter. Die Wohnung ist super Gemütlich Mega sauber und einladend Dankeschön! 😊❤️

Lucy's apartment is wonderful had everything we needed for a great weekend and all in walking distance from Edinburgh Castle and Old Town. Very easy to find and instructions to get into apartment were very clear and helpful. We would definitely recommend. Two Very Happy visitors Thankyou Lucy
wir würden wieder in der Wohnung übernachten!
非常非常好的入住体验！Ted人特别好，帮助我们非常方便快捷地办理入住。房子位置很方便，离主要景点可以步行，公交站点也很近。房子很大而且很温馨，窗外的景点非常美～住着十分舒适
The best place for the price in Edinburgh. Staff is soo friendly they ll make you feel like your at your own place .
Calims appartement is perfect, located in the heart of the old town. Calim is a superhost, very friendly and serviceminded!!
Amazing location!  Great communication with the host. The stairs are no joke, they are pretty steep and precarious but my teenagers and I were able to lug our 50lb bags up them. Pack light ;)
Amazing place to stay and a friendly and accommodating family. I cant recommend this place highly enough.
Very nice appartement on the Royal Mile... Parked and charged the car in the Radisson Blu which is a 5 minute walk!
I really loved my stay at Fiona’s. The apartment was sparkling clean, beautifully stylish, and had a fantastic location. A five star stay!
Ayubs place was really clean and comfy to stay in. He was available to help whenever needed. It’s not very close to the city centre but very easily accessed by several buses and trams.
Thank you :)

Sharon and Paul were super friendly, perfect hosts and took great care of me. The room is small, but well laid out and the bed was super comfy. Definitely recommended for shorter solo stays in Edinburgh.

Scott is very friendly, accommodating and easy to coordinate with. We had a wonderful stay. The location is perfect and within walking distance of the centre and the old town. We absolutely loved the space and it felt like home by the time we left. Could not recommend it enough!!
A great host that was more than accommodating.  This is a great place for peace and quiet, rest and relaxation and a short walk to lots of fun things to do in Edinburgh!  Thanks for everything!

This flat is absolutely stunning. Spotlessly clean, bright, and spacious. The juice, milk, wine, bread, fruit, and coffee were such an unexpected surprise. Jane was always very responsive and helpful. I would definitely stay here again and would 100% recommend this flat.
This is a fantastic location.   Absolutely perfect to walk to many great attractions, and places to eat.  We loved it!  I highly recommend it.

Lovely people, great spacious room, great for a stopover in Edinburgh, perfect for a business traveller.  Good location, great to have a parking place available. Lovely touch having fresh fruit. Only didn’t rate 5/5 as a small fridge in the room would have been helpful for us.
Excellent flat in the center of everything with amazing views of the castle. Our family really enjoyed our stay.

Chambre impeccable, conforme à l’annonce. Instructions très claires qui facilitent l’arrivée. Ryan a été bien réactif et disponible. Je vous recommande ce logement ! L’emplacement est parfait pour visiter Edimbourg.

We had an amazing time staying at Zoe's home in Edinburgh. She was very attentive making checking in and out a breeze. (The milk and prosecco in the fridge was a very nice touch!) Would definitely visit again.

This is a really nice spacious flat in a quiet neighborhood that is close to both old and new town Edinburgh. Trams and buses are both nearby, as are pubs, grocery stores and restaurants.  It’s close to the major sites yet just far enough away to be peaceful in the evenings.  A park with playground is a short walk away if you have smaller kids. The layout is perfect for families, with two full bathrooms and a full kitchen with dishwasher. Definitely coming back the next time we are in Edinburgh.

Appartement conforme à la description, idéalement situé, proche des lieux emblématiques d’Edimbourg. Quartier animé!
Andrew est un hôte très réactif et les échanges ont été agréables.
Merci tout particulièrement à Wiebke pour son accueil chaleureux le jour de notre arrivée.
Nous recommandons ce logement.
James was really friendly and super helpful and responsive. He helped me where I needed. The place was super clean and cozy, felt like at home.

We spent 3 days in Edinburgh before Christmas with my fiancé. We had everything what we need. The accommodation was extremely clean with comfy bed and big, private bathroom. Our bedroom looked at the garden, which is beautiful. Our trip was magical, we would like to say thank you Gwen for the nice accommodation and wish you a Happy Year! 🎊🥂🍾
It was a great stay for our group of 6 in this clean and spacious apartment.  Convenient for parking as backdoor opens direct onto parking area.

We had a great time at Katarzyna’s apartment. Location made it easy to go into the centre of Edinburgh, either by foot, bus or tram. It could not have been more convenient. The area also had some great restaurants just a short walk from the apartment.
Katarzyna was extremely helpful and presented us with impeccable accommodations with a comfy bed, practical kitchen and relaxing space. We would not hesitate to recommend the apartment.
Beautiful place, beyond perfect location, and very clean.

It would be incredibly tricky to fault this apartment. It was homely, well decorated, clean and had everything we needed and a great location (10 minutes walk to th centre and a few minutes from the tram  goes to the airport). Nice little touches like complentary soap, shampoo etc and even shortbread. Will definitely stay again.

Sara estuvo muy pendiente a nuestra llegada y abrió las puertas de su alojamiento para nosotros la misma noche en que llegamos a Edinburgo. Sus instrucciones fueron muy claras y nos permitió facilidad en nuestra estadía. por otra parte el espacio es muy limpio y ordenado, se nota que se preocuparon en cada detalle por decorarlo y por agregar cosas de utilidad y decorativas. muy buena ubicación del centro histórico, por lo que no utilizamos medios de transporte sino que todo lo hicimos caminando. Nos llevamos un recuerdo inolvidable de esta maravillosa y encantadora ciudad.

Javier was one of the most amazing host I've ever come across. Very responsive friendly helpful. Beautiful apartment well kept, and very clean. Apartment location was safe and private, shops, supermarket petrol station all within walking distance. I'd definitely be staying here again. What a brilliant Host.
Really lovely apartment with a spacious room, delicious breakfast and Selby was very helpful with everything and easy to communicate with. I would definitely recommend this place!

A stunning place to stay, and a fantastic experience from start to finish. Ronnie is a super host for how he welcomed us to his property, everything that was provided for us during the stay, and the 1st class amenities for us to use during our time there. Any person wanting to stay near Edinburgh would be mad not to stay here and can’t wait to return again 👏👏
This room was incredibly beautiful. It was clean and secluded but Reggie was around if we ever needed help. Would definitely stay again!
Good communication with host who provided excellent instructions for access, wifi, heating etc. Great central location and apartment in excellent condition would thoroughly recommend
Terrific location in a quiet neighborhood and close to restaurants and shops.

A lovely place to stay overall. The rooms are very spacious, with plenty of room, and everything was very clean, which we really appreciated.
However, even with the heating on, the apartment felt quite cold at times. Also, while the listing mentioned it was a 3rd floor apartment, we weren’t expecting quite so many steps or how steep they would be, which was a bit challenging. There was also a small window leading to a hatch above the bathroom that looked down toward the toilet, which made us feel a little uncomfortable. A few small touches could really improve the stay, such as providing more toilet rolls for longer visits, larger towels, and basic essentials like coffee, tea, and milk on arrival—especially considering the price. That said, the location was very good, and it was easy to order Ubers to get to and from the Royal Mile, although it’s not the most walkable to main attractions. Overall we had a positive stay and did enjoy ourselves just a few things could have made it better

The flat was really well situated for us with a 20 minute walk into town. Closeness to shops was brilliant. The flat was mostly well equipped but there was sometimes a smell in the kitchen. other than being a bit cold, it suited our needs well.

The apartment is beautiful, clean and very quiet. The room has a stunning view of Arthur's Seat, and while you get to enjoy the sunrise in the morning, the curtains and blinds keep the room dark if you want to sleep in.
Caroline was very friendly, and always happy to help with anything I needed.
Nice place to be in Edinburgh, cosy couch & beds, nice kitchen! Michelle was a good host

Logement conforme à la description ; propre ; boite à clé pratique pour l'arrivée.
Seuls point negatif : un peu loin du centre (30-40min en bus).
Je recommande !

Best host, always available for us at anytime
So glad to be at your house💋
The apartment was very clean, Good location. The communication with the host was very easy. We had an amazing stay.
It was lovely to stay in Daphne's home - much preferred it to a B&B - comfortable large room with lovely view of garden. Great location. The dogs are adorable too! Thanks for the stay.

We had a fantastic time staying in Vroni's flat. We unfortunately didn't get to meet her as she was away while we were there, but we met her daughter Sophie and Vroni had made excellent arrangements for a friend to be there and greet me when I arrived. She also provided a lovely note of welcome, lots of helpful recommendations and even a birthday card for my dad, who I was travelling with. She also checked in with us by message now and again to make sure everything was all right. The flat is beautiful and very cosy with lots of quirky decorations and very interesting books and pamphlets both in the room and in the loo - I almost regretted not spending more time in so I could read more of them. The location is great and almost everything is within easy walking distance. We enjoyed sampling lots of the local cafes and restaurants. All in all a very enjoyable experience, I recommend this stay very highly!

Great apartment in excellent location and easy to get to all the main sites. Alison was extremely good at communicating and had there been any issues (which there weren't) we felt she would have been on hand quickly to help.
The apartment was vey clean and well equipped with everything we needed for a great stay. We will certainly look at staying there again when we are next in Edinburgh.

I wish I could give a 5-star review; I honestly love being able to rave about a place and have been able to do so about all our other AirBnB stays of our three week trip to Scotland. And as our last stay of our trip, it was disappointing by comparison. I’ll break it down by Pros, Disappointments and Suggestions.
Pros:
Insanely and wonderfully close to the heart of Old Town, literally one block from the Grass Market where a plethora of eateries can be found and a gorgeous view of (and direct path to) the castle can be found.
VERY hot water for the shower.
Beautifully huge windows and two skylights that let in ample natural light, which helps keep the small space from feeling too cramped.
Washing machine (combo dryer??? We couldn’t tell), stove and oven.
Disappointments:
First of all, I can’t actually rate Ashley and Grant as hosts because I never dealt with them even once. All communication was with a “friend” named Jen who “sometimes helps them out”. I suspect Ashley and Grant are merely the owner’s of the flat and leave management of everything else to a hired manager. Again, this is not in the listing and feels deceptive.
Listing photos deceptively make the space look bigger than it actually is. There was very little maneuverability room for two people, let alone space to put our bags. Maybe an ideal place for just one person.
Stairwell/hall leading to the flat is dingy concrete and poorly lit; we arrived in the evening - it was a bit of a creepy greeting and hard to see to navigate the stairs and see the lock for the key to open the door.
It IS a centuries-old building, so structurally going to be different; nonetheless, the front doorway is quite narrow, requiring turning sideways to get in (we are not large people, quite average). This is also true of the shower room; really, this flat can only accommodate thin people as it’s dimensions are very size-exclusive. Potential guests should be made aware of that.
Speaking of the bathroom; the pictures making the bathroom look standard, if small: toilet, shower and sink all in one room. However, the shower is in a separate room across the hall from the toilet room. Both spaces are the size of a closet. The door to the actual shower is in fact the door to the hallway. And the towel rack in the toilet room is placed so that you have to be very careful not to hit your head if you need to bend over at all. There is also no place to hang the toilet paper; the roll just sits on the bare back of the toilet.
The washing machine is virtually useless unless you are from wherever the machine is made and so familiar with or capable of deciphering its very vague little pictographs. Because that is all there is on the face of the machine; no words. The “welcome packet” says that there “should be” instruction manuals for each of the appliances in one of the cupboards, but this was not true, leaving me to wonder just how often the flat is actually checked over or the manual kept up to date for accurate information of the space.
The manual: based on print dates on the bottom of pages and dates on articles included as information/suggestion of things to see, do and where to eat, the manual hasn’t been updated since 2017, rendering everything in it out of date and useless (I refer back to the missing information on how to operate the washing machine). The manual also informed us of two things we found (a) inconvenient and (b) unsettling. (a) There is no hot water in the flat (shower excepted) but three times a day - and does not say when those times are. Thank god we didn’t stay in the winter; spring in Scotland can be cold enough. (b) RATS. Yes, the manual warned us of the potential of rats and instructed us not to leave any food or crumbs. Understandably, despite the ability to cook our own meals there, we avoided doing so.
There is a bar that runs below the flat; this really should be disclosed in the listing as the noise intrusion of the club music at night into the flat makes sleep maddeningly difficult.
The eating nook is too uncomfortable to want to sit there at all, which is such a shame because the giant window really does otherwise draw one in to sit there and read or gaze or enjoy a cup of tea or coffee. But the bench is both too narrow and quite hard as the cushions are really barely cushions at all, they are so thin. In fact, one cushion is a cheap airline pillow.
The placement of the TV makes it a hassle just to get around to the far side of the bed.
Suggestions:
Ashley and Grant, if you are listed as the “hosts”, then you should make an “appearance” at least once in the entire process, anywhere from right after the booking to the obligatory “thanks for staying with us” note after check-out.
Move the TV higher up the wall or to another location all together.
Make the nook bench adequately deep for the average human rump and replace all the “cushions” with new, actually cushioning cushions.
Update the flat “welcome/instruction” manual entirely: Type up all user instructions for all appliances, etc within the guest manual itself. List the actual times of day hot water is available in the kitchen and toilet room. Keep the list of local eateries and sights and especially articles up to date. Maybe even include a map of the city guests can borrow.

The flat is 10 minute walk to the tram/busses, local pubs and eateries. As a host and avid Airbnb traveler, you could not find a better host and better flat than Fiona’s. 5 stars!!!
I had a fantastic stay at Philip's place. The property was exactly as described which made it feel like a home away from home.

The accomodation was spacious, well maintained and very comfortable. The bus stop close by was perfect for getting into the city. The host was welcoming and offered helpful information about the local area. Highly recommended.

Superb centrally-located apartment with fantastic decor and everything you could need for a city break. The furnishings are extremely comfortable and beautifully maintained.  We stayed for three nights and hope to return again next year. Really friendly host and great communication.

Elizabeth is immediately welcoming and friendly.  Full of tips and local knowledge.  Flat is very clean, in a great location with handy bus stops for a 15-20min journey to/from town, and private parking.  Light and bright double room, with comfy bed and plenty of storage.  Spacious 4-piece private bathroom across the hall is a great find in a shared property.  Perfect base, and a home-from-home in Edinburgh.  Would highly recommend.

Really nice, clean place. Dylan provided good reccomendations on a variety of things to do. An uber to Waverly was roughly £4 which meant it was quick and cheap to travel into town. If you chose to walk it would have been about 25 minutes.

This place is a real gem. Close to the Old town yet on a quiet road which felt peaceful. Monika's place was not only in a great location, it was clean and felt spacious for two people, highly recommend. Monika is also a great host and communicated effectively.

Geweldig en ruim appartement in een klassiek en sfeervol gebouw. Fraaie uitzicht over groot veld, lokatie op loopafstand van centrum. veel restaurants vlakbij. Host Daniela reageerde altijd snel en vriendelijk. We komen graag nog een keer terug!
If you want central Old Town and a fantastic host, this is the place for you!

Pros: Large space, walking distance to bars/restaurants/shops, comfy beds, almost everything you need.
Cons: The noise, this building is attached to ‘The Caves’ a private venue that hosts events, we were kept up until 3am one night due to the noise/bass from the music - I recommend checking the event lists online before you book.
When an event isn’t on, it is quiet and a nice place to stay.
Lovely place likes home. All daily  amenities are provided. Eddie is very friendly and prompt reply.
Great apartment in Edinburg !

Lo mejor que tiene el alojamiento es la ubicación. A partir de ahí ya es un poco decepcionante.
La limpieza de las habitaciones y el baño deja mucho que desear con pelos y manchas en sábanas y almohadas. El baño bastante sucio a parte de que se atasca a la mínima.
Si quieres comer en el apartamento es bastante incómodo. Si no vas a pasar mucho tiempo en él calidad precio no está mal. Las camas y el sofa son cómodos.
La comunicación com Taimur es buena

This host is very responsive and helpful; you'll get all the info you need ASAP. The unit is in a superb location; very close to "Everything Edinburgh" you can think off. Two blocks away from a Hop On-Hop Off stop (John Knox House), one block away from the lower end of The Royal Mile, and 2 blocks away from a NCP Parking lot to dump your car for the weekend. It is on a 3rd floor with no elevator thou, so expect a little bit of work when you arrive if you carry big suitcases, but not too bad. Check in was amazingly easy.  The unit was clean and tidy with the very basic essentials you'll need for a couple of days.

Isla is a wonderful host! The apartment was very large and fit our needs perfectly. I think the listing describes it as having a washer/dryer in the building (which i assumed meant it is shared by all the tenants in the building) but it actually has it’s own washer/dryer inside the apartment, which is a nice amenity. Beds we’re comfortable and satisfactory. Overall the apartment was very clean and equipped with all the linens and furnishings for a lengthy stay.
The apartment is two stories with varying sized rooms and bed arrangements to meet any need.
The location is perfect! Walked everywhere. Closed my move goal rings three times over everyday we were there LoL.
It was my first time Edinburgh and the people were very kind and welcoming. We had a great time.

We really enjoyed staying with Minh, it was within walking distance from the centre so we didn’t have to get public transport and she was really kind and helpful with our luggage and parking when we arrived.

As soon as we got in, we were blown away by how beautiful the flat is. It has lots of charm and is very grand but with a lovely warm bohemian feel. I would mention that we did find it hard to sleep the first night as the main door to the building didn't properly close and the latch to the flat wasn't working. There was also the sound of trickling water throughout the whole night, but Stephen was great at replying to me about the above query and it seems like the main door is getting fixed. The cleanliness wasn't the best, and I imagine for some, it could really dampen their experience. However, if you love just chilling and listening to great vinyl collections in a beautiful light space - this is the place for you!

This super-central Old Town flat is a terrific base for Edinburgh, especially when visiting for the Fringe.
The flat itself is feels safe and comfortable.
Like make of the flats in this buildings, the ceilings are very high, so it feels light and airy.
When we arrived it was clean and uncluttered. The kitchen is fully functional and you have everything you need. There are also some basics to get you going. The kitchen and living room are combined and efficiently laid out. There is also a toilet downstairs.
Upstairs is a nicely sized bedroom with a comfortable bed and a chest of drawers. The combined toilet & shower room is narrow but totally functional. The shower stall itself is small, with plenty of hot water but at low pressure.
The flat faces the street, so there is some noise at night and morning, but less than might be expected given the location - it didn’t bother us.
Chris was very communicative and helpful, and we’d recommend his flat for a great stay!

Rebecca responded to messages very quickly with all the information need to gain entry and for local information - shops, time to walk to places, local recommended restaurants.

Comely Bank was a great area to stay. It's walking distance to the city centre, a big park and great local shops and restaurant.

The flat was quiet and clean. Not huge, but big enough for four.
you can go to the main must dos in Edinburgh on foot from there. and if not, there are plenty of buses nearby

A real Gem in the heart of Edinburgh! Manigeh was a wonderful host with an Airbnb experience that raised standards. everything was clean, organised and as advertised. Manigeh was super responsive, friendly and helpful. I can 100% recommend staying here for any amount of time. also Location is perfect, it took me 20 minutes to walk to my office near Waverly Gate.

Even tough Anne was on a wedding her friend was very welcoming and showed us around.
The animals were no problem at all as they always stayed in the same room.
So all in all everything was great.
Lovely apartment- wonderful character, bright, clean. the street is quiet and the little park across is beautiful. Only a short walk to Princes street. Great place!

Silke has a beautiful flat in a great location. The room is really lovely and the view onto the Meadows just fantastic. The bed is very comfortable. Silke was very nice and uncomplicated and I would definitely come back and stay here!

Cute spot in an excellent location. Heather was very responsive and helpful! Charming touches and a nice kitchen. It was nice and quiet even though it's near so much! Only small thing to note is that the bed is a bit firm - but that seems to be common in the UK (Canadians here!). We enjoyed our stay and would recommend!

Loved staying in Joannes apartment! I was here solo for a few days for a conference, so Carole picked me up from the airport which was great after such a long flight. Apartment is super central, walking distance into town, and close to a nice street with lots of lovely restaurants and bars. Would definitely recommend this apartment!
Thanks guys :)
Lovely room, amazing location & great amenities. Would throughly recommend.

it was a delight staying at Clare's. she is very warm and helpful. the house is located very close to the bus stop and it is an easy commute to the center. the place itself has all  the essential shops. you can expect a very homely stay at Clare's. Thank you for hosting us:)

Very nice stay, all the stuff mentioned in the bio and amenities listed were true, a bit far from the bus stops 15 mins walk to each bus stop and at night the area looked a bit dodgy and quiet but a very beautiful home with nice kitchen
Sehr sympathischer humorvoller Gastgeber. Hat richtig Spaß gemacht
Lovely accommodation in a quiet suburb of Edinburgh. City centre is easily accessible with the bus. Mairi went out of her way to accommodate me.

Carlos's place was great. Very spacious and well stocked with everything you will need to enjoy your stay -- towels, washer, fully stocked kitchen, tv, towel warmers in the bathrooms. It was a little cold when we arrived (December 25th) but Carlos was so helpful in warming it up! He even sent over one of his friends to help.  Carlos is an extremely responsive host and the location is stellar and within walking distance to most everything (Edinburgh Castle, Victoria Street, Holyrood Palace, New Town, Princes Street, etc.).  Some other guests commented on the noise from the street, and while there was definitely a lot of foot traffic given the time of the year, it was not disruptive.   Overall, my guest and I had a great and comfortable time at Carlos's place and would definitely stay there again.
It’s a great place to stay, the room was clean and the area is nice

Fantastic place to stay, in a beautiful city! We loved the location, with lots of cafes and restaurants on our doorstep! With the city centre in walking distance it’s a great place to stay! Photos and accommodation descriptions are accurate and the flat is decorated stylishly with very responsive and accommodating hosts!
We loved this flat. So well located and super comfortable. Had everything we needed.  We would definitely stay here again. Thank you!

Denise’s place was centrally located and very close to all the attractions, however the place was not clean. We found finger nail clippings in one of the bedrooms, the carpet had stains, and the bedsheets were also stained. The room advertises as having 2 king beds, but they are really queen sized beds. The amenities were lacking;  no paper towels in the kitchen, and only two rolls of toilet paper for 5 guests staying 3 nights and no extra linens or towels. The owners are very insistent on no loud noises after 10pm (even installing noise monitoring devices in the living room) but doesn’t take into account that the neighborhood and the neighbors are incredibly noisy, and the apartment is right next to a busy road.
Best Airbnb I have stayed at! Beautiful apartment with amazing views. Calim was very responsive and friendly, we plan on staying here again on our next Scotland trip!
Great place, very spacious and ideally placed for the city centre
Excellent séjour avec un très bon accueil, emplacement proche du centre et pratique. Margaret est discrète et disponible s'il le faut, c'était vraiment très agréable.

Es un lugar fantástico a unos 10 mn caminando al centro , en una zona muy tranquila . Es una residencia de estudiantes , con unas instalaciones de lujo, que en época no escolar alquilan a viajeros . Hay recepción 24 h, son muy amables y tienen desayuno

위치가 정말 좋아요. 왠만한데는 걸어서 다닐수 있었어요. 3층이라 케리어들고 계단 올라가기는 힘들었는데 집에서 보는 경치가 너무 좋아요. 에든버러 주요거리를 창문을 통해 볼수있고 햇빛도 잘 들었어요.
집도 깔끔하고 잘 갖쳐저 있고 슈퍼가 가까워서 사먹는게 지칠때 고기 야채 과일 등을 사서 집에서 해먹었어요.
여기는 정말 추천하고 싶어요. 후회하지 않을거예요.

Good value for money.
The apartment is better than in the photos and location is the best.

Had a lovely two night stay here, the flat is decorated with some lovely art and it was a nice place to go relax at the end of a long day exploring the town. Location was good, took about 20 minutes to get into town by bus and it was nice to be somewhere quiet at the end of the day. The beds were very comfortable and the fire was a nice added bonus! I think one thing to improve on would be to add some chest of drawers in the bedrooms to make it easier to store clothes and I felt as though the place could benefit from a thorough clean but it was nothing major. Overall a great stay and would come back!

nous avons passé deux nuits parfaites chez Laila.
la chambre proposée est spacieuse, très claire et meublée avec goût.
le tout d'une propreté impeccable.
Laila est une hôte disponible, chaleureuse et discrète.
Le quartier est paisible et le centre d'Édimbourg est facilement accessible à pied.
je recommande !

We had a nice time staying at this Airbnb in Edinburgh. The location was good — a 20 minute walk to the Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle. Plenty of shops, cafes, and restaurants nearby. The apartment was quiet and peaceful at night.
The space was clean and well-equipped. We really appreciated thoughtful touches like local guidebooks, tea and coffee.
Our host was friendly and the check-in was smooth.
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Edinburgh.

Loved staying at Danny’s place. The apartment itself is quite a bit larger than it appears in photos. Above all else it is incredibly comfortable. The weather was wet and cold at the time of travel and returning to Danny’s flat at the end of the day really felt like coming home. The flat is warm, well thought through, fully functional.
The flat is also incredibly conveniently located. Close to the royal mile, public transport (walking distance from the airport tram), shopping, restaurants, and multiple tourist attractions. The popular em cartel restaurant is just a few doors down, as well as greyfriars Bobby’s.
Danny and Linda were incredibly attentive and responsive and offered fantastic recommendations for us.
Couldn’t be happier with our stay here!
Excellent value for money.  Everything that you could possibly need was available in the room. Great location, and an ideal base for exploring the city.
Exactly as described, Shilpa & partner very accomodating hosts. All needs catered for. Comfy for a few nights city break, tram line within walk distance about 9 mins. Local shops a mile or so away.
Overall 10/10 experience. Will visit again
We couldn’t walk to the city centre as we had kids and old people but it would be walkable maybe 20-25 min walk!

Great location within walking distance of all attractions, Armando was there to greet us when we arrived. Perfect place to stay for a group of 11 of us. Towels provided, plenty of space and amenities. Thank you!

Studio idéalement situé dans le quartier de Grassmatket en plein coeur de la vieille ville d'Édimbourg.
D'une proprieté irreprochable.
Peu d'équipements (ce qu'il faut pour cuisiner et se faire un petit café/thé) mais largement suffisant pour ceux qui, comme nous, passent la majorité de leur temps à visiter et profiter des merveilles qu'une telle ville possède!
hôte disponible et très professionnel :)
Je recommande sans la moindre hésitation.

We had lovely couple of days in Edinburgh for our mini break and have found Dan and Marta’s flat conveniently located, only 30 min walk to the centre. The apartment has everything we needed, very clean and very comfortable. Decorated tastefully, has very romantic colour lighting around the flat. The bed was comfy, nice shower and it was warm (we visited end of October). Thank you Dan and Marta for creating such a lovely place.
Some food recommendations:
We went for breakfast and dinner in Stockbridge and were very happy with the food and atmosphere. We had dinner at the Raeburn and also at the Bailie Bar. The Bailie Bar is traditionally decorated basement pub serving amazing fish and chips, very atmospheric place - we loved it! For breakfast we went to the Artisan Roast snd also to Two Children Coffee, both very nice.
Bon séjour chez Amanda, appartement bien situé et Propre. Hôte très réactive, communication facile et indications claires. Je recommande. Merci Amanda.
Great location, great hospitality ☺️

Had the best stay here in Edinburgh, the place looks so cool me and my boyfriend loved the decor. The hosts thought of everything you could need even down to seasonings in the cupboards for you to use.
Right close to transport to the city centre and 5 minute walk from Haymarket train station. Lovely area and both hosts were so kind! They even let us leave our stuff in the flat until our train came later on that afternoon.
Would 100% recommend this property!!
logement magnifique et confort,  je recommande.

A gorgeous apartment and perfect size for three adults and two children. Spacious rooms and bedrooms. Well equipped kitchen.
Great shower, too.
Fabulous location, bright rooms and everything spotless.
You need to walk up three flights of stairs so if mobility is an issue then this is not the apartment for you, Ann mentions this clearly in the listing.
The children’s bed was cabin style with a ladder up to it. They loved it. They also loved the window from their bedroom looking into the kitchen.
Check in instructions were very clear and great communication throughout.
On street parking is free at weekends and I was able to find a space about five minutes walk from the flat no problem.
I would definitely return in the future.

Very clean and bright flat.
Sonia was a very responsive and friendly host.
Thomas’s flat was the PERFECT location for us in Edinburgh. It was so close to great restaurants and so many historical sites that we wanted to see.

A great place near the town centre
Lovely fkat lots of space
Very clean well maintained and modern
Everything you need in an apartment
Highky recommend
Good place! Near shops and walkable. Bus stop is around 3minute drive. Very convenient when you want to explore the city. Many restaurants and food stops near the property.

What an amazing location !
Very central and easy to walk everywhere. Your little bolt hole is perfect, one of the best we’ve ever stayed in. We will definitely be back thank you

A great spacious flat very close to town. Lovely parks and the canal just a step away for a pleasant walk in (watch out for bikes at rush-hour). Convenient for food and essentials shopping too. Lovely space with everything you could possibly need!

Situated on the main road into Edinburgh with bus stops right outside so perfect for buses to city centre or the airport. Lovely sized room with lots of extras. The best thing was Carol's amazing hospitality. I was welcomed in like an old friend.

Fantastic stay over New Year. Perfect location in centre of Old Town.
Cosy apartment with all that we needed.
Stairs up to the apartment are a bit tricky with luggage but worth it once inside!
Will definitely be back!

Not only was Patrick’s place immaculate and full of useful amenities, logically and tastefully appointed, but he was extremely easy to communicate with and very kind and hospitable. Highly recommend, especially for easy access to the airport!

an excellent adress
very pleasant stay at's Valerie, she's very friendly and welcoming
the flat is comfortable practical and well located

Nothing but amazing things to say about Mairi and her home. It was the cutest airbnb that was so spacious, with all the amenities you need during your stay. It was very clean and smelled so nice when you walked ins Mairi greeted us when we arrived and she was so warm and welcoming. We were sad to leave but would highly recommend her place for comfort, friendliness and location.
very homely, clean and comfy!!

Super hôte, très disponible et réactif lors de nos questions. John est très gentil. La maison est magnifique et immense. Correspondait bien aux photos, très propre. Quartier calme et à 15min à pied du centre. Je recommande.

Rosie was a fabulous host,very helpful,friendly and attentive.  The place was amazing,had everything we needed inside and at a great location perfect for exploring Edinburgh - we will visit again! Thanks again Rosie!

The lovely host family went out of their way to make me feel welcome and take care of all of my needs from phone charger to tea with honey in the morning and helping me navigate the bus which was very conveniently located.  I slept very well in the cozy, private room and comfortable mattress.  The bathroom was very close by. Note that the bathtub had no shower but it did the job and was a nice chance to relax!
Great stay, fabulous apartment, everything you could need for a long weekend in Edinburgh done in style!

The apartment was great, exactly as described and in the pictures. It is up four flights of stairs - was no problem for me, but some of my visitors found it tough! Also, the Tattoo passes by quite late at night, particularly on a Saturday, so there is quite a lot of street noise then. Overall, I loved the apartment and would gladly stay there again.

Ian est très accueillant et nous a très bien reçu. Les chambres et la salle de bain au top.
Merci à lui pour nous avoir rendu le temps passé à Edimbourg le plus agréable possible.
This is a great little studio in a great location. You are on a major path between the market street and the Castle which is ideal for an Edinburgh stay in my opinion. Shops and restaurants abound.
Great place and right on bus routes

Definitely the flat must stay! Very good location. Stylish design and collection of furniture, books and CDs. Very considerate of host who not only prepared the breakfast in advance but also suggested some wonderful Local restaurants . I wish I could stay longer instead for only one day.

Wonderful flat in the absolute best location. Just down the block from Edinburgh castle on upper bow street, the inside was actually still quiet as the windows faced away from the main street.
Very accommodating and responsive.
Do not book. After confirming the booking, the host was uncontactable and after arriving at the property we could not access it and Airbnb support could not contact the host either.
Comfortable accommodation, great location
Margherita’ s flat was a great place to stay for a short sightseeing visit to Edinburgh. She was very friendly and had some good recommendations for things to do.

Mike's flat was charming and homey, yet modern. Nothing was spared to make us feel comfortable. Close to several fantastic bakeries, restaurants, and shops. We walked everywhere. Mike was very communicative and flexible. We will be back!

Gostei muito da localização, fomos andando para tudo que precisamos.
O apartamento estava muito limpo e cheiroso.
A anfitriã muito gentil, deixou algumas coisinhas para comermos e uns docinhos maravilhosos. 🥰 Deixou também sabonete líquido, shampoo, etc.
A cozinha muito bem equipada, louças, taças, talheres, etc.
Só tive dificuldade na hora de pegar a chave, pois tinham quatro cofres de chave e tentei todos até achar o correto. Não sei se tinha escrito isso em algum lugar, mas nada que atrapalhasse.
Recomendo muito este local.

Fabulous location. Easy to get everywhere. Lots of excellent living space for 3 couples.
Only small issue we had was the heating system was too strong in the upper 2 bedrooms so had to open the windows to overcome the heat. Instruction manual didn't provide any guidance on how to turn off or turn down the heat. In May, this wasn't much of an issue.
The accommodation is in an excellent location, all attractions close by, no need to drive.

The flat was perfect for our party of 4. Ideally located with easy access to the main attractions around Edinburgh. Local shops and restaurants were nearby and the local pub, the Cumberland, very welcoming! Katie and Stuart provided excellent instructions, so checking in and out was particularly smooth. Highly recommended!

If we are to travel to Edinburgh in the future, I would book this exact same spot! Right in the middle of the main roads, beautiful view, and comfy bed. The stairs were a bit of work with luggage but hey, exercise doesn’t hurt 😂
Great location, lovely clean flat, home from home, communication was very prompt and helpful, door was a bit stiff but sorted quickly, would definitely recommend a stay here .

Lovely place to stay. It was described very well, easy to access and good communication.
You can walk to the old town and find lovely cafes and restaurants within 2 minutes.

The AirBnB was a Gem find! It was better than expected - very spacious, squeaky clean, with a bath tub + shower, a fully equipped sizeable kitchen, washer, ironing board, hair dryer... everything u really need. The place is literally just rifht opposite a minimarket - so convenient. Host Philip was responsive. We love the house... it felt just like home! Will surely return...
Really great place to stay and Rachel us very helpful!

The location is a bit outside the city centre but you can get there very easy with public transport.
The room itself is small but got everything you need.
Good place to stay in Edingburgh! quite neighbourhood and 15 minutes from the center bij bus. Appartment for maximum 4 persons. Fully equipped kitchen. Would recommend

My husband, son and I had such a wonderful stay at Emma's place! The location was perfect- very close to everything by foot (and probably tram, but we just walked everywhere) but just around the corner from the action so the street was quiet and we all slept well.
The house itself is a beautiful and comfortable home with high ceilings and lots of light on the first floor and cozy sleeping on the top. I'm a long time Airbnb host and really appreciate when a home is personal and styled for use, which this is, at the same time being very clean and comfortable.
Also- the suggestions that Emma included in the house book were incredibly helpful! We ate at most of the restaurants and had fantastic meals! Highly recommend and look forward to returning soon.
Lovely flat within easy reach of the centre of Edinburgh. Host was very helpful and responsive in replying to queries.

Excellent place to stay for a large group in the centre of the old town. Plenty to see and do and easy links for car, train and tram for the airport. If you need a place for a large group this flat is comfortable and convenient and far better value than multiple hotel rooms. I would stay again next time I bring the whole family to Edinburgh
It is  very quiet and clean place to stay. Angie also has a big beautiful garden. I enjoyed reading books in the garden when it is sunny day. I even met a lovely fox twice in the garden
Easy Check in, nice host and a lovely dog. We only stayed one night and had nothing to complain about.
The flat is lovely and well located. The kitchen is well-appointed and the water pressure is great.

Had a lovely stay!
the place is very clean & in walking distance of the Royal Mile.
Lovely Stay. Very Clean
Beautiful apartment in a really good location. Calum was very friendly and accommodating.
Beautiful Apartement and great communication

Super Ausgangslage mit top Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel. Die Kommunikation mit Nicola war unkompliziert und die Wohnung sehr schön. In der Umgebung gibt es einige kleine Läden und Cafés, die den Aufenthalt noch angenehmer machen.

Amazing location, just a few minutes from museums and other attractions. The flat is warm and cozy, it has everything needed. The bed is soft and comfortable. Both rooms felt smaller than it was shown on pics but it’s not something to complain about. I’m happy with our choice of accommodation.
Well equipped apartment in a quiet area within walking distance to the center. Very convenient for a family of four.
Dylan ist ein super Gastgeber der für gute Gespräche stehts zu haben ist. Das Gästebett ist für zwei Personen recht kuschelig. Es waren gute Übernachtungen und wir können Dylan gut weiterempfehlen.
5/5! Outstanding penthouse. Everything you need and excellent location. Will definitely be using again.
Great location for a relaxing time in a  harbor town.

El apartamento está muy bien ubicado, es limpio y cómodo. Las instrucciones para ingresar son difíciles, ya que la llave estaba en una dirección (calle Elm 74) pero el apartamento estaba publicado en airbnb en calle haddington 35 lo que se prestó a confusión. El apartamento está ubicado en la misma puerta donde se recogen las llaves. Ryan tardo una hora aprox en responder cuando solicitamos instrucciones más precisas para llegar.

Really nice apartment with all mod cons in a great location. Would recommend. Only problem was TV channels mostly didn't work due to bad signal so I advise you to bring your laptop/iPad with netflix! Also there was no curtain on the bedroom window but we managed to sleep well anyway - maybe bring an eye mask if you are easily disturbed by light.

Since it was our first visit to Edinburgh we did not have a full appreciation of what staying at the Observatory would be like, and we in turn were treated to a rare and memorable experience.  First - the host company is incredibly proactive and communicative - before, during and after.  They provide lots of instructions which I strongly recommend anyone considering a stay here read thoroughly.  While the property itself is not a challenge to find, access can be trick as the host clearly explains.  We did have a car, which the host provided parking options and discounts for.  If you have a car, I strongly recommend using the drop off instructions for your bags.  Once there, you will not need a car again as everything Edinburgh has to offer is walking distance.  While the property is busy during the day, the gates close to the public at 5PM on weekdays, and you will then be treated to an unbelievable experience high a top the city with unmatched views.  An amazing experience!

Mark was most helpful and his recommendations were spot on. He accommodated our schedule allowing early check-in even attempting to meet us at the station to assist with bags. Location was perfect and central to all the main attractions. I highly recommend this location. Perfect trip, even for a party of 3 that was comprised of 3 generations. Mark won me over the first day when he graciously endured endless stories from my 75 year old father. You won't be sorry staying here.
Good place, location great just few issues with entry to apartment
Stellar location, provided what we needed, reasonable price

Great location and fabulous apartment. Clean and neat. Very responsive host made the arrangements very easy.
There are many restaurants nearby as well.
Definitely a great place to stay if you are a tourist in Edinburgh.

Absolutely loved our weekend here. Great for getting around the city. Bar and restaurants on the street went down well with the hubby.
Great communication with brilliant suggestions and helpful tips before our trip.
Will definitely be staying again and have already recommended to friends and family x
Lovely place to stay - clean, cosy, and very handy for getting into the city centre. Alex was a very accommodating host. Would definitely stay here again!
Haven’t had a chance meeting Margherita in person but her boyfriend Dario is nice and friendly! The bed is comfortable and the area is great! Walking distance to city center.
Great host and great accommodation. Won’t find better value and quality in a central location.

Mike’s place was fantastic, if you’re looking for somewhere close to all the attractions in Edinburgh then we would highly recommend this apartment.
Mike was a fantastic host, really great communication and guidance throughout our stay.

Bella is sweet and kind, not too much conversations in person (as I was busy exploring the city) but she was helpful in the messages and response efficiently. The room is clean and bed is comfy, nothing to be picky about. House is not too far from city, best to take bus 41 but is not that frequent ( I failed to take 41 everyday), can also take 3, 31, 37 from Princes Street and walk 10 mins, safe and quiet area.
Great place!! Lots of room and close to grocery store. Very walkable. Even to Murray field if you are like us.

Our 2-night stay at Julie's cottage in Edinburgh was the highlight of our 2-week holiday in the British Isles. 3 reasons stand out:
(1) The Host: We arrived at 8 am on the Caledonian Sleeper from London and Julie kindly kept our bags till the cottage was available around 3 pm, then dropped them off before we got there. This allowed us to visit a museum and get to know the City a bit. She also communicated flawlessly and consistently leading up to and during our stay.
(2) The Cottage: This is a gem, located in a quiet and private Mews, yet within walking distance of Waverly Station and all the Old and New Town highlights. Plus one can get easily get taxis or Ubers if one is tired of walking.
(3) The Rooms & Upkeep: The bedrooms, living room, kitchen and bathroom are perfect for a small family, and we made the most of it. The place was spotless, and she had kindly left some tea, sugar and oatmeal in the pantry (which we happily used and replenished).
We highly recommend Julie's Cottage!

I recommend this place to anyone wanting to explore Edinburgh, wish I could’ve stayed longer!!!

We recently had the pleasure of staying in this beautiful townhouse during our trip to Edinburgh, and we couldn't have been more delighted with our experience.
The location is simply unbeatable. Tucked away on a quiet street, yet just a stone's throw from the bustling city center, this townhouse offers the perfect blend of tranquility and accessibility. We found ourselves within walking distance of all the major attractions, including the Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle, and countless charming cafes and shops.
The townhouse itself is a gem. It felt like a home away from home. We especially appreciated the thoughtful touches like a welcome basket and a guidebook with local recommendations.
Lou and Claire were exceptional hosts. Their local insights and recommendations added an extra layer to our trip, helping us discover hidden gems that we might have otherwise missed.

The location alone is worth the stay. Well Court is a 19th century architectural gem set in within a UNESCO World Heritage Site at Dean Village. The apartment has all you need, although - with the Water of Leith Walkway quite literally on your doorstep - I can’t imagine anyone would want to spend too much indoors instead of strolling along the path to visit the restaurants and shops of Stockbridge or ambling along the walkway to the National Galleries (Both Modern One and Two are well worth a visit and are a 10-minute walk from the flat). The bedroom is compact yet cosy, and the shower above the bath feels like a tight squeeze and isn’t designed for Hagrid - but in such an historic building it feels like part of the charm. A bowl of fruit (alongside tea, coffee and milk) was provided. Be aware that when you look out of the bedroom or kitchen window, you will invariably see people on guided tours, pointing out the sites and taking photos - and you will feel….well…. a little smug.
