Beautiful space. Great amenities and close to the centre. Only a 15 minute car journey. I did have a problem with the sofa bed as it did not work and we needed to use it. However, the host was responsive, helpful and compensation was given. Great place to stay to explore the beautiful city of Edinburgh :)
A favourite of mine in Edinburgh! Good value for money and I love the pod concept. I've been here a second time and will continue to come back 👌🏻

Le séjour chez Anna et David était tout simplement parfait ! On ressent aisément l'attention et le soin qu'ils ont porté à la création de leur AirBnB.
Anna et David sont très avenants et accueillants. De la réservation à mon départ, la communication et l'organisation ont été très faciles. Ils ont également pris le temps de me conseiller des lieux de visite en fonction de mes centres d'intérêts.
La maison est facile d'accès, propre et très agréable à vivre. Le lit et les oreillers sont très confortables.
Avis aux amateurs de courses à pied, leur maison est à proximité d'un très beau chemin où courrir ! N'hésitez pas à leur demander des conseils d'itinéraires.

Paul's AirBnB is in a good location. The common areas in the apartment building don't look or smell great, but the apartment itself is fine. It could do with some fixing up, but for Edinburgh it is pretty great. Run the kitchen tap for a while before you have a go at drinking it. The living room is quite big - there is a spectacular circular sofa that spins. The bathroom, however, is quite cramped - no space for a toilet roll holder.
The apartment was exactly as described. Great location! Very easy to find it! Alison is a great host. Definitely recommend the place!

Basement flat in owner’s house with separate front door.
Walkable to city centre and safe location.
Heated all the time, plenty of hot water and good quality kitchen appliances.
Wi-Fi good.
Selection of DVDs, books and cards.
Tea, instant coffee, sugar, biscuits , loo roll, soaps and foil/cling film supplied - a pint of milk would have been nice or some long life cartons/milk sticks.
A great little place

Aceptable.
Si vais con dos adolescentes, una de las habitaciones, tiene la cama muy pequeña!
El apartamento es grande, la ubicación esta bien, en bus se puede ir al centro rápido. Pero no hay nada cerca para comprar.
No estaba muy limpio, había ropa sucia dentro de un armario y en un cajón de la cómoda.

Het verblijf was perfect. De locatie was perfect, binnen 10 min was je overal (restaurants, pubs, toeristische attracties, openbaar vervoer etcetera). De kamer was top, erg schoon. We sliepen heerlijk. Je zit midden in de stad, maar hoort dat niet (zelfs niet als het raam open staat). Zeker een aanrader!!

the owner is hospitable
it’s convenient to live in
A really enjoyable experience

Great spot for travelers looking to be right in the thick of things! Very near the train station, castle, Royal Mile, and plenty of other great spots. The alley it's on was pretty noisy at night, but as I was there over the weekend, it was to be expected. Place was clean, comfortable, well well-equipped and Bilal did a great job communicating everything we needed. Would stay again.

We booked with Dan last minute due to unlucky cancellations out of our hands. He responded quickly and everything went smoothly with easy check-in and he delivered detailed information about the accomodation.
Nice with a fully equipment kitchen even though we didn’t use it.
Definitely recommend!

Anne Marie will meet you with the key and show the flat to you. She's very friendly. If you have questions, she's pretty quick to respond.
The flat is great! Everything needed is provided and there's even a universal plug adapter and all soaps and detergents. There's a TV, wifi (though I was unable to connect for a bit one day), and it's a 10 min walk to the royal mile. I'll certainly return!
Casa aconchegante e limpa, mercadinho em frente muito bom ! Philip nos atendeu sempre com agilidade!
Alles perfekt 👌
Everything is provided, from bedroom to kitchen to bathroom. Nice place to stay.

A great Airbnb in Edinburgh! My husband and I stayed here for several days, and Deborah’s place was in the perfect location for easily exploring the city center and other surrounding areas on foot, while also being a fairly quiet and peaceful neighborhood when we wanted to come back and relax in the evening. Deborah was a responsive host, and she gave us very thorough instructions. If you’re looking for a quaint flat with a cozy feel, this place is a great find!

Khawar was a super host, and described his flat perfectly. I found it comfortable and minimal, with all the amenities which were listed.  It worked well for us as we were on personal business and wanted comfort, ease of coming and going, and peaceful surroundings.  The flat is on ground  level, and the blackout blind was appreciated.  The addition of  a shear curtain could be useful for privacy during the day. The mattress was firm and could be supplemented with a mattress pad to enhance comfort. The kitchen was helpful as I have a special diet and could cook meals. My partner and I enjoyed our stay and would be glad to stay at Khawar’s flat again!
Love this place - and exceptional value.
Nice room
Beautiful flat in the heart of Edinburgh’s New Town! The flat is spacious, well equipped and has a lovely view of Calton Hill. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and communication with the host was fab!

Alex is very friendly and the place is very good for friends or couple.the neigborhood seemed safe and quiet.it takes around 15 minutes to reach the city centre.its also easily accessible from the airport by bus

Host: Richard was very helpful, great communication helping us plan our arrival and giving us local knowledge. When we arrived he suggested a few places to visit and had a big stack of leaflets for all the attractions.
Location: Perfect location at the bottom of the Royal Mile.
Flat: Clean and welcoming. 3rd floor if you're adverse to stairs, but the view from the windows made it worthwhile for us.
Thanks Richard, very much enjoyed our stay.
Great location and spacious, comfortable flat. It was actually up two rather narrow flights of stairs instead of one.

Paul apartment located in a superb neighbourhood with the main street just a stone's throw away. Paul was a great host and very prompt in replying to any queries. Moreover,the host is very flexible to check in and check out time. thanks for being a great host, Paul . will certainly recommend to all!

A beautiful flat and only a 15 minute walk to the centre of Edinburgh.
It was so warm and cozy with the heating on, the windows were beautiful and let in loads of natural light. The speaker was also very nice and was great to listen to music and watch the tv in the evenings.
Thanks!

Bobby was very responsive, friendly and accommodating. The flat was spacious and very clean. The couches were so comfy after a long day of walking around the city.
The showers had great water pressure.
The building and garage felt very safe. There is a lift in the building, which was very helpful for my mother.
Boby gave us very clear and helpful instructions around bus travel and although the bus-stop right outside was not in use during our stay, there was one just 4 minutes' walk down the road.
The buses were very easy to use and I downloaded the app that Bobby recommended.
We had a lovely couple of nights in Edinburgh for the Christmas experience and I would definitely recommend this flat and would use it again in the future.
We had a brilliant stay with Sonia and Chris, the apartment was as described. It has a lovely homely feel and was perfect for what we needed.
Lovely host, explained the apartment location and parking perfectly. The location is incredible and amenities great, exactly what we were looking for.
Amazing flat !Great location.Stuart have a great communication and helpful person.Highly recommended🤗
Flat was very well located in the new town. Appreciated the tips of where to eat, drink and things to do. All amenities you could need were in the flat and easy to check in etc.

Very excellent location.
Place itself as described
We had a wonderful time

My friends and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this airbnb. It’s very clean, cozy, and in a very central location to restaurants, shops, and activities. Sean and Sally are also very responsive and kind hosts. I would definitely recommend staying here!

We loved our stay at Taya's! She was friendly & kind and we even could arrive early. Her place was super cozy and spacious. Even though the weather was quite cold and rainy it was warm inside her apartment. The location was perfect too, since the next bus and tram station is reachable within 5 minutes by foot.

The loveliest place to spend our weekend getaway. Great attention to detail, definetly a place with a soul. We appreciated music and book selection as well as fully eqiluipped kitchen. Thank you for having us.
Gabriele's place was perfect for our long weekend in Edinburgh. Away from the city centre but close enough to walk in, beautiful and very clean room.

Nous avons adore notre sejour chez Meera. La localisation etait parfaite pour nous. Access tres facile du centre ville en bus et possibilite de marcher jusqu a la plage de Portobello. Quartier calme et agreable et tres bien deservi par les bus. Le logement etait parfait pour notre sejour.
Amazing location perfect for exploring everything Edinburgh has to offer
Thanks for the hospitality:)
This property is in an excellent location and Daria was a very responsive host. The house was clean and comfortable.
Lovely clean light room no traffic noise. Great location for exploring town, easy to find.
Echoing all the other stellar reviews, this apartment is a hidden gem in the heart of Edinburgh's tourist district. Beautifully decorated and well equipped for a short stay in a homely atmosphere.

Look nice n modern but muck skirting boards, under double bunk,stains on sheets, gunge n dirt in bathroom,old muffin in cupboards, old cheese slice down bed in sitting roo., hair in bathroom. Very noinsy in single room from outside and sitting room. Messaged host before review and no offer of cleaning fee bk or discount when asked.  Small room beeds soundproofing.  Needs a deep clean and paint. Skirting boards scruffy etc and doslesnt help with civid about. So many germs. I did spk host 1st n obviously not bothered

La limpieza insuficiente. La supuesta tercera habitacion sin puerta y muy muy pequeña.
Todos los armarios llenos con ropa y cosas personales del propietario. Absolutamente ningún espacio para dejar tus cosas.
Toby was a great host and very responsive.  The property was clean and comfortable, just as pictured. Thanks for the enjoyable stay!
Absolutely beautiful house, great location and to top it off, Rea was a great host and her communication was brilliant! Definitely be staying here again

Our stay was delightful! The location is the best thing so close to Arthur’s seat, it was a perfect way to start the morning. The apartment was tidy and all the amenities were helpful. A perfect location to access everything in the city center, and a lot of privacy added to make us feel comfortable in a shared bedroom!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this flat on Airbnb, and I have nothing but positive things to say about my experience.
One thing I particularly appreciated about the flat was how clean and well-maintained it was. It was clear that the hosts take pride in their property and go to great lengths to ensure that it is always in top condition.
Aside from the flat itself, the location was also ideal. It was in a quiet and safe neighbourhood, yet close enough to public transport that getting around was a breeze.
Overall, I can't recommend this flat enough.
Spacious apartment for a family of five. Quiet location. Some fixtures and fittings getting a little tired but perfectly serviceable.

Wij hebben dit appartement gehuurd tijdens Oud en Nieuw. Dan liggen de prijzen hoog, maar daar kies je voor en dat is geen probleem. Je mag dan wel enige luxe verwachten en dat is niet het geval. Bij binnenkomst bleek de boiler niet te werken en kwamen dus in een ijskoud huis aan. Gebeld met host Kevin die ons heeft geadviseerd de boiler opnieuw te resetten. Dat werkte enige uren, maar gedurende ons verblijf hebben we de boiler 9x opnieuw opgestart. Contact met de host bracht ons niet verder dan: "ik was vorige week zelf in het huis en toen was alles nog goed". Heel teleurstellend.
De bedden waren enorm slecht. De matrassen zakten door en de veren prikte in je rug. Verder vinden we de woonkamer onpraktisch ingericht. Het plaatsen van 2 extra barkrukken en twee stoelen zou het allemaal wat meer comfortabel maken. Tenslotte zou het keukenmeubilair, meer kledingkasten en een kapstok wat meer gebaseerd moeten zijn op minimaal 4 personen. Conclusie: prijs/ kwaliteit absoluut niet goed.

Sarah's dovecot is the most unique property I have ever had the pleasure of staying at. It is well-located just south of Bruntsfield where excellent shopping and restaurants abound, and is just a short bus ride from the city center. The property itself is incredibly unique and well appointed - Sarah's renovation of the 15th century dovecot was so tastefully done and so beautiful that we just wanted to stay forever. Sarah was also an absolute delight, from her introduction to walking us around her garden and making herself available, and even coming by to say goodbye; I have never had a greater host.
Only word of advice - stay longer than you initially planned for.
Good stay

Nimesh a jeho rodina byli velmi laskaví, přátelští a ochotní. Po celou dobu pobytu jsme se cítily jako doma. Ubytování je velmi útulné a čisté, tak jako na fotkách. Nimesh skvěle komunikuje a na zprávy odpovídá opravdu rychle. Při příští návštěvě Edinburghu se zde rády ubytujeme znovu.

Place was clean, tidy and inviting. For the price, I would expect an iron and at least a television. Was a bit disappointed to find a tv unit with no tv on it. But none the less, good location, clean and tidy apartment.
Lovely apartment in a central location. Close to transportation and walkable to local attractions and restaurants. Home is clean, well appointed and safe.
Sheryl is a very helpful host, she allowed me to have flexible check in and check out times. The location is quite convenient for both the station and the city center.

This is a lovely flat, really well located for the old town amenities and close enough for a walk up Arthur’s Seat before breakfast!
We felt very comfortable here. The flat is clean and light with a beautiful garden outside.
Very nice appartement, located right next to the bus stop
Had a lovely and comfortable experience. Great location and near some amazing local spots!
很舒服的小窩 交通非常方便

We had a good time at Ds place. The flat was a bit smaller then expected and there is one couch in the kitchen, which can be used as a bet if you are more then 6 people. Everything was clean and working. Check-in and check-out was very easy and communication worked well (almost instant replies).
Thanks for having us and allowing us to have a nice time in Edinburgh.

Beautiful place in Edinburgh! Right near the heart of city centre but far enough that you don't have to deal with the constant buzz of people. Ollie was great with upkeep and communication. Highly recommend this beautiful listing!
Spacious, lovely light filled suite. So good to be up above the traffic noise.

Grace was a wonderful host. Her apartment is cute, clean and the location is amazing. We had dinner, at a fantastic Malaysian restaurant, just steps from our front door. Also,  it was an easy walk to the city center.

Perfect location off Old Town's Royal Mile. 2 minute walk to Royal Mile and 5 minute walk to Holyrood Palace.  Apartment was modern, quiet and very clean...had everything we needed.   Parking included!
Appartement très confortable, calme,  et parfaitement bien situé.

Klein, maar fijn. Alles wat je nodig hebt. Een hele goede uitvalsbasis naar het centrum van Edinburgh. op loopafstand.
Heerlijke bedden.
Vriendelijke en pro actieve host
Wonderful for the six of us. Clean and well appointed. Highly recommend this place.
Great address : spacious, confortable, and very well located at walking distance from the Old Town. The direct neighbourhood is quiet and offers all you need for food & restaurant.

We had a lovely stay and the house was perfect – spotlessly clean and so well equipped with everything we needed. We really enjoyed our time there and would definitely book again in the future. We’ll also be recommending it to our friends and family. Thank you again for a wonderful stay! 😊
Such a great place to stay. I felt very welcome, and the breakfast is really good. Super easy to go to the center, great location. I really recommend staying here to everybody!
Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit in der Wohnung. Es wurde an alles gedacht, sogar frische Blumen gab es für uns. Ich empfehle die Wohnung auf jeden Fall weiter!

Calum's apartment is very nice and in a great location, close to the centre but also away from the Old Town so that the locality has a good 'everyday' feel to it. There are plenty of coffee shops, restaurants and other shops very close by and Princess street is a short easy walk away. Calum is a good, friendly communicator who will quickly respond  if required. I can heartily recommend the apartment
Der Aufenthalt bei Mary hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Sie ist sehr herzlich und hat viele hilfreiche Tipps. Wir würden jederzeit wieder bei ihr übernachten.

This is a really lovely property for 4 (and 6 at a push) wanting proximity to Edinburgh town centre and key sights, but with the peace of a residential area.
It’s beautifully decorated, compact but yet spacious. The lounge is delightful with big sofa and wood burning fire. Kitchen is well equipped and the beds were super comfy.
We’re really impressed and will definitely book again in the future.
We also got a nice check in message from Anna part way through the stay, checking that everything was ok.

The room is very big, much bigger than I expected, also it's clean, and smells good. The bed is really really comfortable. The hosts are easy to communicate with. Recommended to anyone who find a place to stay in Edinburgh!

Denise is a responsive host. We had an pleasant 4 night stay at her place. This is a 3 level apartment with one bedroom with a bathroom at the basement level, one bedroom at ground level and one at the loft which can be claustrophobic for some guests.
Guests with huge luggage might find the narrow staircase cumbersome.

This is a very pretty little flat in a beautiful and well-connected location. Everything works: good shower, excellent wifi, modern hob.
Beautiful walks along Water of Leith, and Botanical Gardens / Gallery of Modern Art nearby. Handy Sainsbury’s / chemist 5 mins away as well as good variety of restaurants.
Would definitely go back.
华人的住宿，沟通很愉快！帮我们洗衣服和晾衣服

We enjoyed staying at Helen's flat. it was warm and very clean and in a great location as well. We struggled a bit with entering the entrance door to the flats. The lock was not working - it took us some time to unlock and enter but overall loved our stay there. Leith is I'm a great location and it's about 20 mins to get in the city centre. Thank you.
Great air bnb!! Beautiful view of the castle, great walking distance to tourist attractions, and the place it’s self felt very safe and clean.
This is a lovely and stylish apartment in the Edinburgh New Town that was great for a family half term break

We visited Edinburgh for the weekend to celebrate our birthdays and shared Lynne’s apartment amongst five of us. Lynne was extremely accommodating as we arrived slightly later than originally planned. The accommodation was second to none, beautifully clean and well stocked with all essentials we could have wished for. We were extremely central with easy access to tourist attractions, bars and restaurants. A great recommendation for food would be The Outsider, however booking a table is essential at busy periods. Thank you Lynne for a wonderful weekend, we would love to stay again!
Very clean space, very easy to get to via bus, drive etc. very nice, helpful and hospitable host
Very comfy and well-equipped in a quiet charming neighborhood. Would book again!

Just a great experience all round,the flat is in a great spot with private parking and a veiw of Carlton hill, I met Tom at the flat to collect the keys and he gave me the conducted tour complete with all the essentials you need you move in without the need for a big shop, the flat was light and airy with super fast wifi, a great base to explore Edinburgh without the hassle of being in town,
Tom works hard to make you feel at home and the flat is immaculate .

Loved Daljit’s place. Met Daljit and his wife upon arrival as they were returning home. Very nice couple. The home was sparkling clean. The bed was comfortable. Everything we needed was provided for including extra coffee. The house is close to the bus stop so an easy ride into the center of Edinburgh. Many restaurants are within walking distance to the house. I highly recommend Daljit’s place!

Eine tolle Unterkunft in Edinburgh!
Die Kommunikation zur Buchung der Unterkunft war sehr freundlich und ohne Zeitverzögerung. In der Wohnung angekommen, wurde ich sofort von Dave in Empfang genommen. Vielen Dank für die schöne Zeit an Dave und Tokes.

aga and her family are sooo sweet! They provided us with a lot! The house is pretty good, cozy, warm with comfortable bedroom. The design and decorations are goooood! I love it so much. It’s like a dream home to stay. Their pets are cuteeeeee!
The apartment is beautifully kept and well equipped! It’s an ideal location, ~15 minutes from the centre of the old town and there is a stunning view of Arthur’s seat from the living room!
Mattia was very friendly and answered any questions quickly. The place was clean and had a lot of information about local activities and how to take transit to different areas.

Bright,  large flat, good amenities,  good location. The flat itself is on a main road so the front bedroom does get noisy.  The stairs up to the flat might be quite hard work for less fit people. There was also a smell of smoke in the flat which was a shame, which other peoplehave noted.
Perfect location and the space is exceptional! We parked the car and walked everywhere, definitely want to return. Thank you for being a wonderful host.

I had a wonderful stay! The room was spacious and the bed comfortable. It was a nice walk to all of the places I wanted to visit. The coffee was even good. I look forward to returning one day and definitely recommend this Air B&B.
Great place and location. Would def go back

The eagles nest is the top floor of a tenement the building felt safe and secure and was brightly lit the apartment was well furnished and the building peaceful. Apartment was clean and comfortable and cozy. Well served by buses and easy to get into the centre of the city. The Sicilian bakery around the corner was superb.

We had a great stay at Katie’s flat. The location was just perfect for us. The flat was super cosy on the chilly January evenings, and the personal touches left by Katie were just perfect. Thanks a lot!
Amazing. perfect location, immaculate apartment ,super clean.....just wish this was my home.
excellent condition,  surrounding area and communal entrance could put you off, don't let it. everyone was lovely test we bumped into Nd that wasn't many. excellent links into the city via the tram.

L’ Appartement (2 chambres, 1 salon, 1 cuisine, 1 salle d’eau) est très bien situé et équipé. La literie est très confortable. Gary est très réactif aux questions et arrangeant.
Avec un pub au bout de la rue, un théâtre et un bbq coréen à l’autre bout de la rue, dans un quartier commerçant et à proximité de la vieille ville, la situation est idéale.
Nous y avons passé 2 nuits et nous y reviendrons.

Die Aufenthalt bei Jake war perfekt! Seine Empfehlungen für Restaurants ersparte uns die ewige Suche und auch die Kommunikation war einfach super! Einfach zu empfehlen 👍🏼

If this isn't an issue for you then the space is perfect, I would definitely stay here again!
Well located place, although ceiling will be low for tall people.

Place is very convenient and accessible to the key attractions as well as plenty of restaurants nearby, making it an excellent choice to stay for a trip to Edinburgh. Danny is also friendly and very responsive in reaching out and providing help to us.
Comfortable, spacious and really well located apartment. Perfect for family (we were 8 people - 2 families), exactly as it is described. Rebecca is a “superhost”! Many thanks.
Tom was a great host and gave lots of amazing recommendations. The flat itself was beautiful and perfect for the two of us. It was close enough to walk everywhere and we had a great stay.

mitch and mairi provided us a lovely weekend in their cabin! it was a very nice retreat

Super appartement, contact avec l'hôte excellent, boite à clef pour une entrée indépendante.
Situation en plein centre-ville, à prendre en compte si c'est le repos que vous recherchez: bruyant la nuit jusqu'à ce que la boîte de nuit en face de l'appartement ferme (3h du matin).

Apartamentul este situat la 5 minute de o statie de autobuz care duce exact in centrul orasului. Apartamentul a fost curat. Camera noastra a fost curata, la fel si baie.

Avendo soggiornato in due coppie di amici il bagno condiviso non é stato un problema.
Consiglio vivamente.

We really enjoyed our stay at Altido, so much so that we cancelled our hotel for Edinburgh next week and opted to stay here again. The staff were fantastic especially Kieran who helped us settle in and gave us a very good tour.
The room was clean and tidy. The common area is great place to unwind after a very long day. Highly recommended for friends and young couples. We look forward to staying here again.

lovely flat, exactly as it is described. Check in stress free Matt was very friendly and helpful .The flat was warm, clean and very comfortable.
Thank you

One of the best AirBnb's I've stayed in. Room is great, and spacious. Sally herself is extremely friendly/personable. She even let us drop our bags off early, which was much appreciated.
Thanks again!

Wonderfully located little nicely designed flat. Great coffee next door.
Walkable from the train station

Parken muss man jedoch im Wohngebiet.
Hat alles super geklappt, 5 Sterne, wir kommen wieder.
Nicolas is the perfect host! very helpful and flexible. I definitely suggest to stay at his Place.

A perfect place to stay in Edinburgh. Very decent flat inside the New Town with a very close walkable distance to the train station and Old Town. Good reception service to make your stay easy and comfortable.

Great communication by hosts, lovey clean apartment just 20min walk from the center.
Very nicely decorated.

The flat itself is beautiful - nice open concept with high ceilings, comfortable bed and couch, incredibly soft linens and towels, heated bathroom floor and towel rack, easily managed temperature, and nice laundry and dishwasher.  Martin went above and beyond to make sure our visit to Edinburgh was special.  He allowed us to check-in early and met us upon our arrival.  He carefully showed us around the apartment.  He then kindly sat down with us, with a map of Edinburgh, and explained the area with wonderful suggestions, including good vegetarian options to accommodate our diet.  He provided lots of food for us for breakfast which made a huge difference for us.  When I sent him a text asking for a couple of extra blankets for the following night because I was going to make the hubby sleep on the couch (because we are used to a king size bed at home) Martin came right over and showed us how to open the sleeper couch (super comfortable by the way).  He even made recommendations on which side of the train we should sit on during our trip up from London to best enjoy the views.  He truly went above and beyond.

This is a dormitory and deserves three stars. It's surrounded by dormitories. It's a fine, clean place for students coming to the university or to the Fringe Festival, which is around the corner. But for any other kind of tourist to Edinburgh it will be a disappointment and the ratings on this listing need to be corrected. So I will be giving it one star to correct what I believe are some fake reviews. All these five star reviews and high ratings led me to believe this would be a place with charm, comfort, something setting it apart. It is not.
The flat: The sink is plastic. You can't get warm water, just hot or cold. The entry is a dark, cement tunnel. The double bedroom was uncomfortable with no room for luggage. Despite what remains in uncorrected glowing reviews, there is no dryer. The washer works, but locks up for a bit at the end of a cycle. The apartment is very humid so your clothes won't dry and the linens feel damp. The iron has a cord that has been mangled, so it goes off and on. The towels are flimsy. There is only one dish towel and no paper towels, so don't spill anything. I had to buy detergent for the washer. The coffee press was filthy--I had to take it apart and scrub it. The shower is a bit moldy and the curtain is ready to fall down. It is not worth this price. Most things are of the cheapest quality--if you are a student and you get blamed for being too careless with the property (see communication), keep this in mind.
The location: It's fine. It's not too long a walk to the Royal Mile or the castle, but it's not as amazing as the reviews imply.
The communication: The communication was clumsy. One of the first messages to me started off with a warning to be quiet, just like most hotels do, right? I'm a 50-year-old mother, not a college student. Then, I never conversed with "Anabel," the "verified" host. All her messages were signed by two other women. When we had an issue with the washer, I had to say four different ways, please give us some privacy to get dressed before coming over to fix it.
I hope Airbnb pays attention to this review. We just finished a 16-day tour of the UK and stayed in four hotels and two Airbnbs. Three of the four hotels were wonderful, and this includes the one by the airport where we had to be put up when our flight home was canceled. As tired and cranky as we were about our flight being canceled, we all remarked that the cheaper hotel British Airways sprang for was more comfortable than our Edinburgh Airbnb. The other Airbnb we stayed in was divine--and cheaper! The one hotel we didn't like will not be getting a poor review because we met the hostess, who communicated with us clearly, and was lovely. She didn't oversell her property. But this Airbnb is going to get the only negative review from this trip because I feel misled and disappointed. Don't inflate your reviews and ratings. I wish I had stayed in a hotel.

Problème d'écoulement de la bonde de la douche : sol de la salle de bain était systématiquement inondé.
Pas de possibilité de relogement ailleurs par notre hôte.
De plus la fermeture de la fenêtre de la chambre avait été modifiée pour l'accès à une personne en fauteuil roulant : la fenêtre n'étant plus étanche, on entendait tous les bruits nocturnes dans la rue principale !
Lovely garden flat which exactly met our needs
Lovely apartments, great location. Perfect for city stay.
Beautiful apartment in a great location..  Third floor walkup with good views

Fabulous flat in ideal location. Comfortable, well-designed, well-located base to have a look round Edinburgh from.  Great to be in Stockbridge and be able to walk into centre/Old Town and also explore local area. Fleur was helpful, attentive and the whole process was easy, relaxed and enjoyable.
A cozy apartment at the perfect location! Had a lovely stay, and the communication with Gemma was great.
The flat was absolutely lovely, clean and easy to navigate. Nice walkable area, close to many nice restaurants.
The flat was extremely comfortable, clean and cozy! It was by far the best flat we stayed in during our trip!
Great place, great location, and great host.

Thomas and Aurélie were incredibly responsive and proactive with their messages. The instructions for gaining access to the apartment were very detailed and difficult to mess up. The apartment itself was perfect for my wife and I. We had been in Edinburgh for a few days already for a wedding, so it was nice to be able to make a meal in their kitchen that had all the pots and pans that we required. The view from the bedrooms and the balcony were incredible. The bathrooms had plenty of hot water for our cold visit (we're from Florida, so anywhere in October is cold for us). We had been staying at a hotel on Prince's Street before this, so it was nice to still be in the city, but not a tourist trap right when you walk out the front door. Parking was included, which was a big plus for us, as we like to do our exploring by car. When we inevitably make it back to Edinburgh in the future, we would love to stay longer than just three nights at this beautiful spot!
Great location!  Great communication.  Washer was a life saver!  Bed was very comfy!
The flat was very clean and comfortable for 4 adults and 2 kids. The tram stop was just round the corner for easy access to the city centre.
Great location that’s local and perfect for a first timer

여러 에어비앤비 중에서도 좋은 선택이었던 것 같습니다.
머무는 동안 세심하게 배려해주셔서 제 집처럼 편안하게 안정적으로 지냈습니다.
깨끗하고 코지한 룸 컨디션과 깔끔한 화장실, 주방과 거실까지 부족함이 없었습니다.
도심과 거리도 멀지 않고 오히려 아침 저녁으로 바로 옆 공원을 산책하거나 여유로운 동네를 즐길 수 있는 점도 좋았어요.
라디에이터나 여러 요청들도 빠르게 응해주시고, 가볼만한 곳들 목록도 공유주셔서 참고해서 재미있게 다녔습니다.
에든버러에 다시 오게 된다면 다시 인사드리고 싶은 곳이 되었어요.

Second time staying at Calims place and it was just as lovley as the first time. When I'm in Edinburgh this is my preferred place to stay - when I'm lucky enough to find a vacancy. Recommend to anyone

Patrick goes above and beyond what is expected of a host. He prepares a breakfast and sits down to chat while you eat, gives amazing and thorough tips on what to do/where to eat, and lavishes the room with amenities (tea, coffee, biscuits, mini fridge). By far the best Airbnb I have visited.

perfectly situated in beautiful grounds. house is immaculate, homely with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Communication is clear, prompt and all instructions are easily understandable. the house is perfectly situated for public transport, lots of shops and beautiful walks. I would definately recommend this house. the price is fantastic for the beautiful home.
It was a great stay at Sevi's apartment. Everything was very clean and we could definately go back. The room was just as we expected it and Sevi was a great hostess. Very welcoming and helpful!
Great stay here, definitely would recommend!
周边很适合散步逛街，非常好的选择

The location was great. As soon as we entered the house, the calming and refreshing aroma changed the whole mood. The house was neat and clean which was a bonus. Me and my partner enjoyed and loved the stay. Thanks to Melissa and her husband for making it a memorable experience for us.

How can I start to describe how nice this place is when it really took my breath away…?

What you first notice is the surrounding areas when you come close to the house. A beautiful forest in the background, sounds of birds and a river running just below, all this absolute silence, away from city noises.

Once you come in it feels really as if it entering a relative’s or good friend’s home. Everything is very welcoming.

The big finale is the room. Incredibly cosy and when you rest you head on the pillow the only sound you hear is the river flowing in the background. It gives an incredible sensation!

The owners of the house are incredibly friendly and easy going. Keeping the sensation of feeling at home and comfortable.

I would without a doubt recommend the place to anyone! Amazing and unique.
Host simpaticissimi e super accoglienti. Un meraviglioso cottage pulitissimo vicino all’aeroporto di Edimburgo. Bellissimo :)
Nell’s place is perfectly located in the middle of beautiful 19th century New  Town. It is a lovely townhouse apartment and the room was light and clean. I would highly recommend it!
Carl is a very nice host, he cares for his guests and is really friendly. The appartement is just wonderful, really big but cozy at the same time. Thanks for everything!

Really nice stay at Lindsay’s. Apartment was quiet, it’s on a bus route but a short walk to leith walk and there are more bus options. Place was really quiet and had everything you need. I  was there for a short stay (2 nights) which made me consider, with the £60 cleaning fee, whether it is better suited to longer stays. Having said that I’d happily stay again. Communication was quick with her Houst team and instructions easy to follow

The apartment at the guest house was perfect for a weekend in Edinburgh! The room was extremely clean and cozy. David gave clear instructions for self-check in and everything went smoothly. He even provided a wonderful list of local recommendations (restaurants, shops, sights) which was incredibly helpful! I really enjoyed the apartment and David's hospitality. I would definitely recommend and stay again!
Fantastic apartment, well furnished and extremely clean. Had no need to contact the hosts. Easy to access building by following the instructions provided. Look forward to visiting again. Thanks!
Too bad we could only stay for one night, but unit was comfortable and spacious and perfectly fit our needs. Jonathan was very friendly and accommodating. Hope to get back some day.

Sonia and Chris are warm and friendly hosts.  They are very considerate of the needs of their guests--a detailed map with major attractions marked out and a list of recommendations for food, drink and what to see or do in Edinburgh are waiting for you on the table.  They are also very responsive if you have any questions.  Not only was the flat super clean, we also found the decor very tasteful.  The flat is in a convenient location for transportation and within walking distance for many attractions.  I don't hesitate to recommend Sonia and Chris's place for anyone who visits Edinburgh as a tourist.

the apartment was perfect for our little girls weekend away. great location if you want to be close to the city but away from all the chaos where it's nice and quiet. friendly atmosphere, clean and spacious space which we all found very cosy. would stay again.

Great location with shops and cafes down the street. It’s close to the main town.
Beds were super comfy.
The place is quite outdated and felt a bit like staying in a university sharehouse… the couch was all torn, the carpet had many stains on it and there was a very bad odour that wouldn’t go away even with the windows open.
If you’re a light sleeper I would recommend either finding other accommodation or bringing an eye mask and earbuds. The curtains didn’t keep much of the light out and the floors are extremely creaky as soon as someone steps on them it rings through the apartment. It is also extremely loud from the upstairs neighbours so keep that in mind when booking!
Expect the best service

We thoroughly enjoyed our week at Mary’s lovely house. It was the perfect base for our extended family group to explore Edinburgh while in town for a wedding. The house has everything you might need, is spacious and extremely clean. We loved having the use of the kitchen and the outdoor space to relax in in the evenings. It’s also super handy for the bus into the city. Can definitely recommend!

Very good stay, except Breakfast was adequate but lacked fresh fruit salad and plain yoghurt.
The bed rooms were very hot throughout the night.
Great location to stay. Close to the bus to the center and airport. Ahmet is very nice and i definitely recommend staying at his house. :)

Excellent accommodation with everything we needed to make our stay very enjoyable. The flat was very clean and comfortable and in an excellent location for us to easily walk everywhere we wanted to visit. Excellent host who was very welcoming and communicative. Couldn't recommend highly enough.
Perfect midpoint between prestonfield house and Waverley station, short walk to the meadows, and solid self catering kitchen.

Perfect airbnb experience - all very easy. The room is stylish and welcoming, Michael is a great host, the facilities are pristine.
The neighbourhood is really beautiful with great cafes within easy walk (BeechWood a personal favourite). I walked home late in the evening and it feels a very safe part of town. It’s an easy and enjoyable walk through parks and attractive streets into central Edinburgh. Holy rood park is close by if you want to get out of the city streets. A super location for a city visit.
Overall, no downside at all - I had a very enjoyable stay!

We loved this home in Edinburgh! It's even more beautiful than the photos. The decor is so lovely and keeps in with what I would want for an authentic Edinburgh experience... comfortable, elegant, personal and just all around lovely. A true home away from home. Comfy bed and great size bathroom. The living room was so nice to relax while getting ready to explore Edinburgh. And having access to a washing machine a dryer was so helpful! Walkable like you live just off the busy bustling town of Edinburgh, and yet a charming route to take through Dean Village and other beautiful neighborhoods. Very much recommend. Note the apartment is in a beautiful building on the lower level, but the place gets plenty of natural light and is well heated and cozy. Loved!

Siamo stati nell'appartamento di Pauline per 4 notti, con un bimbo di 3 anni. La casa è fornita di tutto il necessario, anche per cucinare. È pulita, ordinata e organizzata per stare comodi. La zona è tranquilla, e allo stesso tempo ci sono molti autobus per raggiungere il centro. A due passi un supermercato, bar, ristoranti e un'area giochi in cui portare i bambini. Consigliata!

I absolutely loved staying at Lindsey’s flat, it’s A lovely, cozy flat with everything you need! The location is great, there’s a Tesco at the end of the road , and it’s  about 20 mins walk from Prince’s street and the main shopping area.  I highly recommend it!

Superb location and spacious apartment (must bigger than expected) with secure parking and a lovely view of Arthur's seat. You won't be disappointed with this one! Easy to get to all areas of the city.
Everything is good.

We had a lovely stay with plenty of room for us all and our dog. We had a great welcome from Chris with a kind welcome box. The location was also very convenient. We would definitely stay again when we are back in Edinburgh.

Our stay at Maia’s home was lovely! Maia is such a sweet and warm-hearted woman. It was so easy and comfortable to live with her. If you don’t know what to do in Edinburgh, don’t worry because Maia got your back with so much information you can’t even imagine. The location’s also great and the neighborhood was really lovely. Would definitely recommend to stay at Maia’s place.
Thank you for such a nice hospitality and such beautiful memories!☺️

Anfitrión excelente. Siempre atento a los mensajes y respondiendo en la mayor brevedad.
Alojamiento muy limpio y cómodo. Sin duda para repetir.
Cedric responded to messages very fast and polite the place was great . not too far from the tramline and the busses I would definitely stop there again if visiting Edinburgh thanks Cedric
Nice experience wobderful atmosphere

The flat is incredibly nice, well located, super clean and peaceful. Paul is a fabulous host and went above and beyond to make me feel welcome and comfortable. Will be staying here every time i am in Edinburgh!
This place went beyond our expectations, one of the most unique properties you’ll ever find. Felt like we had traveled back in time but with today’s comforts. Highly recommend to stay here.

I had a wonderful stay at this flat in Edinburgh! The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a relaxing visit. The location was ideal—close to shops, cafes, and public transport, making it easy to explore the city. Communication with the host was smooth and friendly, and they were very accommodating throughout my stay. I really appreciated the thoughtful touches and cozy atmosphere. Would absolutely recommend to anyone visiting Edinburgh, and I’d happily stay here again!
Carol was a great host, and was very welcoming and responsive. I felt at home in her place.
Homey lovely place to stay. The greeting card and little snacks were a really appreciated personal touch.
The flat is big, very clean and everything we needed was provided. There is easy and quick connection to the city centre and many supermarkets and restaurants are close. Definitely recommended!
Perfect location for our stay.  Everything worked out perfectly and the extra amenities like earplugs and a toothbrush and toothpaste were very appreciated.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Édimbourg. Le logement est idéalement situé en hyper centre ce qui permet de visiter facilement la ville à pied. Le logement était parfaitement propre et disposait de tout le côté confort nécessaire.
Le logement est également proche de nombreux restaurants. Excellent café en bas de l’appartement.
Merci pour tout.
Nous y reviendrons sans hésitation.
Julie

Gordon è un host preciso e attento. ci ha fornito tutte le indicazioni possibili per arrivare al suo alloggio e denso semplice l'accesso.
la casa era pulita con una cucina ben attrezzata. Purtroppo era un pochino fredda, ma ci si mette una felpa in più e si sta bene.
la posizione è ottima, in 10 minuti neanche sei nel pieno centro di edinburgo.
Great stay, recommend to everyone

Le logement proposé par Kerry est parfait pour visiter Édimbourg. Bien situé dans un quartier paisible, très propre très accueillant.Kerry est une personne charmante à l’écoute de nos attentions.
Tout est extra, je recommande vivement

Die Wohnung hat eine super Lage um die Stadt zu erkunden. Es ist eine großzügige Wohnung mit Liebe gestaltet. Sie enthält alles was man braucht. Eddie war ein sehr hilfsbereiter Gastgeber der immer sofort mit Rat und Tat zur Seite stand.

We loved our stay here! It is 15 minutes by Uber to the city center. The flat is perfect for 3-4 people, was quiet, and comfortable. Kevin was very responsive and made our stay a great experience.
Highly recommend!

This is a lovely place in a great location. I stayed with my friends and we had a great time. The flat itself is beautiful from the inside. The check in process was smooth and communication was clear and quick. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Super sejour dans cette appartement, il est idéalement situé, et tres bien agencé pour quatre car les chambres sont loin l’une de l’autre , dans un quartier tres calme , a 20min a pied du chateau , je vous conseille ce logement

Tamin et David ont été réactif et très arrangeant sur notre arrivée. L’appartement est super, très propre et bien équipé.
L’emplacement est bien l’accès au centre d’Edimbourg se fait facilement en 30 min en bus.
A good clean place with very active hosts willing to provide good service. A welcome place for family stay.

Such a lovely, kind, welcoming family! I really enjoyed my stay. The location is great - a beautiful view from the window, peaceful location and easy bus to town. The bed was comfortable, I slept really well, and I was grateful to be able to do some work from the desk.
I also really enjoyed chatting to Marta when I first arrived, and the list she sent of places to visit in Edinburgh was very helpful!
Amazing place with a lot of special futures and in the middle of everything you want to see.
Lovely quiet, clean accommodation would stay again

This apartment is something special! Spacious and beautifully designed with loads of creative and unusual furnishing details, as well as thoughtful touches like warm blankets in a basket by the sofas for curling up to watch the tv (which is a modern freeview flatscreen smart tv). The beds are comfy and the water runs hot and fast!
A very well fitted out kitchen and huge fridge make it easy to prepare meals there, but the streets surrounding the property are bursting with amazing restaurants, cafes, asian supermarkets, and takeout options too!
Gordon was a kind and thoughtful host with easy and prompt communications and clear instructions.
The Royal Mile is about a 10 min walk away, I was amazed how central we were. I definitely hope to stay in the flat again, it was a wonderful working break! Highly recommended. I miss it already!
Great location and fantastic outstanding views from apartment well worth the four flight of stairs.
The location and price were both amazing! I would absolutely stay here again upon returning to Edinburgh!

I had a wonderful stay at this cozy flat in Edinburgh. The space was charming, comfortable, and felt like a true home away from home. Nell was a remarkable host—thoughtful, friendly, and always quick to help with anything I needed. Her care and attention made my visit even more memorable. I’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city!
Literally the best place in Edinburgh. Super close to city centre with beautiful views from the balcony. Also, the hosts are super helpful and responsive. Would love to stay here again.
Perfect place to visit the city: very central, near museum, nice cafes and pubs. We spend a great week end there!:)

A+++ Castle stay.  Felt  like we were transported back in time. Beautiful details put in to giving it a true castle feel. Very comfortable bed and pillows. Our best night of sleep out of our 3 week travels. Close to the airport and restaurants. We wish we had booked for more days. Dan was an excellent host and communicated very well. Will definitely book again if/when we go back to Scotland.

Such a gorgeous apartment, within a short walk of the Royal Mile great shops, pubs and restaurants. There were 6 of us staying, but there are 2 bathrooms and huge bedrooms plus plenty of seating in the living room. I would definitely recommend! A very friendly and responsive host

The place was exactly what we needed. Very comfortable and clean. The only issue is that the streets get very noisy. Lots of people partying till late and while there are a lot of pubs and restaurants, all of their kitchens close farely early.  So we found ourselves going from place to place just to find dinner.

Å bo på 16 Carlton Terrace var en meget fin opplevelse. Utrolig fin leilighet, det var rent og rikt med fasiliteter. Leiligheten ligger i et vakkert strøk med gåavstand til det meste. Alt i alt gjorde dette at vi hadde en fantastisk opplevelse i Edinburgh, 5/5 stjerner!

Reggie is a super host, her place is 100% recommended.
The room is clean, fully equipped and comfortable, the position is very good to reach the main spots in Edinburgh.
We enjoyed our stay in Edinburgh! The apartment was easy to reach and perfect to explore the city and everything was as promised. We will definitely visit again.

Fantastic stay with an amazing view. The property was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Great communication from the host(Cong), and the scenery made the trip unforgettable. Would definitely recommend!
Great stay, just what you need when you want a comfy base
The location of the place is good and pleasant with surrounding parks .
Lovely stay
Tudo perfeito, excelente!

We loved our stay at Xavi's apartment. The apartment itself was delightful but the location was unbeatable! We felt right at home, walked everywhere from the apartment and loved the local vibe. Looking up at the castle each evening before turning in and opening the door to that sight each morning was simply magic. The cafe across the road was great for breakfast but we were easily able to self-cater with all amenities provided. We would definitely return and would recommend to all.

Steve's place was beautiful, our favorite parts were the gorgeous floor to ceiling window overlooking the garden and the lofted reading nook. The neighborhood was beautiful and quiet, but very accessible to everything. Steve was a great host, happy to leave us to our own devices and equally happy to offer advice and chat. I would definitely stay here again if/when I find myself back in Edinburgh.
Brilliant place to stay and great location in Leith. Easy to get into the centre of Edinburgh by bus.
A very nice stay, close to the city. The host was very nice and helpful with our arrival. Thank you !

Given that Michelle is new to this, this Airbnb is a great example of what can be offered. She's clearly keen to get this right. The property is well-furnished, high quality, clean, and easy to get settled in. The inclusion of free parking and an instruction booklet, along with a 15-20 minute walk to the city proper, make this an incredible option for staying in Edinburgh

little bit far from Edinburgh city. But it's a really pretty town and worth visiting! (very accessible to city so you don't have to worry about it!) David is wonderful host. Clear explanation, quick reply, and clean house! You can use all the kitchen utensil and even laundry! If you want to experience both portobello beach and  the Edinburgh, you have to choose this house.
A great apartment in a fantastic location. Easily walkable to the new town and centre but out of the way enough to be quiet and peaceful. Very comfortable and tastefully decorated.

Lovely place, very clean, great location, great communication. Water pressure dropped twice whilst there and had no hot water, however, sorted very quickly and able to sort myself on the second occasion. Would return!

A perfect stay, great location, Greg’s communication was great, the list of suggested bars etc was great. The apartment was perfect for our needs and was ideal for all the tourist spots of Edinburgh.
A little noise as people walked home after pubs closed but quickly fell silent. It felt very safe and the apartment had everything we needed for our stay. We would recommend highly.
I miss I could stay longer! Susan's house is beautiful and prepared for the guests. Both Susan and her husband are just more than kind. I was lucky that I met them and could stay at theirs.

We had such a lovely stay in this apartment.  Great local restaurants, a weekly outdoor market right outside the door, easy access to the waterway trail for running/walking through the beauty of Edinburgh.  A clean well lighted place with knowledgeable and responsive hosts (thank you Alex!) and a terrific guest binder to help a us plan out our days.   All in all, the perfect home base for our exploration of a beautiful city.

Would get six stars if they could control the weather.
Great place, bus stop across the road for access to Edinburgh city. Great for family, thanks for the coffee.
un apartamento extraordinario, lo recomiendo si se quiere visitar el centro de edimburgo. todo muy cuidado y limpio. gracias!!!

Lovely place to stay in a great location. Felt really homely and had everything we needed. Would recommend checking out their recommendations (found on the tv). Would go back and will tell others about Eden Locke- thanks!

An amazing apartment and location, but maybe take some ear plugs. The flat was in an ideal location meaning we could walk everywhere. It was clean and tidy and a really stylish place. Hosts were very attentive and provided a helpful guide to Edinburgh. We stayed during the week mon-fri and it was very noisy till about midnight from the pub/bars across the road, we were also woken up every night during the early hours of the morning by people outside and taxis as you can hear everything, otherwise we really enjoyed our stay.

Henry’s description and photos were spot on.  The flat was perfect, beds were comfy, good shower. Kitchen was great, big fridge. Everything including the tv was user friendly. Couldn’t have asked for a better location.  Minutes from the downtown core yet quiet in the evening. Restaurants, shops and cafes nearby.  Henry and Jahzmin were quick to respond thankfully because we locked ourselves out upon arrival.  Highly recommend,  I would live here if it was available! Bonus Starbucks is 5 minutes away walking distance!

We truly enjoyed our stay at the flat hosted by Francois and his partners. It was clean, quiet, spacious and in a PERFECT location. We were able to get around easily via the Tram or the Train or just walking, since it was so close to the Royal Mile, our tour meet ups and all the local sights. The host was responsive and flexible,  helping us to prepare for our visit by answering our questions ahead of our trip. We truly enjoyed this flat and its location, it made our trip truly memorable. Thanks to our hosts for a fab weekend at their lovely apartment!!!

Tolle Lage! Ruhige Gegend mit Charme. Das Zentrum ist gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Die Wohnung bietet ausreichend Platz für sechs Personen. Und ist mit Allem ausgestattet, was man so braucht. Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit.
sporco

This is a comfortable, clean and well cared for property in a quiet residential area. It's close to Edinburgh and the Pentlands. We were not tourists. The location was ideal for us to visit our son in a nearby hospital and then latterly at his home.  The well equipped kitchen is upstairs and that took us by surprise as we hadn't read the property details carefully enough or studied the photographs as we usually do.  We are in our 70s and had to take the stairs carefully, especially as there is a corner at the top without a handhold. This would not be an issue for younger more able bodied guests. Communication with Fiona was excellent and helpful. We can recommend this property.

Very responsive hosts. Always kind and helpful. Made sure we could find the place easily and gave very clear, detailed and accurate instructions.
Would recommend 100%.

Nos alojamos mis padre, mi pareja y nuestro hijo de 11 meses en el departamento de Daniela. La verdad que estuvo bastante bien, ya que posee servicios de gran nivel. Las camas de la habitación secundaria y del sofa-cama son algo endebles, pero en general lo volveríamos a tomar. La ubicación queda a unos 15 minutos en bus, por lo que es una buena opción para dejar las cosas e irse a caminar por la hermosa ciudad de Edimburgo.
Lovely roomy apartment in a great area.
Wonderful place and very nice owner

The unit is located right at the center of the city, extremely convenient for a one-night accommodation if you’re short of time in the town. Unfortunately, the windows are not insulated enough to handle the nearby pub activities (as the owner noted), so we have to bear with noises in the late night. On the side note, the bathroom was slightly short of hot water so we had to take turn and wait a while for it to reheat. Other than that everything else is fine and okay!

Vi budde her i 4 netter. Lett å komme seg til sentrum, og stilt og fredelig område.
Gode senger, reint og fint. Leilighet med stor plass.

L’appartamento di per sé è ottimo ed è in una posizione centrale, a due passi dal centro della New Town. L’unica pecca dell’appartamento è stata la presenza di una moquette con delle macchie (non sono un amante e mi dà un senso di sporco ma capisco sia un classico arredo inglese) e la luce del soggiorno non funzionante. Per il resto l’appartamento risulta nel complesso ordinato e molto comodo per un lungo soggiorno anche grazie alla comoda cucina.

The flat was very easy to access local amenities.
It was clean and tidy and had everything you needed.
Perfect for our trip away
Fijn appartement, op loopafstand naar het centrum.

This is my partner and I second time staying at Bens airbnb that’s how wonderful it is! I definitely recommend it staying here if you couldn’t find a better host or place. Hopefully we’ll be back for year 3 :)
Amazing place!

We booked flights for the Edinburgh Fringe in August and wanted somewhere reasonable to stay and easy to get to Edinburgh and the airport.
This place was ideal , on the 200 Airbus from the airport to Edinburgh and the 43 bus route to and from the centre . 5-10 minutes walk from bus stop to house . About 30 min bus ride to centre.
Our place was in the back garden and easy and safe to access . Felt private and room was stylish and immaculate. It had everything we needed including a fridge (milk, orange juice ) coffee machine, wine glasses and some cereals for breakfast.
Bathroom and shower with lovely white towels and toiletries.
The hosts were very helpful and friendly and quick to communicate.
Would definitely recommend.
Thanks

Upon check-in, the bed linens appeared not to have been changed and had a strong sweat odor. This raised cleanliness and health concerns and did not meet Airbnb’s standard for fresh linens between guests.
It was really great: Breakfast, distance to the city centre and also check in by night went smooth. We can really recommend the house.

Very nice and comfortable apartment with everything you need. Good location within easy walking distance to great restaurants, bars, shops, sightseeing and public transportation. Trudi was a great host with regular attentive communication. I would highly recommend as a great place to stay!
Amazing location, extremely comfortable flat with everything you need! Easy to access and find. We had an amazing Edinburgh stay! Thank you Lain!
lugar perfeito!!! banho,cama,conforto,limpeza,perto de tudo, realmente me senti em casa no apartamento da victoria e de brinde vc ganha companhia dos seus lindos gatos
Good location. Near to Supermarket, Restaurants and Transport links into City.   Apartment spacious and clean. Nice to have essentials like teabags and coffee.
Not bad. Bedclothes quality can be improved tho.

This apartment had all the mod cons and more, especially the very large TV, saved taking the kids to the cinema as there was Sky TV and broadband. Paul the host was very polite, helpful, punctual and had good knowledge of the area. I will  recommend this place as it was very clean, spacious and has a hot tub which wad a bonus.
Nice location
