Beautiful flat, great value! Lovely area--very diverse! Not far from the center of town.  Definitely recommend!

The apartment was lovely, just as you see it online. The secure parking was great also. Our host had very thoughtfully placed some milk, tea, coffee and bread for our arrival. Great location. Will definitely stay again!

Great location and easy to find. Adam was very helpful before our stay.
The flat was clean and tidy with everything you’d need. Would definitely stay again.

Yvonne is a very helpful host who responds to messages promptly. Entry instructions are clear but keysafe is not well lit at night. Used phone for light, typed in the number and the unit fell to the floor. Inside we didn't know which light to turn on so we could follow the next instructions re key  (leave behind the front door which, as open, I couldnt see where) and was worried about turning on lights to other guests rooms. A lowlight on in the hall would be good for late arrivals. The Thistle was a great size for three of us. Mum and child in warm and comfy double. Single is warm but needs new mattress - the springs 'sprung' every time I turned over. Very grateful for the 'supplies' in our room -Tunnocks wafer for breakfast. Went to make coffee, unsuccessfully as instructions for the kettle/aga had been ruined by a previous guest and had not yet been replaced, so  unlikely to be an issue for other guests. Good location for the airport to get some kip before onward journey.

El alojamiento fue facil de encontrar y a 20 min del centro en bus. El barrio tranquilo, la casa limpia y la cama muy cómoda, fue como estar en casa. La decoracion de la casa es muy linda también. Las recomendaciones de Pako nos sirvieron mucho y pudimos recorrer varios puntos de su guía. Muy buena comunicación también. En general nos encantó! Volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí
Lovely central location however we could not find the tv remote & felt the price was inflated because of events going on in Edinburgh that weekend.

Cozy flat. Did the job and was well located to the tram line which is helpful. Felt safe and was comfortable. Would benefit from some bigger bath towels? Aside from that I reckon it is a good fit for the location and expectations.
Liz siempre estuvo atenta a respondernos, preocupada por nuestra estadía y siempre fue amable.

We had a wonderful time at the apartment. Slawomir is a very friendly host and made sure that everything was well. He’s very responsive and easy to communicate with. The appartement is located in a quiet and safe neighborhood. There were a lot of restaurants and just a 20 minute walk to the city centre. I would definitely recommend staying at this apartment and would stay again if I visit Edinburgh again.
Elizabeth was an incredibly welcoming host. The area is quite nice and very easy to reach Center by public transport
Great spot and pretty space.  Out of the hubbub of the Festival but not far from the New Town.  Excellent find.

Whilst a bit out of town Leith is a superb area in itself to stay.  The Water of Leith and it’s array of bars & restaurants is incredible in itself.  Whilst we walked the 45 mins into town the tram is only 10 mins away and buses are right opposite.  I got parked for free within moments of the flat which is worth it’s weight in gold in Edinburgh.  The space is great, open plan and sociable with a lovely wee terrace.  Modern and clean but with character.  I’m a Superhost myself, lived in Edin for 15 years and stayed in many Airbnbs.  Not sure I’ll look anywhere else now.
Great apartment - the location is fantastic, check in was easy. The apartment is very spacious & had everything we needed. We had a lovely time in Edinburgh.

My husband and I had a lovely few days at this Georgian flat. It was true to the photos. Very tastefully decorated and plenty of space for 1 to 2 adults. I loved the layout of the place.
There is a lovely Italian deli called Valvona & Crolla near the flat. A gem! Amazing selection of wine, yummy deli stuff, bread, veg and fruit. I basically got all my breakfast supply from this deli and from Sainsbury's (Also very close by).
Location is convenient, as I walked to town centre (Old and New) every day.
Excellent accommodation with a very friendly and helpful host. Great location for travelling around Edinburgh.

Colin is a great host. Very thoughtful by having some basics already in the flat.
For future guests, I definitely recommend staying here, but I don’t recommend using a hire car. The parking regulations are quite restrictive. Just use cabs or Uber.
good place in the middle of Edinburgh, perfect if you want to visit various places with walking distance

As we arrived very late, we couldn't meet Aileen herself but we were welcomed by Angie and Esther with whom we had some great laughs! It definitely set the mood for our visit to Scotland. The next day, Aileen kindly checked in on us to make sure we were comfortable which we appreciated.
We really enjoyed staying here. The apartment was clean, cosy, characterful and had everything we could want. The decor was very thoughtful and romantic. And to be able to have a cup of tea sitting in a Victorian window sill overlooking the Castle was priceless and truly memorable!
We would definitely recommend this place to family and friends; Aileen will ensure a pleasant stay for all. Thank you Aileen!
Lovely location and host was very helpful and communicative. We had a great stay
Fantastic apartment in great location.
Practical flat with comfy beds in a great location for sightseeing. Plenty of room for three adult couples.

En todo momento Amy estuvo muy pendiente. De hecho, nada más llegar por primera vez al piso tuvimos un par de dudas que nos pudo resolver rápidamente.
El piso es cómodo y calentito. Cumple con las fotos y las descripciones.
Muy buena ubicación: se encuentra a unos 20-30 minutos andando de cualquier sitio importante de Edimburgo, y en un barrio muy tranquilo.
Muy recomendable.

Un apartamento que supero nuestras espectativas.Nos alojamos comodamente siete personas.Tiene todo lo necesario para hacer de comer y todo lo que se quiera.Estaba todo muy limpio e incluso nos dejaron bombones y vino como recibimiento.Autobuses, tren y tranvia a 1km.Supermercados y tido tipo de locales al lado.Todo muy bien, repetiriamos sin duda.

This is a very good little flat, in a convenient location. It is stylish yet very comfortable, with a well- equipped kitchen. It was all spotlessly clean and had everything we needed for a short city break. Cluny was a great host. He replied promptly at booking, provided easy directions and was there to greet us on arrival.
It is up several flights of stairs, as it is a traditional flat, so perhaps not for those with mobility difficulties.

Clear indications to get there, Angie responded fast! The ad wasn't clear if we were sharing the commons with her, if it was her home. Bed was very comfy! Although, we were walking on eggshells because of rules we didn't expect: cleaning the entire shower after EACH use (not nice on our only common holidays), not changing the water temperature which was not very warm, not using the kitchen hood light to cook ( too expensive). Angie could be funny sometimes then turned cold.  Didn't seem to expect us to use the kitchen regularly though it was indicated in the ad that we had access to it. There was no place or table available to settle to eat properly so we either ate standing up in the kitchen or in the bedroom, not comfortable for us who enjoy having large meals. Angie didn't offer any solution for this though she saw us eating standing, she could have provided a table in one of her living room but they were always full of her stuff. Very ambivalent! Not good for long trips

A lovely apartment with lots of space. The beds are really comfortable, even the pull out couch has a proper mattress. The only issue we had was that the toilet did not flush properly and leaked a bit of water overnight. However, when we told the host, he had already phoned to have it repaired so it shouldn't be a problem for future guests. Would definitely recommend this apartment.  Excellent experience for the cost.

Great flat, great location, great owner.  Highly Recommended!  Lots of room, bright and well-equipped, and a very comfortable bed.  Very central location (views of the Castle and the Grassmarket from the living room and bedroom).  Easy walk to the sites; no need for a car. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

Rachel was a lovely host. She was prompt in her responses. The location of the places was perfect. Close to the city centre and to transport links. Everything was in walking distance . The space was beautiful and clean and her thoughtful touches such as milk in the fridge were extremely appreciated.  It’s those little things that really make a host brilliant. We would highly recommend!

Nous avons passé un excellent moment dans le logement de Minh. Les hôtes sont très très accueillants. Ils nous ont donné de nombreux conseils pour les bons restaurants et les visites à faire. Ils sont très réactifs et sympathiques. Le lit et la salle de bain étaient particulièrement confortables. Nous les recommandons tant pour la chambre que pour leurs bons conseils et leur bonne humeur. Nicolas et Florence
A wonderful room and a wonderful host, I totally recommend !
Spacious and quiet, it was a perfect place to rest after having unexpected flight complications. There's a wonderful restaurant with a beautiful walk. Really an idyllic place.

This airbnb provides good facilities, lovely room and bath.
Anne is a great host and communication is easy.
The area is lovely, especially when the sun is out.
It is a very sweet and welcoming family!
Thank you all for at great stay :D

The apartment is in a strategic position, near the castle and very close to New Town and to Old Town. You can find every confort in the house: king size bed, good wifi, a kitchen complete with every tool.
Luke is fantastic, he allowed us to have early check in and late check out!
I recommend this fantastic apartment!
Katherine's house was a please t stay clean tidy and an hours walk to the center of the city or 15 minutes in uber/taxi. It was very clean felt like home and I'm very happy to have stayed there.

The apartment was very clean tidy and a relaxing place to stay, if we do go to Edinburgh again in the future we will definitely see about staying at Spylaw again, very comfortable, very relaxing and a great location.

Thanks to Emma for helpful guide to the cafes of the area. The room is very well situated in the very smart area of the second new town of Edinburgh. Near the city centre but so quiet. We enjoyed our stay immensely

Lovely apartment. Amazing location. Patrick was a fabulous host - answered questions quickly and offered helpful info. We spent time in three different locations and wish we would have stayed here much much longer. Peaceful and pleasant.
amanda est une hote tres sympathique. la chambre et la salle de bain étaient tres sympa et tres propre. je sais où aller lors de mon prochain séjour à edimbourg.
Great location , lovely place & responsive hosts
Awesome place with friendly hosts that would provide warm services and interact with you as though you guys are friends!
Thanks for being such a responsive and lovely host. Your property was perfect for what we needed. I think our vote is in our actions...we're already booked to return!

Laurence was an amazing host.  His recommendations were on point (do not miss the Black Grape for dinner; fabulous) and he was extremely responsive.  The flat is comfortable, bedding and bed were so so lovely it made it hard to get out of bed!  You are in the center of it all w the best coffee, brekkie and bars directly across the street.  Highly recommended flat and host!
Steven is a perfect host and his apartment is a perfect place to stay.

Martin was a welcoming host and offered helpful tips for navigating the city, plus he offered up some interesting historical tidbits. The apartment was comfortable and the kitchen was well stocked. The heated bathroom floor was a nice touch. The location is very walkable to most any site you want to see in Edinburgh and the surrounding suburbs. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again when we return to Edinburgh in the future.

Mi estancia en casa de Rui fue muy agradable. Me sentí como en casa. Lo recomendaría a todo el mundo que quiera estar unos días en Edimburgo. La habitación es amplia y cómoda y todo estaba muy limpio y ordenado. Desde allí uno puede darse un paseo de 20 min hasta el centro, y si no, enfrente mismo hay una parada de bus con frecuencia asidua. Gracias Rui por hacerme la estancia tan cómoda. Un abrazo. Victoria

Fantastic flat in a beautiful area of Edinburgh. Very peaceful. Spotlessly clean, well maintained and very comfortable.
Great location, with lovely shops, cafes, bars and restaurant really close by. Short walk to the center. Stuart is an excellent host and quick with responses.
Will definitely book again as we would love to spend more time there again.
Highly recommended.
Wonderful flat in a fantastic location. We would stay again. Thank you.

Jim is a lovely person, he gave very quick & clear responses to my questions & is an easy-going host. He allowed me to leave items in the home even after checked out of my room so I could pick it up later - which was very kind of him! The location is good as someone who walks everywhere :) I was able to do everything I wanted to do on my Edinburgh list just by walking.
This home is amazing! Beautiful architecture, perfect location, and delightful in every way. I can’t recommend enough! The owners went out of their way to be helpful!.

Tres agréable sejour dans cet appartement dans lequel on se sent comme dans un cocon.
La cuisine est tres bien aménagée.
Seul bemol, le matelas est trop mou et m a donne mal au dos.
A lovely flat, very good location for the sights, warm and clean with everything you could need for a short stay in Edinburgh.

Muy bonito el departamento, se encontraba muy limpio y muy atento a lo que se necesitará
Gracias
Loved this stay! Great walking location to downtown without being on a main street (i.e. quieter than the city center). Well stocked, very cute space.

We had an amazing stay at The Mews Stable. The place was spotless, easy to find and check-in and an ideal spot walking distance to the city. But most of all, Jock was an amazing host and always responsive. Will be staying here again next time we are in Edinburgh!

We thoroughly enjoyed a two night stay and recommend this property highly. It's convenient to the city center and off the main roads, although there are some restaurants and bars on this street so there can be some nighttime street noise. Harry is really organized and communicates clearly before your arrival. The apartment was very clean and well equipped. We will stay here again if we return to Edinburgh.

We had a fantastic time in this flat! The location is perfect if you want to be within walking distance of the city’s main attractions, yet in a quiet, peaceful area. Everything was exactly as described, and the flat was spotless and clean. Edinburgh is such a magical place, and there’s nothing better than feeling at home there in a place like this.

Die Atmosphäre und die angenehme Kommunikation sind hervorhebenswert. Angesichts des geringen Preises lassen sich auch einige Mängel ertragen: ein Feldbett, der kaputte Klodeckel.
Kontakt zu anderen Hausbewohnern hat sich nicht ergeben - richtig gut fanden wir, was Stockbridge direkt in der Nähe bot: Geschäfte, Pubs, Cafes, etc.

My partner and I booked this accommodation for a New Year’s Eve getaway, mainly because we were looking for an "Entire Guest House" as advertised. We hoped for access to a kitchen, implied by the listing. Other affordable options only offered rooms, which didn’t meet our needs. David kindly apologised for the incorrect advertisement, explaining the space was hotel-like, which wasn’t clear in the description. Had we known, we would’ve opted for a different location or a hotel room. The space is a converted house with thin walls, so we heard other guests, affecting privacy. The room also smelled damp. On a positive note, David is friendly and responsive. The property offers limited parking (not stated), a big bonus since street parking is expensive (£16.80 for four hours). If you want an “entire guest house,” this isn’t the option for you.
El alojamiento está muy bien ubicado. Se encuentra en un edificio antiguo y la primera sensación decepciona un poco pero realmente el apartamento en su interior está muy bien y limpio

Maravillosa estancia, el mejor apartamento en el cual nos hemos alojado. Bien situado, con parada de bus directo al centro justo delante. Bonito y tranquilo barrio y precioso apartamento. Mención a parte para el trato de Daniel y los detallitos para dar la bienvenida. 100% recomendado, mil gracias Daniel.

I’ve stayed at many Airbnbs and this was one of the top ones.  Colin was super—left basic groceries and snacks for us, and wine, and whiskey!  Flexible on early check-in.  Very responsive.  The apartment is large and really fully stocked…felt home-like.  Beds were comfy.  The heat and plumbing worked seamlessly (we didn’t experience that everywhere in Scotland).  The neighborhood of Marchmont is ideal if you want to be in a quiet area, but close to the city center.  We walked into Old Town, 20-25 minutes, and it’s a lovely walk through the Meadows and past the university.  Lots of nearby restaurants and markets.  We really loved our stay.  Many thanks to Colin.

Richard a été exceptionnel. Disponible, avenant, il nous a donné plein de conseils pour visiter la ville. une vraie belle rencontre humaine. La chambre était très bien et l'appartement très bien situé.
Mille mercis Richard !
Victor & Pierre
Calvert charming flat.  Would stay again

It's an amazing property with full amenities very close to the centre. The host is quite receptive and helpful.
I would highly recommend this property.

Great location to explore Edinburgh! We loved walking around and catching the bus right outside the flat to various spots. Lots of stairs to get to the flat (78 to be exact, you can fight my 4 year old over that number). Not as clean as expected, hence the 4 stars. All in all, a bright spacious place in a great location.

Great place! Cozy and in a really good location, close to the tram with great pubs and cafes nearby. Everything was clean and comfortable, and communication with the host was easy. Would definitely recommend!
Joseph’s place was clean , modern and spacious. Great location and easy communication
Rubi was a very welcoming host and very kind and thoughtful! The room was very light, airy and comfortable.

Hilary’s place is located on the age of a beautiful national part and local buses and affordable Uber rides can help you get around. Hilary is nice and friendly so as her fury family. We enjoyed staying with Hilary and we missed the breakfast we shared together by her beautiful arranged garden

Good for our family of 5 for 3 nights. Tesco just down the road, near to a tram stop, lots of light, great heating, all the utensils we needed, and the washing machine and drying racks were a lifesaver. The 3 flights of stairs were challenging but we did get a workout.
Enjoyed our stay, everything as described. The super king beds made the apartment standout from the other options.

Fiona was great and able to deal with our late booking quickly, the house is in a quiet residential area and is well equipped for a self sufficient stay or close to a few local shops and pubs. The Riccarton Inn is only a short walk and had great real ale, really good food, mid price range.
Although we didn't use the public transport there is a park and drive into Edinburgh really close.

I recommend staying at Sonia's place. She was easy to communicate with through the app, always responding.
Instructions around the house were clear and if asked, she was responding quickly to text messages.
Great location, easy public transportation around Edynburgh.
Possible to eat and get a beer close by as well.
Plus for a lock in the door to the bedroom.

This was a fantastic place to stay. There was one other guest who was really lovely and it felt like we had our own flat. Marina was a great host, gave really good advice on where to go and made me feel right at home

Isabella’s place was so clean and lovely! Nice and friendly host also. There are bus stops and supermarket nearby! We had great time staying with her! Highly recommended!舒適乾淨的房間令人愉悅!從市區搭幾站公車就可以到達，目標很好找。從住家步行的距離可以到附近的公園和美術館，附近的大超市很棒! 多謝款待!

The location of the place & the way leading up to the apartment looks sleazy. Apartment was big & spacious. Check on the status of the en-suite bath as there was insufficient hot water for bath. Minutes walk to convenient store.
Ok, unkompliziert.

It’s correct but the heat in the building and in the room was really suffocating even when it’s not hot outside. The fact that we can’t open the window is ridiculous.
Also the walls are very thin, so we can hear your neighbors moving during the night.
Other than that, it was very clean and well located. The shared kitchen is fully equipped. No towel provided but milk and coffee so that’s fine.
When we arrived, they ask us a deposit. I thought it was not permitted and using Airbnb was precisely to avoid that.
To finish, It’s good for two or three nights.
Lovely apartment in Edinburgh! Close enough to all of the popular spots, but tucked onto a quiet street. It was the perfect place for our first time here.

Anne-Marie is a very welcoming,helpful and friendly host. She would do everything she can for her guests. Breakfast was lovely and the area where the house is located is very pretty. A little off from the centre but not a big problem. There are buses that go directly to the centre within 2-30 mins (during rush hour a little longer). If I return to Edinburgh, I would like to stay at her place once again. Thank you for your help Anne-Marie.

Brilliant flat in a brilliant location, look no further then this gem. Would not hesitate to say again if the opportunity arises. Large spacious rooms and perfectly clean. We are a family of four and there was plenty of room.
It was a perfect property for our needs. Cosy and well equipped.
Anne is super friendly and the best host i have ever met!
Really nice apartment, great area, would definitely recommend.

Absolutely perfect air bnb for a stay in Edinburgh. Extremely well located for visiting all the major sites by foot.
Car parking is free outside his place from 5.30pm to 8.30am, with NCP carpark nearby charging £7 for any car put there before 9am untill midnight, or £10 for 24 hours with Sams special discount code. Driving/parking in Edinburgh is a nightmare and very expensive, so very glad to have stopped with Sam as this situation was ideal.
The space was extremely clean, featuring a nice size bedroom with comfy bed, a modern bathroom shared only with other guest room, and a small fully equipped kitchen including table/stools. Tea/coffee and cereal/porridge was provided by Sam.
Sam was born to be an air bnb host. Communication was amazing, extremely organised. Provided thorough information and went out of his way to provide tips and suggestions for our trip. He was also very respectful of our privacy but was availlable through the air bnb messaging whenever needed. Check in and out was smooth/flexible.
Would definately stay here again if visiting Edinburgh. A top air bnb host, thank you Sam!

Overall fine, but disappointing that the extractor fan in the bathroom is broke and the toilet had no window which is very unpleasant and inconvenient for us as we have four people in  the apartment. Tried to talked to the host, but he said he could only come over the following day (which he didn’t come) and no follow up after this. Please make sure you double check with the host if the extractor fan works prior to check in.
Great quiet location within walkable distance to the city centre.

5 stars. The host is always a pleasure to deal with. I’ve stayed in one of Gill’s other properties before. The apartments are always immaculate and very comfortable and Gill is always only a text or call away. Lovely stay. Free on street parking was a bonus and the flat has lovely views out to a gorgeous little garden. All amenities close by. Will stay again.

Andy was very quick to respond to all messages and his place was great! It was clean, spacious and comfortable, and close to suitable dog walking areas. Parking was easy, I had a spot right outside the front door during my trip. Access to the apartment was easy and well instructed. It was a 40 minute walk to the centre with nice pubs en route, or there are pet friendly taxis available to take you into town. And it was a short drive to Portobello beach which was also very dog friendly. I’d highly recommend Andy’s place to stay! Thanks so much!

El apartamento por dentro estaba bastante bien, pero el edificio, el patio, la calle, no es nada acogedor, muy viejo, huele mal, etc.
La ubicación a 30 min. andando del centro.
A destacar, un detalle que no me gustó y fue que nuestro avión salía a las 19:00 de la tarde y nos dijeron de dejar el apartamento a las 10:00. Le comenté de dejar las maletas allí para poder disfrutar de la ciudad esa mañana y no nos dejó. Las llaves se dejan fuera como una caja con un código, y tanto ella como nosotros cuando fueramos a por las maletas, podriamos haber dispuesto de las llaves, por si ella quería ir a limpiar, a arreglar el apartamento...

Within easy reach of local transport into city centre. Be aware if you have mobility
problems don't go into any apartment that you need the lift. It broke down and we were trapped for three hours.

This location has everything I needed. It was close enough to plenty of bus stops and even walking distance to locations I had planned to visit. Ilio and Hamish were fast and great communicators to help me with a late night check in and easy check out.

Perfect location right by Edinburgh castle and at the top of the Royal Mile. Easy walking distance to great pubs and restaurants and the sites of Edinburgh.
Flat was spotlessly clean. It is a small 1 bedroom flat, but is good value for money and provides perfect basics for such a central location.
Newly refurbished.  Steps from the bus stop. Best price we could find on a flat during the Fringe.  Thanks

This apartment is amazing: stonishing view from the castle, spotless clean, comfy bed, excellent shower, full equiped kitchen, quiet by night, close to main attractions. Take into account that there is 5-flight upstairs to the flat, but it worths it. Superb place in Edinburgh!
A great apartment to stay at. Wish I could stay one more night but Amanda had her family coming over.
This was a superb venue. Lovely, cosy apartment with excellent facilities and great personal touches. Convenient location in a vibrant area, we are really hoping to return.
Beautiful place. So nice. We will be back. Thank you!

Liz made me feel very welcome in her home, I was greeted and given the tour, shown where everything i would need was and then allowed to get on with my visit.
The house was lovely, immaculate and just as described.
Lovely flat, great location and super stylish

It was great to stay with Jackie and Armando. They are a very lovely couple and very accommodating. They gave us very accurate instructions as to how to get to their place and how to access the accommodation.
We had a nice view of the sea from the room and it’s about a 15 minute drive into central Edinburgh.
I would highly recommend a stay with Jackie and it was well worth every penny!.
Thanks Jackie and Armando. It was great meeting you

We loved Tansie's place so much we're already planning more stays there when we visit our son in Edinburgh. The photos and other reviews say it all. I can only add that it's perfect for us in both location and style and it was a treat to be met at check in by Tansie.
Great location! This flat was right in the center of everything there is to do. Just a block down from the castle! My husband and I enjoyed our stay and highly recommend.

We had a great stay. Andres gave plenty of information to help us identify the property, and the keysafe. As we got there quite late in the evening he sent videos of how to use the appliances (we were offered an in person check in for earlier in the day).
The apartment was great, he's taken a lot of care to make it presentable and fit for families or grouos of friends. The bathroom was very well stocked and all kitchen essentials provided.
The area was quiet and just a quick taxi into Edinburgh itself, or a 20minute amble to the harbour.
They are gettimg a tram stop super close next week so getting around will be much easier, especially to the airport!
A very comfortable and well appointed apartment, conveniently located for Morningside which was a short bus ride away. Communication with Stoil’s team was very good.

This was a lovely Airbnb! Very nice, clean, modern, and spacious. The location was also excellent! We felt like we were at most a 20 minute walk from anything we went to, often closer. Lots of great restaurants in the area. Also appreciated being able to do laundry in unit. Would not hesitate to stay here again.
Tudo óptimo.

A much needed relaxing escape, the location was 30 minutes drive from Edinburgh
Everything was thought of inside the lodge
It’s a beautiful location and everything was of a high standard
Highly recommended 🩷
Great place! Would recommend to anyone staying in Old Town.
这间别墅非常棒，房间很大而且很多，还有一个很大的院子，房间里有乒乓球桌，台球桌，院子里有蹦蹦床，滑滑梯，秋千等许多玩的设施。停车也很方便。家里的各种设施齐全。去市中心也方便，门口有41路公交车到市中心。主人非常友好热情。给人家的感觉，住得非常舒适，值得推荐！

Great location. Local to everything. Very clean and the host was very responsive and helpful. Beautiful location looking at the castle!
Would definitely recommend.

The apartment is really modern and comfortable. Lynn made sure that our check in was as easy as possible. Everything is clean and nice. The owners provided us with a lot of information about places to visit in and around Edinburgh.

Highly recommend! Not only was Charlotte a fantastic host, her air B and B was perfect. Great central location with everything in walking distance, spotlessly clean, and with beautiful views of Edinburgh Castle. Eggs, bread, juices etc on arrival was a lovely added touch!

Our stay here was great! It’s in a perfect location and we were very comfortable in our stay here. Our host gave us wonderful recommendations and we loved the city of Edinburgh. Highly recommend this place!
L'appartamento si trova in un'ottima posizione, è molto ben curato e pulito. ideale per trascorrere una vacanza nella splendida Edimburgo.

Loved this Airbnb- location is simply perfect- walking distance to just about anything.  Great proximity to Waverley station so a simple connection to the airport- with 24/7 service. Beds were comfortable with nice linens. Good hot water pressure and availability. Nice local coffee shops for simple breakfasts just right out the door. On the first floor so not too many steps after walking all day. Only downside if you are a light sleeper- traffic noise is significant in the very early morning hours- earplugs would help.  Highly recommend this listing.

Wir hatten schöne Tage in Edinburgh. Die Altstadt ist von der Unterkunft gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen. In der Umgebung gibt es viele verschiedene Restaurants. Wir bedanken uns für diesen Aufenthalt und die problemlose und schnelle Kommunikation.

Very comfortable unit, the massive smart TV was a bonus.
Supermarket was an easy walk and public transport very close and easy to access.
Nice unit and we enjoyed our stay.
Thanks Rosa!
great stay
Good place to stay for 1-2 nights. Quite neighbourhood, 5 min walking to the tram station, what takes you to the airport and to the city center. Friendly and responsive hosts. Nice and clean room.

Silvia's Place has resulted what described.

Wonderful property in a wonderful location. Would recommend to anybody.

My husband and I really loved our stay! Everything that we needed was there and our place was spotlessly clean and very comfortable. The host is excellent! very responsive! He was ready to answer any questions we had, rapidly and efficiently. He also was very kind letting us live the bags early in the morning, before the cleanup. Great home away from home in Edinburgh!  Located in a quiet neighborhood in walking distance of the Royal Mile, Arthur’s seat etc. Highly recommend breakfast at the Red Kite Cafe or Art and Village, drinks at Herringbone, burger at Safari Lounge. Nice place, great location. The main issue with this property is that it is handled by a large STR  company Altido, hiding behind "Darius". How large? They manage more than 250 properties in Edinburgh along, according to the listings on their own website. Why would you care about this? If everything is ok and you don't have to communicate with them or require someone come to the house to fix something, you'll be fine. In my case I had to deal with them because the cooktop in the kitchen did not work. Communication did not go well. It feels like customer support of a large company (well, it is!) - polite but extremely unhelpful and at times insulting. Nobody is available to come and fix the issue. They offered small financial compensation (after me pressing on them) which I felt was inadequate for the inconvenience and expense caused. I declined it to speak freely here. The reason to book AirBnB is to have a kitchen! We did not have it essentially, would be better off in a hotel!
A beautiful flat and accommodating host. Will definitely be back again.
还不错，挺好的

We had my elderly in-laws with us, but being on the ground floor the flat was perfectly suitable for them too. We really liked being in Leith, which is a vibrant area with lots of cafes and small shops, but not far from the city centre.
This is wonderful space. The location is great, it’s spotlessly clean, immaculately furnished and very well provisioned.

We enjoyed our stay here. The flat was clean, tidy and quiet. Dean Village is a lovely spot and there is a bus stop close by with convenient buses into the old town. It is also easy to get to the beaches at Silverknowles and Portobello (we enjoyed a swim on a hot afternoon at Portobello beach).
Beautifully and thoughtfully appointed space. Quiet despite being in a busy area - lots of great local recommendations from the hosts, who are super communicative.

We had a wonderful stay at Aileen’s. Easy to find and a phenomenal location-we were able to walk to everything we wanted to do and see! Great Location.
Wonderful stay and just 10/15 from the old town

New Town is much quieter than old Town and it feels like a true neighborhood. The beds were big and comfortable. The host answered right away when we needed assistance.

Excellent appartement, propre,  communication au top avec robert.

After a long drive to Edinburgh, it was a little hard to work out where to park and get up to the apartment, despite the clear instructions & fast communication from Roni & Susan. But once in, it was a really great experience. They had anticipated our every need, and the photos definitely didn’t do the place justice. It was so appreciated by us that the place had kitchen necessities, it was warm, heated clothes horse, hair drier, information about places to visit, really effective heating, a microwave, a washing machine, etc etc! So glad to have found it. Thank you, Roni & Susan.
Great place, central location close to the station. Sam was extremely helpful and flexible as we were early. Great experience. Highly recommended.
everything perfect, would stay again
Both Jorden and Cosmin were great hosts! Very friendly and easy-going people. The place was nice and comfortable and overall we enjoyed our stay!

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay with a room full of character close to the beach and promenade. Great place to stay for exploring Edinburgh. Quite area with good public transport options into the city. Wonderful apartment in a lovely location within walking distance of everything Edinburgh has to offer.  Will definitely hope to visit again.

We would 100% recommend this airbnb.

Lesley is a great great host, the best I have seen in a while. She welcomed us in person and showed us the room and around. Great communication before/during our stay. Finally figured out how to fiddle with the flush button to get it to refill properly.

El alojamiento está súper bien conectado a un bus de 10min del centro de Edimburgo, estaba impecable y ordenado, coincidía con todo lo descrito por ella, Sarah estuvo siempre al pendiente de nuestras necesidades, en general fue una estancia muy satisfactoria, solo un recordatorio se suben bastantes escaleras info para los próximos viajeros, también hay una tienda de conveniencia a 5min caminando, súper conveniente para comprar alimentos y bebidas, en general nos gustó mucho!
Ottima posizione vicino al tram per centro e aeroporto, ben fornito pulito e tranquillo
Great place and location. Exactly what we wanted for the stay. Owner is extremely helpful and responsive. Would definitely stay again if in Edinburgh.

Great place, sorry walk into the centre, close to bars & restaurants.
As described and everyone had a good night's sleep.
The only suggestion is make, if you're going to charge and extra £100 for a 1 night booking don't allow for 1 night bookings since it made it really expensive.
The place was clean and tidy and perfect for a didn't weekend for 2 couples.

Carol was a warm, sweet, and truly wonderful person.
Her place was very cosy, peaceful, clean, and especially the bathroom was superb.
The area is near a big market(Tesco extra) and McDonald’s, so it should be nice if you don’t really feel like cooking.
Of course a bus stop is very close to Carol’s house, thus it was really easy to access everywhere.

Don't hesitate to confirm your booking if you're looking for comfort, cleanliness, and everything else.
This is my second time staying here; the first time was in July. Both visits were as I expected and even better. The host was always responsive, and what I love most is that the place is fully equipped with everything, even the heating system. They always recommend the best places I ask about. I won't hesitate to stay here again, and I don't think I'll find a host as wonderful and helpful as you.

We had a great stay at Rebecca’s place. The apartment had everything we needed and was clean. The heating really helped as it was very cold during our stay. She was always available to answer any questions I had.
The only thing that made us uncomfortable was the building the apartment is located in. It almost had an abandoned building look. The entrance to the building was very dirty and run down, with junk laying in the walkway and we felt uneasy until inside the apartment.

Elizabeth’s place is immaculate. Cleanest Airbnb. Stayed there again last week and everything was perfect. Elizabeth is the perfect host and she made us feel like home from the moment we got there.
I will highly recommend Elizabeth and her place without any reservation

Michelle’s place was great, it felt like a home away from home. It’s why I love staying with AirBnB. We booked quite last minute after a mix up with our travel arrangements. Michelle was very helpful at all times. I will book her place again when I next visit Edinburgh.

This is a tip-top, cosy flat in an ideal location for exploring Edinburgh. Everything is well thought out and provided for; communication with the host was also excellent throughout our stay. Highly recommended.
Appartement très sympa dans un coin très tranquille de la ville, à proximité de quartiers sympa avec beaucoup de choses à faire et voir, tout à distance faisable à pieds.
FANTASTIC LOCATION AND GREAT SPACE!  Highly recommend and will stay there again.
This was a great flat to come back to each night after exploring the city.
Loved staying at this flat. Elizabeth and Jen are incredible hosts! Highly recommend!!
Great stay :)

This is my third time in Edinburgh, and this time my boyfriend and I stayed longer to celebrate our anniversary. After looking around, we chose Bruce and Julio’s place, and it was a great decision! We had our own private bathroom, which I really appreciated.
I was first attracted by the photos of the living room, and in reality it looked just the same. The style and colors made the space relaxing and full of energy. Thank you to Julio for letting us use the kitchen ——it was nice to come back after sightseeing and cook a simple dinner that suited our taste.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. It felt comfortable and welcoming, and we would love to come back again.
Amazing location and the views!!!!

Veronique’s appartment was located centrally with a private feel. Anywhere in the city center was within walking distance, but the neighborhood was a quiet residential one.
The appartment was clean, cosy and matched the description.
Veronique is a warm, approachable person. She explained everything clearly and also provided suggestions for things to do in the neighborhood.
Absolutely lovely stay. Andrea is the kindest person, and the location was perfect for a quick trip to the airport early in the morning!
I really enjoyed my stay here. The flat was great and in a perfect location.
It was a wonderful stay. Exactly as described in the pictures. It is a bit far to walk to old town, but it is walkable or by bus.
Highly recommend this host and venue.
Comfortable house in a good location

In a word: perfect. Really cool and unique flat, close to everything, excellent host who really goes the extra mile to make your stay as comfortable as possible. Great value too. Cannot fault one bit.
The cottage was really nice and comfortable and there was always a fast respond from the team when there were any kind of questions.

Wow,  this flat is absolutely beautiful,  we were extreamly pleased. The flat had everything we needed for our stay. It was easy to find and easy to check in. We would definitely recommend a stay here.

Excellent stay with Sarah! We were able to enjoy Edinburgh and its beautiful architecture! Ideal location 20 minutes from the centre, very cosy room and very clean bathroom! Sarah is very attentive and always takes the time to make herself available! Thank you so much!

We had a lovely time at Eleanor’s place!
She is very kind and made us feel like home. She even took the time to show our 2 years old son the 3 chickens every morning, let him search for the fresh eggs and let him feed them :).
The room is nicely decorated, the bed is amazing and the breakfast is delicious.
We loved the neighborhood as well - it gives you a glimpse of the local Edinburgh day to day live.
I would recommend it with eyes closed!
Lovely place, has everything you need for a comfortable stay.

Notre séjour s'est bien passé, la chambre est confirme a la description.
Linda est une hôtesse accueillante et souriante.
C'était notre première expérience chez l'habitant, nous avons beaucoup apprécié.

The best Airbnb we've ever stayed in. Exceptionally well equipped and very clean apartment. Very friendly and helpful host makes you feels like home. Also communication was great, every response within minutes.
Location is amazing, very close to the city centre, 10 minute walk, so we didn't have to take any buses.
The neighborhood is peaceful and really quiet.
Un très bon séjour dans un lieu situé à deux pas du Royal Mile et du sentier Arthur’s Seat (pour une vue incroyable sur la ville)

This apartment is great, the location is perfect, the facilities are just what you need for a relaxing holiday with family and friends. The communication with the host was great, she answered the couple of questions I had very quickly and was very accommodating. I would highly recommend this property and we will definitely be back.
Excellent apartments in central location. Will definitely stay again when we next come to visit Edinburgh!
乾淨度與安靜度佳，地點偏遠些

The apartment is within 6 minutes walking distance to tram station and has perfect looking inside. But the apartment is on the first floor without lift so it is a little bit hard for us to move suitcases.

Charlie was welcoming and courteous. His house is in a very quiet location and right next to a network of footpaths providing a pleasant walk into the centre of Edinburgh.   The bedroom was a pleasant temperature and the bed was comfortable. I can't comment on breakfast because I didn't have breakfast due to a change in timings of my committments.
Francois was able to provide an Airbnb at short notice and was very quick at responding and helping us find the Airbnb. The location is great, very central.
All good 👍

Loved this apartment, was very clean and spacious. Laura had a binder with all the details and instructions; including recommendations for places to visit. Quit area with some local bar/pubs nearby, recommend to uber/taxi from the train station.
Great place and location! Eddie was great. Really recommend

We stayed at Tessa's for a weekend in October and had a lovely experience. She was very accommodating to our arrival time, and was warm and welcoming. She gave us some really nice local recommendations - I would highly recommend exploring them. The walk to Royal Mile and the castle was an easy distance. The flat was truly amazing, full of really pretty decor. We would definitely go again.

Sinan went above and beyond as a host. Lufthansa lost our luggage and, even if we already checked out, thanks to him we were able to retrieve it. Communicating, finding the place and checkin in was all very easy (even if we arrived late at night). The cherry on top was the very comfy bed and silent room.

Suzie was very helpful, prepared and flexible for our stay. She even made a restaurant reservation for us - Rollo - it was lovely food, great atmosphere and close by. Definitely would stay at Suzie’s again and recommend it to our friends! And last but not least, we got to meet Pickles! He is her cute little dog. Loved Edinburgh.

Very nice appartement, everything what you need to have a nice stay .
We definitely recommend !

Lovely cosy apartment in a great location for all the pubs, bars, restaurants, shops and touristy attractions. It was very clean, well maintained and had everything we needed for our 4 night stay. Super easy to get to from the airport whether you decide to get the tram, train or bus.
The check in time is late in the afternoon so we stored our luggage at the Hub in Premier Inn. You need to pre book online using a company called Stasher and you can use discount code 'HOUST'. It cost £6 and we left luggage there all day.
As others have mentioned, be mindful that the bedroom overlooks the back of a pub and we were woken up before 7am everyday (except Christmas Day) with bins being emptied, bottles being recycled/smashed and other deliveries. You will need those earplugs that everyone has already recommended!! However, don't let this put you off, everything else was perfect and I would definitely stay here again - thanks Irene 😊
Great location. Brilliant sized apartment for the 3 of us (adults). Clean and tidy. Cute guidebook from host - very thoughtful! We enjoyed our stay thoroughly. Thank you!
Very comfortable, clean room in a stylish apartment in a great neighborhood of a fantastic city with a very helpful and friendly host.
No hassle, lovely place
Fantastic location.  Very near to royal mile, restaurants and attractions.  Walked everywhere, not a singe cab was needed.
Absolutely beautiful flat with incredible views, right in the heart of Edinburgh.
Vicki was a wonderful, responsive, and kind host making the stay easy and lovely. The location was great, parking was appreciated, and recommendations were helpful.

Beautiful room and bathroom, conveniently located in a quiet area of town.
Everything was absolutely spotless and the bathroom is cleaned daily.
The host is very responsive and accomodating.
We definitely recommend this.

We were treated like VIPs!
Annette has just been the best Airbnb host we have had so far. She is extremely kind, welcoming, and informative. Her high degree of attention to detail is something we see but quite rarely, even though we're in the hospitality business. Her place is fantastic - convenient, super clean, with great accessibility, and simplistic/tasteful.
We would not even consider staying somewhere else when in Edinburgh, and we will be back there soon. This place and Annette, as one, was the biggest highlight of our long trip around Europe.
Annette - we already love you! You are simply so unique. People like you should live forever.
THANK YOU SO MUCH!
Alfredo & Claudia

El alojamiento de Sue And Grant es perfecto para dos personas. Nos ha gustado más que en las fotos: el salón es amplio y la cocina aunque pequeña tiene absolutamente de todo: horno, microondas, lavavajillas, vitrocerámica... La cama no es muy grande, pero si es cómoda y agradable. Se descansa muy bien. La ducha es muy, muy relajante.
Es un lugar ideal para coger el autobús hacia el aeropuerto ya que la parada está a menos de dos minutos.
Aunque no es un apartamento céntrico, la zona es muy buena pues los autobuses puedes cogerlos prácticamente al lado, aunque mi marido y yo nos desplazamos caminando pues es un agradable paseo de 25-30 minutos.
Los anfitriones siempre estuvieron muy atentos por lo que pudiéramos necesitar, aunque lo teníamos todo.
Por los precios que hemos consultado en Edimburgo, lo recomendamos encarecidamente.

Wir hatten eine super schöne Zeit in Edinburgh, auch wegen der perfekten Wohnung. Die Lage ist zentral, die Ausstattung ist geschmackvoll und hochwertig. Selbst eine Gartennutzung ist inkludiert. Der Gastgeber hat umfangreiches Infomaterial zur Verfügung gestellt. Wir haben uns total wohlgefühlt und können die Wohnung nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen.
Kerstin

Wir haben uns von Anfang an sehr wohl in diesem Airbnb gefühlt! Die Kommunikation war ausgezeichnet und alles war klar und verständlich beschrieben. Der Check-in war super easy. Positiv war, wie sauber und wie liebevoll eingerichtet die Wohnung ist. Die Lage der Wohnung ist sehr gut, da direkt um die Ecke eine Bushaltestelle ist und ein Bahnhof 10 min zu Fuß entfernt liegt. Zu Fuß kommt man auch easy in die Innenstadt und hat alles was man braucht. Wir waren begeistert und kommen gerne wieder! ☺️
great stay, Anna is a lovely host with a delightful apartment
Very lovely apartment in great part of town

very nice place to stay, quiet and very clean. very good mattress and amazing rest / sleep there. really easy to go to the city centre with trams and bus. great instructions and easy to find. I would definitely recommend. Was a bit pricey when we went but that was due to Taylor Swift concert - but it did save us as all the hotels were booked already. really happy that we stayed here.
Beautiful place! Great location and only a 3 min walk from the airport tram.

The apartment of Ellie and Scott is absolutely amazing place! Everything was prepared for our arrival, the flat was very tidy and chocolate present was also really nice. The apartment is located in the centre of Edinburgh, so we din't have to use any public transport - you can walk everywhere you want, practically you're in the heart of city in few minutes.
We really felt like at home in this apartment and I can say it was the best choice we could do!
Absolutely recommended!
Great place

We were a group of 8 and absolutely loved our stay. It is a beautiful apartment in a great location - only a 10 minute walk to the centre of Edinburgh. The apartment was spacious and clean and there were lots of lovely shops and restaurants nearby. The hosts were excellent too and very helpful. We couldn't recommend this apartment enough and would definitely stay here again when next in Edinburgh!
mi estadia en casa de Judy fue hermosa, Ella y su familia son encantadores siempre atentos a cualquier necesidad y muy calidos. gracias!!! volvere
Loved the stay! Comfortable and private. Responsive host, followed up.  Was a bit tough the first time to find but worth the find! Will definitely come back. :)

The location is wonderful.  Extremely central but shielded from the noise of the nearby bars etc.  The space was plenty big enough.  It is a little tired though and a bit of redecoration wouldn't go amiss.  The host was absolutely excellent and sorted out a small problem instantly.

Good place for a price. Very good location - walking distance to the city center. There were some issues with the key at the beginning but communication with the host was very good and I was very quickly helped. Wifi did not work which was a bit of an issue.
Great place to stay - worked well to pop into Edinburgh on the bus for the day, and stay quietly a bit outside the centre. Recommend it!

Lovely rental, clean and well decorated, very spacious. The host was responsive via chat and very helpful. Got a handyman out for the next day when we found something broken. A short walk from the old town with a lot of food options nearby. Only small downside was that the ensuite was quite chilly

We had a lovely stay in Edinburgh. Very clean, airy and bright apartment that looked just like the photos. Great location very walkable to the centre and nice bars nearby too. Would definitely stay again.
Appartement très bien situé. Très propre.

A really great location for checking out the sites of Edinburgh.  It is near countless restaurants, pubs, monuments, the Edinburgh castle, museums, train/tram connections...a nice clean 3-bedroom apartment with plenty of space. Our crew of 5 enjoyed staying here.

Beautiful little flat, very by the within walking distance to restaurants and cafes.
Perfect for a couple, clean with all the amenities and tastefully designed. Rachel kind and responsive straight away.

Great location and clear, easy instructions for check in/check out. Kitchen appliances and kitchenware are great, better than I expected! Two pretty big issues for me though: 1) the bed is way too soft - springs have gone, 2) the bathroom was dirty - mould around shower tray seal and old hairs/dust.
Highly recommended

Great location and everything you need to have a comfortable stay.The hosts went out of their way to come and meet us to ensure everything was good.Would highly recommend and if we ever go back to Edinburgh we will definitely stay there again.
A good, functional space in the heart of Edinburgh. The apartment is very compact.

I had a fantastic two days in Edinburgh thanks to Rona's help and hospitality.  She's very generous (she provides breakfast!) and answered my million questions about the city.  The apartment is very nice, clean and in a great location.  There is an excellent pub and Indian restaurant next door.  I highly recommend staying with Rona.

Excellent communication before and during stay.
Location is perfect and everything is within walking distance. Amazing to stay in the middle of so much history.

Super comfy bed and duvet which is exactly what is needed after walking on the hilly streets and up Arthur's seat all day!

Highly recommend.
Clean, comfy, gorgeous finish on the place, easy to find, slept like a baby. Daljit was a great host, check in was easy, we felt safe and secure! Excellent location! We will be back here!

Great place to stay for a couple of days to explore the city and surroundings. Many restaraunts within a 5 min walk as well as shops/supermarket. Nearby train station (10 min walk) and bus stops (<5 min). Quiet location.

Shona is a fabulous host, she was amazing with my 10 year old who really enjoyed his stay and fell in love with jack the dog. Great location, fab sleep, the room is fresh and comfortable. We will be back to see Shona and Jack and discover a bit more of Edingburgh.
Very nice place and also the host is so cooperative.

I had a lovely stay in Charlotte's apartment. The bed was really comfortable, the room was warm and everything was nice and clean. Charlotte is a really nice lady and gave me a warm welcome. The location is also very good, close to the busstation, shopping mall and saint Andrew square tramstop in Newtown. I would recommend this place :)
Great location,  comfortable, place has everything you need
Old food left in freezer, beds not comfortable, dirty dish towel, cooker hood dirty. Stone stairs a health hazard.
Close to all amenities.

This apartment couldn't be closer to the Royal Mile!  We were able to access all of Edinburgh from this location.  Sparkling clean with all the proper necessities.   The relaxing roof top is a great way to enjoy a days travels through the city.  Great choice for any traveler.

This is more of a private room Hostel than Airbnb. Had most of the Hostel type amenities. The one thing is that it is a very noisy location. You can hear what's going on in the next room and on the streets at all hours. Also, it is a good walk from the center of Edinburgh. Other than those things it is a nice place. Full kitchen with washer/dryer. Sitting/dining area. Free wi-fi. Paul responds quickly to any issues.

What a find - this was just what we needed for our stay. Close to the conference centre and walkable to most central tourist spots with really easy bus and tram stops. Wifi wasn’t the best but not much of an issue. We loved the shutters and the garden. Thanks so much.

Sue and Grant were very responsive and the facility is very comfortable to stay. The house is very near to all the interesting places, walkable 5 minutes to Victoria street, Castle and 25 minutes to Calton Hill. The house itself very well arranged, kitchen is good with some basics such as coffee, tea, sugar, oil, pepper, salt and many more. The room is good and the sofa bed also very comfortable. I could watch TV/Youtube while lying down at night and plan for the next day. We stayed 3 nights and cooked. The unit has secured car park, though it is narrow, it was useful for us to park. We are grateful to Sue and Grant for accommodating us. Highly recommended.
Beautiful apartment, perfect location, can’t fault it. A great stay and will be back

Absolutely lovely place with a wonderful host. Super central for New Town and shopping, and being as Edinburgh is quite a small city it's not far for the rest either. Especially well located for the eateries on Rose Street--literally just outside the door. The flat is clean, comfortable, and cosy. The only slight drawback is the three floors of stairs to get up to it but it's worth the climb! Highly recommend staying here.

Ann was incredibly sweet from the first time she messaged me through AirBnB to the day we officially met in her studio. I had told her how I recently graduated and was going on holiday to celebrate and she was as gracious as she was helpful. She even left a bottle of wine in the fridge! The space was exactly as I had expected it and the view of the castle was magical! I also couldn't believe how close it was to everything! We were walking distance to the castle, the Scotch Whiskey Experience, and all other tourist attractions we wanted to go to! Just a 5 minute walk from the Big Lebowski Bar!! It was exactly what my boyfriend and I had been looking for and I would recommend her for anyone looking for a great location in Edinburgh!

This is a wonderful place! The studio is perfect for a stay in Edinburgh. The location is great with the park and a ton of restaurants/cafes nearby. It’s a quick walk to all of the main attractions in the city - and the hosts are incredibly accommodating!
Awesome location, everything is easily walkable in the old town area. Tim and team were very responsive!!

Dina was absolutely the very best people Ive met in a long time. Sometimes you stay at an airbnb and you check in, check out, and rarely interact with your host. Staying at Dina's place is exactly why I use Airbnb in the first place, for the community. As a host, Dina embodies what I think the very mission statement of Airbnb should be: to connect people from all over the world and to build community. Parking was easy, Check in was a breeze, the place was laid out and designed very cleverly, and if you like pineapples you are in for a treat. If you're extra nice, and happen to be into house music, maybe she'll hop on the ones and twos for ya and play some tracks. Her and her boyfriend and the rest of their friends are terrific conversationalists and I had one of the best chats with them that Ive had in a very long time. It really made my first stay in Scotland truly one to remember.
So if you find yourself in Edi.... do yourself a favor. Stay at Dinas. I will ABSOLUTELY be back for a visit. :)
Excellent place, the cleanest airbnb house that I stayed!

Wonderfully located (quite central to Waverly train station, with its many stops and bus lines), very walkable neighborhood, and easy-to-find home, thanks to the thorough directions sent to us in advance. Room is comfortable, and the flat  is very cozy, with a nice open common space to work and watch TV. We'd happily stay again.

Such a lovely apartment. Loved the decor with all the movie posters and figures. I was there alone but it was perfect for 4 people (one big sofabed and two single beds). Very nice and quiet area and really close to public transport that took you to the center in just 10-15 minutes. The only downside is that, if you're a light sleeper, it's right next to the building door which closes with a bang, but it was rather quiet at night. I'd stay there again, check in and check out were very easy and practical.
Perfect location for exploring the old town area by foot. Had every needed for a comfortable stay, especially the kitchen.

Alles wunderbar. Wir sind eine 5-köpfige Familie. Die Kinder (19/21/23) schliefen in einem Zimmer und wir. Das ging gut, dank dem grossen Wohnzimmer und den zwei Bädern. Da wir ohne guten Kaffee keinen Tag beginnen (können) waren wir sehr froh, ware ein „NERO“-Kaffee ganz in der Nähe!

We stayed in Lesley’s quaint little flat for four nights. Lesley personally welcomed  us and showed us through. Everything was immaculately clean and comfortable. Lesley provided milk and butter in the fridge, a few pantry items plus  biscuits and fudge which were great to pack in for sightseeing, not to mention a bottle of bubbles for celebrating. The location is centrally located near the Royal mile so we were able to do most of our sightseeing on foot. We highly recommend Lesley’s air bnb. She is a perfect host.
It was a very cozy place! Lots of parking surrounding the area. Beautiful views. A quick walk to a lot of shops and restaurants.

Great accomodation and a wonderful host! The room is cosy, even more spacious than thought, with a very comfortable bed, two sofas, tea making facilities, TV and an open fire place. The flat is very conveniently located within easy walking distance to shops, restaurants and all the sights of the Old Town. Sally is a lovely host, who made sure I had everthing I needed and gave me some great tips for activities in Edinburgh. I felt welcome and at home from the moment I crossed the doorstep and would stay with Sally again any time.

Amazing person to be dealing with.
Thank you for the great experience. I am glad I had the luck to be your guest.
God bless
perfect location.
Very nice stay in Edinburgh, lorraine was also very nice.
Hot tub is amazing and great
房子整洁还可以，但使用起来的便利性略缺，大部分可能用到的物品包括电吹风都要自己准备😄；
Natalia was extremely communicative from the very beginning. Instructions were in great detail. Place was the perfect location next to the tram.
Pace-full location.
Great location and very reasonable price

Victor was a helpful and friendly host, unfortunately the bathroom at the place itself was tiny and very difficult to use even for average sized human like myself. Shower had stains and hair from previous guests, place and cups in the kitchen were dirty. For the price paid unfortunately it did not feel like good value for money.

Came to Edinburgh to visit my sister living really close by.
Very modern house, sparkling clean. Easy check in and amazing host, really chatty and friendly.
The room big enough for all your needs, very comfortable bed.
The outside private bathroom (front door) very very clean.
I would come back when again in Edinburgh!
Thank you Andy!!!!

Sue and Grant were great hosts. They messaged us before and during the stay and quickly replied to any questions we had. The flat was lovely, great location and accessible to shops, restaurants and bus stops. Beds were comfortable and the linen was of good quality.The sitting room was large and had books, games and local information. The extras eg shampoo, conditioner, cleaning products etc were appreciated.

Lovely cottage! Incredibly comfortable- the  beds, linens are suburb. Large bathrooms, we didn’t need one additional item. A wonderful kitchen outfitted with everything one needs. Sorry we should have replaced all the Nespresso pods we enjoyed every day! Charming outdoor patio to relax and enjoy the peace and quiet. Jemima was beyond helpful and gracious. Just around the corner, not even a five minute walk, there are restaurants, wine stores, a well stocked market, coffee shops and more. A delightful stay!

Es entsprach alles den Beschreibungen. Auch war es möglich etwas früher anzukommen.
Die Lage ist nicht direkt im Stadtzentrum, mit der Tram - ca. 8 Minuten Fußweg - ist es aber kein Problem; diese fährt den ganzen Tag & Nacht.

Great flat in a great location! Overall clean and loved having 2 bathrooms and washer/dryer.
It was a bit frustrating to complete the personalized boarding pass (we did not need to do this for other stays) and it seemed to be totally separate from the Airbnb platform. It was thru the pass where all the specific info was provided (exact location, check in and check out process). When I couldn’t access the boarding pass, the Joivy team was very responsive thru the app (thank goodness!).
PROs: timely and responsive communication, nice flat, excellent location. Internet, Coffee, tea, towels and shampoo provided, as expected.
CONs: only 1 dish towel, which was dirty when we arrived, no instructions for washer and dryer, instructions only available thru online boarding pass.

It was a great stay at this place. The location is excellent, close to everything, and the price is fair for what it offers. The kitchen is well equipped, the bathroom is clean, and the room is very cozy.
Clean, spacius and public tram next door.
Great apartment, and in walking distance to the tram stop, supermarket and local eating places. Perfect for our visit.

Lovely stay in Edinburgh at Malcolm and Beata’s. Great location- especially during Fringe festival. Very clear and easy to follow information and really good to have use of the garage. Hosts were very prompt at communicating and sorting out any issues. Flat was clean and perfect for what we needed!

La estancia en el alojamiento de Skye fue genial.
Todo muy cuidado hasta el ultimo detalle.
Muy buena ubicación para estar en 15 minutos andando del centro. Zona muy tranquila y con todos los servicios que necesarios.
Muy recomendable!

The location of this flat is perfect, a few minutes of walk from Princes Street, there are plenty of coffee shop/ restaurants / grocery shops downstairs. The flat itself is charming, beautiful wood ground, windows with beautiful view on Edinburgh’s roofs. We slept very well the mattress is good quality. Everything necessary is provided and it we enjoyed that convenience. Robin & Lily answered very quickly to our messages. Thank you.
Rent och fint! Helt kök vi kunde använda.

Gorgeous apartment in great location!
Some slight issue with shower but host was quick to say she would sort it!
La recepción de Alistar fue espectacular, y muy agradable.  haberlo conocido fue un placer. muy simpático y muy amable fue con nosotros durante nuestra visita

Friendly, helpful and thoughtful hosts made our stay really great.
Highly recommended! The property is well placed as you could walk to the Omni centre in approximately 10 mins and to the city centre in 20 mins. There are plethora of restaurants, bars and cafes around the area only a short walk away.
Hosts stayed in touch with throughout our stay and made sure our needs are met.

What a fabulous place. From opening the door we were in awe
The place feels like a home already and generally puts you at ease. It's so easy to relax here and with the hifi system being the focal point of the room, you can create a world of your own. The decor is wonderful and combines vintage with modern excellently
Fresh bread, eggs and various other things were provided by Stephen which was a great touch and the private gardens over the road are wonderful. Location is excellent too. A very upmarket area being only around 20 minutes to the royal mile.
Stephen was great with providing information for our trip and we will definitely consider coming back to his place

the apartment was exactly as shown and was perfect for our stay!  bathroom was modern and clean and beds were comfortable. check in isn't until 3 so if you need to drop luggage somewhere head to Waverly train station.
This comfortable and stylish flat gave us everything we needed for our stay in Edinburgh.
