Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Zoé, la chambre est très agréable, l'appartement spacieux. On ne peut pas rêver mieux comme emplacement.
Un grand merci à Zoé pour son accueil !
Great flat and great location. Half mile walk to Holyrood Park to climb Arthur's Seat and 1 mile walk to Royal Mile. Very comfortable and well equipped.

Sharon personally welcomed us (family of four) to her appartment and was very flexible with check-in and check-out, she was very responsive. The apartment was great, sparkling clean and very comfortable. It is very close to downtown Edinburgh but remote enough to not feel in a touristy area. We had a great stay and I totally recommend the place for a weekend or longer period of time.
Graeme did a great job explaining what to do and how close it was to his flat. The location was excellent for sights on the Royal Mile. Thank you for your good communication!

It has been a very good stay in Eleanor's flat.
Eleanor has been extremely helpful in every circumstance, waiting for us after a very late plane.
Extremely quiet and comfortable, Possibility to park a car, easy access to the old town of Edimburgh.
Price is not cheap, as can be expected in the UK

El apartamento en general está bien, pero nosotros fuimos 8 personas y 2 tuvimos que dormir en el sofá cama del salón. El sofá cama fue horroroso, ya que tenía un colchón fino y horrible donde te clavabas todos los hierros. Las demás camas estaban perfectas, por lo que si van hasta 6 personas el apartamento está muy bien.
Had a nice overnight stay at Gary's , really close to all the best bits in Leith. Gary was super welcoming and his flat is quiet and really clean and tidy.

This place was a great find. 20 min walk to all the tourist attractions, just around the corner from multiple restaurants and grocery store, and just next to Haymarket train station. The apartment was clean and everything worked well. Joshua was extremely helpful and friendly. We slept 5 adults and 1 baby very comfortably. Thanks Joshua!
Easy check in process. Great location - walkable to restaurants, shopping, sites.

We stayed at Salma's apartment in October 2024 - whilst visiting our daughter at Edinburgh University.
The apartment is in a beautiful area between The Meadows and Arthur's Seat. It was very easy to walk to the main sites and also wells served by public transport. The area is busy, but relaxed with lots of great restaurants and coffee shops. It's very close to the University.
Salma's apartment is on the 1st floor of a Georgian House. It is stylish and cozy with particularly comfortable bedrooms. The apartment matches the descriptions and photos and was an excellent base for exploring the area. The apartment was very quiet and peaceful.
Salma was super helpful and always responsive. All instructions were clear and we had no problems finding or accessing the property. We didn't have any issues in our stay, but I feel sure Salma would have responded quickly.
Overall we would really recommend this apartment and would book again.
Bra centralt läge. Hyfsat sköna sängar. Lite begränsad med plats för resväskor, annars perfekt för 2 personer.
This is a great apartment in a fantastic location
Great place to stay right at the end of the Royal Mile! Great communication from the host. Parking onsite was a bonus!
Fantastic stay, great location, clean and comfortable apartment, and helpful hosts!
Very beautiful and spacious apartment. Super clean and great location. The host is very friendly and approachable.

David’s unit fully captures all the Edinburgh is! steps from the castle — the building itself even seems partially castle, with the unit being comfortable with modern. The views from right outside the door are amazing of the castle. It was also nice the entrance is on the third floor so it’s only two floors up to the top. I would def reco this unit and would stay again!

We had a great stay in Andrew’s apartment. It’s really clean and comfortable and cosy. Everything has been thought of.
The building itself is great too.
Very good location and an easy stroll into the centre.
Can’t fault anything.

Lovely apartment with a great location to the city centre. All of the amenities that would be needed were provided and it allowed for a great stay in Edinburgh. Deborah was an excellent host being very informative in the lead up to our visit and was very accommodating with our luggage on the morning of us leaving.
so close to airport and handy for a 3 generation family to stay before flying

The place was nice and clean to stay in. A great place to be in the evenings after long days of walking in beautiful Eidenburg. Would highly recommend this place.
Love from Eline.

Pleasant stay - Responsive host, pristinely clean apartment, very well equipped, safe neighbourhood and a convenient location (right opposite the bust stop which reaches Edinburgh City centre in 20 mins or so). As for groceries, there is a Co-Op which is a 5-min walk.
A minor feedback would be that the shower pipe in the common bathroom can be replaced as the water flow was very slow.
In overall, couldn’t recommend more. Well suited for families.

Its a really nice place to stay and very affordable for students for short periods of time, the only con is that they take some time to actually solve any issue. Some locks should be reviewed since they failed often, also for anyone booking here, utensils are available after asking them on reception, no forks and knifes are on the rooms by default, all other appliances are
Fui con mi pareja y nos quedamos 4 días. El apartamento era muy bonito y Rebecca estuvo muy atenta a todas nuestras dudas a lo largo de la estancia

Very comfortable accommodation right in the heart of Rose Street night life of bars and restaurants. Due to the nature of the building, the floors are a little uneven and quite squeaky, and the surrounding night life does create some noise well into the small hours, so light sleepers who aren’t nightowls might want to bring earplugs.
Manigeh es muy amable, y realmente te hace sentir como en casa.❤️

Aufmerksame und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin. Da wir beide eher gross sind, reichte das Bett und Bettwäsche nicht aus. Sie hat uns unkompliziert eine weitere Matratze und eine zusätzliche Bettdecke in die Unterkunft bereitgestellt.
Badetücher dürften etwas grösser sein und pro Person ein Waschlappen.

I can absolutely recommend staying here! The flat is in a great location, close to city centre, right next to a bus stop and less than five minutes of walking from a grocery store.
The apartment was nice and clean and easy to find.
Communication with the host was nice and clear also.
I would definitely come back!

Sevi was on hand to help us as needed and was very gracious. The room we had was very comfortable and even had toiletries in the bathroom. The location was perfect for is as we had only a short time and access to the train station and bus to the airport was important...these were a 5-minute walk away. Walking into the centre of the city took a pleasant 30 minutes, but it was raining so we stopped a few times, might even be quicker on a better day. Highly recommend this place!
Great place

What a lovely apartment in the heart of the Royal Mile.  Well-appointed, immaculate and comfortable. Central to so many sights. Nicola was always helpful and communicative. Of course being this close to the Royal Mile there is bound to be some noise from the street but the new windows do a great job of keeping things quiet in the apartment.  A perfect stay for our first two nights in Scotland!

Appartement propre, avec le nécessaire pour y passer quelques nuits (vaisselle, cuisine équipée, machine à laver, sèche-cheveux...)
Proche du centre d'Edimbourg, à 15 minutes en bus et 25 minutes à pied de Princes Street, facile d'accès et transports à proximité.
Un Lidl est tout proche, très pratique pour y faire quelques courses.

Kilean was great - got us out of a sticky situation where we needed a place last minute. The property is in a very central location with free parking outside. The beds were very comfy and it was so nice to have a garden to sit in! Would definitely stay again if we're back up in Edinburgh.

Fantastic flat in a brilliant location close to city center and all the sights. Groceries, cafes and restaurants right outside. Flat is very bright and airy, lovely views across the rooftops and has everything you need. Great comms as well. Highly recommend and would stay again.
Fiona was a delight to interact with as well.

L'alloggio non si trova vicino al centro di Edimburgo ma è molto comodo da raggiungere con gli autobus. Dall' aeroporto puoi prendere il Nr. 17 che ti lascia a Park Hill Steps, vicino alla fermata c'è un piccolo sentiero che taglia per così direi la collina e ti porta direttamente alla casa di Berry. Se vuoi raggiungere il centro invece puoi prendere il bus nr. 43. Berry è stata carina con noi ed amichevole. Il secondo giorno a Edimburgo che pioveva a dirotto ci ha offerto 2 mantelle antipioggia che sono state provvidenziali!
Valentino's place is much better than expected. The place is clean and fully equipped. Highly recommended.
Waren dort für 5 Tage und es war super. Die Kommunikation lief auch sehr gut

Great location and host very good on communication and responding to questions.
Flat itself is a bit tired. Main bedroom good, second bedroom quite cramped. Very limited clothes storage, no wardrobes.
Edinburgh is a great city to visit, plenty to see and do. Flat is walkable to just about everything.
great place and helpful fun host! fully recommend

Très bon séjour dans ce petit appartement à Edimbourg, situé juste à côté de Hyemarket.
A noter que le lit qui est difficile à supporter. Sinon très bonne communication avec Natalia qui est vraiment adorable, et très réactive. Un très bon rapport qualité prix, pas cher pour Édimbourg qui est une ville magnifique !

Todo bien y la ubicación es muy buena le falta es ventilación y limpieza, el baño se inundo y nadie lo seco. Además de peligroso se veía desaseado. Es bueno que hay recepción 24 horas. Son solo detalles fáciles de manejar pero importantes. La caneca estaba muy llena y eso hacía que hubiera mal olor
Great location and a warm and comfortable space to stay. Really  clear and useful  instructions to get in to the property. Would recommend to friends

Mi spiace dare una valutazione negativa a questo appartamento perché avevamo alte aspettative. Avevamo effettuato la prenotazione a gennaio per soggiornare ad aprile, trovando il prezzo con un’alta percentuale di sconto. Abbiamo chiesto a David di poter posare da lui i bagagli prima del check-in ma ci è stato risposto che non aveva possibilità e che potevamo usufruire di un deposito bagagli (dandoci un codice sconto), ci aveva detto che ci avrebbe fatto sapere se potevamo effettuare un check-in anticipato ma non ci è poi stato comunicato nulla, e un’ora circa prima dell’orario di check-in ci ha cancellato la prenotazione spiegandoci che la casa era inagibile (no acqua calda), causandoci non pochi disagi in quanto era tutto organizzato anche in base alla posizione e ai comfort dell’alloggio (cucina, soggiorno), e anche per il fatto che abbiamo dovuto perdere tempo a riprenotare e cercare una sistemazione per il giorno stesso a prezzi decisamente più elevati data la scarsa disponibilità.
A very nice apartment well connected to the city center, Elisa was very quick to respond whenever we needed help. Thank you!

Another lovely stay in Edinburgh's New Town. The flat was a home from home.  Very comfortable with the welcome addition of a Nespresso machine.  Allowed me a leisurely cup of coffee overlooking  the back garden.

Superleuk appartement op een toplocatie! Veel leuke restaurants en winkels in de buurt zonder dat je er 's avonds last van hebt. Groot appartement van alle gemakken voorzien. Het enige kleine minpuntje was dat de gordijnen niet (makkelijk) dicht gingen.

Positives:
A beautiful studio space in the heart of the city. David's clearly put a lot of effort into the decor of the place and it pays off! Finding the key is a little tricky as you have to go to another road to get it and so a bit of a hassle however David's instructions were very clear. The location is brilliant- easy to get to anything and just a very short walk over the bridge to the main city. David was very responsive.
"Negatives":
In inverted commas as not necessarily everyone's negatives. David informed us on the morning of check in that the underfloor heating wasn't working since 10 days ago and he had two small portable heaters for us. He failed to mention that the underfloor heating is the only heating, and the heaters for us did not suffice as we were not in enough to heat the home. Also there are no curtains and the wall to the bedroom is not to the ceiling. Cue bright shop fronts beaming into the house and little privacy. There's also no ceiling lights, just lamps.

Good location, easy access to the city centre, nice views from the living area.
Host very responsive and helpful.
Modern apartment with all you need for a comfortable stay.
It was really near the great spots
super commutative, fast responder, great experience
Fantastic host,  very responsive!
Lovely spacious apartment with plenty of space for socialising (we were a group of 7). Super comfy beds, great location and great tips from our hosts. Thanks for a great stay!
Excelente lugar, lo recomiendo bastante. Es como estar en casa, muy cómodo. Grande . No tengo queja alguna. Al contrario gracias por el alojamiento. Volveré allí nuevamente.
Clean and spacious private room. Great communication from Laila, thank you!
Highly recommend. Great location and wonderful hospitality.

Gareth and Fiona‘s place was amazing for our first visit to Edinburgh! The flat was just as described and the hosts were proactive and clear communicators. After long days of exploring, it was so nice to come back to the flat and have a comfortable place to rest and reset.
The flat is in a quiet neighborhood but also within decent walking distance of everything.
I highly recommend staying here - you won’t be disappointed!
Everything was just as advertised. Simon was responsive and helpful. Very nice stay!

Beautiful apartment situated in a perfect location! Decorated perfectly and with everything you need! Super comfortable and great features such as the TV, bath and storage closet! we would stay again in a heartbeat and would recommend it to anyone going to Edinburgh!
Nice place

We stayed ar Chris' apartment for our first night in Ediinburgh. Since our flight was late in the evening this was perfect, because the apartment is close to the airport.
The room was cozy, bed and especially the pillows were super comfy and everything was perfectly clean.
Chris is a great host, chatted with us in the morning and helped us to get a cab/uber. We can highly recommend staying with Chris. Everything was perfect.

The flat is superbly located for the Castle and Royal Mile, with everything you could need for a stay in Edinburgh. James and Sindy were great at keeping us informed before and during our stay - thanks so much!
Great stay thank you. lovely accommodation and area. Communication was excellent. We would definitely stay here again.
Wir können diese Unterkunft nur empfehlen, verlief alles einwandfrei

Wir hatten einen wundervollen Aufenthalt in Edinburgh.
Das AirBnB ist in super zentraler Lage und man kann alles zu Fuß erreichen. Es ist trotzdem recht ruhig und man hat einen tollen Ausblick.
Das Zimmer und das Bad waren sehr sauber und gemütlich.
Patrick war ein wundervoller Gast, immer erreichbar und hatte einige Tipps für uns.
Danke!
Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
Really great house, ample room for everyone, luxurious feel and helpful host.  Would recommend! Thanks for a great venue - it made for a brilliant weekend
Great base in the bustling area of Stockbridge. The flat had everything we needed - including space for bikes in the bottom hallway. We enjoyed our stay and loved being so close to everything
We will be back for sure! Had such a great stay and Niamh was such a lovely host! Great location, great room, all you could need really!

The apartment was open, bright and clean! Great location to get to the main sites downtown either by walking or bus. The host was super responsive to all of our questions and requests. Would recommend this apartment for families!

Even though the place looks exactly like the photos, we were still blown away when we walked in. It’s a beautiful space with high ceilings. Impeccably clean. The flat is located on a street that is blocked off to traffic on one end (there’s permit parking on the street), so it’s very quiet. Just a short walk to restaurants and Calton Hill. We walked everyday into Old Town and surrounding areas. We hired a parking space nearby through Just Park and left it there for the whole trip.
The beds were comfy and everything smelled fresh and clean. The water pressure in both showers was great. We had our toddler with us and the flat was equipped with a crib, highchair, kids’ plates, bowls, and cutlery. This space is perfect for all sorts of travelers since it has 2 bed/2 bath.
Our only issue was a (very) weak Wi-Fi signal and spotty cell coverage in the flat, which really wasn’t that big of a deal for us.
We’d love to stay here again!

Couldn’t have been happier with my stay here. The house was lovely, everything from the bedding to the soap in the bathroom was incredibly high quality. Location was fantastic and the host was welcoming and helpful. I would highly recommend a stay here.

Absolutely love this place. We have stayed here twice now and will return again soon.
Well decorated, spotlessly clean & ideal location with free parking.
15 min walk to Princess Street and plenty of shops , cafes within a 1-2 minute walk from the flat.

Vale la pena!! Fuimos 8 y descansamos muy bien, buenos baños y duchas (3 y 3)
Espacio de comedor y sala. Cocina pequeña, pero con lo necesario.
La ubicación fue perfecta, a 1 cuadra de la estación de autobuses y a 2 de trenes (Princess St)… a 3 cuadras de la Royal Mile.
Lo que nos permitió hacer todo caminando.
Great place, would go back!!
We had the pleasure of being hosted here. The apartment is super comfortable and cozy. Very tidy and easily accessible. The children enjoyed the pool. Amazing host!

The flat was in an excellent location in central Edinburgh. Isla was very helpful and prompt in replying to any messages. The flat was spacious and well furnished with a lot of character. We would definitely stay there again next time we are in Edinburgh!

John's place is absolutely wonderful. John was very warm and welcoming host and we were made to feel right at home. He welcomed us with tea and muffins which was very kind of him. We were glad to have met his lovely daughter and pet. Very warm and gracious host.
The room was exactly as shown in pictures. Very cozy and comfortable and the bed was excellent. It had all amenities required. Our stay was absolutely wonderful and we would 100% recommend it to everyone .
Juan was very friendly and helpful! We had a great time in Edinburgh.
Lovely interior with a beautiful location - Julie was always promptly available for questions.

This is a perfectly appointed, timelessly elegant, gem of an apartment.
The beds are gorgeous, the kitchen is perfect, spacious, light and the location is unbeatable for anything you want to do in Edinburgh.
I could have happily moved in and stayed forever. Perfect.
Appartamento comodo e molto carino con bagni nuovi. Posizione centralissima e servitissima anche da e per aeroporto.

Really well equipped apartment in a convenient location. We found absolutely everything we needed in there. You can tell the host goes the extra mile to accommodate any needs and make you feel at home.
I would totally recommend it to anyone visiting Edinburgh!
Very nice place.
nice place, close to center

Nice litte room in city center with it's private batroom. Perfect for a few days. The shared kitchen was handy too.
To enter with the keypads is easy and makes the check in very simple and flexible.
From our window we coud see the castle from one dircetion and the bay in the other :)
I would absolutely recommend the place.

It is a very nice flat, really cozy and vintage. Everything was as described and Rebecca is an excellent hostess. Very friendly and willing to help us with every inquiry we had. The neighborhood is quiet and close to the city centre exactly as we wanted it to be.

Thanks!!!
Spyros - Vassia
Enjoyed our stay. Lovely, quiet neighborhood with grocery stores and restaurants. Would stay here again!

Ryan’s place was a nice central location for our stay in Edinburgh. However it was quite small and we did not realise the space was shared. I feel this should be made clearer on the listing. As it’s listed as apartment then room once clicked onto it.
Overall it did its job for our one night stay over.

A great place to stay while in Edinburgh. Whether you need a place to self-isolate or a base to explore the city, I would highly recommend Lynne's place. Honestly can't think of any downsides.  Lynne was an extremely helpful host, going above and beyond to ensure I had a comfortable stay.

The accommodation is immaculate and even nicer than in the photos.
The hosts were absolutely lovely and very helpful.
It’s in a great location for exploring Edinburgh.
We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them!

The flat is elegant, clean, and tastefully furnished with high ceilings. The kitchen is very spacious and modern. The location is convenient to Edinburgh center with many local pubs, but just beyond the big crowds.
We had a great stay with a family of four. The only surprise is there there is no freezer, despite the beautiful kitchen renovation. We shopped in advance and arrived with frozen food, so it would be helpful to emphasize this unusual aspect in the listing.

Thank you so much for providing such a stunning accommodation for my family and me during our recent stay. Your home truly surpassed our expectations and stands out as one of the most beautiful places we've had the pleasure of staying in. The attention to detail in the decor and amenities made our experience unforgettable. From the moment we stepped through the door, we were greeted with warmth and comfort. Your hospitality and the beauty of your home made our trip all the more memorable. We can't wait to return in the future!
Nice little place in good area

Very comfortable apartment not too far from city center. It was quiet and peaceful. Comfortable beds. Downstairs bathroom is a bit different as the shower isn’t walled off but it wasn’t a problem for us. Decorated very nice with plenty of seating for the 5 of us. Cute patio area out back too. Easy to get Ubers to city center and not far from the airport.

We had a wonderful stay here. The location was ideal, with easy walkability to the Royal Mile, which made exploring Edinburgh so convenient. The views were beautiful, and the accommodation was absolutely pristine, with everything thoughtfully maintained.
We were a group of 8, four couples, and it was perfect for us. Each of us had a lovely room with an ensuite bathroom, which made the stay even more comfortable. We would recommend this property 100%.

This flat was very comfortable for the two of us. Bedroom was comfortable and dark for sleeping. Upstairs kitchen and living room were very spacious. Very convenient to have ground floor flat. Location is really nice and safe, walkable to tons of shops, cafes and restaurants and easy bus access.

Absolute bargain for a charming room in a great location.
Easy to get to and from all the best spots. Quiet road with sounds from the river helping us to drift off to sleep
Host was very responsive and polite

Karen has an amazing flat located centrally next to the Royal Mile with an amazing view of the castle from almost every room in the flat. The flat was clean, welcoming, and Karen offered several tips and recommendations that turned out to be just what we needed. We had a great time here and would certainly come back again.

Good: comfortable mattress on bed, quiet neighbourhood, good size flat, basic amenities all provided and worked. Quirky decor.
Disappointments: Inaccuracies in online description: bed wasn't super king-size (only 5'), walking distances were all underestimates (see Google maps for more accurate times), not an easy walk into town as it requires walking up a steep hill, no personal welcome from Rebecca (keys are kept in locked box outside the front door. You get the access code by email the day before). Access to garden difficult as door lock very stiff.

Enjoyed a great one night stay. Fantastic location and ideally situated for events at Murrayfield.
Margaret was a lovely host and was very responsive.
A really nice stay. Clear instructions of how to get inside and in a really nice part of the city.

Our plan was to spend 2 days in Edinburgh before heading out to the highlands. When we arrived (early) John (might be spelled wrong) met us at the door and was wonderfully gracious. He gave a tour explained breakfast, then handed us the keys. I have to say our room was huge and more than enough for the 3 of us.
However, the next morning my husband woke up with a sore throat so he took a Covid test and it was positive. I immediately went to John and explained the situation and that we would be checking out. His whole family lived in this house and it would not be responsible to stay and sicken the family. He was incredibly kind and appreciated our reasons for leaving. And I do believe he was genuinely upset for us having to halt our vacation for a week while my husband recovers.
Now we will definitely come back to Scotland and will stay here when we do. Sharon and John made such a wonderful impression on us, and we can’t wait to try and stay here again!

Very nice apartment in the best location in central Edinburgh. Clean, friendly and modern decor with plenty of space for a part of 4 girls. Would definitely come back to this apartment on my next trip!

Angie's apartment is truly a gem to find. The apartment is very well equipped and is in a very excellent location. Its proximity to the city center, to shopping, and to the castle make it easy to fit in many different activities into your plan, even if you don't have many days to enjoy Edinburgh. The most striking of everything though was the warm welcome that Angie provided personally in explaining everything to do in the area and answering all questions regarding the home. Angie provided me and my group with some local food and drinks that washed away the fatigue from our day of traveling. Excellent host and an excellent property all around!

We had a wonderful stay at Emma’s and would 100% recommend! Emma was a great host and was very quick to respond to messages. The room itself is absolutely lovely -  very quiet, clean and has everything you need. It is in a great location and the perfect place to stay during a trip to Edinburgh. Thank you Emma and we very much hope to stay again in the future!
Though perhaps fairly basic and small, the apartment was well situated near Foot of the Walk Tram stop and on a few minutes walk to historic Leith oceanfront.

Lovely flat in a great location. Facilities are spot on and the flat lovely and clean and warm. Spacious and everything to make it home from home. Very thoughtful touches such as bread and milk on arrival and a box of chocolates. Would definitely recommend and I will be booking again.
Lovely flat. Great location.

This flat exudes luxury and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful stay with family or friends. We were so comfortable whether we were lounging in front of the fireplace after a rainy afternoon walk, sitting around the dining table for wine and cheese we purchased around the corner, or curling up in one of the comfy beds. This flat was convenient to the trains in Waverly, the tram stop at West End and just walking to many of Edinburgh's many sites.
We would definitely book it again; it was so perfect for us.

Had a wonderful stay at Fiona and Stevie's. They are excellent hosts. The listing is exactly as described and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Easy access to and from the city center - 20 mins by foot or a quick bus ride and there are many bus options. I will definitely be back here my next trip to Edinburgh.

This is a place where you walk in and you feel at home! Loved the location of it, the spacious room, well equipped kitchen, the plants and the incredible tea selection! If anything, we wanted to stay longer and we will be back :)

Anthony’s apartment was spotless with everything you might need. We arrived on a cold afternoon and the apartment was warm and inviting. There were two bathrooms which was a real bonus.
I’d highly recommend a stay at Anthony’s apartment.
The tram at Haymarket was about a ten minute walk away and only two stops to Princes Street. We visited the Castle and the Christmas market and enjoyed delicious meals at cafes. I would advise visitors to book a lunch slot in advance as they were all busy. I’d also recommend a visit to Bruntsfield Place where we found a great choice of excellent cafes and independent shops.

Susan and Roni's place was perfect for our short stay, but would be great for a longer trip as well! The apartment has everything you would need (including biscuits and some sneaky milk for tea) and is truly in a fabulous location. Susan was so attentive to our messages regarding check in, recommendations, and anything else that came up. This place is definitely on our short list for our next stay in Edinburgh!
Great flat! One of my favorite spots I’ve stayed. I felt right at home. The it has everything you need!
The apartment was lovely to stay in and in a really great location for everything. Couldn't stop looking out of the window at the view of the castle! The Old Town is really special.

My best friend & I had a lovely stay at Morris's apartment. Perfectly located & central to where we needed to be. Fabulous restaurants close by & handy to drop our Christmas shopping bags off before heading back out.
It was clean & well thought about. Beautiful big rooms & well equipped kitchen.
My only 1 small thing I can think off that would be very well appreciated, would be a small milk for a well needed cup of tea when you arrive.
Thank you again Morris for a lovely stay.

This was the first time my parents stayed at an Airbnb, and it couldn’t have gone better. The home was immaculately clean, well-equipped, and felt warm and welcoming from the moment we arrived. Everything we needed for a comfortable stay was thoughtfully provided.
The location is incredibly convenient — just a 5-minute walk to the nearest bus stop with direct connections to Edinburgh city centre, which made getting around effortless. There are also a couple of grocery stores nearby, perfect for quick meals or essentials.
One of the standout features for us was the private parking with direct access into the home — a huge bonus, especially since we had luggage and were on a longer road trip. The place was also easy to find, which made the arrival stress-free.
Highly recommend this Airbnb for anyone visiting Edinburgh. We’ll absolutely be rebooking when we return. A great experience from start to finish!

We have had a lovely few nights away at Emanuel's place. The apartment is lovely with so much art on the walls, we loved everything about it. We wanted to explore Edinburgh with our dogs and we are so glad we found Emanuel's apartment, walking distance to the centre and perfect for the walk up to Arthurs seat. Thanks so much.

Perfect apartment in an ideal location, not too far away and not too close to all the noise. Could not recommend this place enough with such a wonderful host going above and beyond. We are really grateful for such an amazing experience of Edinburgh!!

This place was great and very clean when we arrived. It was in a good location in Edinburgh and we really enjoyed our stay in the city. I really recommend this place as it’s a walking distance to all the monuments in Edinburgh.

Armando was an EXCELLENT host who met us along the way to show us where the apartment was.  He was most helpful in directing us to attractions and restaurants in town and spent a lot of time introducing us to Edinburgh.  The flat was well equipped, large and fit its description very well.  The location of the flat was fabulous and we couldn't have been happier with our stay.
Ideal place for 2 people. Cute, cozy and great location!  Short walk from multiple bus stops, a cute park, acess to the Union Canal, and many shops and restaurants! Would love to stay again!
place was tidy and as pictured. Great location, host communicated well.

Two points of information: the attic bedroom is small and on a separate floor without a bathroom. Tall people will need to watch their heads. One of the bathrooms is en-suite and very small. So the other 3 rooms essentially end up sharing the larger bathroom.

Wonderful time in Edinburgh, Catherine is vers welcoming. Her appartment is very well-located.
I could only recommend to stay at her place when you're travelling to this city.
Super place.  Hugely helpful host.  Ideal place for a stay to explore Edinburgh.

Great spacious cosy apartment close to city centre. Can walk to royal mile in five minutes. Handy private car park off the main road. Full use of many appliances throughout the apartment. Would definitely recommend to friends and family. Would happily stay again.
Thanks.

The apartment is very tastefully decorated, with a good use of space and was sufficient for our needs for a few nights in Edinburgh. The flat has free parking which was plentiful and is withing walking distance to many central spots (approx 35-40mins), we did use taxis to get to most places however. Perfect little getaway in a location just outside of the central hustle and bustle! Thanks very much

Reggie was our first experience with Airbnb. We were so glad we picked her place. She is a great host. he room was big, roomy, clean, and a great view to the back gardens. Her neighborhood was safe, with lots of good places to eat and a Tesco if you want to pick something up to bring back to the room. The center of town was not far at all. If you are going to Edinburgh, this is the way to go. PS - we have travelled the world and have stayed at top hotels, this is so much more personal. Thanks Reggie!
Very convenient location and large space. The host was proactive in providing information and very responsive. Overall, great spot!

The dovecot was an absolute dream! We have been planning this trip for years and it was everything we could have imagined--clean, beautiful, historical. The gardens were stunning and Sarah was an amazing host. It was a central location where we could easily walk to downtown Edinburgh, but you would never know with how calm, safe, and peaceful it was. Thank you for a lovely stay!!

The airb&b was a great. Victor was always happy to answer any questions I had about parking and the area. The house was lovely and perfectly as described. Would stay here again and recommend to a friend.

We hebben een fijn verblijf gehad in dit appartement. Het was schoon genoeg en bood alles wat we nodig hadden. De ligging was ideaal: midden in het centrum, maar net in een rustiger gedeelte, waardoor we alles goed konden bereiken en toch prettig konden slapen. Al met al een aanrader!

What a great find. Everything you need with added extras through out the flat. Well equipped kitchen with a welcomed milk, tea/coffee and biscuits too. Comfortable and spacious bedroom. 10 mins walk to the centre. Cafe opposite with lovely coffee etc.. . Lots of restaurants with in a few minutes walk from the flat.

Fabulous host and lovely property. We had to rehouse guests and Farah came to ours and their rescue.
Thank you

Charlotte made us feel home away from home straight away! The room and the entire appartment are spotless, clean, cozy and welcoming. The neighbourhood is quiet but you're still just a few steps away from the buzzling city center - great location!

Andrew was very nice and said we can leave our luggage once the previous guest left. My complaint is that the apartment was not cleaned. The bathroom had pee stained on the toilet, the floors were dirty, no one swept, and mopped. We can tell that only the garbage was removed and bed was made. The apartment also needs maintenance and at least hangers since there are no closets to store your things.

Karen estuvo atent@ a todo lo que necesitamos en la estancia, incluso hubo un pequeño problema con la luz y nos atendió sin problemas siendo fin de año y más de las 12 de la noche.
Gracias Karen

This is a fantastic place in a great location. Just like a fairytale. Fantastic for a short stay or a longer trip!
Loved my stay. My only issue was not being able to control the tv volume and it being very quiet. Otherwise perfect!

We stayed at the apartment as a couple for 3 nights.
The location is excellent! About a 25-minute pleasant walk to the city centre through the main street, or around 10 minutes by bus, with a bus stop just a 3-minute walk from the apartment.
The apartment itself is spacious, comfortable, and well-equipped, and the kitchen has everything you might need for a pleasant stay.
Overall, amazing value for money
Excelente ubicacion!

The appartement is well located, plenty of space, beautiful and close to Stockbridge, a lively neighbourhood.
We had a great time at Craig’s place.

A lovely apartment with all the facilities to make it a home from home. Ideal for families . It is clean and warm with everything you would need. The location was very good- close to Holyrood Palace and on the Royal Mile yet quiet. It could not have been better.

Our visit was during Edinburgh Fringe and the Military Tattoo. The location was super convenient for participation in both. It was also (expectedly) noisy with revelers at night but mostly they were happy revelers so we still felt very safe.  Really could not have asked for more! Thank you Graeme.
Great deal during Fringe and easy to locate with nearby transit options.

Warm eingerichtete Wohnung in guter Lage. Die Gastgeberin war sehr freundlich und bemüht.
Es ist ein offenes Raumkonzept, bei denen das eine Schlafzimmer mit einem Vorhang vom Flur getrennt ist und das andere mit Lamellentür.
Wir haben uns von Anfang an in der Wohnung wohl gefühlt und unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen. Wir empfehlen die Wohnung wärmsten weiter.

An absolutely wonderful stay. A great array of amenities allowed us to travel light which we really appreciated! The apartment was incredibly clean and tidy and we instantly felt at home. A great location ~10 mins from the tram and ~5 mins from an Aldi which was very convenient for us.
We had everything we needed for our stay and would definitely return.
Luc was rapidly responsive when we needed communication and we loved staying here! Thank you, Luc ! 🌟

Good and cozy apartment that’s located in a good and alive neighborhood. The location was also good for everything you want to do as a tourist. There’s not a lot to complain about other than the kitchen felt dirty because plates and cutlery haven’t been washed properly and there was crumbs and sticky stuff on it. The host was very helpful and always quick to answer whenever questions came up.
Karthik was helpful and responsive. the location was good and very near to bus stand with multiple bus connections. the house was nice and good for short stay. the cat Polo was very cute.
An excellent place to stay when visiting Edinburgh. In a quiet area but close to all the attractions and transport links. Hope to stay again in the future!
卡尔顿山脚下的这个大宅非常漂亮，干净整齐，出行方便，周围环境优美。
Super fin bolig. Den eneste grund til den ikke får 5 stjerner, er fordi den umiddelbart ligger længere fra centrum, end der står i opslaget. Det var fint for os, men lidt misvisende 😀

One of the most comfortable places we have ever stayed. Quiet, but easy and quick to get anywhere in the city, including to and from the airport. Jana and Kash were so helpful. Lots of local information and ideas of things to see and places to go. it was nice that there is a great food store only 150m away. There was also a good little Scottish take-away nearby. We arrived in Edinburgh mid-morning but Jana and Kash worked hard to get us checked in just after lunch, even though the room had been just vacated that morning. (thank you for that) We would recommend Jana and Kashs place to anyone, especially if you're looking for a nice place to stay while you spend a week or so in Edinburgh.
Super endroit, propre et complet, je recommande

Een prachtige locatie i
bij het Centrum.
Alleen hadden we het erg koud verwarming kon niet worden aangezet.
We hadden dit ook niet gemeld omdat we maar weinig in het appartement waren.

Irene was a wonderful host! She even stayed back although she was getting late for work when we arrived. The room was clean and ready for us to crash into after our long flight, and Irene took time to walk us through all the amenities, Wifi, etc. She was really warm and welcoming and even offered us freshly baked cookies :D

Would love to stay again. Thank you so much Irene!
You will not be disappointed!

Very beautiful, comfortable and versatile space. Absolutely brilliant location from which to explore Edinburgh. Welcoming host who was knowledgable & helpful. Comfy bed, kitchen kitted-out for self catering & shop nearby to help facilitate that too; equally there is a great range of restaurants in comfortable walking distance. Note - not accessible for all, multiple flights of steep stairs to get to the flat (but if you can climb them then do, view is worth it!). Thanks Charlotte

Appartement confortable à deux pas de la plage. Accès facile aux attractions et activités d'Édimbourg. Les hôtes sont supers sympathiques. Il y a tous les commodités dont vous aurez besoin. Beau cachet. On s'y sent comme à la maison.

Boti and Monia were amazing hosts! We arrived into town earlier than check in and they were flexible and able to accommodate us last minute. They greeted us with a warm welcome. The room was clean, large and had natural light. The home was spotless and comfortable. The bus stop to get directly into the city and to the airport was extremely close. Only a few minutes walk. We had a lovely and relaxing stay and would recommend their home to the Airbnb community.
Great apartment just a quick bus ride from the city center. Lots of amenities to make you feel at home with some good restaurants close by. Definitely recommend for your stay in Edinburgh!

Great quaint house in a great location.
Super commutation from Julie. Bottle of fresh milk waiting for us on arrival.
Will use again for sure.

Petit logement, conforme aux photos et à la description. Un peu loin du centre historique d’Edimbourg, mais proche de Carlton Hill et le trajet est faisable à pied largement.
Je préciserais seulement : pensez à mettre en route le bouton de l’eau chaude à l’avance si vous désirez prendre une douche chaude !
Sinon c’était parfait !
Logement bien équipé, proche de centre ! Bei est une bonne hôte

Amazing view of the Grassmarket, Castle. Very sunny apartment and if you stay up late enough the moon is visible as you lounge. Magical place! Well stocked kitchen. Close to everything on Edinburgh. So grateful to the hosts for sharing their space. Much love & peace to you and your family!!

After the initial disappointment of not being able to access the apartment when promised, we enjoyed the apartment once we gained entry. The apartment is on the top floor of the building and the elevator wasn’t working so if you have difficulty with stairs, you might look elsewhere.
Having said that, the apartment is lovely, spacious and well appointed. It’s about a 15 minute walk to the Old Town

The description definitely fits the place. It was perfectly accommodating for two people just as the reviews had said. It was in a good location easy to get around. And the host was pretty prompt with responding which was helpful when asking questions. Would recommend.

Merci à Louise pour sa gentillesse et sa réactivé. Le logement était superbe et conforme. La communication avant, pendant était parfait également et nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cette magnifique maison!

A lovely apartment, that is well presented in a great location for the centre of Edinburgh.
Nice touches like tea, coffee and dishwasher tablets make such a positive difference for a short break.
Wouldn’t hesitate to go back.

Ground floor flat which felt spacious and light. The front room is very large. We didn't use the kitchen so couldn't comment on stocking/equipment there. No curtains in the bedroom but the shutters did work very well (once we'd figured out how to prize them open as not immediately obvious). The location is the best bit about this flat, walkable from waverley in 15-20 minutes into stockbridge in similar with plenty of restaurants, cafes, shops, inverleith park etc. We had no issues with cold, there are extra heaters if needed. Small freeview TV but hopefully that's not the main focus of visiting Edinburgh...
Amazing location and comfortable apartment. Had everything we needed. Appreciated the little touches such as suggestions of local restaurants and bars to visit. Would definitely stay again!
Immaculate, stylish, gorgeous!  So we’ll laid out, so we’ll equipped.  We will return!

The Albert home is a very cozy apartment and extremely convenient for reaching the center either on foot or by public transport.
The only critical aspect is the condominium, which does not seem well maintained.
However, this will not prevent us from choosing the Albert home again
The apartment was exactly as advertised in the photos. Location was excellent, we were able to visit almost everywhere by walking distance.

Jean es muy buen anfitrión. Nos dejó ingresar antes a dejar las valijas y pasar al baño. Luego me avisó cuando el departamento estuviera listo (fue antes del horario de check in). Súper servicial, responde rápidamente, está en todos los detalles. El departamento es más lindo que en fotos. Todo muy limpio, impecable, no había nada fuera de lugar. Además, está súper completo, no nos hizo falta nada. La calefacción excelente, hay Lavarropas y tender para colgar la ropa. Las camas cómodas, las sábanas impecables. El baño reluciente, con shampoo y acondicionador. Hay aceite y condimentos, lo indispensable para cocinar. La ubicación es muy buena, cerca del castillo y de la calle Grassmarket, que va directo a Victoria street. Ideal para ir caminando a la mayoría de las atracciones . A una cuadra hay un supermercado (sainsbury’s). Está a 10 minutos en taxi de la estación de tren. Si volviera algún día a Edimburgo, sin dudas me hospedaría nuevamente aquí.
Todo muy bien, la zona es algo retirada de la parte antigua de la ciudad pero la escogimos el último día para regresar a tiempo al aeropuerto.

This property was in a convenient location close to many restaurants and things to do. The flat itself was noisier than expected. Also, there were a few maintenance things that were left to be done such as working lightbulbs, toilet paper holder missing.

This is a lovely place surrounded with peaceful neighbor. Easyto acces with public transport nearby. Nice groceries and restaurants are in the walking range. The house is very cute, clean, and well equiped furniture.  The host, Viktoria, is very helpful, kind hospitality with all support instructions.  Highly recommended place for all visitors and  I will stay here again next time.
Final was always available for any help that we needed. the room was really clean and the location was centrally located, just 3 miles from the city center

I want to come back to Edinburgh just to stay at this Airbnb. It felt like home, was comfortable, close to multiple bus routes, and has amazing hosts. They provided some basic food items and left water bottles & chocolates that we are now completely obsessed with.

Roland's flat is beautiful and very cosy - we had a great weekend and would definitely stay again! Has everything you need to make it feel like a home from home. Everything is in walking distance and it's on a very pretty street in a non-touristy neighbourhood. We followed Roland's suggestion for the nearby Turkish and it was delicious!

Magda's place is lovely and practical. We got what we expected from the pictures and a great deal in value for money. It is a nice 20 minutes walk or the quickest bus ride away from the center of Edinburgh, and you also have restaurants and late supermarkets in the neighborhood. The building itself could be better maintained.

Thank you Prayas for the most wonderful stay! The apartments was super clean comfortable, well equipped  and a great central location. Very easy to book and Prayas was very helpful with any question that arose .We loved it so much we have booked another week later this year !
Eva was an excellent host who gave me tonnes of incredibly helpful recommendations!! The room itself is great and very well located to explore Edinburgh, would highly recommend

Gerry is a fantastic host! Such a friendly man who is willing to go out of his way to help you. Also, the bed was very comfortable! It was a cosy place to stay, close to public transportation and in walking distance of the main tourist areas.

The apartment ist perfectly located in the Old Town of Edinburgh, most sights are a reachable in a footwalk. The apartment is clean and well equipped. Communication was always good and friendly with quick response.
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean and was situated perfectly for walking everywhere we wanted to visit. Also having Tesco nearby was a great plus. I’d definitely stay here again :)

Vivien certainly is a superhost.
She and her family gave us a warm welcome and her beautiful property ticked all the boxes. Spotlessly clean and equiped with everything we needed. The outside decking area was a perfect suntrap in the afternoon and evening to enjoy a glass of wine. The property's location was ideal and all the attractions of Edinburgh were within easy walking distance. Having a private parking space was also a huge bonus. We will definitely be returning.

L appartement est très fonctionnel - très propre - bien situé - bien desservi par les bus et proches de magasins alimentaires - les instructions d entrée étaient très claires - nous avons apprécié notre séjour chez Valentino et nous le remercions vivement - nous recommandons ce logement

The accommodation was lovely.
We were delighted to stay in this apartment.
very good location close to all momuments and downtown.
I recommend
lovely big house for our family of 6. fantastic location,  easy to walk to shops and restaurants. easy to get buses into city. felt like home

Our stay at Amanda’s was great! The place was perfect for us to walk to cafes and restaurants. It was also a great location for us to walk to tourist locations like Edinburgh Castle. We traveled with our 15 month old and Amanda was very accommodating. The pack and play crib and high chair were a huge help. Thank you for having us!

Fantastic apartment quite close to the centre of Edinburgh. Plenty of space for 6/8 people. All the mod cons. The host made us feel very welcome. Would highly recommend but just to add, there are quite a few steps up to the top floor.
Great place in a great location! Emily was also very friendly, helpful and responsive. We’d love to stay here again next time we visit.

Wir hatten eine fantastische Zeit in Edinburgh. Die Unterkunft ist perfekt gelegen, ruhig aber zentral. Emma war sehr freundlich und das Zimmer ist eine Ruheoase in der Stadt.
Das Zimmer ist absolut so wie auf den Fotos, sehr sauber und gemütlich.
Danke Emma, das wir deine Gäste sein durften!
Lovely people, lovely stay.

Oh My..The room is amazing and the welcome and ambience are incredible.  We wish we could have had longer to appreciate the art and atmosphere and beauty.  So fortunate to have had the opportunity to share this beautiful home. Thank you so much 🙏

Gosia’s place is lovely, aesthetic, comfortable, near to bus stop, everything was perfect!!
Thanks for hosting us :)
A very well located hidden gem. Equipped with everything you need to be able to explore Edinburgh. Well decorated and comfortable.
Beautiful little place. Super clean & very conveniently central for sightseeing in Edinburgh. Pristine bathroom & kitchen.

The apartment was exactly as described - clean, modern and well designed. We only stayed a night but it was very comfortable. It is a short but uphill walk into town, so slightly off the main city area but in reality only 15mins coming back from princes street if we didn't take a wrong turn and got lost! My only gripe was that there wasn't much privacy without putting the curtains down but it was such a quiet street off the main road and we spent most of the day out! Very handy folder left out by Sharon and John about nearby walks, attractions, amenities and places to eat!
Had a lovely stay, thanks Erin x

Martin's apartment is absolutely beautiful- spotlessly clean, in a fantastic location right in the middle of everything yet very quiet and peaceful at night.
Martin was the perfect host and had thought of everything down to the last detail to make our stay as seamless and enjoyable as possible.
I will stay here again on future trips and can't recommend highly enough .
Modern, spacious apartment. Great location and helpful communication with host before our stay. Would stay here again

I can recommend this hostel. It's right next to the railway station. The staff was very nice and the rooms and showers were clean and the bed comftrable.
I stayed in the 8 bed women only and felt very safe there. It was perfect for a 1 night stay!

This was a 'gem' of a find. There is free parking in the street outside the property or nearby. Once inside the propety is clean, tidy and spacious. The beds are really comfortable as is the lounge area, we certainly felt at home and comfortable for the 4 days we were there. The kitchen is small but has everything you need and the bathroom is practicle with a bath and over bath shower. Everything you see in the photos is how it is!
Giles is responsive although as he is a serving Officer in the army it may take a while for him to respond but that didn't affect us at all.
All in all we were very happy with the great location, shops and restaurants nearby as is The Royal Yacht Brittania, trams and buses. And great value for money.
Thanks Giles!
Lovely spacious apartment within walking distance to everything! Great little pub/restaurant across the street!
Great place, excellent location. Definitely will stay on my next trip !!

Everything was simply great. Luna was so cute too. We liked our stay and it was very comfortable. The flat was very clean, however when the hosts cooked, the whole flat smelled. And on the last day, their guest used our bathroom even though it was supposed to be our private bathroom. But besides these two details we enjoyed our stay.
Great location and great home base to explore Edinburgh!

Warm and welcoming,
Our host’s apartment was clean and well appointed. The washing machine was a plus as was the large screen TV. She checked in on us through the Air BnB messaging. Access to the city was by bus, simple and easy. I highly this Air BnB
Valentino est un hôte tres réactif et accueillant, son appart est tres facile d’acces et proche des centres d’interet. ( tram, bus ).

we had a lovely stay and overall it was very clean, apart from a dusty picture rail.
the kitchen was fine but we struggled to get the oven to work so just used the hob.
would also recommend a Cork screw as I couldn't find one for my bottle of wine.
it was very quiet and we had no problems sleeping at night. everything is accessible such as buses etc and on one night walked to the Pier House for lovely fish and chips and lovely views of the sea. we found a parking space outside no problem and left the car to get buses, but it does get busy so plan for this.
overall we had a lovely stay and would recommend instead of a hotel.

Host was very helpful and responsive
Flat within easy walking distance of shops and bus to Princes Street. Flat had everything you needed and was very clean.
Carol's place was a great place to stay at, I stayed there like it was my own home and she is very welcoming and kind! I would recommend Carol's place to anyone who wants to visit Edinburgh!
The place is beautiful and at great location. We would highly recommend staying here.

Claire and her family were extremely welcoming and friendly, and made my short stay really easy. It’s a beautiful, well appointed, clean and quiet flat on a particularly beautiful street in the New Town, very walkable to the city centre and Stockbridge. Highly recommended. Thank you for having me!

The place was lovely and modern and very clean. And very easy to get to the centre.
It had lots of amenities and condiments.
It was unusually extreamly hot, there was 2 fans available but was still very warm in the twin room.
The only down side was the light switches which were hard to use and being next to the road, but that wasnt too bad.

This charming flat was so sunny and convenient to all the sights, restaurants and the beautiful meadow. We loved that it was both contemporary and historic! Felt authentic! Sharon was a friendly helpful host. Highly recommend!
Superb apartment and great location. The tram is so close trips onto the city centre are really  easy Haymarket has got a good vibe and plenty bars and restaurants

This stunning apartment has everything - beautifully decorated and furnished and an amazing central location for the sights of Edinburgh. Everything was perfect and ensured we had a fantastic holiday.

Jen had great communication with very clear instructions on arrival and departure. The place itself is the perfect location in old town to see all the key sites - you can even see the castle from the window! Surrounded by lots of cafes, restaurants, pubs and a Sainsbury’s - it really does cater for everything!
Beautiful and private place! Nice area to walk around and a great pub near by!! Highly recommend
Fabulous stay, great location

A fantastic close to the action place to stay. Very secure and comfortable with everything you need. You are right in the hub of the grass market with Edinburgh castle just behind you, and so close to the centre of Edinburgh. Just fantastic.
Basics wie Kaffee, Zucker, Tee, Duschbad war alles vorhanden. Unterkunft war super sauber. Von der Endstation des Airlink zu Fuß etwa 15min. Alles super unkompliziert. Wir haben nichts zu bemängeln.

My husband and I chose Irene's place because of the character, the great reviews and location! We had a brief stay but Irene was so kind and flexible with our arrival and departure.
There is so much to see nearby and the accommodations are just a listed!
We enjoyed shopping, days tours and the night life and slept very well at Irene's place. She is a great host and gave care to ensure we had everything we needed! We definitely recommend Irene's place to fellow travelers.
Chambre ravissante avec salle de bains privative. Très bien placée dans New Town et à côté de stockbridge market.

Really pleased with our recent stay. It was about a 30-minute walk to the shopping centre and a 25-minute walk to the playhouse. The staff were friendly, and the room was clean, tidy, and as described. We were very pleased with the space. It was easy to get in and out of the room. Would definitely stay here again.
We stayed for 3 nights. Our stay was wonderful. The apartment was in an amazing location. Spotless. Very comfortable. It was exactly as described. Would stay again if we returned.
I really enjoyed my stay. It was a short bus ride to the centre and the area was very quiet and peaceful. Catherine was a very friendly and helpful host.
Emplacement idéal et appartement spacieux et confort. Je recommande ++
Clean and comfortable
Such a beautiful place with character and history. We loved it. Thanks Jon :)

Gwen’s home was very welcoming, as was Gwen, very kind and considerate.
Great location only 10mins into Princes St, Edinburgh by bus. Buses run frequently. My room was comfortable and great having my own en-suite.
Supermarkets are just down the road and also restaurants.
Very quiet location. Great spot.
It was a nice, comfy place, kept clean and had what we needed, we were able to take the bus downtown nearby and return easily, thank you (:

Ubytovanie samo o sebe bolo skvele, čisté, pekne zariadené so všetkým čo bolo treba. Nič nám nechýbalo a aj keby hostiteľka Youlia bola vždy so všetkým nápomocná. U Youlie sme sa naozaj cítili skvelo a ubytovanie sme si užili.

Marion’s place was exactly as advertised in a great location walkable to everything we wanted to see in the city center. The apartment was comfortable and all details were laid out in a binder. We would stay again and recommend to others.

We had a great time at D&D appartment. Perfect location to visit Edinburgh, lovely place to stay, warm welcoming and special attentions. We had very quick and nice answers to all of our questions. Thank you very much dear hosts, we will recommand it !

We had a great stay at this comfortable and clean apartment in Edinburgh. The flat was exactly as described, with everything we needed for a relaxing visit. Our host was friendly and helpful, and made sure we were settled and taken care of, which we appreciated!

Kenneth’s house is very cozy and inviting. The book he left about the history of Cramond opened my eyes to the significance of the area, which is very charming and peaceful. The fact that the bus that takes you to the centre is right across the street is an incredible advantage. Kenneth himself is a fantastic host, responsible and always ready to help.

chez sa nita bon accueil tres bon emplacement pour ceux qui aiment marcher proche des commerces des arrêts de bus le seul bémol est le lit qui est très inconfortable pour les personnes fragiles du dos
War alles gut:)
Great for group bookings. Very spacious, modern and well equipped. Di communicated very well throughout allowing flexible check in.

Hannah was an amazing host and the property was top notch. No complaints my end, she was very helpful. All the nice touches to make you feel like you were at home were readily available! Would definitely recommend

This apartment was beautifully furnished and the size that you would expect from a period property. The kitchen was extremely well equipped and the location was brilliant for everything within the city. Even the local shops restaurants and facilities are great. I would have no hesitation in booking again.

Patrick was an amazing host; we had a wonderful time in Edinburgh. The apartment is very central and convenient to reach from the train station. We appreciated the recommendations and conversation. Hope to visit again someday :)
David is a fantastic host, as for the BnB, if you're looking to have a personal stay with the ability to cook your own food and take your time in the city, this is the place to stay.
Thank you Jenny for your hospitality, everything was perfect ! The room was very clean and the bed comfortable ! The location was perfect too since we walked from there to the city center easily !
Stanza piccola ma perfetta per una persona. posizione super centrale e comoda per pochi giorni.

We really enjoyed our stay.  The apartment was very clean and comfortable and was perfect for our weekend getaway. I loved that it had a parking spot in a secure garage. We were able to park our car for the weekend and easily access the city center using the bus stop right down the street.
A good place to stay
Beautifully presented flat in a fantastic location in Edinburgh. Steven was a great host and gave us some excellent recommendations. Can’t wait to visit again.
This place is perfect in every way. Simon is a wonderful host!

Vi har været rigtig glade for at være i lejlighed. Koster kun 11 pund med taxa fra midtbyen så mega perfekt når man vil besøge Edinburgh. Lejlighed ligger i dejlig roligt område. Fell in love with South Queensferry and hope to be back!

Nice room - clean, really easy transport access to the airport across the road, nice shower with shower gel and an extensive kitchen.
I would recommend this as a place to stay!

A fantastic little flat, small enough to be cozy, just big enough for us not to be in each other's way. Ideal as a base from which to explore Edinburgh, Leith and it's environs. Spotlessly clean and incredibly helpful.

Easy to follow Helen’s directions to the place and she was easy to communicate with. And great that there was coffee and milk. THANKS!!
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Edinburgh. Ashleigh war immer total nett und hat uns auch viele Tipps gegeben!

Great flat in an awesome location. Property was exactly as shown/described in the listing. Super walkable and in a great neighborhood. Hosts were proactive in their communication and check-in/check-out was seamless.
Didn’t make it to this location but Douglas was very kind, helpful and very responsive. Maybe another time!
Thank you for letting us stay. We had a great night.

You won't find a more beautiful location to stay, especially with such wonderful views of the city. Though it's a bit of a climb to reach, it's only a short distance from the train station and Royal Mile. There's plenty of space for a large group to have a comfortable, luxurious stay.

Royal Mile Art is a perfect location with incredible access to the Royal Mile and outstanding views from the windows and window seats. We enjoyed everything about our flat accommodations...clean, well maintainded, beautiful creative artwork, and an exceptional host in Carlos.

Parfait !!! Wendy est tellement gentille et accueillante notre séjour chez elle s’est parfaitement déroulé de A à Z. L’appartement est extrêmement bien situé pour découvrir Edinburgh et la chambre est très confortable.
Une belle expérience humaine pour nous et notre rencontre avec Wendy a été un enchantement.
Fantastic apartment in a great location! This was a great base for us and felt very homely when we came back from long days out exploring the city!
I stayed there for 3 nights and I enjoyed my stay. It was a very cozy room and decoration was pleasing as well. Kate is a nice person and easy to talk to.

A beautiful place full of character. Beautiful area of Edinburgh and walkable to the centre.
Lots of space for our group of 6.
This was a last minute booking and Wilson was very accommodating.

Linda was a phenomenal host! Very responsive and from the moment we walked in she did everything she could to make us feel at home. The huge plus is the parking! The beds and linens were very comfortable and the kitchen was very well equipped with everything you could possibly need. The apartment is very centrally located that we very rarely took cabs or buses, but if you need to the bus stop in only a few minutes walk away! Thank you so much Linda for an incredible stay we hope to come back again soon!

Check in was super easy, apartment was spotless, tidy and cossy. It's very spacious and have all the necessary amenities.
The location is superb and tips for nearby restaurants and pubs were really helpful as well.
Angus and team were quick to respond and helpful with all kind of queries. Overall, got nothing but great things to say about the apartment and our time there.

J’ai passé un très bon séjour chez Janet ! Le logement se trouve sur la même propriété que celui de Janet, mais on reste très indépendant, et elle respecte totalement la vie privée de ses hôtes. Lorsque je reviendrai à Édimbourg je serai ravie de séjourner à nouveau dans ce logement !
Merci beaucoup Janet !
Beautiful cosy home in an ideal location to explore Edinburgh's southside.

Spacious place with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathroom with showers. We could leave two 24-inch luggages open in the bedroom. Apartment is clean and well lit, looks as good as the pictures in the listing. Groceries are right next door. A short walk to bus stop. During our stay we took Uber at comparable price to bus fare to city center.
You might find worth noting is we couldn’t find a drying mode for the laundry machine so we didn’t do laundry. Host left instructions to wash up dishes as well as take out trash bags to disposal just down the street, which is not difficult but you might want to leave extra time at checkout. Also, there is a short flight (1 floor) of stairs leading up to the apartment.
The snug is the perfect place to stay! It is absolutely lovely, ideally situated, clean and very comfy. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a place to stay in Edinburgh.
Todo en general muy bien. Buena ubicación.. y con todos los servicios que esperabamos.

Dee and Dougie are the very best experience of airbnb; their apartment is part of their home and their hospitality is way and beyond what you expect. The self contained holiday home is connected to a family home with a warm welcome from Dee and Dougie as you arrive. The apartment is immaculately clean and neatly designed to combine kitchen, bedroom and bathroom areas with everything you need.  A five star experience at a much welcome affordable rate.

We had a lovely trip to Edinburgh and enjoyed our stay at Eden Locke. However, we felt that the Airbnb listing that Eden Locke posted for the room was fairly misleading. Our room was significantly darker than one would expect, there is very little natural light and barely any light provided by the light bulbs in the room. It is also quite small. Although these aspects were disappointing, the bathroom was fantastic, the kitchen was well equipped and the location is perfect for a stay in Edinburgh.
Logement conforme à l’annonce, proche du centre ville accessible en bus.

My partner and I had a lovely weekend in Edinburgh in this beautiful little flat. The location is perfect for exploring the royal mile & old town and whenever we needed anything Nat & James were really quick to respond! Thanks so much guys!
Amaing apartment. Very clean & cosy.

Very Nice apartment, small but quite comfortable and very well communicated by public transport.

We had a great stay at Cameron’s. The location is very convenient, close to many stores and restaurants and to the Meadows. Communication was very smooth. The apartment was very clean and kitchen well-equipped.

Such a beautiful and quiet place to stay! A very friendly family - a beautiful apartment and of course a stunning city. I could not ask for more! Super tidy room, nice and friendly hosts - everything was perfect 👏🏻
Great location, great host that added touches of home to make us feel welcome - cookies when we arrived and breakfast buns for the morning of our early check out.
Lovely flat, central location and exactly what we needed.  The host was very thorough with instructions and proactive.  We had a wonderful trip.  Ty!

Really great location with everything in walkable distance. Rose street is busy with shops, restaurants, pubs, etc, but didn’t hear anything in the apartment. Appreciated the long list of recommendations - really good food spots!

Claire was a great host and very responsive who went out of her way to be helpful. The flat is very clean with everything yo could want for your stay and more. The garden area out the back was pleasant and on the whole the flat was fairly quiet. The bed was very comfortable and it was lovely and warm inside the flat. Edinburgh was full of history and architecture and would recommend the hop on and off buses, Holyrood house, botanical gardens and so many fascinating places to visit all around Edinburgh.

The room was very comfortable and exactly what we needed for an overnight.  Plenty of outlets, nice TV, beautiful view out of the window, easy check in and check out.  The beds were comfortable and the bathroom and shower were immaculate and very nice. Very nice neighborhood.  I would stay again.
Everything was as described, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Thaiha and Duc’s place and would gladly stay here again.
Perfect location and great home. Thank you!
Great location and comfortable property.

Sin duda alguna Doreen fue la mejor anfitrión que he tenido desde que usado esta plataforma. La zona es muy cómoda y tranquila, a 20/30 minutos del centro en bus, tienes dos opciones, el bus número #5 y el #16 y a unos 10/15 minutos andando tienes buenos sitios para desayunar y un bonito parque. La habitación era cómoda, el baño excelente y la cocina también, todo lo necesario que una persona pueda necesitar durante su estadía 👌.
We had a quick stay and a great time. The streets below can be a noisy but that didn’t bother us! The location is 10/10, we walked everywhere we wanted to go. Would definitely stay again!

l'appartement est idéalement situé pour une dernière nuit avant de repartir d'Ecosse. L'aéroport est a environ 13mn de l appartement via les bus spécifiques.

hyper pratique.

I really loved staying in this flat and would be happy to come back, the hosts are amazing at letting you know what to expect and even though I didn’t need anything I felt I could reach out any time! Amazing wee flat, highly recommended!

Absolutely beautiful flat! So central to everything. Very clean and well maintained. Hope to stay again next year.
Nice apartment and neighborhood :)

Very nice and cozy apartment in a perfect location in a quiet neighbourhood. The apartment is about 20-30min walk to the centre of Edinburgh. The apartment has everything you need, fully equipped kitchen, nice bed and a nice bath.
Viv and Shaun are good hosts, easy to communicate with and always willing to help. Great location to stay and discover Edinburgh/Leith.
Very convenient location with lots of main attractions within 10 to 15 minute walk. Very quiet, very comfortable. Nadia was very responsive. Enjoyed our stay and will come again.

Such a unique and beautiful place, set in gorgeous gardens. Everything you need is provided and the little design touches, using the wood from a large cedar tree in the garden, are pretty and clever. Sarah was very helpful with advice on the local area, part of Edinburgh we had not really explored before but full of cafes and restaurants. Highly recommend!

Unique and fabulously designed.  Lots of attention to detail bathrooms were fabulous.  Bath great for a soak followed by huge fluffy towels bliss!  Very well stocked everything you could possibly want.  Great location for airport.  Vicky was a wonderful host.  Will definitely return 5 star experience all round

Wonderful place, great location with parking for the hire car.  Loved the kitchen table for a cup of tea and a chat with old friends.  Meet and greet check-in made us feel welcome.  When we come back to Edinburgh we will defiantly stay again.

Anthony and Caroline's place is a lovely, large flat at the back of Marchmont - an area walkable to the city centre (about 30-35 mins) or very easily bussed.

The flat itself was well equipped and very comfortable. Would definitely recommend / stay again if I should be so lucky
Hermoso el departamento y en un lugar muy tranquilo

Great location, comfy beds, prompt greeting and entry to apartment, plenty of room for a group of 9 or more for one night.

When I messaged Assean with a question he responded very quickly and was helpful. Because of the central location it was a bit noisy, but it was worth it for the location and the value of this accommodation. I would recommend staying here.

Roland's apartment is really perfect.  It is nicely decorated and well appointed with everything you could want or need. David ist ein sehr freundlicher und hilfsbereiten Gastgeber. Ich hab mich in seiner Wohnung sehr wohl und willkommen gefühlt. Overall a great place that we would definitely recommend to anyone looking to explore Edinburgh for a few days!

L'appartamento è carino ed ottimo per una coppia, il suo punto di forza è certamente la posizione. Da qui è possibile raggiungere a piedi qualsiasi punto della città.

L'appartamento è pulito e un po' vintage.
Assolutamente consiglio questo appartamento se è la vostra prima volta ad Edimburgo.

The apartment clean, as described and in a great location. The information booklet provided was a nice touch and provided some extra information on amenities, attractions and also had some discounts! We had a lovely stay.

Dawn and Natalie were excellent hosts. Their communication was quick and helpful and they went out of their way to ensure we had a pleasant stay. The flat was welcoming, clean and had personal touches which made it feel homely and inviting. It was an excellent location with everything you might need to enjoy a holiday in Edinburgh or relax after a busy month working the fringe as we did! I would definitely recommend this flat and stay again 😊
Nous avons passé un super séjour à Édimbourg dans l'appartement de Chris. L'appartement était très propre, dans un quartier calme et facilement accessible en bus depuis l'aéroport et le centre ville.

A great spot for our stay in Edinburgh, with the space perfect for two and with everything we needed to have a comfortable stay.

Excellent séjour chez Monica. L'appartement magnifique, ultra propre et très agréable pour y séjourner dans un quartier tranquille et facilement accessible par bus pour aller dans le centre. Mille merci.

Stayed here while looking for a long-term let after moving to Edinburgh. No complaints. Main positives: 5 minutes walk to Holyrood Park and Edinburgh University, delightful heated mattress, and sunshine through the window most afternoons.

Also of course loved the centre of Edinburgh and the summer craze and many nice shows on at the Fringe festival. It was so nice we consider coming back next year! Thank you Caz.
Place was lovely, handy location, shops directly across the road, quiet both from neighbours and traffic outside. Would happily stay again.

Great room, great location, and great host. Trystan was on the ball and made finding the room easy and stress free.

The room was as advertised and very clean, as was the rest of the flat.

Highly recommend staying here.

This place was fantastic. The location is unbeatable. Right in the heart of old town with lots of things to do off the doorstep. The host was great, very responsive, and accommodating. The unit was as expected based on the listing description and photos. We traveled as two couples and this worked well. The bedroom is in its own room with lots of space. The sleeper sofa is in the living room which also can be closed off by a door. The kitchen and bathroom are off the small hallway in between them. Worked out great. The flat isn’t high end or fancy but the place is comfortable. The bathroom was recently renovated which was well done. The entry way and stairwell are dark but that’s to be expected in an old building. The flat is bright and airy. Windows open to let some breeze in. Had to carry our bags up three flights of stairs but we knew about that ahead of time. It was also a bit noisy at times outside but the flat is in heart of city. Would stay here again and recommend!
Great affordable and clean place with good bus connectivity
Went on a citytrip with my lovely girlfriend and this place really added to it. Fantastic location and great decor. When in Edinburgh, no brainer to rent this

It is a lovely apartment in a great location with a great price. The rooms were so bright and allowed the sun in, which was amazing.
