The only negative part was that the apartment was not that clean. The surfaces were dusty, the bathroom walls were dirty and the towel rack was filthy. We spent a bit of time on the first day cleaning. Other than that, we really enjoyed our stay.

Amy and Stu, flat is lovely.
Perfect for our short stay, although we never got to meet our hosts Amy's dad Callum met us on our arrival to hand over the keys and told us a bit about things to do in the area.
It is on quite a noisy road but Amy had thoughtfully left a box of ear plugs and we all slept like babies.
We would all definitely stay again,

Andy est très soucieux du bien être des personnes qu’il reçoit. Très disponible malgré son activité professionnelle. Grande discrétion, toujours très très respectueux. un hôte vraiment exceptionnel. Nous ne pouvons que recommander.
Beautiful property and awesome  hospitality
Light, clean and spacious apartment in great location (if a bit noisy from the street).  Very good stay.

I had a great time staying with Asmaa (& Mr Darcy!). Asmaa was an amazing host – friendly, welcoming, and always checking in to make sure I had everything I needed. It truly felt like home during my stay. Thank you so much for everything, Asmaa!
clean room, nice host.  recommend 100%

Did what it said on the box. Very convenient for me. Suggest a USB port somewhere. Thanks David.

L'appartamento di James gode di tutti i comfort per una vacanza nel centro di Edinburgo. È stato molto semplice raggiungere a piedi le principali attrazioni e gode di una splendida vista sul Castello. Grazie per l'ospitalità!
We hebben genoten, ook het weer zat mee.

If we were to stay in the same area again, Sam's place would definitely be one of the first options.
We had a lovely stay! The cabin was nice and clean. It was very peaceful.  The communication with the hosts was easy. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb!
Great location, everything is within a 5 to 15 minute walk. Apartment is very clean and comfortable. Great place to stay!!!

We can definitely recommend this place.

The location of the flat and the fact that parking is free on the street makes this place absolutely a perfect choice when visiting Edinburgh. Great place to stay! Definitely will stay again if in town!

They have created a very high-end feeling place in a great location (especially if you like walking through parks and green space--there are scenic walks right behind their home) for a reasonable price. I highly recommend staying here!
As long as you don’t mind running into other guests in the hallway, the apartment is very walkable for all to do in Edinburgh. We had a great stay and would come back!
The apartment was perfect! In an amazing location, 10min walk away from the town but on an incredibly peaceful street. The space was great for four people, would definitely recommend!

Lovely, spacious, well-decorated apartment. Close to major attractions but not too close to be disturbed by noises and all. Love the kitchen, the bathroom, the living room, and of course the bedrooms, so everything! Heat is smart-controlled. Great value for the price. Would come back again!

Wonderful hospitality - perfect balance between privacy when we needed and friendly, attentive conversation too! The place was well located and had everything we needed and meeting Janet and her partner was the cherry on top of a great stay
Perfect for those who need a room close to everything in Edinburgh. Allan was a great host.

Awesome place for our family to stay. Comfortable, homey and with great touches. Master bed is incredibly comfortable. Have a chance to stay here? Do it.

A wonderful stay, great location. Clean, wonderful shower and facilities.
The host was great and we will be returning in the future !

Die Betten sind mit 1,40 cm Breite ziemlich klein für zwei Erwachsene.
Schön wäre es gewesen, wenn man vorher gewusst hätte, dass man das Frühstück auf dem Zimmer einnimmt.
Es war ziemlich nervig, die Teller und Tasse zu balancieren. Ein Tablett wäre super gewesen.
The place was clean, large, and great location. We had a wonderful time! Thanks again!

We enjoyed the views, location and cosiness of this quiet little flat. A perfect location to access both the old and new town. We walked everywhere owing to its location and saw a huge amount of Edinburgh in only a few days!
Richard couldn’t have been more helpful with check in arrangements and any enquiries. On arrival we were set up with fresh milk, eggs, bread and coffee/tea along with all condiment items being available. There were fresh flowers which was a lovely touch.
I would throughly recommend staying.

appartement clair très bien aménagé.
rien ne manque
la décoration élégante et soignée vous donne un sentiment cosy
tout y est : la cuisine est très complète, la literie impeccable. les pièces sont grandes et lumineuses
Jacob’s place was perfect for our City trip to Edinburgh - ideally located in a quiet area close enough to walk into the city. Would certainly stay again.
Alojamiento cómodo y confortable.  2 habitaciones y 2  baños.  Algunos pequeños aspectos mejorables en la cocina. por lo demás todo muy bien. zona tranquila.

Michael and Paul have a gorgeous home. The art and interior design are amazing. We had the most comfortable and stylish stay here. Both hosts made us feel welcome and provided us with a wonderful breakfast. The location is perfect, only a short 20 minute walk into Edinburgh Princes Street and the views from the house are breathtaking. Could not recommend enough for a little getaway.
Gordon’s place is great. Large apartment, amazing location. Id stay here again.
Great location near Leith Links, 5 mins to the park, 5 mins to tram, walkable restaurants 5-10 mins.  Nice and clean apartment, thanks

Het appartement zag er precies zo uit als in de omschrijving. Netjes en warm. Afstand naar het centrum was een klein half uurtje lopen. Goede busverbinding in de buurt. Rustige omgeving met supermarkt op loopafstand. Enige minpuntje was de klapperende voordeur ‘s nachts door de wind. We hebben een stukje karton tussen de deur gedaan. Gordijnen gaan niet helemaal tot beneden dicht. In de zomer kan dit vervelend zijn. In deze tijd geen probleem omdat het laat licht wordt. We hebben ons goed vermaakt en zouden dit appartement zeker aanraden. En Edinburgh is een prachtige stad waar we graag nog een keer terugkomen.

Had a wonderful stay at Rona's on my first visit to Edinburgh. The flat is conveniently located, close to the Royal Mile and with lots of restaurants, shops and cafes within walking distance. The neighborhood is both quiet and safe (in addition to the flat being in a gated complex) - I often walked back alone late at night and never felt uncomfortable or unsafe.

The flat is lovely and the guest bedroom is downstairs, so you can enjoy your privacy and come and go as you please without bothering anyone. Everything is clean and comfortable - especially loved the rainfall showerhead in the guest bath. Rona and Lewis were generous hosts, and provided tips on sights, shopping etc. I was even able to do a much-needed load of laundry. Thanks for a great stay!

Our stay in Edinburgh was lovely thanks to our time at David’s apartment! The location could not be more perfect and it was incredibly spacious. Although it says one bathroom, there are two separate rooms one for the toilet and one for the shower which is very convenient. Great views from all windows and very thorough communication from host.
Steve's place was gorgeous. Great location close to the city centre + cool upper level reading room!
Wonderful comfortable home we all enjoyed in a beautiful part of Edinburgh  with easy access to lovely walks with our dogs

Agréable séjour chez Malcolm !
La chambre correspond parfaitement à la description et est idéalement situé afin de visiter la ville à pied.
Malcom a été réactif et très arrangeant afin que nous puissions déposer nos bagages plus tôt que prévu.
Nous recommandons sans hésitation !
Amazing space as a solo traveler. Easy to get to and really close to the city center, either by foot or public transport. The hosts are super helpful and responsive. Thank you so much for the stay!!!

This accomodation is fun and funky and has everything you need. Its location too is great and parking wasn't difficult.
Would highly recommend!
Lovely place, a great location too. Cosy and perfect for a long weekend stay. Sinan and Susan were very attentive to any requests we had and were lovely hosts.
The place, the staff and location were all amazing. Highly recommend

We've just enjoyed a wonderful 3 x nights at Rebecca's very quaint mews home. The superb location can't be overstated, it's literally comfortable walking distance to all that the New Town and Old town have to offer, we didn't use the car once. It's also located a short walk down (3-4min) the hill to Stockbridge, which has an array of good restaurants (booking recommended!), great pubs and various shops, for pretty much anything you need.
The home itself is full of character and well equipped. We were a group of 5 x adults, so having 2 x bathrooms was a lifesaver. The big bonus was the garage, which housed our VW Passat estate comfortably, as otherwise parking can be a challenge, without a permit.
We'd all more than happily stay again!

Stayed here one night with my mom after we had explored the Highlands and were catching a flight out of Edinburgh the next day. Chas and Gillian were incredibly communicative, allowed us a flexible check in, and were so friendly and kind. They provided plenty of great recommendations and were lovely to talk with. The breakfast was fantastic in a lovely sunroom with lots of windows to look at the beautiful backyard. Highly recommend and would want to stay again!
Beautiful & clean flat. The listing is accurate. Kristie made me feel right at home. Thanks!

What a beautiful and bohemian flat. It felt immediately like home. We loved searching through the book shelves for old favourites and new discoveries. It was very near to the centre but so quiet. I really didn't want to leave.

Couldn't fault it!
Thank you so much to Don for such an incredible week away. The perfect place to stay, everything you need, beautiful scenery and helpful local tips. Would recommend to anyone
Daniel's place is beautiful and conveniently located, with large bright rooms, high ceilings, and original features of a classic Edinburgh tenement.
Everything was perfect, the flat was super clean and the host was ready to help all the time. Full recommendation!
Nice house, centrally located with all the necessary amenities... Sofia is a very chilled out host and nice to talk to :-)

Lora is a fantastic host, very responsive and super friendly. My sister and I had everything we needed for our stay, the place was very tidy and peaceful, the bed comfy and the area really pretty and quiet. I highly recommend Lora as your host and hopefully we'll meet again in the future 🖤
Dejligt store rum med højt til loftet på en perfekt lokation i byen meget tæt på mad fra hele verden. Kan klart anbefales
Great little stay at Lynn’s place. Managed to book in at short notice and everything was fab and very clean! Thank you for a great stay!

Super stay with Margaret. Bedroom and bathroom immaculate with all the facilities I needed. I was grateful for the thoughtful drawer of toiletries as I had forgotten to pack my deodorant! Fresh strawberries for breakfast were  a treat.

This was our second time staying at Jane’s home, and once again, everything was absolutely perfect!
The apartment is lovely, just as we remembered, and it truly feels like our home. From now on, we know we have only one address in Edinburgh, Jane’s place!.
We’re so grateful for Jane’s wonderful hospitality and kindness. She’s such a thoughtful and welcoming host, and I feel lucky to have gotten to know her.
Thank you again, Jane — already looking forward to our next visit!
Lovely place to stay at! Convenient location and is exactly as described.
Great location nice place and good value for money. Temperature in room was abit hot and didn’t have no control of this apart from that was nice

A really charming & well-located place, quiet and yet within 15 mins walk of the centre of Edinburgh. The room was lovely & Michael & Craig were welcoming and accommodating (even lending me a rucksack!). I hope I'll be able to stay again on my next visit...
Pokoj ładny, ma swój styl. Duże i wygodne łóżko i kanapa. Gospodarze mili oraz chętni do pomocy. Niestety czystość kuchni oraz łazienki pozostawia wiele do życzenia.
ottimo servizio. appartamento confortevole e pulito. letto comodissimo

LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!  The location of this flat was excellent.  It is in the heart of the grass market and a block from the Royal Mile.  So many pubs, restaurants and shops in the vicinity.  It can get noisy on Friday and Saturday nights but really wasn’t too bad.  The only downside is the 55 spiral concrete steps to get up to the flat, but that is not the hosts fault.  We are still trying to figure out how they got the furniture in there, lol.  The flat itself was very clean.  We would definitely recommend this flat, but be warned if steps are an issue.

The room is very well placed, spacious and well equipped. The only concern we had was that we had to go to the hallway to get wifi as it is almost nonexistent in the room. Thanks to Joss and his team who were very communicative. Edinburgh is AMAZING.

Amazing location, right smack on The Royal Mile and right next to the bus stop, restaurants and shops.  Fast communication as well, and easy check in and check out. We were able to check in well before the standard time, so that was a treat. The toilet flush just seems weak and the heater was difficult to operate. Loved the small “Welcome Andrea” sign and the pretty interiors. Would stay here again if we’re back in Edinburgh!
Beautiful view and great location. Very spacious

Harriet is such a welcoming host, it was very easy to feel at home. She has a truly fascinating life and we had a long and rambling discussion with her about social ethics, educational policy, food and world politics, armed with a cup of tea each. She even sent us home with a box of eggs.
Thank you again Harriet.

Sam was an absolute star! Even before I arrived in Edinburgh, he was incredibly thoughtful and thorough, with clear instructions on how to get to his accommodation and helpful tips and advice to enjoy Edinburgh at his best. The location was superb, only a 20 minute walk or so to central Edinburgh, and the place was very comfy, clean, and organised. Sam’s energy is definitely infectious! And makes you love Edinburgh even more. I would definitely recommend!

A gem of an apartment within easy walking distance of everything the city has to offer. Charlotte head friendly and welcoming, met us there and showed us how everything worked etc and we agreed checkout time for our last day. The property is compact but space is well utilised and it has everything you need - comfortable bed, great shower (good selection of toiletries provided) and a well equipped kitchen (full oven and hob, microwave, fridge, dishwasher). Eggs, milk, bread and juice were waiting for us and the cupboards also have a wide selection of basics such as tea, coffee, cereals, oil, salt & pepper.
No hesitation in recommending the property and hopefully it will be available for our next visit later in the year!
We had a lovely weekend at Vivs place. The apartment was clean and cosy. It’s also really well located, in walking distance from both Central Edinburgh and Leith.

A clean and comfortable apartment right next to the walls of Edinburgh Castle. Convenient for most tourist attractions, including the Whisky Tour, Edinburgh Castle and Mary King Close. Very warm and cosy, it was a pleasure to come back to each evening.

I had a great experience staying in this unit. The host was very responsive and even allow us to check in early since they had finished cleaning. The place is great for the price although it can be a bit dark in the bedroom. Also it is around 30 minutes walk to Edinburgh Castle and other main attraction area.
Most beautiful area.  Close to high street.  10 out of 10.
Mel was terrific.  She met us at the place, gave us a solid orientation and got us settled.   The flat is centrally located, very clean and has a lot of sleeping room.

Beautifully clean, warm and cozy. Lynn was in contact via our stay and made sure everything was okay and going well during our stay. Would have absolutely no hesitation in recommending this accommodation

The host was very clear with instructions. The place was better than the pictures. Clean contemporary design. He was kind to let us use the laundry machine. The price was more affordable than many places on the city but a bit far from attractions, including Leith and the old city/new city, which ends up costing more with transportation.

Great stay for couples or solo travelers. Toshie was friendly and hospitable. The space was private, compact, and  quiet. Edinburgh Waverley Station and many attractions are in walking distance. Early baggage drop-off provided us flexibility to maximize our day. We also appreciated the complimentary beverages in the mini-fridge.

Although brief I enjoyed my stay during the Fringe.
Carol is very helpful, friendly and easy to talk to.
Very close to bus stops and a quick ride into the town. Can also walk into town quite easily.
I found it a comfortable place to stay.

Very cute apartment in a very lively neighborhood. Room and bed was comfortable and beautifully decorated. Close to the heart of the city with short walks to the royal mile and castle. Scibor is a very welcoming and knowledgable host, he gave us great ideas for our short stay. Highly recommend if you want to stay in Edinburgh.

Doug’s place was great! It was a bit outside the areas where you would want to visit as a tourist in Edinburgh, but an easy 20-30 minute walk to wherever our group needed to go. The flat was clean and comfy with very nice beds. Doug and his team always answered quick, even into the night which was much appreciated and helped the booking process go smoothly. I highly recommend booking here if you have the chance to visit Edinburgh.
This is a great place to stay for the location and walkability to all of the main sites in Edinburgh! It’s a cute, small apartment with everything you need for a few days.
Fantastic value accommodation in great location

This flat is in the perfect location! A small but very comfortable flat very centrally located yet quiet enough to enjoy a peaceful evening there. The beds have plenty of pillows and the kitchen has all the essentials. Andy and his team are very responsive, and the check-in and check-out process could not have been easier. I would definitely stay here again.

Very nice place to stay in a hostel-like environment, where they promote social activities!
The room is just okay. Not dirty and a bit pricy for what it is. Location is just great and if it is in your budget you won’t regret anyway.
Daniel est tres reactif et attentionné, l’appartement est tres propre. nous avons aimé la localisation à proximite de arthur seat et du centre ville.

A beautifully kept flat in one of the city’s most historic areas—full of character and charm. You can walk to just about anywhere in 15 to 20 minutes, and there’s a grocery shop down the road.
The flat was exactly as described: clean, spacious and very comfortable. Stephanie was a wonderful host—quick to respond and genuinely thoughtful throughout.
If you're after a place where you can make a bit of a noise, this probably isn’t for you. It’s a quiet, residential building, which suited us perfectly. Just the kind of calm, cultured city stay we were hoping for.

This Edinburgh apartment was as advertised in terms of space, but not located near the Castle, but rather in the West End. This is a convenient location nonetheless. The unit needs some basic maintenance: there are water stains on the ceiling of one bedroom, and patching needs in one bathroom. One blinking lightbulb in the kitchen was so annoying we just kept a dark kitchen. More hooks please! Wet towels were everywhere, in want of hooks. One bedroom door would not close because the bed protruded too much, so we had to do some furniture moving. No duvet covers! With a little spiffing up, this could be a very nice apartment in a nice location, but it feels ignored, honestly.

Michelle‘s place is beautiful. Very responsive to all our correspondence. In a fantastic location. Close to shopping and the bus. Great place to stay in Edinburgh. I would recommend her place to anyone. Really enjoyed our stay here

Gostei imenso da minha estadia neste espaço. São vários os pontos positivos que poderia enumerar, mas, acima de tudo, gostaria de destacar a amabilidade e atenção da Jessica. Ela fez-me sentir bem em toda a estadia.
A comfortable and well located flat which is ideal for groups wanting to enjoy the delights of Edinburgh.

Moray’s place was great for our couple of days in Edinburgh for the Hogmanay festival - was as described and clean. Moray was also an accommodating host, however would be beneficial for a few more amenities to be provided.

It was a very pleasant stay over 6 nights. Very fully equipped, even had a mini fridge with milk! Everything is set up very comfortably. If I had to nitpick, the desk was just a tad small when shared with the kettle and fridge, but it's ok with some rearranging.
And the shortbread was delicious!
Lovely house Megan was quick to reply to questions. The area was perfect lovely restaurants everything in walking distance would stay again
Very nice
Had a very pleasant stay at the place, the host was kind enough to give us tips about the city, she was very thoughtful and nice
Bryan’s place was in a wonderful location, extremely clean, and beautifully furnished. We were able to walk to Old Town and New Town and enjoy all Edinburgh had to offer.
Super schöne, kleine Wohnung, es war sehr gemütlich und der Standort ist sehr zentral gelegen (man kommt überall gut zu Fuss hin). Wir würden sofort wieder kommen 🥰
Very central location and Andrew was very easy to communicate with. Great tips and great stay.

A very warm welcome, clean, cosy rooms, amazing breakfasts that make every morning a fun picnic, helpful advice, a very handy location that is close to the heart of Edinburgh but a short walk to calm, quiet surroundings that let you refresh and revive before taking in more of this fantastic city. Jennifer made us feel so welcome and we loved staying with her. We hope you enjoy a stay with her soon too!
Las fotos son tal cual la estancia, Linda es una persona super amable que te hace sentir como en casa, me encanto quedarme con ella. Además el centro esta 20 minutos en autobus.

Cathleens home was absolutely beautiful - what an incredible place to have been lucky enough to stay in. It was immaculate and so incredibly welcoming - a lovely place to come back to at the end of our Fringe Festival days! We all looked forward to getting back to the cosiness and comfortable beds. The location is incredible - a walk in to town and some lovely places nearby. Would definitely stay here again - a real treasure!
Good stay and hospitality

Eine kleine, feine Wohnung über den Dächern von Edinburghs New Town. Geschmackvoll eingerichtet, hell, urgemütlich. Toll ist die zweite Toilette und die wirklich toll ausgestattete Küche. Drumherum gibt es schöne Cafés, Shops und Restaurants, Busse erreicht man in ein paar Minuten. Perfekt für ein langes WE!
David est un hôte très accueillant et chaleureux. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez lui. Je le recommande vivement.

I had a lovely stay at Vroni's place! While I was not able to meet Vroni since she was out of town, I appreciated the help that she provided virtually and the support from her friends as well. Unfortunately there was no Wi-Fi during my stay (I was warned ahead of time), but other services like the included breakfast cereals and coffee/tea and lists of local recommendations were a nice touch. I would recommend this place for a cozy, central stay!

Jane è un Host molto gentile e premurosa, la sua casa è molto bella e spaziosa la Old Town si può raggiungere a piedi con una comoda camminata, il tram dall' aeroporto ti lascia a 5 minuti dalla casa, insomma promossa a pieni voti.
We had a very nice stay with Doreen.  She is very kind and helpful. I recommend her place.
We had a wonderful weekend stay at Clare's place! Clare is kind, friendly, helpful, and very hospitable. Highly recommend!
Absolutely beautiful location, great architecture and wonderful hospitality!
Central location, clean rooms. Even the shared bathroom was clean, good value for money

La stanza di Mark è stata perfetta come punto di partenza per visitare la città.
La camera era calda e accogliente e il bagno pulito e ben fornito.
Mark ha rispettato al massimo la nostra privacy. Ottima soluzione per passare un weekend con gli amici.

A lovely, base to explore Edinburgh. The nearest tram stop is two minutes walk away, making it so easy to travel around Edinburgh. The kitchen is well equipped (and a supermarket is just round the corner), bedroom is very comfortable, and has a good shower!
As we stayed in Edinburgh on our departure day, we found the National Gallery (next to Edinburgh Waverley train station) has lockers where you can store your luggage until you are ready to leave. You do need a £2 coin for them though.
Recommended, next time we come back to Edinburgh, we’ll be looking to stay here.
Everything g was great about this place except for the directions on how to find it.  I hope to return someday
great place and location,  just lovely!

Responsive and flexible host, great location.  For us Wi-Fi did not work few hours after checking in, apartment is at the third storey without elevator. Stairs are very very old and slippery, not safe for kids or anyone carrying suitcases or even elderly. There was a water leak from ceiling in dining/bedroom. Very basic appliances and no microwave.

Bonjour
Super séjour à Edinbourg juste sous le château avec un bébé. Ben nous a mis à disposition un lit parapluie et à répondu très vite à toutes nos questions. L'appartement est refait à neuf, calme et hyper central pour tout visiter.

Amazing location, super comfy and a great host. We were able to arrive a little early, which we were very grateful for. Agie have us loads of recommendations and was really helpful throughout our stay. The flat is furnished really well and was lovely and warm after getting back from cold walks. The only thing that could have been better was the shower, the water pressure was not good. We didn’t ask Agie if there was a way to change this or improve it, so maybe we could have done, but we followed her instructions on what settings to use. Not a big deal though and everything else was great. Thank you!
Excellent location. You do hear the bars at night but that didn’t bother us

Great place to stay, clean, spacious, location fab for exploring Edinburgh. Just pay attention to the description of apartment as there is a fair bit of late night noise.  Host was friendly and accommodating. We had a great trip.
The apartment is very well located, spacious and comfortable. Katie is a lovely host and made our check-in process very smooth. Loved it!
All around great place.
Nice place
beautiful place, conveniently located and near to the city
Cozy and very convenient location. Noel is supportive and nice

Great location, within walking distance to everything we wanted to do and see. Room was immaculate and bathroom was clean. Hosts were super responsive and extremely helpful, even gave recommendations :) Would definitely stay again

Jim was a fantastic, thoughtful host whom replied quickly and made me feel like he cared very much about our stay at his place and about the activities we were wanting to do while in his city.   I appreciated all his replies to my questions, as well as the suggestions that he made. I would reach out to him again if we were able to come to Edinburgh again.  His location was close to transit as well as grocery stores.  While we utilized his well equipped kitchen, we noticed that there were many options of restaurants nearby also.
Stayed over a weekend. Fine location. The appartment  was nice and clean with everything you need. Good instruction, no troubble, easy to recommend.

The apartment was immaculate, with lovely antique furniture, a four poster bed, a large modern kitchen — and on arrive delighted to discover some treats in the fridge and some Scottish shortbread on the sideboard for hungry travellers. The location was superb, and the hosts were so responsive and so helpful — really making a hugely positive impact on our stay by being so accommodating. Phenomenal location a short walk to Edinburgh castle and so many of the main tourist sights. I couldn’t recommend staying here highly enough. Wonderful.

Absolutely love the location. Staff was extremely helpful. Basic dorm-style bunkbeds but works well for us. The only suggestion for future guests would be to skip the prepaid breakfast - you can absolutely do better outside.
Excelent location, liam was very polite, would stay there again
Great location, well equipped clean apart from window frames. Strongly recommend asthmatics give this a wide berth until windows and slightly convoluted check in are sorted out..

A fantastic, stylish apartment at the heart of Edinburgh. Perfect location for the Fringe, we were able to come and go as needed throughout the day! Comfortable bed, spacious apartment, lovely welcome from Charlotte! Everything we needed was there, would absolutely recommend to anyone visiting Edinburgh!

Elizabeth’s place is easily reached by public transport - frequent buses to/from the city centre and the bus stop is very close by.  The bedroom is simply furnished but has everything needed for a quiet night’s sleep and the guest bathroom is just across the hall.
평화로운 숙박 하고 갑니다. 호스트 분이 안내를 잘해주시고, 여행을 조용히 즐길 수 있게 도와주셨어요. 고양이가 너무 귀여워요!❤️
Beautiful and a cozy place. Sally was amazing and friendly from the start.
Pete and Laura's place was great with everything you'd need! They were also really friendly and we felt comfortable and enjoyed our stay. Would definitely recommend 😊
Lovely and peacefull cottage
Great location and parking was a huge bonus. Diane was very welcoming and accommodating. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

What an amazing apartment. The location was perfect. So central! Perfect place to stay if you're vegetarian/vegan as Hendersons in directly opposite. Great value for money, huge rooms with great character. Can't wait to visit again new year. Thank you Rafaela ☺️
James is a fantastic host and the flat is exactly is advertised.
Všetko bolo super. Roberto je veľmi priateľský a nápomocný. Izba, ktorú ponúka obsahovala všetko, čo sme potrebovali. Autobusové zastávky boli vždy do 10min peši.
Loved our stay here. Perfect for night in Edinburgh! Location is perfect, staff were so lovely and we had everything we needed! Thank you!
accès rapide au bus et commerces alimentaires. Adam et Nikki sont très gentils et réactifs. l'appartement en lui même est très propre et correspond à la description.

알렉스님! 덕분에 우리집에 머물다 온것처럼 편안하고 안락했습니다.
모던하고 감각적인 인테리어와 트렘 1분 거리의 위치, 방문자를 위한 에든버러 관광안내서는 유익한 정보를 충분히 제공하여 주었습니다. 그리고 알렉스님의 배려해주시는 마음과 모든것에 거듭 감사드립니다. 항상 건강하시고 행복한 일만 가득하세요.
2024.5.18.(토)
에든버러에서 킹스크로스행 기차안에서~
기호&은서 드림^^

We had such a wonderful time staying in Roland’s beautiful flat. The location was perfect - right by a tram stop, walkable to pretty much everything, nice and quiet at night, so many nice cafes & restaurants nearby. The flat is gorgeous, full of eclectic furnishings with big windows & natural light. Roland went above and beyond to accommodate us, meeting us at the flat, providing recommendations, checking in, etc :) Thanks Roland, we will certainly be recommending to others! X
Great apartment with all the facilities you could need. Comfortable living space and comfort beds

The apartment is in a very convenient location - we traveled with 4 children between 5&10 and had flown into Edinburgh Airport so the buses just around the corner on Shadwick Place were great. We were a little surprised by the stairs up to the apartment - our children had to take them carefully so if you’re carrying lots up and down or have an elderly member in your party I wouldn’t recommend. The apartment was lovely and bright, a lovely size for the 6 of us given that we were out most of the time. Almost everything you need in the kitchen, I’ve sent Rebecca a couple of suggestions. Overall the stay was lovely. We felt it would have been easy to contact Rebecca should we have needed to, the location great. The apartment itself is a little old and some maintenance is required but nothing that majorly affected our stay.

This property was clean, quiet and comfortably furnished.
Within walking distance of central Edinburgh and passing numerous restaurants on the way.
There is a corner shop 30 yards from the house for basic essentials.
We would definitely stay again and thoroughly recommend this property.
Fantastic visit to Edinburgh

We loved staying at Roland's place. He greeted us when we arrived and had cleaned up--and even put out fresh flowers. He gave us some great tips for how to spend our first evening and also showed us around the flat. The space itself had personality and felt like you were comfortable, staying with old friends.

This was a great place to stay. The location was amazing! Pretty much everything important was on walking distance. The place was neat and the kitchen had everything you need for cooking basic meals by yourself. Blender was a nice surprise 👍
Really good host and air b n b close to the city centre - 15 minute Uber in at most. Nice and easy and quiet also.

The apartment is not fit for purpose. It was very dirty, the mattresses and pillows were old and stained the bathroom was dirty the kitchen was filthy and not enough glasses etc and we had to re wash everything the toilet seat was broken windows were dirty the sofas were stained

Great place to stay, and close to the city centre.
We were going to a gig in Glasgow, and it was easy to get to the main stations from the flat.
Clean and comfortable. Close to various supermarkets.
The host was very helpful and kind, and was able to fit us in for an early check in, which was amazing as we arrived in Scotland in the morning.
Overall very happy with our stay.

We had a great stay in this apartment, it was absolutely perfect! It's right on the Royal Mile in the centre of Edinburgh, but it's high enough up and with good insulation so street noise isn't a problem. The whole place was really clean and tidy, with comfy beds, very good showers in all the bathrooms, and a large living room with good kitchen facilities. Even with 18 of us staying there, it didn't feel crowded. Will definitely stay here again when visiting Edinburgh with lots of friends!
Alles war im Ganzen gut. Bis auf das Schlafzimmer ist die kleine Wohnung jedoch sehr dunkel.
I definitely enjoyed staying at code. Everyone was so kind.Absolutely recommended.
Had a great stay, flat was clean and well equipped with appliances and even robes and slippers. Would stay again

Ottimo appartamento molto carino situato in una zona comodissima per raggiungere a piedi sia la New Town che la Old Town e, più in generale tutta la città e i principali punti di interesse.
C’è tutto quello che serve, una buona cucina, un discreto bagno, un soggiorno comodo con divano, poltrona e tavolino con due sedie e naturalmente una camera da letto molto carina.

Thank you for a wonderful stay! Liv and her family are so warm and inviting, and their home is lovely!

Thanks to Scibor for a amazing stay, and a great experience for my first Airbnb and Scotland!!

lovely stay, many thanks

Great studio flat in walking distance of everwhere. Quiet given the city location felt very secure. Good amenities and bed comfortable. Great communication

Alles sehr gut. Leider kein WLAN, aber das war angekündigt.

Richard was very friendly , great and cozy environment, will definitely visit again 👍
Comfortable accommodation, hospitable host.
Beautiful and homely apartment. Well equipped kitchen, cosy bed and perfect location to explore Edinburgh. Thank you for letting us stay.

I loved my stay at Ji-eun’s home! There were so many beautiful peaceful places in the neighbourhood. I also made a new friend there that was using one of the other rooms. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour de 4 nuits chez Maria Eugenia. Un grand merci pour tout et au plaisir de revenir !
Nice clean homely place very close to everything in Edinburgh.
Very good listings! Let my trip is full of beautiful memories, daily necessities and kitchen supplies are very complete, the landlord must be a considerate person!

We had a great stay here. The house is in a convenient location, just a 10-minute walk to The Shore and harbour area, and only 5 minutes from the tram stop. It was clean, comfortable, and ideal for exploring Edinburgh over a couple of days. Would happily stay here again.
We had no problem finding the apartment and the secure parking was ideal... inside the apartment was spotless, very spacious and quiet. It had everything we needed for our stay...

We really enjoyed our stay in Edinburgh! The house is as described. Clean and tidy. We slept 7 adults and 2 kids very comfortably. The host provided a travel cot. We didn’t feel cramped at all. This house is awesome and better than the picture you see on the website. It has everything you need and it's super clean. The house is very modern, especially the kitchen. Great place in perfect location, room and bathroom were fantastic, Irene was lovely.
Off road parking. Clean and tidy. Quiet area. Everything worked. Clear comms.
Fantastic place in a great neighborhood. Perfect location with lots of coffee shops, restaurants and walking distance to the main sights.

We really enjoyed our stay. Everything was as described and although the shower was small, as described, it was easy to use.

A+ apartment!
Cant fault anything, it was absolutely perfect!
Thanks Martin.....X
Le logement était conforme à la description. Pour visiter le centre ville, prendre la ligne 33 qui passe juste en bas de la rue.

Everything was great. The flat was very clean, easy to access. Location is heart of the Edinburgh old city everywhere is walking distance. Restaurants, cafes and pubs are surrounded around the flat. Elaine was really responsible landlord. Thanks for her everything.

Wonderful host Julie-Ann with friendly Louis and cute alfie - the perfect hosts! Located superbly with many food options around. The listing was neat, and the room was cosy. The bathroom was clean too! Thanks for hosting us!

A really lovely spacious house with a gorgeous sitting room, well equipped kitchen and comfortable beds.  The location was fantastic and a short walk from the station.  We didn't find it noisy as some reviews have said.  Would highly recommend.
Excellent place to crash for a night.
Perfect little spot within walking distance of great pubs and restaurants.

We stayed over in Edinburgh for 1 night and it was fab. A short walk to the castle and the Royal Mile was had before dinner. We had a whole host of food delivery options but opted to cook at home instead. Wine was purchased from the Coop 1 minute away. Everything you need is quite literally on your doorstep. Excellent communication and help when I asked about parking. We had a lovely time.
Apartamento súper cómodo, súper cerca del centro de la ciudad además hay una parada de bus al lado del edificio con muy buenas conexiones, si vuelvo seguro que cojo el mismo alojamiento.

We were very happy with the Apartment. We felt right at home the moment we entered it.
Since it is located in the old town you can easily explore the best parts of city in short time.
To conclude, when in Edinburgh, we would definitely choose David and Amy‘s Apartment again!

A great spot in a trendy area - a nice stroll through the park to the main part of the old town. Chris is a friendly and accommodating host, and his place has everything you might need. Highly recommended!
Everything as expected: had a great stay.

We stayed with Karen Kennedy for our first two nights in Scotland.  Karen was very helpful before we arrived in planning our arrival.  We wanted to meet a local family rather than stay in a hotel, and we found Karen and her family  to be very friendly.  Our room was upstairs, and was clean and private.  We also had space to park our car off the street.  The experience met out expectations and we appreciated the Kennedy's hospitality.

A fabulous flat in such a great location - everything is easily walkable, from the beautiful Dean village and Stockbridge to the castle and royal mile area. A perfect place to stay to explore Edinburgh’s wonderful Christmas market and fun activities. We loved coming back to the toasty warm flat after a days exploring.

El departamento era muy cómodo y bien instalado. Lo único a mencionar era el pasillo de entrada sucio y la puerta de ingreso con problemas de cerradura. Quedaba un poco lejos de los puntos de interés, pero solo eran unas 9 cuadras.

Carol is a lovely lady very welcoming. I would recommend her place the location is great walking distance to city centre and bus service few yards from her property. I had a pleasant experience there 🙂
Great place with 2 large bedrooms
The place was exactly what we wanted for a quick long weekend. Everything was good and the instructions very clear. Definitely recommended!
Great location, comfortable accommodation and super responsive host. Thank you Nicola!
Lovely apartment, well furnished & very clean. Would recommend if you're looking at a weekend away in Edinburgh.

superbe appartement bien situé.

Ben’s place was brilliant, great value for money and great location, Flat was clean and welcoming and beds were comfy. Overall a wonderful place.
Could not recommend a better place, we definitely would stay here again.

Diogo’s place is a good base to explore Edinburgh from. Spotlessly clean, great interiors and loved the plants! Diogo was a fab host; really responsive and had lots of great recommendations. Would highly recommend!
Nice place in the quiet end of the mile. All you need. We enjoyed our stay

We had an excellent stay at this very central apartment. Great location in Tollcross, it only took about 20 minutes to walk from Waverley station and it is in easy walking distance of many of City’s main central attractions. It had everything we needed and the host was always very fast to respond. I will definitely be returning soon and will happily recommend it to my family and friends.
Sehr sympathische Gastgeberin und  Straßenkünstlerin, die sich viel Zeit für uns genommen und uns wertvolle Tipps gegeben hat.

One of our favorite places to stay ever! Beautiful flat in the heart of Edinburgh. So much to see and do and flat well appointed. Belinda and Stephen go above and beyond in every way and we will most definitely return.
Terrific stay! Very good communication from Caroline. Location is perfect to the Royal Mile. Wonderful time in Edinburgh.

Le logement correspondait à l’annonce, était propre et assez bien placé avec un arrêt de bus juste à côté.

This is a superior location. Simply perfect. I thought having the restaurant underneath would be noisy but we never heard anything.

It’s a good and very accessible location even without a car. It’s in between the airport and old town. Tram network is so close for few mins walk. 15-20 mins walks there are 2 big supermarket. The flat already equipped all we need even for a long stay traveller. I would recommend that place for anyone who is first time visit Edinburgh.

Andrew’s apartment was beautiful in a great location and very good value . Well equipped immaculately presented. Andrew was a great host and very helpful.
We will certainly be using this Airbnb on a repeat trip to Edinburgh.

Great, VERY central location with bus and tram stops right outside. In case you are worried about noise, secondary glazing to windows meant any street noise was massively muffled and we barely noticed it until the windows were opened. Huge open plan living area with sofa bed meant that we could comfortably sleep 3 people in the property without feeling on top of each other. The property manager, Karen, was extremely helpful and accommodating and any questions or problems we had were rectified quickly and easily. Would definitely stay again 😁

Ahmet was a great host. He was responsive from the moment we booked through to checkout, and always flexible despite our additional requests. The home was very tidy, and we had a comfortable stay throughout. We had a wonderful time in Scotland, and the house really added to the experience thanks to Ahmet’s hospitality. He is a very friendly host, and I would definitely recommend staying here.
Wonderful stay in Edinburgh, lovely place, convenient location, charming and helpful hostess

It was my first experience with Airbnb and I found it very positive. Rona and her husband were very welcoming, the room was clean and comfortable, the bathroom was great and the flat very close to the city centre. I do recommend it!! Thank you Rona!

Fantastic stay!!! Incredible location, and Dunc and Dee provided incredible recommendations to maximize our stay in the area and around Edinburgh. We walked everywhere and absolutely loved all of it. The flat was beautiful, clean, and a great size. We wish we could have stayed longer!!

Great flat, within easy walking distance of the city centre, and very close to both the Meadows and Arthur's Seat. Very quiet location. The flat is exactly how we imagined it, comfy bed and had everything we might need. Would stay again.
Great place to stay, perfect for a city break to Edinburgh due to the proximity to the town and the authentic feel of the house.

It's been an apartment far better than we expected. Extremely well decorated, very comfortable and neat. The area is very quiet and relaxed. A wonderful experience.
A really Great location! Very easy check in too 😊 great hosts.. and beautiful place to stay. thank you!

Lovely place to stay, very comfortable and easy to walk from there to the Royal Mile. While the area wasn't the most exciting, it was clean and easy to navigate. Definitely would stay there again in the future.

Perfect location for seeing all Edinburgh has to offer. The property was very clean. The fridge and the washer were a big PLUS. Centrally located but not loud and busy at night. Highly recommend booking this spot!

Great place to stay close to vital visits in Edinburgh. Friendly and generous hosts made me feel very at home.  Everything you need is there. Warm and cosy in a cold winter. Très bon emplacement au cœur de la vieille ville, 3 grandes chambres confortables et beaucoup de charme.

My parents, husband, and I really enjoyed our stay at Erics place! The living room/kitchen was perfect for what we needed, the bedrooms were a good size with comfortable beds, and the entire apartment was clean. The location is phenomenal and easy walking distance to everything! Would recommend!

Good price/quality

Very nice place to stay at. It is excatly as it's described. The flat is very well located and even better with the bar below. Barkeepers exactly know what they do and how :) The only thing which was a little bit of frustrating is the noise when you want to sleep...but who needs to sleep? ;)
Even when Trystan wasn't there he did a good job to manage our arrival. Thank you very much for your hospitality

Sheilah’s flat was very comfortable, spacious and clean. She supplies so many extra items like milk, croissants and everyones favorite Walker’s shortbread, plus anything else you could possibly need. We just stayed one night but we enjoyed it very much. Kim was so sweet and the room very cosy.
My mother stayed at Catherine’s while visiting us locally, lovely accommodation. Nice big room, lovely house and a fab host! Thanks for everything Catherine

Kindly some Swirls biscuits welcomed us on the kitchen counter , when we arrived .
We know Edinburgh, and Stockbridge is usually a quiet neighbourhood at night , we knew we could expect some noise coming from the front pub the Reaburn which didn’t happen .
We know a city is noisy but this wasn’t helped by noisy neighbours on Sunday night at 2:00 am banging doors , and loud talk in the staircase of the building, and a lot of loud coming in and going out and drilling noise in the building on Monday morning , and Monday night around 3:00 am the upstairs neighbours just above starting a violent shouting fight , and Spring in Scotland with almost no darkness, bright light starting at 4:45 am , no anti- light curtains, no inside wood shutters , no double glazing windows on the busy street of Comely Bank road , where the 2 bedrooms are , made these 2 nights in Edinburgh very exhausting !
The living room /kitchen is on the courtyard with 1 small window so this makes more an evening place

This is a charming space with beautiful plants and a stylish, eclectic design. All the amenities you need are provided, and the bed is very comfortable. Robert was an attentive, friendly, and communicative host.

Holyrood Park is a short and pleasant walk, and if you're interested in the sites of Old and New Town, the walk is a bit longer but very nice, or, the bus stop is just down the street (also an easy ride to/from Waverley).
Wonderful Airbnb. Location couldn't be better for exploring Edinburgh.
Fun place with plenty of space . Easy to get around the town, thank you for the stay

Very nice stay . Everything we needed was there , comfortable beds and rooms all very clean , kitchen well equipped . Easy access to buses to centre of Edinburgh for the festival and good to be able to walk to promenade at Potobello . Even enjoyed a dip in the sea !
We will definitely back to this great apartment in the Old school house

Super séjour dans un appartement très chaleureux et cosy.

Absolutely perfect. Tony's place is in an ideal location, is spacious and lovely and has everything you will need for your visit - including a binder with tons of info on the flat, the area and anything else you could think of. Tony kept in touch regularly before our arrival and Patricia was so gracious and helpful throughout our entire stay.
We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Kellie’s spot was perfect for our three days in Edinburgh. You couldn’t ask for a more central location. Kellie was a great host and available to answer any questions. This apartment is on a busy street so there can be some late night noise from the bars below. We were there during the Fringe Festival so it was more active than usual, but it was completely fine for us. We would definitely stay here again!
Beautiful place in the middle of downtown, one of the best stays I’ve ever had. Very first class.

Muy agradecidos con el anfitrión, llegamos de noche y nos dió muchas facilidades. La casa es muy grande y está muy bien cuidada; solo había una cama que no pudimos usar porque las patas estaban a punto de romperse pero había más disponibles.
I enjoyed my time at Simon’s place! Simon was very helpful and friendly and gave lots of great local recommendations

Gabriella was extremely communicative and gave us all the information we needed.

Phoning James whilst standing on the doorstep of 27 Maryfield with our bags was not the welcome we had anticipated. As previous occupants had warned, the entrance hall is a bit off putting. It was good to be able to cook for ourselves and to be provided with the basic essentials - it would have been good to know that the breakfast items are not refreshed during a 3 night stay - it is not clear from the website info.
All the necessary bits and pieces were in the kitchen although the mugs had seen better days. The sink plug was missing a piece making washing up difficult. Finally there is no shaver socket in the bathroom. There is an adapter provided but it's hard to get near a mirror! There is no bath plug.
Just a few minor issues which add up to a bit of a lack of attention to detail. Otherwise it's a lovely apartment, fairly well placed for walking everywhere.
My partner and I had a lovely stay. Patrick is full of good tips if you are keen to explore the city, it was m7ch appreciated.
Very nice stay and friendly
Lovely place located in Grassmarket. Lots of restaurants and cafes for you to go to. For me, it was nice to spend a couple days in this busy hub and be able to walk to anywhere I’d like.

Helen was very helpful and attentive. I booked the place for my parents who don't speak English and there were no issues whatsoever - great communication, the place's had everything we needed. The price was justified considering the distance to the city center. Great hosts overall, would book again :)

The washing machine doesn’t have a dryer, so keep this in mind if you plan to do laundry. Another big plus is that it has private parking. We didn’t use it, but for those with a car, it’s super convenient. It was very clean, which is a must for me and my family. Pier was very nice and helpful.

A lovely apartment to stay in. Very spacious, clean and comfortable. Superb location. You can walk everywhere to see the sights, shops, restaurants and access buses and train station within a few minutes. There are 54 steps to the apartment so I do advise a light suitcase! Five of us in our sixties managed them very well!
I highly recommend staying at Cat's apartment. We all enjoyed our weekend there and would certainly stay again.
Good place to stay

Waldemar war ein sehr freundlicher und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Er hat uns sofort Sehenswürdigkeiten geschickt und war immer für alle Fragen offen. Man hat sich bei ihm als Gastgeber und in seinem AirBNB  sehr willkommen gefühlt. Die Wohnungsnummer hatten wir leider in der Beschreibung nicht gefunden und mussten daher kurz im Haus suchen, es hat dann aber alles geklappt. Die Busse fahren direkt vor der Haustür und man erreicht die Altstadt in 30 min. 15 min, wie es in der Beschreibung steht, haben leider nickt ganz gereicht für den Weg in die Stadt (der Begriff Stadt ist natürlich auch Auslegungssache). Die Wohnung war Ansich sehr sauber. Besonders das Bad war super sauber. Leider waren auf dem Lacken ein paar dunkle kurze Haare, was ich als etwas unangenehm empfand, aber das kann ja mal passieren… Aber sonst war alles super! Wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder dort wohnen.

We absolutely loved our stay here! Waking up to the stunning view of Edinburgh castle was worth every penny :)
The location is great for wandering the city and sightseeing, flat is beautiful and cozy and Aileen was very nice and helpful.
10/10 experience :)

For me the only concern was the mattress.  As I need some level of support in a mattress, this one didn't really do the job and was uncomfortable for me.  However the bedding/linen pillows were very luxurious.

The apartment was perfect.  It was as central in Edinburgh as you could hope to be.  It is close to the train station and the buses that go to the airport.  It was about a 10 minute walk max from most major attractions.  Andrew was very friendly and helpful and bought a fan for us as a special request.  We would definitely stay again if we return to Edinburgh.

Tessa’s place is amazing - by far our favorite stay of our trip! Tessa is such a kind, helpful and considerate host!
