I wound up spraining my ankle and Tessa set me up ice, a hot water bottle and a cup of tea :) You couldn’t ask for a nicer host or a lovelier location!
Perfect stay, Everything was great, and the hosts were extremely kind and welcoming.

C’était une belle expérience ! Le logement était très propre et idéalement situé, avec tout à proximité. L'ambiance est agréable et le personnel est chaleureux et toujours disponible. L'espace pour manger et prendre un café est vraiment plaisant. Je recommande vivement cet endroit !
Nice and no complications

A nice place away from the noise of the centre, but still within walking distance to everything. The only shower is in the en suite of the second bedroom, which was a bit annoying. Lots of coffee but the only thing to make it with was a very very old moka pot.
Sehr zu empfehlen
Couldn’t imagine a better place to stay in Edinburgh. Calum is absolutely wonderful and helpful as well. Such a beautiful, special and homey place.
Kay was a lovely host and we enjoyed our stay, the place had everything we needed and more... plus lovely views. Would recommend it!
Ideal location, easy to find. Helpful host, i would recommend to anyone.

What a nice place to stay! The apartment is big, modern and nearby everything you need (restaurants, pubs and stores).  I really liked the style of Rebecca's place and would highly recommend staying here. 5*!
A cosy welcoming space with an individual, attractively designed interior. Gabriella was very helpful with tips on the local area.
It is a very comfortable house to stay. Right in the centre of old town. Everything was very nice, thank you.
Beautiful place right by the beach. Responsive hosts, and a wonderful stay overall
入住体验很好～房东很热情，环境舒适，一切都很好，是一次很开心的旅行

Natalia was a great host for me and my brother. She was always caring and friendly to us during our stay. The flat is well located (just 15-20 min from city centre), many pubs and shops as you step out from the flat. The property had all essentials more than what I expected. I will truly recommend staying with Natalia, she will make your stay in Edinburgh more enjoyable!!

Nous avons été époustouflés par la beauté de ce logement : vraiment très charmant et superbement décoré, il offre un espace généreux et confortable. L'accueil a été chaleureux, et l'emplacement est idéal pour profiter pleinement d'un séjour à Édimbourg.

Everything was perfect! It's a cbeautiful house, really clean and also well located! The communication with Grace was excelent, she is really kind and helped us with everything we needed,  we are so greatful for that! I recommend it !!
Amazing place, great location, furnished to a really high standard and generally a great pleasure to spend time in, in this amazing city!
Nice, clean flat in a good location. Check-in is easy and though the parking's not on site it is a minute's walk away.

Cary's family is definitely super host!
Cary & Pete & Alex is very friendly and super helpful, I misremember the train time of my leaving and didn't have enough time to go back home and pick up all my stuff, Alex just sent all my stuff to train station so that I can catch the train, I will definitely miss the train without your help!! Thanks a lot...
Btw, the whole family is gorgeous, Pete and their sons are handsome guys, Cary is beautiful lol
Their house is wonderful with cozy room/ inspiring painting/ colorful deco, Cary introduced everything about their home to us when we first arrived, we enjoyed staying here very very much, amazing experience! We will definitely choose here again next time!

We loved staying at Eddie’s place! We enjoyed walking to the Royal Mile within about 15 minutes, and took advantage of the shopping/dining located conveniently close by. The place itself was perfect for 2 couples, with space to hang out all together but privacy when needed. Eddie was quick to communicate and helpful with the check in/out process. Highly recommend!
It was an amazing staying! The place is so nice and the hostesses are very kind and polite! When coming to Edinburgh I’ll be definitely staying there again!
My dad and I had a very pleasant time staying at the apartment. Great location for anyone looking for where to stay for a few days in Edinburgh!

Very helpful host with regular communication and easy to follow instructions. Location was very handy for
exploring Edinburgh.
Ideal base to see Edinburgh from. Very clean, bed comfy. Only 20 min walk to centre and plenty of restaurants nearby to end the day. Good choice

La casa es tan grande como se anuncia, pero por eso mismo es fría y el dueño tiene sus propias restricciones sobre el agua caliente y la calefacción. Pasamos casi tanto tiempo ingeniándonoslas para tener la habitación caldeada y poder darnos duchas realmente calientes, como visitando la ciudad. Los colchones de nuestras camas individuales eran incomodísimos (muelles sueltos que se clavan, hundidos, etc) y pasamos bastante frío el poco tiempo que estuvimos allí.
En los 3 días que estuvimos allí no coincidimos con el dueño.
Very nice room for two. Not far to the centre, 15 mins walk. The owner is so kind and nice. Realy good place to stay in Edimburgh
The flat was great, and stocked with many amenities that made the stay that much better. It's in a great location, close to all the major attractions, and many great pubs and restaurants.
Really fab flat. Spacious and clean and perfect for families. Good location and we managed to get parked right outside with no bother. Communication was anazing too. Thanks for an excellent stay!
Huge, luxurious, perfect spot to get to things in Edinburgh. We will be back!
Great place in a brilliant location with really good communication with the owner.  Highly recommended.

Excellent host..all amenities were up to date and clean..we felt like home..no interference and disturbance..One request to increase the heater capacity..Overall a great host and great experience..We will recommend to all friends
Appartement agréable, très bien situé. Dommage que le jardin à l'arrière de l'appartement ne soit pas accessible.
We enjoyed our stay. Very cute place in a great part of town
Fabulous apartment in a good location to explore the city, nice clean place with everything you could need for a short break. Would highly recommend!
Great location and fast communication when had issue with check in solved instantly almost

Location is important, and Angie's apartment has a great location. Edinburgh castle is a short walk up the street. Shops and restaurants are very close and of every type. I recommend this place to anyone interested in sightseeing, food and drink.
Fantastic location and the place was warm and comfortable. Good quality fittings and linen. Perfect for our visit.
The host Lora was kind & hospitality was amazing. 5 stars xxxx

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre semaine à Edimbourg dans le logement proposé par Seb. Nous avons été assez autonomes mais Seb était toujours réactif pour répondre à nos interrogations. Le logement est très beau et bien décoré. Loin du tumulte du centre-ville, il est très bien desservi par plusieurs lignes de bus.  En plus la plage est vraiment juste à côté !
Very homely and a warm welcome! Easy to walk or get bus into city. Had a great sleep! Very peaceful oasis near Arthur’s Seat. Great host! Highly recommend.

Maggie and her Lady share a wonderful home in which I felt right at home. Perfect for getting some good rest after a long day of wandering around the city. City centre is easily accessible by bus. Nothing to complain about and will definitely recommend!
Estuvimos tres días en familia y el apartamento genial. Muy bien equipado y bonito.
Great place, 2nd stay within a week! Great location and communication!
Great host, convenient location. Good times 😀
Secure accommodation if you want a place to put your bags before check in. Nice apartment, good for a short stay and great shower pressure! 👍
Fantastic property in a great location, would definitely stay here again
Our whole family enjoyed our stay and will recommend to anyone.
Lovely little condo perfect for a solo traveller. It was close to public transport and lots of little shops, cafes, pubs, restaurants, etc. Figuring out that lock/handle took some practice haha!

We had a pleasant stay here. The place was quiet and very tidy, and the flat was nice and clean throughout. While the apartment itself is a bit old, the flat is well maintained and comfortable. The location is very convenient for exploring Edinburgh, with the nearest tram station just a 5-minute walk away
This place was absolutely  beautiful.  Definitely luxurious.   Wish we had stayed longer

Great location
Quick and efficient communication
Simple check in
Can't recommend this flat enough! A great looking spot right in the heart of the city with a polite and super helpful host.
Awesome space, very cozy and clean!
la chambre est superbe, décoré avec goût, spacieuse et charmante! et jake est très gentils et amical ! c'était un plaisir de séjourner dans cet appartement. Merci encore
Viihtyisä asunto rauhallisella alueella. Lähistöltä hyvät liikenneyhteydet. Isäntä ja emäntä koko ajan tavoitettavissa.

We had a wonderful time staying in Edinburgh! The flat is absolutely lovely in a great location close to the city centre and right next to a tram stop. Everything was clean and the decor is fun and tasteful.
Lastly, Natalia was super friendly and a great host. She was quick to respond and made us feel right at home. We would definitely recommend a stay at her lovely flat.
Simons place was an ideal place to explore the fringe. A lovely quiet neighbourhood and the flat had everything we needed

Jag blev jättefint mottagen av Fiona. Sängen var mycket bekväm. Boendet är i ett lugnt och trevligt område. Jag tyckte att det var intressant att uppleva hur det är att sova i ett fint gammalt stenhus.  Fiona och hennes familj är mycket trevliga. Jag fick hjälp med alla frågor och tips på ställen att se i Edinborough. Det var mycket lätt att ta bussen till centrum.

Suzanna was a very lovely host. She welcomed us personally and showed us our room and the bathroom. The room was clean and comforable. We had plenty of space. A kettle, cups and glasses are in the room avalible. We had a wonderful stay in Edinburgh and would recommened Suzannas house.

It was through pure serendipity that we stumbled across Aileen’s air bnb. Spectacular views, idyllic location and magical charm.
Definitely recommend.

Our staying was more than perfect at Patrick! The room was very cosy, clean and well equipped! The building is situated in a very heart of the old town. Everything is close and easy to reach by walk.Patrick is a very kind and polite person who is always ready to give some advice if you ask for! He is a perfect host with great hospitality! Highly recommened!
Perfect for our short trip. Thanks for having us Tracey:)x

The apartment was as expensive as hotels in the area and had the convenience of being in a prime location right next to the station and close to great restaurants etc. Parking at Omni was not too expensive (£26 for 24 hours) and only minutes walk away.
We only stayed at the apartment for one night so didn’t spend a lot of time there but it reminded me of a student flat in terms of size, decor and comfort.
Whilst not a requirement or necessarily to be expected my experience of other AirBnB’s are there’s usually milk, tea and some basic ingredients in the kitchen but at this property there was nothing.
Good location.
This is Airbnb at its best. Superb place in a great location. One morning there was an issue with a boiler, and within 2 hours of reporting it was fixed. Brilliant. 5 out of 5.

Charlotte is a very welcoming host. Charlotte gave us a through tour of the flat and even got some bread and biscuits for us which was very sweet. The flat was very clean, cosy and located in a very central location.

Make no mistake this is in the Cowgate right in the night life area. It is noisy and boisterous but it’s still one of my favorite areas in Edinburgh for the night life. Ear plugs provided if you need them. It is ridiculously close to the castle, I could literally throw a cricket ball and hit the base of the castle. The room itself was very tight but efficiently laid out. It’s a bit squishy for 4 adults but we had 2 adults and 2 teens and it was awesome.
Climbing into the bed is an adventure, especially if you’ve had some cheeky bevvies before.
10/10 would stay here again in a heartbeat with anyone who’s looking to have an adventure.
Possibly not suited for a relaxing stay though.
Great host and very clean house. Located in the New Town and very close to the old Town

Loved this spot!! Super cozy and chill, the large living room was perfect. We did forget about the 4 floors of stairs we needed to take up, and we heard some late night parties going home pretty clearly through the window facing the street. Overall a really great stay!
Vary Good Host

Denise was a great host and was very responsive to any questions we had. The place looks the same as it does on the photos and it pretty spacious. Very easy to get into the main town from the location. Thanks again for a lovely stay!

fijne warme persoonlijke ontvangst. knus ingericht en van alle gemakken voorzien.
dicht bij het centrum en makkelijk bereikbaar met openbaar vervoer van en naar het vliegveld. Zeer vriendelijke en flexibele gastvrouw, aanrader !

Ubytování bylo naprosto skvělé, cítili jsme se jako doma. Rémi reagoval na všechny zprávy velmi brzy, všechno nám rád a mile vysvětlil. Přístup do domu i do bytu, byl bezproblémově vysvětlen, takže všechno probíhalo hladce. Dokonce nám Rémi vyšel vstříc a v den příjezdu jsme se mohli ubytovat dříve. Plně zařízená kuchyně, krásný obývací pokoj, pěkná koupelna a v ložnici zdůrazním velmi pohodlná matrace. Prostě jako doma :-) !  Závěrem, prostě perfektní ubytování a všem ho ráda doporučím. Moc díky Zuzka

Very good location for transportation, quick links to the city centre using trams, buses and trains.
Great communication with the host, Assean gave helpful advice and tips for places to visit and eat.
The boiler does turn on and off every 5-10 minutes during the night in room 2 and the traffic outside is quite loud too but if you use the ear plugs provided, it shouldn't be a problem.

Nice and simple! Tom was a great host from start to finish. Great communication and even managed to let us check in early despite having a busy schedule. Clean flat and great location. Will 100% return!

Joyce put back the "Breakfast" in B&B, we would give 6 stars if we could. She is really hospitable, kind and fabulous. The room is clean and cozy. My sister and I felt safe and at home right away. Joyce is very attentive and generous, she makes sure you have everything you need: from food and coffee to fresh towels and a nicely made bed. The service really is top notch & has a homely feel at the same time. We'd both love to stay here again if we ever come back to Edinburgh.

The apartment was exactly what you can see in the pictures. It was well located, modern, very comfortable, well equiped an very clean too. Liz was always very kind and willing to help us with anything. Communication with her was always quick. I enjoyed both the apartment as well as the beautiful Edinburgh. I will recommend Liz's apartment.

Agnes is a great host and has a beautiful room in her home. Beautiful views and right in the centre of town near the beach and all amenities that you could want. We loved the area. Would highly recommend Agnes’s room.
Really nice place in a quiet neighbourhood. Good access to public transit.

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable dans cet appartement confortable et bien décoré et avec de bons équipements. Une chaise supplémentaire à la table serait un plus. Un peu excentré, il permet d’être au calme après les journées de visite. Le centre-ville est facilement accessible en tram en 15mn. L’hôte est très réactif et de bon conseil. Je recommande sans hésitation. Merci Ricky!
Denise is attentive, the place is really clean and nice and its very close to a lot of independent coffee shops but also the city center. we definitely recommended staying here

Fairly basic apartment. Exactly what you would expect from a shared apartment. Other guests were mostly considerate but there are times when you are waiting to use the facilities which can be very inconvenient at times.
The apartment is in a three storey building on the top floor so be prepared for climbing.
The advert states free onsite parking. Which we had to message the host about to find this information out as it isnt in the guest information. The parking of which is a five minute walk down the road and isnt 24/7 as there are restrictions when there are football matches so make sure to read the signs carefully.
The kitchen was fully stocked with everything you would need down to tin foil.
Allan was very attentive with replies.

The flat is conveniently located very close to a tramway stop, which brings you in a few minutes to the city's main attractions or to Leith. There are some nice restaurants close by and also a few super markets. The street is very calm and quiet.
The flat itself is modern and clean, and especially the bed was extremely comfortable.
We found everything we needed for our stay and would definitely stay there again!

Easy check in, clean, well furnished flat. Neil was very very understanding when we accidentally locked ourselves out one evening and came to our rescue very promptly. Would recommend and would stay again.
Great flat with parking - really enjoyed our stay.
The accomodation was exactly like the photos. Super easy to find, view of the castle on the doorstep. Friendly reception staff as well!
Lovely clean and well equipped flat. Easy check in with very good communication before and during.
It´s a nice and quiet place

This airbnb's location was amazing, it was walking distance to everything which was really nice.
However, the Airbnb itself did have some concerns. I messaged them via the app and they told me to talk directly to the property manager Victoria who never responded. We requested a second key, as well as mentioned that the front door handle was bending and also how the kettle leaks and leaves puddles. Never heard from her even to say a second key isn't available. The lack of any communication from an Airbnb host was just very surprising.
Along with that the listing says there is a dryer when there isn't. The wifi doesn't reach one room at all and is spotty in the other two. It was also pretty cold in the apartment itself even with the heater so bring layers in the winter.

A cozy flat right in the thick of the pub scene of Edinburgh.
Stones throw from Princess Street, Castle and Royal mile.
Anji made me feel right at home with welcome chocolates and a few goodies in the fridge also.
Highly recommend you bring your ear plugs as you are right in the night district and there is only a single pane glass window between you and the pub goers.

Die Wohnung von Ryan ist wirklich wunderbar! Wir haben uns direkt wohl und wie Zuhause gefühlt. Wir hatten kleine Probleme die Schlüsselbox zu öffnen, haben aber Ryan direkt telefonisch erreicht und Hilfe bekommen! Alles was man braucht, im Bad und in der Küche ist genug vorhanden.
Die Wohnung ist von Edinburgh City sehr gut mit verschiedenen Bussen erreichbar. Auch einen schönen Spaziergang kann man zur Altstadt entlang des Flusses machen.
Eine kleiner netter Laden ist direkt gegenüber und ein großer Lidl ca. 10 Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar.
Wir können die Wohnung nur empfehlen!

A great place to stay -  right on the Royal Mile, next to the big church/clock tower. Perfect location. 2 bedrooms and a twin bed in the living room. Nice shower, fully equipped kitchen, fast internet. Can hear the people on the street below but I was very comfortable. Great stay!

Victoria is a friendly host. A guest cancelled on her and she let me in earlier which was nice of her. The place was nice and private - just what I needed for what I came for and it’s only a few minutes walk to the town centre. Hope to be back fs

We had a wonderful 4-day stay at Roza's place with my family. The flat felt cozy, spotless and so well cared for. It really made our trip to Edinburgh special and we would love to stay here again on our next visit. Truly a place I would recommend to anyone.

Nice spot for a spending time in Edinburgh with plenty to do. Bring luggage that is easy to walk and carry- stairs, parking - which the host clearly informs you of ahead of time. The host also gives great advice on pretty much everything and is easy to reach.
Great location and a great flat to spend a week in.

You can not beat the location of this wonderful apartment.  It is within walking distance to countless delicious restaurants, historic sites, nightlife, tourist attractions, etc.  we never had to use any public transportation as we were so close to everything! My wife and I traveled with our 6 month old daughter and David made it so easy by providing everything we needed so we didn’t have to pay extra to bring excess baby stuff.

Abi is a great hostess - she went above the call of duty to procure a bike for me and offered to include me in social events with her friends.  The Stockbridge location is optimal and the apartment is spacious.  I realize that 100% cleanliness is difficult with pets, but the cats are loveable and friendly, as advertised!

We were 2 couples who stayed for one week. The apartment has plenty of space, was clean, and in a great location just a 5 minute walk to the beach. However, it was lacking in many basic items. The kitchen had only 3 forks, very few plates, and very few glasses. There was no toaster, coffee maker, or microwave. As for the rest of the space, there were no trash bins in the kitchen or either bathroom and no working hair dryer. The beds had a bottom sheet that just sat on top of the mattress, and since it wasn’t a fitted sheet, it didn’t stay put which made us uncomfortable with touching the mattress underneath. The beds were made up with just one pillow for each person. There were extra pillows in the wardrobe, but no extra pillow cases, so we couldn’t use them. It would be nice to have an extra pillow for support to sit up in bed.
Lovely place near Stockbridge and a short walk to Princes street. Really quiet lovely street!

I was aware of Calum's presence throughout my stay. He is a very pleasant and friendly man but, as a lone female guest, I would have felt more secure had there been a proper lock on my bedroom. The flat has wooden floorboards and I could hear Calum moving around at night, which made me feel a little uneasy.
This is the first property I've stayed where I've felt as if I was encroaching on the owner's personal space. I didn't use the sitting room as I didn't know if I was a shared space.
Colin is a very responsive host and accommodating :) A lovely place to stay too!

그의 집은 아주 조용하고 깨끗합니다. 위치도 적당하며 모든것이 완벽합니다. 무엇보다, 체크아웃 후 나는 하이랜드 여행을 하고 런던으로 떠나기로 했는데, 돌아오는 도중에 교통사고로 예정보다 2시간이상 지체되었습니다. 하마터면 코치를 놓칠 상황이었지만 그의 도움으로 무사히 코치를 탈 수 있었습니다. 무리한 부탁을 했지만, 그는 너무도 친절하게 모든것을 수락 해 주었습니다. 정말로 고맙습니다. 그의 집을 적극 추천합니다.I highly recommend his house.
Fantastic spot, very communicative hosts. It's like having your own private slice of the neighborhood in a way that you wouldn't get anywhere else.
amazing hosts, so lovely! would absolutely recommend!

Great location,  close to the sights and centre without being too busy and loud. Sue’s home is full of character, and was a great place for our family trip to Edinburgh. Sue was responsive and helpful. Would recommend.

This is a great air bnb and Marcus is a great host. He was really helpful and kind. The location is great. Actually the only thing that might be a slight disadvantage is that the appartement is quite noisy (loud doors and creaky floors). My boyfriend woke up a couple of times, but immediately fell asleep again. And I sleep with noice cancelling headphones anyway because I am very sensitive to sounds while sleeping, so it wasn't really an issue.
It is a lovely appartement and it was very nice to be able to sit in the living room. It was very nice to be able to use the kitchen as well. Marcus always responded very quick and we could have nice conversations with him.
We could also make good agreements with other guests about being queit in the morning or evening when we had different sleeping times. Actually for us this was a great experience. An absolutely great air bnb that I would definately recommand!
Nice room in a charming flat in a great location. Stephen was very friendly and helpful. I'd definitely stay there again.

Paul was a great host, we had good communication and my arrival was pretty smooth. The place is exactly as the picture show, neat and clean, the bedroom is small but for a one person just wishing to sleep there is perfect. It is very well-located within 20 minutes walking to the city centre and with a convenience store around the corner.

Denis is just so friendly and kind. Had a really great time talking with Denis. Wish I could stay longer but I need to catch the flight. I would recommend the place. Besides it was a fantastic worthy price for stay.
We loved our stay here! It was very spacious and close to town centre. Would definitely stay here again!
This was just perfect I have no other words, just amazing and couldn’t have asked for a more perfect accommodation
This is a lovely place to call home during your stay in Edinburgh. Good location, beautiful building, lots of privacy. Would definitely stay again.

I would like to thank the team. They are very helpful.
Many thanks

We had a perfect stay at the house. Everything you might need was there and it was clean. Location was perfect, with a lot at walking distance. Communication was clear, elaborate and swift. Would stay here again.

We stayed at Laura's apartment fora week. we were very pleased with how modern it was and all the facility s provided. We loved Laura's attention to detail and offers of advice for things to do during our stay. We are defiantly hoping to book again next year. Thomson family.
Amazing flat for our trip in Edinburgh !

The apartment is really lovely and cozy. Everything you need is prepared (towels, shower gel, hair dryer, cereals, city map and tips,...) and the location is also fine. There’s a bus stop across the street and the bus takes you within 5 minutes to central places like princess street or miles end. We really loved staying there and absolutely recommend it to everyone :) (only the mattress seems to be quite old and is in bad condition)
Excelente estadía en Edimburgo. El alojamiento es cómodo, limpio y muy bien ubicado. Se agradecen los detalles como los paraguas y los pañuelos. Muy recomendable.
A little bit far from points of interest but very convenient for 8 people, clean and very pleasant inside.
Recommended!!!!!! You will feel like home everything is perfect 👌 Rona is the best host ever😽😽😽
Amazing apartment. Amazing host. Better than expected. Will highly recommend.

We spent four nights at Oscar’s ground floor flat (3 adults and a 15-year-old).
The flat is brand new so everything is spic and span and shiny! My daughter and I shared the double bed in the main bedroom while the others shared the small room.
The flat is well-organised, nicely furnished and comes with a supply of toiletries in the shower, detergents in the kitchen, teabags, Nescafé, sugar, salt and pepper.
The beds are super comfy, the kitchen sparkly clean and the bathroom has a heated towel rail and a very efficient shower.
The flat looks out onto a garden so you don’t hear the cars in the street.
The neighbourhood is safe, the neighbours are quiet and there are plenty of little shops, cafés and restaurants at the end of the road. It is a 15-20 minute walk up to the city centre which is actually very nice especially if you go via the Dean Village. On the way into Princes Street it’s uphill but that’s ok as in the morning you are usually rested and on the way home it’s downhill which is super if you are tired! There are buses too but it’s a nice walk. My daughter and I walked home from the Playhouse at 11pm one evening and didn’t feel uneasy at all.
We didn’t get the chance to meet Oscar, but he replies quickly and is an attentive host.
Highly recommended. Will definitely book up again next time!

Had everything we needed for a great stay 😀
The coffee machine was such a winner that the husband now plans to buy the same one for our home!

Très bel appartement, chaleureux et bien situé.
Parfait pour passer un bon moment dans cette belle ville d’Edimbourg.

Super peaceful stay. Its obvious they spend a lot of effort to make the cabins welcoming.
Not too far from the P&R which gets you right into the city.

This Airbnb is in a fantastic location—just a 5-minute walk to Portobello town centre and 10 minutes from a supermarket. The bus ride to Edinburgh city centre takes about 30 minutes, which was ideal for us as we enjoyed being outside the hustle and bustle. The place was clean, and the bed was comfortable. The kitchen was well-equipped with plenty of utensils and cookware, which we really appreciated since we like to cook as we do at home.
The only downside for us was that the rooms felt quite cold. Despite having the heating on constantly, it never fully warmed up—but that’s just our personal preference. Aside from that, we had a great stay. Thanks, David!

We had a wonderful stay with Alan. He is a great host. Extreemly friendly with lots of good advice on which places to visit and which to avoid. His restaurant and pub suggestions were great too. His apartment is in a lovely, quite area of Edinburgh with easy access to parking. His place is immaculate but comfortable at the same time. Thank you Alan for making us feel so welcome. Not if, but when we are back in Edinburgh we will be sure to stay with you again.

We had an incredible stay! We were able to check our bags while waiting for our room, and we used that time to go explore.
The people working at the desk were very friendly and helpful. The apartment was very clean & cozy, and the kitchen was well stocked with everything we needed (the fridge even came with a complimentary bottle of milk!).
I really enjoyed my time there and would definitely book it again.

The apartment is neat and modern  with a minimalist uncluttered style, and we were very comfortable. Stockbridge is a great location. It’s walking distance of the old town, but feels like a self-contained village, with independent shops, cafes, bakeries and restaurants. There’s a Co-op supermarket and a Waitrose within a short walk of the apartment.

Once we climbed the 4 flights up the interior stone stairs, the apartment/flat was squeaky clean, well-renovated, big, airy and bright.  Big bedrooms,  comfortable beds, well-appointed kitchen with new clothes washer.  The large living room had two comfortable couches for relaxing.   The neighborhood was full of great restaurants, art galleries and coffee shops and very close to the University.  Our host was very responsive.  Highly recommended!!

My partner and I had a lovely 2 night stay at Sharon's apartment. Very clean and stylish and very well located with just a short drive to the zoo or a short walk into the centre. Sharon was a great host and responded very promptly to all our correspondence. Highly recommended!

Fast efficient check-in, not a real airbnb - more like and apartment hotel (no personal touch). Needs a bit of maintenance. Central location. Noisy restaurant staff if you get one of the inward facing rooms.

Dean was absolutely a gentleman all along! He was truly adorable and really opened to all kind of questions or requests, I have never been so well welcomed in an Airbnb so far and by an artist furthermore!
Hope to see you soon another time in Edinburgh or in Paris life liver !

Le logement proposé est composé d'une chambre familiale et sa salle de bains privée dans un logement collectif. Les équipements proposés sont très bien (cuisine, lave-long et sèche-linge).
Il est plutôt bien situé à proximité des commerces et des transports en commun.
ce logement est très pratique pour avoir un endroit pour visiter Edimbourg et rentrer dormir et profiter des équipements.
Great vibrant city pulsating on your skin when You stay here! Loving the atmosphere from the 17th century houses.
Our stay with Seb was lovely. Everything is tidy and Seb is a really nice host! The place is really accessible through busses. Would definitely recommend this place for your stay in Edinburgh.

Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt.
Die Lage ist perfekt. Wohnbereich und Küche top man hält sich da gerne auf. . Schlafzimmer eher nüchtern.

My husband, son and I spent two wonderful days in Edinburgh. Eleanor's flat was perfect for us. It was cozy, well-equipped and within easy reach of the main attractions. When we arrived we had tea, which Eleanor had prepared for us. Furthermore, after leaving, we realized our son had forgotten a receipt for a purchase he had made. Eleanor got in touch with the people from the shop and the problem was solved immediately. In short, the experience was great. Graciela - Feb 2015

Katie and Christian’s place was PERFECTLY located! Just steps away from the Royal Mile and in the center of everything. The apartment was large and spacious, and communication was great. Would definitely stay again.

Flat was clean. Tastefully decorated. Could have done with another chair in sitting room. No microwave in kitchen. Could do with mirrors in two of the bedrooms. Hard to close front door of flat - no handle. Very enjoyable stay in a beautiful city.

A lovely place, which feels very cosy. It is full of character and has everything you need for your perfect stay. It also is very central which makes sightseeing really easy. Would highly recommend. Lily is also very friendly and is always around should you need her!
Great location!
The outside of the building looks rough but as soon as you are inside it’s cosy, clean and modern

This is a lovely little place and was perfect for a few days up visiting Edinburgh. Perfect distance to the centre and easy to travel around . The flat was cosy and we really appreciated the teas and coffees as we were gasping for a cuppa by the time we got back! Haha thanks for letting us stay! 💕
Great location for exploring a great city.  Lots of space in a gorgeous apartment.

we zijn met 4 volwassenen vijf dagen in dit appartement geweest. het was prima te doen. goede bedden en goede douche. midden in het centrum,vlak bij de treinen. leuke pubs in de omgeving en mooie wandelingen gemaakt. komen graag nog eens terug

very well furnished flat. comfortable bed.
10 minute walk to Royal Mile. provided coffee,tea, and sugar. .

Great little house with all the comforts of home. Perfect location for exploring the city, walkable and good access to public transport. Private parking allowed us take the car and explore Scotland from Edinburgh as a base. Close enough to shops and eateries so you don't need to stray too far.

Fabulous little find for our mum and daughters weekend away. Greg kept in touch from booking to us checking out. He sent me local places to visit, eat, drink. Location was spot on for everything we had planned. Apartment was just like the advertisement, clean and felt cosy. If we come back again i'd definitely come back here. Thanks 😊

Alles super! Sehr sauber, tolles Zimmer mit eigenem, riesigen Bad, toller Kontakt (Rebecca hat immer sofort auf Fragen geantwortet und hatte tolle Tips). Alles in allem ein super Urlaubsbeginn für uns

I initially booked the Snug for a few days for myself after traveling the rest of the UK with my mother, but at the last moment, my mother asked to come along- Gabriella was super flexible and set up a cot in the living room, and we went from there!
Super walkable area, beautiful surroundings, shops and restaurants nearby- easy to walk to Old Town and the Castle; easy to catch a bus, too. The snug was the perfect HQ for the last few days of our Mother-Daughter trip!

You can't get much more central than Lotta's flat,  just a short walk off the Royal Mile.  The place is as described, spacious, spotlessly clean and well equipped.  Checkin and checkout totally painless and Dayna kindly allowed us to store our bags until the afternoon, which was very much appreciated.  Communication was prompt and helpful.  Thanks, will happily stay again on our next visit!
Everything was amazing, the house was super cute and well equipped. It was perfect for the two of us, and located at a nice walking distance from the city center.
Great location for enjoying all things Edinburgh! Catherine communicated really well before and during the stay.

Alice’s flat is very bright and clean, and has a lovely bohemian feel to it. Communication from Alice was great, with replies leading up to the stay being pretty much instant and all very helpful.
The flat is well situated with some great cafes, bakeries, and restaurants nearby. The walk in to Edinburgh centre is only about 20mins and work is underway to run trams down leith walk so once completed, you’ll be able to catch a tram in.
Only thing to bear in mind is the flat is on the 4th floor so getting to it is a good workout! Not a problem for us but may be difficult for some.
Would definitely stay there again. Thanks Alice!

Host disponibile e gentile
appartamento magnifico pieno di confort e bellissimo
Fantastic communication, such a cute place to stay. Amazing location, walk to everything, tons of good food, drinks and activities in the area.

Great location in idyllic Dean Village! I fell asleep to the sounds of the Waters of Leith each night, which was lovely and relaxing. Only about a 10-15 minute walk to Prince’s Street, though there is quite a steep incline to get up to the main road! The bed was very comfortable, and Melissa includes several touches to make your stay extra homey, including a fully-stocked coffee bar.
Great place to stay, great host. Bus lines are close by and the local yacht club is nice to look at

El apartamento está ubicado en pleno centro de la Ciudad Vieja, con unas vistas espectaculares al castillo y a escasa distancia a pie de los principales puntos turísticos, como Victoria Street, la Royal Mile y Grassmarket.
Está equipado con todo lo necesario para disfrutar de una estancia cómoda, incluyendo detalles prácticos como secador de pelo, cafetera, lavadora y lavavajillas, lo que facilita especialmente las estancias de varios días.
Cabe destacar también su excelente nivel de limpieza, ya que transmite una sensación de cuidado y orden desde el primer momento.
Los anfitriones están atentos a tus necesidades y responden rápidamente ante cualquier consulta.
En conjunto, es una opción muy recomendable para alojarse en la ciudad.
The place was easy to find and lots of parking which was great.  Stefano was always available and nothing was to much trouble. I would stay again

Lovely cottage in a nice area of Edinburgh. Walkable into the main town, only 10 minute from the station and shops and pubs close by. (We liked the Wally Dug!)
Kirsteen was a lovely host, replied quickly to messages and was very flexible.
We really enjoyed our stay, thanks for having us.
Susan's apparment was very clean and cosy. We really enjoyed it.
Really enjoyed our stay at Ben's place! A very modern, cosy and clean apartment - and great communication, local tips and flexibility regarding check in/out times from Ben!

Lovely flat, well supplied with everything you're likely to need. Location was good, lots of nice restaurants nearby - we had great food at Macau Kitchen in particular. However, sound travels well in the block of flats with the front door slamming etc, so I'd suggest taking ear plugs (unfortunately we had some very noisy neighbours the first night). I would happily stay here again though!
Mark has a lovely home and our stay was truly comfortable and enjoyable. He helped us with places to eat and see! Would totally visit again if I had a chance.  Cheers.

Xavi’s place was great. First night I was not able to sleep well since there were people outside talking very loud and I could hear them from the apartment I thought the windows in the apartment were open but there weren’t. It was a Sunday morning though so I understand people are out till late. Other nights were great. Slept pretty well. Checking in went very smooth and easy, Xavi provided easy instructions with pictures on how to get into the apartment. The place was very clean, spotless, and cozy. It was close to pretty much everything.
Overall it was a magnificent place to stay for a few nights. I will definitely be back.
Thanks for the lovely stay, it’s nice place and experience for 2days at Edinburgh.
Accommodation was perfect
Very good place to stay in, The room was neat and spatious, so were the bathrooms. Very close to any place in town with some restaurants and bars, Edinburgh Castle is just a 5-min walk away.
Location was perfect and Janice the host was lovely and the building had character and space for everyone
Good location, good information provided beforehand.

A mostly clean & comfortable flat (mainly bedrooms & living room). Very comfy twin beds, clean sheets & lovely towels, cosy throws, double bed dipped a bit but was okay. Mostly clean bathroom, the ceiling & top of the walls had paint peeling off, some mouldy looking areas, no extractor. Needed to open the large window to ventilate, heavy & awkward to open. Living room sofa was comfy & spacious, TV & wifi good. The kitchen, superficially clean but some cupboards, appliances & utensils were dirty, the oven & pans very greasy, also the pans cupboard. We couldn't use oven shelves without the trays, dusty & very greasy as was the bottom tray which couldn't be used! No kitchen sink plug or washing up bowl which wasted hot water and time! We had to wash pans & utensils before use. The crockery was good (in a cleaner cupboard), the fridge was clean & freezer okay. Good communication from Brian's team. Appearance of location & entrance disappointing for the price but generally a comfy interior.
Great place and very friendly hosts! The house is very cosy and comfortable
Perfect for us! Great location, a good space  and the bonus of parking. We will recommend and hopefully be back.

Nice and clean place to sleep
You can easily join the city center by bus just in front of the flat!

This place is in a great location in New Town.  It is walkable to just about everything.  The building is safe and quiet, and it has an elevator.     We had a couple of minor mechanical issues, but our host took care of them quickly.  We would definitely stay here again.
Great apartment, very modern and extremely spacious. Our family loved the apartment. Sparkling clean and extra touches, such as milk and chocolate. Great location too.
Great place to relax for a few days!

Flat is in a lovely location in portobello. It is amazingly clean. The 26 bus stops right outside and takes 25 mins into town with traffic. Super easy and super regular. We tried Otto cafe which was lovely for breakfast and also tanifika which is a new looking coffee / pastry shop and was fab. Flat is equipped with everything you need for a lovely stay in Edinburgh and is very modern.
Couple of negatives which DO NOT outweigh the positives of this lovely flat but the water pressure in the shower is awful. I have medium length hair and it would take 30 mins to wash my hair. The bed is also very noisy if you toss / turn. Not sure if it’s the sheet combo with the bed but anytime me or my partner moved around, it would wake us up. Would also be nice to have a house one pager / manual rather than go through air b n b messages which has details like shower switch and stuff.
We would stay here again but would be lovely if shower could be looked at ☺️
Perfect Airbnb to explore Edinburgh. everything was very clean and exactly as in the Pictures.

We stayed for a week and Carly was extremely helpful.  From providing restaurant recommendations to extra toiletries, Carly was welcoming and communicative throughout.  The location is perfectly situated between new town and walking distance to Leith.  Definitely would stay again!

Luke & Jolita were really great with communication in advance of our stay, they were also very accommodating of our early check in request. The arrival instructions made it easy to gain access to the property and there was a comprehensive book providing information on the local area, appliances etc.
The apartment was clean & tidy & the bed was comfortable. We found the location really handy for lots of bars & restaurants & really enjoyed our stay!
Exactly as advertised, clean, quiet and private, walkable to city centre within 15 minutes. Would definitely recommend
Kongressbesuch im nahegelegenen Kongresscenter. Alles gut  und schnell erreichbar.
The location of this apartment is amazing! Right in the middle of everything.

A very comfortable room in a lovely old building by the canal, within walkable distance of all that Edinburgh is famous for. Christine was welcoming and friendly and the kitchen and garden were lovely places to relax out of the room
Yvonne e um amor, fiquei apaixonada. Voltaríamos sem dúvidas

The apartment looks over the Royal Mile and is steps away from the Castle and St. Giles. Great restaurants and pubs are everywhere. The apartment is clean and comfortable. People should be aware that the stairs getting to the apartment are challenging, especially with suitcases. They are spiral narrow stone steps up two steep flights. If you have large suitcases, you will likely have a problem. And it is not for anyone with any mobility issues. There is soap but no shampoo. Be aware that you must take out the trash as you leave and put it in a bin on the street. Paul leaves instructions for where to find these bins but I advise that you find them before your last day. They are not right there. Overall, we had a lovely stay in a great apartment in a very central historic location.

Traditional Edinburgh style flat, fully quipped for cooking, living with a family. Location is great, as it is close to the center and at the same time very quiet. Highly recommend for any tourists who want to fully feel the city culture.

The cottage is amazing!! It is close enough to easily travel into Edinburgh but also it’s surrounded by the countryside and has lovely views from the garden. We were really impressed with how spacious the cottage is and the great hospitality upon arrival. Thanks for a great weekend in Edinburgh! Would definitely stay again :)

We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely come back. The location was perfect. It was close to everything we wanted to see and do, yet still felt comfortable and relaxing.
The accommodation itself was lovely, with thoughtful extra touches that really made a difference and made us feel at home. Everything was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described.
The hosts were fantastic—friendly, responsive, and incredibly accommodating throughout our stay. They went out of their way to ensure we had everything we needed, which we really appreciated.
Overall, a great experience and I would highly recommend staying here!

We had a good stay. Quick response during check-in with very detailed instructions. They allowed us to drop our luggages earlier than check-in time which we appreciate. The apartment was clean and cozy, good size for us, 4 adults and 2 kids. The only problem was the water heater was not working for the last 2 days of our stay which was a hassle because we cannot take a shower with a freezing water especially the kids. They did not respond when I raised the issue despite seeing my message. Overall it was a good experience but it can be better.

We spent several days at Wendy's lovely appartment and couldn't be luckier to had the chance to! Wendy and Sebastian gave us such a warm welcome and we immediately felt comfortable. The room is bright and spacious and looks even greater in real life than on the pictures. Everything is super clean and tidy and we even found an impressive varieties of tea, coffee and biscuits on the room.
The location is fabulous, in a quiet neighborhood but also in walking distance to the city center.
We will definitely come back (and not only because we miss the cute cats and dog already!).

The Jack's aparment is perfect in all senses. It has a great location and it's very clean and comfortable.
The most importat Jack was very kind.
Great apartment in a location with delicious restaurants
A fantastic central location! Very impressed with the room and the home away from home feel! Definitely staying here again when in Edinburgh again.

Don’t look further. Location and accommodations were perfect. Everything was within walking distance. Location was close to train station and centered off the Royal Mile. Accommodations are clean and modernized. What made the experience 5 star vs a 4 was the host. Emma was very responsive and accommodating to flexibility in traveling needs. Thank you, Emma!!!
Lovely home, comfortable bed and room, friendly and generous hosts, and easy access to new and old town. Breakfast too!!
Loved Jakob's space! Clean, modern, and quiet. Walkable to several Edinburgh highlights as well as next to several bus lines.

The stay went very well! We were nevertheless surprised by the fittings which are different from those in France. Explanations could have been given to make the experience even more pleasant. We also enjoyed the English breakfast in a charming setting.

The place is lovely, close to lots of amenities on main road  but far enough down a side street to be quiet. Salma kept us well informed and was happy to cater to any requests we might have. Its about 20 minutes walk to train station

Lovely place with everything you need for a few days in Edinburgh. Great location, with easy access to shops and to the city centre. We mostly got Ubers when there but we did walk to and from the city the odd time which took 15/20 minutes walk to Waverley Station.
David was since the beginning available to help. Left instructions making sure I got home safe
Brilliant apartment. Very clean, everything you need. Much more spacious than we expected & great location. Will definitely be booking again!

Exceptional hospitality provided by Gareth during my recent stay. His prompt responsiveness and attention to detail made my and my family's experience enjoyable. He was very accommodating and helpful. The flat was immaculately clean and well-appointed, with convenient amenities. It is perfect for 2 couples or for a family of 4. The central location in Leith, an upcoming area with numerous pubs and restaurants, yet still within walking distance from the city centre, was ideal. I would highly recommend it and look forward to returning in the future.
L’appartement était très bien placé, en plein centre ville, dans une rue pleine d’excellents restaurants. L’appartement était fonctionnel.

One of the best stays I’ve ever booked via air BnB! Kirsty was so friendly and helpful; her place were perfect for my trip. The room was comfortable and spacious, with everything I needed in the flat. Edinburgh centre was a short walk away, but there is also a bus and tram nearby. Parking was right outside although quite busy when I arrived. There are some lovely restaurant a short walk away too. Kirsty was a great host and provided lots of recommendations for me. I’ll definitely stay here again - thank you Kirsty!
Due to flight cancellations only my parents made it. However, they said they LOVED the stay at Trudy’s. Would definitely book here again, and recommend to others. Thanks

Very nice spot to visit the town, good situation, apartment is very cosy, clean. Duncan is very kind and reactive.
Very good choice :-)

Annette could not have been more friendly, helpful and welcoming.
This is a great place in a terrific location. Unrestricted parking is rare in Edinburgh and while Newhaven (right next to Leith) might seem a long way out, it is a few minutes walk the tram, which gets you to the City Centre in 20 easy minutes.
The room has all you could need, and more and the morning view across the water to Fife is stunning.
A great place and a lovely host.
it is a really nice room. it was lovely.!!!

Fint og koselig gate og bebyggelse, litt i utkanten av Edinburgh sentrum. Rommet var fint og badet var rent, bortsett fra speil og noe som minnet om urin som siget ut fra en plass der ikke var lett å vaske. Litt uheldig, men Gemma ordnet raskt opp igjen så snart hun fik vite om det. Topp service!
Lett å ta buss til og fra sentrum med google maps. Spiste frokost hver dag på Bijou 'on the links' bistro - nydelig og tradisjonell mat.
Vil anbefale dette rommet (med eget bad) med tanke på pris, beliggenhet og nabolag. Stille og rolig når man ville trekke seg tilbake etter en hel dag ute å oppleve Edinburgh.

We loved the flat and had a fantastic time. There’s plenty of room and the living area is spacious and comfortable. Location wise it is so close to all the main sights and just perfectly located. Nothing was missing inside and it was as highly specified as the pictures suggest. Plus, we found the beds and pillows especially comfortable. We’d love to revisit Edinburgh and will definitely try to stay here again.
Beautiful apartment, everything is thought of to make your stay comfortable

Die Unterkunft von Zoe liegt sehr zentral, aber dennoch ist es super ruhig und angenehm im Haus. Man kann in die Stadt oder umgebene Viertel laufen. Wenn man mal keine Lust hat zu laufen kann man auch ganz einfach den Bus nehmen, der um die Ecke hält. Zur anderen Seite hinaus liegt direkt Arthurs Seat und man kann dort schön spazieren oder joggen gehen. Die Unterkunft selbst war sauber und gut ausgestattet. Es standen bei unserer Ankunft sogar kleine frische Snacks bereit.
Zu dritt haben wir uns dort wohl gefühlt, mit vier oder mehr Personen, wäre uns persönlich ein wenig zu eng gewesen, da die Schlafzimmer relativ klein sind und es nur ein WC gibt.
Zoe war immer erreichbar und sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Wie können wir die Unterkunft definitiv weiterempfehlen!
Excellent location with loads of space to socialise when you're worn out. Would definitely stay here again. Thanks

Appartement lumineux au dernier étage, très fonctionnel. Logement très bien situé. Pas loin du tram. Pratique pour se rendre au centre-ville. Accueil bien organisé par des étudiants au sein de l'immeuble.
Would totally book again 😊 thank you Andrea!
Great flat, well situated for the main attractions and very helpful host

The location is really amazing, where you can easily access many interesting places in Edinburgh. The apartment is very interesting and we would've loved to explore it more than we did. Will was an amazing host, who very kindly made sure we had some food to start with when we checked in, and made sure that everything was in order. It is very handy that he lives in the next apartment, so he is easy to communicate with. The bed was very comfortable as well. Would recommend this place both because of it's great location and host, but also because it is a very interesting place to stay.

Lovely cottage, very clean, all the facilities you need and within walking distance of all the things you may wish to see in Edinburgh. Julie was very responsive to any questions that we had.
As well as walking into the old town, the cottage is also located in a good position for walking up Arthur's Seat, Carlton Hill and visiting the new town. There are also plenty of places to eat and various shops (if you wish to buy groceries) in close proximity.
All in all a good find and I would recommend staying here for your visit to Edinburgh.

Spectacular location, everything perfectly walkable in New Town, and Old Town too (though a bit further - still a nice walk and was what we were looking for, convenient location outside of Old Town). Place was super clean, kitchen was inviting, there was plenty of room for us 6 and we enjoyed our stay. Highly recommend!
Great location, spacious room and a comfortable stay.
Excellent place. Clean, tidy, central and the hosts are lovely. Highly recommended.

Un séjour parfait chez Drew et Tom. La chambre est magnifique, très confortable, spacieuse, dans une rue très calme tout en étant à 2 minutes de l'arrêt de bus qui permet d'aller dans le centre ou vers la mer. Le fait d'avoir une table et un frigo ( avec du lait et de l'eau) nous a permis de prendre notre petit déjeuner ( thé,café disponibles) et souvent notre dîner dans la chambre, ce qui était très appréciable après toute toute une journée dehors. En outre, juste au coin de la rue, il y a un petit supermarché...génial, que ce soit pour acheter un sandwich ou parce qu'on a oublié le dentifrice!
Drew et Tom ont été d'une gentillesse extrême, nous fournissant la prise que l'on avait oubliée, acceptant de laver le t-shirt de mon mari qui avait été malade et nous fournissant le plan exact de l'arrêt de bus modifié à cause des travaux lors de notre dernier jour . Nous avons été choyés et recommandons à 100 %!

Great place to stay. Would definitely stay again if we visit Edinburgh again.
- Rose and Jake are wonderful hosts. They made us feel very welcomed and were quick to offer help in any way we needed. Very thoughtful.
- Good spread for breakfast!
- Good location. There is a direct bus from the airport.
- Extremely clean.
- Provided great suggestions for what we could do while in Edinburgh.
Had a great stay! Lovely, cozy, well-furnished place with a great bed and a great bathtub/shower, as well as a cozy living room. Little out of the way, but we managed.

It was a truly wonderful stay. First of all, the location - just a minute's walk from Edinburgh Castle and close to lots of great restaurants and shops.
The owner provided detailed information for guests, which was very useful. It's only a one-minute walk from Edinburgh Castle! You can see the castle from this room. It was very comfortable to be able to return to rest after each walk.
The room is a wonderful place with a quaint atmosphere. We felt like we were in medieval aristocracy. If you prefer a modern and contemporary hotel, this might not be the place for you. However, it is definitely recommended for travelers who love the old and traditional Edinburgh. We have already loved this room.
The room was old and traditional, but the kitchen and bathroom had been renovated and were very comfortable. There was a high-end Miele washing machine and dishwasher, and plenty of detergent and dishwashing liquid was provided.
The owner, Craig, responded quickly and we felt very reassured.

Great host, really helpful comfortable bed.
The location is not far from the city centre.
This place is perfect.. great location comfortable close to a lot!! I would recommend this to anyone traveling.
Delighted with the flat a, the area and its proximity to the tram stop. We had a great time, thanks for everything.

à 15min de l' aéroport en taxi (25 livres) et à 10min à pieds de la ligne principale de tram pour aller dans le centre ville
accueil très facile et de nuit pour nous (vol arrivé à 00h), Rana a été très arrangeant.
Les équipements sont tops et en plus Rana a eu la gentillesse et l'attention de nous laisser de quoi déjeuner !
location au top !!
A wonderful appartment in a beautiful location. A short walk to most of Edinburgh's cultural highlights. The appartment is well-equipped and cosy. Communication from the host was excellent.

We stayed for three nights and we don‘t have anything to complain about. Andreas was very easily available and considerate.
The location was also really practical. It is a 20 min walk to the city center and on the way there were enough shops and restaurants to try out.
The free breakfast was the cherry on top. Thank you for this comfy stay! We will keep this place it in mind for the next time!
Lovely and cozy Airbnb in an amazing location! We had a great honeymoon visit. Ashlie & Grant were very responsive and helpful.

Mélanie is a nice and welcoming host, i totally recommend this Airbnb for a weekend or a week-stay.
There is a lot of buses to go to the city center and even the tramway nearby. The bedroom was confortable too.
Thank you again for the heartwarming welcome ☺️

The apartment is stylish, clean and quiet. The host Valerie is accommodating with flexible check in and out. Love the bedrooms and spacious living room, we even managed to do yoga in the living room! The ensuite shower room is a nice touch. Beautiful and comfortable linen. The area is wonderful with lots of cafes, restaurants, boutique shops and next to nature with the meadows and canal just 5 minutes walk away. Castle is only 10 minutes by bus, it is between two major rail stations and and 2 minutes walk to bus stop with 6 buses stopping. I highly recommend Valerie's place.
Excellent stay. Great location and an amazing apartment. Heaps of space and great facilities. Would definitely recommend!
Manigeh was a wonderful hostess, and her place was just perfect for my 3-night stay. Highly recommended.
great apartment! perfect location for exploring edinburgh! would recommend to anyone looking for a centre located lovely apartment! gareth was a great host. very helpful with details. thank you!!

Très bon emplacement, proche de tout à pied.
Très bien pour un week end.

I booked this apartment for my 50th birthday weekend and my friends and I were not disappointed - this apartment is amazing!!! It is in a  great central location and is so stylish and comfortable  with plenty room for 10 people. Pauline was very quick to reply to all my queries before our trip and, on arrival we were warmly welcomed. Check-out is 10am but Pauline extended this as our train home wasn’t until 1pm - we really appreciated this kind gesture. We would not hesitate rebooking this apartment and are already thinking about  our 2019 trip to Edinburgh.
Absolutely incredible hosts who go above and beyond. My idiot mate left his passport there and they were so helpful and responsive and were the ones who informed us. THANK YOU SO MUCH

Apartamento con encanto en plena Royal Mile. Cerca de todos los puntos de interés y con muchas opciones de restauración. Gran ubicación, pero si se quiere tranquilidad por la noche en determinados momentos a la salida de pubs i restaurantes hay personas incivicas que pueden perturbar tu descanso…
Great location and great space for a large family group
Berry was very kind and courteous. The accommodation is close to the bus station and it's easy to get to the city center.

It was an overall good budget-friendly one night stay. The place is enjoyable and has a well equipped kitchen. It is very well located, just next to the tram station for the airport, and within walking distance of Edinburgh’s New Town and Old Town.
However, we did not have a great sleep, as we did not expected the noise from the street and the brightness. The flat is indeed very poorly soundproof, with not so convenient curtains, letting in a lot of light in the morning. We felt that the place has a good potential, with spacious shared spaces and rooms, but lacks in the details, such as comfort and practicality. Overall, we would recommend it for a quick and budget stay in the city.
They are super nice and patient!!! If I go to Edinburgh in the future, I’ll choose their house to live without a doubt!
nice and cozy place loved the accomodation
Bravo ! qu'elle séjour nous avons passé. C'était au delà de nos espérances, l'hôte est très chaleureux, un endroit magnifique et tout ce fais à pied. nous avons simplement adoré. Merci xx

We had a really enjoyable 2 night's stay at  Karen's apartment. It was very attractively decorated, comfortable, with all necessary equipment and was very handy for the tram and restaurants. Karen was very responsive in communications and although we were initially confused about check in details, she sent us photos to clarify. All in all an excellent visit. I would highly recommend it as a based for visiting Edinburgh.

It was a good rate, we would stay here again. The shower was nice, but it would've been cool to have more than maybe 1 roll of toilet paper. The beds are really only okay. The house was small and  neighborhood was old, that's not a knock as it was pretty expected. The grocery stores are half a mile from the place, not half a km, which is still walkable. It's also a decent area to catch a bus.

Dharma’s place is a very nice (and nicely decorated) apartment, and the room itself is bright, clean, and roomy, with a comfy bed. And a spacious, clean bathroom is always a great plus. You couldn’t ask more in a location—out the front door and you’re on the Royal Mile, far enough from the prime tourist areas to avoid the bustle and noise, but only a block to the beginning of it. Lots of great restaurants (from basic coffee shops to fancy dinner locales) and places to see within a five-minute walk (the train station is that close as well), with other Old and New Town areas within minutes as well.
Dharma is very attentive to her guests’ needs and very helpful.
Couldn’t ask for a better place.

What a lovely place to stay; clean and comfortable and in a quiet neighbourhood. Very comfortable beds, plenty of extras and the handmade soap was a lovely touch. I will book again and my sister said she would book with her two children - they would love the hidey beds!!
Great, place exactly what we needed for the weekend! Great location too!
Excellent location, walkable to tram station which ment we can leave the car and take the tram into town.
Colin went over everything we need to know to stay at the apartment. The apartment is very nice and it feels like home. The location is convenient to the main part of the city, but it's quiet.

The location was perfect. Close to lots of shopping, pubs and restaurants. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. There is a big construction project going on next door, but they didn't start working until 8am when we were there. I would definitely stay here again when in Edinburgh.

Simon’s place was superb. It was clean and had a great location. It has all the essential tools to easily whip up a breakfast. The Asda superstore is close nearby as well which is really handy for all your essential supplies. Overall, it was a great stay.

Lovely, clean and private. All amenities needed for a comfortable stay. Great location, quiet but near shops, restaurants and transport links. Really helpful and friendly host

The road is noisy even at 2 a.m. if you have the windows open on a warm night and we heard the neighbors through the walls/floors - a couple having a loud conversation from midnight to 12:30 am one night and then talking again and dragging things across the floor at 7 a.m., and the next door neighbor running the washing machine at 11 p.m.

We had the windows open and honestly thought there was a small riot from the noise and commotion going on (we turn in early due to children and an older relative who was traveling with us). But, the noise was gone after simply shutting the windows so no worries there (I'm just saying this to let people know about the area). The Host was wonderful, super-responsive and so helpful (even sent us tips to get our tickets refunded after flight delays on BA). I would definitely recommend staying here and should I ever get the chance to travel to Edinburgh again, will stay here once more!
