The Zebra Club is in a wonderful location, particularly for those new to Edinburgh. The hosts have the most thorough guidebook for guests that I have seen, and it was fun to read through recommendations ahead of time. Highly recommend going to Baba (make a reservation if you can!) for dinner, which is just around the corner! Thanks for a great first stop in Scotland!
Très bonne réactivité et très bon acceuil de la part de Marie, la chambre était parfaite pour ma nuit passée sur Édimbourg !

This is a very large house in the centre of town, and is well suited to big groups visiting Edinburgh. The rooms were not dirty, but neither were they in excellent condition - the whole place feels like it needs a good clean.

La estancia en el departamento de Fiona fue excelente. Todo estaba impecable y funcionaba, era cálido y práctico. La ubicación , inmejorable para quién quiere recorrer la ciudad a pie. De todos modos dejamos el auto en un aparcamiento pago cerca del departamento y no tuvimos ningún inconveniente. Ella fue muy amable y dispuesta a darnos toda la información que necesitábamos. Estamos muy conformes con el servicio y lo volveríamos a elegir.
It's a beautiful space , warm , cozy and conveniently located . This place has a very good collection of books for book lovers. Helen is very helpful throughout your stay.
Lynne’s place was fantastic. It was spacious and comfortable while in an unbeatable location. On a quiet street but walkable to everything you will want to do. I would highly recommend staying here.
Great apartment, very convenient for the tram into town and to the airport. Very clean and comfortable and Conrad was very helpful.
The apartment is beautiful and in walking distance of all of the major sights of Edinburgh. It is bigger than it looks in the photos and was a great place to relax after big days out.

Amazing stay great location  in the heart of old town we walked everywhere did not need a car, It's a busy city so a bit noisy at night bring a noise machine or ear plugs and you'll  be fine. As common in edinburgh no elevator and a few stairs but well worth it. clean cozy and well stocked would recommend

Ruth's house is amazing. Everything is perfect. From her house I can see that she love life. Good location, can walk to city centre.
Ruth is very nice, I would highly recommend.
Responsive and helpful host.  Clean place.  Just right for two people, but okay for four people. Good public transportation nearby.
V. Good
We had a lovely time, despite the rubbish weather! Looking forward to our next visit 🙃

After our 14 hours flight from Malaysia to Edinburgh, arriving at Duncan's place was a welcomed relief. We felt at home almost immediately. The location was fantastic. Getting around was easy as there are places that were within walking distance. Since there were 6 of us and occasionally we used City Cab, they were extremely reliable. The apartment was spotlessly clean and all the amenities were as listed in the site. Duncan himself was very friendly and helpful. We will only take back fond memories of our stay in Edinburgh and Duncan's apartment (our home away from home).
Lovely apartment

Talula is a lively person and was always willing to assist us. The flat is newly renovated to a very nice standard. There were a few tiny quirks that we will convey to Talula and we're certain those will be resolved soon. The flat is a ground floor, rather busy street but more than makes up for this by being close to several attractions and not more than a 15 minutes stroll from the Royal Mile. We were in the city for the festival and had a great time. Thank you Talula!

Lauren a été très réactive et arrangeante. Le logement est très bien situé près des transports en commun pour accéder à Edimbourg.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Lovely place. Lovely people. Great location. Nothing not to like!

Very easy check in with clear instructions from hosts. Perfect location for walking, transport and Lidl at the end of the road, and the cosiest flat we've had - we loved it so much! Kitchen is great to cook in, but flat is also close to restaurants. Separating the toilet from the rest of the bathroom was so useful. Quick to respond to queries and checked everything was ok which was sweet. They helped make our first trip to Edinburgh wonderful.  Thank you so much Hana and Viktor 😊
Very friendly! We appreciated the complementary breakfast.
Great accommodation! Clean and modern, and it's at a great location close to the city centre.

L’appartement est parfait, il y a tout ce qu’il faut sel, poivre, huile bouteille de prosecco petits gâteaux tous les ustensiles pour faire à manger.
La literie est parfaite, on a très bien dormi . Le matin pour les courageux il y a la montagne juste en face. Vous pouvez l’escalader vous regardez le soleil se lever et vous redescendez, c’est une promenade très sympa.
Vous n’êtes vraiment pas loin du centre-ville, nous avons tout pu faire à pied.
Je conseille vivement.
Lovely apartment, amazing location and super friendly and helpful communication! Would 100% stay again!
The space was clean and walkable to everything we needed. Beautiful views and we all felt right at home.
Perfect Local!! Close to the principal locals in Edinburgh! And your vision for the castle’s perfect!!

Tilly's place feels like a home. It is decorated with exquisite taste and tge area is nice and quiet.
It was a pleasure staying at Tilly's!

This is a very nice flat with beautiful  big windows and stylishly decorated. It’s in a part of the city with good train and bus services, and I found I could walk more or less anywhere I wanted to go.

A wonderful place to stay, off the beaten track yet you can walk everywhere.  The apartment is perfect and surprisingly spacious, with everything you could need. Pack your swimming things - just around the corner is the most beautifully restored Victorian pool, complete with sauna and steam room- we went every day.  Bob was the perfect host, friendly and informative.  Can't wait to make a return visit!
Logement idéal pour découvrir Edimbourg

Very unhappy with the host. We tried to obtain the key, but were given the wrong code for the key lock. I called several times and no one called me back, instead I got a message with a new code to try. We had several issues and were never called back, worst experience was as the heater was not working and i asked „please give me a call“. Instead they scheduled a plumber for 5 pm and he resolved it in one second. It would have been great to speak. The apartment is ok but not luxury (except the price).

Such an amazing place. Very clean in a quiet, safe neighborhood. About a 15-20 minute walk to all the major sights and a 5 minute walk to Arthur’s Seat. Oliver and Ben were very accommodating and let us extend our trip when our travel plans changed, so 10/10 hosts. Would definitely come back again!

Amazing location and an absolutely beautiful home that is decorated fantastically. The host was very accommodating and very responsive. Would highly recommend this location to anyone looking to stay in Edinburgh.

We had a great time in Edinburgh. Jennifer and Richard are really friendly and arranging.
The bed is very comfortable and the room isn't small; it's the perfect size to be a morning/evening base to be exploring all that Edinburgh has to offer.
Jennifer made sure to restock fresh water, instant coffee, tea and breakfast (brioches, croissants etc.) every day, which was really appreciated. She'll try her best to work with your schedule so that your arrival and departure go smoothly. You'll also have a key to the apartment to be able to come and go as you please.
The bathroom has everything you need and everything was clean.
I can 100% recommend staying there. Although there is no access to the kitchen, I thought it would be better to spend the extra money eating out rather than trying to find another apartment with a kitchen (that I would have had to share).

This was the first stop on our 2 week European trip with 2 teenage boys and grandma. We have a very tall family and the space was great. The apartment is very clean and quiet. Multiple bathrooms and bedrooms is a great feature when traveling with a group.
Host very responsive to all questions.

We had a lovely stay with Diane. She accommodated an early check-in and was very helpful with restaurant and activity recommendations.  She was very responsive when we had questions. We’d highly recommend staying with her.

We had a great stay at Tom & Izzy's Edinburgh appartment.
It was spacious and well situated for visiting all areas of the city.
Having a place in the backyard to securely park the car was a great bonus.

Wir hatten ein paar tolle Tage in Edinburgh. Die Wohnung war genau so wie auf den Fotos und der Beschreibung. Alles funktionierte und war sehr sauber. Von der Nachbarschaft haben wir nie etwas gehört. Auf jeden Fall können wir die Wohnung von Tony weiterempfehlen.

Die Unterkunft war den Bildern entsprechend eingerichtet.
Es war alles wie erwartet.
Zusätzlich gab es noch kleine Annehmlichkeiten, wie ein gefüllter Getränkekühlschrank.
Diese Wohnung ist nur zu empfehlen!

Excelente ubicación, muy bonito departamento.
Súper recomendado, además que Denise es muy atenta para cualquier duda.
Muchas gracias sin duda volvería ✨✨🙌🏻

Harvey was a excellent host and the apartments were ideally located in the centre of Edinburgh. They were also spotlessly clean and the check-in and check-out process was effortless. Highly recommended, especially for large groups.
We really loved our stay with Iga and Scibor! Cute room and good location! The hosts were really kind and helpful.
You won't find a better location, place was clean and well equipped and comms with the owner were easy and swift.  Thanks for a great stay.

We felt very comfortable and at home during our whole stay. The whole house looks absolutely
lovely and the relaxing breakfast in the mornings out in the wintergarden gave us a wonderful
start into the day. Since the apartment is so close to the sea we were able to watch the sunset
by the pier just a few minutes from our room which definitely was one of the highlights of our
stay.
Chas and Gillian really make you feel like you live in your own single- room-hotel and they are
absolutely sweet and welcoming hosts.
I couldn't recommend this airbnb more.
We have unfortunately really not planned enough time to stay here and will definitely be back :)
Had a lovely stay easy walking distance to the castle fantastic breakfast, very clean quiet apartment highly recommend, could not fault it at all
Ann is a very interesting and charming Person, we had great talks and we would have loved to stay longer!

A beautiful clean spacious apartment in a fantastic location. Communication with Victor was 5 star throughout our stay. We received the wrong instructions for check in which meant having to then travel to the train station to pick up the keys. Which was a pain as we were outside the apartment when we were told. The heating and hot water was playing up but a maintenance guy arrived a few times to fix it. This was going to be properly looked at on our departure. I would definitely recommend staying here and I would stay again even with the issues we had as the apartment is lovely.

fabulous stay, gorgeous gardens and the host is extremely kind and helpful.
a beautiful house, perfect for family and friends.
I would thoroughly recommend a stay.

Five star accommodation and communication from start to finish .. kept in the loop at every stage, check in and check out so easy and help offered all the way. Couldn’t have made our stay in Edinburgh any easier.   We are a family of 4 and it was absolutely perfect .. great location too for exploring the city .. definitely recommend and we’ll definitely be back if we are ever back in town  .. thank you so much

Bon point de chute à Edimbourg!
accès au centre facile et rapide par le bus, en 15min env .
ballade qui suit le canal jusqu'au centre très sympa, en 40min env.

Excellent stay. Thanks for letting us leave our luggage since we arrived early. The location was great - about 10 to 15 mins from most everything, the train station was about a 20min walk. Yes, there is night time road noise from the bedroom as others mentioned, but it quiets down - the WiFi was also spotty in that area of the house, but overall zero issues and we loved our stay. Thank you!
Very clean and great location

Martin est disponible et accueillant. Le séjour s’est très déroulé. Sa maison est bien située, il suffit de prendre les bus qui passent pas loin pour aller en direction du centre de Édimbourg. Le quartier est magnifique et calme. La maison de Martin est très bien équipée et fonctionnelle. Super séjour 🙏🏼

I had the honor of being Jacob’s first Air b&b guest.  He is a thoughtful, organised,and a good communicator. The flat is clean and easy to reach and near wonderful places to hike or cycle. I highly recommend Jacob’s place.
Great stay here. Clean and easily accessible . Will definitely book this place again!
Great location for getting into town centre.

I enjoyed my stay at Mike’s place. The place was cosy and had everything what I needed. It’s a short walk from the main road  where are some lovely places to eat. The owners  went an extra mile to make me comfortable. They are a lovely couple and their dog is so adorable.  Thank you very much for everything and I hope to stay at your place again.
Just perfect

Lovely apartment, near everything you might need in less then 10 min walk. The apartment was situated in a peaceful residential neighbourhood and it was really to go to the center. Apartment was clean and got everything you need! Nathalie was also very responsive!

The accommodation was ideal. Our main aim for our few days in Edinburgh was to be out and about exploring as much of the city as we could without paying a fortune. The location is excellent with all the sites easily accessible on foot. The apartment was more than adequate as we were able to have breakfast and cook dinner when we wanted. It was also comfortable and warm enough that we could relax in the evening watching TV after dinner. My wife and I were unsure whether it might be quite noisy at night due to the local clubs and being on the ground floor. However, we both had 5 good nights' sleep. Finally, we both felt that it was good value for money and we would have no hesitation in recommending this apartment.

L'appartement se situe assez proche du centre 30min à pied ou 10min en bus et  non loin de Leith, quartier animé, également 2 commerces sont à proximité (Lidl, Tesco). L'appartement est assez fonctionnel dans l'ensemble,se situe au rez de chaussée .  Quelques ustensiles supplémentaires de cuisine serait très appréciable .  Quand nous sommes arrivés nous avons malheureusement pas trouvés l'appartement très propre . Nous avons malgré tout passés un très bon séjour .
this is a very nicely appointed apartment in the best location on the royal mile. excellent stay
Sehr schöne Wohnung, gepflegt und zentral gelegen. Freundlicher Kontakt, gute Empfehlungen betreffend de Gegend. Vielen Dank für den tollen Aufenthalt!
非常好的居住体验，房子和照片一模一样，Rohane和Calim非常友好且有帮助的！房子里生活用品和厨房用品一应俱全，甚至还有早餐和牛奶！这对于带着儿子的旅行真的太棒了！一定会再次入住的！

We really enjoyed our stay for a long weekend. The Airbnb was clean, easy to find and had all the amenities described. The location was good - 30 mins walk to town or lots of local buses/ train station, lots of cafes and restaurants nearby too. Would recommend!

We enjoyed staying in Francesca‘s flat. The style of the flat and the atmosphere is really cosy and even better than on the pictures. Francesca is nice, proactive and friendly person. We recommend staying here!

We had a wonderful stay in this Airbnb. The place is cosy and made us felt like home.
The owner was understanding and allowed us to have late checkout when we had an emergency to deal with.

The apartment and all the amenities were top notch. Comfy sofa & Bed, showers were excellent as was the decor and facilities.
There were only 2 issues. The street noise from the deliveries & traffic was relentless.
The lounge area which was magnificent was also a little cold. Everywhere else seemed to have underfloor heating except the lounge.
Lovely place, cozy, clean, quiet.  Excellent location! Would stay there again!

Wir waren für 2 Nächte bei Alan und waren sehr überrascht, über die schöne ruhige Lage vor Ort und das Zimmer an sich. Alles war wie beschrieben und Alan selbst war ein sehr netter und hilfsbereiter Host, der hier und da sehr gute Empfehlungen für uns hatte.
Wir würden auf jeden Fall nochmal wieder kommen, Liebe Grüße aus Berlin B+E

Lovely and specious place with a very comfortable bed. It was very quiet at night even though the location was near the main road. Perfect for walking to the Holyrood park, a hike to the Arthur's Seat took only 40 minutes.
Everything in the apartment functioned properly. Fresh towels and kitchen supplies (tea, coffee, sugar, and condiments) were appreciated. Pier Luigi and Stewart made us feel very welcome.
Overall, it was a great stay
This place was clean and as described. We enjoyed the walk to Old Town (10-15 min, but an uphill walk!) quiet and clean, rather large. Laundry was a nice perk. Would stay here again.
Deborah’s unit was clean and tidy and the location is quite close to the town. Will recommend the unit to everyone

Nous avons pu accéder au logement rapidement.
Facile près des transports,
Un appartement situé dans un quartier calme.
Nous y avons passé quatre nuits. C'était super une partie terrasse.
merci barry
I loved the place, very peaceful and close to the center. Probably a bit expensive due to the high demand weekend when I visited but overall quite nice!
Great location with all things old town in close proximity. Property was clean and tidy with no clutter. Property on road but the Main road didn’t disrupt our sleep at all. It was never that busy.
L'accueil était parfait, la maison est très propre et très agréable dans un quartier très calme et pourtant très proche du centre. Je valide sans hésiter !
A very pleasant place to stay and a good location. Transport was just across the road & very accessible. Would stay there again.

Loved staying here! its a great apartment with enough space for us as a family of four (2 adults and 2 small kids). The beds, pillows and sofas are all very comfy. Everything was clean and in good order, a well kept place. Peter made us feel welcome and arriving and departure was easy. Its an easy stroll across the medows to town. All in all a great experience. The welcome basket is a lovely touch.
Great thank you for your hospitality and clear instructions.
Great place to stay, all very clean, car parking in front of the appartment, nice location near the beach, very quiet neighbourhood, lovely restaurants nearby, we highly recommend!

Great location - around the corner from all transportation and only 10-15 min walk to the Royal Mile. Just a few steps away are great restaurants too. Room was very comfortable and spacious - Rory was also fast at communicating with us when we had questions. Would definitely recommend to others!
The apartment is brilliantly located and has everything you need for a pleasant stay in Edinburgh.  Steve was a great host. Would definitely recommend.

Lovely stay! Located in the very nice area of the West End with bars and shops on the same road and walkable distance to the centre of Edinburgh past the castle - would highly recommend. Beautifully decorated and clean apartment with all the amenities you need - couldn’t ask for more and Suzanne was a lovely host.

Die Unterkunft war sehr schön, sauber und gut ausgestattet, nur eine Schere hat in der Küche gefehlt ;) Man könnte die Innenstadt super mit verschieben Bussen erreichen. Wer ohne Auto kommt, hat dadurch keinen Nachteil.
Albert is very friendly and helpful! His place is exactly like the description and photos. The location is great and within walking distance to all the city attractions. I recommend staying here.
He was very hospitable and helped with everything.

David’s place was amazing! The location was ideal for a morning stroll to the beach and there are so many links to the city centre within a few minute walk. The flat itself was unbelievably cosy that we had to make ourself leave to explore Edinburgh instead of staying in the whole time. Would highly recommend and would gladly stay again.

Dave & Tokes have a lovely and conveniently located home in the heart of Edinburgh- and they are some of the most hospitable people I've ever stayed with! The bed in the back room was incredibly comfortable and the croissant breakfast was just what my friend and I needed to kickstart our days of trekking around the city! I also felt right at home with their record collection- not going to lie, I perused that heavily, you guys. Thanks again!

Room was cozy. Low ceiling tho as it was in the attic. Shared bathroom, kitchen, and living area are  on the lower floor that made you have to go up and down the stairs. House was clean. Nice location, bus stops and grocery stores just 5 mins away walking. As Debby   worked from home tenants were expected not to stay in the room during weekdays. I was not expecting this TBH. Anyway, Debby was very friendly and she made yummy soup!!
Maggie was an excellent host - communicative, kind and flexible- we really appreciated her hospitality

Très bon séjour chez Paul, l'hygiène était nickel, l'arrivée facile et les lits étaient confortables (un peu court pour des grands).
Le salon est très agréable et la cuisine semblait nickel.

Hemos estado súper bien en el apartamento de Richard, cerca de todo y a la vez tranquilo, con todas las comodidades y limpio. Richard un anfitrión muy atento y amable, te agradecemos muchísimo tu hospitalidad. La verdad que un 10 de apartamento.
Carol is a great host. She was very welcoming and made sure all is set perfectly for our stay.
Andrew était toujours disponible et de bons conseils. Très discret en parallèle pour ne pas nous déranger. Merci !

Nice, clean & light room, thoughtful extra’s were provided (cereal, milk, some snacks).
The bus ride to the city center takes some time, but it’s easy to navigate and the daytickets (£5 pp) are absolutely fair priced and very practical!
We enjoyed our stay very much!
Buena ubicación, ideal para estudiantes
Sabrina was a welcoming and friendly host. The airbnb was in a great location with the city centre in old town being a short walk away.

Great place to stay. The beds were very comfortable. The place was also walking distance to various places.
There were a couple flights of stairs we had to walk up with our big luggage, which was a challenge. I don't believe stairs were mentioned in the description.

A great place to stay whilst in Edinburgh!
The flat was very central, clean and very comfortable.
Highly recommended ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Great comfortable place to stay!! So close to tram and restaurants

Jose is an excellent host, warm and generous. Whilst we didn't realise the rooms were shared with our host there weren't any problems at all. We would happily stay here again if we needed accommodation in Edinburgh again. Thanks Jose. :-)
the place is nice, clean, location is good, next to a tram, not too crowded. It would've been better to have a kettle inside the room and a hair dryer. They are only available at the reception.

Agie’s place is stylish, spacious and super clean. The bed are comfy I didn't want to get up! Communication with Agie was easy, she always respond to the message real quick. Her instruction to the flat is detailed, and there was no hassle about it. The location was great as well, with a walking distance to the city centre, Calton Hill and palace of Holyrood. Definitely recommend this place :)
Very good location, tidy and nice flat. Very thoughtful tips and warm hospitality! Highly recommend
Good place to stay in Edinburgh. Rebecca gave a lot of information. About the appartment, but also Good restaurants to visit and things to do. The place was clean and we had everything we needed.
Melissa’s place was beautiful! We love Dean Village. Melissa was very responsive and they have a very charming little place!

Look no further for an incredible apartment in Edinburgh. We had two couples in our party and there was plenty of space. The apartment is in a great location - walking distance from everything. It was very clean and well furnished. The fresh flowers on the table were a lovely touch!

I had a wonderful stay at Mike's apartment in Edinburgh. The location is excellent — close to the city center, in a nice neighborhood with plenty of restaurants, supermarkets, and very convenient access to public transport. The apartment itself was very clean, comfortable, and well-kept. The hosts, Mike and Pauline, were absolutely fantastic: friendly, responsive, and made everything smooth and easy. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Edinburgh and would definitely stay here again!
Spacious living room to relax, super comfortable beds and an excellent location.
Nice, clean, well equipped apartment that was walking distance from the centre and cafes/restaurants. V was very helpful and friendly! Thank you for a lovely stay!

We had a good time there. Location is superb! Just next door to the castle and not far from saintbury. Clean and full facilities.
Small car park is nearby. It was £12 all day if get in before 9am.
Flat is on 2nd floor without lift. We had pushchair and 2 elderly so it was not easy but we could manage.
This is THE place to go if visiting Edinburgh. It is finished to a very high level. The hosts are very helpful and accommodating. Just don't book after reading this when we want to go again 😊
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Édimbourg. Le logement est très bien situé : près d’une station de train. Maël a toujours été disponible et de bon conseil.

This is a prefect little flat. Fantastic location for sightseeing  or visiting friends/students. Charming interior and very peaceful . A very comfortable bed after a long day walking around Edinburgh. Lots of shops and cafes within short walking distance.

this is brilliant.
there is really nothing that‘s not perfect. It is a very special place right in the center. super clean and very smart studio. check in is easy aswell as the communication. 100% recommandable.

One of the nicest Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in. It was clean and spacious. We had six people fit comfortably. It was in a quiet spot but walkable to downtown and close to the bus. I would highly recommend to anyone that it looking for a wonderful stay in Edinburgh.

This is a great spot in Stockbridge. The apartment is private (no shared walls, just another unit below) and very quiet. My favorite spot in the apartment was the living room in the evenings. Comfy with throw blankets and dim lighting. The location is great for nearby cafes, bakeries, and restaurants. The bus stop is a handful of steps away to get to old town. The only minor negative is the bathroom is a bit tight, but considering the age of the building, it makes sense :).
Alisa was great to work with, always responsive, and very flexible. We will gladly stay here again and recommend it to others!
excellent location

David's place was an excellent locations for our stay in Edinburgh. He was very quick to communicate with and the flat was excellent for walking around town and exploring. Just be ready for those stairs.

The facilities, comfortability, location, and value are all tremendous, and Patrick was friendly, helpful, and accommodating throughout the duration of our stay. I highly recommend staying here when visiting Edinburgh

This is an amazing flat just a 10 minute walk from the Waverley Train Station. The apartment has a ton of room and character nestled at the end of South Niddry Street in Old Town where you are a quick 5 minute walk from The Royal Mile. The flat is thoroughly modern and super comfortable. It is tastefully decorated and the two bathrooms are a real score. The landlord is very responsive to any questions and we cannot recommend this property enough!
We had a great weekend and the flat was perfect - had all we needed and was cosy and clean. Thanks so much☺️
정말 너무 만족스러운 숙소였습니다! 내부 인테리어가 따뜻한 느낌에 캐슬 근처여서 정말 좋았어요. 주변 관광명소도 모두 도보권에 있어서 위치도 매우 좋습니다. 에든버러에 방문한다면 에어비앤비 중 이 숙소를 추천해요!
Great host, super friendly and great place to stay
Nice and cosy place, we enjoyed our stay.

The apartment was great! It is in a great spot for wandering into Edinburgh easily and is a very homely, comfortable and clean place to stay.
Momo is very helpful and responds quickly to any emails and questions.
I would not hesitate in staying here again if I venture up to Edinburgh in the future.
Thank you Marc for hosting us. We enjoyed staying in this spot-on, bustling location. Couldn't ask for more! 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
Yvonne's flat was lovely and comfortable and very close to the city centre. Unfortunately we didn't get to meet Yvonne but she was very helpful and easy to contact. Would definitely recommend!

Really nice appartment that felt like a tidy comfortable home from home. High ceilings made it feel especially spacious. Joshua was proactive in arranging check-in that worked for us and we felt like he would always be available should we have any questions. A great host in a great city.
Marek was great! Super informative and friendly. The place was clean and orderly and in a very central location which made it easy to get around.

Lovely and very spacious flat for 2, had everything we needed.
We would definitely recommend the Edinburgh Larder round the corner for breakfast/brunch, but you do need to book or go early. Lovely food at Baba, and loads of lovely pubs including St Vincent & Queens arms. Don’t visit the surgeons museum after having a large breakfast! 🤢

The room is practical and conveniently located, with many shops and restaurants nearby and a supermarket right down the street. It has all the essentials for a confortable overnight stay. The bathroom is very clean. The room looks directly onto the street so it can be noisy in the evening, but it becomes quiet after midnight. Nonetheless we had a nice stay and would be happy to come back.
Great airbnb, everything matched the pictures and was satisfied with my stay. Would highly recommend!

Cong is a very nice host. The place is cozy and comfortable. We did not expect to have breakfast which was really a big surprise and Cong is so kind to prepare an early breakfast for us at 6:15am. We felt thankful indeed.
great place, close to the centre of town, good for families
Close to everything on our list to see and do - being able to walk to most places saved us money on cabs. The area is very popular, with many places for good, drinks, and shopping as well.

We have good luck with ABB, but this was by far the best place we stayed in. It was definitely A Room with a View! The castle and Grassmarket being right out of the LR window was spectacular. The apartment is designed very well. Top things we noticed - plenty of hangers, great pillows, the view/location, instant hot water, a well designed interior, lots of electric plugs and quick responses by Douglas. Be sure to pack light though, there are a few steps up.
Poor walkway into the flat as it’s a Rebuilt council flat. Lovely inside and good parking. Location within the city also great.

Lovely, spacious apartment in a great location, Jing was really helpful with all check in information. Very clean with great facilities, would definitely stay her again as it was very affordable and easily slept 8 people.
Very quiet area with regular buses into town and bathrooms were great as well with good hot water and big shower.

Gabriella was a wonderful host with lots of advice on how best to get around the city and things to do. She supplied an excellent map which really helps when you first arrive in a new place and always replied to messages very quickly. We were lucky enough to be in Edinburgh for the last night of the festival and the fireworks and it was easy to walk to Princes Street from the apartment. Bruntsfield was a perfect location for us, close enough to walk everywhere but very quiet and residential. The apartment was spotless and well supplied with kitchen items. A welcome pack of goodies was an extra nice touch. Thank you!!
Really great welcome, fantastic area with lots of places to eat and right on the doorstep of the commonwealth swimming pool.
Great location, right at the foot of Edinburg Castle, close to shops and transportation.
The place was incredible - a great flat in a great location!

We stayed at Peters place for two nights and it was great.
Very inviting and comfortable. Had everything we needed.
Great location with everything you need of the street and walkable to the city centre

Helen's air bnb was perfect for my stay in Edinburgh. Right next to the botanical Gardens,  there was no noise at night and the mattress was so comfy.  Loved the private access and would definitely use this host again.  Helen was super helpful and the flat was beautifully maintained.  Thanks again Helen!
Bonita y limpia casa con buenos accesos para ir al centro de Edimburgo. Muchas gracias Douglas por las atenciones!

Fantastic stay, lovely apartment which was very handy for restaurants in Leith. Parking ideal. Emily was so helpful with instructions on arrival and was very quick with responses. Excellent host and would definitely stay again!

A perfect 2 day stay with Dave and Tokes! A cooooool designed house, and my room is exactly the same as the picture shows - stylish, cozy and clean. The host are kind and fascinating, and having some chatting with Dave and Tokes is such an amazing and particular experience. It's not like just simply visiting the city's famous sightseeings one by one. By communicating and sharing views and thoughts with Dave & Tokes, you feel more about the local and will definitely love Edinburgh more! I just hope I could stay longer here. Highly recommend!
Staying at Joan's was the best decision: a fabulous place, conveniently located and perfect with our kids (4 yo and 7 yo). The place has all what you need and the beds are very comfortable.
This place is in a great location in a beautiful building! The house felt a bit like a living museum, a bit messy but interesting. Great record collection :)
Amazing location. Comfortable room with private bathroom. James gave us valuable tips for our stay in the city. Would definitely rebook.
Great location for visiting the Castle, Princes Street and Grassmarket with all being within 1-10 mins walking distance. The apartment has all of the facilities you'd expect to have.

Exceptionally clean. Very comfortable space for 2 people. As other reviews mentioned, the flat is on a main street and there is quite a bit of street noise. We took ear plugs to use while sleeping and all was fine. The trade off is that it's very convenient to many attractions and restaurants. Extremely walkable location. I would definitely recommend for a few nights in Edinburgh.

Convenient location close to center, west end and Haymarket. Clean and well-heated flat. Recently painted.  Bedroom bed very good. A bit grotty staircase and no light on landing. Otherwise perfectly good for a couple of nights. Just very nice and made great recommendations
Alles war perfekt, wir sind sehr zufrieden!

schone nette kamers. top locatie. midden in het oude centrum

Perfect location for getting around Edinburgh.

Our stay was good; the neighborhood was quiet and accessible. If you’re looking to stay here, I will note it’s a little far from city center, but it is close to Arthur’s Seat and the beach, so just keep in mind what your plans or goals are. The neighborhood was quite safe though, and it has access to multiple bus stops.

Loved my time at Tessa’s place. The room was so cute! It was awesome to also get breakfast with the room as well. Tessa was fabulous, responsive and easy to chat to! Would deffo recommend staying at her place.
Good location, perfect for our stay.

Spacious, practical and stylish stay, 20/30 mins (dependent on traffic) from Edinburgh city centre. Not the most pretty of areas, though the hills as a backdrop, the interior of the property and the directness into the city outweighed this. For a family of four it was perfect, with both sons loving having a 'cool' room to themselves. The main bedroom is chic and relaxing and all the beds and pillows super comfortable. The kitchen is well stocked amenities wise,  with a huge stove and oven ,though do bring your tea bags and coffee as not supplied. If, like me, you feel the cold, then bring slippers or inside shoes as its a shoes off policy and mostly wooden floors . And I was glad we brought larger towels with us (though towels are included). Clare was an amazing host, always responsive and understanding. Thank you for a great stay.

Very well located apartment in the middle of the old town. Host was super responsive and everything inside functioned well and the place was very clean. Only negative comment is the noise from the street which is quite significant (we stayed Thu-Sun) and prevented peaceful nights.
Excellent location, comfortable and clean room and a friendly host.
Great stay, great location and lovely flat! Thank you so much for hosting us.

My wife and I stayed at Youlia's place for a night while attending a function nearby. The room was spotless, with a comfortable bed and excellent bathroom. Youlia was very helpful and responsive at every stage of the process. Highly recommended
Good location with public transport links, trendy restaurants and cafes in the area

Fantastic location, lovely little flat and fab guide! Hosts were really quick to reply to questions before and during stay. Guide had everything you could want - ideas on things to do and places to eat as well as all the info you’d need about check in, the flat during your stay and check out. Would 100% stay here again if we come back to Edinburgh

100% recommend, especially for a solo traveler or couple. The location was perfect, close to university, Arthur’s Seat, Meadows and Royal Mile. It was a perfect base for exploring. Kelly’s local guide and tips book she had created is second to none, make sure to read it, it had everything in it. Super comfortable bed, very clean flat and easy to use kitchen. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!
The place was amazing. Great location. Everything worked fine. Host Raymond was quick to respond and check in was a breeze.

Beautiful and spacious apartment, great location, walking distance to main attractions. Stunning views!!!! Clean and in very good condition.
Rebecca was very responsive and helpful.
Thank you for your hospitality. We had a wonderful time!

A szállás kicsit kiesik, a belváros peremén van, de jó buszközlekedéssel rendelkezik és a környék is nyugodt/biztonságos. A szállás tiszta, jó ár/erték arányú. A konyha abszolút használható, a közelben kávézó, pizzázó, boltok és és egy remek pub is található. A hazigazdák nagyon segítőkészek. mi nagyon jól éreztük itt magunkat!

Nikki could not have been more darling, only to rivaled by her apartment.  It was equally charming, true to description and was a great “nest” to spend time in.  We had two rainy days, and this was a wonderful place to come back to.  Easy walking distance to old and new town.  Grocery and restaurants close by.  We literally walked out the door to every place we wanted to visit.  We also had an early morning flight day of departure.  We walked out of the flat to the tram, only minutes away, for the airport.  Super easy.

David’s place is one of the best out there with regards of location, price, cleanliness and amenities. The place has got everything and we really appreciate him for putting all the needed toiletries, basic things in the kitchen such as a loaf of bread, milk, coffee, a couple of drinks and etc. The place is well maintained as well and really appreciate his prompt reply and for being a very accommodating host. Will definitely book this place again if I come back to Edinburgh. The best!!! ❤️

We loved the cosy cabin. It met with all our needs and Gill and Colin went beyond expectations, they were warm friendly, flexible and helpful. The cabin was all we needed, and more, for a four night stay in the middle of a Scottish winter. We would definitely recommend it and will stay there again. Thank you!
Good experience
I felt like this was my second home. It has always been such a lovely place. Very quiet and peaceful experience again with the wonderful hosts. Well-maintained as always!!

Very clean. Truly spacious and located in a good spot.
Hosts left some cookies and coffee/tea, which was very nice.
Its very easy to sleep in this place as the beds were comfy and room had blinds.
The only 2 issue are:
1. the furniture in the living room is very uncomfortable, specially the 2 armchairs.
2. No mirrors other than the one in the bathroom (no electric outlet) which makes getting ready a little inconvenient
The place was perfect for our stay to explore Edinburgh. Great location and we enjoyed the very large living room for our chatting! Highly recommend.

The place was great, the outside and the stairs in to it are a bit deceptive but the unit itself was very modern and very well kept. The location is walkable to many of the attractions and there are restaurants and food outlets near by. Only issue we would raise is it can be a little noisy at night from street traffic and there is a lot of light from the street as well. This didn't worry us but its something to be aware of if you are sensitive to those issues.
We had an amazing stay at Donna’s flat in Edinburgh! Beautifully presented and spacious. Donna communicated consistently and provided great local knowledge too! Would absolutely love to stay again.

Accommodation was as described, very walkable to city centre, also well served by buses,
Very nice living area with a modern kitchen and lounge and dining table, although chairs were a bit wobbly.
Bathroom has nice big shower, although water pressure not great, and there was a flickering light. And the issue with the water on a timer, you might need to fiddle with a boiler setting.
Nice TV with streaming services.
Area is quiet, and nice break if you're going into the city, to come back to for some pease and quiet. There is a grocery shop nearby.
There is a cafe called "not just coffee", nice coffee and pastries, however service was very very slow and chaotic.
Bedroom is on the small side, and there are bright lights on all night outside but curtains do block out most of the light.
Be sure to read the guide, I hadn't seen the note about the hot water, which ran out quite quickly on the first day, but Luke was responsive and pointed out how to resolve the issue.

This space is cozy and in the best location! The living space is great for relaxing after a day of exploring and the kitchen is fully equipped. It’s a delightful and perfect place to stay while enjoying an amazing city. Caroline was great to coordinate with and made sure the apartment was fully stocked with essentials.

Fantastic stay at Dovecot Cottage. Beautiful setting that is very different to a typical hotel, which made all the difference.
Host was extremely helpful, professional and friendly making us feel welcome. Would 100% recommend.
Thanks Sarah :)

Very clean. Well equipped. Modern and comfortable. Good access and parking. Well located for our three night stay over Christmas. Be aware that the electricity meter operates on credit top ups. On Boxing Day the electricity went off and the whole morning was wasted trying to contact someone to help and resolve the problem, something I eventually managed to do myself at some inconvenience. Such a shame that this took the shine off an otherwise enjoyable stay.
really enjoyed the house/location and the owners went out their way to help when we had a problem. Just perfect
Easy to check in, great location for staying in Edinburgh

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. Rushdi est un excellent hôte, toujours disponible et réactif. L'accès aux commodités de l'appartement est très pratique et la proximité à pieds du centre ville d'Edimbourg et des sites touristiques est un véritable atout.

I couldn't recommend staying at Steve's place more! Our travel arrangements went a bit wrong meaning we were late for check-in. Steve was so accommodating and was happy to make other arrangements. The flat itself is beautiful with spacious rooms, 2 bathrooms and a huge living room. There's currently no kitchen but Steve left us water, snacks and some bits and bobs for breakfast. The location is very central but perfectly quiet at night. If I needed somewhere else to stay in Edinburgh, I'd definitely book with Steve again!

This apartment is in the PERFECT place for travelers, and people who want the full Edinburgh experience! It is so easy to get to all the major tourist areas, and has a stunning view of  the university, right across the street! Great base for solo travelers, and the space is massive! The room feels like it’s own entire flat! Trystan is great at responding and you’ll feel right at home! I highly recommend this as a great place to stay!
房间非常完美，各种细节都做的很好，是我们爱丁堡之旅中最好的组成部分！

This was an absolutely delightful and well appointed apartment . Such comfy beds, fully kitted out kitchen & bathroom. Everything was so clean & pleasing to the eye. Super location . The host was very sweet and helpful. Thank u very much Aleksandra, much appreciated 🙏💕
BUT one thing that was very hard & bothersome were the stairs that felt uncomfortable and endless given we had to haul suitcases and boxes up and down . I wish it had been mentioned that there was no lift in the building which was also very old and not well maintained.
I really like the place , it matches the description and photos. Quite environment as well !
Yatin was a great host and the accommodation was exactly as advertised. A very comfortable stay with easy access to the centre.
Poco luminoso
Mel was great! We were running late for reasons out of our control and she was very flexible and patient with our arrival. The apartment is very cute and functional.

Wonderful stay in a beautiful home and a prime location. Very short walk to the train, buses and tram. The home was also close to a prime shopping district and great restaurants. Owners were helpful, friendly and organized. Would highly recommend this Airbnb and we would stay again in a heartbeat.

Extremely friendly and welcoming, surprisingly peaceful location.
Thank you Irene xx

The team was really nice and helpful when I did have issues, which there were multiple during the check in process (first room hadn’t been cleaned, second had key card issues at first).
The location was a good combination of walkable to Old Town but not in a super packed area. Was also very close to bus stop.
Room was fine outside of the shower, which was definitely subpar compared to hostels I have stayed at in the area.
Take out the issues with the shower and upfront communication/checking in, overall a good value and wouldn’t mind staying again in a pinch.

Estuvimos muy comodos en el apartamento de Margaret. Es muy amplio, esta impecablemente limpio, ordenado y bien equipada la cocina. La calefaccion se encendia de a ratos y mantenia el ambiente agradablemente calefaccionado.  La parada del bus justo enfrente te deja en el centro en 10 minutos. La ubicacion es muy comoda para pasear x Edimburgo. Margaret es la mejor anfitriona, se comunico con nosotros antes de nuestra llegada, durante la  estadia y despues de retirarnos preocupandose por nuestro bienestar y comodidad. Nos dejo de regalo una hermosa tarjeta de bienvenida y una botella de Prosecco para brindar. Gracias Margaret por tu dedicada atencion, te recordaremos gratamente. Recomiendo sin dudarlo este apartamento y la ciudad de Edimburgo es fabulosa!!!
Pawel is a good guy and he makes you feel very welcome in his home

It has a very luxurious feel to the apartment. It was great have two bathrooms - one for each bedroom. The location is on a street with no traffic, but is just a few feet from a main street with bakeries, cafes,  and pubs. You can easily walk into the heart of Edinburgh. We enjoyed our stay, and really appreciate the support from Gintare.
A modern, clean apartment in a perfect central location. Friendly and efficient responses from Rebecca. Would recommend.

The Flat was right on the Royal mile which was great. Location wise couldn't have been better. Once we got into the flat, it was nicely quiet. You couldn't hear the noise from the Mile. The flat looks out over a courtyard which you can look out over from the dining table. It feels magical. The bathroom was very clean and well stocked. The kitchen was nice, though honestly we didn't use it as we were only there for our return before heading back home. But it was well stocked enough that if we needed to cook we could have. The beds were nice and there was enough light and plugs for everyone. Everything about it was great. Also Harvey was really nice and gave great communication. Directions to get in where very easy. We had a great time.

Sehr nette Gastgeber. Sehr hilfsbereit. Bekamen sofort Kaffee angeboten und wurden zum Nudelessen eingeladen. Zimmer hatte eigenes Bad und eine kleine Terrasse. Bus nach EDI nur wenige Minuten entfernt.
Stylish apartment that was a great distance from the city centre.
Central appartment with two bedrooms, clean and tidy, about 10-15 minutes from central Edinburgh. Comfortable, warm. Host was welcoming and helpful.

Ottima posizione, camera ampia. Ci ha offerto anche a colazione pur non essendo compresa. Ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo. Cong ci ha anche permesso di fare il check in anticipato senza farci pagare nulla

Prima accommodatie, lekker centraal en alles op loop afstand. Kan wel wat lawaai van de straat en feestvierders horen. Oud gebouw maar goed onderhouden.
Naast het app zit de beste koffiebrander van de stad. Heerlijk wakker worden 's morgens. Fijn dat er een verloopstekker lag, die waren wij vergeten.
Je hebt verder geen live contact met de verhuurder. Ook niet nodig maar kan wat kil overkomen. Inside tips of must see's in het appartement was nog leuk geweest.
A very good flat, near the city center reachable by walk or by transports, the flat itself has everything and the bed is really comfortable

A fabulous place to stay, easy access to Edinburgh- great beds, amazing view of both the Forth Road and Rail bridges, room to move around and in the beautiful village of South Queensferry. Thanks Cody for sharing this little gem.
We really enjoyed stay at Alistair's house. It was cozy, with great location near city centre and Artur's Seat. Alistair is super friendly host and we will definitely recommend this accommodation:)

An amazing friendly and very helpful host- SPLENDID communication throughout. The room looks even better in reality- super spacious, warm, plenty of storage and TV with a large collection of films if it's raining outside ;) the flat is in a very calm and beautiful neighborhood, easy access to the city centre- maximum 15 min on foot but there are buses just round the corner form the flat. Definitely coming back (both to Edinburgh and William :))
Beautiful flat in a brilliant location - take me back!
Great spot - the flat was clean and comfortable. It’s in a great location just off the meadows and the check in process was seamless. Would recommend!

Great place to stay! The bus stop is just outside the door and there are lots of coffee shops and cafes around for a convenient breakfast, as well as little markets for daily needs. The bus takes you right to the Royal mile and is less than a 10min ride. You can also take the bus to and from the train station with great ease. There are stairs, so be prepared if traveling with heavier luggage. Truly, this place is great and exactly what we needed for our short 3 day stay!
Awesome apartment, well equipped, super clean, modern and well-divided.

Julia is an absolutely wonderful host and we enjoyed our stay at her lovely Airbnb. Such a charming room and everything, including the bathroom was impeccably clean. Thank you for the warm welcome, the fresh fruit, water, milk and cookies. The location is perfect for experiencing Edinburgh. We walked everywhere and never needed to take the tram or bus. For breakfast there are great options close by. We liked the "Braw Brunch’ the best, but also found ‘Preachers" a delightful experience. In the evening we took a walk to the "Ensign Ewart"’ and loved the atmosphere of the pub’s front room, especially with folk music being played after 9 PM. Thank you, Julia for your quick answers and helpful insight whenever we had questions. We can highly recommend Julia’s Airbnb and hope to return soon.
Anne’s place is right in the middle of the Royal Mile! It can be a little noisy at night but that is what you could expect. The food at the Copper Still below is very nice.
ottima posizione e host supergentile e reattivo. perfetto per un viaggio on the road, disponibile anche all'ultimo minuto.
The flat was clean, quiet and had all the essentials. The bed very comfortable and we had a great stay. Thank you !
The room was great. The location is very good. Host is the best. Of u finding space to stay in Edinburg recommend here. :)
On the top floor up a steep staircase; otherwise fine.   Good location for the University and for Arthur's Seat.
Great stay, great location! Thank you!
Really nice little apartment. nice and light despite being a basement. the little outdoor space was also lovely on a warm evening

Susan’s apartment is just perfect. It is located within the very centre of Edinburgh, with lots of amenities within walking distance, including bars, restaurants, supermarkets and Edinburgh Castle, but situated just off Leith Walk it is quiet and secluded enough not to be too noisy.
We will definitely be back the next time we have a trip to Edinburgh planned.
It was a really nice stay thanks to Ceysa’s heartwarming hospitality. We stayed as if we were in our own house. The bathroom was great. And finally “Shanti” is very cute and smart dog.

A fantastic, super comfortable flat - the location is amazing (right under the castle) and the flat is cosy with every amenity we could have needed. Great communication in the run-up to arrival and Stephanie was more than happy to answer any questions we had about Edinburgh and the fringe. We had a lovely stay.
Very nice place and lovely host

Nous avons passé un super séjour dans la superbe maison de Laura, située dans un quartier paisible. Plusieurs bus sont accessibles pour rejoindre Édimbourg jusque tard en soirée.
Nous avons pu séjourner à 8 personnes à notre aise. Nous recommandons ce logement.

El departamento superó nuestras expectativas.  Es realmente hermoso y muy bien ubicado. No fue necesario usar transporte público.  Rosie estuvo pendiente de cada detalle. Volveríamos a elegirlo sin dudar.

This apartment is very well done in a good location. My only complaint is that it is up two flight of a winding staircase that had no lighting. We arrived after dark and nearly broke our necks trying to carry our bags up. The host said she was not aware of it, and I do believe her, but it was treacherous getting to the apartment. Great location, though!

Una’s place was very centrally located-walking distance to Edinburgh Castle and Royal mile -the tour of the castle was awesome-farmers market every Saturday morning down at the end of the street! Very helpful with answering any questions we had ! Personally met us at apartment to greet us and let us in ! Enjoyed our stay!definitely recommend!
This place was a great place to stay at, especially if you like to be a little away from the city. The beds were comfortable and it really felt like a home.
The flat was lovely and ideal for exploring central edinburgh. The size was perfect for us and it was great having the garden. We would highly recommend.

Lovely stay close to Edinburgh. Great for a group of friends.
A really lovely space within walking distance of Edinburgh City centre. You even have a nice balcony on the not so chilly nights to enjoy the fresh air

Great communication, Matt met me outside , let me in showed me everything and how ting worked, gave his number and made suggestions of where to go.
Fantastic location, Harry Potter names on the Graves in Greyfriars Kirkyard behind, the Royal Mile within 5 minutes walking, 15 mins from the tram drop-off from the airport on Prince's street.
The flat is an old building, a little creeky and drafty but not a problem, lots of character, good heating when you get the hang of it, all the amenities you need and 2 convenience stores within 3 mins walk.
I'll be trying to book this place again next time I come back to Edinburgh!!
Many thanks to Andy & Margaret for sharing their accomodation!
Great location next to the castle and great restaurants. A bit noisy on the bottom floor. Could use a few doorstops to keep the heavy bedroom doors open and prevent slamming.

This is really comfy nice place. The bathroom is next door and is practically private for the room. Gwen and Jazz (the cat) are lovely, make us feel like home.  Everything was really clear to get there and use the facilities,  besides the room has a beautiful decoration and there were some cookies and tea bags for us.  I location is great, close to some pubs, supermarkets and bus stops, to reach the city center in 20 minutes. I really recommend this place.
Fantastic spot. Gorgeous little apartment. Couldn't have asked for a better stay.
This was a fantastic place to stay. Very central. I would recommend it.

Such a beautiful place which we felt right at home in. The beds were dreamy comfy and everywhere super clean. We had such a wonderful time.
The location is perfect, with everything being in walking distance.
We went between Leith, along the river and Stockbridge, where they have a wonderful farmers market on a Sunday.
It was lovely that the pantry was fully stocked so we didn’t have to nip out for basics and ample bread and milk supplies too. The kitchen was so well equipped that it was a joy to cook in.
Would recommend to anyone wanting a home from home for family and friends. Such an adorable apartment. Thank you for sharing it with us..!

Great flat in a bustling part of the city with walkability in every direction. Good size for 1 person, good for two people too but the bed was a bit smaller than we expected so it was snug. Heating was a little finicky but we were out and about so much we barely noticed. Would definitely recommend this flat to anyone visiting Edinburgh!

Can’t say enough good things about our stay. It was our first trip to Edinburgh and this was a great location for us. Local & quiet, Close enough to get into the city within 10-15 minutes, close bus stops, good food close by, Cafe Florentin, convenience stores and pubs.
The flat was just what we needed space wise with 4 adults and was so cute! The other residents were very kind and quiet as well.
But beyond all that, Elisa was amazing. She always answered questions right away and when we inadvertently locked ourselves out, she drove into town with extra keys one night! She went Above and beyond!!
If we are ever fortunate enough to come back, we would love to stay again!
Very nice house, clean,comfortable and cosy

Wir haben uns bei Rosie sehr wohl gefühlt, bis auf Kleinigkeiten, wie das sehr schmale Bett im 2. Schlafzimmer und nur 2 Pätze am Esstisch (wir waren 4 Gäste). Ansosten war alles super, viele kleine zusätzliche Extras, wie echter gemahlener Bohnenkaffee, Haferkekse, Frischmilch, Hafermilch ... haben uns erfreut. Wir können die Unterkunft und vor allem auch Rosie als super nette Gastgeberin nur weiter empfehlen. Die Wohnung ist als Ausgangspunkt für alle Unternehmungen in Edinburgh excellent gelegen. Danke sagen wir 4 Reisenden.

I’ve been in this apartment for 4 days, and it went smoothly. The apartment was clean and well organized. It was near old town, only 20 min on foot.
I would recommend it for sure
Great apartment, well located, clean and has everything you need. Lovely garden as well!

Christine was an amazing host! We stayed for my wife’s birthday and Christine and her beautiful home helped make the trip phenomenal. She was always in communication with us. The location is close to so many different things! It’s a lovely home that makes you feel comfortable and relaxed. We very much hope to stay again in the future. We highly recommend this stay! Thank you Christine!!!
Nice place in Edinburgh. Host suggests a lot of great places to eat.

This place was absolutely perfect for our stay! We didn’t want to leave! It’s in a great location for lots of bars and restaurants, it was super clean and comfortable with a delightful bed and shower.

Catalina’s place is nice and we felt at home.
It was hard to find so we would recommend you do not arrive after dark.
A piece of info that would have helped us greatly is that the gate/entrance to the building is right next door to Starbucks (starbucks is on a corner)
This location is great for experiencing the Royal Mile but not good for sleeping. It is very loud all night long out on the street level. This is due to the sounds of people below. Each night of our stay there were drunk people who seemed to hang out down below, yelling for hours on end.
We got very little sleep because of this.
Noise would be a problem anywhere on the Royal Mile actually.
This is not a reflection on the actual apartment, which was quite nice but the noise made it hard to enjoy a restful sleep.

Catherine’s place is absolutely wonderful! It’s welcoming, peaceful, and located in a quiet area with a bus stop just a few minute walk away, making it very accessible. The house is clean and tidy, with all the amenities you could need. The bathroom was spotless, and the cosy bedroom made for a very comfortable stay. Catherine and her family are so kind and made us feel right at home. Highly recommend!
Great location and exactly as described. Brandon was so responsive and provided great instructions on how to locate and get in the flat as well as how to use the amenities.

James och Allison var fantastiskt trevliga värdar - välkomnande, generösa och hjälpsamma. De delade med sig av bra rekommendationer på både saker att se och restauranger. Boendet var nytt och fräscht. Vi fick låna familjens eget kök till frukost, men själva sovrummet med badrum låg separat. Detta gjorde också att vi lätt fick kontakt med värdarna och fick möjlighet att småprata lite då och då. Läget var perfekt med gångavstånd till det mesta, men i ett lugnt område. Rekommenderar verkligen detta boende! Tack för en trevlig vistelse!

Elizabeth’s home is sparkling clean and welcoming. Elizabeth herself was a warm, kind and energetic person who was very responsive to my requests for things like bus timetables and power adapters. Although her place is slightly out of town, it was very easy to catch a bus to and from town. A safe, beautiful and comfortable spot from which to explore Edinburgh.

Mycket bra läge nära till allt. Trevlig omgivning med bra restauranger. Lätt att hitta. Stort härligt vardagsrum och bra köksdel o badrum. Mysigt.

Excellent location, very clean and a very comfortable bed! We were so pleased with the room and the communication was quick and extremely helpful. We would definitely recommend Bide and would stay again if we return to Edinburgh Newtown!
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in Jackies geschmackvoll eingerichteter Wohnung und Jackie war sehr hilfsbereit, großzügig und freundlich zu uns.
Great place and will love to stay at the place again.
Lovely apartment, matched everything Lukasz has said in the listing. Some of the headboards of the bedz were broken but nothing that caused any issues. Would recommend, very private area too

This place was perfect! Great location right in the magical old town of Edinburgh! If i ever came back i would 100% stay here again. Stuart aas so quick to communicate and help us out when we had questions!

Alan is an incredible human, and his love, curiosity, and interest in travelers is clearly evident from the moment he shakes your hand in the train station -- yes, Alan picked my boyfriend and I up from said station when we arrived, and even drove us around the city and then to our rental car spot the next day -- his friendliness and generosity knows no bounds! His apartment is in a fantastic location just minutes from central Edinburgh by bus or foot, with tons of excellent eateries and shops just around the corner (which he can advise you on), and is clean, comfortable, and professional feeling (hotel-sized shampoo and conditioners await you in your private bathroom, etc) without ever feeling stuffy. The positive reviews for this flat may have been appropriate if it weren't for that fact that we had a mouse run through the living room during our stay. The host was apologetic and agreed to provide a refund, but didn't agree that a refund for the cost of one night was reasonable, although most of us didn't sleep well at all given the mouse. He refunded just under 15% of my total cost for two nights and stopped communicating with me when I asked if he would compromise on an amount in between.
I also provided him with feedback on the quality of the sleeping accommodations in the living room, but he didn't respond to my comments/concerns.
Although I typically expect to have some kind of breakfast provided at an AirBnb, there was no breakfast or food of any type in the flat, except for sugar and tea.

We will definately stay here again when we come to Edinburgh.
