There were two bottles of shampoo which looked like the last guests had left them behind. For the almost $500 AUD per night that we paid, we expected a little more. Overall, we enjoyed our time there and whilst our issues were not serious, a bit more attention to detail, like we had encountered in our prior accommodation, would have escalated our experience from disappointing to "wow factor".

I had a great stay at Adam and Rebecca’s ! The locations is excellent for walking into Edinburgh aswell as exploring the many restaurants and bars in the area. The place was spotlessly clean and had all the amenities to make me feel right at home. If you are thinking of staying in Edinburgh, I can’t recommend this place enough!!
The room is huge and the bed very comfortable!
Outstanding

Hemos tenido una gran estancia en el apartamento de Teresa. Tiene todo lo necesario para pasar unos días, con detalle de bienvenida muy completo: leche, café, galletas, mermelada, zumo, etc etc. El alojamiento es incluso más bonito de cómo se ve en las imágenes. La cama y el sofá son cómodos. La zona es tranquila y a la vez está cerca del centro y del transporte público, así como se supermercados. Teresa, la anfitriona, ha sido muy amable y nos ha proporcionado información completa tanto para la entrada al apartamento, como para hacer cosas por la ciudad. Muchas gracias por todo!

Such a great spot! Location was superb. Not very loud considering.
Craig was very helpful (we are sometimes clueless Americans).

This apartment is in a great location for sightseeing! The tiny balcony with the view of the castle was amazing. You can hear the music from the tattoo each night and you’ll have a view of the drone show and the fireworks as well.
The apartment is a great space for two people. I can’t imagine having a 3rd person using the sofa bed as it would feel pretty cramped.
As other reviewers have said, there are four flights of stairs up to the apartment. I didn’t think they were bad at all, but after a long day of walking it is something to consider.
The only thing I wish the apartment had is some sort of fan. It was warm while we were visiting and the apartment does heat up… A fan would have made the temperature more comfortable.
Parking was not easy to find as our phone maps didn’t seem to be updated to where the parking lots actually are. There is an NCP lot close by, our phones just didn’t see it for whatever reason.
Overall a great stay!

Espectacular, súper bien atendido en todo momento. Taya muy atenta y preocupada de cada detalle. Si vuelvo a la ciudad me encantaría volver a hospedar aquí. Habitación amplia, limpia y luminosa. Zona inmejorable

Appartement très bien situé, calme et proche du centre à pied. Super carte de la ville rédigée par Kelly avec les endroits à voir, les lieux où sortir,... nous avions toujours la carte avec nous! Il y a tout à disposition dans l'appartement pour passer un très bon séjour.
A réserver sans hésiter.

Skye’s place was perfect for our three day stay in Edinburgh.  About a 25 minute walk from Waverley train station and 20 to the Royal Mile. Very convenient Sainsbury’s almost next door came in handy every day. Quiet and comfortable for relaxing after long days on the streets. Skye was very helpful and pleasant in all communications. Highly recommended!

Host was very accommodating and flexible with check in and check out times. Host was friendly and easy to communicate with. The place was pristine and peaceful. I did enjoy my stay there. A little far from my city center which was the only nuisance other than that it is easily accessible. Would highly recommend it for anyone visiting Edinburgh.
Locations is convenient, room is clean and has everything I need. Host is friendly and responsive. An absolutely pleasant stay
Great clean place in a good location with fantastic hospitality. Would recommend.

The house is in a perfect location, walking distance to all main attractions, the house was very clean and cosy to stay in.
Highly recommended.

It’s a lovely flat, very cosy and warm with everything you need, in a quiet area… very close to a tram stop (we didn’t use it because we had a car, but we parked right in front of the house). Gosia was always very kind and helpful, has answered all of our questions and was very understandable. Definitely a place I recommend to stay ☺️
Mingjun is a very helpful host who prioritises his guests.
Great space for our last day in Scotland. Clean, cozy, and a short walk to all the main sites in Edinburgh. Highly recommend.

A Beautiful Penthouse Apartment with all the amenities, spotless, every morning I woke up there was a friendly good morning note,offering cereals, tea,coffee and fresh Bread.Such a peaceful home and not far from the City and 100% worth coming here.Thank you very much .
The flat is very nice and clean. It only takes 5min work form Edinburgh Waverley to the flat. And it is also close to the Royal mile, princess street, Edinburgh castle and other famous sightseeings.

A great spacious two bedroom apartment, easy to get into the centre of Edinburgh with a super responsive host. Spotless and lovely decoration we were delighted with our stay and hope to be back, thank you
We stayed at the cozy little loft. Great location, easy check in and a little chared kitchen! We would recommend!
An amazing little flat incredibly close to the town centre, Kym went out of her way to ensure  it was a special experience for us.

Jo a été une hôte remarquable : disponible, flexible, très chaleureuse. L’appartement est encore mieux que les photos, situé dans un coin paisible et tout est à pied à proximité.
L’appartement est grand, confortable, très propre et bien équipé: on s’y sent chez soi et Jo a à cœur le confort de ses invités.
5 stars all the way ❤️

Lynne’s place is just wonderful! She is so accommodating and is super prompt in her responses to inquiries. The place has incredible views of Edinburgh Castle. The location is great with lots of pubs, shops, and bars around. Check out the Dragonfly bar across the street. Super cool spot (thanks to Lynne’s recommendation!). Overall, this place is great and I would definitely stay here next time I am in Edinburgh.

Fantastic Leith/Newhaven location; easy tram transport from and to airport. Groceries nearby. Easy walk into city centre. we used the Leith river walk daily to get everywhere we needed to go. While the rate was high for us we needed the privacy and the apartment was well appointed in so many ways. Emily’s guide to great restaurants was excellent. Tx Emily for such good accommodation. Also felt very safe space and neighborhood.
Great location and very comfortable flat.  Host most welcoming and helpful.  Quiet bedrooms with good beds, blinds and curtains for a great night's sleep.  I'd definitely recommend it.

Very nice place. It is a little outside of town, but still accessible by bus. Honestly, it is a little more spacious than the pictures make it seem. We comfortably slept three. Squeaky clean and good amenities.

Thank you for a very enjoyable stay in the flat. Location is ideal and the communication with the host is fast and efficient.  Instructions to check in and check out were clear and easy. Would highly recommended this place for 2 guests.
Isaac and Derek were wonderful hosts and very accommodating.  They have a beautiful apartment, well furnished and a stones throw from the royal mile.
The flat was delightful! Exactly as promised and a very responsive host! Highly recommend!!

Very friendly and welcoming host. The room was very comfortable with all amenities you might need for even a longish stay.

The location is fairly typical Edinburgh, near enough to the City Centre to walk and just round the corner from Holyrood Park.

Certainly would consider this booking for future visits to the City.

Mille was at the flat when we arrived. I highly recommend renting this flat it has everything you need. The location was fabulous
Thanks
Cozy little room perfectly situated to explore Edinburgh. Alexia was quick to respond to communication and had great recommendations for things to see and places to eat. Definitely recommend!
Great location

We had a wonderful stay at Lindsey's glamorous apartment in the centre of Edinburgh. So comfy and with lots of generous touches like the breakfast hamper and even some food for our little one. (That said, it's a bit of a hike up the stairs with a pusher, we regretted not bringing the sling!)
A lovely apartment in an excellent location! Brilliant communication from Charlotte. Would definitely stay again X X
tout était adéquat
Great location and lovely little flat!  Thanks :)
Great place at good location!

Muy buena estadía. El apartamento muy cómodo y limpio. Buena ubicación cerca de transporte público y supermercados.
Bonito sector.

We had the most incredible stay here. The apartment was even more beautiful, spacious and luxurious feeling that it seemed from the pictures. The attention to detail
was exceptional and it felt like a stay in a 5 star hotel. The apartment was so beautifully decorated, everything we needed was there including things like a cocktail shaker and beautiful glassware for drinks. The bed linen and towels were pristine and hotel standard. This is a perfect place for a family/friend celebration trip or just a fantastic base for an Edinburgh city trip. I cannot recommend it more. We will certainly be returning.

Wir waren drei Erwachsene und ein Baby und bleiben 5 Nächte.
Das Airbnb liegt sehr zentral, direkt in der berühmten Victoria Street. Das Apartment liegt im 1. Stock ohne Lift mit Fenstern raus auf die Straße trotzdem war es nicht laut im Apartment.
Leider war das Apartment nicht sehr sauber und müsste dringend saniert werden. Das Waschbecken im Badezimmer war schon zu Beginn verstopft.
Auf den Fotos waren in dem einen Schlafzimmer zwei Einzelbetten abgebildet. Als wir ankamen waren diese zusammengeschoben und es gab nur eine Decke für beide Betten. Außerdem gab es nur zwei große Handtücher für drei Erwachsene. Der Vermieter hat uns am nächsten Tag zusätzliche Bettwäsche/Handtücher bringen lassen. Dennoch würde ich bei drei Erwachsenen auch drei Bettdecken erwarten. Ein Leintuch für das zweite Bett haben wir leider nicht erhalten.

In dem kleineren Schlafzimmer zog es leider durchs Fenster direkt auf das Bett.
Die Küche ist allerdings recht modern und gut ausgestattet.

I stayed in St Giles Views for 3 nights and the room was exactly as described. It was lovely, immaculate and bright with a fantastic view of St Giles Cathedral and Arthur's Seat. The location is perfect and I was able to walk everywhere. Patrick's instructions on getting to the apartment were clear and easy. Patrick kindly gave me a map of the city and a list of restaurant recommendations which was so helpful. He was also happy to answer any questions and was quick at responding to any messages I sent online. Thank you both so much for such a lovely stay. It was my first time using Airbnb and it was a great experience.
we enjoyed staying in this apartment. big enough for three friends.  close to the city center, good restaurants right next door. lovely city! enjoying Scottish hospitality in Edinburgh.
Perfect stay! Hôte très disponible et réactif , emplacement parfait , appartement qui ne manque de rien ! Merci et à bientôt peut être 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿

Hôte très compréhensif et réactif, j'ai passé un super séjour dans sa chambre, idéalement située et agréable.
Je lui dis une fois de plus merci pour tout !
Amazing place and near to city center. Skye was super helpful. Highly recommend this place if you plan to visit Edinburgh.

A cosy house in good condition with plenty of space for 4. Between the airport and the city centre. Supermarkets and restaurants 15 minute walk, with a corner shop even closer. Recommended for a visit to Edinburgh.
Lovely place. Thank you for your hospitality

Amazing location, walking distance to the whole of the city. If you can walk 15-20 mins. We had no car and didn’t use public transport once. Stockbridge perfect place as not as hectic as the old town and a nice peaceful place to rest up after a long day. Plenty shops, pubs and food nearby too. The noise of the river from bedroom might be a little noisy to some but to me is very relaxing and loved falling asleep to that. Highly recommend David’s place! Very spacious and great value. Cheers
Excellent location and clean comfortable apartment. So many delicious restaurants within a few minutes’ walk too!

We really had a very pleasant stay here. Location is considerable which is not far from the station and just a few minutes walk from the center. Victor is a very good and accomodating host and the place is superb. Good value and it’s very recommended especially for groups.

Great place to be located when visiting Edinburgh. Nice walk to princes street and all the attractions of the old city. Nearby shops too which is very convenient.
Shower was great, and wifi and checkin straightforward.
Only distraction for those who are noise sensitive is you can hear people walking about at times in the apartment above.

Camera molto carina ed accogliente con vista piacevole sul giardinetto. A disposizione un bollitore e tante qualità di infusi e tea. A fianco della stanza c'è il bagno ad uso privato. Tutto molto pulito ed ambiente riservato. La posizione è ottima, in una zona tranquilla e poco trafficata di Edimburgo, ad una ventina di minuti dal cuore della Old Town. Ideale per lasciare la macchina. Gwen è un'ospite gentile, sorridente e si rende disponibile per ogni necessità. Abbiamo anche incontrato la sua splendida gatta. Consigliamo il posto senza dubbio.

We had a fabtastic stay with Sevi, great communication throughout and a lovely room with en-suite. We walked into the centre of town in around 15 minutes, but the location was far enough out that it was very quiet at night. Highly recommended!

Les Plus :
Un vaste et charmant appartement à 30 secondes du Royal Mill (juste derrière le Radisson Blu), idéal pour visiter Old Town.
Les Moins :
La literie vraiment médiocre, un lit "rebondissant", des draps (mi-synthétiques?) très désagréables, une couette "ultra-transpirante" très bas de gamme (mon mari s'est gratté toute la nuit).
La douche, vétuste, très petite (attention aux personnes corpulentes qui ne pourraient y rentrer) était sale, crasse sur les murs carrelés, moisissures sur les portes coulissantes , et rainures du bac à douche remplie de... je-ne-sais-pas-quoi de bien gluant et noir...
Manquaient aussi un torchon (on voyage rarement avec) et un rouleau d'Essuie-tout. Une seule serviette de toilette (pas très grande) par personne, c'est un peu juste aussi.
Bref, un bel appartement idéalement placé et pas trop cher, qui - si l'arrivée avait été mieux organisée (code reçu au dernier moment, inaccessible pour nous), si l'insonorisation avait été meilleure, si la literie avait été simplement "ordinaire" au lieu d'être vraiment "cheap", si la salle de douche était rénovée, à tout le moins mieux nettoyée, - mériterait 5 étoiles...
Jing, que nous n'avons pas vu (boîte à clés avec code), semble être un hôte charmant et réactif.
Jim’s flat is lovely and well located. Jim was very communicative and a great host

The photos don't do the appartment justice - when you see it in person, it's SO beautiful and in a brilliant location. Rafaela is a fantastic host. There was excellent communication and she really went the extra mile for us when our train was super delayed and we needed to check in late.
Thank you for an amazing stay. We'll be back the next time we're in Edinburgh!! X

Nosso check-in foi super fácil, a casa tem todas as instruções necessárias pra deixar ainda mais confortável pra todos. Sobre o banheiro: além de estar impecavelmente limpo, poderia passar horas naquela ducha. Muito acima dos Airbnbs mais caros que estive em Roma e Paris na última semana.
Russel nos ajudou com dúvidas relacionadas a transporte, foi gentil e solicito o tempo todo.
Talvez possa ser um pouco cansativo a ida do centro a pé até a casa pois tem muita ladeira, mas tem um ônibus que chega perto por 2£ (aceita cartão no ônibus) e leva cerca de 15 minutos.

The accommodation is absolutely perfect. You will not find a better place to stay in Edinburgh. The room is very well appointed and the amenities are perfect.
You are guaranteed to feel at home here.
As for the host, I cannot ask for more! Emily was perfect. She went above and beyond what was needed!
5* all the way.

We stayed 4 nights at Lucinda’s apartment and found it to be perfect for what we needed. The apartment is very comfortable, quiet/soundproof,  secure car park, and very accessible to public transport. The kitchen is well appointed, and the beds are great. There is central heating, and a balcony to watch the boats in the harbour. I would recommend staying here!

We had a lovely time staying t Rebecca’s place. The flat was really great with plenty of space and all the amenities she listed on the ad. It felt very safe and is walkable to both town and Stockbridge
Thank you Rebecca
Amanda was wonderfully accommodating with check-in times and making sure we knew how to find her. Everything was so clean and the location is wonderful for a quick easy bus trip into the city.

I had a great stay at Andy's place. He went out of his way to get us an early check-in when requested. The property was clean and had great transport links across the city. If you're traveling by bus from the airport, the bus drops you off right outside the property. Very convenient, highly recommend it.
Great

Great place and very central. Easy to get to and lots of restaurants close by.
Place was clean and modern. The Christmas tree was a lovely touch for our Christmas night out!

We spent only one night here, and it was perfect with all comfort one needs. A little far from the main sightseeing spots, but for us it was just what we needed. We recommend it highly, as it was super clean and spacious.

The apartment is clean and cozy. Location is close to main road which has lots of restaurants. The host is nice and helpful. There are all necessary amenities and kitchenware. Almost everything is perfect. Just only the size of queen bed which is smaller than what we expected (thought it is 5 feet). Anyway, one of us could  sleep on the comfy sofa in living room.
我们是第一个住客，所有的东西都是新的，包括厨房设施水杯刀具，以及浴室物品。在大学边上，餐厅超市非常方便，楼下就是中国超市。步行到火车站15分钟，性价比超级高。装修简单，两张双人床足够4人入住
Great location with easy walking access to all the sites. Had a great view over the Christmas Markets

We had a lovely stay in Edinburgh. The Free parking was a massive plus and the location was fantastic, just outside the centre but walking distance to anywhere you’d want to go. Really clean, facilities available. Liz was on hand for any questions. The only thing I will say is that the smoke alarm went off two nights in a row and woke up my toddler which was a bit of a nightmare (perhaps from the steam of the shower, but the bathroom door was shut) but Liz reassured me it would get sorted and she seemed to be extremely accommodating and flexible and was even happy for us to leave the car there longer and checkout later if needed. We really enjoyed our stay here and would come back. Oh and very comfortable beds!!

Location is the best if you wanna see Edinburgh Castle, Grassmarket, Royal Mile.
Very complete amenities, and Charlotte is the great host because she’s very humble and the communication with her is very great.
And she give me a bonus for breakfast : an egg and bread . So thankyouuu so much Charlotte..
Highly recommended!

This was my first Airbnb experience - and it definitely won't be my last. I was obsessed with how great the location of the room is - walking distance to every single thing i wanted to see in Edinburgh. Reggie's hospitality and that of her husband's was incredible. The room was spotless, had surprising thoughtful amenities - milk in the fridge, board games in the room, etc.. If I were to go back to Edinburgh (which I certainly will), I'd hope to find this room available.

10/10 location. Really couldn’t have asked for a better location. Stockbridge is awesome and it’s a close walk (~15min) from all the tourist attractions, but you’re more removed from that hustle and bustle and feel like you’re in more of a local spot. Tons of bakeries and coffee shops that were great.
The flat was much bigger than I expected. Felt more like a US sized apartment than a UK one. The place could use a tiny bit more love, but who cares with the location that good. Loved the fact it was on the top floor. The floor was creaky so I’m happy there was no one above to worry about. Overall, it was nice and clean.
Erin was nice, place was great, definitely recommend for the price range.

Everything about this apartment was great! Location, cleanliness, near bus stops and of course Daljit, who was very kind and answered all messages within minutes and personally came to help us when we had a small problem with the showers. I absolutely would recommend staying here and will come again when I visit Edinburgh!

Fantastic modern space fitted with everything you need. Situated in the heart of new town, it's a perfect place to stay for a few days if you want alittle more independence than what you normally get in a nice hotel. Room could have been slightly bigger but apart from that, it's a steal for the price. Highly recommend!

Very centrally located apartment and a great location if you want to be there right in the heart of the old town. It can be a bit loud at night due to bars/clubs down below, but the double paned windows definitely help. Apartment was very clean and more spacious than we expected so plenty of room. Seems to be an older apartment, although kitchen and bathroom look recently renovated. Idrisha was a great host, super easy with communication. Thanks for the stay.
This was a great apartment. Really centrally located and with a bonus third bedroom. Aida was so welcoming and helpful, both before and during our stay. Would definitely recommend.
Really appreciated the fast communication, thank you. And the apartment was lovely.
Good place, near the city center. Windows were a bit old so noise got inside and they did not hold the warmth but I guess that is part of living Great Britain.
Very pretty apartment in a great location that is equipped with everything you need. We really enjoyed our short stay in Edinburgh and would surely be back.
Would definitely recommend this flat in Edinburgh. It’s in a great location, it’s homely and comfortable and has everything you need!

This is such a charming place in a fantastic city. I loved it from the moment I walked in. So clean, spacious, welcoming, very quiet and safe neighborhood. Bed was super comfortable and the place felt like you were staying with a friend.
Right off of Grassmarket, close to pubs and a short 15 minute walk up Victoria Street to Royal Mile to see sites, Castle, shopping and more.
Susan was very helpful and responsive via email. When I come back to Edinburgh I will definitely stay here again.

We loved staying in this lovely home for a couple of days.  Very good location and easy to get around.  Only warning - lots of stairs so if stairs is an issue this may not be for you - otherwise it is great.
wonderful stay
The location was wonderful and the apartment was furnished with everything we could have needed. The tea and biscuits were a nice touch as well.

Great location! Property had everything that we needed for a long weekend with friends.
Some parts of the apartment could do with some TLC but overall it is perfect as a base to explore the city.

A good house to consider.Elizabeth provided superb hospitality.The house is spotlessly clean and the house location is near to the bus stop which takes about 15minutes to the city centre.Highly recommended and we surely would stay here in our future visit to Edinburgh.
Great place, great location, great host 10/10

We had a great time staying in Pauline's place! The area has amazing restaurants and bars right around the corner and a beautiful view of the castle from the street. The apartment had everything we needed and we're really glad we stayed here for our weekend in Edinburgh!

L'appartement était très propre et correspond complétement à sa description. Le quartier est un peu excentré du cœur de la ville, mais les bus sont assez fréquents.
Notre hôte était proactif en amont du séjour et très réactif. On peut juste regretter l'absence de quelques équipements élémentaires dans la cuisine (saladier, couteau qui coupe, épluche légumes,...), mais sinon, nous avons été satisfaits de notre séjour dans cet appartement. Nous reviendrons.

I completely recommend Paul's place, quick response, spacious and clean apartment. It has a very good location near the old and new towns in Edinburgh (just 10 min walking). The place is really nice and has everything you need.

Le logement est extrêmement bien situé, dans un quartier très agréable et pittoresque.
Il a été très facile de communiquer avec Jennifer qui a été arrangeante sur nos horaires d’arrivée et de départ.
Le logement est agréable et simple.
Seul point noir: le chauffage n’était pas mis à notre arrivée ce qui procure une sensation d’inconfort, ce qui est dommage.
Super séjour dans le logement !
Great apartment in a great location. Very responsive host, would highly recommend.
really enjoyed my stay and the company of morris who is terribly hospitable and such an interesting person.
Very nice and clean apartment in a really amazing location and Alison was a great host!
l'appartement est très bien placé sabrina est très accueillante disponible et serviable. Appartement parfait à recommander

A really nice hostel to stay in ! It’s close to a lot of touristic places, so it’s really practical as you don’t need to take public transportation too much and can do a lot just by foot ! I unfortunately didn’t have time to do the activities they proposed there but I’m sure the staff can give you useful information about it.
I had a good stay overall so thank you !
We loved our stay in Patrick’s characterful apartment with a group of friends. Easy walking distance into Stockbridge and central Edinburgh. Had all of the amenities we needed!
Wonderful stay, Joyce was beyond nice, we could even check in early so that was perfect for us, place pristine and well maintained. lots of thanks 🙌🏻

We had a fabulous few days in Edinburgh and will definitely be back to see more of the city. As a family of 4 we had plenty of space in the cute apartment. Everything was as advertised and Nikki, the host was very responsive and always available with lots of helpful advice. Apartment was clean and tidy and well stocked. That said, we didn't cook during our stay so I can't comment on that, but we had everything we needed. The only disappointed for us was heavy footed people in the apartment above us and a bit of street noise; it was very warm in the apartment so needed the windows open overnight and were woken every night by car alarms going off. That may have just been unfortunate timing on our part!

Great location, and lovely apartment. Knocking one star off because the bedroom window opened straight onto a busy walkway, which meant it was quite noisy and you couldn’t open the curtains or windows because people were walking 30cm from the glass.
Greay
Great apartment in lovely New Town area

We enjoyed our stay at Jackie’s place. It was exactly as advertised; clean, spacious, comfy bed and powerful shower. The location was perfect too, walking distance to the centre and close to great cafes and restaurants.
Jackie responded promptly to our messages.
We came by car and even though the street parking is free on wknds spaces are limited. But that’s a common issue in Edinburgh :)
Overall, we had a great time and I’d definitely recommend this place.
Thank you!

Had a wonderful stay .... brilliant location next to Leith Waterway; Stockbridge and Botanic Gardens.
Best of all we loved the peaceful rooftop terrace for relaxing in the warm sunny evenings !
Would definitely book again. A great find !

Really great Edinburgh location and classic flat in a classic tenement. After having lived in Edinburgh many years ago this felt like coming home! Beautiful flat only minutes away from Edinburgh classics like Valvona & Crolla, Leith Walk, Playhouse, Calton Hill and many more. Easily walkable to restaurants, cafes, bookstores and shopping. Despite such close location to amenities the flat was supremely quiet and peaceful, the perfect retreat after a busy day!
Roland was super helpful and responsive throughout the stay and made sure that everything was in order, fantastic host. Hope to stay there again in the future!

Ci siamo trovati molto bene: Duc è stato molto gentile e ci ha fornito diverse indicazioni per i mezzi pubblici.
La stanza era pulita e conforme alla descrizione.
Consigliato +++

We generally liked Martin’s place. We were able to cook our meals in the kitchen, which had all the necessary equipment and was clean. The bathroom also met our expectations.
However, the room door made a rubbing noise when opening and closing, which was a bit loud. It might have been due to the season we stayed in, but it was a bit cold at night and we felt chilly.
Greatb p[lace for a short stay in Edinburgh. Frequent buses to the city centre stop in front of the house. Restuarants in the neighbourhood. Great breakfast prepared by the host.
was a great stay. he was so helpful as well.
I lovely flat that has everything and more that you could expect . a lovely location just beautiful
We were extremely pleased! Everything was close and walkable. We enjoyed our 3 night four day stay very much. The only thing we would have changed was the weather.

Great place and very central. Excellently appointed and super comfy (once we got the heating fixed upstairs!)
Denise was super responsive to messages and very helpful and friendly.
The multiple flights of stairs with luggage was a challenge, but once in all good.
If you want to be part of the action - this is the place for you. If you struggle to sleep with noise - best to bring ear plugs….. being right in the action means you’ll hear night clubbers and music to the wee hours!

Val was responsive and reactive from the moment I booked until I left. Her flat is located in a very quiet area and easily accessible by bus. The whole flat was very clean and I really felt at home with the lovely cat. I enjoyed the complimentary breakfast. I highly recommend this place for a solo traveler or even a couple with the second bed available. I will definitely go back
Very aesthetic place and clean comfortable place to stay in.

Great apartment and great location. Warm and nice! There was a pretty strong smell of weed in the apartment, but it got better over our stay. Not the host’s fault as it clearly was coming from other parts of the building, but still something to be aware of! Otherwise this was a perfect stay.

Slawomir is a great host! Great communication and happy to answer questions. He even gave us a ride to a nearby restaurant when we arrived as it was late. The apartment is as pictured, clean and well located. Taking Uber to the town center was only about 7 pounds,
A lovely place to stay to explore Edinburgh. In the heart of the city / west end, views of castle. Beautiful accommodation.

My fiancée and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay with Harriet & Alejandro. They were both so friendly and helpful. The room was perfect for us with an ensuite bathroom. It was so peaceful, private and quiet there. Harriet was very accommodating in letting us come and go as we please. They have a huge selection of brochures for you to plan your days while in Edinburgh. We loved walking into town each day as it was only a 40 minute walk along the riverbanks after taking a walk through Harrison Park. I would certainly visit again.

Clean, warm and spacious flat in a top location in Edinburgh.
would highly recommend!

Megan’s apartment was the perfect location for a city break in Edinburgh. Clean, cosy and comfortable in a lovely, peaceful but vibrant location. Megan was very helpful in extending my check out time to fit with my remote working pattern. Highly recommended.

It was a perfect place in the old Town, very close to everything, the City centre, the castle, the Railway Station. Next to pubs, shops, buses. It’s a very nice accomodation for 6 people with separate bedrooms, nicely furnished, very cool flat to get enchanted with the médieval City.
Super tolle Wohnung in einer hervorragenden Lage. Hat alles sehr unkompliziert funktioniert und kann die Wohnung nur weiterempfehlen.

Our stay at Daniela's place has been a decent one. The house is clean and quite well kept - just that the main entrance to the apartment building looks a bit shady and old.. Daniela has been rather helpful in giving us the required information for checking in/out.

Great apartment to stay in feels very homely and is very stylish. absolutely perfect
could not have been better.
we will definitely come back.
thank you so much for hosting us
Great place, close to tram/train/bus station and walkable distance from city center.

Very clean and spacious, a lovely place to stay

Lyn's house was great. The location was perfect for the wedding we were attending, as well as for walking into town. David has been a very attentive from the very beginning. His house is very comfortable. He was very considerate about the things we needed. It's clear he has experience and has placed a lot of trust in us.
Great place in the heart of Edinburgh! We only stayed 1 night but wish we could’ve stayed longer!

We absolutely loved our stay in Dean’s Village and would 100% return. Melissa’s place was packed with cute and unique decor (the owl lamp was just the beginning). It’s truly one of a kind! Les's place has great views and we had a comfortable nights stay.
Very convenient if visiting the Royal Yacht Britannia, as we were the following morning.
Had a wonderful stay. Location was awesome with lots do. Definitely would recommend!
We had a lovely stay at Abigail‘s place! Situated perfectly, not too far from anything. Clean and cozy as shown on the photos! We would defintely stay there again!
Lien is a great host! She was very communicative and helpful whenever we needed.
Great apartment with a very friendly host. The location is ideal with lots of local amenities and easy transport links to the city centre.

Lovely room for a stop over. Everything lovely, bright and clean. Walking distance to Arthur’s Seat was amazing.

The flat was excellently sited to visit all of Edinburgh's touristy places. It was easy to find and to access.  It is well equipped and was clean. The beds were comfortable.

Judy’s place was wonderful all around! It was so close to public transit yet still so quiet and peaceful. A lovely place to stay. The neighbourhood was lovely and there were a lot of options for food and drinks! The bed was very comfy too. Would recommend it for two travellers.
Beautiful accommodation, hidden away in private surroundings. We will be coming back. Convenient and easy to find.
Very comfortable stay. Ben is very helpful and accommodating.
we had a lovely stay at Brewers apartment, highly recommend.
Beautiful apartment. Spotless clean. Well equipped and couldn’t fault anything. Parking spot on. Well worth the money and more. Will definitely go there again!

Everything was easy and Jo was very accommodating with requests about storing our luggage.

This is a super apartment in a fantastic location. We were visiting Edinburgh for the Fringe and could easily walk or catch a bus to all the venues. And it was just a short walk to the Botanic Gardens, Inverleith Park, the Co-op and lovely local bars, shops and restaurants.
The apartment is extremely well-equipped and the beds were really comfy. As others have said, it is a home away from home. Thank you for thinking of everything!

Staying with Rachel was just so lovely! She is an extremely kind woman and we had great conversations. She recommended some nice things to do and see and always made sure that I felt comfortable.
Her apartment is really nice, it looks just like in the pictures. You have an amazing view over the city and everything just feels so cozy and warm. I would totally recommend staying with Rachel if you want to be in a private area that has a cozy atmosphere, hosted by a lovely and sympathetic woman!
Such a quiet location but very convenient for Stockbridge and all it’s charms . The flat is spotlessly clean and very comfortable . Would recommend for a visit.

Very well renovated hotel-style apartment. A few maintenance issues, but these were dealt with extremely swiftly by Steven - him and Claire were great hosts. Well located to get into town, but not much going on in the local area. Quite pricey, but that's Edinburgh...
We enjoyed our stay, easy communication, very well positioned to get around with great burger bars, coffeeshops away from the main stream.

Excellent location and well equipped property. The parking space was a bonus too as we were travelling with a baby and this made everything so much easier. We would definitely stay again if travelling as a family. Thank you!

Shirene's place is beautifully decorated - I loved the artwork and sitting in the egg-shaped swinging chair in the living room - and meticulously clean. The space and view was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, spaceous, well stocked bathroom, beautiful. Ricky was helpful and a gracious host. Spacious , good location, walking distance to Royal Mile
THE BEST Host… highly recommended.

excellent stay here. location is amazing and the place was spotless. the perfect size and everything we needed was provided. will definitely be coming back when we are next coming to edinburgh!

I had a really wonderful weekend staying in Claire and Robs place. they went above and beyond to be helpful and make everything as smooth as possible. Wonderful apartment on the lower half of the Royal Mile with everything needed to be a great home base/home away from home while exploring Edinburgh. We really enjoyed our stay, the city, and hope to be back one day.

otherwise amazing

El apartamento es muy bonito y confortable. Está situado en un lugar tranquilo con buena comunicación a los transportes públicos y rodeado de buenos restaurantes. También cerca de supermercados y farmacia.
El apartamento estaba súper limpio y muy bonito decorado. Nos hemos sentido como en casa en todo momento!
Levi fue muy amable, nos permitió entrar una hora antes del check in y estuvo pendiente de nosotros en todo momento. En el apartamento también nos dejó café, té y algunas cosas más necesarias para cocinar. Todo un detalle.
Los libros que hay en el apartamento son geniales y bonitos. También hay una carpeta con un conjunto de indicaciones y recomendaciones de todo tipo y que agradecimos mucho contar con ellas.
Volveremos sin duda y lo recomiendo mucho a los futuros viajeros. Os encantará!

Julie-Ann was so responsive and welcoming. Her place was a really quick walk from Waverley and very easy to find. And when my train was delayed and I ended up getting in late, Julie-Ann was super understanding and flexible with my check-in!

Wonderful stay, with sunshine streaming in the morning. The space is beautiful, comfy and stylish. It is a 2 min walk to groceries, a great neighbourhood pub, and a sweet cupcake spot! A massive city park is a 5 min walk and an excellent spot to relax and enjoy. The loft on two levels with two full baths makes it perfect spot for couples or families. The building is very safe and secure as well. A terrific place to stay in a truly great city! Cheers.

Steven’s home was by far the best Airbnb we have ever stayed in! It is only a short 10 minute walk from Waverley station and surrounded by a long list of beautiful shops, restaurants and pubs in the New Town. Steven gave us great recommendations and the airbnb itself was absolutely beautiful - a traditional Georgian apartment with original features. Highly recommend for a unique and memorable Edinburgh experience.
Great place, great location.  Was very cozy and welcoming.
Location was everything! Great Airbnb for a group of 5! Very clean and had everything we needed to cook a few nights in the kitchen. We would love to come back!

It was spotless, light and spacious with a good location close to the tram. My only complaint is that the mattress on the bed in the second bedroom was terrible and needs replacing. Had a huge dip in the middle and the end seemed to be higher than the center, which meant we spent the whole night rolling into each other. Not sure what the master bed was like as didn't try it. Shame as it was so quiet and big, would have been perfect otherwise.

Really friendly and helpful hosts. Location was closer to the centre than I thought. Next door to a bar which is handy, shops close by. Private parking around the corner which was handy. Good for a short stay!

Lovely apartment in the city centre. Great location for exploring the city.
Greg gives good recommendations for places to visit and clear check in/out instructions.
Would stay again :)

Beautiful flat nicely done with all the amenities needed for a longer stay.  Castle view is breath taking.  A short 2 minute walk to the bus stop or easily hail a taxi if needed for further destination such as Waverly Station.  15 minute walk up the hill to Edinburgh Castle and the start of the Royal Mile.  Plenty of wonderful restaurants and grocery stores within 10 minutes of the front door.  Was a welcome retreat from the hustle and bustle of the crouds at the end of the day.  Highly recommend.  The 4 flights of stairs is worth the climb!
The best in Edinburgh
Beautiful accommodation, excellent location - very easy to deal with
Sean was a really good host and communicated really well. Enjoyed my stay and it was a good location for exploring Edinburgh!

Great place to stay whilst in Edinburgh, close enough to the city centre to be walkable but far enough that it was peaceful and quiet on an evening. Lovely space and had everything you needed for a few days away. We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment and will return again when we're next in Edinburgh. Clear instructions given for check in and Nicholas was available as needed throughout our stay.

At the beginning, we had difficulty finding the house because Google Maps and other map apps couldn’t locate it accurately. They led us to a very dark park, which was quite scary. It took us almost one hour to find the house, but the house owner was helpful. Thank you very much!
The house was a little dilapidated, and part of the floor was broken, but it was okay since we only stayed for one night. It was not very convenient to access the city centre—we needed to walk around 20 minutes. However, the biggest advantage was that it had a private parking space, as parking in Edinburgh city centre is very expensive.
位置非常方便，背靠calton hill，距王子街、火车站和美术馆超级近，附近有很多可爱的小咖啡馆。房东人很好，房间干净并且设备充足～愉快的居住体验

Kelly's flat is just lovely. The flat was easy to find and in a great location. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Thoughtfully decorated and had a great vibe. Kelly was really helpful and communicative, and has clearly gone above and beyond to make sure her guests have a great stay in Edinburgh. Thank you, we'd love to come back!
Thank you :)
A great stay in a really brilliant location - so close to everything we wanted to see! Denise was great at answering my messages quickly and so helpful. Thanks Denise, we’ll be back!
Easy going host, Jennet made me feel welcome as well as let me get on with things as I wanted. Nice house with charm.
We struggled to find the apartment at first and Peter was very helpful and descriptive, I also asked for a later checkout and he was very kind to give it to us. Lovely stay! Thank you
Muy bien.

This is a fantastic little flat - a true home away from home! The location is great - lots of cute cafes nearby and easy walking distance to everything while being off the busiest tourist thoroughfares. The shared residents’ garden is a wonderful oasis and it was such a privilege to get to use it. The flat was clean, comfortable, homey and had a good-size desk for working.

Had a great stay at Arandale Guest House.
The room was very clean and comfortable, exactly as described. In a great location with good bus routes in to the city centre.
While breakfast isn’t available due to COVID-19, the Earl Grange Cafe round the corner is great for breakfast.
Off street parking is available across the street outside Alexander Guest house.
The room keys are stored in key safes on the same wall as the door bell which you get the code for by ringing the bell on the wall.

Simple, clean, five simple and clean separate sleeping rooms, two bathrooms, and a central place to meet and connect—wonderful food and drink waiting when we go there. Location is the true selling point to this true “crash pad”.
We loved our stay at Gemma's apartment! The location was perfect for us and the space felt so homely. Would definitely stay again!

We absolutely loved our stay with Lucy and Christian! Their home is so beautiful and very comfortable for travelers. We found the location perfect for everything we wanted to do in Edinburgh and loved being right on the meadows- such a lovely walk! They are great communicators and gave us local recs in town as well. Breakfast was such a treat too, don’t miss out on this wonderful stay!!!

The Ratho Park Steading was absolutely perfect! Dannii and Andrew were wonderful hosts and it was so interesting to hear about their journey in making the Steading what it is today. The Steading was comfortable and perfectly decorated, the outside areas were incredible, and the kids areas were perfect for our kids to relax and unwind after a full day in the city. We would highly recommend the Steading and if we are ever back in Edinburg we will definitely stay here. Thank you Dannii and Andrew for making such a lovely place to stay.

We had a great time in Edinburgh and thank you so much for letting us stay in your apartment. The accommodation was a perfect place to lay down after a day of exploring. The apartment was very clean and tidy and loved how easy check in and out was with the lock box and separate access. Viven was very prompt at replying to messages and gave lots of helpful hints and places to try in the area. Would definitely recommend!
It was great to stay in Ruth’s lovely flat. An extremely well provisioned flat in a great location and would definitely stay again.

We loved Charlottes place!! It was super central,
Literally could not have been in a better or more convenient location to the old town (which is the best part of Edinburgh). The place was a great size, super clean - comfy bed and really nicely and authentically decorated.
We would go back in a heartbeat!!
Thank you Charlotte for an amazing stay ❤️
The place is very cozy and good for family & friends in group. Uber / Bolt is very convinient as well. Highly recommend 👌

The place was nice and comfortable. The room, kitchen and bathroom were very clean. Our stay was very peaceful as there wasn’t noise during the night. Very nice location with everything at a walking distance. The only thing less positive is the staircase before you get into the apartment smelled a bit of urine but I guess that’s out of the host’s control.

We had a great stay with Andy & Kumi. Andy gave us a warm and personalised welcome and provided very helpful tips. The room was extremely clean and beautifully furnished and the little basket of goodies were much appreciated

Martin is a very good host, very accommodating and friendly. The flat is in a superb location literally around the corner to grassmarket so close to restaurantsand a stones throw from Edinburgh Castle.
The flat is clean and tidy, the bed is comfy and in a quiet location. it represents very good value for money.
It was our 1st visit to Edinburgh and we loved it. Martin's place is in a great location for exploring this beautiful city.
Very good location. Quiet bedrooms.

We verbleven hier de laatste nacht van onze vakantie in Schotland. We konden gratis parkeren in een rustige buurt en dichtbij het vliegveld. Alle voorzieningen aanwezig en heel vlotte communicatie met Alex
Amazing stay! A lovely, cosy flat in a fantastic location. Great communication too. Will definitely book again

Although tucked away in this rather austere building, it was cosy and warm with a good amount of space and facilities for 4 people. Not flashy but homely and warm but the biggest plus is the location - university,  jazz club, many bistros, bars and coffee houses all within a short and interesting walk. Would be perfect location for Fringe visits too.

Great flat in a quiet area within walking distance to royal mile.
Lien was very friendly & accommodating & responded very quickly to any questions we had.
Milk, water, tea, coffee, cereals & biscuits all left in flat which I thought was a lovely touch.
Would definitely stay again. Highly recommend!
Thankyou for a great stay!
Mili i gościnny gospodarze. Pokój skromy, ale świetny stosunek cena/jakość. Znalezienie adresu mogłoby być łatwiejsze. Dobry dojazd do centrum.

the apartment was bright, clean and perfectly located in portobello, with gorgeous views overlooking the beach! it was also ideal for getting into central edinburgh - only a 10 minute bus ride away. would definitely recommend and love to stay again!

Absolutely fabulous stay! The space was very clean, well decorated, and had everything I needed. Location was excellent to dip in and out of the city. The host was incredibly helpful and made the whole process seamless. I would definitely stay here again!
Lovely house. Easy to get around by bus as it was in the vicinity of a bus station. : )
Lovely well equipped and clean flat with great view!
Estaba bien conectado con la ciudad y el aeropuerto. Baño privado y con dos armarios, zona segura y cómoda, lo único mejorable es los pelos que encontramos en la cama, de resto bien.

It was a comfortable and pleasurable stay. Mandy made us feel welcome and was very helpful if we had any questions. The house is situated in a quiet,green area, but the bus options are good and pretty regular. Mandy kindly left us fruit and snacks, which we really appreciated after the long journey.

Perfect location  to be right in the heart of things, Bars very close by, Fair to say you can slightly hear the noise from local bars but no worse than in any other city it was the perfect location to have a look around Edinburgh!

L'appartamento di Mike e Pauline si trova in una posizione strategica a Bruntsfield, quartiere molto carino vicino al centro ma non "troppo" al punto da soffrire il traffico. All'interno di una villa d'epoca, per questo affascinante anche se un pochino fredda. Mike e Pauline sono stati super disponibili e gentili nel venire incontro alle nostre esigenze e nel fornire consigli utili. La casa è essenziale e va bene come punto di appoggio per qualche giorno. Grazie di tutto ai due host!
It was my first ever airbnb experience. It stood out very well and i enjoyed every services i was offered. I would like to recommend for others as well who’s looking for the perfect flat to rent.
Thank you for a great stay! Truly a gorgeous flat, clean with everything you need and lots of gorgeous cafes and restaurants around.

Stayed here for the bank holiday weekend and we had a great time. The Airbnb was clean, check-in was easy and the flat matched the photographs. The location is great and is in a quiet area where we felt safe. Hana even let us have check out a bit later which we were very grateful for.
Would recommend to anyone! Thanks for a great stay

Lovely, clean apartment in a great location with a beautiful view of Edinburgh castle.

We had a lovely time in Susan's place, we're even given biscuits and tea and coffee to welcome us in.

Very comfortable and friendly neighbours great place to stay if you're planning a visit.
Fiona was a wonderful and helpful host.The location of her apartment was brilliant and easy walking distance to the city centre.We recommend Fionas's as a great place to stay.

I stayed in Andrews’ apartment as a family party of 7 (my children, their partners and my young grandchildren) for two nights mid February 2026.
Andrew was very helpful in the lead up to our stay, he responded quickly to my messages, helped with a high chair and cot for my grandson and facilitated an early check in, this was all greatly appreciated.
The apartment is located in a lovely area with great coffee shops, restaurants, local shops and within easy access to a pretty park.
We arrived in Edinburgh during a spell of very cold weather, the apartment was bitterly cold on our arrival and despite us running the heating constantly for several hours the room temperature remained at 12degrees when the children were going to bed, understandably this was concerning for their parents.
The apartment was spacious, private and quiet but was sparse and lacked the homely feeling I have experienced in most let’s I have taken previously. Overall I was disappointed with this holiday let.
Super logement! Très facile d’accès et relativement proche de tout!🥰

This apartment is a great choice for visitors coming from the Airport. The bus station is right outside the apartment and the distance from/to the Airport is approximately 30min. Also you need only 15min on foot to go to the city center. Very clean and cozy, perfect choice for a couple.
We had a lovely time. The apartment is super central and doesn’t take long to get anywhere.
Great apartment that are 10 minutes away from the castle and parks. Close to grocery stores and some really good eecommendation on restaurant!
Excellent stay. Wonderful time
It’s the perfect place to escape to for a few days for a lovey change of scenery in a really  pleasant area of Edinburgh.
A perfect stay for a wee trip to Edinburgh. Location was perfect and luckily we got to park inside the complex which was very convenient for us! The hot tub was definitely a bonus.
Everything fit the description perfectly. Will definately come back if staying again in Edinburgh.
Everything is prefect will definitely recommend！
We had a great stay in Georgia’s place in Leith. The flat was great and had everything we needed and more! Would thoroughly recommended this place!

É simplesmente maravilhoso a casa da Eleanore. Extremamente limpo o cheiroso, tudo em seu devido lugar, a casa completa com tudo k que você precisa e mais um pouco. A casa é deliciosa, em um lugar silencioso e com acesso muito fácil ao ônibus que leva ao centro da cidade.
Eleanore é uma pessoa incrível, educada, gentil, disposta a ajudar a todo momento e muito mais experiente no ramo hoteleiro.
O café da manhã é delicioso. Eleanore faz tudo com muito capricho com ingredientes frescos e de excelente qualidade. Superou todas as expectativas!!

The apartment is in a great location and spacious - would definitely book again and recommend to others. The beds are comfy and warm, and the flat is quiet despite its great, central location.  Communication was great - and speedy response to a query we had whilst we were staying.  We have given 4 stars rather than 5 due to some small things that would improve the experience and have fed back to the owner.  All in all, would highly recommend.

Wow! I could not possibly say enough wonderful things about my stay with Chris. An incredibly responsive, welcoming, warm & hospitable host. Truly a gem in an ideal location within Edinburgh. Thank you millions, Chris! You are the best!

What a fantastic base from which to explore Edinburgh. From booking, Daniela kept in touch and on arrival we found the perfect pied a terre - clean, well appointed and with lovely quirky touches and art work - just my type of place. Comfy beds and well equipped kitchen. We walked along Leith Walk the first day into Edinburgh and back - ended up doing 11 miles. Second day took Daniela's suggestion and downloaded the bus app - fab and from the doorstep. Plenty of restaurants within walking distance (in Leith itself) including The Kitchen Michelin starred restaurant - well worth a visit for a special occasion. Will certainly return and recommend highly.
Great place, clean and tidy. Only issue is the bed mattress a bit lumpy and needs replacing.

Nous avons passé une excellente semaine en compagnie de notre fils et des grands-parents. Appartement extrêmement bien situé donnant un accès rapide à tous les centres d'intérêt d'Édimbourg.  Le logement est très bien équipé et super bien décoré. Excellente communication et réactivité de la part de Denise et de l'agence de gestion. Merci à eux.
En résumé à recommander sans hésitation.
Nicely kept place that matched the photos! Enjoyed our stay.

Dawns flat is simply amazing. Located in a prime location outside of the hustle of Edinburgh, it is a nice respite from true city life. Although we did not meet her, Dawn was quick to address any needs we had, and was always available even though she was out of town. We will certainly stay here again when we return!
beautiful place

Brian was a friendly and communicative host with a lovely apartment which was as described. The place is well situated, only a 15min walk in to Edinburgh old time, and right next to the meadows so lots of greenery around :)
Great location. The bathroom is a gem. Emma is super friendly & helpful. Very clean and comfortable in a nice neighbourhood.
Cool place

Very comfortable bedrooms and beds, perfect location - it was a work trip so we had someone to deal with check in and check out.  We were extremely happy.  Kitchen is a little smaller than it looks in the photos but was very well stocked with pots and pans, etc.  A little confusion about the bath and shower - cannot be used at the same time, and you need to run the bath at a trickle otherwise it goes cold.  Not a problem as soon as we got the hang of it.

we had a lovely stay at Darren's place, everything was fantastic, we visited lots of historical places, we took a walk to the Edinburgh castle 🏰, visited some restaurants around, took a walk to the beach, took some lovely pictures.
Darren's was very responsive to us,the first one was when we thought we were lost but actually we were standing at the front of the apartment was very funny 😁. Thanks alot Darren We are definitely coming back again in the future.

We hebben 3 nachten bij Huong en Tadas mogen slapen. Tadas hebben we weinig gezien ivm zijn werk, maar Huong was vaak/altijd aanwezig. De communicatie (ook vooraf) was altijd prima en het ontvangst was fijn. Huong kwam beneden de parkeervergunning afgeven en gaf enkele instructies over de woning en tips voor de omgeving. We hebben prima geslapen tijdens ons verblijf en ook de badkamer was brandschoon. Fijn dat we ook spullen konden gebruiken die daar stonden. Kortom; een aanrader om bij Huong en Tadas te overnachten!
Was a lovely stay, close to the heart of Edinburgh. Would definitely stay here on our next stay.
posizione comodissima, in 15min a piedi dal centro storico. Camera ok ma molto fredda perché c'era un vetro rotto. Anche la doccia fredda ci ha creato disagio a novembre, ma per il resto bene.

Plenty of room for us. Very convenient location, walking distance to the things we wanted to see in Edinburgh.
Philip was very responsive to late minute changes to booking.
Nicely furnished apartment and we had a very comfortable stay. Accessible and convenient location, within walking distance to many sights in the Old Town.

We spent a vy nice week-end in Greg's flat!
The flat is very well located (near the castle, center of the town, bus stops and bus tranfer from/to the airport), cosy and well decorated. If the come again in Edimburgh we will rent this flat again. We were very happy with our choice and our journey!

We immediately felt at ease at Karen's house. Cosy, large bedroom and comfy beds! Karen and her family were super welcoming. The offered breakfast was a great start of the day.
The location is very good, by bus 30 minutes to the airport and the city centre.
Greatly recommended!
Appartement bien situé, dans endroit calme, conforme a la description.

Great stay at Michal’s place. Bijou apartment perfectly located between city centre and leith, which was just perfect for us. Michal’s communication and service was exceptional. And we found this apartment amazing value for money x

Stayed here for 3 nights and the location was great as we were within walking distance of everything including the station! Apartment was very clean, wifi was fast and it was perfect for our staycation. The host was lovely and gave us free breakfast at his cafe just down the road 😊
Joyce's place was a very pleasant place to stay at. Joyce was very pleasant and responsive. The breakfast was very filling and delicious. The ground floor room was very comfortable and clean.
Dani who greeted us was very warm and welcoming 💗

People working in the reception were very kind and helpful; they made me feel very welcome, and if I had a question they weren’t able to answer right away, they’d get back to me quickly with an answer.
The sleeping was small but rather comfortable, with two USB ports by the bedside (unfortunately mine didn’t work, but they offered me another bed which I declined). There weren’t much room for luggage anywhere in the 4-people-room, but people living there made room for each other and we made it work without issue.
The bathroom facilities were just great! As was the kitchen area. I’d definitely stay here again, and I highly recommend Code!

Tivemos uma excelente estadia no espaço do Andrew e da Natalie. O apartamento está localizado numa das ruas mais icónicas do centro histórico de Edimburgo, o que torna a experiência ainda mais agradável. O apartamento está muito bem equipado, tendo tudo o que é prciso para um estadia de curta duração. Adorámos! Esperamos voltar em breve.

This is a great apartment for a visit to Edinburgh, especially if you have limited time (we were just there for the weekend), as it's extremely central to the Old Town area. The place itself was a less than 15 minute walk to almost all the places we wanted to see, and an even shorter walk to several good restaurants and bars that had showed up on "best of" lists (Bon Vivant, Scran and Scallie in Stockbridge). The warm minimalism of the decor, original art, and vintage furniture make the place feel very special.
Bring earplugs if you go to bed early. There's a bar across the street but the flat is on the top floor (so somewhat above the noise) and the noise mostly stopped at around 11. Rachel and Roddy were quick with communication and the check-in was easy.

We have amazing experience in George’s place. The apartment is easy to find because of the clear guidance that George provided to us. The room is very clean and almost everything are new. Recommend to every traveler who will stay in Edinburgh.
This is a great value in a fantastic location. The hosts are very responsive and accommodating. The room was exceptionally clean and equipped with everything needed. The price was right too!
lovely host and in a perfect location
Beautiful room in a perfect location. Would absolutely recommend.

Sharon was very helpful and communicated well to make our stay easy. I did not meet her but she kindly offered an early check in and arranged for a relative to show us around.

Thanks!
Lovely flat, very clean and Angie was great with help on exploring Edinburgh. Would recommend to stay

We couldn't find fault with this flat. It was in a perfect position for what we wanted to do on the Fringe. The bed was very comfortable, the water was hot, everything worked and it was surprisingly quiet, considering how close it is to everything and how busy the city is at this time of year. It was spotlessly clean and the welcome goodies and toiletries were greatly appreciated. We would unhesitatingly stay here again when visiting Edinburgh. We are probably a bit late to the party as this was our first experience of Airbnb but based on this, it will not be our last. David was extremely prompt to respond from first enquiry to when we left and we felt that if we had had any problems he would have sorted them promptly. The comprehensive welcome pack was also very useful.
Oh, and the breakfast at the Coffee Mill Cafe directly opposite is highly recommended!

I had a very good time at Sally's place.
The room is huge, sunny, the bed is confortable and you'll find nice fresh and soft linen! It was hard to leave this bed in the morning. The street is really quiet, absolutely no noise! I really felt good there. Sally took breakfast with me, we chatted a bit and she ave me advices for the day. Very nice and natural breakfast. It was also a great pleasure, which is important to me (too many hosts forget the name of the site: air Bed & BREAKFAST!!). Sally is a humanist person, very attentive and welcoming. A lot of little but nice attentions wait for you in the room (guides, water, glass, tissues, etc...)
I highly recommend you to stay.
15 min walk to centrum. That was Nice

We very much enjoyed our stay at Dee‘s and Dunc‘s Airbnb! It was super cozy and Dee‘s homemade shortbread as well as the flowers on the table were the cherry on the top. We would all come back for sure!
Clean and convenient
Pleasant and friendly host! Location is good as there are plenty of restaurants nearby and near to tourist attractions as well

We had a great time at the apartment! Travelling with baby too 😊 if you don’t mind some stairs and the lights of Rose street on all night.
Walking around is super easy and everything was ready for us, we would definitely recommend it!

We loved the location of Paul’s flat. It was easy to walk to major sights and allowed us to easily duck out of the crowds when we wanted a short break. It was also walking distance to great restaurants and pubs/cocktail bars. As others have noted, some items are a little worn, but it was very clean and quite comfortable. Paul was also a helpful, responsive host. If you don’t mind stairs, which are all over Edinburgh, it’s a wonderful place to stay. We’ve already recommended it to friends.
Loved the little touches and characters around your flat! We’d totally stay again 10/10!!
Nice and clean,  good hospitality!
非常感谢房主为我们提供了一个非常舒适的居住环境，我们度过了三天愉快的假期，厨房设施完备，我们自己做了早餐和晚餐，房主沟通非常及时为我们提供帮助，我们希望有机会再回来。
Great location. Cosy flat with all you could ask for. Very helpful. Very much recommend.

Janet and her husband were wonderful hosts! They were very helpful whenever we had questions about our stay in Edinburgh. The apartment was lovely; we had our own bedroom, living room and bathroom and a shared kitchen, all of which were  clean and well equipped :) I highly recommend her place - I'd definitely stay here again. Many thanks :)
Francois was very responsible and flexible, and the amenities were great!

A beautiful and clean space. Big spacious room with a private bathroom and a gorgeous garden. Perfect to come back to after a busy day. Walkable from the centre of Edinburgh and the surrounding area also nice. Anna was very responsive and made the room very welcoming. Very thoughtful host. Would definitely come back again if I was ever in Edinburgh! Thank you very much!
Fantastic stay. Sally is really a super host. And room is just lovely:)

Ji-Eun is a very caring and responsive hosts, who provides her guests with all the information they need to arrive at the property, check in, and find their way around the local area. The property is immaculate, and there are a wealth of instructions around the flat to help guests settle in. How guests are expected to behave is also made very clear, thereby making this property an excellent choice if you are visiting Edinburgh for business purposes and want to be sure of a good night's sleep. The location is not ideal if you are hoping to pop in and out of the city center during the day, though Ji-Eun provides a lot of information about local public transport options to help offset this. In summary, if you are looking for a quiet and clean place to stay, and don't mind commuting to reach the city center, then this is a probably an ideal property for you.

Beautiful spacious apartment that’s minutes walk from cafes, bars and the waterfront yet very peaceful. The most comfortable bed we’ve ever slept in! Kitchen has everything you could wish for.
Highly recommend.

My fiancee and I stayed at Jon's apartment over Christmas and New Year's and it was the perfect space to spend both periods in. The apartment is cosy, warm and comfortable, and neatly tucked in by the Shore in Leith. Its location is quiet yet accessible. There are nearby bus stops to take you to the City, Ocean Terminal (mall) and the Airport. What we loved about it too was that there were convenient parking spaces available just outside the apartment building.
If you're keen to explore the city and learn about the rich history of both Leith and Edinburgh, making this apartment home base would be the perfect start to your journey.

It was a nice place to stay
And an accessible location

Appartement conforme aux photos, propre , bien aménagé, suffisamment spacieux pour 3 personnes. Super réactivité de Danai à nos questions. Éloigné du centre mais accessible en bus et faisable à pieds.

The apartment is a great location in Old Town, convenient for exploring all of Edinburgh! I can see how it would be difficult for families or elderly, as you do have to climb 3 flights of stairs. It was not a problem for us though. We coordinated early on with Glenn via email and were instructed to call Dave 45 min prior to arrival. Upon calling Dave, we were told a 3rd person would be meeting us to give us keys and show us around. Even though it may have been a bit easier to have one point of contact the whole time, everyone was easy to reach and quick to respond. One thing to note is that even though it's not in the very noisy part of Old Town, it can still be lively in the afternoon/evening (especially if you like to open any of the windows). Overall, an incredible apartment, location and stay!
Bright,clean, comfortable. Ideal base for exploring Exploring Edinburgh. Hosts very responsive. Would definitely stay again.
A fantastic place.  Magical.
Lindsay’s place waa beautiful and was a perfect location for everything we needed. We will hopefully be back again sometime soon!
Would give our highest recommendation! Place was perfect due to its beauty and location. Host was very responsive throughout the process. Hurry and book this if it's available!!
Very spacious spot, nicely decorated and outstanding location—great for groups/families.

La experiencia fue increíble. El apartamento tiene una ubicación perfecta, con una hermosa vista a la ciudad. Está cerca de muchas atracciones turisticas, restaurantes, bares, ferias, etc. Por otro lado, el apartamento estuvo impecable, cómodo y tenía todo lo necesario para pasar una agradable estancia.
