Good location, very nice breakfast, everyone at the place was super firendly and helpful. Easy access.
Amazing! Our favorite AirBnB yet! 6 stars!!

We loved our stay. Duncans Land is in the beautiful and quaint neighborhood of Stockbridge, only a 5 minute walk to several grocery stores, coffee shops, restaurants, pubs, bakeries, and the Stockbridge market. About a 20 minute walk to Old Town and the Royal Mile, 10 minutes to Dean Village. Perfect if you want to be away from the hectic pace of Edinburgh but close enough to get to all the action and sightseeing. The home is beautifully decorated and has a well stocked kitchen with everything you need. Bathroom was large, newly renovated, with hot water and good water pressure. Beds were very comfortable. We loved the gas fireplace in the evening and the Scottish quotes on the wall. The host was very communicative and friendly. Be aware that the entrance has around 15 steps up a winding staircase if you have suitcases, but we did not have a problem. It was worth it. We would definitely stay again.  Don’t hesitate to book this beautiful little gem of a home. You won’t regret it.

I really enjoyed staying at Agnieszka’s apartment. She was very responsive, helpful and friendly. The apartment is very central, walking distance from touristic places. Much recommended for a touristic visit. Thank you!
Perfect place, host is so kind and caring. I couldn’t imagine better staying
The room is lovely. Sabrina is a very great host !

Had a really lovely stay here! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The hosts was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. The location was great too—quiet but still convenient for getting around.
Overall, a very pleasant experience and I’d happily stay again. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a relaxing and hassle-free stay!

Great find! I thought it was a bit far from city center but it’s just a 20-25 min bus ride from the center of Edinburgh. Bus station is right in front of the flat.
Keep in mind that you have a great nice chilled beach just 5 minutes away, walking distance. Stunning sunsets!
I recommend the place if you are solo traveling. The host is great and I had everything I need. I will book again soon.

L'appartement de Dimitriy est agréable, fonctionnel et extrêmement bien situé. Il a été très arrangeant pour notre départ et reste toujours très disponible. Seul point négatif, le sommier du lit est vraiment à changer 😉.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans son appartement qui est vraiment calme bien qu'il soit en plein centre. Merci encore 😃

Shona is delightful and could not be a better host. However, the apartment is at the top of two long flights of stairs in an apartment building. The garden is a shared space with other apartment blocks. The bedroom, whilst clean, did not have a working bedside lamp and access to plugs was not easy. It is also under the flight path, although flights stop overnight. Whilst good value for anywhere in Edinburgh during the fringe and the tattoo I have stayed in other Airbnb’s with much better facilities for the same price.

If you want to stay somewhere that truly feels like a home base, this is it. We like to have a comfortable and quiet place to return to (and sleep in at) in between sight seeing, and Tansie’s is a warm and quiet retreat. If you like the idea of walking to and from the attractions, then the townhome’s distance from the major sights is perfect (15-30 minutes to everything). There are also a number of cute restaurants and coffee shops just around the corner so you don’t have to travel far for an easy bite. We were surprised at how hard the restaurants are to get into though, and wish we had made reservations ahead of time. Tansie responds really quickly and met us early in the morning to accommodate our flight and check us in - it was nice to have a personal check in experience instead of just a lockbox. Overall wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

If you are going to Edinburgh STAY HERE. It’s a spacious, clean, stylish home that is in the cutest neighborhood of all time. Easy to walk to many of the big sites and be sure to check out the entire village - very picturesque.
Sharon was so quick to communicate with any of our questions and super friendly when we met her in person. The check-in instructions were also extremely clear, which is so appreciated when you are coming from a long journey and just want to rest.
I hope we can stay there again someday!

This space was absolutely immaculate. Beautifully furnished with a lot of really thoughtful touches. Really modern and had everything we could’ve needed for our stay and more. Would absolutely recommend x

Flat is very tidy, clean and cozy. Room is quite spacious, has chest of drawers, table and a chair and a wardrobe. Bed is very comfortable!
Location is good as well. It is not in the heart of a city, but quite central. Around 20-25 min walk to Waverley Train Station. And just 5 min walk to the street with all the shops, bars and public transport.
Steve is nice and friendly and always ready to help.
It is very nice place to stay in Edinburgh. I would totally recommend it to my friends.

James' apartment is great! Fantastic location, has a great view, and has everything you need in it. James wasn't there personally to get me when I arrived, but that don't matter because he was very clear with the instructions to getting to and into the apartment. Thanks again!
Agie place was even nicer then the pictures! She was very quick with her responses and was in an amazing location! If we come back to Edinburgh we would come back to Agies place! 😊
One of the best position in the Edinburgh Old Town, the 'Cottage in the Sky' is charming, warm, clean, full of books and original artworks. Will is a perfect host. Highly recommended.
One of the best hosts and her hospitality is 5 star! Sparkling and extremely clean! Truly the warmest experience :)
Appartement is netjes rn schoon. Salvatore is vriendelijk en reageert snel.
The place was perfect. The location was exactly what we needesd The beds were comfy, the shower was great the living room was comfy. Everything you need will be at hand!!
A fantastic place to stay, with everything you could need. It’s in the heart of Edinburgh and it’s perfect for a short trip or even a longer stay!

We stayed for 4 nights in Elizabeth's flat. We were greeted by Jen who was fantastic and who took the time to explain everything there was to know about the flat. The flat is amazing and very well situated just at the West End. It was very clean and it was also very quiet. We highly recommend Elizabeth's flat and would happily stay again next time in Edinburgh.
Great location. The room is nice and clean. Really nice and efficient host.

Great stay in Michelle’s lovely apartment in New Town. Ideal for exploring the touristy areas but also away from the hustle and bustle and has great local restaurants and pubs. Michelle was flexible on our check in (our flight was delayed), met us at the apartment and gave us some local insights. Would recommend.

Thank you for a lovely stay in Edinburgh Marion. Your home was perfectly situated for us to explore your beautiful and interesting city. We were able to explore, rest, and enjoy every minute of our trip.

Great place to stay in New Town. It’s on a quiet street and yet still only a 10 minutes walk to Old Town and Princes St. 5 minutes to the bus station and St. Andrew’s Sq (to catch the tram). It was comfortable and the kitchen had good amenities. We liked having a second bathroom and a lift to get to our floor (FYI there are about 10 stairs before you get to the lift).

The unit door entry code is loud, and you will hear other people on your floor entering their units (at one point we thought they were trying to get into our unit). The concierge wasn’t helpful with recommendations for food or activities. and we didn’t like that they required us to provide our address and email at the front desk.
The unit was very clean. We’d asked for one room to have two twin beds though when we got there the two beds were next to each other (like a double bed). Not hard to fix but little details like that are why we didn’t think the value for the money was great. But overall it was a good stay.
Great garden house in a nice and quiet part of Edinburgh. Very friendly hosts and great opportunities to eat out. The busses take you to the city center in no time. We loved our stay there.
Ryan's place was exactly what we needed for a quick night in Edinburgh. Thank you!

A perfect location for our family of four. The apartment is about 10 minute's from Haymarket station and tram service. Supermarkets were nearby. We enjoyed being able to walk into Edinburgh. We had a lovely swim too. The icing on the cake was the view of the castle from the roof terrace to watch the wonderful Hogmanay fireworks with the fizz that fizz that Valentin kindly provided. Thanks for being a great host with excellent communication.
Super appartement, idéalement placé ! Hôte très réactif et disponible . Je recommande ! ☺️👍
My third overnight stay at Yuris great flat.. It won’t be my last.

A fantastic place to stay if you want to see Edinburgh. Walkable distance to the city centre but also quiet. All the amenities you would need were there. Deborah was a fantastic host. She responds to queries very quickly and is eager to help. Thank you for letting us stay in your apartment Deborah. Would definitely return if we visit the city again.

Second stay ,perfect again.
Thank you.

Very stylish, comfortable apartment in a great location. It was spacious for our party of five and our stay was far too short to make the most of this lovely place.  Everything was there that we needed, to a high standard and we appreciated being met at the property and all the advice in the notes in the apartment. Our contact with Rowan and Will was always prompt and helpful and we would recommend this apartment.
Liela is very kind. The location is good and quiet.

Lovely stay. Comfortable clean abs excellent location
Scott was extremely helpful and kind

Alojamiento aún más bonito que en las fotos. Tienes toda la privacidad que necesites por estar en el piso de abajo, pero a la vez puedes disfrutar de una agradable charla con los encantadores dueños Fiona y Stevie. El barrio es muy tranquilo y está a 20 minutos andando del centro ( aunque también puedes ir fácilmente en bus) en una zona con muchos restaurantes cerca, más baratos que los del centro, y cerca también del barrio costero de Leith. Volvería a alojarme aquí sin dudarlo!
Great location with shops and coffee spots right at your doorstep. Nice and cosy and the hose was very responsive!
A good flat in the near of the Royal Mile (5 Minute walk). Good communication and exact discriptions with the landlord.

This is a wonderful apartment in a great location, just a block from the Meadows. Communication with Andrew was nice, easy and efficient, and the apartment had everything I needed. It is beautifully
furnished and cosy - I honestly didn’t want to leave! It is very highly recommended - I can’t wait to go back!

We chose Michelle's apartment for location, parking and because it looked nice.  We were not disappointed, it matched the description and actually exceeded our expectations.  We wouldn't hesitate to book again and would highly recommend.
Good apartment, spacious, amazing location for all the main attractions.

Terrific location in the New Town, surrounded by pubs and restaurants. Clean, spacious room with a shared bathroom (I did not realise this before coming, but it’s only shared between 2 and wasn’t a problem).
Blinds and curtains, which helps with the daylight this time of year. Great host communication and nice and quiet house.
Stairs only, which might be a problem for less mobile people.
Absolutely would stay again.
Great location, quick response and helpful for earlier check in. Great help for transport etc
A large comfortable apartment, with good parking and amazing views.

These apartments are within a large property. They are full of character.
The property is clean with very comfy beds and 3 good size bathroom / shower rooms.
The location is fab being 5-10 mins walk from the Train Station. The kitchen is well equipped and would easily work for a party of 10. We were under this number but the space worked well.
The communication from the host was superb and an initial problem on arrival was sorted out super quick.
I would recommend this property to anyone who wanted to come to Edinburgh for a short break. Thank you.

Our flight was delayed after already being a late flight but Joanna stayed up to make sure we were greeted with a warm welcome which made us feel right at home from the very start. She was an excellent host and was easy to communicate with throughout our stay.
Enjoyed a lovely chat over coffee (has a great coffee machine). It’s a great location to stay at, not too far from the city centre and public transport was easy to work out and would love to stay again.
P.S thank you again for the dog treats, Nelson and Dolly loved them. :)

From time of booking Anna was fantastic at communicating.
Accommodation was absolutely spotless .
Would 100 percent recommend anyone staying here .

I was just as impressed on my second visit to this apartment as on my first.  The apartment is lovely ( modern, clean and comfortable) and ideally located.  Joanne is very helpful and accommodating.  Highly recommended.

Loved our stay in this beautiful apartment, the views from the windows were incredible and everything was clean and tidy! A nice 20-30min walk to the middle of old town and all the cafes and restaurants. Loved it!

When we arrived, we were ready to go.
We could walk to the station also can use bus.
There is a supermarket nearby, which I recommend.
I spent tow nights in the very comfortable loft room, the flat was clean and is maintained to a high standard. Location is great. Reaaaz was friendly and accommodating. All in all highly recommended.

The apartment was clean and tidy, especially the kitchen. Elisa was very friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend this apartment. It is suitable for 3 people. The building is a bit old, but it is located in a very quiet neighborhood. It is on the first floor and there is no elevator, but it is not a problem for me.
Lovely apartment, great location!
Perfect location. Clean room and apartment, easy access, close to everything. We highly recommend this place if you stay in Edinburgh ! Thank you.

This place is in the perfect location,  Daniela is outstanding and lovely to interact with.  She understands somethings are out of our control and makes us feel super welcomed.  The location is near the canal which is brilliant to run or walk.  the place is super close to the heart of the city, and each time we walked it, it seemed like the walk was shorter and shorter.  the park near the canal is big and full of people that are doing activates and feels great to be around.    We rarely got in a car because there was so much to talk to, and having ALDI and Sainsbury and small CoOp right by the flat, it was easy to pop out and grab whatever we needed.  The place is the perfect size for us and is easy to warm up when needed.  the kitchen is clean and a great size, we did a a lot of cooking great meals here, and with the living room attached its a great place to be with the person cooking but also doing other things.  The Beds are comfortable and we had good night sleep each night.  bathroom shower has amazing pressure and having hot water all the time is fantastic!   I highly recommend this place, and excited we got the chance to extend our stay.  If we are back in Edinburgh we will be looking up this place first!!

Lovely apartment with spectacular views. What we had not realized is that it is in a new condo area and the amenities are not yet in place- no restaurants, no corner stores even. We were on foot so this made it difficult especially in the evening for meals (breakfast was provided). Bus transportation in the area was very good so it was easy to get downtown.
Very stylish and clean space! Would stay again.
We enjoyed our few days on The Mound!
We had an amazing stay at Jacqui’s flat. Like a home from home with all the little touches. Really big comfy bed, perfect location with lots of cafes, restaurants and pubs.

Great place to stay! Very close to the tram so was easy to get to Murrayfield stadium. We had a bit of trouble understanding how to check in however when we arrived it was just like a hotel check in. Great communication with the host after our stay as we left some belongings in the room and the host was very helpful to get these sent back to us. Thank you!
wonderful place to stay!
Great overall experience! No better location!
Anne was so lovely and kind. She provided a nice little breakfast and had above-and-beyond hospitality! My sister and I were so comfortable and appreciative!

Carol is an outstanding host.Very friendly and helpful.The property is at an excellent location.The room was cosy and the bed super comfortable.We loved every aspect of our stay and would love to return

A great apartment in the heart of Bruntsfield. Two good sized bedrooms, a large living room and a separate large kitchen-diner. Location is super right in the heart of Bruntsfield and only a short walk across the Meadows into the centre of Edinburgh.

Pier was a wonderful host. Checking-in and out was simple and he stayed in touch throughout the stay making sure I had everything I needed. The apartment is spacious, very comfortable and has convenient access to the city and major tourist attractions; usually only a 20-30 minute walk away. Buses are also easy to catch from nearby. Having such a great place to stay certainly made my trip to Edinburgh more enjoyable.
Greig is a great host and communicated quickly and efficiently each time I had a question. His apartment is in a great location and has all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay in Edinburgh.
Super place to stay in historic area of Edinburgh within easy reach of everything.  Thanks again for a great stay!

Really homely. We relaxed so much in this tranquil, stylish, modern space. So convenient in location and just what we needed. We loved how spacious the home was. Lynne was very communicative and we are grateful for the truly lovely stay.

Had a wonderful stay at Comely bank. The flat was lovely and the location amazing with Stockbridge high street on your doorstep and an easy walk into central Edinburgh. The kitchen was very well equipped and there were fresh flowers which was a very nice touch. Would not hesitate to recommend to anyone. Thank you for hosting such a lovely space

Angie is the most amazing host and showed us outstanding hospitality! She had special treats waiting for us and our 8 yo son upon arrival, a very nice touch and much appreciated. The location of this apartment can not be beat and we also loved just sitting around the fire watching the Royal Mile. Our family absolutely loved our stay in Edinburgh and this was an ideal home away from home. We hope to come back some day.

I spent 4 days at James's apartment with friends and family. For a couple of nights there were 7 of us and it never felt overcrowded even though we used the sofa bed in the living space as well as the 3 bedrooms. There is a spacious feel to the apartment. James was very welcoming and assured us he lives just around the corner and could easily pop round if needed. He left us with butter, Scottish jam, scones and more as a welcome. The location of the apartment is excellent, lots of cafes and independent shops and bars right on the doorstep and easy walking and buses to everything in Edinburgh. The apartment was very clean and is well-equipped, we lacked for nothing. It's a lovely place to stay; high ceilings, big windows, comfortable furnishing and bed, lots of hot water for showers. Although it's on a busy street, it's not noisy at all. After full days out and about in the city, we sat in the living room at the table and enjoyed gazing at the leafy park opposite. A very, very good airbnb experience. Thank you James.

Really lovely compact accommodation for great accessibility to the city centre using the 8 bus. We loved the self check-in and out system! It meant we could go out and enjoy ourselves till the late hours of the evening and not worry about waking anyone up 😊

Overall we had a comfortable stay, but for a family of 4 it was a bit cramped.   We had to put the dining table into one of the bedrooms in order to have enough space to sit around it and to be able to leave it out for the duration of our stay (it folds down to take up less space). The bathroom is a decent size and the shower looks the part but unfortunately is not very powerful. The bedrooms are a good size and the beds were comfortable. The kitchen has all you would expect, but I found it a bit old and depressing. Luckily there are some good local restaurants!
This was a wonderful find near the city. We got around by car. It was spacious and clean. We hope to be back!

The apartment was absolutely lovely and very clean, it also couldn't of been in a better location. David made us feel very welcome and was always easy to get in touch with if we ever had any questions. Would recommend to anyone.
Fantastic place to stay, in an lovely little location and just the loveliest hosts, if we are ever over that way again that's where we are staying :)

We had an awesome stay at Connor’s place! He is very helpful and responsive as a host. The decor was so neat and made our trip more memorable and fun. The street was quiet and bed was very comfortable making it easy to get a good night’s sleep. We were able to walk to groceries and several restaurants. Overall we enjoyed our time here and would love to come back and stay again!

Very tidy place!
Amazing for a short stay like ours.
We highly recommend.

Jane is an excellent host and the place is clean with all described amenities. It locates in a quiet but safe community with easy access to public transportation. it only takes a few minutes walk to the bus stops. Jane has excellent recommendations of places. I appreciate the pub and farmstores she recommended. there are also highland cow behind the farmstore in 15 mins walk. I felt sad that I missed them because I missed Jane's message. you should definitely check the stores and cows out. it was a nice walk with sun.

Excellent property that felt like a home from home.  Nice finish, good bedrooms / bathrooms and full facilities. Lots of local restaurants etc and good location. Excellent comms from Katherine and would definitely stay again, one of the best AirBnBs we've stayed in for ages.

Stunning apartment, right in the centre of things, extremely well equipped and comfortable - excellent and helpful host; a real experience of Edinburgh with beautiful high ceilinged super-spacious rooms, exceptional stay.
Lovely stay! Great host. I will be back
Better than the listed pictures. Very nice house. One of the best Airbnb ive stayed.
Beautiful apartment, very well appointed. Much quieter than staying very central but easy to get to via bus or walking.

Great place to stay in a perfect central location. Would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a central place to stay in Edinburgh. near to all the local amenities and tourist areas. The bed was super comfy and the room was clean and tidy.

My wife and I were travelling with another couple.  We found Gareth's place comfortable, clean and well located. Gareth was easy to reach, quick to respond, and provided us with some great recommendations of places to see and places to eat.   Some days we walked into town. Other days we took advantage of Edinburgh's excellent transit system.  The property was well equipped, and had two bathrooms which was a must for us.  Overall, the place more than met our needs and we would definitely stay here again if and when we return to Edinburgh.

Casa adorabile ben collegata al centro.
Tutto molto curato e pulito, ci hanno fatto trovare anche dei generi di conforto come acqua, the e biscotti.
Host disponibile e reattivo, indicazioni chiare e inequivocabili.
Super consigliato

Loved our stay in Edinburgh. We were only a twenty minute walk from Oldtown and had local grocery stores and bus routes accessible as well. Brendan was also very responsive and replied immediately to any questions/ concerns we had. Highly recommend staying here.

Great hosts, met us at the door by chance and showed us around. Gave amazing tips of the local area.
Very generous and lent us an umbrella.
Spotless studio.
Would definitely stay here again 😁
Great - could do with 2 sets of keys.
Charming accommodation, perfect location, organisation all very smooth

This flat is perfectly situated by Edinburgh castle. Very walkable area with plenty of pubs, restaurants, and shops!
Great apartment, sharply decorated and comfortable! Highly recommend!

Spotless flat in a great location. Tom was great and provided really clear and helpful instructions for checking in and parking.  Parking space was an added bonus as it’s hard to find in Edinburgh! Would definitely recommend and hope to be back!
Home from home
Gorgeous stay in Edinburgh, lovely home, hosts were so welcoming and looked after us extremely well. Super breakfast, super location - we had a wonderful stay with Carol and George.

After staying in Paris and London, I was excited to be getting a bigger space for the same price. But once walking in, the side of the door was broken, the walls were painted on, and the shampoo bottles were not filled entirely. Overall, the place did not seem the cleanest and for the price it was not entirely worth it. There is loud noise at night and early in the morning, but I believe that is an Edinburgh issue, not this airbnb. I would say for the money, this was not worth it for me, though it was safe and overall decent.

Todella kaunis loft-asunto, jossa upeat isot ikkunat ja paljon luonnonvaloa. Asunto oli tyylikkäästi ja kodikkaasti sisustettu ja toimi täydellisesti nelihenkiselle seurueellemme. Asunto oli myös erinomaisessa kunnossa, se näytti vastikään remontoidulta.
Erityiset kiitokset Ionalle herkkukorista, jossa mm juustoja, hilloja, hedelmiä, tuoremehua ja kaikkea, mitä aamupalalla voisi kaivata kuten jogurttia, mysliä ja kananmunia. Tuli heti todella tervetullut olo ja oleskelu Edinburghissa alkoi mukavissa tunnelmissa. Iona oli muutenkin erinomaisen avulias, hän vastasi kaikkiin kysymyksiimme aina ystävällisesti.

Voimme suositella lämpimästi, tämä on paras Airbnb-kokemuksemme tähän mennessä.
Allan was a great host. house was perfect for a family stay. Allan made cot and booster seat available for us.

Host was wonderful! Location was absolutely perfect! Few misc things could have been helpful such as guide book for home and an adapter charger but host was extremely communicative and explained everything we needed when we contact her.
A fantastic location!

La estancia en este alojamiento ha sido excelente. apartamento muy limpio y todos los servicios funcionaban correctamente. muy cerca de la estación haymarket y muy buena comunicación con el centro. lo recomendamos 100%
Beautiful studio located in an excellent and exclusive area of Edinburgh!

We would have given it 5 stars for ‘worth what you paid ‘but for the bed room which was a wee bit cramped but it was verging on 5 stars. We could not have had a nicer host even down to the gift I received on day one, which was a lovely surprise.  He could not have been more helpful throughout and we were staying for quite a while.  His flat was lovely overall.
Very comfortable flat in a quiet yet central location.

Lovely apartment with everything you could possibly need—fully equipped and thoughtfully stocked. Great location with nearby shops and easy access to Edinburgh.
Would definitely recommend!
Location was ideal, only a 20 minute walk from the city centre and 10 min bus ride. A bit small for three people but definitely met our needs. Thanks for the lovely stay :)

A cozy place to stay, especially the loft! It’s a quiet and safe neighborhood, walkable to Edinburgh old town. Steve is a really nice guy to talk with, and he is always responsive and helpful.
Unfortunately during our stay the flush of toilet wasn’t working quite good, we had to flush 3-4 times each time..
Stunning location and beautifully kept accommodation.
We loved our stay here!  The location is absolutely perfect so exploring the city.  The apartment is clean and comfortable and had everything we needed for our stay!

Wir haben zu zweit ein paar schöne Tage in Edinburgh verbracht und uns in unserer Unterkunft sehr wohl gefühlt. Das Zimmer war gemütlich und ruhig gelegen, mit Fenster zum Garten.
Die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich, daher haben wir uns auch im Haus sehr willkommen gefühlt :)
Wir kommen gerne wieder!
A super clean flat in a secure location close to the Meadows. Nice coffee shops and artisan bakers just close by.

Edinburgh is a very busy area. It felt Amazing to return to a relaxing flat to prepare for the next day adventures!! Enjoyed our stay and the location was Great! Loved seeing the surrounding “outside” the city Life!  Short walking distance to the local store and bus pick-up.
great place to stay
Elisa was lovely and very easy to communicate with. The apartment had everything you need for a few days away. Thank you!
Fantastic location, clean place, great hosts. Probably the best city break we’ve had in a long time. Highly recommended!

House in the heart of city.
Lovely, classy.
Enchanting ornaments from travels all over the place make this house unique.

Welcomed with kindness and friendliness.
Made me feel like at home.

The apartment is really nice and located perfectly… Clean and homely…
A couple of issues were the mattress to the sofa bed is uncomfortable and really needs a good topper or replacement… The noise from the street can get annoying and is very loud late at night… I think a secondary glazing internally would help this as it was the only real downside of the weekend…. There are a lot of buses and lorries passing early morning also…
Maybe an informative folder regarding how the heating works, how to turn on the towel rails and a few local recommendations to eat, taxis etc where Julie could arrange discounts with local businesses…
Overall a great weekend where the weather was fantastic for late October….😁

Alison was a wonderful host to my Mum, making her cups of tea and even going to find her when she was lost.
We would definitely use Alison again as we had a great experience this time.

If you are visiting Edinburgh you’ll hardly find a better location. Right in the middle of the royal mile, easily walkable to all of the main attractions, great restaurants, etc.
Harvey was a fantastic host, friendly and very responsive. I had an important work call and was having internet issues, and he helped me resolve them quickly and effectively. While some of the furniture is a little run down, the beds were very comfy and we had a lovely stay!
The one thing I would say is you have to go up a fairly steep staircase to get to the flat, which we had no problem with but something to keep in mind if you have mobility issues.
All in all it was a fantastic place, and I highly recommend it!

Calim’s apartment is a gem! It’s spacious, extremely well-appointed, and in a great location. We loved the artwork, books, furniture, etc. It conveyed sophistication and class. Calim also left us snacks and a loaf of delicious bread, which we greatly enjoyed.
Be aware that this is a 5-story walk-up, which is a bit of a workout with luggage! Even so we would definitely stay here again if we get the chance.

We stayed at Vicky's place the night before a relatively early flight from the airport. The place itself is amazing and *much* bigger than we expected (and very quiet), and Vicky was a gracious and welcoming host, accommodating our evening arrival.
For people looking for a place to stay that allows a quick drive to the airport -- this is your spot. You can get there taking traffic-free back roads in under 10 minutes.

Irene is a terrific hostess with taste. She gave detailed directions that helped me to find her place very easily from the railway station. The house is lovely, with a beautiful yard. The bed is comfortable and the room is delicately decorated. The location of the house is also good, only 10 minutes walk from Edinburgh Castle. Highly recommendable to others.
非常有品味的房东，非常值得推荐的地方。房屋整洁舒适，院子美丽大方，距离爱丁堡城堡走路只要10分钟。庆幸自己的选择。

Excellent location for exploring Edinburgh. Lovely quiet street with great local coffee shops.
The property had everything we needed, including a little perfume selection, and the decor was stylish yet comfortable.
Would certainly recommend or book again.
Located close to tram station

Really lovely flat. Very clean and tidy and filled with the essentials (sugar, butter, tea, coffee). In house guide was very helpful and notes on which bus to use to get where and lots of maps. Restaurant around the corner is lovely and the zoo is worth a visit. Easy to walk to the zoo and also into the town. Doesn't  feel as long as it says. Would love to come back again. Very attentive host x
Nice flat ,👍

A perfect location and flat for two couples to visit Edinburgh
Hannah’s instructions were ideal
Had a fantastic stay at the apartment. Place was beautiful and spacious. Location was perfect too for exploring. Great heating system. Would stay again without hesitation.

Good stay at the Castle Den. We were comfortable & warm and had everything we needed for our 2 night stay. The unit was clean and tidy on arrival and accurate as presented on Airbnb. Checkin was complicated but good instructions were provided and we managed ok. The unit is on the 2nd floor, no lift, so many stairs up. The area is very busy but the location was great. Communication with Hosts’ representatives was very good and all enquiries acknowledged. We did have a couple of issues with the hot water to the bathroom & Kitchen sinks (shower had hot water) and a heater that wouldn’t switch off which weren’t solved during the short time we were staying and it was a weekend so difficult to fix. Wifi was good. Overall we had a comfortable stay at Castle Den.
Great stay in a perfectly located apartment, Susie was great help throughout!

A lovely flat with great views of Arthur’s Seat.  The flat was clean and well furnished.  The only problem we had was too few towels but this was quickly rectified by Steve after I texted him about it.  Great location by Holyrood Park.  Only a few minutes walk and you’re at the bottom of the Royal Mile.  Excellent communication with Steve who replied promptly to texts.  He kindly allowed us to leave our bags in the flat on our last day and return about 1.30pm to collect them before heading home.

Beautiful home, lovely room and bathroom, very kind and helpful hosts, incredible English breakfast and nice location close to the center and easy to reach by bus. Simply excellent, Thank you very much Pete and Fiona for your warm welcoming !
Great place!

Heather was a lovely host!
Home was very spacious and well appointed!
View is stunning from the entire flat!!
Would highly recommend!

We stayed two nights with 4 adults in the flat. The flat is in a cool area of Edi and near to cafes and bars and very tidy
As well. Steve was very kind to give us a bit of extra time before checkout because our flight was cancelled. Thanks again for this!
I would definitely go there again when I would be just with my husband and want to be there for a long weekend to explore EDI. But for our needs ( 4 grownups with luggage for a 15 days holiday in Scotland) it was not perfect. The two sofa beds are not super comfy for grown ups, maybe we are heavier than youngsters or kids🙄. Also the lots of stairs without an elevator are okay for a weekend luggage but not for the luggage of a two weeks journey through Scotland. We always love to enjoy brekkie back home, so keep in mind that there is no proper dining table and chairs for 4 people.
But for a couple or 4 young people who don’t want to cook or eat back home, I can definitively recommend this flat.
Check in and communication was very easy and good with Steve.
Had a really great stay. Met at the property by the co host who was extremely helpful and friendly.
Clean, comfortable, and in a central location with lots of restaurants nearby. Would recommend!

Sharan is an amazing host, great communication and he gave us many suggestions on what to visit and things to do in the city. The apartment was beautiful with amazing view, very clean and comfortable. Very well connected with many bus options and just 20 min walk from the Royal mile. I highly recommend your stay there!
Our stay was excellent and I would definitely recommend it to anyone needing to stay in Edinburgh.
Great loft! Highly recommend!
Alison was a great host and her place could not have been in a better location.  Would stay here again in a heartbeat.
The place is very nice and clean. Right by grass market so saves walking time. Most tours and experiences are within a 10min walk.
Stayed with my missus and our mates, both of us with young babies, nice flat lovely view out the window. We had our own travel cots so bear that in mind if you want babies.
Net i pulit, molt comode. Molt ben situat
Wonderful location!  Paths and botanic garden nearby, as well as great restaurants.  Helen was a very good host.

Accueil de Daniela au top. Indications précises et la chambre est conforme à la description.
L'appartement de Daniela est idéalement situé pour visiter Édimbourg. Je recommande !

Future travellers can only expect the best at Yvonne’s place.The location is in a trendy place not very far from City Centre by public transportation which is very well organized.Close by a few convenient stores where you can buy things you need for breakfast,lunch or dinner,not very expensive.Also close by a few restaurants also not very expensive.So enjoy your stay at Yvonne’s place .
Clean, cute stay in incredible location close to everything! We loved coming out the door and seeing the castle above us every day.

Je recommande le logement d’Alice. Il est situé dans le quartier de Leith, à environ 20 min à pied de la gare ( mais un tram est en construction).C’est un quartier animé ( bars, restos, supérette) et agréable. N’hésitez pas à poursuivre jusqu’au bout de Leith vers le port pour profitez du calme et de bons petits restaurants!
Le logement est agréable et lumineux et bien équipé . Les fenêtres sont en simple vitrage ce qui peut être gênant si vous aimez vous lever tard ( nous avons été réveillés vers 7:00 en général) mais les nuits étaient plutôt calmes.
Alice est très réactive aux demandes.

Assean was really helpful and responded quickly to my queries. Room was in a very central location, near railway station and walk into the city with some nice cafes near it. It is probably more suited to a younger person as you had to climb on the bed to close blinds as no space next to bed. Can be noisy at night due to trams outside and close guests in other rooms near your room. Overall great value for money.
Logement très sympathique et à proximité de plusieurs restaurants et attractions! Joss et son équipe nous ont très bien reçus et accommodés! Merci pour tout!

This was perfect try located for me because there are buses into town very frequently and it is in a quiet location with large rooms and a really nice kitchen to cook in. My kids lived their rooms.
Clare is a great host and ensures you have whatever you need but at the same time completely respects your privacy. We just needed to communicate via the message system at the beginning and she was very quick to answer.
I'd definitely stay here again.

Kieron's mum met us at the apartment who was so welcoming. The apartment itself is a great, clean space with everything you need in a lovely, quiet location which is an easy walk into the centre. Kieron was extremely attentive and a great host. Highly recommend for a weekend away in beautiful Edinburgh!

Ideal spot for couples needing somewhere convenient for Edinburgh
Ann is really responsive and helpful
The area is gated
15-20 minute walk from the train station
All very easy

We enjoyed staying at Fiona & Stevie's place so much. We got greeted by Stevie, giving us the best of the best recommendations which we followed. It's a lovely area to stay in, great coffee shops and hikes just nearby. The room + bathroom were both super clean, stylish and worked perfectly for us. 🤗 I would definitely recommend staying at Fiona & Stevie's :)

Dorothy was a wonderful host, and very prompt to respond to any questions we had. She consistently checked in to make sure things were okay. We were there for over two weeks with a show at fringe, and we loved coming home to the quiet street and comfort of the quaint little house, nestled in the midst of it all. Would definitely stay there again.

The flat was in a fair location which matched up with the price compared to more central properties.
However the building was not particularly pleasant and there was quite a bit of mould on the bedroom walls.
Fine for what we wanted: somewhere to come back and sleep. Wouldn’t want to spend long periods in the flat.

A wonderful gem in the middle of Edinburgh.
Lovely and homely flat with everything you need and more.
Dawn and Natalie, our hosts, really went to great lengths to make us feel welcome with everything from a great guide for the city to little extras in the flat.
The location is fantastic, couldn’t get much better. Walking distance to almost everything, right in the middle of the city but still quiet and peaceful.
For us there is no need to look anywhere else and we can’t wait to come back next year!!
Mark and Ellinor.

Location is good. Near Bus or Tram stops. Near Waverley. Nice host.
Room given is too small. Bathroom is a bit away from room. Cant say 'value for money' as in this same rate there are better rooms or places in the area. As a result rate should be lesser.

Wonderful apartment right next to the castle, perfect for exploring, relaxing and eating out.
We had some less mobile members in our party and the location meant they got to enjoy Edinburgh without having to use public transport.

We had a great stay with Kate. The room was so cosy and comfortable and the private bathroom was really nice, both immaculate. The location is very quiet and a picturesque street but still within walking distance of town and the river, though we did need to get a few buses when tired. Kate was really responsive and friendly, gave us nice local recommendations and helpfully let us leave our luggage in the hallway past checkout.

The location is perfect, and all of the main attractions are within walking distance.
the apartment is very classy, and the kitchen is fully equipped. fresh bread, milk, eggs were thoughtful, and the homemade shortbread was delicious.
David a été très accueillant et sympathique. Il a été disponible à tout moment pour s'occuper de ce dont j'avais besoin. Si je dois revenir sur Edinburgh je chercherai à revenir chez lui.
This apartment was fantastic, we stayed here with 2 adults & 3 children and it was perfect for us all. Perfect city location for getting around Edinburgh. Would highly recommend this property.

A great place for a great stay. Comfy, clean, quiet and well equipped. Lovely  comfy bed, a kitchen with everything you need and a a good shower room, nothing more needed. Dawn and Leon were friendly and so welcoming and happy to help with anything, thank you both. We will definitely be saving this one in our favourites.

We had a great stay at Andre and Jim’s home. Excellent location and easy to get to the tourist spots. The room is quite nice and has everything you need and more. The neighborhood had many lovely restaurants and coffee shops in close proximity. We would highly recommend staying here!

Vi fikk lov å skjekke inn tidlig. Leiligheten var skittent da vi kom. Meldte til verten og ordnet rask med å finne ut hva som skjedde med rengjørings firma. VI fikk en liten gave fra Greig for beklagelse av hendelsen som vi synes var en fin måte å vise at han tar sine gjester serious. Kunne kanskje rengjøre inne panel ovn. Det var støvete. Elles var stedet godt plassert.
Perfekt beliggenhet, alt var innenfor gangavstand.

We had a nice time in Edinburgh in this flat. Barry and Denise were very helpful and reactive, and the information they gave us were very thorough and complete. The flexible arrival was a real plus, as our flight was a bit delayed. The apartment was clean, very pleasant and welcoming, big functional kitchen (that allowed us to cook French toasts for breakfast and dinner in the oven). We had a lovely time eating out as well, I recommend the Brunswick Bookclub for breakfast or dinner, and Joseph Pearce for a drink, both less than 5mn away. The incredible Topping & Company Bookstore is also right around the corner, and the city center was just a 15mn walk away. There are also a lot of buses available, and the tram. I had a little problem with the sofa bed as well as other little comments, but Denise has already taken them into account and is finding a solution. Thanks again for a nice stay in Edinburgh !
This was the perfect place to stay for our first visit to Edinburgh! In the middle of Old Town without being overwhelming and loud. Perfect size flat and very clean and cozy.

Appartement parfait pour 2 couples,propreté impeccable,tous les équipements nécessaires disponibles.Connection WIFI internet au top,même une tablette avec toutes les infos pour les restaurants,visites,etc.Emplacement idéal,en plein centre ville et en même temps isolé du bruit grâce à cette courre intérieure très sympa.Vraiment tout était super,grosse envie de revenir chez Tony et de revoir cette superbe ville.

I spent 3 nights here and it was very comfortable. The underfloor heating took a little fiddling (4 separate digital wall thermostat displays) but nice and cozy once I worked it out! Loads of restaurants, shops and takeaways within a few minutes walk. About 15 mins walk to Princes Street and same to Grassmarket area. Very quiet at night but there’s an art centre next door which can be noisy during the day with people constantly coming and going. Didn’t bother me as I was out every day. A very quirky little place which I really enjoyed! Thanks for having me.

A great place to stay in Edinburgh, convenient to Prince’s Street shops and restaurants, a quiet residential street, huge room, really comfortable place to stay and made to feel very welcome by Fiona. Tea, coffee and biscuits very welcome. I stayed for 2 nights.

Reggie and her husband have created a little oasis of calm in a busy city.  The room is exactly as shown in the photos, very spacious and comfortable, beautifully furnished and quiet at night.  Their flat is in a great location - central to everywhere in the city you might wish to visit.  They were both lovely welcoming hosts and we are only sorry that we weren't around to chat to them for longer.  Reggie was also very quick to reply to my question about parking at the time of booking - she's the perfect Airbnb host with special little touches such as providing fresh fruit alongside the usual tea/coffee making facilities, and nice toiletries to use in the bathroom.    We would thoroughly recommend staying here and we will be back I'm sure (our daughter is at uni in Edinburgh, though away next year, returning in the Autumn 2017).
Great, convenient location with lots of top tips on local tourist attractions. Directions on accessing the property couldn’t have been better, and getting in and out was a dream. Thanks again :)

This place was truly wonderful, with a beautiful view from the window. Jim was incredibly responsible and helpful, especially since I was traveling with my infant. He took great care of everything, particularly ensuring the heater was working well as the temperature in Edinburgh was quite low at the time. He even offered me a refreshing drink made with mango juice. The location is perfect—within walking distance of all major tourist spots in the city. One of the best parts was the availability of nearby halal restaurants. As a family, we absolutely loved staying here.
Beautiful place. Really enjoyed our stay.
房子位置非常好，去哪都很方便，我们一行10个人在这住了非常开心的两天。房主回复有点慢，但是没有影响我们入住，希望还有机会可以回到这里来～

I enjoyed my stay at Liam's. The room was as described and the location was convenient - only a short walk into the centre and also some nice places to eat close by. I didn't meet Liam but he messaged to explain how to access the flat and rang to check I had found it okay, which was nice. I stayed during the film festival so having the Cine World on my doorstep was a bonus, and the nearby canal is also very pretty. Having tea making facilities (kettle, tea bags etc!) in the room was great. I would recommend it. (As I think has been mentioned the water pressure on the shower is pretty weak - it's not something that bothers me but something to be aware of if you like a power shower.)
Great location, great house. Would definitely go stay again.
Really good apartment in a cool location.
Great host! The place was very neat and tidy, and the host was really nice.
Craig’s place was great and spacious and he was always happy to help and sent clear instructions.
I had a really great time in Edi, thanks so much!!
很不错的体验
Loved the apartment, especially the piano and vinyls…it wasn’t too far from the Edinburgh castle and there is a really good Japanese restaurant down the road…would recommend this place!!

Location is fantastic - a short walk to Waverley station and 30 seconds from being out of the door you’re on the royal mile, with a 15-20 min walk to arthur’s seat too.
The room was nice and clean, only problem we had was with the shower. Burning hot or freezing cold and seemingly nowhere in between for more than 2 mins at a time. Otherwise, the room was as described and was very ideal to use as a base in Edinburgh.

Francois’ place is the nicest Airbnb we’ve stayed at in Edinburgh, the pictures don’t do it justice. It is really big for a 2 bedroom, and the added garden space is great. The location is superb, right at the bottom of Princes Street, fantastic for seeing the sights, shopping, and places to eat. Parking is probably the most stressful part, as it’s right in the heart of the city centre, the council only allow you to park for a maximum of 4 hours during the day, but it is free at night. It is worth noting that there is parking at the Waldorf Astoria car park next to the apartment, and on the RingGo app it is £40 for 24 hours. We will definitely stay at Francois’ place again.

The location was spot-on, the flat was clean, and check-in was easy. There was no shampoo or soap present which was a miss. Otherwise, everything was perfect we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and had an amazing experience.

I had a wonderful stay at Louise’s place in Edinburgh. The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, making it a perfect base for exploring the city. Louise was a fantastic host—friendly, responsive, and made everything very easy from check-in to check-out.
The location was great, with good connections to the city centre and plenty to see and do nearby. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Edinburgh.

Magnifique décoration, situé dans la vieille ville, à deux pas du château.
Les horaires d'arrivée sont très flexibles, pratique quand on arrive tard.
Je recommande cet appartement à tous les amoureux d'Harry Potter !
Great communication with Ann from booking to arriving. Wonderful reception and amazing host.  Thank you for a hearty breakfast which set us up for our days cycling.
Lovely apartment away from the chaos of Easter road ! Great amenities and very beautifully done!
Lovely short break, well equipped comfortable accommodation & fantastic views

This is the first time I have ever used Airbnb and I will definitely be using it again. The flat is in the perfect location, only a 10 minute walk into Edinburgh town centre on all routes. There are also a variety of shops/bars/restaurants etc. in the surrounding area. Would definitely recommend staying in this Airbnb.
We had a great stay! It’s a perfect location for those wanting to walk around the city. Alex gave us early check in after our overnight flight from the US which was very much appreciated!

We had a truly relaxing stay in a cosy and warm room, wonderful bed, nice shower with plenty of hot water/water pressure, usual facilities, all very comfortable and clean.  Location was great, near Botanic Gardens, about 20 minutes easy walk from city centre (George Street) but also on a bus route with frequent services into town.  The house is on a main road  (and so very easy to find), but the room overlooks the back gardens and is very quiet.  Fiona is a responsive and helpful host, we highly recommend this place for a stay in beautiful Edinburgh.
Repeat guest, I always enjoy staying in this room. It is small but beautifully presented and comfortable.

We totally enjoyed the stay at Marks place. Nice room, personal experience to get to know people behind the city.
Mark is a very uncomplicated host. Could totally recommend in a stay.
great location, relaxing interior design. everything looks exactly like the pictures.
Lappartement est située a 10 min a pied de la vieille ville ,il est situé dans une rue très calme , et brian est très reactif et sympathique ! Merci
No problems at all with Liens place and would book again if in the area.

Our stay was absolutely fantastic, Marina & Dylan were both very welcoming and helpful with organising a late check in for us. I cannot stress enough how excellent the location is from old town either, rather than being on the stairs side of it it's an easy 10 minute stroll to grassmarket and old town - past some excellent coffee shops too.
thank you Marina & Dylan 🌼

This apartment is beautiful - its comfortable and stylish. Everything was spotlessly clean. We often go to Edinburgh and this location is a great starting point wherever you decide to go while you're there.
Derek and Liz were great hosts, responding to any enquiries really quickly before we arrived. The check in and check out process is really easy and we had no issues during our stay.
Thoroughly enjoyed out short break and would definitely book again.
The room is huge and exactly as shown in the pictures. Joe is an amazing guy, really helpful and friendly and we would be glad to stay there again!
Everything was good

Great apartment - not far from the centre of Edinburgh which you can walk to in about 20/25 mins - also around the property were plenty of restaurants and coffee shops
The apartment was clean and just as described
Wouldn’t hesitate to stay again
Great location, lovely apartment. A wonderful stay in a beautiful city! Nicola was great and responds very quickly, really very helpful! Nothing to fault, would return asap!

David was extremely helpful and pleasant in our communications. As we were traveling and without wifi access for several days, we did not communicate our exact arrival time. As a result we arrived when David was completing the cleaning. He was most gracious and it also afforded us the opportunity to meet him. He was so kind to leave the necessities for a quick breakfast before our bust day in the city. The flat is in an idyllic setting, very clean and comfortable.
Le logement était bien situé mais manquait de modernité. La cuisine était vétuste. Et pas de chauffage dans la salle de bain.

Appartement propre et au calme, à proximité du centre d’Édimbourg (15 min à pied).
Les 2 chambres donnent sur cour donc pas de bruit (1 lit double et 1 lit simple).
Le parc The Meadows en bas de la rue est simplement incroyable.
Je recommande donc sans hésiter
The best place to stay in Edinburgh! Great host. Wonderful scented candles
Well positioned apartment with easy foot access to the city center. Make sure to eat at the Greek restaurant, Taxidi, nearby as well as the coffee shop, Machina Espresso around the corner.

I had an amazing stay at Angana’s place in Dublin! From the moment I arrived, Angana was a fantastic host, welcoming and attentive. The accommodation was spotless and beautifully decorated, making it a comfortable and cozy retreat after exploring the city. The location was perfect.
Angana went above and beyond to ensure I had everything I needed for a great stay, providing thoughtful touches. Her warmth and hospitality truly made my experience unforgettable. I strongly recommend staying at Angana’s Airbnb if you’re visiting Dublin. You won’t be disappointed!
the host is very nice, great thanks!

Absolutely amazing! We have stayed at many Airbnbs and this place was just perfect. Close to activities and good restaurants. I loved the decor and attention to details! We would definitely stay here again!

Very nice room, comfortable and clean, conveniently situated in a quiet neighbourhood with ample on-street parking (free). Hosts Chris and Natalia were lovely - very welcoming, friendly and helpful, and all online communications got an almost immediate response.
The accommodation is however just one room with en-suite facilities. The main photo shows the kitchen and dining area, which is shared with other guests. This wasn't a problem, although we felt that overall value wasn't as good as some other places we've stayed at in Edinburgh.

We really enjoyed our stay at the Airbnb, it was very well kept and clean.
Sean was a great host giving us all the information we needed for the local area.
The small things made a big difference to our stay such as leaving us milk, irn bru, cereal and tea and coffee.
I would highly recommend staying at this Airbnb and it was only a 20 min drive to the centre of Edinburgh.

Sally, n'a pu nous accueillir à notre arriver car nous sommes arrivés tard de l'aéroport! Mais son organisation fut extraordinaire pour que l'on arrive chez elle sans aucun problème et dans les meilleurs conditions.(Parcours, clefs...) nous avons pu la voir plus tard dans la soirée, après une petite virée nocturne dans Edimbourg, de notre arrivé. Mais c'est surtout le lendemain matin, que nous avons parler avec elle. Sa gentillesse, sa joie et bien d'autres qualités font Sally. Merci pour ces deux jours forts sympathique des visites et de rencontres.
Nette Unterkunft in guter Lage, gute Kommunikation und viele Möglichkeiten, etwas zu unternehmen.

Brilliant little flat, perfect for singles or couples. Very private and easy to access with great modern finishing. Appreciated the warmth of the building and the little extras in the kitchen! And what a comfy bed. Would stay again.

The flat was spotlessly clean, the location can’t be beat, and David is truly a great host. Check in and out were both super easy - David was always quick to respond whenever we had any questions. Though the flat is in the heart of the city, it was really quiet and cozy.

Really lovely apartment. Croissants, coffee and milk for breakfast.
Excellent location, with lots of pubs and restaurants nearby and a 20 minute walk to the center.
Incredibly clean.
This is what an Airbnb should be.

Lynn’s space is beautiful and clean! It’s a shame I wasn’t able to stay longer. Check-in and check-our were simple. Lynn was incredibly responsive and hospitable. There is ample parking as well. Would love to stay again!
Josh’s place is a wonderful spot to stay in Edinburgh. The two bedrooms were perfect and charming for four people and we were able to do plenty of activities within walking distance.

Stuart is amazing, and his home is even more! Located SO near to the centre, its just the perfect spot to not having to get a bus or a cab for anything.
His house is dreamy! Full of character and personality with lots of light coming through!
Its so cozy and has this warmth to it!
Bed was really comfy! And all the rest of amenities where in perfect stage and use :)
NOW, BEWARE! Hahhaha not a problem for me cos i have been living in top floors since im little. But its a 4th floor with lots of stair, so prepare to have a mini workout! In a good note, it will prepare you to walk all the hills in Edinburgh hahahha.
Final note: i loved it, communication was great, Stuart was an amazing host and i will definitely be repeating again!
Also. AMAZING BOOK COLLECTION!
We had an amazing stay! Everything was as described, clean, perfect location! would definitely return! Thank you 😊
房子很干净，很舒服，厨房设备一应俱全。位置也很好，景点都可以步行抵达，楼下餐饮购物有很多。房主也很热情好客，总之就是非常满意！
Great location. Super clean and convenient

Great stay ! Easy to find and had lot of transport options to visit city center of Edinburgh even in the night timings. House was super clean and kitchen was fully equipped.
Host was good to speak to and let us stay a bit late for the checkout.

Emma is a friendly and welcoming host- she was very patient and easy going and knows the area well so was able to answer all the questions I had. The room is comfortable and cozy, big enough and very clean. The host, Emma, made me feel at ease and was willing for conversation but also gave me privacy- the perfect balance!
Thanks Emma!
Very comfy and clean with great amenities, loved the neighborhood as well!
Very good location, easy to walk everywhere and a nearby park.
Logement parfait pour le week-end

Gracias por tu hospitalidad Zee.
Mi hijo y su amigo, tuvieron una excelente estancia en tu alojamiento.

Apart from being provided with the incorrect house number (wrong side and wrong end of the road), our stay was better than I anticipated. I was stressed and hot walking up and down the road trying to find a non existent number 100 St Leonard's St, so was pleasantly surprised when we finally found our accommodation. The location was perfect for getting to the marathon start (main objective) and for exploring Holyrood Park and climbing Arthur's Seat as well as for walking into town and all the attractions. The bed was large, super comfy, the bed linen was lovely and everywhere was clean. We didn't see much of our hosts (I think my husband had a chat about bikes), but the other guest on the ground floor was very nice. I was really worried about the shared bathroom, but it wasn't a problem. I would have liked a lock on the inside of our bedroom door.
I had a relaxing evening in Steve's apartment. It was quiet, clean, and a perfect place to rest.

Go on book this great little apartment you won't be disappointed. From the minute we arrived we loved it. Just of the grass market and 5mins to the Royal Mile and Castle its Superb!! 😊 Comfortable bed and sofa bed and everything you need for a city break. Me and a friend visited for the Edinburgh half marathon and it was absolutely perfect.

We really enjoyed our stay over New Year at Martha’s flat. The flat had everything we needed and was in a good location. Close enough to the city, but also nice and quiet. The space was well appointed and tidy. Would stay here again :)

While I'm sure the host did their best with the apartment interior, you will get better value of getting a hotel room for the same price (or less).
Photos don't show this but the apartment exterior is very unattractive and the apartment block smells of urine and marijuana at all times.
There was mould in the bathroom and bedroom and the apartment smells mouldy. (I have pictures)
I left after the first night (out of a 3 night stay) and found a hotel that was cheaper and closer to the centre. The host called me a liar when I brought up the issue with the apartment and only saw fit to give me £65 back, one night value.
I always go by reviews and this apartment had plenty of great reviews so I can only assume the people that spent their time there were high when they wrote them.
Very disappointed with the apartment, more disappointed with the hosts behaviuour.

My family and I loved our stay at Tansie’s place.  We immediately felt at home and repeated numerous times how wonderful the place was.  We loved the wood stove and the natural light.  The kitchen had everything we needed to cook numerous meals in.  The location was perfect, great neighborhood with restaurants/pubs but out of the craziness of Edinburgh’s busier areas.  We were still able to walk to The Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle, New Town, etc.  Tansie was a wonderful host who responded quickly to any questions.

Die Lage ist perfekt! Sehr zentral, man erreicht das Zentrum in ca. 10 Minuten Fußweg. In der Nähe sind auch Restaurants, Bars, ein Einkaufszentrum etc.
Das Zimmer ist sauber und Rory reinigt auch täglich Bad und Küche, allerdings teilt man sich die Wohnung noch mit anderen Reisenden, die (zumindest bei uns) das Badezimmer leider nicht immer wirklich sauber hinterlassen haben. Für einen Kurztrip eignet sich die Wohnung sehr.
Het was mooi en gewoon perfect. Het was goed uitgerust en de voorzieningen zijn goed ingericht. Dus we hebben niets gemist.
Prachtige accommodatie op loopafstand van de bezienswaardigheden in Old Town. Tessa is zeer behulpzaam en gastvrij, bovendien bakt ze iedere ochtend heerlijk, vers brood.

Clean, stylish and within walking distance of the centre. If you don’t fancy walking, there are plenty of buses nearby, as well as a Sainsbury’s on your doorstep.
An excellent stay!

I had a great stay! The apartment is beautiful, well-equipped, and in a perfect location.
Alan was an outstanding host, very responsive and always attentive to my questions and needs, which made everything smooth and easy.
I would definitely recommend this place and would happily stay again!

Dina’s place was great, just what I needed for a short break. Was really respectful of social distancing and really quick to respond to any questions! Her animals were also so lovely and welcoming- highlight of my stay 😄

We had a wonderful time staying at James' Airbnb.  Both James and Callum were very helpful and responsive and gave us great recommendations.  The flat itself was lovely with a great mix of original features plus modern furnishings.

I had a fantastic stay with Rob! We never ended up connecting in person but it was clear from his communication and the quality/cleanliness of his place that he puts a lot of care and effort into keeping his guests as happy as possible. Would highly recommend!
Great place to stay, ideal location for restaurants, Bars and hop on hop off bus to see all Edinburgh.

An incredibly large and well appointed flat in a terrific part of the city.  Away from the crushing crowds of the royal mile, more at the center of where the people of Edinburgh actually live and shop. The shop will also store your luggage for a small fee via the bounce service, which can be booked via the airbnb app.  Our hosts offered early check in for a very reasonable fee, which we opted for.   We found the flat a great place from which to explore the city and we walked anywhere from the Castle to Arthur’s seat.  Our best meal was at The Black Grape, and we made use of the flat’s amazing kitchen one night with food from the nearby Marks and Spencer food hall.  Note there is some lively nightlife outside, but we always travel with earplugs and the hosts even provided an ambient noise machine so we slept well.
